en.question: A company collects data for temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure in cities across multiple continents. The average volume of data that the company collects from each site daily is 500 GB. Each site has a high-speed Internet connection. The company wants to aggregate the data from all these global sites as quickly as possible in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The solution must minimize operational complexity. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration on the destination S3 bucket. Use multipart uploads to directly upload site data to the destination S3 bucket.
options.B: Upload the data from each site to an S3 bucket in the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket. Then remove the data from the origin S3 bucket.
options.C: Schedule AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device jobs daily to transfer data from each site to the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket.
options.D: Upload the data from each site to an Amazon EC2 instance in the closest Region. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. At regular intervals, take an EBS snapshot and copy it to the Region that contains the destination S3 bucket. Restore the EBS volume in that Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** S3 Transfer Acceleration is designed for exactly this pattern: uploads to a **centralized S3 bucket from all over the world**, regular **gigabytes-to-terabytes transfers across continents**, and cases where internet uploads to S3 do not use all available bandwidth. AWS states that an accelerated bucket is accessed through the `bucket-name.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com` endpoint after enabling Transfer Acceleration on the bucket ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)). Multipart upload also fits the 500 GB/day/site volume because S3 constructs one object from uploaded parts, and AWS gives a 100 GB multipart-upload example with many `UploadPart` calls, enabling efficient large-object uploads directly into the bucket ([S3 multipart upload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)). This is the fastest and lowest-complexity option because each site uploads directly to the single destination bucket over optimized S3 endpoints.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Uploading to regional buckets and then using S3 Cross-Region Replication adds extra buckets, replication configuration, and cleanup. CRR is for copying objects between buckets in different AWS Regions, commonly for compliance, lower read latency near users, or multi-Region processing—not for the simplest direct aggregation into one bucket ([S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).
- **C:** Snowball Edge is a physical device workflow. AWS describes Snowball Edge as importing/exporting data between local environments and S3 by **physically transporting** devices without using the internet ([Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)). Daily device jobs from every global site would be operationally complex and slower than using the sites’ existing high-speed internet connections.
- **D:** Sending data to EC2, storing it on EBS, taking snapshots, copying snapshots, and restoring volumes does not directly aggregate data into the required S3 bucket and introduces unnecessary EC2/EBS operations. The requirement is a single S3 bucket with minimal operational complexity; direct accelerated multipart upload to S3 is the appropriate service pattern.

zh.question: 一家公司在多个大洲的城市中收集温度、湿度和大气压力数据。该公司每天从每个站点收集的数据平均量为 500 GB。每个站点都有高速 Internet 连接。该公司希望尽快将所有这些全球站点的数据聚合到单个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该解决方案必须最大限度地降低运维复杂性。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在目标 S3 存储桶上开启 S3 Transfer Acceleration。使用分段上传将站点数据直接上传到目标 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 将每个站点的数据上传到最近 Region 中的 S3 存储桶。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication 将对象复制到目标 S3 存储桶。然后从源 S3 存储桶中删除数据。
options.C: 每天调度 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备作业，将数据从每个站点传输到最近的 Region。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication 将对象复制到目标 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 将每个站点的数据上传到最近 Region 中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。定期创建 EBS 快照，并将其复制到包含目标 S3 存储桶的 Region。在该 Region 中还原 EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** S3 Transfer Acceleration 正是为这种模式而设计的：从**世界各地上传到一个集中式 S3 存储桶**、定期进行**跨大洲的 GB 到 TB 级传输**，以及 Internet 上传到 S3 未能使用全部可用带宽的场景。AWS 声明，在存储桶上启用 Transfer Acceleration 后，可以通过 `bucket-name.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com` 端点访问加速存储桶（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。分段上传也适合每站点每天 500 GB 的数据量，因为 S3 会从已上传的各个分段构建一个对象，并且 AWS 给出了一个包含许多 `UploadPart` 调用的 100 GB 分段上传示例，从而能够将大型对象高效地直接上传到存储桶中（[S3 multipart upload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)）。这是最快且复杂性最低的选项，因为每个站点都通过优化的 S3 端点直接上传到单个目标存储桶。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 上传到区域性存储桶，然后使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication，会增加额外的存储桶、复制配置和清理工作。CRR 用于在不同 AWS Regions 的存储桶之间复制对象，常见用途包括合规性、降低靠近用户位置的读取延迟或多 Region 处理，而不是以最简单的方式直接聚合到一个存储桶中（[S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。
- **C:** Snowball Edge 是一种物理设备工作流。AWS 将 Snowball Edge 描述为通过**物理运输**设备、在不使用互联网的情况下，在本地环境和 S3 之间导入/导出数据（[Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。每天从每个全球站点安排设备作业会带来很高的运维复杂性，并且比使用这些站点现有的高速 Internet 连接更慢。
- **D:** 将数据发送到 EC2、存储在 EBS 上、创建快照、复制快照并还原卷，并不能将数据直接聚合到所需的 S3 存储桶中，而且引入了不必要的 EC2/EBS 操作。要求是使用单个 S3 存储桶并最大限度地降低运维复杂性；直接加速的分段上传到 S3 才是合适的服务模式。

en.question: A company needs the ability to analyze the log files of its proprietary application. The logs are stored in JSON format in an Amazon S3 bucket. Queries will be simple and will run on-demand. A solutions architect needs to perform the analysis with minimal changes to the existing architecture. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Redshift to load all the content into one place and run the SQL queries as needed.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to store the logs. Run SQL queries as needed from the Amazon CloudWatch console.
options.C: Use Amazon Athena directly with Amazon S3 to run the queries as needed.
options.D: Use AWS Glue to catalog the logs. Use a transient Apache Spark cluster on Amazon EMR to run the SQL queries as needed.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use Amazon Athena directly with Amazon S3 to run the queries as needed.**

Amazon Athena is the best fit because the logs are already in Amazon S3, the queries are simple and on-demand, and the requirement is least operational overhead. AWS states that Athena makes it easy to analyze data **directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL**, and that you can point Athena at S3 data and run ad-hoc queries. Athena SQL is also **serverless**, with no infrastructure to set up or manage, and you pay only for the queries you run ([What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). Athena documentation also includes support for querying JSON-encoded datasets and service logs with SQL statements ([Run SQL queries in Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon Redshift**: Redshift would require loading or integrating the S3 data into a data warehouse environment. AWS Redshift documentation describes loading data from S3 with steps such as creating a cluster, creating tables, and running COPY commands, which adds operational overhead for simple ad-hoc log analysis ([Tutorial: Loading data from Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/tutorial-loading-data.html)).
- **B. CloudWatch Logs**: The logs are already stored in S3. Moving them to CloudWatch Logs changes the existing architecture and adds ingestion/storage work. CloudWatch Logs Insights is for querying logs in CloudWatch log groups, not the most direct choice for existing S3 JSON logs.
- **D. AWS Glue + transient EMR Spark cluster**: This introduces multiple services and cluster lifecycle management. Amazon EMR is a managed cluster platform for big data frameworks such as Spark, but launching and using clusters is more operationally involved than serverless Athena for simple on-demand SQL queries ([What is Amazon EMR?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要能够分析其专有应用程序的日志文件。这些日志以 JSON 格式存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。查询将很简单，并且将按需运行。解决方案架构师需要在对现有架构进行最少更改的情况下执行分析。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Redshift 将所有内容加载到一个位置，并根据需要运行 SQL 查询。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 存储日志。根据需要从 Amazon CloudWatch 控制台运行 SQL 查询。
options.C: 直接将 Amazon Athena 与 Amazon S3 结合使用，根据需要运行查询。
options.D: 使用 AWS Glue 对日志进行编目。使用 Amazon EMR 上的临时 Apache Spark 集群根据需要运行 SQL 查询。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 直接将 Amazon Athena 与 Amazon S3 结合使用，根据需要运行查询。**

Amazon Athena 是最合适的选择，因为日志已经在 Amazon S3 中，查询很简单且按需运行，并且要求是最低运营开销。AWS 表示，Athena 可让你轻松使用标准 SQL **直接在 Amazon S3 中**分析数据，并且你可以将 Athena 指向 S3 数据并运行即席查询。Athena SQL 也是**无服务器**的，无需设置或管理基础设施，并且你只需为运行的查询付费（[What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。Athena 文档还包含对使用 SQL 语句查询 JSON 编码数据集和服务日志的支持（[Run SQL queries in Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon Redshift**：Redshift 需要将 S3 数据加载或集成到数据仓库环境中。AWS Redshift 文档描述了从 S3 加载数据的步骤，例如创建集群、创建表以及运行 COPY 命令，这会为简单的即席日志分析增加运营开销（[Tutorial: Loading data from Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/tutorial-loading-data.html)）。
- **B. CloudWatch Logs**：日志已经存储在 S3 中。将它们移动到 CloudWatch Logs 会改变现有架构，并增加摄取/存储工作。CloudWatch Logs Insights 用于查询 CloudWatch 日志组中的日志，对于现有的 S3 JSON 日志来说不是最直接的选择。
- **D. AWS Glue + transient EMR Spark cluster**：这会引入多个服务和集群生命周期管理。Amazon EMR 是一个用于 Spark 等大数据框架的托管集群平台，但与用于简单按需 SQL 查询的无服务器 Athena 相比，启动和使用集群涉及更多运营工作（[What is Amazon EMR?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)）。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts for different departments. The management account has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains project reports. The company wants to limit access to this S3 bucket to only users of accounts within the organization in AWS Organizations. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Add the aws PrincipalOrgID global condition key with a reference to the organization ID to the S3 bucket policy.
options.B: Create an organizational unit (OU) for each department. Add the aws:PrincipalOrgPaths global condition key to the S3 bucket policy.
options.C: Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor the CreateAccount, InviteAccountToOrganization, LeaveOrganization, and RemoveAccountFromOrganization events. Update the S3 bucket policy accordingly.
options.D: Tag each user that needs access to the S3 bucket. Add the aws:PrincipalTag global condition key to the S3 bucket policy.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Use `aws:PrincipalOrgID` in the S3 bucket policy. AWS S3 documentation specifically says that to restrict IAM-based access so that only principals from AWS accounts in your organization, including the management account, can access a bucket, you can use the `aws:PrincipalOrgID` global condition key in a resource-based bucket policy ([S3 bucket policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)). The IAM documentation further states that `aws:PrincipalOrgID` is an alternative to listing all account IDs in an organization and that when accounts are added or removed, policies using this key automatically include the correct accounts and do not require manual updating ([IAM global condition keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)). This is the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` can restrict access based on a specific Organizations root or OU path, but the requirement is access for all accounts in the organization, not per-department OU scoping. Creating OUs and maintaining OU path conditions adds unnecessary overhead.
- **C:** Monitoring Organizations events with CloudTrail and updating the bucket policy manually or through automation is higher operational overhead. AWS documentation explicitly notes that `aws:PrincipalOrgID` avoids manual policy updates when accounts are added or removed.
- **D:** `aws:PrincipalTag` controls access based on tags attached to IAM users, roles, or sessions, not membership in AWS Organizations. Tagging every user would require ongoing tag management and does not directly satisfy the organization-wide account membership requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理不同部门的多个 AWS 账户。管理账户有一个包含项目报告的 Amazon S3 存储桶。公司希望将对此 S3 存储桶的访问限制为仅限 AWS Organizations 中该组织内账户的用户。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 aws PrincipalOrgID 全局条件键添加到 S3 存储桶策略中，并引用组织 ID。
options.B: 为每个部门创建一个组织单位 (OU)。将 aws:PrincipalOrgPaths 全局条件键添加到 S3 存储桶策略中。
options.C: 使用 AWS CloudTrail 监控 CreateAccount、InviteAccountToOrganization、LeaveOrganization 和 RemoveAccountFromOrganization 事件。相应地更新 S3 存储桶策略。
options.D: 标记每个需要访问 S3 存储桶的用户。将 aws:PrincipalTag 全局条件键添加到 S3 存储桶策略中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

在 S3 存储桶策略中使用 `aws:PrincipalOrgID`。AWS S3 文档明确指出，要限制基于 IAM 的访问，使只有来自你组织中 AWS 账户（包括管理账户）的主体可以访问某个存储桶，可以在基于资源的存储桶策略中使用 `aws:PrincipalOrgID` 全局条件键（[S3 bucket policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)）。IAM 文档进一步说明，`aws:PrincipalOrgID` 是列出组织中所有账户 ID 的替代方式，并且当账户被添加或移除时，使用此键的策略会自动包含正确的账户，不需要手动更新（[IAM global condition keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)）。这是运营开销最少的方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` 可以基于特定 Organizations 根或 OU 路径限制访问，但要求是允许组织中所有账户访问，而不是按部门 OU 范围限定。创建 OU 并维护 OU 路径条件会增加不必要的开销。
- **C:** 使用 CloudTrail 监控 Organizations 事件并手动或通过自动化更新存储桶策略，会产生更高的运营开销。AWS 文档明确指出，`aws:PrincipalOrgID` 可避免在账户添加或移除时手动更新策略。
- **D:** `aws:PrincipalTag` 基于附加到 IAM 用户、角色或会话的标签控制访问，而不是基于 AWS Organizations 中的成员身份。标记每个用户需要持续的标签管理，并且不能直接满足组织范围账户成员资格的要求。

en.question: An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC. The application processes logs that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The EC2 instance needs to access the S3 bucket without connectivity to the internet. Which solution will provide private network connectivity to Amazon S3?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Stream the logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the logs to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an instance profile on Amazon EC2 to allow S3 access.
options.D: Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a private link to access the S3 endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Create a gateway VPC endpoint to the S3 bucket.**

A gateway VPC endpoint is designed for this exact requirement: AWS documentation states that gateway VPC endpoints provide connectivity to **Amazon S3** without requiring an **internet gateway or NAT device** for the VPC, and that traffic from the VPC to Amazon S3 is routed to the gateway endpoint ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)). The S3 documentation also states that a gateway endpoint is specified in a route table to access Amazon S3 from a VPC over the AWS network ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Stream the logs to CloudWatch Logs and export to S3** changes the log-processing workflow and does not provide the EC2 instance with private network connectivity to the existing S3 bucket.
- **C. Create an instance profile on Amazon EC2 to allow S3 access** can provide IAM permissions. AWS notes that an instance profile passes IAM role information to the instance and policies can grant S3 access, but this is authorization, not network connectivity ([Attach an IAM role to an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/attach-iam-role.html)).
- **D. Create an API Gateway API with a private link** is not the standard VPC-to-S3 private connectivity solution. For S3 access from within a VPC, AWS documents gateway endpoints and interface endpoints; the question specifically asks for private network connectivity to S3 without internet, which a gateway endpoint provides directly ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).

zh.question: 一个应用程序在 VPC 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。该应用程序处理存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的日志。EC2 实例需要在没有互联网连接的情况下访问该 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案将为 Amazon S3 提供私有网络连接？

options.A: 为该 S3 存储桶创建一个网关 VPC 端点。
options.B: 将日志流式传输到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。将日志导出到 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 上创建一个实例配置文件以允许 S3 访问。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway API，并使用 private link 访问 S3 端点。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 为该 S3 存储桶创建一个网关 VPC 端点。**

网关 VPC 端点正是为这一需求而设计的：AWS 文档说明，网关 VPC 端点可为 **Amazon S3** 提供连接，而无需为 VPC 使用 **internet gateway or NAT device**，并且从 VPC 到 Amazon S3 的流量会路由到网关端点（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。S3 文档还说明，网关端点是在路由表中指定的，用于通过 AWS 网络从 VPC 访问 Amazon S3（[Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B. Stream the logs to CloudWatch Logs and export to S3** 会改变日志处理工作流，并且不会为 EC2 实例提供到现有 S3 存储桶的私有网络连接。
- **C. Create an instance profile on Amazon EC2 to allow S3 access** 可以提供 IAM 权限。AWS 指出，实例配置文件会将 IAM 角色信息传递给实例，策略可以授予 S3 访问权限，但这是授权，而不是网络连接（[Attach an IAM role to an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/attach-iam-role.html)）。
- **D. Create an API Gateway API with a private link** 不是标准的 VPC 到 S3 私有连接解决方案。对于从 VPC 内访问 S3，AWS 记录了网关端点和接口端点；该题明确要求在没有互联网的情况下到 S3 的私有网络连接，而网关端点可以直接提供这一点（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。

en.question: A company is hosting a web application on AWS using a single Amazon EC2 instance that stores user- uploaded documents in an Amazon EBS volume. For better scalability and availability, the company duplicated the architecture and created a second EC2 instance and EBS volume in another Availability Zone, placing both behind an Application Load Balancer. After completing this change, users reported that, each time they refreshed the website, they could see one subset of their documents or the other, but never all of the documents at the same time. What should a solutions architect propose to ensure users see all of their documents at once?

options.A: Copy the data so both EBS volumes contain all the documents
options.B: Configure the Application Load Balancer to direct a user to the server with the documents
options.C: Copy the data from both EBS volumes to Amazon EFS. Modify the application to save new documents to Amazon EFS
options.D: Configure the Application Load Balancer to send the request to both servers. Return each document from the correct server

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The problem occurs because each EC2 instance is using its own EBS volume, so requests routed to different instances see different local document sets. Amazon EBS volumes can be attached only to instances in the **same Availability Zone** as the volume, so separate EBS volumes in different AZs do not provide a single shared file store for both servers ([EBS attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-attaching-volume.html)). Amazon EFS is the appropriate shared file system: EFS can be mounted on EC2 instances using the EFS mount helper or NFS ([EFS mounting documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)), and Regional EFS file systems store data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones for continuous availability ([EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). Migrating existing documents from both EBS volumes to EFS and saving new uploads to EFS gives both application instances the same shared document view.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Copying data to both EBS volumes is a synchronization/replication workaround, not a durable shared-write design. New uploads could still land on only one volume unless the application implements ongoing consistency logic.
- **B:** An Application Load Balancer selects a healthy target from the target group; the default routing algorithm is round robin ([ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). Routing users to a particular server would not ensure all documents are visible, and it reduces availability/scalability by tying state to an instance.
- **D:** An ALB sends a request to a selected target, not to both servers and then merges application data. The documented ALB behavior is to select a target from the target group for the rule action, not aggregate responses from multiple targets ([ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上使用单个 Amazon EC2 实例托管一个 Web 应用程序，该实例将用户上传的文档存储在 Amazon EBS 卷中。为了获得更好的可扩展性和可用性，该公司复制了该架构，在另一个 Availability Zone 中创建了第二个 EC2 实例和 EBS 卷，并将两者置于 Application Load Balancer 后面。完成此更改后，用户报告说，每次刷新网站时，他们只能看到自己文档的一个子集或另一个子集，但从来无法同时看到所有文档。解决方案架构师应提出什么方案，以确保用户一次看到所有文档？

options.A: 复制数据，使两个 EBS 卷都包含所有文档
options.B: 配置 Application Load Balancer，将用户定向到包含其文档的服务器
options.C: 将两个 EBS 卷中的数据复制到 Amazon EFS。修改应用程序以将新文档保存到 Amazon EFS
options.D: 配置 Application Load Balancer，将请求发送到两台服务器。从正确的服务器返回每个文档

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 问题发生的原因是每个 EC2 实例都在使用自己的 EBS 卷，因此路由到不同实例的请求会看到不同的本地文档集合。Amazon EBS 卷只能附加到与该卷位于**同一 Availability Zone** 的实例，因此不同 AZ 中的独立 EBS 卷无法为两台服务器提供单一共享文件存储（[EBS attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-attaching-volume.html)）。Amazon EFS 是合适的共享文件系统：EFS 可以使用 EFS mount helper 或 NFS 挂载到 EC2 实例上（[EFS mounting documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)），并且 Regional EFS 文件系统会在多个 Availability Zones 中冗余存储数据，以实现持续可用性（[EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。将两个 EBS 卷中的现有文档迁移到 EFS，并将新上传内容保存到 EFS，可以让两个应用程序实例看到相同的共享文档视图。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** 将数据复制到两个 EBS 卷是一种同步/复制变通方案，而不是持久的共享写入设计。除非应用程序实现持续一致性逻辑，否则新的上传内容仍可能只落在一个卷上。
- **B:** Application Load Balancer 会从目标组中选择一个健康目标；默认路由算法是 round robin（[ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。将用户路由到特定服务器并不能确保所有文档都可见，并且会通过将状态绑定到实例而降低可用性/可扩展性。
- **D:** ALB 会将请求发送到选定目标，而不是发送到两台服务器然后合并应用程序数据。记录的 ALB 行为是为规则操作从目标组中选择一个目标，而不是聚合来自多个目标的响应（[ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。

en.question: A company uses NFS to store large video files in on-premises network attached storage. Each video file ranges in size from 1 MB to 500 GB. The total storage is 70 TB and is no longer growing. The company decides to migrate the video files to Amazon S3. The company must migrate the video files as soon as possible while using the least possible network bandwidth. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket. Create an IAM role that has permissions to write to the S3 bucket. Use the AWS CLI to copy all files locally to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create an AWS Snowball Edge job. Receive a Snowball Edge device on premises. Use the Snowball Edge client to transfer data to the device. Return the device so that AWS can import the data into Amazon S3.
options.C: Deploy an S3 File Gateway on premises. Create a public service endpoint to connect to the S3 File Gateway. Create an S3 bucket. Create a new NFS file share on the S3 File Gateway. Point the new file share to the S3 bucket. Transfer the data from the existing NFS file share to the S3 File Gateway.
options.D: Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and AWS. Deploy an S3 File Gateway on premises. Create a public virtual interface (VIF) to connect to the S3 File Gateway. Create an S3 bucket. Create a new NFS file share on the S3 File Gateway. Point the new file share to the S3 bucket. Transfer the data from the existing NFS file share to the S3 File Gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Snowball Edge import jobs are designed for moving on-premises data into Amazon S3 by copying data to a physical Snowball Edge device using the built-in Amazon S3 adapter or an **NFS mount point**; after the device is returned, AWS imports the data into the specified S3 buckets ([Snowball Edge import jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/importtype.html)). This matches the on-premises NFS source and uses essentially no WAN/Internet bandwidth for the 70 TB transfer. A single storage-optimized Snowball Edge device can provide **210 TB usable storage**, enough for the 70 TB dataset ([device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)). AWS also documents Snowball Edge planning for large data transfers and determining the number of devices based on total data and desired transfer time ([large data migration planning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/LargeDataMigration.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Using the AWS CLI to copy 70 TB directly to S3 would consume the company’s network bandwidth for the entire transfer, which violates the “least possible network bandwidth” requirement.
- **C:** S3 File Gateway provides NFS/SMB access to S3 and manages data transfer to and from AWS, but it is still an online transfer path to AWS and would require sending the 70 TB over the network ([S3 File Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). It is not the least-bandwidth option.
- **D:** Direct Connect can provide private connectivity, but it still requires provisioning a network connection and transferring the full 70 TB over that connection. It does not minimize network bandwidth as well as an offline Snowball Edge import job.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 NFS 将大型视频文件存储在本地网络附加存储中。每个视频文件的大小范围为 1 MB 到 500 GB。总存储量为 70 TB，并且不再增长。公司决定将视频文件迁移到 Amazon S3。公司必须尽快迁移视频文件，同时使用尽可能少的网络带宽。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 S3 bucket。创建一个具有写入该 S3 bucket 权限的 IAM role。使用 AWS CLI 将所有文件从本地复制到该 S3 bucket。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Snowball Edge 作业。在本地接收一台 Snowball Edge 设备。使用 Snowball Edge 客户端将数据传输到该设备。归还设备，以便 AWS 可以将数据导入 Amazon S3。
options.C: 在本地部署一个 S3 File Gateway。创建一个公共服务端点以连接到 S3 File Gateway。创建一个 S3 bucket。在 S3 File Gateway 上创建一个新的 NFS 文件共享。将新的文件共享指向该 S3 bucket。将数据从现有 NFS 文件共享传输到 S3 File Gateway。
options.D: 在本地网络和 AWS 之间设置一个 AWS Direct Connect 连接。在本地部署一个 S3 File Gateway。创建一个公共虚拟接口 (VIF) 以连接到 S3 File Gateway。创建一个 S3 bucket。在 S3 File Gateway 上创建一个新的 NFS 文件共享。将新的文件共享指向该 S3 bucket。将数据从现有 NFS 文件共享传输到 S3 File Gateway。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

AWS Snowball Edge 导入作业旨在通过使用内置 Amazon S3 适配器或 **NFS mount point** 将数据复制到物理 Snowball Edge 设备，从而将本地数据移动到 Amazon S3；设备归还后，AWS 会将数据导入到指定的 S3 buckets（[Snowball Edge import jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/importtype.html)）。这与本地 NFS 源相匹配，并且在 70 TB 传输过程中基本不使用 WAN/互联网带宽。单台存储优化型 Snowball Edge 设备可提供 **210 TB usable storage**，足以容纳 70 TB 数据集（[device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。AWS 还记录了 Snowball Edge 针对大规模数据传输的规划，以及如何根据总数据量和期望传输时间确定设备数量（[large data migration planning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/LargeDataMigration.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A:** 使用 AWS CLI 将 70 TB 直接复制到 S3 会在整个传输过程中消耗公司的网络带宽，这违反了“尽可能少的网络带宽”要求。
- **C:** S3 File Gateway 提供对 S3 的 NFS/SMB 访问，并管理与 AWS 之间的数据传输，但它仍然是通往 AWS 的在线传输路径，并且需要通过网络发送 70 TB（[S3 File Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。它不是带宽使用最少的选项。
- **D:** Direct Connect 可以提供专用连接，但它仍然需要预置网络连接，并通过该连接传输完整的 70 TB。它不像离线 Snowball Edge 导入作业那样最大限度地减少网络带宽使用。

en.question: A company has an application that ingests incoming messages. Dozens of other applications and microservices then quickly consume these messages. The number of messages varies drastically and sometimes increases suddenly to 100,000 each second. The company wants to decouple the solution and increase scalability. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Persist the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics. Configure the consumer applications to read and process the messages.
options.B: Deploy the ingestion application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to scale the number of EC2 instances based on CPU metrics.
options.C: Write the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with a single shard. Use an AWS Lambda function to preprocess messages and store them in Amazon DynamoDB. Configure the consumer applications to read from DynamoDB to process the messages.
options.D: Publish the messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SOS) subscriptions. Configure the consumer applications to process the messages from the queues.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Publishing each incoming message to an **Amazon SNS topic** and subscribing **multiple Amazon SQS queues** implements the fanout pattern for many downstream applications. AWS states that SNS can send time-critical messages to multiple subscribers, while SQS can decouple sending and receiving components so they do not need to be concurrently available; together, SNS and SQS deliver messages immediately and persist them in queues for later processing ([SNS fanout to SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html)). SQS standard queues are also appropriate for highly variable throughput because they support a “nearly unlimited number of API calls per second” for send, receive, and delete operations ([SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics is for stream processing/analytics, not the best service to persist and fan out messages to dozens of independent consumers. The question calls for decoupled message distribution, which AWS specifically documents as an SNS-to-SQS fanout use case ([SNS fanout to SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html)).
- **B:** Scaling EC2 instances based on CPU metrics does not decouple producers from consumers. Also, EC2 Auto Scaling reacts after CloudWatch alarm thresholds and evaluation periods are breached, and new instances have warmup time ([EC2 Auto Scaling step scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-simple-step.html)); this is not ideal for sudden spikes to 100,000 messages per second.
- **C:** A single Kinesis Data Streams shard cannot handle 100,000 messages per second. AWS documents that each shard supports writes up to **1,000 records per second** for PutRecord/PutRecords ([Kinesis Data Streams quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/service-sizes-and-limits.html)). Reading from DynamoDB also does not provide the same simple independent fanout/queue isolation for dozens of consumers as SNS plus separate SQS queues.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个用于摄取传入消息的应用程序。随后，数十个其他应用程序和微服务会快速消费这些消息。消息数量变化非常剧烈，有时会突然增加到每秒 100,000 条。该公司希望对解决方案进行解耦并提高可扩展性。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 将消息持久化到 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics。配置消费者应用程序读取并处理这些消息。
options.B: 将摄取应用程序部署在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上，以根据 CPU 指标扩展 EC2 实例的数量。
options.C: 使用单个分片将消息写入 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。使用 AWS Lambda 函数预处理消息并将其存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。配置消费者应用程序从 DynamoDB 读取以处理这些消息。
options.D: 将消息发布到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，并配置多个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SOS) 订阅。配置消费者应用程序从队列中处理这些消息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

将每条传入消息发布到一个 **Amazon SNS topic**，并订阅 **多个 Amazon SQS queues**，即可为许多下游应用程序实现 fanout 模式。AWS 表示，SNS 可以将时间关键型消息发送给多个订阅者，而 SQS 可以解耦发送和接收组件，使它们不需要同时可用；结合使用时，SNS 和 SQS 可以立即传递消息，并将消息持久保存在队列中以供稍后处理（[SNS fanout to SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html)）。SQS standard queues 也适合高度可变的吞吐量，因为它们对发送、接收和删除操作支持“几乎无限数量的 API calls per second”（[SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 用于流处理/分析，并不是将消息持久化并扇出到数十个独立消费者的最佳服务。题目要求解耦的消息分发，而 AWS 明确将 SNS-to-SQS fanout 记录为此类用例（[SNS fanout to SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html)）。
- **B:** 根据 CPU 指标扩展 EC2 实例并不能解耦生产者和消费者。此外，EC2 Auto Scaling 是在 CloudWatch alarm 阈值和评估周期被突破之后才做出反应，并且新实例还有 warmup time（[EC2 Auto Scaling step scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-simple-step.html)）；这并不适合突然激增到每秒 100,000 条消息的场景。
- **C:** 单个 Kinesis Data Streams shard 无法处理每秒 100,000 条消息。AWS 文档说明，每个 shard 对 PutRecord/PutRecords 的写入最多支持 **每秒 1,000 条记录**（[Kinesis Data Streams quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/service-sizes-and-limits.html)）。从 DynamoDB 读取也无法像 SNS 加独立 SQS queues 那样，为数十个消费者提供同样简单的独立 fanout/queue 隔离。

en.question: A company is migrating a distributed application to AWS. The application serves variable workloads. The legacy platform consists of a primary server that coordinates jobs across multiple compute nodes. The company wants to modernize the application with a solution that maximizes resiliency and scalability. How should a solutions architect design the architecture to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling to use scheduled scaling.
options.B: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the size of the queue.
options.C: Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure AWS CloudTrail as a destination for the jobs. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the primary server.
options.D: Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) as a destination for the jobs. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the compute nodes.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

Amazon SQS is appropriate for replacing the legacy primary coordinator with a resilient, decoupled work queue: AWS documents SQS standard queues as suitable for **decoupling** requests from background work and **allocating tasks to multiple worker nodes**, and SQS redundantly stores messages across multiple Availability Zones so that no single computer, network, or AZ failure makes messages inaccessible ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)). For scalability, AWS specifically documents an architecture with **an Auto Scaling group to manage EC2 instances for processing messages from an SQS queue** and a target tracking policy that scales based on a queue backlog metric; dynamic scaling based on an SQS queue metric can adjust to the application's demand curve ([Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)). This matches option B.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: SQS plus an Auto Scaling group is good, but **scheduled scaling** scales at specified times and desired capacities, not according to the current variable job backlog ([Scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)). Variable workloads require demand-based scaling, not fixed schedules.
- **C**: CloudTrail is for operational/risk auditing and records actions taken by users, roles, AWS services, APIs, and SDKs; it is not a job destination or work queue ([What is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)). Keeping a primary server also preserves a coordinator bottleneck/single point of failure instead of decoupling work.
- **D**: EventBridge event buses route events from sources to targets and rules send matching events to targets; it is an event routing service, not the best fit for durable job backlog processing by many workers ([Event bus concepts in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-what-is-how-it-works-concepts.html)). Scaling only on compute-node load also does not directly track queued job demand the way SQS backlog-based scaling does.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个分布式应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序处理可变的工作负载。旧平台由一台主服务器组成，该主服务器在多个计算节点之间协调作业。公司希望使用一种能够最大限度提高弹性和可扩展性的解决方案来现代化该应用程序。解决方案架构师应如何设计该架构以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为作业的目标。使用由 Auto Scaling 组管理的 Amazon EC2 实例来实现计算节点。配置 EC2 Auto Scaling 使用计划扩展。
options.B: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为作业的目标。使用由 Auto Scaling 组管理的 Amazon EC2 实例来实现计算节点。根据队列大小配置 EC2 Auto Scaling。
options.C: 使用由 Auto Scaling 组管理的 Amazon EC2 实例来实现主服务器和计算节点。将 AWS CloudTrail 配置为作业的目标。根据主服务器上的负载配置 EC2 Auto Scaling。
options.D: 使用由 Auto Scaling 组管理的 Amazon EC2 实例来实现主服务器和计算节点。将 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 配置为作业的目标。根据计算节点上的负载配置 EC2 Auto Scaling。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

Amazon SQS 适合用于以具备弹性、解耦的工作队列来替代旧的主协调器：AWS 文档说明，SQS 标准队列适合用于将请求与后台工作**解耦**，并将任务**分配给多个工作节点**；此外，SQS 会在多个 Availability Zones 中冗余存储消息，因此单台计算机、网络或 AZ 故障都不会导致消息无法访问（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。对于可扩展性，AWS 明确记录了一种架构：使用 **Auto Scaling 组来管理用于处理 SQS 队列中消息的 EC2 实例**，并使用基于队列积压指标进行扩展的目标跟踪策略；基于 SQS 队列指标的动态扩展可以适应应用程序的需求曲线（[Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。这与选项 B 相匹配。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：SQS 加 Auto Scaling 组是好的，但**计划扩展**是在指定时间和指定所需容量进行扩展，而不是根据当前可变的作业积压进行扩展（[Scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。可变工作负载需要基于需求的扩展，而不是固定计划。
- **C**：CloudTrail 用于运营/风险审计，并记录用户、角色、AWS 服务、API 和 SDK 执行的操作；它不是作业目标或工作队列（[What is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)）。保留主服务器也会保留协调器瓶颈/单点故障，而不是对工作进行解耦。
- **D**：EventBridge 事件总线将事件从源路由到目标，规则将匹配的事件发送到目标；它是一项事件路由服务，并不是最适合由多个工作节点进行持久作业积压处理的服务（[Event bus concepts in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-what-is-how-it-works-concepts.html)）。仅基于计算节点负载进行扩展，也无法像基于 SQS 积压的扩展那样直接跟踪排队作业需求。

en.question: A company is running an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that are accessed frequently for the first few days after the files are created. After 7 days the files are rarely accessed. The total data size is increasing and is close to the company's total storage capacity. A solutions architect must increase the company's available storage space without losing low-latency access to the most recently accessed files. The solutions architect must also provide file lifecycle management to avoid future storage issues. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to extend the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system to extend the company's storage space.
options.D: Install a utility on each user's computer to access Amazon S3. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed for this hybrid SMB file-server use case: it lets on-premises clients store and retrieve files in Amazon S3 using standard file protocols including **SMB**, and it can be treated as a file-system mount on S3. It also supports managing the S3 data with **lifecycle policies** and provides **low-latency access through transparent local caching** ([AWS Storage Gateway: What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). Deploying the gateway close to SMB clients further improves client performance, and the gateway cache is sized for the active “working set” of files ([S3 File Gateway throughput guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance-Throughput.html)). After 7 days, S3 Lifecycle can transition objects from S3 Standard to **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**; AWS documents that Lifecycle supports transitions to S3 Glacier Deep Archive and that Glacier classes are for archived objects that are not needed in real time ([S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS DataSync would copy older data to AWS, but this option does not provide an SMB file interface backed by S3 with transparent local caching, nor does it define lifecycle management for future growth. It is a data transfer approach, not the best ongoing storage-extension solution described by the requirements.
- **C:** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server can provide Windows file storage, but the option only says to create an FSx file system. It does not provide S3-based lifecycle transition to archival storage after 7 days, so it does not meet the lifecycle management requirement.
- **D:** Installing a utility on each user’s computer to access S3 is not an SMB file-server extension and does not provide File Gateway’s transparent local cache for low-latency access to the active working set. Also, although S3 Lifecycle can transition to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval, the question’s pattern says files are rarely accessed after 7 days, making archival transition through the gateway-managed S3 bucket the appropriate solution.

zh.question: 一家公司在其数据中心运行一台 SMB 文件服务器。该文件服务器存储大文件，这些文件在创建后的最初几天会被频繁访问。7 天后，这些文件很少被访问。总数据量正在增加，并且接近公司的总存储容量。解决方案架构师必须增加公司的可用存储空间，同时不失去对最近访问文件的低延迟访问能力。解决方案架构师还必须提供文件生命周期管理，以避免未来出现存储问题。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 将 SMB 文件服务器上超过 7 天的数据复制到 AWS。
options.B: 创建 Amazon S3 File Gateway 以扩展公司的存储空间。创建 S3 Lifecycle policy，在 7 天后将数据转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 创建 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统以扩展公司的存储空间。
options.D: 在每个用户的计算机上安装一个实用程序来访问 Amazon S3。创建 S3 Lifecycle policy，在 7 天后将数据转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon S3 File Gateway 专为这种混合 SMB 文件服务器使用场景而设计：它允许本地客户端使用标准文件协议（包括 **SMB**）在 Amazon S3 中存储和检索文件，并且可以将其视为 S3 上的文件系统挂载点。它还支持使用 **lifecycle policies** 管理 S3 数据，并通过透明的本地缓存提供 **低延迟访问**（[AWS Storage Gateway: What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。将 gateway 部署在靠近 SMB 客户端的位置可进一步提升客户端性能，并且 gateway cache 会根据活动的文件“工作集”进行大小规划（[S3 File Gateway throughput guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance-Throughput.html)）。7 天后，S3 Lifecycle 可以将对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**；AWS 文档说明 Lifecycle 支持转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，并且 Glacier 类适用于不需要实时访问的归档对象（[S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS DataSync 会将较旧的数据复制到 AWS，但此选项并未提供由 S3 支持且具有透明本地缓存的 SMB 文件接口，也未为未来增长定义生命周期管理。它是一种数据传输方法，而不是需求所描述的最佳持续性存储扩展解决方案。
- **C:** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 可以提供 Windows 文件存储，但该选项只说创建一个 FSx 文件系统。它没有提供在 7 天后基于 S3 的生命周期转换到归档存储，因此不满足生命周期管理要求。
- **D:** 在每个用户的计算机上安装一个实用程序来访问 S3，并不是 SMB 文件服务器扩展，也不提供 File Gateway 对活动工作集进行低延迟访问所需的透明本地缓存。此外，虽然 S3 Lifecycle 可以转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，但题目中的模式说明文件在 7 天后很少被访问，因此通过 gateway 管理的 S3 bucket 进行归档转换才是合适的解决方案。

en.question: A company is building an ecommerce web application on AWS. The application sends information about new orders to an Amazon API Gateway REST API to process. The company wants to ensure that orders are processed in the order that they are received. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an API Gateway integration to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the application receives an order. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the topic to perform processing.
options.B: Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue when the application receives an order. Configure the SQS FIFO queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.
options.C: Use an API Gateway authorizer to block any requests while the application processes an order.
options.D: Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue when the application receives an order. Configure the SQS standard queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon SQS FIFO queues are specifically designed for cases where operation/event order is critical. AWS states that FIFO queues strictly preserve the order in which messages are sent and received, and even lists an “E-commerce order management system where order is critical” as a FIFO queue use case. When Lambda processes an SQS FIFO queue, Lambda respects the FIFO ordering guarantees; within the same message group, only one Lambda instance processes messages at a time, so messages are handled sequentially. Therefore, API Gateway sending each order to an SQS FIFO queue, with Lambda processing the queue, meets the requirement to process orders in received order ([SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html), [SQS FIFO queue and Lambda concurrency behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/fifo-queue-lambda-behavior.html), [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
- **A:** SNS-to-Lambda does not provide the required ordered queue processing pattern. The requirement is strict processing order; SQS FIFO is the AWS service designed for that.
- **C:** API Gateway authorizers are for request authorization, not for building an ordered processing pipeline. Blocking requests while an order is processed is not an appropriate or scalable ordering mechanism.
- **D:** SQS standard queues do not guarantee ordering. AWS says standard queues provide at-least-once delivery, messages may occasionally arrive out of order, and ordering is only best-effort ([SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个电子商务 Web 应用程序。该应用程序会将新订单的信息发送到 Amazon API Gateway REST API 进行处理。公司希望确保订单按照接收顺序进行处理。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 当应用程序收到订单时，使用 API Gateway 集成将消息发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。将 AWS Lambda 函数订阅到该主题以执行处理。
options.B: 当应用程序收到订单时，使用 API Gateway 集成将消息发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列。配置 SQS FIFO 队列以调用 AWS Lambda 函数进行处理。
options.C: 在应用程序处理订单时，使用 API Gateway 授权方阻止任何请求。
options.D: 当应用程序收到订单时，使用 API Gateway 集成将消息发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列。配置 SQS 标准队列以调用 AWS Lambda 函数进行处理。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon SQS FIFO 队列专为操作/事件顺序至关重要的场景而设计。AWS 指出，FIFO 队列会严格保留消息发送和接收的顺序，甚至将“订单顺序至关重要的电子商务订单管理系统”列为 FIFO 队列的一个使用案例。当 Lambda 处理 SQS FIFO 队列时，Lambda 会遵循 FIFO 排序保证；在同一个消息组内，一次只有一个 Lambda 实例处理消息，因此消息会按顺序处理。因此，由 API Gateway 将每个订单发送到 SQS FIFO 队列，并由 Lambda 处理该队列，可以满足按接收顺序处理订单的要求（[SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)、[SQS FIFO queue and Lambda concurrency behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/fifo-queue-lambda-behavior.html)、[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**
- **A:** SNS-to-Lambda 不提供所需的有序队列处理模式。要求是严格的处理顺序；SQS FIFO 是为此而设计的 AWS 服务。
- **C:** API Gateway 授权方用于请求授权，而不是用于构建有序处理管道。在处理订单时阻塞请求并不是一种合适或可扩展的排序机制。
- **D:** SQS 标准队列不保证顺序。AWS 表示，标准队列提供至少一次传递，消息有时可能会乱序到达，并且排序仅为尽力而为（[SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon Aurora database. The EC2 instances connect to the database by using user names and passwords that are stored locally in a file. The company wants to minimize the operational overhead of credential management. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this goal?

options.A: Use AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation.
options.B: Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on automatic rotation.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store objects that are encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Migrate the credential file to the S3 bucket. Point the application to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for each EC2 instance. Attach the new EBS volume to each EC2 instance. Migrate the credential file to the new EBS volume. Point the application to the new EBS volume.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A. Use AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation.**

AWS Secrets Manager is designed for this use case: it helps manage, retrieve, and rotate **database credentials** and other secrets throughout their lifecycle. AWS documentation also states that applications can replace stored/hard-coded credentials with a runtime call to Secrets Manager, and that Secrets Manager can be configured with an **automatic rotation schedule**, so credential rotation does not require updating and redeploying the application clients ([AWS Secrets Manager intro](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). For rotation specifically, Secrets Manager can update credentials in both the secret and the database/service and supports automatic rotation ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). This minimizes operational overhead for Aurora database credentials.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Systems Manager Parameter Store with automatic rotation** — Parameter Store can centrally store and retrieve parameters, including values used by other services, but the documented Parameter Store features focus on parameter management, history, notifications, and policies; it is not the AWS service described as automatically rotating database credentials in the way Secrets Manager is ([Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)).
- **C. Store the credential file in S3 with KMS encryption** — This may protect the file at rest, but it still leaves the company managing a credential file and does not provide automatic database credential rotation.
- **D. Store the credential file on encrypted EBS volumes** — This also only changes where the local credential file is stored and protects it at rest. It does not centralize secret lifecycle management or automatically rotate Aurora credentials.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序，并使用 Amazon Aurora 数据库。EC2 实例通过使用本地文件中存储的用户名和密码连接到数据库。该公司希望最大限度地减少凭证管理的运营开销。解决方案架构师应如何实现这一目标？

options.A: 使用 AWS Secrets Manager。开启自动轮换。
options.B: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store。开启自动轮换。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，用于存储使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密密钥加密的对象。将凭证文件迁移到 S3 存储桶。将应用程序指向 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 为每个 EC2 实例创建一个加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。将新的 EBS 卷附加到每个 EC2 实例。将凭证文件迁移到新的 EBS 卷。将应用程序指向新的 EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A. 使用 AWS Secrets Manager。开启自动轮换。**

AWS Secrets Manager 专为这种使用场景而设计：它有助于在 **database credentials** 和其他密钥的整个生命周期内管理、检索和轮换它们。AWS 文档还说明，应用程序可以使用对 Secrets Manager 的运行时调用来替代已存储/硬编码的凭证，并且可以为 Secrets Manager 配置 **automatic rotation schedule**，因此凭证轮换不需要更新和重新部署应用程序客户端（[AWS Secrets Manager intro](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。具体到轮换，Secrets Manager 可以同时更新 secret 和数据库/服务中的凭证，并支持自动轮换（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。这可以最大限度地减少 Aurora 数据库凭证的运营开销。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Systems Manager Parameter Store with automatic rotation** — Parameter Store 可以集中存储和检索参数，包括其他服务使用的值，但文档中记录的 Parameter Store 功能侧重于参数管理、历史记录、通知和策略；它不是像 Secrets Manager 那样被描述为可自动轮换数据库凭证的 AWS 服务（[Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)）。
- **C. Store the credential file in S3 with KMS encryption** — 这可能会保护静态存储的文件，但公司仍然需要管理凭证文件，并且不会提供自动数据库凭证轮换。
- **D. Store the credential file on encrypted EBS volumes** — 这也只是改变了本地凭证文件的存储位置，并保护其静态存储状态。它不会集中管理 secret 生命周期，也不会自动轮换 Aurora 凭证。

en.question: A global company hosts its web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The web application has static data and dynamic data. The company stores its static data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to improve performance and reduce latency for the static data and dynamic data. The company is using its own domain name registered with Amazon Route 53. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the S3 bucket and the ALB as origins. Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the CloudFront distribution.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that has the S3 bucket as an endpoint Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the CloudFront distribution.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the S3 bucket as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that has the ALB and the CloudFront distribution as endpoints. Create a custom domain name that points to the accelerator DNS name. Use the custom domain name as an endpoint for the web application.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that has the S3 bucket as an endpoint. Create two domain names. Point one domain name to the CloudFront DNS name for dynamic content. Point the other domain name to the accelerator DNS name for static content. Use the domain names as endpoints for the web application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Create one Amazon CloudFront distribution with two origins: the S3 bucket for static objects and the ALB for the dynamic web application. AWS documentation states that CloudFront can use an Amazon S3 bucket as an origin, and that using CloudFront with S3 makes downloads faster because objects are stored closer to users. The same CloudFront origins documentation also states that CloudFront can route traffic to Application Load Balancers, including internet-facing ALBs for HTTP(S) servers on EC2 instances ([CloudFront origins: S3 and ALB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)). Then Route 53 can route the company’s domain name to the CloudFront distribution by creating an alias record to the CloudFront distribution ([Route 53 routing to CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** Incorrect. The CloudFront part only includes the ALB origin and does not put the S3 static content behind CloudFront. Also, AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator endpoints are **Network Load Balancers, Application Load Balancers, EC2 instances, or Elastic IP addresses**—not S3 buckets ([Global Accelerator endpoint types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).
- **C:** Incorrect. Although CloudFront can use S3 as an origin, Global Accelerator cannot use a CloudFront distribution as a standard accelerator endpoint; supported standard endpoint types are NLB, ALB, EC2, and Elastic IP addresses ([Global Accelerator endpoint types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).
- **D:** Incorrect. It incorrectly proposes using an S3 bucket as a Global Accelerator endpoint, which is unsupported. It also unnecessarily splits static and dynamic content across two domain names when a single CloudFront distribution can use both S3 and ALB origins and Route 53 can point the application domain to that distribution ([CloudFront origins: S3 and ALB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html), [Route 53 routing to CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)).

zh.question: 一家全球公司将其 Web 应用程序托管在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 Web 应用程序包含静态数据和动态数据。公司将其静态数据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司希望提高静态数据和动态数据的性能并降低延迟。公司正在使用其在 Amazon Route 53 中注册的自有域名。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，将 S3 存储桶和 ALB 作为源。配置 Route 53 将流量路由到 CloudFront 分配。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，将 ALB 作为源。创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator 标准加速器，将 S3 存储桶作为端点。配置 Route 53 将流量路由到 CloudFront 分配。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，将 S3 存储桶作为源。创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator 标准加速器，将 ALB 和 CloudFront 分配作为端点。创建一个指向加速器 DNS 名称的自定义域名。将该自定义域名用作 Web 应用程序的端点。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，将 ALB 作为源。创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator 标准加速器，将 S3 存储桶作为端点。创建两个域名。将一个域名指向用于动态内容的 CloudFront DNS 名称。将另一个域名指向用于静态内容的加速器 DNS 名称。将这些域名用作 Web 应用程序的端点。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并配置两个源：用于静态对象的 S3 存储桶，以及用于动态 Web 应用程序的 ALB。AWS 文档说明，CloudFront 可以使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为源，并且将 CloudFront 与 S3 结合使用可以让下载速度更快，因为对象会存储在更靠近用户的位置。同一份 CloudFront 源文档还说明，CloudFront 可以将流量路由到 Application Load Balancers，包括用于 EC2 实例上 HTTP(S) 服务器的面向互联网的 ALB（[CloudFront origins: S3 and ALB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)）。然后，Route 53 可以通过创建指向 CloudFront 分配的别名记录，将公司的域名路由到 CloudFront 分配（[Route 53 routing to CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **B:** 错误。CloudFront 部分只包含 ALB 源，并没有将 S3 静态内容放在 CloudFront 后面。此外，AWS Global Accelerator 标准加速器端点是 **Network Load Balancers, Application Load Balancers, EC2 instances, or Elastic IP addresses**——而不是 S3 存储桶（[Global Accelerator endpoint types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。
- **C:** 错误。虽然 CloudFront 可以使用 S3 作为源，但 Global Accelerator 不能将 CloudFront 分配用作标准加速器端点；受支持的标准端点类型是 NLB、ALB、EC2 和 Elastic IP addresses（[Global Accelerator endpoint types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。
- **D:** 错误。它错误地提出将 S3 存储桶用作 Global Accelerator 端点，而这是不受支持的。它还不必要地将静态和动态内容拆分到两个域名上；而单个 CloudFront 分配可以同时使用 S3 和 ALB 源，并且 Route 53 可以将应用程序域名指向该分配（[CloudFront origins: S3 and ALB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html), [Route 53 routing to CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-cloudfront-distribution.html)）。

en.question: A company performs monthly maintenance on its AWS infrastructure. During these maintenance activities, the company needs to rotate the credentials for its Amazon RDS for MySQL databases across multiple AWS Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Use multi-Region secret replication for the required Regions. Configure Secrets Manager to rotate the secrets on a schedule.
options.B: Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Systems Manager by creating a secure string parameter. Use multi-Region secret replication for the required Regions. Configure Systems Manager to rotate the secrets on a schedule.
options.C: Store the credentials in an Amazon S3 bucket that has server-side encryption (SSE) enabled. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to invoke an AWS Lambda function to rotate the credentials.
options.D: Encrypt the credentials as secrets by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) multi-Region customer managed keys. Store the secrets in an Amazon DynamoDB global table. Use an AWS Lambda function to retrieve the secrets from DynamoDB. Use the RDS API to rotate the secrets.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Secrets Manager is designed for this use case. It can store database credentials as secrets and supports automatic secret rotation: AWS states that rotation updates credentials in both the secret and the database/service, and that Secrets Manager can be configured for automatic rotation ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). For scheduled rotation, Secrets Manager supports rotation schedules with `cron()` or `rate()` expressions ([Set up automatic rotation using the AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-cli.html)). It also supports replicating secrets across multiple AWS Regions, and if rotation is enabled on the primary secret, the new value propagates to replica secrets so rotation does **not** need to be managed separately in each Region ([Replicate AWS Secrets Manager secrets across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/replicate-secrets.html)). This provides the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Systems Manager Parameter Store can store SecureString parameters, but the cited Parameter Store features focus on parameter storage, sharing, history, events, and notifications; it does not provide the Secrets Manager combination of multi-Region secret replication with automatic database credential rotation ([AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)).
- **C:** Storing credentials in S3 and building EventBridge/Lambda rotation logic is a custom solution. It lacks the built-in database credential rotation and multi-Region secret replication behavior that Secrets Manager provides, so it has more operational overhead.
- **D:** KMS, DynamoDB global tables, Lambda, and RDS API calls would require designing and maintaining custom secret storage, retrieval, replication, and rotation workflows. Secrets Manager already provides these capabilities with less operational work.

zh.question: 一家公司每月对其 AWS 基础设施执行维护。在这些维护活动期间，该公司需要轮换其跨多个 AWS Regions 的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库凭证。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将凭证作为密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。对所需的 Regions 使用多区域密钥复制。配置 Secrets Manager 按计划轮换密钥。
options.B: 通过创建安全字符串参数，将凭证作为密钥存储在 AWS Systems Manager 中。对所需的 Regions 使用多区域密钥复制。配置 Systems Manager 按计划轮换密钥。
options.C: 将凭证存储在启用了服务器端加密 (SSE) 的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 调用 AWS Lambda 函数来轮换凭证。
options.D: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 多区域客户托管密钥将凭证加密为密钥。将密钥存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 全局表中。使用 AWS Lambda 函数从 DynamoDB 检索密钥。使用 RDS API 轮换密钥。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS Secrets Manager 专为此使用场景而设计。它可以将数据库凭证作为密钥存储，并支持自动密钥轮换：AWS 说明轮换会同时更新密钥和数据库/服务中的凭证，并且 Secrets Manager 可以配置为自动轮换（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。对于计划轮换，Secrets Manager 支持使用 `cron()` 或 `rate()` 表达式的轮换计划（[Set up automatic rotation using the AWS CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_turn-on-cli.html)）。它还支持跨多个 AWS Regions 复制密钥，并且如果在主密钥上启用了轮换，新值会传播到副本密钥，因此**不**需要在每个 Region 中单独管理轮换（[Replicate AWS Secrets Manager secrets across Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/replicate-secrets.html)）。这提供了最少的运营开销。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Systems Manager Parameter Store 可以存储 SecureString 参数，但所引用的 Parameter Store 功能侧重于参数存储、共享、历史记录、事件和通知；它不提供 Secrets Manager 所具备的多区域密钥复制与自动数据库凭证轮换的组合能力（[AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)）。
- **C:** 将凭证存储在 S3 中并构建 EventBridge/Lambda 轮换逻辑是一种自定义解决方案。它缺少 Secrets Manager 提供的内置数据库凭证轮换和多区域密钥复制行为，因此运营开销更高。
- **D:** KMS、DynamoDB 全局表、Lambda 和 RDS API 调用将需要设计并维护自定义的密钥存储、检索、复制和轮换工作流。Secrets Manager 已经以更少的运营工作提供了这些能力。

en.question: A company runs an ecommerce application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The Auto Scaling group scales based on CPU utilization metrics. The ecommerce application stores the transaction data in a MySQL 8.0 database that is hosted on a large EC2 instance. The database's performance degrades quickly as application load increases. The application handles more read requests than write transactions. The company wants a solution that will automatically scale the database to meet the demand of unpredictable read workloads while maintaining high availability. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Redshift with a single node for leader and compute functionality.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS with a Single-AZ deployment Configure Amazon RDS to add reader instances in a different Availability Zone.
options.C: Use Amazon Aurora with a Multi-AZ deployment. Configure Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with EC2 Spot Instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use Amazon Aurora with a Multi-AZ deployment and configure Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas.**

Aurora is the best fit because the workload is MySQL-compatible, read-heavy, unpredictable, and requires high availability. AWS documentation states that Aurora stores data copies across multiple Availability Zones and synchronously replicates writes across AZs for redundancy. Aurora Replicas can offload `SELECT` queries for read-intensive applications, and a replica can be promoted automatically during failover. AWS also recommends distributing writer and reader instances across multiple AZs to improve availability ([Aurora high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)). Aurora Auto Scaling uses scaling policies to adjust the number of Aurora Replicas, adding or removing replicas to keep a target metric close to its target and to adjust to changing workload fluctuations ([Aurora Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon Redshift single node** — Redshift is a data warehouse service for analytics/BI workloads, not a MySQL-compatible transactional ecommerce database replacement ([What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). A single-node Redshift deployment also does not address the application's OLTP read-scaling and HA requirements.
- **B. Amazon RDS Single-AZ with reader instances** — RDS read replicas can help read-heavy workloads, but AWS documentation explicitly says RDS does **not** support autoscaling of read replicas; they must be created manually ([RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). Single-AZ also does not meet the high availability requirement.
- **D. ElastiCache for Memcached with EC2 Spot Instances** — ElastiCache is an in-memory data store/cache, not a durable MySQL transactional database solution ([What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)). It may reduce some read load for cacheable data, but it does not replace the database or provide automatic database read scaling with HA.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个电子商务应用程序。这些实例在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中运行。Auto Scaling 组根据 CPU 利用率指标进行扩展。该电子商务应用程序将交易数据存储在托管于大型 EC2 实例上的 MySQL 8.0 数据库中。随着应用程序负载增加，数据库性能迅速下降。该应用程序处理的读取请求多于写入事务。该公司希望采用一种解决方案，能够自动扩展数据库以满足不可预测的读取工作负载需求，同时保持高可用性。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Redshift，并使用单个节点来实现领导节点和计算功能。
options.B: 使用采用 Single-AZ 部署的 Amazon RDS。配置 Amazon RDS 在不同的 Availability Zone 中添加读取器实例。
options.C: 使用采用 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon Aurora。配置带有 Aurora Replicas 的 Aurora Auto Scaling。
options.D: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached，并配合 EC2 Spot Instances。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用采用 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon Aurora，并配置带有 Aurora Replicas 的 Aurora Auto Scaling。**

Aurora 是最合适的选择，因为该工作负载兼容 MySQL、读取密集、不可预测，并且需要高可用性。AWS 文档说明，Aurora 会跨多个 Availability Zones 存储数据副本，并在 AZs 之间同步复制写入以实现冗余。Aurora Replicas 可以为读取密集型应用程序分担 `SELECT` 查询，并且副本可以在故障转移期间自动提升。AWS 还建议将写入器和读取器实例分布在多个 AZs 中，以提高可用性（[Aurora high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)）。Aurora Auto Scaling 使用扩展策略来调整 Aurora Replicas 的数量，添加或移除副本，使目标指标保持接近其目标值，并适应不断变化的工作负载波动（[Aurora Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon Redshift single node** — Redshift 是用于分析/BI 工作负载的数据仓库服务，而不是兼容 MySQL 的事务型电子商务数据库替代方案（[What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。单节点 Redshift 部署也无法满足应用程序的 OLTP 读取扩展和 HA 要求。
- **B. Amazon RDS Single-AZ with reader instances** — RDS read replicas 可以帮助读取密集型工作负载，但 AWS 文档明确说明 RDS **不**支持 read replicas 的自动扩展；它们必须手动创建（[RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。Single-AZ 也不满足高可用性要求。
- **D. ElastiCache for Memcached with EC2 Spot Instances** — ElastiCache 是内存中数据存储/缓存，而不是持久的 MySQL 事务数据库解决方案（[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。它可能会减少可缓存数据的一些读取负载，但它不能替代数据库，也不能提供带 HA 的自动数据库读取扩展。

en.question: A company recently migrated to AWS and wants to implement a solution to protect the traffic that flows in and out of the production VPC. The company had an inspection server in its on-premises data center. The inspection server performed specific operations such as traffic flow inspection and traffic filtering. The company wants to have the same functionalities in the AWS Cloud. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon GuardDuty for traffic inspection and traffic filtering in the production VPC.
options.B: Use Traffic Mirroring to mirror traffic from the production VPC for traffic inspection and filtering.
options.C: Use AWS Network Firewall to create the required rules for traffic inspection and traffic filtering for the production VPC.
options.D: Use AWS Firewall Manager to create the required rules for traffic inspection and traffic filtering for the production VPC.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use AWS Network Firewall.**

AWS Network Firewall is the managed AWS service intended for inline VPC traffic inspection and filtering. AWS documentation states that Network Firewall rule groups are reusable criteria for **“inspecting and handling network traffic,”** and that rules provide packet-inspection criteria and actions to take when traffic matches those criteria ([AWS Network Firewall rule groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/rule-groups.html)). This matches the company’s requirement to replace an on-premises inspection/filtering server for traffic flowing in and out of the production VPC. AWS VPC documentation also describes attaching Network Firewall functionality to inspect and filter traffic, where the appliance **“inspects and filters the traffic”** and allowed traffic continues to its destination ([Inspect traffic from NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-inspect-traffic.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon GuardDuty** is a threat detection service. It continuously monitors and analyzes AWS data sources and logs to identify suspicious or malicious activity, but it is not an inline traffic filtering firewall for a VPC ([What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)).
- **B. Traffic Mirroring** copies traffic from an elastic network interface and sends it to out-of-band monitoring appliances for inspection, threat monitoring, or troubleshooting. Because it mirrors/copies traffic out-of-band, it does not itself provide inline filtering or blocking of production VPC traffic ([What is Traffic Mirroring?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/mirroring/what-is-traffic-mirroring.html)).
- **D. AWS Firewall Manager** simplifies administration and maintenance of protections across multiple accounts and resources, including AWS Network Firewall policies. It is a centralized management service, not the inspection/filtering engine itself ([What is AWS Firewall Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近迁移到 AWS，并希望实施一种解决方案来保护进出生产 VPC 的流量。该公司在其本地数据中心有一台检查服务器。该检查服务器执行特定操作，例如流量流检查和流量筛选。该公司希望在 AWS Cloud 中具备相同的功能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在生产 VPC 中使用 Amazon GuardDuty 进行流量检查和流量筛选。
options.B: 使用 Traffic Mirroring 镜像来自生产 VPC 的流量，以进行流量检查和筛选。
options.C: 使用 AWS Network Firewall 为生产 VPC 创建流量检查和流量筛选所需的规则。
options.D: 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 为生产 VPC 创建流量检查和流量筛选所需的规则。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用 AWS Network Firewall。**

AWS Network Firewall 是用于内联 VPC 流量检查和筛选的托管 AWS 服务。AWS 文档指出，Network Firewall 规则组是用于**“检查和处理网络流量”**的可重用条件，并且规则提供数据包检查条件以及在流量匹配这些条件时要采取的操作（[AWS Network Firewall rule groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/rule-groups.html)）。这符合该公司用来替换本地检查/筛选服务器，以处理进出生产 VPC 流量的要求。AWS VPC 文档还描述了附加 Network Firewall 功能来检查和筛选流量，其中该设备会**“检查并筛选流量”**，允许的流量会继续到达其目标（[Inspect traffic from NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-inspect-traffic.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon GuardDuty** 是一项威胁检测服务。它会持续监控和分析 AWS 数据源和日志，以识别可疑或恶意活动，但它不是用于 VPC 的内联流量筛选防火墙（[What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)）。
- **B. Traffic Mirroring** 会从 elastic network interface 复制流量，并将其发送到带外监控设备，以用于检查、威胁监控或故障排除。由于它以带外方式镜像/复制流量，因此它本身不提供对生产 VPC 流量的内联筛选或阻止（[What is Traffic Mirroring?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/mirroring/what-is-traffic-mirroring.html)）。
- **D. AWS Firewall Manager** 可简化跨多个账户和资源的保护措施的管理和维护，包括 AWS Network Firewall 策略。它是一项集中式管理服务，而不是检查/筛选引擎本身（[What is AWS Firewall Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts a data lake on AWS. The data lake consists of data in Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company needs a reporting solution that provides data visualization and includes all the data sources within the data lake. Only the company's management team should have full access to all the visualizations. The rest of the company should have only limited access. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an analysis in Amazon QuickSight. Connect all the data sources and create new datasets. Publish dashboards to visualize the data. Share the dashboards with the appropriate IAM roles.
options.B: Create an analysis in Amazon QuickSight. Connect all the data sources and create new datasets. Publish dashboards to visualize the data. Share the dashboards with the appropriate users and groups.
options.C: Create an AWS Glue table and crawler for the data in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to produce reports. Publish the reports to Amazon S3. Use S3 bucket policies to limit access to the reports.
options.D: Create an AWS Glue table and crawler for the data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena Federated Query to access data within Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. Generate reports by using Amazon Athena. Publish the reports to Amazon S3. Use S3 bucket policies to limit access to the reports.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon QuickSight is the managed BI/reporting service designed to turn data into “interactive visualizations, dashboards, and reports” and supports the workflow of connecting to data sources, preparing datasets, creating analyses, and sharing dashboards ([QuickSight BI overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/quick-bi.html)). QuickSight can use both required data sources: it supports Amazon S3/file data and relational sources including PostgreSQL; the docs also note PostgreSQL connections from QuickSight are supported for RDS-hosted PostgreSQL ([supported data sources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/supported-data-sources.html)). Dashboard access is granted to specific QuickSight **users and groups**, with permission levels such as Viewer and Co-owner, which fits the requirement for management to have full access and the rest of the company to have limited access ([grant users and groups dashboard access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/share-a-dashboard-grant-access-users.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** QuickSight is the right visualization service, but the documented way to share dashboards for this use case is with QuickSight users and groups, not by sharing dashboards with IAM roles ([dashboard access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/share-a-dashboard.html)).
- **C:** AWS Glue can catalog and transform data, but this option does not provide an interactive visualization/dashboard reporting solution like QuickSight. It also addresses only the S3 data path and does not include the RDS for PostgreSQL source.
- **D:** Athena Federated Query can help query RDS data, but generating files in S3 and controlling them with bucket policies is not a full dashboard/visualization solution. QuickSight is the purpose-built service for analyses, dashboards, and controlled sharing of visualizations.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管一个数据湖。该数据湖由 Amazon S3 中的数据和 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 组成。公司需要一个报表解决方案，该方案能够提供数据可视化，并包含数据湖中的所有数据源。只有公司的管理团队应拥有对所有可视化内容的完全访问权限。公司其他人员应只有有限访问权限。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建一个分析。连接所有数据源并创建新的数据集。发布仪表板以可视化数据。与适当的 IAM 角色共享仪表板。
options.B: 在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建一个分析。连接所有数据源并创建新的数据集。发布仪表板以可视化数据。与适当的用户和组共享仪表板。
options.C: 为 Amazon S3 中的数据创建 AWS Glue 表和爬网程序。创建 AWS Glue 提取、转换和加载 (ETL) 作业来生成报表。将报表发布到 Amazon S3。使用 S3 存储桶策略限制对报表的访问。
options.D: 为 Amazon S3 中的数据创建 AWS Glue 表和爬网程序。使用 Amazon Athena Federated Query 访问 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 中的数据。使用 Amazon Athena 生成报表。将报表发布到 Amazon S3。使用 S3 存储桶策略限制对报表的访问。

zh.explanation:
