**正确答案：B.** Amazon QuickSight 是托管式 BI/报表服务，旨在将数据转化为“交互式可视化、仪表板和报表”，并支持连接数据源、准备数据集、创建分析以及共享仪表板的工作流（[QuickSight BI overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/quick-bi.html)）。QuickSight 可以使用两个所需的数据源：它支持 Amazon S3/文件数据以及包括 PostgreSQL 在内的关系型数据源；文档还指出，QuickSight 支持连接 RDS 托管的 PostgreSQL（[supported data sources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/supported-data-sources.html)）。仪表板访问权限授予给特定的 QuickSight **用户和组**，并具有 Viewer 和 Co-owner 等权限级别，这符合管理团队拥有完全访问权限、公司其他人员拥有有限访问权限的要求（[grant users and groups dashboard access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/share-a-dashboard-grant-access-users.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** QuickSight 是正确的可视化服务，但针对该用例，共享仪表板的文档化方式是使用 QuickSight 用户和组，而不是与 IAM 角色共享仪表板（[dashboard access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/share-a-dashboard.html)）。
- **C:** AWS Glue 可以编目和转换数据，但该选项未提供像 QuickSight 那样的交互式可视化/仪表板报表解决方案。它也只处理 S3 数据路径，并未包含 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据源。
- **D:** Athena Federated Query 可以帮助查询 RDS 数据，但在 S3 中生成文件并使用存储桶策略控制这些文件，并不是完整的仪表板/可视化解决方案。QuickSight 是专为分析、仪表板以及可视化内容受控共享而构建的服务。

en.question: A company is implementing a new business application. The application runs on two Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon S3 bucket for document storage. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the EC2 instances can access the S3 bucket. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an IAM role that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the role to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the policy to the EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an IAM group that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the group to the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an IAM user that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the user account to the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS recommends granting applications on EC2 access to AWS services by creating an **IAM role** with the required permissions and attaching/assigning that role to the EC2 instance. AWS gives the exact pattern for an EC2 application accessing an S3 bucket: create a role, put the S3 permissions in the role's permissions policy, attach/assign the role to the EC2 instance, and the application uses temporary credentials from instance metadata to access S3 ([IAM: roles for EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)). The EC2 documentation also states that you can create an IAM role and attach it to an instance, and even gives S3 access as an example permission for such a role ([Attach an IAM role to an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/attach-iam-role.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An IAM policy defines permissions, but it is not attached directly to an EC2 instance. The policy should be associated with an IAM role, and the role is attached to the instance ([Attach an IAM role to an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/attach-iam-role.html)).
- **C:** An IAM user group is a collection of IAM users, not EC2 instances, so it cannot be attached to EC2 instances to grant instance permissions ([IAM identities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id.html)).
- **D:** An IAM user is an identity for a person or application, but the correct AWS mechanism for EC2 applications is an IAM role with temporary credentials, avoiding long-term credential management on the instance ([IAM: roles for EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在实施一个新的业务应用程序。该应用程序运行在两个 Amazon EC2 实例上，并使用一个 Amazon S3 存储桶进行文档存储。解决方案架构师需要确保 EC2 实例可以访问 S3 存储桶。解决方案架构师应如何满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个授予对 S3 存储桶访问权限的 IAM role。将该 role 附加到 EC2 实例。
options.B: 创建一个授予对 S3 存储桶访问权限的 IAM policy。将该 policy 附加到 EC2 实例。
options.C: 创建一个授予对 S3 存储桶访问权限的 IAM group。将该 group 附加到 EC2 实例。
options.D: 创建一个授予对 S3 存储桶访问权限的 IAM user。将该用户账户附加到 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS 建议通过创建具有所需权限的 **IAM role** 并将该 role 附加/分配给 EC2 实例，来授予 EC2 上的应用程序访问 AWS 服务的权限。AWS 为 EC2 应用程序访问 S3 存储桶给出了确切模式：创建一个 role，将 S3 权限放入该 role 的 permissions policy 中，将该 role 附加/分配给 EC2 实例，并且应用程序使用来自 instance metadata 的临时凭证来访问 S3（[IAM: roles for EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)）。EC2 文档还说明，你可以创建一个 IAM role 并将其附加到实例，并且甚至将 S3 访问权限作为此类 role 的示例权限（[Attach an IAM role to an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/attach-iam-role.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** IAM policy 定义权限，但它不会直接附加到 EC2 实例。policy 应与 IAM role 关联，而 role 会附加到实例（[Attach an IAM role to an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/attach-iam-role.html)）。
- **C:** IAM user group 是 IAM users 的集合，而不是 EC2 实例的集合，因此它不能附加到 EC2 实例以授予实例权限（[IAM identities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id.html)）。
- **D:** IAM user 是用于人员或应用程序的身份，但 EC2 应用程序的正确 AWS 机制是使用带有临时凭证的 IAM role，从而避免在实例上管理长期凭证（[IAM: roles for EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)）。

en.question: An application development team is designing a microservice that will convert large images to smaller, compressed images. When a user uploads an image through the web interface, the microservice should store the image in an Amazon S3 bucket, process and compress the image with an AWS Lambda function, and store the image in its compressed form in a different S3 bucket. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that uses durable, stateless components to process the images automatically. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the S3 bucket to send a notification to the SQS queue when an image is uploaded to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure the Lambda function to use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the invocation source. When the SQS message is successfully processed, delete the message in the queue.
options.C: Configure the Lambda function to monitor the S3 bucket for new uploads. When an uploaded image is detected, write the file name to a text file in memory and use the text file to keep track of the images that were processed.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to monitor an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. When items are added to the queue, log the file name in a text file on the EC2 instance and invoke the Lambda function.
options.E: Configure an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) event to monitor the S3 bucket. When an image is uploaded, send an alert to an Amazon ample Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with the application owner's email address for further processing.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and B**.

- **A is correct** because Amazon S3 event notifications support **new object created events** and can send event notification messages to **Amazon SQS queues**. This lets the upload bucket automatically place a durable processing request on a queue when an image is uploaded. SQS standard queues redundantly store messages in multiple Availability Zones before acknowledging them, which supports the durability requirement. AWS also lists media upload followed by background resize/encode work as a standard queue use case. [Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)
- **B is correct** because Lambda can use an **Amazon SQS event source mapping**. Lambda polls the queue, invokes the function with messages, and when the function successfully processes a batch, Lambda deletes the messages from the queue. This provides an automatic, stateless serverless processing path. [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html), [Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)

Why the other options are wrong:

- **C is wrong** because keeping a text file in Lambda memory to track processed images is not durable and violates the stateless requirement. Lambda should be triggered by an event source such as SQS, not maintain processing state in memory.
- **D is wrong** because adding an EC2 instance to poll SQS and keep a local text file introduces a stateful server component and unnecessary operational overhead. Lambda can read directly from SQS through an event source mapping. [Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)
- **E is wrong** because sending an email alert to an SNS topic does not automatically process and compress the image. Although S3 can send events to EventBridge/SNS, this option routes the event to a human notification rather than to the image-processing workflow. [Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)

zh.question: 一个应用程序开发团队正在设计一个微服务，用于将大图像转换为更小的压缩图像。当用户通过 Web 界面上传图像时，该微服务应将图像存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理并压缩图像，然后将压缩后的图像存储到另一个 S3 存储桶中。解决方案架构师需要设计一个使用持久、无状态组件自动处理图像的解决方案。以下哪组操作组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置 S3 存储桶，使其在图像上传到 S3 存储桶时向 SQS 队列发送通知。
options.B: 配置 Lambda 函数，将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列用作调用源。当 SQS 消息成功处理后，删除队列中的该消息。
options.C: 配置 Lambda 函数以监控 S3 存储桶的新上传。当检测到上传的图像时，将文件名写入内存中的文本文件，并使用该文本文件跟踪已处理的图像。
options.D: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例来监控 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。当项目添加到队列时，在 EC2 实例上的文本文件中记录文件名并调用 Lambda 函数。
options.E: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 事件来监控 S3 存储桶。当图像上传时，向包含应用程序所有者电子邮件地址的 Amazon ample Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发送提醒，以便进一步处理。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 B**。

- **A 正确**，因为 Amazon S3 事件通知支持 **new object created events**，并且可以向 **Amazon SQS queues** 发送事件通知消息。这使上传存储桶能够在图像上传时自动将一个持久的处理请求放入队列。SQS standard queues 会在确认消息之前，将消息冗余存储在多个 Availability Zones 中，这支持持久性要求。AWS 还将媒体上传后进行后台调整大小/编码工作列为标准队列使用场景。 [Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)
- **B 正确**，因为 Lambda 可以使用 **Amazon SQS event source mapping**。Lambda 会轮询队列、使用消息调用函数，并且当函数成功处理一批消息后，Lambda 会从队列中删除这些消息。这提供了一条自动、无状态的无服务器处理路径。 [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html), [Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)

其他选项错误的原因：

- **C 错误**，因为在 Lambda 内存中保留文本文件来跟踪已处理图像并不持久，并且违反了无状态要求。Lambda 应由 SQS 等事件源触发，而不是在内存中维护处理状态。
- **D 错误**，因为添加 EC2 实例来轮询 SQS 并保留本地文本文件，会引入有状态的服务器组件和不必要的运维开销。Lambda 可以通过 event source mapping 直接从 SQS 读取。 [Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)
- **E 错误**，因为向 SNS 主题发送电子邮件提醒并不会自动处理和压缩图像。虽然 S3 可以将事件发送到 EventBridge/SNS，但此选项将事件路由到人工通知，而不是路由到图像处理工作流。 [Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)

en.question: A company has a three-tier web application that is deployed on AWS. The web servers are deployed in a public subnet in a VPC. The application servers and database servers are deployed in private subnets in the same VPC. The company has deployed a third-party virtual firewall appliance from AWS Marketplace in an inspection VPC. The appliance is configured with an IP interface that can accept IP packets. A solutions architect needs to integrate the web application with the appliance to inspect all traffic to the application before the traffic reaches the web server. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a Network Load Balancer in the public subnet of the application's VPC to route the traffic to the appliance for packet inspection.
options.B: Create an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet of the application's VPC to route the traffic to the appliance for packet inspection.
options.C: Deploy a transit gateway in the inspection VPConfigure route tables to route the incoming packets through the transit gateway.
options.D: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer in the inspection VPC. Create a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint to receive the incoming packets and forward the packets to the appliance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Gateway Load Balancer is the AWS service designed for this exact pattern: deploying, scaling, and managing virtual appliances such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, and deep packet inspection systems. It acts as a transparent network gateway and distributes traffic to appliance targets. AWS documentation states that a Gateway Load Balancer operates at OSI layer 3, listens for **all IP packets across all ports**, and forwards traffic to the configured target group. It also uses **Gateway Load Balancer endpoints** to securely exchange traffic across VPC boundaries, with route tables sending traffic from the application VPC endpoint to the Gateway Load Balancer in the appliance/inspection VPC and then back again ([Gateway Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)). This provides centralized inline inspection with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Network Load Balancer** — An NLB is a layer 4 load balancer that selects targets by protocol and port for TCP/UDP/QUIC flows; it is not the purpose-built transparent L3 appliance insertion service for inspecting all IP packets across VPC boundaries ([Network Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)).
- **B. Application Load Balancer** — An ALB operates at layer 7 and routes based on application-layer listener rules and request content, not all IP packets. It is not suitable for transparent packet inspection by a third-party firewall appliance ([Application Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)).
- **C. Transit gateway** — A transit gateway can provide routing connectivity, but by itself it does not provide the managed appliance distribution, flow stickiness, scaling, and Gateway Load Balancer endpoint integration that AWS documents for virtual appliance inspection. It would require more operational design and management than GWLB.

Therefore, **D** is the best solution.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个部署在 AWS 上的三层 Web 应用程序。Web 服务器部署在 VPC 的公有子网中。应用程序服务器和数据库服务器部署在同一 VPC 的私有子网中。该公司已在一个检查 VPC 中部署了来自 AWS Marketplace 的第三方虚拟防火墙设备。该设备配置了一个可以接收 IP 数据包的 IP 接口。解决方案架构师需要将 Web 应用程序与该设备集成，以便在流量到达 Web 服务器之前检查所有到应用程序的流量。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在应用程序 VPC 的公有子网中创建 Network Load Balancer，将流量路由到该设备以进行数据包检查。
options.B: 在应用程序 VPC 的公有子网中创建 Application Load Balancer，将流量路由到该设备以进行数据包检查。
options.C: 在检查 VPC 中部署 transit gateway。配置路由表以通过 transit gateway 路由传入数据包。
options.D: 在检查 VPC 中部署 Gateway Load Balancer。创建 Gateway Load Balancer endpoint 来接收传入数据包并将数据包转发到该设备。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** Gateway Load Balancer 是 AWS 中专为这种确切模式设计的服务：部署、扩展和管理虚拟设备，例如 firewalls、IDS/IPS 和 deep packet inspection systems。它充当透明的网络网关，并将流量分发到设备目标。AWS 文档说明，Gateway Load Balancer 在 OSI 第 3 层运行，侦听**所有端口上的所有 IP 数据包**，并将流量转发到已配置的目标组。它还使用 **Gateway Load Balancer endpoints** 在 VPC 边界之间安全地交换流量，通过路由表将流量从应用程序 VPC endpoint 发送到设备/检查 VPC 中的 Gateway Load Balancer，然后再返回（[Gateway Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)）。这以最少的运营开销提供了集中式内联检查。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Network Load Balancer** — NLB 是第 4 层负载均衡器，它按协议和端口为 TCP/UDP/QUIC 流选择目标；它不是专门用于在 VPC 边界之间检查所有 IP 数据包的透明 L3 设备插入服务（[Network Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。
- **B. Application Load Balancer** — ALB 在第 7 层运行，并基于应用层侦听器规则和请求内容进行路由，而不是处理所有 IP 数据包。它不适合由第三方防火墙设备进行透明数据包检查（[Application Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。
- **C. Transit gateway** — transit gateway 可以提供路由连接，但它本身不提供 AWS 文档中针对虚拟设备检查所描述的托管式设备分发、流粘性、扩展能力和 Gateway Load Balancer endpoint 集成。与 GWLB 相比，它需要更多的运营设计和管理。因此，**D** 是最佳解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to improve its ability to clone large amounts of production data into a test environment in the same AWS Region. The data is stored in Amazon EC2 instances on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Modifications to the cloned data must not affect the production environment. The software that accesses this data requires consistently high I/O performance. A solutions architect needs to minimize the time that is required to clone the production data into the test environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Restore the snapshots onto EC2 instance store volumes in the test environment.
options.B: Configure the production EBS volumes to use the EBS Multi-Attach feature. Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Attach the production EBS volumes to the EC2 instances in the test environment.
options.C: Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Create and initialize new EBS volumes. Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2 instances in the test environment before restoring the volumes from the production EBS snapshots.
options.D: Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Turn on the EBS fast snapshot restore feature on the EBS snapshots. Restore the snapshots into new EBS volumes. Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2 instances in the test environment.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

EBS snapshots are point-in-time backups that persist independently from the source volume, and AWS states that you can restore **new volumes** from those snapshots at any time, which keeps the test copy separate from production data ([Amazon EBS persistent block storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)). Enabling **EBS fast snapshot restore (FSR)** is the key optimization: FSR creates a volume from a snapshot that is **fully initialized at creation**, eliminates first-access I/O latency, and volumes created with FSR “instantly deliver all of their provisioned performance” ([Amazon EBS fast snapshot restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-fast-snapshot-restore.html)). Therefore, taking snapshots, enabling FSR, and restoring them into new EBS volumes best meets the needs for fast cloning, isolation from production, and consistently high I/O performance.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EBS snapshots are used to create/restore **EBS volumes**, not EC2 instance store volumes. Instance store is temporary storage physically attached to the host and is not the appropriate snapshot-restore target for cloning EBS production data ([Instance store temporary block storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html)).
- **B:** Multi-Attach attaches the **same** EBS volume to multiple instances, and each attached instance has full read/write permission ([EBS Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)). That violates the requirement that modifications in test must not affect production.
- **C:** Creating volumes from snapshots without FSR requires snapshot blocks to be downloaded and written before full performance is reached; during initialization, volumes can experience increased I/O latency and reduced performance ([Create an Amazon EBS volume](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-creating-volume.html), [Initialize Amazon EBS volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-initialize.html)). This does not minimize cloning time while providing immediate consistent high I/O performance.

zh.question: 一家公司希望提高其在同一 AWS Region 中将大量生产数据克隆到测试环境的能力。数据存储在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。对克隆数据的修改不得影响生产环境。访问这些数据的软件需要持续的高 I/O 性能。解决方案架构师需要最大限度地减少将生产数据克隆到测试环境所需的时间。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为生产 EBS 卷创建 EBS 快照。将快照还原到测试环境中的 EC2 instance store 卷。
options.B: 配置生产 EBS 卷以使用 EBS Multi-Attach 功能。为生产 EBS 卷创建 EBS 快照。将生产 EBS 卷附加到测试环境中的 EC2 实例。
options.C: 为生产 EBS 卷创建 EBS 快照。创建并初始化新的 EBS 卷。在从生产 EBS 快照还原卷之前，将新的 EBS 卷附加到测试环境中的 EC2 实例。
options.D: 为生产 EBS 卷创建 EBS 快照。在 EBS 快照上启用 EBS fast snapshot restore 功能。将快照还原到新的 EBS 卷中。将新的 EBS 卷附加到测试环境中的 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

EBS 快照是独立于源卷持久保存的时间点备份，AWS 声明您可以随时从这些快照还原**新卷**，从而使测试副本与生产数据保持分离（[Amazon EBS persistent block storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)）。启用 **EBS fast snapshot restore (FSR)** 是关键优化：FSR 会从快照创建一个在**创建时已完全初始化**的卷，消除首次访问时的 I/O 延迟，并且使用 FSR 创建的卷会“立即提供其所有预置性能”（[Amazon EBS fast snapshot restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-fast-snapshot-restore.html)）。因此，创建快照、启用 FSR，并将其还原到新的 EBS 卷中，最能满足快速克隆、与生产隔离以及持续高 I/O 性能的需求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EBS 快照用于创建/还原 **EBS 卷**，而不是 EC2 instance store 卷。Instance store 是物理附加到主机的临时存储，不适合作为克隆 EBS 生产数据的快照还原目标（[Instance store temporary block storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html)）。
- **B:** Multi-Attach 会将**同一个** EBS 卷附加到多个实例，并且每个已附加的实例都具有完整的读/写权限（[EBS Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。这违反了测试环境中的修改不得影响生产环境的要求。
- **C:** 在没有 FSR 的情况下从快照创建卷，需要先下载并写入快照块，然后才能达到完整性能；在初始化期间，卷可能会经历更高的 I/O 延迟和降低的性能（[Create an Amazon EBS volume](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-creating-volume.html), [Initialize Amazon EBS volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-initialize.html)）。这无法在提供即时且持续高 I/O 性能的同时最大限度地减少克隆时间。

en.question: An ecommerce company wants to launch a one-deal-a-day website on AWS. Each day will feature exactly one product on sale for a period of 24 hours. The company wants to be able to handle millions of requests each hour with millisecond latency during peak hours. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 to host the full website in different S3 buckets. Add Amazon CloudFront distributions. Set the S3 buckets as origins for the distributions. Store the order data in Amazon S3.
options.B: Deploy the full website on Amazon EC2 instances that run in Auto Scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones. Add an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to distribute the website traffic. Add another ALB for the backend APIs. Store the data in Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.C: Migrate the full application to run in containers. Host the containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to increase and decrease the number of pods to process bursts in traffic. Store the data in Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.D: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to host the website's static content. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the S3 bucket as the origin. Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions for the backend APIs. Store the data in Amazon DynamoDB.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** This architecture uses managed/serverless services for each tier, which best matches the need for very high request volume, millisecond latency, and **least operational overhead**. Amazon S3 can host static website content, and CloudFront can accelerate delivery of static content from an S3 bucket by using edge servers and the AWS backbone for a fast, reliable experience ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [CloudFront static content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)). For dynamic backend APIs, API Gateway with Lambda is explicitly part of AWS serverless infrastructure; Lambda runs code without managing servers and handles capacity provisioning, server/OS maintenance, and automatic scaling ([API Gateway serverless infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html), [AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). DynamoDB is a serverless, fully managed database with single-digit millisecond performance at any scale; on-demand capacity can instantly scale up or down with zero administration, making it well suited for spiky ecommerce traffic ([DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** is incomplete and unsuitable for order processing because it stores order data in S3. S3 is appropriate for static website content, but the option does not provide a backend API layer or a low-latency transactional database for orders.
* **B** can scale, but EC2 Auto Scaling groups, ALBs, and RDS require more operational management than serverless services, including instance, database, scaling, and patching considerations. It does not provide the least operational overhead.
* **C** also can scale, but EKS introduces Kubernetes cluster and workload management overhead. Even with autoscaling, operating Kubernetes and RDS is more operationally complex than S3 + CloudFront + API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司希望在 AWS 上推出一个每日一款特价商品的网站。每天将只展示一款促销产品，促销时间为 24 小时。公司希望能够在高峰时段以毫秒级延迟处理每小时数百万个请求。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 在不同的 S3 存储桶中托管整个网站。添加 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将 S3 存储桶设置为这些分配的源。将订单数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。
options.B: 将整个网站部署在跨多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例上。添加 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 来分发网站流量。为后端 API 添加另一个 ALB。将数据存储在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 中。
options.C: 将整个应用程序迁移到容器中运行。将容器托管在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上。使用 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 增加和减少 Pod 数量，以处理突发流量。将数据存储在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 中。
options.D: 使用 Amazon S3 存储桶托管网站的静态内容。部署 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将 S3 存储桶设置为源。将 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数用于后端 API。将数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 该架构在每一层都使用托管/无服务器服务，最符合超高请求量、毫秒级延迟以及**最少运营开销**的需求。Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站内容，而 CloudFront 可以通过使用边缘服务器和 AWS 骨干网络，加速从 S3 存储桶交付静态内容，从而提供快速、可靠的体验（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)，[CloudFront static content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)）。对于动态后端 API，API Gateway 与 Lambda 明确属于 AWS 无服务器基础设施的一部分；Lambda 无需管理服务器即可运行代码，并负责容量预置、服务器/操作系统维护以及自动扩展（[API Gateway serverless infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)，[AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。DynamoDB 是一种无服务器、完全托管的数据库，可在任何规模下提供个位数毫秒级性能；按需容量可以在零管理的情况下即时向上或向下扩展，因此非常适合流量波动明显的电子商务场景（[DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A** 不完整，并且不适合订单处理，因为它将订单数据存储在 S3 中。S3 适合静态网站内容，但该选项没有提供后端 API 层，也没有为订单提供低延迟的事务型数据库。
* **B** 可以扩展，但 EC2 Auto Scaling 组、ALB 和 RDS 比无服务器服务需要更多运营管理，包括实例、数据库、扩展和补丁方面的考虑。它不能提供最少的运营开销。
* **C** 也可以扩展，但 EKS 会引入 Kubernetes 集群和工作负载管理开销。即使使用自动扩展，运营 Kubernetes 和 RDS 也比 S3 + CloudFront + API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB 更复杂。

en.question: A solutions architect is using Amazon S3 to design the storage architecture of a new digital media application. The media files must be resilient to the loss of an Availability Zone. Some files are accessed frequently while other files are rarely accessed in an unpredictable pattern. The solutions architect must minimize the costs of storing and retrieving the media files. Which storage option meets these requirements?

options.A: S3 Standard
options.B: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.C: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.D: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. S3 Intelligent-Tiering**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering is the best fit because the workload has **unknown/unpredictable access patterns** and must minimize storage and retrieval costs. AWS states that S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed to optimize costs by automatically moving objects to the most cost-effective access tier as access patterns change, is ideal for data with unknown or changing access patterns, and has **no retrieval fees**. The S3 storage-class comparison also lists S3 Intelligent-Tiering as designed for “unknown, changing, or unpredictable access patterns” and storing data across **>= 3 Availability Zones** ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). Its automatic tiers keep frequently accessed objects in Frequent Access and move objects not accessed for 30/90 days to lower-cost tiers while retaining low-latency performance in the automatic tiers ([AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 Standard**: It is resilient across **>= 3 AZs**, but it is designed for frequently accessed data and does not automatically optimize costs for mixed/unpredictable access patterns ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **C. S3 Standard-IA**: It is resilient to AZ loss, but it is designed for long-lived, infrequently accessed data and has per-GB retrieval fees, making it less suitable when some objects are frequently accessed and access is unpredictable ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **D. S3 One Zone-IA**: It is stored in only **one Availability Zone** and AWS explicitly says it is **not resilient to the physical loss of the Availability Zone**, so it fails the resilience requirement ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在使用 Amazon S3 为新的数字媒体应用程序设计存储架构。媒体文件必须能够抵御一个 Availability Zone 丢失的情况。有些文件会被频繁访问，而其他文件则很少被访问，且访问模式不可预测。解决方案架构师必须最大限度地降低存储和检索媒体文件的成本。哪种存储选项满足这些要求？

options.A: S3 Standard
options.B: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.C: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.D: S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. S3 Intelligent-Tiering**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是最佳选择，因为该工作负载具有 **未知/不可预测的访问模式**，并且必须最大限度地降低存储和检索成本。AWS 表示，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在通过在访问模式变化时自动将对象移动到最具成本效益的访问层来优化成本，适用于访问模式未知或变化的数据，并且**没有检索费用**。S3 存储类比较还将 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 列为专为“unknown, changing, or unpredictable access patterns”而设计，并将数据存储在 **>= 3 Availability Zones** 中（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。其自动层会将频繁访问的对象保留在 Frequent Access 中，并将 30/90 天未访问的对象移动到成本更低的层，同时在自动层中保持低延迟性能（[AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. S3 Standard**：它在 **>= 3 AZs** 中具备弹性，但它是为频繁访问的数据而设计的，无法针对混合/不可预测的访问模式自动优化成本（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **C. S3 Standard-IA**：它能够抵御 AZ 丢失，但它是为长期保存、不频繁访问的数据而设计的，并且按 GB 收取检索费用，因此当某些对象被频繁访问且访问模式不可预测时，它不太适合（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **D. S3 One Zone-IA**：它仅存储在 **one Availability Zone** 中，并且 AWS 明确表示它 **not resilient to the physical loss of the Availability Zone**，因此不满足弹性要求（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A company is storing backup files by using Amazon S3 Standard storage. The files are accessed frequently for 1 month. However, the files are not accessed after 1 month. The company must keep the files indefinitely. Which storage solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically migrate objects.
options.B: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 month.
options.C: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 1 month.
options.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone- Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 1 month.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The access pattern is known: files are frequently accessed for 1 month and then not accessed, but must be retained indefinitely. Amazon S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to less-expensive storage classes and archive them, and AWS explicitly supports transitioning from **S3 Standard** directly to **S3 Glacier Deep Archive** by using an S3 Lifecycle configuration. AWS also states that S3 Glacier Deep Archive is designed for multi-year retention, backup/disaster recovery, and data accessed less than once a year, and that it is the **lowest-cost storage option in AWS**. Therefore, transitioning the objects after 1 month to S3 Glacier Deep Archive is the most cost-effective fit for indefinite, rarely accessed backup retention ([S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html), [S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering** is best when access patterns are unknown or changing; AWS says to use it when you do not know object access patterns or they change over time. Here the pattern is known, and Deep Archive is lower cost for long-term archive data ([S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)).
- **C. S3 Standard-IA** is for infrequently accessed data that still needs real-time access. The files are not accessed after 1 month, so an archival class is more cost-effective. AWS states storage classes with less frequent access and longer retrieval times offer lower storage costs, and Deep Archive is the lowest-cost option ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).
- **D. S3 One Zone-IA** is also an infrequent-access class, not the lowest-cost long-term archive class. It does not match the long-term archival requirement as cost-effectively as S3 Glacier Deep Archive ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon S3 Standard 存储来存储备份文件。这些文件在 1 个月内会被频繁访问。但是，1 个月后这些文件不再被访问。公司必须无限期保留这些文件。哪种存储解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 以自动迁移对象。
options.B: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 1 个月后将对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 1 个月后将对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
options.D: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，在 1 个月后将对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 One Zone- Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 访问模式是已知的：文件在 1 个月内被频繁访问，之后不再访问，但必须无限期保留。Amazon S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的存储类并对其进行归档，而且 AWS 明确支持通过使用 S3 Lifecycle 配置，直接从 **S3 Standard** 转换到 **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**。AWS 还说明，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 专为多年期保留、备份/灾难恢复以及每年访问少于一次的数据而设计，并且它是 **AWS 中成本最低的存储选项**。因此，在 1 个月后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，是针对无限期、很少访问的备份保留需求最具成本效益的匹配方案（[S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)，[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering** 最适用于访问模式未知或会变化的情况；AWS 表示，当你不知道对象访问模式或访问模式会随时间变化时使用它。这里的模式是已知的，而对于长期归档数据，Deep Archive 的成本更低（[S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。
- **C. S3 Standard-IA** 适用于不频繁访问但仍需要实时访问的数据。这些文件在 1 个月后不再被访问，因此归档类更具成本效益。AWS 说明，访问频率更低且检索时间更长的存储类可提供更低的存储成本，而 Deep Archive 是成本最低的选项（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。
- **D. S3 One Zone-IA** 也是一种不频繁访问类，而不是成本最低的长期归档类。它在成本效益方面不如 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 那样符合长期归档要求（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

en.question: A company observes an increase in Amazon EC2 costs in its most recent bill. The billing team notices unwanted vertical scaling of instance types for a couple of EC2 instances. A solutions architect needs to create a graph comparing the last 2 months of EC2 costs and perform an in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of the vertical scaling. How should the solutions architect generate the information with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget report and compare EC2 costs based on instance types.
options.B: Use Cost Explorer's granular filtering feature to perform an in-depth analysis of EC2 costs based on instance types.
options.C: Use graphs from the AWS Billing and Cost Management dashboard to compare EC2 costs based on instance types for the last 2 months.
options.D: Use AWS Cost and Usage Reports to create a report and send it to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon QuickSight with Amazon S3 as a source to generate an interactive graph based on instance types.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**. AWS Cost Explorer is designed to view and analyze cost and usage, including using the main graph and Cost Explorer reports. It can show data for up to the last 13 months, which covers the required 2-month comparison, and it is explicitly intended to help identify areas that need further inquiry and cost trends ([Cost Explorer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)). Cost Explorer also lets you change report filters and constraints, and the Cost Explorer API documentation confirms that cost and usage data can be filtered and grouped by dimensions in a time range; `INSTANCE_TYPE` is a valid `GroupBy` dimension ([GetCostAndUsage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/latest/APIReference/API_GetCostAndUsage.html)). Therefore, using Cost Explorer filtering/grouping by EC2 instance type provides the needed graph and in-depth analysis with the least operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A:** AWS Budgets is primarily for tracking costs/usage against budgets and alerts, not for detailed ad hoc root-cause analysis of vertical scaling by instance type. It is less suitable than Cost Explorer for in-depth cost exploration.
- **C:** The Billing and Cost Management home/dashboard pages provide high-level widgets and summaries, but the question requires an in-depth analysis by instance type. Cost Explorer reports provide the more appropriate customizable filters/groupings and graphing capability.
- **D:** AWS Cost and Usage Reports can provide comprehensive data and can be delivered to S3 and analyzed with other tools, but AWS documentation notes that CUR publishes report files to an S3 bucket and can involve files/manifest files and downstream analysis tools ([AWS CUR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)). Building a QuickSight analysis from S3 adds unnecessary operational overhead compared with using Cost Explorer directly.

zh.question: 一家公司在最近的账单中发现 Amazon EC2 成本增加。账单团队注意到有几个 EC2 实例的实例类型发生了不必要的垂直扩展。解决方案架构师需要创建一个图表来比较过去 2 个月的 EC2 成本，并进行深入分析以确定垂直扩展的根本原因。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的运营开销生成这些信息？

options.A: 使用 AWS Budgets 创建预算报告，并根据实例类型比较 EC2 成本。
options.B: 使用 Cost Explorer 的精细筛选功能，根据实例类型对 EC2 成本执行深入分析。
options.C: 使用 AWS Billing and Cost Management 控制面板中的图表，根据实例类型比较过去 2 个月的 EC2 成本。
options.D: 使用 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 创建报告并将其发送到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon QuickSight 并以 Amazon S3 作为源，根据实例类型生成交互式图表。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。AWS Cost Explorer 旨在查看和分析成本与使用量，包括使用主图表和 Cost Explorer 报告。它可以显示最长过去 13 个月的数据，覆盖所需的 2 个月比较，并且其明确用途是帮助识别需要进一步调查的领域和成本趋势（[Cost Explorer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)）。Cost Explorer 还允许你更改报告筛选条件和约束，并且 Cost Explorer API 文档确认，可以在时间范围内按维度筛选和分组成本与使用量数据；`INSTANCE_TYPE` 是有效的 `GroupBy` 维度（[GetCostAndUsage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-cost-management/latest/APIReference/API_GetCostAndUsage.html)）。因此，使用 Cost Explorer 按 EC2 实例类型进行筛选/分组，可以以最少的运营开销提供所需的图表和深入分析。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A:** AWS Budgets 主要用于根据预算和警报跟踪成本/使用量，而不是按实例类型对垂直扩展进行详细的临时根因分析。与 Cost Explorer 相比，它不太适合深入的成本探索。
- **C:** Billing and Cost Management 主页/控制面板页面提供高层级的小组件和摘要，但题目要求按实例类型进行深入分析。Cost Explorer 报告提供了更合适的可自定义筛选/分组和图表功能。
- **D:** AWS Cost and Usage Reports 可以提供全面的数据，并可交付到 S3 且使用其他工具进行分析，但 AWS 文档指出 CUR 会将报告文件发布到 S3 存储桶，并且可能涉及文件/清单文件和下游分析工具（[AWS CUR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)）。与直接使用 Cost Explorer 相比，从 S3 构建 QuickSight 分析会增加不必要的运营开销。

en.question: A company is designing an application. The application uses an AWS Lambda function to receive information through Amazon API Gateway and to store the information in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. During the proof-of-concept stage, the company has to increase the Lambda quotas significantly to handle the high volumes of data that the company needs to load into the database. A solutions architect must recommend a new design to improve scalability and minimize the configuration effort. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Refactor the Lambda function code to Apache Tomcat code that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Connect the database by using native Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers.
options.B: Change the platform from Aurora to Amazon DynamoDProvision a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Use the DAX client SDK to point the existing DynamoDB API calls at the DAX cluster.
options.C: Set up two Lambda functions. Configure one function to receive the information. Configure the other function to load the information into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
options.D: Set up two Lambda functions. Configure one function to receive the information. Configure the other function to load the information into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Using an **Amazon SQS queue between two Lambda functions** decouples ingestion from database writes. The first Lambda can quickly accept API Gateway requests and enqueue work; the second Lambda can process messages from the queue at a controlled rate. AWS documentation states that, for SQS event source mappings, **Lambda polls the queue**, invokes the function with **batches of multiple messages**, and deletes messages after successful processing. If processing fails, messages become visible again after the visibility timeout, providing buffering and retry behavior for spikes in load ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). AWS also documents that SQS event source mappings can scale Lambda invocations and support **maximum concurrency** to control how many concurrent function instances an SQS source can invoke, which helps protect the Aurora database from being overwhelmed ([Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)). This improves scalability with minimal redesign and keeps the existing serverless/Aurora architecture.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Moving the Lambda function to Apache Tomcat on EC2 would require application refactoring and EC2 operational configuration. It does not provide the simple managed buffering/back-pressure mechanism needed between high-volume ingestion and database writes.
- **B:** DynamoDB is a **NoSQL** database, unlike the existing Aurora PostgreSQL relational database, so this would require a major data-model/platform change. Also, DAX is a cache for DynamoDB read operations such as `GetItem`, `BatchGetItem`, `Query`, and `Scan`; it is not a solution for loading high write volumes into Aurora ([DAX cache behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-config-considerations.html), [DynamoDB characteristics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)).
- **C:** SNS can deliver messages to Lambda subscribers, but it is primarily a pub/sub delivery service to subscribers such as Lambda, SQS, HTTP/S, email, and SMS ([What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). Direct SNS-to-Lambda delivery does not provide the same queue-based buffering, polling, batching, and concurrency controls that SQS provides for smoothing load into the database.

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一个应用程序。该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数通过 Amazon API Gateway 接收信息，并将信息存储在 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库中。在概念验证阶段，该公司必须显著提高 Lambda 配额，以处理需要加载到数据库中的大量数据。解决方案架构师必须推荐一种新的设计，以提高可扩展性并尽量减少配置工作量。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数代码重构为在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的 Apache Tomcat 代码。使用原生 Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) 驱动程序连接数据库。
options.B: 将平台从 Aurora 更改为 Amazon DynamoDProvision 一个 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。使用 DAX client SDK 将现有 DynamoDB API 调用指向 DAX 集群。
options.C: 设置两个 Lambda 函数。配置一个函数来接收信息。配置另一个函数将信息加载到数据库中。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 集成这些 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 设置两个 Lambda 函数。配置一个函数来接收信息。配置另一个函数将信息加载到数据库中。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列集成这些 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

在两个 Lambda 函数之间使用 **Amazon SQS 队列**，可以将摄取与数据库写入解耦。第一个 Lambda 可以快速接受 API Gateway 请求并将工作加入队列；第二个 Lambda 可以以受控速率处理队列中的消息。AWS 文档说明，对于 SQS 事件源映射，**Lambda 会轮询队列**，使用**多条消息的批次**调用函数，并在成功处理后删除消息。如果处理失败，消息会在可见性超时后再次变为可见，从而为负载峰值提供缓冲和重试行为（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。AWS 还记录了 SQS 事件源映射可以扩展 Lambda 调用，并支持**最大并发数**来控制一个 SQS 源可以调用多少个并发函数实例，这有助于保护 Aurora 数据库不被压垮（[Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)）。这以最少的重新设计提高了可扩展性，并保留了现有的 serverless/Aurora 架构。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将 Lambda 函数迁移到 EC2 上的 Apache Tomcat，需要进行应用程序重构和 EC2 运维配置。它无法在高容量摄取与数据库写入之间提供所需的简单托管缓冲/反压机制。
- **B:** DynamoDB 是 **NoSQL** 数据库，不同于现有的 Aurora PostgreSQL 关系数据库，因此这需要重大的数据模型/平台变更。此外，DAX 是用于 DynamoDB 读取操作的缓存，例如 `GetItem`、`BatchGetItem`、`Query` 和 `Scan`；它不是用于将高写入量加载到 Aurora 的解决方案（[DAX cache behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-config-considerations.html), [DynamoDB characteristics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。
- **C:** SNS 可以向 Lambda 订阅者传递消息，但它主要是一个面向订阅者的 pub/sub 传递服务，订阅者包括 Lambda、SQS、HTTP/S、email 和 SMS（[What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。直接 SNS-to-Lambda 传递不提供 SQS 所提供的相同基于队列的缓冲、轮询、批处理和并发控制，这些能力可用于平滑进入数据库的负载。

en.question: A company needs to review its AWS Cloud deployment to ensure that its Amazon S3 buckets do not have unauthorized configuration changes. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this goal?

options.A: Turn on AWS Config with the appropriate rules.
options.B: Turn on AWS Trusted Advisor with the appropriate checks.
options.C: Turn on Amazon Inspector with the appropriate assessment template.
options.D: Turn on Amazon S3 server access logging. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon Cloud Watch Events).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Turn on AWS Config with the appropriate rules.**

AWS Config is the service designed to review and govern AWS resource configurations. The AWS Config documentation states that it provides visibility into how resources are configured, can notify when resources are created/modified/deleted, and that **AWS Config rules evaluate configuration settings**; if a resource violates a rule, AWS Config marks it noncompliant and sends a notification. It also provides historical configurations for auditing and compliance. This directly matches the need to ensure S3 buckets do not have unauthorized configuration changes ([AWS Config: What Is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. AWS Trusted Advisor** — Trusted Advisor inspects an AWS environment and makes best-practice recommendations for cost, availability, performance, and security gaps. It is not the primary service for recording resource configuration history or continuously evaluating S3 bucket configuration changes against rules ([AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html)).
- **C. Amazon Inspector** — Amazon Inspector is for vulnerability and network exposure scanning of eligible resources, producing vulnerability findings and remediation recommendations. It is not used to audit S3 bucket configuration changes ([Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).
- **D. S3 server access logging with EventBridge** — S3 server access logging records **requests made to a bucket**, including request type, resources, and time/date. That can help with access audits, but it does not evaluate bucket configurations against compliance rules or maintain configuration compliance state like AWS Config does ([Enabling Amazon S3 server access logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/enable-server-access-logging.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要审查其 AWS Cloud 部署，以确保其 Amazon S3 存储桶没有未经授权的配置更改。解决方案架构师应如何实现这一目标？

options.A: 开启 AWS Config 并使用适当的规则。
options.B: 开启 AWS Trusted Advisor 并使用适当的检查。
options.C: 开启 Amazon Inspector 并使用适当的评估模板。
options.D: 开启 Amazon S3 服务器访问日志记录。配置 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon Cloud Watch Events)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 开启 AWS Config 并使用适当的规则。**

AWS Config 是为审查和治理 AWS 资源配置而设计的服务。AWS Config 文档指出，它可以让你了解资源的配置方式，可以在资源被创建/修改/删除时发出通知，并且 **AWS Config rules evaluate configuration settings**；如果某个资源违反规则，AWS Config 会将其标记为不合规并发送通知。它还提供用于审计和合规的历史配置。这直接符合确保 S3 存储桶没有未经授权配置更改的需求（[AWS Config: What Is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. AWS Trusted Advisor** — Trusted Advisor 会检查 AWS 环境，并针对成本、可用性、性能和安全差距提出最佳实践建议。它不是用于记录资源配置历史或根据规则持续评估 S3 存储桶配置更改的主要服务（[AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html)）。
- **C. Amazon Inspector** — Amazon Inspector 用于对符合条件的资源进行漏洞和网络暴露扫描，生成漏洞发现结果和修复建议。它不用于审计 S3 存储桶配置更改（[Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。
- **D. S3 server access logging with EventBridge** — S3 服务器访问日志记录会记录**对存储桶发出的请求**，包括请求类型、资源以及时间/日期。这可以帮助进行访问审计，但它不会像 AWS Config 那样根据合规规则评估存储桶配置，也不会维护配置合规状态（[Enabling Amazon S3 server access logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/enable-server-access-logging.html)）。

en.question: A company is launching a new application and will display application metrics on an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard. The company's product manager needs to access this dashboard periodically. The product manager does not have an AWS account. A solutions architect must provide access to the product manager by following the principle of least privilege. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share the dashboard from the CloudWatch console. Enter the product manager's email address, and complete the sharing steps. Provide a shareable link for the dashboard to the product manager.
options.B: Create an IAM user specifically for the product manager. Attach the CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess AWS managed policy to the user. Share the new login credentials with the product manager. Share the browser URL of the correct dashboard with the product manager.
options.C: Create an IAM user for the company's employees. Attach the ViewOnlyAccess AWS managed policy to the IAM user. Share the new login credentials with the product manager. Ask the product manager to navigate to the CloudWatch console and locate the dashboard by name in the Dashboards section.
options.D: Deploy a bastion server in a public subnet. When the product manager requires access to the dashboard, start the server and share the RDP credentials. On the bastion server, ensure that the browser is configured to open the dashboard URL with cached AWS credentials that have appropriate permissions to view the dashboard.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon CloudWatch supports sharing a dashboard with specific users by email address. The AWS procedure says to choose **Actions → Share dashboard**, select **Share your dashboard and require a username and password**, add the users’ email addresses, then **Confirm and generate shareable link**; the invited users receive credentials separately and use the link to connect to the dashboard ([Sharing a CloudWatch dashboard with specific users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/share-cloudwatch-dashboard-email-addresses.html)). This meets the requirement because the product manager does not need an AWS account, and access is limited to the shared dashboard workflow rather than general AWS console access. AWS also provides a way to review and adjust the IAM role permissions for shared dashboards, including limiting alarm and Contributor Insights visibility where applicable ([Reviewing shared CloudWatch dashboard permissions and changing permission scope](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/share-cloudwatch-dashboard-review-permissions.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Creating an IAM user gives the product manager an AWS account login, which is unnecessary. The `CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess` managed policy is broader than dashboard viewing; AWS states it grants read-only access to CloudWatch and related observability features and includes permissions for Logs, Auto Scaling, Application Signals, SNS, X-Ray, RUM, Synthetics, and more ([CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/managed-policies-cloudwatch.html)). That is not least privilege for periodically viewing one dashboard.
- **C:** This also creates and shares AWS login credentials unnecessarily and uses a broad view-only access approach rather than access to the specific dashboard. AWS defines least privilege as granting only the permissions required to perform a task ([Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).
- **D:** A bastion server with cached AWS credentials is operationally complex, creates unnecessary infrastructure and credential exposure, and does not align with least privilege when CloudWatch has a native dashboard sharing feature for this use case.

zh.question: 一家公司正在发布一个新应用程序，并将在 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板上显示应用程序指标。公司的产品经理需要定期访问此控制面板。该产品经理没有 AWS 账户。解决方案架构师必须遵循最小权限原则为产品经理提供访问权限。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 CloudWatch 控制台共享该控制面板。输入产品经理的电子邮件地址，并完成共享步骤。向产品经理提供该控制面板的可共享链接。
options.B: 专门为产品经理创建一个 IAM 用户。将 CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess AWS 托管策略附加到该用户。与产品经理共享新的登录凭证。将正确控制面板的浏览器 URL 共享给产品经理。
options.C: 为公司的员工创建一个 IAM 用户。将 ViewOnlyAccess AWS 托管策略附加到该 IAM 用户。与产品经理共享新的登录凭证。要求产品经理导航到 CloudWatch 控制台，并在 Dashboards 部分按名称找到该控制面板。
options.D: 在公有子网中部署一台堡垒服务器。当产品经理需要访问该控制面板时，启动该服务器并共享 RDP 凭证。在堡垒服务器上，确保浏览器配置为使用缓存的、具有查看该控制面板所需适当权限的 AWS 凭证来打开控制面板 URL。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

Amazon CloudWatch 支持通过电子邮件地址与特定用户共享控制面板。AWS 流程说明选择 **Actions → Share dashboard**，选择 **Share your dashboard and require a username and password**，添加用户的电子邮件地址，然后选择 **Confirm and generate shareable link**；受邀用户会单独收到凭证，并使用该链接连接到控制面板（[Sharing a CloudWatch dashboard with specific users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/share-cloudwatch-dashboard-email-addresses.html)）。这满足要求，因为产品经理不需要 AWS 账户，并且访问权限仅限于共享控制面板工作流，而不是一般的 AWS 控制台访问。AWS 还提供了一种方式来查看和调整共享控制面板的 IAM 角色权限，包括在适用时限制 alarm 和 Contributor Insights 的可见性（[Reviewing shared CloudWatch dashboard permissions and changing permission scope](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/share-cloudwatch-dashboard-review-permissions.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 创建 IAM 用户会给产品经理一个 AWS 账户登录身份，这是不必要的。`CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess` 托管策略的范围比查看控制面板更广；AWS 表示它授予对 CloudWatch 及相关可观测性功能的只读访问权限，并包含 Logs、Auto Scaling、Application Signals、SNS、X-Ray、RUM、Synthetics 等权限（[CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/managed-policies-cloudwatch.html)）。对于定期查看一个控制面板来说，这不是最小权限。
- **C:** 这同样会不必要地创建并共享 AWS 登录凭证，并使用广泛的只读访问方式，而不是访问特定控制面板。AWS 将最小权限定义为仅授予执行任务所需的权限（[Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。
- **D:** 使用带缓存 AWS 凭证的堡垒服务器在运营上复杂，会产生不必要的基础设施和凭证暴露，并且在 CloudWatch 针对此用例已有原生控制面板共享功能的情况下，不符合最小权限原则。

en.question: A company is migrating applications to AWS. The applications are deployed in different accounts. The company manages the accounts centrally by using AWS Organizations. The company's security team needs a single sign-on (SSO) solution across all the company's accounts. The company must continue managing the users and groups in its on-premises self-managed Microsoft Active Directory. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console. Create a one-way forest trust or a one-way domain trust to connect the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.
options.B: Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console. Create a two-way forest trust to connect the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.
options.C: Use AWS Directory Service. Create a two-way trust relationship with the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory.
options.D: Deploy an identity provider (IdP) on premises. Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Single Sign-On is now **AWS IAM Identity Center**. IAM Identity Center is designed to provide workforce users access to AWS accounts and applications, and it supports organization instances that provide “a single point from which to manage user access across AWS” for AWS Organizations accounts ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)). For a self-managed on-premises Microsoft AD connected through AWS Managed Microsoft AD, AWS explicitly states to **create a two-way trust relationship**; “one-way trusts do not work with IAM Identity Center,” because IAM Identity Center must read and synchronize user and group metadata from the AD domain ([Connect a self-managed directory in Active Directory to IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/connectonpremad.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** is incorrect because it allows a one-way forest or domain trust. AWS documentation explicitly says one-way trusts do **not** work with IAM Identity Center for this use case.
* **C** is incorrect because creating only an AWS Directory Service trust relationship does not by itself enable the central AWS SSO/IAM Identity Center access solution across AWS Organizations accounts.
* **D** is incorrect because merely deploying an on-premises IdP and enabling AWS SSO does not describe the required integration for continuing to use self-managed Microsoft AD users and groups with IAM Identity Center. The documented AWS Directory Service path for self-managed AD via AWS Managed Microsoft AD requires a **two-way trust**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将应用程序迁移到 AWS。这些应用程序部署在不同的账户中。公司使用 AWS Organizations 集中管理这些账户。公司的安全团队需要一个覆盖公司所有账户的单点登录 (SSO) 解决方案。公司必须继续在其本地自管理的 Microsoft Active Directory 中管理用户和组。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 AWS SSO 控制台启用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO)。通过使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory，创建单向林信任或单向域信任，以将公司的自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 与 AWS SSO 连接起来。
options.B: 从 AWS SSO 控制台启用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO)。通过使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory，创建双向林信任，以将公司的自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 与 AWS SSO 连接起来。
options.C: 使用 AWS Directory Service。与公司的自管理 Microsoft Active Directory 创建双向信任关系。
options.D: 在本地部署身份提供商 (IdP)。从 AWS SSO 控制台启用 AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Single Sign-On 现在是 **AWS IAM Identity Center**。IAM Identity Center 旨在为员工用户提供对 AWS 账户和应用程序的访问，并且它支持组织实例，为 AWS Organizations 账户提供“一个用于管理整个 AWS 用户访问权限的单一位置”（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。对于通过 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 连接的自管理本地 Microsoft AD，AWS 明确说明要**创建双向信任关系**；“单向信任不适用于 IAM Identity Center”，因为 IAM Identity Center 必须从 AD 域读取并同步用户和组元数据（[Connect a self-managed directory in Active Directory to IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/connectonpremad.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A** 不正确，因为它允许单向林信任或域信任。AWS 文档明确说明，对于此用例，单向信任**不**适用于 IAM Identity Center。
* **C** 不正确，因为仅创建 AWS Directory Service 信任关系本身并不能启用跨 AWS Organizations 账户的集中式 AWS SSO/IAM Identity Center 访问解决方案。
* **D** 不正确，因为仅部署本地 IdP 并启用 AWS SSO，并未描述继续将自管理 Microsoft AD 用户和组与 IAM Identity Center 一起使用所需的集成。通过 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 使用自管理 AD 的 AWS Directory Service 文档化路径需要**双向信任**。

en.question: A company provides a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) service that uses UDP connections. The service consists of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. The company has deployments across multiple AWS Regions. The company needs to route users to the Region with the lowest latency. The company also needs automated failover between Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the NLB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the ALB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
options.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 latency record that points to aliases for each NLB. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the latency record as an origin.
options.D: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted record that points to aliases for each ALB. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the weighted record as an origin.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

A VoIP service using **UDP** needs a Layer 4 load balancer and a global routing service that can route users to the closest healthy Region and fail over automatically. A **Network Load Balancer** is appropriate because NLB listeners support **UDP** (as well as TCP, TLS, TCP_UDP, etc.) on ports 1-65535 ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)). Elastic Load Balancing also integrates with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling so instances launched by the Auto Scaling group are automatically registered with the load balancer and terminated instances are deregistered ([ELB related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)).

Using the NLBs as **AWS Global Accelerator** endpoints meets the multi-Region routing and failover requirements: Global Accelerator routes traffic over the AWS global network to endpoints in the **nearest Region** to the client, supports endpoints such as **Network Load Balancers** in one or multiple Regions, and routes based on health, client location, and configured policies ([What is Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Global Accelerator also tries to fail over to a healthy endpoint in another endpoint group/Region when endpoints are unhealthy ([failover behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-endpoint-weights.unhealthy-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An Application Load Balancer is not suitable for UDP VoIP traffic. ALB listeners support only **HTTP and HTTPS**, not UDP ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
- **C:** Although an NLB supports UDP, placing **CloudFront** in front is not appropriate for a UDP VoIP service. CloudFront is a web content delivery service; origins are S3 or **HTTP servers**, and objects are served over HTTP ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **D:** This has multiple problems: ALB does not support UDP, Route 53 **weighted** records do not specifically route to the lowest-latency Region, and CloudFront is for HTTP/web content rather than UDP VoIP traffic ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html), [CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司提供使用 UDP 连接的 Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) 服务。该服务由在 Auto Scaling group 中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例组成。该公司在多个 AWS Regions 中都有部署。公司需要将用户路由到延迟最低的 Region。公司还需要在 Regions 之间实现自动故障转移。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 和一个关联的目标组。将目标组与 Auto Scaling group 关联。在每个 Region 中将 NLB 用作 AWS Global Accelerator 端点。
options.B: 部署一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 和一个关联的目标组。将目标组与 Auto Scaling group 关联。在每个 Region 中将 ALB 用作 AWS Global Accelerator 端点。
options.C: 部署一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 和一个关联的目标组。将目标组与 Auto Scaling group 关联。创建一条 Amazon Route 53 延迟记录，指向每个 NLB 的别名。创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并使用该延迟记录作为源站。
options.D: 部署一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 和一个关联的目标组。将目标组与 Auto Scaling group 关联。创建一条 Amazon Route 53 加权记录，指向每个 ALB 的别名。部署一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并使用该加权记录作为源站。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

使用 **UDP** 的 VoIP 服务需要一个第 4 层负载均衡器，以及一个能够将用户路由到最近的健康 Region 并自动故障转移的全局路由服务。**Network Load Balancer** 是合适的，因为 NLB 侦听器在端口 1-65535 上支持 **UDP**（以及 TCP、TLS、TCP_UDP 等）（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。Elastic Load Balancing 还与 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 集成，因此 Auto Scaling group 启动的实例会自动注册到负载均衡器，终止的实例会被注销（[ELB related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。将 NLB 用作 **AWS Global Accelerator** 端点可以满足多 Region 路由和故障转移要求：Global Accelerator 通过 AWS global network 将流量路由到距离客户端**最近的 Region** 中的端点，支持一个或多个 Regions 中的 **Network Load Balancers** 等端点，并根据运行状况、客户端位置和配置的策略进行路由（[What is Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。当端点不健康时，Global Accelerator 还会尝试故障转移到另一个端点组/Region 中的健康端点（[failover behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-endpoint-weights.unhealthy-endpoints.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Application Load Balancer 不适用于 UDP VoIP 流量。ALB 侦听器仅支持 **HTTP and HTTPS**，不支持 UDP（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
- **C:** 虽然 NLB 支持 UDP，但在前面放置 **CloudFront** 不适合 UDP VoIP 服务。CloudFront 是一种 Web 内容分发服务；源站是 S3 或 **HTTP servers**，对象通过 HTTP 提供服务（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **D:** 这有多个问题：ALB 不支持 UDP，Route 53 **weighted** 记录不会专门路由到最低延迟的 Region，而 CloudFront 用于 HTTP/Web 内容，而不是 UDP VoIP 流量（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html), [CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

en.question: A development team runs monthly resource-intensive tests on its general purpose Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with Performance Insights enabled. The testing lasts for 48 hours once a month and is the only process that uses the database. The team wants to reduce the cost of running the tests without reducing the compute and memory attributes of the DB instance. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Stop the DB instance when tests are completed. Restart the DB instance when required.
options.B: Use an Auto Scaling policy with the DB instance to automatically scale when tests are completed.
options.C: Create a snapshot when tests are completed. Terminate the DB instance and restore the snapshot when required.
options.D: Modify the DB instance to a low-capacity instance when tests are completed. Modify the DB instance again when required.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The tests run for only 48 hours per month, so the most cost-effective approach is to keep only a restorable backup between test runs and avoid running or retaining the DB instance’s provisioned storage for the rest of the month. Amazon RDS documentation states that when deleting a DB instance, you can create a final DB snapshot, and if you take that snapshot, you can use it to restore the deleted DB instance later; RDS retains final and manual snapshots after deletion ([Deleting a DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_DeleteInstance.html)). RDS also documents that you can restore a DB instance from a DB snapshot and specify instance settings during restore ([Restoring to a DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_RestoreFromSnapshot.html)). Restoring the snapshot to the same DB instance class preserves the required compute and memory attributes during the tests.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Stop the DB instance** — Stopping saves DB instance-hour charges, but RDS explicitly says stopped instances still incur charges for provisioned storage, Provisioned IOPS if applicable, backup storage, snapshots, and automated backups. Also, a stopped RDS DB instance is automatically restarted after 7 consecutive days ([Stopping an Amazon RDS DB instance temporarily](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)). Since the idle period is almost a month, this is not the most cost-effective option.
- **B. Use an Auto Scaling policy** — RDS storage autoscaling is for increasing allocated storage capacity; it cannot decrease allocated storage after it has been allocated ([Managing capacity automatically with Amazon RDS storage autoscaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIOPS.Autoscaling.html)). It does not automatically scale the DB instance’s compute and memory down after tests.
- **D. Modify to a low-capacity instance** — RDS supports modifying settings such as the DB instance class, but AWS notes that some modifications can cause downtime ([Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)). More importantly, this option reduces the compute and memory attributes while the instance continues to exist and incur charges, so it does not meet the requirement as cost-effectively as deleting and restoring from a snapshot.

zh.question: 一个开发团队在其启用了 Performance Insights 的通用型 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance 上运行每月一次的资源密集型测试。测试每月进行一次，持续 48 小时，并且这是唯一使用该数据库的进程。团队希望在不降低 DB instance 的计算和内存属性的情况下降低运行测试的成本。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些要求？

options.A: 测试完成后停止 DB instance。需要时重新启动 DB instance。
options.B: 对 DB instance 使用 Auto Scaling 策略，以便在测试完成后自动扩展。
options.C: 测试完成后创建快照。终止 DB instance，并在需要时还原快照。
options.D: 测试完成后将 DB instance 修改为低容量实例。需要时再次修改 DB instance。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

测试每月只运行 48 小时，因此最具成本效益的方法是在测试运行之间仅保留可还原的备份，并避免在当月其余时间运行或保留 DB instance 的预置存储。Amazon RDS 文档说明，删除 DB instance 时可以创建最终 DB snapshot；如果创建了该快照，则之后可以使用它还原已删除的 DB instance；RDS 会在删除后保留最终快照和手动快照（[Deleting a DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_DeleteInstance.html)）。RDS 还说明，可以从 DB snapshot 还原 DB instance，并在还原期间指定实例设置（[Restoring to a DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_RestoreFromSnapshot.html)）。将快照还原到相同的 DB instance class，可在测试期间保留所需的计算和内存属性。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Stop the DB instance** — 停止可节省 DB instance-hour 费用，但 RDS 明确说明，已停止的实例仍会产生预置存储、Provisioned IOPS（如果适用）、备份存储、快照和自动备份的费用。此外，已停止的 RDS DB instance 会在连续 7 天后自动重启（[Stopping an Amazon RDS DB instance temporarily](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。由于空闲期接近一个月，因此这不是最具成本效益的选项。
- **B. Use an Auto Scaling policy** — RDS storage autoscaling 用于增加已分配的存储容量；它无法在存储分配后减少已分配的存储（[Managing capacity automatically with Amazon RDS storage autoscaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIOPS.Autoscaling.html)）。它不会在测试结束后自动降低 DB instance 的计算和内存。
- **D. Modify to a low-capacity instance** — RDS 支持修改 DB instance class 等设置，但 AWS 指出某些修改可能导致停机（[Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)）。更重要的是，此选项会在实例继续存在并产生费用的同时降低计算和内存属性，因此不如删除并从快照还原那样以具成本效益的方式满足要求。

en.question: A company that hosts its web application on AWS wants to ensure all Amazon EC2 instances. Amazon RDS DB instances. and Amazon Redshift clusters are configured with tags. The company wants to minimize the effort of configuring and operating this check. What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.A: Use AWS Config rules to define and detect resources that are not properly tagged.
options.B: Use Cost Explorer to display resources that are not properly tagged. Tag those resources manually.
options.C: Write API calls to check all resources for proper tag allocation. Periodically run the code on an EC2 instance.
options.D: Write API calls to check all resources for proper tag allocation. Schedule an AWS Lambda function through Amazon CloudWatch to periodically run the code.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Use AWS Config rules to define and detect resources that are not properly tagged.**

AWS Config has a managed rule named **`required-tags`** that “checks if your resources have the tags that you specify.” The documentation explicitly gives examples for checking **Amazon EC2 instances** and **RDS instances**, and the supported resource types include `AWS::EC2::Instance`, `AWS::RDS::DBInstance`, and `AWS::Redshift::Cluster`—exactly the resources in the question. The rule is triggered by **configuration changes**, so it provides an AWS-managed compliance check with minimal custom code or operational effort. AWS also states that this rule can be used to “find resources in your account that were not launched with your desired configurations” and that remediation actions can be run to fix tagging mistakes ([AWS Config required-tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Cost Explorer** is for viewing and analyzing **costs and usage**, including historical costs, forecasts, and cost trends—not for continuously evaluating resource configuration compliance or detecting missing tags across EC2, RDS, and Redshift resources ([AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)).
- **C. Custom API calls on an EC2 instance** would require writing, maintaining, securing, and operating custom code and infrastructure. That does not minimize effort compared with a managed AWS Config rule.
- **D. Custom API calls in Lambda on a schedule** reduces server management compared with EC2, but still requires custom code, IAM permissions, scheduling, error handling, and maintenance. AWS Config already provides the managed `required-tags` rule for this use case.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管其 Web 应用程序，希望确保所有 Amazon EC2 实例、Amazon RDS DB 实例和 Amazon Redshift 集群都配置了标签。该公司希望尽量减少配置和运行此项检查的工作量。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来实现这一目标？

options.A: 使用 AWS Config 规则来定义并检测未正确标记的资源。
options.B: 使用 Cost Explorer 显示未正确标记的资源。手动标记这些资源。
options.C: 编写 API 调用来检查所有资源是否正确分配标签。定期在 EC2 实例上运行该代码。
options.D: 编写 API 调用来检查所有资源是否正确分配标签。通过 Amazon CloudWatch 调度 AWS Lambda 函数以定期运行该代码。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Use AWS Config rules to define and detect resources that are not properly tagged.**

AWS Config 有一个名为 **`required-tags`** 的托管规则，它会“检查你的资源是否具有你指定的标签”。文档明确给出了检查 **Amazon EC2 instances** 和 **RDS instances** 的示例，并且支持的资源类型包括 `AWS::EC2::Instance`、`AWS::RDS::DBInstance` 和 `AWS::Redshift::Cluster`——这正是题目中的资源。该规则由**配置更改**触发，因此它以最少的自定义代码或运营工作量提供 AWS 托管的合规性检查。AWS 还说明，此规则可用于“查找账户中未按所需配置启动的资源”，并且可以运行修复操作来修正标签错误（[AWS Config required-tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Cost Explorer** 用于查看和分析**成本和使用情况**，包括历史成本、预测和成本趋势，而不是用于持续评估资源配置合规性或检测 EC2、RDS 和 Redshift 资源中缺失的标签（[AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)）。
- **C. Custom API calls on an EC2 instance** 需要编写、维护、保护并运行自定义代码和基础设施。与托管的 AWS Config 规则相比，这并不能最大限度减少工作量。
- **D. Custom API calls in Lambda on a schedule** 与 EC2 相比减少了服务器管理，但仍然需要自定义代码、IAM 权限、调度、错误处理和维护。AWS Config 已经为此用例提供了托管的 `required-tags` 规则。

en.question: A development team needs to host a website that will be accessed by other teams. The website contents consist of HTML, CSS, client-side JavaScript, and images. Which method is the MOST cost-effective for hosting the website?

options.A: Containerize the website and host it in AWS Fargate.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and host the website there.
options.C: Deploy a web server on an Amazon EC2 instance to host the website.
options.D: Configure an Application Load Balancer with an AWS Lambda target that uses the Express.js framework.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Create an Amazon S3 bucket and host the website there.**

The site consists only of static assets: HTML, CSS, client-side JavaScript, and images. AWS documentation states that Amazon S3 can host a static website, and that static webpages can include static content and client-side scripts ([Amazon S3 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). AWS also describes S3 website hosting as requiring no web server and being highly performant and scalable at a fraction of the cost of a traditional web server; after files are uploaded, S3 serves the content ([AWS whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/build-static-websites-aws/use-amazon-s3-website-hosting-to-host-without-a-single-web-server.html)). Therefore, S3 is the most cost-effective option among the choices.

- **A is wrong:** AWS Fargate would require containerizing and running compute capacity. That adds unnecessary compute/container overhead for static files that S3 can serve directly.
- **C is wrong:** An EC2 web server requires provisioning and managing a server and paying for compute. The AWS whitepaper explicitly contrasts S3 static hosting with traditional web servers and notes S3 avoids provisioning machines or managing OS/web server configurations.
- **D is wrong:** An Application Load Balancer plus Lambda/Express.js is unnecessary application infrastructure for content that does not require server-side processing. Static client-side assets can be served directly from S3.

zh.question: 一个开发团队需要托管一个将由其他团队访问的网站。网站内容包括 HTML、CSS、客户端 JavaScript 和图片。哪种方法托管该网站的成本效益最高？
