Amazon EFS Regional file systems store data redundantly across multiple geographically separated Availability Zones and provide continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable; AWS lists Regional EFS as designed for data requiring the highest durability and availability, with 99.999999999% durability and 99.99% availability ([EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. ElastiCache for Redis**: ElastiCache is a distributed **in-memory** data store/cache environment, intended for caching rather than as the durable primary location for a website catalog ([What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)).
- **B. Larger EC2 instance with larger instance store**: This increases capacity but does not change the ephemeral nature of instance store; the data still does not persist beyond the instance lifetime ([EC2 instance store data persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)).
- **C. S3 Glacier Deep Archive**: Deep Archive is for archive data accessed less than once a year, is not available for real-time access, and retrieval typically takes hours, so it does not meet a highly available website catalog requirement ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的的网站使用 Amazon EC2 实例存储来存放其商品目录。公司希望确保该目录具有高可用性，并且存储在持久的位置。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将目录迁移到 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。
options.B: 部署具有更大实例存储的更大 EC2 实例。
options.C: 将目录从实例存储迁移到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.D: 将目录迁移到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D. Move the catalog to an Amazon EFS file system.**

Amazon EC2 实例存储不适合作为持久目录，因为实例存储卷仅在其实例生命周期内存在，无法配置为在该生命周期之后继续保留，并且在停止、休眠、终止、某些恢复或磁盘故障时数据会丢失。AWS 明确表示不要依赖实例存储卷来保存有价值的长期数据，并建议在需要保留数据时将数据复制到持久存储，例如 Amazon EFS（[EC2 instance store data persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)）。Amazon EFS Regional 文件系统会跨多个地理位置分隔的 Availability Zones 冗余存储数据，即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用，也能提供持续可用性；AWS 将 Regional EFS 列为专为需要最高持久性和可用性的数据而设计，具有 99.999999999% 的持久性和 99.99% 的可用性（[EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. ElastiCache for Redis**：ElastiCache 是一种分布式**内存中**数据存储/缓存环境，旨在用于缓存，而不是作为网站目录的持久主要位置（[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。
- **B. Larger EC2 instance with larger instance store**：这会增加容量，但不会改变实例存储的临时性；数据仍然不会在实例生命周期之外持久保留（[EC2 instance store data persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)）。
- **C. S3 Glacier Deep Archive**：Deep Archive 用于每年访问少于一次的归档数据，不适用于实时访问，并且检索通常需要数小时，因此不满足高可用网站目录的要求（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

en.question: A company stores call transcript files on a monthly basis. Users access the files randomly within 1 year of the call, but users access the files infrequently after 1 year. The company wants to optimize its solution by giving users the ability to query and retrieve files that are less than 1-year-old as quickly as possible. A delay in retrieving older files is acceptable. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Query the tags to retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
options.B: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files that are in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Query and retrieve the files that are in S3 Glacier by using S3 Glacier Select.
options.C: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Store search metadata for each archive in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files by searching for metadata from Amazon S3.
options.D: Store individual files in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Store search metadata in Amazon RDS. Query the files from Amazon RDS. Retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B.** S3 Intelligent-Tiering is the best fit for the first year because AWS describes it as designed to optimize costs for data with unknown, changing, or unpredictable access patterns, while still providing low-latency/high-throughput access tiers and no retrieval fees ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). After the first year, access is infrequent and a retrieval delay is acceptable, so an S3 Lifecycle transition to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is appropriate: S3 Lifecycle can transition objects to lower-cost storage classes, including S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval, to save storage costs ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is recommended for archive data accessed one to two times per year and supports retrieval times from minutes to hours, matching the accepted delay for older files ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)). Athena can query data in S3, but for archived Glacier objects, the objects must be restored before Athena can query them ([Athena Glacier querying](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-glacier.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **A:** S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is for long-term archive data that is rarely accessed but needs millisecond retrieval; it also has retrieval fees and a 90-day minimum storage duration ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). Starting all files there is not the most cost-effective choice for random access during the first year.
* **C:** S3 Standard provides fast access, but it does not automatically optimize costs for changing or unpredictable access the way S3 Intelligent-Tiering does. Moving files after 1 year to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is also less cost-effective than Flexible Retrieval when a retrieval delay is acceptable, because Instant Retrieval is for archive data requiring millisecond access ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).
* **D:** S3 Standard plus Amazon RDS adds unnecessary database cost and operational overhead for metadata. S3 Glacier Deep Archive is AWS’s lowest-cost archive tier, but it is recommended for data accessed less than once per year and has 9–48 hour retrieval times; the question only says access is infrequent after 1 year, making Flexible Retrieval a better match ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司按月存储通话转录文件。用户会在通话后的 1 年内随机访问这些文件，但 1 年后用户很少访问这些文件。该公司希望优化其解决方案，使用户能够尽可能快地查询和检索不到 1 年的文件。对于较旧文件的检索延迟是可以接受的。哪种解决方案将以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 将带有标签的单个文件存储在 Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 中。查询标签以从 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 检索文件。
options.B: 将单个文件存储在 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中。使用 S3 Lifecycle policies 在 1 年后将文件移动到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。使用 Amazon Athena 查询和检索 Amazon S3 中的文件。使用 S3 Glacier Select 查询和检索 S3 Glacier 中的文件。
options.C: 将带有标签的单个文件存储在 Amazon S3 Standard storage 中。将每个归档的搜索元数据存储在 Amazon S3 Standard storage 中。使用 S3 Lifecycle policies 在 1 年后将文件移动到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。通过从 Amazon S3 搜索元数据来查询和检索文件。
options.D: 将单个文件存储在 Amazon S3 Standard storage 中。使用 S3 Lifecycle policies 在 1 年后将文件移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。将搜索元数据存储在 Amazon RDS 中。从 Amazon RDS 查询文件。从 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 检索文件。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B。** S3 Intelligent-Tiering 最适合第一年，因为 AWS 将其描述为旨在为访问模式未知、变化或不可预测的数据优化成本，同时仍提供低延迟/高吞吐量访问层且无检索费用（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。第一年之后，访问变得不频繁，并且检索延迟可以接受，因此通过 S3 Lifecycle 转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 是合适的：S3 Lifecycle 可以将对象转换到成本更低的存储类，包括 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，以节省存储成本（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 推荐用于每年访问一到两次的归档数据，并支持从几分钟到几小时的检索时间，符合较旧文件可接受延迟的要求（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。Athena 可以查询 S3 中的数据，但对于已归档的 Glacier 对象，必须先恢复这些对象，Athena 才能查询它们（[Athena Glacier querying](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-glacier.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

* **A:** S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 适用于很少访问但需要毫秒级检索的长期归档数据；它还具有检索费用和 90 天最短存储期限（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。第一年随机访问期间从一开始就将所有文件放在那里并不是最具成本效益的选择。
* **C:** S3 Standard 提供快速访问，但它不像 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 那样针对变化或不可预测的访问自动优化成本。当检索延迟可以接受时，1 年后将文件移动到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 也不如 Flexible Retrieval 具有成本效益，因为 Instant Retrieval 适用于需要毫秒级访问的归档数据（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。
* **D:** S3 Standard 加 Amazon RDS 会为元数据增加不必要的数据库成本和运营开销。S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是 AWS 成本最低的归档层，但它推荐用于每年访问少于一次的数据，并且检索时间为 9–48 小时；题目只说 1 年后访问不频繁，因此 Flexible Retrieval 更匹配（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

en.question: A company has a production workload that runs on 1,000 Amazon EC2 Linux instances. The workload is powered by third-party software. The company needs to patch the third-party software on all EC2 instances as quickly as possible to remediate a critical security vulnerability. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
options.C: Schedule an AWS Systems Manager maintenance window to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances.**

Run Command is designed to remotely and securely manage EC2 managed nodes, automate administrative tasks, and perform **one-time configuration changes at scale**. AWS also states that administrators use Run Command to **install or bootstrap applications**, and the CLI walkthrough shows that `AWS-RunShellScript` can run **any command or script** on a Linux managed node as if logged in locally. For an urgent third-party software patch across 1,000 Linux EC2 instances, a custom Run Command script is the fastest and most direct fit. ([Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html), [Run Command CLI walkthrough](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/walkthrough-cli.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Lambda function**: Lambda can run code, but the requirement is to execute patch commands on 1,000 EC2 Linux instances. Systems Manager Run Command is the AWS tool documented for remotely running commands/scripts on managed nodes at scale.
- **B. Patch Manager**: Patch Manager automates patching and supports Linux patching, and on Linux it uses configured repositories and does not differentiate between OS and application patches. However, AWS notes that Patch Manager’s **primary focus** is operating system patching and application patching is for **some applications**. The question requires quickly applying a specific third-party software patch, making a custom Run Command action more appropriate. ([Patch Manager application patches](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-windows-and-linux-differences.html), [Patch Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html))
- **C. Maintenance Window**: Maintenance Windows are for defining a **schedule** for potentially disruptive actions and can run Run Command tasks. Scheduling a window adds an unnecessary timing layer when the requirement is to patch as quickly as possible. ([Maintenance Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-windows.html))

zh.question: 一家公司有一个生产工作负载，运行在 1,000 个 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例上。该工作负载由第三方软件提供支持。公司需要尽快在所有 EC2 实例上修补该第三方软件，以修复一个关键安全漏洞。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将补丁应用到所有 EC2 实例。
options.B: 配置 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager，将补丁应用到所有 EC2 实例。
options.C: 计划一个 AWS Systems Manager 维护时段，将补丁应用到所有 EC2 实例。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 运行自定义命令，将补丁应用到所有 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances.**

Run Command 旨在远程且安全地管理 EC2 托管节点、自动执行管理任务，并大规模执行**一次性配置更改**。AWS 还说明，管理员使用 Run Command 来**安装或引导应用程序**，并且 CLI 演练显示 `AWS-RunShellScript` 可以在 Linux 托管节点上运行**任何命令或脚本**，就像在本地登录一样。对于需要在 1,000 个 Linux EC2 实例上紧急应用第三方软件补丁的情况，自定义 Run Command 脚本是最快且最直接的选择。([Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html), [Run Command CLI walkthrough](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/walkthrough-cli.html))

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Lambda function**：Lambda 可以运行代码，但需求是在 1,000 个 EC2 Linux 实例上执行补丁命令。Systems Manager Run Command 是 AWS 文档中用于在托管节点上大规模远程运行命令/脚本的工具。
- **B. Patch Manager**：Patch Manager 可自动执行修补并支持 Linux 修补，并且在 Linux 上它使用配置的存储库，且不区分 OS 补丁和应用程序补丁。但是，AWS 指出 Patch Manager 的**主要重点**是操作系统修补，而应用程序修补适用于**某些应用程序**。本题要求快速应用特定的第三方软件补丁，因此自定义 Run Command 操作更合适。([Patch Manager application patches](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-windows-and-linux-differences.html), [Patch Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html))
- **C. Maintenance Window**：Maintenance Windows 用于为可能造成中断的操作定义**计划**，并且可以运行 Run Command 任务。当需求是尽快修补时，计划一个时段会增加不必要的时间层。([Maintenance Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-windows.html))

en.question: A company is developing an application that provides order shipping statistics for retrieval by a REST API. The company wants to extract the shipping statistics, organize the data into an easy-to-read HTML format, and send the report to several email addresses at the same time every morning. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure the application to send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
options.B: Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to format the data and to send the report by email.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Glue job to query the application's API for the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Lambda function to query the application's API for the data.
options.E: Store the application data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as an S3 event destination to send the report by email.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and D**.

- **B is correct** because Amazon SES is the appropriate service for sending the report to multiple email recipients in an HTML-formatted email. AWS documentation states that the SES `SendEmail` action lets you compose and send a formatted email and that the message body can be **text, HTML, or both** ([Sending formatted email using the Amazon SES API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-formatted.html)).
- **D is correct** because the report must run every morning and must query a REST API. EventBridge Scheduler supports recurring schedules using cron or rate expressions, and when configured with Lambda, it invokes the Lambda function on the schedule ([Invoke a Lambda function on a schedule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-eventbridge-scheduler.html)). The Lambda function can call the application’s REST API, organize the data, and use SES to send the HTML report.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect** because Kinesis Data Firehose is for delivering streaming data; it does not address the required daily scheduled REST API retrieval or email report delivery.
- **C is incorrect** because AWS Glue is primarily a serverless data integration/ETL service for discovering, preparing, moving, and integrating data from multiple sources and running ETL pipelines ([What is AWS Glue?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)). A Glue job is unnecessary for a simple scheduled REST API call and email report; Lambda is the better fit.
- **E is incorrect** because SNS email subscriptions are not suitable for customized HTML reports. AWS documentation states that customization of the SNS email message body is not supported and that SNS email delivery is intended for internal system alerts, not marketing or formatted messages ([Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)). S3 event notifications also do not directly satisfy the “every morning” scheduled retrieval requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个应用程序，该应用程序通过 REST API 提供订单配送统计信息供检索。该公司希望提取配送统计信息，将数据整理为易于阅读的 HTML 格式，并在每天早晨同一时间将报告发送到多个电子邮件地址。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 配置应用程序将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 格式化数据，并通过电子邮件发送报告。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 计划事件，该事件调用 AWS Glue 作业来查询应用程序的 API 以获取数据。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 计划事件，该事件调用 AWS Lambda 函数来查询应用程序的 API 以获取数据。
options.E: 将应用程序数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题作为 S3 事件目标，以通过电子邮件发送报告。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 D**。

- **B 是正确的**，因为 Amazon SES 是以 HTML 格式电子邮件向多个电子邮件收件人发送报告的合适服务。AWS 文档指出，SES `SendEmail` 操作允许你编写并发送格式化电子邮件，并且消息正文可以是 **text, HTML, or both**（[Sending formatted email using the Amazon SES API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email-formatted.html)）。
- **D 是正确的**，因为报告必须每天早晨运行，并且必须查询 REST API。EventBridge Scheduler 支持使用 cron 或 rate 表达式的重复计划；当它与 Lambda 配置在一起时，会按计划调用 Lambda 函数（[Invoke a Lambda function on a schedule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-eventbridge-scheduler.html)）。Lambda 函数可以调用应用程序的 REST API，组织数据，并使用 SES 发送 HTML 报告。其他选项为何不正确：

- **A 是不正确的**，因为 Kinesis Data Firehose 用于交付流式数据；它不能解决所需的每日计划 REST API 检索或电子邮件报告交付问题。
- **C 是不正确的**，因为 AWS Glue 主要是一项无服务器数据集成/ETL 服务，用于发现、准备、移动和集成来自多个来源的数据，并运行 ETL 管道（[What is AWS Glue?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。对于简单的计划 REST API 调用和电子邮件报告，Glue 作业是不必要的；Lambda 更适合。
- **E 是不正确的**，因为 SNS 电子邮件订阅不适合自定义 HTML 报告。AWS 文档指出，不支持自定义 SNS 电子邮件消息正文，并且 SNS 电子邮件投递旨在用于内部系统警报，而不是营销或格式化消息（[Amazon SNS email subscription setup and management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)）。S3 事件通知也不能直接满足“每天早晨”的计划检索要求。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises application to AWS. The application produces output files that vary in size from tens of gigabytes to hundreds of terabytes. The application data must be stored in a standard file system structure. The company wants a solution that scales automatically. is highly available, and requires minimum operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon S3 for storage.
options.B: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage.
options.C: Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for storage.
options.D: Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon EFS is the best fit because it is managed, elastic **file storage**: AWS states that EFS provides “serverless, fully elastic file storage” without provisioning or managing storage capacity/performance, scales on demand to petabytes, and grows/shrinks automatically as files are added or removed. EFS also supports NFSv4 and file-system semantics such as consistency and locking, so it matches the requirement for a standard file system structure. A Regional EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones and provides continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable. Running the application on EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group also aligns with high availability because EC2 Auto Scaling can span multiple AZs and launch replacement instances in unaffected AZs. [EFS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html), [EFS availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html), [EC2 Auto Scaling across AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon S3 is highly scalable object storage, but this option does not provide the required standard file system structure for the migrated application. In S3, “folders” are part of an object key name, not a native hierarchical file system. [S3 folders/object keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-folders.html)
- **B:** EBS volumes are block storage attached to instances in the **same Availability Zone** as the volume, which does not naturally satisfy a Multi-AZ shared file system requirement. EBS Multi-Attach is limited and AWS notes that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers; clustered file systems are required. [EBS attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-attaching-volume.html), [EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)
- **D:** Same storage issue as B: EBS is AZ-scoped block storage, not a managed, automatically scaling, Regional shared file system for a Multi-AZ application. [EBS attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-attaching-volume.html)

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其本地应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序会生成输出文件，文件大小从数十 GB 到数百 TB 不等。应用程序数据必须存储在标准文件系统结构中。公司希望采用一种能够自动扩展、高可用且所需运维开销最小的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将应用程序迁移为在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上以容器形式运行。使用 Amazon S3 进行存储。
options.B: 将应用程序迁移为在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上以容器形式运行。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 进行存储。
options.C: 将应用程序迁移到 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 进行存储。
options.D: 将应用程序迁移到 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 进行存储。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon EFS 是最佳选择，因为它是托管的、弹性的**文件存储**：AWS 表示，EFS 提供“serverless, fully elastic file storage”，无需预置或管理存储容量/性能，可按需扩展到 PB 级，并随着文件的添加或删除自动增长/收缩。EFS 还支持 NFSv4 以及一致性和锁定等文件系统语义，因此符合标准文件系统结构的要求。Regional EFS 文件系统会在多个 Availability Zones 中冗余存储数据，即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用，也能提供持续可用性。在 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例上运行应用程序也符合高可用性要求，因为 EC2 Auto Scaling 可以跨多个 AZ，并在未受影响的 AZ 中启动替代实例。[EFS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html), [EFS availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html), [EC2 Auto Scaling across AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon S3 是高度可扩展的对象存储，但此选项无法为迁移后的应用程序提供所需的标准文件系统结构。在 S3 中，“folders” 是对象键名称的一部分，而不是原生的分层文件系统。[S3 folders/object keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-folders.html)
- **B:** EBS 卷是附加到与该卷位于**同一 Availability Zone** 中实例的块存储，这并不能自然满足 Multi-AZ 共享文件系统要求。EBS Multi-Attach 具有局限性，并且 AWS 指出，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多个服务器同时访问而设计；需要使用集群文件系统。[EBS attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-attaching-volume.html), [EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)
- **D:** 与 B 存在相同的存储问题：EBS 是 AZ 范围的块存储，而不是面向 Multi-AZ 应用程序的托管、自动扩展、Regional 共享文件系统。[EBS attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-attaching-volume.html)

en.question: A company needs to store its accounting records in Amazon S3. The records must be immediately accessible for 1 year and then must be archived for an additional 9 years. No one at the company, including administrative users and root users, can be able to delete the records during the entire 10-year period. The records must be stored with maximum resiliency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the records in S3 Glacier for the entire 10-year period. Use an access control policy to deny deletion of the records for a period of 10 years.
options.B: Store the records by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use an IAM policy to deny deletion of the records. After 10 years, change the IAM policy to allow deletion.
options.C: Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode for a period of 10 years.
options.D: Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode for a period of 10 years.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The records need two things: lifecycle-based storage placement and immutable retention. S3 Lifecycle can transition objects to other storage classes or archive them as they age ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). S3 Standard is appropriate for the first year of immediate access because it is for frequently accessed data with millisecond access and is stored across at least 3 Availability Zones; S3 Glacier Deep Archive is designed for long-term archive data accessed less than once a year, with 99.999999999% durability and storage across at least 3 Availability Zones ([S3 storage class comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

S3 Object Lock in **compliance mode** is the key requirement for “no one, including administrative users and root users, can delete” the records. AWS states that in compliance mode, a protected object version cannot be overwritten or deleted by **any user, including the root user**, and the retention period cannot be shortened ([S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)). Therefore, transitioning from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year and applying a 10-year Object Lock retention period in compliance mode meets all requirements.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** S3 Glacier storage classes such as S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and Deep Archive are archival and not available for real-time access, so storing records there for the entire 10 years would not meet the first-year immediate-access requirement. Also, an access control policy is not the same as Object Lock compliance mode and can be changed by sufficiently privileged users.
- **B:** IAM policies do not provide immutable WORM retention against account administrators/root in the way Object Lock compliance mode does. The option also does not define a required archive transition after 1 year.
- **D:** Governance mode can be bypassed by users with `s3:BypassGovernanceRetention`, so it does not satisfy the “no one, including administrative users and root users” deletion prohibition. In addition, S3 One Zone-IA stores data in one Availability Zone and is explicitly less resilient/not resilient to loss of the Availability Zone, so it fails the maximum resiliency requirement ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要将其会计记录存储在 Amazon S3 中。这些记录必须在 1 年内可立即访问，然后必须再归档 9 年。在整个 10 年期间，公司内任何人（包括管理用户和根用户）都不能删除这些记录。记录必须以最高弹性存储。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在整个 10 年期间将记录存储在 S3 Glacier 中。使用访问控制策略拒绝在 10 年内删除这些记录。
options.B: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储这些记录。使用 IAM 策略拒绝删除这些记录。10 年后，更改 IAM 策略以允许删除。
options.C: 使用 S3 Lifecycle 策略在 1 年后将记录从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。使用合规模式的 S3 Object Lock，期限为 10 年。
options.D: 使用 S3 Lifecycle 策略在 1 年后将记录从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。使用治理模式的 S3 Object Lock，期限为 10 年。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

这些记录需要两项内容：基于生命周期的存储放置和不可变保留。S3 Lifecycle 可以随着对象老化将其转换到其他存储类或将其归档（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。S3 Standard 适合第一年的立即访问，因为它用于频繁访问的数据，具有毫秒级访问能力，并且存储在至少 3 个 Availability Zones 中；S3 Glacier Deep Archive 专为每年访问少于一次的长期归档数据而设计，具有 99.999999999% 的持久性，并存储在至少 3 个 Availability Zones 中（[S3 storage class comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)，[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

**合规模式**下的 S3 Object Lock 是满足“任何人（包括管理用户和根用户）都不能删除”这些记录这一关键要求。AWS 表示，在合规模式下，受保护的对象版本不能被**任何用户（包括 root user）**覆盖或删除，并且保留期不能缩短（[S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。因此，在 1 年后从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，并在合规模式下应用 10 年的 Object Lock 保留期，可以满足所有要求。

**为什么其他选项错误：**

- **A:** S3 Glacier 存储类（例如 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 和 Deep Archive）属于归档类，不能用于实时访问，因此在整个 10 年期间都将记录存储在那里无法满足第一年的立即访问要求。此外，访问控制策略不同于 Object Lock 合规模式，并且可由具有足够权限的用户更改。
- **B:** IAM 策略无法像 Object Lock 合规模式那样针对账户管理员/root 提供不可变的 WORM 保留。该选项也没有定义在 1 年后所需的归档转换。
- **D:** 治理模式可以被具有 `s3:BypassGovernanceRetention` 的用户绕过，因此不满足“任何人（包括管理用户和根用户）”都不能删除的禁止要求。此外，S3 One Zone-IA 将数据存储在一个 Availability Zone 中，并且明确表示其弹性较低/无法抵御该 Availability Zone 丢失，因此不满足最高弹性要求（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A company runs multiple Windows workloads on AWS. The company's employees use Windows file shares that are hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The file shares synchronize data between themselves and maintain duplicate copies. The company wants a highly available and durable storage solution that preserves how users currently access the files. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate all the data to Amazon S3. Set up IAM authentication for users to access files.
options.B: Set up an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Mount the S3 File Gateway on the existing EC2 instances.
options.C: Extend the file share environment to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to FSx for Windows File Server.
options.D: Extend the file share environment to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to Amazon EFS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is purpose-built for this requirement: AWS documents that a Windows file share is exposed to compute instances using **SMB**, and FSx for Windows File Server can be accessed from Windows clients and mapped on EC2 instances, so users can continue using Windows file shares in the same general way as today. FSx also supports Microsoft Active Directory authentication and Windows ACLs, and **Multi-AZ file systems provide high availability and failover support across Availability Zones** by maintaining a standby file server in another AZ. FSx backups are described as file-system-consistent, highly durable, and incremental. Therefore, migrating the data to FSx for Windows File Server with Multi-AZ meets the high availability, durability, and access-preservation requirements ([FSx overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html), [accessing FSx file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon S3 is object storage, not a native Windows SMB file share. Using IAM authentication to access S3 objects would change how employees access files and would not preserve the existing Windows file share experience.
- **B:** Amazon S3 File Gateway can expose S3 through NFS or SMB and can run as an EC2 AMI, but it is a gateway/cache interface to S3 objects, not the best managed replacement for highly available Windows file servers with native Windows file-system features, AD integration, and Multi-AZ Windows file server failover ([S3 File Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **D:** Amazon EFS is mounted using the EFS mount helper on EC2 **Linux and Mac** instances or by using the standard Linux NFS client; it supports NFSv4, not native Windows SMB file shares. Migrating Windows file shares to EFS would not preserve the current Windows SMB access model ([EFS mounting documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行多个 Windows 工作负载。该公司的员工使用托管在两个 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Windows 文件共享。这些文件共享彼此同步数据并维护重复副本。该公司希望获得一个高可用且持久的存储解决方案，同时保留用户当前访问文件的方式。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有数据迁移到 Amazon S3。为用户设置 IAM 身份验证以访问文件。
options.B: 设置 Amazon S3 File Gateway。将 S3 File Gateway 挂载到现有 EC2 实例上。
options.C: 使用 Multi-AZ 配置将文件共享环境扩展到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。将所有数据迁移到 FSx for Windows File Server。
options.D: 使用 Multi-AZ 配置将文件共享环境扩展到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。将所有数据迁移到 Amazon EFS。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 专为此需求而构建：AWS 文档说明 Windows 文件共享通过 **SMB** 向计算实例公开，并且可以从 Windows 客户端访问 FSx for Windows File Server，也可以将其映射到 EC2 实例上，因此用户可以继续以与当前大体相同的方式使用 Windows 文件共享。FSx 还支持 Microsoft Active Directory 身份验证和 Windows ACLs，并且 **Multi-AZ 文件系统通过在另一个 AZ 中维护备用文件服务器，提供跨 Availability Zones 的高可用性和故障转移支持**。FSx 备份被描述为文件系统一致、高度持久且增量式。因此，将数据迁移到采用 Multi-AZ 的 FSx for Windows File Server，可满足高可用性、持久性和保留访问方式的要求（[FSx overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)，[accessing FSx file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon S3 是对象存储，不是原生 Windows SMB 文件共享。使用 IAM 身份验证来访问 S3 对象会改变员工访问文件的方式，并且无法保留现有 Windows 文件共享体验。
- **B:** Amazon S3 File Gateway 可以通过 NFS 或 SMB 暴露 S3，并且可以作为 EC2 AMI 运行，但它是面向 S3 对象的网关/缓存接口，并不是替代高可用 Windows 文件服务器的最佳托管方案；后者需要原生 Windows 文件系统功能、AD 集成以及 Multi-AZ Windows 文件服务器故障转移（[S3 File Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **D:** Amazon EFS 通过 EC2 **Linux and Mac** 实例上的 EFS mount helper 挂载，或使用标准 Linux NFS 客户端挂载；它支持 NFSv4，而不是原生 Windows SMB 文件共享。将 Windows 文件共享迁移到 EFS 无法保留当前的 Windows SMB 访问模型（[EFS mounting documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is developing a VPC architecture that includes multiple subnets. The architecture will host applications that use Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon RDS DB instances. The architecture consists of six subnets in two Availability Zones. Each Availability Zone includes a public subnet, a private subnet, and a dedicated subnet for databases. Only EC2 instances that run in the private subnets can have access to the RDS databases. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new route table that excludes the route to the public subnets' CIDR blocks. Associate the route table with the database subnets.
options.B: Create a security group that denies inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the public subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances.
options.C: Create a security group that allows inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the private subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances.
options.D: Create a new peering connection between the public subnets and the private subnets. Create a different peering connection between the private subnets and the database subnets.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon RDS access in a VPC is controlled with VPC security groups. AWS states that a security group rule for a DB instance can use **another VPC security group as the source**, which allows inbound traffic from the instances that use that source security group—typically application servers ([RDS security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)). AWS also describes the exact pattern: create a DB security group and add a rule whose source is the EC2/application security group, then associate that DB security group with the DB instance ([RDS security group scenario](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)). Therefore, attaching to the RDS DB instances a security group that allows database-port inbound traffic from the security group used by the private-subnet EC2 instances limits DB access to those instances.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Route tables determine network routing, not fine-grained database access by EC2 instance group. Also, within a VPC, subnets can route to each other through the VPC local route; excluding routes to public subnet CIDRs is not the correct control to allow only private-subnet EC2 instances to reach RDS. Security groups are the correct mechanism for DB instance access control.
- **B:** Security groups do not support explicit deny rules. AWS states that security groups allow you to specify **allow rules, but not deny rules**, and that new security groups have no inbound rules so inbound traffic is denied until allowed ([VPC security group rule basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)).
- **D:** VPC peering is for connecting VPCs, not for creating peering connections between subnets in the same VPC. It also would not by itself enforce that only private-subnet EC2 instances can access the RDS databases.

Thus, the best solution is to use a DB security group that allows inbound database traffic only from the security group attached to the private-subnet EC2 instances.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在开发一个包含多个子网的 VPC 架构。该架构将托管使用 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon RDS DB 实例的应用程序。该架构由两个可用区中的六个子网组成。每个可用区都包含一个公有子网、一个私有子网以及一个专用于数据库的子网。只有在私有子网中运行的 EC2 实例才能访问 RDS 数据库。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的路由表，排除到公有子网 CIDR 块的路由。将该路由表与数据库子网关联。
options.B: 创建一个安全组，拒绝来自分配给公有子网中实例的安全组的入站流量。将该安全组附加到 DB 实例。
options.C: 创建一个安全组，允许来自分配给私有子网中实例的安全组的入站流量。将该安全组附加到 DB 实例。
options.D: 在公有子网和私有子网之间创建新的对等连接。在私有子网和数据库子网之间创建另一个不同的对等连接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

VPC 中的 Amazon RDS 访问由 VPC 安全组控制。AWS 说明，DB 实例的安全组规则可以使用**另一个 VPC 安全组作为源**，这允许来自使用该源安全组的实例的入站流量——通常是应用程序服务器（[RDS security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)）。AWS 还描述了确切的模式：创建一个 DB 安全组，并添加一条源为 EC2/应用程序安全组的规则，然后将该 DB 安全组与 DB 实例关联（[RDS security group scenario](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)）。因此，将一个允许来自私有子网 EC2 实例所用安全组的数据库端口入站流量的安全组附加到 RDS DB 实例，可以将 DB 访问限制为这些实例。

**为什么其他选项错误：**

- **A:** 路由表决定网络路由，而不是按 EC2 实例组进行细粒度数据库访问控制。此外，在 VPC 内，子网可以通过 VPC 本地路由彼此路由；排除到公有子网 CIDR 的路由并不是只允许私有子网 EC2 实例访问 RDS 的正确控制方式。安全组才是 DB 实例访问控制的正确机制。
- **B:** 安全组不支持显式拒绝规则。AWS 说明，安全组允许你指定**允许规则，但不能指定拒绝规则**，并且新的安全组没有入站规则，因此入站流量在被允许之前都会被拒绝（[VPC security group rule basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。
- **D:** VPC 对等连接用于连接 VPC，而不是在同一 VPC 中的子网之间创建对等连接。它本身也无法强制确保只有私有子网 EC2 实例可以访问 RDS 数据库。因此，最佳解决方案是使用一个 DB 安全组，该安全组仅允许来自附加到私有子网 EC2 实例的安全组的入站数据库流量。

en.question: A company has registered its domain name with Amazon Route 53. The company uses Amazon API Gateway in the ca-central-1 Region as a public interface for its backend microservice APIs. Third-party services consume the APIs securely. The company wants to design its API Gateway URL with the company's domain name and corresponding certificate so that the third-party services can use HTTPS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create stage variables in API Gateway with Name="Endpoint-URL" and Value="Company Domain Name" to overwrite the default URL. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
options.B: Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point the alias record to the Regional API Gateway stage endpoint. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region.
options.C: Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region. Attach the certificate to the API Gateway endpoint. Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the API Gateway endpoint.
options.D: Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region. Attach the certificate to the API Gateway APIs. Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point an A record to the company's domain name.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C**.

For a **Regional** API Gateway custom domain, AWS states that you must provide a **Region-specific ACM certificate** and that the certificate **must be in the same Region as your API**. The setup procedure is to create a custom domain name, choose **Regional** as the API endpoint type, choose the ACM certificate in that same Region, and then create DNS to point the custom domain name to the Regional API Gateway domain name. AWS also says that when Route 53 is the DNS provider, you should create an **A alias record** to the Regional domain name so traffic for the custom domain is routed to the API Gateway Regional hostname ([AWS API Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-regional-api-custom-domain-create.html)). Since the API is in **ca-central-1**, the ACM certificate must also be in **ca-central-1**.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Stage variables do not replace the default execute-api URL with a custom HTTPS domain. The required configuration is an API Gateway **custom domain name** with an ACM certificate and DNS routing.
- **B**: For a Regional API in **ca-central-1**, importing the certificate into **us-east-1** is wrong. AWS requires the ACM certificate to be in the **same Region as the API** for Regional custom domains. It also refers to pointing directly to a stage endpoint rather than properly creating/using the Regional custom domain target.
- **D**: This also incorrectly places the certificate in **us-east-1**. Additionally, the certificate is associated with the custom domain/Regional endpoint, not generically “attached to the APIs,” and DNS should point the custom domain to the API Gateway Regional domain name, not create an A record that points to the company’s own domain name.

zh.question: 一家公司已在 Amazon Route 53 中注册了其域名。该公司在 ca-central-1 Region 中使用 Amazon API Gateway 作为其后端微服务 API 的公共接口。第三方服务安全地使用这些 API。该公司希望使用公司的域名和相应证书来设计其 API Gateway URL，以便第三方服务可以使用 HTTPS。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 API Gateway 中创建阶段变量，Name="Endpoint-URL"，Value="Company Domain Name"，以覆盖默认 URL。将与公司域名关联的公共证书导入到 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。
options.B: 使用公司的域名创建 Route 53 DNS 记录。将别名记录指向 Regional API Gateway 阶段端点。将与公司域名关联的公共证书导入到 us-east-1 Region 中的 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。
options.C: 创建 Regional API Gateway 端点。将 API Gateway 端点与公司的域名关联。将与公司域名关联的公共证书导入到同一 Region 中的 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。将证书附加到 API Gateway 端点。配置 Route 53 将流量路由到 API Gateway 端点。
options.D: 创建 Regional API Gateway 端点。将 API Gateway 端点与公司的域名关联。将与公司域名关联的公共证书导入到 us-east-1 Region 中的 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。将证书附加到 API Gateway API。使用公司的域名创建 Route 53 DNS 记录。将 A 记录指向公司的域名。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C**。对于 **Regional** API Gateway 自定义域，AWS 说明您必须提供**特定于 Region 的 ACM 证书**，并且该证书**必须与您的 API 位于同一 Region**。设置过程是创建自定义域名，选择 **Regional** 作为 API 端点类型，选择同一 Region 中的 ACM 证书，然后创建 DNS 以将自定义域名指向 Regional API Gateway 域名。AWS 还说明，当 Route 53 是 DNS 提供商时，您应创建指向 Regional 域名的 **A alias record**，以便将自定义域的流量路由到 API Gateway Regional 主机名（[AWS API Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-regional-api-custom-domain-create.html)）。由于 API 位于 **ca-central-1**，ACM 证书也必须位于 **ca-central-1**。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：阶段变量不会用自定义 HTTPS 域替换默认的 execute-api URL。所需配置是带有 ACM 证书和 DNS 路由的 API Gateway **custom domain name**。
- **B**：对于位于 **ca-central-1** 的 Regional API，将证书导入到 **us-east-1** 是错误的。AWS 要求对于 Regional 自定义域，ACM 证书必须位于**与 API 相同的 Region**。它还提到直接指向阶段端点，而不是正确创建/使用 Regional 自定义域目标。
- **D**：此选项同样错误地将证书放在 **us-east-1**。此外，证书是与自定义域/Regional 端点关联的，而不是笼统地“附加到 API”，并且 DNS 应将自定义域指向 API Gateway Regional 域名，而不是创建一个指向公司自身域名的 A 记录。

en.question: A company is running a popular social media website. The website gives users the ability to upload images to share with other users. The company wants to make sure that the images do not contain inappropriate content. The company needs a solution that minimizes development effort. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions.
options.B: Use Amazon Rekognition to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions.
options.C: Use Amazon SageMaker to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions.
options.D: Use AWS Fargate to deploy a custom machine learning model to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon Rekognition is the managed AWS service designed for image and video analysis/content moderation. AWS states that Rekognition can detect content that is “inappropriate, unwanted, or offensive” and that its moderation APIs are applicable to social media use cases. The same documentation notes that Rekognition image/video moderation can reduce the amount of content needing human moderator review and is integrated with Amazon Augmented AI for human review tasks ([Amazon Rekognition content moderation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/moderation.html)). For low-confidence cases, Rekognition is directly integrated with Amazon A2I so you can implement human review for unsafe images and define confidence thresholds that trigger review ([Reviewing inappropriate content with Amazon Augmented AI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/a2i-rekognition.html)). This meets the requirement with minimal development effort by using a prebuilt managed moderation capability.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Amazon Comprehend is for NLP/text analysis. Its documented insights are from a “document or set of documents,” such as entities, key phrases, PII, language, sentiment, and syntax—not image moderation ([Amazon Comprehend insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
- **C:** Amazon SageMaker/Ground Truth is primarily for building labeled training datasets and training your own ML models. AWS says Ground Truth helps build labeled datasets that you can use to train your own models ([SageMaker Ground Truth](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/sms.html)). That is more development effort than using Rekognition’s built-in moderation API.
- **D:** Deploying a custom ML model on AWS Fargate would require building, training, deploying, and operating the model. This is not the minimal-effort managed image moderation approach; Ground Truth labeling is for creating training datasets for custom models, not for simple managed moderation ([SageMaker Ground Truth](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/sms.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在运营一个受欢迎的社交媒体网站。该网站允许用户上传图片以与其他用户分享。公司希望确保这些图片不包含不当内容。公司需要一个尽量减少开发工作的解决方案。解决方案架构师应怎么做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 检测不当内容。对低置信度预测使用人工审核。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Rekognition 检测不当内容。对低置信度预测使用人工审核。
options.C: 使用 Amazon SageMaker 检测不当内容。使用 ground truth 标记低置信度预测。
options.D: 使用 AWS Fargate 部署自定义机器学习模型来检测不当内容。使用 ground truth 标记低置信度预测。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon Rekognition 是专为图像和视频分析/内容审核而设计的托管 AWS 服务。AWS 表示，Rekognition 可以检测“不当、不需要或冒犯性”的内容，并且其审核 APIs 适用于社交媒体用例。同一文档还指出，Rekognition 图像/视频审核可以减少需要人工审核员审查的内容量，并与 Amazon Augmented AI 集成以执行人工审核任务（[Amazon Rekognition content moderation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/moderation.html)）。对于低置信度情况，Rekognition 与 Amazon A2I 直接集成，因此你可以为不安全图像实施人工审核，并定义触发审核的置信度阈值（[Reviewing inappropriate content with Amazon Augmented AI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/a2i-rekognition.html)）。这通过使用预构建的托管审核功能，以最少的开发工作满足要求。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** Amazon Comprehend 用于 NLP/文本分析。其文档化的洞察来自“文档或一组文档”，例如实体、关键短语、PII、语言、情绪和语法，而不是图像审核（[Amazon Comprehend insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon SageMaker/Ground Truth 主要用于构建带标签的训练数据集并训练你自己的 ML 模型。AWS 表示，Ground Truth 可帮助构建带标签的数据集，你可以使用这些数据集来训练自己的模型（[SageMaker Ground Truth](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/sms.html)）。与使用 Rekognition 的内置审核 API 相比，这需要更多开发工作。
- **D:** 在 AWS Fargate 上部署自定义 ML 模型需要构建、训练、部署和运维该模型。这不是开发工作最少的托管图像审核方法；Ground Truth 标记用于为自定义模型创建训练数据集，而不是用于简单的托管审核（[SageMaker Ground Truth](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/sms.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to run its critical applications in containers to meet requirements for scalability and availability. The company prefers to focus on maintenance of the critical applications. The company does not want to be responsible for provisioning and managing the underlying infrastructure that runs the containerized workload. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 instances, and install Docker on the instances.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 worker nodes.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Use Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)-optimized Amazon Machine Image (AMI).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate.**

AWS Fargate is the best fit because the company wants containers for scalability/availability but does **not** want to provision or manage the underlying infrastructure. The Amazon ECS documentation states that Fargate lets you run containers with ECS “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances” and removes the need to “provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines” ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). The ECS cluster guidance also describes Fargate as “serverless compute” for running tasks “without managing any infrastructure,” suitable when you want to minimize operational overhead and need rapid deployment and scaling ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. EC2 instances with Docker installed** — This requires the company to provision, configure, patch, scale, and maintain EC2 instances and Docker, which conflicts with the requirement to avoid managing infrastructure.
- **B. Amazon ECS on EC2 worker nodes** — ECS would orchestrate containers, but the company would still manage the underlying EC2 capacity. AWS documentation describes Amazon EC2 instances as the option where “you manage the underlying Amazon EC2 instances directly” ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)).
- **D. EC2 instances from an ECS-optimized AMI** — The ECS-optimized AMI simplifies running ECS on EC2, but it is still EC2-based infrastructure that must be selected, configured, maintained, and scaled by the customer.

zh.question: 一家公司希望在容器中运行其关键应用程序，以满足可扩展性和可用性要求。该公司更希望专注于关键应用程序的维护。该公司不希望负责预置和管理运行容器化工作负载的底层基础设施。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 实例，并在这些实例上安装 Docker。
options.B: 在 Amazon EC2 工作节点上使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.C: 在 AWS Fargate 上使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.D: 使用来自 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 优化的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 的 Amazon EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Use Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate.**

AWS Fargate 是最佳选择，因为该公司希望使用容器来实现可扩展性/可用性，但**不**希望预置或管理底层基础设施。Amazon ECS 文档说明，Fargate 允许你使用 ECS 运行容器，“without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances”，并且无需“provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines” ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html))。ECS 集群指南还将 Fargate 描述为用于运行任务的“serverless compute”，“without managing any infrastructure”，适用于希望最大限度降低运维开销并需要快速部署和扩展的场景 ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 安装了 Docker 的 EC2 实例** — 这要求公司预置、配置、修补、扩展和维护 EC2 实例以及 Docker，与避免管理基础设施的要求相冲突。
- **B. 在 EC2 工作节点上运行 Amazon ECS** — ECS 会编排容器，但公司仍需管理底层 EC2 容量。AWS 文档将 Amazon EC2 实例描述为“you manage the underlying Amazon EC2 instances directly”的选项 ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html))。
- **D. 来自 ECS 优化 AMI 的 EC2 实例** — ECS 优化的 AMI 简化了在 EC2 上运行 ECS，但它仍然是基于 EC2 的基础设施，必须由客户选择、配置、维护和扩展。

en.question: A company hosts more than 300 global websites and applications. The company requires a platform to analyze more than 30 TB of clickstream data each day. What should a solutions architect do to transmit and process the clickstream data?

options.A: Design an AWS Data Pipeline to archive the data to an Amazon S3 bucket and run an Amazon EMR cluster with the data to generate analytics.
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to process the data and send it to an Amazon S3 data lake for Amazon Redshift to use for analysis.
options.C: Cache the data to Amazon CloudFront. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. When an object is added to the S3 bucket. run an AWS Lambda function to process the data for analysis.
options.D: Collect the data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transmit the data to an Amazon S3 data lake. Load the data in Amazon Redshift for analysis.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is designed for rapid, continuous intake of streaming data, including **web clickstream data**, and AWS documentation specifically lists processing website clickstreams in real time as a typical use case. It also provides durability, elasticity, and managed intake-pipeline capabilities, which fits a global, high-volume workload of 30+ TB/day. Amazon Data Firehose can automatically read from an existing Kinesis data stream and load records into destinations; for S3 destinations, it delivers streaming data to an S3 bucket, and for Amazon Redshift destinations it first delivers to S3 and then issues a Redshift **COPY** command to load the data into Redshift. Therefore, collecting with Kinesis Data Streams, delivering through Firehose to an S3 data lake, and loading into Redshift is the best managed, scalable architecture for transmitting and analyzing the clickstream data ([Kinesis Data Streams use cases and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html), [Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html), [Firehose destination settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Data Pipeline with EMR is a batch-style archive-and-process approach. The question asks for a platform to transmit and process very large clickstream data; Kinesis is the AWS service documented for rapid, continuous clickstream intake and real-time processing.
- **B:** A custom Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances would require the company to build and operate its own ingestion and processing layer. Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose are managed services that reduce the operational burden of running a data intake pipeline.
- **C:** CloudFront is a content delivery/cache service, not the primary service for collecting large-scale clickstream streams. Triggering Lambda after S3 object creation is also not the best fit for continuous high-volume streaming ingestion compared with Kinesis Data Streams plus Firehose.

Thus, **D** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司托管了 300 多个全球网站和应用程序。该公司需要一个平台来每天分析超过 30 TB 的点击流数据。解决方案架构师应如何传输和处理这些点击流数据？

options.A: 设计一个 AWS Data Pipeline，将数据归档到 Amazon S3 存储桶，并使用这些数据运行 Amazon EMR 集群来生成分析结果。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组来处理数据，并将其发送到 Amazon S3 数据湖，供 Amazon Redshift 用于分析。
options.C: 将数据缓存到 Amazon CloudFront。将数据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。当对象添加到 S3 存储桶时，运行 AWS Lambda 函数来处理数据以进行分析。
options.D: 从 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 收集数据。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将数据传输到 Amazon S3 数据湖。将数据加载到 Amazon Redshift 中进行分析。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 专为快速、持续摄取流数据而设计，包括 **web clickstream data**，并且 AWS 文档明确将实时处理网站点击流列为典型用例。它还提供持久性、弹性以及托管式摄取管道能力，这适合每天 30+ TB 的全球高容量工作负载。Amazon Data Firehose 可以自动从现有 Kinesis data stream 读取并将记录加载到目标；对于 S3 目标，它会将流数据传送到 S3 存储桶；对于 Amazon Redshift 目标，它会先传送到 S3，然后发出 Redshift **COPY** 命令将数据加载到 Redshift。因此，使用 Kinesis Data Streams 收集，通过 Firehose 传送到 S3 数据湖，并加载到 Redshift，是用于传输和分析点击流数据的最佳托管式可扩展架构（[Kinesis Data Streams use cases and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)，[Amazon Data Firehose data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)，[Firehose destination settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS Data Pipeline 搭配 EMR 是一种批处理式的归档并处理方法。题目要求一个用于传输和处理超大规模点击流数据的平台；Kinesis 是 AWS 文档中用于快速、持续摄取点击流和实时处理的服务。
- **B:** 自定义的 EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组会要求公司自行构建和运营摄取与处理层。Kinesis Data Streams 和 Firehose 是托管服务，可以降低运行数据摄取管道的运营负担。
- **C:** CloudFront 是内容分发/缓存服务，不是用于收集大规模点击流流数据的主要服务。与 Kinesis Data Streams 加 Firehose 相比，在 S3 对象创建后触发 Lambda 也并不最适合持续的高容量流式摄取。因此，**D** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company has a website hosted on AWS. The website is behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is configured to handle HTTP and HTTPS separately. The company wants to forward all requests to the website so that the requests will use HTTPS. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Update the ALB's network ACL to accept only HTTPS traffic.
options.B: Create a rule that replaces the HTTP in the URL with HTTPS.
options.C: Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
options.D: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer configured to use Server Name Indication (SNI).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.**

Application Load Balancer listener rules include actions, and each rule must include one terminal action such as `forward`, `redirect`, or `fixed-response` ([Listener rules for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)). AWS specifically documents that a `redirect` action redirects client requests from one URL to another and that the protocol can be changed from HTTP to HTTPS; the example redirect action changes an HTTP request to HTTPS on port 443 while preserving the host, path, and query string ([Action types for listener rules: Redirect actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)). Therefore, an HTTP listener rule/default action that redirects to HTTPS is the correct ALB-native solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Update the ALB's network ACL to accept only HTTPS traffic.** A network ACL would filter traffic at the subnet network layer; it would not issue an HTTP redirect response to clients. Blocking HTTP would fail HTTP requests rather than forwarding users to HTTPS.
- **B. Create a rule that replaces the HTTP in the URL with HTTPS.** URL rewrite/transforms are not the right mechanism for changing the client protocol. AWS describes transforms as rewriting inbound requests before routing and notes that URL rewrite modifies the path or query string, whereas the documented protocol change from HTTP to HTTPS is done with a `redirect` action ([Transforms for listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-transforms.html), [Redirect actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)).
- **D. Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer configured to use SNI.** The requirement is to redirect HTTP to HTTPS. AWS documents this as an ALB listener rule redirect action, so replacing the ALB with an NLB is unnecessary and does not address HTTP-to-HTTPS redirection at the ALB listener-rule level.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个托管在 AWS 上的网站。该网站位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面，该 ALB 配置为分别处理 HTTP 和 HTTPS。公司希望将所有对该网站的请求转发为使用 HTTPS。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足此要求？

options.A: 更新 ALB 的网络 ACL，使其仅接受 HTTPS 流量。
options.B: 创建一条规则，将 URL 中的 HTTP 替换为 HTTPS。
options.C: 在 ALB 上创建监听器规则，将 HTTP 流量重定向到 HTTPS。
options.D: 将 ALB 替换为配置为使用 Server Name Indication (SNI) 的 Network Load Balancer。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 在 ALB 上创建监听器规则，将 HTTP 流量重定向到 HTTPS。**

Application Load Balancer 监听器规则包含操作，并且每条规则必须包含一个终止操作，例如 `forward`、`redirect` 或 `fixed-response`（[Listener rules for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)）。AWS 明确记录了 `redirect` 操作会将客户端请求从一个 URL 重定向到另一个 URL，并且协议可以从 HTTP 更改为 HTTPS；示例重定向操作会将 HTTP 请求更改为端口 443 上的 HTTPS，同时保留主机、路径和查询字符串（[Action types for listener rules: Redirect actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)）。因此，使用 HTTP 监听器规则/默认操作重定向到 HTTPS，是正确的 ALB 原生解决方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 更新 ALB 的网络 ACL，使其仅接受 HTTPS 流量。** 网络 ACL 会在子网网络层筛选流量；它不会向客户端发出 HTTP 重定向响应。阻止 HTTP 会导致 HTTP 请求失败，而不是将用户转发到 HTTPS。
- **B. 创建一条规则，将 URL 中的 HTTP 替换为 HTTPS。** URL 重写/转换并不是更改客户端协议的正确机制。AWS 将 transforms 描述为在路由之前重写入站请求，并指出 URL rewrite 修改的是路径或查询字符串，而文档中从 HTTP 到 HTTPS 的协议更改是通过 `redirect` 操作完成的（[Transforms for listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-transforms.html), [Redirect actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)）。
- **D. 将 ALB 替换为配置为使用 SNI 的 Network Load Balancer。** 要求是将 HTTP 重定向到 HTTPS。AWS 将此记录为 ALB 监听器规则的重定向操作，因此用 NLB 替换 ALB 是不必要的，并且无法在 ALB 监听器规则级别解决 HTTP-to-HTTPS 重定向。

en.question: A company is developing a two-tier web application on AWS. The company's developers have deployed the application on an Amazon EC2 instance that connects directly to a backend Amazon RDS database. The company must not hardcode database credentials in the application. The company must also implement a solution to automatically rotate the database credentials on a regular basis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the database credentials in the instance metadata. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and instance metadata at the same time.
options.B: Store the database credentials in a configuration file in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and the credentials in the configuration file at the same time. Use S3 Versioning to ensure the ability to fall back to previous values.
options.C: Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation for the secret. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the secret.
options.D: Store the database credentials as encrypted parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on automatic rotation for the encrypted parameters. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the encrypted parameters.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Secrets Manager is designed for this use case: it helps manage, retrieve, and rotate database credentials, and AWS explicitly states that it replaces hard-coded credentials with a runtime call to retrieve credentials dynamically when needed. Secrets Manager also lets you configure an automatic rotation schedule, so rotating credentials does not require application redeployment ([Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). In addition, Secrets Manager rotation updates credentials in both the secret and the database or service ([Rotate Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). Attaching permissions through the EC2 instance role is appropriate because EC2 uses an instance profile as the container for an IAM role, and permissions should be attached to the role for the resources the application needs ([IAM roles for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Storing database credentials in instance metadata is not the managed secrets solution, and the EventBridge/Lambda rotation workflow would require custom code to update both RDS and metadata, increasing operational overhead. Secrets Manager provides built-in automatic rotation instead.
- **B:** An encrypted S3 configuration file avoids plaintext storage but still requires custom scheduled Lambda logic to rotate both RDS credentials and the file. S3 Versioning also preserves prior credential values, which is not a least-overhead credential-rotation design.
- **D:** Parameter Store can store and retrieve configuration data and encrypted parameters, but its documented features include change events/notifications such as notifying when a parameter has not been rotated; this is not the same as built-in automatic database credential rotation ([Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)). Secrets Manager is the AWS service documented for automatic secrets rotation.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上开发一个两层 Web 应用程序。该公司的开发人员已将应用程序部署在一个 Amazon EC2 实例上，该实例直接连接到后端 Amazon RDS 数据库。公司不得在应用程序中硬编码数据库凭证。公司还必须实施一种解决方案，以定期自动轮换数据库凭证。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库凭证存储在实例元数据中。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 规则运行计划的 AWS Lambda 函数，同时更新 RDS 凭证和实例元数据。
options.B: 将数据库凭证存储在加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中的配置文件里。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 规则运行计划的 AWS Lambda 函数，同时更新 RDS 凭证和配置文件中的凭证。使用 S3 Versioning 确保能够回退到以前的值。
options.C: 将数据库凭证作为密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。为该密钥启用自动轮换。将所需权限附加到 EC2 角色，以授予对该密钥的访问权限。
options.D: 将数据库凭证作为加密参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。为加密参数启用自动轮换。将所需权限附加到 EC2 角色，以授予对加密参数的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Secrets Manager 专为此使用场景而设计：它有助于管理、检索和轮换数据库凭证，并且 AWS 明确说明它会用运行时调用来动态检索所需凭证，从而替代硬编码凭证。Secrets Manager 还允许你配置自动轮换计划，因此轮换凭证不需要重新部署应用程序（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。此外，Secrets Manager 轮换会同时更新密钥以及数据库或服务中的凭证（[Rotate Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。通过 EC2 实例角色附加权限是合适的，因为 EC2 使用实例配置文件作为 IAM 角色的容器，并且应将权限附加到该角色，以访问应用程序所需的资源（[IAM roles for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/iam-roles-for-amazon-ec2.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将数据库凭证存储在实例元数据中并不是托管密钥解决方案，并且 EventBridge/Lambda 轮换工作流需要自定义代码来同时更新 RDS 和元数据，从而增加运营开销。Secrets Manager 提供内置自动轮换功能。
- **B:** 加密的 S3 配置文件可以避免明文存储，但仍需要自定义计划 Lambda 逻辑来同时轮换 RDS 凭证和文件。S3 Versioning 还会保留以前的凭证值，这不是最少开销的凭证轮换设计。
- **D:** Parameter Store 可以存储和检索配置数据以及加密参数，但其文档化功能包括变更事件/通知，例如在参数未被轮换时发出通知；这与内置的自动数据库凭证轮换并不相同（[Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)）。Secrets Manager 才是 AWS 文档中用于自动密钥轮换的服务。

en.question: A company is deploying a new public web application to AWS. The application will run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application needs to be encrypted at the edge with an SSL/TLS certificate that is issued by an external certificate authority (CA). The certificate must be rotated each year before the certificate expires. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue an SSL/TLS certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.
options.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue an SSL/TLS certificate. Import the key material from the certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALUse the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) Private Certificate Authority to issue an SSL/TLS certificate from the root CA. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.
options.D: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to import an SSL/TLS certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to send a notification when the certificate is nearing expiration. Rotate the certificate manually.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The certificate is issued by an **external CA**, so it should be **imported into ACM**. AWS states that you can import certificates obtained outside AWS, such as from a third-party CA, and use imported certificates with ACM-integrated services. Elastic Load Balancing is integrated with ACM to deploy ACM certificates on the load balancer, which fits the ALB requirement ([ACM imported certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/import-certificate.html), [ACM integrated services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)).

The key limitation is renewal: ACM **does not provide managed renewal for imported certificates**. AWS says you must obtain a new certificate from the issuer and manually reimport it, and that you are responsible for monitoring expiration. AWS also notes that Amazon CloudWatch Events/EventBridge can send notices as imported certificates approach expiration ([ACM imported certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/import-certificate.html)). EventBridge expiration events apply to imported certificates and AWS notes that imported certificates must be reissued and reimported before expiration ([ACM EventBridge support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/supported-events.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
- **A:** Uses an ACM-issued certificate, not a certificate issued by an external CA. Also, managed renewal applies to eligible ACM-issued certificates, not externally issued imported certificates.
- **B:** Still says ACM issues the certificate and uses managed renewal. That does not meet the requirement for an external CA certificate, and ACM does not manage renewal for imported certificates.
- **C:** ACM Private CA is for private CA-issued certificates, not an external public CA certificate for a public web application. This also does not match the stated requirement that the certificate be issued by an external CA.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上部署一个新的公共 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后运行。该应用程序需要在边缘使用由外部证书颁发机构 (CA) 颁发的 SSL/TLS 证书进行加密。该证书必须在每年到期前轮换。解决方案架构师应如何做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 颁发 SSL/TLS 证书。将该证书应用到 ALB。使用托管续订功能自动轮换证书。
options.B: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 颁发 SSL/TLS 证书。从该证书导入密钥材料。将该证书应用到 ALUse 托管续订功能自动轮换证书。
options.C: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) Private Certificate Authority 从根 CA 颁发 SSL/TLS 证书。将该证书应用到 ALB。使用托管续订功能自动轮换证书。
options.D: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 导入 SSL/TLS 证书。将该证书应用到 ALB。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 在证书即将过期时发送通知。手动轮换该证书。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 该证书由 **external CA** 颁发，因此应当 **导入 ACM**。AWS 表示，你可以导入在 AWS 外部获取的证书，例如来自第三方 CA 的证书，并将导入的证书与 ACM 集成服务一起使用。Elastic Load Balancing 与 ACM 集成，可在负载均衡器上部署 ACM 证书，这符合 ALB 的要求（[ACM imported certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/import-certificate.html)、[ACM integrated services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)）。关键限制在于续订：ACM **不会为导入的证书提供托管续订**。AWS 表示，你必须从颁发者获取新证书并手动重新导入，并且你负责监控到期时间。AWS 还指出，当导入的证书接近到期时，Amazon CloudWatch Events/EventBridge 可以发送通知（[ACM imported certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/import-certificate.html)）。EventBridge 到期事件适用于导入的证书，并且 AWS 指出，导入的证书必须在到期前重新颁发并重新导入（[ACM EventBridge support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/supported-events.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**
- **A:** 使用的是 ACM 颁发的证书，而不是由外部 CA 颁发的证书。此外，托管续订适用于符合条件的 ACM 颁发证书，而不适用于外部颁发的导入证书。
- **B:** 仍然说由 ACM 颁发证书并使用托管续订。这不满足外部 CA 证书的要求，并且 ACM 不会管理导入证书的续订。
- **C:** ACM Private CA 用于由私有 CA 颁发的证书，而不是用于公共 Web 应用程序的外部公共 CA 证书。这也不符合题述的证书必须由外部 CA 颁发的要求。

en.question: A company runs its infrastructure on AWS and has a registered base of 700,000 users for its document management application. The company intends to create a product that converts large .pdf files to .jpg image files. The .pdf files average 5 MB in size. The company needs to store the original files and the converted files. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution to accommodate demand that will grow rapidly over time. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Save the .pdf files to Amazon S3. Configure an S3 PUT event to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to .jpg format and store them back in Amazon S3.
options.B: Save the .pdf files to Amazon DynamoDUse the DynamoDB Streams feature to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to .jpg format and store them back in DynamoDB.
options.C: Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the files to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store.
options.D: Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the file to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Store the PDFs and generated JPGs as Amazon S3 objects, and use an S3 object-created/PUT event to invoke AWS Lambda for conversion. S3 is designed for object storage and offers storage classes and lifecycle management to store data cost-effectively at scale; AWS states that S3 charges only for what is actually used and can grow with the business ([Amazon S3 features and pricing model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). S3 Event Notifications support **new object created events** and can send notifications directly to an **AWS Lambda function** ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). Lambda is serverless and AWS manages capacity provisioning and **automatic scaling**, so this avoids running conversion servers continuously ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** DynamoDB is not appropriate for storing 5 MB PDF/JPG files because the maximum DynamoDB item size is **400 KB** ([DynamoDB constraints: item size](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)). DynamoDB Streams can trigger processing, but the storage choice fails the file-size requirement.
- **C:** Elastic Beanstalk with EC2 instances, EBS volumes, and Auto Scaling can work technically, but it requires provisioning and operating compute and block storage. It is less cost-effective and less serverless than S3 + Lambda for event-driven file conversion, especially when demand is variable or rapidly growing.
- **D:** Similar to C, this relies on an Elastic Beanstalk/EC2-based processing tier and file storage instead of serverless object storage and event-driven processing. It adds infrastructure management and is not the most cost-effective scalable approach for storing and processing large numbers of objects.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行其基础设施，并且其文档管理应用程序拥有 700,000 名注册用户。该公司打算创建一个产品，将大型 .pdf 文件转换为 .jpg 图像文件。.pdf 文件平均大小为 5 MB。公司需要存储原始文件和转换后的文件。解决方案架构师必须设计一个可扩展的解决方案，以适应随时间快速增长的需求。哪种解决方案能以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 .pdf 文件保存到 Amazon S3。配置一个 S3 PUT 事件来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将文件转换为 .jpg 格式并将其存回 Amazon S3。
options.B: 将 .pdf 文件保存到 Amazon DynamoDUse DynamoDB Streams 功能来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将文件转换为 .jpg 格式并将其存回 DynamoDB。
options.C: 将 .pdf 文件上传到一个 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 应用程序，该应用程序包括 Amazon EC2 实例、Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储和 Auto Scaling 组。使用 EC2 实例中的程序将文件转换为 .jpg 格式。将 .pdf 文件和 .jpg 文件保存在 EBS 存储中。
options.D: 将 .pdf 文件上传到一个 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 应用程序，该应用程序包括 Amazon EC2 实例、Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 存储和 Auto Scaling 组。使用 EC2 实例中的程序将文件转换为 .jpg 格式。将 .pdf 文件和 .jpg 文件保存在 EBS 存储中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** 将 PDF 和生成的 JPG 作为 Amazon S3 对象存储，并使用 S3 object-created/PUT 事件调用 AWS Lambda 进行转换。S3 专为对象存储而设计，并提供存储类别和生命周期管理，以便以经济高效的方式大规模存储数据；AWS 表示，S3 仅对实际使用量收费，并且可以随业务增长而扩展（[Amazon S3 features and pricing model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。S3 Event Notifications 支持 **new object created events**，并且可以直接向 **AWS Lambda function** 发送通知（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。Lambda 是无服务器的，并且 AWS 管理容量预置和**自动扩展**，因此可避免持续运行转换服务器（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B:** DynamoDB 不适合存储 5 MB PDF/JPG 文件，因为 DynamoDB item 的最大大小是 **400 KB**（[DynamoDB constraints: item size](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)）。DynamoDB Streams 可以触发处理，但存储选择无法满足文件大小要求。
- **C:** 带有 EC2 实例、EBS volumes 和 Auto Scaling 的 Elastic Beanstalk 在技术上可以工作，但它需要预置和运维计算资源与块存储。对于事件驱动的文件转换，尤其是在需求可变或快速增长时，它不如 S3 + Lambda 具有成本效益，也不如其无服务器。
- **D:** 与 C 类似，该方案依赖基于 Elastic Beanstalk/EC2 的处理层和文件存储，而不是无服务器对象存储和事件驱动处理。它增加了基础设施管理工作，并不是用于存储和处理大量对象的最具成本效益的可扩展方法。

en.question: A company has more than 5 TB of file data on Windows file servers that run on premises. Users and applications interact with the data each day. The company is moving its Windows workloads to AWS. As the company continues this process, the company requires access to AWS and on-premises file storage with minimum latency. The company needs a solution that minimizes operational overhead and requires no significant changes to the existing file access patterns.
