* **消费者层：** 跨两个 Availability Zones 的 **EC2 Auto Scaling group** 比手动添加一个额外实例具有更高可用性。EC2 Auto Scaling 可以在已启用的 AZs 中维护实例，并且如果在某个 AZ 中启动失败，可以尝试另一个健康的 AZ（[Auto Scaling AZ distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-availability-zone-balanced.html)）。它还会作为运行状况检查的一部分，自动替换受损、停止或终止的实例（[Auto Scaling health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ts-as-healthchecks.html)）。
* **数据库层：** **Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ** 提供托管式高可用性和故障转移支持。RDS 会在不同的 AZ 中自动预置并维护同步备用副本，帮助防范 DB 实例故障和 AZ 中断（[RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A:** 将 ActiveMQ 和 MySQL 保持为在 EC2 上自托管。手动添加服务器并配置复制会增加运营复杂性，并且不提供 Amazon MQ 和 RDS Multi-AZ 的托管故障转移能力。
* **B:** 使用 Amazon MQ 改进了代理层，但 MySQL 数据库仍然是自托管并使用跨 AZ 复制，而不是使用托管的 RDS Multi-AZ 故障转移。
* **C:** 使用托管的 Amazon MQ 和 RDS Multi-AZ，但只添加了一个额外的消费者 EC2 实例。它缺少 Auto Scaling group 来自动替换故障消费者、维持容量并在 AZs 之间分布实例。因此，**D** 是最佳选择，因为它为代理和数据库使用托管 HA 服务，并为消费者层使用自动化的 multi-AZ 容量管理。

en.question: A company hosts a containerized web application on a fleet of on-premises servers that process incoming requests. The number of requests is growing quickly. The on-premises servers cannot handle the increased number of requests. The company wants to move the application to AWS with minimum code changes and minimum development effort. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Fargate on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to run the containerized web application with Service Auto Scaling. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
options.B: Use two Amazon EC2 instances to host the containerized web application. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda with a new code that uses one of the supported languages. Create multiple Lambda functions to support the load. Use Amazon API Gateway as an entry point to the Lambda functions.
options.D: Use a high performance computing (HPC) solution such as AWS ParallelCluster to establish an HPC cluster that can process the incoming requests at the appropriate scale.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The workload is already containerized and the company wants minimum code changes and least operational overhead. AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS is designed for this: AWS documentation states that Fargate runs containers without requiring you to manage servers or EC2 clusters, and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters for containers ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). ECS Service Auto Scaling can automatically increase or decrease the desired task count, including by using request-based metrics such as `ALBRequestCountPerTarget` ([ECS target tracking scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/target-tracking-create-policy.html)). An Application Load Balancer is appropriate for distributing HTTP/HTTPS traffic; Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming traffic across targets including containers and scales as traffic changes ([ALB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)), and ECS supports ALBs for routing traffic to container tasks ([Use an Application Load Balancer for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/alb.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Running containers on EC2 instances adds operational overhead: the company must provision, patch, manage, and scale EC2 capacity. Fargate specifically avoids managing servers or EC2 clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). Also, only two instances may not handle rapidly growing requests without additional capacity management.
- **C:** Lambda would require new code in a supported Lambda runtime and a redesign into functions, which conflicts with the requirement for minimum code changes. AWS’s decision guide contrasts Fargate as container-based serverless compute for long-running containerized applications, while Lambda is event-driven functions for short-duration tasks ([Fargate or Lambda decision guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/fargate-or-lambda/fargate-or-lambda.html)).
- **D:** AWS ParallelCluster is for deploying and managing HPC clusters, not for a standard containerized web application. It would introduce unnecessary complexity and operational effort compared with ECS on Fargate; AWS describes it as an open source tool for deploying and managing HPC clusters in AWS ([AWS ParallelCluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/parallelcluster/v2/ug/what-is-aws-parallelcluster.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在一组本地服务器上托管一个容器化 Web 应用程序，用于处理传入请求。请求数量正在快速增长。本地服务器无法处理增加的请求数量。公司希望以最少的代码更改和最少的开发工作量将该应用程序迁移到 AWS。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上的 AWS Fargate 运行容器化 Web 应用程序，并使用 Service Auto Scaling。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发传入请求。
options.B: 使用两个 Amazon EC2 实例托管容器化 Web 应用程序。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发传入请求。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda，并编写使用其中一种受支持语言的新代码。创建多个 Lambda 函数以支持负载。使用 Amazon API Gateway 作为 Lambda 函数的入口点。
options.D: 使用高性能计算 (HPC) 解决方案（例如 AWS ParallelCluster）建立一个 HPC 集群，该集群可以按适当规模处理传入请求。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** 该工作负载已经容器化，并且公司希望尽量减少代码更改并实现最少的运营开销。结合 Amazon ECS 使用 AWS Fargate 正是为此而设计的：AWS 文档说明，Fargate 可以运行容器，而无需你管理服务器或 EC2 集群，并且消除了为容器预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群的需要（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。ECS Service Auto Scaling 可以自动增加或减少所需任务数量，包括使用基于请求的指标，例如 `ALBRequestCountPerTarget`（[ECS target tracking scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/target-tracking-create-policy.html)）。Application Load Balancer 适合分发 HTTP/HTTPS 流量；Elastic Load Balancing 会将传入流量分发到包括容器在内的目标，并随着流量变化进行扩展（[ALB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)），并且 ECS 支持 ALB 将流量路由到容器任务（[Use an Application Load Balancer for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/alb.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 在 EC2 实例上运行容器会增加运营开销：公司必须预置、修补、管理和扩展 EC2 容量。Fargate 专门避免了管理服务器或 EC2 集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。此外，如果没有额外的容量管理，仅两个实例可能无法处理快速增长的请求。
- **C:** Lambda 需要使用受支持的 Lambda 运行时编写新代码，并将应用程序重新设计为函数，这与最少代码更改的要求相冲突。AWS 的决策指南将 Fargate 描述为适用于长期运行的容器化应用程序的基于容器的 serverless 计算，而 Lambda 是用于短时任务的事件驱动函数（[Fargate or Lambda decision guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/decision-guides/latest/fargate-or-lambda/fargate-or-lambda.html)）。
- **D:** AWS ParallelCluster 用于部署和管理 HPC 集群，而不是用于标准的容器化 Web 应用程序。与在 Fargate 上使用 ECS 相比，它会引入不必要的复杂性和运营工作；AWS 将其描述为一个用于在 AWS 中部署和管理 HPC 集群的开源工具（[AWS ParallelCluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/parallelcluster/v2/ug/what-is-aws-parallelcluster.html)）。

en.question: A company uses 50 TB of data for reporting. The company wants to move this data from on premises to AWS. A custom application in the company’s data center runs a weekly data transformation job. The company plans to pause the application until the data transfer is complete and needs to begin the transfer process as soon as possible. The data center does not have any available network bandwidth for additional workloads. A solutions architect must transfer the data and must configure the transformation job to continue to run in the AWS Cloud. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to move the data. Create a custom transformation job by using AWS Glue.
options.B: Order an AWS Snowcone device to move the data. Deploy the transformation application to the device.
options.C: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Copy the data to the device. Create a custom transformation job by using AWS Glue.
options.D: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device that includes Amazon EC2 compute. Copy the data to the device. Create a new EC2 instance on AWS to run the transformation application.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

A 50 TB migration with no spare network bandwidth should use an offline transfer device, not an online transfer service. AWS DataSync requires network connectivity between the on-premises storage/agent and AWS; the docs list Direct Connect, VPN, or public internet as the connectivity options for DataSync transfers, so it does not fit the “no available network bandwidth” constraint ([DataSync networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)). A Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device is appropriate because it can physically transport data without using the internet and has large usable capacity; AWS documents Snowball Edge Storage Optimized as having **210 TB usable** storage and supporting import/export between local environments and Amazon S3 by physically transporting the device ([Snowball Edge overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html), [device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)).

For the transformation job, **AWS Glue** is the lowest-operational-overhead cloud-native choice. AWS Glue is designed to “transform, prepare, and clean data for analysis,” supports ETL jobs that can be invoked on a schedule, and automatically scales resources based on workload ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

* **A**: DataSync is network-based and requires connectivity to AWS, which conflicts with the data center having no bandwidth for additional workloads ([DataSync networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)).
* **B**: Snowcone is not the best fit for a 50 TB bulk migration and running the transformation on the device would not configure the job to continue in the AWS Cloud. Snowball Edge Storage Optimized is the documented large-capacity physical transfer option here ([Snowball Edge device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)).
* **D**: Although EC2 could run the existing application, creating and operating EC2 instances for the transformation job adds server/instance management overhead. AWS Glue provides managed ETL capabilities, scheduling, and automatic scaling, so it better satisfies “least operational overhead” ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 50 TB 数据进行报告。该公司希望将这些数据从本地迁移到 AWS。公司数据中心中的一个自定义应用程序每周运行一次数据转换作业。公司计划暂停该应用程序，直到数据传输完成，并且需要尽快开始传输过程。数据中心没有任何可用的网络带宽来承载额外工作负载。解决方案架构师必须传输数据，并且必须配置转换作业，使其继续在 AWS Cloud 中运行。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 迁移数据。使用 AWS Glue 创建自定义转换作业。
options.B: 订购 AWS Snowcone 设备来迁移数据。将转换应用程序部署到该设备。
options.C: 订购 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。将数据复制到该设备。使用 AWS Glue 创建自定义转换作业。
options.D: 订购包含 Amazon EC2 计算能力的 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。将数据复制到该设备。在 AWS 上创建新的 EC2 实例来运行转换应用程序。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。在没有可用备用网络带宽的情况下进行 50 TB 迁移，应使用离线传输设备，而不是在线传输服务。AWS DataSync 需要本地存储/agent 与 AWS 之间的网络连接；文档列出了 Direct Connect、VPN 或公共互联网作为 DataSync 传输的连接选项，因此它不符合“没有可用网络带宽”的限制（[DataSync networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)）。Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备是合适的，因为它可以在不使用互联网的情况下物理传输数据，并且具有较大的可用容量；AWS 文档说明 Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 具有 **210 TB usable** 存储，并支持通过物理运输设备在本地环境与 Amazon S3 之间进行导入/导出（[Snowball Edge overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)，[device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。对于转换作业，**AWS Glue** 是运营开销最低的云原生选择。AWS Glue 旨在“transform, prepare, and clean data for analysis”，支持可按计划调用的 ETL 作业，并根据工作负载自动扩展资源（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

* **A**：DataSync 是基于网络的，并且需要连接到 AWS，这与数据中心没有带宽用于额外工作负载相冲突（[DataSync networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)）。
* **B**：Snowcone 并不最适合 50 TB 的批量迁移，而且在设备上运行转换并不能将作业配置为继续在 AWS Cloud 中运行。Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 是此处文档化的大容量物理传输选项（[Snowball Edge device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。
* **D**：虽然 EC2 可以运行现有应用程序，但为转换作业创建和操作 EC2 实例会增加服务器/实例管理开销。AWS Glue 提供托管的 ETL 功能、调度和自动扩展，因此更能满足“least operational overhead”的要求（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。

en.question: A company has created an image analysis application in which users can upload photos and add photo frames to their images. The users upload images and metadata to indicate which photo frames they want to add to their images. The application uses a single Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon DynamoDB to store the metadata. The application is becoming more popular, and the number of users is increasing. The company expects the number of concurrent users to vary significantly depending on the time of day and day of week. The company must ensure that the application can scale to meet the needs of the growing user base. Which solution meats these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store the photos and metadata in DynamoDB.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to process the photos and to store the photos and metadata.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store the photos in Amazon S3. Retain DynamoDB to store the metadata.
options.D: Increase the number of EC2 instances to three. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to store the photos and metadata.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

Using **AWS Lambda** for photo processing removes the fixed capacity of a single EC2 instance and better handles variable concurrency: AWS states that as a function receives more requests, Lambda “automatically scales up the number of execution environments” to handle them, within concurrency quotas ([Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)). Storing images in **Amazon S3** is appropriate because S3 stores uploaded files as objects, supports images and other file types, and a bucket can contain an unlimited number of objects ([Uploading objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/upload-objects.html)). Keeping **DynamoDB for metadata** is appropriate, and AWS specifically recommends storing large values as S3 objects and storing the S3 object identifier in DynamoDB when data exceeds DynamoDB item limits ([Best practices for storing large items and attributes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

* **A** is not ideal because it stores photos in DynamoDB. DynamoDB has a 400 KB item size limit, and AWS recommends storing large values in S3 and only storing the S3 object identifier in DynamoDB ([DynamoDB large item best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)).
* **B** is not the right fit. Amazon Data Firehose is for delivering real-time streaming data to destinations such as S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, and HTTP endpoints; it is not an image-processing service for applying photo frames. Firehose records are also limited to 1,000 KB, which is unsuitable for many photos ([What is Amazon Data Firehose?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)).
* **D** adds a small, fixed number of EC2 instances and uses EBS volumes, which does not provide the same elastic, event-driven scaling for highly variable concurrent usage. It also stores photos and metadata together on EBS rather than using S3 for scalable object storage and DynamoDB for metadata.

zh.question: 一家公司创建了一个图像分析应用程序，用户可以上传照片并为其图像添加相框。用户上传图像和元数据，以指明他们想为图像添加哪些相框。该应用程序使用单个 Amazon EC2 实例，并使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储元数据。该应用程序越来越受欢迎，用户数量正在增加。公司预计并发用户数会根据一天中的时间和一周中的日期而显著变化。公司必须确保应用程序能够扩展以满足不断增长的用户群的需求。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Lambda 处理照片。将照片和元数据存储在 DynamoDB 中。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 处理照片，并存储照片和元数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda 处理照片。将照片存储在 Amazon S3 中。保留 DynamoDB 用于存储元数据。
options.D: 将 EC2 实例数量增加到三个。使用 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷来存储照片和元数据。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。使用 **AWS Lambda** 进行照片处理可以消除单个 EC2 实例的固定容量限制，并更好地处理可变并发：AWS 表示，当函数接收更多请求时，Lambda 会“automatically scales up the number of execution environments”来处理这些请求，但受并发配额限制（[Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)）。将图像存储在 **Amazon S3** 中是合适的，因为 S3 将上传的文件作为对象存储，支持图像和其他文件类型，并且一个 bucket 可以包含无限数量的对象（[Uploading objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/upload-objects.html)）。保留 **DynamoDB for metadata** 是合适的，并且 AWS 明确建议，当数据超过 DynamoDB 项目限制时，将大值存储为 S3 对象，并在 DynamoDB 中存储 S3 对象标识符（[Best practices for storing large items and attributes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

* **A** 并不理想，因为它将照片存储在 DynamoDB 中。DynamoDB 有 400 KB 的项目大小限制，并且 AWS 建议将大值存储在 S3 中，只在 DynamoDB 中存储 S3 对象标识符（[DynamoDB large item best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)）。
* **B** 并不适合。Amazon Data Firehose 用于将实时流数据传送到 S3、Redshift、OpenSearch 和 HTTP 端点等目标；它不是用于应用相框的图像处理服务。Firehose 记录还限制为 1,000 KB，这对于许多照片来说并不适合（[What is Amazon Data Firehose?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。
* **D** 增加了少量固定数量的 EC2 实例并使用 EBS 卷，这无法为高度可变的并发使用提供同样的弹性、事件驱动扩展。它还将照片和元数据一起存储在 EBS 上，而不是使用 S3 进行可扩展对象存储并使用 DynamoDB 存储元数据。

en.question: A medical records company is hosting an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes customer data files that are stored on Amazon S3. The EC2 instances are hosted in public subnets. The EC2 instances access Amazon S3 over the internet, but they do not require any other network access. A new requirement mandates that the network traffic for file transfers take a private route and not be sent over the internet. Which change to the network architecture should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the route table for the public subnets to send traffic to Amazon S3 through the NAT gateway.
options.B: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances to restrict outbound traffic so that only traffic to the S3 prefix list is permitted.
options.C: Move the EC2 instances to private subnets. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3, and link the endpoint to the route table for the private subnets.
options.D: Remove the internet gateway from the VPC. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection, and route traffic to Amazon S3 over the Direct Connect connection.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A gateway VPC endpoint is the intended architecture for private access from a VPC to Amazon S3. AWS states that gateway endpoints provide connectivity to Amazon S3 and DynamoDB **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device**. For a gateway endpoint, traffic from the VPC to S3 is routed to the endpoint, and each subnet route table must have a route that sends service-destined traffic to the gateway endpoint using the AWS-managed prefix list. When the endpoint is associated with the relevant route tables, instances in those subnets automatically use it to access the service. Therefore, placing the EC2 instances in private subnets and associating the S3 gateway endpoint with those subnets' route table meets the requirement that S3 file transfer traffic not be sent over the internet ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. NAT gateway** — A public NAT gateway lets instances in private subnets connect to the internet, and AWS notes that public NAT gateway traffic is routed to the VPC's internet gateway. This does not satisfy the requirement for a private route to S3 ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)).
- **B. Security group restriction** — Restricting outbound traffic to the S3 prefix list can limit destinations, but it does not change the network path. AWS gateway endpoint routing, not security group rules alone, is what causes S3 traffic to use the endpoint route in the route table ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).
- **D. Direct Connect** — Direct Connect is for linking an internal/on-premises network to AWS and can create virtual interfaces to AWS services or VPCs. The problem is traffic from EC2 instances in a VPC to S3, which is solved directly with an S3 gateway endpoint; Direct Connect is unnecessary and does not address the VPC subnet route-table requirement as directly ([What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家医疗记录公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个应用程序。该应用程序处理存储在 Amazon S3 上的客户数据文件。EC2 实例托管在公有子网中。EC2 实例通过互联网访问 Amazon S3，但它们不需要任何其他网络访问。新的要求规定，文件传输的网络流量必须走私有路由，不能通过互联网发送。解决方案架构师应建议对网络架构进行哪项更改以满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个 NAT gateway。配置公有子网的路由表，使流量通过 NAT gateway 发送到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 配置 EC2 实例的安全组以限制出站流量，使其仅允许发往 S3 prefix list 的流量。
options.C: 将 EC2 实例移动到私有子网。为 Amazon S3 创建一个 VPC endpoint，并将该 endpoint 关联到私有子网的路由表。
options.D: 从 VPC 中移除 internet gateway。设置一个 AWS Direct Connect 连接，并通过 Direct Connect 连接将流量路由到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

gateway VPC endpoint 是从 VPC 私有访问 Amazon S3 的预期架构。AWS 表示，gateway endpoints 提供到 Amazon S3 和 DynamoDB 的连接，**无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device**。对于 gateway endpoint，从 VPC 到 S3 的流量会被路由到该 endpoint，并且每个子网路由表都必须有一条路由，使用 AWS-managed prefix list 将发往该服务的流量发送到 gateway endpoint。当 endpoint 与相关路由表关联后，这些子网中的实例会自动使用它来访问该服务。因此，将 EC2 实例放在私有子网中，并将 S3 gateway endpoint 与这些子网的路由表关联，可以满足 S3 文件传输流量不通过互联网发送的要求（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A. NAT gateway** — public NAT gateway 允许私有子网中的实例连接到互联网，AWS 也指出 public NAT gateway 流量会被路由到 VPC 的 internet gateway。这不满足到 S3 的私有路由要求（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。
- **B. Security group restriction** — 将出站流量限制到 S3 prefix list 可以限制目标，但不会改变网络路径。是 AWS gateway endpoint 路由，而不是仅靠 security group 规则，使 S3 流量使用路由表中的 endpoint 路由（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。
- **D. Direct Connect** — Direct Connect 用于将内部/本地网络连接到 AWS，并且可以创建到 AWS 服务或 VPCs 的 virtual interfaces。问题是 VPC 中 EC2 实例到 S3 的流量，这可以直接通过 S3 gateway endpoint 解决；Direct Connect 并非必要，并且不能像 VPC 子网路由表要求那样直接解决问题（[What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company uses a popular content management system (CMS) for its corporate website. However, the required patching and maintenance are burdensome. The company is redesigning its website and wants anew solution. The website will be updated four times a year and does not need to have any dynamic content available. The solution must provide high scalability and enhanced security. Which combination of changes will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront in front of the website to use HTTPS functionality.
options.B: Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL in front of the website to provide HTTPS functionality.
options.C: Create and deploy an AWS Lambda function to manage and serve the website content.
options.D: Create the new website and an Amazon S3 bucket. Deploy the website on the S3 bucket with static website hosting enabled.
options.E: Create the new website. Deploy the website by using an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and D**.

- **D is correct** because the site has no dynamic content and is updated only four times per year. AWS documentation states that you can use **Amazon S3 to host a static website**, and the S3 setup procedure explicitly enables **static website hosting** on a bucket and uses an index document such as `index.html` ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [S3 tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/HostingWebsiteOnS3Setup.html)). This avoids CMS/server patching and minimizes operational overhead.
- **A is correct** because CloudFront is designed to accelerate static website content globally and provide a safe, reliable viewer experience; AWS also notes that using S3 with CloudFront is a simple approach for storing and delivering static content ([CloudFront static content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)). CloudFront can require HTTPS from viewers by setting the viewer protocol policy to **Redirect HTTP to HTTPS** or **HTTPS only** ([CloudFront HTTPS for viewers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-viewers-to-cloudfront.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B is wrong** because AWS WAF web ACLs provide fine-grained control to allow or block HTTP(S) requests based on criteria such as IP address, country, string/regex matches, request size, SQL injection, or scripting. WAF protects resources, but it is not the service that provides HTTPS functionality ([AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)).
- **C is wrong** because a Lambda function to manage and serve static website content is unnecessary operational complexity when S3 static website hosting and CloudFront directly meet the requirements.
- **E is wrong** because EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an ALB would require more infrastructure management and patching than a static S3/CloudFront architecture, conflicting with the requirement for the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司将一个流行的内容管理系统 (CMS) 用于其企业网站。然而，所需的补丁和维护工作负担很重。该公司正在重新设计其网站，并希望采用一种新解决方案。该网站每年将更新四次，并且不需要提供任何动态内容。该解决方案必须提供高可扩展性和增强的安全性。哪种变更组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在网站前配置 Amazon CloudFront，以使用 HTTPS 功能。
options.B: 在网站前部署 AWS WAF web ACL，以提供 HTTPS 功能。
options.C: 创建并部署 AWS Lambda 函数来管理和提供网站内容。
options.D: 创建新网站和一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将网站部署到启用了静态网站托管的 S3 存储桶上。
options.E: 创建新网站。通过使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组来部署网站。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 D**。

- **D 正确**，因为该网站没有动态内容，并且每年只更新四次。AWS 文档指出，你可以使用 **Amazon S3 托管静态网站**，并且 S3 设置过程明确会在 bucket 上启用 **static website hosting**，并使用诸如 `index.html` 之类的索引文档（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [S3 tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/HostingWebsiteOnS3Setup.html)）。这避免了 CMS/服务器补丁，并最大限度地减少运营开销。
- **A 正确**，因为 CloudFront 旨在全球范围内加速静态网站内容，并提供安全、可靠的查看器体验；AWS 还指出，将 S3 与 CloudFront 结合使用是存储和交付静态内容的一种简单方法（[CloudFront static content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)）。CloudFront 可以通过将查看器协议策略设置为 **Redirect HTTP to HTTPS** 或 **HTTPS only** 来要求查看器使用 HTTPS（[CloudFront HTTPS for viewers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https-viewers-to-cloudfront.html)）。错误选项：

- **B 错误**，因为 AWS WAF web ACLs 提供精细控制，可根据 IP 地址、国家/地区、字符串/正则表达式匹配、请求大小、SQL 注入或脚本等条件允许或阻止 HTTP(S) 请求。WAF 可保护资源，但它不是提供 HTTPS 功能的服务（[AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)）。
- **C 错误**，因为当 S3 static website hosting 和 CloudFront 能够直接满足要求时，使用 Lambda 函数来管理和提供静态网站内容是不必要的运营复杂性。
- **E 错误**，因为位于 ALB 后面的 Auto Scaling group 中的 EC2 实例比静态 S3/CloudFront 架构需要更多基础设施管理和补丁工作，这与最少运营开销的要求相冲突。

en.question: A company stores its application logs in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. A new policy requires the company to store all application logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) in near-real time. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription to stream the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Use the log group to invoke the function to write the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the log group as the delivery streams sources. Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) as the delivery stream's destination.
options.D: Install and configure Amazon Kinesis Agent on each application server to deliver the logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Configure Kinesis Data Streams to deliver the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS documentation states that you can configure a CloudWatch Logs log group to stream data to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster **in near real time**: [Streaming CloudWatch Logs data to Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_OpenSearch_Stream.html). The subscription workflow specifically includes creating an **Amazon OpenSearch Service subscription filter** for the log group and starting streaming, which directly matches the requirement with the least operational overhead.

Why the other options are not best:

- **B**: A Lambda function could process CloudWatch Logs, but creating and maintaining custom function code to write to OpenSearch adds operational overhead. AWS already provides the CloudWatch Logs subscription integration for OpenSearch.
- **C**: CloudWatch Logs subscriptions can deliver log events to services such as Kinesis/Data Firehose, and subscription events are delivered soon after ingestion, usually in less than three minutes, according to the subscriptions documentation: [Real-time processing of log data with subscriptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/Subscriptions.html). However, using Firehose as an intermediate delivery stream is more components and overhead than the direct CloudWatch Logs-to-OpenSearch subscription option.
- **D**: Installing and managing Kinesis Agent on each application server plus Kinesis Data Streams introduces the most operational overhead and is unnecessary because the logs are already in CloudWatch Logs.

zh.question: 一家公司将其应用程序日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组中。一项新策略要求该公司近实时地将所有应用程序日志存储在 Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) 中。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足此要求？

options.A: 配置 CloudWatch Logs 订阅，将日志流式传输到 Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。使用该日志组调用该函数，将日志写入 Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。将日志组配置为传输流源。将 Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) 配置为传输流的目标。
options.D: 在每台应用程序服务器上安装并配置 Amazon Kinesis Agent，以将日志传送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams。配置 Kinesis Data Streams 将日志传送到 Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** AWS 文档指出，你可以配置 CloudWatch Logs 日志组，将数据**近实时**流式传输到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集群：[Streaming CloudWatch Logs data to Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_OpenSearch_Stream.html)。该订阅工作流明确包括为日志组创建 **Amazon OpenSearch Service subscription filter** 并开始流式传输，这直接符合要求且运营开销最小。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **B**：Lambda 函数可以处理 CloudWatch Logs，但创建和维护用于写入 OpenSearch 的自定义函数代码会增加运营开销。AWS 已经为 OpenSearch 提供了 CloudWatch Logs 订阅集成。
- **C**：CloudWatch Logs 订阅可以将日志事件传送到 Kinesis/Data Firehose 等服务，并且根据订阅文档，订阅事件会在摄取后不久传送，通常少于三分钟：[Real-time processing of log data with subscriptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/Subscriptions.html)。但是，与直接的 CloudWatch Logs 到 OpenSearch 订阅选项相比，使用 Firehose 作为中间传输流会带来更多组件和开销。
- **D**：在每台应用程序服务器上安装和管理 Kinesis Agent，再加上 Kinesis Data Streams，会引入最多的运营开销，并且没有必要，因为日志已经在 CloudWatch Logs 中。

en.question: A company is building a web-based application running on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. The web application will provide access to a repository of text documents totaling about 900 TB in size. The company anticipates that the web application will experience periods of high demand. A solutions architect must ensure that the storage component for the text documents can scale to meet the demand of the application at all times. The company is concerned about the overall cost of the solution. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.C: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
options.D: Amazon S3

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Amazon S3**

Amazon S3 is the most cost-effective fit for a 900 TB repository of text documents that must handle high-demand periods. AWS states that S3 applications can achieve thousands of transactions per second and that S3 **automatically scales to high request rates**; there are no limits to the number of prefixes in a bucket, enabling horizontal request scaling. AWS also describes S3 data lake workloads running over **petabytes of data** with aggregated throughput across multiple EC2 instances, which matches a large multi-AZ web application serving a very large document repository ([S3 performance optimization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)). S3 also provides multiple storage classes so you can choose based on access patterns and optimize storage cost, performance, and availability ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon EBS**: EBS is block-level storage attached to EC2 instances, and the volume and instance must be in the **same Availability Zone**. That makes it a poor primary shared repository for EC2 instances spread across multiple AZs, and AWS also notes account limits on total EBS storage ([EBS volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes.html)).
- **B. Amazon EFS**: EFS can serve shared file storage and has elastic throughput for spiky workloads, but its performance is governed by file system configuration and regional throughput/IOPS limits; requests beyond regional maximum throughput require quota increases ([EFS performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)). For simple storage and retrieval of 900 TB of text objects, S3 is the more appropriate cost-optimized object store.
- **C. Amazon OpenSearch Service**: OpenSearch Service is for building search applications and indexing/querying data, not for serving as the primary cost-effective storage repository for hundreds of TB of documents. AWS’s tutorial shows documents being indexed into an OpenSearch domain for search ([OpenSearch search application tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/search-example.html)), which would add cost and operational complexity compared with storing the documents in S3.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个基于 Web 的应用程序，该应用程序运行在多个 Availability Zones 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 Web 应用程序将提供对一个文本文件存储库的访问，该存储库总大小约为 900 TB。公司预计该 Web 应用程序将经历高需求时期。解决方案架构师必须确保文本文件的存储组件能够始终扩展以满足应用程序的需求。公司关注解决方案的总体成本。哪种存储解决方案能以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.C: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
options.D: Amazon S3

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. Amazon S3**

Amazon S3 最适合需要处理高需求时期的 900 TB 文本文档存储库，并且最具成本效益。AWS 表示，S3 应用程序可以实现每秒数千次事务，并且 S3 **会自动扩展以适应高请求速率**；bucket 中的前缀数量没有限制，从而支持水平请求扩展。AWS 还描述了 S3 数据湖工作负载可在 **PB 级数据** 上运行，并在多个 EC2 实例之间实现聚合吞吐量，这与一个服务于超大型文档存储库的大型 multi-AZ Web 应用程序相匹配（[S3 performance optimization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)）。S3 还提供多个存储类，因此你可以根据访问模式进行选择，并优化存储成本、性能和可用性（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon EBS**：EBS 是附加到 EC2 实例的块级存储，并且卷和实例必须位于**同一个 Availability Zone**。这使其不适合作为分布在多个 AZ 中的 EC2 实例的主要共享存储库，而且 AWS 也指出账户对 EBS 总存储量有限制（[EBS volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes.html)）。
- **B. Amazon EFS**：EFS 可以提供共享文件存储，并且针对突发工作负载具有弹性吞吐量，但其性能受文件系统配置以及区域吞吐量/IOPS 限制的约束；超出区域最大吞吐量的请求需要提高配额（[EFS performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。对于 900 TB 文本对象的简单存储和检索，S3 是更适合成本优化的对象存储。
- **C. Amazon OpenSearch Service**：OpenSearch Service 用于构建搜索应用程序以及索引/查询数据，而不是作为数百 TB 文档的主要成本高效存储库。AWS 的教程展示了将文档索引到 OpenSearch domain 中以进行搜索（[OpenSearch search application tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/search-example.html)），与将文档存储在 S3 中相比，这会增加成本和运营复杂性。

en.question: A global company is using Amazon API Gateway to design REST APIs for its loyalty club users in the us- east-1 Region and the ap-southeast-2 Region. A solutions architect must design a solution to protect these API Gateway managed REST APIs across multiple accounts from SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of administrative effort?

options.A: Set up AWS WAF in both Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
options.B: Set up AWS Firewall Manager in both Regions. Centrally configure AWS WAF rules.
options.C: Set up AWS Shield in bath Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
options.D: Set up AWS Shield in one of the Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Set up AWS Firewall Manager in both Regions. Centrally configure AWS WAF rules.**

AWS WAF is the service that protects API Gateway REST APIs from web exploits such as **SQL injection** and **cross-site scripting (XSS)**. The API Gateway documentation explicitly states that AWS WAF can protect API Gateway REST APIs from SQL injection and XSS attacks and that API Gateway requires a Regional AWS WAF web ACL for Regional APIs [Use AWS WAF to protect your REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html).

Because the APIs are in **multiple accounts**, AWS Firewall Manager is the least-administrative-effort solution. Firewall Manager simplifies administration across multiple accounts and resources for protections including AWS WAF, and automatically applies protections across accounts and resources as new accounts and resources are added [AWS Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/fms-chapter.html). For multi-Region resources other than CloudFront, AWS documentation says you must create separate Firewall Manager policies for each Region, which matches setting it up in both `us-east-1` and `ap-southeast-2` [Setting up AWS Firewall Manager AWS WAF policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/getting-started-fms.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS WAF in each Region can protect API Gateway REST APIs, but manually setting up and associating Regional web ACLs with API stages across multiple accounts requires more administrative effort than using Firewall Manager for centralized policy management.
- **C:** AWS Shield is primarily for DDoS protection. The documentation describes Shield Advanced as expanded DDoS protection, not the primary service for SQL injection or XSS filtering [What are AWS WAF, Shield Advanced, and Firewall Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html). Also, associating web ACLs manually does not minimize multi-account administration.
- **D:** A single-Region Shield setup would not cover Regional APIs in both Regions, and Shield is not the correct control for SQL injection/XSS protection.

zh.question: 一家全球性公司正在使用 Amazon API Gateway，为其位于 us- east-1 Region 和 ap-southeast-2 Region 的忠诚度俱乐部用户设计 REST APIs。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案，保护这些跨多个账户的 API Gateway 托管 REST APIs 免受 SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 在两个 Regions 中设置 AWS WAF。将 Regional web ACLs 与 API stage 关联。
options.B: 在两个 Regions 中设置 AWS Firewall Manager。集中配置 AWS WAF rules。
options.C: 在两个 Regions 中设置 AWS Shield。将 Regional web ACLs 与 API stage 关联。
options.D: 在其中一个 Regions 中设置 AWS Shield。将 Regional web ACLs 与 API stage 关联。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 在两个 Regions 中设置 AWS Firewall Manager。集中配置 AWS WAF rules。**

AWS WAF 是用于保护 API Gateway REST APIs 免受 **SQL injection** 和 **cross-site scripting (XSS)** 等 Web 漏洞利用的服务。API Gateway 文档明确指出，AWS WAF 可以保护 API Gateway REST APIs 免受 SQL injection 和 XSS 攻击，并且 API Gateway 对 Regional APIs 需要 Regional AWS WAF web ACL [Use AWS WAF to protect your REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)。由于这些 APIs 位于**多个账户**中，AWS Firewall Manager 是管理工作量最少的解决方案。Firewall Manager 简化了跨多个账户和资源的管理，适用于包括 AWS WAF 在内的防护，并且会在添加新账户和资源时自动跨账户和资源应用保护 [AWS Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/fms-chapter.html)。对于 CloudFront 之外的多 Region 资源，AWS 文档指出你必须为每个 Region 创建单独的 Firewall Manager 策略，这与在 `us-east-1` 和 `ap-southeast-2` 中都进行设置相匹配 [Setting up AWS Firewall Manager AWS WAF policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/getting-started-fms.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 每个 Region 中的 AWS WAF 可以保护 API Gateway REST APIs，但跨多个账户手动设置 Regional web ACLs 并将其与 API stages 关联，比使用 Firewall Manager 进行集中策略管理需要更多管理工作。
- **C:** AWS Shield 主要用于 DDoS 防护。文档将 Shield Advanced 描述为增强的 DDoS 防护，而不是用于 SQL injection 或 XSS 过滤的主要服务 [What are AWS WAF, Shield Advanced, and Firewall Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)。此外，手动关联 web ACLs 也无法最小化多账户管理工作。
- **D:** 单 Region 的 Shield 设置无法覆盖两个 Regions 中的 Regional APIs，而且 Shield 不是用于 SQL injection/XSS 防护的正确控制措施。

en.question: A company has implemented a self-managed DNS solution on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the us-west-2 Region. Most of the company's users are located in the United States and Europe. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the solution. The company launches and configures three EC2 instances in the eu-west-1 Region and adds the EC2 instances as targets for a new NLB. Which solution can the company use to route traffic to all the EC2 instances?

options.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
options.B: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Add the two NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups.
options.C: Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.
options.D: Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Global Accelerator is designed for this exact multi-Region, internet-facing performance and availability use case. A **standard accelerator** improves availability for global users and routes traffic over the AWS global network to endpoints in the nearest/optimal Region. AWS documentation states that standard accelerator endpoints can be **Network Load Balancers**, ALBs, EC2 instances, or Elastic IP addresses in one or multiple Regions, and that routing considers health, client location, and configured policies ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Global Accelerator also uses **endpoint groups associated with specific AWS Regions**, and listeners can be configured for **TCP, UDP, or both**, which is appropriate for a self-managed DNS service behind NLBs ([Global Accelerator components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-components.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Route 53 geolocation can route DNS queries based on user location, but adding **CloudFront** is inappropriate for a self-managed DNS service. CloudFront is for accelerating **static and dynamic web content**, and custom origins are HTTP servers/S3 origins that serve content over HTTP ([CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **C:** This bypasses the existing NLBs by routing directly to EC2 instances, reducing the load-balancing architecture. It also incorrectly adds CloudFront, which is for HTTP/web content, not DNS traffic ([CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **D:** Replacing NLBs with ALBs is not appropriate for a DNS solution, and this option again relies on CloudFront, which is for web content delivery over HTTP rather than DNS traffic ([CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). Route 53 latency routing to ALBs also would not provide the same Global Accelerator benefits of routing over the AWS global network to healthy optimal endpoints across Regions ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 us-west-2 Region 中的三台 Amazon EC2 实例上实现了自管理 DNS 解决方案，这些实例位于 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 后面。该公司的大多数用户位于美国和欧洲。公司希望提高该解决方案的性能和可用性。公司在 eu-west-1 Region 中启动并配置了三台 EC2 实例，并将这些 EC2 实例作为目标添加到一个新的 NLB。公司可以使用哪种解决方案将流量路由到所有 EC2 实例？

options.A: 创建 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由策略，将请求路由到两个 NLB 之一。创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配。使用 Route 53 记录作为该分配的源站。
options.B: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建标准加速器。在 us-west-2 和 eu-west-1 中创建端点组。将两个 NLB 作为端点添加到端点组。
options.C: 将 Elastic IP 地址附加到六台 EC2 实例。创建 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由策略，将请求路由到六台 EC2 实例之一。创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配。使用 Route 53 记录作为该分配的源站。
options.D: 将两个 NLB 替换为两个 Application Load Balancers (ALBs)。创建 Amazon Route 53 延迟路由策略，将请求路由到两个 ALB 之一。创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配。使用 Route 53 记录作为该分配的源站。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

AWS Global Accelerator 正是为这种多 Region、面向互联网的性能和可用性使用场景而设计的。**标准加速器**可提高全球用户的可用性，并通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最近/最优 Region 中的端点。AWS 文档说明，标准加速器端点可以是一个或多个 Region 中的 **Network Load Balancers**、ALB、EC2 实例或 Elastic IP 地址，并且路由会考虑运行状况、客户端位置以及配置的策略（[AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。Global Accelerator 还使用**与特定 AWS Regions 关联的端点组**，并且侦听器可以配置为 **TCP、UDP 或两者**，这适用于位于 NLB 后面的自管理 DNS 服务（[Global Accelerator components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-components.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Route 53 geolocation 可以根据用户位置路由 DNS 查询，但添加 **CloudFront** 不适合自管理 DNS 服务。CloudFront 用于加速**静态和动态 Web 内容**，自定义源站是通过 HTTP 提供内容的 HTTP 服务器/S3 源站（[CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **C:** 这会绕过现有 NLB，直接路由到 EC2 实例，从而削弱负载均衡架构。它还错误地添加了 CloudFront，而 CloudFront 用于 HTTP/Web 内容，不用于 DNS 流量（[CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **D:** 将 NLB 替换为 ALB 不适合 DNS 解决方案，并且此选项同样依赖 CloudFront，而 CloudFront 用于通过 HTTP 交付 Web 内容，而不是 DNS 流量（[CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。Route 53 到 ALB 的延迟路由也无法提供与 Global Accelerator 相同的优势，即通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到跨 Region 的健康最优端点（[AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。

en.question: A company is running an online transaction processing (OLTP) workload on AWS. This workload uses an unencrypted Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Daily database snapshots are taken from this instance. What should a solutions architect do to ensure the database and snapshots are always encrypted moving forward?

options.A: Encrypt a copy of the latest DB snapshot. Replace existing DB instance by restoring the encrypted snapshot.
options.B: Create a new encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and copy the snapshots to it. Enable encryption on the DB instance.
options.C: Copy the snapshots and enable encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Restore encrypted snapshot to an existing DB instance.
options.D: Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that is encrypted using server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys (SSE-KMS).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon RDS encryption for an existing unencrypted DB instance cannot be enabled in place: AWS states that you can encrypt an RDS DB instance only when you create it, not after it is created. The documented way to “effectively add encryption” is to create/copy an unencrypted snapshot as an **encrypted** snapshot and then restore a DB instance from that encrypted snapshot ([Amazon RDS encryption limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)). Once the restored DB instance is encrypted, RDS encrypts the underlying storage, logs, automated backups, read replicas, and snapshots; for an encrypted DB instance, all logs, backups, and snapshots are encrypted ([RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)). AWS also documents that when copying a DB snapshot, you can choose **Enable Encryption**, specify a KMS key, and that specifying `--kms-key-id` when copying an unencrypted snapshot encrypts the copy ([Copying a DB snapshot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CopySnapshot.html)). Therefore, encrypting a copy of the latest snapshot and replacing the existing DB instance by restoring from it is the right forward-looking solution.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B** is wrong because RDS DB instance encryption is not enabled by creating or attaching an EBS volume; RDS-managed storage is handled by RDS, and encryption cannot be turned on for an existing RDS DB instance after creation ([Amazon RDS encryption limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).
- **C** is wrong because you cannot restore an encrypted snapshot **to an existing DB instance**. The AWS-supported approach is to restore a **new DB instance** from the encrypted snapshot; AWS also says you cannot restore an unencrypted backup or snapshot to an encrypted DB instance ([Amazon RDS encryption limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).
- **D** is wrong because copying snapshots to an SSE-KMS-encrypted S3 bucket does not make the RDS DB instance encrypted and is not the RDS snapshot restore workflow. RDS encryption uses AWS KMS for RDS resources, and encrypted RDS DB instances encrypt their own storage, backups, and snapshots ([RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上运行在线事务处理 (OLTP) 工作负载。该工作负载使用 Multi-AZ 部署中的未加密 Amazon RDS DB 实例。每天都会从该实例创建数据库快照。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施，以确保数据库和快照从现在开始始终加密？

options.A: 加密最新 DB 快照的副本。通过还原加密快照来替换现有 DB 实例。
options.B: 创建新的加密 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，并将快照复制到该卷。对 DB 实例启用加密。
options.C: 复制快照，并使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 启用加密。将加密快照还原到现有 DB 实例。
options.D: 将快照复制到使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 托管密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 的 Amazon S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

现有未加密 DB 实例的 Amazon RDS 加密不能就地启用：AWS 声明，你只能在创建 RDS DB 实例时对其加密，创建之后不能加密。文档中“有效添加加密”的方法是将未加密快照创建/复制为**加密**快照，然后从该加密快照还原 DB 实例（[Amazon RDS encryption limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。还原后的 DB 实例加密后，RDS 会加密底层存储、日志、自动备份、只读副本和快照；对于加密的 DB 实例，所有日志、备份和快照都会加密（[RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。AWS 还记录了在复制 DB 快照时，你可以选择 **Enable Encryption**、指定 KMS key，并且在复制未加密快照时指定 `--kms-key-id` 会加密该副本（[Copying a DB snapshot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CopySnapshot.html)）。因此，加密最新快照的副本，并通过从该副本还原来替换现有 DB 实例，是面向未来的正确解决方案。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B** 错误，因为 RDS DB 实例加密不是通过创建或附加 EBS 卷来启用的；RDS 托管存储由 RDS 处理，并且现有 RDS DB 实例在创建后无法开启加密（[Amazon RDS encryption limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。
- **C** 错误，因为你不能将加密快照还原**到现有 DB 实例**。AWS 支持的方法是从加密快照还原一个**新的 DB 实例**；AWS 还说明你不能将未加密备份或快照还原到加密 DB 实例（[Amazon RDS encryption limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。
- **D** 错误，因为将快照复制到 SSE-KMS 加密的 S3 存储桶并不会使 RDS DB 实例加密，也不是 RDS 快照还原工作流。RDS 加密使用 AWS KMS 保护 RDS 资源，并且加密的 RDS DB 实例会加密其自身的存储、备份和快照（[RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to build a scalable key management infrastructure to support developers who need to encrypt data in their applications. What should a solutions architect do to reduce the operational burden?

options.A: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to protect the encryption keys.
options.B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.
options.C: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create, store, and assign the encryption keys.
options.D: Use an IAM policy to limit the scope of users who have access permissions to protect the encryption keys.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.**

AWS KMS is specifically designed for this requirement: it is an AWS managed service that makes it easy to create and control keys used to encrypt and sign data, and KMS keys are protected in AWS KMS and never leave the service unencrypted. AWS documentation also states that AWS KMS protects the root keys in an encryption key hierarchy and that KMS keys are created, managed, used, and deleted entirely within AWS KMS. This directly reduces the operational burden of building and operating a scalable key management infrastructure for application developers ([AWS KMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. MFA** can strengthen authentication for users, but it is not a scalable key management infrastructure and does not create, manage, rotate, or protect application encryption keys.
- **C. ACM** is for SSL/TLS X.509 certificates and keys used to protect websites and applications, not general-purpose application data encryption key management. ACM documentation describes it as handling creation, storage, and renewal of public and private SSL/TLS certificates ([ACM overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html)).
- **D. IAM policy** can help control access, and AWS KMS customer managed keys can use key policies and IAM policies, but IAM by itself does not provide managed cryptographic key generation, storage, rotation, and encryption/decryption operations. KMS is the managed service that provides those key-management capabilities ([AWS KMS keys concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望构建一个可扩展的密钥管理基础设施，以支持需要在其应用程序中加密数据的开发人员。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来降低运营负担？

options.A: 使用多重身份验证 (MFA) 来保护加密密钥。
options.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来保护加密密钥。
options.C: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 来创建、存储和分配加密密钥。
options.D: 使用 IAM policy 来限制具有访问权限以保护加密密钥的用户范围。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来保护加密密钥。**

AWS KMS 专为此需求而设计：它是一项 AWS 托管服务，可让创建和控制用于加密和签名数据的密钥变得简单，并且 KMS keys 受 AWS KMS 保护，永远不会以未加密形式离开该服务。AWS 文档还说明，AWS KMS 保护加密密钥层次结构中的 root keys，并且 KMS keys 完全在 AWS KMS 内创建、管理、使用和删除。这直接降低了为应用程序开发人员构建和运营可扩展密钥管理基础设施的运营负担（[AWS KMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/overview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. MFA** 可以增强用户身份验证，但它不是可扩展的密钥管理基础设施，也不会创建、管理、轮换或保护应用程序加密密钥。
- **C. ACM** 用于 SSL/TLS X.509 certificates 以及用于保护网站和应用程序的密钥，而不是用于通用应用程序数据加密密钥管理。ACM 文档将其描述为处理公共和私有 SSL/TLS certificates 的创建、存储和续订（[ACM overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html)）。
- **D. IAM policy** 可以帮助控制访问，并且 AWS KMS customer managed keys 可以使用 key policies 和 IAM policies，但 IAM 本身不提供托管的加密密钥生成、存储、轮换以及加密/解密操作。KMS 是提供这些密钥管理功能的托管服务（[AWS KMS keys concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。

en.question: A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certificate, which is on each instance to perform SSL termination. There has been an increase in traffic recently, and the operations team determined that SSL encryption and decryption is causing the compute capacity of the web servers to reach their maximum limit. What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?

options.A: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination.
options.C: Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances.
options.D: Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The bottleneck is SSL/TLS processing on the EC2 web servers. An Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener moves TLS termination to the load balancer: AWS documentation states that for an HTTPS listener, the load balancer uses the server certificate to **terminate the front-end connection and decrypt requests from clients before sending them to the targets** ([Create an HTTPS listener for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/create-https-listener.html)). Because the company already has its own certificate, it can import that externally obtained certificate into ACM; AWS documents that ACM supports importing certificates obtained outside AWS and that imported certificates can be used with AWS services integrated with ACM ([Import certificates into AWS Certificate Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/import-certificate.html)). ACM is integrated with Elastic Load Balancing to deploy ACM certificates on the load balancer ([Services integrated with ACM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Creating a new ACM certificate and installing it on each EC2 instance does not offload SSL processing from the instances. Also, ACM documentation says you generally **cannot install your ACM certificate directly on your AWS-based website or application**; ACM is intended to integrate with services such as Elastic Load Balancing ([Services integrated with ACM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)).
- **B:** Amazon S3 is object storage, not an SSL termination endpoint for EC2 instances. Storing a certificate in S3 would not reduce encryption/decryption work on the web servers.
- **C:** A self-managed proxy EC2 instance would move the bottleneck to another instance and adds operational burden. The managed ALB option is purpose-built to distribute traffic across EC2 targets and scale request handling capacity ([Services integrated with ACM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个托管在两台 Amazon EC2 实例上的动态 Web 应用程序。该公司拥有自己的 SSL 证书，并且该证书位于每个实例上以执行 SSL 终止。最近流量有所增加，运维团队确定 SSL 加密和解密导致 Web 服务器的计算容量达到其最大限制。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来提高应用程序的性能？

options.A: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建一个新的 SSL 证书。将 ACM 证书安装在每个实例上。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将 SSL 证书迁移到该 S3 存储桶。配置 EC2 实例引用该存储桶以进行 SSL 终止。
options.C: 创建另一个 EC2 实例作为代理服务器。将 SSL 证书迁移到新实例，并将其配置为把连接定向到现有 EC2 实例。
options.D: 将 SSL 证书导入 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。创建一个 Application Load Balancer，并配置一个使用 ACM 中 SSL 证书的 HTTPS 侦听器。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

瓶颈在于 EC2 Web 服务器上的 SSL/TLS 处理。带有 HTTPS 侦听器的 Application Load Balancer 会将 TLS 终止移到负载均衡器：AWS 文档说明，对于 HTTPS 侦听器，负载均衡器使用服务器证书来**终止前端连接，并在将请求发送到目标之前解密来自客户端的请求**（[Create an HTTPS listener for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/create-https-listener.html)）。由于该公司已经拥有自己的证书，因此可以将该外部获取的证书导入 ACM；AWS 文档说明，ACM 支持导入在 AWS 之外获取的证书，并且导入的证书可以与集成了 ACM 的 AWS 服务一起使用（[Import certificates into AWS Certificate Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/import-certificate.html)）。ACM 与 Elastic Load Balancing 集成，可在负载均衡器上部署 ACM 证书（[Services integrated with ACM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 创建新的 ACM 证书并将其安装在每个 EC2 实例上，并不会从实例上卸载 SSL 处理。此外，ACM 文档说明，通常**不能将 ACM 证书直接安装在基于 AWS 的网站或应用程序上**；ACM 旨在与 Elastic Load Balancing 等服务集成（[Services integrated with ACM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)）。
- **B:** Amazon S3 是对象存储，不是 EC2 实例的 SSL 终止端点。将证书存储在 S3 中不会减少 Web 服务器上的加密/解密工作。
- **C:** 自行管理的代理 EC2 实例会将瓶颈转移到另一个实例，并增加运维负担。托管的 ALB 选项专为在 EC2 目标之间分发流量并扩展请求处理容量而设计（[Services integrated with ACM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-services.html)）。

en.question: A company has a highly dynamic batch processing job that uses many Amazon EC2 instances to complete it. The job is stateless in nature, can be started and stopped at any given time with no negative impact, and typically takes upwards of 60 minutes total to complete. The company has asked a solutions architect to design a scalable and cost-effective solution that meets the requirements of the job. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Implement EC2 Spot Instances.
options.B: Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances.
options.C: Implement EC2 On-Demand Instances.
options.D: Implement the processing on AWS Lambda.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A. Implement EC2 Spot Instances**.

The workload is stateless, highly dynamic, and can be stopped and restarted without impact. AWS documentation says Spot Instances use unused EC2 capacity and can **significantly reduce EC2 costs** ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). AWS also states that Spot workloads should be fault-tolerant and time-flexible; if interrupted, Spot Instances can be stopped or hibernated and later resumed when capacity is available, and Auto Scaling groups or EC2 Fleet can maintain target aggregate capacity and replace disrupted resources ([Spot best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)). This matches the requirement for a scalable, cost-effective batch job that tolerates interruption.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B. Reserved Instances** — Reserved Instances reduce cost only by committing to a specific instance configuration for a 1- or 3-year term ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). The job is highly dynamic and interruption-tolerant, so Spot is a better cost-optimized fit.
* **C. On-Demand Instances** — On-Demand has no long-term commitment, but it is not the lowest-cost option for an interruptible workload. Spot is specifically identified as the EC2 option that can significantly reduce costs ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)).
* **D. AWS Lambda** — Lambda has a maximum function timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)** ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)). The batch job typically takes 60+ minutes, so Lambda is not the appropriate direct compute choice here.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个高度动态的批处理作业，需要使用许多 Amazon EC2 实例来完成。该作业本质上是无状态的，可以在任何给定时间启动和停止且不会产生负面影响，通常总共需要 60 分钟以上才能完成。公司要求解决方案架构师设计一个满足该作业要求的可扩展且经济高效的解决方案。解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

options.A: 实施 EC2 Spot Instances。
options.B: 购买 EC2 Reserved Instances。
options.C: 实施 EC2 On-Demand Instances。
options.D: 在 AWS Lambda 上实施该处理。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A. Implement EC2 Spot Instances**。该工作负载是无状态的、高度动态的，并且可以停止和重新启动而不会产生影响。AWS 文档说明，Spot Instances 使用未使用的 EC2 容量，并且可以**显著降低 EC2 成本**（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。AWS 还指出，Spot 工作负载应具备容错性和时间灵活性；如果被中断，Spot Instances 可以停止或休眠，并在容量可用时稍后恢复，而 Auto Scaling groups 或 EC2 Fleet 可以维持目标聚合容量并替换受影响的资源（[Spot best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)）。这符合该批处理作业对可扩展、经济高效且能容忍中断的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **B. Reserved Instances** — Reserved Instances 只有在承诺使用特定实例配置 1 年或 3 年期限时才能降低成本（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。该作业高度动态且可容忍中断，因此 Spot 是更符合成本优化的选择。
* **C. On-Demand Instances** — On-Demand 没有长期承诺，但对于可中断的工作负载来说，它不是成本最低的选项。Spot 被明确认定为可以显著降低成本的 EC2 选项（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。
* **D. AWS Lambda** — Lambda 的最大函数超时时间为 **900 秒（15 分钟）**（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。该批处理作业通常需要 60+ 分钟，因此 Lambda 不是这里合适的直接计算选择。

en.question: A company runs its two-tier ecommerce website on AWS. The web tier consists of a load balancer that sends traffic to Amazon EC2 instances. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS DB instance. The EC2 instances and the RDS DB instance should not be exposed to the public internet. The EC2 instances require internet access to complete payment processing of orders through a third-party web service. The application must be highly available. Which combination of configuration options will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
options.B: Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets.
options.C: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
options.D: Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet.
options.E: Configure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and E**.

**A. Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.**  
This meets the requirement that the EC2 instances and RDS DB instance are not exposed to the public internet. Placing the EC2 instances in private subnets prevents direct inbound internet access, while an Auto Scaling group across Availability Zones supports high availability. Deploying Amazon RDS as a Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets keeps the database private and provides database high availability. Amazon RDS DB subnet groups must cover at least two Availability Zones to support Multi-AZ deployments, as described in the RDS documentation on configuring the network for a DB instance: [Amazon RDS DB instance prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CreateDBInstance.html).

**E. Configure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.**  
This provides the required highly available network design. The public subnets host the internet-facing Application Load Balancer and NAT gateways. The private subnets host the EC2 instances and RDS database. The EC2 instances can initiate outbound internet connections through the NAT gateways to reach the third-party payment service, but external services cannot initiate connections directly to the instances. AWS states that a public NAT gateway lets instances in private subnets connect to the internet while preventing unsolicited inbound connections, and that a public NAT gateway is created in a public subnet: [NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html). AWS also recommends deploying resources in two Availability Zones, with public and private subnets, an Application Load Balancer, Auto Scaling, and NAT gateways in both Availability Zones for resiliency: [VPC with servers in private subnets and NAT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-example-private-subnets-nat.html).

The other options are incorrect:

**B. Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets.**  
This does not provide an internet-facing load balancer for the ecommerce website. Also, public NAT gateways that provide internet access must be created in public subnets and route through an internet gateway. A NAT gateway placed only in private subnets would not satisfy the requirement for outbound internet access to a third-party web service over the public internet.

**C. Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.**  
This violates the requirement that the EC2 instances should not be exposed to the public internet. Even if security groups restrict access, placing application instances in public subnets is not the correct design when the requirement explicitly says the instances must not be publicly exposed.

**D. Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet.**  
This is not highly available. A highly available design requires subnets across at least two Availability Zones for the public load balancer tier and the private application tier. With only one public subnet and one private subnet, the architecture has Availability Zone-level single points of failure. Elastic Load Balancing creates load balancer nodes in enabled Availability Zones, and it is most effective when Availability Zones are enabled for the load balancer and targets are available across them: [How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行其两层电子商务网站。Web 层由一个负载均衡器组成，该负载均衡器将流量发送到 Amazon EC2 实例。数据库层使用一个 Amazon RDS DB 实例。EC2 实例和 RDS DB 实例不应暴露到公有互联网。EC2 实例需要访问互联网，以通过第三方 Web 服务完成订单的支付处理。应用程序必须具有高可用性。哪种配置选项组合将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 Auto Scaling 组在私有子网中启动 EC2 实例。在私有子网中部署一个 RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例。
options.B: 配置一个 VPC，其中包含跨两个 Availability Zones 的两个私有子网和两个 NAT gateways。在私有子网中部署一个 Application Load Balancer。
options.C: 使用 Auto Scaling 组在跨两个 Availability Zones 的公有子网中启动 EC2 实例。在私有子网中部署一个 RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例。
options.D: 配置一个 VPC，其中包含跨两个 Availability Zones 的一个公有子网、一个私有子网和两个 NAT gateways。在公有子网中部署一个 Application Load Balancer。
options.E: 配置一个 VPC，其中包含跨两个 Availability Zones 的两个公有子网、两个私有子网和两个 NAT gateways。在公有子网中部署一个 Application Load Balancer。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A and E**。

**A. Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.**  
这满足了 EC2 实例和 RDS DB 实例不暴露到公有互联网的要求。将 EC2 实例放在私有子网中可防止来自互联网的直接入站访问，而跨 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组支持高可用性。将 Amazon RDS 作为 Multi-AZ DB 实例部署在私有子网中，可使数据库保持私有并提供数据库高可用性。Amazon RDS DB subnet groups 必须覆盖至少两个 Availability Zones 才能支持 Multi-AZ 部署，如 RDS 文档中关于为 DB 实例配置网络的说明所述：[Amazon RDS DB instance prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CreateDBInstance.html)。

**E. Configure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.**  
这提供了所需的高可用网络设计。公有子网托管面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer 和 NAT gateways。私有子网托管 EC2 实例和 RDS 数据库。EC2 实例可以通过 NAT gateways 发起出站互联网连接以访问第三方支付服务，但外部服务无法直接向这些实例发起连接。AWS 说明，public NAT gateway 允许私有子网中的实例连接到互联网，同时防止未经请求的入站连接，并且 public NAT gateway 创建在公有子网中：[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)。AWS 还建议在两个 Availability Zones 中部署资源，包括公有和私有子网、Application Load Balancer、Auto Scaling，以及位于两个 Availability Zones 中的 NAT gateways，以实现弹性：[VPC with servers in private subnets and NAT](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-example-private-subnets-nat.html)。其他选项不正确：

**B. Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets.**  
这不会为电子商务网站提供面向互联网的负载均衡器。此外，提供互联网访问的 public NAT gateways 必须在公有子网中创建，并通过 internet gateway 路由。仅放置在私有子网中的 NAT gateway 无法满足通过公有互联网对第三方 Web 服务进行出站互联网访问的要求。

**C. Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.**  
这违反了 EC2 实例不应暴露到公有互联网的要求。即使 security groups 限制访问，当要求明确说明实例不得公开暴露时，将应用程序实例放在公有子网中也不是正确的设计。

**D. Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet.**  
这不是高可用的。高可用设计要求公有负载均衡器层和私有应用程序层的子网至少跨两个 Availability Zones。只有一个公有子网和一个私有子网时，该架构存在 Availability Zone 级别的单点故障。Elastic Load Balancing 会在启用的 Availability Zones 中创建负载均衡器节点，并且当为负载均衡器启用多个 Availability Zones 且目标分布在这些可用区中时，其效果最佳：[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to reduce a company's storage costs. All the company's data is in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. The company must keep all data for at least 25 years. Data from the most recent 2 years must be highly available and immediately retrievable. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive immediately.
options.B: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.
options.C: Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the archiving option to ensure that data is archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately and to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to keep the newest 2 years in S3 Standard, then transition older objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive. S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to less-expensive storage classes or archive them as objects age, which matches the known 2-year access pattern and long retention requirement ([Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). S3 Standard provides frequently accessed data with millisecond access and 99.99% designed availability across at least 3 Availability Zones, satisfying the “highly available and immediately retrievable” requirement for the most recent 2 years ([S3 storage classes comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). After 2 years, S3 Glacier Deep Archive is appropriate because it is AWS’s lowest-cost storage option for multi-year archival retention, but it is not real-time access storage ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Transitioning immediately to S3 Glacier Deep Archive would violate the 2-year immediate retrieval requirement. Deep Archive objects are archived, are not available for real-time access, and require a restore request before access ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).
- **C:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering with archiving activated can move objects into optional Archive Access or Deep Archive Access tiers. Those tiers are for asynchronous access; objects must be restored before retrieval, and Deep Archive Access has S3 Glacier Deep Archive performance ([S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)). That does not reliably guarantee immediate retrieval for all data from the most recent 2 years as stated.
- **D:** S3 One Zone-IA stores data in only one Availability Zone and is less available and less resilient than multi-AZ classes; AWS notes it is not resilient to physical loss of an Availability Zone ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). This fails the “highly available” requirement for the most recent 2 years.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要实施一个解决方案，以降低公司的存储成本。公司的所有数据都位于 Amazon S3 Standard 存储类中。公司必须将所有数据至少保留 25 年。最近 2 年的数据必须具备高可用性并且可以立即检索。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 S3 Lifecycle policy，将对象立即转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.B: 设置 S3 Lifecycle policy，在 2 年后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。激活归档选项，以确保数据归档到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.D: 设置 S3 Lifecycle policy，将对象立即转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)，并在 2 年后转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 使用 S3 Lifecycle policy 将最新 2 年的数据保留在 S3 Standard 中，然后将较旧的对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。S3 Lifecycle 规则可以随着对象老化而将对象转换到成本更低的存储类，或将其归档，这与已知的 2 年访问模式和长期保留要求相匹配（[Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。S3 Standard 为频繁访问的数据提供毫秒级访问，并在至少 3 个 Availability Zones 中提供 99.99% 的设计可用性，满足最近 2 年数据“高可用且可立即检索”的要求（[S3 storage classes comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。2 年后，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是合适的，因为它是 AWS 用于多年归档保留的最低成本存储选项，但它不是实时访问存储（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 立即转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 会违反 2 年内可立即检索的要求。Deep Archive 对象已归档，不可用于实时访问，并且在访问前需要 restore request（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。
- **C:** 激活归档的 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 可以将对象移动到可选的 Archive Access 或 Deep Archive Access 层级。这些层级用于异步访问；对象必须先还原才能检索，并且 Deep Archive Access 具有 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的性能（[S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。这无法可靠保证最近 2 年内的所有数据都按题述可立即检索。
