- **D:** S3 One Zone-IA 仅在一个 Availability Zone 中存储数据，与多 AZ 类别相比可用性和弹性更低；AWS 指出它无法抵御 Availability Zone 的物理丢失（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。这不满足最近 2 年数据的“高可用”要求。

en.question: A media company is evaluating the possibility of moving its systems to the AWS Cloud. The company needs at least 10 TB of storage with the maximum possible I/O performance for video processing, 300 TB of very durable storage for storing media content, and 900 TB of storage to meet requirements for archival media that is not in use anymore. Which set of services should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
options.B: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 for archival storage
options.D: Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage

en.explanation:
**Answer: D.**

The video-processing working storage needs **at least 10 TB with maximum possible I/O performance**. Amazon EC2 **instance store** is temporary block storage physically attached to the host and is ideal for frequently changing temporary content such as **buffers, caches, and scratch data**—a good fit for video-processing scratch space ([EC2 instance store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html)). AWS also documents NVMe SSD instance store volumes exposed as block devices for **better performance**, and instance store capacity varies by instance type; documented examples include instance store totals above 10 TB, such as 11,400 GB and 22,800 GB ([SSD instance store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ssd-instance-store.html), [instance store volume limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-volumes.html)).

For the **300 TB of very durable media content**, Amazon S3 is appropriate because S3 Standard and most S3 storage classes are designed for **99.999999999% durability** across multiple Availability Zones ([S3 storage classes comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). For the **900 TB of archival media not in use**, S3 Glacier storage classes are designed for **low-cost, long-term data storage and data archiving**, with S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive being archival classes not available for real-time access ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A:** Amazon EBS can provide high-performance persistent block storage, but the question asks for the **maximum possible I/O performance** for processing scratch data; EC2 instance store is the better fit among the options because it is local temporary block storage for scratch/buffer workloads.
- **B:** Uses EBS instead of instance store for the maximum-I/O processing tier, and uses **EFS** instead of S3 for the 300 TB durable media repository. The S3 documentation specifically supports the durable object-storage requirement with 11 nines durability.
- **C:** Correctly uses EC2 instance store for the processing tier, but uses **EFS** rather than S3 for durable media content and uses **Amazon S3** instead of **S3 Glacier** for archival media. S3 Glacier classes are explicitly designed for archival storage.

zh.question: 一家媒体公司正在评估将其系统迁移到 AWS Cloud 的可能性。该公司需要至少 10 TB 的存储，并且要为视频处理提供尽可能最高的 I/O 性能；需要 300 TB 的高耐久性存储来存储媒体内容；还需要 900 TB 的存储来满足不再使用的归档媒体需求。解决方案架构师应推荐哪组服务来满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon EBS 用于最高性能，Amazon S3 用于耐久数据存储，Amazon S3 Glacier 用于归档存储
options.B: Amazon EBS 用于最高性能，Amazon EFS 用于耐久数据存储，Amazon S3 Glacier 用于归档存储
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store 用于最高性能，Amazon EFS 用于耐久数据存储，Amazon S3 用于归档存储
options.D: Amazon EC2 instance store 用于最高性能，Amazon S3 用于耐久数据存储，Amazon S3 Glacier 用于归档存储

zh.explanation:
**答案：D。**

视频处理的工作存储需要**至少 10 TB，并具备尽可能最高的 I/O 性能**。Amazon EC2 **instance store** 是物理连接到主机的临时块存储，非常适合频繁变化的临时内容，例如**缓冲区、缓存和临时数据**，因此很适合作为视频处理的临时工作空间（[EC2 instance store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html)）。AWS 还记录了作为块设备公开的 NVMe SSD instance store volumes，可提供**更好的性能**；instance store 容量因实例类型而异，文档示例包括超过 10 TB 的 instance store 总容量，例如 11,400 GB 和 22,800 GB（[SSD instance store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ssd-instance-store.html)，[instance store volume limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-volumes.html)）。对于 **300 TB 的高耐久性媒体内容**，Amazon S3 是合适的，因为 S3 Standard 和大多数 S3 存储类都设计为可跨多个 Availability Zones 提供 **99.999999999% durability**（[S3 storage classes comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。对于**不再使用的 900 TB 归档媒体**，S3 Glacier 存储类专为**低成本、长期数据存储和数据归档**而设计，其中 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 和 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是无法实时访问的归档类（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A:** Amazon EBS 可以提供高性能持久块存储，但题目要求处理临时数据的**尽可能最高的 I/O 性能**；在这些选项中，EC2 instance store 更合适，因为它是用于临时/缓冲区工作负载的本地临时块存储。
- **B:** 在最大 I/O 处理层使用 EBS 而不是 instance store，并且使用 **EFS** 而不是 S3 作为 300 TB 耐久媒体存储库。S3 文档明确支持具备 11 个 9 耐久性的耐久对象存储需求。
- **C:** 正确地在处理层使用 EC2 instance store，但使用 **EFS** 而不是 S3 来存储耐久媒体内容，并使用 **Amazon S3** 而不是 **S3 Glacier** 来存储归档媒体。S3 Glacier 类明确是为归档存储而设计的。

en.question: A company wants to run applications in containers in the AWS Cloud. These applications are stateless and can tolerate disruptions within the underlying infrastructure. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers.
options.B: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.
options.C: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers.
options.D: Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B. Use Spot Instances in an Amazon EKS managed node group.**

The workload is containerized, stateless, and can tolerate infrastructure disruptions, so Spot capacity is appropriate. AWS states that Spot Instances provide spare EC2 capacity at steep discounts and are a good fit for applications that can be interrupted. For EKS specifically, AWS says Spot managed node groups are a good fit for **stateless, fault-tolerant, flexible applications**, and that you can schedule fault-tolerant applications to Spot managed node groups while using On-Demand for fault-intolerant workloads ([Amazon EKS managed node group capacity types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)).

This option also minimizes operational overhead because Amazon EKS managed node groups **create and manage EC2 instances for you**, and each managed node is part of an Auto Scaling group that is managed by Amazon EKS. For Spot node groups, EKS configures the Auto Scaling group with Spot best practices and enables capacity rebalancing/draining behavior to reduce disruption ([Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)). The eksctl documentation similarly states that EKS Managed Nodegroups help fault-tolerant applications easily provision and manage EC2 Spot Instances, configure and launch an Auto Scaling group following Spot best practices, drain Spot worker nodes automatically, and have no incremental charge beyond underlying resources ([Spot instances - Eksctl User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/spot-instances.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Spot Instances in an EC2 Auto Scaling group:** Spot Instances are cost-effective for interruptible workloads, and EC2 Auto Scaling can maintain desired capacity ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/launch-template-spot-instances.html)). However, this option does not provide the managed container orchestration and EKS managed node group automation for container scheduling, node draining, and Spot best-practice integration. It has more operational overhead for running containers.
- **C. On-Demand Instances in an EC2 Auto Scaling group:** On-Demand avoids Spot interruptions but costs more than Spot, so it does not minimize cost for a stateless, disruption-tolerant workload.
- **D. On-Demand Instances in an EKS managed node group:** This reduces container operational overhead, but On-Demand capacity is recommended for fault-intolerant/stateful workloads, not for the given stateless interruption-tolerant workload. It does not minimize cost compared with Spot managed node groups.

zh.question: 一家公司希望在 AWS Cloud 中以容器形式运行应用程序。这些应用程序是无状态的，并且可以容忍底层基础设施中的中断。公司需要一种能够最大限度降低成本和运营开销的解决方案。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 Spot Instances 来运行应用程序容器。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 托管节点组中的 Spot Instances。
options.C: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 On-Demand Instances 来运行应用程序容器。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 托管节点组中的 On-Demand Instances。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B. 使用 Amazon EKS 托管节点组中的 Spot Instances。**

该工作负载是容器化、无状态的，并且可以容忍基础设施中断，因此 Spot 容量是合适的。AWS 表示，Spot Instances 以大幅折扣提供备用 EC2 容量，非常适合可以被中断的应用程序。具体到 EKS，AWS 表示 Spot 托管节点组非常适合 **无状态、容错、灵活的应用程序**，并且你可以将容错应用程序调度到 Spot 托管节点组，同时将 On-Demand 用于不容错的工作负载（[Amazon EKS managed node group capacity types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)）。此选项还可以最大限度降低运营开销，因为 Amazon EKS 托管节点组会**为你创建和管理 EC2 实例**，并且每个托管节点都是由 Amazon EKS 管理的 Auto Scaling 组的一部分。对于 Spot 节点组，EKS 会使用 Spot 最佳实践配置 Auto Scaling 组，并启用容量再平衡/排空行为以减少中断（[Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)）。eksctl 文档同样指出，EKS Managed Nodegroups 可帮助容错应用程序轻松预置和管理 EC2 Spot Instances，按照 Spot 最佳实践配置和启动 Auto Scaling 组，自动排空 Spot 工作节点，并且除底层资源外没有增量费用（[Spot instances - Eksctl User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/spot-instances.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 Spot Instances：** Spot Instances 对于可中断工作负载具有成本效益，并且 EC2 Auto Scaling 可以维持所需容量（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/launch-template-spot-instances.html)）。但是，此选项不提供用于容器调度、节点排空和 Spot 最佳实践集成的托管容器编排和 EKS 托管节点组自动化。运行容器时它具有更多运营开销。
- **C. EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 On-Demand Instances：** On-Demand 可避免 Spot 中断，但成本高于 Spot，因此对于无状态、可容忍中断的工作负载，它无法最大限度降低成本。
- **D. EKS 托管节点组中的 On-Demand Instances：** 这会降低容器运营开销，但 On-Demand 容量建议用于不容错/有状态工作负载，而不是题目给定的无状态、可容忍中断的工作负载。与 Spot 托管节点组相比，它无法最大限度降低成本。

en.question: A company is running a multi-tier web application on premises. The web application is containerized and runs on a number of Linux hosts connected to a PostgreSQL database that contains user records. The operational overhead of maintaining the infrastructure and capacity planning is limiting the company's growth. A solutions architect must improve the application's infrastructure. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora.
options.B: Migrate the web application to be hosted on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.C: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the web application content.
options.D: Set up Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and the PostgreSQL database.
options.E: Migrate the web application to be hosted on AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and E**.

- **A. Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora** — Aurora is a **fully managed relational database engine** compatible with PostgreSQL, and existing PostgreSQL code/tools/applications can be used with Aurora. AWS also states that Aurora storage grows automatically and that Aurora/RDS handles routine database tasks such as provisioning, patching, backup, recovery, failure detection, and repair. This directly reduces database infrastructure operations and capacity-planning burden. [AWS Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)
- **E. Migrate the web application to AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS** — The application is already containerized. AWS Fargate runs containers with Amazon ECS **without having to manage servers or clusters of EC2 instances**; it removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters and to choose server types or optimize cluster packing. This directly addresses the operational overhead of Linux hosts and capacity planning. [AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

Incorrect options:

- **B. Host the web application on EC2 instances** — EC2 would move the Linux hosts to AWS, but the company would still need to manage instances, capacity, patching, and scaling. Fargate is a better fit because it removes server and cluster management for containers. [AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)
- **C. Set up CloudFront** — CloudFront accelerates delivery of static and dynamic content through edge locations, but it does not migrate the containerized application or PostgreSQL database, nor does it solve the main operational overhead of maintaining hosts and database infrastructure. [Amazon CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)
- **D. Set up ElastiCache between the app and database** — ElastiCache can cache frequently used data and reduce repeated database reads, but it adds a caching layer rather than replacing the on-premises hosts or database management. It does not directly solve infrastructure maintenance and capacity planning for the core application/database stack. [Amazon ElastiCache overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/choosing-an-aws-nosql-database/amazon-elasticache.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在本地运行一个多层 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序已容器化，并运行在多台连接到 PostgreSQL 数据库的 Linux 主机上，该数据库包含用户记录。维护基础设施和容量规划的运营开销正在限制公司的增长。解决方案架构师必须改进该应用程序的基础设施。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作组合来实现这一目标？（选择两个。）

options.A: 将 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora。
options.B: 将 Web 应用程序迁移为托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。
options.C: 为 Web 应用程序内容设置 Amazon CloudFront 分配。
options.D: 在 Web 应用程序和 PostgreSQL 数据库之间设置 Amazon ElastiCache。
options.E: 将 Web 应用程序迁移为托管在 AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 E**。

- **A. Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora** — Aurora 是与 PostgreSQL 兼容的**完全托管的关系数据库引擎**，现有的 PostgreSQL 代码/工具/应用程序可以与 Aurora 一起使用。AWS 还说明 Aurora 存储会自动增长，并且 Aurora/RDS 会处理常规数据库任务，例如预置、修补、备份、恢复、故障检测和修复。这直接降低了数据库基础设施运维和容量规划负担。[AWS Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)
- **E. Migrate the web application to AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS** — 该应用程序已经容器化。AWS Fargate 使用 Amazon ECS 运行容器，**无需管理服务器或 EC2 实例集群**；它消除了预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群，以及选择服务器类型或优化集群装箱的需要。这直接解决了 Linux 主机和容量规划的运营开销。[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

错误选项：

- **B. Host the web application on EC2 instances** — EC2 会将 Linux 主机迁移到 AWS，但公司仍需要管理实例、容量、补丁和扩展。Fargate 更适合，因为它消除了容器的服务器和集群管理。[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)
- **C. Set up CloudFront** — CloudFront 通过边缘站点加速静态和动态内容的交付，但它不会迁移容器化应用程序或 PostgreSQL 数据库，也不能解决维护主机和数据库基础设施的主要运营开销。[Amazon CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)
- **D. Set up ElastiCache between the app and database** — ElastiCache 可以缓存常用数据并减少重复的数据库读取，但它增加的是缓存层，而不是替换本地部署的主机或数据库管理。它不能直接解决核心应用程序/数据库堆栈的基础设施维护和容量规划问题。[Amazon ElastiCache overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/choosing-an-aws-nosql-database/amazon-elasticache.html)

en.question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. The application performs best when the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances is at or near 40%. What should a solutions architect do to maintain the desired performance across all instances in the group?

options.A: Use a simple scaling policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function ta update the desired Auto Scaling group capacity.
options.D: Use scheduled scaling actions to scale up and scale down the Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.**

A target tracking scaling policy is designed for exactly this requirement: keep a utilization metric near a desired target. AWS documentation states that target tracking policies require a target value that represents the optimal average utilization for the Auto Scaling group, and that when the application is optimally scaled the actual metric should be at or just below that target value. Target tracking also supports the predefined metric `ASGAverageCPUUtilization`, the average CPU utilization of the Auto Scaling group ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)). Setting the target to **40% CPU utilization** will cause EC2 Auto Scaling to adjust capacity dynamically to maintain the desired performance.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Simple scaling policy** — Simple scaling can react to CloudWatch alarms, but it is not the best fit for maintaining a metric at a specific target. AWS describes dynamic scaling policies as tracking metrics and adjusting desired capacity when alarm thresholds are breached, but target tracking is the policy type that directly uses a target value for optimal average utilization ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scale-based-on-demand.html), [target tracking docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).
- **C. Lambda function to update desired capacity** — This would be custom automation and unnecessary. EC2 Auto Scaling already provides managed dynamic scaling policies for adjusting group capacity based on CloudWatch metrics ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scale-based-on-demand.html)).
- **D. Scheduled scaling actions** — Scheduled scaling is useful for predictable time-based demand, but the question asks to maintain CPU utilization near 40% across changing load. A metric-based target tracking policy is more appropriate.

Therefore, the best answer is **B**.

zh.question: 一个应用程序运行在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些实例位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中。当 EC2 实例的 CPU 利用率处于或接近 40% 时，应用程序性能最佳。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来维持该组中所有实例的期望性能？

options.A: 使用简单扩展策略来动态扩展 Auto Scaling 组。
options.B: 使用目标跟踪策略来动态扩展 Auto Scaling 组。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数来更新所需的 Auto Scaling 组容量。
options.D: 使用计划扩展操作来扩展和缩减 Auto Scaling 组。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用目标跟踪策略来动态扩展 Auto Scaling 组。**

目标跟踪扩展策略正是为此类需求而设计：使利用率指标保持在接近期望目标的位置。AWS 文档说明，目标跟踪策略需要一个目标值，该值表示 Auto Scaling 组的最佳平均利用率；当应用程序已被最佳扩展时，实际指标应处于或略低于该目标值。目标跟踪还支持预定义指标 `ASGAverageCPUUtilization`，即 Auto Scaling 组的平均 CPU 利用率（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。将目标设置为 **40% CPU 利用率** 将使 EC2 Auto Scaling 动态调整容量，以维持期望性能。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 简单扩展策略** — 简单扩展可以响应 CloudWatch 警报，但它并不是将指标维持在特定目标的最佳选择。AWS 将动态扩展策略描述为跟踪指标并在警报阈值被突破时调整所需容量，但目标跟踪才是直接使用目标值来实现最佳平均利用率的策略类型（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scale-based-on-demand.html)，[target tracking docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。
- **C. Lambda 函数来更新所需容量** — 这将是自定义自动化，并且没有必要。EC2 Auto Scaling 已经提供托管的动态扩展策略，可根据 CloudWatch 指标调整组容量（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scale-based-on-demand.html)）。
- **D. 计划扩展操作** — 计划扩展适用于可预测的基于时间的需求，但题目要求在不断变化的负载下将 CPU 利用率维持在接近 40%。基于指标的目标跟踪策略更合适。因此，最佳答案是 **B**。

en.question: A company is developing a file-sharing application that will use an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The company wants to serve all the files through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company does not want the files to be accessible through direct navigation to the S3 URL. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Write individual policies for each S3 bucket to grant read permission for only CloudFront access.
options.B: Create an IAM user. Grant the user read permission to objects in the S3 bucket. Assign the user to CloudFront.
options.C: Write an S3 bucket policy that assigns the CloudFront distribution ID as the Principal and assigns the target S3 bucket as the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
options.D: Create an origin access identity (OAI). Assign the OAI to the CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket permissions so that only the OAI has read permission.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

To prevent users from accessing objects directly by S3 URL while still allowing CloudFront to serve them, configure a CloudFront **origin access identity (OAI)** for the S3 origin and update the S3 bucket policy so only that OAI can read the objects. AWS documentation states that when using an OAI, you should ensure that the CloudFront OAI can access files on behalf of viewers and that viewers **can't use Amazon S3 URLs to access your files outside of CloudFront**. The same documentation shows a bucket policy granting the OAI `s3:GetObject` permission on `arn:aws:s3:::<S3 bucket name>/*` with the OAI as the `Principal` ([Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A:** Bucket policies are needed, but the option is vague and does not create or attach a CloudFront origin identity/control. Merely writing policies for buckets does not identify CloudFront securely as the only allowed accessor.
- **B:** CloudFront is not assigned an IAM user for S3 origin access. AWS documents OAI/OAC-based access, not embedding or assigning IAM user credentials to CloudFront.
- **C:** For the modern OAC model, AWS uses the CloudFront service principal `cloudfront.amazonaws.com` with a condition such as `AWS:SourceArn` containing the CloudFront distribution ARN—not the distribution ID as the `Principal`. Therefore this policy structure is wrong ([Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)).

Note: Current AWS documentation recommends **origin access control (OAC)** over OAI for new configurations, but among the provided choices, only **D** correctly describes the documented OAI pattern for blocking direct S3 access while allowing CloudFront access.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个文件共享应用程序，该应用程序将使用一个 Amazon S3 bucket 进行存储。公司希望通过一个 Amazon CloudFront distribution 提供所有文件。公司不希望这些文件可以通过直接导航到 S3 URL 来访问。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个 S3 bucket 编写单独的策略，仅授予 CloudFront 访问的读取权限。
options.B: 创建一个 IAM user。授予该用户对 S3 bucket 中对象的读取权限。将该用户分配给 CloudFront。
options.C: 编写一个 S3 bucket policy，将 CloudFront distribution ID 指定为 Principal，并将目标 S3 bucket 指定为 Amazon Resource Name (ARN)。
options.D: 创建一个 origin access identity (OAI)。将 OAI 分配给 CloudFront distribution。配置 S3 bucket 权限，使只有 OAI 具有读取权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

为了防止用户通过 S3 URL 直接访问对象，同时仍允许 CloudFront 提供这些对象，请为 S3 origin 配置 CloudFront **origin access identity (OAI)**，并更新 S3 bucket policy，使只有该 OAI 可以读取对象。AWS 文档说明，使用 OAI 时，应确保 CloudFront OAI 可以代表查看者访问文件，并且查看者**不能使用 Amazon S3 URLs 在 CloudFront 之外访问您的文件**。同一文档展示了一个 bucket policy，该策略向 OAI 授予对 `arn:aws:s3:::<S3 bucket name>/*` 的 `s3:GetObject` 权限，并将 OAI 作为 `Principal`（[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A:** Bucket policies 是需要的，但该选项表述含糊，并且没有创建或附加 CloudFront origin identity/control。仅为 buckets 编写策略并不能安全地将 CloudFront 标识为唯一允许的访问者。
- **B:** CloudFront 不会被分配 IAM user 来进行 S3 origin 访问。AWS 记录的是基于 OAI/OAC 的访问，而不是将 IAM user 凭证嵌入或分配给 CloudFront。
- **C:** 对于现代 OAC 模型，AWS 使用 CloudFront service principal `cloudfront.amazonaws.com`，并带有诸如 `AWS:SourceArn` 的条件，其中包含 CloudFront distribution ARN，而不是将 distribution ID 作为 `Principal`。因此，此策略结构是错误的（[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。注意：当前 AWS 文档建议新配置使用 **origin access control (OAC)** 而不是 OAI，但在提供的选项中，只有 **D** 正确描述了用于阻止直接 S3 访问并允许 CloudFront 访问的文档化 OAI 模式。

en.question: A company’s website provides users with downloadable historical performance reports. The website needs a solution that will scale to meet the company’s website demands globally. The solution should be cost-effective, limit the provisioning of infrastructure resources, and provide the fastest possible response time. Which combination should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3
options.B: AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB
options.C: Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.D: Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3**

The reports are downloadable historical files, which are a good fit for object/static content storage in Amazon S3. AWS states that Amazon S3 can host static website content, and S3 also provides pay-as-you-go storage classes and lifecycle features to optimize costs with no upfront commitment ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [S3 cost optimization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cost-optimization.html)). Amazon CloudFront is designed to speed distribution of static and dynamic web content through a worldwide network of edge locations, routing requests to the lowest-latency edge location and caching objects in multiple edge locations globally; CloudFront can use an S3 bucket as an origin ([CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). This combination minimizes infrastructure provisioning while providing global scale and fast response times.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB**: This is better for compute and structured NoSQL data, not for globally distributing downloadable static report files. It does not provide CDN edge caching for fastest global downloads.
- **C. Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling**: This would require provisioning and managing EC2-based web infrastructure. CloudFront documentation contrasts S3 origins with HTTP servers such as web servers running on EC2, but the question asks to limit infrastructure provisioning and optimize cost/latency for static downloads ([CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **D. Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers**: Internal ALBs are not internet-facing for public global users, and Route 53 DNS alone does not cache content at edge locations. This option does not meet the requirement for fastest possible global response for downloadable files.

zh.question: 一家公司的网页向用户提供可下载的历史性能报告。该网站需要一个解决方案，能够扩展以满足公司网站在全球范围内的需求。该解决方案应具有成本效益，限制基础设施资源的预置，并提供尽可能最快的响应时间。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种组合来满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3
options.B: AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB
options.C: Application Load Balancer 与 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
options.D: Amazon Route 53 与内部 Application Load Balancers

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3**

这些报告是可下载的历史文件，非常适合存储在 Amazon S3 中作为对象/静态内容。AWS 声明 Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站内容，S3 还提供按需付费的存储类和生命周期功能，以便在没有前期承诺的情况下优化成本（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)，[S3 cost optimization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cost-optimization.html)）。Amazon CloudFront 旨在通过全球边缘站点网络加速静态和动态 Web 内容的分发，将请求路由到延迟最低的边缘站点，并在全球多个边缘站点缓存对象；CloudFront 可以使用 S3 bucket 作为源站（[CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。这种组合在提供全球扩展能力和快速响应时间的同时，最大限度地减少基础设施预置。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **B. AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB**：这更适用于计算和结构化 NoSQL 数据，而不是在全球范围内分发可下载的静态报告文件。它不提供用于最快全球下载的 CDN 边缘缓存。
- **C. Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling**：这需要预置和管理基于 EC2 的 Web 基础设施。CloudFront 文档将 S3 源站与 HTTP 服务器（例如在 EC2 上运行的 Web 服务器）进行了对比，但题目要求限制基础设施预置，并针对静态下载优化成本/延迟（[CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **D. Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers**：内部 ALBs 不面向互联网，无法服务公共全球用户，而 Route 53 DNS 本身不会在边缘站点缓存内容。此选项不满足可下载文件尽可能最快全球响应的要求。

en.question: A company runs an Oracle database on premises. As part of the company’s migration to AWS, the company wants to upgrade the database to the most recent available version. The company also wants to set up disaster recovery (DR) for the database. The company needs to minimize the operational overhead for normal operations and DR setup. The company also needs to maintain access to the database's underlying operating system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region.
options.B: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to another AWS Region.
options.C: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region.
options.D: Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **A**.

**A. Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region.**

Running Oracle on Amazon EC2 gives the company access to the underlying operating system, which is an explicit requirement. It also allows the company to install and manage the desired Oracle database version, including upgrading to the most recent version that is supported by its licensing and application requirements. For DR, the company can configure Oracle replication, such as Oracle Data Guard or another database-level replication mechanism, to a separate AWS Region. Among the choices, this is the only option that satisfies both the OS access requirement and the cross-Region DR requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

**B. Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to another AWS Region.**  
Amazon RDS for Oracle reduces operational overhead and Cross-Region automated backups can help with disaster recovery, but standard Amazon RDS does not provide access to the underlying operating system. AWS states that if the entire database and operating system should be fully managed by AWS, use Amazon RDS; if administrative rights to the database and underlying operating system are needed, use RDS Custom instead ([Amazon RDS Custom](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-custom.html)). Therefore, this option fails the OS access requirement.

**C. Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region.**  
Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle does provide access to and customization of the database environment and operating system ([Amazon RDS Custom](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-custom.html)). However, the proposed DR design depends on creating an RDS Custom for Oracle read replica in another AWS Region. RDS Custom for Oracle replication has specific guidelines and limitations, and not all RDS for Oracle replica options are supported ([RDS Custom for Oracle replication limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/custom-rr.reqs-limitations.html)). This option therefore does not meet the stated cross-Region DR setup as written.

**D. Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone.**  
A Multi-AZ Amazon RDS deployment provides failover support by maintaining a standby DB instance in another Availability Zone ([Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)). However, this is an Availability Zone-level high availability configuration, not a separate-Region DR solution. Additionally, standard Amazon RDS for Oracle does not provide access to the underlying operating system, so this option also fails a key requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地运行 Oracle 数据库。作为公司迁移到 AWS 的一部分，公司希望将数据库升级到当前可用的最新版本。公司还希望为该数据库设置灾难恢复 (DR)。公司需要尽量减少正常运行和 DR 设置的运营开销。公司还需要保持对数据库底层操作系统的访问。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。设置数据库复制到不同的 AWS Region。
options.B: 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。启用 Cross-Region automated backups，将快照复制到另一个 AWS Region。
options.C: 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle。在另一个 AWS Region 中为该数据库创建 read replica。
options.D: 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。在另一个 Availability Zone 中创建 standby database。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A**。

**A. 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。设置数据库复制到不同的 AWS Region。**

在 Amazon EC2 上运行 Oracle 可让公司访问底层操作系统，这是一个明确要求。它还允许公司安装和管理所需的 Oracle 数据库版本，包括升级到其许可和应用程序要求所支持的最新版本。对于 DR，公司可以配置 Oracle 复制，例如 Oracle Data Guard 或其他数据库级复制机制，复制到单独的 AWS Region。在这些选项中，这是唯一同时满足 OS 访问要求和跨 Region DR 要求的选项。其他选项不正确的原因：

**B. 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。启用 Cross-Region automated backups，将快照复制到另一个 AWS Region。**  
Amazon RDS for Oracle 可以减少运营开销，Cross-Region automated backups 可以帮助实现灾难恢复，但标准 Amazon RDS 不提供对底层操作系统的访问。AWS 表示，如果整个数据库和操作系统应由 AWS 完全托管，请使用 Amazon RDS；如果需要数据库和底层操作系统的管理权限，请改用 RDS Custom ([Amazon RDS Custom](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-custom.html))。因此，此选项未满足 OS 访问要求。

**C. 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle。在另一个 AWS Region 中为该数据库创建 read replica。**  
Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle 确实提供对数据库环境和操作系统的访问与自定义 ([Amazon RDS Custom](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-custom.html))。但是，所提出的 DR 设计依赖于在另一个 AWS Region 中创建 RDS Custom for Oracle read replica。RDS Custom for Oracle 复制有特定的指南和限制，并且并非所有 RDS for Oracle 副本选项都受支持 ([RDS Custom for Oracle replication limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/custom-rr.reqs-limitations.html))。因此，此选项按其描述并不满足所述的跨 Region DR 设置。

**D. 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。在另一个 Availability Zone 中创建 standby database。**  
Multi-AZ Amazon RDS 部署通过在另一个 Availability Zone 中维护 standby DB instance 来提供故障转移支持 ([Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html))。但是，这是 Availability Zone 级别的高可用性配置，而不是单独 Region 的 DR 解决方案。此外，标准 Amazon RDS for Oracle 不提供对底层操作系统的访问，因此此选项也未满足一项关键要求。

en.question: A company wants to move its application to a serverless solution. The serverless solution needs to analyze existing and new data by using SL. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data requires encryption and must be replicated to a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region kays (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.B: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.
options.C: Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

Amazon Athena is the appropriate serverless analytics service because AWS states that Athena makes it easy to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 with standard SQL, and that Athena SQL is serverless with no infrastructure to set up or manage ([Athena: What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). S3 Cross-Region Replication is used to copy objects across S3 buckets in different AWS Regions, including for compliance or when compute/analytics in multiple Regions need the same objects ([S3 replication: When to use CRR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)). For encryption with the least operational overhead, SSE-S3 is the simplest choice: S3 encrypts new object uploads by default with Amazon S3 managed keys, uses 256-bit AES-GCM, and does not require KMS key management ([SSE-S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)). S3 documentation also states that replicas of SSE-S3 encrypted source objects use the same encryption type as the source objects ([replicating encrypted objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-config-for-kms-objects.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A** uses Athena, but SSE-KMS with multi-Region KMS keys adds operational overhead. For SSE-KMS/DSSE-KMS replication, S3 requires explicit opt-in, destination KMS key configuration, and KMS permissions such as `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:Encrypt` ([replicating encrypted objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-config-for-kms-objects.html)). Creating a new bucket and reloading data also adds unnecessary work when the data is already in S3.
* **B** has the same unnecessary KMS and bucket-migration overhead as A, and Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service based on DB instances, not a serverless SQL query service for data already stored in S3 ([Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
* **D** uses the lower-overhead SSE-S3 and CRR approach, but RDS is not the right service for ad hoc SQL analysis of S3 data; Athena is serverless and queries S3 directly.

Note: if some objects were already in the bucket before replication was configured, S3 Batch Replication is the AWS mechanism to replicate those existing objects; live CRR applies to replication rules going forward ([S3 Batch Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)). Among the provided options, **C** best meets the requirements with the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其应用程序迁移到无服务器解决方案。该无服务器解决方案需要使用 SL 分析现有数据和新数据。公司将数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中。数据需要加密，并且必须复制到不同的 AWS Region。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 S3 bucket。将数据加载到新的 S3 bucket 中。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 将加密对象复制到另一个 Region 中的 S3 bucket。使用带有 AWS KMS multi-Region kays (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.B: 创建一个新的 S3 bucket。将数据加载到新的 S3 bucket 中。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 将加密对象复制到另一个 Region 中的 S3 bucket。使用带有 AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密。使用 Amazon RDS 查询数据。
options.C: 将数据加载到现有的 S3 bucket 中。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 将加密对象复制到另一个 Region 中的 S3 bucket。使用带有 Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) 的服务器端加密。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.D: 将数据加载到现有的 S3 bucket 中。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 将加密对象复制到另一个 Region 中的 S3 bucket。使用带有 Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) 的服务器端加密。使用 Amazon RDS 查询数据。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

Amazon Athena 是合适的无服务器分析服务，因为 AWS 声明 Athena 可以轻松地使用标准 SQL 直接分析 Amazon S3 中的数据，并且 Athena SQL 是无服务器的，无需设置或管理基础设施（[Athena: What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。S3 Cross-Region Replication 用于在不同 AWS Regions 中的 S3 bucket 之间复制对象，包括用于合规性，或者当多个 Regions 中的计算/分析需要相同对象时（[S3 replication: When to use CRR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。对于以最少运营开销实现加密，SSE-S3 是最简单的选择：S3 默认使用 Amazon S3 managed keys 加密新对象上传，使用 256-bit AES-GCM，并且不需要 KMS 密钥管理（[SSE-S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)）。S3 文档还声明，SSE-S3 加密源对象的副本使用与源对象相同的加密类型（[replicating encrypted objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-config-for-kms-objects.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **A** 使用 Athena，但带有 multi-Region KMS keys 的 SSE-KMS 会增加运营开销。对于 SSE-KMS/DSSE-KMS 复制，S3 要求显式选择加入、配置目标 KMS key，以及配置 `kms:Decrypt` 和 `kms:Encrypt` 等 KMS 权限（[replicating encrypted objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-config-for-kms-objects.html)）。在数据已经位于 S3 中时，创建新的 bucket 并重新加载数据也会增加不必要的工作。
* **B** 与 A 一样具有不必要的 KMS 和 bucket 迁移开销，而且 Amazon RDS 是基于 DB instances 的托管关系型数据库服务，并不是用于查询已存储在 S3 中的数据的无服务器 SQL 查询服务（[Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
* **D** 使用较低开销的 SSE-S3 和 CRR 方法，但 RDS 并不是对 S3 数据进行临时 SQL 分析的正确服务；Athena 是无服务器的，并且直接查询 S3。注意：如果某些对象在配置复制之前已经位于 bucket 中，S3 Batch Replication 是 AWS 用于复制这些现有对象的机制；实时 CRR 适用于复制规则生效后的后续复制（[S3 Batch Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。在给定选项中，**C** 最能以最少的运营开销满足要求。

en.question: A company runs workloads on AWS. The company needs to connect to a service from an external provider. The service is hosted in the provider's VPC. According to the company’s security team, the connectivity must be private and must be restricted to the target service. The connection must be initiated only from the company’s VPC. Which solution will mast these requirements?

options.A: Create a VPC peering connection between the company's VPC and the provider's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service.
options.B: Ask the provider to create a virtual private gateway in its VPC. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
options.C: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company’s VPUpdate the route table to connect to the target service.
options.D: Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint for the target service. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**. AWS PrivateLink is designed for this exact pattern: private connectivity from a consumer VPC to a service hosted in another account/VPC, without using the public internet. AWS states that PrivateLink establishes private connectivity to “services hosted by other AWS accounts” and that you do not need an internet gateway, NAT device, Direct Connect, or Site-to-Site VPN to communicate with the service. To use it, the consumer creates a VPC endpoint in the subnets that need access, and a service provider can create a VPC endpoint service powered by PrivateLink to let other AWS customers access only that service securely ([AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)). This meets the requirements for private, service-scoped, company-initiated connectivity.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. VPC peering** provides private connectivity between two VPCs, but AWS describes peered VPC resources as communicating “as if they are within the same network” ([VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)). That is broader VPC-to-VPC connectivity, not connectivity restricted to only the target service.
- **B. Virtual private gateway + PrivateLink** is not the PrivateLink architecture. A virtual private gateway is associated with VPN/Direct Connect-style routing, while AWS PrivateLink uses VPC endpoints and endpoint services, and AWS explicitly notes that PrivateLink does not require Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN ([AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)).
- **C. NAT gateway** allows instances in a private subnet to connect to services outside the VPC, and a public NAT gateway can connect through the internet gateway ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)). It does not provide private, target-service-restricted connectivity to a provider-hosted service.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行工作负载。该公司需要连接到外部提供商的一项服务。该服务托管在提供商的 VPC 中。根据公司安全团队的要求，连接必须是私有的，并且必须限制为只能访问目标服务。连接必须只能从公司的 VPC 发起。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在公司的 VPC 和提供商的 VPC 之间创建 VPC peering connection。更新路由表以连接到目标服务。
options.B: 要求提供商在其 VPC 中创建 virtual private gateway。使用 AWS PrivateLink 连接到目标服务。
options.C: 在公司 VPUpdate 的公有子网中创建 NAT gateway 路由表以连接到目标服务。
options.D: 要求提供商为目标服务创建 VPC endpoint。使用 AWS PrivateLink 连接到目标服务。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。AWS PrivateLink 正是为这种模式而设计的：从消费者 VPC 到托管在另一个账户/VPC 中的服务进行私有连接，而无需使用公共互联网。AWS 表示，PrivateLink 可建立到“其他 AWS 账户托管的服务”的私有连接，并且您不需要 internet gateway、NAT device、Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN 即可与该服务通信。要使用它，消费者需要在需要访问的子网中创建 VPC endpoint，而服务提供商可以创建由 PrivateLink 提供支持的 VPC endpoint service，以允许其他 AWS 客户仅安全地访问该服务（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。这满足私有、服务范围限定、由公司发起连接的要求。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. VPC peering** 在两个 VPC 之间提供私有连接，但 AWS 将对等 VPC 资源描述为“就像它们位于同一网络中一样”进行通信（[VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。这是更广泛的 VPC 到 VPC 连接，而不是仅限制到目标服务的连接。
- **B. Virtual private gateway + PrivateLink** 不是 PrivateLink 架构。virtual private gateway 与 VPN/Direct Connect 风格的路由相关联，而 AWS PrivateLink 使用 VPC endpoints 和 endpoint services，并且 AWS 明确指出 PrivateLink 不需要 Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。
- **C. NAT gateway** 允许私有子网中的实例连接到 VPC 外部的服务，并且 public NAT gateway 可以通过 internet gateway 进行连接（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。它不提供到提供商托管服务的私有、目标服务受限连接。

en.question: A company is migrating its on-premises PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The on- premises database must remain online and accessible during the migration. The Aurora database must remain synchronized with the on-premises database. Which combination of actions must a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an ongoing replication task.
options.B: Create a database backup of the on-premises database.
options.C: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication server.
options.D: Convert the database schema by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT).
options.E: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor the database synchronization.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and C.**

AWS DMS is designed to migrate data from a source endpoint to a target endpoint when at least one endpoint is on AWS, which fits an on-premises PostgreSQL source and an Aurora PostgreSQL target ([AWS DMS terminology and concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.html)). An AWS DMS migration requires the necessary **replication instance**, endpoints, and tasks; the replication instance is the managed compute that hosts one or more replication tasks ([Components of AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Components.html)). Therefore, creating the DMS replication server/replication instance is required (**C**). To keep the Aurora target synchronized while the source remains online, use a DMS replication task with CDC: DMS supports “Full load + CDC” to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes, or “CDC only” to replicate changes and keep source and target in sync ([Components of AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Components.html)). For PostgreSQL sources, AWS documents that PostgreSQL logical replication enables CDC during migration and “reduces downtime” while helping ensure the target database is in sync with the source ([Using a PostgreSQL database as an AWS DMS source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.html)). Thus an ongoing replication task is required (**A**).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Create a database backup** — A backup can help with a bulk load, but by itself it does not keep the Aurora database synchronized while the on-premises database remains online. CDC/ongoing replication is the synchronization mechanism.
- **D. Use AWS SCT** — Schema conversion is for migrations between different database types; AWS DMS documentation says schema conversion makes migrations “between different types of databases” more predictable ([Components of AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Components.html)). PostgreSQL to Aurora PostgreSQL is a homogeneous PostgreSQL-compatible migration, so SCT is not one of the required actions.
- **E. Create an EventBridge rule** — EventBridge can monitor or react to events, but it does not perform database replication or keep the target synchronized. The DMS replication task with CDC does that.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其本地 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL。在迁移期间，本地数据库必须保持在线并可访问。Aurora 数据库必须与本地数据库保持同步。解决方案架构师必须采取哪组操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个持续复制任务。
options.B: 创建本地数据库的数据库备份。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 复制服务器。
options.D: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 转换数据库架构。
options.E: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 规则来监控数据库同步。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 C。**

AWS DMS 旨在当至少一个端点位于 AWS 上时，将数据从源端点迁移到目标端点，这符合本地 PostgreSQL 源和 Aurora PostgreSQL 目标的场景（[AWS DMS terminology and concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.html)）。AWS DMS 迁移需要必要的 **replication instance**、端点和任务；replication instance 是托管一个或多个复制任务的托管计算资源（[Components of AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Components.html)）。因此，需要创建 DMS 复制服务器/replication instance（**C**）。为了在源数据库保持在线时让 Aurora 目标保持同步，请使用带 CDC 的 DMS 复制任务：DMS 支持 “Full load + CDC” 来迁移现有数据并复制持续发生的更改，或使用 “CDC only” 来复制更改并保持源和目标同步（[Components of AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Components.html)）。对于 PostgreSQL 源，AWS 文档说明 PostgreSQL 逻辑复制可在迁移期间启用 CDC，并“reduces downtime”，同时帮助确保目标数据库与源数据库同步（[Using a PostgreSQL database as an AWS DMS source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.PostgreSQL.html)）。因此，需要一个持续复制任务（**A**）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Create a database backup** — 备份可以帮助进行批量加载，但仅靠它无法在本地数据库保持在线时让 Aurora 数据库保持同步。CDC/持续复制才是同步机制。
- **D. Use AWS SCT** — 架构转换用于不同数据库类型之间的迁移；AWS DMS 文档说明，架构转换使 “between different types of databases” 的迁移更可预测（[Components of AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Components.html)）。PostgreSQL 到 Aurora PostgreSQL 是同构的 PostgreSQL 兼容迁移，因此 SCT 不是必需操作之一。
- **E. Create an EventBridge rule** — EventBridge 可以监控事件或对事件作出响应，但它不会执行数据库复制，也不会保持目标同步。带 CDC 的 DMS 复制任务才会完成这项工作。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to create dedicated AWS accounts for each business unit to manage each business unit's account independently upon request. The root email recipient missed a notification that was sent to the root user email address of one account. The company wants to ensure that all future notifications are not missed. Future notifications must be limited to account administrators. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the company’s email server to forward notification email messages that are sent to the AWS account root user email address to all users in the organization.
options.B: Configure all AWS account root user email addresses as distribution lists that go to a few administrators who can respond to alerts. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.
options.C: Configure all AWS account root user email messages to be sent to one administrator who is responsible for monitoring alerts and forwarding those alerts to the appropriate groups.
options.D: Configure all existing AWS accounts and all newly created accounts to use the same root user email address. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS recommends using a **group email address** for root user credentials: the email address should be managed by the business and forward messages to a group of users, reducing response delays when an individual is unavailable; it also says the root user email should not be used for other purposes ([AWS IAM root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)). This matches configuring each account’s root email as a distribution list limited to a few account administrators. In addition, AWS account **alternate contacts** can be distribution lists, are used for billing/operations/security issues, and can be centrally updated for member accounts in an organization from the AWS Organizations console or programmatically via CLI/SDKs ([AWS Account Management alternate contacts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-update-contact-alternate.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A** is too broad: forwarding root notifications to **all users** does not meet the requirement that notifications be limited to account administrators.
* **C** creates a single point of failure. AWS’s guidance is to forward root email to a **group of users** to reduce delays if an individual is unavailable, not to one administrator ([AWS IAM root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)).
* **D** is not valid for multiple AWS accounts. When creating a member account, the account owner email “cannot already be associated with another AWS account” because it becomes the root user name credential ([AWS Organizations account creation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create.html)). Therefore, all accounts cannot use the same root user email address.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 为每个业务部门创建专用 AWS 账户，以便在请求时独立管理每个业务部门的账户。根邮箱收件人错过了一条发送到某个账户的根用户电子邮件地址的通知。公司希望确保未来所有通知都不会被错过。未来的通知必须仅限于账户管理员。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置公司的电子邮件服务器，将发送到 AWS 账户根用户电子邮件地址的通知电子邮件转发给组织中的所有用户。
options.B: 将所有 AWS 账户根用户电子邮件地址配置为分发列表，发送给少数可以响应警报的管理员。在 AWS Organizations 控制台中或通过编程方式配置 AWS 账户备用联系人。
options.C: 将所有 AWS 账户根用户电子邮件消息配置为发送给一名负责监控警报并将这些警报转发给相应组的管理员。
options.D: 配置所有现有 AWS 账户和所有新创建的账户使用相同的根用户电子邮件地址。在 AWS Organizations 控制台中或通过编程方式配置 AWS 账户备用联系人。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

AWS 建议为根用户凭证使用 **组电子邮件地址**：该电子邮件地址应由企业管理，并将消息转发给一组用户，从而在某个人不可用时减少响应延迟；同时还说明根用户电子邮件不应被用于其他目的（[AWS IAM root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。这与将每个账户的根电子邮件配置为仅限少数账户管理员的分发列表相匹配。此外，AWS 账户 **备用联系人** 可以是分发列表，用于账单/运营/安全问题，并且可以在组织中通过 AWS Organizations 控制台或以编程方式通过 CLI/SDKs 集中更新成员账户的备用联系人（[AWS Account Management alternate contacts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-update-contact-alternate.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **A** 范围过宽：将根用户通知转发给 **所有用户** 不符合通知仅限于账户管理员的要求。
* **C** 会造成单点故障。AWS 的指导是将根用户电子邮件转发给 **一组用户**，以便在某个人不可用时减少延迟，而不是转发给一名管理员（[AWS IAM root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。
* **D** 对多个 AWS 账户无效。创建成员账户时，账户所有者电子邮件“不能已与另一个 AWS 账户关联”，因为它会成为根用户名凭证（[AWS Organizations account creation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create.html)）。因此，所有账户不能使用相同的根用户电子邮件地址。

en.question: A company runs its ecommerce application on AWS. Every new order is published as a massage in a RabbitMQ queue that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a single Availability Zone. These messages are processed by a different application that runs on a separate EC2 instance. This application stores the details in a PostgreSQL database on another EC2 instance. All the EC2 instances are in the same Availability Zone. The company needs to redesign its architecture to provide the highest availability with the least operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database.
options.B: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.
options.C: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.
options.D: Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create a third Multi- AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

This design removes the single-AZ/single-instance points of failure while minimizing operations by using managed services where appropriate. Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ provides managed broker deployment options; for high availability, AWS documents a RabbitMQ cluster deployment as three broker nodes behind a Network Load Balancer, sharing queues/state across multiple Availability Zones, with Amazon MQ managing HA policies and replicating data across nodes/AZs ([Amazon MQ RabbitMQ broker architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazon-mq/latest/developer-guide/rabbitmq-broker-architecture.html)). The processing application can run in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group; AWS recommends spanning Auto Scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones for geographic redundancy, and EC2 Auto Scaling can launch replacement instances in unaffected AZs if one AZ becomes unavailable ([EC2 Auto Scaling: Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). For the PostgreSQL database, Amazon RDS Multi-AZ provides managed high availability: RDS automatically switches to a standby replica in another Availability Zone during planned or unplanned outages and handles failover without administrative intervention ([RDS Multi-AZ failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Keeps PostgreSQL self-managed on EC2. Even with a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group, operating a database cluster on EC2 requires more administration than Amazon RDS and does not provide the same managed database failover benefits.
- **C:** Keeps RabbitMQ self-managed on EC2. A Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group can replace instances, but it does not by itself provide managed RabbitMQ clustering, queue replication, broker maintenance, or broker failover. Amazon MQ reduces operational overhead for the message broker.
- **D:** Keeps both RabbitMQ and PostgreSQL self-managed on EC2, creating the greatest operational burden and fewer managed HA capabilities than using Amazon MQ and Amazon RDS Multi-AZ.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行其电子商务应用程序。每个新订单都会作为一条消息发布到一个 RabbitMQ 队列中，该队列运行在单个 Availability Zone 中的一台 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些消息由运行在另一台独立 EC2 实例上的不同应用程序处理。该应用程序将详细信息存储在另一台 EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 数据库中。所有 EC2 实例都位于同一个 Availability Zone。公司需要重新设计其架构，以在最少运营开销的情况下提供最高可用性。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将队列迁移到 Amazon MQ 上一对冗余（active/standby）的 RabbitMQ 实例。为托管应用程序的 EC2 实例创建一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。为托管 PostgreSQL 数据库的 EC2 实例创建另一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。
options.B: 将队列迁移到 Amazon MQ 上一对冗余（active/standby）的 RabbitMQ 实例。为托管应用程序的 EC2 实例创建一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 的 Multi-AZ 部署上运行。
options.C: 为托管 RabbitMQ 队列的 EC2 实例创建一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。为托管应用程序的 EC2 实例创建另一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 的 Multi-AZ 部署上运行。
options.D: 为托管 RabbitMQ 队列的 EC2 实例创建一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。为托管应用程序的 EC2 实例创建另一个 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组。为托管 PostgreSQL 数据库的 EC2 实例创建第三个 Multi- AZ Auto Scaling 组

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

该设计通过在适当位置使用托管服务，消除了 single-AZ/single-instance 故障点，同时最大限度减少运营工作。Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ 提供托管代理部署选项；对于高可用性，AWS 文档将 RabbitMQ 集群部署描述为三个代理节点位于 Network Load Balancer 后面，跨多个 Availability Zones 共享队列/状态，并由 Amazon MQ 管理 HA 策略以及跨节点/AZ 复制数据（[Amazon MQ RabbitMQ broker architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazon-mq/latest/developer-guide/rabbitmq-broker-architecture.html)）。处理应用程序可以在 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组中运行；AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 Availability Zones 扩展以实现地理冗余，并且如果某个 AZ 不可用，EC2 Auto Scaling 可以在未受影响的 AZ 中启动替代实例（[EC2 Auto Scaling: Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。对于 PostgreSQL 数据库，Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 提供托管高可用性：在计划内或计划外中断期间，RDS 会自动切换到另一个 Availability Zone 中的备用副本，并在无需管理干预的情况下处理故障转移（[RDS Multi-AZ failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将 PostgreSQL 保持为 EC2 上自管理。即使使用 Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组，在 EC2 上运营数据库集群也比 Amazon RDS 需要更多管理工作，并且无法提供相同的托管数据库故障转移优势。
- **C:** 将 RabbitMQ 保持为 EC2 上自管理。Multi-AZ Auto Scaling 组可以替换实例，但它本身并不提供托管的 RabbitMQ 集群、队列复制、代理维护或代理故障转移。Amazon MQ 降低了消息代理的运营开销。
- **D:** 将 RabbitMQ 和 PostgreSQL 都保持为 EC2 上自管理，相比使用 Amazon MQ 和 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ，会造成最大的运营负担，并且托管 HA 能力更少。

en.question: A reporting team receives files each day in an Amazon S3 bucket. The reporting team manually reviews and copies the files from this initial S3 bucket to an analysis S3 bucket each day at the same time to use with Amazon QuickSight. Additional teams are starting to send more files in larger sizes to the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team wants to move the files automatically analysis S3 bucket as the files enter the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team also wants to use AWS Lambda functions to run pattern-matching code on the copied data. In addition, the reporting team wants to send the data files to a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.B: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.
options.C: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.
options.D: Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

Amazon S3 replication is the lowest-operational-overhead way to automatically copy new objects from the initial bucket to the analysis bucket. AWS documents that S3 replication makes copies of objects and that Same-Region Replication is used to copy objects across S3 buckets in the same Region; live replication can replicate new objects automatically, with S3 RTC available when predictable replication time is required ([S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)). After the object is copied into the analysis bucket, Amazon S3 can publish new-object-created events, and S3 event notifications can be sent to Amazon EventBridge ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). EventBridge rules can then target both an AWS Lambda function and a SageMaker AI Pipeline, because EventBridge supports AWS service targets including “Lambda function (ASYNC)” and “SageMaker AI Pipeline” ([EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Uses a Lambda function to perform the copy, which adds operational overhead compared with native S3 replication. It also attempts to configure SageMaker Pipelines directly as an S3 event notification destination; S3 event notification destinations are SNS, SQS, Lambda, and EventBridge—not SageMaker Pipelines directly ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)).
- **B**: EventBridge can route to Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines, but this option still uses a custom Lambda function to copy files between buckets. Native S3 replication is simpler and lower overhead for automatic object copying ([S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).
- **C**: Uses S3 replication correctly for the copy, but incorrectly tries to configure SageMaker Pipelines as a direct S3 event notification destination. S3 can send notifications to SNS, SQS, Lambda, or EventBridge; SageMaker Pipeline targeting should be done through EventBridge ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)).

zh.question: 一个报告团队每天都会在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中接收文件。报告团队每天在同一时间手动审查文件，并将文件从这个初始 S3 存储桶复制到一个分析 S3 存储桶，以便与 Amazon QuickSight 一起使用。其他团队开始向初始 S3 存储桶发送更多且更大的文件。报告团队希望在文件进入初始 S3 存储桶时，自动将文件移动到分析 S3 存储桶。报告团队还希望使用 AWS Lambda 函数对复制的数据运行模式匹配代码。此外，报告团队还希望将数据文件发送到 Amazon SageMaker Pipelines 中的管道。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Lambda 函数，将文件复制到分析 S3 存储桶。为分析 S3 存储桶创建一个 S3 事件通知。将 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该事件通知的目标。将 s3:ObjectCreated:Put 配置为事件类型。
options.B: 创建一个 Lambda 函数，将文件复制到分析 S3 存储桶。配置分析 S3 存储桶，将事件通知发送到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。在 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中配置一个 ObjectCreated 规则。将 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该规则的目标。
options.C: 在两个 S3 存储桶之间配置 S3 replication。为分析 S3 存储桶创建一个 S3 事件通知。将 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该事件通知的目标。将 s3:ObjectCreated:Put 配置为事件类型。
options.D: 在两个 S3 存储桶之间配置 S3 replication。配置分析 S3 存储桶，将事件通知发送到 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events)。在 EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) 中配置一个 ObjectCreated 规则。将 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为该规则的目标。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

Amazon S3 replication 是以最低运营开销将新对象从初始存储桶自动复制到分析存储桶的方式。AWS 文档说明，S3 replication 会创建对象副本，并且 Same-Region Replication 用于在同一 Region 的 S3 存储桶之间复制对象；live replication 可以自动复制新对象，当需要可预测的复制时间时可以使用 S3 RTC（[S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。对象复制到分析存储桶后，Amazon S3 可以发布新对象创建事件，并且 S3 event notifications 可以发送到 Amazon EventBridge（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。然后，EventBridge 规则可以同时以 AWS Lambda 函数和 SageMaker AI Pipeline 作为目标，因为 EventBridge 支持包括“Lambda function (ASYNC)”和“SageMaker AI Pipeline”在内的 AWS 服务目标（[EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：使用 Lambda 函数执行复制，与原生 S3 replication 相比增加了运营开销。它还试图将 SageMaker Pipelines 直接配置为 S3 事件通知目标；S3 事件通知目标是 SNS、SQS、Lambda 和 EventBridge，而不是直接支持 SageMaker Pipelines（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。
- **B**：EventBridge 可以路由到 Lambda 和 SageMaker Pipelines，但此选项仍然使用自定义 Lambda 函数在存储桶之间复制文件。对于自动对象复制，原生 S3 replication 更简单且开销更低（[S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。
- **C**：正确地使用 S3 replication 进行复制，但错误地尝试将 SageMaker Pipelines 配置为直接的 S3 事件通知目标。S3 可以将通知发送到 SNS、SQS、Lambda 或 EventBridge；SageMaker Pipeline 目标应通过 EventBridge 实现（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to help a company optimize the cost of running an application on AWS. The application will use Amazon EC2 instances, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda for compute within the architecture. The EC2 instances will run the data ingestion layer of the application. EC2 usage will be sporadic and unpredictable. Workloads that run on EC2 instances can be interrupted at any time. The application front end will run on Fargate, and Lambda will serve the API layer. The front-end utilization and API layer utilization will be predictable over the course of the next year. Which combination of purchasing options will provide the MOST cost-effective solution for hosting this application? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer
options.B: Use On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer
options.C: Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.
options.D: Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved instances for the data ingestion layer.
options.E: Purchase a 1-year EC2 instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and C.**

- **A. Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer** — The EC2-based ingestion workload is described as sporadic, unpredictable, and interruptible. AWS states that Spot Instances use unused EC2 instances and can significantly reduce EC2 costs, and that Spot Instances are cost-effective when applications are flexible about when they run and **can be interrupted** ([Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)).
- **C. Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer** — The Fargate front end and Lambda API have predictable utilization for the next year, making a committed-use discount appropriate. AWS documentation says **Compute Savings Plans** apply to usage across **Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, and AWS Fargate** ([Services eligible for Savings Plans benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html)) and that Compute Savings Plans also apply to Fargate and Lambda usage ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer** — On-Demand is flexible, but it is not the most cost-effective for an interruptible workload. AWS specifically identifies Spot Instances as the cost-effective choice when workloads can be interrupted ([Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)).
- **D. 1-year All Upfront Reserved Instances for the data ingestion layer** — Reserved Instances require a commitment to a consistent instance configuration for 1 or 3 years. The ingestion workload is sporadic and unpredictable, so committing to reserved capacity is not the best fit; Spot is better for interruptible EC2 usage ([Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)).
- **E. 1-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer** — EC2 Instance Savings Plans apply to EC2 usage only, while the front end runs on Fargate and the API layer runs on Lambda. AWS states that Compute Savings Plans apply across EC2, Lambda, and Fargate, whereas EC2 Instance Savings Plans apply to EC2 usage ([Services eligible for Savings Plans benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要帮助一家公司优化在 AWS 上运行应用程序的成本。该应用程序将在架构中使用 Amazon EC2 实例、AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda 进行计算。EC2 实例将运行应用程序的数据摄取层。EC2 使用量将是零散且不可预测的。在 EC2 实例上运行的工作负载可以随时被中断。应用程序前端将在 Fargate 上运行，Lambda 将为 API 层提供服务。前端利用率和 API 层利用率在未来一年中将是可预测的。哪种购买选项组合将为托管此应用程序提供最具成本效益的解决方案？（选择两项。）

options.A: 对数据摄取层使用 Spot Instances
options.B: 对数据摄取层使用 On-Demand Instances
options.C: 为前端和 API 层购买 1 年期 Compute Savings Plan。
options.D: 为数据摄取层购买 1 年期 All Upfront Reserved instances。
options.E: 为前端和 API 层购买 1 年期 EC2 instance Savings Plan。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 C。**

- **A. Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer** — 基于 EC2 的摄取工作负载被描述为零散、不可预测且可中断。AWS 表示 Spot Instances 使用未使用的 EC2 实例，并且可以显著降低 EC2 成本；当应用程序对运行时间具有灵活性并且**可以被中断**时，Spot Instances 具有成本效益（[Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)）。
- **C. Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer** — Fargate 前端和 Lambda API 在未来一年具有可预测的利用率，因此适合使用承诺使用量折扣。AWS 文档指出，**Compute Savings Plans** 适用于跨 **Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, and AWS Fargate** 的使用量（[Services eligible for Savings Plans benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html)），并且 Compute Savings Plans 也适用于 Fargate 和 Lambda 使用量（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer** — On-Demand 很灵活，但对于可中断的工作负载而言并不是最具成本效益的选择。AWS 明确指出，当工作负载可以被中断时，Spot Instances 是具有成本效益的选择（[Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)）。
- **D. 1-year All Upfront Reserved Instances for the data ingestion layer** — Reserved Instances 要求对 1 年或 3 年内一致的实例配置做出承诺。摄取工作负载是零散且不可预测的，因此承诺预留容量并不是最佳匹配；对于可中断的 EC2 使用量，Spot 更合适（[Amazon EC2 billing and purchasing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-purchasing-options.html)）。
- **E. 1-year EC2 Instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer** — EC2 Instance Savings Plans 仅适用于 EC2 使用量，而前端运行在 Fargate 上，API 层运行在 Lambda 上。AWS 表示 Compute Savings Plans 适用于 EC2、Lambda 和 Fargate，而 EC2 Instance Savings Plans 适用于 EC2 使用量（[Services eligible for Savings Plans benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-services.html)）。

en.question: A company runs a web-based portal that provides users with global breaking news, local alerts, and weather updates. The portal delivers each user a personalized view by using mixture of static and dynamic content. Content is served over HTTPS through an API server running on an Amazon EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants the portal to provide this content to its users across the world as quickly as possible. How should a solutions architect design the application to ensure the LEAST amount of latency for all users?

options.A: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin.
options.B: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.
options.C: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB.
options.D: Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

Amazon CloudFront is designed to speed up delivery of **both static and dynamic web content** to global users. AWS states that CloudFront routes requests to the edge location that provides the **lowest latency**, uses the AWS backbone network, and reduces the number of networks a request must traverse, resulting in lower latency and higher transfer rates ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). The ALB can be used as a CloudFront origin: AWS documents using internet-facing Application Load Balancers with CloudFront and notes that CloudFront can help reduce latency and cache objects served by an ALB ([Restrict access to Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/restrict-access-to-load-balancer.html)). Therefore, putting CloudFront in front of the ALB for **all** content is the lowest-latency global design among the choices.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **B**: Route 53 latency routing is useful when resources are in multiple Regions and you want to route users to the Region with best latency ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)). However, this option does not use CloudFront, so it lacks CloudFront edge caching and AWS edge network acceleration for static and dynamic content.
- **C**: Serving only static content through CloudFront leaves dynamic API traffic going directly to the ALB over the internet. AWS specifically says CloudFront speeds up static **and dynamic** web content and can reduce latency with ALB origins, so bypassing CloudFront for dynamic content is not the least-latency design.
- **D**: Geolocation routing routes based on user location, not measured latency; AWS distinguishes it from latency routing, which is for routing to the Region that provides the best latency ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)). It also omits CloudFront.

zh.question: 一家公司运行一个基于 Web 的门户，为用户提供全球突发新闻、本地警报和天气更新。该门户通过混合使用静态和动态内容，为每个用户提供个性化视图。内容通过 HTTPS 由运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 API 服务器提供，该实例位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面。公司希望该门户能够尽可能快速地向世界各地的用户提供这些内容。解决方案架构师应如何设计该应用程序，以确保所有用户的延迟最低？

options.A: 在单个 AWS Region 中部署应用程序堆栈。使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供所有静态和动态内容，并将 ALB 指定为源站。
options.B: 在两个 AWS Region 中部署应用程序堆栈。使用 Amazon Route 53 延迟路由策略，从最近 Region 中的 ALB 提供所有内容。
options.C: 在单个 AWS Region 中部署应用程序堆栈。使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供静态内容。直接从 ALB 提供动态内容。
options.D: 在两个 AWS Region 中部署应用程序堆栈。使用 Amazon Route 53 地理位置路由策略，从最近 Region 中的 ALB 提供所有内容。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。
