Amazon CloudFront 旨在加速向全球用户交付**静态和动态 Web 内容**。AWS 说明，CloudFront 会将请求路由到提供**最低延迟**的边缘站点，使用 AWS 骨干网络，并减少请求必须穿越的网络数量，从而实现更低延迟和更高传输速率（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。ALB 可以用作 CloudFront 源站：AWS 文档说明了将面向互联网的 Application Load Balancers 与 CloudFront 配合使用，并指出 CloudFront 可以帮助降低延迟并缓存由 ALB 提供的对象（[Restrict access to Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/restrict-access-to-load-balancer.html)）。因此，在 ALB 前为**所有**内容放置 CloudFront，是这些选择中延迟最低的全球设计。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B**：当资源位于多个 Regions 中，并且希望将用户路由到延迟最佳的 Region 时，Route 53 延迟路由很有用（[Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。但是，此选项没有使用 CloudFront，因此缺少 CloudFront 边缘缓存以及针对静态和动态内容的 AWS 边缘网络加速。
- **C**：仅通过 CloudFront 提供静态内容，会使动态 API 流量通过互联网直接到达 ALB。AWS 明确表示 CloudFront 可加速静态**和动态** Web 内容，并且可以通过 ALB 源站降低延迟，因此让动态内容绕过 CloudFront 并不是最低延迟设计。
- **D**：地理位置路由基于用户位置进行路由，而不是基于测量到的延迟；AWS 将其与延迟路由区分开来，后者用于路由到提供最佳延迟的 Region（[Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。它也省略了 CloudFront。

en.question: A gaming company is designing a highly available architecture. The application runs on a modified Linux kernel and supports only UDP-based traffic. The company needs the front-end tier to provide the best possible user experience. That tier must have low latency, route traffic to the nearest edge location, and provide static IP addresses for entry into the application endpoints. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Route 53 to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in AWS Application Auto Scaling.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in an AWS Application Auto Scaling group.
options.C: Configure AWS Global Accelerator to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Configure Amazon API Gateway to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

AWS Global Accelerator is the right front door because it improves availability/performance for global users, routes traffic over the AWS global network to the nearest/optimal regional endpoint, and provides static anycast IP addresses by default. It can use Network Load Balancers as endpoints ([AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). A Network Load Balancer is appropriate for this game traffic because NLB target groups support **UDP** and NLB operates at Layer 4; it can also provide static IP addresses/Elastic IPs ([Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)). The application requires a modified Linux kernel, so EC2 instances in an EC2 Auto Scaling group are appropriate; Lambda runs in an AWS-managed execution environment/runtime based on Amazon Linux rather than a customer-modified kernel ([Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An Application Load Balancer listener supports only **HTTP and HTTPS**, not UDP, and Lambda is not suitable for an application that requires a modified Linux kernel ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html), [Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)).
- **B:** CloudFront is designed to accelerate static/dynamic **web content** and retrieves content from origins such as S3 buckets or HTTP servers; it is not the best fit for UDP-based gaming traffic. This option also uses Lambda, which does not meet the modified-kernel requirement ([CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html), [Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)).
- **D:** API Gateway is for REST/HTTP APIs, and the ALB behind it supports only HTTP/HTTPS listeners, so this design does not support UDP traffic ([API Gateway REST/HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html), [ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).

zh.question: 一家游戏公司正在设计一种高度可用的架构。该应用程序运行在经过修改的 Linux kernel 上，并且仅支持基于 UDP 的流量。公司需要前端层提供尽可能最佳的用户体验。该层必须具有低延迟，将流量路由到最近的边缘站点，并为进入应用程序端点提供静态 IP 地址。解决方案架构师应如何做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Amazon Route 53 将请求转发到 Application Load Balancer。将 AWS Lambda 用于 AWS Application Auto Scaling 中的应用程序。
options.B: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 将请求转发到 Network Load Balancer。将 AWS Lambda 用于 AWS Application Auto Scaling 组中的应用程序。
options.C: 配置 AWS Global Accelerator 将请求转发到 Network Load Balancer。将 Amazon EC2 实例用于 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的应用程序。
options.D: 配置 Amazon API Gateway 将请求转发到 Application Load Balancer。将 Amazon EC2 实例用于 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的应用程序。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

AWS Global Accelerator 是正确的前门服务，因为它可以为全球用户提高可用性/性能，通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最近/最佳的区域端点，并默认提供静态 anycast IP 地址。它可以使用 Network Load Balancers 作为端点（[AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。Network Load Balancer 适合这种游戏流量，因为 NLB 目标组支持 **UDP**，并且 NLB 运行在 Layer 4；它还可以提供静态 IP 地址/Elastic IPs（[Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。该应用程序需要经过修改的 Linux kernel，因此 EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例是合适的；Lambda 运行在基于 Amazon Linux 的 AWS 托管执行环境/运行时中，而不是客户修改过的 kernel（[Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Application Load Balancer 侦听器仅支持 **HTTP and HTTPS**，不支持 UDP，并且 Lambda 不适合需要经过修改的 Linux kernel 的应用程序（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html), [Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)）。
- **B:** CloudFront 旨在加速静态/动态 **web content**，并从 S3 buckets 或 HTTP servers 等源检索内容；它并不是基于 UDP 的游戏流量的最佳选择。此选项还使用 Lambda，而 Lambda 不满足修改 kernel 的要求（[CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html), [Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)）。
- **D:** API Gateway 用于 REST/HTTP APIs，其后面的 ALB 仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS 侦听器，因此此设计不支持 UDP 流量（[API Gateway REST/HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html), [ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its existing on-premises monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to keep as much of the front-end code and the backend code as possible. However, the company wants to break the application into smaller applications. A different team will manage each application. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway.
options.B: Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda.
options.C: Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as targets.
options.D: Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the target.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The requirement is to keep as much existing front-end and back-end code as possible while decomposing a monolith into smaller applications owned by different teams. AWS Prescriptive Guidance describes migrating a monolith to microservices by splitting it into smaller components that can **scale independently**, be **released independently**, and be **owned by individual teams**; it also warns that fully rewriting/refactoring the code is a large, risky undertaking ([Strangler fig pattern](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/strangler-fig.html)). Containerizing the existing application components and running them as Amazon ECS services aligns well with that incremental decomposition while preserving more code than a full serverless rewrite.

Amazon ECS with an Application Load Balancer is also a scalable, low-operational-overhead fit. AWS documents that ECS services can use Elastic Load Balancing to distribute traffic across tasks, and that Application Load Balancers are recommended for ECS services because they support HTTP/HTTPS traffic, multiple target groups, dynamic host port mapping, and path-based routing/priority rules so multiple services can use one listener port ([ECS service load balancing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-load-balancing.html)). With ECS on Fargate, containers can run without managing servers or EC2 clusters, reducing operational overhead ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Lambda + API Gateway:** API Gateway can route HTTP requests to Lambda functions ([Lambda with API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)), but moving a monolithic front end/back end to Lambda generally requires significant refactoring into functions. That conflicts with keeping as much existing code as possible.
- **B. Amplify + API Gateway + Lambda:** Amplify is primarily for front-end/web and mobile app hosting and development workflows, while the backend still must be refactored into Lambda functions behind API Gateway. This is a larger architectural rewrite than containerizing existing components.
- **C. EC2 + ALB + Auto Scaling group:** This can scale, but it keeps the application on servers and requires more operational management of EC2 instances, patching, capacity, and Auto Scaling configuration. It also does not naturally support decomposing the application into independently managed containerized services as well as ECS.

Therefore, **Amazon ECS with an Application Load Balancer** best meets the need for incremental decomposition, team ownership, scalability, and minimized operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其现有的本地单体应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司希望尽可能保留前端代码和后端代码。但是，该公司希望将该应用程序拆分为更小的应用程序。每个应用程序将由不同的团队管理。该公司需要一个高度可扩展且最大限度减少运营开销的解决方案。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Lambda 上托管该应用程序。将该应用程序与 Amazon API Gateway 集成。
options.B: 使用 AWS Amplify 托管该应用程序。将该应用程序连接到与 AWS Lambda 集成的 Amazon API Gateway API。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 实例上托管该应用程序。设置一个 Application Load Balancer，并将 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例作为目标。
options.D: 在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上托管该应用程序。设置一个 Application Load Balancer，并将 Amazon ECS 作为目标。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

要求是在将单体应用分解为由不同团队拥有的较小应用程序的同时，尽可能保留现有的前端和后端代码。AWS Prescriptive Guidance 描述了通过将单体应用拆分为更小组件来迁移到微服务的方式，这些组件可以**独立扩展**、**独立发布**并由**各个团队拥有**；它还警告说，完全重写/重构代码是一项规模大且风险高的工作（[Strangler fig pattern](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/cloud-design-patterns/strangler-fig.html)）。将现有应用程序组件容器化并作为 Amazon ECS 服务运行，非常适合这种渐进式分解，同时相比完全无服务器重写能保留更多代码。

Amazon ECS 与 Application Load Balancer 组合也是一种可扩展、低运营开销的合适方案。AWS 文档说明，ECS 服务可以使用 Elastic Load Balancing 在任务之间分配流量，并且建议 ECS 服务使用 Application Load Balancers，因为它们支持 HTTP/HTTPS 流量、多个目标组、动态主机端口映射以及基于路径的路由/优先级规则，使多个服务可以使用一个侦听器端口（[ECS service load balancing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-load-balancing.html)）。使用 ECS on Fargate，容器可以在无需管理服务器或 EC2 集群的情况下运行，从而减少运营开销（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Lambda + API Gateway：** API Gateway 可以将 HTTP 请求路由到 Lambda functions（[Lambda with API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)），但将单体前端/后端迁移到 Lambda 通常需要大量重构为函数。这与尽可能保留现有代码的要求相冲突。
- **B. Amplify + API Gateway + Lambda：** Amplify 主要用于前端/web 和移动应用托管及开发工作流，而后端仍必须重构为 API Gateway 后面的 Lambda functions。与容器化现有组件相比，这是一种更大的架构重写。
- **C. EC2 + ALB + Auto Scaling group：** 这可以扩展，但它仍将应用程序运行在服务器上，并且需要更多运营管理，包括 EC2 实例、补丁、容量和 Auto Scaling 配置。它也不像 ECS 那样自然支持将应用程序分解为可独立管理的容器化服务。因此，**Amazon ECS with an Application Load Balancer** 最能满足渐进式分解、团队所有权、可扩展性以及最小化运营开销的需求。

en.question: A company recently started using Amazon Aurora as the data store for its global ecommerce application. When large reports are run, developers report that the ecommerce application is performing poorly. After reviewing metrics in Amazon CloudWatch, a solutions architect finds that the ReadIOPS and CPUUtilizalion metrics are spiking when monthly reports run. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.A: Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift.
options.B: Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.
options.C: Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class.
options.D: Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.**

Aurora Replicas are read-only DB instances in the same Aurora cluster. AWS states that you can issue queries to Aurora Replicas to **scale read operations**, typically through the reader endpoint, which spreads read-only connections across replicas. AWS also notes that Aurora Replicas are “fully dedicated to read operations” while writes are handled by the primary instance, with minimal additional replication work because the cluster volume is shared ([Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)). Monthly reports are read-heavy and are causing ReadIOPS and CPU spikes on the application’s primary workload, so moving those reports to a replica offloads read/query CPU activity from the writer and is the most cost-effective targeted fix.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift** — Redshift is a fully managed petabyte-scale data warehouse for analytics and BI querying ([What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). It could be appropriate for a broader analytics platform, but for this scenario it introduces a separate service and data movement/ETL complexity when Aurora already provides read replicas for read scaling.
- **C. Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class** — Scaling up the primary instance may add CPU, but the reporting workload would still contend with the ecommerce workload on the same primary path. Aurora’s documented pattern for read-only query traffic is to use up to 15 Aurora Replicas and the reader endpoint ([Aurora endpoint connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.Endpoints.html)).
- **D. Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance** — The problem includes CPU spikes as well as ReadIOPS spikes, and the workload is read-only reporting contention. Increasing IOPS does not isolate the reporting workload from the ecommerce application. Aurora Replicas specifically address read scaling and offloading read-only queries ([Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近开始使用 Amazon Aurora 作为其全球电子商务应用程序的数据存储。当运行大型报告时，开发人员报告电子商务应用程序性能不佳。在查看 Amazon CloudWatch 中的指标后，解决方案架构师发现 ReadIOPS 和 CPUUtilizalion 指标在月度报告运行时出现峰值。哪种解决方案最具成本效益？

options.A: 将月度报告迁移到 Amazon Redshift。
options.B: 将月度报告迁移到 Aurora Replica。
options.C: 将 Aurora 数据库迁移到更大的实例类。
options.D: 增加 Aurora 实例上的 Provisioned IOPS。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.**

Aurora Replicas 是同一 Aurora 集群中的只读 DB 实例。AWS 指出，你可以向 Aurora Replicas 发出查询以**扩展读取操作**，通常通过 reader endpoint 实现，该端点会将只读连接分布到各个 replicas。AWS 还指出，Aurora Replicas “fully dedicated to read operations”，而写入由主实例处理；由于集群卷是共享的，因此只需极少的额外复制工作（[Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。月度报告以读取为主，并导致应用程序主工作负载上的 ReadIOPS 和 CPU 峰值，因此将这些报告移动到 replica 可以从 writer 卸载读取/查询 CPU 活动，是最具成本效益的针对性修复方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift** — Redshift 是一种完全托管的 PB 级数据仓库，用于分析和 BI 查询（[What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。它可能适合更广泛的分析平台，但在此场景中，当 Aurora 已经提供用于读取扩展的 read replicas 时，它会引入单独的服务以及数据移动/ETL 复杂性。
- **C. Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class** — 扩展主实例可能会增加 CPU，但报告工作负载仍会在同一主路径上与电子商务工作负载竞争。Aurora 针对只读查询流量的文档化模式是使用最多 15 个 Aurora Replicas 和 reader endpoint（[Aurora endpoint connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.Endpoints.html)）。
- **D. Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance** — 问题同时包含 CPU 峰值和 ReadIOPS 峰值，而工作负载是只读报告争用。增加 IOPS 并不能将报告工作负载与电子商务应用程序隔离。Aurora Replicas 专门用于解决读取扩展和卸载只读查询（[Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts a website analytics application on a single Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance. The analytics software is written in PHP and uses a MySQL database. The analytics software, the web server that provides PHP, and the database server are all hosted on the EC2 instance. The application is showing signs of performance degradation during busy times and is presenting 5xx errors. The company needs to make the application scale seamlessly. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%.
options.D: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The requirement is to make the application **scale seamlessly** and do so **cost-effectively**. Option D separates the database tier from the web/application tier by moving MySQL-compatible data to Aurora, which is a fully managed relational database engine compatible with MySQL and can provide higher throughput while its storage grows automatically as needed ([Amazon Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)). For the PHP/web tier, an Auto Scaling group using a launch template can add and remove EC2 capacity automatically. AWS documentation states that Auto Scaling can automatically increase or decrease instances as demand changes, and when used with Elastic Load Balancing, launched instances are automatically registered and terminated instances are automatically deregistered ([Elastic Load Balancing related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)). An Application Load Balancer distributes workloads across multiple compute resources, supports health checks, and lets resources be added or removed without disrupting the request flow ([ELB benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)). Using Spot capacity improves cost-effectiveness; EC2 Auto Scaling supports Spot allocation strategies such as `price-capacity-optimized`, which selects pools that are less likely to be interrupted and have the lowest possible price ([Auto Scaling allocation strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/allocation-strategies.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Moving the database to RDS for MySQL is a valid improvement, and an ALB is appropriate, but launching only a second On-Demand Instance creates a fixed two-instance architecture. It does not automatically scale out or in as demand changes, so it is not as seamless or cost-effective as an Auto Scaling group with Spot capacity.
- **B:** Route 53 weighted routing is DNS routing, not an application load balancer with automatic target registration, health-based request distribution, and tight Auto Scaling integration. This option also uses only two fixed On-Demand Instances, so it does not meet the seamless scaling requirement.
- **C:** Changing the size of a single EC2 instance is vertical scaling and still leaves a single web/application server. It does not distribute traffic across multiple instances and does not provide automatic horizontal scaling. AWS Auto Scaling target tracking is designed to manage scaling and its CloudWatch alarms automatically for changing utilization patterns ([target tracking policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在单个 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance 上托管一个网站分析应用程序。该分析软件使用 PHP 编写，并使用 MySQL 数据库。分析软件、提供 PHP 的 Web 服务器以及数据库服务器都托管在该 EC2 实例上。该应用程序在繁忙时段出现性能下降的迹象，并呈现 5xx 错误。公司需要使该应用程序能够无缝扩展。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例。创建 Web 应用程序的 AMI。使用该 AMI 启动第二个 EC2 On-Demand Instance。使用 Application Load Balancer 将负载分发到每个 EC2 实例。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例。创建 Web 应用程序的 AMI。使用该 AMI 启动第二个 EC2 On-Demand Instance。使用 Amazon Route 53 加权路由在两个 EC2 实例之间分发负载。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 实例。创建 AWS Lambda 函数以停止 EC2 实例并更改实例类型。创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，在 CPU 利用率超过 75% 时调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 实例。创建 Web 应用程序的 AMI。将该 AMI 应用于启动模板。使用该启动模板创建 Auto Scaling 组。配置启动模板以使用 Spot Fleet。将 Application Load Balancer 附加到 Auto Scaling 组。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

要求是使应用程序能够**无缝扩展**，并且要**具有成本效益**。选项 D 通过将 MySQL 兼容数据迁移到 Aurora，把数据库层与 Web/应用程序层分离；Aurora 是与 MySQL 兼容的完全托管关系数据库引擎，可以提供更高吞吐量，并且其存储会根据需要自动增长（[Amazon Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。对于 PHP/Web 层，使用启动模板的 Auto Scaling 组可以自动添加和移除 EC2 容量。AWS 文档说明，Auto Scaling 可以随着需求变化自动增加或减少实例；并且与 Elastic Load Balancing 结合使用时，启动的实例会自动注册，终止的实例会自动取消注册（[Elastic Load Balancing related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。Application Load Balancer 会在多个计算资源之间分发工作负载，支持运行状况检查，并允许在不中断请求流的情况下添加或移除资源（[ELB benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。使用 Spot 容量可提高成本效益；EC2 Auto Scaling 支持 Spot 分配策略，例如 `price-capacity-optimized`，它会选择更不可能中断且价格尽可能最低的池（[Auto Scaling allocation strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/allocation-strategies.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将数据库迁移到 RDS for MySQL 是有效的改进，ALB 也很合适，但只启动第二个 On-Demand Instance 会形成固定的双实例架构。它不会随着需求变化自动向外扩展或向内缩减，因此不如使用带 Spot 容量的 Auto Scaling 组那样无缝或具有成本效益。
- **B:** Route 53 加权路由是 DNS 路由，不是具备自动目标注册、基于运行状况的请求分发以及与 Auto Scaling 紧密集成的应用程序负载均衡器。此选项也只使用两个固定的 On-Demand Instances，因此不满足无缝扩展要求。
- **C:** 更改单个 EC2 实例的大小是垂直扩展，并且仍然只保留单个 Web/应用程序服务器。它不会将流量分发到多个实例，也不提供自动水平扩展。AWS Auto Scaling 目标跟踪旨在为不断变化的利用率模式管理扩展及其 CloudWatch 警报（[target tracking policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。

en.question: A company runs a stateless web application in production on a group of Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application experiences heavy usage during an 8- hour period each business day. Application usage is moderate and steady overnight. Application usage is low during weekends. The company wants to minimize its EC2 costs without affecting the availability of the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Spot Instances for the entire workload.
options.B: Use Reserved Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
options.C: Use On-Demand Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
options.D: Use Dedicated Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use On-Demand Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The workload has a predictable baseline: moderate, steady overnight usage and recurring business-day usage. For the baseline capacity that must remain available, **Reserved Instances** are appropriate because AWS states that they reduce EC2 costs by committing to a specific instance configuration for 1 or 3 years. For variable peak capacity, **Spot Instances** can significantly reduce EC2 costs by using unused EC2 capacity, and the application is stateless and behind an ALB, so extra instances can be added/replaced more safely. AWS also documents that Auto Scaling mixed instances groups can specify percentages of On-Demand and Spot capacity, supporting a mixed model for scaling additional capacity. ([EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html), [Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html), [mixed instances groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/mixed-instances-groups-set-up-overview.html))

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A:** Using Spot Instances for the entire workload could reduce cost, but it can affect availability because Spot Instances run only when spare capacity is available and can be interrupted when EC2 needs the capacity back. This is not appropriate for the required baseline availability. ([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html))
- **C:** On-Demand Instances for baseline usage are available without long-term commitment, but they do not minimize cost as well as Reserved Instances for steady, predictable baseline usage. AWS specifically lists Reserved Instances as a way to reduce EC2 costs through a term commitment, whereas On-Demand has no long-term commitment or upfront payment. ([EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html))
- **D:** Dedicated Instances are for running instances with dedicated tenancy/hardware isolation characteristics, not for minimizing general web application compute cost. AWS notes Dedicated Instance pricing differs from On-Demand pricing, and there is no requirement for dedicated tenancy or compliance isolation here. ([Dedicated Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-instance.html))

zh.question: 一家公司在生产环境中，在 Application Load Balancer 后面的一组 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 上运行一个无状态 Web 应用程序。该应用程序在每个工作日的 8 小时期间使用量很高。夜间应用程序使用量中等且稳定。周末应用程序使用量较低。公司希望在不影响应用程序可用性的情况下尽量降低 EC2 成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 对整个工作负载使用 Spot Instances。
options.B: 对基线使用量使用 Reserved Instances。对应用程序需要的任何额外容量使用 Spot instances。
options.C: 对基线使用量使用 On-Demand Instances。对应用程序需要的任何额外容量使用 Spot Instances。
options.D: 对基线使用量使用 Dedicated Instances。对应用程序需要的任何额外容量使用 On-Demand Instances。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该工作负载具有可预测的基线：夜间中等且稳定的使用量，以及工作日重复出现的使用量。对于必须保持可用的基线容量，**Reserved Instances** 是合适的，因为 AWS 表示，通过承诺使用特定实例配置 1 年或 3 年，它们可以降低 EC2 成本。对于可变的峰值容量，**Spot Instances** 可以通过使用未使用的 EC2 容量显著降低 EC2 成本，并且该应用程序是无状态的且位于 ALB 后面，因此可以更安全地添加/替换额外实例。AWS 还记录了 Auto Scaling mixed instances groups 可以指定 On-Demand 和 Spot 容量的百分比，从而支持用于扩展额外容量的混合模型。([EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html), [Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html), [mixed instances groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/mixed-instances-groups-set-up-overview.html))

其他选项错误的原因：

- **A:** 对整个工作负载使用 Spot Instances 可以降低成本，但它可能影响可用性，因为 Spot Instances 仅在有空闲容量时运行，并且当 EC2 需要收回容量时可能会被中断。这不适合所需的基线可用性。([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html))
- **C:** 用于基线使用量的 On-Demand Instances 无需长期承诺即可使用，但对于稳定、可预测的基线使用量，它们不像 Reserved Instances 那样能更好地最小化成本。AWS 明确将 Reserved Instances 列为一种通过期限承诺降低 EC2 成本的方式，而 On-Demand 没有长期承诺或预付款。([EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html))
- **D:** Dedicated Instances 用于运行具有专用租赁/硬件隔离特性的实例，而不是用于最小化一般 Web 应用程序计算成本。AWS 指出 Dedicated Instance 定价不同于 On-Demand 定价，并且这里没有专用租赁或合规隔离要求。([Dedicated Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-instance.html))

en.question: A company needs to retain application log files for a critical application for 10 years. The application team regularly accesses logs from the past month for troubleshooting, but logs older than 1 month are rarely accessed. The application generates more than 10 TB of logs per month. Which storage option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.B: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.C: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Store the logs in Amazon S3 and use **S3 Lifecycle policies** to transition objects older than 1 month to **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**. AWS documentation states that S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects between storage classes to save costs, including from **S3 Standard** to **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**; it also explicitly says you can use an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive for archiving ([S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)). S3 Glacier Deep Archive is designed for data accessed less than once a year, retained for multiple years for compliance, and is the **lowest-cost storage option in AWS**, matching 10-year retention with rare access after the first month ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** AWS Backup is not the right mechanism to move S3 objects to Glacier Deep Archive. AWS Backup documentation lists the S3 storage classes it supports and says **S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive are not supported** ([AWS Backup for S3 supported storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/s3-backups.html)).
- **C:** This uses CloudWatch Logs plus AWS Backup, adding unnecessary cost and complexity, and AWS Backup still does not support S3 Glacier Deep Archive as a target/storage class for S3 backup data ([AWS Backup for S3 supported storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/s3-backups.html)).
- **D:** S3 Lifecycle policies apply to **Amazon S3 objects** and transition S3 objects between S3 storage classes; they do not directly transition CloudWatch Logs log groups to S3 Glacier Deep Archive ([S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要为一个关键应用程序保留应用程序日志文件 10 年。应用程序团队会定期访问过去一个月的日志以进行故障排查，但超过 1 个月的日志很少被访问。该应用程序每月生成超过 10 TB 的日志。哪种存储选项能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 AWS Backup 将超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.B: 将日志存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 S3 Lifecycle policies 将超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 将日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。使用 AWS Backup 将超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.D: 将日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。使用 Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies 将超过 1 个月的日志移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 将日志存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用 **S3 Lifecycle policies** 将超过 1 个月的对象转换到 **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**。AWS 文档说明，S3 Lifecycle rules 可以在 storage classes 之间转换对象以节省成本，包括从 **S3 Standard** 转换到 **S3 Glacier Deep Archive**；文档还明确说明，你可以使用 S3 Lifecycle configuration 将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 以进行归档（[S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。S3 Glacier Deep Archive 专为每年访问少于一次、为合规目的保留多年数据而设计，并且是 **AWS 中成本最低的存储选项**，符合 10 年保留期以及第一个月后很少访问的需求（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** AWS Backup 不是将 S3 objects 移动到 Glacier Deep Archive 的正确机制。AWS Backup 文档列出了它支持的 S3 storage classes，并说明 **S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive are not supported**（[AWS Backup for S3 supported storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/s3-backups.html)）。
- **C:** 该选项使用 CloudWatch Logs 加 AWS Backup，增加了不必要的成本和复杂性，并且 AWS Backup 仍不支持将 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 作为 S3 backup data 的目标/storage class（[AWS Backup for S3 supported storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/s3-backups.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Lifecycle policies 适用于 **Amazon S3 objects**，并在 S3 storage classes 之间转换 S3 objects；它们不能直接将 CloudWatch Logs log groups 转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive（[S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。

en.question: A company has a data ingestion workflow that includes the following components: An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that receives notifications about new data deliveries An AWS Lambda function that processes and stores the data The ingestion workflow occasionally fails because of network connectivity issues. When failure occurs, the corresponding data is not ingested unless the company manually reruns the job. What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all notifications are eventually processed?

options.A: Configure the Lambda function for deployment across multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Modify the Lambda function's configuration to increase the CPU and memory allocations for the function.
options.C: Configure the SNS topic’s retry strategy to increase both the number of retries and the wait time between retries.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the on-failure destination. Modify the Lambda function to process messages in the queue.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

SNS invokes Lambda asynchronously. To ensure failed notifications are not lost and can be processed later, configure a failure path that persists the failed invocation records in SQS, then have the Lambda function process/reprocess messages from that queue. AWS Lambda supports **on-failure destinations** for asynchronous invocations, and an **Amazon SQS queue** is a supported destination; AWS shows configuring `OnFailure` to an SQS queue when an event cannot be processed ([Lambda async invocation destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html)). AWS also states that a dead-letter queue/on-failure mechanism is used when an event fails all processing attempts or expires, and that to reprocess events in an SQS dead-letter queue you can set it as an event source for the Lambda function ([Lambda dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A.** Lambda is a managed service and AWS already runs the service across multiple Availability Zones; configuring a Lambda function for multi-AZ deployment is not the mechanism to retain and reprocess failed notifications.
- **B.** Increasing memory/CPU might help performance-related failures, but the stated cause is intermittent network connectivity. It does not guarantee that failed notifications are captured for later processing.
- **C.** SNS delivery retry policies for AWS managed endpoints such as Lambda are already defined by SNS, and AWS notes that, except for HTTP/S, you cannot change SNS-defined delivery policies. After the policy is exhausted, SNS discards the message unless a dead-letter queue is attached ([SNS message delivery retries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-delivery-retries.html)). Therefore, simply increasing the SNS topic retry strategy is not the best supported solution for Lambda endpoints and does not ensure eventual processing.

Using SQS as the failure destination provides durable storage for failed events until the Lambda function can successfully process them.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个数据摄取工作流，其中包括以下组件：一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，用于接收有关新数据交付的通知；一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于处理并存储数据。该摄取工作流偶尔会因网络连接问题而失败。发生失败时，除非公司手动重新运行作业，否则相应的数据不会被摄取。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来确保所有通知最终都会被处理？

options.A: 配置 Lambda 函数，使其跨多个 Availability Zones 部署。
options.B: 修改 Lambda 函数的配置，以增加该函数的 CPU 和内存分配。
options.C: 配置 SNS 主题的重试策略，以同时增加重试次数和重试之间的等待时间。
options.D: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为 on-failure 目标。修改 Lambda 函数以处理队列中的消息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

SNS 会异步调用 Lambda。为确保失败的通知不会丢失，并且可以稍后处理，应配置一条失败路径，将失败的调用记录持久保存在 SQS 中，然后让 Lambda 函数从该队列处理/重新处理消息。AWS Lambda 支持用于异步调用的 **on-failure destinations**，并且 **Amazon SQS queue** 是受支持的目标；AWS 展示了当事件无法处理时将 `OnFailure` 配置到 SQS 队列的方式（[Lambda async invocation destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html)）。AWS 还说明，当事件在所有处理尝试后仍失败或过期时，会使用 dead-letter queue/on-failure 机制；并且若要重新处理 SQS dead-letter queue 中的事件，可以将其设置为 Lambda 函数的事件源（[Lambda dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-retain-records.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A.** Lambda 是一项托管服务，AWS 已经在多个 Availability Zones 中运行该服务；为 Lambda 函数配置 multi-AZ 部署并不是保留和重新处理失败通知的机制。
- **B.** 增加内存/CPU 可能有助于解决与性能相关的故障，但题目所述原因是间歇性的网络连接问题。它不能保证失败的通知会被捕获以供后续处理。
- **C.** 对于 Lambda 等 AWS 托管端点，SNS 传递重试策略已由 SNS 定义，并且 AWS 指出，除 HTTP/S 外，不能更改 SNS 定义的传递策略。策略耗尽后，除非附加 dead-letter queue，否则 SNS 会丢弃消息（[SNS message delivery retries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-delivery-retries.html)）。因此，仅仅增加 SNS 主题重试策略并不是针对 Lambda 端点的最佳受支持解决方案，也不能确保最终处理。使用 SQS 作为失败目标，可以为失败事件提供持久存储，直到 Lambda 函数能够成功处理它们。

en.question: A company has a service that produces event data. The company wants to use AWS to process the event data as it is received. The data is written in a specific order that must be maintained throughout processing. The company wants to implement a solution that minimizes operational overhead. How should a solutions architect accomplish this?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon SQS FIFO queues are specifically designed for cases where event/order processing is critical: AWS states that FIFO queues strictly preserve the order in which messages are sent and received, and are appropriate when events need to be processed in order ([Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)). When Lambda processes an SQS FIFO queue, Lambda respects the FIFO ordering guarantees; only one Lambda instance processes a given message group at a time, maintaining sequential processing within that group ([SQS FIFO queue and Lambda concurrency behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/fifo-queue-lambda-behavior.html)). This is also low operational overhead because both SQS and Lambda are managed services.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An SNS topic with Lambda subscriber is a publish/subscribe notification pattern, but the option does not specify an SNS FIFO topic or an SQS FIFO queue. AWS documentation describes SNS FIFO topics as the feature used for strict message ordering and deduplication, especially with SQS FIFO queues ([SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)). A generic SNS-to-Lambda subscription is not the best fit for maintaining processing order.
- **C:** SQS standard queues do not guarantee strict ordering. AWS states that standard queues provide at-least-once delivery and messages may occasionally arrive out of order; they only make a best-effort attempt to preserve send order ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)).
- **D:** SNS to SQS could decouple producers and consumers, but the option does not specify FIFO components or a Lambda processor. For strict ordering, AWS points to SNS FIFO topics integrated with SQS FIFO queues, not a generic SNS topic with a generic SQS queue ([SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个会生成事件数据的服务。该公司希望使用 AWS 在接收到事件数据时对其进行处理。数据是按特定顺序写入的，并且在整个处理过程中必须保持该顺序。该公司希望实现一个将运营开销降至最低的解决方案。解决方案架构师应如何完成此任务？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列来保存消息。设置一个 AWS Lambda 函数来处理队列中的消息。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，用于传递包含待处理负载的通知。将一个 AWS Lambda 函数配置为订阅者。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列来保存消息。设置一个 AWS Lambda 函数以独立方式处理队列中的消息。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，用于传递包含待处理负载的通知。将一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为订阅者。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon SQS FIFO 队列专门为事件/顺序处理至关重要的场景而设计：AWS 声明 FIFO 队列会严格保留消息发送和接收的顺序，并且适用于需要按顺序处理事件的情况（[Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)）。当 Lambda 处理 SQS FIFO 队列时，Lambda 会遵循 FIFO 的顺序保证；同一时间只有一个 Lambda 实例处理给定消息组，从而在该组内维持顺序处理（[SQS FIFO queue and Lambda concurrency behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/fifo-queue-lambda-behavior.html)）。这也具有较低的运营开销，因为 SQS 和 Lambda 都是托管服务。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 带有 Lambda 订阅者的 SNS 主题是一种发布/订阅通知模式，但该选项未指定 SNS FIFO 主题或 SQS FIFO 队列。AWS 文档将 SNS FIFO 主题描述为用于严格消息排序和去重的功能，尤其是与 SQS FIFO 队列结合使用时（[SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)）。通用的 SNS-to-Lambda 订阅并不是保持处理顺序的最佳选择。
- **C:** SQS 标准队列不保证严格排序。AWS 声明标准队列提供至少一次传递，消息偶尔可能会乱序到达；它们只会尽力尝试保留发送顺序（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。
- **D:** SNS to SQS 可以解耦生产者和消费者，但该选项未指定 FIFO 组件或 Lambda 处理器。对于严格排序，AWS 指向的是与 SQS FIFO 队列集成的 SNS FIFO 主题，而不是通用 SNS 主题与通用 SQS 队列的组合（[SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating an application from on-premises servers to Amazon EC2 instances. As part of the migration design requirements, a solutions architect must implement infrastructure metric alarms. The company does not need to take action if CPU utilization increases to more than 50% for a short burst of time. However, if the CPU utilization increases to more than 50% and read IOPS on the disk are high at the same time, the company needs to act as soon as possible. The solutions architect also must reduce false alarms. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible.
options.B: Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the metrics and react to issues quickly.
options.C: Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries to monitor the application and raise an alarm.
options.D: Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A. Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible.**

CloudWatch composite alarms are designed for this exact scenario: they monitor the states of other alarms and use Boolean logic to combine them. AWS states that composite alarms can reduce alarm noise and can create complex alarming conditions that take action only when multiple conditions are met, such as notifying only when both a CPU alarm and another resource alarm have triggered. The rule expression supports `AND`, which returns true only when all specified conditions are true. Therefore, the architect can create one metric alarm for CPU utilization > 50%, another for high disk read IOPS, and a composite alarm such as `ALARM(CPUHigh) AND ALARM(DiskReadIOPSHigh)` with actions only on the composite alarm. This avoids action on short CPU-only bursts and reduces false alarms. [Composite alarms - Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. CloudWatch dashboards** provide visualizations and operational awareness, but dashboards do not automatically enforce the required combined alarm condition or trigger action as soon as both thresholds are met. AWS describes dashboards as offering a unified view of resources and applications, whereas alarms continuously monitor thresholds and can trigger automated actions. [What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)
- **C. CloudWatch Synthetics canaries** monitor endpoints, APIs, availability, latency, and user experience by running scheduled scripts. They are not the right tool for combining EC2 infrastructure metrics such as CPU utilization and disk read IOPS. [Synthetic monitoring (canaries)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Synthetics_Canaries.html)
- **D. Single metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds** do not best meet the requirement to take action only when two independent alarm conditions are simultaneously true. Composite alarms specifically combine separate metric alarms with Boolean logic and are the AWS-documented mechanism for reducing alarm noise in this way. [Composite alarms - Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个应用程序从本地服务器迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。作为迁移设计要求的一部分，解决方案架构师必须实施基础设施指标告警。如果 CPU 利用率在短时间突增到超过 50%，公司不需要采取行动。但是，如果 CPU 利用率增加到超过 50%，并且磁盘上的读取 IOPS 同时也很高，公司需要尽快采取行动。解决方案架构师还必须减少误报。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 在可能的情况下创建 Amazon CloudWatch 复合告警。
options.B: 创建 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板以可视化指标并快速响应问题。
options.C: 创建 Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries 来监控应用程序并触发告警。
options.D: 在可能的情况下创建具有多个指标阈值的单个 Amazon CloudWatch 指标告警。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A. 在可能的情况下创建 Amazon CloudWatch 复合告警。**

CloudWatch 复合告警正是为这种场景而设计的：它们监控其他告警的状态，并使用布尔逻辑将其组合起来。AWS 说明，复合告警可以减少告警噪声，并且可以创建复杂的告警条件，只有在满足多个条件时才执行操作，例如仅当 CPU 告警和另一个资源告警都已触发时才发送通知。规则表达式支持 `AND`，它仅在所有指定条件都为 true 时返回 true。因此，架构师可以为 CPU 利用率 > 50% 创建一个指标告警，为高磁盘读取 IOPS 创建另一个指标告警，并创建一个类似 `ALARM(CPUHigh) AND ALARM(DiskReadIOPSHigh)` 的复合告警，且仅在复合告警上配置操作。这可以避免对仅 CPU 短暂突增采取操作，并减少误报。[Composite alarms - Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. CloudWatch dashboards** 提供可视化和运营感知能力，但控制面板不会自动强制执行所需的组合告警条件，也不会在两个阈值都满足时立即触发操作。AWS 将控制面板描述为提供资源和应用程序的统一视图，而告警会持续监控阈值并可以触发自动化操作。[What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)
- **C. CloudWatch Synthetics canaries** 通过运行计划脚本来监控端点、API、可用性、延迟和用户体验。它们不是用于组合 EC2 基础设施指标（例如 CPU 利用率和磁盘读取 IOPS）的合适工具。[Synthetic monitoring (canaries)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Synthetics_Canaries.html)
- **D. Single metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds** 不能最好地满足仅在两个独立告警条件同时为 true 时才采取操作的要求。复合告警专门使用布尔逻辑组合单独的指标告警，并且是 AWS 文档化的用于以这种方式减少告警噪声的机制。[Composite alarms - Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html)

en.question: A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to AWS. According to the company's compliance requirements, the company can use only the ap-northeast-3 Region. Company administrators are not permitted to connect VPCs to the internet. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.B: Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap- northeast-3 in the AWS account settings.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
options.D: Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3.
options.E: Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and C.**

- **A is correct.** AWS Control Tower controls apply to an entire OU and affect every account in that OU; AWS states that controls/guardrails are used for ongoing governance and can be preventive, detective, or proactive ([AWS Control Tower controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/controls.html)). Control Tower also lets you customize governed Regions and enable **Region Deny** to control access to most AWS services in ungoverned Regions ([Customize Regions / Region Deny](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/console-customize.html)). Its data residency controls are intended to help inhibit creation/copying/sharing of data outside selected Regions and include a Region-deny SCP concept ([Data residency controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/data-residency-controls.html)). For the internet requirement, Control Tower has a control to **disallow inbound and outbound internet connections to VPCs through an IGW or egress-only IGW** ([CT.EC2.PV.8](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/ct-ec2-pv-8.html)).

- **C is correct.** AWS Organizations SCPs provide centralized control over the **maximum available permissions** for accounts/OUs/organizations, and AWS describes them as coarse-grained guardrails ([SCP examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_examples.html)). Therefore, SCPs can be used to deny actions that would give VPCs internet access, such as internet-gateway-related actions, and to deny use of Regions other than `ap-northeast-3`.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B is incorrect.** AWS WAF protects web applications from HTTP(S) web exploits; it is not an organization-wide mechanism to prevent administrators from attaching internet gateways or using other AWS Regions. Also, there is no general “AWS account setting” that denies all Regions in the way described; Region restrictions are normally enforced through SCPs or Control Tower Region Deny.
- **D is incorrect.** Network ACL outbound rules in each VPC are per-VPC controls and do not prevent administrators from creating other VPCs, attaching internet gateways, changing routing, or using other accounts. Per-user IAM policies are also weaker and harder to govern centrally than OU/account-level SCPs or Control Tower controls.
- **E is incorrect.** AWS Config is primarily for tracking, auditing, evaluating, and reporting resource configurations/compliance ([What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)). Detecting and alerting on internet gateways or resources in other Regions does not by itself **prevent** internet access or deny use of disallowed Regions, so it does not meet the stated requirements as an enforcement solution.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。根据公司的合规性要求，公司只能使用 ap-northeast-3 Region。公司管理员不允许将 VPC 连接到互联网。哪些解决方案将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Control Tower 实施数据驻留护栏，以拒绝互联网访问，并拒绝访问除 ap-northeast-3 之外的所有 AWS Regions。
options.B: 使用 AWS WAF 中的规则来阻止互联网访问。在 AWS 账户设置中拒绝访问除 ap- northeast-3 之外的所有 AWS Regions。
options.C: 使用 AWS Organizations 配置 service control policies (SCPS)，以防止 VPC 获得互联网访问权限。拒绝访问除 ap-northeast-3 之外的所有 AWS Regions。
options.D: 为每个 VPC 中的 network ACL 创建出站规则，以拒绝来自 0.0.0.0/0 的所有流量。为每个用户创建 IAM policy，以阻止使用除 ap-northeast-3 之外的任何 AWS Region。
options.E: 使用 AWS Config 激活托管规则，以检测互联网网关并发出警报，并检测部署在 ap-northeast-3 之外的新资源并发出警报。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 C。**

- **A 正确。** AWS Control Tower 控制项适用于整个 OU，并影响该 OU 中的每个账户；AWS 表示，控制项/护栏用于持续治理，并且可以是预防性、检测性或主动性的（[AWS Control Tower controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/controls.html)）。Control Tower 还允许你自定义受治理的 Regions，并启用 **Region Deny** 来控制对未受治理 Regions 中大多数 AWS 服务的访问（[Customize Regions / Region Deny](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/console-customize.html)）。其数据驻留控制旨在帮助抑制在所选 Regions 之外创建/复制/共享数据，并包含 Region-deny SCP 概念（[Data residency controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/data-residency-controls.html)）。对于互联网要求，Control Tower 有一个控制项可以**禁止通过 IGW 或 egress-only IGW 与 VPC 建立入站和出站互联网连接**（[CT.EC2.PV.8](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/controlreference/ct-ec2-pv-8.html)）。

- **C 正确。** AWS Organizations SCPs 为账户/OUs/组织提供对**最大可用权限**的集中控制，并且 AWS 将其描述为粗粒度护栏（[SCP examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_examples.html)）。因此，SCPs 可用于拒绝会使 VPC 获得互联网访问权限的操作，例如与互联网网关相关的操作，并拒绝使用 `ap-northeast-3` 以外的 Regions。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B 不正确。** AWS WAF 保护 Web 应用程序免受 HTTP(S) Web 漏洞利用；它不是一种组织范围的机制，无法阻止管理员附加互联网网关或使用其他 AWS Regions。此外，不存在题述那种用于拒绝所有 Regions 的通用“AWS 账户设置”；Region 限制通常通过 SCPs 或 Control Tower Region Deny 来强制执行。
- **D 不正确。** 每个 VPC 中的 Network ACL 出站规则是按 VPC 应用的控制，无法阻止管理员创建其他 VPC、附加互联网网关、更改路由或使用其他账户。按用户设置的 IAM policies 也比 OU/账户级别的 SCPs 或 Control Tower 控制更弱且更难以集中治理。
- **E 不正确。** AWS Config 主要用于跟踪、审计、评估和报告资源配置/合规性（[What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。检测互联网网关或其他 Regions 中的资源并发出警报，本身并不能**阻止**互联网访问或拒绝使用不允许的 Regions，因此它不符合题述作为强制执行解决方案的要求。

en.question: A company uses a three-tier web application to provide training to new employees. The application is accessed for only 12 hours every day. The company is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store information and wants to minimize costs. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an IAM policy for AWS Systems Manager Session Manager. Create an IAM role for the policy. Update the trust relationship of the role. Set up automatic start and stop for the DB instance.
options.B: Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache cluster that gives users the ability to access the data from the cache when the DB instance is stopped. Invalidate the cache after the DB instance is started.
options.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Create an IAM role that grants access to Amazon RDS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance. Configure a cron job to start and stop the EC2 instance on the desired schedule.
options.D: Create AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the DB instance. Create Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled rules to invoke the Lambda functions. Configure the Lambda functions as event targets for the rules.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Amazon RDS explicitly supports temporarily stopping a DB instance for **cost optimization**: while stopped, you are not charged for DB instance hours, and AWS lists **training** as a use case where DB instances can be started during the session and shut down afterward ([RDS stop instance use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)). A stopped RDS DB instance can later be started again and retains key configuration such as the instance ID, DNS endpoint, DB parameter group, VPC security group, and option group ([RDS start instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StartInstance.html)).

Using **Lambda functions** to call the RDS start/stop APIs and **EventBridge scheduled rules** to invoke those functions fits the daily 12-hour schedule. EventBridge scheduled rules can run at specific times using cron expressions, and EventBridge documentation specifically describes scheduled rules and scheduling Lambda invocations ([scheduled rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-create-rule-schedule.html), [schedule a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** The steps resemble Systems Manager automation/State Manager patterns, but the option says **Session Manager**. Session Manager is for establishing secure interactive connections to managed nodes and running commands in a session, not for scheduling RDS start/stop actions ([Session Manager features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).
- **B:** ElastiCache does not solve the requirement to store and reliably access the RDS-backed application data while the DB is stopped. The cost-saving action is to stop and start the RDS instance on schedule, not to serve database state from a cache.
- **C:** This starts and stops an **EC2 instance**, not the Amazon RDS DB instance. It also adds an unnecessary instance to manage and pay for, whereas EventBridge plus Lambda can schedule RDS API calls directly.

zh.question: 一家公司使用三层 Web 应用程序为新员工提供培训。该应用程序每天仅访问 12 小时。该公司正在使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例来存储信息，并希望最大限度地降低成本。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 配置 IAM 策略。为该策略创建 IAM 角色。更新该角色的信任关系。为 DB 实例设置自动启动和停止。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 缓存集群，使用户能够在 DB 实例停止时从缓存访问数据。在 DB 实例启动后使缓存失效。
options.C: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例。创建一个授予 Amazon RDS 访问权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色附加到 EC2 实例。配置 cron 作业，按所需计划启动和停止 EC2 实例。
options.D: 创建 AWS Lambda 函数来启动和停止 DB 实例。创建 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 计划规则来调用 Lambda 函数。将 Lambda 函数配置为规则的事件目标。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

Amazon RDS 明确支持为了**成本优化**而临时停止 DB 实例：停止时，您无需为 DB 实例小时数付费，并且 AWS 将**培训**列为一种使用场景，即 DB 实例可以在会话期间启动并在之后关闭（[RDS stop instance use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。已停止的 RDS DB 实例稍后可以再次启动，并保留关键配置，例如实例 ID、DNS 端点、DB 参数组、VPC 安全组和选项组（[RDS start instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StartInstance.html)）。使用 **Lambda 函数**调用 RDS 启动/停止 API，并使用 **EventBridge scheduled rules** 调用这些函数，符合每天 12 小时的计划。EventBridge scheduled rules 可以使用 cron 表达式在特定时间运行，并且 EventBridge 文档专门描述了计划规则和计划 Lambda 调用（[scheduled rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-create-rule-schedule.html)，[schedule a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 这些步骤类似于 Systems Manager 自动化/State Manager 模式，但该选项说的是 **Session Manager**。Session Manager 用于与托管节点建立安全的交互式连接并在会话中运行命令，而不是用于计划 RDS 启动/停止操作（[Session Manager features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。
- **B:** ElastiCache 不能解决在 DB 停止时存储并可靠访问由 RDS 支持的应用程序数据这一要求。节省成本的操作是按计划停止和启动 RDS 实例，而不是从缓存提供数据库状态。
- **C:** 这会启动和停止一个 **EC2 实例**，而不是 Amazon RDS DB 实例。它还会增加一个不必要的实例，需要管理和付费；而 EventBridge 加 Lambda 可以直接计划 RDS API 调用。

en.question: A company sells ringtones created from clips of popular songs. The files containing the ringtones are stored in Amazon S3 Standard and are at least 128 KB in size. The company has millions of files, but downloads are infrequent for ringtones older than 90 days. The company needs to save money on storage while keeping the most accessed files readily available for its users. Which action should the company take to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage for the initial storage tier of the objects.
options.B: Move the files to S3 Intelligent-Tiering and configure it to move objects to a less expensive storage tier after 90 days.
options.C: Configure S3 inventory to manage objects and move them to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A) after 90 days.
options.D: Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy that moves the objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A) after 90 days.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The access pattern is known: new ringtones should remain in S3 Standard for ready/frequent access, and objects older than 90 days become infrequently downloaded. AWS documents this exact pattern: for older data that is accessed infrequently but still needs millisecond access, you can upload to S3 Standard and use a lifecycle configuration to transition objects to S3 Standard-IA or S3 One Zone-IA. S3 Lifecycle transition actions define when objects move to another storage class, such as S3 Standard-IA, and are intended to store objects cost-effectively throughout their lifecycle ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html), [S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). The files are at least 128 KB and will remain for more than 30 days after transition, which fits the documented suitability of S3 Standard-IA for objects larger than 128 KB stored at least 30 days ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **A**: Using S3 Standard-IA as the initial tier is not best because newer ringtones are the most accessed. S3 Standard-IA is for long-lived, infrequently accessed data and has retrieval charges, so frequently accessed new objects should not start there ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
* **B**: S3 Intelligent-Tiering is best for unknown or changing access patterns and includes a monthly monitoring and automation fee. Here the rule is known: after 90 days, access becomes infrequent. Also, if configuring Intelligent-Tiering optional Archive Access at 90 days, retrieval is asynchronous and requires restore, which does not meet “readily available” access; its Archive Instant Access tier is automatic, not a lifecycle-style configured move ([S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html), [S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
* **C**: S3 Inventory reports object metadata; it is not the most direct or cost-effective mechanism to transition objects. S3 Lifecycle is the native feature for defining when objects transition to lower-cost storage classes ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司销售由流行歌曲片段制作的铃声。包含这些铃声的文件存储在 Amazon S3 Standard 中，大小至少为 128 KB。该公司有数百万个文件，但对于超过 90 天的铃声，下载并不频繁。公司需要在保持访问量最高的文件可供用户随时访问的同时节省存储成本。公司应采取哪项操作以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 为对象的初始存储层配置 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储。
options.B: 将文件移动到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，并将其配置为在 90 天后将对象移动到更低成本的存储层。
options.C: 配置 S3 inventory 来管理对象，并在 90 天后将它们移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A)。
options.D: 实施一项 S3 Lifecycle policy，在 90 天后将对象从 S3 Standard 移动到 S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 访问模式是已知的：新铃声应保留在 S3 Standard 中，以便随时/频繁访问，而超过 90 天的对象下载会变得不频繁。AWS 文档说明了这种确切模式：对于较旧的数据，如果访问不频繁但仍需要毫秒级访问，可以上传到 S3 Standard，并使用生命周期配置将对象转换到 S3 Standard-IA 或 S3 One Zone-IA。S3 Lifecycle 转换操作定义对象何时移动到另一个存储类，例如 S3 Standard-IA，并旨在在对象整个生命周期内以经济高效的方式存储对象（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)，[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。这些文件至少为 128 KB，并且在转换后会保留超过 30 天，这符合文档中关于 S3 Standard-IA 适用于大于 128 KB 且至少存储 30 天的对象的说明（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

* **A**：将 S3 Standard-IA 用作初始层并不是最佳选择，因为较新的铃声访问量最高。S3 Standard-IA 适用于长期存在、不频繁访问的数据，并且有检索费用，因此频繁访问的新对象不应从该层开始（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
* **B**：S3 Intelligent-Tiering 最适合未知或变化的访问模式，并包含每月监控和自动化费用。这里的规则是已知的：90 天后，访问变得不频繁。此外，如果将 Intelligent-Tiering 可选的 Archive Access 配置为 90 天，检索是异步的并且需要恢复，这不满足“随时可用”的访问要求；其 Archive Instant Access tier 是自动的，而不是生命周期式的已配置移动（[S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)，[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
* **C**：S3 Inventory 报告对象元数据；它不是转换对象最直接或最具成本效益的机制。S3 Lifecycle 是用于定义对象何时转换到较低成本存储类的原生功能（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to save the results from a medical trial to an Amazon S3 repository. The repository must allow a few scientists to add new files and must restrict all other users to read-only access. No users can have the ability to modify or delete any files in the repository. The company must keep every file in the repository for a minimum of 1 year after its creation date. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode with a legal hold of 1 year.
options.B: Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with a retention period of 365 days.
options.C: Use an IAM role to restrict all users from deleting or changing objects in the S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to only allow the IAM role.
options.D: Configure the S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function every time an object is added. Configure the function to track the hash of the saved object so that modified objects can be marked accordingly.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Use **S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with a 365-day retention period**. S3 Object Lock retention periods protect object versions for a fixed amount of time; a bucket default retention period can protect every object version placed in the bucket by calculating a retain-until date from the object creation timestamp. In **compliance mode**, a protected object version cannot be overwritten or deleted by **any user, including the AWS account root user**, and its retention mode cannot be changed or shortened during the retention period ([AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)). This meets the requirement to retain every file for at least 1 year and prevent all users from modifying or deleting stored files. Scientists can still be granted permission to add new objects; Object Lock protects the stored object versions after creation.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Governance mode with a legal hold** is not appropriate. In governance mode, users with special permissions can bypass or remove retention protections, so it does not satisfy “no users” can modify or delete files. Also, legal holds do not have a fixed duration and remain until removed by a user with permission ([AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)).
- **C. IAM role and bucket policy only** can restrict ordinary access, but it does not provide immutable WORM retention. Permissions or policies could be changed by sufficiently privileged users, so this does not guarantee that no user can modify or delete objects for 1 year.
- **D. Lambda hash tracking** might detect changes after upload, but it does not prevent modification or deletion and does not enforce a 1-year retention period.

Therefore, **B** is the only solution that enforces immutable retention for 365 days with no user able to overwrite or delete protected objects.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将医疗试验的结果保存到 Amazon S3 存储库。该存储库必须允许少数科学家添加新文件，并且必须将所有其他用户限制为只读访问。任何用户都不能具有修改或删除存储库中任何文件的能力。公司必须在每个文件创建日期之后，将存储库中的每个文件至少保留 1 年。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用治理模式下的 S3 Object Lock，并设置 1 年的法定保留。
options.B: 使用合规模式下的 S3 Object Lock，并设置 365 天的保留期。
options.C: 使用 IAM 角色限制所有用户删除或更改 S3 桶中的对象。使用 S3 桶策略仅允许该 IAM 角色。
options.D: 将 S3 桶配置为每次添加对象时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该函数以跟踪已保存对象的哈希值，以便可以相应地标记已修改的对象。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

使用**合规模式下的 S3 Object Lock，并设置 365 天保留期**。S3 Object Lock 保留期会在固定时间内保护对象版本；桶默认保留期可以通过根据对象创建时间戳计算 retain-until 日期，来保护放入桶中的每个对象版本。在**合规模式**下，受保护的对象版本不能被**任何用户（包括 AWS 账户 root 用户）**覆盖或删除，并且在保留期内其保留模式不能被更改，保留期也不能被缩短（[AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。这满足了将每个文件至少保留 1 年并防止所有用户修改或删除已存储文件的要求。仍然可以授予科学家添加新对象的权限；Object Lock 会在对象创建后保护已存储的对象版本。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 具有法定保留的治理模式**不合适。在治理模式下，具有特殊权限的用户可以绕过或移除保留保护，因此它不满足“没有用户”可以修改或删除文件的要求。此外，法定保留没有固定持续时间，并会一直保持，直到由具有权限的用户移除（[AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。
- **C. 仅使用 IAM 角色和桶策略**可以限制普通访问，但它不提供不可变的 WORM 保留。具有足够权限的用户可能会更改权限或策略，因此这不能保证没有用户可以在 1 年内修改或删除对象。
- **D. Lambda 哈希跟踪**可能会在上传后检测到更改，但它不能防止修改或删除，也不能强制执行 1 年保留期。因此，**B** 是唯一能够强制实施 365 天不可变保留，并且没有用户能够覆盖或删除受保护对象的解决方案。

en.question: A large media company hosts a web application on AWS. The company wants to start caching confidential media files so that users around the world will have reliable access to the files. The content is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The company must deliver the content quickly, regardless of where the requests originate geographically. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
options.B: Deploy AWS Global Accelerator to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
options.C: Deploy Amazon CloudFront to connect the S3 buckets to CloudFront edge servers.
options.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Deploy Amazon CloudFront to connect the S3 buckets to CloudFront edge servers.**

Amazon CloudFront is the correct service because it is a CDN designed to deliver content with low latency from geographically distributed edge locations. AWS documentation states that CloudFront uses edge servers close to viewers to deliver content quickly, can use an **Amazon S3 bucket** as an origin, and distributes content from CloudFront edge locations worldwide where CloudFront caches copies of files ([CloudFront: How you set up CloudFront to deliver content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). For confidential S3 content, CloudFront also supports origin access control (OAC) to send authenticated requests to S3 and help secure S3 origins ([Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS DataSync** is for transferring or migrating data, including to AWS storage, not for globally caching and serving media files to viewers ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **B. AWS Global Accelerator** improves global application availability and performance using accelerators/static anycast IPs, but it is not a CDN and does not cache S3 media files at edge locations ([What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).
- **D. Amazon SQS** is a message queue service for sending and processing messages, not a content delivery or caching service ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)).

zh.question: 一家大型媒体公司在 AWS 上托管一个 Web 应用程序。该公司希望开始缓存机密媒体文件，以便全球用户都能可靠地访问这些文件。内容存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。无论请求在地理位置上来自何处，公司都必须快速交付内容。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 将 S3 存储桶连接到 Web 应用程序。
options.B: 部署 AWS Global Accelerator 将 S3 存储桶连接到 Web 应用程序。
options.C: 部署 Amazon CloudFront，将 S3 存储桶连接到 CloudFront 边缘服务器。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 将 S3 存储桶连接到 Web 应用程序。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 部署 Amazon CloudFront，将 S3 存储桶连接到 CloudFront 边缘服务器。**

Amazon CloudFront 是正确的服务，因为它是一个 CDN，旨在通过地理位置分布的边缘站点以低延迟交付内容。AWS 文档说明，CloudFront 使用靠近查看者的边缘服务器来快速交付内容，可以使用 **Amazon S3 bucket** 作为源站，并从全球 CloudFront 边缘站点分发内容，CloudFront 会在这些位置缓存文件副本（[CloudFront: How you set up CloudFront to deliver content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。对于机密 S3 内容，CloudFront 还支持源访问控制 (OAC)，用于向 S3 发送经过身份验证的请求，并帮助保护 S3 源站（[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS DataSync** 用于传输或迁移数据，包括传输到 AWS 存储，而不是用于向查看者进行全球缓存和提供媒体文件（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **B. AWS Global Accelerator** 使用加速器/静态 anycast IP 提高全球应用程序的可用性和性能，但它不是 CDN，也不会在边缘站点缓存 S3 媒体文件（[What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。
- **D. Amazon SQS** 是一种用于发送和处理消息的消息队列服务，不是内容分发或缓存服务（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。

en.question: A company produces batch data that comes from different databases. The company also produces live stream data from network sensors and application APIs. The company needs to consolidate all the data into one place for business analytics. The company needs to process the incoming data and then stage the data in different Amazon S3 buckets. Teams will later run one-time queries and import the data into a business intelligence tool to show key performance indicators (KPIs). Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
options.C: Create custom AWS Lambda functions to move the individual records from the databases to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.D: Use an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the data into JSON format. Load the data into multiple Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) clusters.
options.E: Use blueprints in AWS Lake Formation to identify the data that can be ingested into a data lake. Use AWS Glue to crawl the source, extract the data, and load the data into Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and E.**

- **A is correct** because the staged data will be in Amazon S3 and teams need one-time/ad hoc queries plus BI dashboards. Amazon Athena is an interactive query service for analyzing data directly in S3 with standard SQL and is serverless, so there is no infrastructure to manage; it is explicitly suited to ad hoc queries. Amazon QuickSight is a BI service for turning raw data into insights through interactive visualizations, dashboards, and reports. ([Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html), [QuickSight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/quick-bi.html))
- **E is correct** because Lake Formation blueprints create simplified, automated workflows that generate AWS Glue crawlers, jobs, and triggers for ETL loading and updating data. The blueprints include database snapshot, incremental database, and log-file ingestion patterns. AWS Glue is serverless, integrates with Amazon S3 data lakes, supports ETL/streaming workloads, and can write Parquet files to S3. This best matches consolidating batch and streaming sources into S3 with the least operational overhead. ([Lake Formation blueprints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/workflows-about.html), [AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html), [Glue Parquet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-parquet-home.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Kinesis Data Analytics is for processing streaming data, not the best fit for later one-time/ad hoc SQL queries over staged S3 data. Athena is the AWS service documented for ad hoc SQL analysis directly on S3. ([Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html))
- **C:** Custom Lambda functions moving records into Amazon Redshift would add custom code and operational work, and it stages data in Redshift rather than the required S3 buckets. AWS Glue/Lake Formation provides managed, serverless ETL into data lakes instead. ([AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html))
- **D:** Loading JSON data into multiple OpenSearch Service clusters does not meet the requirement to stage processed data in different S3 buckets and would introduce cluster management overhead. Glue writing Parquet to S3 is a better analytics/data-lake pattern. ([Glue Parquet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-parquet-home.html))

zh.question: 一家公司生成来自不同数据库的批处理数据。该公司还生成来自网络传感器和应用程序 API 的实时流数据。公司需要将所有数据整合到一个位置用于业务分析。公司需要处理传入数据，然后将数据暂存到不同的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。团队稍后将运行一次性查询，并将数据导入业务智能工具以显示关键绩效指标 (KPIs)。哪组步骤组合能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Athena 进行一次性查询。使用 Amazon QuickSight 为 KPIs 创建仪表板。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 进行一次性查询。使用 Amazon QuickSight 为 KPIs 创建仪表板。
options.C: 创建自定义 AWS Lambda 函数，将各条记录从数据库移动到 Amazon Redshift 集群。
options.D: 使用 AWS Glue 提取、转换和加载 (ETL) 作业将数据转换为 JSON 格式。将数据加载到多个 Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) 集群中。
options.E: 使用 AWS Lake Formation 中的蓝图来识别可摄取到数据湖中的数据。使用 AWS Glue 爬取源、提取数据，并以 Apache Parquet 格式将数据加载到 Amazon S3 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 E。**

- **A 正确**，因为暂存数据将位于 Amazon S3 中，并且团队需要一次性/临时查询以及 BI 仪表板。Amazon Athena 是一种交互式查询服务，可使用标准 SQL 直接分析 S3 中的数据，并且是无服务器的，因此无需管理基础设施；它明确适用于临时查询。Amazon QuickSight 是一项 BI 服务，可通过交互式可视化、仪表板和报告将原始数据转化为洞察。([Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html), [QuickSight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/quick-bi.html))
