- **A. AWS Global Accelerator** improves availability/performance by routing traffic over the AWS global network to optimal regional endpoints and provides static anycast IP addresses. Its standard accelerator endpoints are NLBs, ALBs, EC2 instances, or Elastic IP addresses—not an S3 bucket cache—and it does not cache static objects to reduce origin load ([Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).
- **C and D. ElastiCache for Redis or Memcached** are in-memory caches commonly used to cache data from databases or data stores and accelerate application data access. They are not a global CDN for browser delivery of S3-hosted videos and images, and would not be the most cost-effective way to serve identical static media worldwide ([ElastiCache related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/related-services-choose-between-memorydb-and-redis.html)).

zh.question: 一家游戏公司在 AWS 上托管一个基于浏览器的应用程序。该应用程序的用户会消费大量存储在 Amazon S3 中的视频和图像。此内容对所有用户都是相同的。该应用程序越来越受欢迎，全球有数百万用户访问这些媒体文件。公司希望在降低源站负载的同时，将文件提供给用户。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Web 服务器前面部署一个 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器。
options.B: 在 S3 bucket 前面部署一个 Amazon CloudFront Web 分配。
options.C: 在 Web 服务器前面部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 实例。
options.D: 在 Web 服务器前面部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront web distribution in front of the S3 bucket.**

CloudFront 正是为这种场景而设计的：从 Amazon S3 等源站向全球交付 HTTP 内容，例如图像和媒体文件。AWS 表示，CloudFront 分配可以使用 **Amazon S3 bucket** 作为源站，并且 CloudFront 会将分配配置发送到全球边缘站点/POPs，在那里它会**缓存文件副本**。这减少了对 S3 源站的重复请求，并改善了面向数百万全球用户的交付延迟。CloudFront 还指出，从 S3 等 AWS 源站到 CloudFront 的数据传输是免费的；客户为 CloudFront 到查看器的传输付费，这支持了静态共享内容交付的成本效益要求（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。CloudFront 源站设置明确支持将 **Amazon S3 bucket** 作为源站域（[CloudFront origin settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Global Accelerator** 通过在 AWS 全球网络上将流量路由到最佳区域端点来提高可用性/性能，并提供静态 anycast IP 地址。其标准加速器端点是 NLBs、ALBs、EC2 instances 或 Elastic IP addresses，而不是 S3 bucket 缓存，并且它不会缓存静态对象来降低源站负载（[Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。
- **C and D. ElastiCache for Redis or Memcached** 是内存缓存，通常用于缓存来自数据库或数据存储的数据，并加速应用程序数据访问。它们不是用于通过浏览器全球交付 S3 托管视频和图像的全球 CDN，也不是向全球提供相同静态媒体的最具成本效益方式（[ElastiCache related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/related-services-choose-between-memorydb-and-redis.html)）。

en.question: A company has a multi-tier application that runs six front-end web servers in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect needs to modify the infrastructure to be highly available without modifying the application. Which architecture should the solutions architect choose that provides high availability?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses three instances across each of two Regions.
options.B: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use three instances across each of two Availability Zones.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling template that can be used to quickly create more instances in another Region.
options.D: Change the ALB in front of the Amazon EC2 instances in a round-robin configuration to balance traffic to the web tier.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

To make the application highly available without changing the application, the web tier should be spread across multiple Availability Zones in the same Region. AWS explicitly recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attaching a load balancer to distribute traffic across those AZs for geographic redundancy. If one Availability Zone becomes unhealthy, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected Availability Zone and later redistributes instances evenly when the AZ recovers ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). Auto Scaling also distributes desired capacity across the specified Availability Zones and maintains balance across them ([Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)). For the ALB, AWS states that multiple Availability Zones help ensure the load balancer can continue routing traffic if one AZ becomes unavailable or has no healthy targets ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An Auto Scaling group should span multiple Availability Zones **within the Region** for this use case; the AWS guidance cited above says to span the Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones of the Region you are working in, not across Regions.
- **C:** A template that can quickly create instances in another Region is not active high availability. It is a recovery aid, but it does not keep the current application continuously available during an AZ failure.
- **D:** Changing to round-robin routing does not remove the single-AZ dependency. ALB routing can distribute requests to healthy targets, but high availability requires enabled multiple Availability Zones with healthy targets so traffic can continue if one AZ fails.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个多层应用程序，在单个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组内运行六台前端 Web 服务器，并位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面。解决方案架构师需要在不修改应用程序的情况下修改基础设施，使其具备高可用性。解决方案架构师应选择哪种架构来提供高可用性？

options.A: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，在两个 Region 中各使用三个实例。
options.B: 修改 Auto Scaling 组，在两个 Availability Zone 中各使用三个实例。
options.C: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 模板，可用于在另一个 Region 中快速创建更多实例。
options.D: 将 Amazon EC2 实例前面的 ALB 更改为轮询配置，以平衡到 Web 层的流量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

要在不更改应用程序的情况下使应用程序具备高可用性，应将 Web 层分布到同一 Region 中的多个 Availability Zones。AWS 明确建议将 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 Availability Zones 部署，并附加负载均衡器以在这些 AZ 之间分配流量，从而实现地理冗余。如果某个 Availability Zone 变为不正常，Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 Availability Zone 中启动实例，并在该 AZ 恢复后再将实例均匀重新分布（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。Auto Scaling 还会在指定的 Availability Zones 之间分配所需容量，并在它们之间保持平衡（[Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）。对于 ALB，AWS 表示，多个 Availability Zones 有助于确保在某个 AZ 不可用或没有正常目标时，负载均衡器仍可继续路由流量（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 对于此用例，Auto Scaling 组应跨同一 Region **内的多个 Availability Zones**；上面引用的 AWS 指南说明，应将 Auto Scaling 组跨你正在使用的 Region 的多个 Availability Zones 部署，而不是跨 Regions。
- **C:** 能够在另一个 Region 中快速创建实例的模板并不是主动高可用性。它是一种恢复辅助工具，但不能在 AZ 故障期间使当前应用程序持续可用。
- **D:** 更改为轮询路由并不能消除单 AZ 依赖。ALB 路由可以将请求分发到正常目标，但高可用性要求启用多个 Availability Zones 并具有正常目标，这样在一个 AZ 发生故障时流量仍可继续。

en.question: An ecommerce company has an order-processing application that uses Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. During a recent sales event, a sudden surge in customer orders occurred. Some customers experienced timeouts, and the application did not process the orders of those customers. A solutions architect determined that the CPU utilization and memory utilization were high on the database because of a large number of open connections. The solutions architect needs to prevent the timeout errors while making the least possible changes to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function. Modify the database to be a global database in multiple AWS Regions.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the database. Modify the Lambda function to use the RDS Proxy endpoint instead of the database endpoint.
options.C: Create a read replica for the database in a different AWS Region. Use query string parameters in API Gateway to route traffic to the read replica.
options.D: Migrate the data from Aurora PostgreSQL to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Modify the Lambda function to use the DynamoDB table.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

Amazon RDS Proxy directly addresses the identified bottleneck: too many open database connections causing high CPU and memory utilization. AWS documentation states that RDS Proxy lets applications “pool and share database connections” to improve scaling, handles “unpredictable surges in database traffic,” establishes and reuses a database connection pool, and avoids the memory and CPU overhead of opening new database connections each time. It can also queue or throttle connection requests so the application can continue to scale without abruptly overwhelming the database ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). For Lambda-to-Aurora connectivity, AWS documents that RDS can configure the Lambda, DB cluster, and proxy security groups, and the Lambda function can send traffic through a proxy ([Automatically connecting a Lambda function and an Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)). This requires only changing the Lambda function to use the proxy endpoint instead of the DB endpoint.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A**: Lambda provisioned concurrency helps pre-initialize Lambda execution environments to reduce function start latency, but it does not solve database connection exhaustion. Making the database an Aurora global database adds major complexity and does not reduce the number of open write connections to the primary database.
* **C**: A read replica helps read scaling, but this is an order-processing workload that must write orders. Routing API Gateway requests to a read replica would not solve write connection pressure and would not process orders correctly.
* **D**: Migrating from Aurora PostgreSQL to DynamoDB could require substantial schema and application changes. The requirement is to make the least possible changes, and RDS Proxy is designed for this connection-pooling use case; AWS notes it can be enabled for most applications with no code changes or minimal endpoint changes ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)).

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司有一个订单处理应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数。该应用程序将数据存储在 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库中。在最近的一次促销活动期间，客户订单突然激增。一些客户遇到了超时，并且应用程序没有处理这些客户的订单。解决方案架构师确定，由于存在大量打开的连接，数据库的 CPU 利用率和内存利用率都很高。解决方案架构师需要在对应用程序进行尽可能少的更改的同时防止超时错误。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Lambda 函数配置预置并发。将数据库修改为跨多个 AWS Regions 的全局数据库。
options.B: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 为数据库创建代理。修改 Lambda 函数，使其使用 RDS Proxy 端点而不是数据库端点。
options.C: 在不同的 AWS Region 中为数据库创建只读副本。使用 API Gateway 中的查询字符串参数将流量路由到只读副本。
options.D: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据从 Aurora PostgreSQL 迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。修改 Lambda 函数，使其使用 DynamoDB 表。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

Amazon RDS Proxy 直接解决了已识别的瓶颈：过多打开的数据库连接导致 CPU 和内存利用率很高。AWS 文档指出，RDS Proxy 允许应用程序“池化并共享数据库连接”以改进扩展，处理“数据库流量中不可预测的激增”，建立并重用数据库连接池，并避免每次打开新数据库连接所带来的内存和 CPU 开销。它还可以对连接请求进行排队或限流，使应用程序能够继续扩展，而不会突然压垮数据库（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。对于 Lambda 到 Aurora 的连接，AWS 文档说明 RDS 可以配置 Lambda、DB 集群和代理安全组，并且 Lambda 函数可以通过代理发送流量（[Automatically connecting a Lambda function and an Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)）。这只需要将 Lambda 函数改为使用代理端点而不是 DB 端点。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **A**：Lambda 预置并发有助于预初始化 Lambda 执行环境以减少函数启动延迟，但它不能解决数据库连接耗尽问题。将数据库改为 Aurora global database 会增加重大复杂性，并且不会减少到主数据库的打开写入连接数量。
* **C**：只读副本有助于读取扩展，但这是必须写入订单的订单处理工作负载。将 API Gateway 请求路由到只读副本无法解决写入连接压力，也无法正确处理订单。
* **D**：从 Aurora PostgreSQL 迁移到 DynamoDB 可能需要大量架构和应用程序更改。要求是进行尽可能少的更改，而 RDS Proxy 正是为这种连接池用例而设计的；AWS 指出，对于大多数应用程序，可以在无需代码更改或仅需最小端点更改的情况下启用它（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。

en.question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The application needs to access an Amazon DynamoDB table. What is the MOST secure way to access the table while ensuring that the traffic does not leave the AWS network?

options.A: Use a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.
options.B: Use a NAT gateway in a public subnet.
options.C: Use a NAT instance in a private subnet.
options.D: Use the internet gateway attached to the VPC.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A. Use a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.** AWS states that DynamoDB can be accessed from an Amazon VPC using VPC endpoints, including gateway endpoints and interface endpoints. A DynamoDB gateway endpoint is specified in a route table to access DynamoDB from the VPC **over the AWS network**, and AWS explicitly notes that for DynamoDB VPC endpoints, “your network traffic remains on the AWS network” ([AWS DynamoDB Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). This satisfies both requirements: private EC2 instances can access DynamoDB, and traffic does not leave the AWS network.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. NAT gateway in a public subnet**: A public NAT gateway is used to let instances in private subnets send outbound traffic to the **internet**; AWS documents that private subnet instances reach the internet through a route to the NAT gateway, and the NAT gateway’s public subnet routes to an internet gateway ([AWS VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)). That is not the most secure DynamoDB-specific solution.
- **C. NAT instance in a private subnet**: NAT-based designs are for outbound connectivity outside the VPC, not private DynamoDB access. Also, a subnet without a route to an internet gateway is private, and instances in such a subnet cannot communicate with the internet through an internet gateway ([AWS VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)). This does not provide the requested secure AWS-network-only DynamoDB path.
- **D. Internet gateway attached to the VPC**: An internet gateway is for internet access; AWS describes routes to an internet gateway as sending internet-bound traffic and requiring public addressing for IPv4 internet communication ([AWS VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)). It does not keep DynamoDB access private like a VPC endpoint does.

zh.question: 一个应用程序运行在私有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序需要访问一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。在确保流量不离开 AWS 网络的同时，访问该表的最安全方式是什么？

options.A: 为 DynamoDB 使用 VPC endpoint。
options.B: 在公有子网中使用 NAT gateway。
options.C: 在私有子网中使用 NAT instance。
options.D: 使用附加到 VPC 的 internet gateway。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A. Use a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.** AWS 表明，可以使用 VPC endpoints 从 Amazon VPC 访问 DynamoDB，包括 gateway endpoints 和 interface endpoints。DynamoDB gateway endpoint 在 route table 中指定，用于从 VPC **通过 AWS 网络**访问 DynamoDB，并且 AWS 明确指出，对于 DynamoDB VPC endpoints，“your network traffic remains on the AWS network” ([AWS DynamoDB Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html))。这同时满足两个要求：私有 EC2 实例可以访问 DynamoDB，并且流量不会离开 AWS 网络。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B. NAT gateway in a public subnet**：public NAT gateway 用于让私有子网中的实例向 **internet** 发送出站流量；AWS 文档说明，私有子网实例通过指向 NAT gateway 的路由访问互联网，而 NAT gateway 所在的公有子网则路由到 internet gateway ([AWS VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html))。这不是最安全的 DynamoDB 专用解决方案。
- **C. NAT instance in a private subnet**：基于 NAT 的设计用于 VPC 外部的出站连接，而不是私有 DynamoDB 访问。此外，没有指向 internet gateway 的路由的子网是私有子网，位于此类子网中的实例无法通过 internet gateway 与互联网通信 ([AWS VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html))。这不能提供所请求的仅限 AWS 网络的安全 DynamoDB 路径。
- **D. Internet gateway attached to the VPC**：internet gateway 用于互联网访问；AWS 将指向 internet gateway 的路由描述为发送面向互联网的流量，并且 IPv4 互联网通信需要公有地址 ([AWS VPC User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html))。它不像 VPC endpoint 那样使 DynamoDB 访问保持私有。

en.question: An entertainment company is using Amazon DynamoDB to store media metadata. The application is read intensive and experiencing delays. The company does not have staff to handle additional operational overhead and needs to improve the performance efficiency of DynamoDB without reconfiguring the application. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
options.B: Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).
options.C: Replicate data by using DynamoDB global tables.
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with Auto Discovery enabled.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX).**

DAX is purpose-built for DynamoDB read acceleration. AWS describes DAX as a **DynamoDB-compatible caching service** that provides fast in-memory performance, reduces eventually consistent read latency from single-digit milliseconds to microseconds, and is especially beneficial for **read-heavy or bursty workloads**. AWS also states that DAX reduces operational and application complexity because it is a **managed service that is API-compatible with DynamoDB** and requires only minimal functional changes for an existing application ([AWS DynamoDB DAX documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). This directly matches the requirement to improve read performance without adding operational overhead or substantially reconfiguring the application.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon ElastiCache for Redis** – ElastiCache is a general-purpose distributed in-memory cache/data store service, not a DynamoDB-compatible accelerator. Using Redis would require the application to implement separate caching logic and cache invalidation patterns, unlike DAX, which is API-compatible with DynamoDB ([Amazon ElastiCache overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)).
- **C. DynamoDB global tables** – Global tables are for multi-Region replication, multi-Region writes, and resiliency patterns, not for accelerating repeated reads in a single read-intensive workload. AWS describes global tables as supporting replicas across Regions/accounts and multi-Region replication characteristics ([DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)).
- **D. Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with Auto Discovery** – Like Redis, Memcached is a separate ElastiCache engine and would require application-level integration with a separate cache. It is not the managed, DynamoDB-compatible acceleration layer that DAX provides ([Amazon ElastiCache overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)).

zh.question: 一家娱乐公司正在使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储媒体元数据。该应用程序以读取为主，并且正在出现延迟。该公司没有人员来处理额外的运营开销，并且需要在不重新配置应用程序的情况下提高 DynamoDB 的性能效率。解决方案架构师应推荐什么来满足此要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。
options.B: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。
options.C: 使用 DynamoDB global tables 复制数据。
options.D: 使用启用了 Auto Discovery 的 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。**

DAX 专为 DynamoDB 读取加速而构建。AWS 将 DAX 描述为一种 **DynamoDB-compatible caching service**，可提供快速的内存性能，将最终一致性读取延迟从个位数毫秒降低到微秒级，并且特别适用于 **read-heavy or bursty workloads**。AWS 还说明，DAX 可以降低运营和应用程序复杂性，因为它是一个 **managed service that is API-compatible with DynamoDB**，并且对于现有应用程序只需要最少的功能性更改（[AWS DynamoDB DAX documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。这直接符合在不增加运营开销或不大幅重新配置应用程序的情况下提升读取性能的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon ElastiCache for Redis** – ElastiCache 是一种通用的分布式内存缓存/数据存储服务，而不是与 DynamoDB 兼容的加速器。使用 Redis 将要求应用程序实现单独的缓存逻辑和缓存失效模式，这不同于 DAX，后者与 DynamoDB API 兼容（[Amazon ElastiCache overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。
- **C. DynamoDB global tables** – Global tables 用于多 Region 复制、多 Region 写入和弹性模式，而不是用于加速单个读取密集型工作负载中的重复读取。AWS 将 global tables 描述为支持跨 Regions/accounts 的副本以及多 Region 复制特性（[DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。
- **D. Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with Auto Discovery** – 与 Redis 一样，Memcached 是一个独立的 ElastiCache 引擎，需要在应用程序级别与单独的缓存集成。它不是 DAX 所提供的托管、DynamoDB-compatible 加速层（[Amazon ElastiCache overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。

en.question: A company’s infrastructure consists of Amazon EC2 instances and an Amazon RDS DB instance in a single AWS Region. The company wants to back up its data in a separate Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Backup to copy EC2 backups and RDS backups to the separate Region.
options.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to copy EC2 backups and RDS backups to the separate Region.
options.C: Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to the separate Region. Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance in the separate Region.
options.D: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots. Copy the EBS snapshots to the separate Region. Create RDS snapshots. Export the RDS snapshots to Amazon S3. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to the separate Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS Backup is designed for this exact requirement with the least operational overhead. It provides centralized backup management and policy-based backup plans across AWS services, and it can copy backups to other AWS Regions on demand or automatically as part of a scheduled backup plan ([AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). AWS Backup supports both **Amazon EC2 instances backed by EBS volumes** and **Amazon RDS DB instances** as backup/restore resource types ([supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). Its feature availability table also shows **Cross-Region backup** support for Amazon EC2, Amazon EBS, and Amazon RDS DB instances ([feature availability by resource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager automates lifecycle management for **EBS snapshots and EBS-backed AMIs**, and is described as a backup solution for **EC2 instances and individual EBS volumes**, not RDS databases ([Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)). Therefore it cannot centrally handle both EC2 and RDS backups.
- **C:** Manually creating/copying AMIs and separately creating an RDS read replica adds more operational overhead than a single AWS Backup backup plan. A read replica is not the same as a backup copy strategy for both EC2 and RDS.
- **D:** This uses several separate mechanisms: EBS snapshots, RDS snapshots, export to S3, and S3 CRR. That is more complex than using AWS Backup’s centralized, policy-based, Cross-Region backup capability for both resource types.

zh.question: 一家公司的基础设施由单个 AWS Region 中的 Amazon EC2 实例和一个 Amazon RDS DB 实例组成。该公司希望将其数据备份到单独的 Region。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Backup 将 EC2 备份和 RDS 备份复制到单独的 Region。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 将 EC2 备份和 RDS 备份复制到单独的 Region。
options.C: 为 EC2 实例创建 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)。将 AMIs 复制到单独的 Region。在单独的 Region 中为 RDS DB 实例创建只读副本。
options.D: 创建 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快照。将 EBS 快照复制到单独的 Region。创建 RDS 快照。将 RDS 快照导出到 Amazon S3。配置 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 到单独的 Region。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** AWS Backup 正是为这种需求而设计的，并且运营开销最少。它可跨 AWS 服务提供集中式备份管理和基于策略的备份计划，并且可以按需或作为计划备份方案的一部分自动将备份复制到其他 AWS Regions（[AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。AWS Backup 支持 **由 EBS 卷支持的 Amazon EC2 实例** 和 **Amazon RDS DB 实例** 作为备份/还原资源类型（[supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。其功能可用性表还显示 Amazon EC2、Amazon EBS 和 Amazon RDS DB 实例支持 **Cross-Region backup**（[feature availability by resource](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 可自动化 **EBS 快照和 EBS 支持的 AMIs** 的生命周期管理，并被描述为针对 **EC2 实例和单个 EBS 卷** 的备份解决方案，而不是针对 RDS 数据库（[Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)）。因此，它无法集中处理 EC2 和 RDS 备份。
- **C:** 手动创建/复制 AMIs，并单独创建 RDS 只读副本，比使用单个 AWS Backup 备份计划增加更多运营开销。只读副本并不等同于同时适用于 EC2 和 RDS 的备份副本策略。
- **D:** 这使用了多个独立机制：EBS 快照、RDS 快照、导出到 S3，以及 S3 CRR。与使用 AWS Backup 针对这两类资源的集中式、基于策略的 Cross-Region 备份功能相比，这更加复杂。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to securely store a database user name and password that an application uses to access an Amazon RDS DB instance. The application that accesses the database runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The solutions architect wants to create a secure parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has read access to the Parameter Store parameter. Allow Decrypt access to an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter. Assign this IAM role to the EC2 instance.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that allows read access to the Parameter Store parameter. Allow Decrypt access to an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key that is used to encrypt the parameter. Assign this IAM policy to the EC2 instance.
options.C: Create an IAM trust relationship between the Parameter Store parameter and the EC2 instance. Specify Amazon RDS as a principal in the trust policy.
options.D: Create an IAM trust relationship between the DB instance and the EC2 instance. Specify Systems Manager as a principal in the trust policy.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The application runs on an EC2 instance, so the proper way to grant it AWS API permissions is to use an **IAM role attached to the EC2 instance**. AWS documentation explains that an administrator creates a role, attaches it to the EC2 instance, and the application obtains temporary credentials from instance metadata to access AWS resources according to the role’s permissions ([IAM roles for EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)).

For a Parameter Store `SecureString`, the role’s permissions policy must allow read access such as `ssm:GetParameter*`, and if the parameter is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key, the principal also needs `kms:Decrypt` to decrypt the value. AWS Systems Manager documentation states that decrypting a `SecureString` parameter requires `kms:Decrypt`, and shows an example policy allowing `ssm:GetParameter*` plus `kms:Decrypt` on the KMS key ([SecureString KMS permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/secure-string-parameter-kms-encryption.html)). Therefore, creating a role with Parameter Store read access and KMS decrypt access, then assigning it to the EC2 instance, meets the requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An IAM policy by itself cannot be “assigned to” an EC2 instance. The policy must be attached to an IAM principal, such as an IAM role, and the role is associated with the instance ([IAM roles for EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)).
- **C:** A trust relationship is between an IAM role and the service or principal that can assume it. Parameter Store parameters do not form IAM trust relationships with EC2 instances, and Amazon RDS is not the principal that needs Parameter Store access.
- **D:** Creating a trust relationship between the DB instance and EC2 instance does not grant the application permission to call `ssm:GetParameter*` or `kms:Decrypt`. Systems Manager documentation requires IAM permissions for Parameter Store access and KMS permissions for decryption, not an RDS-to-EC2 trust relationship ([Parameter Store access with KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/sysman-paramstore-access.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要安全地存储应用程序用于访问 Amazon RDS DB instance 的数据库用户名和密码。访问数据库的应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 instance 上。解决方案架构师希望在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中创建一个安全参数。解决方案架构师应如何满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个对 Parameter Store 参数具有读取访问权限的 IAM role。允许对用于加密该参数的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key 具有 Decrypt 访问权限。将此 IAM role 分配给 EC2 instance。
options.B: 创建一个 IAM policy，允许对 Parameter Store 参数进行读取访问。允许对用于加密该参数的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key 具有 Decrypt 访问权限。将此 IAM policy 分配给 EC2 instance。
options.C: 在 Parameter Store 参数和 EC2 instance 之间创建 IAM 信任关系。在信任策略中指定 Amazon RDS 作为主体。
options.D: 在 DB instance 和 EC2 instance 之间创建 IAM 信任关系。在信任策略中指定 Systems Manager 作为主体。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

应用程序运行在 EC2 instance 上，因此授予其 AWS API 权限的正确方式是使用**附加到 EC2 instance 的 IAM role**。AWS 文档说明，管理员创建一个 role，将其附加到 EC2 instance，应用程序从实例元数据获取临时凭证，并根据该 role 的权限访问 AWS 资源（[IAM roles for EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)）。对于 Parameter Store `SecureString`，该 role 的权限策略必须允许读取访问，例如 `ssm:GetParameter*`；如果该参数使用客户托管的 KMS key 加密，则主体还需要 `kms:Decrypt` 来解密该值。AWS Systems Manager 文档说明，解密 `SecureString` 参数需要 `kms:Decrypt`，并展示了一个示例策略，允许对 KMS key 执行 `ssm:GetParameter*` 以及 `kms:Decrypt`（[SecureString KMS permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/secure-string-parameter-kms-encryption.html)）。因此，创建一个具有 Parameter Store 读取访问权限和 KMS 解密访问权限的 role，然后将其分配给 EC2 instance，即可满足要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** IAM policy 本身不能被“分配给” EC2 instance。该 policy 必须附加到 IAM 主体，例如 IAM role，然后该 role 与实例关联（[IAM roles for EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_switch-role-ec2.html)）。
- **C:** 信任关系存在于 IAM role 与可代入该 role 的服务或主体之间。Parameter Store 参数不会与 EC2 instances 形成 IAM 信任关系，而且 Amazon RDS 也不是需要 Parameter Store 访问权限的主体。
- **D:** 在 DB instance 和 EC2 instance 之间创建信任关系，并不会授予应用程序调用 `ssm:GetParameter*` 或 `kms:Decrypt` 的权限。Systems Manager 文档要求使用 IAM 权限来访问 Parameter Store，并使用 KMS 权限进行解密，而不是 RDS 到 EC2 的信任关系（[Parameter Store access with KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/sysman-paramstore-access.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing a cloud communications platform that is driven by APIs. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The company uses Amazon API Gateway to provide external users with access to the application through APIs. The company wants to protect the platform against web exploits like SQL injection and also wants to detect and mitigate large, sophisticated DDoS attacks. Which combination of solutions provides the MOST protection? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS WAF to protect the NLB.
options.B: Use AWS Shield Advanced with the NLB.
options.C: Use AWS WAF to protect Amazon API Gateway.
options.D: Use Amazon GuardDuty with AWS Shield Standard
options.E: Use AWS Shield Standard with Amazon API Gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: B and C.**

- **B. Use AWS Shield Advanced with the NLB** — The requirement is to detect and mitigate **large, sophisticated DDoS attacks**. AWS documentation states that Shield Advanced provides expanded DDoS protection for Elastic Load Balancing load balancers, and specifically explains how to protect **Network Load Balancers** by protecting their Elastic IP addresses in Shield Advanced. During an attack, Shield Advanced can promote network ACL protections to the AWS border, where they can process multiple terabytes of traffic, providing protection beyond the VPC/instance capacity ([Shield Advanced for EC2 and NLBs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-ec2-nlb.html), [What is AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)).
- **C. Use AWS WAF to protect Amazon API Gateway** — The requirement is also to protect against web exploits such as **SQL injection**. AWS WAF supports protecting **Amazon API Gateway REST APIs** and AWS explicitly says you can use AWS WAF to protect API Gateway REST APIs from common web exploits, including SQL injection and XSS attacks ([API Gateway with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Use AWS WAF to protect the NLB** — AWS WAF supported regional resources include API Gateway REST API, Application Load Balancer, AppSync, Cognito user pool, App Runner, Verified Access, and Amplify; **Network Load Balancer is not listed** as an AWS WAF-protectable resource ([AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)).
- **D. Use Amazon GuardDuty with AWS Shield Standard** — GuardDuty is a threat detection service, but this option does not provide the requested web exploit filtering for SQL injection. Also, Shield Standard is not the “most protection” choice for large, sophisticated DDoS attacks when Shield Advanced is available.
- **E. Use AWS Shield Standard with Amazon API Gateway** — Shield Standard is automatically included, but Shield Advanced is the service AWS describes as providing expanded DDoS protection and advanced capabilities. This option also does not address SQL injection protection; AWS WAF on API Gateway does that ([What is AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html), [API Gateway with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一个由 API 驱动的云通信平台。该应用程序托管在 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 通过 API 为外部用户提供对应用程序的访问。公司希望保护该平台免受 SQL 注入等 Web 漏洞利用的影响，并且还希望检测和缓解大规模、复杂的 DDoS 攻击。哪种解决方案组合能提供最多保护？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS WAF 保护 NLB。
options.B: 将 AWS Shield Advanced 与 NLB 一起使用。
options.C: 使用 AWS WAF 保护 Amazon API Gateway。
options.D: 将 Amazon GuardDuty 与 AWS Shield Standard 一起使用
options.E: 将 AWS Shield Standard 与 Amazon API Gateway 一起使用。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B 和 C。**

- **B. 将 AWS Shield Advanced 与 NLB 一起使用** — 要求是检测和缓解**大规模、复杂的 DDoS 攻击**。AWS 文档指出，Shield Advanced 为 Elastic Load Balancing 负载均衡器提供扩展的 DDoS 防护，并且专门说明了如何通过在 Shield Advanced 中保护 **Network Load Balancers** 的 Elastic IP 地址来保护它们。在攻击期间，Shield Advanced 可以将 network ACL 防护提升到 AWS 边界，在那里它们可以处理数 TB 的流量，从而提供超出 VPC/实例容量的保护（[Shield Advanced for EC2 and NLBs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-ec2-nlb.html)，[What is AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。
- **C. 使用 AWS WAF 保护 Amazon API Gateway** — 要求还包括防护 **SQL injection** 等 Web 漏洞利用。AWS WAF 支持保护 **Amazon API Gateway REST APIs**，并且 AWS 明确表示你可以使用 AWS WAF 保护 API Gateway REST APIs 免受常见 Web 漏洞利用的影响，包括 SQL injection 和 XSS 攻击（[API Gateway with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 使用 AWS WAF 保护 NLB** — AWS WAF 支持的区域资源包括 API Gateway REST API、Application Load Balancer、AppSync、Cognito user pool、App Runner、Verified Access 和 Amplify；**Network Load Balancer 未列出**为可由 AWS WAF 保护的资源（[AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。
- **D. 将 Amazon GuardDuty 与 AWS Shield Standard 一起使用** — GuardDuty 是一项威胁检测服务，但此选项不提供所请求的针对 SQL injection 的 Web 漏洞利用过滤。此外，当 Shield Advanced 可用时，Shield Standard 并不是用于大规模、复杂 DDoS 攻击的“最多保护”选择。
- **E. 将 AWS Shield Standard 与 Amazon API Gateway 一起使用** — Shield Standard 会自动包含，但 AWS 描述 Shield Advanced 是提供扩展 DDoS 防护和高级功能的服务。此选项也没有解决 SQL injection 防护；在 API Gateway 上使用 AWS WAF 才能做到这一点（[What is AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)，[API Gateway with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)）。

en.question: A company has a legacy data processing application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Data is processed sequentially, but the order of results does not matter. The application uses a monolithic architecture. The only way that the company can scale the application to meet increased demand is to increase the size of the instances. The company’s developers have decided to rewrite the application to use a microservices architecture on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). What should a solutions architect recommend for communication between the microservices?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Add code to the data producers, and send data to the queue. Add code to the data consumers to process data from the queue.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Add code to the data producers, and publish notifications to the topic. Add code to the data consumers to subscribe to the topic.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to pass messages. Add code to the data producers to call the Lambda function with a data object. Add code to the data consumers to receive a data object that is passed from the Lambda function.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Enable DynamoDB Streams. Add code to the data producers to insert data into the table. Add code to the data consumers to use the DynamoDB Streams API to detect new table entries and retrieve the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon SQS is the best fit for communication between the rewritten microservices because it provides a hosted queue to **integrate and decouple distributed software systems and components**. AWS describes an SQS architecture with producers that send messages to a queue and consumers that receive and process those messages. SQS also scales transparently for load spikes and supports multiple producers and consumers processing messages concurrently, which matches the requirement to scale sequential work where result order does not matter ([Amazon SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Amazon SNS topic** — SNS is primarily a publish/subscribe service: publishers send messages to a topic, and the topic delivers messages to **multiple subscribers** across endpoints. AWS specifically describes fanout as replicating a published message to multiple endpoints for parallel processing. That is useful for one-to-many notification/fanout patterns, not the best simple work-queue pattern for distributing units of work among consumers ([Amazon SNS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **C. AWS Lambda function to pass messages** — Lambda can be invoked asynchronously, and Lambda itself queues events before sending them to the function. However, this option makes Lambda a custom message-passing intermediary rather than using the managed queue service designed for producer/consumer decoupling. AWS also notes that Lambda can send invocation records to downstream resources such as SQS or EventBridge to chain components, which reinforces that SQS is the appropriate decoupling queue service here ([AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async.html)).
- **D. DynamoDB table with DynamoDB Streams** — DynamoDB Streams captures **data modifications** in a DynamoDB table. Consumers must connect to a Streams endpoint, identify shards, and retrieve records with APIs such as `GetShardIterator` and `GetRecords`; records are retained for 24 hours. This is a change data capture mechanism, not the simplest managed queue for distributing processing tasks among microservice consumers ([Amazon DynamoDB Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的旧版数据处理应用程序。数据按顺序处理，但结果的顺序并不重要。该应用程序使用单体架构。公司扩展该应用程序以满足增长需求的唯一方法是增大实例的规格。公司的开发人员已决定重写该应用程序，以便在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上使用微服务架构。解决方案架构师应建议微服务之间使用什么方式进行通信？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。向数据生产者添加代码，并将数据发送到队列。向数据消费者添加代码，以处理队列中的数据。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。向数据生产者添加代码，并向该主题发布通知。向数据消费者添加代码，以订阅该主题。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来传递消息。向数据生产者添加代码，以使用数据对象调用 Lambda 函数。向数据消费者添加代码，以接收从 Lambda 函数传递的数据对象。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。启用 DynamoDB Streams。向数据生产者添加代码，以将数据插入表中。向数据消费者添加代码，以使用 DynamoDB Streams API 检测新的表条目并检索数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon SQS 最适合用于重写后的微服务之间的通信，因为它提供托管队列来**集成和解耦分布式软件系统及组件**。AWS 描述了一种 SQS 架构，其中生产者将消息发送到队列，消费者接收并处理这些消息。SQS 还可以针对负载峰值透明扩展，并支持多个生产者和消费者并发处理消息，这符合扩展顺序工作的要求，且结果顺序并不重要（[Amazon SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. Amazon SNS 主题** — SNS 主要是一种发布/订阅服务：发布者将消息发送到主题，主题将消息传递给跨端点的**多个订阅者**。AWS 明确将扇出描述为将已发布消息复制到多个端点以进行并行处理。这对于一对多通知/扇出模式很有用，但并不是在消费者之间分发工作单元的最佳简单工作队列模式（[Amazon SNS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **C. 用于传递消息的 AWS Lambda 函数** — Lambda 可以被异步调用，并且 Lambda 本身会在将事件发送到函数之前对事件进行排队。但是，此选项使 Lambda 成为自定义消息传递中介，而不是使用专为生产者/消费者解耦而设计的托管队列服务。AWS 还指出，Lambda 可以将调用记录发送到下游资源（例如 SQS 或 EventBridge）以串联组件，这进一步说明 SQS 是此处合适的解耦队列服务（[AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async.html)）。
- **D. 带有 DynamoDB Streams 的 DynamoDB 表** — DynamoDB Streams 捕获 DynamoDB 表中的**数据修改**。消费者必须连接到 Streams 端点，识别分片，并使用诸如 `GetShardIterator` 和 `GetRecords` 的 API 检索记录；记录保留 24 小时。这是一种变更数据捕获机制，而不是用于在微服务消费者之间分发处理任务的最简单托管队列（[Amazon DynamoDB Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its MySQL database from on premises to AWS. The company recently experienced a database outage that significantly impacted the business. To ensure this does not happen again, the company wants a reliable database solution on AWS that minimizes data loss and stores every transaction on at least two nodes. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance with synchronous replication to three nodes in three Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance with Multi-AZ functionality enabled to synchronously replicate the data.
options.C: Create an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance and then create a read replica in a separate AWS Region that synchronously replicates the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon EC2 instance with a MySQL engine installed that triggers an AWS Lambda function to synchronously replicate the data to an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon RDS for MySQL with **Multi-AZ** enabled is the managed high-availability design that meets the requirement. AWS states that in a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment, RDS automatically provisions and maintains a **synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone**, and that the primary DB instance is **synchronously replicated** to the standby to provide data redundancy and protection from DB instance or AZ disruption ([AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). This stores committed data on the primary and standby nodes and minimizes data loss.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** This describes synchronous replication to **three nodes in three AZs** for a DB instance. The standard RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment described by AWS uses a primary plus a **single synchronous standby** in another AZ, not three synchronous DB instance nodes ([AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).
- **C:** RDS read replicas, including cross-Region read replicas, are not synchronous. AWS states that RDS uses the **asynchronous replication** method to update a read replica, and read-replica data can be stale ([AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). Therefore, this does not meet the “minimizes data loss” and synchronous replication requirement.
- **D:** A self-managed MySQL database on EC2 with Lambda-based replication is a custom architecture, not the managed RDS high-availability feature. It does not provide the documented RDS synchronous standby behavior that Multi-AZ provides ([AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其 MySQL 数据库从本地迁移到 AWS。该公司最近经历了一次数据库中断，对业务造成了重大影响。为确保这种情况不再发生，公司希望在 AWS 上获得一个可靠的数据库解决方案，以最大限度地减少数据丢失，并将每笔事务存储在至少两个节点上。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon RDS DB instance，并在三个 Availability Zones 中同步复制到三个节点。
options.B: 创建一个启用了 Multi-AZ 功能的 Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance，以同步复制数据。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance，然后在单独的 AWS Region 中创建一个 read replica，以同步复制数据。
options.D: 创建一个安装了 MySQL 引擎的 Amazon EC2 instance，该实例触发 AWS Lambda 函数，以将数据同步复制到 Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

启用 **Multi-AZ** 的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是满足该要求的托管式高可用性设计。AWS 表示，在 Multi-AZ DB instance deployment 中，RDS 会在不同的 Availability Zone 中自动预置并维护一个**同步备用副本**，并且主 DB instance 会**同步复制**到备用副本，以提供数据冗余并防范 DB instance 或 AZ 中断（[AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。这会将已提交的数据存储在主节点和备用节点上，并最大限度减少数据丢失。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 这描述的是针对一个 DB instance，同步复制到**三个 AZs 中的三个节点**。AWS 描述的标准 RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment 使用一个主实例加另一个 AZ 中的**单个同步备用实例**，而不是三个同步 DB instance 节点（[AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。
- **C:** RDS read replicas（包括跨 Region read replicas）不是同步的。AWS 表示，RDS 使用**异步复制**方法来更新 read replica，并且 read-replica 数据可能是过期的（[AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。因此，这不满足“minimizes data loss”和同步复制要求。
- **D:** 在 EC2 上自管理 MySQL 数据库并使用基于 Lambda 的复制是一种自定义架构，而不是托管的 RDS 高可用性功能。它不提供 Multi-AZ 所提供的、有文档说明的 RDS 同步备用行为（[AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。

en.question: A company is building a new dynamic ordering website. The company wants to minimize server maintenance and patching. The website must be highly available and must scale read and write capacity as quickly as possible to meet changes in user demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Host static content in Amazon S3. Host dynamic content by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. Use Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity for the database. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver the website content.
options.B: Host static content in Amazon S3. Host dynamic content by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. Use Amazon Aurora with Aurora Auto Scaling for the database. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver the website content.
options.C: Host all the website content on Amazon EC2 instances. Create an Auto Scaling group to scale the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic. Use Amazon DynamoDB with provisioned write capacity for the database.
options.D: Host all the website content on Amazon EC2 instances. Create an Auto Scaling group to scale the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic. Use Amazon Aurora with Aurora Auto Scaling for the database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

This design uses managed/serverless services for the application tier and a database mode that scales both reads and writes quickly. AWS Lambda runs code on highly available compute infrastructure and manages server/OS maintenance, capacity provisioning, and automatic scaling, so it minimizes server maintenance and patching ([AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). DynamoDB on-demand capacity automatically adapts to application traffic and can instantly accommodate up to double the previous peak traffic; its capacity units cover both read and write requests ([DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html)). S3 for static content, API Gateway + Lambda for dynamic content, DynamoDB on-demand, and CloudFront together provide a highly available, scalable, low-operations web architecture.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Aurora Auto Scaling scales the number of Aurora Replicas, which are **reader DB instances**. AWS explicitly notes that Aurora Auto Scaling **doesn't apply to the workload on the writer DB instance** and helps only with reader instances ([Aurora Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)). This does not meet the requirement to scale **read and write** capacity as quickly as possible.
- **C:** EC2 instances require more server and OS maintenance/patching than a Lambda-based serverless approach. Also, DynamoDB **provisioned** capacity with auto scaling adjusts throughput after CloudWatch alarms and target tracking, and AWS notes that it modifies throughput only when workload stays elevated or depressed for several minutes ([DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)); on-demand is better for rapid unpredictable changes.
- **D:** EC2 again adds server maintenance/patching, and Aurora Auto Scaling does not scale the writer workload, so it does not satisfy rapid scaling of both reads and writes ([Aurora Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个新的动态订购网站。该公司希望尽量减少服务器维护和补丁管理。该网站必须具备高可用性，并且必须尽可能快速地扩展读取和写入容量，以满足用户需求的变化。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将静态内容托管在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 托管动态内容。数据库使用具有按需容量的 Amazon DynamoDB。配置 Amazon CloudFront 来交付网站内容。
options.B: 将静态内容托管在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 托管动态内容。数据库使用带有 Aurora Auto Scaling 的 Amazon Aurora。配置 Amazon CloudFront 来交付网站内容。
options.C: 将所有网站内容托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。创建一个 Auto Scaling 组来扩展 EC2 实例。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发流量。数据库使用具有预置写入容量的 Amazon DynamoDB。
options.D: 将所有网站内容托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。创建一个 Auto Scaling 组来扩展 EC2 实例。使用 Application Load Balancer 分发流量。数据库使用带有 Aurora Auto Scaling 的 Amazon Aurora。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

该设计在应用层使用托管/无服务器服务，并采用能够快速扩展读取和写入的数据库模式。AWS Lambda 在高度可用的计算基础设施上运行代码，并管理服务器/OS 维护、容量预置和自动扩展，因此可以尽量减少服务器维护和补丁管理（[AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。DynamoDB 按需容量会自动适应应用程序流量，并且可以立即容纳高达先前峰值流量两倍的流量；其容量单位同时涵盖读取和写入请求（[DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html)）。S3 用于静态内容，API Gateway + Lambda 用于动态内容，DynamoDB 按需模式以及 CloudFront 共同提供了一个高可用、可扩展、低运维的网站架构。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Aurora Auto Scaling 扩展的是 Aurora Replicas 的数量，而这些是 **reader DB instances**。AWS 明确指出，Aurora Auto Scaling **doesn't apply to the workload on the writer DB instance**，并且只帮助处理 reader instances 上的工作负载（[Aurora Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)）。这不满足尽可能快速扩展 **read and write** 容量的要求。
- **C:** 与基于 Lambda 的无服务器方法相比，EC2 实例需要更多服务器和 OS 维护/补丁管理。此外，DynamoDB **provisioned** 容量配合 auto scaling 会在 CloudWatch 警报和目标跟踪之后调整吞吐量，并且 AWS 指出，只有在工作负载持续升高或降低数分钟时，它才会修改吞吐量（[DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)）；对于快速且不可预测的变化，按需模式更合适。
- **D:** EC2 同样会增加服务器维护/补丁管理，并且 Aurora Auto Scaling 不会扩展 writer 工作负载，因此它不能满足读取和写入都快速扩展的要求（[Aurora Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)）。

en.question: A company has an AWS account used for software engineering. The AWS account has access to the company’s on-premises data center through a pair of AWS Direct Connect connections. All non-VPC traffic routes to the virtual private gateway. A development team recently created an AWS Lambda function through the console. The development team needs to allow the function to access a database that runs in a private subnet in the company’s data center. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the Lambda function to run in the VPC with the appropriate security group.
options.B: Set up a VPN connection from AWS to the data center. Route the traffic from the Lambda function through the VPN.
options.C: Update the route tables in the VPC to allow the Lambda function to access the on-premises data center through Direct Connect.
options.D: Create an Elastic IP address. Configure the Lambda function to send traffic through the Elastic IP address without an elastic network interface.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

A Lambda function created without VPC configuration runs outside the VPC networking context. To reach private resources through the company’s existing VPC connectivity, configure the function with VPC settings: AWS documents that you attach an existing Lambda function to a VPC by selecting the VPC and choosing the subnets and security groups for the network interface. The same Lambda documentation notes: “To access private resources, connect your function to private subnets” and explains that Lambda creates managed Hyperplane ENIs as the network interface between the function and the resources it needs to connect to. Therefore, placing the function in the VPC with appropriate subnets/security group lets it use the VPC’s existing routes to the virtual private gateway/Direct Connect path ([Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)). Direct Connect documentation confirms that a private virtual interface is used to access a VPC using private IP addresses ([Direct Connect VIF types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: A new VPN is unnecessary because the account already has Direct Connect connectivity to the on-premises data center. The requirement is to make the Lambda function participate in the VPC networking path, not to create another hybrid connection.
- **C**: Route tables may already be involved in the existing VPC-to-on-premises connectivity, but route-table changes alone do not attach a console-created Lambda function to the VPC. AWS requires VPC configuration with subnets and security groups for Lambda to access private resources ([Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).
- **D**: An Elastic IP address is not how Lambda privately reaches VPC or on-premises resources. AWS states that when Lambda is attached to a VPC it uses managed Hyperplane ENIs, and connecting to a public subnet does not give the function a public IP address ([Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个用于软件工程的 AWS 账户。该 AWS 账户通过一对 AWS Direct Connect 连接访问公司的本地数据中心。所有非 VPC 流量都会路由到虚拟私有网关。一个开发团队最近通过控制台创建了一个 AWS Lambda 函数。开发团队需要允许该函数访问在公司数据中心的私有子网中运行的数据库。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数配置为在 VPC 中运行，并使用适当的安全组。
options.B: 从 AWS 到数据中心建立 VPN 连接。通过 VPN 路由来自 Lambda 函数的流量。
options.C: 更新 VPC 中的路由表，以允许 Lambda 函数通过 Direct Connect 访问本地数据中心。
options.D: 创建一个 Elastic IP 地址。配置 Lambda 函数在没有弹性网络接口的情况下通过 Elastic IP 地址发送流量。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。未配置 VPC 的 Lambda 函数是在 VPC 网络上下文之外运行的。要通过公司现有的 VPC 连接访问私有资源，请为该函数配置 VPC 设置：AWS 文档说明，可以通过选择 VPC 并为网络接口选择子网和安全组，将现有 Lambda 函数附加到 VPC。同一 Lambda 文档还指出：“To access private resources, connect your function to private subnets”，并解释 Lambda 会创建托管的 Hyperplane ENI，作为函数与其需要连接的资源之间的网络接口。因此，将该函数放入具有适当子网/安全组的 VPC 中，可以让它使用 VPC 到虚拟私有网关/Direct Connect 路径的现有路由（[Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。Direct Connect 文档确认，私有虚拟接口用于使用私有 IP 地址访问 VPC（[Direct Connect VIF types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：不需要新的 VPN，因为该账户已经与本地数据中心建立了 Direct Connect 连接。要求是让 Lambda 函数参与 VPC 网络路径，而不是创建另一个混合连接。
- **C**：路由表可能已经参与了现有的 VPC 到本地连接，但仅更改路由表并不会将通过控制台创建的 Lambda 函数附加到 VPC。AWS 要求为 Lambda 配置包含子网和安全组的 VPC，才能访问私有资源（[Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。
- **D**：Elastic IP 地址不是 Lambda 私有访问 VPC 或本地资源的方式。AWS 声明，当 Lambda 附加到 VPC 时，它使用托管的 Hyperplane ENI，并且连接到公有子网不会给该函数分配公有 IP 地址（[Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an application using Amazon ECS. The application creates resized versions of an original image and then makes Amazon S3 API calls to store the resized images in Amazon S3. How can a solutions architect ensure that the application has permission to access Amazon S3?

options.A: Update the S3 role in AWS IAM to allow read/write access from Amazon ECS, and then relaunch the container.
options.B: Create an IAM role with S3 permissions, and then specify that role as the taskRoleArn in the task definition.
options.C: Create a security group that allows access from Amazon ECS to Amazon S3, and update the launch configuration used by the ECS cluster.
options.D: Create an IAM user with S3 permissions, and then relaunch the Amazon EC2 instances for the ECS cluster while logged in as this account.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon ECS supports a **task IAM role** for application permissions. AWS states that permissions in the IAM role are vended to containers in the task, allowing application code in the container to use other AWS services, and that the task role is required when the application accesses services such as Amazon S3 ([Amazon ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)). The task definition parameter is `taskRoleArn`; AWS says this is the IAM role that allows containers in the task permission to call AWS APIs specified in the role's policies ([Task definition parameters - Task role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definition_parameters.html)). Therefore, create an IAM role with the needed S3 permissions and specify it as `taskRoleArn` in the task definition.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** There is no generic “S3 role” to update for ECS access. The role must be associated with the ECS task so the container receives those credentials. AWS specifically identifies the **task role** as the role for application code in containers to access S3 ([IAM roles for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ecs-iam-role-overview.html)).
- **C:** Security groups control network traffic; they do not grant IAM authorization to call S3 APIs. The required permission is IAM-based through the ECS task role, not a security group.
- **D:** Creating an IAM user and logging in when relaunching EC2 instances does not grant permissions to the running ECS task. AWS notes that task roles let you specify IAM permissions for containers without putting those permissions on EC2 instance profiles, and SDKs in the containers use task-role credentials rather than inheriting permissions from the EC2 instance ([Amazon ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon ECS 运行一个应用程序。该应用程序会创建原始图像的调整大小版本，然后调用 Amazon S3 API 将调整大小后的图像存储在 Amazon S3 中。解决方案架构师如何确保该应用程序具有访问 Amazon S3 的权限？

options.A: 更新 AWS IAM 中的 S3 角色，以允许来自 Amazon ECS 的读/写访问，然后重新启动容器。
options.B: 创建一个具有 S3 权限的 IAM 角色，然后在任务定义中将该角色指定为 taskRoleArn。
options.C: 创建一个允许从 Amazon ECS 访问 Amazon S3 的安全组，并更新 ECS 集群使用的启动配置。
options.D: 创建一个具有 S3 权限的 IAM 用户，然后在以该账户登录的情况下重新启动 ECS 集群的 Amazon EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon ECS 支持用于应用程序权限的 **task IAM role**。AWS 表示，IAM 角色中的权限会提供给任务中的容器，使容器中的应用程序代码能够使用其他 AWS 服务；并且当应用程序访问 Amazon S3 等服务时，需要使用任务角色（[Amazon ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)）。任务定义参数是 `taskRoleArn`；AWS 表示，这是允许任务中的容器调用该角色策略中指定的 AWS API 的 IAM 角色（[Task definition parameters - Task role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definition_parameters.html)）。因此，应创建一个具有所需 S3 权限的 IAM 角色，并在任务定义中将其指定为 `taskRoleArn`。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 不存在可为 ECS 访问而更新的通用“S3 role”。该角色必须与 ECS 任务关联，以便容器接收这些凭证。AWS 明确指出，**task role** 是供容器中的应用程序代码访问 S3 的角色（[IAM roles for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ecs-iam-role-overview.html)）。
- **C:** 安全组控制网络流量；它们不会授予调用 S3 API 的 IAM 授权。所需权限是通过 ECS 任务角色实现的基于 IAM 的权限，而不是安全组。
- **D:** 创建 IAM 用户并在重新启动 EC2 实例时登录，并不会向正在运行的 ECS 任务授予权限。AWS 指出，任务角色允许您为容器指定 IAM 权限，而无需将这些权限放在 EC2 实例配置文件上；容器中的 SDK 使用任务角色凭证，而不是继承 EC2 实例的权限（[Amazon ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)）。

en.question: A company has a Windows-based application that must be migrated to AWS. The application requires the use of a shared Windows file system attached to multiple Amazon EC2 Windows instances that are deployed across multiple Availability Zone: What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure AWS Storage Gateway in volume gateway mode. Mount the volume to each Windows instance.
options.B: Configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the Amazon FSx file system to each Windows instance.
options.C: Configure a file system by using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS file system to each Windows instance.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume with the required size. Attach each EC2 instance to the volume. Mount the file system within the volume to each Windows instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.**

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is purpose-built for this requirement: it provides **fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers** backed by a native Windows file system, supports Windows file system features, and uses the **SMB protocol** for network file access. AWS also states that Windows file shares in FSx are accessible to compute instances with SMB and can be mapped on Amazon EC2 instances. For availability across Availability Zones, FSx for Windows File Server supports **Multi-AZ file systems** that provide high availability and failover support across multiple AZs by maintaining a standby file server in a separate AZ ([AWS FSx for Windows File Server documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Storage Gateway in volume gateway mode** is not the best fit because Volume Gateway provides **volume-based** cloud-backed storage that is mounted as **iSCSI devices**, not a managed shared Windows SMB file system for multiple EC2 Windows instances ([AWS Storage Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **C. Amazon EFS** is not appropriate for a Windows-based shared file system requirement. EFS documentation describes mounting EFS on **EC2 Linux and Mac instances** using the EFS mount helper, or manually using the **Linux NFS client** with NFSv4 protocols ([Amazon EFS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)).
- **D. Amazon EBS volume attached to each instance** is not appropriate for a shared file system across multiple AZs. EBS Multi-Attach volumes can be attached only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, and AWS cautions that standard file systems are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers without a clustered file system ([Amazon EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个基于 Windows 的应用程序，必须迁移到 AWS。该应用程序需要使用一个共享的 Windows 文件系统，并将其挂载到多个部署在多个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon EC2 Windows 实例。解决方案架构师应如何满足此要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS Storage Gateway 为卷网关模式。将该卷挂载到每个 Windows 实例。
options.B: 配置 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。将 Amazon FSx 文件系统挂载到每个 Windows 实例。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 配置文件系统。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到每个 Windows 实例。
options.D: 配置具有所需大小的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。将每个 EC2 实例附加到该卷。将该卷内的文件系统挂载到每个 Windows 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.**

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 专为此要求而构建：它提供由原生 Windows 文件系统支持的**完全托管的 Microsoft Windows file servers**，支持 Windows 文件系统功能，并使用 **SMB protocol** 进行网络文件访问。AWS 还说明，FSx 中的 Windows 文件共享可供具有 SMB 的计算实例访问，并且可以映射到 Amazon EC2 实例上。对于跨 Availability Zones 的可用性，FSx for Windows File Server 支持 **Multi-AZ file systems**，通过在单独的 AZ 中维护备用文件服务器，在多个 AZ 之间提供高可用性和故障转移支持（[AWS FSx for Windows File Server documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Storage Gateway in volume gateway mode** 不是最佳选择，因为 Volume Gateway 提供的是基于**卷**的云后端存储，并作为 **iSCSI devices** 挂载，而不是为多个 EC2 Windows 实例提供的托管共享 Windows SMB 文件系统（[AWS Storage Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **C. Amazon EFS** 不适合 Windows 基于共享文件系统的要求。EFS 文档描述了使用 EFS mount helper 将 EFS 挂载到 **EC2 Linux and Mac instances**，或使用带 NFSv4 协议的 **Linux NFS client** 手动挂载（[Amazon EFS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。
- **D. Amazon EBS volume attached to each instance** 不适合跨多个 AZ 的共享文件系统。EBS Multi-Attach volumes 只能附加到**同一 Availability Zone** 中的实例，并且 AWS 提醒，如果没有集群文件系统，标准文件系统并非设计用于由多个服务器同时访问（[Amazon EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing an ecommerce application that will consist of a load-balanced front end, a container-based application, and a relational database. A solutions architect needs to create a highly available solution that operates with as little manual intervention as possible. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance in Multi-AZ mode.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS DB instance and one or more replicas in another Availability Zone.
options.C: Create an Amazon EC2 instance-based Docker cluster to handle the dynamic application load.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with a Fargate launch type to handle the dynamic application load.
options.E: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an Amazon EC2 launch type to handle the dynamic application load.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and D**.

- **A. Create an Amazon RDS DB instance in Multi-AZ mode** — Correct. An RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment is designed for high availability: Amazon RDS “automatically provisions and maintains a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone,” which helps protect against DB instance failure and Availability Zone disruption ([AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). This minimizes manual intervention for the relational database tier.
- **D. Create an Amazon ECS cluster with a Fargate launch type** — Correct. AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS runs containers “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances,” and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). This fits the container-based application requirement with little operational management.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. RDS DB instance with replicas in another AZ** — Read replicas are primarily for read scaling and disaster recovery, not automatic high availability failover for the primary database. RDS read replicas use asynchronous replication and you must manually create them; RDS also does not autoscale read replicas ([RDS read replicas overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). Promoting a read replica requires an explicit promotion operation and includes stopping replication and rebooting the replica ([Promoting a read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.Promote.html)).
- **C. EC2 instance-based Docker cluster** — This would require the company to manage EC2 instances and Docker cluster capacity itself, which conflicts with “as little manual intervention as possible.”
- **E. ECS with EC2 launch type** — ECS on EC2 still uses EC2 capacity that the customer manages. AWS documentation describes EC2 capacity providers as running on “self-managed EC2 instances,” whereas Fargate is serverless compute ([ECS launch types and capacity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-launch-type-comparison.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个电子商务应用程序，该应用程序将包含一个负载均衡的前端、一个基于容器的应用程序以及一个关系数据库。解决方案架构师需要创建一个高可用的解决方案，并且尽可能少地进行人工干预。哪些解决方案满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 以 Multi-AZ 模式创建一个 Amazon RDS DB instance。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon RDS DB instance，并在另一个 Availability Zone 中创建一个或多个副本。
options.C: 创建一个基于 Amazon EC2 instance 的 Docker 集群来处理动态应用程序负载。
options.D: 创建一个采用 Fargate launch type 的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群来处理动态应用程序负载。
options.E: 创建一个采用 Amazon EC2 launch type 的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群来处理动态应用程序负载。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A and D**。

- **A. Create an Amazon RDS DB instance in Multi-AZ mode** — 正确。RDS Multi-AZ DB instance 部署专为高可用性而设计：Amazon RDS “automatically provisions and maintains a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone,” 这有助于防范 DB instance 故障和 Availability Zone 中断（[AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。这最大限度减少了关系数据库层的人工干预。
- **D. Create an Amazon ECS cluster with a Fargate launch type** — 正确。AWS Fargate 与 Amazon ECS 结合使用时，可以 “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances,” 运行容器，并且无需预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。这符合基于容器的应用程序要求，同时运营管理工作很少。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. RDS DB instance with replicas in another AZ** — Read replicas 主要用于读取扩展和灾难恢复，而不是为主数据库提供自动高可用故障转移。RDS read replicas 使用异步复制，并且你必须手动创建它们；RDS 也不会自动扩展 read replicas（[RDS read replicas overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。提升 read replica 需要显式执行提升操作，并包括停止复制和重新启动副本（[Promoting a read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.Promote.html)）。
- **C. EC2 instance-based Docker cluster** — 这将要求公司自行管理 EC2 instances 和 Docker 集群容量，这与“尽可能少地进行人工干预”相冲突。
- **E. ECS with EC2 launch type** — ECS on EC2 仍然使用由客户管理的 EC2 容量。AWS 文档将 EC2 capacity providers 描述为运行在 “self-managed EC2 instances” 上，而 Fargate 是 serverless compute（[ECS launch types and capacity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-launch-type-comparison.html)）。

en.question: A company uses Amazon S3 as its data lake. The company has a new partner that must use SFTP to upload data files. A solutions architect needs to implement a highly available SFTP solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Transfer Family to configure an SFTP-enabled server with a publicly accessible endpoint. Choose the S3 data lake as the destination.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway as an SFTP server. Expose the S3 File Gateway endpoint URL to the new partner. Share the S3 File Gateway endpoint with the new partner.
options.C: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet in a VPInstruct the new partner to upload files to the EC2 instance by using a VPN. Run a cron job script, on the EC2 instance to upload files to the S3 data lake.
options.D: Launch Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet in a VPC. Place a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in front of the EC2 instances. Create an SFTP listener port for the NLB. Share the NLB hostname with the new partner. Run a cron job script on the EC2 instances to upload files to the S3 data lake.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

AWS Transfer Family is designed for this use case: it is a **fully managed** service for transferring files into and out of **Amazon S3** over protocols including **SFTP**. AWS documentation also states that Transfer Family supports up to **3 Availability Zones** and is backed by an **auto scaling, redundant fleet**, which addresses high availability and minimizes operational overhead compared with self-managed SFTP servers ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). The getting-started documentation specifically shows creating an **SFTP-enabled server**, selecting a **publicly accessible** endpoint, and choosing **Amazon S3** as the domain; uploaded files can be transferred directly into an S3 bucket ([Getting started with Transfer Family server endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/getting-started.html)). The endpoint matrix also confirms that the **Public** endpoint type supports **SFTP** and is accessible over the internet ([Transfer Family endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B** is incorrect because Amazon S3 File Gateway is not an SFTP server. It provides file access to S3 using **NFS** and **SMB** protocols, not SFTP ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **C** is incorrect because running SFTP on a single EC2 instance plus a VPN and cron job is self-managed, not highly available, and creates operational overhead for patching, scaling, monitoring, and failure recovery.
- **D** is incorrect because although an NLB can improve availability in front of EC2 instances, the company would still need to manage EC2-based SFTP servers and cron jobs. This is more operationally intensive than the managed, redundant Transfer Family service.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 作为其数据湖。该公司有一个新的合作伙伴必须使用 SFTP 上传数据文件。解决方案架构师需要实施一个高可用的 SFTP 解决方案，并最大限度地减少运维开销。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Transfer Family 配置一个启用 SFTP 的服务器，并使用可公开访问的端点。选择 S3 数据湖作为目标位置。
options.B: 使用 Amazon S3 File Gateway 作为 SFTP 服务器。将 S3 File Gateway 端点 URL 暴露给新的合作伙伴。与新的合作伙伴共享 S3 File Gateway 端点。
options.C: 在私有子网中的 VPInstruct 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例，让新的合作伙伴使用 VPN 将文件上传到该 EC2 实例。在该 EC2 实例上运行 cron job 脚本，将文件上传到 S3 数据湖。
options.D: 在 VPC 的私有子网中启动 Amazon EC2 实例。在 EC2 实例前面放置一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。为 NLB 创建一个 SFTP 侦听器端口。与新的合作伙伴共享 NLB 主机名。在 EC2 实例上运行 cron job 脚本，将文件上传到 S3 数据湖。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

AWS Transfer Family 专为此使用场景而设计：它是一项**完全托管**的服务，用于通过包括 **SFTP** 在内的协议将文件传入和传出 **Amazon S3**。AWS 文档还说明，Transfer Family 最多支持 **3 Availability Zones**，并由**自动扩展的冗余队列**提供支持；与自管理的 SFTP 服务器相比，这解决了高可用性问题并最大限度地减少了运维开销（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。入门文档专门展示了如何创建**启用 SFTP 的服务器**、选择**可公开访问**的端点，并选择 **Amazon S3** 作为域；上传的文件可以直接传输到 S3 存储桶中（[Getting started with Transfer Family server endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/getting-started.html)）。端点矩阵还确认，**Public** 端点类型支持 **SFTP**，并且可通过互联网访问（[Transfer Family endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **B** 不正确，因为 Amazon S3 File Gateway 不是 SFTP 服务器。它使用 **NFS** 和 **SMB** 协议提供对 S3 的文件访问，而不是 SFTP（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **C** 不正确，因为在单个 EC2 实例上运行 SFTP，再加上 VPN 和 cron job，属于自管理方式，不具备高可用性，并且会产生补丁、扩展、监控和故障恢复方面的运维开销。
- **D** 不正确，因为虽然 NLB 可以提高 EC2 实例前端的可用性，但公司仍然需要管理基于 EC2 的 SFTP 服务器和 cron jobs。与托管的冗余 Transfer Family 服务相比，这种方式的运维强度更高。

en.question: A company needs to store contract documents. A contract lasts for 5 years. During the 5-year period, the company must ensure that the documents cannot be overwritten or deleted. The company needs to encrypt the documents at rest and rotate the encryption keys automatically every year. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the documents in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode.
options.B: Store the documents in Amazon S3. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode.
options.C: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Configure key rotation.
options.D: Use server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. Configure key rotation.
options.E: Use server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer provided (imported) keys. Configure key rotation.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **B and D**.

- **B is correct**: Store the contracts in Amazon S3 and use **S3 Object Lock in compliance mode** with a 5-year retention period. AWS states that, in compliance mode, a protected object version cannot be overwritten or deleted by any user, including the AWS account root user, and the retention period cannot be shortened. This matches the requirement that documents cannot be overwritten or deleted during the 5-year contract period. [AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)
- **D is correct**: Use **SSE-KMS with an AWS KMS customer managed key** and enable automatic key rotation. S3 supports SSE-KMS for encrypting S3 objects, and AWS KMS can centrally create, rotate, and manage KMS keys used with S3. AWS KMS documentation states that when automatic key rotation is enabled, KMS generates new cryptographic material every year by default, with no need to change applications or aliases. [AWS S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html), [AWS KMS automatic rotation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect**: Governance mode does not provide the strongest immutability. Users with special permissions can bypass governance-mode retention and delete or alter protected objects. The requirement says the documents must not be overwritten or deleted, so compliance mode is the better fit. [AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)
- **C is incorrect**: SSE-S3 encrypts S3 objects by default, but the question requires the company to rotate encryption keys automatically every year. AWS documentation says that if you need more control over keys, such as managing key rotation, you should use SSE-KMS rather than SSE-S3. [AWS S3 bucket encryption documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)
- **E is incorrect**: KMS keys with imported key material cannot be automatically rotated; AWS says they can only be rotated manually.
