That does not meet the automatic yearly rotation requirement and would add operational overhead. [AWS KMS automatic rotation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)

zh.question: 一家公司需要存储合同文档。一份合同持续 5 年。在这 5 年期间，公司必须确保这些文档不能被覆盖或删除。公司需要对静态文档进行加密，并且每年自动轮换加密密钥。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤组合，以在运营开销最少的情况下满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将文档存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用治理模式下的 S3 Object Lock。
options.B: 将文档存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用合规模式下的 S3 Object Lock。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥 (SSE-S3) 进行服务器端加密。配置密钥轮换。
options.D: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥进行服务器端加密。配置密钥轮换。
options.E: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户提供（导入）的密钥进行服务器端加密。配置密钥轮换。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B 和 D**。

- **B 正确**：将合同存储在 Amazon S3 中，并使用带有 5 年保留期的**合规模式下的 S3 Object Lock**。AWS 表示，在合规模式下，受保护的对象版本不能被任何用户覆盖或删除，包括 AWS 账户 root 用户，并且保留期不能缩短。这符合文档在 5 年合同期内不能被覆盖或删除的要求。[AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)
- **D 正确**：使用**带有 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥的 SSE-KMS**，并启用自动密钥轮换。S3 支持使用 SSE-KMS 加密 S3 对象，AWS KMS 可以集中创建、轮换和管理与 S3 一起使用的 KMS keys。AWS KMS 文档说明，启用自动密钥轮换后，KMS 默认每年生成新的加密材料，而无需更改应用程序或别名。[AWS S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html), [AWS KMS automatic rotation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)

其他选项为什么不正确：

- **A 不正确**：治理模式不提供最强的不可变性。拥有特殊权限的用户可以绕过治理模式保留并删除或更改受保护对象。要求说明文档不得被覆盖或删除，因此合规模式更合适。[AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)
- **C 不正确**：SSE-S3 默认加密 S3 对象，但题目要求公司每年自动轮换加密密钥。AWS 文档说明，如果你需要对密钥有更多控制，例如管理密钥轮换，则应使用 SSE-KMS 而不是 SSE-S3。[AWS S3 bucket encryption documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)
- **E 不正确**：带有导入密钥材料的 KMS keys 不能自动轮换；AWS 表示它们只能手动轮换。这不满足每年自动轮换的要求，并且会增加运营开销。[AWS KMS automatic rotation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)

en.question: A company has a web application that is based on Java and PHP. The company plans to move the application from on premises to AWS. The company needs the ability to test new site features frequently. The company also needs a highly available and managed solution that requires minimum operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable static web hosting on the S3 bucket. Upload the static content to the S3 bucket. Use AWS Lambda to process all dynamic content.
options.B: Deploy the web application to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk environment. Use URL swapping to switch between multiple Elastic Beanstalk environments for feature testing.
options.C: Deploy the web application to Amazon EC2 instances that are configured with Java and PHP. Use Auto Scaling groups and an Application Load Balancer to manage the website’s availability.
options.D: Containerize the web application. Deploy the web application to Amazon EC2 instances. Use the AWS Load Balancer Controller to dynamically route traffic between containers that contain the new site features for testing.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Elastic Beanstalk is the best fit because it is a managed web-application platform that supports both **Java** and **PHP** applications. AWS states that Elastic Beanstalk deploys web applications, provisions EC2 instances, configures load balancing, sets up health monitoring, and dynamically scales the environment, reducing operational overhead ([Elastic Beanstalk overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)). For frequent feature testing, Elastic Beanstalk blue/green deployment guidance says to deploy the new version to a separate environment, test it there, and then use **Swap environment URLs**; Elastic Beanstalk swaps the CNAME records and redirects traffic to the new version ([Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Amazon S3 static website hosting is for static websites whose pages contain static content and possibly client-side scripts, not for directly hosting a Java/PHP dynamic web application ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). Rebuilding all dynamic Java/PHP behavior with Lambda would not be the simplest managed migration path.
- **C:** EC2 instances with Auto Scaling and an Application Load Balancer can provide availability, but the company would manage more of the platform, patching, deployment process, and runtime configuration. Elastic Beanstalk provides these underlying resources and management functions automatically ([Elastic Beanstalk overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).
- **D:** Containerizing the application and managing containers on EC2 adds migration and operational complexity. The question asks for minimum operational overhead; Elastic Beanstalk natively supports Java/PHP and provides environment URL swapping for testing without requiring a custom container-based routing solution ([Elastic Beanstalk overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html), [Blue/Green deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个基于 Java 和 PHP 的 Web 应用程序。该公司计划将该应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。公司需要能够频繁测试新的站点功能。公司还需要一个高度可用且托管的解决方案，并且要求最低的运营开销。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。在该 S3 存储桶上启用静态网站托管。将静态内容上传到该 S3 存储桶。使用 AWS Lambda 处理所有动态内容。
options.B: 将 Web 应用程序部署到 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 环境。使用 URL swapping 在多个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境之间切换，以进行功能测试。
options.C: 将 Web 应用程序部署到配置了 Java 和 PHP 的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Auto Scaling groups 和 Application Load Balancer 来管理网站的可用性。
options.D: 将 Web 应用程序容器化。将 Web 应用程序部署到 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 AWS Load Balancer Controller 在包含新站点功能的容器之间动态路由流量以进行测试。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Elastic Beanstalk 是最合适的选择，因为它是一个托管的 Web 应用程序平台，支持 **Java** 和 **PHP** 应用程序。AWS 表示，Elastic Beanstalk 会部署 Web 应用程序、预置 EC2 实例、配置负载均衡、设置运行状况监控，并动态扩展环境，从而降低运营开销（[Elastic Beanstalk overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。对于频繁的功能测试，Elastic Beanstalk 蓝/绿部署指南说明，应将新版本部署到单独的环境，在那里进行测试，然后使用 **Swap environment URLs**；Elastic Beanstalk 会交换 CNAME 记录，并将流量重定向到新版本（[Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** Amazon S3 静态网站托管适用于页面包含静态内容并可能包含客户端脚本的静态网站，而不是直接托管 Java/PHP 动态 Web 应用程序（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。使用 Lambda 重建所有动态 Java/PHP 行为并不是最简单的托管迁移路径。
- **C:** 配合 Auto Scaling 和 Application Load Balancer 的 EC2 实例可以提供可用性，但公司需要管理更多平台、补丁、部署流程和运行时配置。Elastic Beanstalk 会自动提供这些底层资源和管理功能（[Elastic Beanstalk overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。
- **D:** 将应用程序容器化并在 EC2 上管理容器会增加迁移和运营复杂性。题目要求最低运营开销；Elastic Beanstalk 原生支持 Java/PHP，并提供用于测试的环境 URL swapping，而不需要自定义的基于容器的路由解决方案（[Elastic Beanstalk overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html), [Blue/Green deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)）。

en.question: A company has an ordering application that stores customer information in Amazon RDS for MySQL. During regular business hours, employees run one-time queries for reporting purposes. Timeouts are occurring during order processing because the reporting queries are taking a long time to run. The company needs to eliminate the timeouts without preventing employees from performing queries. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a read replica. Move reporting queries to the read replica.
options.B: Create a read replica. Distribute the ordering application to the primary DB instance and the read replica.
options.C: Migrate the ordering application to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity.
options.D: Schedule the reporting queries for non-peak hours.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Create a read replica. Move reporting queries to the read replica.**

Amazon RDS read replicas are intended to scale read-heavy workloads by directing excess read traffic to one or more replicas. AWS specifically lists **business reporting or data warehousing scenarios** as a use case where reporting queries should run against a read replica instead of the production DB instance. Read replicas are read-only DB instances, and applications can connect to them like any other DB instance, so employees can continue running reports while the primary RDS for MySQL instance remains focused on order processing ([AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Create a read replica. Distribute the ordering application to the primary DB instance and the read replica.** Incorrect. A read replica allows only read-only connections, so it cannot handle the ordering application's write operations. The better pattern is to keep transactional order processing on the primary DB instance and move read-only reporting traffic to the replica ([AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).
- **C. Migrate the ordering application to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity.** Incorrect. This is an unnecessary database migration and does not directly solve the stated problem of long-running reporting queries affecting the existing RDS for MySQL production workload.
- **D. Schedule the reporting queries for non-peak hours.** Incorrect. The requirement says employees must not be prevented from performing queries during regular business hours. Scheduling reports outside peak hours would restrict when employees can run them rather than isolating the workload.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个订购应用程序，将客户信息存储在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 中。在正常工作时间，员工会运行一次性查询用于报告目的。由于报告查询运行时间很长，订单处理期间发生超时。公司需要在不阻止员工执行查询的情况下消除超时。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个只读副本。将报告查询移至该只读副本。
options.B: 创建一个只读副本。将订购应用程序分布到主 DB 实例和只读副本上。
options.C: 将订购应用程序迁移到具有按需容量的 Amazon DynamoDB。
options.D: 将报告查询安排在非高峰时段运行。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Create a read replica. Move reporting queries to the read replica.**

Amazon RDS 只读副本旨在通过将多余的读取流量定向到一个或多个副本来扩展读取密集型工作负载。AWS 明确将 **业务报告或数据仓库场景** 列为一个使用案例，在该场景中，报告查询应针对只读副本运行，而不是针对生产 DB 实例运行。只读副本是只读 DB 实例，应用程序可以像连接任何其他 DB 实例一样连接到它们，因此员工可以继续运行报告，同时主 RDS for MySQL 实例仍专注于订单处理（[AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Create a read replica. Distribute the ordering application to the primary DB instance and the read replica.** 不正确。只读副本仅允许只读连接，因此无法处理订购应用程序的写入操作。更好的模式是将事务性订单处理保留在主 DB 实例上，并将只读报告流量移至副本（[AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。
- **C. Migrate the ordering application to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand capacity.** 不正确。这是不必要的数据库迁移，并且不能直接解决长时间运行的报告查询影响现有 RDS for MySQL 生产工作负载这一既定问题。
- **D. Schedule the reporting queries for non-peak hours.** 不正确。要求说明不得阻止员工在正常工作时间执行查询。将报告安排在高峰时段之外运行会限制员工运行报告的时间，而不是隔离工作负载。

en.question: A hospital wants to create digital copies for its large collection of historical written records. The hospital will continue to add hundreds of new documents each day. The hospital’s data team will scan the documents and will upload the documents to the AWS Cloud. A solutions architect must implement a solution to analyze the documents, extract the medical information, and store the documents so that an application can run SQL queries on the data. The solution must maximize scalability and operational efficiency. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Write the document information to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs a MySQL database.
options.B: Write the document information to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to run a custom application that processes the scanned files and extracts the medical information.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new documents are uploaded. Use Amazon Rekognition to convert the documents to raw text. Use Amazon Transcribe Medical to detect and extract relevant medical information from the text.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new documents are uploaded. Use Amazon Textract to convert the documents to raw text. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to detect and extract relevant medical information from the text.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and E**.

- **B is correct** because the extracted document information can be stored in **Amazon S3** and queried with **Amazon Athena**. AWS states that Athena tables describe “the location where the table data are located in Amazon S3 for read-time querying,” and Athena uses the schema to read the data “when you query the table using SQL” ([Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)). This provides scalable storage and avoids operating a database server.
- **E is correct** because this is a serverless, managed document-processing workflow. S3 can invoke a Lambda function when an object is created ([Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)). Amazon Textract is designed to detect typed and handwritten text in documents, including “medical records,” and can analyze image and PDF files at scale ([What is Amazon Textract?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)). Amazon Comprehend Medical then detects useful information in unstructured clinical text, including medical conditions, medications, and PHI ([What is Amazon Comprehend Medical?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend-medical/latest/dev/comprehendmedical-welcome.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **A** is wrong because running MySQL on an EC2 instance adds server and database administration and is less scalable/operationally efficient than S3 plus Athena for SQL-on-S3 analytics.
- **C** is wrong because an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances running a custom extraction application adds operational overhead. Managed services such as Lambda, Textract, and Comprehend Medical meet the requirement more efficiently.
- **D** is wrong because Amazon Transcribe is for transcribing **audio**; AWS describes Transcribe streaming as producing real-time transcriptions for “media content” and “speech-to-text” applications ([Transcribing streaming audio](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html)). The source data here is scanned written documents, for which Textract and Comprehend Medical are the appropriate services.

zh.question: 一家医院希望为其大量历史手写记录创建数字副本。医院每天还会继续新增数百份新文档。医院的数据团队将扫描这些文档，并将文档上传到 AWS Cloud。解决方案架构师必须实施一个解决方案来分析文档、提取医疗信息，并存储文档，以便应用程序可以对数据运行 SQL 查询。该解决方案必须最大限度提高可扩展性和运营效率。解决方案架构师应采取哪两个步骤的组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将文档信息写入运行 MySQL 数据库的 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.B: 将文档信息写入 Amazon S3 bucket。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组，用于运行自定义应用程序来处理扫描文件并提取医疗信息。
options.D: 创建一个在上传新文档时运行的 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon Rekognition 将文档转换为原始文本。使用 Amazon Transcribe Medical 从文本中检测并提取相关医疗信息。
options.E: 创建一个在上传新文档时运行的 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon Textract 将文档转换为原始文本。使用 Amazon Comprehend Medical 从文本中检测并提取相关医疗信息。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 E**。

- **B 正确**，因为提取出的文档信息可以存储在 **Amazon S3** 中，并使用 **Amazon Athena** 查询。AWS 说明 Athena 表描述“表数据在 Amazon S3 中的位置，以便进行读取时查询”，并且 Athena 使用 schema 在“使用 SQL 查询表时”读取数据（[Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)）。这提供了可扩展的存储，并避免了运行数据库服务器。
- **E 正确**，因为这是一个无服务器的托管文档处理工作流。当对象被创建时，S3 可以调用 Lambda 函数（[Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)）。Amazon Textract 旨在检测文档中的打印和手写文本，包括“medical records”，并且可以大规模分析图像和 PDF 文件（[What is Amazon Textract?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。随后，Amazon Comprehend Medical 在非结构化临床文本中检测有用信息，包括疾病、药物和 PHI（[What is Amazon Comprehend Medical?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend-medical/latest/dev/comprehendmedical-welcome.html)）。错误选项：

- **A** 错误，因为在 EC2 实例上运行 MySQL 会增加服务器和数据库管理工作，并且与使用 S3 加 Athena 进行 SQL-on-S3 分析相比，可扩展性和运营效率较低。
- **C** 错误，因为运行自定义提取应用程序的 EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组会增加运营开销。Lambda、Textract 和 Comprehend Medical 等托管服务可以更高效地满足要求。
- **D** 错误，因为 Amazon Transcribe 用于转录 **audio**；AWS 将 Transcribe streaming 描述为为“media content”和“speech-to-text”应用程序生成实时转录（[Transcribing streaming audio](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html)）。这里的源数据是扫描的书面文档，适合使用 Textract 和 Comprehend Medical。

en.question: A company is running a batch application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application consists of a backend with multiple Amazon RDS databases. The application is causing a high number of reads on the databases. A solutions architect must reduce the number of database reads while ensuring high availability. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Add Amazon RDS read replicas.
options.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
options.C: Use Amazon Route 53 DNS caching
options.D: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **B. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.**

Amazon ElastiCache can be used to cache frequently accessed database query results so that repeated reads are served from an in-memory cache instead of from the RDS databases. AWS describes query caching as a common pattern where the application checks the cache first, returns cached results when available, and queries the database only on a cache miss; this is especially effective for read-heavy applications and high-concurrency scenarios because it offloads reads from the database ([AWS ElastiCache query caching documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)).

ElastiCache for Redis also supports high availability with Multi-AZ and automatic failover. If the primary node or an Availability Zone fails, ElastiCache can promote a read replica to become the new primary and update the endpoint transparently ([AWS ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Redis OSS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html)). This meets both requirements: reducing database reads and maintaining high availability.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Add Amazon RDS read replicas**: RDS read replicas can reduce the load on the primary DB instance by routing read queries to replica DB instances, and they are useful for scaling read-heavy workloads ([Amazon RDS read replica documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). However, the reads still go to database instances. This scales database read capacity but does not reduce the total number of database reads in the way a cache does.

- **C. Use Amazon Route 53 DNS caching**: DNS caching improves or reduces DNS lookups, not application database reads. It does not cache RDS query results or reduce read pressure on the databases. Route 53 DNS cache tuning is related to DNS resolution performance, not database workload reduction ([Route 53 resolver performance documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/gr-resolve-performance-issues.html)).

- **D. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached**: Memcached can be used as a cache, but the requirement includes high availability. For this use case, Redis is the better ElastiCache engine because it supports replication, Multi-AZ, and automatic failover. AWS distinguishes Redis OSS/Valkey from Memcached when selecting an ElastiCache engine, and Redis is the appropriate choice when advanced availability and replication features are required ([ElastiCache engine selection documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个批处理应用程序。该应用程序由一个后端组成，后端包含多个 Amazon RDS 数据库。该应用程序导致数据库上产生大量读取。解决方案架构师必须在确保高可用性的同时减少数据库读取次数。解决方案架构师应如何满足此要求？

options.A: 添加 Amazon RDS 只读副本。
options.B: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Route 53 DNS 缓存
options.D: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.**

Amazon ElastiCache 可用于缓存频繁访问的数据库查询结果，从而使重复读取由内存缓存提供，而不是来自 RDS 数据库。AWS 将查询缓存描述为一种常见模式：应用程序首先检查缓存，在可用时返回缓存结果，仅在缓存未命中时查询数据库；这对于读取密集型应用程序和高并发场景尤其有效，因为它可以从数据库卸载读取 ([AWS ElastiCache query caching documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html))。

ElastiCache for Redis 还支持通过 Multi-AZ 和自动故障转移实现高可用性。如果主节点或某个 Availability Zone 发生故障，ElastiCache 可以提升一个只读副本成为新的主节点，并透明地更新端点 ([AWS ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Redis OSS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html))。这同时满足两个要求：减少数据库读取并保持高可用性。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Add Amazon RDS read replicas**：RDS 只读副本可以通过将读取查询路由到副本 DB 实例来减少主 DB 实例上的负载，并且对扩展读取密集型工作负载很有用 ([Amazon RDS read replica documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html))。但是，读取仍然会到达数据库实例。这扩展了数据库读取容量，但不像缓存那样减少数据库读取总次数。

- **C. Use Amazon Route 53 DNS caching**：DNS 缓存改善或减少的是 DNS 查找，而不是应用程序数据库读取。它不会缓存 RDS 查询结果，也不会减少数据库上的读取压力。Route 53 DNS 缓存调优与 DNS 解析性能有关，而不是减少数据库工作负载 ([Route 53 resolver performance documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/gr-resolve-performance-issues.html))。

- **D. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached**：Memcached 可以用作缓存，但该要求包含高可用性。对于此用例，Redis 是更好的 ElastiCache 引擎，因为它支持复制、Multi-AZ 和自动故障转移。AWS 在选择 ElastiCache 引擎时区分 Redis OSS/Valkey 与 Memcached，并且当需要高级可用性和复制功能时，Redis 是合适的选择 ([ElastiCache engine selection documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html))。

en.question: A company needs to run a critical application on AWS. The company needs to use Amazon EC2 for the application’s database. The database must be highly available and must fail over automatically if a disruptive event occurs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Launch two EC2 instances, each in a different Availability Zone in the same AWS Region. Install the database on both EC2 instances. Configure the EC2 instances as a cluster. Set up database replication.
options.B: Launch an EC2 instance in an Availability Zone. Install the database on the EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) to back up the data. Use AWS CloudFormation to automate provisioning of the EC2 instance if a disruptive event occurs.
options.C: Launch two EC2 instances, each in a different AWS Region. Install the database on both EC2 instances. Set up database replication. Fail over the database to a second Region.
options.D: Launch an EC2 instance in an Availability Zone. Install the database on the EC2 instance. Use an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) to back up the data. Use EC2 automatic recovery to recover the instance if a disruptive event occurs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

A database running on EC2 must provide its own high availability architecture. AWS Prescriptive Guidance states that for SQL Server on Amazon EC2, supported replication technologies such as log shipping, database mirroring, Always On availability groups, and Always On Failover Cluster Instances can be used to achieve high availability, data protection, and disaster recovery. It also describes a design with SQL Server on EC2 **across multiple Availability Zones within a single AWS Region**, with a primary database and a secondary database configured for high availability ([AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-sql-server/ec2-sql-ha.html)). Deploying the two EC2 database nodes in different AZs, clustering them, and configuring replication is the option that meets the requirement for high availability and automatic failover.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A single EC2 instance with AMI backups and CloudFormation reprovisioning is a recovery/rebuild approach, not a highly available database with automatic failover. It would have downtime and possible data loss between backups.
- **C:** Multi-Region replication can be part of disaster recovery, but the option does not specify clustering or automatic failover. For this requirement, AWS documentation supports a Multi-AZ EC2 database configuration for high availability within a Region ([AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-sql-server/ec2-sql-ha.html)). Multi-Region failover is typically more complex and is not required by the question.
- **D:** EC2 automatic recovery is not the same as database high availability. AWS documents limitations for simplified automatic recovery, including that it does not operate during AWS service events and can fail because of insufficient capacity or daily recovery limits ([Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-configuration-recovery.html)). A single instance also cannot withstand an Availability Zone failure; AWS recommends running workloads in more than one AZ because each AZ is an isolated failure domain ([AWS Whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/real-time-communication-on-aws/use-multiple-availability-zones.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要在 AWS 上运行一个关键应用程序。该公司需要为该应用程序的数据库使用 Amazon EC2。该数据库必须具备高可用性，并且在发生破坏性事件时必须自动故障转移。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 启动两个 EC2 实例，每个实例位于同一 AWS Region 中的不同 Availability Zone。在两个 EC2 实例上安装数据库。将 EC2 实例配置为一个集群。设置数据库复制。
options.B: 在一个 Availability Zone 中启动一个 EC2 实例。在该 EC2 实例上安装数据库。使用 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 备份数据。如果发生破坏性事件，使用 AWS CloudFormation 自动预置该 EC2 实例。
options.C: 启动两个 EC2 实例，每个实例位于不同的 AWS Region。在两个 EC2 实例上安装数据库。设置数据库复制。将数据库故障转移到第二个 Region。
options.D: 在一个 Availability Zone 中启动一个 EC2 实例。在该 EC2 实例上安装数据库。使用 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 备份数据。如果发生破坏性事件，使用 EC2 automatic recovery 恢复该实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

在 EC2 上运行的数据库必须提供自身的高可用性架构。AWS Prescriptive Guidance 指出，对于 Amazon EC2 上的 SQL Server，可以使用受支持的复制技术（例如日志传送、数据库镜像、Always On 可用性组以及 Always On Failover Cluster Instances）来实现高可用性、数据保护和灾难恢复。它还描述了一种在单个 AWS Region 内跨多个 Availability Zones 部署 EC2 上的 SQL Server 的设计，其中包含一个主数据库和一个配置用于高可用性的辅助数据库（[AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-sql-server/ec2-sql-ha.html)）。将两个 EC2 数据库节点部署在不同 AZ 中、对它们进行集群配置并配置复制，是满足高可用性和自动故障转移要求的选项。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 单个 EC2 实例配合 AMI 备份和 CloudFormation 重新预置是一种恢复/重建方法，而不是具有自动故障转移能力的高可用数据库。它会产生停机时间，并可能在备份之间发生数据丢失。
- **C:** Multi-Region 复制可以作为灾难恢复的一部分，但该选项没有指定集群或自动故障转移。对于此要求，AWS 文档支持在一个 Region 内使用 Multi-AZ EC2 数据库配置来实现高可用性（[AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-sql-server/ec2-sql-ha.html)）。Multi-Region 故障转移通常更复杂，并且题目并未要求。
- **D:** EC2 automatic recovery 不等同于数据库高可用性。AWS 记录了 simplified automatic recovery 的限制，包括它不会在 AWS 服务事件期间运行，并且可能因容量不足或每日恢复限制而失败（[Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-configuration-recovery.html)）。单个实例也无法承受 Availability Zone 故障；AWS 建议在多个 AZ 中运行工作负载，因为每个 AZ 都是一个隔离的故障域（[AWS Whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/real-time-communication-on-aws/use-multiple-availability-zones.html)）。

en.question: A company’s order system sends requests from clients to Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances process the orders and then store the orders in a database on Amazon RDS. Users report that they must reprocess orders when the system fails. The company wants a resilient solution that can process orders automatically if a system outage occurs. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to target an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task.
options.B: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Update the order system to send messages to the ALB endpoint.
options.C: Move the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group. Configure the order system to send messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the EC2 instances to consume messages from the queue.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Create an AWS Lambda function, and subscribe the function to the SNS topic. Configure the order system to send messages to the SNS topic. Send a command to the EC2 instances to process the messages by using AWS Systems Manager Run Command.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The requirement is to avoid losing order-processing work during outages and to process orders automatically after failures. Putting the EC2 workers in an Auto Scaling group helps keep worker capacity available because EC2 Auto Scaling replaces unhealthy instances by terminating the unhealthy instance and launching a new one ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/replace-unhealthy-instance.html)). Sending orders to Amazon SQS decouples the order intake from the EC2 workers. With SQS, a received message remains in the queue until it is successfully deleted; if the worker does not process and delete it because of an application error, crash, or connectivity problem, the message becomes visible again and can be retrieved by the same or another consumer, ensuring messages are not lost if initial processing fails ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)). SQS also stores copies of messages on multiple servers for redundancy and high availability ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues-at-least-once-delivery.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Auto Scaling helps EC2 availability, but EventBridge targeting an ECS task does not create a durable work queue for the order requests or allow the existing EC2 processing fleet to reliably retry unprocessed orders.
- **B:** An ALB distributes incoming requests to EC2 instances, but it does not provide durable message storage and retry semantics for orders that cannot be processed during an outage. The problem requires asynchronous buffering and reprocessing.
- **D:** SNS with Lambda and Systems Manager Run Command is unnecessarily indirect and does not provide the durable pull-based work queue behavior needed for EC2 instances to automatically resume processing unprocessed orders. SQS specifically provides the retry behavior where failed or undeleted messages become visible again for another processing attempt.

zh.question: 一家公司的订单系统将来自客户端的请求发送到 Amazon EC2 实例。EC2 实例处理订单，然后将订单存储在 Amazon RDS 上的数据库中。用户报告说，当系统发生故障时，他们必须重新处理订单。该公司希望获得一种弹性解决方案，在发生系统中断时能够自动处理订单。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 EC2 实例移入 Auto Scaling 组。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 规则，以 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 任务作为目标。
options.B: 将 EC2 实例移入 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Auto Scaling 组。更新订单系统，将消息发送到 ALB 端点。
options.C: 将 EC2 实例移入 Auto Scaling 组。配置订单系统，将消息发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置 EC2 实例从该队列中消费消息。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，并将该函数订阅到 SNS 主题。配置订单系统，将消息发送到 SNS 主题。使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 向 EC2 实例发送命令以处理这些消息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

要求是在中断期间避免丢失订单处理工作，并在故障后自动处理订单。将 EC2 工作节点放入 Auto Scaling 组有助于保持工作节点容量可用，因为 EC2 Auto Scaling 会通过终止不正常实例并启动新实例来替换不正常实例（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/replace-unhealthy-instance.html)）。将订单发送到 Amazon SQS 可将订单接收与 EC2 工作节点解耦。使用 SQS 时，已接收的消息会保留在队列中，直到它被成功删除；如果工作节点由于应用程序错误、崩溃或连接问题而未处理并删除该消息，该消息会再次变为可见，并可由同一消费者或其他消费者检索，从而确保初始处理失败时消息不会丢失（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)）。SQS 还会在多台服务器上存储消息副本，以实现冗余和高可用性（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues-at-least-once-delivery.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Auto Scaling 有助于提高 EC2 可用性，但以 ECS 任务为目标的 EventBridge 并不会为订单请求创建持久的工作队列，也不能让现有 EC2 处理实例组可靠地重试未处理的订单。
- **B:** ALB 将传入请求分发到 EC2 实例，但它不会为在中断期间无法处理的订单提供持久消息存储和重试语义。该问题需要异步缓冲和重新处理。
- **D:** SNS 与 Lambda 和 Systems Manager Run Command 的组合是不必要的间接方案，并且无法提供 EC2 实例自动恢复处理未处理订单所需的持久、基于拉取的工作队列行为。SQS 专门提供这种重试行为：失败或未删除的消息会再次变为可见，以便进行另一次处理尝试。

en.question: A company runs an application on a large fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads and writes entries into an Amazon DynamoDB table. The size of the DynamoDB table continuously grows, but the application needs only data from the last 30 days. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and development effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the complete solution. Redeploy the CloudFormation stack every 30 days, and delete the original stack.
options.B: Use an EC2 instance that runs a monitoring application from AWS Marketplace. Configure the monitoring application to use Amazon DynamoDB Streams to store the timestamp when a new item is created in the table. Use a script that runs on the EC2 instance to delete items that have a timestamp that is older than 30 days.
options.C: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams to invoke an AWS Lambda function when a new item is created in the table. Configure the Lambda function to delete items in the table that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Extend the application to add an attribute that has a value of the current timestamp plus 30 days to each new item that is created in the table. Configure DynamoDB to use the attribute as the TTL attribute.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL) is designed for exactly this use case: expiring items that are no longer relevant. AWS states that TTL is a **cost-effective method for deleting items**, lets you define a **per-item expiration timestamp**, and DynamoDB **automatically deletes expired items** without consuming write throughput in the Region where the TTL expiration occurs. To use it, you enable TTL on the table and define an attribute that stores the expiration timestamp; each time an item is created or updated, the application can compute and save that expiration time in the TTL attribute ([Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html)). AWS also describes the common implementation as setting the TTL based on creation or update time, such as `createdAt + 90 days`; in this question, that value would be current timestamp + 30 days ([Computing time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/time-to-live-ttl-before-you-start.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Redeploying a CloudFormation stack every 30 days is not an appropriate data-retention mechanism for an existing DynamoDB table and EC2 fleet. It would be operationally disruptive and does not directly implement per-item expiration.
- **B:** Running a separate EC2 monitoring application and custom scripts adds infrastructure cost and development/operational effort. DynamoDB TTL already provides automatic item expiration without needing a separate EC2-based deletion process.
- **C:** DynamoDB Streams plus Lambda requires custom Lambda code to find and delete old items, and delete operations would need to be implemented and managed. This is more development effort than using DynamoDB’s built-in TTL capability. TTL deletions themselves can appear in DynamoDB Streams as service deletions, but Streams are not required to perform the expiration ([Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在大量 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。该应用程序向一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表读取和写入条目。DynamoDB 表的大小持续增长，但应用程序只需要最近 30 天的数据。公司需要一种能够最大限度降低成本和开发工作量的解决方案。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署完整解决方案。每 30 天重新部署一次 CloudFormation 堆栈，并删除原始堆栈。
options.B: 使用一个运行来自 AWS Marketplace 的监控应用程序的 EC2 实例。配置该监控应用程序使用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 来存储表中新项目创建时的时间戳。使用在 EC2 实例上运行的脚本删除时间戳早于 30 天的项目。
options.C: 配置 Amazon DynamoDB Streams 在表中新项目创建时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数删除表中早于 30 天的项目。
options.D: 扩展应用程序，为表中创建的每个新项目添加一个属性，其值为当前时间戳加 30 天。配置 DynamoDB 将该属性用作 TTL 属性。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** DynamoDB Time to Live (TTL) 正是为这种用例而设计的：使不再相关的项目过期。AWS 表示，TTL 是一种**具有成本效益的项目删除方法**，允许你定义**每个项目的过期时间戳**，并且 DynamoDB 会在 TTL 过期发生的 Region 中**自动删除过期项目**，而不消耗写入吞吐量。要使用它，你需要在表上启用 TTL，并定义一个存储过期时间戳的属性；每次创建或更新项目时，应用程序都可以计算并将该过期时间保存到 TTL 属性中（[Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html)）。AWS 还将常见实现描述为基于创建或更新时间来设置 TTL，例如 `createdAt + 90 days`；在本题中，该值将是当前时间戳 + 30 天（[Computing time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/time-to-live-ttl-before-you-start.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 每 30 天重新部署一次 CloudFormation 堆栈并不是现有 DynamoDB 表和 EC2 队列的适当数据保留机制。这样会造成运营中断，并且不能直接实现按项目过期。
- **B:** 运行单独的 EC2 监控应用程序和自定义脚本会增加基础设施成本以及开发/运营工作量。DynamoDB TTL 已经提供自动项目过期，无需单独基于 EC2 的删除流程。
- **C:** DynamoDB Streams 加 Lambda 需要自定义 Lambda 代码来查找并删除旧项目，并且删除操作需要实现和管理。与使用 DynamoDB 内置 TTL 功能相比，这需要更多开发工作。TTL 删除本身可以作为服务删除出现在 DynamoDB Streams 中，但执行过期并不需要 Streams（[Using time to live (TTL) in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html)）。

en.question: A company has a Microsoft .NET application that runs on an on-premises Windows Server. The application stores data by using an Oracle Database Standard Edition server. The company is planning a migration to AWS and wants to minimize development changes while moving the application. The AWS application environment should be highly available. Which combination of actions should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Refactor the application as serverless with AWS Lambda functions running .NET Core.
options.B: Rehost the application in AWS Elastic Beanstalk with the .NET platform in a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.C: Replatform the application to run on Amazon EC2 with the Amazon Linux Amazon Machine Image (AMI).
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate from the Oracle database to Amazon DynamoDB in a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate from the Oracle database to Oracle on Amazon RDS in a Multi-AZ deployment.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **B and E**.

**B is correct** because the application is a Microsoft .NET application currently running on Windows Server, and Elastic Beanstalk supports **.NET** applications while provisioning the AWS resources needed to run them, such as EC2 instances ([Elastic Beanstalk supported platforms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)). A load-balanced Elastic Beanstalk environment uses an Auto Scaling group for multiple instances, and AWS recommends using **at least two Availability Zones** for production so the application remains available if one Availability Zone goes out ([Elastic Beanstalk capacity configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-autoscaling-configuration-approaches.html)). This is a low-change rehost approach.

**E is correct** because keeping the database engine as Oracle on Amazon RDS minimizes application changes compared with changing the data model or database engine. Amazon RDS documentation lists **AWS DMS** as an option to migrate data into Oracle on Amazon RDS, including migrations without downtime ([Importing data into Oracle on Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Oracle.Procedural.Importing.html)). Amazon RDS also supports **Multi-AZ deployments for Oracle** as a high-availability failover solution and recommends Multi-AZ for production workloads ([RDS for Oracle licensing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Oracle.Concepts.Licensing.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A**: Refactoring into Lambda functions is not a minimal-change migration. Lambda supports .NET runtimes, but converting a Windows Server-hosted application into serverless functions is a refactor, not a rehost ([Lambda supported runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)).
- **C**: Moving a Windows Server .NET application to Amazon Linux would introduce operating system and platform changes, which conflicts with minimizing development changes.
- **D**: AWS DMS can target DynamoDB, but AWS documentation notes that relational-to-DynamoDB migrations may require restructuring data and object mapping because DynamoDB has a different key/value and document data model ([DMS DynamoDB target mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.DynamoDB.html)). That would require more application and data-model changes than staying on Oracle.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Microsoft .NET 应用程序，运行在本地 Windows Server 上。该应用程序使用 Oracle Database Standard Edition 服务器存储数据。公司正计划迁移到 AWS，并希望在迁移应用程序时尽量减少开发变更。AWS 应用程序环境应具有高可用性。公司应采取哪两项操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将应用程序重构为 serverless，并使用运行 .NET Core 的 AWS Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 中使用 .NET 平台重新托管该应用程序，并采用 Multi-AZ 部署。
options.C: 将应用程序重新平台化，使其在使用 Amazon Linux Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 的 Amazon EC2 上运行。
options.D: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到采用 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon DynamoDB。
options.E: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将 Oracle 数据库迁移到采用 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon RDS 上的 Oracle。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B 和 E**。

**B 是正确的**，因为该应用程序是当前运行在 Windows Server 上的 Microsoft .NET 应用程序，而 Elastic Beanstalk 支持 **.NET** 应用程序，并会预置运行这些应用程序所需的 AWS 资源，例如 EC2 实例（[Elastic Beanstalk supported platforms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。负载均衡的 Elastic Beanstalk 环境使用 Auto Scaling group 来运行多个实例，并且 AWS 建议在生产环境中使用**至少两个 Availability Zones**，这样如果一个 Availability Zone 出现故障，应用程序仍然可用（[Elastic Beanstalk capacity configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-autoscaling-configuration-approaches.html)）。这是一种低变更的重新托管方法。

**E 是正确的**，因为与更改数据模型或数据库引擎相比，将数据库引擎保留为 Amazon RDS 上的 Oracle 可以最大限度减少应用程序变更。Amazon RDS 文档将 **AWS DMS** 列为将数据迁移到 Amazon RDS 上的 Oracle 的一个选项，包括无停机迁移（[Importing data into Oracle on Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Oracle.Procedural.Importing.html)）。Amazon RDS 还支持 **Oracle 的 Multi-AZ 部署**，作为高可用性故障转移解决方案，并建议生产工作负载使用 Multi-AZ（[RDS for Oracle licensing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Oracle.Concepts.Licensing.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A**：重构为 Lambda 函数不是最小变更迁移。Lambda 支持 .NET 运行时，但将托管在 Windows Server 上的应用程序转换为 serverless 函数属于重构，而不是重新托管（[Lambda supported runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)）。
- **C**：将 Windows Server .NET 应用程序迁移到 Amazon Linux 会引入操作系统和平台变更，这与最大限度减少开发变更相冲突。
- **D**：AWS DMS 可以将 DynamoDB 作为目标，但 AWS 文档指出，从关系型数据库迁移到 DynamoDB 可能需要重构数据和对象映射，因为 DynamoDB 具有不同的键/值和文档数据模型（[DMS DynamoDB target mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.DynamoDB.html)）。与继续使用 Oracle 相比，这将需要更多应用程序和数据模型变更。

en.question: A company runs a containerized application on a Kubernetes cluster in an on-premises data center. The company is using a MongoDB database for data storage. The company wants to migrate some of these environments to AWS, but no code changes or deployment method changes are possible at this time. The company needs a solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes for compute and MongoDB on EC2 for data storage.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate for compute and Amazon DynamoDB for data storage
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes for compute and Amazon DynamoDB for data storage.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with AWS Fargate for compute and Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) for data storage.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The existing application runs on **Kubernetes** and cannot change code or deployment methods. Amazon EKS is a fully managed Kubernetes service, and AWS states that EKS is Kubernetes-conformant, so Kubernetes-compatible applications can be deployed “without refactoring” and existing Kubernetes tooling/plugins can be used ([Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)). Using **AWS Fargate with EKS** further minimizes operations because Fargate runs Kubernetes Pods without requiring the company to provision, configure, or scale VM/node groups ([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)). For the database, Amazon DocumentDB supports MongoDB compatibility, and AWS says most applications, drivers, and tools already used with MongoDB can be used with DocumentDB with little or no change ([DocumentDB compatibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/compatibility.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** ECS is not Kubernetes, so moving from Kubernetes manifests/deployment methods to ECS task definitions/services would not meet the “no deployment method changes” requirement. Also, ECS on EC2 requires choosing instance types/count and managing capacity, increasing operational overhead ([Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html)). MongoDB on EC2 also leaves database administration to the company rather than using a managed MongoDB-compatible service.
- **B:** ECS again changes the orchestration/deployment model away from Kubernetes. DynamoDB is not MongoDB-compatible; AWS guidance for DynamoDB emphasizes designing schemas around access/query patterns, which would imply application/data-model redesign rather than no code changes ([DynamoDB design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)).
- **C:** EKS preserves Kubernetes, but EC2 worker nodes add operational overhead compared with Fargate, which avoids provisioning/configuring/scaling VM groups ([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)). DynamoDB also does not satisfy the MongoDB compatibility/no-code-change requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地数据中心的 Kubernetes 集群上运行一个容器化应用程序。该公司正在使用 MongoDB 数据库存储数据。公司希望将其中一些环境迁移到 AWS，但目前无法进行代码更改或部署方法更改。公司需要一个能够最大限度降低运营开销的解决方案。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 工作节点进行计算，并使用 EC2 上的 MongoDB 进行数据存储。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 AWS Fargate 进行计算，并使用 Amazon DynamoDB 进行数据存储
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 工作节点进行计算，并使用 Amazon DynamoDB 进行数据存储。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 AWS Fargate 进行计算，并使用 Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) 进行数据存储。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 现有应用程序运行在 **Kubernetes** 上，并且不能更改代码或部署方法。Amazon EKS 是一项完全托管的 Kubernetes 服务，AWS 表示 EKS 符合 Kubernetes 标准，因此可以“无需重构”地部署与 Kubernetes 兼容的应用程序，并且可以使用现有的 Kubernetes 工具/插件（[Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)）。将 **AWS Fargate 与 EKS** 结合使用可进一步最大限度降低运维工作，因为 Fargate 运行 Kubernetes Pods，而不需要公司预置、配置或扩展 VM/节点组（[EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)）。对于数据库，Amazon DocumentDB 支持 MongoDB 兼容性，并且 AWS 表示，大多数已与 MongoDB 一起使用的应用程序、驱动程序和工具都可以在很少或无需更改的情况下与 DocumentDB 一起使用（[DocumentDB compatibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/compatibility.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** ECS 不是 Kubernetes，因此从 Kubernetes 清单/部署方法迁移到 ECS 任务定义/服务不满足“无部署方法更改”的要求。此外，ECS on EC2 需要选择实例类型/数量并管理容量，从而增加运营开销（[Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html)）。EC2 上的 MongoDB 也会把数据库管理工作留给公司，而不是使用托管的 MongoDB 兼容服务。
- **B:** ECS 同样会将编排/部署模型从 Kubernetes 改为其他模式。DynamoDB 不兼容 MongoDB；AWS 针对 DynamoDB 的指导强调围绕访问/查询模式设计架构，这意味着需要重新设计应用程序/数据模型，而不是无需代码更改（[DynamoDB design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。
- **C:** EKS 保留了 Kubernetes，但与 Fargate 相比，EC2 工作节点会增加运营开销；Fargate 避免了预置/配置/扩展 VM 组（[EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)）。DynamoDB 也不满足 MongoDB 兼容性/无需代码更改的要求。

en.question: A telemarketing company is designing its customer call center functionality on AWS. The company needs a solution that provides multiple speaker recognition and generates transcript files. The company wants to query the transcript files to analyze the business patterns. The transcript files must be stored for 7 years for auditing purposes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Rekognition for multiple speaker recognition. Store the transcript files in Amazon S3. Use machine learning models for transcript file analysis.
options.B: Use Amazon Transcribe for multiple speaker recognition. Use Amazon Athena for transcript file analysis.
options.C: Use Amazon Translate for multiple speaker recognition. Store the transcript files in Amazon Redshift. Use SQL queries for transcript file analysis.
options.D: Use Amazon Rekognition for multiple speaker recognition. Store the transcript files in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Textract for transcript file analysis.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon Transcribe is the service designed for speech-to-text transcription and supports multiple-speaker identification through speaker partitioning/diarization. The AWS documentation shows enabling **Speaker partitioning** and specifying the number of speakers, and the API examples use `ShowSpeakerLabels=true` with `MaxSpeakerLabels` for multiple speakers ([Amazon Transcribe diarization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/diarization.html)). Amazon Transcribe produces JSON transcript output, and AWS states that all batch transcripts are stored in Amazon S3 buckets; if you specify your own bucket, the transcript remains there until you remove it ([Transcribe data input and output](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/how-input.html)). For the 7-year audit requirement, S3 can apply Object Lock retention periods in days or years to protect objects for a fixed duration ([S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)). Amazon Athena is appropriate for analysis because Athena defines schemas over data located in Amazon S3 and queries it using SQL without loading or transforming the data ([Athena tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** and **D**: Amazon Rekognition is for image and video analysis, not call audio transcription or speaker diarization ([Amazon Rekognition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
* **C**: Amazon Translate is for translating text/documents between languages, not recognizing multiple speakers in audio or generating call transcripts ([Amazon Translate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
* **D** also incorrectly uses Amazon Textract for transcript analysis. Textract extracts text and structured data from documents/images; it is not the right service for querying transcript files for business patterns ([Amazon Textract](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家电话营销公司正在 AWS 上设计其客户呼叫中心功能。该公司需要一种能够提供多说话人识别并生成转录文件的解决方案。该公司希望查询这些转录文件以分析业务模式。出于审计目的，转录文件必须存储 7 年。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Rekognition 进行多说话人识别。将转录文件存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用机器学习模型进行转录文件分析。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 进行多说话人识别。使用 Amazon Athena 进行转录文件分析。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Translate 进行多说话人识别。将转录文件存储在 Amazon Redshift 中。使用 SQL 查询进行转录文件分析。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Rekognition 进行多说话人识别。将转录文件存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon Textract 进行转录文件分析。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon Transcribe 是专为语音转文本转录而设计的服务，并通过说话人分区/说话人分离支持多说话人识别。AWS 文档展示了如何启用 **Speaker partitioning** 并指定说话人数量，API 示例则使用 `ShowSpeakerLabels=true` 和 `MaxSpeakerLabels` 来处理多个说话人（[Amazon Transcribe diarization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/diarization.html)）。Amazon Transcribe 会生成 JSON 转录输出，AWS 表示所有批量转录都会存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中；如果你指定自己的存储桶，转录会保留在那里，直到你将其删除（[Transcribe data input and output](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/how-input.html)）。对于 7 年审计要求，S3 可以按天或年应用 Object Lock 保留期，以在固定期限内保护对象（[S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。Amazon Athena 适合用于分析，因为 Athena 可在位于 Amazon S3 中的数据之上定义架构，并使用 SQL 进行查询，而无需加载或转换数据（[Athena tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **A** 和 **D**：Amazon Rekognition 用于图像和视频分析，而不是呼叫音频转录或说话人分离（[Amazon Rekognition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。
* **C**：Amazon Translate 用于在不同语言之间翻译文本/文档，而不是识别音频中的多个说话人或生成通话转录（[Amazon Translate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。
* **D** 还错误地使用 Amazon Textract 进行转录分析。Textract 从文档/图像中提取文本和结构化数据；它不是用于查询转录文件以分析业务模式的正确服务（[Amazon Textract](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts its application on AWS. The company uses Amazon Cognito to manage users. When users log in to the application, the application fetches required data from Amazon DynamoDB by using a REST API that is hosted in Amazon API Gateway. The company wants an AWS managed solution that will control access to the REST API to reduce development efforts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an AWS Lambda function to be an authorizer in API Gateway to validate which user made the request.
options.B: For each user, create and assign an API key that must be sent with each request. Validate the key by using an AWS Lambda function.
options.C: Send the user’s email address in the header with every request. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to validate that the user with that email address has proper access.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Cognito user pool authorizer in API Gateway to allow Amazon Cognito to validate each request.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

API Gateway REST APIs have a built-in integration with Amazon Cognito user pools for access control. AWS documentation states that, as an alternative to IAM roles/policies or Lambda authorizers, you can use an **Amazon Cognito user pool to control who can access your API in Amazon API Gateway**. To do this, you create an authorizer of type `COGNITO_USER_POOLS` and configure API methods to use it. Clients sign in to the user pool, obtain an identity or access token, and send it—typically in the `Authorization` header; the API call succeeds only when the required token is supplied and valid ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-integrate-with-cognito.html)). This is the managed solution with the least operational overhead because the company already uses Amazon Cognito and does not need to write custom validation logic.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: A Lambda authorizer can control access, but AWS describes it as a way to implement a **custom authorization scheme** where API Gateway invokes a Lambda function that authenticates the caller and returns an IAM policy ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)). This requires custom code and maintenance, so it has more operational overhead than a Cognito user pool authorizer.
- **B**: API keys are not appropriate for user authentication/authorization. AWS explicitly says, **“Don’t use API keys for authentication or authorization to control access to your APIs”** and recommends IAM roles, Lambda authorizers, or Amazon Cognito user pools instead ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)). Adding Lambda validation also increases development effort.
- **C**: Sending an email address in a header and validating it with Lambda is a custom, insecure authorization approach. It requires custom code and does not use the managed Cognito/API Gateway authorization capability.

Therefore, configuring an **Amazon Cognito user pool authorizer in API Gateway** is the correct least-overhead solution.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管其应用程序。该公司使用 Amazon Cognito 来管理用户。当用户登录应用程序时，应用程序通过托管在 Amazon API Gateway 中的 REST API，从 Amazon DynamoDB 获取所需数据。该公司希望采用一种 AWS 托管解决方案来控制对 REST API 的访问，以减少开发工作量。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS Lambda 函数配置为 API Gateway 中的授权方，以验证是哪个用户发出了请求。
options.B: 为每个用户创建并分配一个 API 密钥，该密钥必须随每个请求一起发送。使用 AWS Lambda 函数验证该密钥。
options.C: 在每个请求的标头中发送用户的电子邮件地址。调用 AWS Lambda 函数来验证具有该电子邮件地址的用户是否拥有适当的访问权限。
options.D: 在 API Gateway 中配置 Amazon Cognito 用户池授权方，以允许 Amazon Cognito 验证每个请求。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

API Gateway REST APIs 内置了与 Amazon Cognito 用户池的集成，用于访问控制。AWS 文档说明，作为 IAM roles/policies 或 Lambda 授权方的替代方案，你可以使用 **Amazon Cognito 用户池来控制谁可以访问你在 Amazon API Gateway 中的 API**。为此，你需要创建类型为 `COGNITO_USER_POOLS` 的授权方，并配置 API 方法来使用它。客户端登录用户池，获取身份令牌或访问令牌，并将其发送出去——通常是在 `Authorization` 标头中；只有在提供所需令牌且令牌有效时，API 调用才会成功（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-integrate-with-cognito.html)）。这是运营开销最少的托管解决方案，因为该公司已经使用 Amazon Cognito，并且不需要编写自定义验证逻辑。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：Lambda 授权方可以控制访问，但 AWS 将其描述为一种实现 **自定义授权方案** 的方式，其中 API Gateway 调用 Lambda 函数来验证调用方身份并返回 IAM policy（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-use-lambda-authorizer.html)）。这需要自定义代码和维护，因此比 Cognito 用户池授权方具有更多运营开销。
- **B**：API 密钥不适合用于用户身份验证/授权。AWS 明确表示，**“Don’t use API keys for authentication or authorization to control access to your APIs”**，并建议改用 IAM roles、Lambda 授权方或 Amazon Cognito 用户池（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)）。添加 Lambda 验证也会增加开发工作量。
- **C**：在标头中发送电子邮件地址并使用 Lambda 进行验证是一种自定义且不安全的授权方式。它需要自定义代码，并且没有使用托管的 Cognito/API Gateway 授权功能。因此，在 API Gateway 中配置 **Amazon Cognito 用户池授权方** 是正确的最低开销解决方案。

en.question: A company is developing a marketing communications service that targets mobile app users. The company needs to send confirmation messages with Short Message Service (SMS) to its users. The users must be able to reply to the SMS messages. The company must store the responses for a year for analysis. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Connect contact flow to send the SMS messages. Use AWS Lambda to process the responses.
options.B: Build an Amazon Pinpoint journey. Configure Amazon Pinpoint to send events to an Amazon Kinesis data stream for analysis and archiving.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to distribute the SMS messages. Use AWS Lambda to process the responses.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topic. Subscribe an Amazon Kinesis data stream to the SNS topic for analysis and archiving.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon Pinpoint is purpose-built for customer engagement across channels, including text messages, and includes segmentation, campaigns, and **journeys** for sending the right message to the right customer at the right time ([Amazon Pinpoint welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pinpoint/latest/userguide/welcome.html)). Its SMS channel can send SMS messages and, in supported countries, receive customer replies through **two-way SMS** ([Amazon Pinpoint SMS channel](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pinpoint/latest/userguide/channels-sms.html)). For the storage/analysis requirement, Amazon Pinpoint can stream application, campaign, and **journey events** to **Amazon Kinesis Data Streams** or Firehose for flexible analysis and storage; Pinpoint’s own analytics retention is 90 days, so streaming is the right way to keep the data longer ([Streaming events with Amazon Pinpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pinpoint/latest/userguide/analytics-streaming.html)). Kinesis Data Streams can retain records up to **8760 hours (365 days)**, matching the one-year requirement ([Kinesis retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/kinesis-extended-retention.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Amazon Connect contact flow + Lambda** — Amazon Connect is for building custom **contact center** solutions and contact flows, not the best-fit marketing communications/journey service for mobile app users ([Amazon Connect Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/devguide/what-is-connect-dev.html)).
* **C. Amazon SQS + Lambda** — SQS is a distributed queue for producers and consumers; it does not itself provide SMS delivery, two-way SMS, user targeting, or marketing journeys. Also, SQS message retention is at most **14 days**, not one year ([Amazon SQS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)).
* **D. SNS FIFO topic + Kinesis data stream** — SNS topics deliver published messages to subscribers, but the documented subscription endpoint types include SQS, Lambda, HTTP/S, email, SMS, mobile push, and Firehose; the console subscription options for FIFO topics specifically point to SQS, not Kinesis Data Streams ([SNS subscriptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-create-subscribe-endpoint-to-topic.html)). SNS also lacks Pinpoint’s journey-based marketing orchestration and two-way SMS response handling needed here.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一项面向移动应用用户的营销通信服务。公司需要使用 Short Message Service (SMS) 向其用户发送确认消息。用户必须能够回复这些 SMS 消息。公司必须将这些回复存储一年以供分析。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Connect 联系流程来发送 SMS 消息。使用 AWS Lambda 处理回复。
options.B: 构建一个 Amazon Pinpoint journey。配置 Amazon Pinpoint 将事件发送到 Amazon Kinesis data stream，以便进行分析和归档。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 分发 SMS 消息。使用 AWS Lambda 处理回复。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO 主题。将 Amazon Kinesis data stream 订阅到该 SNS 主题，以便进行分析和归档。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.** Amazon Pinpoint 专为跨渠道的客户互动而构建，包括文本消息，并包含细分、活动和 **journeys**，用于在正确的时间向正确的客户发送正确的消息（[Amazon Pinpoint welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pinpoint/latest/userguide/welcome.html)）。其 SMS 渠道可以发送 SMS 消息，并且在受支持的国家/地区，可以通过 **two-way SMS** 接收客户回复（[Amazon Pinpoint SMS channel](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pinpoint/latest/userguide/channels-sms.html)）。对于存储/分析要求，Amazon Pinpoint 可以将应用程序、活动和 **journey events** 流式传输到 **Amazon Kinesis Data Streams** 或 Firehose，以便进行灵活的分析和存储；Pinpoint 自身的分析保留期为 90 天，因此流式传输是更长时间保留数据的正确方式（[Streaming events with Amazon Pinpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pinpoint/latest/userguide/analytics-streaming.html)）。Kinesis Data Streams 可以将记录保留最多 **8760 hours (365 days)**，符合一年的要求（[Kinesis retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/kinesis-extended-retention.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A. Amazon Connect contact flow + Lambda** — Amazon Connect 用于构建自定义 **contact center** 解决方案和联系流程，而不是最适合移动应用用户的营销通信/journey 服务（[Amazon Connect Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/devguide/what-is-connect-dev.html)）。
* **C. Amazon SQS + Lambda** — SQS 是面向生产者和消费者的分布式队列；它本身不提供 SMS 投递、双向 SMS、用户定向或营销 journeys。此外，SQS 消息保留期最多为 **14 days**，不是一年（[Amazon SQS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)）。
* **D. SNS FIFO topic + Kinesis data stream** — SNS 主题将发布的消息传递给订阅者，但记录在案的订阅端点类型包括 SQS、Lambda、HTTP/S、email、SMS、mobile push 和 Firehose；FIFO 主题的控制台订阅选项明确指向 SQS，而不是 Kinesis Data Streams（[SNS subscriptions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-create-subscribe-endpoint-to-topic.html)）。SNS 还缺少此处所需的 Pinpoint 基于 journey 的营销编排和双向 SMS 回复处理能力。

en.question: A company is planning to move its data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted when it is stored in the S3 bucket. Additionally, the encryption key must be automatically rotated every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Move the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket’s default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Move the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year.
options.D: Encrypt the data with customer key material before moving the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon S3 applies server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) by default for new object uploads, so moving the data into S3 with SSE-S3 provides encryption at rest with essentially no customer key-management work. AWS states that S3 encrypts each object with a unique key and encrypts that key with another key that it rotates regularly; AWS KMS documentation also states that AWS-managed key material is rotated every year and this rotation cannot be enabled or disabled by the customer. This meets the encryption and automatic rotation requirement with the **least operational overhead** because there is no customer managed KMS key to create, configure, monitor, or rotate ([S3 SSE-S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html), [S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html), [KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)).

**Why the other options are not best:**

- **B** would work technically: AWS KMS automatic rotation for customer managed symmetric keys is supported, and the default rotation period is 365 days. However, it requires creating and managing a customer managed KMS key and configuring the bucket for SSE-KMS, which adds operational overhead compared with built-in SSE-S3 ([KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html), [S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)).
- **C** is worse than B because it requires **manual** yearly rotation, so it does not meet the “automatically rotated” requirement and adds operational overhead.
- **D** is invalid for the automatic-rotation requirement: AWS KMS automatic key rotation is supported only for symmetric KMS keys with key material generated by AWS KMS (`AWS_KMS` origin), not imported key material (`EXTERNAL` origin). It also adds unnecessary client-side/envelope key-management complexity ([KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将其数据迁移到一个 Amazon S3 bucket。数据在存储到 S3 bucket 中时必须加密。此外，加密密钥必须每年自动轮换。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据移动到 S3 bucket。使用采用 Amazon S3 managed encryption keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-S3)。使用 SSE-S3 加密密钥的内置密钥轮换行为。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key。启用自动密钥轮换。将 S3 bucket 的默认加密行为设置为使用该 customer managed KMS key。将数据移动到 S3 bucket。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key。将 S3 bucket 的默认加密行为设置为使用该 customer managed KMS key。将数据移动到 S3 bucket。每年手动轮换 KMS key。
options.D: 在将数据移动到 S3 bucket 之前，使用客户密钥材料对数据进行加密。创建一个不含密钥材料的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key。将客户密钥材料导入到 KMS key 中。启用自动密钥轮换。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** Amazon S3 默认对新对象上传应用使用 Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) 的服务器端加密，因此将数据移动到使用 SSE-S3 的 S3 中，可以在几乎无需客户进行密钥管理工作的情况下提供静态加密。AWS 表示，S3 使用唯一密钥加密每个对象，并使用另一个会定期轮换的密钥来加密该密钥；AWS KMS 文档还说明，AWS-managed key material 每年轮换一次，并且客户无法启用或禁用此轮换。这以**最少的运营开销**满足了加密和自动轮换要求，因为无需创建、配置、监控或轮换 customer managed KMS key（[S3 SSE-S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)、[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)、[KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：**

- **B** 在技术上可行：customer managed symmetric keys 支持 AWS KMS 自动轮换，默认轮换周期为 365 天。但是，它需要创建和管理 customer managed KMS key，并为 SSE-KMS 配置 bucket，与内置的 SSE-S3 相比增加了运营开销（[KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)、[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。
- **C** 比 B 更差，因为它需要每年**手动**轮换，因此不满足“自动轮换”的要求，并增加了运营开销。
- **D** 对于自动轮换要求无效：AWS KMS 自动密钥轮换仅支持由 AWS KMS 生成密钥材料的 symmetric KMS keys（`AWS_KMS` origin），不支持导入的密钥材料（`EXTERNAL` origin）。它还增加了不必要的客户端/信封密钥管理复杂性（[KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)）。

en.question: The customers of a finance company request appointments with financial advisors by sending text messages. A web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances accepts the appointment requests. The text messages are published to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue through the web application. Another application that runs on EC2 instances then sends meeting invitations and meeting confirmation email messages to the customers. After successful scheduling, this application stores the meeting information in an Amazon DynamoDB database. As the company expands, customers report that their meeting invitations are taking longer to arrive. What should a solutions architect recommend to resolve this issue?

options.A: Add a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the DynamoDB database.
options.B: Add an Amazon API Gateway API in front of the web application that accepts the appointment requests.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the origin as the web application that accepts the appointment requests.
options.D: Add an Auto Scaling group for the application that sends meeting invitations. Configure the Auto Scaling group to scale based on the depth of the SQS queue.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The bottleneck is the EC2-based worker application that consumes messages from the SQS queue and sends meeting invitations. AWS specifically recommends using an Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that process SQS messages and scaling it with an SQS backlog metric: the documentation describes “an Auto Scaling group to manage EC2 instances for the purposes of processing messages from an SQS queue” and a target tracking policy that scales based on a queue backlog-per-instance metric. It also notes that when backlog per instance exceeds the target, “a scale-out event will happen” to maintain acceptable latency ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)). This directly addresses the growing queue delay and slower invitation delivery.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. DAX** improves DynamoDB read performance for read-heavy workloads. AWS says DAX is ideal for applications requiring fast response time for **reads** and is not ideal for write-intensive applications ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). The problem is delayed processing of SQS messages and email/invitation sending, not DynamoDB read latency.
- **B. API Gateway** can act as a front door for backend services and handle API traffic management ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)), but the delay occurs after messages are already in SQS, in the downstream scheduling/invitation application.
- **C. CloudFront** is for delivering web content through distributions ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/GettingStarted.html)). It would not increase the capacity of the EC2 worker fleet that processes SQS messages and sends meeting invitations.

zh.question: 一家金融公司的客户通过发送短信来预约财务顾问。在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的 Web 应用程序接受预约请求。短信通过该 Web 应用程序发布到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。随后，另一个在 EC2 实例上运行的应用程序向客户发送会议邀请和会议确认电子邮件。成功安排日程后，该应用程序将会议信息存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库中。随着公司扩张，客户报告他们的会议邀请需要更长时间才能送达。解决方案架构师应建议什么来解决此问题？

options.A: 在 DynamoDB 数据库前面添加 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群。
options.B: 在接受预约请求的 Web 应用程序前面添加 Amazon API Gateway API。
options.C: 添加 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将源设置为接受预约请求的 Web 应用程序。
options.D: 为发送会议邀请的应用程序添加 Auto Scaling 组。配置 Auto Scaling 组，使其根据 SQS 队列的深度进行扩展。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 瓶颈在于基于 EC2 的工作线程应用程序，该应用程序从 SQS 队列中消费消息并发送会议邀请。AWS 明确建议对处理 SQS 消息的 EC2 实例使用 Auto Scaling 组，并使用 SQS 积压指标进行扩展：文档描述了“an Auto Scaling group to manage EC2 instances for the purposes of processing messages from an SQS queue”，以及基于每个实例队列积压指标进行扩展的目标跟踪策略。它还指出，当每个实例的积压超过目标时，“a scale-out event will happen”，以维持可接受的延迟（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。这直接解决了队列延迟增长和邀请送达变慢的问题。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. DAX** 可提高读取密集型工作负载的 DynamoDB 读取性能。AWS 表示，DAX 非常适合需要快速**读取**响应时间的应用程序，而不适合写入密集型应用程序（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。问题是 SQS 消息处理以及电子邮件/邀请发送延迟，而不是 DynamoDB 读取延迟。
- **B. API Gateway** 可以充当后端服务的前门，并处理 API 流量管理（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)），但延迟发生在消息已经进入 SQS 之后，位于下游的日程安排/邀请应用程序中。
- **C. CloudFront** 用于通过分配交付 Web 内容（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/GettingStarted.html)）。它不会增加处理 SQS 消息并发送会议邀请的 EC2 工作线程队列的容量。

en.question: An online retail company has more than 50 million active customers and receives more than 25,000 orders each day. The company collects purchase data for customers and stores this data in Amazon S3. Additional customer data is stored in Amazon RDS. The company wants to make all the data available to various teams so that the teams can perform analytics. The solution must provide the ability to manage fine-grained permissions for the data and must minimize operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the purchase data to write directly to Amazon RDS. Use RDS access controls to limit access.
options.B: Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon RDS to Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue crawler. Use Amazon Athena to query the data. Use S3 policies to limit access.
options.C: Create a data lake by using AWS Lake Formation. Create an AWS Glue JDBC connection to Amazon RDS. Register the S3 bucket in Lake Formation. Use Lake Formation access controls to limit access.
options.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically copy data from Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift access controls to limit access.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

AWS Lake Formation is purpose-built for creating and governing data lakes. AWS documentation says Lake Formation helps combine structured and unstructured data into a centralized repository, crawl/catalog/prepare it for analytics, and provide secure self-service access to analytics services. It also can import data from Amazon RDS databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MariaDB, and Oracle, supporting both bulk and incremental loading ([AWS Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)). For the existing S3 purchase data, registering the S3 location with Lake Formation lets you use Lake Formation permissions for fine-grained access control to the Data Catalog objects and the underlying S3 data ([Adding an Amazon S3 location to your data lake](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/register-data-lake.html)). Lake Formation also provides a single place to manage policies at database, table, column, row, and cell levels, which directly matches the requirement for fine-grained permissions with low operational overhead ([AWS Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)). AWS Glue supports JDBC connections to Amazon RDS engines such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, and MariaDB, so using an AWS Glue JDBC connection to the RDS data is appropriate ([AWS Glue JDBC connection properties](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/connection-properties.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Migrating all purchase data from S3 into RDS does not create a data lake and would add unnecessary migration/storage burden. RDS access controls are not the best fit for centralized, fine-grained analytics permissions across S3 and database-derived data.
- **B:** Copying RDS data to S3 with a scheduled Lambda function and relying on S3 policies would add custom operational work and does not provide Lake Formation’s database/table/column/row/cell-level governance. S3 policies are not the same as fine-grained Data Catalog/table-level data lake permissions.
- **D:** Loading both S3 and RDS data into Amazon Redshift by scheduled Lambda jobs introduces additional cluster management, data movement, and duplication. The requirement is to minimize operational overhead and centrally govern a data lake; Lake Formation is the more direct managed solution.

zh.question: 一家在线零售公司拥有超过 5000 万活跃客户，并且每天接收超过 25,000 个订单。该公司收集客户的购买数据，并将这些数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。其他客户数据存储在 Amazon RDS 中。该公司希望让各个团队都能访问所有数据，以便这些团队执行分析。该解决方案必须能够对数据管理细粒度权限，并且必须最大限度降低运营开销。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将购买数据迁移为直接写入 Amazon RDS。使用 RDS 访问控制来限制访问。
options.B: 计划一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期将数据从 Amazon RDS 复制到 Amazon S3。创建一个 AWS Glue crawler。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。使用 S3 策略限制访问。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lake Formation 创建一个数据湖。创建一个到 Amazon RDS 的 AWS Glue JDBC connection。在 Lake Formation 中注册 S3 bucket。使用 Lake Formation 访问控制来限制访问。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Redshift 集群。计划一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期将数据从 Amazon S3 和 Amazon RDS 复制到 Amazon Redshift。使用 Amazon Redshift 访问控制来限制访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

AWS Lake Formation 专为创建和治理数据湖而构建。AWS 文档说明，Lake Formation 可帮助将结构化和非结构化数据组合到集中式存储库中，对其进行爬取/编目/准备以用于分析，并向分析服务提供安全的自助式访问。它还可以从 Amazon RDS 数据库（例如 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MariaDB 和 Oracle）导入数据，支持批量加载和增量加载（[AWS Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)）。对于现有的 S3 购买数据，在 Lake Formation 中注册 S3 位置后，可以使用 Lake Formation 权限对 Data Catalog 对象和底层 S3 数据进行细粒度访问控制（[Adding an Amazon S3 location to your data lake](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/register-data-lake.html)）。Lake Formation 还提供一个单一位置，用于在数据库、表、列、行和单元格级别管理策略，这直接符合以低运营开销实现细粒度权限的要求（[AWS Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)）。AWS Glue 支持到 Amazon RDS 引擎（例如 MySQL、PostgreSQL、Oracle、SQL Server 和 MariaDB）的 JDBC connections，因此使用 AWS Glue JDBC connection 连接到 RDS 数据是合适的（[AWS Glue JDBC connection properties](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/connection-properties.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将所有购买数据从 S3 迁移到 RDS 并不会创建数据湖，而且会增加不必要的迁移/存储负担。RDS 访问控制并不最适合对 S3 和数据库派生数据进行集中式、细粒度的分析权限管理。
- **B:** 使用计划的 Lambda 函数将 RDS 数据复制到 S3，并依赖 S3 策略，会增加自定义运营工作，并且无法提供 Lake Formation 的数据库/表/列/行/单元格级治理。S3 策略不同于细粒度的 Data Catalog/表级数据湖权限。
