- **D:** 通过计划的 Lambda 作业将 S3 和 RDS 数据都加载到 Amazon Redshift 中，会引入额外的集群管理、数据移动和数据重复。要求是最大限度降低运营开销并集中治理数据湖；Lake Formation 是更直接的托管解决方案。

en.question: A company hosts a marketing website in an on-premises data center. The website consists of static documents and runs on a single server. An administrator updates the website content infrequently and uses an SFTP client to upload new documents. The company decides to host its website on AWS and to use Amazon CloudFront. The company’s solutions architect creates a CloudFront distribution. The solutions architect must design the most cost- effective and resilient architecture for website hosting to serve as the CloudFront origin. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a virtual server by using Amazon Lightsail. Configure the web server in the Lightsail instance. Upload website content by using an SFTP client.
options.B: Create an AWS Auto Scaling group for Amazon EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer. Upload website content by using an SFTP client.
options.C: Create a private Amazon S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to allow access from a CloudFront origin access identity (OAI). Upload website content by using the AWS CLI.
options.D: Create a public Amazon S3 bucket. Configure AWS Transfer for SFTP. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting. Upload website content by using the SFTP client.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The site is static and content changes infrequently, so an Amazon S3 bucket used as the CloudFront origin is the simplest, resilient, and cost-effective design. AWS states that CloudFront can accelerate static website content and that a simple approach is to store and deliver static content from an S3 bucket; using S3 with CloudFront also lets you restrict access to the S3 content ([CloudFront static content use case](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)). With CloudFront OAI, AWS documents that you can update an S3 bucket policy so the OAI can access files on behalf of viewers and viewers cannot use S3 URLs to bypass CloudFront; AWS also shows an OAI bucket policy granting `s3:GetObject` ([restrict access to an S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)). Uploading infrequent changes with the AWS CLI avoids running servers or a managed SFTP endpoint.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Lightsail would require running and maintaining a virtual server/web server. That is less resilient and less cost-effective for purely static documents than S3 as an origin.
- **B:** An Auto Scaling group plus EC2 instances and an Application Load Balancer is unnecessarily complex and costly for a static website.
- **D:** AWS Transfer Family can provide SFTP into S3 and supports standard SFTP clients ([AWS Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)), but this adds an extra managed service when uploads are infrequent. It also specifies a **public** S3 bucket configured for website hosting. S3 website endpoints require publicly readable content for public access and do not support HTTPS ([S3 website endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteEndpoints.html)). In contrast, the CloudFront secured-origin pattern uses a regular S3 bucket origin with an access identity/control and bucket policy, not a public website endpoint.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地数据中心托管一个营销网站。该网站由静态文档组成，并在单台服务器上运行。管理员很少更新网站内容，并使用 SFTP 客户端上传新文档。公司决定在 AWS 上托管其网站并使用 Amazon CloudFront。公司的解决方案架构师创建了一个 CloudFront 分配。解决方案架构师必须为网站托管设计最具成本效益且具有弹性的架构，以作为 CloudFront 源站。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Lightsail 创建一台虚拟服务器。在 Lightsail 实例中配置 Web 服务器。使用 SFTP 客户端上传网站内容。
options.B: 为 Amazon EC2 实例创建一个 AWS Auto Scaling 组。使用 Application Load Balancer。使用 SFTP 客户端上传网站内容。
options.C: 创建一个私有 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 S3 存储桶策略允许来自 CloudFront origin access identity (OAI) 的访问。使用 AWS CLI 上传网站内容。
options.D: 创建一个公有 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 AWS Transfer for SFTP。为网站托管配置 S3 存储桶。使用 SFTP 客户端上传网站内容。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 该网站是静态的，并且内容很少更改，因此使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为 CloudFront 源站是最简单、具有弹性且具有成本效益的设计。AWS 表示 CloudFront 可以加速静态网站内容，并且一种简单方法是从 S3 存储桶存储和交付静态内容；将 S3 与 CloudFront 结合使用还可以限制对 S3 内容的访问（[CloudFront static content use case](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)）。借助 CloudFront OAI，AWS 文档说明你可以更新 S3 存储桶策略，使 OAI 能够代表查看者访问文件，并且查看者不能使用 S3 URL 绕过 CloudFront；AWS 还展示了一个授予 `s3:GetObject` 的 OAI 存储桶策略（[restrict access to an S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。使用 AWS CLI 上传不频繁的更改，可以避免运行服务器或托管的 SFTP 端点。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Lightsail 需要运行和维护虚拟服务器/Web 服务器。对于纯静态文档而言，与使用 S3 作为源站相比，这种方式弹性更低且成本效益更差。
- **B:** 对于静态网站，Auto Scaling 组加 EC2 实例和 Application Load Balancer 过于复杂且成本过高。
- **D:** AWS Transfer Family 可以提供到 S3 的 SFTP，并支持标准 SFTP 客户端（[AWS Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)），但在上传不频繁时，这会增加一个额外的托管服务。它还指定了一个配置为网站托管的 **public** S3 存储桶。S3 website endpoints 要求内容可公开读取才能进行公有访问，并且不支持 HTTPS（[S3 website endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteEndpoints.html)）。相比之下，CloudFront 安全源站模式使用带有访问身份/控制和存储桶策略的常规 S3 存储桶源站，而不是公有网站端点。

en.question: A company wants to manage Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). The company currently copies AMIs to the same AWS Region where the AMIs were created. The company needs to design an application that captures AWS API calls and sends alerts whenever the Amazon EC2 CreateImage API operation is called within the company’s account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to query AWS CloudTrail logs and to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected.
options.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail with an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification that occurs when updated logs are sent to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to create a new table and to query on CreateImage when an API call is detected.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for the CreateImage API call. Configure the target as an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an alert when a CreateImage API call is detected.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue as a target for AWS CloudTrail logs. Create an AWS Lambda function to send an alert to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when a CreateImage API call is detected.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon EventBridge is designed for this pattern. AWS documentation states that you can use EventBridge rules to react to AWS API calls recorded by CloudTrail, and the rule can match an EC2 API operation by selecting event type **AWS API Call via CloudTrail** and specifying the operation name (the example uses `StopInstances`; the same pattern applies to `CreateImage`) ([EventBridge tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html)). CloudTrail API-call events are delivered to the default EventBridge event bus as `AWS API Call via CloudTrail` events ([CloudTrail events in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-service-event-cloudtrail.html)). EventBridge rules can target AWS services, including an **Amazon SNS topic**, so an EventBridge rule matching EC2 `CreateImage` can directly publish an alert to SNS with minimal operational overhead ([EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)).

Why the other options are not best:

- **A**: A Lambda function that queries CloudTrail logs would require custom code, scheduling or log-processing logic, and operational maintenance. EventBridge can natively match the API call event and invoke SNS.
- **B**: CloudTrail SNS notifications are sent when log files are written to S3, and the notification contains the S3 log file path, not a direct `CreateImage` alert. Adding Athena tables and queries is unnecessary overhead ([CloudTrail SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/configure-sns-notifications-for-cloudtrail.html)).
- **D**: CloudTrail does not directly send logs to an SQS FIFO queue as described. The documented CloudTrail SNS notification pattern is for notifications about S3 log file delivery, and processing those messages with Lambda adds more operational overhead than an EventBridge rule with an SNS target ([CloudTrail SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/configure-sns-notifications-for-cloudtrail.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司想要管理 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)。该公司目前会将 AMIs 复制到创建这些 AMIs 的同一个 AWS Region。该公司需要设计一个应用程序，用于捕获 AWS API 调用，并在公司账户内调用 Amazon EC2 CreateImage API 操作时发送警报。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来查询 AWS CloudTrail 日志，并在检测到 CreateImage API 调用时发送警报。
options.B: 配置 AWS CloudTrail，使其在更新后的日志发送到 Amazon S3 时触发 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。使用 Amazon Athena 创建一个新表，并在检测到 API 调用时查询 CreateImage。
options.C: 为 CreateImage API 调用创建一个 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 规则。将目标配置为 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便在检测到 CreateImage API 调用时发送警报。
options.D: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列配置为 AWS CloudTrail 日志的目标。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在检测到 CreateImage API 调用时向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发送警报。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon EventBridge 是为这种模式而设计的。AWS 文档说明，你可以使用 EventBridge 规则来响应 CloudTrail 记录的 AWS API 调用，并且该规则可以通过选择事件类型 **AWS API Call via CloudTrail** 并指定操作名称来匹配 EC2 API 操作（示例使用 `StopInstances`；同样的模式也适用于 `CreateImage`）（[EventBridge tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html)）。CloudTrail API 调用事件会作为 `AWS API Call via CloudTrail` 事件传递到默认的 EventBridge 事件总线（[CloudTrail events in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-service-event-cloudtrail.html)）。EventBridge 规则可以将 AWS 服务作为目标，包括 **Amazon SNS topic**，因此匹配 EC2 `CreateImage` 的 EventBridge 规则可以直接向 SNS 发布警报，并且运营开销最小（[EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)）。其他选项不是最佳选择的原因：

- **A**：查询 CloudTrail 日志的 Lambda 函数需要自定义代码、调度或日志处理逻辑，以及运营维护。EventBridge 可以原生匹配该 API 调用事件并调用 SNS。
- **B**：CloudTrail SNS 通知是在日志文件写入 S3 时发送的，通知包含的是 S3 日志文件路径，而不是直接的 `CreateImage` 警报。添加 Athena 表和查询是不必要的开销（[CloudTrail SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/configure-sns-notifications-for-cloudtrail.html)）。
- **D**：CloudTrail 不会像描述的那样直接将日志发送到 SQS FIFO 队列。文档化的 CloudTrail SNS 通知模式是关于 S3 日志文件交付的通知，使用 Lambda 处理这些消息比使用带 SNS 目标的 EventBridge 规则增加了更多运营开销（[CloudTrail SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/configure-sns-notifications-for-cloudtrail.html)）。

en.question: A company owns an asynchronous API that is used to ingest user requests and, based on the request type, dispatch requests to the appropriate microservice for processing. The company is using Amazon API Gateway to deploy the API front end, and an AWS Lambda function that invokes Amazon DynamoDB to store user requests before dispatching them to the processing microservices. The company provisioned as much DynamoDB throughput as its budget allows, but the company is still experiencing availability issues and is losing user requests. What should a solutions architect do to address this issue without impacting existing users?

options.A: Add throttling on the API Gateway with server-side throttling limits.
options.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB.
options.C: Create a secondary index in DynamoDB for the table with the user requests.
options.D: Use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D. Use an Amazon SQS queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB**.

The problem is write-side back pressure: user requests arrive faster than the provisioned DynamoDB write capacity can reliably absorb, causing lost requests. SQS is designed as a durable queue between producers and consumers. Lambda can process messages from SQS: AWS documents that with an SQS event source mapping, **Lambda polls the queue**, invokes the function with batches of messages, and **deletes messages only after the function successfully processes a batch** ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). SQS messages also remain in the queue during processing and are deleted only after processing; if not deleted before the visibility timeout expires, they become visible again for retry ([Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)). This buffers spikes, preserves requests, and lets Lambda write to DynamoDB at a controlled rate without changing the API contract for existing asynchronous users.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Add API Gateway throttling**: Throttling protects APIs from excessive requests, but when limits are exceeded, clients can receive **`429 Too Many Requests`** responses ([API Gateway throttling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-throttling.html)). That impacts existing users and does not inherently preserve their requests.
- **B. Use DAX and Lambda to buffer writes**: DAX is for DynamoDB read acceleration. AWS lists DAX use cases as fast in-memory **read** performance and says DAX is **not ideal for write-intensive applications** ([DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). It is not a write buffer.
- **C. Create a secondary index**: A DynamoDB global secondary index helps with alternate `Query`/`Scan` access patterns, not buffering writes. In fact, index updates consume additional write capacity, and insufficient GSI write capacity can throttle table writes ([GSI throughput considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个异步 API，用于摄取用户请求，并根据请求类型将请求分派到相应的微服务进行处理。该公司正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 部署 API 前端，并使用一个 AWS Lambda 函数调用 Amazon DynamoDB，在将用户请求分派到处理微服务之前先存储这些请求。该公司已经在预算允许的范围内预置了尽可能多的 DynamoDB 吞吐量，但仍然遇到可用性问题，并且正在丢失用户请求。解决方案架构师应如何在不影响现有用户的情况下解决此问题？

options.A: 在 API Gateway 上添加限流，并设置服务器端限流限制。
options.B: 使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 和 Lambda 来缓冲写入 DynamoDB 的操作。
options.C: 在 DynamoDB 中为包含用户请求的表创建一个二级索引。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列和 Lambda 来缓冲写入 DynamoDB 的操作。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D. Use an Amazon SQS queue and Lambda to buffer writes to DynamoDB**。问题在于写入端背压：用户请求到达速度超过了预置的 DynamoDB 写入容量能够可靠吸收的速度，从而导致请求丢失。SQS 被设计为生产者和消费者之间的持久队列。Lambda 可以处理来自 SQS 的消息：AWS 文档说明，使用 SQS 事件源映射时，**Lambda polls the queue**，以消息批次调用函数，并且**仅在函数成功处理一个批次后才删除消息**（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。SQS 消息在处理期间也会保留在队列中，并且仅在处理后才会被删除；如果在可见性超时到期前未被删除，它们会再次变为可见以便重试（[Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)）。这可以缓冲峰值、保留请求，并让 Lambda 以受控速率写入 DynamoDB，而无需更改现有异步用户的 API 契约。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Add API Gateway throttling**：限流可以保护 API 免受过量请求影响，但当超过限制时，客户端可能会收到 **`429 Too Many Requests`** 响应（[API Gateway throttling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-throttling.html)）。这会影响现有用户，并且本身并不能保留他们的请求。
- **B. Use DAX and Lambda to buffer writes**：DAX 用于 DynamoDB 读取加速。AWS 将 DAX 的使用场景列为快速内存中**读取**性能，并说明 DAX **not ideal for write-intensive applications**（[DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。它不是写入缓冲区。
- **C. Create a secondary index**：DynamoDB global secondary index 有助于替代的 `Query`/`Scan` 访问模式，而不是缓冲写入。事实上，索引更新会消耗额外的写入容量，而 GSI 写入容量不足可能会限制表写入（[GSI throughput considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GSI.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to move data from an Amazon EC2 instance to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company must ensure that no API calls and no data are routed through public internet routes. Only the EC2 instance can have access to upload data to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.B: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the Availability Zone where the EC2 instance is located. Attach appropriate security groups to the endpoint. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.C: Run the nslookup tool from inside the EC2 instance to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.
options.D: Use the AWS provided, publicly available ip-ranges.json file to obtain the private IP address of the S3 bucket’s service API endpoint. Create a route in the VPC route table to provide the EC2 instance with access to the S3 bucket. Attach a resource policy to the S3 bucket to only allow the EC2 instance’s IAM role for access.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon S3 supports both **gateway endpoints** and **interface endpoints**. For S3 interface endpoints, AWS states that they use **private IP addresses from your VPC to access Amazon S3**, and that network traffic remains on the AWS network for both S3 endpoint types ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). Creating the interface endpoint in the EC2 instance’s subnet provides private connectivity for S3 API calls and data transfer without using public internet routes. The S3 bucket policy can restrict access to the EC2 instance’s IAM role; AWS documentation confirms endpoint policies specify the IAM principal, actions, and resources, and S3 bucket policies can be used to restrict bucket access ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A gateway endpoint is valid for S3 private connectivity, but this option describes it incorrectly. Gateway endpoints are associated with **route tables**, not an Availability Zone, and AWS automatically adds a route with the service prefix list as the destination and the gateway endpoint as the target ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)). Also, the security configuration for gateway endpoints is on the **instances’ security groups** and subnet network ACLs; you do not attach security groups to the gateway endpoint itself ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).
- **C:** Manually resolving an S3 API endpoint with `nslookup` and creating routes to private IPs is not the supported method. AWS-supported private S3 access is through VPC endpoints: gateway endpoints use AWS-managed prefix lists in route tables, and interface endpoints use private IP addresses from the VPC ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html), [Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).
- **D:** The public `ip-ranges.json` file contains AWS public IP ranges, not private S3 service API endpoint addresses for this purpose. Routing to S3 privately should be implemented with an S3 VPC endpoint, not manual routes to discovered IP ranges ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要将数据从 Amazon EC2 实例移动到 Amazon S3 存储桶。公司必须确保没有 API 调用和数据通过公共互联网路由。只有该 EC2 实例可以访问并将数据上传到 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 EC2 实例所在的子网中为 Amazon S3 创建一个接口 VPC 端点。将资源策略附加到 S3 存储桶，以仅允许 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色进行访问。
options.B: 在 EC2 实例所在的 Availability Zone 中为 Amazon S3 创建一个网关 VPC 端点。将适当的安全组附加到该端点。将资源策略附加到 S3 存储桶，以仅允许 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色进行访问。
options.C: 从 EC2 实例内部运行 nslookup 工具，以获取 S3 存储桶的服务 API 端点的私有 IP 地址。在 VPC 路由表中创建一条路由，为 EC2 实例提供对 S3 存储桶的访问权限。将资源策略附加到 S3 存储桶，以仅允许 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色进行访问。
options.D: 使用 AWS 提供的、公开可用的 ip-ranges.json 文件来获取 S3 存储桶的服务 API 端点的私有 IP 地址。在 VPC 路由表中创建一条路由，为 EC2 实例提供对 S3 存储桶的访问权限。将资源策略附加到 S3 存储桶，以仅允许 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色进行访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon S3 同时支持 **gateway endpoints** 和 **interface endpoints**。对于 S3 interface endpoints，AWS 声明它们使用来自你的 VPC 的 **private IP addresses to access Amazon S3**，并且对于这两种 S3 端点类型，网络流量都保留在 AWS 网络上（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。在 EC2 实例的子网中创建 interface endpoint，可为 S3 API 调用和数据传输提供私有连接，而不使用公共互联网路由。S3 bucket policy 可以将访问限制为 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色；AWS 文档确认 endpoint policies 会指定 IAM 主体、操作和资源，并且 S3 bucket policies 可用于限制存储桶访问（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** gateway endpoint 对 S3 私有连接是有效的，但此选项的描述不正确。Gateway endpoints 与 **route tables** 关联，而不是与某个 Availability Zone 关联，并且 AWS 会自动添加一条路由，以服务前缀列表作为目标地址、以 gateway endpoint 作为目标（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。此外，gateway endpoints 的安全配置位于 **instances’ security groups** 和子网网络 ACL 上；你不会将安全组附加到 gateway endpoint 本身（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。
- **C:** 使用 `nslookup` 手动解析 S3 API 端点并创建到私有 IP 的路由，并不是受支持的方法。AWS 支持的私有 S3 访问是通过 VPC endpoints 实现的：gateway endpoints 在路由表中使用 AWS 管理的前缀列表，而 interface endpoints 使用来自 VPC 的私有 IP 地址（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html), [Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。
- **D:** 公共 `ip-ranges.json` 文件包含 AWS 公共 IP 范围，而不是用于此目的的私有 S3 服务 API 端点地址。私有路由到 S3 应通过 S3 VPC endpoint 实现，而不是手动路由到发现的 IP 范围（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing the architecture of a new application being deployed to the AWS Cloud. The application will run on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances and will automatically scale across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances will scale up and down frequently throughout the day. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) will handle the load distribution. The architecture needs to support distributed session data management. The company is willing to make changes to code if needed. What should the solutions architect do to ensure that the architecture supports distributed session data management?

options.A: Use Amazon ElastiCache to manage and store session data.
options.B: Use session affinity (sticky sessions) of the ALB to manage session data.
options.C: Use Session Manager from AWS Systems Manager to manage the session.
options.D: Use the GetSessionToken API operation in AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to manage the session.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Use Amazon ElastiCache to manage and store session data.**

The application scales frequently across multiple Availability Zones, so session state should not be stored on individual EC2 instances. Amazon ElastiCache is designed to provide a managed, scalable **distributed in-memory data store or cache** and can be deployed with node placement across Availability Zones; ElastiCache Serverless also provides a highly available cache that scales with application usage ([What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)). Its in-memory key-value access is appropriate for frequently accessed data that must be retrieved quickly ([Common ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)). With code changes, the application can store and retrieve session data from ElastiCache instead of local instance memory, supporting distributed session management as instances scale in and out.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. ALB sticky sessions**: Sticky sessions/session affinity bind a user session to a **specific target**, sending that user’s requests to the same target ([ALB sticky sessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)). This does not create a distributed session data store. It can also create uneven load during scale-out, and if a target is deregistered or unhealthy, the load balancer chooses a new target—local session state on the old target would not be available.
- **C. Systems Manager Session Manager**: Session Manager is for administrative connections to managed nodes, such as EC2 instances, using secure bidirectional command sessions and IAM-based access control; it is not for web application user session state ([AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).
- **D. AWS STS GetSessionToken**: `GetSessionToken` retrieves short-term AWS credentials for an IAM identity, often for MFA-protected AWS API access; it is not an application session data store or session management mechanism ([Use GetSessionToken with an AWS SDK or CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/sts_example_sts_GetSessionToken_section.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在设计一个将部署到 AWS Cloud 的新应用程序架构。该应用程序将在 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 上运行，并将在多个 Availability Zones 中自动扩展。EC2 实例将在一天中频繁扩缩容。Application Load Balancer (ALB) 将处理负载分发。该架构需要支持分布式会话数据管理。如果需要，公司愿意更改代码。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来确保该架构支持分布式会话数据管理？

options.A: 使用 Amazon ElastiCache 来管理和存储会话数据。
options.B: 使用 ALB 的会话亲和性（粘性会话）来管理会话数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 中的 Session Manager 来管理会话。
options.D: 使用 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 中的 GetSessionToken API 操作来管理会话。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Use Amazon ElastiCache to manage and store session data.**

该应用程序会在多个 Availability Zones 中频繁扩展，因此会话状态不应存储在单个 EC2 实例上。Amazon ElastiCache 旨在提供托管式、可扩展的 **distributed in-memory data store or cache**，并且可以通过跨 Availability Zones 的节点放置进行部署；ElastiCache Serverless 还提供可随应用程序使用量扩展的高可用缓存（[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。其内存中的键值访问适用于必须快速检索的频繁访问数据（[Common ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)）。通过代码更改，应用程序可以从 ElastiCache 存储和检索会话数据，而不是使用本地实例内存，从而在实例扩缩容时支持分布式会话管理。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. ALB sticky sessions**：粘性会话/会话亲和性会将用户会话绑定到一个 **specific target**，把该用户的请求发送到同一目标（[ALB sticky sessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)）。这并不会创建分布式会话数据存储。它还可能在扩展时造成负载不均，并且如果某个目标被注销或变为不正常，负载均衡器会选择一个新目标——旧目标上的本地会话状态将不可用。
- **C. Systems Manager Session Manager**：Session Manager 用于与托管节点（例如 EC2 实例）建立管理连接，使用安全的双向命令会话和基于 IAM 的访问控制；它不是用于 Web 应用程序用户会话状态（[AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。
- **D. AWS STS GetSessionToken**：`GetSessionToken` 为 IAM 身份检索短期 AWS 凭证，通常用于受 MFA 保护的 AWS API 访问；它不是应用程序会话数据存储或会话管理机制（[Use GetSessionToken with an AWS SDK or CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/sts_example_sts_GetSessionToken_section.html)）。

en.question: A company offers a food delivery service that is growing rapidly. Because of the growth, the company’s order processing system is experiencing scaling problems during peak traffic hours. The current architecture includes the following: • A group of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to collect orders from the application • Another group of EC2 instances that run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to fulfill orders The order collection process occurs quickly, but the order fulfillment process can take longer. Data must not be lost because of a scaling event. A solutions architect must ensure that the order collection process and the order fulfillment process can both scale properly during peak traffic hours. The solution must optimize utilization of the company’s AWS resources. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the CPU of each instance in the Auto Scaling groups. Configure each Auto Scaling group’s minimum capacity according to peak workload values.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the CPU of each instance in the Auto Scaling groups. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that creates additional Auto Scaling groups on demand.
options.C: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues: one for order collection and another for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queue. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on notifications that the queues send.
options.D: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues: one for order collection and another for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queue. Create a metric based on a backlog per instance calculation. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on this metric.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Using separate Amazon SQS queues decouples the fast order collection stage from the slower order fulfillment stage, so messages can wait safely while each worker Auto Scaling group scales independently. AWS specifically recommends scaling an EC2 Auto Scaling group that processes an SQS queue by using a **backlog per instance** metric: calculate queue length from `ApproximateNumberOfMessages` and divide by the number of `InService` instances, then use that value in a target tracking policy ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)). This matches the requirement to scale both processes properly while optimizing utilization. AWS also notes that messages not processed before an instance is terminated are returned to the SQS queue for processing by another instance, helping prevent data loss during scaling events ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Setting each Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to peak workload values would overprovision resources during non-peak periods and does not optimize utilization. CPU also might not reflect queue backlog or processing latency accurately for this workload.
- **B:** Creating additional Auto Scaling groups on demand through SNS is not the standard or efficient way to scale queue-processing workers. Auto Scaling policies should adjust capacity within the existing groups.
- **C:** SQS queues are appropriate, but scaling based merely on queue notifications or raw queue activity is not the recommended approach. AWS warns that SQS queue depth alone, such as `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible`, might not change proportionally with Auto Scaling group size; instead, a custom metric for messages **per EC2 instance** can work for target tracking ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司提供一项正在快速增长的食品配送服务。由于业务增长，该公司的订单处理系统在流量高峰时段遇到了扩展问题。当前架构包括以下内容：• 一组在 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group 中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例，用于从应用程序收集订单 • 另一组在 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group 中运行的 EC2 实例，用于履行订单订单收集过程发生得很快，但订单履行过程可能需要更长时间。数据不得因扩展事件而丢失。解决方案架构师必须确保订单收集过程和订单履行过程都能在流量高峰时段正确扩展。该解决方案必须优化公司 AWS 资源的利用率。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控 Auto Scaling groups 中每个实例的 CPU。根据峰值工作负载值配置每个 Auto Scaling group 的最小容量。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控 Auto Scaling groups 中每个实例的 CPU。配置 CloudWatch 警报以调用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，该主题按需创建额外的 Auto Scaling groups。
options.C: 预置两个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列：一个用于订单收集，另一个用于订单履行。配置 EC2 实例轮询各自的队列。根据队列发送的通知扩展 Auto Scaling groups。
options.D: 预置两个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列：一个用于订单收集，另一个用于订单履行。配置 EC2 实例轮询各自的队列。创建一个基于每个实例积压量计算的指标。根据此指标扩展 Auto Scaling groups。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

使用单独的 Amazon SQS 队列可以将快速的订单收集阶段与较慢的订单履行阶段解耦，因此消息可以安全等待，同时每个工作线程 Auto Scaling group 独立扩展。AWS 明确建议，处理 SQS 队列的 EC2 Auto Scaling group 应使用 **每个实例的积压量** 指标进行扩展：根据 `ApproximateNumberOfMessages` 计算队列长度，并除以 `InService` 实例数量，然后在目标跟踪策略中使用该值（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。这符合在优化利用率的同时正确扩展两个流程的要求。AWS 还指出，如果实例终止前未处理消息，这些消息会返回到 SQS 队列中，由另一个实例处理，从而有助于防止扩展事件期间的数据丢失（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 将每个 Auto Scaling group 的最小容量设置为峰值工作负载值，会在非高峰时段过度预置资源，且不能优化利用率。对于此工作负载，CPU 也可能无法准确反映队列积压量或处理延迟。
- **B:** 通过 SNS 按需创建额外的 Auto Scaling groups 并不是扩展队列处理工作线程的标准或高效方式。Auto Scaling 策略应调整现有组内的容量。
- **C:** SQS 队列是合适的，但仅根据队列通知或原始队列活动进行扩展并不是推荐方法。AWS 警告说，单独的 SQS 队列深度（例如 `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible`）可能不会随 Auto Scaling group 大小成比例变化；相反，用于每个 **EC2 instance** 的消息数的自定义指标可用于目标跟踪（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts multiple production applications. One of the applications consists of resources from Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Amazon RDS, Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS), and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) across multiple AWS Regions. All company resources are tagged with a tag name of “application” and a value that corresponds to each application. A solutions architect must provide the quickest solution for identifying all of the tagged components. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS CloudTrail to generate a list of resources with the application tag.
options.B: Use the AWS CLI to query each service across all Regions to report the tagged components.
options.C: Run a query in Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to report on the components with the application tag.
options.D: Run a query with the AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor to report on the resources globally with the application tag.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Tag Editor is designed for exactly this use case: it lets you build a query to find taggable resources in **one or more AWS Regions**, choose up to 20 resource types or **All resource types**, and filter by a tag key or key-value pair; results are displayed in a resource search results table. Therefore, querying for tag key `application` and the application value is the quickest centralized way to identify the tagged EC2, Lambda, RDS, SNS, and SQS resources across Regions. [AWS Tag Editor documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/tag-editor/latest/userguide/find-resources-to-tag.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudTrail** records actions taken by users, roles, and AWS services as events for auditing, governance, and compliance. It is not a resource inventory/tag search tool, and Event history is a record of management events, not a consolidated current list of all resources with a tag. [AWS CloudTrail documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)
- **B. AWS CLI per service/per Region** could be scripted, but it would require querying multiple services and Regions individually. That is not the quickest solution compared with Tag Editor’s built-in multi-Region, multi-resource-type tag query capability. [AWS Tag Editor documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/tag-editor/latest/userguide/find-resources-to-tag.html)
- **C. CloudWatch Logs Insights** is for interactive queries on **log data**, not for discovering all current AWS resources by tag across services and Regions. [Amazon CloudWatch documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)

zh.question: 一家公司托管多个生产应用程序。其中一个应用程序由跨多个 AWS Regions 的 Amazon EC2、AWS Lambda、Amazon RDS、Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 和 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 资源组成。公司所有资源都使用标签名 “application” 以及与每个应用程序对应的值进行标记。解决方案架构师必须提供最快的解决方案来识别所有已标记的组件。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudTrail 生成带有 application 标签的资源列表。
options.B: 使用 AWS CLI 查询所有 Regions 中的每项服务，以报告已标记的组件。
options.C: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 中运行查询，以报告带有 application 标签的组件。
options.D: 使用 AWS Resource Groups Tag Editor 运行查询，以报告全局范围内带有 application 标签的资源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** AWS Tag Editor 正是为此类用例而设计的：它允许你构建查询，在 **one or more AWS Regions** 中查找可标记资源，选择最多 20 种资源类型或 **All resource types**，并按标签键或键值对进行筛选；结果会显示在资源搜索结果表中。因此，查询标签键 `application` 和对应的应用程序值，是跨 Regions 识别已标记 EC2、Lambda、RDS、SNS 和 SQS 资源的最快集中式方式。[AWS Tag Editor documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/tag-editor/latest/userguide/find-resources-to-tag.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. CloudTrail** 将用户、角色和 AWS 服务执行的操作记录为事件，用于审计、治理和合规。它不是资源清单/标签搜索工具，并且 Event history 是管理事件的记录，而不是所有带有某个标签的资源的集中式当前列表。[AWS CloudTrail documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)
- **B. AWS CLI per service/per Region** 可以通过脚本实现，但需要分别查询多个服务和 Regions。与 Tag Editor 内置的多 Region、多资源类型标签查询能力相比，这不是最快的解决方案。[AWS Tag Editor documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/tag-editor/latest/userguide/find-resources-to-tag.html)
- **C. CloudWatch Logs Insights** 用于对 **log data** 进行交互式查询，而不是用于按标签跨服务和 Regions 发现所有当前 AWS 资源。[Amazon CloudWatch documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)

en.question: A company needs to export its database once a day to Amazon S3 for other teams to access. The exported object size varies between 2 GB and 5 GB. The S3 access pattern for the data is variable and changes rapidly. The data must be immediately available and must remain accessible for up to 3 months. The company needs the most cost-effective solution that will not increase retrieval time. Which S3 storage class should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.B: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
options.C: S3 Standard
options.D: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering is the best fit because the access pattern is explicitly described as **variable and rapidly changing**. AWS states that S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed to optimize storage costs by automatically moving data to the most cost-effective access tier **without performance impact or operational overhead**, and that it is the ideal storage class for data with **unknown or changing access patterns**. AWS also states that there are **no retrieval fees** for S3 Intelligent-Tiering and that its automatic tiers provide low-latency, high-throughput access; objects can move after 30 days of no access to Infrequent Access and after 90 days to Archive Instant Access while maintaining low-latency access in those automatic tiers ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)). The object size is 2–5 GB, well above the 128 KB threshold for Intelligent-Tiering monitoring.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval** — It provides millisecond retrieval, but AWS describes S3 Glacier storage classes as for **low-cost, long-term storage and archiving** and most effective for **rarely accessed data**, with minimum storage durations and retrieval fees. The question says access is variable and changes rapidly, not rarely accessed ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **C. S3 Standard** — S3 Standard is appropriate for frequently accessed, performance-sensitive data, but it does not automatically optimize cost as access patterns change. For unknown/changing access patterns, AWS identifies S3 Intelligent-Tiering as the ideal class ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **D. S3 Standard-IA** — Standard-IA is for **long-lived and infrequently accessed** data and has retrieval fees. Rapidly changing/variable access could make retrieval charges and access assumptions unfavorable; Intelligent-Tiering is specifically designed for this uncertainty ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要每天将其数据库导出一次到 Amazon S3，以供其他团队访问。导出的对象大小在 2 GB 到 5 GB 之间变化。该数据的 S3 访问模式不固定且变化迅速。数据必须立即可用，并且必须保持可访问最长 3 个月。公司需要最具成本效益且不会增加检索时间的解决方案。公司应使用哪种 S3 存储类来满足这些要求？

options.A: S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.B: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval
options.C: S3 Standard
options.D: S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering 最符合要求，因为访问模式被明确描述为**不固定且变化迅速**。AWS 表示，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在通过自动将数据移动到最具成本效益的访问层来优化存储成本，且**不会影响性能，也不会产生运营开销**；它是具有**未知或变化访问模式**的数据的理想存储类。AWS 还表示，S3 Intelligent-Tiering **没有检索费用**，其自动层提供低延迟、高吞吐量访问；对象可在 30 天未访问后移动到 Infrequent Access，并在 90 天后移动到 Archive Instant Access，同时在这些自动层中保持低延迟访问（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)，[How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。对象大小为 2–5 GB，远高于 Intelligent-Tiering 监控的 128 KB 阈值。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval** — 它提供毫秒级检索，但 AWS 将 S3 Glacier 存储类描述为用于**低成本、长期存储和归档**，并且最适合**很少访问的数据**，同时具有最短存储期限和检索费用。题目说访问是不固定且变化迅速的，而不是很少访问（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **C. S3 Standard** — S3 Standard 适用于频繁访问且对性能敏感的数据，但它不会随着访问模式变化自动优化成本。对于未知/变化的访问模式，AWS 将 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 指定为理想类别（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **D. S3 Standard-IA** — Standard-IA 用于**长期且不频繁访问**的数据，并且有检索费用。快速变化/不固定的访问可能会使检索费用和访问假设变得不利；Intelligent-Tiering 专门为这种不确定性而设计（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing a new mobile app. The company must implement proper traffic filtering to protect its Application Load Balancer (ALB) against common application-level attacks, such as cross-site scripting or SQL injection. The company has minimal infrastructure and operational staff. The company needs to reduce its share of the responsibility in managing, updating, and securing servers for its AWS environment. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS WAF rules and associate them with the ALB.
options.B: Deploy the application using Amazon S3 with public hosting enabled.
options.C: Deploy AWS Shield Advanced and add the ALB as a protected resource.
options.D: Create a new ALB that directs traffic to an Amazon EC2 instance running a third-party firewall, which then passes the traffic to the current ALB.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Configure AWS WAF rules and associate them with the ALB.**

AWS WAF is the service designed for this requirement. AWS documentation states that AWS WAF is a web application firewall for HTTP/HTTPS requests and can protect an **Application Load Balancer**. It also explicitly lists protections based on the presence of malicious SQL code (**SQL injection**) and malicious scripts (**cross-site scripting**) in web requests, and supports reusable rules and AWS managed rule groups ([AWS WAF overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)). AWS WAF also has specific rule statement types for XSS, which inspect for malicious scripts in web request components ([XSS rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-xss-match.html)), and SQL injection, which inspects for malicious SQL code in web requests ([SQL injection rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)). Because it is an AWS managed service associated directly with the ALB, it avoids deploying and maintaining firewall servers.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Amazon S3 public hosting** does not protect an ALB and is not a traffic-filtering solution for common web application attacks against the ALB.
- **C. AWS Shield Advanced** is primarily for enhanced **DDoS** protection. AWS documentation describes Shield Advanced as expanded DDoS protection for resources such as Elastic Load Balancing load balancers, with features like application-layer DDoS mitigation and SRT support ([AWS WAF and Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)). The question specifically names application-level attacks such as SQL injection and XSS, which are AWS WAF rule use cases.
- **D. Third-party firewall on EC2** would add servers that the company must manage, update, and secure, which conflicts with the requirement to minimize operational responsibility. AWS WAF provides the needed protection without adding EC2 firewall instances.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一款新的移动应用。该公司必须实施适当的流量过滤，以保护其 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 免受常见应用程序级攻击，例如跨站脚本或 SQL 注入。该公司的基础设施和运维人员都很少。该公司需要减少其在管理、更新和保护 AWS 环境中服务器方面所承担的责任份额。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS WAF 规则并将其与 ALB 关联。
options.B: 使用启用公有托管的 Amazon S3 部署应用程序。
options.C: 部署 AWS Shield Advanced，并将 ALB 添加为受保护资源。
options.D: 创建一个新的 ALB，将流量定向到运行第三方防火墙的 Amazon EC2 实例，然后该防火墙再将流量传递到当前的 ALB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Configure AWS WAF rules and associate them with the ALB.**

AWS WAF 是专为此需求设计的服务。AWS 文档说明，AWS WAF 是用于 HTTP/HTTPS 请求的 Web 应用程序防火墙，并且可以保护 **Application Load Balancer**。它还明确列出了基于 Web 请求中存在恶意 SQL 代码（**SQL injection**）和恶意脚本（**cross-site scripting**）的防护，并支持可重用规则和 AWS 托管规则组（[AWS WAF overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。AWS WAF 还具有针对 XSS 的特定规则语句类型，用于检查 Web 请求组件中的恶意脚本（[XSS rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-xss-match.html)），以及针对 SQL 注入的规则语句类型，用于检查 Web 请求中的恶意 SQL 代码（[SQL injection rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-sqli-match.html)）。由于它是直接与 ALB 关联的 AWS 托管服务，因此可以避免部署和维护防火墙服务器。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Amazon S3 public hosting** 不会保护 ALB，也不是针对 ALB 的常见 Web 应用程序攻击的流量过滤解决方案。
- **C. AWS Shield Advanced** 主要用于增强型 **DDoS** 防护。AWS 文档将 Shield Advanced 描述为面向 Elastic Load Balancing 负载均衡器等资源的扩展 DDoS 防护，并具有应用层 DDoS 缓解和 SRT 支持等功能（[AWS WAF and Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。题目明确提到 SQL 注入和 XSS 等应用程序级攻击，这些是 AWS WAF 规则的使用场景。
- **D. Third-party firewall on EC2** 会增加公司必须管理、更新和保护的服务器，这与最大限度降低运维责任的要求相冲突。AWS WAF 可以在不增加 EC2 防火墙实例的情况下提供所需防护。

en.question: A company’s reporting system delivers hundreds of .csv files to an Amazon S3 bucket each day. The company must convert these files to Apache Parquet format and must store the files in a transformed data bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Create an Amazon EMR cluster with Apache Spark installed. Write a Spark application to transform the data. Use EMR File System (EMRFS) to write files to the transformed data bucket.
options.B: Create an AWS Glue crawler to discover the data. Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to transform the data. Specify the transformed data bucket in the output step.
options.C: Use AWS Batch to create a job definition with Bash syntax to transform the data and output the data to the transformed data bucket. Use the job definition to submit a job. Specify an array job as the job type.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data and output the data to the transformed data bucket. Configure an event notification for the S3 bucket. Specify the Lambda function as the destination for the event notification.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Glue is the best fit and requires the least development effort because it is a **fully managed ETL service** for categorizing, cleaning, enriching, and moving data between data stores. AWS documentation specifically describes using AWS Glue job types to convert data in Amazon S3 to **Apache Parquet** and notes that Glue can run batch ETL jobs in managed environments ([AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/three-aws-glue-etl-job-types-for-converting-data-to-apache-parquet.html)). AWS Glue crawlers can automatically infer schema information and add it to the AWS Glue Data Catalog, including built-in classifiers for common formats such as CSV ([AWS Glue crawlers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-crawler.html)). Glue ETL jobs can then write output to Amazon S3 with `format="parquet"` and an S3 output path ([Using the Parquet format in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-parquet-home.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon EMR with Spark could perform the conversion, but it requires creating and managing a cluster and writing a Spark application. That is more operational and development effort than using AWS Glue’s managed ETL and crawler capabilities.
- **C:** AWS Batch would require custom job logic/scripts to parse CSV, convert to Parquet, and write to S3. It does not provide the built-in data discovery, cataloging, and ETL authoring features that AWS Glue provides.
- **D:** Lambda with S3 notifications could trigger per-file processing, but the company would need to develop and maintain custom transformation code. AWS Glue is designed for ETL pipelines and can automatically generate/assist ETL code through its visual job editor and support scheduled, on-demand, or event-based jobs ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的报告系统每天向一个 Amazon S3 存储桶交付数百个 .csv 文件。该公司必须将这些文件转换为 Apache Parquet 格式，并且必须将文件存储在一个转换后数据存储桶中。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个安装了 Apache Spark 的 Amazon EMR 集群。编写一个 Spark 应用程序来转换数据。使用 EMR File System (EMRFS) 将文件写入转换后数据存储桶。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Glue crawler 来发现数据。创建一个 AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) 作业来转换数据。在输出步骤中指定转换后数据存储桶。
options.C: 使用 AWS Batch 创建一个采用 Bash 语法的作业定义来转换数据，并将数据输出到转换后数据存储桶。使用该作业定义提交作业。将数组作业指定为作业类型。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来转换数据，并将数据输出到转换后数据存储桶。为 S3 存储桶配置事件通知。将 Lambda 函数指定为事件通知的目标。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

AWS Glue 是最合适的选择，并且需要最少的开发工作量，因为它是一项用于在数据存储之间分类、清理、丰富和移动数据的 **fully managed ETL service**。AWS 文档专门描述了使用 AWS Glue 作业类型将 Amazon S3 中的数据转换为 **Apache Parquet**，并指出 Glue 可以在托管环境中运行批处理 ETL 作业（[AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/three-aws-glue-etl-job-types-for-converting-data-to-apache-parquet.html)）。AWS Glue crawlers 可以自动推断架构信息并将其添加到 AWS Glue Data Catalog，包括用于 CSV 等常见格式的内置分类器（[AWS Glue crawlers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-crawler.html)）。然后，Glue ETL 作业可以使用 `format="parquet"` 和 S3 输出路径将输出写入 Amazon S3（[Using the Parquet format in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-parquet-home.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 带 Spark 的 Amazon EMR 可以执行该转换，但它需要创建和管理集群，并编写 Spark 应用程序。与使用 AWS Glue 的托管 ETL 和 crawler 功能相比，这需要更多运营和开发工作量。
- **C:** AWS Batch 需要自定义作业逻辑/脚本来解析 CSV、转换为 Parquet 并写入 S3。它不提供 AWS Glue 所提供的内置数据发现、编目和 ETL 编写功能。
- **D:** 带 S3 通知的 Lambda 可以触发按文件处理，但公司需要开发和维护自定义转换代码。AWS Glue 专为 ETL 管道而设计，可以通过其可视化作业编辑器自动生成/辅助生成 ETL 代码，并支持计划、按需或基于事件的作业（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。

en.question: A company has 700 TB of backup data stored in network attached storage (NAS) in its data center. This backup data need to be accessible for infrequent regulatory requests and must be retained 7 years. The company has decided to migrate this backup data from its data center to AWS. The migration must be complete within 1 month. The company has 500 Mbps of dedicated bandwidth on its public internet connection available for data transfer. What should a solutions architect do to migrate and store the data at the LOWEST cost?

options.A: Order AWS Snowball devices to transfer the data. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.B: Deploy a VPN connection between the data center and Amazon VPC. Use the AWS CLI to copy the data from on premises to Amazon S3 Glacier.
options.C: Provision a 500 Mbps AWS Direct Connect connection and transfer the data to Amazon S3. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data and deploy a DataSync agent on premises. Use the DataSync task to copy files from the on-premises NAS storage to Amazon S3 Glacier.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The 1-month migration requirement makes network transfer infeasible. At 500 Mbps (about 62.5 MB/s), the ideal maximum transfer in 30 days is only about 162 TB, far less than 700 TB, before accounting for protocol overhead or interruptions. AWS Snowball Edge is designed for large-scale data migrations: AWS documentation says to determine how many Snowball Edge devices are needed based on the total data, transfer speed, and number of days, and notes that Snowball Edge devices can have approximately **210 TB** of usable storage, so multiple devices can be ordered and used in parallel for this 700 TB migration ([Snowball Edge large data migration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/LargeDataMigration.html)). After import to S3, an S3 Lifecycle rule can transition objects to lower-cost archival classes ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). S3 Glacier Deep Archive is specifically recommended for data accessed less than once per year, retained for multiple years for compliance, backup, or disaster recovery, and is the **lowest-cost storage option in AWS** ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A VPN over the existing 500 Mbps internet bandwidth cannot transfer 700 TB within 1 month. Also, S3 Glacier Deep Archive is lower cost than S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval for long-term, rarely accessed compliance archives.
- **C:** A 500 Mbps Direct Connect connection has the same bandwidth limitation and therefore still cannot complete the 700 TB transfer in 1 month. It also adds provisioning/connection cost and does not solve the timeline problem.
- **D:** AWS DataSync can transfer data to Amazon S3 storage classes, including S3 Glacier Deep Archive, but it still depends on available network bandwidth; the 500 Mbps link cannot move 700 TB within 1 month. DataSync documentation also highlights storage-class considerations for S3 Glacier Deep Archive, including archive restore requirements and potential charges ([DataSync S3 storage class considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在其数据中心的网络附加存储（NAS）中存储了 700 TB 的备份数据。这些备份数据需要可供不频繁的监管请求访问，并且必须保留 7 年。公司已决定将这些备份数据从其数据中心迁移到 AWS。迁移必须在 1 个月内完成。公司在其公共互联网连接上有 500 Mbps 的专用带宽可用于数据传输。解决方案架构师应如何以最低成本迁移和存储这些数据？

options.A: 订购 AWS Snowball 设备来传输数据。使用生命周期策略将文件转换到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.B: 在数据中心和 Amazon VPC 之间部署 VPN 连接。使用 AWS CLI 将数据从本地复制到 Amazon S3 Glacier。
options.C: 预置 500 Mbps AWS Direct Connect 连接，并将数据传输到 Amazon S3。使用生命周期策略将文件转换到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.D: 使用 AWS DataSync 传输数据，并在本地部署 DataSync 代理。使用 DataSync 任务将文件从本地 NAS 存储复制到 Amazon S3 Glacier。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

1 个月的迁移要求使网络传输不可行。在 500 Mbps（约 62.5 MB/s）下，30 天内的理想最大传输量只有约 162 TB，远低于 700 TB，而且这还未计入协议开销或中断。AWS Snowball Edge 专为大规模数据迁移而设计：AWS 文档说明，应根据总数据量、传输速度和天数确定所需的 Snowball Edge 设备数量，并指出 Snowball Edge 设备可提供约 **210 TB** 的可用存储，因此可以订购多台设备并行使用，以完成这次 700 TB 迁移（[Snowball Edge large data migration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/LargeDataMigration.html)）。导入到 S3 后，S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的归档类（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。S3 Glacier Deep Archive 专门推荐用于每年访问少于一次、因合规、备份或灾难恢复而保留多年的数据，并且是 **AWS 中成本最低的存储选项**（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 通过现有 500 Mbps 互联网带宽建立的 VPN 无法在 1 个月内传输 700 TB。此外，对于长期、很少访问的合规归档，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的成本低于 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。
- **C:** 500 Mbps Direct Connect 连接具有相同的带宽限制，因此仍然无法在 1 个月内完成 700 TB 传输。它还会增加预置/连接成本，并且无法解决时间线问题。
- **D:** AWS DataSync 可以将数据传输到 Amazon S3 存储类，包括 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，但它仍取决于可用网络带宽；500 Mbps 链路无法在 1 个月内移动 700 TB。DataSync 文档还强调了 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的存储类注意事项，包括归档恢复要求和潜在费用（[DataSync S3 storage class considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html)）。

en.question: A company has a serverless website with millions of objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company uses the S3 bucket as the origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company did not set encryption on the S3 bucket before the objects were loaded. A solutions architect needs to enable encryption for all existing objects and for all objects that are added to the S3 bucket in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket. Turn on the default encryption settings for the new S3 bucket. Download all existing objects to temporary local storage. Upload the objects to the new S3 bucket.
options.B: Turn on the default encryption settings for the S3 bucket. Use the S3 Inventory feature to create a .csv file that lists the unencrypted objects. Run an S3 Batch Operations job that uses the copy command to encrypt those objects.
options.C: Create a new encryption key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Change the settings on the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS managed encryption keys (SSE-KMS). Turn on versioning for the S3 bucket.
options.D: Navigate to Amazon S3 in the AWS Management Console. Browse the S3 bucket’s objects. Sort by the encryption field. Select each unencrypted object. Use the Modify button to apply default encryption settings to every unencrypted object in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Turning on S3 default encryption addresses future uploads: AWS documents that after default encryption is enabled, uploads without explicit encryption headers use the bucket’s default encryption settings, but **existing objects are not changed**. AWS also explicitly states that to encrypt existing unencrypted S3 objects, you can use **S3 Batch Operations** with the **Copy** operation to copy objects back to the same bucket as encrypted objects, and that a single Batch Operations job can operate on **billions of objects**. S3 Inventory can produce a CSV inventory list and can include an **Encryption status** field with `NOT-SSE` for objects not encrypted with server-side encryption, which provides the list of objects for the Batch Operations job. Therefore, option B meets both requirements with the least effort. ([Configuring default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html), [Setting default server-side encryption behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html), [S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html), [S3 Batch Operations basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Creating a new bucket and manually downloading/re-uploading millions of objects is unnecessary operational effort. AWS supports encrypting existing objects in place by using S3 Batch Operations Copy back to the same bucket. ([Setting default server-side encryption behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html))
- **C:** Changing the bucket to SSE-KMS would help future uploads, but AWS states that enabling default encryption causes **no change** to objects that already existed in the bucket. Versioning does not encrypt existing objects. ([Configuring default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html))
- **D:** Manually browsing and selecting each unencrypted object is impractical for millions of objects. AWS provides S3 Inventory for object lists and S3 Batch Operations to perform bulk actions across large object sets. ([S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html), [S3 Batch Operations basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html))

zh.question: 一家公司有一个无服务器网站，其中包含 Amazon S3 存储桶中的数百万个对象。该公司将该 S3 存储桶用作 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源。该公司在加载对象之前没有在 S3 存储桶上设置加密。解决方案架构师需要为所有现有对象以及将来添加到 S3 存储桶的所有对象启用加密。哪种解决方案能够以最少的工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 S3 存储桶。为新的 S3 存储桶开启默认加密设置。将所有现有对象下载到临时本地存储。将这些对象上传到新的 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 为该 S3 存储桶开启默认加密设置。使用 S3 Inventory 功能创建一个列出未加密对象的 .csv 文件。运行一个使用 copy 命令来加密这些对象的 S3 Batch Operations 作业。
options.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建一个新的加密密钥。更改 S3 存储桶上的设置，以使用 AWS KMS 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。为该 S3 存储桶开启版本控制。
options.D: 在 AWS Management Console 中导航到 Amazon S3。浏览该 S3 存储桶的对象。按加密字段排序。选择每个未加密对象。使用 Modify 按钮将默认加密设置应用到 S3 存储桶中的每个未加密对象。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

开启 S3 默认加密可以处理未来上传：AWS 文档说明，启用默认加密后，没有显式加密标头的上传会使用存储桶的默认加密设置，但**现有对象不会改变**。AWS 还明确说明，要加密现有未加密的 S3 对象，可以使用 **S3 Batch Operations** 搭配 **Copy** 操作，将对象作为加密对象复制回同一存储桶，并且单个 Batch Operations 作业可以处理**数十亿个对象**。S3 Inventory 可以生成 CSV 清单列表，并且可以包含 **Encryption status** 字段，其中 `NOT-SSE` 表示未使用服务器端加密进行加密的对象，这为 Batch Operations 作业提供了对象列表。因此，选项 B 以最少的工作量满足这两个要求。([Configuring default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html), [Setting default server-side encryption behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html), [S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html), [S3 Batch Operations basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html))

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 创建新存储桶并手动下载/重新上传数百万个对象是不必要的运维工作。AWS 支持使用 S3 Batch Operations Copy 将对象复制回同一存储桶，从而就地加密现有对象。([Setting default server-side encryption behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html))
- **C:** 将存储桶更改为 SSE-KMS 会帮助未来上传，但 AWS 说明启用默认加密对存储桶中已存在的对象**不会产生变化**。版本控制不会加密现有对象。([Configuring default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html))
- **D:** 对于数百万个对象，手动浏览并选择每个未加密对象并不现实。AWS 提供 S3 Inventory 用于对象列表，并提供 S3 Batch Operations 用于跨大型对象集执行批量操作。([S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html), [S3 Batch Operations basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html))

en.question: A company runs a global web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application stores data in Amazon Aurora. The company needs to create a disaster recovery solution and can tolerate up to 30 minutes of downtime and potential data loss. The solution does not need to handle the load when the primary infrastructure is healthy. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application with the required infrastructure elements in place. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora Replica in a second AWS Region.
options.B: Host a scaled-down deployment of the application in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-active failover. Create an Aurora Replica in the second Region.
options.C: Replicate the primary infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-active failover. Create an Aurora database that is restored from the latest snapshot.
options.D: Back up data with AWS Backup. Use the backup to create the required infrastructure in a second AWS Region. Use Amazon Route 53 to configure active-passive failover. Create an Aurora second primary instance in the second Region.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

A 30-minute RTO/RPO target with no need for the secondary Region to serve traffic during normal operation matches an **active/passive pilot-light-style DR** approach: keep the core recovery infrastructure and replicated data ready, then switch traffic during a disaster. AWS describes active/passive DR as an active Region serving traffic and a passive Region used for recovery that does not serve traffic until failover is triggered, and says pilot light replicates data to another Region while keeping core infrastructure available for rapid recovery ([AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)). Route 53 active-passive failover is specifically for a primary resource group with a secondary resource group on standby; Route 53 uses the primary while healthy and the secondary only when the primary is unhealthy ([Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)). For Aurora MySQL, cross-Region Aurora Replicas create a replica of the primary DB cluster in another Region, and an Aurora read replica can be promoted as a data recovery scheme if the source DB cluster fails ([Cross-Region Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aurora-replication-options/cross-region-aurora-replicas.html), [Promoting an Aurora read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Replication.CrossRegion.Promote.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: A scaled-down deployment can be part of warm standby/pilot light, but **active-active** is wrong here. Route 53 active-active is for when all resources are available most of the time and Route 53 can answer with any healthy record, which conflicts with the requirement that the DR solution does not need to handle load while the primary is healthy ([Route 53 active-active failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)).
- **C**: Replicating the full primary infrastructure and using **active-active** is more costly and unnecessary. Also, restoring Aurora from the latest snapshot is a backup/restore approach rather than continuous replication; AWS notes backup/restore requires data and infrastructure restoration at failover time and can increase recovery time ([AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)).
- **D**: AWS Backup-based restore is a backup/restore strategy. AWS documentation states that data stored as backups in the DR Region must be restored at failover and that AWS Backup restore is not scheduled or automatic by default, making it a weaker fit for a 30-minute downtime/data-loss target than having a live Aurora replica ([AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)). The phrase “Aurora second primary instance” is also not the appropriate DR mechanism; the documented approach is to create a read replica and promote it during recovery ([Promoting an Aurora read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Replication.CrossRegion.Promote.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个全球 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将数据存储在 Amazon Aurora 中。公司需要创建一个灾难恢复解决方案，并且可以容忍最多 30 分钟的停机时间和潜在数据丢失。当主基础设施运行状况良好时，该解决方案不需要处理负载。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署应用程序，并使所需的基础设施元素就位。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-被动故障转移。在第二个 AWS Region 中创建 Aurora Replica。
options.B: 在第二个 AWS Region 中托管该应用程序的缩减规模部署。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-主动故障转移。在第二个 Region 中创建 Aurora Replica。
options.C: 在第二个 AWS Region 中复制主基础设施。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-主动故障转移。创建一个从最新快照还原的 Aurora 数据库。
options.D: 使用 AWS Backup 备份数据。使用该备份在第二个 AWS Region 中创建所需的基础设施。使用 Amazon Route 53 配置主动-被动故障转移。在第二个 Region 中创建 Aurora 第二个主实例。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

30 分钟的 RTO/RPO 目标，并且正常运行期间不需要辅助 Region 提供流量服务，这与 **active/passive pilot-light-style DR** 方法相匹配：保持核心恢复基础设施和复制的数据就绪，然后在灾难期间切换流量。AWS 将 active/passive DR 描述为一个 active Region 提供流量服务，而一个 passive Region 用于恢复，在触发故障转移之前不提供流量服务；并说明 pilot light 会将数据复制到另一个 Region，同时保持核心基础设施可用以实现快速恢复（[AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。Route 53 active-passive failover 专门用于具有主资源组和处于待命状态的辅助资源组的场景；Route 53 在主资源健康时使用主资源，只有当主资源不健康时才使用辅助资源（[Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。对于 Aurora MySQL，跨 Region Aurora Replicas 会在另一个 Region 中创建主 DB 集群的副本；如果源 DB 集群发生故障，可以提升 Aurora 只读副本作为数据恢复方案（[Cross-Region Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/aurora-replication-options/cross-region-aurora-replicas.html)，[Promoting an Aurora read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Replication.CrossRegion.Promote.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：缩减规模部署可以是 warm standby/pilot light 的一部分，但这里 **active-active** 是错误的。Route 53 active-active 适用于所有资源在大多数时间都可用，并且 Route 53 可以用任何健康记录应答的情况，这与 DR 解决方案在主基础设施健康时不需要处理负载的要求相冲突（[Route 53 active-active failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。
- **C**：复制完整主基础设施并使用 **active-active** 成本更高且不必要。此外，从最新快照还原 Aurora 是备份/还原方法，而不是连续复制；AWS 指出，备份/还原需要在故障转移时还原数据和基础设施，并可能增加恢复时间（[AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。
- **D**：基于 AWS Backup 的还原是一种备份/还原策略。AWS 文档指出，存储在 DR Region 中的备份数据必须在故障转移时还原，并且 AWS Backup 还原默认不是计划执行或自动执行的，因此与拥有实时 Aurora 副本相比，它不太适合 30 分钟停机/数据丢失目标（[AWS DR options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。短语“Aurora second primary instance”也不是合适的 DR 机制；文档化的方法是创建只读副本并在恢复期间提升它（[Promoting an Aurora read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Replication.CrossRegion.Promote.html)）。

en.question: A company has a web server running on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet with an Elastic IP address. The default security group is assigned to the EC2 instance. The default network ACL has been modified to block all traffic. A solutions architect needs to make the web server accessible from everywhere on port 443. Which combination of steps will accomplish this task? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0.
options.B: Create a security group with a rule to allow TCP port 443 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.C: Update the network ACL to allow TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0.
options.D: Update the network ACL to allow inbound/outbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and to destination 0.0.0.0/0.
options.E: Update the network ACL to allow inbound TCP port 443 from source 0.0.0.0/0 and outbound TCP port 32768-65535 to destination 0.0.0.0/0.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and E**.

- **A is correct** because the instance needs an instance-level security group rule that allows inbound HTTPS. AWS lists the web server security group rule for HTTPS as **TCP port 443** with source **0.0.0.0/0**, which “allows inbound HTTPS access from any IPv4 address” ([AWS EC2 security group web server rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)). Security groups are stateful, so return traffic for allowed inbound traffic is automatically allowed.
- **E is correct** because the modified network ACL currently blocks all traffic. Network ACLs are stateless, so return traffic must be explicitly allowed ([AWS VPC network ACL examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-examples.html)). For an internet client connecting to the web server on port 443, the inbound NACL rule must allow TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0, and the outbound NACL rule must allow responses to the client’s ephemeral ports. AWS documentation notes that ephemeral port ranges vary, and the example range includes **32768-65535**; it also states that, for requests to a web server from internet clients, the network ACL must allow outbound traffic destined for the client ephemeral ports ([AWS VPC ephemeral ports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/custom-network-acl.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect** because security group rules for allowing web access are inbound rules defined by **source** IP, not a rule allowing TCP 443 “to destination 0.0.0.0/0.” An outbound security group rule to destination 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 would not permit inbound HTTPS clients.
- **C is incorrect** because it only allows inbound TCP 443 at the network ACL. Since network ACLs are stateless, outbound response traffic must also be explicitly allowed.
- **D is incorrect** because allowing outbound TCP port 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 does not allow the server’s responses to internet clients. The response packets are destined for the clients’ ephemeral ports, not destination port 443.

zh.question: 一家公司有一台 Web 服务器运行在公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例上，并关联了一个 Elastic IP 地址。该 EC2 实例分配了默认安全组。默认网络 ACL 已被修改为阻止所有流量。解决方案架构师需要使该 Web 服务器能够从任何位置通过端口 443 访问。哪组步骤组合可以完成此任务？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个安全组，其中包含一条允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 端口 443 的规则。
options.B: 创建一个安全组，其中包含一条允许 TCP 端口 443 到目标 0.0.0.0/0 的规则。
options.C: 更新网络 ACL，以允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 端口 443。
options.D: 更新网络 ACL，以允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的入站/出站 TCP 端口 443，并允许到目标 0.0.0.0/0。
options.E: 更新网络 ACL，以允许来自源 0.0.0.0/0 的入站 TCP 端口 443，以及到目标 0.0.0.0/0 的出站 TCP 端口 32768-65535。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A 和 E**。

- **A 正确**，因为该实例需要一个实例级别的安全组规则来允许入站 HTTPS。AWS 将 Web 服务器的 HTTPS 安全组规则列为源为 **0.0.0.0/0** 的 **TCP port 443**，这“允许来自任何 IPv4 地址的入站 HTTPS 访问”([AWS EC2 security group web server rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html))。安全组是有状态的，因此允许的入站流量的返回流量会自动被允许。
- **E 正确**，因为已修改的网络 ACL 当前阻止所有流量。网络 ACL 是无状态的，因此必须显式允许返回流量 ([AWS VPC network ACL examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-examples.html))。对于从互联网客户端连接到 Web 服务器端口 443 的情况，入站 NACL 规则必须允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的 TCP 443，并且出站 NACL 规则必须允许响应发送到客户端的临时端口。AWS 文档指出，临时端口范围会有所不同，示例范围包括 **32768-65535**；文档还说明，对于来自互联网客户端到 Web 服务器的请求，网络 ACL 必须允许目标为客户端临时端口的出站流量 ([AWS VPC ephemeral ports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/custom-network-acl.html))。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确**，因为用于允许 Web 访问的安全组规则是按 **source** IP 定义的入站规则，而不是允许 TCP 443 “到目标 0.0.0.0/0”的规则。到目标 0.0.0.0/0 且端口为 443 的出站安全组规则不会允许入站 HTTPS 客户端。
- **C 不正确**，因为它只在网络 ACL 中允许入站 TCP 443。由于网络 ACL 是无状态的，出站响应流量也必须被显式允许。
- **D 不正确**，因为允许出站 TCP 端口 443 到 0.0.0.0/0 并不能允许服务器对互联网客户端的响应。响应数据包的目标是客户端的临时端口，而不是目标端口 443。

en.question: A company’s application is having performance issues. The application is stateful and needs to complete in-memory tasks on Amazon EC2 instances. The company used AWS CloudFormation to deploy infrastructure and used the M5 EC2 instance family. As traffic increased, the application performance degraded. Users are reporting delays when the users attempt to access the application. Which solution will resolve these issues in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Replace the EC2 instances with T3 EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. Make the changes by using the AWS Management Console.
options.B: Modify the CloudFormation templates to run the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. Increase the desired capacity and the maximum capacity of the Auto Scaling group manually when an increase is necessary.
options.C: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch built-in EC2 memory metrics to track the application performance for future capacity planning.
options.D: Modify the CloudFormation templates. Replace the EC2 instances with R5 EC2 instances. Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to generate custom application latency metrics for future capacity planning.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The workload is **stateful** and performs **in-memory tasks**, so the immediate performance bottleneck is most likely memory capacity/performance rather than simply needing burstable CPU or horizontal scaling. AWS documentation states that **memory optimized instances are designed to deliver fast performance for workloads that process large data sets in memory**, and the R5 family is listed under memory optimized instance families ([EC2 memory optimized instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/mo.html)). Because the infrastructure was deployed with CloudFormation, modifying the templates is operationally efficient and keeps the environment under infrastructure-as-code control; CloudFormation templates describe resources and properties and help track infrastructure changes ([CloudFormation infrastructure management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

Deploying the **CloudWatch agent** is also the right monitoring approach. By default, CloudWatch provides basic EC2 metrics such as `CPUUtilization` and `NetworkIn`; to collect additional metrics, you install and configure the CloudWatch agent ([EC2 custom metrics with CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/install-and-configure-cloudwatch-agent-using-ec2-console.html)). The CloudWatch agent can collect internal system metrics from EC2 instances and retrieve **custom metrics from applications or services** using StatsD or collectd ([CloudWatch agent overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Install-CloudWatch-Agent.html)). It also supports memory metrics such as `mem_used`, `mem_available`, and `mem_used_percent` ([CloudWatch agent metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/metrics-collected-by-CloudWatch-agent.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** T3 instances are burstable general-purpose instances, not the best fit for memory-intensive in-memory processing. Making changes manually in the console is also less operationally efficient than updating the existing CloudFormation templates.
- **B:** Adding an Auto Scaling group with manual capacity increases does not directly address memory pressure on stateful in-memory tasks, and manual scaling is not the most operationally efficient approach.
- **C:** Replacing M5 with R5 is appropriate, but the option is wrong because EC2 does **not** provide built-in memory metrics by default.
