AWS documentation says default EC2 CloudWatch monitoring includes basic metrics like CPU and network, and additional metrics require the CloudWatch agent ([EC2 custom metrics with CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/install-and-configure-cloudwatch-agent-using-ec2-console.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序出现性能问题。该应用程序是有状态的，并且需要在 Amazon EC2 实例上完成内存中任务。该公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署基础设施，并使用了 M5 EC2 实例系列。随着流量增加，应用程序性能下降。用户报告称，当用户尝试访问该应用程序时会出现延迟。哪种解决方案将以最具运营效率的方式解决这些问题？

options.A: 将 EC2 实例替换为在 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 T3 EC2 实例。使用 AWS Management Console 进行这些更改。
options.B: 修改 CloudFormation 模板，使 EC2 实例在 Auto Scaling 组中运行。在需要增加容量时，手动增加 Auto Scaling 组的所需容量和最大容量。
options.C: 修改 CloudFormation 模板。将 EC2 实例替换为 R5 EC2 实例。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 内置的 EC2 内存指标来跟踪应用程序性能，以便进行未来的容量规划。
options.D: 修改 CloudFormation 模板。将 EC2 实例替换为 R5 EC2 实例。在 EC2 实例上部署 Amazon CloudWatch agent，以生成自定义应用程序延迟指标，用于未来的容量规划。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

该工作负载是 **stateful** 的，并执行 **in-memory tasks**，因此直接的性能瓶颈最可能是内存容量/性能，而不是单纯需要可突增 CPU 或水平扩展。AWS 文档说明，**memory optimized instances are designed to deliver fast performance for workloads that process large data sets in memory**，并且 R5 系列被列在内存优化实例系列下（[EC2 memory optimized instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/instancetypes/mo.html)）。由于基础设施是使用 CloudFormation 部署的，修改模板在运营上是高效的，并可让环境保持在基础设施即代码的控制之下；CloudFormation 模板描述资源和属性，并有助于跟踪基础设施变更（[CloudFormation infrastructure management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。部署 **CloudWatch agent** 也是正确的监控方法。默认情况下，CloudWatch 提供基本 EC2 指标，例如 `CPUUtilization` 和 `NetworkIn`；要收集其他指标，需要安装并配置 CloudWatch agent（[EC2 custom metrics with CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/install-and-configure-cloudwatch-agent-using-ec2-console.html)）。CloudWatch agent 可以从 EC2 实例收集内部系统指标，并使用 StatsD 或 collectd 从应用程序或服务检索 **custom metrics**（[CloudWatch agent overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Install-CloudWatch-Agent.html)）。它还支持内存指标，例如 `mem_used`、`mem_available` 和 `mem_used_percent`（[CloudWatch agent metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/metrics-collected-by-CloudWatch-agent.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** T3 实例是可突增通用实例，并不是内存密集型内存中处理的最佳选择。在控制台中手动进行更改，也不如更新现有 CloudFormation 模板那样具有运营效率。
- **B:** 添加 Auto Scaling 组并手动增加容量，不能直接解决有状态内存中任务的内存压力，而且手动扩展也不是最具运营效率的方法。
- **C:** 将 M5 替换为 R5 是合适的，但该选项错误，因为 EC2 默认**不**提供内置内存指标。AWS 文档说明，默认 EC2 CloudWatch 监控包含 CPU 和网络等基本指标，其他指标需要 CloudWatch agent（[EC2 custom metrics with CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/install-and-configure-cloudwatch-agent-using-ec2-console.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a new API using Amazon API Gateway that will receive requests from users. The volume of requests is highly variable; several hours can pass without receiving a single request. The data processing will take place asynchronously, but should be completed within a few seconds after a request is made. Which compute service should the solutions architect have the API invoke to deliver the requirements at the lowest cost?

options.A: An AWS Glue job
options.B: An AWS Lambda function
options.C: A containerized service hosted in Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)
options.D: A containerized service hosted in Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. An AWS Lambda function**

Lambda is the best fit for a highly variable, intermittent API workload at the lowest cost. AWS describes Lambda as a compute service that runs code without managing servers; code “scal[es] up and down automatically” with “pay-per-use pricing,” and Lambda is suitable for web applications and API backends ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). API Gateway can directly route HTTP requests to Lambda functions; AWS states that API Gateway provides web APIs that route HTTP requests to Lambda functions ([Invoking a Lambda function using an Amazon API Gateway endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)). Lambda also automatically scales execution environments as requests increase ([Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)), so it handles traffic bursts without paying for always-running compute during idle hours.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Glue job** — Glue jobs are for ETL/data integration. AWS Glue streaming ETL jobs run continuously, process data in default 100-second windows, and are billed hourly while running ([Streaming ETL jobs in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-job-streaming.html)). That does not match “complete within a few seconds” or “lowest cost” for hours with no requests.
- **C. Containerized service on Amazon EKS** — EKS is a managed Kubernetes service for running Kubernetes clusters, and EKS pricing includes per-cluster pricing plus separate charges for worker-node resources used to run applications ([What is Amazon EKS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)). This is more operationally complex and less cost-efficient than event-driven Lambda for sporadic API invocations.
- **D. Containerized service on Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2** — ECS on EC2 requires EC2 instance capacity registered to the cluster, with cluster auto scaling managing EC2 instances through Auto Scaling groups and scaling policies ([Automatically manage Amazon ECS capacity with cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html)). EC2-backed capacity is not as cost-effective as Lambda’s pay-per-use model for workloads that can be idle for hours.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计一个新的 API，该 API 将接收来自用户的请求。请求量高度可变；可能连续几个小时都收不到一个请求。数据处理将异步进行，但应在发出请求后的几秒内完成。为了以最低成本满足这些要求，解决方案架构师应让该 API 调用哪种计算服务？

options.A: 一个 AWS Glue 作业
options.B: 一个 AWS Lambda 函数
options.C: 托管在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 中的容器化服务
options.D: 托管在 Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2 中的容器化服务

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 一个 AWS Lambda 函数**

Lambda 最适合以最低成本处理高度可变、间歇性的 API 工作负载。AWS 将 Lambda 描述为一种无需管理服务器即可运行代码的计算服务；代码会“自动扩展和缩减”，采用“按使用量付费定价”，并且 Lambda 适用于 Web 应用程序和 API 后端（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。API Gateway 可以将 HTTP 请求直接路由到 Lambda 函数；AWS 表示，API Gateway 提供可将 HTTP 请求路由到 Lambda 函数的 Web API（[Invoking a Lambda function using an Amazon API Gateway endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)）。随着请求增加，Lambda 还会自动扩展执行环境（[Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)），因此它可以处理流量突增，而无需在空闲时间为始终运行的计算资源付费。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Glue job** — Glue 作业用于 ETL/数据集成。AWS Glue 流式 ETL 作业会持续运行，在默认 100 秒窗口内处理数据，并在运行期间按小时计费（[Streaming ETL jobs in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-job-streaming.html)）。这不符合“在几秒内完成”或在数小时无请求时“最低成本”的要求。
- **C. Containerized service on Amazon EKS** — EKS 是用于运行 Kubernetes 集群的托管 Kubernetes 服务，EKS 定价包括按集群计价以及用于运行应用程序的工作节点资源的单独费用（[What is Amazon EKS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)）。与用于零星 API 调用的事件驱动 Lambda 相比，这在运维上更复杂且成本效率更低。
- **D. Containerized service on Amazon ECS with Amazon EC2** — ECS on EC2 需要向集群注册 EC2 实例容量，并通过 Auto Scaling groups 和扩展策略由集群自动扩展来管理 EC2 实例（[Automatically manage Amazon ECS capacity with cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html)）。对于可能空闲数小时的工作负载，基于 EC2 的容量不如 Lambda 的按使用量付费模型具有成本效益。

en.question: A company runs an application on a group of Amazon Linux EC2 instances. For compliance reasons, the company must retain all application log files for 7 years. The log files will be analyzed by a reporting tool that must be able to access all the files concurrently. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store
options.D: Amazon S3

en.explanation:
**Answer: D. Amazon S3**

Amazon S3 is the most cost-effective fit for retaining application logs for 7 years while allowing a reporting tool to read many files concurrently. AWS documents S3 storage classes for long-term retention and archiving: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval, Flexible Retrieval, and Deep Archive are “designed for low-cost, long-term data storage and data archiving,” and S3 Standard/IA classes provide millisecond access with 99.999999999% designed durability depending on access needs ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). S3 also supports high concurrent access patterns: it automatically scales to high request rates, including at least 5,500 GET/HEAD requests per second per partitioned prefix, and performance can be increased through parallelization ([S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)).

Why the other options are not best:

- **A. Amazon EBS**: EBS is block storage for EC2. Although EBS Multi-Attach exists, AWS limits it to Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes and up to 16 Nitro instances in the same Availability Zone; standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)). This is not the most cost-effective long-term log archive.
- **B. Amazon EFS**: EFS can be accessed by multiple EC2 instances; AWS shows multiple EC2 instances accessing an EFS file system ([EFS with EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). However, for 7-year log retention, S3’s low-cost long-term storage classes are a better cost-optimized archive solution.
- **C. Amazon EC2 instance store**: Instance store is ephemeral. AWS states it exists only for the lifetime of the associated instance, data does not persist after stop/hibernate/terminate, and you should not rely on it for valuable long-term data ([instance store persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在一组 Amazon Linux EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。出于合规原因，该公司必须将所有应用程序日志文件保留 7 年。这些日志文件将由一个报告工具进行分析，该工具必须能够并发访问所有文件。哪种存储解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.C: Amazon EC2 instance store
options.D: Amazon S3

zh.explanation:
**答案：D. Amazon S3**

Amazon S3 是保留应用程序日志 7 年并允许报告工具并发读取大量文件的最具成本效益的选择。AWS 文档说明了用于长期保留和归档的 S3 存储类：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval、Flexible Retrieval 和 Deep Archive “专为低成本、长期数据存储和数据归档而设计”，而 S3 Standard/IA 类则根据访问需求提供毫秒级访问和 99.999999999% 的设计耐久性（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。S3 还支持高并发访问模式：它会自动扩展到高请求速率，包括每个分区前缀每秒至少 5,500 个 GET/HEAD 请求，并且可以通过并行化提高性能（[S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)）。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A. Amazon EBS**：EBS 是用于 EC2 的块存储。虽然存在 EBS Multi-Attach，但 AWS 将其限制为 Provisioned IOPS SSD 卷，并且最多只能连接同一 Availability Zone 中的 16 个 Nitro 实例；XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多台服务器同时访问而设计（[EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。这不是最具成本效益的长期日志归档方案。
- **B. Amazon EFS**：EFS 可以由多个 EC2 实例访问；AWS 展示了多个 EC2 实例访问一个 EFS 文件系统的情况（[EFS with EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。但是，对于 7 年日志保留，S3 的低成本长期存储类是成本优化更好的归档解决方案。
- **C. Amazon EC2 instance store**：Instance store 是临时性的。AWS 声明它仅在关联实例的生命周期内存在，数据在 stop/hibernate/terminate 后不会持久保留，并且不应依赖它来保存有价值的长期数据（[instance store persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)）。

en.question: A company has hired an external vendor to perform work in the company’s AWS account. The vendor uses an automated tool that is hosted in an AWS account that the vendor owns. The vendor does not have IAM access to the company’s AWS account. How should a solutions architect grant this access to the vendor?

options.A: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendor’s IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.B: Create an IAM user in the company’s account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.C: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the tool’s IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.D: Create a new identity provider by choosing “AWS account” as the provider type in the IAM console. Supply the vendor’s AWS account ID and user name. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the new provider for the permissions that the vendor requires.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The vendor's tool runs in the vendor's AWS account and needs access to resources in the company's AWS account. AWS documentation describes this as cross-account delegation: create an IAM role in the resource-owning/trusting account, attach a permissions policy for the needed actions, and configure a trust policy that allows the trusted account/principal to assume the role. AWS also states that roles are the primary way to grant cross-account access and that roles provide temporary credentials instead of long-term passwords or access keys ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)). The cross-account roles tutorial similarly says this approach avoids creating individual IAM users in each account and lets the other account access resources by assuming the role ([Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** Creating an IAM user in the company's account gives the vendor long-term credentials in the company account. AWS recommends temporary credentials with IAM roles for workloads running on AWS and says there is no need to distribute long-lived IAM user credentials to workloads running on AWS ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **C:** IAM groups are for managing permissions for IAM users in an account; this does not create a cross-account trust relationship and you cannot simply add the vendor account's IAM user/tool identity to a group in the company's account. Cross-account delegation is done by creating a role in the trusting account with trust and permissions policies ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)).
- **D:** An identity provider is for federating external identities, such as SAML or OIDC identities. The scenario involves a principal in another AWS account, for which AWS documents cross-account IAM roles and `AssumeRole`, not creating an IdP for an AWS account ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司聘请了一家外部供应商在公司的 AWS 账户中执行工作。该供应商使用一个自动化工具，该工具托管在供应商拥有的 AWS 账户中。供应商没有对公司 AWS 账户的 IAM 访问权限。解决方案架构师应如何向供应商授予此访问权限？

options.A: 在公司的账户中创建一个 IAM role，以将访问权限委托给供应商的 IAM role。将适当的 IAM policies 附加到该 role，以授予供应商所需的权限。
options.B: 在公司的账户中创建一个 IAM user，并设置一个满足密码复杂性要求的密码。将适当的 IAM policies 附加到该 user，以授予供应商所需的权限。
options.C: 在公司的账户中创建一个 IAM group。将供应商账户中该工具的 IAM user 添加到该 group。将适当的 IAM policies 附加到该 group，以授予供应商所需的权限。
options.D: 在 IAM console 中选择“AWS account”作为提供商类型，创建一个新的身份提供商。提供供应商的 AWS 账户 ID 和用户名。将适当的 IAM policies 附加到新的提供商，以授予供应商所需的权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

供应商的工具在供应商的 AWS 账户中运行，并且需要访问公司 AWS 账户中的资源。AWS 文档将此描述为跨账户委托：在拥有资源/信任方账户中创建 IAM role，附加一个用于所需操作的权限策略，并配置一个信任策略，允许受信任的账户/主体代入该 role。AWS 还说明，roles 是授予跨账户访问权限的主要方式，并且 roles 提供临时凭证，而不是长期密码或访问密钥（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)）。跨账户 roles 教程同样说明，这种方法避免了在每个账户中创建单独的 IAM users，并允许其他账户通过代入该 role 来访问资源（[Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B:** 在公司的账户中创建 IAM user 会向供应商提供公司账户中的长期凭证。AWS 建议对在 AWS 上运行的工作负载使用带 IAM roles 的临时凭证，并说明无需向在 AWS 上运行的工作负载分发长期存在的 IAM user 凭证（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **C:** IAM groups 用于管理账户中 IAM users 的权限；这不会创建跨账户信任关系，并且你不能简单地将供应商账户的 IAM user/工具身份添加到公司账户中的 group。跨账户委托是通过在信任方账户中创建带有信任策略和权限策略的 role 来完成的（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)）。
- **D:** 身份提供商用于联合外部身份，例如 SAML 或 OIDC 身份。该场景涉及另一个 AWS 账户中的主体；对此，AWS 记录的是跨账户 IAM roles 和 `AssumeRole`，而不是为 AWS 账户创建 IdP（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)）。

en.question: A company has deployed a Java Spring Boot application as a pod that runs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) in private subnets. The application needs to write data to an Amazon DynamoDB table. A solutions architect must ensure that the application can interact with the DynamoDB table without exposing traffic to the internet. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)

options.A: Attach an IAM role that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod.
options.B: Attach an IAM user that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod.
options.C: Allow outbound connectivity to the DynamoDB table through the private subnets’ network ACLs.
options.D: Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.
options.E: Embed the access keys in the Java Spring Boot code.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and D**.

- **A. Attach an IAM role that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod** — The pod needs AWS credentials/permissions to call DynamoDB write APIs. Amazon EKS Pod Identity lets you associate an IAM role with a Kubernetes service account so pods using that service account receive credentials for AWS service access; AWS notes this avoids creating and distributing AWS credentials to containers and supports least-privilege permissions per service account ([Amazon EKS Pod Identity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-identities.html)). IAM best practices also state that workloads should use temporary credentials with IAM roles rather than long-lived IAM user credentials ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **D. Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB** — To keep traffic off the internet, create a DynamoDB VPC endpoint. AWS states that DynamoDB can be accessed from a VPC using gateway VPC endpoints, and with a gateway endpoint you can access DynamoDB from the VPC **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device** ([Gateway endpoints for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-ddb.html)). DynamoDB also supports gateway and interface VPC endpoints for access over the AWS network/private connectivity ([AWS PrivateLink for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B** is wrong because an IAM user provides long-term credentials; for workloads running on AWS, AWS recommends using IAM roles and temporary credentials instead of distributing long-lived IAM user credentials ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **C** is not sufficient. Network ACLs may need to allow traffic, but they do not provide a private route to DynamoDB or eliminate the need for internet/NAT connectivity. The private connectivity requirement is met by a DynamoDB VPC endpoint ([Gateway endpoints for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-ddb.html)).
- **E** is wrong because embedding access keys in application code creates long-lived credential distribution risk; AWS recommends temporary credentials with IAM roles where possible ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司已将一个 Java Spring Boot 应用程序部署为在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上运行的 pod。该应用程序需要向 Amazon DynamoDB 表写入数据。解决方案架构师必须确保该应用程序可以与 DynamoDB 表交互，而不会将流量暴露到互联网。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来实现此目标？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将具有足够权限的 IAM 角色附加到 EKS pod。
options.B: 将具有足够权限的 IAM 用户附加到 EKS pod。
options.C: 通过私有子网的网络 ACL 允许到 DynamoDB 表的出站连接。
options.D: 为 DynamoDB 创建 VPC 端点。
options.E: 将访问密钥嵌入 Java Spring Boot 代码中。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A and D**。

- **A. Attach an IAM role that has sufficient privileges to the EKS pod** — 该 pod 需要 AWS 凭证/权限来调用 DynamoDB 写入 API。Amazon EKS Pod Identity 允许你将 IAM 角色与 Kubernetes 服务账户关联，使使用该服务账户的 pod 能够接收用于 AWS 服务访问的凭证；AWS 指出，这可以避免创建和分发 AWS 凭证到容器，并支持按服务账户实施最低权限权限（[Amazon EKS Pod Identity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-identities.html)）。IAM 最佳实践还指出，工作负载应使用带有 IAM 角色的临时凭证，而不是长期有效的 IAM 用户凭证（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **D. Create a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB** — 为了使流量不经过互联网，请创建 DynamoDB VPC 端点。AWS 说明，可以使用网关 VPC 端点从 VPC 访问 DynamoDB，并且借助网关端点，你可以从 VPC 访问 DynamoDB，**无需互联网网关或 NAT 设备**（[Gateway endpoints for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-ddb.html)）。DynamoDB 还支持网关和接口 VPC 端点，以便通过 AWS 网络/私有连接进行访问（[AWS PrivateLink for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B** 错误，因为 IAM 用户提供长期凭证；对于在 AWS 上运行的工作负载，AWS 建议使用 IAM 角色和临时凭证，而不是分发长期有效的 IAM 用户凭证（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **C** 不充分。Network ACL 可能需要允许流量，但它们不会提供到 DynamoDB 的私有路由，也不会消除对互联网/NAT 连接的需求。私有连接要求通过 DynamoDB VPC 端点来满足（[Gateway endpoints for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-ddb.html)）。
- **E** 错误，因为将访问密钥嵌入应用程序代码中会带来长期凭证分发风险；AWS 建议尽可能使用带有 IAM 角色的临时凭证（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

en.question: A company recently migrated its web application to AWS by rehosting the application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The company wants to redesign its application architecture to be highly available and fault tolerant. Traffic must reach all running EC2 instances randomly. Which combination of steps should the company take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy.
options.B: Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy.
options.C: Create an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy.
options.D: Launch three EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and one instance in another Availability Zone.
options.E: Launch four EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and two instances in another Availability Zone.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **C and E**.

- **C. Create an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy**: Route 53 multivalue answer routing is designed to return multiple healthy records, such as IP addresses for web servers. AWS states that it can be used “to route traffic approximately randomly to multiple resources” and that Route 53 gives different answers to different DNS resolvers. The routing policy summary also says multivalue answer routing returns up to eight healthy records “selected at random” ([Multivalue answer routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html), [Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)). This matches the requirement that traffic reach all running EC2 instances randomly.
- **E. Launch four EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and two instances in another Availability Zone**: Deploying instances across multiple Availability Zones protects the application from the failure of a single location in the Region. AWS says launching EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones can protect applications from a single-location failure, and if an instance fails, another Availability Zone can handle requests ([Regions and Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-regions-availability-zones.html)). Using two instances in each of two AZs provides a balanced, fault-tolerant deployment across AZs.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Route 53 failover routing policy** is for **active-passive failover**, not random distribution to all running instances. AWS describes failover routing as the policy to use when configuring active-passive failover ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)).
- **B. Route 53 weighted routing policy** routes traffic to resources in **proportions that you specify**, not by returning randomly selected healthy records as required here ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)).
- **D. Three EC2 instances with two in one AZ and one in another AZ** does span multiple AZs, but it is unbalanced. If the AZ with two instances fails, only one instance remains; if the AZ with one instance fails, two remain. Option E provides a more even and fault-tolerant deployment across Availability Zones.

zh.question: 一家公司最近通过在单个 AWS Region 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上重新托管应用程序，将其 Web 应用程序迁移到了 AWS。该公司希望重新设计其应用程序架构，使其具备高可用性和容错能力。流量必须随机到达所有正在运行的 EC2 实例。该公司应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建 Amazon Route 53 故障转移路由策略。
options.B: 创建 Amazon Route 53 加权路由策略。
options.C: 创建 Amazon Route 53 多值应答路由策略。
options.D: 启动三个 EC2 实例：两个实例位于一个 Availability Zone，另一个实例位于另一个 Availability Zone。
options.E: 启动四个 EC2 实例：两个实例位于一个 Availability Zone，另外两个实例位于另一个 Availability Zone。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C 和 E**。

- **C. Create an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy**：Route 53 multivalue answer routing 旨在返回多条健康记录，例如 Web 服务器的 IP 地址。AWS 表示，它可用于“to route traffic approximately randomly to multiple resources”，并且 Route 53 会向不同的 DNS 解析器给出不同的答案。路由策略摘要还说明，multivalue answer routing 会返回最多八条“selected at random”的健康记录（[Multivalue answer routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)，[Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。这符合流量随机到达所有正在运行的 EC2 实例的要求。
- **E. Launch four EC2 instances: two instances in one Availability Zone and two instances in another Availability Zone**：跨多个 Availability Zones 部署实例可保护应用程序免受 Region 中单个位置故障的影响。AWS 表示，在多个 Availability Zones 中启动 EC2 实例可以保护应用程序免受单个位置故障的影响，并且如果一个实例发生故障，另一个 Availability Zone 可以处理请求（[Regions and Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-regions-availability-zones.html)）。在两个 AZ 中各使用两个实例，可提供跨 AZ 的均衡且具备容错能力的部署。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Route 53 failover routing policy** 用于 **active-passive failover**，而不是将流量随机分配到所有正在运行的实例。AWS 将 failover routing 描述为配置 active-passive failover 时使用的策略（[Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。
- **B. Route 53 weighted routing policy** 会按**你指定的比例**将流量路由到资源，而不是按此处要求返回随机选择的健康记录（[Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。
- **D. Three EC2 instances with two in one AZ and one in another AZ** 确实跨越多个 AZ，但它是不平衡的。如果有两个实例的 AZ 发生故障，只剩下一个实例；如果有一个实例的 AZ 发生故障，则剩下两个实例。选项 E 在 Availability Zones 之间提供了更均衡且更具容错能力的部署。

en.question: A media company collects and analyzes user activity data on premises. The company wants to migrate this capability to AWS. The user activity data store will continue to grow and will be petabytes in size. The company needs to build a highly available data ingestion solution that facilitates on-demand analytics of existing data and new data with SQL. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Send activity data to an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the stream to deliver the data to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.C: Place activity data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon S3 to run an AWS Lambda function on the data as the data arrives in the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an ingestion service on Amazon EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Configure the service to forward data to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon Data Firehose is the best fit for least operational overhead because AWS describes it as a **fully managed** service for delivering real-time streaming data to destinations including **Amazon Redshift**; AWS also states that with Firehose, you do not need to write applications or manage resources and it automatically delivers data to the configured destination ([Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)). For Redshift destinations, Firehose stages data in S3 and then issues an Amazon Redshift **COPY** command to load the data into Redshift ([Firehose Redshift data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html); [Configure destination settings for Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)). Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, **petabyte-scale** data warehouse and supports familiar SQL-based analytics regardless of dataset size ([Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). This directly meets the requirements for highly available managed ingestion, petabyte scale, and SQL analytics.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Kinesis Data Streams is an ingestion stream, but a stream is made of shards and, in provisioned mode, shard count must be specified and adjusted; consumers/applications process stream records, and such applications commonly run on EC2 instances ([Kinesis Data Streams concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)). This adds operational work and does not by itself provide the SQL analytics data warehouse capability.
- **C:** S3 event notifications can invoke Lambda when objects arrive ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)), but this option does not include a SQL analytics engine or data warehouse. Lambda processing on arrival is not an on-demand SQL analytics solution for petabyte-scale data.
- **D:** Building an ingestion service on EC2 creates the highest operational overhead. Amazon RDS Multi-AZ is for relational database high availability, not a petabyte-scale analytics warehouse, whereas Redshift is explicitly the petabyte-scale SQL data warehouse service ([Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家媒体公司在本地收集并分析用户活动数据。该公司希望将此能力迁移到 AWS。用户活动数据存储将持续增长，并将达到 PB 级规模。该公司需要构建一个高可用的数据摄取解决方案，以便使用 SQL 对现有数据和新数据进行按需分析。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将活动数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis data stream。配置该流将数据传送到 Amazon S3 bucket。
options.B: 将活动数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream。配置该流将数据传送到 Amazon Redshift cluster。
options.C: 将活动数据放入 Amazon S3 bucket。配置 Amazon S3 在数据到达 S3 bucket 时对数据运行 AWS Lambda function。
options.D: 在分布于多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 instances 上创建摄取服务。配置该服务将数据转发到 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ database。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

Amazon Data Firehose 最适合实现最少运营开销，因为 AWS 将其描述为一项**完全托管**的服务，用于将实时流式数据传送到包括 **Amazon Redshift** 在内的目的地；AWS 还说明，使用 Firehose 时，你无需编写应用程序或管理资源，它会自动将数据传送到配置的目的地（[Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。对于 Redshift 目的地，Firehose 会先将数据暂存到 S3，然后发出 Amazon Redshift **COPY** 命令将数据加载到 Redshift（[Firehose Redshift data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)；[Configure destination settings for Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。Amazon Redshift 是完全托管的 **petabyte-scale** 数据仓库，并且无论数据集大小如何，都支持熟悉的基于 SQL 的分析（[Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。这直接满足了高可用托管摄取、PB 级规模和 SQL 分析的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Kinesis Data Streams 是一种摄取流，但一个流由 shards 组成，并且在 provisioned mode 下，必须指定并调整 shard 数量；consumers/applications 处理流记录，而此类应用程序通常运行在 EC2 instances 上（[Kinesis Data Streams concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)）。这增加了运营工作量，并且其本身不提供 SQL 分析数据仓库能力。
- **C:** S3 event notifications 可以在对象到达时调用 Lambda（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)），但此选项不包括 SQL 分析引擎或数据仓库。在对象到达时进行 Lambda 处理并不是适用于 PB 级数据的按需 SQL 分析解决方案。
- **D:** 在 EC2 上构建摄取服务会产生最高的运营开销。Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 用于关系数据库高可用性，而不是 PB 级分析仓库；相比之下，Redshift 被明确定位为 PB 级 SQL 数据仓库服务（[Amazon Redshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company collects data from thousands of remote devices by using a RESTful web services application that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance receives the raw data, transforms the raw data, and stores all the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The number of remote devices will increase into the millions soon. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Glue to process the raw data in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to different EC2 instances.
options.C: Add more EC2 instances to accommodate the increasing amount of incoming data.
options.D: Send the raw data to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Use EC2 instances to process the data.
options.E: Use Amazon API Gateway to send the raw data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to use the data stream as a source to deliver the data to Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and E**.

- **E is correct** because the ingestion tier should be managed and scalable instead of a single EC2-based REST service. AWS documentation shows that API Gateway can create a **REST API** integrated with Kinesis and expose methods that invoke Kinesis `PutRecord`/`PutRecords`, enabling clients to write records into a Kinesis stream ([API Gateway Kinesis proxy tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/integrating-api-with-aws-services-kinesis.html)). Amazon Data Firehose can then use a **Kinesis data stream as the source** ([Firehose source settings for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-kinesis-streams.html)) and can deliver streaming data to an **Amazon S3 bucket** as its destination ([Firehose destination settings for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)). This removes the EC2 ingestion bottleneck and reduces operations.
- **A is correct** because after raw data lands in S3, AWS Glue is appropriate for transformation. AWS Glue is a **serverless** data integration service with ETL, cleansing, and transforming capabilities, with no infrastructure to manage and scaling on demand ([What is AWS Glue?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)). AWS Glue jobs can use files in an S3 bucket as a data source ([Using files in Amazon S3 for the data source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/edit-jobs-source-s3-files.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B**: Route 53 can route DNS traffic, but it does not replace the EC2-based ingestion and transformation architecture with a managed streaming/ETL solution.
- **C**: Adding more EC2 instances may increase capacity, but it increases instance management, scaling, patching, and operational overhead rather than minimizing it.
- **D**: SQS can decouple ingestion, but using EC2 instances to process the queue still leaves the company operating and scaling EC2 workers. The managed API Gateway/Kinesis/Firehose plus Glue pattern better fits millions of devices with lower operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司使用运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 RESTful Web 服务应用程序，从数千台远程设备收集数据。该 EC2 实例接收原始数据，转换原始数据，并将所有数据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。远程设备的数量很快将增加到数百万台。公司需要一个高度可扩展且能够最大限度减少运营开销的解决方案。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Glue 处理 Amazon S3 中的原始数据。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Route 53 将流量路由到不同的 EC2 实例。
options.C: 添加更多 EC2 实例以适应不断增加的传入数据量。
options.D: 将原始数据发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS)。使用 EC2 实例处理数据。
options.E: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 将原始数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis data stream。配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 使用该 data stream 作为源，将数据传送到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 E**。

- **E 正确**，因为摄取层应当是托管且可扩展的，而不是基于单个 EC2 的 REST 服务。AWS 文档显示，API Gateway 可以创建一个与 Kinesis 集成的 **REST API**，并公开调用 Kinesis `PutRecord`/`PutRecords` 的方法，使客户端能够将记录写入 Kinesis stream（[API Gateway Kinesis proxy tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/integrating-api-with-aws-services-kinesis.html)）。然后，Amazon Data Firehose 可以使用 **Kinesis data stream 作为源**（[Firehose source settings for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-kinesis-streams.html)），并可将流式数据传送到 **Amazon S3 bucket** 作为其目标位置（[Firehose destination settings for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。这消除了 EC2 摄取瓶颈并减少了运维工作。
- **A 正确**，因为在原始数据落入 S3 后，AWS Glue 适合用于转换。AWS Glue 是一种 **serverless** 数据集成服务，具备 ETL、清洗和转换能力，无需管理基础设施，并可按需扩展（[What is AWS Glue?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。AWS Glue 作业可以使用 S3 bucket 中的文件作为数据源（[Using files in Amazon S3 for the data source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/edit-jobs-source-s3-files.html)）。错误选项：

- **B**：Route 53 可以路由 DNS 流量，但它不能用托管的流式传输/ETL 解决方案替代基于 EC2 的摄取和转换架构。
- **C**：添加更多 EC2 实例可能会增加容量，但会增加实例管理、扩展、修补和运营开销，而不是将其最小化。
- **D**：SQS 可以解耦摄取，但使用 EC2 实例处理队列仍然需要公司运营和扩展 EC2 worker。托管的 API Gateway/Kinesis/Firehose 加 Glue 模式更适合数百万台设备，并且运营开销更低。

en.question: A company needs to retain its AWS CloudTrail logs for 3 years. The company is enforcing CloudTrail across a set of AWS accounts by using AWS Organizations from the parent account. The CloudTrail target S3 bucket is configured with S3 Versioning enabled. An S3 Lifecycle policy is in place to delete current objects after 3 years. After the fourth year of use of the S3 bucket, the S3 bucket metrics show that the number of objects has continued to rise. However, the number of new CloudTrail logs that are delivered to the S3 bucket has remained consistent. Which solution will delete objects that are older than 3 years in the MOST cost-effective manner?

options.A: Configure the organization’s centralized CloudTrail trail to expire objects after 3 years.
options.B: Configure the S3 Lifecycle policy to delete previous versions as well as current versions.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to enumerate and delete objects from Amazon S3 that are older than 3 years.
options.D: Configure the parent account as the owner of all objects that are delivered to the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The bucket has S3 Versioning enabled. In a versioning-enabled bucket, expiring only the **current** version does not permanently remove the object; Amazon S3 creates a delete marker, and the old object becomes a **noncurrent/previous version**. AWS explicitly notes that if lifecycle rules expire only current versions, the object count can increase, and that to permanently remove objects you should add lifecycle configuration to delete previous versions and expired delete markers ([AWS S3 troubleshooting lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-lifecycle.html)). AWS also states that when using expiration with versioning, you must add a **noncurrent expiration configuration** to manage deletion of noncurrent object versions ([S3 Versioning with S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)). Therefore, configuring the lifecycle policy to expire both current and noncurrent versions is the native and most cost-effective solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudTrail delivers logs to S3, but CloudTrail is not the correct place to manage object expiration in an S3 bucket. Retention/deletion of S3 objects and versions is handled by S3 Lifecycle.
- **C:** A Lambda function could enumerate and delete old versions, but it adds code, execution cost, operational overhead, and risk. S3 Lifecycle natively supports noncurrent version expiration, including permanent deletion of eligible noncurrent versions ([S3 Lifecycle examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html)).
- **D:** Changing object ownership does not delete old versions or delete markers. The problem is lifecycle behavior in a versioned bucket, not ownership.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将其 AWS CloudTrail 日志保留 3 年。该公司正在通过父账户使用 AWS Organizations，在一组 AWS 账户中强制启用 CloudTrail。CloudTrail 目标 S3 存储桶已配置为启用 S3 Versioning。已设置一条 S3 Lifecycle 策略，用于在 3 年后删除当前对象。在该 S3 存储桶使用到第 4 年后，S3 存储桶指标显示对象数量持续上升。但是，传送到该 S3 存储桶的新 CloudTrail 日志数量一直保持稳定。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式删除超过 3 年的对象？

options.A: 配置组织的集中式 CloudTrail 跟踪，以在 3 年后使对象过期。
options.B: 配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略，以删除先前版本以及当前版本。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于枚举并删除 Amazon S3 中超过 3 年的对象。
options.D: 将父账户配置为传送到该 S3 存储桶的所有对象的所有者。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

该存储桶已启用 S3 Versioning。在启用 versioning 的存储桶中，仅使**当前**版本过期并不会永久删除对象；Amazon S3 会创建一个 delete marker，而旧对象会变成一个**非当前/先前版本**。AWS 明确指出，如果 lifecycle 规则仅使当前版本过期，对象数量可能会增加；要永久删除对象，应添加 lifecycle 配置来删除先前版本和过期的 delete markers（[AWS S3 troubleshooting lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-lifecycle.html)）。AWS 还说明，在使用带有 versioning 的 expiration 时，必须添加一个**非当前过期配置**来管理非当前对象版本的删除（[S3 Versioning with S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)）。因此，配置 lifecycle policy 以同时使当前版本和非当前版本过期，是原生且最具成本效益的解决方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** CloudTrail 将日志传送到 S3，但 CloudTrail 不是管理 S3 存储桶中对象过期的正确位置。S3 对象和版本的保留/删除由 S3 Lifecycle 处理。
- **C:** Lambda 函数可以枚举并删除旧版本，但它会增加代码、执行成本、运维开销和风险。S3 Lifecycle 原生支持非当前版本过期，包括永久删除符合条件的非当前版本（[S3 Lifecycle examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html)）。
- **D:** 更改对象所有权不会删除旧版本或 delete markers。问题在于启用 versioning 的存储桶中的 lifecycle 行为，而不是所有权。

en.question: A company has an API that receives real-time data from a fleet of monitoring devices. The API stores this data in an Amazon RDS DB instance for later analysis. The amount of data that the monitoring devices send to the API fluctuates. During periods of heavy traffic, the API often returns timeout errors. After an inspection of the logs, the company determines that the database is not capable of processing the volume of write traffic that comes from the API. A solutions architect must minimize the number of connections to the database and must ensure that data is not lost during periods of heavy traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the size of the DB instance to an instance type that has more available memory.
options.B: Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ DB instance. Configure the application to write to all active RDS DB instances.
options.C: Modify the API to write incoming data to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use an AWS Lambda function that Amazon SQS invokes to write data from the queue to the database.
options.D: Modify the API to write incoming data to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use an AWS Lambda function that Amazon SNS invokes to write data from the topic to the database.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

Amazon SQS is the appropriate buffer between the API and the database. AWS documents that SQS standard queues support a nearly unlimited number of API calls per second, provide at-least-once delivery, and store messages redundantly in multiple Availability Zones before acknowledging them. The documented use cases include **decoupling live user requests from intensive background work** and **batching messages for future processing**, including scheduling entries to be added to a database later ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)). Lambda can process messages from an SQS queue: Lambda polls the queue, invokes the function with batches of messages, and deletes messages only after successful processing; failed batches become visible again after the visibility timeout ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). Lambda event source mappings for SQS can also control concurrency, which helps limit the rate of database writes and therefore reduce database connections ([Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A**: Increasing instance memory may temporarily improve capacity, but it does not decouple bursty ingestion from database writes, does not minimize database connections, and does not provide a durable buffer for traffic spikes.
* **B**: A Multi-AZ RDS DB instance is for high availability/failover, not write scaling. AWS states that the primary is synchronously replicated to a standby replica, and the standby is not a scaling target; Multi-AZ DB instances can even have increased write and commit latency because of synchronous replication ([Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). The option’s statement to write to all active RDS DB instances is not how a standard Multi-AZ RDS DB instance works.
* **D**: SNS is a pub/sub notification service and can invoke Lambda subscribers, but this option does not provide the same queue-based back-pressure and worker-polling pattern required to smooth bursts and control database write concurrency. SQS is the AWS service explicitly suited for durable queuing, decoupling, and later database processing in this scenario.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 API，用于接收来自一组监控设备的实时数据。该 API 将这些数据存储在 Amazon RDS DB 实例中，以便后续分析。监控设备发送到 API 的数据量会波动。在高流量期间，API 经常返回超时错误。检查日志后，公司确定数据库无法处理来自 API 的写入流量。解决方案架构师必须最大限度地减少与数据库的连接数，并且必须确保在高流量期间数据不会丢失。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 DB 实例的大小增加到具有更多可用内存的实例类型。
options.B: 将 DB 实例修改为 Multi-AZ DB 实例。配置应用程序写入所有活动的 RDS DB 实例。
options.C: 修改 API，将传入数据写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。使用由 Amazon SQS 调用的 AWS Lambda 函数，将数据从队列写入数据库。
options.D: 修改 API，将传入数据写入 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。使用由 Amazon SNS 调用的 AWS Lambda 函数，将数据从主题写入数据库。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

Amazon SQS 是 API 和数据库之间合适的缓冲区。AWS 文档说明，SQS 标准队列支持每秒几乎无限数量的 API 调用，提供至少一次传递，并且在确认消息之前会将消息冗余存储在多个 Availability Zones 中。文档化的使用场景包括**将实时用户请求与密集型后台工作解耦**以及**对消息进行批处理以供将来处理**，包括计划稍后将条目添加到数据库中（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。Lambda 可以处理来自 SQS 队列的消息：Lambda 轮询队列，使用消息批次调用函数，并且只有在处理成功后才删除消息；失败的批次会在可见性超时后再次变为可见（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。用于 SQS 的 Lambda 事件源映射还可以控制并发，这有助于限制数据库写入速率，从而减少数据库连接（[Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **A**：增加实例内存可能会暂时提高容量，但它不会将突发式摄取与数据库写入解耦，不会最大限度地减少数据库连接，也不会为流量峰值提供持久缓冲区。
* **B**：Multi-AZ RDS DB 实例用于高可用性/故障转移，而不是写入扩展。AWS 表示，主实例会同步复制到备用副本，并且备用实例不是扩展目标；由于同步复制，Multi-AZ DB 实例甚至可能增加写入和提交延迟（[Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。该选项中关于写入所有活动 RDS DB 实例的说法并不是标准 Multi-AZ RDS DB 实例的工作方式。
* **D**：SNS 是一种发布/订阅通知服务，可以调用 Lambda 订阅者，但此选项没有提供相同的基于队列的背压和工作线程轮询模式，而这是平滑突发流量并控制数据库写入并发所必需的。在此场景中，SQS 是 AWS 中明确适用于持久排队、解耦以及后续数据库处理的服务。

en.question: A company manages its own Amazon EC2 instances that run MySQL databases. The company is manually managing replication and scaling as demand increases or decreases. The company needs a new solution that simplifies the process of adding or removing compute capacity to or from its database tier as needed. The solution also must offer improved performance, scaling, and durability with minimal effort from operations. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora MySQL.
options.B: Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora PostgreSQL.
options.C: Combine the databases into one larger MySQL database. Run the larger database on larger EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group for the database tier. Migrate the existing databases to the new environment.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Migrate the databases to Amazon Aurora Serverless for Aurora MySQL.**

Aurora Serverless is designed for variable workloads: AWS states that it **automatically scales capacity** to meet peak load and scales back down when demand decreases, including adding or removing capacity in granular increments as workload changes ([Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)). It also reduces the effort of planning and resizing DB instances and provides faster, easier scaling with minimal disruption ([Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)). Because the current databases are MySQL, Aurora MySQL is the compatible target: Aurora is MySQL- and PostgreSQL-compatible, and existing MySQL code, tools, and applications can be used with Aurora; Aurora can also deliver up to five times MySQL throughput for some workloads and automates clustering and replication ([What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)). Aurora cluster storage spans multiple Availability Zones, and replicas can improve availability and offload reads ([Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Aurora Serverless for Aurora PostgreSQL has the serverless scaling benefit, but the source databases are MySQL. Choosing PostgreSQL would introduce an engine change instead of using the MySQL-compatible Aurora option.
- **C:** Running a larger MySQL database on larger EC2 instances is vertical scaling and still leaves the company managing database operations, replication, and future capacity changes manually. It does not provide Aurora Serverless automatic compute scaling or managed clustering/replication.
- **D:** An EC2 Auto Scaling group scales EC2 instances, but it does not by itself solve database replication, clustering, consistency, or managed database scaling. Aurora specifically automates and standardizes database clustering and replication, which are challenging aspects of database administration.

zh.question: 一家公司自行管理运行 MySQL 数据库的 Amazon EC2 实例。随着需求增加或减少，该公司正在手动管理复制和扩展。公司需要一种新解决方案，以便根据需要简化向其数据库层添加或移除计算容量的过程。该解决方案还必须以最少的运维工作提供更好的性能、扩展能力和持久性。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库迁移到适用于 Aurora MySQL 的 Amazon Aurora Serverless。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到适用于 Aurora PostgreSQL 的 Amazon Aurora Serverless。
options.C: 将这些数据库合并为一个更大的 MySQL 数据库。在更大的 EC2 实例上运行这个更大的数据库。
options.D: 为数据库层创建一个 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。将现有数据库迁移到新环境。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 将数据库迁移到适用于 Aurora MySQL 的 Amazon Aurora Serverless。**

Aurora Serverless 专为可变工作负载而设计：AWS 表示，它会**自动扩展容量**以满足峰值负载，并在需求下降时缩减容量，包括随着工作负载变化以细粒度增量添加或移除容量（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。它还减少了规划和调整 DB 实例大小的工作量，并以最小中断提供更快、更轻松的扩展（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。由于当前数据库是 MySQL，Aurora MySQL 是兼容的目标：Aurora 与 MySQL 和 PostgreSQL 兼容，现有的 MySQL 代码、工具和应用程序可以与 Aurora 一起使用；对于某些工作负载，Aurora 还可以提供高达 MySQL 五倍的吞吐量，并自动化集群和复制（[What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。Aurora 集群存储跨多个 Availability Zones，副本可以提高可用性并分担读取负载（[Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 适用于 Aurora PostgreSQL 的 Aurora Serverless 具有 serverless 扩展优势，但源数据库是 MySQL。选择 PostgreSQL 会引入数据库引擎变更，而不是使用与 MySQL 兼容的 Aurora 选项。
- **C:** 在更大的 EC2 实例上运行更大的 MySQL 数据库属于纵向扩展，并且仍然需要公司手动管理数据库运维、复制以及未来的容量变更。它不提供 Aurora Serverless 的自动计算扩展或托管集群/复制。
- **D:** EC2 Auto Scaling 组可以扩展 EC2 实例，但它本身不能解决数据库复制、集群、一致性或托管数据库扩展问题。Aurora 专门自动化并标准化数据库集群和复制，而这些是数据库管理中具有挑战性的方面。

en.question: A company is concerned that two NAT instances in use will no longer be able to support the traffic needed for the company’s application. A solutions architect wants to implement a solution that is highly available, fault tolerant, and automatically scalable. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in the same Availability Zone.
options.B: Use Auto Scaling groups with Network Load Balancers for the NAT instances in different Availability Zones.
options.C: Remove the two NAT instances and replace them with two NAT gateways in different Availability Zones.
options.D: Replace the two NAT instances with Spot Instances in different Availability Zones and deploy a Network Load Balancer.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

AWS recommends replacing NAT instances with NAT gateways because NAT gateways provide **better availability and bandwidth** and require less administration. NAT gateways are **highly available**, are implemented with redundancy within each Availability Zone, are AWS managed, and can **scale up to 100 Gbps**. AWS specifically states: “Create a NAT gateway in each Availability Zone to ensure zone-independent architecture” and recommends replacing existing NAT instances with NAT gateways ([AWS NAT gateway vs NAT instance comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-comparison.html)). Therefore, two NAT gateways in **different Availability Zones** provide the highly available, fault-tolerant, automatically scalable solution required.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Two NAT gateways in the **same** Availability Zone do not provide zone-independent fault tolerance. AWS recommends creating a NAT gateway in **each Availability Zone** for zone-independent architecture.
- **B**: Auto Scaling groups and Network Load Balancers would still use NAT instances, which AWS says depend on instance type for bandwidth and require customer-managed failover and maintenance. This is more operationally complex and less aligned with the requirement than AWS-managed NAT gateways.
- **D**: Spot Instances can be interrupted and are not appropriate for a highly available, fault-tolerant NAT solution. This option also keeps the solution based on NAT instances rather than the AWS-recommended NAT gateway approach.

zh.question: 一家公司担心正在使用的两个 NAT instances 将无法再支持公司应用程序所需的流量。解决方案架构师希望实施一个高可用、容错且可自动扩展的解决方案。解决方案架构师应建议什么？

options.A: 移除这两个 NAT instances，并用位于同一 Availability Zone 中的两个 NAT gateways 替换它们。
options.B: 对位于不同 Availability Zones 中的 NAT instances 使用带有 Network Load Balancers 的 Auto Scaling groups。
options.C: 移除这两个 NAT instances，并用位于不同 Availability Zones 中的两个 NAT gateways 替换它们。
options.D: 用位于不同 Availability Zones 中的 Spot Instances 替换这两个 NAT instances，并部署 Network Load Balancer。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

AWS 建议用 NAT gateways 替换 NAT instances，因为 NAT gateways 提供**更好的可用性和带宽**，并且需要更少的管理。NAT gateways **高可用**，在每个 Availability Zone 内以冗余方式实现，由 AWS 托管，并且可以**扩展到 100 Gbps**。AWS 明确说明：“Create a NAT gateway in each Availability Zone to ensure zone-independent architecture”，并建议用 NAT gateways 替换现有 NAT instances（[AWS NAT gateway vs NAT instance comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-comparison.html)）。因此，位于**不同 Availability Zones** 中的两个 NAT gateways 可提供所需的高可用、容错、自动可扩展解决方案。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：位于**同一** Availability Zone 中的两个 NAT gateways 无法提供独立于区域的容错能力。AWS 建议在**每个 Availability Zone** 中创建一个 NAT gateway，以实现独立于区域的架构。
- **B**：Auto Scaling groups 和 Network Load Balancers 仍会使用 NAT instances，而 AWS 表示 NAT instances 的带宽取决于实例类型，并且需要客户管理故障转移和维护。与 AWS 托管的 NAT gateways 相比，这在运维上更复杂，也更不符合要求。
- **D**：Spot Instances 可能会被中断，不适合用于高可用、容错的 NAT 解决方案。此选项也仍然将解决方案建立在 NAT instances 之上，而不是采用 AWS 推荐的 NAT gateway 方法。

en.question: An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance that has an Elastic IP address in VPC A. The application requires access to a database in VPC B. Both VPCs are in the same AWS account. Which solution will provide the required access MOST securely?

options.A: Create a DB instance security group that allows all traffic from the public IP address of the application server in VPC A.
options.B: Configure a VPC peering connection between VPC A and VPC B.
options.C: Make the DB instance publicly accessible. Assign a public IP address to the DB instance.
options.D: Launch an EC2 instance with an Elastic IP address into VPC B. Proxy all requests through the new EC2 instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Configure a VPC peering connection between VPC A and VPC B.**

A VPC peering connection is the most secure option because it provides **private connectivity between the two VPCs**. AWS states that VPC peering enables secure, direct communication between VPCs within AWS infrastructure and eliminates the need for traffic to traverse the public internet. Resources in peered VPCs can communicate as if they are in the same network, and traffic between peered VPCs never traverses the public internet ([AWS VPC peering documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)). After peering, appropriate routes and least-privilege security group rules can be configured to allow only the application-to-database traffic required.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create a DB instance security group that allows all traffic from the public IP address of the application server in VPC A.** This relies on the application server’s **public/Elastic IP** and allows **all traffic**, not just the database port. AWS security group guidance for RDS emphasizes specifying allowed sources and ports; for example, rules should specify the port that the rule allows access for ([RDS security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)). This option is less secure than private VPC-to-VPC connectivity.
- **C. Make the DB instance publicly accessible. Assign a public IP address to the DB instance.** This exposes the database through public networking. AWS explains that internet communication for IPv4 requires public IP addressing and internet gateway routing/NAT behavior ([Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)). Publicly exposing the database is not the most secure design.
- **D. Launch an EC2 instance with an Elastic IP address into VPC B. Proxy all requests through the new EC2 instance.** This adds an unnecessary public-facing proxy and operational complexity. VPC peering already provides private VPC-to-VPC communication without requiring gateways, VPN, or additional physical hardware ([AWS VPC peering documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)).

zh.question: 一个应用程序运行在 VPC A 中具有 Elastic IP 地址的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序需要访问 VPC B 中的数据库。两个 VPC 都在同一个 AWS 账户中。哪种解决方案将以最安全的方式提供所需访问？

options.A: 创建一个 DB 实例安全组，允许来自 VPC A 中应用程序服务器公有 IP 地址的所有流量。
options.B: 在 VPC A 和 VPC B 之间配置 VPC peering connection。
options.C: 使 DB 实例可公开访问。为 DB 实例分配一个公有 IP 地址。
options.D: 在 VPC B 中启动一个具有 Elastic IP 地址的 EC2 实例。通过新的 EC2 实例代理所有请求。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 在 VPC A 和 VPC B 之间配置 VPC peering connection。**

VPC peering connection 是最安全的选项，因为它在两个 VPC 之间提供 **private connectivity**。AWS 表示，VPC peering 可在 AWS 基础设施内实现 VPC 之间安全、直接的通信，并且无需让流量穿越公共互联网。对等连接的 VPC 中的资源可以像在同一网络中一样通信，并且对等 VPC 之间的流量绝不会穿越公共互联网（[AWS VPC peering documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。建立 peering 后，可以配置适当的路由和最小权限安全组规则，仅允许所需的应用程序到数据库流量。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 创建一个 DB 实例安全组，允许来自 VPC A 中应用程序服务器公有 IP 地址的所有流量。** 这依赖应用程序服务器的 **public/Elastic IP**，并且允许 **all traffic**，而不仅仅是数据库端口。AWS 针对 RDS 的安全组指南强调应指定允许的来源和端口；例如，规则应指定该规则允许访问的端口（[RDS security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)）。此选项不如私有 VPC 到 VPC 连接安全。
- **C. 使 DB 实例可公开访问。为 DB 实例分配一个公有 IP 地址。** 这会通过公共网络暴露数据库。AWS 解释说，IPv4 的互联网通信需要公有 IP 寻址以及 Internet gateway 路由/NAT 行为（[Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。公开暴露数据库并不是最安全的设计。
- **D. 在 VPC B 中启动一个具有 Elastic IP 地址的 EC2 实例。通过新的 EC2 实例代理所有请求。** 这增加了不必要的面向公网的代理和运营复杂性。VPC peering 已经提供私有 VPC 到 VPC 通信，而无需网关、VPN 或额外的物理硬件（[AWS VPC peering documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。

en.question: A company runs demonstration environments for its customers on Amazon EC2 instances. Each environment is isolated in its own VPC. The company’s operations team needs to be notified when RDP or SSH access to an environment has been established.

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights to create AWS Systems Manager OpsItems when RDP or SSH access is detected.
options.B: Configure the EC2 instances with an IAM instance profile that has an IAM role with the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy attached.
options.C: Publish VPC flow logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create required metric filters. Create an Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm with a notification action for when the alarm is in the ALARM state.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to listen for events of type EC2 Instance State-change Notification. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as a target. Subscribe the operations team to the topic.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** VPC Flow Logs can capture information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC and can publish that data to **Amazon CloudWatch Logs**; AWS also states flow logs are useful for **monitoring the traffic that is reaching your instance** ([VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)). Flow log records include fields such as source/destination ports, protocol, and `action` (`ACCEPT` or `REJECT`) ([Flow log records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-log-records.html)). AWS examples explicitly show accepted SSH traffic on destination port **22** and RDP traffic on destination port **3389** in flow log records ([Flow log record examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs-records-examples.html)). After publishing to CloudWatch Logs, CloudWatch metric filters can look for patterns in log data, and a CloudWatch alarm based on the metric filter can notify an Amazon SNS topic when the alarm enters the `ALARM` state ([Alarming on logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudWatch Application Insights creating OpsItems is not the right mechanism for detecting network-level RDP/SSH access. The documented pattern for alarming on log patterns is CloudWatch Logs metric filters plus CloudWatch alarms and notifications, not Application Insights OpsItems.
- **B:** Attaching an instance profile with `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` enables Systems Manager management/session capabilities, but by itself it does not detect or notify on RDP/SSH connections. Session Manager can notify on Session Manager session activity, but that is a different access path and requires EventBridge/SNS configuration; it does not monitor ordinary RDP/SSH network access ([Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).
- **D:** EC2 Instance State-change Notification events are for instance state changes. AWS’s example uses EventBridge and SNS to send email when an instance changes state, such as starting, stopping, or launching an instance—not when an SSH or RDP connection is established ([EC2 state-change alarm example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-events-eventbridge-example.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上为其客户运行演示环境。每个环境都隔离在其自己的 VPC 中。该公司的运营团队需要在已建立对某个环境的 RDP 或 SSH 访问时收到通知。

options.A: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights，以便在检测到 RDP 或 SSH 访问时创建 AWS Systems Manager OpsItems。
options.B: 为 EC2 实例配置一个 IAM instance profile，该配置文件具有附加了 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy 的 IAM role。
options.C: 将 VPC flow logs 发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。创建所需的 metric filters。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch metric alarm，并在该 alarm 处于 ALARM 状态时配置通知操作。
options.D: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge rule，以侦听类型为 EC2 Instance State-change Notification 的事件。将一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic 配置为目标。让运营团队订阅该 topic。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** VPC Flow Logs 可以捕获有关进出 VPC 中 network interfaces 的 IP 流量信息，并且可以将该数据发布到 **Amazon CloudWatch Logs**；AWS 还说明 flow logs 对于**监控到达你的实例的流量**很有用（[VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)）。Flow log records 包括源/目标端口、协议和 `action`（`ACCEPT` 或 `REJECT`）等字段（[Flow log records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-log-records.html)）。AWS 示例明确展示了 flow log records 中目标端口 **22** 上已接受的 SSH 流量，以及目标端口 **3389** 上的 RDP 流量（[Flow log record examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs-records-examples.html)）。发布到 CloudWatch Logs 后，CloudWatch metric filters 可以在日志数据中查找模式，而基于 metric filter 的 CloudWatch alarm 可以在 alarm 进入 `ALARM` 状态时通知 Amazon SNS topic（[Alarming on logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** CloudWatch Application Insights 创建 OpsItems 并不是检测网络级 RDP/SSH 访问的正确机制。针对日志模式进行告警的文档化模式是 CloudWatch Logs metric filters 加 CloudWatch alarms 和通知，而不是 Application Insights OpsItems。
- **B:** 附加带有 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 的 instance profile 可以启用 Systems Manager 管理/会话功能，但它本身不会检测或通知 RDP/SSH 连接。Session Manager 可以通知 Session Manager 会话活动，但这是不同的访问路径，并且需要 EventBridge/SNS 配置；它不会监控普通的 RDP/SSH 网络访问（[Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。
- **D:** EC2 Instance State-change Notification 事件用于实例状态变化。AWS 的示例使用 EventBridge 和 SNS 在实例状态发生变化时发送电子邮件，例如启动、停止或启动运行某个实例，而不是在 SSH 或 RDP 连接建立时（[EC2 state-change alarm example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-events-eventbridge-example.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect has created a new AWS account and must secure AWS account root user access. Which combination of actions will accomplish this? (Choose two.)

options.A: Ensure the root user uses a strong password.
options.B: Enable multi-factor authentication to the root user.
options.C: Store root user access keys in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Add the root user to a group containing administrative permissions.
options.E: Apply the required permissions to the root user with an inline policy document.

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **A and B**.

- **A. Ensure the root user uses a strong password** — Correct. AWS root user best practices recommend using a password that is **strong and unique** for the root user, with AWS-defined complexity requirements such as length and character-type rules ([Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)).
- **B. Enable multi-factor authentication to the root user** — Correct. AWS states that because the root user can perform privileged actions, it is crucial to add MFA as a second authentication factor, and the Well-Architected guidance says MFA should always be used for the AWS account root user ([Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html), [SEC01-BP02](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/sec_securely_operate_aws_account.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **C. Store root user access keys in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket** — Incorrect. AWS strongly recommends that you **do not create access keys for the root user** because the root user has full access to all AWS services and resources in the account ([Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)).
- **D. Add the root user to a group containing administrative permissions** — Incorrect. The root user already has complete access to all AWS services and resources; it is not secured by adding it to an administrative group. AWS recommends using the root user only for tasks that require root-level permissions ([AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)).
- **E. Apply the required permissions to the root user with an inline policy document** — Incorrect. The root user is already the most privileged identity and, in some cases, cannot be constrained by security policies; securing it means guarding credentials and avoiding routine use, not attaching policies to it ([SEC01-BP02](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/sec_securely_operate_aws_account.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师创建了一个新的 AWS 账户，并且必须保护 AWS 账户根用户访问。哪两项操作组合可以实现这一目标？（选择两项。）

options.A: 确保根用户使用强密码。
options.B: 为根用户启用多重身份验证。
options.C: 将根用户访问密钥存储在加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.D: 将根用户添加到包含管理权限的组中。
options.E: 使用内联策略文档将所需权限应用到根用户。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A and B**。

- **A. Ensure the root user uses a strong password** — 正确。AWS root user 最佳实践建议为 root user 使用**强且唯一**的密码，并满足 AWS 定义的复杂性要求，例如长度和字符类型规则（[Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。
- **B. Enable multi-factor authentication to the root user** — 正确。AWS 表示，由于 root user 可以执行特权操作，因此添加 MFA 作为第二个身份验证因素至关重要，并且 Well-Architected 指南指出，应始终为 AWS account root user 使用 MFA（[Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html), [SEC01-BP02](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/sec_securely_operate_aws_account.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **C. Store root user access keys in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket** — 错误。AWS 强烈建议你**不要为 root user 创建访问密钥**，因为 root user 对账户中的所有 AWS 服务和资源拥有完全访问权限（[Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。
- **D. Add the root user to a group containing administrative permissions** — 错误。root user 已经对所有 AWS 服务和资源拥有完全访问权限；将其添加到管理组并不能保护它。AWS 建议仅在需要 root 级别权限的任务中使用 root user（[AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)）。
- **E. Apply the required permissions to the root user with an inline policy document** — 错误。root user 已经是权限最高的身份，并且在某些情况下无法通过安全策略进行约束；保护它意味着保护凭证并避免日常使用，而不是将策略附加到它（[SEC01-BP02](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2023-10-03/framework/sec_securely_operate_aws_account.html)）。

en.question: A company is building a new web-based customer relationship management application. The application will use several Amazon EC2 instances that are backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application will also use an Amazon Aurora database. All data for the application must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) certificates on the ALB to encrypt data in transit. Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest.
options.B: Use the AWS root account to log in to the AWS Management Console. Upload the company’s encryption certificates. While in the root account, select the option to turn on encryption for all data at rest and in transit for the account.
options.C: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the EBS volumes and Aurora database storage at rest. Attach an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.
options.D: Use BitLocker to encrypt all data at rest. Import the company’s TLS certificate keys to AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Attach the KMS keys to the ALB to encrypt data in transit.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon EBS encryption uses **AWS KMS keys** when creating encrypted volumes and snapshots, and it secures data at rest for EBS volumes attached to EC2 instances ([Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)). Amazon Aurora encrypted DB clusters also use an **AWS Key Management Service key** to encrypt Aurora resources, and when creating an encrypted DB cluster you can specify a KMS key ([Encrypting Amazon Aurora resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)). For traffic to the Application Load Balancer, AWS documentation states that a secure ALB listener requires an X.509 **SSL/TLS certificate**, and recommends using **AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)** because ACM integrates with Elastic Load Balancing so the certificate can be deployed on the load balancer ([SSL certificates for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/https-listener-certificates.html)).

Therefore, using **AWS KMS for EBS and Aurora encryption at rest** and attaching an **ACM certificate to the ALB for TLS encryption in transit** meets the requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Reverses the services. KMS keys, not KMS certificates, are used for EBS/Aurora encryption at rest; ACM provides SSL/TLS certificates for the ALB, not EBS/Aurora storage encryption.
- **B:** There is no valid account-level root-user setting that turns on all encryption at rest and in transit for every service. Also, routine use of the AWS root account is not the correct design pattern.
- **D:** BitLocker is not the AWS-native encryption mechanism for EBS and Aurora. Also, ALBs use SSL/TLS certificates deployed through ACM/IAM mechanisms, not KMS keys attached to the ALB for TLS termination.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个新的基于 Web 的客户关系管理应用程序。该应用程序将使用多个 Amazon EC2 实例，这些实例由 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷支持，并位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面。该应用程序还将使用 Amazon Aurora 数据库。该应用程序的所有数据都必须在静态和传输过程中加密。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 ALB 上使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 证书来加密传输中的数据。使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 来加密静态的 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储。
options.B: 使用 AWS 根账户登录 AWS Management Console。上传公司的加密证书。在根账户中，选择为该账户的所有静态和传输中数据开启加密的选项。
options.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密静态的 EBS 卷和 Aurora 数据库存储。将 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 证书附加到 ALB，以加密传输中的数据。
options.D: 使用 BitLocker 加密所有静态数据。将公司的 TLS 证书密钥导入 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 将 KMS 密钥附加到 ALB，以加密传输中的数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon EBS 加密在创建加密卷和快照时使用 **AWS KMS keys**，并为附加到 EC2 实例的 EBS 卷保护静态数据（[Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)）。Amazon Aurora 加密的数据库集群也使用 **AWS Key Management Service key** 来加密 Aurora 资源，并且在创建加密的数据库集群时可以指定 KMS key（[Encrypting Amazon Aurora resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。对于到 Application Load Balancer 的流量，AWS 文档说明，安全的 ALB 侦听器需要 X.509 **SSL/TLS certificate**，并建议使用 **AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)**，因为 ACM 与 Elastic Load Balancing 集成，因此证书可以部署在负载均衡器上（[SSL certificates for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/https-listener-certificates.html)）。因此，使用 **AWS KMS 对 EBS 和 Aurora 进行静态加密**，并将 **ACM 证书附加到 ALB 以进行传输中的 TLS 加密**，可以满足要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 颠倒了服务的用途。用于 EBS/Aurora 静态加密的是 KMS keys，而不是 KMS 证书；ACM 为 ALB 提供 SSL/TLS 证书，而不是为 EBS/Aurora 存储加密提供服务。
- **B:** 不存在有效的账户级根用户设置，可以为每个服务开启所有静态和传输中数据的加密。此外，日常使用 AWS 根账户并不是正确的设计模式。
- **D:** BitLocker 不是用于 EBS 和 Aurora 的 AWS 原生加密机制。此外，ALB 使用通过 ACM/IAM 机制部署的 SSL/TLS 证书，而不是将 KMS keys 附加到 ALB 来进行 TLS 终止。

en.question: A company is moving its on-premises Oracle database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The database has several applications that write to the same tables. The applications need to be migrated one by one with a month in between each migration. Management has expressed concerns that the database has a high number of reads and writes. The data must be kept in sync across both databases throughout the migration. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync for the initial migration. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.C: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a memory optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select all tables.
options.D: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool with AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) using a compute optimized replication instance. Create a full load plus change data capture (CDC) replication task and a table mapping to select the largest tables.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

This is a heterogeneous database migration (Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL), so the schema must be converted to the target engine format. AWS documentation states that for converting an existing schema to a different database engine, DMS Schema Conversion converts source schemas and database code objects such as tables, views, stored procedures, functions, and data types to a target-compatible format ([AWS DMS best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_BestPractices.html)). For keeping the databases synchronized during the phased application cutover, AWS DMS supports **full load plus CDC**, which “migrates existing data and then updates the target database based on changes to the source database” ([AWS DMS CDC tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)). A table mapping selecting all tables is appropriate because all applications write to the same tables and all migrated data must remain in sync. For the high read/write workload, a memory-optimized replication instance is reasonable: AWS notes that most DMS replication processing happens in memory and that R5 memory-optimized instances are designed for workloads that process large data sets in memory; ongoing high-throughput replication can consume large amounts of CPU and memory ([AWS DMS replication instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_ReplicationInstance.html), [AWS DMS best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_BestPractices.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** DataSync is for transferring storage data such as files/objects between on-premises storage and AWS storage services, not for converting and migrating relational database schemas from Oracle to PostgreSQL ([AWS DataSync on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)).
