Also, EC2 instances need a public IPv4 or Elastic IP address for IPv4 internet communication through an internet gateway, which is not the intended private-subnet design.
- **C:** A NAT instance must be in a **public subnet** with internet access and a public IPv4 or Elastic IP address. Placing it in the same private subnet as the EC2 instance would not provide the required outbound internet path ([NAT instance basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_NAT_Instance.html)).
- **D:** This routes the private subnet to the internet gateway rather than to the NAT instance, which does not implement NAT for the private instance. In addition, the NAT instance is incorrectly placed in the same private subnet; AWS says a NAT instance must be in a public subnet ([NAT instance basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_NAT_Instance.html)).

zh.question: 一个 Amazon EC2 实例位于新 VPC 的私有子网中。该子网没有出站互联网访问权限，但 EC2 实例需要能够从外部供应商下载每月安全更新。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 internet gateway，并将其附加到 VPC。配置私有子网路由表，将 internet gateway 用作默认路由。
options.B: 创建一个 NAT gateway，并将其放置在公有子网中。配置私有子网路由表，将 NAT gateway 用作默认路由。
options.C: 创建一个 NAT instance，并将其放置在 EC2 实例所在的同一子网中。配置私有子网路由表，将 NAT instance 用作默认路由。
options.D: 创建一个 internet gateway，并将其附加到 VPC。创建一个 NAT instance，并将其放置在 EC2 实例所在的同一子网中。配置私有子网路由表，将 internet gateway 用作默认路由。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

公有 NAT gateway 正是为这种需求而设计的：它允许私有子网中的实例向互联网发起出站连接，同时阻止来自互联网的非请求入站连接。AWS 声明“instances in private subnets can connect to the internet through a public NAT gateway”，并且你应在公有子网中创建 public NAT gateway。私有子网路由表应将 `0.0.0.0/0` 流量发送到 NAT gateway，如 AWS NAT gateway 互联网访问路由示例中所示（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html), [NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将私有子网直接路由到 internet gateway 会按 AWS 定义使其成为公有子网：具有到 internet gateway 路由的子网是公有子网；没有该路由的子网是私有子网（[Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。此外，EC2 实例需要公有 IPv4 或 Elastic IP 地址，才能通过 internet gateway 进行 IPv4 互联网通信，而这并不是预期的私有子网设计。
- **C:** NAT instance 必须位于具有互联网访问权限以及公有 IPv4 或 Elastic IP 地址的**公有子网**中。将其放置在与 EC2 实例相同的私有子网中，无法提供所需的出站互联网路径（[NAT instance basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_NAT_Instance.html)）。
- **D:** 这会将私有子网路由到 internet gateway，而不是路由到 NAT instance，因此不会为私有实例实现 NAT。此外，NAT instance 被错误地放置在同一私有子网中；AWS 表示 NAT instance 必须位于公有子网中（[NAT instance basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_NAT_Instance.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to design a system to store client case files. The files are core company assets and are important. The number of files will grow over time. The files must be simultaneously accessible from multiple application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The solution must have built-in redundancy. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.C: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.D: AWS Backup

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A — Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).**

Amazon EFS is the best fit because it provides shared file storage for compute instances and automatically scales as files are added. AWS states that EFS provides “fully elastic file storage” to share file data, scales on demand to petabytes, and grows/shrinks automatically as files are added or removed. It is accessible from Amazon EC2 instances and allows “massively parallel access from compute instances” to the data. For redundancy, the recommended Regional EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones, providing continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable ([Amazon EFS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html), [EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Amazon EBS** — EBS is block storage, not a managed shared file system. Although EBS Multi-Attach exists, it is limited to specific Provisioned IOPS volumes, up to 16 Nitro instances in the same AZ, and standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple EC2 instances; AWS recommends a clustered file system for resiliency and reliability in such cases ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
- **C. Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive** — This is archival storage for data accessed less than once per year. Objects are not available for real-time access and must be restored first, with retrieval typically taking hours, so it does not meet the requirement for simultaneous access by multiple application servers ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).
- **D. AWS Backup** — AWS Backup centralizes and automates backup policies; it is not a primary shared file storage system for EC2 application servers ([What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要设计一个系统来存储客户案例文件。这些文件是公司的核心资产，并且非常重要。文件数量会随着时间增长。这些文件必须能够由运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的多个应用程序服务器同时访问。该解决方案必须具有内置冗余。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.C: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.D: AWS Backup

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A — Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。**

Amazon EFS 是最合适的选择，因为它为计算实例提供共享文件存储，并会随着文件的添加自动扩展。AWS 表示，EFS 提供“完全弹性的文件存储”来共享文件数据，可按需扩展到 PB 级，并会随着文件的添加或删除自动增长/收缩。它可由 Amazon EC2 实例访问，并允许计算实例对数据进行“大规模并行访问”。在冗余方面，推荐的 Regional EFS 文件系统会跨多个 Availability Zones 冗余存储数据，即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用，也能提供持续可用性（[Amazon EFS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)，[EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Amazon EBS** — EBS 是块存储，而不是托管的共享文件系统。尽管存在 EBS Multi-Attach，但它仅限于特定的 Provisioned IOPS 卷、同一 AZ 中最多 16 个 Nitro 实例，并且 XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多个 EC2 实例同时访问而设计；在这种情况下，AWS 建议使用集群文件系统来实现弹性和可靠性（[EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
- **C. Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive** — 这是用于每年访问少于一次的数据的归档存储。对象无法用于实时访问，必须先进行还原，检索通常需要数小时，因此不满足多个应用程序服务器同时访问的要求（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。
- **D. AWS Backup** — AWS Backup 集中并自动化备份策略；它不是用于 EC2 应用程序服务器的主共享文件存储系统（[What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。

options.A: Deleting IAM users
options.B: Deleting directories
options.C: Deleting Amazon EC2 instances
options.D: Deleting logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs

en.explanation:
The cloud engineer can perform **C. Deleting Amazon EC2 instances**.

AWS evaluates all applicable policies, requests are denied unless explicitly allowed, and **an explicit deny overrides an explicit allow** ([IAM policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic_policy-eval-denyallow.html)). IAM `Action` entries use a service prefix such as `ec2` or `iam`, and `*` can grant all actions for that service namespace, such as `s3:*` for all S3 actions ([IAM Action element](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_action.html)). Therefore, `ec2:*` allows EC2 actions, including terminating instances. The EC2 `TerminateInstances` API “terminates (deletes) the specified instances” ([TerminateInstances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_TerminateInstances.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A. Deleting IAM users** — Policy1 allows only `iam:Get*` and `iam:List*`; it does not allow IAM delete actions such as `iam:Delete*`. With no explicit allow, the request is implicitly denied.
- **B. Deleting directories** — Policy1 allows `ds:*`, but Policy2 explicitly denies `ds:Delete*`. Because an explicit deny overrides an allow, directory delete actions are denied.
- **D. Deleting logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs** — Policy1 allows only `logs:Get*` and `logs:Describe*`; it does not allow CloudWatch Logs delete actions such as `logs:Delete*`. With no explicit allow, the request is implicitly denied.

options.A: 删除 IAM 用户
options.B: 删除目录
options.C: 删除 Amazon EC2 实例
options.D: 从 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 删除日志

zh.explanation:
该云工程师可以执行 **C. 删除 Amazon EC2 实例**。

AWS 会评估所有适用的策略，除非被显式允许，否则请求会被拒绝，并且**显式拒绝会覆盖显式允许**（[IAM policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic_policy-eval-denyallow.html)）。IAM `Action` 条目使用服务前缀，例如 `ec2` 或 `iam`，并且 `*` 可以授予该服务命名空间的所有操作，例如 `s3:*` 表示所有 S3 操作（[IAM Action element](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_action.html)）。因此，`ec2:*` 允许 EC2 操作，包括终止实例。EC2 `TerminateInstances` API “terminates (deletes) the specified instances”（[TerminateInstances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_TerminateInstances.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. 删除 IAM 用户** — Policy1 只允许 `iam:Get*` 和 `iam:List*`；它不允许 IAM 删除操作，例如 `iam:Delete*`。由于没有显式允许，该请求会被隐式拒绝。
- **B. 删除目录** — Policy1 允许 `ds:*`，但 Policy2 显式拒绝 `ds:Delete*`。由于显式拒绝会覆盖允许，因此目录删除操作会被拒绝。
- **D. 从 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 删除日志** — Policy1 只允许 `logs:Get*` 和 `logs:Describe*`；它不允许 CloudWatch Logs 删除操作，例如 `logs:Delete*`。由于没有显式允许，该请求会被隐式拒绝。

en.question: A company is reviewing a recent migration of a three-tier application to a VPC. The security team discovers that the principle of least privilege is not being applied to Amazon EC2 security group ingress and egress rules between the application tiers. What should a solutions architect do to correct this issue?

options.A: Create security group rules using the instance ID as the source or destination.
options.B: Create security group rules using the security group ID as the source or destination.
options.C: Create security group rules using the VPC CIDR blocks as the source or destination.
options.D: Create security group rules using the subnet CIDR blocks as the source or destination.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Create security group rules using the security group ID as the source or destination.**

AWS security group rules can specify the **source for inbound rules** or **destination for outbound rules** as several types of values, including **the ID of a security group** (for example, `sg-1234567890abcdef0`) [AWS VPC security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html). When one security group references another, AWS allows communication only between instances associated with those security groups, in the specified direction, protocol, and port [AWS VPC security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html). AWS even gives a three-tier-style example: web servers allow traffic only from the load balancer security group, and database servers allow database requests from the web server security group [AWS example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html). This is the best fit for least privilege between application tiers.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Instance ID** — Security group rule sources/destinations support IP addresses, CIDR ranges, prefix list IDs, and security group IDs; the documented list does **not** include EC2 instance IDs as a rule source or destination [AWS VPC security group rule components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html).
- **C. VPC CIDR blocks** — This would allow traffic from or to any applicable address in the VPC CIDR, which is broader than allowing only the specific tier’s security group.
- **D. Subnet CIDR blocks** — This is narrower than the whole VPC but still allows any resource in the subnet CIDR, not only the intended application tier instances.

Therefore, referencing **security group IDs** provides the most appropriate tier-to-tier access control for least privilege.

zh.question: 一家公司正在审查最近将一个三层应用程序迁移到 VPC 的情况。安全团队发现，在应用程序各层之间的 Amazon EC2 安全组入站和出站规则中，没有应用最小权限原则。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来纠正此问题？

options.A: 使用实例 ID 作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。
options.B: 使用安全组 ID 作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。
options.C: 使用 VPC CIDR 块作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。
options.D: 使用子网 CIDR 块作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用安全组 ID 作为源或目标来创建安全组规则。**

AWS 安全组规则可以将**入站规则的源**或**出站规则的目标**指定为多种类型的值，包括**安全组的 ID**（例如，`sg-1234567890abcdef0`）[AWS VPC security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)。当一个安全组引用另一个安全组时，AWS 仅允许与这些安全组关联的实例之间按指定方向、协议和端口进行通信 [AWS VPC security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)。AWS 甚至给出了一个三层风格的示例：Web 服务器仅允许来自负载均衡器安全组的流量，数据库服务器允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的数据库请求 [AWS example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)。这最符合应用程序各层之间的最小权限要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Instance ID** — 安全组规则的源/目标支持 IP 地址、CIDR 范围、前缀列表 ID 和安全组 ID；文档列出的列表中**不**包含将 EC2 实例 ID 作为规则源或目标 [AWS VPC security group rule components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)。
- **C. VPC CIDR blocks** — 这会允许来自或发往 VPC CIDR 中任何适用地址的流量，比仅允许特定层的安全组更宽泛。
- **D. Subnet CIDR blocks** — 这比整个 VPC 更窄，但仍会允许子网 CIDR 中的任何资源，而不仅仅是预期的应用程序层实例。因此，引用**安全组 ID**可以为最小权限提供最合适的层到层访问控制。

en.question: A company has an ecommerce checkout workflow that writes an order to a database and calls a service to process the payment. Users are experiencing timeouts during the checkout process. When users resubmit the checkout form, multiple unique orders are created for the same desired transaction. How should a solutions architect refactor this workflow to prevent the creation of multiple orders?

options.A: Configure the web application to send an order message to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Set the payment service to retrieve the message from Kinesis Data Firehose and process the order.
options.B: Create a rule in AWS CloudTrail to invoke an AWS Lambda function based on the logged application path request. Use Lambda to query the database, call the payment service, and pass in the order information.
options.C: Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Set the payment service to poll Amazon SNS, retrieve the message, and process the order.
options.D: Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the payment service to retrieve the message and process the order. Delete the message from the queue.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Use an **Amazon SQS FIFO queue** between order creation and payment processing. FIFO queues are designed for cases where order matters or duplicates cannot be tolerated; AWS states that FIFO queues provide FIFO delivery and exactly-once processing, preserve send/receive order, keep a message unavailable until it is processed and deleted, and do not introduce duplicates. AWS also lists an **e-commerce order management system** as an example FIFO use case ([Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)). After the payment service receives a message, SQS visibility timeout prevents other consumers from processing the same message while it is being worked on, and messages should be deleted after successful processing ([Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)). This decouples checkout from payment processing and avoids user-facing timeouts that lead to repeated submissions.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon Data Firehose is for automatically delivering streaming data to configured destinations such as S3, Redshift, and OpenSearch; it buffers and delivers records to destinations, not to a payment service that polls it as a work queue ([Understand data delivery in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/basic-deliver.html)).
- **B:** AWS CloudTrail is for operational/risk auditing, governance, and compliance; it records AWS account actions as events, including console, CLI, SDK, and API activity. It is not the right mechanism to orchestrate an application checkout workflow ([What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)).
- **C:** Amazon SNS is a pub/sub notification service where publishers send messages to a topic and SNS delivers them to subscribers such as SQS, Lambda, HTTP(S), email, and others. The option incorrectly describes the payment service polling SNS directly, and SNS alone does not provide the queue visibility/delete workflow needed for reliable task processing ([What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个电子商务结账工作流，该工作流会将订单写入数据库，并调用一个服务来处理付款。用户在结账过程中遇到超时。当用户重新提交结账表单时，会为同一个期望的交易创建多个唯一订单。解决方案架构师应如何重构此工作流，以防止创建多个订单？

options.A: 配置 Web 应用程序将订单消息发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。设置付款服务从 Kinesis Data Firehose 检索消息并处理订单。
options.B: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一条规则，根据记录的应用程序路径请求调用 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Lambda 查询数据库、调用付款服务，并传入订单信息。
options.C: 将订单存储在数据库中。向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 发送一条包含订单号的消息。设置付款服务轮询 Amazon SNS、检索消息并处理订单。
options.D: 将订单存储在数据库中。向 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列发送一条包含订单号的消息。设置付款服务检索消息并处理订单。从队列中删除该消息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** 在订单创建和付款处理之间使用 **Amazon SQS FIFO queue**。FIFO 队列专为顺序重要或无法容忍重复的场景而设计；AWS 声明 FIFO 队列提供 FIFO 传递和恰好一次处理，保留发送/接收顺序，在消息被处理并删除之前使其保持不可用，并且不会引入重复。AWS 还将 **e-commerce order management system** 列为 FIFO 使用案例示例（[Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)）。付款服务收到消息后，SQS visibility timeout 会防止其他使用者在该消息正在处理时处理同一消息，并且消息应在成功处理后删除（[Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)）。这将结账与付款处理解耦，并避免导致用户重复提交的面向用户的超时。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon Data Firehose 用于自动将流数据传送到配置的目标，例如 S3、Redshift 和 OpenSearch；它会缓冲记录并将其传送到目标，而不是传送给将其作为工作队列轮询的付款服务（[Understand data delivery in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/basic-deliver.html)）。
- **B:** AWS CloudTrail 用于运营/风险审计、治理和合规性；它将 AWS 账户操作记录为事件，包括控制台、CLI、SDK 和 API 活动。它不是编排应用程序结账工作流的正确机制（[What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon SNS 是一种 pub/sub 通知服务，发布者将消息发送到主题，SNS 将消息传送给订阅者，例如 SQS、Lambda、HTTP(S)、电子邮件及其他。该选项错误地描述了付款服务直接轮询 SNS，而仅使用 SNS 并不能提供可靠任务处理所需的队列 visibility/delete 工作流（[What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is implementing a document review application using an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The solution must prevent accidental deletion of the documents and ensure that all versions of the documents are available. Users must be able to download, modify, and upload documents. Which combination of actions should be taken to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable a read-only bucket ACL.
options.B: Enable versioning on the bucket.
options.C: Attach an IAM policy to the bucket.
options.D: Enable MFA Delete on the bucket.
options.E: Encrypt the bucket using AWS KMS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: B and D.**

- **B. Enable versioning on the bucket** — S3 Versioning keeps multiple variants of an object in the same bucket and lets you “preserve, retrieve, and restore every version” of objects. AWS also states that versioning-enabled buckets help recover from accidental deletion or overwrite because deletes add a delete marker and overwrites create a new object version rather than destroying the prior version. This directly satisfies the requirement that all document versions remain available. [Amazon S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)
- **D. Enable MFA Delete on the bucket** — MFA Delete adds another layer of protection for versioned buckets by requiring two forms of authentication to permanently delete an object version or change the bucket versioning state. AWS explicitly says MFA Delete helps ensure bucket data cannot be accidentally deleted. [Configuring MFA delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Enable a read-only bucket ACL** — A read-only ACL would not allow users to upload modified documents. AWS describes bucket ACL `READ` as allowing listing, while `WRITE` is what allows creating new objects; the application requires users to download, modify, and upload documents. [S3 ACL permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/acl-overview.html)
- **C. Attach an IAM policy to the bucket** — Access policies can control permissions, but this option does not by itself ensure that every object version is retained or add MFA protection for permanent deletion. The specific S3 features for these requirements are Versioning and MFA Delete.
- **E. Encrypt the bucket using AWS KMS** — Encryption protects data confidentiality, not version retention or accidental deletion prevention. It does not ensure all document versions remain available.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为存储来实施一个文档审阅应用程序。该解决方案必须防止文档被意外删除，并确保文档的所有版本都可用。用户必须能够下载、修改和上传文档。应采取哪两项操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 启用只读存储桶 ACL。
options.B: 在存储桶上启用版本控制。
options.C: 将 IAM 策略附加到存储桶。
options.D: 在存储桶上启用 MFA Delete。
options.E: 使用 AWS KMS 加密存储桶。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B 和 D。**

- **B. 在存储桶上启用版本控制** — S3 Versioning 会在同一个存储桶中保留对象的多个变体，并让你能够“保留、检索和还原”对象的每个版本。AWS 还说明，启用版本控制的存储桶有助于从意外删除或覆盖中恢复，因为删除会添加一个删除标记，而覆盖会创建新的对象版本，而不是销毁之前的版本。这直接满足了所有文档版本都保持可用的要求。[Amazon S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)
- **D. 在存储桶上启用 MFA Delete** — MFA Delete 通过要求使用两种身份验证形式才能永久删除对象版本或更改存储桶版本控制状态，为启用版本控制的存储桶增加了另一层保护。AWS 明确表示，MFA Delete 有助于确保无法意外删除存储桶数据。[Configuring MFA delete](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiFactorAuthenticationDelete.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 启用只读存储桶 ACL** — 只读 ACL 不允许用户上传修改后的文档。AWS 将存储桶 ACL `READ` 描述为允许列出，而 `WRITE` 才允许创建新对象；该应用程序要求用户能够下载、修改和上传文档。[S3 ACL permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/acl-overview.html)
- **C. 将 IAM 策略附加到存储桶** — 访问策略可以控制权限，但此选项本身并不能确保保留每个对象版本，也不能为永久删除增加 MFA 保护。满足这些要求的具体 S3 功能是 Versioning 和 MFA Delete。
- **E. 使用 AWS KMS 加密存储桶** — 加密保护数据机密性，而不是版本保留或防止意外删除。它不能确保所有文档版本保持可用。

en.question: A company is building a solution that will report Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling events across all the applications in an AWS account. The company needs to use a serverless solution to store the EC2 Auto Scaling status data in Amazon S3. The company then will use the data in Amazon S3 to provide near-real- time updates in a dashboard. The solution must not affect the speed of EC2 instance launches. How should the company move the data to Amazon S3 to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon CloudWatch metric stream to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.B: Launch an Amazon EMR cluster to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a schedule. Configure the Lambda function to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data directly to Amazon S3.
options.D: Use a bootstrap script during the launch of an EC2 instance to install Amazon Kinesis Agent. Configure Kinesis Agent to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling publishes Auto Scaling group status/capacity metrics to CloudWatch, including pending, in-service, terminating, standby, desired capacity, and total instance metrics, giving “nearly continuous visibility” into the group history when metrics collection is enabled ([EC2 Auto Scaling CloudWatch metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-metrics.html)). CloudWatch metric streams are designed to **continually stream CloudWatch metrics** with **near-real-time delivery and low latency**, and AWS documents a “Custom setup with Firehose” in which a metric stream sends metrics to an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream that delivers them to a data lake such as Amazon S3 ([CloudWatch metric streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Metric-Streams.html)). Firehose supports Amazon S3 as a destination by selecting an S3 bucket for the streaming data ([Firehose S3 destination settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)). This is serverless and does not add work to the EC2 instance launch path.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Amazon EMR requires launching and operating a cluster, so it is not the simplest serverless way to continuously move CloudWatch/Auto Scaling status metrics to S3. CloudWatch metric streams plus Firehose already provide the managed streaming path to S3.
- **C:** A scheduled Lambda function is polling on an interval, not a continuous near-real-time stream. It also requires custom code to gather and write the data, whereas metric streams are explicitly built for continuous near-real-time metric delivery.
- **D:** Installing Kinesis Agent with a bootstrap script runs during EC2 instance launch, which can affect launch speed. It also collects from the instances rather than using the account-level CloudWatch Auto Scaling metrics stream, which is the managed source for Auto Scaling group status data.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个解决方案，用于报告 AWS 账户中所有应用程序的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 事件。该公司需要使用无服务器解决方案将 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。随后公司将使用 Amazon S3 中的数据在仪表板中提供近实时更新。该解决方案不得影响 EC2 实例启动的速度。公司应如何将数据移动到 Amazon S3 以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch metric stream 将 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。
options.B: 启动一个 Amazon EMR 集群来收集 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据，并将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，按计划调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数将 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据直接发送到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 在 EC2 实例启动期间使用 bootstrap 脚本安装 Amazon Kinesis Agent。配置 Kinesis Agent 收集 EC2 Auto Scaling 状态数据，并将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose。将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会将 Auto Scaling group 状态/容量指标发布到 CloudWatch，包括 pending、in-service、terminating、standby、desired capacity 和 total instance 指标；启用指标收集后，这可以提供对组历史的“几乎连续的可见性”([EC2 Auto Scaling CloudWatch metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-metrics.html))。CloudWatch metric streams 旨在以**近实时交付和低延迟**来**持续流式传输 CloudWatch 指标**，并且 AWS 文档记录了一种 “Custom setup with Firehose”，其中 metric stream 将指标发送到 Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream，再由其将指标交付到 Amazon S3 等数据湖 ([CloudWatch metric streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Metric-Streams.html))。Firehose 支持 Amazon S3 作为目标，方法是为流式数据选择一个 S3 bucket ([Firehose S3 destination settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html))。这是无服务器的，并且不会向 EC2 实例启动路径添加工作。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** Amazon EMR 需要启动并运行一个集群，因此它不是将 CloudWatch/Auto Scaling 状态指标持续移动到 S3 的最简单无服务器方式。CloudWatch metric streams 加 Firehose 已经提供了到 S3 的托管流式传输路径。
- **C:** 定时 Lambda 函数是在按间隔轮询，而不是连续的近实时流。它还需要自定义代码来收集和写入数据，而 metric streams 是专门为连续的近实时指标交付而构建的。
- **D:** 使用 bootstrap 脚本安装 Kinesis Agent 会在 EC2 实例启动期间运行，这可能会影响启动速度。它还从实例收集数据，而不是使用账户级 CloudWatch Auto Scaling metrics stream，后者是 Auto Scaling group 状态数据的托管来源。

en.question: A company has an application that places hundreds of .csv files into an Amazon S3 bucket every hour. The files are 1 GB in size. Each time a file is uploaded, the company needs to convert the file to Apache Parquet format and place the output file into an S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to download the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function for each S3 PUT event.
options.B: Create an Apache Spark job to read the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the Spark job.
options.C: Create an AWS Glue table and an AWS Glue crawler for the S3 bucket where the application places the .csv files. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically use Amazon Athena to query the AWS Glue table, convert the query results into Parquet format, and place the output files into an S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Parquet format and place the output files into an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the ETL job.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

AWS Glue is the best fit because the workload is a recurring ETL file-format conversion at scale. AWS Glue is designed to “transform, prepare, and clean data for analysis,” can invoke jobs “on a schedule, on demand, or based on an event,” and can automatically scale workers based on workload ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)). AWS Glue also directly supports writing Parquet output to Amazon S3 by specifying `format="parquet"` and an S3 output path in the ETL job ([Using the Parquet format in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-parquet-home.html)). A Lambda function can be triggered by S3 object-created events, and Lambda can call AWS Glue `StartJobRun` to start the ETL job for the uploaded object ([S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html), [StartJobRun examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/example_glue_StartJobRun_section.html)). This provides serverless orchestration with less operational overhead than running and managing the conversion logic directly in Lambda or a self-managed Spark workflow.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A:** Lambda can be invoked by S3 PUT events, but using Lambda to download and transform each 1 GB file is not the best fit. Lambda has a maximum runtime of 900 seconds (15 minutes), and AWS notes that large S3 downloads and computational complexity can cause timeout risk ([Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)). This also puts the CSV-to-Parquet implementation and scaling/error handling into custom function code.
* **B:** Spark can perform the conversion, but this option introduces more operational overhead than AWS Glue. Glue can run Spark-based ETL jobs and automatically scale resources for jobs ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)), so creating a separate Spark job outside the managed Glue ETL pattern is unnecessarily complex.
* **C:** A Glue crawler/table is for cataloging and schema discovery, not the ETL conversion itself. The option also uses a scheduled Lambda/Athena process, which is less direct and may not process each new S3 PUT immediately. AWS Glue ETL directly supports event-based jobs and Parquet output to S3, making D simpler and more appropriate.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，每小时会将数百个 .csv 文件放入一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。这些文件大小为 1 GB。每次上传文件时，公司都需要将该文件转换为 Apache Parquet 格式，并将输出文件放入一个 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于下载 .csv 文件、将文件转换为 Parquet 格式，并将输出文件放入一个 S3 存储桶。针对每个 S3 PUT 事件调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 创建一个 Apache Spark 作业，用于读取 .csv 文件、将文件转换为 Parquet 格式，并将输出文件放入一个 S3 存储桶。针对每个 S3 PUT 事件创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来调用该 Spark 作业。
options.C: 为应用程序放置 .csv 文件的 S3 存储桶创建一个 AWS Glue 表和一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序。计划一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期使用 Amazon Athena 查询 AWS Glue 表，将查询结果转换为 Parquet 格式，并将输出文件放入一个 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) 作业，将 .csv 文件转换为 Parquet 格式，并将输出文件放入一个 S3 存储桶。针对每个 S3 PUT 事件创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来调用该 ETL 作业。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

AWS Glue 是最佳选择，因为该工作负载是在大规模场景下反复进行的 ETL 文件格式转换。AWS Glue 旨在“转换、准备和清理用于分析的数据”，可以“按计划、按需或基于事件”调用作业，并且可以根据工作负载自动扩展工作器（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。AWS Glue 还通过在 ETL 作业中指定 `format="parquet"` 和 S3 输出路径，直接支持将 Parquet 输出写入 Amazon S3（[Using the Parquet format in AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-format-parquet-home.html)）。Lambda 函数可以由 S3 object-created 事件触发，并且 Lambda 可以调用 AWS Glue `StartJobRun` 来为上传的对象启动 ETL 作业（[S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)，[StartJobRun examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/example_glue_StartJobRun_section.html)）。这提供了 serverless 编排，相比直接在 Lambda 中运行和管理转换逻辑或使用自管理 Spark 工作流，运营开销更少。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A:** Lambda 可以由 S3 PUT 事件调用，但使用 Lambda 下载并转换每个 1 GB 文件并不是最合适的选择。Lambda 的最大运行时间为 900 秒（15 分钟），并且 AWS 指出，大型 S3 下载和计算复杂性可能导致超时风险（[Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。这还会把 CSV 到 Parquet 的实现以及扩展/错误处理放入自定义函数代码中。
* **B:** Spark 可以执行该转换，但此选项比 AWS Glue 引入更多运营开销。Glue 可以运行基于 Spark 的 ETL 作业，并自动为作业扩展资源（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)），因此在托管 Glue ETL 模式之外创建单独的 Spark 作业是不必要的复杂化。
* **C:** Glue 爬网程序/表用于编目和架构发现，而不是用于 ETL 转换本身。该选项还使用计划的 Lambda/Athena 流程，这不够直接，并且可能无法立即处理每个新的 S3 PUT。AWS Glue ETL 直接支持基于事件的作业以及将 Parquet 输出到 S3，因此 D 更简单且更合适。

en.question: A company is implementing new data retention policies for all databases that run on Amazon RDS DB instances. The company must retain daily backups for a minimum period of 2 years. The backups must be consistent and restorable. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a backup vault in AWS Backup to retain RDS backups. Create a new backup plan with a daily schedule and an expiration period of 2 years after creation. Assign the RDS DB instances to the backup plan.
options.B: Configure a backup window for the RDS DB instances for daily snapshots. Assign a snapshot retention policy of 2 years to each RDS DB instance. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to schedule snapshot deletions.
options.C: Configure database transaction logs to be automatically backed up to Amazon CloudWatch Logs with an expiration period of 2 years.
options.D: Configure an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication task. Deploy a replication instance, and configure a change data capture (CDC) task to stream database changes to Amazon S3 as the target. Configure S3 Lifecycle policies to delete the snapshots after 2 years.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS Backup is designed for centralized, policy-based backup across AWS services. Its docs state that you can create backup plans to define backup requirements and apply them to protected resources, and that AWS Backup can back up and restore **Amazon RDS database instances**. When creating a backup plan, the console workflow lets you choose or create a backup vault, set the backup frequency/schedule, and set lifecycle/total retention period. For RDS specifically, AWS Backup periodic snapshots are snapshot-based backups taken according to the backup plan schedule. Therefore, a daily AWS Backup plan with a 2-year retention period assigned to the RDS DB instances meets the retention and restorable-backup requirement. [AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html), [Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html), [RDS backups with AWS Backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/rds-backup.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B** is not suitable. Native RDS automated backup retention can be set only from **0 to 35 days** for a DB instance, not 2 years. Also, Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager is for automating creation, retention, and deletion of **EBS snapshots and EBS-backed AMIs**, not RDS snapshots. [RDS backup retention](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html), [Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)
- **C** is incorrect because sending transaction logs to CloudWatch Logs is not a database backup plan and does not provide RDS recovery points/snapshots that can be restored as databases.
- **D** is incorrect because AWS DMS CDC is for ongoing replication/migration from a change stream, not for retaining daily, consistent, restorable RDS backup recovery points. AWS DMS documentation describes CDC tasks as ongoing replication starting from CDC points in transaction logs. [AWS DMS CDC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在为所有运行在 Amazon RDS DB 实例上的数据库实施新的数据保留策略。该公司必须将每日备份至少保留 2 年。备份必须一致且可恢复。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种解决方案来满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Backup 中创建一个备份保管库以保留 RDS 备份。创建一个新的备份计划，设置每日计划，并将过期时间设置为创建后 2 年。将 RDS DB 实例分配给该备份计划。
options.B: 为 RDS DB 实例配置一个备份窗口以进行每日快照。为每个 RDS DB 实例分配 2 年的快照保留策略。使用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 来计划快照删除。
options.C: 将数据库事务日志配置为自动备份到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs，并设置 2 年的过期时间。
options.D: 配置 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 复制任务。部署一个复制实例，并配置一个变更数据捕获 (CDC) 任务，以将数据库更改流式传输到作为目标的 Amazon S3。配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略，以在 2 年后删除快照。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** AWS Backup 旨在为 AWS 服务提供集中式、基于策略的备份。其文档说明，你可以创建备份计划来定义备份要求并将其应用于受保护资源，并且 AWS Backup 可以备份和还原 **Amazon RDS database instances**。创建备份计划时，控制台工作流允许你选择或创建备份保管库、设置备份频率/计划，并设置生命周期/总保留期。对于 RDS，AWS Backup 周期性快照是根据备份计划的计划执行的基于快照的备份。因此，将具有 2 年保留期的每日 AWS Backup 计划分配给 RDS DB 实例，可以满足保留和可恢复备份的要求。[AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html), [Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html), [RDS backups with AWS Backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/rds-backup.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B** 不适合。原生 RDS 自动备份保留期对于一个 DB 实例只能设置为 **0 to 35 days**，而不是 2 年。此外，Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 用于自动创建、保留和删除 **EBS snapshots and EBS-backed AMIs**，而不是 RDS 快照。[RDS backup retention](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html), [Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)
- **C** 不正确，因为将事务日志发送到 CloudWatch Logs 并不是数据库备份计划，也不会提供可作为数据库还原的 RDS 恢复点/快照。
- **D** 不正确，因为 AWS DMS CDC 用于从变更流进行持续复制/迁移，而不是用于保留每日、一致且可恢复的 RDS 备份恢复点。AWS DMS 文档将 CDC 任务描述为从事务日志中的 CDC 点开始的持续复制。[AWS DMS CDC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)

en.question: A company’s compliance team needs to move its file shares to AWS. The shares run on a Windows Server SMB file share. A self-managed on-premises Active Directory controls access to the files and folders. The company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as part of the solution. The company must ensure that the on-premises Active Directory groups restrict access to the FSx for Windows File Server SMB compliance shares, folders, and files after the move to AWS. The company has created an FSx for Windows File Server file system. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Active Directory Connector to connect to the Active Directory. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
options.B: Assign a tag with a Restrict tag key and a Compliance tag value. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
options.C: Create an IAM service-linked role that is linked directly to FSx for Windows File Server to restrict access.
options.D: Join the file system to the Active Directory to restrict access.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D**.

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is designed to integrate with Microsoft Active Directory. AWS states that when you create an FSx for Windows File Server file system, you **join it to your Active Directory domain** to provide **user authentication and file- and folder-level access control**. Users can then use their existing Active Directory identities to authenticate and control access to individual files and folders, and existing ACLs can be migrated without modification ([AWS FSx AD integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/aws-ad-integration-fsxW.html)). For a self-managed on-premises AD, AWS specifically says you can join the FSx for Windows File Server file system to that self-managed Active Directory domain ([self-managed AD for FSx](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/self-managed-AD.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** is incorrect because Amazon FSx for Windows File Server does **not** support Active Directory Connector, and mapping AD groups to IAM groups is not how SMB share, folder, and file permissions are enforced. AWS explicitly notes that Amazon FSx does not support Active Directory Connector ([AWS FSx AD integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/aws-ad-integration-fsxW.html)).
- **B** is incorrect because resource tags do not enforce Windows SMB share, folder, or file permissions. FSx for Windows File Server uses Windows/Active Directory identities and ACLs for file-level access control.
- **C** is incorrect because an IAM service-linked role is for AWS service permissions, not for restricting SMB access to Windows shares, folders, and files by on-premises AD groups.

Therefore, the file system must be joined to the Active Directory domain so the existing AD groups and ACL-based permissions can restrict access.

zh.question: 一家公司的合规团队需要将其文件共享迁移到 AWS。这些共享运行在 Windows Server SMB 文件共享上。一个自管理的本地 Active Directory 控制对文件和文件夹的访问。该公司希望将 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 作为解决方案的一部分。公司必须确保在迁移到 AWS 后，本地 Active Directory 组能够限制对 FSx for Windows File Server SMB 合规共享、文件夹和文件的访问。公司已创建了一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Active Directory Connector 以连接到 Active Directory。将 Active Directory 组映射到 IAM 组以限制访问。
options.B: 分配一个标签，其标签键为 Restrict，标签值为 Compliance。将 Active Directory 组映射到 IAM 组以限制访问。
options.C: 创建一个直接链接到 FSx for Windows File Server 的 IAM 服务相关角色以限制访问。
options.D: 将文件系统加入 Active Directory 以限制访问。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D**。

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 旨在与 Microsoft Active Directory 集成。AWS 表示，当你创建 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统时，你会将其 **加入你的 Active Directory 域**，以提供 **用户身份验证以及文件和文件夹级别的访问控制**。然后，用户可以使用其现有的 Active Directory 身份进行身份验证，并控制对单个文件和文件夹的访问；现有 ACL 也可以在不修改的情况下迁移（[AWS FSx AD integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/aws-ad-integration-fsxW.html)）。对于自管理的本地 AD，AWS 明确表示你可以将 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统加入该自管理的 Active Directory 域（[self-managed AD for FSx](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/self-managed-AD.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A** 不正确，因为 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server **不**支持 Active Directory Connector，并且将 AD 组映射到 IAM 组并不是强制执行 SMB 共享、文件夹和文件权限的方式。AWS 明确指出 Amazon FSx 不支持 Active Directory Connector（[AWS FSx AD integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/aws-ad-integration-fsxW.html)）。
- **B** 不正确，因为资源标签不会强制执行 Windows SMB 共享、文件夹或文件权限。FSx for Windows File Server 使用 Windows/Active Directory 身份和 ACL 进行文件级访问控制。
- **C** 不正确，因为 IAM 服务相关角色用于 AWS 服务权限，而不是用于通过本地 AD 组限制对 Windows 共享、文件夹和文件的 SMB 访问。因此，必须将文件系统加入 Active Directory 域，以便现有 AD 组和基于 ACL 的权限能够限制访问。

en.question: A company recently announced the deployment of its retail website to a global audience. The website runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The company wants to provide its customers with different versions of content based on the devices that the customers use to access the website. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront to cache multiple versions of the content.
options.B: Configure a host header in a Network Load Balancer to forward traffic to different instances.
options.C: Configure a Lambda@Edge function to send specific objects to users based on the User-Agent header.
options.D: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up host-based routing to different EC2 instances.
options.E: Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up path-based routing to different EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and C**.

- **A is correct**: Amazon CloudFront can cache separate versions of the same object based on request header values. AWS states that this lets you serve different versions of content based on criteria such as the **device the user is using**. This meets the global retail website requirement by caching device-specific content at edge locations. See [Cache content based on request headers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/header-caching.html).
- **C is correct**: Lambda@Edge can customize CloudFront behavior based on viewer device type. The AWS Lambda@Edge examples include “Serve different versions of an object based on the device,” where the function rewrites the request URI to `/desktop`, `/mobile`, `/tablet`, or `/smarttv` content based on CloudFront device headers. See [Lambda@Edge example functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-examples.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect**: A Network Load Balancer is not used for HTTP host-header routing. NLB listeners support protocols such as TCP, TLS, UDP, TCP_UDP, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC, and their default action forwards requests to target groups. Host-header and path-pattern conditions are Application Load Balancer listener rule features, not NLB features. See [Network Load Balancer listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html) and [Application Load Balancer listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html).
- **D is incorrect**: It relies on an NLB doing host-based routing, which is not supported by NLB listener rules. Host-header conditions are documented for Application Load Balancer rules, not Network Load Balancers. See [Application Load Balancer listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html).
- **E is incorrect**: It relies on an NLB doing path-based routing, which is also an Application Load Balancer listener rule condition, not an NLB feature. See [Application Load Balancer listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html).

zh.question: 一家公司最近宣布将其零售网站部署给全球受众。该网站运行在 Elastic Load Balancer 后面的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些实例在跨多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组中运行。公司希望根据客户用于访问网站的设备，为客户提供不同版本的内容。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 以缓存内容的多个版本。
options.B: 在 Network Load Balancer 中配置主机标头，以将流量转发到不同实例。
options.C: 配置 Lambda@Edge 函数，以根据 User-Agent 标头向用户发送特定对象。
options.D: 配置 AWS Global Accelerator。将请求转发到 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。配置 NLB 以设置基于主机的路由到不同的 EC2 实例。
options.E: 配置 AWS Global Accelerator。将请求转发到 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。配置 NLB 以设置基于路径的路由到不同的 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 C**。

- **A 正确**：Amazon CloudFront 可以根据请求标头值缓存同一对象的不同版本。AWS 表示，这使你能够根据诸如**用户正在使用的设备**等条件提供不同版本的内容。通过在边缘站点缓存特定于设备的内容，这满足了全球零售网站的要求。请参阅 [Cache content based on request headers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/header-caching.html)。
- **C 正确**：Lambda@Edge 可以根据查看者设备类型自定义 CloudFront 行为。AWS Lambda@Edge 示例包括“Serve different versions of an object based on the device”，其中函数会根据 CloudFront 设备标头将请求 URI 重写为 `/desktop`、`/mobile`、`/tablet` 或 `/smarttv` 内容。请参阅 [Lambda@Edge example functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-examples.html)。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确**：Network Load Balancer 不用于 HTTP 主机标头路由。NLB 监听器支持 TCP、TLS、UDP、TCP_UDP、QUIC 和 TCP_QUIC 等协议，其默认操作是将请求转发到目标组。主机标头和路径模式条件是 Application Load Balancer 监听器规则功能，而不是 NLB 功能。请参阅 [Network Load Balancer listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html) 和 [Application Load Balancer listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)。
- **D 不正确**：它依赖 NLB 执行基于主机的路由，而 NLB 监听器规则不支持这一点。主机标头条件记录在 Application Load Balancer 规则中，而不是 Network Load Balancers 中。请参阅 [Application Load Balancer listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)。
- **E 不正确**：它依赖 NLB 执行基于路径的路由，而这同样是 Application Load Balancer 监听器规则条件，不是 NLB 功能。请参阅 [Application Load Balancer listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)。

en.question: A company plans to use Amazon ElastiCache for its multi-tier web application. A solutions architect creates a Cache VPC for the ElastiCache cluster and an App VPC for the application’s Amazon EC2 instances. Both VPCs are in the us-east-1 Region. The solutions architect must implement a solution to provide the application’s EC2 instances with access to the ElastiCache cluster. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.
options.B: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster's security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.
options.C: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the peering connection’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.
options.D: Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the Transit VPC’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS documentation for ElastiCache access in **different VPCs in the same Region** states that you can use **VPC peering**. The documented procedure is to **peer the two VPCs**, **update the routing table**, and **modify the ElastiCache cache security group to allow inbound connection from the application security group in the peered VPC** ([ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)). This matches option A exactly. VPC peering is also direct/private connectivity between two VPCs and does not require a gateway, Site-to-Site VPN, or additional physical hardware ([Amazon VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)), making it the most cost-effective fit for two VPCs in the same Region.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B**: A Transit VPC is unnecessary for two VPCs in the same Region. The ElastiCache documentation presents VPC peering as the same-Region approach, while Transit VPC is discussed as an alternative pattern for connecting geographically dispersed/different-Region VPCs ([ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)). This adds avoidable complexity and cost.
- **C**: The routing portion is correct, but a **VPC peering connection does not have a security group** to configure. The documented step is to modify the **ElastiCache cache security group** to allow inbound access from the application security group ([ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)).
- **D**: Like B, Transit VPC is not the most cost-effective same-Region solution, and configuring a Transit VPC security group is not the documented control point for ElastiCache access. The required inbound rule belongs on the **ElastiCache cache security group**, not on a transit component ([ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将 Amazon ElastiCache 用于其多层 Web 应用程序。一名解决方案架构师为 ElastiCache 集群创建了一个 Cache VPC，并为应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例创建了一个 App VPC。两个 VPC 都位于 us-east-1 Region。该解决方案架构师必须实施一种解决方案，使应用程序的 EC2 实例能够访问 ElastiCache 集群。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在两个 VPC 之间创建对等连接。在两个 VPC 中为该对等连接添加路由表条目。为 ElastiCache 集群的安全组配置入站规则，以允许来自应用程序安全组的入站连接。
options.B: 创建一个 Transit VPC。更新 Cache VPC 和 App VPC 中的 VPC 路由表，使流量通过 Transit VPC 路由。为 ElastiCache 集群的安全组配置入站规则，以允许来自应用程序安全组的入站连接。
options.C: 在两个 VPC 之间创建对等连接。在两个 VPC 中为该对等连接添加路由表条目。为该对等连接的安全组配置入站规则，以允许来自应用程序安全组的入站连接。
options.D: 创建一个 Transit VPC。更新 Cache VPC 和 App VPC 中的 VPC 路由表，使流量通过 Transit VPC 路由。为 Transit VPC 的安全组配置入站规则，以允许来自应用程序安全组的入站连接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

关于 **同一 Region 中不同 VPC** 的 ElastiCache 访问，AWS 文档说明可以使用 **VPC peering**。文档所述流程是：**将两个 VPC 建立对等连接**、**更新路由表**，并且**修改 ElastiCache 缓存安全组，以允许来自对等 VPC 中应用程序安全组的入站连接**（[ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)）。这与选项 A 完全匹配。VPC peering 还提供两个 VPC 之间的直接/私有连接，并且不需要网关、Site-to-Site VPN 或额外的物理硬件（[Amazon VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)），因此对于同一 Region 中的两个 VPC，这是最具成本效益的选择。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B**：对于同一 Region 中的两个 VPC，不需要 Transit VPC。ElastiCache 文档将 VPC peering 作为同一 Region 的方法，而 Transit VPC 被讨论为用于连接地理位置分散/不同 Region VPC 的替代模式（[ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)）。这会增加可避免的复杂性和成本。
- **C**：路由部分是正确的，但 **VPC peering 连接没有可配置的安全组**。文档步骤是修改 **ElastiCache 缓存安全组**，以允许来自应用程序安全组的入站访问（[ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)）。
- **D**：与 B 一样，Transit VPC 不是同一 Region 场景下最具成本效益的解决方案，并且配置 Transit VPC 安全组并不是文档中用于 ElastiCache 访问的控制点。所需的入站规则应位于 **ElastiCache 缓存安全组** 上，而不是位于某个传输组件上（[ElastiCache VPC access patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-vpc-accessing.html)）。

en.question: A company is building an application that consists of several microservices. The company has decided to use container technologies to deploy its software on AWS. The company needs a solution that minimizes the amount of ongoing effort for maintenance and scaling. The company cannot manage additional infrastructure. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster.
options.B: Deploy the Kubernetes control plane on Amazon EC2 instances that span multiple Availability Zones.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Specify a desired task number level of greater than or equal to 2.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service with a Fargate launch type. Specify a desired task number level of greater than or equal to 2.
options.E: Deploy Kubernetes worker nodes on Amazon EC2 instances that span multiple Availability Zones. Create a deployment that specifies two or more replicas for each microservice.

en.explanation:
The best combination is **A and D**.

- **A is correct** because an Amazon ECS cluster is the logical grouping used to run ECS tasks and services for containerized applications. AWS documentation states that an ECS cluster is “a logical grouping of tasks or services” that provides infrastructure capacity for containerized applications, and a cluster can contain tasks hosted on AWS Fargate, EC2, or other infrastructure types ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)).
- **D is correct** because Fargate is the serverless ECS compute option. AWS states that Fargate lets you run containers “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances” and removes the need to “provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines” ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). An ECS service is appropriate for long-running applications, and the ECS service scheduler supports changing the desired number of running tasks and spreads tasks across multiple Availability Zones by default ([Schedule your containers on Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/scheduling_tasks.html)). Setting desired tasks to at least 2 improves availability for the microservices.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **B is wrong** because deploying the Kubernetes control plane on EC2 instances would require the company to manage those EC2 instances and the Kubernetes control plane, which violates the requirement to avoid additional infrastructure management.
- **C is wrong** because the ECS EC2 launch type uses EC2 container instances. AWS states that when tasks are placed on active container instances, “you are responsible for the container instance management and maintenance” ([Amazon EC2 container instances for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/create-capacity.html)). This does not minimize operational effort as well as Fargate.
- **E is wrong** because deploying Kubernetes worker nodes on EC2 instances also requires managing the EC2 worker-node infrastructure, which conflicts with the requirement that the company cannot manage additional infrastructure.

Therefore, the lowest-maintenance solution is to use **Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate**: create an ECS cluster and run ECS services on Fargate with a desired task count of at least 2.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个由多个微服务组成的应用程序。该公司已决定使用容器技术在 AWS 上部署其软件。该公司需要一种解决方案，以最大限度地减少持续维护和扩展所需的工作量。该公司无法管理额外的基础设施。解决方案架构师应采取哪一组操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 部署一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。
options.B: 在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署 Kubernetes 控制平面。
options.C: 部署一个使用 Amazon EC2 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务。指定所需任务数量级别大于或等于 2。
options.D: 部署一个使用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务。指定所需任务数量级别大于或等于 2。
options.E: 在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署 Kubernetes 工作节点。创建一个部署，为每个微服务指定两个或更多副本。

zh.explanation:
最佳组合是 **A 和 D**。

- **A 正确**，因为 Amazon ECS 集群是用于为容器化应用程序运行 ECS 任务和服务的逻辑分组。AWS 文档指出，ECS 集群是“任务或服务的逻辑分组”，为容器化应用程序提供基础设施容量，并且一个集群可以包含托管在 AWS Fargate、EC2 或其他基础设施类型上的任务（[Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)）。
- **D 正确**，因为 Fargate 是 serverless ECS 计算选项。AWS 表示，Fargate 允许你运行容器，“without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances”，并且无需“provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines”（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。ECS 服务适用于长期运行的应用程序，并且 ECS 服务调度器支持更改所需运行任务数量，默认会将任务分布到多个 Availability Zones（[Schedule your containers on Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/scheduling_tasks.html)）。将所需任务数量设置为至少 2 可以提高微服务的可用性。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B 错误**，因为在 EC2 实例上部署 Kubernetes 控制平面将要求公司管理这些 EC2 实例和 Kubernetes 控制平面，这违反了避免额外基础设施管理的要求。
- **C 错误**，因为 ECS EC2 启动类型使用 EC2 容器实例。AWS 表示，当任务被放置在活动容器实例上时，“you are responsible for the container instance management and maintenance”（[Amazon EC2 container instances for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/create-capacity.html)）。与 Fargate 相比，这并不能同样程度地最大限度减少运维工作量。
- **E 错误**，因为在 EC2 实例上部署 Kubernetes 工作节点同样需要管理 EC2 工作节点基础设施，这与公司无法管理额外基础设施的要求相冲突。因此，维护工作量最低的解决方案是使用 **Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate**：创建 ECS 集群，并在 Fargate 上运行 ECS 服务，将所需任务计数设置为至少 2。

en.question: A company has a web application hosted over 10 Amazon EC2 instances with traffic directed by Amazon Route 53. The company occasionally experiences a timeout error when attempting to browse the application. The networking team finds that some DNS queries return IP addresses of unhealthy instances, resulting in the timeout error. What should a solutions architect implement to overcome these timeout errors?

options.A: Create a Route 53 simple routing policy record for each EC2 instance. Associate a health check with each record.
options.B: Create a Route 53 failover routing policy record for each EC2 instance. Associate a health check with each record.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with EC2 instances as its origin. Associate a health check with the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a health check in front of the EC2 instances. Route to the ALB from Route 53.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

An Application Load Balancer is the best fit for a web application running on multiple EC2 instances. AWS states that a load balancer is a single point of contact that distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets such as EC2 instances, and that ALB target groups can have health checks. AWS also states that these health checks let the load balancer send requests **only to healthy targets** ([Application Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)). Route 53 can then route the application DNS name to the ELB load balancer by using an alias record ([Route 53 routing to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)). This removes the need for clients to receive individual EC2 instance IP addresses and avoids routing traffic to unhealthy instances.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Simple routing is not appropriate for multiple EC2 instance endpoints with health-based load balancing. AWS says simple routing is typically for a **single resource** and, if multiple IP values are specified, Route 53 returns all values in random order; with simple routing, those IP addresses are **not health checked** ([Simple routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-simple.html)).
- **B:** Failover routing is for **active-passive failover**, not normal load balancing across 10 active web servers. AWS describes failover routing as sending traffic to one resource when healthy or to a different resource when the first is unhealthy ([Failover routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-failover.html)); active-passive failover is for a primary resource or group with a secondary standby resource or group ([Active-active and active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)).
- **C:** CloudFront origin failover is not the stated solution for health-checking and distributing traffic across 10 EC2 instances. AWS CloudFront origin failover uses an origin group with a primary and secondary origin and sends requests to the secondary origin only after the primary fails in configured ways ([CloudFront origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)). It does not replace an ALB for balancing requests across multiple EC2 targets with target health checks.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Web 应用程序托管在 10 个 Amazon EC2 实例上，流量由 Amazon Route 53 定向。该公司在尝试浏览该应用程序时偶尔会遇到超时错误。网络团队发现，一些 DNS 查询返回了不健康实例的 IP 地址，从而导致超时错误。解决方案架构师应实施什么来克服这些超时错误？

options.A: 为每个 EC2 实例创建一个 Route 53 简单路由策略记录。将运行状况检查与每条记录关联。
options.B: 为每个 EC2 实例创建一个 Route 53 故障转移路由策略记录。将运行状况检查与每条记录关联。
options.C: 创建一个以 EC2 实例作为源站的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将运行状况检查与 EC2 实例关联。
options.D: 在 EC2 实例前创建一个带有运行状况检查的 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。从 Route 53 路由到 ALB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

Application Load Balancer 最适合运行在多个 EC2 实例上的 Web 应用程序。AWS 说明，负载均衡器是单一联系点，可在多个目标（例如 EC2 实例）之间分发传入的应用程序流量，并且 ALB 目标组可以具有运行状况检查。AWS 还说明，这些运行状况检查使负载均衡器能够**仅向健康目标**发送请求（[Application Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。然后，Route 53 可以使用别名记录将应用程序 DNS 名称路由到 ELB 负载均衡器（[Route 53 routing to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)）。这消除了客户端接收单个 EC2 实例 IP 地址的需要，并避免将流量路由到不健康实例。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 简单路由不适合具有基于运行状况的负载均衡的多个 EC2 实例端点。AWS 表示，简单路由通常用于**单个资源**，并且如果指定了多个 IP 值，Route 53 会按随机顺序返回所有值；使用简单路由时，这些 IP 地址**不会进行运行状况检查**（[Simple routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-simple.html)）。
- **B:** 故障转移路由用于**主动-被动故障转移**，而不是在 10 台活动 Web 服务器之间进行常规负载均衡。AWS 将故障转移路由描述为：当一个资源健康时向其发送流量，或当第一个资源不健康时向另一个不同资源发送流量（[Failover routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-failover.html)）；主动-被动故障转移用于主资源或主资源组，以及辅助备用资源或资源组（[Active-active and active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。
- **C:** CloudFront 源站故障转移并不是针对 10 个 EC2 实例进行运行状况检查并分发流量的既定解决方案。AWS CloudFront 源站故障转移使用包含主源站和辅助源站的源站组，并且仅在主源站按配置方式失败后才将请求发送到辅助源站（[CloudFront origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)）。它不能替代 ALB 来在具有目标运行状况检查的多个 EC2 目标之间均衡请求。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to design a highly available application consisting of web, application, and database tiers. HTTPS content delivery should be as close to the edge as possible, with the least delivery time. Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST secure?

options.A: Configure a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the public ALB as the origin.
options.B: Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.
options.C: Configure a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the public ALB as the origin.
options.D: Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** CloudFront is the right service for HTTPS delivery close to users because a distribution uses edge servers close to viewers to deliver content quickly, and it can require HTTPS between viewers and CloudFront and between CloudFront and the origin ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html), [Use HTTPS with CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https.html)). Using an internet-facing/public ALB as the CloudFront origin is valid; AWS documents using internet-facing Application Load Balancers with CloudFront and notes that CloudFront can cache and serve content to viewers, reducing load on the ALB ([Restrict access to Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/restrict-access-to-load-balancer.html)). Placing the EC2 instances in private subnets is more secure because Elastic Load Balancing routes requests to targets using private IP addresses, so targets do not need public IP addresses to receive requests from an internet-facing load balancer ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). ALB also supports high availability because Application Load Balancers require at least two Availability Zones, and if one AZ is unavailable the load balancer can route to healthy targets in another AZ ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A**: Although CloudFront with a public ALB origin is appropriate, placing the EC2 instances in public subnets is less secure than private subnets because the targets do not need public IP addresses when behind an internet-facing load balancer.
- **B**: This bypasses the ALB by configuring CloudFront to use the EC2 instances as the origin, so it does not use the ALB for origin load balancing and high availability. EC2 instances in private subnets also are not the appropriate public custom origin in this design.
- **D**: This both exposes EC2 instances in public subnets and bypasses the ALB by using the EC2 instances as the CloudFront origin, making it less secure and less highly available than using CloudFront -> public ALB -> private EC2 targets.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要设计一个由 Web 层、应用层和数据库层组成的高可用应用程序。HTTPS 内容交付应尽可能靠近边缘位置，并且交付时间最短。哪种解决方案满足这些要求并且最安全？

options.A: 配置一个公共 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，并在公有子网中配置多个冗余 Amazon EC2 实例。配置 Amazon CloudFront 使用该公共 ALB 作为源站来交付 HTTPS 内容。
options.B: 配置一个公共 Application Load Balancer，并在私有子网中配置多个冗余 Amazon EC2 实例。配置 Amazon CloudFront 使用这些 EC2 实例作为源站来交付 HTTPS 内容。
options.C: 配置一个公共 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，并在私有子网中配置多个冗余 Amazon EC2 实例。配置 Amazon CloudFront 使用该公共 ALB 作为源站来交付 HTTPS 内容。
options.D: 配置一个公共 Application Load Balancer，并在公有子网中配置多个冗余 Amazon EC2 实例。配置 Amazon CloudFront 使用这些 EC2 实例作为源站来交付 HTTPS 内容。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** CloudFront 是将 HTTPS 交付到靠近用户位置的正确服务，因为一个分配会使用靠近查看者的边缘服务器来快速交付内容，并且它可以要求查看者与 CloudFront 之间以及 CloudFront 与源站之间使用 HTTPS（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)，[Use HTTPS with CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https.html)）。使用面向互联网/公共 ALB 作为 CloudFront 源站是有效的；AWS 文档说明了将面向互联网的 Application Load Balancers 与 CloudFront 一起使用，并指出 CloudFront 可以缓存内容并将其提供给查看者，从而减少 ALB 上的负载（[Restrict access to Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/restrict-access-to-load-balancer.html)）。将 EC2 实例放在私有子网中更安全，因为 Elastic Load Balancing 使用私有 IP 地址将请求路由到目标，因此目标不需要公有 IP 地址即可接收来自面向互联网的负载均衡器的请求（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。ALB 也支持高可用性，因为 Application Load Balancers 至少需要两个 Availability Zones，并且如果一个 AZ 不可用，负载均衡器可以将请求路由到另一个 AZ 中的正常目标（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A**：尽管使用 CloudFront 并以公共 ALB 作为源站是合适的，但将 EC2 实例放在公有子网中不如放在私有子网中安全，因为在面向互联网的负载均衡器后面的目标不需要公有 IP 地址。
- **B**：这通过配置 CloudFront 使用 EC2 实例作为源站而绕过了 ALB，因此没有使用 ALB 进行源站负载均衡和实现高可用性。私有子网中的 EC2 实例也不是此设计中合适的公共自定义源站。
- **D**：这既暴露了公有子网中的 EC2 实例，又通过使用 EC2 实例作为 CloudFront 源站绕过了 ALB，因此与使用 CloudFront -> public ALB -> private EC2 targets 相比，它安全性更低且高可用性更差。

en.question: A company has a popular gaming platform running on AWS. The application is sensitive to latency because latency can impact the user experience and introduce unfair advantages to some players. The application is deployed in every AWS Region. It runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are part of Auto Scaling groups configured behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs). A solutions architect needs to implement a mechanism to monitor the health of the application and redirect traffic to healthy endpoints. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Add a listener for the port that the application listens on, and attach it to a Regional endpoint in each Region. Add the ALB as the endpoint.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and specify the ALB as the origin server. Configure the cache behavior to use origin cache headers. Use AWS Lambda functions to optimize the traffic.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and specify Amazon S3 as the origin server. Configure the cache behavior to use origin cache headers. Use AWS Lambda functions to optimize the traffic.
options.D: Configure an Amazon DynamoDB database to serve as the data store for the application. Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster to act as the in-memory cache for DynamoDB hosting the application data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Global Accelerator is designed for global, latency-sensitive applications. For a standard accelerator, AWS states that it routes traffic over the AWS global network to the **optimal regional endpoint based on health, client location, and configured policies**, and that supported endpoints include **Application Load Balancers** in one or multiple Regions ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Its setup model also matches the option: create an accelerator, configure listeners for the required protocol/port, configure regional endpoint groups, and add regional resources such as load balancers as endpoints ([getting started with Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-get-started.html)). Global Accelerator continuously monitors endpoint health and directs new connections away from unhealthy endpoints to available healthy endpoints ([how Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)); if an endpoint group has no healthy endpoint, it attempts failover to a healthy endpoint in another Region ([failover for unhealthy endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-endpoint-weights.unhealthy-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** CloudFront is primarily a content delivery/cache service. It routes requests to edge locations, checks the cache, and forwards cache misses to an origin such as an S3 bucket or HTTP server ([CloudFront delivery process](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html)). It is not the best fit for optimizing dynamic gaming traffic across ALBs in every Region with endpoint health-based regional failover.
- **C:** Using S3 as the origin is unsuitable because the application runs on EC2 behind ALBs, not from S3. This option also does not address routing to healthy regional application endpoints.
- **D:** DAX is an in-memory cache for DynamoDB read access; AWS describes it as useful for microsecond-latency reads and read-intensive DynamoDB workloads ([DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). It does not monitor ALB/application endpoint health or redirect global user traffic.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个热门游戏平台。该应用程序对延迟很敏感，因为延迟会影响用户体验，并给某些玩家带来不公平优势。该应用程序部署在每个 AWS Region 中。它运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，这些实例属于配置在 Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 后面的 Auto Scaling 组。解决方案架构师需要实现一种机制来监控应用程序的运行状况，并将流量重定向到健康端点。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中配置一个加速器。为应用程序侦听的端口添加一个侦听器，并将其附加到每个 Region 中的 Regional endpoint。将 ALB 添加为端点。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 ALB 指定为源服务器。配置缓存行为以使用源缓存标头。使用 AWS Lambda 函数来优化流量。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 Amazon S3 指定为源服务器。配置缓存行为以使用源缓存标头。使用 AWS Lambda 函数来优化流量。
options.D: 配置一个 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库作为应用程序的数据存储。创建一个 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 集群，作为托管应用程序数据的 DynamoDB 的内存缓存。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

AWS Global Accelerator 专为全球性、对延迟敏感的应用程序而设计。对于标准加速器，AWS 表示它会通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到**基于运行状况、客户端位置和已配置策略的最佳区域端点**，并且支持的端点包括一个或多个 Region 中的 **Application Load Balancers**（[AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。其设置模型也与该选项匹配：创建加速器，为所需协议/端口配置侦听器，配置区域端点组，并将负载均衡器等区域资源添加为端点（[getting started with Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-get-started.html)）。Global Accelerator 会持续监控端点运行状况，并将新连接从不健康端点引导到可用的健康端点（[how Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)）；如果某个端点组没有健康端点，它会尝试故障转移到另一个 Region 中的健康端点（[failover for unhealthy endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-endpoint-weights.unhealthy-endpoints.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** CloudFront 主要是一项内容交付/缓存服务。它将请求路由到边缘站点，检查缓存，并将缓存未命中转发到源，例如 S3 存储桶或 HTTP 服务器（[CloudFront delivery process](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html)）。对于在每个 Region 中跨 ALBs 优化动态游戏流量并基于端点运行状况进行区域故障转移，它并不是最佳选择。
- **C:** 使用 S3 作为源并不合适，因为该应用程序运行在 ALBs 后面的 EC2 上，而不是从 S3 运行。此选项也没有解决将流量路由到健康区域应用程序端点的问题。
- **D:** DAX 是用于 DynamoDB 读取访问的内存缓存；AWS 将其描述为适用于微秒级延迟读取和读取密集型 DynamoDB 工作负载（[DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。它不会监控 ALB/应用程序端点运行状况，也不会重定向全球用户流量。

en.question: A company has one million users that use its mobile app. The company must analyze the data usage in near-real time. The company also must encrypt the data in near-real time and must store the data in a centralized location in Apache Parquet format for further processing. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics application to analyze the data. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to send the data to the Kinesis Data Analytics application.
options.B: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to analyze the data. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to send the data to the EMR cluster.
options.C: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to analyze the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics application to analyze the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Amazon Data Firehose is the lowest-overhead ingestion and delivery choice here because producers send records to a Firehose stream, and for Amazon S3 destinations Firehose delivers the streaming data to the S3 bucket; it buffers by size or interval before delivery, which fits near-real-time delivery semantics ([Amazon Data Firehose concepts and data flow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)). Firehose also directly supports S3 server-side encryption with AWS KMS for delivered data ([advanced Firehose settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-configure-advanced.html)).
