options.B: 预置两个跨两个 Availability Zones 扩展的子网。配置 Auto Scaling group，使 EC2 实例分布在两个 Availability Zones 中。配置 DB instance，使其连接到每个网络。
options.C: 在每个 Availability Zone 中预置一个子网。配置 Auto Scaling group，使 EC2 实例分布在两个 Availability Zones 中。将 DB instance 配置为 Multi-AZ deployment。
options.D: 预置一个跨两个 Availability Zones 扩展的子网。配置 Auto Scaling group，使 EC2 实例分布在两个 Availability Zones 中。将 DB instance 配置为 Multi-AZ deployment。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

要使应用程序跨两个 Availability Zones 实现高可用性，EC2 层和数据库层都必须针对 AZ 故障进行设计。AWS VPC 子网以 AZ 为范围：“Each subnet must reside entirely within one Availability Zone and cannot span zones”，并且将资源放置在不同的 AZs 中有助于保护应用程序免受单个 AZ 故障的影响（[AWS VPC subnets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/configure-subnets.html)）。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 可以在启用的 Availability Zones 之间保持相等数量的实例；如果在某个 AZ 中启动尝试失败，它可以在另一个健康的 AZ 中启动实例（[Auto Scaling AZ distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-availability-zone-balanced.html)）。对于数据库，Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments 通过在不同的 Availability Zone 中自动预置并维护一个同步备用副本，提供高可用性和故障转移支持，从而帮助防范 DB instance 故障和 AZ 中断（[RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。因此，正确的设计是在每个 Availability Zone 中预置一个子网，将 Auto Scaling group 分布在两个 AZs 中，并将 RDS DB instance 配置为 Multi-AZ deployment。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将 EC2 实例分布在两个 AZs 中是正确的，但仅将 DB instance 配置为“connections to each network”并不能提供 RDS 高可用性或自动故障转移。DB 必须配置为 **Multi-AZ**。
- **B:** 设计无效，因为子网不能跨多个 Availability Zones 扩展或跨越。它也缺少 RDS Multi-AZ。
- **D:** RDS Multi-AZ 是正确的，但子网设计无效，因为单个子网不能跨两个 Availability Zones 扩展。

en.question: A research laboratory needs to process approximately 8 TB of data. The laboratory requires sub- millisecond latencies and a minimum throughput of 6 GBps for the storage subsystem. Hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux will distribute and process the data. Which solution will meet the performance requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Sat each volume’ tiering policy to ALL. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the fila system on the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent SSD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent HDD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Set each volume’s tiering policy to NONE. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon FSx for Lustre is designed for this type of high-performance, distributed Linux compute workload. AWS states that FSx for Lustre supports concurrent access from **thousands of compute instances**, scales to **multiple TBps of throughput and millions of IOPS**, and provides sub-millisecond file-operation latency; throughput scales with provisioned storage capacity ([FSx for Lustre SSD/HDD performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/ssd-storage.html)). The SSD storage class is specifically optimized for workloads that need up to TBps of throughput and **consistent sub-millisecond latency access to the full dataset**, whereas HDD is for consistent single-digit millisecond latency ([What is FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)). FSx for Lustre also integrates natively with Amazon S3: linked S3 objects can be presented as files, imported at file system creation, and written back to S3 ([Using data repositories with Amazon FSx for Lustre](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/fsx-data-repositories.html)). Therefore, persistent SSD FSx for Lustre linked to S3 meets the latency, throughput, and EC2 Linux mounting requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A:** FSx for NetApp ONTAP with tiering policy **ALL** is not appropriate for maximum active-dataset performance. AWS says the **All** policy marks all user and snapshot data as cold and tiers existing data from SSD to the capacity pool; reads remain cold and are not written back to primary storage ([FSx for ONTAP volume tiering policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/volume-storage-capacity.html)).
* **C:** FSx for Lustre with **persistent HDD** does not meet the sub-millisecond full-dataset latency requirement. AWS documents HDD storage as providing data latency in the **single-digit millisecond** range, while SSD provides sub-millisecond metadata and data latency ([FSx for Lustre SSD/HDD performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/ssd-storage.html)).
* **D:** FSx for ONTAP with tiering policy **NONE** keeps data on primary SSD storage, but the workload described is a large-scale HPC-style distributed Linux processing job. FSx for Lustre is the AWS file system specifically documented for high-performance processing, S3 data repository integration, and access from EC2 using the Lustre client ([What is FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家研究实验室需要处理大约 8 TB 的数据。该实验室要求存储子系统具有亚毫秒级延迟和至少 6 GBps 的吞吐量。数百个运行 Amazon Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例将分发并处理这些数据。哪种解决方案将满足性能要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统。将每个卷的分层策略设置为 ALL。将原始数据导入文件系统。在 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储原始数据。创建一个使用持久性 SSD 存储的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。选择从 Amazon S3 导入数据以及向 Amazon S3 导出数据的选项。在 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储原始数据。创建一个使用持久性 HDD 存储的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。选择从 Amazon S3 导入数据以及向 Amazon S3 导出数据的选项。在 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统。将每个卷的分层策略设置为 NONE。将原始数据导入文件系统。在 EC2 实例上挂载该文件系统。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

Amazon FSx for Lustre 专为这类高性能、分布式 Linux 计算工作负载而设计。AWS 表示，FSx for Lustre 支持来自**数千个计算实例**的并发访问，可扩展到**多个 TBps 的吞吐量和数百万 IOPS**，并提供亚毫秒级文件操作延迟；吞吐量会随预置存储容量扩展（[FSx for Lustre SSD/HDD performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/ssd-storage.html)）。SSD 存储类别专门针对需要高达 TBps 吞吐量以及对完整数据集进行**一致的亚毫秒级延迟访问**的工作负载进行了优化，而 HDD 适用于一致的个位数毫秒级延迟（[What is FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。FSx for Lustre 还与 Amazon S3 原生集成：链接的 S3 对象可以以文件形式呈现，可以在文件系统创建时导入，并可以写回 S3（[Using data repositories with Amazon FSx for Lustre](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/fsx-data-repositories.html)）。因此，链接到 S3 的持久性 SSD FSx for Lustre 满足延迟、吞吐量和 EC2 Linux 挂载要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **A:** 使用分层策略 **ALL** 的 FSx for NetApp ONTAP 不适合获得最大的活动数据集性能。AWS 表示，**All** 策略会将所有用户数据和快照数据标记为冷数据，并将现有数据从 SSD 分层到容量池；读取仍保持为冷数据，不会写回主存储（[FSx for ONTAP volume tiering policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/volume-storage-capacity.html)）。
* **C:** 使用 **persistent HDD** 的 FSx for Lustre 不满足完整数据集的亚毫秒级延迟要求。AWS 文档说明，HDD 存储提供**个位数毫秒**范围的数据延迟，而 SSD 提供亚毫秒级元数据和数据延迟（[FSx for Lustre SSD/HDD performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/ssd-storage.html)）。
* **D:** 使用分层策略 **NONE** 的 FSx for ONTAP 会将数据保留在主 SSD 存储上，但题中描述的工作负载是大规模 HPC 风格的分布式 Linux 处理任务。FSx for Lustre 是 AWS 文件系统中专门被记录用于高性能处理、S3 数据存储库集成以及使用 Lustre client 从 EC2 访问的服务（[What is FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to migrate a legacy application from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud because of hardware capacity constraints. The application runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The application’s database storage continues to grow over time. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon S3.
options.B: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS On-Demand Instances.
options.C: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances.
options.D: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS Reserved Instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The workload runs continuously (24x7), so the application compute layer is a steady, predictable EC2 usage pattern. AWS documentation states that EC2 **Reserved Instances** reduce EC2 costs by making a 1- or 3-year commitment to a specific configuration, and that RIs provide significant savings compared with On-Demand pricing ([EC2 Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/standard-vs.-convertible-offering-classes.html); [EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). For the database, Aurora is well suited to growing database storage because Aurora cluster volumes **automatically grow as the amount of data increases** and you are charged only for the storage used ([Amazon Aurora storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)). Aurora Reserved DB instances also provide a discounted rate, and AWS gives examples showing monthly savings versus Aurora On-Demand DB instances ([Reserved DB instances for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EC2 Spot Instances use unused EC2 capacity and can reduce costs, but this option is not the best fit for a legacy application that must run 24x7. Also, Amazon S3 is object storage, not a relational database storage layer for a migrated legacy database.
- **B:** EC2 Reserved Instances are appropriate, but using **RDS On-Demand** for a continuously running database is less cost-effective than a reserved database option when usage is steady; AWS documents that reserved DB instances provide discounted rates and savings compared with on-demand DB instances.
- **D:** RDS Reserved Instances can reduce database cost, but using **EC2 On-Demand** for the always-running application layer misses the EC2 reservation savings available for steady 24x7 compute usage.

zh.question: 一家公司由于硬件容量限制，需要将一个遗留应用程序从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud。该应用程序每周 7 天、每天 24 小时运行。该应用程序的数据库存储会随着时间持续增长。解决方案架构师应如何以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将应用程序层迁移到 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances。将数据存储层迁移到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 将应用程序层迁移到 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances。将数据存储层迁移到 Amazon RDS On-Demand Instances。
options.C: 将应用程序层迁移到 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances。将数据存储层迁移到 Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances。
options.D: 将应用程序层迁移到 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances。将数据存储层迁移到 Amazon RDS Reserved Instances。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** 该工作负载连续运行 (24x7)，因此应用程序计算层是一种稳定、可预测的 EC2 使用模式。AWS 文档说明，EC2 **Reserved Instances** 通过对特定配置做出 1 年或 3 年承诺来降低 EC2 成本，并且 RIs 与 On-Demand 定价相比可提供显著节省（[EC2 Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-reservation-models/standard-vs.-convertible-offering-classes.html)；[EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。对于数据库，Aurora 非常适合不断增长的数据库存储，因为 Aurora 集群卷会**随着数据量增加而自动增长**，并且你只需为已使用的存储付费（[Amazon Aurora storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)）。Aurora Reserved DB instances 也提供折扣费率，AWS 给出的示例显示了与 Aurora On-Demand DB instances 相比的每月节省（[Reserved DB instances for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EC2 Spot Instances 使用未使用的 EC2 容量并可以降低成本，但对于必须 24x7 运行的遗留应用程序，此选项并不是最佳选择。此外，Amazon S3 是对象存储，不是用于迁移的遗留数据库的关系数据库存储层。
- **B:** EC2 Reserved Instances 是合适的，但对于连续运行的数据库，在使用量稳定时，使用 **RDS On-Demand** 不如预留数据库选项具有成本效益；AWS 文档说明 reserved DB instances 与 on-demand DB instances 相比可提供折扣费率和节省。
- **D:** RDS Reserved Instances 可以降低数据库成本，但对始终运行的应用程序层使用 **EC2 On-Demand** 会错过可用于稳定 24x7 计算使用的 EC2 预留节省。

en.question: A university research laboratory needs to migrate 30 TB of data from an on-premises Windows file server to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. The laboratory has a 1 Gbps network link that many other departments in the university share. The laboratory wants to implement a data migration service that will maximize the performance of the data transfer. However, the laboratory needs to be able to control the amount of bandwidth that the service uses to minimize the impact on other departments. The data migration must take place within the next 5 days. Which AWS solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: AWS Snowcone
options.B: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.C: AWS DataSync
options.D: AWS Transfer Family

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C — AWS DataSync.**

AWS DataSync is designed for this exact type of online migration. AWS documentation says DataSync can transfer files between on-premises/self-managed storage and AWS storage services, including **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** ([Transferring to or from on-premises storage with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)). For FSx for Windows File Server specifically, DataSync creates an FSx transfer location that can be used as a **source or destination** for transfers ([Configuring transfers with FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)). DataSync also fits the performance requirement because AWS describes it as using a purpose-built protocol and parallel, multi-threaded architecture to accelerate transfers ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).

Most importantly, DataSync satisfies the requirement to control impact on the shared 1 Gbps link: a task can either use available bandwidth or set a maximum bandwidth limit, and the limit can also be modified for a running task execution ([Setting bandwidth limits for your AWS DataSync task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-bandwidth.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Snowcone** — Snow devices are portable edge/data-transfer devices, not the best fit for an online, bandwidth-throttled migration directly from a Windows file server to FSx for Windows File Server within a short window. The Snow documentation describes Snow devices as edge devices that can be transported and can optionally send data back to AWS by DataSync ([What are Snow devices?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snow/latest/swsbe-pack/whatitis.html)). DataSync is the service that directly addresses the FSx migration and bandwidth-control requirements.
- **B. Amazon FSx File Gateway** — FSx File Gateway provides low-latency on-premises access to an existing FSx for Windows File Server file system and maps local shares to remote FSx shares; it is not the migration service optimized for bulk data transfer with task bandwidth throttling ([What is Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)).
- **D. AWS Transfer Family** — Transfer Family is for managed transfers into and out of **Amazon S3** or **Amazon EFS** over SFTP, FTPS, FTP, AS2, or browser-based transfers, not for migrating an on-premises SMB Windows file server directly to FSx for Windows File Server with bandwidth limits ([What is AWS Transfer Family?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)).

zh.question: 一所大学研究实验室需要将 30 TB 数据从本地 Windows 文件服务器迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。该实验室有一条 1 Gbps 网络链路，大学中的许多其他部门也共享这条链路。该实验室希望实施一种数据迁移服务，以最大限度提高数据传输性能。但是，该实验室需要能够控制该服务使用的带宽量，以尽量减少对其他部门的影响。数据迁移必须在接下来的 5 天内进行。哪种 AWS 解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: AWS Snowcone
options.B: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.C: AWS DataSync
options.D: AWS Transfer Family

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C — AWS DataSync。**

AWS DataSync 专为这种在线迁移场景而设计。AWS 文档说明，DataSync 可以在本地/自管理存储与 AWS 存储服务之间传输文件，包括 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server**（[Transferring to or from on-premises storage with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)）。对于 FSx for Windows File Server，DataSync 会创建一个 FSx 传输位置，该位置可用作传输的**源或目标**（[Configuring transfers with FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)）。DataSync 也符合性能要求，因为 AWS 将其描述为使用专用协议以及并行、多线程架构来加速传输（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。最重要的是，DataSync 满足了控制对共享 1 Gbps 链路影响的要求：任务可以使用可用带宽，也可以设置最大带宽限制，并且还可以为正在运行的任务执行修改该限制（[Setting bandwidth limits for your AWS DataSync task](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-bandwidth.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Snowcone** — Snow 设备是便携式边缘/数据传输设备，并不是在短时间窗口内从 Windows 文件服务器直接在线、带宽限流迁移到 FSx for Windows File Server 的最佳选择。Snow 文档将 Snow 设备描述为可以运输的边缘设备，并且可以选择通过 DataSync 将数据发送回 AWS（[What are Snow devices?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snow/latest/swsbe-pack/whatitis.html)）。DataSync 才是直接满足 FSx 迁移和带宽控制要求的服务。
- **B. Amazon FSx File Gateway** — FSx File Gateway 提供对现有 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统的低延迟本地访问，并将本地共享映射到远程 FSx 共享；它不是针对批量数据传输并支持任务带宽限流而优化的迁移服务（[What is Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)）。
- **D. AWS Transfer Family** — Transfer Family 用于通过 SFTP、FTPS、FTP、AS2 或基于浏览器的传输，将数据传入和传出 **Amazon S3** 或 **Amazon EFS**，而不是用于将本地 SMB Windows 文件服务器直接迁移到 FSx for Windows File Server 并设置带宽限制（[What is AWS Transfer Family?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to create a mobile app that allows users to stream slow-motion video clips on their mobile devices. Currently, the app captures video clips and uploads the video clips in raw format into an Amazon S3 bucket. The app retrieves these video clips directly from the S3 bucket. However, the videos are large in their raw format. Users are experiencing issues with buffering and playback on mobile devices. The company wants to implement solutions to maximize the performance and scalability of the app while minimizing operational overhead. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AW'S Regions in other S3 buckets.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.
options.D: Deploy an Auto Sealing group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching.
options.E: Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and C**.

* **A. Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching** — CloudFront is designed to deliver content from origins such as an **Amazon S3 bucket** through globally distributed edge locations, where it caches copies of files close to viewers. AWS documentation also specifically says CloudFront supports VOD streaming in common formats such as MPEG-DASH, Apple HLS, Microsoft Smooth Streaming, and CMAF to any device, and can cache media fragments at the edge. This improves playback performance and scalability with low operational overhead. [CloudFront setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html) / [CloudFront video use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)
* **C. Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats** — The raw videos are too large for mobile playback. AWS documentation describes Amazon Elastic Transcoder as converting media files stored in Amazon S3 into formats required by consumer playback devices. This directly addresses buffering caused by large raw video files and is managed compared with running your own transcoding fleet. [Amazon SNS media services integration page describing Elastic Transcoder](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-event-sources-media.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B. DataSync replication across Regions** — DataSync can migrate, archive, replicate, or transfer data, but replicating the same large raw videos to more S3 buckets does not optimize video size/format or provide edge caching for mobile playback. [DataSync use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)
* **D. EC2 Auto Scaling in Local Zones for caching** — This would require building and operating a custom caching/content-delivery layer. CloudFront already provides managed edge caching and video delivery, so EC2 adds unnecessary operational overhead.
* **E. EC2 Auto Scaling for conversion** — EC2 instances could perform transcoding, but the question asks to minimize operational overhead. A managed media transcoding service is a better fit than managing an Auto Scaling fleet for conversion.

zh.question: 一家公司想要创建一个移动应用，允许用户在其移动设备上流式播放慢动作视频剪辑。目前，该应用会捕获视频剪辑，并将这些视频剪辑以原始格式上传到 Amazon S3 bucket 中。该应用直接从 S3 bucket 检索这些视频剪辑。但是，这些视频的原始格式体积很大。用户在移动设备上遇到了缓冲和播放问题。公司希望实施解决方案，在最大限度提高应用性能和可扩展性的同时，最大限度减少运营开销。哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 部署 Amazon CloudFront 用于内容分发和缓存。
options.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 将视频文件复制到其他 S3 bucket 中的 AW'S Regions。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic Transcoder 将视频文件转换为更合适的格式。
options.D: 在 Local Zones 中部署 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Sealing 组，用于内容分发和缓存。
options.E: 部署 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组，将视频文件转换为更合适的格式。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 C**。

* **A. Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching** — CloudFront 旨在通过全球分布的边缘站点从诸如 **Amazon S3 bucket** 之类的源站交付内容，并在这些边缘站点缓存靠近查看者的文件副本。AWS 文档还明确说明，CloudFront 支持以常见格式（例如 MPEG-DASH、Apple HLS、Microsoft Smooth Streaming 和 CMAF）向任何设备进行 VOD 流式传输，并且可以在边缘缓存媒体片段。这能够以低运营开销提高播放性能和可扩展性。[CloudFront setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html) / [CloudFront video use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)
* **C. Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats** — 原始视频对于移动端播放来说太大。AWS 文档将 Amazon Elastic Transcoder 描述为可将存储在 Amazon S3 中的媒体文件转换为消费者播放设备所需的格式。这直接解决了由大型原始视频文件导致的缓冲问题，并且与运行自己的转码机群相比，它是托管式的。[Amazon SNS media services integration page describing Elastic Transcoder](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-event-sources-media.html)

为什么其他选项不正确：

* **B. DataSync replication across Regions** — DataSync 可以迁移、归档、复制或传输数据，但将相同的大型原始视频复制到更多 S3 bucket 中，并不会优化视频大小/格式，也不会为移动端播放提供边缘缓存。[DataSync use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)
* **D. EC2 Auto Scaling in Local Zones for caching** — 这需要构建并运营自定义缓存/内容分发层。CloudFront 已经提供托管式边缘缓存和视频交付，因此 EC2 会增加不必要的运营开销。
* **E. EC2 Auto Scaling for conversion** — EC2 实例可以执行转码，但题目要求最大限度减少运营开销。与管理用于转换的 Auto Scaling 机群相比，托管式媒体转码服务更适合。

en.question: A company is launching a new application deployed on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster and is using the Fargate launch type for ECS tasks. The company is monitoring CPU and memory usage because it is expecting high traffic to the application upon its launch. However, the company wants to reduce costs when utilization decreases. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale at certain periods based on previous traffic patterns.
options.B: Use an AWS Lambda function to scale Amazon ECS based on metric breaches that trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with simple scaling policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
options.D: Use AWS Application Auto Scaling with target tracking policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling is the appropriate mechanism for changing the number of ECS tasks. AWS states that ECS automatic scaling can increase or decrease the desired number of tasks and that Amazon ECS uses **Application Auto Scaling** for this functionality. ECS publishes average CPU and memory CloudWatch metrics, and these can be used to scale out for peak demand and scale in to reduce costs during low utilization ([Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)). A target tracking policy is also specifically supported for ECS services and can use `ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization` and `ECSServiceAverageMemoryUtilization`; it automatically increases or decreases the desired task count based on a target metric value ([Create a target tracking scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/target-tracking-create-policy.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** is incorrect because scheduled EC2 Auto Scaling based on previous traffic patterns scales EC2 instances, not the desired task count of an ECS service. Also, this workload uses **Fargate**, where AWS says you run containers without managing servers or clusters of EC2 instances and no longer need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).
* **B** is incorrect because a custom Lambda function is unnecessary operational complexity. ECS already integrates with Application Auto Scaling for automatic task scaling based on CloudWatch metrics ([Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)).
* **C** is incorrect because EC2 Auto Scaling policies scale EC2 Auto Scaling groups/instances, not Fargate task count. ECS cluster auto scaling for Auto Scaling groups is for EC2 instances registered to a cluster, whereas Fargate removes the need to scale EC2 clusters ([ECS cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html), [AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在启动一个新应用程序，该应用程序部署在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群上，并对 ECS 任务使用 Fargate 启动类型。该公司正在监控 CPU 和内存使用率，因为预计应用程序上线时会有高流量。但是，公司希望在利用率下降时降低成本。解决方案架构师应建议什么？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 根据以往的流量模式在特定时段进行扩展。
options.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数根据触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报的指标超限来扩展 Amazon ECS。
options.C: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 和简单扩展策略，在 ECS 指标超限触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报时进行扩展。
options.D: 使用 AWS Application Auto Scaling 和目标跟踪策略，在 ECS 指标超限触发 Amazon CloudWatch 警报时进行扩展。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling 是更改 ECS 任务数量的适当机制。AWS 表示，ECS 自动扩展可以增加或减少所需任务数量，并且 Amazon ECS 使用 **Application Auto Scaling** 来实现此功能。ECS 会发布平均 CPU 和内存 CloudWatch 指标，这些指标可用于在峰值需求时向外扩展，并在低利用率期间向内缩减以降低成本（[Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)）。ECS 服务也明确支持目标跟踪策略，并且可以使用 `ECSServiceAverageCPUUtilization` 和 `ECSServiceAverageMemoryUtilization`；它会根据目标指标值自动增加或减少所需任务数（[Create a target tracking scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/target-tracking-create-policy.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A** 不正确，因为基于以往流量模式的计划 EC2 Auto Scaling 扩展的是 EC2 实例，而不是 ECS 服务的所需任务数。此外，此工作负载使用 **Fargate**，AWS 表示在 Fargate 中，您可以运行容器而无需管理服务器或 EC2 实例集群，并且不再需要预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。
* **B** 不正确，因为自定义 Lambda 函数会带来不必要的运营复杂性。ECS 已经与 Application Auto Scaling 集成，可基于 CloudWatch 指标自动扩展任务（[Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)）。
* **C** 不正确，因为 EC2 Auto Scaling 策略扩展的是 EC2 Auto Scaling 组/实例，而不是 Fargate 任务数。用于 Auto Scaling 组的 ECS 集群自动扩展适用于注册到集群的 EC2 实例，而 Fargate 消除了扩展 EC2 集群的需要（[ECS cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html), [AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

en.question: A company recently created a disaster recovery site in a different AWS Region. The company needs to transfer large amounts of data back and forth between NFS file systems in the two Regions on a periodic basis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync.
options.B: Use AWS Snowball devices.
options.C: Set up an SFTP server on Amazon EC2.
options.D: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Use AWS DataSync.**

AWS DataSync is the best fit because it is designed to automate high-speed data movement between storage systems and AWS storage services. AWS documentation lists **replicating data** to Amazon EFS or Amazon FSx for a standby file system as a DataSync use case, and states that DataSync **automates both the management of data-transfer processes and the infrastructure required for high performance and secure data transfers**—which directly addresses the requirement for the least operational overhead. DataSync also supports transfers with Amazon EFS: to transfer data to or from an EFS file system, you create a DataSync transfer location that can be used as a source or destination ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [Configuring AWS DataSync transfers with Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-efs-location.html)).

A key exam nuance: AWS documentation says that when transferring **between AWS storage services in different AWS Regions**, one of the two locations must be in the Region where DataSync is being used; it also notes that cross-Region transfer is not supported when the location type is a generic **NFS location** rather than an AWS storage-service location ([Where can I transfer my data with AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/working-with-locations.html)). In the context of an AWS Region disaster recovery site and NFS-based AWS file systems such as EFS/FSx, DataSync is the managed service intended for this type of recurring replication.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. AWS Snowball devices** — Snowball Edge is for physically shipped, offline transfers between Amazon S3 and onsite storage locations; AWS documentation describes import/export jobs using shipping carriers. That is not suitable for periodic back-and-forth transfers between Regional file systems and would add significant operational overhead ([Upload large amounts of data with AWS Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)).
* **C. SFTP server on Amazon EC2** — This would require provisioning, securing, patching, scaling, monitoring, and operating EC2-based transfer infrastructure. DataSync is explicitly managed and automates transfer management, so EC2/SFTP is higher overhead ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
* **D. AWS DMS** — AWS Database Migration Service is for migrating databases and supported database engines, not NFS file-system replication ([What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近在不同的 AWS Region 创建了一个灾难恢复站点。该公司需要定期在两个 Region 中的 NFS 文件系统之间来回传输大量数据。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync。
options.B: 使用 AWS Snowball 设备。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 上设置 SFTP 服务器。
options.D: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 使用 AWS DataSync。**

AWS DataSync 是最合适的选择，因为它旨在自动化存储系统与 AWS 存储服务之间的高速数据移动。AWS 文档将**复制数据**到 Amazon EFS 或 Amazon FSx 以用于备用文件系统列为 DataSync 的使用场景，并指出 DataSync **自动化管理数据传输流程以及实现高性能和安全数据传输所需的基础设施**——这直接满足了最少运营开销的要求。DataSync 还支持与 Amazon EFS 的传输：要向 EFS 文件系统传输数据或从 EFS 文件系统传输数据，你可以创建一个 DataSync 传输位置，该位置可用作源或目标（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [Configuring AWS DataSync transfers with Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-efs-location.html)）。一个关键的考试细节：AWS 文档指出，当在**不同 AWS Region 中的 AWS 存储服务之间**传输时，两个位置之一必须位于正在使用 DataSync 的 Region；文档还指出，当位置类型是通用 **NFS location** 而不是 AWS 存储服务位置时，不支持跨 Region 传输（[Where can I transfer my data with AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/working-with-locations.html)）。在 AWS Region 灾难恢复站点以及基于 NFS 的 AWS 文件系统（例如 EFS/FSx）的上下文中，DataSync 是用于此类定期复制的托管服务。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B. AWS Snowball devices** — Snowball Edge 用于 Amazon S3 与现场存储位置之间通过物理运输进行的离线传输；AWS 文档描述了使用运输承运商的导入/导出作业。这不适合 Regional 文件系统之间定期来回传输，并且会增加显著的运营开销（[Upload large amounts of data with AWS Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)）。
* **C. SFTP server on Amazon EC2** — 这需要预置、保护、修补、扩展、监控和运营基于 EC2 的传输基础设施。DataSync 明确是托管服务，并自动化传输管理，因此 EC2/SFTP 的开销更高（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
* **D. AWS DMS** — AWS Database Migration Service 用于迁移数据库和受支持的数据库引擎，而不是 NFS 文件系统复制（[What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which AWS solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
options.B: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Assign an IAM role to the application to grant access to the S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the application server.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is purpose-built for this requirement: AWS states that it provides **fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers** and supports fully managed file storage with native support for the industry-standard **Server Message Block (SMB)** protocol for network file access ([FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)). AWS also documents that clients access FSx for Windows File Server file shares using SMB, and that applications can access mapped/mounted shares as if they are local files and folders ([Accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: AWS DataSync is a high-speed **file transfer** service for moving file or object data to, from, and between storage services; it does not provide a mountable shared file system for application clients ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **B**: A Windows file share on an EC2 instance could support SMB, but it is not fully managed; the company would manage the instance, Windows file server role, patching, availability, and storage.
- **D**: Amazon S3 is accessed as object storage through S3 APIs/IAM, not as a native fully managed SMB file share for SMB clients. The FSx documentation specifically identifies SMB file access as a feature of FSx for Windows File Server, not S3 ([FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在为托管在 AWS Cloud 中的游戏应用程序设计共享存储解决方案。该公司需要能够使用 SMB 客户端访问数据。该解决方案必须是完全托管的。哪种 AWS 解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS DataSync 任务，将数据作为可挂载的文件系统进行共享。将该文件系统挂载到应用程序服务器。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon EC2 Windows 实例。在该实例上安装并配置 Windows 文件共享角色。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件共享。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。将该文件系统附加到源服务器。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件系统。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。为应用程序分配一个 IAM 角色，以授予对 S3 存储桶的访问权限。将 S3 存储桶挂载到应用程序服务器。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 专为此需求而构建：AWS 表示它提供 **fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers**，并支持完全托管的文件存储，同时原生支持行业标准 **Server Message Block (SMB)** 协议用于网络文件访问（[FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。AWS 还在文档中说明，客户端使用 SMB 访问 FSx for Windows File Server 文件共享，并且应用程序可以像访问本地文件和文件夹一样访问映射/挂载的共享（[Accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：AWS DataSync 是一种高速 **file transfer** 服务，用于在存储服务之间、向存储服务或从存储服务移动文件或对象数据；它不为应用程序客户端提供可挂载的共享文件系统（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **B**：EC2 实例上的 Windows 文件共享可以支持 SMB，但它不是完全托管的；公司需要管理该实例、Windows 文件服务器角色、修补、可用性和存储。
- **D**：Amazon S3 是通过 S3 APIs/IAM 作为对象存储访问的，而不是作为面向 SMB 客户端的原生完全托管 SMB 文件共享。FSx 文档明确将 SMB 文件访问标识为 FSx for Windows File Server 的一项功能，而不是 S3 的功能（[FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to run an in-memory database for a latency-sensitive application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes more than 100,000 transactions each minute and requires high network throughput. A solutions architect needs to provide a cost-effective network design that minimizes data transfer charges. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Launch all EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with cluster strategy when launching EC2 instances.
options.B: Launch all EC2 instances in different Availability Zones within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with partition strategy when launching EC2 instances.
options.C: Deploy an Auto Scaling group to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones based on a network utilization target.
options.D: Deploy an Auto Scaling group with a step scaling policy to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

A **cluster placement group** is specifically designed for this workload. AWS states that a cluster placement group is a logical grouping of instances **within a single Availability Zone**, and that instances in the same cluster placement group are placed in a high-bisection-bandwidth network segment with higher per-flow throughput. AWS also recommends cluster placement groups for applications that need **low network latency, high network throughput, or both**, especially when most traffic is between instances in the group ([AWS EC2 placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)). Keeping the instances in one AZ also avoids inter-AZ data transfer: AWS documentation identifies data transfer **between Availability Zones** in the same Region as regional data transfer that can be charged for both inbound and outbound traffic ([AWS data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A partition placement group is for reducing correlated hardware failures by spreading instances across partitions/racks, and it can have partitions in multiple AZs. It is not the best choice for the lowest latency and highest throughput; cluster placement groups are the AWS-recommended strategy for that requirement ([AWS EC2 placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)). Spanning AZs also introduces inter-AZ data transfer charges.
- **C:** Auto Scaling across different AZs improves availability, but it does not ensure the close physical placement, low latency, or high-throughput networking of a cluster placement group. Multi-AZ placement can also incur inter-AZ transfer charges.
- **D:** A step scaling policy controls scaling behavior, not network topology. Launching instances in different AZs does not meet the requirement to minimize latency and data transfer charges for a high-throughput in-memory database.

zh.question: 一家公司希望为一个延迟敏感型应用程序运行内存数据库，该应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序每分钟处理超过 100,000 笔事务，并且需要高网络吞吐量。解决方案架构师需要提供一种经济高效的网络设计，以最大限度地减少数据传输费用。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在同一 AWS Region 内的同一 Availability Zone 中启动所有 EC2 实例。启动 EC2 实例时指定采用 cluster 策略的置放群组。
options.B: 在同一 AWS Region 内的不同 Availability Zones 中启动所有 EC2 实例。启动 EC2 实例时指定采用 partition 策略的置放群组。
options.C: 部署一个 Auto Scaling group，根据网络利用率目标在不同 Availability Zones 中启动 EC2 实例。
options.D: 部署一个带有步进扩展策略的 Auto Scaling group，以在不同 Availability Zones 中启动 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

**cluster placement group** 专为此类工作负载而设计。AWS 表示，cluster placement group 是 **单个 Availability Zone 内** 实例的逻辑分组，并且同一 cluster placement group 中的实例会放置在高双分带宽网络段中，从而提供更高的每流吞吐量。AWS 还建议，对于需要**低网络延迟、高网络吞吐量，或两者都需要**的应用程序，尤其是当大多数流量发生在该组内实例之间时，使用 cluster placement groups（[AWS EC2 placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。将实例保留在一个 AZ 中还可以避免跨 AZ 数据传输：AWS 文档将同一 Region 中 **Availability Zones 之间**的数据传输定义为区域性数据传输，可能会对入站和出站流量均收费（[AWS data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** partition placement group 用于通过将实例分散到不同 partitions/racks 来减少相关硬件故障，并且可以在多个 AZ 中包含 partitions。它不是实现最低延迟和最高吞吐量的最佳选择；cluster placement groups 才是 AWS 针对此要求推荐的策略（[AWS EC2 placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。跨越 AZ 还会引入跨 AZ 数据传输费用。
- **C:** 跨不同 AZ 的 Auto Scaling 可提高可用性，但它不能确保 cluster placement group 所具备的紧密物理放置、低延迟或高吞吐量网络。Multi-AZ 放置还可能产生跨 AZ 传输费用。
- **D:** 步进扩展策略控制的是扩展行为，而不是网络拓扑。在不同 AZ 中启动实例不满足为高吞吐量内存数据库最大限度降低延迟和数据传输费用的要求。

en.question: A company that primarily runs its application servers on premises has decided to migrate to AWS. The company wants to minimize its need to scale its Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) storage on premises. The company wants only its recently accessed data to remain stored locally. Which AWS solution should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon S3 File Gateway
options.B: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
options.C: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volumes
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D. AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes**.

AWS Volume Gateway provides cloud-backed storage volumes that on-premises application servers can mount as **iSCSI** devices. For **cached volumes**, AWS states that data is stored in Amazon S3 while a copy of **frequently accessed data subsets** is retained locally; this configuration “minimize[s] the need to scale your storage on-premises” and preserves low-latency access to frequently accessed data. This exactly matches the requirement to keep only recently accessed data local while reducing on-premises iSCSI storage growth ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon S3 File Gateway** is for a **file interface** to S3 using NFS or SMB protocols, not iSCSI block volumes for application servers ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway** provides cloud-backed **virtual tape** storage for backup archiving to S3 Glacier storage classes, not primary iSCSI block storage with a local hot-data cache ([What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **C. Volume Gateway stored volumes** store **all** data locally first and asynchronously back up snapshots to Amazon S3, which does not meet the requirement to keep only recently accessed data stored locally ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

zh.question: 一家主要在本地运行其应用程序服务器的公司已决定迁移到 AWS。该公司希望尽量减少在本地扩展其 Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) 存储的需求。该公司希望只有最近访问的数据继续存储在本地。该公司应使用哪种 AWS 解决方案来满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon S3 File Gateway
options.B: AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
options.C: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volumes
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D. AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes**。

AWS Volume Gateway 提供由云支持的存储卷，本地应用程序服务器可以将其作为 **iSCSI** 设备挂载。对于 **cached volumes**，AWS 表示数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，同时会在本地保留一份**频繁访问的数据子集**的副本；此配置可“minimize[s] the need to scale your storage on-premises”，并保持对频繁访问数据的低延迟访问。这完全符合仅将最近访问的数据保留在本地，同时减少本地 iSCSI 存储增长的要求（[What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Amazon S3 File Gateway** 用于通过 NFS 或 SMB 协议为 S3 提供**文件接口**，而不是为应用程序服务器提供 iSCSI 块卷（[What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway** 提供由云支持的**虚拟磁带**存储，用于备份归档到 S3 Glacier 存储类，而不是带有本地热数据缓存的主 iSCSI 块存储（[What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **C. Volume Gateway stored volumes** 会先将**所有**数据存储在本地，然后将快照异步备份到 Amazon S3，这不满足只将最近访问的数据存储在本地的要求（[What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。

en.question: A company has multiple AWS accounts that use consolidated billing. The company runs several active high performance Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances for 90 days. The company’s finance team has access to AWS Trusted Advisor in the consolidated billing account and all other AWS accounts. The finance team needs to use the appropriate AWS account to access the Trusted Advisor check recommendations for RDS. The finance team must review the appropriate Trusted Advisor check to reduce RDS costs. Which combination of steps should the finance team take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the account where the RDS instances are running.
options.B: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the consolidated billing account to see all RDS instance checks at the same time.
options.C: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization.
options.D: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances.
options.E: Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization.

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **B and C**.

**B. Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the consolidated billing account to see all RDS instance checks at the same time.**  
With AWS Organizations and consolidated billing, the management/consolidated billing account can be used to centrally view Trusted Advisor information across member accounts by using the Trusted Advisor organizational view. This allows the finance team to review recommendations across accounts instead of checking each account individually. Consolidated billing also combines usage and billing visibility across accounts, which is relevant for cost optimization activities ([AWS consolidated billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html), [Trusted Advisor organizational view](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/organizational-view.html)).

**C. Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization.**  
The RDS instances are described as **active**, **high performance**, and running as **On-Demand DB instances** for an extended period. The appropriate Trusted Advisor cost optimization check is **Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization**, which identifies opportunities to reduce costs by purchasing RDS Reserved DB Instances for steady On-Demand usage. Reserved DB Instances provide a significant discount compared with On-Demand pricing for one-year or three-year commitments ([Trusted Advisor cost optimization checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/cost-optimization-checks.html), [Amazon RDS Reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

**A. Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the account where the RDS instances are running.**  
Although individual account-level recommendations can be viewed in the account that owns the resources, the question asks for the appropriate account to use when the company has multiple accounts with consolidated billing and wants to see the RDS checks together. The consolidated billing/management account with Trusted Advisor organizational view is the better fit.

**D. Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances.**  
This check is for identifying idle or unused RDS DB instances. The scenario specifically says the company is running several **active high performance** RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances, so the idle DB instance check is not the most appropriate cost reduction check for this workload.

**E. Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization.**  
This check applies to Amazon Redshift reserved nodes, not Amazon RDS DB instances. The workload in the scenario is Amazon RDS for Oracle, so this check is not relevant.

zh.question: 一家公司有多个使用整合账单的 AWS 账户。该公司运行多个活跃的高性能 Amazon RDS for Oracle 按需型数据库实例，持续 90 天。该公司的财务团队可以访问整合账单账户以及所有其他 AWS 账户中的 AWS Trusted Advisor。财务团队需要使用适当的 AWS 账户来访问针对 RDS 的 Trusted Advisor 检查建议。财务团队必须查看适当的 Trusted Advisor 检查以降低 RDS 成本。财务团队应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用运行 RDS 实例的账户中的 Trusted Advisor 建议。
options.B: 使用整合账单账户中的 Trusted Advisor 建议，以便同时查看所有 RDS 实例检查。
options.C: 查看针对 Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。
options.D: 查看针对 Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。
options.E: 查看针对 Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B 和 C**。

**B. 使用整合账单账户中的 Trusted Advisor 建议，以便同时查看所有 RDS 实例检查。**  
借助 AWS Organizations 和整合账单，管理/整合账单账户可以通过使用 Trusted Advisor organizational view，集中查看跨成员账户的 Trusted Advisor 信息。这使财务团队能够跨账户查看建议，而不必逐个账户检查。整合账单还会合并跨账户的使用量和账单可见性，这与成本优化活动相关（[AWS consolidated billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/consolidated-billing.html), [Trusted Advisor organizational view](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/organizational-view.html)）。

**C. 查看针对 Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。**  
这些 RDS 实例被描述为 **active**、**high performance**，并且作为 **On-Demand DB instances** 运行了较长时间。适当的 Trusted Advisor 成本优化检查是 **Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization**，它会识别通过为稳定的按需使用购买 RDS Reserved DB Instances 来降低成本的机会。与按需定价相比，Reserved DB Instances 可在一年期或三年期承诺下提供显著折扣（[Trusted Advisor cost optimization checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/cost-optimization-checks.html), [Amazon RDS Reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

**A. 使用运行 RDS 实例的账户中的 Trusted Advisor 建议。**  
虽然可以在拥有资源的账户中查看单个账户级别的建议，但题目询问的是当公司有多个采用整合账单的账户并希望一起查看 RDS 检查时应使用的适当账户。具有 Trusted Advisor organizational view 的整合账单/管理账户更合适。

**D. 查看针对 Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。**  
此检查用于识别空闲或未使用的 RDS DB 实例。该场景明确说明公司正在运行多个 **active high performance** RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances，因此空闲数据库实例检查不是针对此工作负载最合适的成本降低检查。

**E. 查看针对 Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization 的 Trusted Advisor 检查。**  
此检查适用于 Amazon Redshift 预留节点，而不是 Amazon RDS DB 实例。场景中的工作负载是 Amazon RDS for Oracle，因此此检查不相关。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to optimize storage costs. The solutions architect must identify any Amazon S3 buckets that are no longer being accessed or are rarely accessed. Which solution will accomplish this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 Storage Lens dashboard for advanced activity metrics.
options.B: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 dashboard in the AWS Management Console.
options.C: Turn on the Amazon CloudWatch BucketSizeBytes metric for buckets. Analyze bucket access patterns by using the metrics data with Amazon Athena.
options.D: Turn on AWS CloudTrail for S3 object monitoring. Analyze bucket access patterns by using CloudTrail logs that are integrated with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon S3 Storage Lens is designed for this use case with the least operational overhead. AWS describes S3 Storage Lens as a cloud-storage analytics feature for organization-wide visibility into S3 **usage and activity**, and says its interactive dashboard can visualize trends, flag outliers, provide cost-optimization recommendations, and drill down to bucket and prefix levels ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)). With the advanced tier, S3 Storage Lens can enable **activity metrics**, and AWS specifically notes that you can analyze **request activity per bucket** to find buckets where objects could be transitioned to lower-cost storage classes ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** The basic S3 console/bucket dashboard does not provide the same purpose-built advanced activity metrics, drill-down analysis, and cost-optimization insights as S3 Storage Lens. The relevant S3 console analytics capability for this task is the Storage Lens dashboard, not the generic S3 dashboard ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)).
- **C:** `BucketSizeBytes`/daily storage metrics show bucket storage size, not whether buckets are being accessed. AWS states daily storage metrics monitor bucket storage and are reported once per day; request/activity monitoring is a separate metric category ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-monitoring.html)). Querying metrics with Athena would add unnecessary operational overhead.
- **D:** CloudTrail can record S3 API activity and details such as who made a request and when ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)), but enabling object-level monitoring and analyzing logs through CloudWatch Logs is a log-processing solution with more operational overhead than using the managed Storage Lens dashboard for access-pattern and cost-optimization analysis.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要优化存储成本。该解决方案架构师必须识别任何不再被访问或很少被访问的 Amazon S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销实现此目标？

options.A: 通过使用 S3 Storage Lens 控制面板中的高级活动指标来分析存储桶访问模式。
options.B: 通过使用 AWS Management Console 中的 S3 控制面板来分析存储桶访问模式。
options.C: 为存储桶开启 Amazon CloudWatch BucketSizeBytes 指标。使用 Amazon Athena 结合指标数据来分析存储桶访问模式。
options.D: 为 S3 对象监控开启 AWS CloudTrail。使用与 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 集成的 CloudTrail 日志来分析存储桶访问模式。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** Amazon S3 Storage Lens 专为此用例而设计，并且运营开销最少。AWS 将 S3 Storage Lens 描述为一种云存储分析功能，可为组织范围内的 S3 **使用情况和活动**提供可见性，并说明其交互式控制面板可以可视化趋势、标记异常值、提供成本优化建议，并深入分析到存储桶和前缀级别（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)）。通过高级层级，S3 Storage Lens 可以启用**活动指标**，并且 AWS 特别指出，你可以分析**每个存储桶的请求活动**，以找出其中对象可以转换到成本更低的存储类的存储桶（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **B:** 基本的 S3 控制台/存储桶控制面板不提供与 S3 Storage Lens 相同的、专为此目的构建的高级活动指标、深入分析和成本优化洞察。针对此任务的相关 S3 控制台分析能力是 Storage Lens 控制面板，而不是通用的 S3 控制面板（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)）。
- **C:** `BucketSizeBytes`/每日存储指标显示的是存储桶的存储大小，而不是存储桶是否正在被访问。AWS 说明每日存储指标用于监控存储桶存储，并且每天报告一次；请求/活动监控是一个单独的指标类别（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-monitoring.html)）。使用 Athena 查询指标会增加不必要的运营开销。
- **D:** CloudTrail 可以记录 S3 API 活动以及请求者和请求时间等详细信息（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)），但启用对象级监控并通过 CloudWatch Logs 分析日志是一种日志处理解决方案，与使用托管的 Storage Lens 控制面板进行访问模式和成本优化分析相比，运营开销更高。

en.question: A company sells datasets to customers who do research in artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML). The datasets are large, formatted files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. The company hosts a web application that the customers use to purchase access to a given dataset. The web application is deployed on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. After a purchase is made, customers receive an S3 signed URL that allows access to the files. The customers are distributed across North America and Europe. The company wants to reduce the cost that is associated with data transfers and wants to maintain or improve performance. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration on the existing S3 bucket. Direct customer requests to the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the existing S3 bucket as the origin. Direct customer requests to the CloudFront URL. Switch to CloudFront signed URLs for access control.
options.C: Set up a second S3 bucket in the eu-central-1 Region with S3 Cross-Region Replication between the buckets. Direct customer requests to the closest Region. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
options.D: Modify the web application to enable streaming of the datasets to end users. Configure the web application to read the data from the existing S3 bucket. Implement access control directly in the application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Deploying CloudFront in front of the existing S3 bucket best meets both goals: lower transfer cost and maintain/improve performance. CloudFront distributions can use an **Amazon S3 bucket as an origin**, and CloudFront delivers content from geographically distributed edge locations close to viewers, improving delivery speed for customers in North America and Europe ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). For AWS origins such as S3, **data transfer from the origin to CloudFront is free**; charges are for outbound transfer from CloudFront to viewers, and cached objects reduce repeated origin retrievals ([CloudFront pricing section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). For access control, CloudFront explicitly supports private content with **signed URLs**, where the application verifies entitlement, returns a signed URL, and CloudFront validates the signature before serving the file from the edge cache or origin ([CloudFront signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** S3 Transfer Acceleration is mainly for fast transfers over long distances, especially when customers **upload** to a centralized S3 bucket or cannot use full bandwidth when uploading to S3 ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)). It does not provide CloudFront caching/private-content controls and is not the best cost-reduction approach for repeated dataset downloads.
- **C:** S3 Cross-Region Replication can minimize latency by maintaining object copies closer to users, but AWS describes it as copying objects across buckets/Regions for compliance, latency, or operational efficiency—not as a CDN/caching cost-optimization layer ([S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)). It would also add storage and replication management/costs for a second bucket.
- **D:** Streaming through the EC2 web application removes the direct S3/CloudFront delivery pattern and makes the application instances handle large data transfers. This adds load and data-transfer path complexity rather than using CloudFront edge caching and signed URL authorization designed for this use case.

zh.question: 一家公司向从事人工智能和机器学习 (AI/ML) 研究的客户销售数据集。这些数据集是大型的格式化文件，存储在 us-east-1 区域的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司托管了一个 Web 应用程序，客户使用该应用程序购买对指定数据集的访问权限。该 Web 应用程序部署在 Application Load Balancer 后面的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上。购买完成后，客户会收到一个 S3 签名 URL，用于访问这些文件。客户分布在北美和欧洲。该公司希望降低与数据传输相关的成本，并希望维持或提升性能。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 在现有 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Transfer Acceleration。将客户请求定向到 S3 Transfer Acceleration 端点。继续使用 S3 签名 URL 进行访问控制。
options.B: 部署一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将现有 S3 存储桶作为源站。将客户请求定向到 CloudFront URL。改用 CloudFront 签名 URL 进行访问控制。
options.C: 在 eu-central-1 区域中设置第二个 S3 存储桶，并在这些存储桶之间配置 S3 Cross-Region Replication。将客户请求定向到最近的区域。继续使用 S3 签名 URL 进行访问控制。
options.D: 修改 Web 应用程序，以便向最终用户流式传输数据集。配置 Web 应用程序从现有 S3 存储桶读取数据。直接在应用程序中实现访问控制。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

在现有 S3 存储桶前部署 CloudFront 最能同时满足两个目标：降低传输成本并维持/提升性能。CloudFront 分配可以使用 **Amazon S3 bucket as an origin**，并且 CloudFront 会从地理上分布、靠近查看者的边缘站点交付内容，从而提升北美和欧洲客户的交付速度（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。对于 S3 等 AWS 源站，**从源站到 CloudFront 的数据传输是免费的**；费用针对从 CloudFront 到查看者的出站传输收取，而缓存对象会减少重复的源站检索（[CloudFront pricing section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。对于访问控制，CloudFront 明确支持使用 **signed URLs** 的私有内容，其中应用程序验证权限、返回签名 URL，然后 CloudFront 在从边缘缓存或源站提供文件之前验证签名（[CloudFront signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** S3 Transfer Acceleration 主要用于长距离快速传输，尤其是在客户需要向集中式 S3 存储桶**上传**，或在上传到 S3 时无法使用全部带宽的情况下（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。它不提供 CloudFront 缓存/私有内容控制，并且对于重复的数据集下载而言，并不是最佳的成本降低方法。
- **C:** S3 Cross-Region Replication 可以通过在更靠近用户的位置维护对象副本来最大限度降低延迟，但 AWS 将其描述为出于合规性、延迟或运营效率目的在存储桶/区域之间复制对象，而不是作为 CDN/缓存成本优化层（[S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。它还会为第二个存储桶增加存储以及复制管理/成本。
- **D:** 通过 EC2 Web 应用程序进行流式传输会移除直接的 S3/CloudFront 交付模式，并使应用程序实例处理大量数据传输。这会增加负载和数据传输路径复杂性，而不是使用专为此用例设计的 CloudFront 边缘缓存和签名 URL 授权。

en.question: A company is using AWS to design a web application that will process insurance quotes. Users will request quotes from the application. Quotes must be separated by quote type, must be responded to within 24 hours, and must not get lost. The solution must maximize operational efficiency and must minimize maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type. Configure the web application to send messages to the proper data stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to use the Kinesis Client Library (KCL) to pool messages from its own data stream.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for each quote type. Subscribe the Lambda function to its associated SNS topic. Configure the application to publish requests for quotes to the appropriate SNS topic.
options.C: Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure SNS message filtering to publish messages to the proper SQS queue based on the quote type. Configure each backend application server to use its own SQS queue.
options.D: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams based on the quote type to deliver data streams to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Configure the application to send messages to the proper delivery stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to search for the messages from OpenSearch Service and process them accordingly.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A single SNS topic with SQS subscriptions and SNS filter policies is the best fit. AWS states that an SNS subscriber can use a **filter policy** to receive only a subset of messages, and SNS compares message attributes or message body properties against each subscription’s filter policy before sending the message to that subscriber ([Amazon SNS message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html)). Therefore, quote type can be used to route each request to the correct SQS queue. AWS also documents the SNS-to-SQS fanout pattern: when an SQS queue subscribes to an SNS topic, publishing to the topic causes SNS to send an SQS message to the subscribed queue; using SNS and SQS together lets messages be delivered and also **persisted in an Amazon SQS queue for later processing** ([Fanout Amazon SNS notifications to Amazon SQS queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html)). SQS visibility timeout behavior also supports reliable processing because a received message remains in the queue until it is deleted after processing; if it is not deleted before the visibility timeout expires, it becomes visible again for another consumer ([Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)). This meets separation by quote type, prevents loss through durable queues/retry semantics, and uses managed services with minimal operational maintenance.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Multiple Kinesis data streams and KCL consumers add unnecessary stream and consumer-application management. The requirement is message routing and reliable asynchronous work queues, which SNS filtering plus SQS provides more directly.
- **B:** SNS topics invoking Lambda functions per quote type do not provide separate durable backend queues for each quote type. It also requires more per-type resources and does not match the requirement for each backend group to process its own retained work queue.
- **D:** Kinesis Data Firehose delivering to OpenSearch is for delivery/indexing/search/analytics workflows, not a durable work-queue pattern for application servers to process quote requests. Having backend servers search OpenSearch for work items is less efficient and more operationally complex than SQS queues.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS 设计一个用于处理保险报价的 Web 应用程序。用户将从该应用程序请求报价。报价必须按报价类型分离，必须在 24 小时内得到响应，并且不得丢失。该解决方案必须最大限度提高运营效率，并且必须最大限度减少维护。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 根据报价类型创建多个 Amazon Kinesis data streams。配置 Web 应用程序将消息发送到正确的 data stream。配置每个后端应用程序服务器组使用 Kinesis Client Library (KCL) 从其自己的 data stream 中轮询消息。
options.B: 为每种报价类型创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic。将 Lambda 函数订阅到其关联的 SNS topic。配置应用程序将报价请求发布到相应的 SNS topic。
options.C: 创建一个单一的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic。将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues 订阅到该 SNS topic。配置 SNS message filtering，根据报价类型将消息发布到正确的 SQS queue。配置每个后端应用程序服务器使用其自己的 SQS queue。
options.D: 根据报价类型创建多个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams，以将 data streams 传输到 Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster。配置应用程序将消息发送到正确的 delivery stream。配置每个后端应用程序服务器组从 OpenSearch Service 搜索消息并相应地处理它们。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

使用单个 SNS topic，配合 SQS subscriptions 和 SNS filter policies 是最佳选择。AWS 说明，SNS 订阅者可以使用 **filter policy** 仅接收消息的一个子集，并且 SNS 会在将消息发送给订阅者之前，将消息属性或消息正文属性与每个订阅的 filter policy 进行比较（[Amazon SNS message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html)）。因此，可以使用报价类型将每个请求路由到正确的 SQS queue。AWS 还记录了 SNS-to-SQS fanout 模式：当 SQS queue 订阅 SNS topic 时，发布到该 topic 会使 SNS 向已订阅的 queue 发送一条 SQS 消息；结合使用 SNS 和 SQS 可以让消息被传递，并且还可以 **persisted in an Amazon SQS queue for later processing**（[Fanout Amazon SNS notifications to Amazon SQS queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html)）。SQS visibility timeout 行为也支持可靠处理，因为已接收的消息会保留在 queue 中，直到处理后被删除；如果在 visibility timeout 过期前未被删除，它会再次对另一个消费者可见（[Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)）。这满足了按报价类型分离、通过持久队列/重试语义防止丢失，以及使用托管服务以实现最少运营维护的要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 多个 Kinesis data streams 和 KCL consumers 会增加不必要的流和消费者应用程序管理。需求是消息路由和可靠的异步工作队列，而 SNS filtering 加 SQS 能更直接地提供这些能力。
- **B:** 按报价类型使用 SNS topics 调用 Lambda 函数，并不能为每种报价类型提供独立的持久后端队列。它还需要更多按类型划分的资源，并且不符合每个后端组处理其自身保留工作队列的要求。
- **D:** Kinesis Data Firehose 传输到 OpenSearch 适用于传输/索引/搜索/分析工作流，而不是供应用程序服务器处理报价请求的持久工作队列模式。让后端服务器在 OpenSearch 中搜索工作项，比使用 SQS queues 效率更低且运营复杂性更高。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on several Amazon EC2 instances. Each EC2 instance has multiple Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) data volumes attached to it. The application’s EC2 instance configuration and data need to be backed up nightly. The application also needs to be recoverable in a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application’s EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Region.
options.B: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EC2 instances as resources.
options.C: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EBS volumes as resources.
options.D: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application's EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Availability Zone.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Backup is the most operationally efficient choice because it provides centralized, policy-based backup plans that can be applied to AWS resources and scheduled to run automatically. AWS documentation states that backup plans define backup requirements and apply them to the AWS resources to protect, and that AWS Backup can copy backups to multiple AWS Regions on demand or automatically as part of a scheduled backup plan ([What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). The backup plan console workflow also includes selecting a backup frequency and an optional **Copy to destination** setting to create a cross-Region copy ([Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)).

Adding the **EC2 instances** as the protected resources satisfies both parts of the requirement: instance configuration and data. AWS Backup supports “Amazon EC2 instances backed by Amazon EBS volumes” as a resource type ([What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). When restoring an EC2 recovery point, AWS Backup creates an AMI, an instance, the EBS root volume, EBS data volumes if present, and EBS snapshots; it can restore an entire EC2 instance including root volume, data volumes, and instance settings such as instance type and key pair ([Restore an Amazon EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-ec2.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A custom Lambda solution to snapshot and copy only EBS volumes is less operationally efficient than using AWS Backup managed backup plans. It also backs up volumes, not the EC2 instance configuration needed for recovery.
- **C:** Adding only the EBS volumes protects the data volumes, but the requirement includes the EC2 instance configuration. Protecting the EC2 instances captures the instance-level recovery point, including volumes and some instance settings.
- **D:** Copying snapshots to another Availability Zone does not meet the requirement to recover in a different AWS Region, and it is also a custom, less operationally efficient approach than AWS Backup.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个运行在多个 Amazon EC2 实例上的应用程序。每个 EC2 实例都附加了多个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 数据卷。该应用程序的 EC2 实例配置和数据需要每晚备份。该应用程序还需要能够在不同的 AWS Region 中恢复。哪种解决方案将以最高运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于计划每晚创建该应用程序 EBS 卷的快照，并将快照复制到不同的 Region。
options.B: 使用 AWS Backup 创建备份计划以执行每晚备份。将备份复制到另一个 Region。将该应用程序的 EC2 实例添加为资源。
options.C: 使用 AWS Backup 创建备份计划以执行每晚备份。将备份复制到另一个 Region。将该应用程序的 EBS 卷添加为资源。
options.D: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于计划每晚创建该应用程序 EBS 卷的快照，并将快照复制到不同的 Availability Zone。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

AWS Backup 是运营效率最高的选择，因为它提供集中式、基于策略的备份计划，可以应用于 AWS 资源并计划自动运行。AWS 文档说明，备份计划定义备份要求并将其应用于要保护的 AWS 资源，并且 AWS Backup 可以按需或作为计划备份计划的一部分自动将备份复制到多个 AWS Regions（[What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。备份计划控制台工作流还包括选择备份频率以及可选的 **Copy to destination** 设置，以创建跨 Region 副本（[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。将 **EC2 instances** 添加为受保护资源可以满足要求的两个部分：实例配置和数据。AWS Backup 支持“Amazon EC2 instances backed by Amazon EBS volumes”作为资源类型（[What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。还原 EC2 恢复点时，AWS Backup 会创建 AMI、实例、EBS 根卷、如存在则创建 EBS 数据卷，以及 EBS 快照；它可以还原整个 EC2 实例，包括根卷、数据卷以及实例类型和密钥对等实例设置（[Restore an Amazon EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-ec2.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 用于创建快照并仅复制 EBS 卷的自定义 Lambda 解决方案，其运营效率低于使用 AWS Backup 托管备份计划。它还只备份卷，而不是恢复所需的 EC2 实例配置。
- **C:** 仅添加 EBS 卷会保护数据卷，但要求包括 EC2 实例配置。保护 EC2 实例会捕获实例级恢复点，包括卷和一些实例设置。
- **D:** 将快照复制到另一个 Availability Zone 不满足在不同 AWS Region 中恢复的要求，并且这也是一种自定义方法，运营效率低于 AWS Backup。

en.question: A company is building a mobile app on AWS. The company wants to expand its reach to millions of users. The company needs to build a platform so that authorized users can watch the company’s content on their mobile devices. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Publish content to a public Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stream content.
options.B: Set up IPsec VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content.
options.D: Set up AWS Client VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content.**

CloudFront is designed for large-scale internet content delivery and supports streaming media to global viewers, including VOD formats such as MPEG-DASH, Apple HLS, Microsoft Smooth Streaming, and CMAF, to any device ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)). For authorization, AWS documents that private media streams can be securely served by requiring users to access content with CloudFront signed URLs or signed cookies ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)). Signed URLs fit this use case because the application can verify that a user is entitled to access the content, return a signed URL, and the signed URL then allows the user to download or stream the content through CloudFront ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A.** A public S3 bucket would make content publicly reachable, which conflicts with the requirement that only authorized users can watch it. AWS recommends requiring access through CloudFront URLs for private content to prevent users from bypassing signed URL or signed cookie restrictions ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)). AWS KMS is for encryption key management, not an authorization mechanism for internet-scale video streaming.
- **B.** IPsec VPN is not an appropriate mechanism for delivering content to millions of mobile users. The requirement is global, scalable content distribution with user authorization; CloudFront signed URLs provide that pattern.
- **D.** AWS Client VPN is for private network access by clients, not for scalable public mobile content streaming to millions of users. It would add unnecessary VPN connectivity overhead and does not provide CDN-style edge caching or signed URL-based content delivery.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个移动应用。该公司希望将覆盖范围扩大到数百万用户。公司需要构建一个平台，使授权用户可以在其移动设备上观看公司的内容。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将内容发布到公共 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys 来流式传输内容。
options.B: 在移动应用和 AWS 环境之间设置 IPsec VPN 以流式传输内容。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudFront。提供 signed URLs 以流式传输内容。
options.D: 在移动应用和 AWS 环境之间设置 AWS Client VPN 以流式传输内容。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content.**

CloudFront 专为大规模互联网内容分发而设计，并支持向全球观看者流式传输媒体，包括 MPEG-DASH、Apple HLS、Microsoft Smooth Streaming 和 CMAF 等 VOD 格式，且可传输到任何设备（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)）。对于授权，AWS 文档说明，可以通过要求用户使用 CloudFront signed URLs 或 signed cookies 访问内容，来安全地提供私有媒体流（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)）。Signed URLs 适合此使用场景，因为应用程序可以验证用户是否有权访问内容，返回一个 signed URL，然后该 signed URL 允许用户通过 CloudFront 下载或流式传输内容（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A.** 公共 S3 存储桶会使内容可被公开访问，这与只有授权用户才能观看内容的要求相冲突。AWS 建议对于私有内容，要求通过 CloudFront URLs 进行访问，以防止用户绕过 signed URL 或 signed cookie 限制（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)）。AWS KMS 用于加密密钥管理，并不是面向互联网规模视频流式传输的授权机制。
- **B.** IPsec VPN 不是向数百万移动用户交付内容的适当机制。要求是具有用户授权的全球可扩展内容分发；CloudFront signed URLs 提供了这种模式。
- **D.** AWS Client VPN 用于客户端的私有网络访问，而不是面向数百万用户的可扩展公共移动内容流式传输。它会增加不必要的 VPN 连接开销，并且不提供 CDN 风格的边缘缓存或基于 signed URL 的内容交付。

en.question: A company has an on-premises MySQL database used by the global sales team with infrequent access patterns. The sales team requires the database to have minimal downtime. A database administrator wants to migrate this database to AWS without selecting a particular instance type in anticipation of more users in the future. Which service should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Amazon Aurora MySQL
options.B: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL
options.C: Amazon Redshift Spectrum
options.D: Amazon RDS for MySQL

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL**

Aurora Serverless is the best fit because the workload has infrequent/variable access and the administrator does not want to choose a fixed instance type. AWS states that for variable workloads, Aurora Serverless automatically scales database capacity up and down and you “no longer need to provision for peak or average capacity.” It is also explicitly recommended for new applications where you are unsure about the DB instance size, because the database autoscale matches the application’s capacity requirements.
