Aurora Serverless scaling is also designed to be minimally disruptive, scaling compute and memory “with no disruption to client transactions or your overall workload” ([Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon Aurora MySQL** — Aurora MySQL is MySQL-compatible, but a standard/provisioned Aurora deployment requires capacity planning with DB instance classes. AWS says a DB instance class determines the compute and memory capacity of an Aurora DB instance ([Amazon Aurora DB instance classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.DBInstanceClass.html)). This does not meet the “without selecting a particular instance type” requirement as directly as Aurora Serverless.
- **C. Amazon Redshift Spectrum** — Redshift Spectrum is for querying data in Amazon S3/external data lakes, not for migrating and running a MySQL OLTP database. AWS describes Redshift Spectrum as querying data in Amazon S3 ([Getting started with Amazon Redshift Spectrum](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c-getting-started-using-spectrum.html)).
- **D. Amazon RDS for MySQL** — RDS for MySQL is a managed MySQL database, but it uses provisioned DB instances/instance classes rather than serverless autoscaling capacity, so the administrator would still need to select and manage instance sizing. The Aurora DB instance class documentation illustrates why provisioned database options require choosing compute and memory capacity ([Amazon Aurora DB instance classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.DBInstanceClass.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个本地 MySQL 数据库，供全球销售团队使用，访问模式不频繁。销售团队要求数据库具有最短停机时间。一名数据库管理员希望将此数据库迁移到 AWS，并且不想选择特定实例类型，以便为未来更多用户做准备。解决方案架构师应推荐哪项服务？

options.A: Amazon Aurora MySQL
options.B: Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL
options.C: Amazon Redshift Spectrum
options.D: Amazon RDS for MySQL

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL**

Aurora Serverless 是最合适的选择，因为该工作负载访问不频繁/可变，并且管理员不想选择固定实例类型。AWS 表示，对于可变工作负载，Aurora Serverless 会自动向上和向下扩展数据库容量，并且你“no longer need to provision for peak or average capacity”。对于你不确定 DB 实例大小的新应用程序，也明确建议使用它，因为数据库自动扩展会匹配应用程序的容量需求。Aurora Serverless 扩展也被设计为尽量减少中断，可“with no disruption to client transactions or your overall workload”地扩展计算和内存（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Amazon Aurora MySQL** — Aurora MySQL 与 MySQL 兼容，但标准/预置的 Aurora 部署需要使用 DB instance classes 进行容量规划。AWS 表示，DB instance class 决定 Aurora DB instance 的计算和内存容量（[Amazon Aurora DB instance classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.DBInstanceClass.html)）。这不像 Aurora Serverless 那样直接满足“without selecting a particular instance type”的要求。
- **C. Amazon Redshift Spectrum** — Redshift Spectrum 用于查询 Amazon S3/外部数据湖中的数据，而不是用于迁移和运行 MySQL OLTP 数据库。AWS 将 Redshift Spectrum 描述为查询 Amazon S3 中的数据（[Getting started with Amazon Redshift Spectrum](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c-getting-started-using-spectrum.html)）。
- **D. Amazon RDS for MySQL** — RDS for MySQL 是托管式 MySQL 数据库，但它使用预置的 DB instances/instance classes，而不是 serverless 自动扩展容量，因此管理员仍然需要选择并管理实例大小。Aurora DB instance class 文档说明了为什么预置数据库选项需要选择计算和内存容量（[Amazon Aurora DB instance classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.DBInstanceClass.html)）。

en.question: A company experienced a breach that affected several applications in its on-premises data center. The attacker took advantage of vulnerabilities in the custom applications that were running on the servers. The company is now migrating its applications to run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to implement a solution that actively scans for vulnerabilities on the EC2 instances and sends a report that details the findings. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS Shield to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Create an AWS Lambda function to log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.B: Deploy Amazon Macie and AWS Lambda functions to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.C: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty. Deploy the GuardDuty agents to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.
options.D: Turn on Amazon Inspector. Deploy the Amazon Inspector agent to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon Inspector is the AWS service designed for this requirement: it is a vulnerability management service that automatically discovers workloads and continually scans them for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure, including **Amazon EC2 instances**. When it detects a vulnerability or exposure, it creates a **finding**, described by AWS as a detailed report about the issue ([Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)). Amazon Inspector findings reports can be exported as CSV or JSON and provide a detailed snapshot of findings; the `CreateFindingsReport` API can be used for programmatic report generation, which a Lambda function could automate ([Exporting Amazon Inspector findings reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-managing-exporting-reports.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. AWS Shield** protects AWS resources against DDoS attacks at layers 3, 4, and 7; it is not a vulnerability scanner for EC2 instances or custom applications ([AWS Shield](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)). Also, CloudTrail records API activity; it is not where vulnerability findings are normally “logged” as reports.
- **B. Amazon Macie** discovers and reports sensitive data, primarily in Amazon S3, using machine learning and pattern matching. It does not scan EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities ([Amazon Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)).
- **C. Amazon GuardDuty** is a threat detection service that analyzes AWS data sources and logs to identify suspicious or malicious activity, such as compromised credentials, cryptomining, or malware indicators. It is not the service for proactive vulnerability scanning and vulnerability reports for EC2 instances ([Amazon GuardDuty](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司经历了一次安全漏洞事件，影响了其本地数据中心中的多个应用程序。攻击者利用了运行在服务器上的自定义应用程序中的漏洞。该公司现在正在将其应用程序迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。该公司希望实施一种解决方案，能够主动扫描 EC2 实例上的漏洞，并发送一份详细说明发现结果的报告。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署 AWS Shield 来扫描 EC2 实例中的漏洞。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将任何发现结果记录到 AWS CloudTrail。
options.B: 部署 Amazon Macie 和 AWS Lambda 函数来扫描 EC2 实例中的漏洞。将任何发现结果记录到 AWS CloudTrail。
options.C: 启用 Amazon GuardDuty。将 GuardDuty 代理部署到 EC2 实例。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，以自动生成和分发详细说明发现结果的报告。
options.D: 启用 Amazon Inspector。将 Amazon Inspector 代理部署到 EC2 实例。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，以自动生成和分发详细说明发现结果的报告。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** Amazon Inspector 是为此需求而设计的 AWS 服务：它是一项漏洞管理服务，可自动发现工作负载，并持续扫描其中的软件漏洞和非预期网络暴露，包括 **Amazon EC2 instances**。当它检测到漏洞或暴露时，会创建一个 **finding**，AWS 将其描述为关于该问题的详细报告（[Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。Amazon Inspector findings reports 可以导出为 CSV 或 JSON，并提供发现结果的详细快照；`CreateFindingsReport` API 可用于以编程方式生成报告，Lambda 函数可以将其自动化（[Exporting Amazon Inspector findings reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-managing-exporting-reports.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. AWS Shield** 保护 AWS 资源免受第 3、4 和 7 层的 DDoS 攻击；它不是用于 EC2 实例或自定义应用程序的漏洞扫描器（[AWS Shield](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)）。此外，CloudTrail 记录 API 活动；它通常不是将漏洞发现结果作为报告“记录”的位置。
- **B. Amazon Macie** 使用机器学习和模式匹配来发现和报告敏感数据，主要是在 Amazon S3 中。它不会扫描 EC2 实例中的软件漏洞（[Amazon Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。
- **C. Amazon GuardDuty** 是一项威胁检测服务，用于分析 AWS 数据源和日志，以识别可疑或恶意活动，例如凭证被盗用、加密货币挖矿或恶意软件指标。它不是用于对 EC2 实例进行主动漏洞扫描并生成漏洞报告的服务（[Amazon GuardDuty](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)）。

en.question: A company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run a script to poll for and process messages in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The company wants to reduce operational costs while maintaining its ability to process a growing number of messages that are added to the queue. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the size of the EC2 instance to process messages faster.
options.B: Use Amazon EventBridge to turn off the EC2 instance when the instance is underutilized.
options.C: Migrate the script on the EC2 instance to an AWS Lambda function with the appropriate runtime.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on demand.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Migrate the script on the EC2 instance to an AWS Lambda function with the appropriate runtime.**

AWS Lambda is the best fit because it removes the need to operate an EC2 instance for queue polling. AWS states that with Lambda, you are responsible only for your code, while Lambda manages server and OS maintenance, capacity provisioning, automatic scaling, and logging ([AWS Lambda: How Lambda works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). For Amazon SQS specifically, Lambda event source mappings poll the queue and invoke the function with batches of messages; after successful processing, Lambda deletes the messages from the queue ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). Lambda also automatically scales SQS event pollers based on message volume, increasing concurrent processing as messages remain available and scaling back when traffic is low ([Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)). This meets both requirements: lower operational overhead/cost and the ability to process a growing queue.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Increase the size of the EC2 instance** — This may process messages faster, but it keeps the company managing EC2 capacity and likely increases compute cost. It does not provide the automatic, event-driven scaling that Lambda provides for SQS workloads.
- **B. Use EventBridge to turn off the EC2 instance when underutilized** — Stopping the instance can reduce costs during idle periods, but it also stops polling and processing. It does not maintain continuous ability to process a growing number of messages.
- **D. Use Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on demand** — Run Command is not an event-driven SQS processing mechanism and would require external scheduling or manual triggering. It does not automatically poll SQS or scale processing based on queue depth.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例运行一个脚本，用于轮询并处理 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列中的消息。该公司希望在保持处理不断增加的队列消息数量的能力的同时，降低运营成本。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 增加 EC2 实例的大小，以更快地处理消息。
options.B: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 在 EC2 实例利用率不足时关闭该实例。
options.C: 将 EC2 实例上的脚本迁移到具有适当运行时的 AWS Lambda 函数。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 按需运行该脚本。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Migrate the script on the EC2 instance to an AWS Lambda function with the appropriate runtime.**

AWS Lambda 是最合适的选择，因为它消除了为队列轮询而运行 EC2 实例的需求。AWS 表示，使用 Lambda 时，你只需负责自己的代码，而 Lambda 会管理服务器和 OS 维护、容量预置、自动扩展以及日志记录（[AWS Lambda: How Lambda works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。专门针对 Amazon SQS，Lambda 事件源映射会轮询队列，并使用消息批次调用函数；成功处理后，Lambda 会从队列中删除这些消息（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。Lambda 还会根据消息量自动扩展 SQS 事件轮询器，在消息仍可用时增加并发处理，并在流量较低时缩减（[Configuring scaling behavior for SQS event source mappings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-scaling.html)）。这同时满足两个要求：降低运营开销/成本，并具备处理不断增长队列的能力。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. Increase the size of the EC2 instance** — 这可能会更快地处理消息，但仍然需要公司管理 EC2 容量，并且很可能增加计算成本。它无法提供 Lambda 为 SQS 工作负载提供的自动、事件驱动扩展能力。
- **B. Use EventBridge to turn off the EC2 instance when underutilized** — 停止实例可以在空闲期间降低成本，但也会停止轮询和处理。它不能持续保持处理不断增加的消息数量的能力。
- **D. Use Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on demand** — Run Command 不是事件驱动的 SQS 处理机制，并且需要外部调度或手动触发。它不会自动轮询 SQS，也不会根据队列深度扩展处理能力。

en.question: A company uses a legacy application to produce data in CSV format. The legacy application stores the output data in Amazon S3. The company is deploying a new commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) application that can perform complex SQL queries to analyze data that is stored in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 only. However, the COTS application cannot process the .csv files that the legacy application produces. The company cannot update the legacy application to produce data in another format. The company needs to implement a solution so that the COTS application can use the data that the legacy application produces. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs on a schedule. Configure the ETL job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in Amazon Redshift.
options.B: Develop a Python script that runs on Amazon EC2 instances to convert the .csv files to .sql files. Invoke the Python script on a cron schedule to store the output files in Amazon S3.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use an S3 event to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to launch an Amazon EMR cluster on a weekly schedule. Configure the EMR cluster to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in an Amazon Redshift table.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Glue is the best fit because it is designed for ETL: AWS Glue jobs contain transformation scripts, can be initiated **on a schedule**, and transform data from a source format to a target format. AWS Glue also supports Amazon S3 and Amazon Redshift as data sources/destinations, and AWS states that Glue provisions and manages the required resources so you do not need to create ETL infrastructure yourself ([AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)). AWS Glue documentation also shows writing transformed data to Amazon Redshift clusters or Redshift Serverless environments ([Redshift connections - AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-connect-redshift-home.html)). This meets the requirement with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Running a custom Python conversion script on EC2 with cron adds operational overhead for instance provisioning, patching, scaling, monitoring, and script maintenance. It also outputs `.sql` files to S3, which does not directly solve loading transformed analyzable data into Redshift.
- **C:** DynamoDB is not an allowed target for the COTS application, which can analyze data only in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3. Although AWS Glue can work with DynamoDB, storing the processed data in DynamoDB would not meet the application requirement ([AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)).
- **D:** EMR can run big data processing jobs, but launching and managing an EMR cluster for this scheduled ETL task is more operationally complex than using AWS Glue. Glue specifically provides managed ETL job scheduling and managed resource provisioning ([AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html), [AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用一个旧版应用程序以 CSV 格式生成数据。该旧版应用程序将输出数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。该公司正在部署一个新的商用现成 (COTS) 应用程序，该应用程序可以执行复杂的 SQL 查询，以分析仅存储在 Amazon Redshift 和 Amazon S3 中的数据。但是，COTS 应用程序无法处理旧版应用程序生成的 .csv 文件。该公司无法更新旧版应用程序以生成其他格式的数据。公司需要实施一个解决方案，使 COTS 应用程序能够使用旧版应用程序生成的数据。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个按计划运行的 AWS Glue 提取、转换和加载 (ETL) 作业。配置该 ETL 作业以处理 .csv 文件，并将处理后的数据存储在 Amazon Redshift 中。
options.B: 开发一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的 Python 脚本，将 .csv 文件转换为 .sql 文件。按 cron 计划调用该 Python 脚本，以将输出文件存储在 Amazon S3 中。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。使用 S3 事件调用 Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数执行提取、转换和加载 (ETL) 作业，以处理 .csv 文件并将处理后的数据存储在 DynamoDB 表中。
options.D: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 按每周计划启动一个 Amazon EMR 集群。配置 EMR 集群执行提取、转换和加载 (ETL) 作业，以处理 .csv 文件并将处理后的数据存储在 Amazon Redshift 表中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS Glue 是最合适的选择，因为它专为 ETL 而设计：AWS Glue 作业包含转换脚本，可以**按计划**启动，并将数据从源格式转换为目标格式。AWS Glue 还支持 Amazon S3 和 Amazon Redshift 作为数据源/目标，并且 AWS 表示 Glue 会预置和管理所需资源，因此你无需自行创建 ETL 基础设施（[AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)）。AWS Glue 文档还展示了将转换后的数据写入 Amazon Redshift 集群或 Redshift Serverless 环境（[Redshift connections - AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-connect-redshift-home.html)）。这能以最少的运营开销满足要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 在 EC2 上使用 cron 运行自定义 Python 转换脚本，会为实例预置、修补、扩展、监控和脚本维护增加运营开销。它还将 `.sql` 文件输出到 S3，这并不能直接解决将转换后的、可分析的数据加载到 Redshift 中的问题。
- **C:** DynamoDB 不是 COTS 应用程序允许的目标，该应用程序只能分析 Amazon Redshift 和 Amazon S3 中的数据。虽然 AWS Glue 可以与 DynamoDB 配合使用，但将处理后的数据存储在 DynamoDB 中并不能满足应用程序要求（[AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)）。
- **D:** EMR 可以运行大数据处理作业，但为这个计划性 ETL 任务启动和管理 EMR 集群，比使用 AWS Glue 在运营上更复杂。Glue 专门提供托管 ETL 作业计划和托管资源预置（[AWS Glue features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html), [AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)）。

en.question: A company recently migrated its entire IT environment to the AWS Cloud. The company discovers that users are provisioning oversized Amazon EC2 instances and modifying security group rules without using the appropriate change control process. A solutions architect must devise a strategy to track and audit these inventory and configuration changes. Which actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing.
options.B: Use data lifecycle policies for the Amazon EC2 instances.
options.C: Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and reference the security dashboard.
options.D: Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes.
options.E: Restore previous resource configurations with an AWS CloudFormation template.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and D**.

- **A. Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing** — CloudTrail is the service designed for operational/risk auditing, governance, and compliance. It records actions taken by users, roles, and AWS services as events, including actions through the AWS Management Console, AWS CLI, SDKs, and APIs. This directly helps audit who launched or changed EC2 instances and who modified security group rules. AWS notes that Event history is available automatically for 90 days, but trails or CloudTrail Lake are used when you need ongoing recording, storage, and audit analysis beyond that scope. [AWS CloudTrail documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

- **D. Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes** — AWS Config provides a detailed view of AWS resource configurations, including EC2 instances and security groups, and shows how configurations changed over time. It discovers resources, records configuration changes, tracks security group changes, and AWS Config rules continuously evaluate resources for desired settings and flag noncompliant resources. This directly meets the requirement to track and audit inventory and configuration changes. [AWS Config overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html), [How AWS Config works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/how-does-config-work.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. Use data lifecycle policies for the Amazon EC2 instances** — Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager is for automating AMI lifecycle actions such as creation, retention, copying, and deprecation/deletion. It does not audit user activity, EC2 instance sizing choices, or security group rule changes. [Amazon EC2 AMI lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ami-lifecycle.html)
- **C. Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and reference the security dashboard** — Trusted Advisor can provide checks and recommendations, but the requirement is to track and audit inventory and configuration changes over time. AWS Config and CloudTrail are the services documented for configuration history/compliance evaluation and API/user activity auditing.
- **E. Restore previous resource configurations with an AWS CloudFormation template** — CloudFormation can detect drift between stack templates and actual resource configuration, but it is limited to resources managed in stacks and supported properties; it is not the correct general-purpose service for auditing all inventory/configuration changes across a migrated AWS environment. [CloudFormation drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)

zh.question: 一家公司最近将其整个 IT 环境迁移到了 AWS Cloud。该公司发现，用户正在预置过大的 Amazon EC2 实例，并且在未使用适当变更控制流程的情况下修改安全组规则。解决方案架构师必须制定一项策略来跟踪和审计这些清单与配置变更。解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 启用 AWS CloudTrail，并将其用于审计。
options.B: 对 Amazon EC2 实例使用数据生命周期策略。
options.C: 启用 AWS Trusted Advisor，并参考安全控制面板。
options.D: 启用 AWS Config，并创建用于审计和合规目的的规则。
options.E: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板还原以前的资源配置。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 D**。

- **A. 启用 AWS CloudTrail，并将其用于审计** — CloudTrail 是专为运营/风险审计、治理和合规而设计的服务。它将用户、角色和 AWS 服务执行的操作记录为事件，包括通过 AWS Management Console、AWS CLI、SDKs 和 APIs 执行的操作。这直接有助于审计是谁启动或更改了 EC2 实例，以及是谁修改了安全组规则。AWS 指出，Event history 会自动提供 90 天，但当你需要在该范围之外进行持续记录、存储和审计分析时，则使用 trails 或 CloudTrail Lake。[AWS CloudTrail documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)

- **D. 启用 AWS Config，并创建用于审计和合规目的的规则** — AWS Config 提供 AWS 资源配置的详细视图，包括 EC2 实例和安全组，并显示配置随时间如何变化。它发现资源、记录配置变更、跟踪安全组变更，并且 AWS Config rules 会持续评估资源是否符合期望设置并标记不合规资源。这直接满足跟踪和审计清单及配置变更的要求。[AWS Config overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html), [How AWS Config works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/how-does-config-work.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. 对 Amazon EC2 实例使用数据生命周期策略** — Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 用于自动执行 AMI 生命周期操作，例如创建、保留、复制以及弃用/删除。它不会审计用户活动、EC2 实例大小选择或安全组规则变更。[Amazon EC2 AMI lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ami-lifecycle.html)
- **C. 启用 AWS Trusted Advisor，并参考安全控制面板** — Trusted Advisor 可以提供检查和建议，但要求是随时间跟踪和审计清单及配置变更。AWS Config 和 CloudTrail 才是文档中用于配置历史/合规评估以及 API/用户活动审计的服务。
- **E. 使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板还原以前的资源配置** — CloudFormation 可以检测堆栈模板与实际资源配置之间的漂移，但它仅限于堆栈中托管的资源和受支持的属性；它不是用于审计已迁移 AWS 环境中所有清单/配置变更的正确通用服务。[CloudFormation drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)

en.question: A company has hundreds of Amazon EC2 Linux-based instances in the AWS Cloud. Systems administrators have used shared SSH keys to manage the instances. After a recent audit, the company’s security team is mandating the removal of all shared keys. A solutions architect must design a solution that provides secure access to the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of administrative overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to generate one-time SSH keys on demand.
options.C: Allow shared SSH access to a set of bastion instances. Configure all other instances to allow only SSH access from the bastion instances.
options.D: Use an Amazon Cognito custom authorizer to authenticate users. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate a temporary SSH key.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to the EC2 instances.**

AWS Systems Manager Session Manager is designed for this use case. AWS states that Session Manager provides centralized access control through IAM policies and enables access with **“no open inbound ports and no need to manage bastion hosts or SSH keys.”** It also lets administrators start sessions from the console or CLI, and access is granted through IAM instead of SSH keys, reducing operational overhead. Session Manager also supports Linux EC2 instances and provides logging/auditing integrations such as CloudTrail, Amazon S3, CloudWatch Logs, EventBridge, and SNS ([AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. AWS STS to generate one-time SSH keys** — AWS STS provides **temporary security credentials** for making programmatic requests to AWS services using the AWS CLI/API/SDKs; these credentials include session tokens and expire after a set interval. The documentation describes STS credentials for AWS resource access, federation, delegation, cross-account access, and IAM roles—not generating SSH keys for EC2 login ([Use temporary credentials with AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_use-resources.html), [Temporary security credentials in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html)).
* **C. Shared SSH access to bastion instances** — This still relies on shared SSH access and introduces/maintains bastion hosts. AWS specifically lists Session Manager as removing the need to manage **bastion hosts or SSH keys** ([AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).
* **D. Cognito custom authorizer + Lambda to generate temporary SSH keys** — This is a custom solution that still involves SSH key generation and management, plus additional services and code. It has more administrative overhead than the managed Session Manager approach, which uses IAM policies directly and avoids SSH keys altogether ([AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中有数百个基于 Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例。系统管理员一直使用共享 SSH 密钥来管理这些实例。最近一次审计后，该公司的安全团队要求移除所有共享密钥。解决方案架构师必须设计一个为 EC2 实例提供安全访问的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足此要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 连接到 EC2 实例。
options.B: 使用 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 按需生成一次性 SSH 密钥。
options.C: 允许对一组堡垒实例进行共享 SSH 访问。配置所有其他实例仅允许来自堡垒实例的 SSH 访问。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Cognito 自定义授权方对用户进行身份验证。调用 AWS Lambda 函数生成临时 SSH 密钥。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 连接到 EC2 实例。**

AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 就是为此用例而设计的。AWS 表示，Session Manager 通过 IAM 策略提供集中式访问控制，并支持在 **“no open inbound ports and no need to manage bastion hosts or SSH keys.”** 的情况下进行访问。它还允许管理员从控制台或 CLI 启动会话，并且访问权限通过 IAM 授予，而不是通过 SSH 密钥，从而降低运营开销。Session Manager 还支持 Linux EC2 实例，并提供日志记录/审计集成，例如 CloudTrail、Amazon S3、CloudWatch Logs、EventBridge 和 SNS（[AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B. AWS STS to generate one-time SSH keys** — AWS STS 提供用于通过 AWS CLI/API/SDKs 向 AWS 服务发出编程请求的 **temporary security credentials**；这些凭证包括会话令牌，并会在设定的时间间隔后过期。文档描述的是用于 AWS 资源访问、联合身份、委派、跨账户访问和 IAM 角色的 STS 凭证，而不是为 EC2 登录生成 SSH 密钥（[Use temporary credentials with AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_use-resources.html)，[Temporary security credentials in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html)）。
* **C. Shared SSH access to bastion instances** — 这仍然依赖共享 SSH 访问，并且会引入/维护堡垒主机。AWS 明确列出 Session Manager 可以消除管理 **bastion hosts or SSH keys** 的需求（[AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。
* **D. Cognito custom authorizer + Lambda to generate temporary SSH keys** — 这是一个自定义解决方案，仍然涉及 SSH 密钥生成和管理，并且需要额外的服务和代码。相比使用 IAM 策略并完全避免 SSH 密钥的托管 Session Manager 方法，它具有更高的管理开销（[AWS Systems Manager Session Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。

en.question: A company is using a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances to ingest data from on-premises data sources. The data is in JSON format and ingestion rates can be as high as 1 MB/s. When an EC2 instance is rebooted, the data in-flight is lost. The company’s data science team wants to query ingested data in near-real time. Which solution provides near-real-time data querying that is scalable with minimal data loss?

options.A: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Use Kinesis Data Analytics to query the data.
options.B: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon Redshift as the destination. Use Amazon Redshift to query the data.
options.C: Store ingested data in an EC2 instance store. Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon S3 as the destination. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Store ingested data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Publish data to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Subscribe to the Redis channel to query the data.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is the best fit because it is designed for rapid, continuous, real-time data intake and processing. AWS states that producers can push data directly into a stream and data is available for processing in seconds, preventing loss if the front-end/application server fails; Kinesis Data Streams also provides durability and elasticity, with a typical put-to-get delay of less than 1 second ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). The stated 1 MB/s ingestion rate is also directly supported: in provisioned mode, each shard supports up to **1 MB/sec** write throughput, and the stream can be scaled by adding shards; on-demand mode starts at 4 MB/s write throughput and scales higher ([Kinesis quotas and limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/service-sizes-and-limits.html)). Kinesis retains records for 24 hours by default and can retain them for longer, reducing loss during EC2 reboots ([Kinesis concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)). The data science team can query the stream with SQL and view results in seconds using the Kinesis Data Streams Data Analytics capability / Managed Apache Flink Studio notebook ([query data streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/querying-data.html)).

**Why the other options are not best:**

- **B:** Amazon Data Firehose buffers incoming streaming data before delivering it, and for Redshift it first delivers data to S3 and then issues a Redshift `COPY` command ([Firehose buffering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-configure-backup.html), [Redshift destination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)). That is better for delivery/loading than immediate stream querying.
- **C:** EC2 instance store is temporary storage and is not the right durability layer for in-flight ingest data; instance store data is lost on stop, hibernation, or termination ([EC2 instance store persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)). Firehose-to-S3 plus Athena queries only after buffered S3 delivery, not direct near-real-time stream analytics.
- **D:** EBS would make local storage more persistent, but publishing to ElastiCache for Redis and subscribing to a channel is not a scalable durable streaming analytics/query solution like Kinesis Data Streams with SQL analytics. It does not address the required near-real-time querying with minimal data loss as well as Kinesis.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用一组 Amazon EC2 实例从本地数据源摄取数据。数据采用 JSON 格式，摄取速率最高可达 1 MB/s。当 EC2 实例重启时，正在传输中的数据会丢失。该公司的数据科学团队希望以近实时方式查询已摄取的数据。哪种解决方案能够提供可扩展且数据丢失最少的近实时数据查询？

options.A: 将数据发布到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams，使用 Kinesis Data Analytics 查询数据。
options.B: 将数据发布到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose，并将 Amazon Redshift 作为目标。使用 Amazon Redshift 查询数据。
options.C: 将摄取的数据存储在 EC2 实例存储中。将数据发布到 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose，并将 Amazon S3 作为目标。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.D: 将摄取的数据存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。将数据发布到 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。订阅 Redis 通道来查询数据。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 是最合适的选择，因为它专为快速、连续、实时的数据摄取和处理而设计。AWS 表示，生产者可以将数据直接推送到流中，并且数据可在数秒内用于处理；如果前端/应用程序服务器发生故障，可防止数据丢失；Kinesis Data Streams 还提供持久性和弹性，典型的 put-to-get 延迟小于 1 秒（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。题目中给出的 1 MB/s 摄取速率也受到直接支持：在预置模式下，每个分片最多支持 **1 MB/sec** 写入吞吐量，并且可以通过添加分片来扩展流；按需模式从 4 MB/s 写入吞吐量开始，并可扩展到更高（[Kinesis quotas and limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/service-sizes-and-limits.html)）。Kinesis 默认保留记录 24 小时，并且可以保留更长时间，从而减少 EC2 重启期间的数据丢失（[Kinesis concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)）。数据科学团队可以使用 Kinesis Data Streams Data Analytics capability / Managed Apache Flink Studio notebook 通过 SQL 查询流并在数秒内查看结果（[query data streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/querying-data.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：**

- **B:** Amazon Data Firehose 会先缓冲传入的流数据再进行传送；对于 Redshift，它会先将数据传送到 S3，然后发出 Redshift `COPY` 命令（[Firehose buffering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-configure-backup.html)，[Redshift destination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。这更适合传送/加载，而不是即时流查询。
- **C:** EC2 instance store 是临时存储，不适合作为传输中摄取数据的持久层；实例存储数据会在停止、休眠或终止时丢失（[EC2 instance store persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)）。Firehose 到 S3 再加 Athena 查询只能在缓冲后的 S3 传送完成后进行，而不是直接进行近实时流分析。
- **D:** EBS 会使本地存储更持久，但发布到 ElastiCache for Redis 并订阅通道，并不是像 Kinesis Data Streams 配合 SQL 分析那样可扩展且持久的流分析/查询解决方案。它无法像 Kinesis 那样很好地满足近实时查询和最小数据丢失的要求。

en.question: What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all objects uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket are encrypted?

options.A: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set.
options.B: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set to private.
options.C: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an aws:SecureTransport header set to true.
options.D: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an x-amz-server-side-encryption header set.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** To enforce encryption on uploaded objects, use a bucket policy that denies `s3:PutObject` unless the request includes the server-side encryption setting. AWS’s S3 documentation gives this exact pattern: a bucket policy can deny upload unless the request includes the `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header to request server-side encryption, and PUT uploads can specify this header when uploading data ([Using server-side encryption with SSE-S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)). AWS also shows encryption-enforcement policies that deny writes when objects are not encrypted with SSE-KMS ([Examples of Amazon S3 bucket policies: Requiring encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A and B:** `s3:x-amz-acl` / `x-amz-acl` controls canned ACL/object access settings, not encryption. AWS documents `x-amz-acl` policy conditions for controlling object ACL behavior, such as requiring a specific canned ACL, not encrypting data ([Policy examples for ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-condition-keys.html)).
- **C:** `aws:SecureTransport` is used to require HTTPS/TLS and deny HTTP requests. That protects data in transit, but it does not ensure uploaded objects are encrypted at rest in S3 ([Managing access based on HTTP or HTTPS requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)).

zh.question: 解决方案架构师应如何确保上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶的所有对象都已加密？

options.A: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 没有设置 s3:x-amz-acl 标头，则拒绝。
options.B: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 没有将 s3:x-amz-acl 标头设置为 private，则拒绝。
options.C: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 没有将 aws:SecureTransport 标头设置为 true，则拒绝。
options.D: 更新存储桶策略：如果 PutObject 没有设置 x-amz-server-side-encryption 标头，则拒绝。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 要对上传的对象强制执行加密，请使用存储桶策略来拒绝未在请求中包含服务器端加密设置的 `s3:PutObject`。AWS 的 S3 文档给出了这一确切模式：存储桶策略可以拒绝上传，除非请求包含用于请求服务器端加密的 `x-amz-server-side-encryption` 标头，并且 PUT 上传可以在上传数据时指定此标头（[Using server-side encryption with SSE-S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)）。AWS 还展示了加密强制执行策略，在对象未使用 SSE-KMS 加密时拒绝写入（[Examples of Amazon S3 bucket policies: Requiring encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A and B:** `s3:x-amz-acl` / `x-amz-acl` 控制预置 ACL/对象访问设置，而不是加密。AWS 记录了用于控制对象 ACL 行为的 `x-amz-acl` 策略条件，例如要求特定的预置 ACL，而不是加密数据（[Policy examples for ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-condition-keys.html)）。
- **C:** `aws:SecureTransport` 用于要求 HTTPS/TLS 并拒绝 HTTP 请求。这可以保护传输中的数据，但不能确保上传的对象在 S3 中静态加密（[Managing access based on HTTP or HTTPS requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a multi-tier application for a company. The application's users upload images from a mobile device. The application generates a thumbnail of each image and returns a message to the user to confirm that the image was uploaded successfully. The thumbnail generation can take up to 60 seconds, but the company wants to provide a faster response time to its users to notify them that the original image was received. The solutions architect must design the application to asynchronously dispatch requests to the different application tiers. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Write a custom AWS Lambda function to generate the thumbnail and alert the user. Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure Step Functions to handle the orchestration between the application tiers and alert the user when thumbnail generation is complete.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. Alert the user through an application message that the image was received.
options.D: Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. Use one subscription with the application to generate the thumbnail after the image upload is complete. Use a second subscription to message the user's mobile app by way of a push notification after thumbnail generation is complete.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon SQS is the best fit because the requirement is to decouple application tiers and dispatch work asynchronously while returning a fast confirmation that the original image was received. AWS describes Amazon SQS as a queue service that **decouples and scales distributed software systems and components**, with producers sending messages to a queue and consumers processing them later; SQS also stores messages redundantly and supports scalable, durable processing ([Amazon SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)). Therefore, after the image upload tier stores the original image, it can place a message on an SQS queue for thumbnail workers to process, then immediately return an application message to the user confirming receipt.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A Lambda function triggered by the upload could process the thumbnail asynchronously, and AWS notes that asynchronous Lambda invocation returns without waiting for function code to complete ([AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async.html)). However, this option says the Lambda function will generate the thumbnail **and alert the user**, which does not clearly meet the requirement to confirm immediately that the original image was received before the potentially 60-second thumbnail generation completes. It also does not explicitly introduce a queue to decouple tiers.
- **B:** Step Functions is intended for workflow orchestration, but the option alerts the user **when thumbnail generation is complete**, which conflicts with the requirement for a faster response confirming receipt of the original image. It is also more orchestration than is needed for a simple asynchronous background task.
- **D:** SNS supports asynchronous pub/sub delivery to multiple endpoint types, including Lambda, SQS, HTTP(S), email, and mobile push notifications ([Amazon SNS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). However, this option sends the user notification only **after thumbnail generation is complete**, not immediately after the original upload is received. SNS fanout is useful for broadcasting events, but SQS is the more direct fit for queueing thumbnail-generation work while the application responds quickly to the user.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一家公司设计一个多层应用程序。该应用程序的用户会从移动设备上传图像。应用程序会为每张图像生成缩略图，并向用户返回一条消息以确认图像已成功上传。缩略图生成最多可能需要 60 秒，但公司希望为用户提供更快的响应时间，以通知他们原始图像已收到。解决方案架构师必须设计该应用程序，以异步方式将请求分派到不同的应用程序层。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 编写一个自定义 AWS Lambda 函数来生成缩略图并提醒用户。使用图像上传过程作为事件源来调用 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Step Functions 工作流。配置 Step Functions 以处理应用程序层之间的编排，并在缩略图生成完成时提醒用户。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 消息队列。图像上传时，将一条用于缩略图生成的消息放入 SQS 队列。通过应用程序消息提醒用户图像已收到。
options.D: 创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知主题和订阅。使用一个订阅与应用程序配合，在图像上传完成后生成缩略图。使用第二个订阅在缩略图生成完成后通过推送通知向用户的移动应用发送消息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon SQS 最合适，因为要求是解耦应用程序层，并以异步方式分派工作，同时快速返回确认信息，表明原始图像已收到。AWS 将 Amazon SQS 描述为一种队列服务，可**解耦并扩展分布式软件系统和组件**，生产者将消息发送到队列，消费者稍后处理这些消息；SQS 还会冗余存储消息，并支持可扩展、持久的处理（[Amazon SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)）。因此，在图像上传层存储原始图像后，它可以将一条消息放入 SQS 队列，供缩略图工作器处理，然后立即向用户返回一条应用程序消息以确认已收到。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 由上传触发的 Lambda 函数可以异步处理缩略图，AWS 也指出异步 Lambda 调用会在不等待函数代码完成的情况下返回（[AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async.html)）。但是，此选项说 Lambda 函数将生成缩略图**并提醒用户**，这并未明确满足在可能需要 60 秒的缩略图生成完成之前，立即确认原始图像已收到的要求。它也没有明确引入队列来解耦各层。
- **B:** Step Functions 用于工作流编排，但该选项是在**缩略图生成完成时**提醒用户，这与更快响应并确认原始图像已收到的要求相冲突。对于简单的异步后台任务来说，它也比所需的编排更复杂。
- **D:** SNS 支持向多种端点类型进行异步发布/订阅传递，包括 Lambda、SQS、HTTP(S)、电子邮件和移动推送通知（[Amazon SNS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。但是，此选项仅在**缩略图生成完成后**才发送用户通知，而不是在原始上传收到后立即发送。SNS 扇出适用于广播事件，但对于在应用程序快速响应用户的同时排队处理缩略图生成工作，SQS 是更直接匹配的选择。

en.question: A company’s facility has badge readers at every entrance throughout the building. When badges are scanned, the readers send a message over HTTPS to indicate who attempted to access that particular entrance. A solutions architect must design a system to process these messages from the sensors. The solution must be highly available, and the results must be made available for the company’s security team to analyze. Which system architecture should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to serve as the HTTPS endpoint and to process the messages. Configure the EC2 instance to save the results to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Create an HTTPS endpoint in Amazon API Gateway. Configure the API Gateway endpoint to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.C: Use Amazon Route 53 to direct incoming sensor messages to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
options.D: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure a Site-to-Site VPN connection from the facility network to the VPC so that sensor data can be written directly to an S3 bucket by way of the VPC endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The badge readers already send messages over **HTTPS**, so the best fit is to expose an HTTPS API with Amazon API Gateway and integrate it with AWS Lambda for processing. AWS documentation states that API Gateway supports stateless **HTTP** and REST APIs and that Lambda functions can be exposed through API methods in API Gateway; API Gateway also supports Lambda proxy integrations with HTTP endpoints ([API Gateway welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)). AWS also shows that an HTTP API provides an HTTP endpoint for a Lambda function and can be integrated with a Lambda function ([HTTP API with Lambda and DynamoDB tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)). Lambda is appropriate for the processing layer because AWS says Lambda runs code on a **high-availability compute infrastructure** and manages capacity provisioning and automatic scaling ([AWS Lambda welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). DynamoDB is an appropriate highly available data store for the results because it is serverless, fully managed, handles high availability, and replicates data across three Availability Zones by default ([DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A single EC2 instance as the HTTPS endpoint is a single point of failure and does not meet the highly available requirement without additional architecture. It also requires server management, unlike Lambda/API Gateway.
- **C:** Amazon Route 53 is DNS, not an HTTPS application endpoint or event-processing service. The documented pattern is to expose Lambda through API Gateway HTTP/REST APIs, not route sensor HTTPS messages directly to Lambda.
- **D:** An S3 gateway VPC endpoint plus Site-to-Site VPN would only provide a network path for writing objects to S3. It does not provide the required HTTPS API endpoint and message-processing layer, and it stores raw sensor data rather than processed results for analysis.

zh.question: 一家公司的设施在整栋建筑的每个入口都安装了工牌读卡器。当扫描工牌时，读卡器会通过 HTTPS 发送一条消息，以指示是谁尝试访问该特定入口。解决方案架构师必须设计一个系统来处理来自这些传感器的消息。该解决方案必须具有高可用性，并且必须将结果提供给公司的安全团队进行分析。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种系统架构？

options.A: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例作为 HTTPS 端点并处理这些消息。配置该 EC2 实例将结果保存到 Amazon S3 存储桶。
options.B: 在 Amazon API Gateway 中创建一个 HTTPS 端点。配置该 API Gateway 端点调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理这些消息，并将结果保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Route 53 将传入的传感器消息定向到 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数处理这些消息，并将结果保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表。
options.D: 为 Amazon S3 创建 gateway VPC endpoint。配置从设施网络到 VPC 的 Site-to-Site VPN 连接，以便传感器数据可以通过该 VPC endpoint 直接写入 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

工牌读卡器已经通过 **HTTPS** 发送消息，因此最合适的方案是使用 Amazon API Gateway 公开 HTTPS API，并将其与 AWS Lambda 集成以进行处理。AWS 文档说明，API Gateway 支持无状态 **HTTP** 和 REST API，并且 Lambda 函数可以通过 API Gateway 中的 API 方法公开；API Gateway 还支持与 HTTP 端点的 Lambda proxy integrations（[API Gateway welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)）。AWS 还说明，HTTP API 可为 Lambda 函数提供 HTTP 端点，并可与 Lambda 函数集成（[HTTP API with Lambda and DynamoDB tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)）。Lambda 适合作为处理层，因为 AWS 表示 Lambda 在**高可用性计算基础设施**上运行代码，并管理容量预置和自动扩展（[AWS Lambda welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。DynamoDB 是用于存储结果的合适高可用数据存储，因为它是无服务器、完全托管的服务，可处理高可用性，并且默认情况下会跨三个 Availability Zones 复制数据（[DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 将单个 EC2 实例作为 HTTPS 端点会形成单点故障，如果没有额外架构，则无法满足高可用性要求。与 Lambda/API Gateway 不同，它还需要服务器管理。
- **C:** Amazon Route 53 是 DNS，不是 HTTPS 应用程序端点或事件处理服务。文档化的模式是通过 API Gateway HTTP/REST API 公开 Lambda，而不是将传感器 HTTPS 消息直接路由到 Lambda。
- **D:** S3 gateway VPC endpoint 加上 Site-to-Site VPN 只会为向 S3 写入对象提供网络路径。它不提供所需的 HTTPS API 端点和消息处理层，并且它存储的是原始传感器数据，而不是用于分析的处理后结果。

en.question: A company wants to implement a disaster recovery plan for its primary on-premises file storage volume. The file storage volume is mounted from an Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) device on a local storage server. The file storage volume holds hundreds of terabytes (TB) of data. The company wants to ensure that end users retain immediate access to all file types from the on- premises systems without experiencing latency. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the company's existing infrastructure?

options.A: Provision an Amazon S3 File Gateway as a virtual machine (VM) that is hosted on premises. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Modify existing applications to access the files through the NFS protocol. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and mount the S3 bucket that contains the files.
options.B: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Use a data backup solution to back up all existing data to a virtual tape library. Configure the data backup solution to run nightly after the initial backup is complete. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and restore the data to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume from the volumes in the virtual tape library.
options.C: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Mount the Volume Gateway cached volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.D: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume with the same amount of disk space as the existing file storage volume. Mount the Volume Gateway stored volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The key requirements are immediate, low-latency access to the **entire** on-premises file dataset, minimal infrastructure change from an existing iSCSI-mounted volume, and cloud-based DR. AWS Storage Gateway **Volume Gateway stored volumes** are designed for exactly this pattern: AWS states that stored volumes store primary data locally, provide on-premises applications with low-latency access to their **entire datasets**, mount as **iSCSI** devices, and asynchronously back up to AWS as **Amazon EBS snapshots**. The same documentation says this is ideal when you need low-latency access to all data and backups in AWS, and that snapshots can be used as the starting point for a new EBS volume attached to an EC2 instance ([How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)). The Volume Gateway overview also says stored volumes can be recovered to Amazon EC2 for disaster recovery ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** S3 File Gateway would require changing access to file shares such as NFS/SMB, rather than preserving the existing iSCSI-style volume access. It also relies on gateway cache and is not the best fit for immediate low-latency access to hundreds of TB locally; S3 File Gateway documentation is about file shares, S3 buckets, and cache management ([Managing your Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/managing-gateway-file.html)).
- **B:** Tape Gateway is for virtual tape backup/archive infrastructure, not an immediately accessible primary iSCSI storage volume. AWS describes Tape Gateway as cloud-backed virtual tape storage for archiving backup data in S3 Glacier classes ([What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). This would require restore operations before access after disaster recovery.
- **C:** Cached volumes keep primary data in Amazon S3 and only retain frequently accessed or recently read data locally, so a 10 TB cache cannot guarantee immediate low-latency access to **all** hundreds of TB. AWS explicitly contrasts cached volumes, which provide low-latency access to frequently accessed data, with stored volumes, which provide low-latency access to the entire dataset ([How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望为其主要本地文件存储卷实施灾难恢复计划。该文件存储卷是从本地存储服务器上的 Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) 设备挂载的。该文件存储卷保存了数百 TB 的数据。公司希望确保最终用户能够从本地系统立即访问所有文件类型，并且不会遇到延迟。哪种解决方案能够在对公司现有基础设施进行最少更改的情况下满足这些要求？

options.A: 预置一个作为虚拟机 (VM) 在本地托管的 Amazon S3 File Gateway。将本地缓存设置为 10 TB。修改现有应用程序，使其通过 NFS 协议访问文件。要从灾难中恢复，请预置一个 Amazon EC2 实例，并挂载包含这些文件的 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway。使用数据备份解决方案将所有现有数据备份到虚拟磁带库。配置数据备份解决方案，使其在初始备份完成后每晚运行。要从灾难中恢复，请预置一个 Amazon EC2 实例，并从虚拟磁带库中的卷将数据还原到 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。
options.C: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway 缓存卷。将本地缓存设置为 10 TB。使用 iSCSI 将 Volume Gateway 缓存卷挂载到现有文件服务器，并将所有文件复制到该存储卷。配置该存储卷的计划快照。要从灾难中恢复，请将快照还原到 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，并将该 EBS 卷附加到 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.D: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway 存储卷，其磁盘空间与现有文件存储卷相同。使用 iSCSI 将 Volume Gateway 存储卷挂载到现有文件服务器，并将所有文件复制到该存储卷。配置该存储卷的计划快照。要从灾难中恢复，请将快照还原到 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，并将该 EBS 卷附加到 Amazon EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

关键要求是对**整个**本地文件数据集进行即时、低延迟访问；从现有的 iSCSI 挂载卷进行最少的基础设施更改；以及基于云的 DR。AWS Storage Gateway **Volume Gateway stored volumes** 正是为这种模式而设计的：AWS 说明，stored volumes 将主数据存储在本地，为本地应用程序提供对其**整个数据集**的低延迟访问，以 **iSCSI** 设备形式挂载，并作为 **Amazon EBS snapshots** 异步备份到 AWS。同一文档还说明，当你需要对所有数据进行低延迟访问并在 AWS 中进行备份时，这非常理想，并且快照可用作附加到 EC2 实例的新 EBS 卷的起点（[How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)）。Volume Gateway 概述还说明，stored volumes 可以恢复到 Amazon EC2 以进行灾难恢复（[What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** S3 File Gateway 需要将访问方式更改为 NFS/SMB 等文件共享，而不是保留现有的 iSCSI 风格卷访问。它还依赖网关缓存，并且并不最适合在本地对数百 TB 数据进行即时低延迟访问；S3 File Gateway 文档讨论的是文件共享、S3 存储桶和缓存管理（[Managing your Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/managing-gateway-file.html)）。
- **B:** Tape Gateway 用于虚拟磁带备份/归档基础设施，而不是可立即访问的主 iSCSI 存储卷。AWS 将 Tape Gateway 描述为由云支持的虚拟磁带存储，用于在 S3 Glacier 存储类中归档备份数据（[What is Tape Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。这在灾难恢复后需要先执行还原操作才能访问。
- **C:** Cached volumes 将主数据保存在 Amazon S3 中，并且只在本地保留经常访问或最近读取的数据，因此 10 TB 缓存无法保证对**所有**数百 TB 数据进行即时低延迟访问。AWS 明确对比了 cached volumes 和 stored volumes：cached volumes 为经常访问的数据提供低延迟访问，而 stored volumes 为整个数据集提供低延迟访问（[How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)）。

en.question: A company is hosting a web application from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses Amazon Cognito as an identity provider to authenticate users and return a JSON Web Token (JWT) that provides access to protected resources that are stored in another S3 bucket. Upon deployment of the application, users report errors and are unable to access the protected content. A solutions architect must resolve this issue by providing proper permissions so that users can access the protected content. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content.
options.B: Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content.
options.C: Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content.
options.D: Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon Cognito identity pools are used to provide application users with temporary, limited-privilege AWS credentials. AWS states that Cognito identities are exchanged for credentials using AWS STS, and that authenticated users can receive scoped credentials to access AWS resources such as S3 objects ([Getting credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/getting-credentials.html)). In an identity pool, an IAM role defines the permissions for users to access AWS resources, and application users assume the roles that you create. AWS also states that each identity type has an assigned role with an attached policy that controls which AWS services that identity type can access; changing the role or policy controls access ([Identity pools console overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools.html)). Therefore, updating the Cognito identity pool to use an IAM role with the required S3 permissions, such as `s3:GetObject` on the protected bucket or objects, is the correct fix.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** S3 ACLs are not the appropriate mechanism for granting authenticated Cognito users access. The issue is that users need AWS credentials and permissions through Cognito/IAM. AWS specifically describes identity-pool access as temporary AWS credentials for an IAM role, where the role permissions determine access to AWS resources ([Security best practices for Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools-security-best-practices.html)).
- **C:** This is not a consistency problem. Amazon S3 provides strong read-after-write consistency for object PUT and DELETE operations, and subsequent GET or LIST requests return the written data after a successful PUT ([Amazon S3 data consistency model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). Redeploying the application would not fix missing permissions.
- **D:** Custom attribute mappings do not directly grant access to S3. Access is granted through IAM roles and policies associated with Cognito identity-pool identities. AWS documentation states that modifying a policy or assigning a different role to an identity type controls which AWS services the identity type can access ([Identity pools console overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在从一个 Amazon S3 存储桶托管 Web 应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon Cognito 作为身份提供商来对用户进行身份验证，并返回一个 JSON Web Token (JWT)，该令牌可用于访问存储在另一个 S3 存储桶中的受保护资源。应用程序部署后，用户报告出现错误，且无法访问受保护内容。解决方案架构师必须通过提供适当的权限来解决此问题，以便用户能够访问受保护内容。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新 Amazon Cognito 身份池，使其代入适当的 IAM 角色以访问受保护内容。
options.B: 更新 S3 ACL，以允许应用程序访问受保护内容。
options.C: 将应用程序重新部署到 Amazon S3，以防止 S3 存储桶中的最终一致性读取影响用户访问受保护内容的能力。
options.D: 更新 Amazon Cognito 池，在身份池中使用自定义属性映射，并授予用户访问受保护内容的适当权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon Cognito 身份池用于为应用程序用户提供临时的、权限受限的 AWS 凭证。AWS 说明，Cognito 身份会使用 AWS STS 交换凭证，并且经过身份验证的用户可以接收限定范围的凭证，以访问 AWS 资源，例如 S3 对象（[Getting credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/getting-credentials.html)）。在身份池中，IAM 角色定义用户访问 AWS 资源的权限，应用程序用户会代入你创建的角色。AWS 还说明，每种身份类型都有一个分配的角色，该角色附加了一个策略，用于控制该身份类型可以访问哪些 AWS 服务；更改角色或策略即可控制访问权限（[Identity pools console overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools.html)）。因此，更新 Cognito 身份池，使其使用具有所需 S3 权限的 IAM 角色，例如对受保护存储桶或对象具有 `s3:GetObject` 权限，是正确的修复方法。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** S3 ACLs 不是授予经过身份验证的 Cognito 用户访问权限的适当机制。问题在于用户需要通过 Cognito/IAM 获得 AWS 凭证和权限。AWS 明确将身份池访问描述为 IAM 角色的临时 AWS 凭证，其中角色权限决定对 AWS 资源的访问权限（[Security best practices for Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools-security-best-practices.html)）。
- **C:** 这不是一致性问题。Amazon S3 为对象 PUT 和 DELETE 操作提供强读后写一致性，并且在成功 PUT 后，后续 GET 或 LIST 请求会返回已写入的数据（[Amazon S3 data consistency model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。重新部署应用程序无法修复缺失的权限。
- **D:** 自定义属性映射不会直接授予对 S3 的访问权限。访问权限是通过与 Cognito 身份池身份关联的 IAM 角色和策略授予的。AWS 文档说明，修改策略或为某种身份类型分配不同角色，可以控制该身份类型可以访问哪些 AWS 服务（[Identity pools console overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/identity-pools.html)）。

en.question: An image hosting company uploads its large assets to Amazon S3 Standard buckets. The company uses multipart upload in parallel by using S3 APIs and overwrites if the same object is uploaded again. For the first 30 days after upload, the objects will be accessed frequently. The objects will be used less frequently after 30 days, but the access patterns for each object will be inconsistent. The company must optimize its S3 storage costs while maintaining high availability and resiliency of stored assets. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days.
options.B: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads.
options.C: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up expired object delete markers.
options.D: Move assets to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.E: Move assets to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and B**.

- **A. Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days** — The objects are frequently accessed for the first 30 days, then access becomes less frequent but inconsistent. AWS says S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed to optimize costs by automatically moving data to cost-effective tiers, and is ideal for data with **unknown or changing access patterns**. It also automatically moves objects not accessed for **30 consecutive days** to the Infrequent Access tier, with no retrieval fees, while providing 99.9% availability and 99.999999999% durability across at least 3 AZs ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)).
- **B. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads** — The company uses multipart upload for large assets. AWS states that after initiating multipart upload, you must complete or stop it to stop incurring charges for uploaded parts, and recommends an `AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload` lifecycle rule to minimize storage costs. The rule stops incomplete uploads and deletes associated parts after a specified number of days ([Multipart upload overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html), [Delete incomplete multipart uploads](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpu-abort-incomplete-mpu-lifecycle-config.html)).

Why the other options are not the best:

- **C** — Expired object delete markers are relevant to versioning-enabled buckets and delete-marker cleanup scenarios. The question does not describe versioning or object deletion; it describes overwrites and multipart uploads. AWS documents expired object delete markers specifically in the context of versioning-enabled buckets ([Lifecycle examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html)).
- **D** — S3 Standard-IA can be used for long-lived, infrequently accessed data, but it charges retrieval fees and is intended for more predictable infrequent access. Because access patterns are inconsistent/unknown, S3 Intelligent-Tiering is the better cost-optimization choice and has no retrieval fees ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **E** — S3 One Zone-IA stores data in only one Availability Zone and is not resilient to the physical loss of that AZ; AWS recommends it only when data can be re-created. This does not meet the requirement to maintain high availability and resiliency for stored assets ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家图像托管公司将其大型资产上传到 Amazon S3 Standard 存储桶。该公司通过使用 S3 APIs 并行执行分段上传，并且如果再次上传相同对象则会覆盖该对象。上传后的前 30 天，对象将被频繁访问。30 天后对象的使用频率会降低，但每个对象的访问模式将不一致。该公司必须优化其 S3 存储成本，同时保持已存储资产的高可用性和弹性。解决方案架构师应推荐哪一组操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 30 天后将资产移动到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。
options.B: 配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略以清理未完成的分段上传。
options.C: 配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略以清理过期的对象删除标记。
options.D: 30 天后将资产移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
options.E: 30 天后将资产移动到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 B**。

- **A. Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days** — 对象在前 30 天会被频繁访问，之后访问频率降低但不一致。AWS 表示，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在通过自动将数据移动到具有成本效益的层来优化成本，并且非常适合具有 **未知或不断变化的访问模式** 的数据。它还会自动将 **连续 30 天** 未访问的对象移动到 Infrequent Access 层，且无检索费用，同时在至少 3 个 AZs 中提供 99.9% 可用性和 99.999999999% 持久性（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)，[How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。
- **B. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads** — 该公司对大型资产使用分段上传。AWS 声明，在启动分段上传后，必须完成或停止它，才能停止为已上传的分段产生费用，并建议使用 `AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload` 生命周期规则来最小化存储成本。该规则会在指定天数后停止未完成的上传并删除关联的分段（[Multipart upload overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)，[Delete incomplete multipart uploads](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpu-abort-incomplete-mpu-lifecycle-config.html)）。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **C** — 过期的对象删除标记与启用了版本控制的存储桶以及删除标记清理场景相关。题目没有描述版本控制或对象删除；它描述的是覆盖和分段上传。AWS 文档专门在启用了版本控制的存储桶上下文中记录过期对象删除标记（[Lifecycle examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html)）。
- **D** — S3 Standard-IA 可用于长期保存、低频访问的数据，但它会收取检索费用，并且适用于更可预测的低频访问。由于访问模式不一致/未知，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是更好的成本优化选择，并且没有检索费用（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **E** — S3 One Zone-IA 仅将数据存储在一个 Availability Zone 中，并且无法抵御该 AZ 的物理丢失；AWS 建议仅在数据可以重新创建时使用它。这不满足为已存储资产保持高可用性和弹性的要求（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect must secure a VPC network that hosts Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances contain highly sensitive data and run in a private subnet. According to company policy, the EC2 instances that run in the VPC can access only approved third-party software repositories on the internet for software product updates that use the third party’s URL. Other internet traffic must be blocked. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the route table for the private subnet to route the outbound traffic to an AWS Network Firewall firewall. Configure domain list rule groups.
options.B: Set up an AWS WAF web ACL. Create a custom set of rules that filter traffic requests based on source and destination IP address range sets.
options.C: Implement strict inbound security group rules. Configure an outbound rule that allows traffic only to the authorized software repositories on the internet by specifying the URLs.
options.D: Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the EC2 instances. Direct all outbound traffic to the ALB. Use a URL-based rule listener in the ALB’s target group for outbound access to the internet.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Network Firewall is designed to be inserted into the VPC traffic path by updating route tables. AWS docs state that after creating a firewall, you reroute VPC traffic through firewall endpoints so they can filter traffic, and for internet-bound traffic you change the subnet route table to direct that traffic to the firewall endpoint ([VPC route table configuration for AWS Network Firewall](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/vpc-config-route-tables.html)). Network Firewall domain list rule groups can match explicit domains or wildcard domains and inspect HTTP/HTTPS traffic; with an **Allow** domain rule, traffic of the specified protocol that does **not** match the domain specifications is denied ([Stateful domain list rule groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/stateful-rule-groups-domain-names.html)). This meets the requirement to allow only approved third-party repository URLs and block other internet traffic.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. AWS WAF web ACL** — AWS WAF protects specific web-facing resources such as CloudFront distributions, Application Load Balancers, API Gateway REST APIs, AppSync, Cognito user pools, App Runner, Verified Access, and Amplify ([Resources that you can protect with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)). It is not the correct service to route and filter all outbound internet traffic from private EC2 instances by repository URL.
- **C. Security group outbound rules by URL** — Security group rules are based on protocol, port range, and source/destination such as CIDR blocks, prefix lists, or security group IDs; URLs/domain names are not rule components ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)).
- **D. ALB for outbound access** — Elastic Load Balancing routes client requests to registered targets; ALB listener rules evaluate incoming requests and select target groups ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). An ALB is not an outbound internet filtering device for EC2 instances.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师必须保护一个托管 Amazon EC2 实例的 VPC 网络。EC2 实例包含高度敏感的数据，并在私有子网中运行。根据公司策略，在 VPC 中运行的 EC2 实例只能访问互联网上已批准的第三方软件存储库，以便通过该第三方的 URL 进行软件产品更新。必须阻止其他互联网流量。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新私有子网的路由表，将出站流量路由到 AWS Network Firewall 防火墙。配置域列表规则组。
options.B: 设置 AWS WAF web ACL。创建一组自定义规则，根据源 IP 地址范围集和目标 IP 地址范围集筛选流量请求。
options.C: 实施严格的入站安全组规则。配置一条出站规则，通过指定 URL 仅允许流量访问互联网上授权的软件存储库。
options.D: 在 EC2 实例前配置 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将所有出站流量定向到 ALB。使用 ALB 目标组中的基于 URL 的规则侦听器来实现对互联网的出站访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

AWS Network Firewall 旨在通过更新路由表插入到 VPC 流量路径中。AWS 文档说明，创建防火墙后，你需要通过防火墙端点重新路由 VPC 流量，以便它们可以筛选流量；对于发往互联网的流量，你需要更改子网路由表，将该流量定向到防火墙端点（[VPC route table configuration for AWS Network Firewall](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/vpc-config-route-tables.html)）。Network Firewall 域列表规则组可以匹配显式域或通配符域，并检查 HTTP/HTTPS 流量；使用 **Allow** 域规则时，指定协议中**不**匹配域规范的流量会被拒绝（[Stateful domain list rule groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/stateful-rule-groups-domain-names.html)）。这满足了仅允许访问已批准的第三方存储库 URLs 并阻止其他互联网流量的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. AWS WAF web ACL** — AWS WAF 保护特定面向 Web 的资源，例如 CloudFront distributions、Application Load Balancers、API Gateway REST APIs、AppSync、Cognito user pools、App Runner、Verified Access 和 Amplify（[Resources that you can protect with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。它不是用于按存储库 URL 路由和筛选来自私有 EC2 实例的所有出站互联网流量的正确服务。
- **C. Security group outbound rules by URL** — Security group 规则基于协议、端口范围以及源/目标，例如 CIDR blocks、prefix lists 或 security group IDs；URLs/域名不是规则组件（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。
- **D. ALB for outbound access** — Elastic Load Balancing 将客户端请求路由到已注册目标；ALB listener rules 评估传入请求并选择 target groups（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。ALB 不是用于 EC2 实例的出站互联网筛选设备。

en.question: A company is hosting a three-tier ecommerce application in the AWS Cloud. The company hosts the website on Amazon S3 and integrates the website with an API that handles sales requests. The company hosts the API on three Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The API consists of static and dynamic front-end content along with backend workers that process sales requests asynchronously. The company is expecting a significant and sudden increase in the number of sales requests during events for the launch of new products. What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure that all the requests are processed successfully?

options.A: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Increase the number of EC2 instances to handle the increase in traffic.
options.B: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Place the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on network traffic.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Add an Amazon ElastiCache instance in front of the ALB to reduce traffic for the API to handle.
options.D: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to receive requests from the website for later processing by the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The key requirement is to survive a **significant and sudden** spike and ensure that **all sales requests are processed successfully**. Amazon SQS is the appropriate buffering/decoupling layer for asynchronous backend work: SQS standard queues support a nearly unlimited number of API calls per second, provide at-least-once delivery, and store messages redundantly across multiple Availability Zones before acknowledging them. AWS lists common SQS use cases including **decoupling live user requests from intensive background work**, **allocating tasks to multiple worker nodes**, and **batching messages for future processing** ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)). CloudFront is also appropriate for the static website/content because it speeds up delivery of static and dynamic web content from origins such as S3 and caches objects at edge locations for performance and availability ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudFront for dynamic content plus manually increasing EC2 instances does not provide a durable buffer for sudden bursts. Requests can still overwhelm the API before enough capacity exists.
- **B:** Auto Scaling can add capacity based on metrics such as network I/O or ALB request count per target, but newly launched instances have warmup time and scaling is reactive; it does not by itself guarantee that every sudden-burst request is retained for processing ([Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).
- **C:** ElastiCache is for caching/accelerating access to data, not for durable request buffering. Also, putting a cache “in front of the ALB” does not ensure that non-cacheable sales requests are accepted and processed.

Therefore, using **CloudFront for static content** and **SQS to queue sales requests for later worker processing** best meets the requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中托管一个三层电子商务应用程序。该公司将网站托管在 Amazon S3 上，并将网站与一个处理销售请求的 API 集成。该公司将 API 托管在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的三个 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 API 包含静态和动态前端内容，以及异步处理销售请求的后端工作程序。该公司预计在新产品发布活动期间，销售请求数量会出现显著且突然的增加。解决方案架构师应建议什么，以确保所有请求都能成功处理？

options.A: 为动态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。增加 EC2 实例数量以处理流量增长。
options.B: 为静态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将 EC2 实例放入 Auto Scaling 组中，以根据网络流量启动新实例。
options.C: 为动态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。在 ALB 前面添加一个 Amazon ElastiCache 实例，以减少 API 需要处理的流量。
options.D: 为静态内容添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。添加一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，用于接收来自网站的请求，以便稍后由 EC2 实例处理。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

关键要求是应对一次**显著且突然**的峰值，并确保**所有销售请求都成功处理**。Amazon SQS 是适用于异步后端工作的合适缓冲/解耦层：SQS 标准队列支持几乎无限数量的每秒 API 调用，提供至少一次交付，并在确认消息之前将消息跨多个 Availability Zones 冗余存储。AWS 列出的常见 SQS 使用场景包括**将实时用户请求与密集型后台工作解耦**、**将任务分配给多个工作节点**，以及**批量处理消息以供将来处理**（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。CloudFront 也适用于静态网站/内容，因为它可以加速从 S3 等源交付静态和动态 Web 内容，并在边缘站点缓存对象，以提升性能和可用性（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 为动态内容使用 CloudFront 并手动增加 EC2 实例，无法为突然突增的请求提供持久缓冲。在具备足够容量之前，请求仍可能压垮 API。
- **B:** Auto Scaling 可以根据网络 I/O 或 ALB 每目标请求数等指标增加容量，但新启动的实例需要预热时间，并且扩缩容是响应式的；它本身不能保证每个突然突增的请求都会被保留下来以供处理（[Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。
- **C:** ElastiCache 用于缓存/加速对数据的访问，而不是用于持久请求缓冲。此外，将缓存放在“ALB 前面”并不能确保不可缓存的销售请求会被接受并处理。因此，使用**CloudFront 处理静态内容**并使用 **SQS 将销售请求排队以供后续工作程序处理**，最符合该要求。

en.question: A security audit reveals that Amazon EC2 instances are not being patched regularly. A solutions architect needs to provide a solution that will run regular security scans across a large fleet of EC2 instances. The solution should also patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule and provide a report of each instance’s patch status. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up Amazon Macie to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up a cron job on each EC2 instance to patch the instance on a regular schedule.
options.B: Turn on Amazon GuardDuty in the account. Configure GuardDuty to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
options.C: Set up Amazon Detective to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
options.D: Turn on Amazon Inspector in the account. Configure Amazon Inspector to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon Inspector is the AWS service designed for this scan requirement: it is a vulnerability management service that automatically discovers workloads and continually scans them for software vulnerabilities, including Amazon EC2 instances, and produces findings when vulnerabilities are detected ([Amazon Inspector overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).
