For EC2, Inspector can perform continuous agent-based scans and evaluates collected inventory to generate findings for detected vulnerabilities; in hybrid mode it can also perform agentless scans every 24 hours for eligible instances ([Scanning EC2 instances with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2.html)).

AWS Systems Manager **Patch Manager** meets the patching and reporting requirements: it automates patching of managed nodes with security-related and other updates, supports recurring patch operations, can scan or scan-and-install missing patches, and provides compliance reporting showing which nodes are out of patch compliance and which patches are missing ([Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)). Patch compliance reports can also be generated on demand or on a schedule and saved to S3 as CSV files ([Generating patch compliance reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-store-compliance-results-in-s3.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon Macie is for discovering and reporting sensitive data and monitoring S3 data security posture, not scanning EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities ([Macie overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)). Cron jobs on each instance are not a centralized fleet-scale patching and compliance reporting solution.
- **B:** GuardDuty is a threat detection service that uses log data to uncover suspected malicious or high-risk activity, not a software vulnerability scanner for EC2 patch status ([Detective documentation describing GuardDuty findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-investigation-about.html)). Also, Systems Manager **Session Manager** is for interactive instance access, whereas Patch Manager is the Systems Manager capability documented for patching and compliance reporting.
- **C:** Amazon Detective is for analyzing and investigating security findings or suspicious activity and identifying root cause; it is not the service that scans EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities or patches them ([Detective investigation overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-investigation-about.html)). EventBridge can schedule actions, but this option does not identify a patching service or provide patch compliance reporting.

zh.question: 一次安全审计发现 Amazon EC2 实例没有定期打补丁。解决方案架构师需要提供一种解决方案，能够在大量 EC2 实例中运行定期安全扫描。该解决方案还应按常规计划为 EC2 实例打补丁，并提供每个实例的补丁状态报告。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 Amazon Macie 来扫描 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。在每个 EC2 实例上设置 cron 作业，以按常规计划为实例打补丁。
options.B: 在账户中启用 Amazon GuardDuty。配置 GuardDuty 来扫描 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。设置 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager，以按常规计划为 EC2 实例打补丁。
options.C: 设置 Amazon Detective 来扫描 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。设置 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，以按常规计划为 EC2 实例打补丁。
options.D: 在账户中启用 Amazon Inspector。配置 Amazon Inspector 来扫描 EC2 实例的软件漏洞。设置 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager，以按常规计划为 EC2 实例打补丁。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Amazon Inspector 是专为此扫描要求而设计的 AWS 服务：它是一项漏洞管理服务，可自动发现工作负载并持续扫描其中的软件漏洞，包括 Amazon EC2 实例，并在检测到漏洞时生成发现结果（[Amazon Inspector overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。对于 EC2，Inspector 可以执行基于代理的持续扫描，并评估收集到的清单以针对检测到的漏洞生成发现结果；在混合模式下，它还可以每 24 小时对符合条件的实例执行无代理扫描（[Scanning EC2 instances with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2.html)）。

AWS Systems Manager **Patch Manager** 满足打补丁和报告要求：它可自动为托管节点应用安全相关更新和其他更新，支持周期性补丁操作，可以扫描或扫描并安装缺失补丁，并提供合规性报告，显示哪些节点不符合补丁合规性以及缺少哪些补丁（[Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)）。补丁合规性报告也可以按需或按计划生成，并以 CSV 文件形式保存到 S3（[Generating patch compliance reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-store-compliance-results-in-s3.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon Macie 用于发现和报告敏感数据，并监控 S3 数据安全态势，而不是扫描 EC2 实例的软件漏洞（[Macie overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。每个实例上的 Cron 作业并不是集中式、适用于大规模队列的补丁和合规性报告解决方案。
- **B:** GuardDuty 是一种威胁检测服务，使用日志数据来发现可疑的恶意活动或高风险活动，而不是用于 EC2 补丁状态的软件漏洞扫描器（[Detective documentation describing GuardDuty findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-investigation-about.html)）。此外，Systems Manager **Session Manager** 用于交互式实例访问，而 Patch Manager 才是 Systems Manager 中记录用于打补丁和合规性报告的功能。
- **C:** Amazon Detective 用于分析和调查安全发现结果或可疑活动并识别根本原因；它不是用于扫描 EC2 实例软件漏洞或为其打补丁的服务（[Detective investigation overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-investigation-about.html)）。EventBridge 可以计划操作，但此选项没有指定补丁服务，也没有提供补丁合规性报告。

en.question: A company is planning to store data on Amazon RDS DB instances. The company must encrypt the data at rest. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Create a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable encryption for the DB instances.
options.B: Create an encryption key. Store the key in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the key to encrypt the DB instances.
options.C: Generate a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.
options.D: Generate a certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **A**.

Amazon RDS encryption at rest is implemented by enabling encryption on the DB instance and using an AWS KMS key. AWS states that RDS encrypted DB instances protect data on underlying storage and fulfill encryption-at-rest requirements, and that “Amazon RDS uses an AWS Key Management Service key” for this encryption. When creating an encrypted DB instance, you can choose a customer managed KMS key or the AWS managed key for RDS; to encrypt a new DB instance, choose **Enable encryption** or set the relevant storage encryption/KMS key parameters in the CLI/API ([Amazon RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: Secrets Manager is for storing secrets such as credentials, not for providing the RDS storage encryption mechanism. RDS encryption at rest uses KMS keys, not a key stored in Secrets Manager.
- **C**: ACM certificates and SSL/TLS relate to encrypting connections, not data at rest. RDS documentation says SSL/TLS is used to encrypt a connection to a DB instance ([RDS encrypted connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.html)).
- **D**: IAM certificates/SSL/TLS likewise address connection encryption, not storage encryption at rest; RDS at-rest encryption is done with KMS keys.

Therefore, the solutions architect should create/use a KMS key and enable encryption for the RDS DB instances.

zh.question: 一家公司计划在 Amazon RDS DB 实例上存储数据。该公司必须对静态数据进行加密。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足此要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建一个密钥。为 DB 实例启用加密。
options.B: 创建一个加密密钥。将该密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。使用该密钥加密 DB 实例。
options.C: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中生成证书。使用该证书在 DB 实例上启用 SSL/TLS。
options.D: 在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中生成证书。使用该证书在 DB 实例上启用 SSL/TLS。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A**。

Amazon RDS 静态加密是通过在 DB 实例上启用加密并使用 AWS KMS key 来实现的。AWS 表示，RDS encrypted DB instances 会保护底层存储上的数据并满足静态加密要求，并且 “Amazon RDS uses an AWS Key Management Service key” 来进行此加密。创建加密的 DB 实例时，你可以选择 customer managed KMS key 或用于 RDS 的 AWS managed key；要加密新的 DB 实例，请选择 **Enable encryption**，或在 CLI/API 中设置相关的存储加密/KMS key 参数（[Amazon RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B**：Secrets Manager 用于存储凭证等密钥信息，而不是提供 RDS 存储加密机制。RDS 静态加密使用 KMS keys，而不是存储在 Secrets Manager 中的密钥。
- **C**：ACM 证书和 SSL/TLS 与加密连接有关，而不是加密静态数据。RDS 文档说明 SSL/TLS 用于加密到 DB 实例的连接（[RDS encrypted connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.html)）。
- **D**：IAM 证书/SSL/TLS 同样用于连接加密，而不是静态存储加密；RDS 静态加密是通过 KMS keys 完成的。因此，解决方案架构师应创建/使用 KMS key，并为 RDS DB 实例启用加密。

en.question: A company must migrate 20 TB of data from a data center to the AWS Cloud within 30 days. The company’s network bandwidth is limited to 15 Mbps and cannot exceed 70% utilization. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Snowball.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync.
options.C: Use a secure VPN connection.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A. Use AWS Snowball**.

At the allowed utilization, the effective bandwidth is only **15 Mbps × 70% = 10.5 Mbps**. Using AWS’s documented transfer-time formula—`(DATA_SIZE * 8) / (CIRCUIT * NETWORK_UTILIZATION * 3600 * AVAILABLE_HOURS)`—20 TB over 10.5 Mbps would take roughly **176+ days** at the theoretical minimum, far beyond the 30-day requirement ([AWS DataSync migration timeline formula](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/datasync-large-migration-timelines.html)). AWS Snowball Edge devices are designed to transfer data to or from AWS by physically shipping devices; AWS states that each device can transport data “at speeds faster than the internet,” and that you can import/export data between local environments and Amazon S3 without using the internet ([What is Snowball Edge?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)). A storage-optimized Snowball Edge device has **210 TB usable capacity**, which is sufficient for 20 TB ([Snowball Edge device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B. AWS DataSync** — DataSync is an online transfer service and its timeline depends on available network bandwidth; with only 10.5 Mbps effective bandwidth, it cannot meet the 30-day requirement based on AWS’s own calculation method ([Estimating migration timelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/datasync-large-migration-timelines.html)).
* **C. Secure VPN connection** — A VPN still uses the company’s constrained network path. AWS documents VPN as one possible network connection for DataSync, but it does not solve the insufficient bandwidth problem ([DataSync networking options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)).
* **D. Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration** — Transfer Acceleration helps optimize long-distance uploads to S3 when using the internet, especially when you cannot use all available bandwidth, but it cannot overcome the hard limit that the company cannot exceed 70% of a 15 Mbps link ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司必须在 30 天内将 20 TB 数据从数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司的网络带宽限制为 15 Mbps，并且利用率不能超过 70%。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Snowball。
options.B: 使用 AWS DataSync。
options.C: 使用安全的 VPN 连接。
options.D: 使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A. 使用 AWS Snowball**。在允许的利用率下，有效带宽仅为 **15 Mbps × 70% = 10.5 Mbps**。使用 AWS 文档中的传输时间公式——`(DATA_SIZE * 8) / (CIRCUIT * NETWORK_UTILIZATION * 3600 * AVAILABLE_HOURS)`——通过 10.5 Mbps 传输 20 TB 数据，在理论最短时间下也大约需要 **176+ 天**，远远超过 30 天的要求（[AWS DataSync migration timeline formula](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/datasync-large-migration-timelines.html)）。AWS Snowball Edge 设备旨在通过物理运输设备在 AWS 与本地之间传输数据；AWS 表示每台设备都可以“以比互联网更快的速度”传输数据，并且你可以在本地环境和 Amazon S3 之间导入/导出数据，而无需使用互联网（[What is Snowball Edge?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。存储优化型 Snowball Edge 设备具有 **210 TB 可用容量**，足以容纳 20 TB（[Snowball Edge device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **B. AWS DataSync** — DataSync 是一种在线传输服务，其时间线取决于可用网络带宽；在有效带宽只有 10.5 Mbps 的情况下，根据 AWS 自己的计算方法，它无法满足 30 天的要求（[Estimating migration timelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/datasync-large-migration-timelines.html)）。
* **C. Secure VPN connection** — VPN 仍然使用公司受限的网络路径。AWS 文档将 VPN 列为 DataSync 的一种可能网络连接方式，但它无法解决带宽不足的问题（[DataSync networking options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)）。
* **D. Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration** — Transfer Acceleration 有助于在使用互联网时优化到 S3 的长距离上传，尤其是在你无法使用所有可用带宽的情况下，但它无法突破公司不能超过 15 Mbps 链路 70% 的硬性限制（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to provide its employees with secure access to confidential and sensitive files. The company wants to ensure that the files can be accessed only by authorized users. The files must be downloaded securely to the employees’ devices. The files are stored in an on-premises Windows file server. However, due to an increase in remote usage, the file server is running out of capacity. . Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the file server to an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet. Configure the security group to limit inbound traffic to the employees’ IP addresses.
options.B: Migrate the files to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Integrate the Amazon FSx file system with the on-premises Active Directory. Configure AWS Client VPN.
options.C: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a private VPC endpoint. Create a signed URL to allow download.
options.D: Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a public VPC endpoint. Allow employees to sign on with AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is the best fit because the source is an on-premises Windows file server and the requirement is secure, authorized access to files. AWS describes FSx for Windows File Server as fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers with native Windows file system features and SMB support, and its storage capacity can be modified after creation as needs change ([FSx for Windows overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)). FSx also joins an Active Directory domain to provide user authentication and file/folder-level access control; users can use existing AD identities, and existing ACLs can be migrated without modification ([Working with Microsoft Active Directory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/aws-ad-integration-fsxW.html)). AWS Client VPN provides a managed client-based VPN that enables secure access to AWS resources, and the administrator controls which networks and resources users can access ([AWS Client VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-user/client-vpn-user-what-is.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **A:** Moving the server to an EC2 instance in a public subnet does not provide a fully managed Windows file service and does not solve authorization at the user/file ACL level merely by restricting source IPs. It also exposes the file server in a public subnet rather than using a VPN-based private access pattern.
* **C:** Amazon S3 is object storage, not a native Windows SMB file server with AD-based file and folder ACLs. A presigned URL grants time-limited permission to download an object and can be entered in a browser or used by a program ([S3 presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)); it is not equivalent to continuous authorization of employees through Windows/AD file permissions. Also, an S3 gateway VPC endpoint is for access from within a VPC and does not allow access from on-premises networks ([S3 gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).
* **D:** “Public VPC endpoint” is not the right construct for private S3 access, and IAM Identity Center sign-in alone does not provide native Windows file-share access or preserve AD/NTFS-style authorization for the existing Windows file server workload.

zh.question: 一家公司需要为其员工提供对机密和敏感文件的安全访问。公司希望确保只有授权用户才能访问这些文件。文件必须安全地下载到员工的设备。这些文件存储在本地 Windows 文件服务器中。然而，由于远程使用量增加，文件服务器容量即将耗尽。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将文件服务器迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。配置安全组以将入站流量限制为员工的 IP 地址。
options.B: 将文件迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。将 Amazon FSx 文件系统与本地 Active Directory 集成。配置 AWS Client VPN。
options.C: 将文件迁移到 Amazon S3，并创建私有 VPC endpoint。创建 signed URL 以允许下载。
options.D: 将文件迁移到 Amazon S3，并创建公有 VPC endpoint。允许员工使用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 登录。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是最合适的选择，因为源是本地 Windows 文件服务器，并且要求是对文件进行安全、授权的访问。AWS 将 FSx for Windows File Server 描述为完全托管的 Microsoft Windows 文件服务器，具有原生 Windows 文件系统功能和 SMB 支持，并且其存储容量可以在创建后随着需求变化进行修改（[FSx for Windows overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。FSx 还会加入 Active Directory 域，以提供用户身份验证以及文件/文件夹级别的访问控制；用户可以使用现有 AD 身份，并且现有 ACL 可以在不修改的情况下迁移（[Working with Microsoft Active Directory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/aws-ad-integration-fsxW.html)）。AWS Client VPN 提供托管的基于客户端的 VPN，可实现对 AWS 资源的安全访问，并且管理员可以控制用户能够访问哪些网络和资源（[AWS Client VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-user/client-vpn-user-what-is.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

* **A:** 将服务器移动到公有子网中的 EC2 实例并不能提供完全托管的 Windows 文件服务，而且仅通过限制源 IP 并不能在用户/文件 ACL 级别解决授权问题。它还会将文件服务器暴露在公有子网中，而不是使用基于 VPN 的私有访问模式。
* **C:** Amazon S3 是对象存储，不是具有基于 AD 的文件和文件夹 ACL 的原生 Windows SMB 文件服务器。presigned URL 会授予下载对象的限时权限，并且可以在浏览器中输入或由程序使用（[S3 presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)）；它并不等同于通过 Windows/AD 文件权限对员工进行持续授权。此外，S3 gateway VPC endpoint 用于从 VPC 内部访问，并且不允许从本地网络访问（[S3 gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。
* **D:** “Public VPC endpoint” 不是用于私有 S3 访问的正确构造，并且仅靠 IAM Identity Center 登录并不能为现有 Windows 文件服务器工作负载提供原生 Windows 文件共享访问，也不能保留 AD/NTFS 风格的授权。

en.question: A company’s application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. On the first day of every month at midnight, the application becomes much slower when the month-end financial calculation batch runs. This causes the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances to immediately peak to 100%, which disrupts the application. What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure the application is able to handle the workload and avoid downtime?

options.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB.
options.B: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling simple scaling policy based on CPU utilization.
options.C: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule.
options.D: Configure Amazon ElastiCache to remove some of the workload from the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule.**

The workload spike is known in advance: the first day of every month at midnight. AWS states that scaling by schedule is useful when you know exactly when to increase or decrease instances because the need arises on a predictable schedule. Scheduled actions can set the Auto Scaling group's desired, minimum, and maximum capacity at a specified date and time, and can run on a recurring schedule using a cron expression. This lets the group scale out before the month-end batch drives CPU to 100%, avoiding a reactive delay and reducing downtime risk ([Choose your scaling method](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/scaling-overview.html), [Scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudFront in front of the ALB**: CloudFront accelerates content delivery through edge locations, but the problem is a predictable compute-intensive monthly financial batch on EC2 instances. A CDN does not proactively add EC2 compute capacity for that batch ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **B. Simple scaling based on CPU utilization**: Dynamic scaling is useful when demand changes and you do not know when traffic will change. Here, the spike is known and immediate. A simple scaling policy would react after CPU rises, and simple scaling policies also use cooldown behavior, so it is less suitable than scaling ahead of the scheduled event ([Choose your scaling method](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/scaling-overview.html), [Scaling cooldowns for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scaling-cooldowns.html)).
- **D. ElastiCache**: ElastiCache can reduce latency for cacheable data such as database query results, especially read-heavy workloads, but the question describes CPU saturation from a monthly batch calculation. There is no indication that caching query results would remove the compute spike or guarantee capacity at midnight ([Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。这些实例在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中运行。每个月第一天的午夜，当月末财务计算批处理运行时，应用程序会变得慢得多。这会导致 EC2 实例的 CPU 利用率立即达到 100% 的峰值，从而中断应用程序。解决方案架构师应建议什么来确保应用程序能够处理该工作负载并避免停机？

options.A: 在 ALB 前面配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。
options.B: 配置一个基于 CPU 利用率的 EC2 Auto Scaling 简单扩展策略。
options.C: 配置一个基于每月计划的 EC2 Auto Scaling 计划扩展策略。
options.D: 配置 Amazon ElastiCache，以从 EC2 实例中移除部分工作负载。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule.**

工作负载峰值是事先已知的：每个月第一天的午夜。AWS 表示，当你确切知道何时需要增加或减少实例，因为该需求按可预测的计划发生时，按计划扩展非常有用。计划操作可以在指定日期和时间设置 Auto Scaling 组的所需容量、最小容量和最大容量，并且可以使用 cron 表达式按重复计划运行。这使该组能够在月末批处理将 CPU 推高到 100% 之前进行横向扩展，避免反应式延迟并降低停机风险（[Choose your scaling method](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/scaling-overview.html)，[Scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. CloudFront in front of the ALB**：CloudFront 通过边缘站点加速内容交付，但问题是在 EC2 实例上按可预测时间运行的计算密集型每月财务批处理。CDN 不会为该批处理主动增加 EC2 计算容量（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **B. Simple scaling based on CPU utilization**：当需求变化且你不知道流量何时会变化时，动态扩展很有用。这里的峰值是已知且会立即发生的。简单扩展策略会在 CPU 上升后才做出反应，并且简单扩展策略还使用冷却行为，因此不如在计划事件之前提前扩展合适（[Choose your scaling method](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/scaling-overview.html)，[Scaling cooldowns for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scaling-cooldowns.html)）。
- **D. ElastiCache**：ElastiCache 可以降低可缓存数据（例如数据库查询结果）的延迟，尤其适用于读取密集型工作负载，但题目描述的是每月批处理计算导致的 CPU 饱和。没有迹象表明缓存查询结果会消除计算峰值或保证午夜时的容量（[Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to give a customer the ability to use on-premises Microsoft Active Directory to download files that are stored in Amazon S3. The customer’s application uses an SFTP client to download the files. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead and no changes to the customer’s application?

options.A: Set up AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.B: Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to synchronize the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
options.C: Set up AWS DataSync to synchronize between the on-premises location and the S3 location by using AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).
options.D: Set up a Windows Amazon EC2 instance with SFTP to connect the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Integrate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS Transfer Family is the managed service designed for this scenario: it provides fully managed file transfers over **SFTP** directly into and out of AWS storage services, including **Amazon S3**, while allowing existing client-side configurations to remain unchanged so “nothing changes” for applications. AWS also states that Transfer Family avoids the need to run file-transfer server infrastructure and that applications do not need to be modified ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). When creating an SFTP-enabled Transfer Family server, you can choose **AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory** as the identity provider so users authenticate with credentials stored in Active Directory, and you can choose **Amazon S3** as the storage domain ([Create an SFTP-enabled server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/create-server-sftp.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** AWS DMS is for migrating data from supported **database** sources to targets such as S3, where it writes database load/CDC output as CSV or Parquet files. It is not an SFTP endpoint for customers to download existing S3 files with an SFTP client ([AWS DMS S3 target](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.S3.html)).
- **C:** AWS DataSync transfers files/objects between on-premises or self-managed storage systems and AWS storage services such as S3. It is a data transfer/synchronization service, not a customer-facing SFTP service that preserves the customer’s SFTP client workflow ([AWS DataSync on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)).
- **D:** Running SFTP on a Windows EC2 instance would require operating and maintaining server infrastructure. Transfer Family specifically provides a file-transfer protocol-enabled server “without the need to run any server infrastructure,” making EC2 higher operational overhead ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望让一位客户能够使用本地 Microsoft Active Directory 下载存储在 Amazon S3 中的文件。该客户的应用程序使用 SFTP 客户端下载文件。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求，并且无需更改客户的应用程序？

options.A: 为 Amazon S3 设置带有 SFTP 的 AWS Transfer Family。配置集成的 Active Directory 身份验证。
options.B: 设置 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS)，以同步本地客户端与 Amazon S3。配置集成的 Active Directory 身份验证。
options.C: 设置 AWS DataSync，通过使用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 在本地位置和 S3 位置之间进行同步。
options.D: 设置一个带有 SFTP 的 Windows Amazon EC2 实例，以连接本地客户端和 Amazon S3。集成 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** AWS Transfer Family 是专为此场景设计的托管服务：它提供通过 **SFTP** 直接传入和传出 AWS 存储服务（包括 **Amazon S3**）的完全托管文件传输，同时允许现有客户端配置保持不变，因此对应用程序来说“无需任何更改”。AWS 还说明，Transfer Family 避免了运行文件传输服务器基础设施的需要，并且应用程序无需修改（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。创建启用 SFTP 的 Transfer Family 服务器时，你可以选择 **AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory** 作为身份提供商，使用户使用存储在 Active Directory 中的凭证进行身份验证，并且可以选择 **Amazon S3** 作为存储域（[Create an SFTP-enabled server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/create-server-sftp.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** AWS DMS 用于将数据从受支持的**数据库**源迁移到 S3 等目标，其中它会将数据库加载/CDC 输出写为 CSV 或 Parquet 文件。它不是供客户使用 SFTP 客户端下载现有 S3 文件的 SFTP 端点（[AWS DMS S3 target](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.S3.html)）。
- **C:** AWS DataSync 在本地或自管理存储系统与 S3 等 AWS 存储服务之间传输文件/对象。它是一项数据传输/同步服务，而不是面向客户的、可保留客户 SFTP 客户端工作流的 SFTP 服务（[AWS DataSync on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html)）。
- **D:** 在 Windows EC2 实例上运行 SFTP 将需要运营和维护服务器基础设施。Transfer Family 专门提供“无需运行任何服务器基础设施”的启用文件传输协议的服务器，因此 EC2 的运营开销更高（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。

en.question: A company is experiencing sudden increases in demand. The company needs to provision large Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). The instances will run in an Auto Scaling group. The company needs a solution that provides minimum initialization latency to meet the demand. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use the aws ec2 register-image command to create an AMI from a snapshot. Use AWS Step Functions to replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Enable Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) fast snapshot restore on a snapshot. Provision an AMI by using the snapshot. Replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group with the new AMI.
options.C: Enable AMI creation and define lifecycle rules in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM). Create an AWS Lambda function that modifies the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Backup lifecycle policies that provision AMIs. Configure Auto Scaling group capacity limits as an event source in EventBridge.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon EBS Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) is specifically designed to minimize initialization latency for EBS volumes created from snapshots: AWS states that FSR creates a volume from a snapshot that is “fully initialized at creation,” eliminates first-access I/O latency, and lets volumes “instantly deliver all of their provisioned performance” ([Amazon EBS fast snapshot restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-fast-snapshot-restore.html)). This fits EC2 Auto Scaling launches from an EBS-backed AMI because when an instance is launched from an EBS-backed AMI, EC2 creates the root EBS volume using the AMI’s snapshot ([Create an Amazon EBS-backed AMI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-an-ami-ebs.html)). Creating/registering an AMI from the FSR-enabled snapshot and updating the Auto Scaling group’s launch template/AMI allows new scale-out instances to use initialized volumes; Auto Scaling groups can be updated to use a launch template version when scaling out ([Migrate your Auto Scaling groups to launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/migrate-to-launch-templates.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Registering an AMI from a snapshot is a valid AMI creation method, but by itself it does not eliminate EBS volume initialization latency. Step Functions orchestration does not address the storage initialization problem.
- **C:** Amazon DLM lifecycle automation can help create/manage AMIs, but lifecycle rules and a Lambda update do not make EBS volumes fully initialized at launch.
- **D:** EventBridge and AWS Backup lifecycle policies are not the mechanism for reducing EC2/EBS initialization latency, and Auto Scaling capacity limits as an event source do not solve the requirement to provision large instances with minimum initialization latency.

zh.question: 一家公司正在经历需求的突然增长。该公司需要从 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 预置大型 Amazon EC2 实例。这些实例将在 Auto Scaling group 中运行。公司需要一种能够提供最低初始化延迟以满足需求的解决方案。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 aws ec2 register-image 命令从快照创建 AMI。使用 AWS Step Functions 替换 Auto Scaling group 中的 AMI。
options.B: 在快照上启用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) fast snapshot restore。使用该快照预置 AMI。用新的 AMI 替换 Auto Scaling group 中的 AMI。
options.C: 在 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) 中启用 AMI 创建并定义生命周期规则。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来修改 Auto Scaling group 中的 AMI。
options.D: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 调用用于预置 AMI 的 AWS Backup 生命周期策略。将 Auto Scaling group 容量限制配置为 EventBridge 中的事件源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon EBS Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) 专门用于最大限度降低从快照创建的 EBS 卷的初始化延迟：AWS 表示，FSR 会从快照创建在“创建时已完全初始化”的卷，消除首次访问 I/O 延迟，并让卷“立即交付其所有预置性能”([Amazon EBS fast snapshot restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-fast-snapshot-restore.html))。这适用于从 EBS-backed AMI 启动的 EC2 Auto Scaling，因为当实例从 EBS-backed AMI 启动时，EC2 会使用该 AMI 的快照创建根 EBS 卷（[Create an Amazon EBS-backed AMI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-an-ami-ebs.html)）。从启用 FSR 的快照创建/注册 AMI，并更新 Auto Scaling group 的 launch template/AMI，可让新的扩展实例使用已初始化的卷；Auto Scaling groups 可以更新为在扩展时使用某个 launch template 版本（[Migrate your Auto Scaling groups to launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/migrate-to-launch-templates.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 从快照注册 AMI 是一种有效的 AMI 创建方法，但它本身并不能消除 EBS 卷初始化延迟。Step Functions 编排并不能解决存储初始化问题。
- **C:** Amazon DLM 生命周期自动化可以帮助创建/管理 AMI，但生命周期规则和 Lambda 更新不会使 EBS 卷在启动时完全初始化。
- **D:** EventBridge 和 AWS Backup 生命周期策略不是降低 EC2/EBS 初始化延迟的机制，而将 Auto Scaling 容量限制作为事件源也无法满足以最低初始化延迟预置大型实例的要求。

en.question: A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company’s IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.
options.B: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.
options.C: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.
options.D: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **A**.

AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built to manage, retrieve, and rotate database credentials. The documentation states that Secrets Manager helps manage and rotate database credentials throughout their lifecycle, and that you can configure an automatic rotation schedule so applications do not need to be updated when credentials rotate ([What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). Aurora also integrates with Secrets Manager: Aurora can create a managed secret for master user credentials and manage rotation for those credentials ([How Amazon Aurora uses AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/integrating-AUR.html)). Secrets Manager encrypts secret values and lets you choose a customer managed AWS KMS key when creating a secret ([Secret encryption and decryption in AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)). A 14-day custom rotation period is supported because Secrets Manager rate expressions support `rate(Value days)` with a maximum rotation period of 999 days ([Rotation schedules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_schedule.html)). This meets encryption and 14-day rotation with the least operational effort.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: Systems Manager Parameter Store `SecureString` can use KMS encryption, but this option requires building and operating a custom Lambda rotation process. Secrets Manager provides automatic secret rotation, so this is more operational effort.
- **C**: Storing credentials in an encrypted EFS file and writing custom Lambda logic to rotate Aurora credentials and update files is not a managed credential-rotation pattern and adds file-system access and synchronization overhead.
- **D**: Storing credentials in an encrypted S3 object and using custom Lambda rotation plus application downloads also requires custom rotation and distribution logic. It is more operationally complex than Secrets Manager automatic rotation.

zh.question: 一家公司托管了一个多层 Web 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 集群进行存储。应用程序层托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。该公司的 IT 安全指南要求数据库凭证必须加密，并且每 14 天轮换一次。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施，以便用最少的运营工作量满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密密钥。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 创建一个使用该 KMS 密钥且包含相应凭证的新密钥。将该密钥与 Aurora DB 集群关联。配置 14 天的自定义轮换周期。
options.B: 在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中创建两个参数：一个用于用户名的字符串参数，另一个使用 SecureString 类型用于密码。为密码参数选择 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密，并在应用程序层加载这些参数。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 14 天轮换一次密码。
options.C: 将包含凭证的文件存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。在应用程序层的所有 EC2 实例中挂载该 EFS 文件系统。限制对文件系统中文件的访问，使应用程序可以读取该文件，并且只有超级用户可以修改该文件。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 14 天在 Aurora 中轮换密钥，并将新凭证写入该文件。
options.D: 将包含凭证的文件存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中，应用程序使用该文件加载凭证。定期将该文件下载到应用程序，以确保使用正确的凭证。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 14 天轮换 Aurora 凭证，并将这些凭证上传到 S3 存储桶中的该文件。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A**。

AWS Secrets Manager 专为管理、检索和轮换数据库凭证而构建。文档说明，Secrets Manager 可帮助在数据库凭证的整个生命周期中管理和轮换这些凭证，并且你可以配置自动轮换计划，这样应用程序在凭证轮换时无需更新（[What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。Aurora 也与 Secrets Manager 集成：Aurora 可以为主用户凭证创建托管密钥，并管理这些凭证的轮换（[How Amazon Aurora uses AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/integrating-AUR.html)）。Secrets Manager 会加密密钥值，并允许你在创建密钥时选择客户托管的 AWS KMS 密钥（[Secret encryption and decryption in AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)）。Secrets Manager 速率表达式支持 `rate(Value days)`，最大轮换周期为 999 天，因此支持 14 天的自定义轮换周期（[Rotation schedules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotate-secrets_schedule.html)）。这以最少的运营工作量满足了加密和 14 天轮换的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：Systems Manager Parameter Store `SecureString` 可以使用 KMS 加密，但此选项需要构建和运营自定义 Lambda 轮换流程。Secrets Manager 提供自动密钥轮换，因此此选项需要更多运营工作量。
- **C**：将凭证存储在加密的 EFS 文件中，并编写自定义 Lambda 逻辑来轮换 Aurora 凭证和更新文件，这不是托管的凭证轮换模式，并且会增加文件系统访问和同步开销。
- **D**：将凭证存储在加密的 S3 对象中，并使用自定义 Lambda 轮换以及应用程序下载，也需要自定义轮换和分发逻辑。它比 Secrets Manager 自动轮换在运营上更复杂。

en.question: A company has deployed a web application on AWS. The company hosts the backend database on Amazon RDS for MySQL with a primary DB instance and five read replicas to support scaling needs. The read replicas must lag no more than 1 second behind the primary DB instance. The database routinely runs scheduled stored procedures. As traffic on the website increases, the replicas experience additional lag during periods of peak load. A solutions architect must reduce the replication lag as much as possible. The solutions architect must minimize changes to the application code and must minimize ongoing operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Replace the read replicas with Aurora Replicas, and configure Aurora Auto Scaling. Replace the stored procedures with Aurora MySQL native functions.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the database. Modify the application to check the cache before the application queries the database. Replace the stored procedures with AWS Lambda functions.
options.C: Migrate the database to a MySQL database that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Choose large, compute optimized EC2 instances for all replica nodes. Maintain the stored procedures on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Provision a large number of read capacity units (RCUs) to support the required throughput, and configure on-demand capacity scaling. Replace the stored procedures with DynamoDB streams.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A.**

Migrating from RDS for MySQL with traditional MySQL read replicas to **Amazon Aurora MySQL** best meets the requirements. Aurora is MySQL-compatible, and AWS states that the existing MySQL code, tools, and applications can be used with Aurora and that Aurora can improve throughput “without requiring changes to most of your existing applications” ([What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)). Aurora Replicas are designed for read scaling through the reader endpoint, and AWS states that Aurora Replicas share the cluster volume and normally have **replica lag much less than 100 milliseconds** after a primary write, which is well within the 1-second target ([Replication with Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)). Aurora Auto Scaling can dynamically add or remove Aurora Replicas based on workload, reducing operational overhead for peak traffic periods ([Amazon Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)). AWS also recommends Aurora MySQL native functions such as `lambda_sync` and `lambda_async` for Lambda integration, which aligns with replacing deprecated procedure-based approaches where applicable ([Recommendations for MySQL features in Aurora MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.BestPractices.FeatureRecommendations.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B:** ElastiCache can reduce some database reads, but it requires application changes to check and maintain the cache. It also does not directly reduce MySQL replication lag caused by the primary-to-replica replication process. The question requires minimizing application changes and reducing replica lag.
* **C:** Running MySQL on EC2 increases operational overhead because the company would have to self-manage database instances, replication, patching, scaling, and failover. It also does not provide Aurora’s shared storage architecture and normally sub-100 ms replica lag.
* **D:** DynamoDB would require a major data model and application rewrite from relational MySQL to NoSQL, and DynamoDB Streams are not a replacement for MySQL stored procedures. This violates the requirement to minimize application code changes and operational disruption.

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS 上部署了一个 Web 应用程序。该公司将后端数据库托管在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 上，包含一个主数据库实例和五个只读副本，以支持扩展需求。只读副本相对于主数据库实例的滞后时间不得超过 1 秒。该数据库会定期运行计划的存储过程。随着网站流量增加，副本在高峰负载期间出现额外滞后。解决方案架构师必须尽可能减少复制滞后。解决方案架构师必须尽量减少对应用程序代码的更改，并且必须尽量减少持续的运维开销。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL。用 Aurora Replicas 替换只读副本，并配置 Aurora Auto Scaling。用 Aurora MySQL native functions 替换存储过程。
options.B: 在数据库前面部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群。修改应用程序，使应用程序在查询数据库之前先检查缓存。用 AWS Lambda functions 替换存储过程。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 MySQL 数据库。为所有副本节点选择大型计算优化型 EC2 实例。在 EC2 实例上保留存储过程。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。预置大量读取容量单位 (RCUs) 以支持所需吞吐量，并配置按需容量扩展。用 DynamoDB streams 替换存储过程。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A.**

从带有传统 MySQL 只读副本的 RDS for MySQL 迁移到 **Amazon Aurora MySQL** 最符合要求。Aurora 与 MySQL 兼容，并且 AWS 表示，现有的 MySQL 代码、工具和应用程序可以与 Aurora 一起使用，而且 Aurora 可以“无需更改大多数现有应用程序”即可提高吞吐量（[What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。Aurora Replicas 旨在通过读取器端点进行读取扩展，并且 AWS 表示 Aurora Replicas 共享集群卷，在主实例写入后通常具有**远低于 100 毫秒的副本滞后**，完全满足 1 秒目标（[Replication with Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。Aurora Auto Scaling 可以根据工作负载动态添加或移除 Aurora Replicas，从而减少高峰流量期间的运维开销（[Amazon Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Integrating.AutoScaling.html)）。AWS 还建议使用 Aurora MySQL native functions，例如 `lambda_sync` 和 `lambda_async`，用于 Lambda 集成，这与在适用情况下替换已弃用的基于过程的方法相一致（[Recommendations for MySQL features in Aurora MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.BestPractices.FeatureRecommendations.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

* **B:** ElastiCache 可以减少一些数据库读取，但它需要更改应用程序以检查和维护缓存。它也不能直接减少由主库到副本的复制过程造成的 MySQL 复制滞后。题目要求尽量减少应用程序更改并减少副本滞后。
* **C:** 在 EC2 上运行 MySQL 会增加运维开销，因为公司必须自行管理数据库实例、复制、修补、扩展和故障转移。它也不提供 Aurora 的共享存储架构以及通常低于 100 ms 的副本滞后。
* **D:** DynamoDB 需要从关系型 MySQL 到 NoSQL 的重大数据模型和应用程序重写，并且 DynamoDB Streams 不能替代 MySQL 存储过程。这违反了尽量减少应用程序代码更改和运维中断的要求。

en.question: A solutions architect must create a disaster recovery (DR) plan for a high-volume software as a service (SaaS) platform. All data for the platform is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The DR plan must replicate data to a secondary AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use MySQL binary log replication to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Provision one DB instance for the Aurora cluster in the secondary Region.
options.B: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. When setup is complete, remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to continuously replicate data to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
options.D: Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. Specify a minimum of one DB instance in the secondary Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Aurora Global Database is the best fit for cross-Region DR for an Aurora MySQL cluster. AWS states that Aurora Global Database replicates from the primary Region to secondary Regions using dedicated infrastructure with latency typically under a second, and that it supports failover to recover from a primary Region outage ([Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)). For the most cost-effective DR-only design, AWS specifically supports a **headless secondary Aurora DB cluster**: a secondary cluster with **no DB instance**. AWS says this lowers expenses because compute and storage are decoupled; without a DB instance, you are charged for storage but not compute, and the secondary storage volume remains in sync with the primary. The documented procedure is to add the secondary Region and then delete the read-only DB instance after replication begins ([Creating a headless Aurora DB cluster in a secondary Region](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-attach.console.headless.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A**: Cross-Region Aurora MySQL read replicas use MySQL binary log replication. AWS notes this has more cross-Region lag and requires enabling/managing binary logging; for effective replication, each read replica should have similar compute and storage resources as the source cluster, which is not the most cost-effective DR-only design ([Aurora MySQL cross-Region replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Replication.CrossRegion.html)).
- **C**: AWS DMS can perform ongoing replication, but this is a migration/CDC service, not the native Aurora storage-layer DR mechanism. Removing the DB instance from a normal target Aurora cluster would remove the compute endpoint DMS would need to apply changes. The AWS-supported headless configuration that remains in sync is specifically for **Aurora Global Database** secondary clusters ([headless Aurora secondary cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-attach.console.headless.html)).
- **D**: This would meet the replication requirement, but keeping at least one DB instance in the secondary Region incurs compute cost. AWS explicitly says deleting the secondary reader instance creates a headless cluster and lowers expenses because you are not charged for compute, making **B** more cost-effective ([headless Aurora secondary cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-attach.console.headless.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师必须为一个高流量的软件即服务 (SaaS) 平台创建灾难恢复 (DR) 计划。该平台的所有数据都存储在一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 集群中。该 DR 计划必须将数据复制到一个辅助 AWS Region。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 MySQL 二进制日志复制到辅助 Region 中的一个 Aurora 集群。为辅助 Region 中的 Aurora 集群预置一个 DB 实例。
options.B: 为该 DB 集群设置一个 Aurora global database。设置完成后，从辅助 Region 中移除该 DB 实例。
options.C: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据持续复制到辅助 Region 中的一个 Aurora 集群。从辅助 Region 中移除该 DB 实例。
options.D: 为该 DB 集群设置一个 Aurora global database。在辅助 Region 中指定至少一个 DB 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Aurora Global Database 最适合用于 Aurora MySQL 集群的跨 Region DR。AWS 表示，Aurora Global Database 使用专用基础设施从主 Region 复制到辅助 Regions，延迟通常低于一秒，并且支持故障转移以从主 Region 中断中恢复（[Aurora Global Database overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。对于最具成本效益的仅 DR 设计，AWS 明确支持 **headless secondary Aurora DB cluster**：即**没有 DB instance** 的辅助集群。AWS 表示，这会降低费用，因为计算和存储是解耦的；没有 DB instance 时，你需要为存储付费，但无需为计算付费，并且辅助存储卷会与主集群保持同步。文档化的过程是添加辅助 Region，然后在复制开始后删除只读 DB instance（[Creating a headless Aurora DB cluster in a secondary Region](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-attach.console.headless.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A**：跨 Region Aurora MySQL 只读副本使用 MySQL binary log replication。AWS 指出，这会有更多跨 Region 延迟，并且需要启用/管理二进制日志记录；为了实现有效复制，每个只读副本都应具有与源集群相似的计算和存储资源，这不是最具成本效益的仅 DR 设计（[Aurora MySQL cross-Region replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.Replication.CrossRegion.html)）。
- **C**：AWS DMS 可以执行持续复制，但它是迁移/CDC 服务，而不是原生 Aurora 存储层 DR 机制。从普通目标 Aurora 集群中移除 DB instance 会移除 DMS 应用更改所需的计算端点。AWS 支持的、可保持同步的 headless 配置专门用于 **Aurora Global Database** 辅助集群（[headless Aurora secondary cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-attach.console.headless.html)）。
- **D**：这可以满足复制要求，但在辅助 Region 中保留至少一个 DB instance 会产生计算成本。AWS 明确表示，删除辅助 reader instance 会创建 headless cluster，并且由于不再为计算付费而降低费用，因此 **B** 更具成本效益（[headless Aurora secondary cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-attach.console.headless.html)）。

en.question: A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. Management says the application must be made more secure with the least amount of programming effort. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create keys. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation.
options.B: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function that rotates the credentials in Secret Manager.
options.C: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager.
options.D: Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Parameter Store.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

AWS Secrets Manager is designed for this use case: it helps manage, retrieve, and rotate **database credentials**, and it lets applications replace hard-coded credentials with a runtime call to Secrets Manager, improving security without embedding secrets in code ([AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). Secrets Manager also supports configuring an **automatic rotation schedule**, so credential rotation no longer requires application updates or redeployments ([AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). AWS documentation specifically shows creating an Amazon RDS database user, storing that user's credentials as “Credentials for Amazon RDS database,” and turning on automatic rotation with a rotation schedule ([single-user rotation tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-single.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** is incorrect because AWS KMS is for encryption keys, not for managing and rotating database credentials. AWS explicitly recommends Secrets Manager for database/application credentials and KMS for encryption keys ([AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)).
- **B** is not the best answer because it implies creating a custom Lambda function to rotate the credentials. While Secrets Manager rotation can use Lambda, the lower-effort approach is to configure rotation through Secrets Manager for the RDS secret; AWS shows this as a managed console workflow where Secrets Manager/CloudFormation creates the rotation resources and schedules the secret for rotation ([single-user rotation tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-single.html)).
- **D** is incorrect because Parameter Store can store and retrieve parameters, including SecureString values, but the documented Parameter Store features focus on parameter storage, retrieval, history, and notifications; automatic database credential rotation is a Secrets Manager capability ([Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html), [AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个自定义应用程序，其中嵌入了凭证，用于从 Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance 检索信息。管理层表示，必须以最少的编程工作量提高该应用程序的安全性。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建密钥。配置应用程序从 AWS KMS 加载数据库凭证。启用自动密钥轮换。
options.B: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建凭证，并将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于轮换 Secret Manager 中的凭证。
options.C: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建凭证，并将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。使用 Secrets Manager 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用程序用户设置凭证轮换计划。
options.D: 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建凭证，并将凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。配置应用程序从 Parameter Store 加载数据库凭证。使用 Parameter Store 为 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的应用程序用户设置凭证轮换计划。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

AWS Secrets Manager 专为此用例而设计：它帮助管理、检索和轮换 **database credentials**，并允许应用程序用对 Secrets Manager 的运行时调用替代硬编码凭证，从而在不将密钥嵌入代码的情况下提高安全性（[AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。Secrets Manager 还支持配置 **automatic rotation schedule**，因此凭证轮换不再需要应用程序更新或重新部署（[AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。AWS 文档专门展示了如何创建 Amazon RDS 数据库用户，将该用户的凭证存储为 “Credentials for Amazon RDS database”，并通过轮换计划开启自动轮换（[single-user rotation tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-single.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A** 不正确，因为 AWS KMS 用于加密密钥，而不是用于管理和轮换数据库凭证。AWS 明确建议将 Secrets Manager 用于数据库/应用程序凭证，将 KMS 用于加密密钥（[AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。
- **B** 不是最佳答案，因为它暗示要创建自定义 Lambda 函数来轮换凭证。虽然 Secrets Manager 轮换可以使用 Lambda，但工作量更低的方法是通过 Secrets Manager 为 RDS secret 配置轮换；AWS 将其展示为托管控制台工作流，其中 Secrets Manager/CloudFormation 创建轮换资源并为 secret 安排轮换（[single-user rotation tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/tutorials_rotation-single.html)）。
- **D** 不正确，因为 Parameter Store 可以存储和检索参数，包括 SecureString 值，但已记录的 Parameter Store 功能侧重于参数存储、检索、历史记录和通知；自动数据库凭证轮换是 Secrets Manager 的能力（[Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html), [AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。

en.question: A media company hosts its website on AWS. The website application’s architecture includes a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and a database that is hosted on Amazon Aurora. The company’s cybersecurity team reports that the application is vulnerable to SQL injection. How should the company resolve this issue?

options.A: Use AWS WAF in front of the ALB. Associate the appropriate web ACLs with AWS WAF.
options.B: Create an ALB listener rule to reply to SQL injections with a fixed response.
options.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.
options.D: Set up Amazon Inspector to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS WAF is the appropriate service for protecting a web application from SQL injection attempts at the HTTP(S) request layer. AWS WAF web ACLs provide fine-grained control over HTTP(S) requests and can allow or block requests based on criteria that include the **detection of malicious SQL code or scripting**. AWS documentation also states that a web ACL can protect an **Application Load Balancer**, and AWS WAF can be associated with an ALB to allow or block requests based on web ACL rules ([AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html), [associate web ACL with resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html), [ALB integrations - AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-integrations.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B:** ALB listener rules are primarily request-routing rules with actions such as `forward`, `redirect`, or `fixed-response`, and conditions such as host header, path, source IP, HTTP header, or query string. They are not a managed SQL injection detection and mitigation engine ([ALB listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)).
* **C:** AWS Shield Advanced is for protection against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, not for automatically blocking SQL injection payloads ([AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)).
* **D:** Amazon Inspector continuously scans eligible resources for vulnerabilities and network exposure and produces findings with remediation recommendations. It does not sit in front of an ALB or automatically block incoming SQL injection requests ([Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).

zh.question: 一家媒体公司将其网站托管在 AWS 上。该网站应用程序的架构包括一组位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例，以及一个托管在 Amazon Aurora 上的数据库。该公司的网络安全团队报告称，该应用程序容易受到 SQL 注入攻击。公司应如何解决此问题？

options.A: 在 ALB 前面使用 AWS WAF。将适当的 web ACLs 与 AWS WAF 关联。
options.B: 创建 ALB 侦听器规则，以固定响应来回复 SQL 注入。
options.C: 订阅 AWS Shield Advanced，以自动阻止所有 SQL 注入尝试。
options.D: 设置 Amazon Inspector，以自动阻止所有 SQL 注入尝试。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** AWS WAF 是在 HTTP(S) 请求层保护 Web 应用程序免受 SQL 注入尝试的适当服务。AWS WAF web ACLs 提供对 HTTP(S) 请求的精细控制，并且可以根据包括**检测恶意 SQL 代码或脚本**在内的条件允许或阻止请求。AWS 文档还说明，web ACL 可以保护 **Application Load Balancer**，并且 AWS WAF 可以与 ALB 关联，以根据 web ACL 规则允许或阻止请求（[AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)，[associate web ACL with resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html)，[ALB integrations - AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-integrations.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B:** ALB 侦听器规则主要是请求路由规则，其操作包括 `forward`、`redirect` 或 `fixed-response`，条件包括 host header、path、source IP、HTTP header 或 query string。它们不是托管的 SQL 注入检测和缓解引擎（[ALB listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)）。
* **C:** AWS Shield Advanced 用于防护 Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) 攻击，而不是用于自动阻止 SQL 注入负载（[AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)）。
* **D:** Amazon Inspector 会持续扫描符合条件的资源，以发现漏洞和网络暴露，并生成包含修复建议的发现结果。它不会位于 ALB 前面，也不会自动阻止传入的 SQL 注入请求（[Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。

en.question: A company has an Amazon S3 data lake that is governed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create a visualization in Amazon QuickSight by joining the data in the data lake with operational data that is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company wants to enforce column-level authorization so that the company’s marketing team can access only a subset of columns in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon EMR to ingest the data directly from the database to the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.
options.B: Use AWS Glue Studio to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Attach an IAM policy to the QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.C: Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create a materialized view for the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.
options.D: Use a Lake Formation blueprint to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

A Lake Formation blueprint is the lowest-overhead fit because Lake Formation workflows can generate the AWS Glue jobs, crawlers, and triggers needed to discover and ingest data into the S3 data lake from a JDBC database source; for MySQL sources, the blueprint source path format is explicitly supported (`<database>/%`) and the target is an S3 data lake location ([Lake Formation JDBC tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/getting-started-tutorial-jdbc.html)). Lake Formation also provides centralized, fine-grained access controls at the database, table, **column**, row, and cell levels, and those controls can be used with **Athena** ([Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)). QuickSight’s Lake Formation integration expects the data to be accessible through Athena; AWS docs state to verify access using Athena with Lake Formation and then verify that QuickSight can connect to Athena, and QuickSight must have access to Amazon Athena and the relevant S3 buckets ([QuickSight Lake Formation authorization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/lake-formation.html)). Athena documentation also says that when using Lake Formation, permissions can be administered centrally rather than by configuring IAM policies for users to read data and metadata ([Athena with Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/security-athena-lake-formation.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A:** EMR ingestion directly into SPICE by selecting only certain columns is a custom ETL approach and does not use the existing Lake Formation governance model for column-level authorization. It also creates more operational overhead than using Lake Formation ingestion and permissions.
* **B:** AWS Glue Studio can ingest data, but IAM policies for QuickSight users are not the right mechanism for Lake Formation-governed column-level authorization. Athena docs state that Lake Formation permissions can centrally administer access instead of configuring IAM policies for users to read data and metadata ([Athena with Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/security-athena-lake-formation.html)).
* **C:** S3 bucket policies are not an appropriate way to enforce column-level permissions. Lake Formation is the AWS service that provides centralized database/table/column/row/cell-level controls for the data lake ([Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)).

Therefore, using a Lake Formation blueprint for ingestion, Lake Formation column-level permissions, and Athena as the QuickSight data source best satisfies the requirements with the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个由 AWS Lake Formation 管理的 Amazon S3 数据湖。该公司希望通过将数据湖中的数据与存储在 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库中的运营数据进行联接，在 Amazon QuickSight 中创建可视化。该公司希望实施列级授权，以便公司的营销团队只能访问数据库中的一部分列。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EMR 将数据直接从数据库摄取到 QuickSight SPICE 引擎。仅包含所需的列。
options.B: 使用 AWS Glue Studio 将数据从数据库摄取到 S3 数据湖。为 QuickSight 用户附加 IAM policy 以实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中使用 Amazon S3 作为数据源。
options.C: 使用 AWS Glue Elastic Views 在 Amazon S3 中为数据库创建物化视图。创建 S3 bucket policy 以对 QuickSight 用户实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中使用 Amazon S3 作为数据源。
options.D: 使用 Lake Formation blueprint 将数据从数据库摄取到 S3 数据湖。使用 Lake Formation 对 QuickSight 用户实施列级访问控制。在 QuickSight 中使用 Amazon Athena 作为数据源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

Lake Formation blueprint 是运营开销最低的匹配方案，因为 Lake Formation 工作流可以生成从 JDBC 数据库源发现数据并将数据摄取到 S3 数据湖所需的 AWS Glue 作业、爬网程序和触发器；对于 MySQL 源，blueprint 源路径格式被明确支持（`<database>/%`），目标是 S3 数据湖位置（[Lake Formation JDBC tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/getting-started-tutorial-jdbc.html)）。Lake Formation 还在数据库、表、**列**、行和单元格级别提供集中式的细粒度访问控制，并且这些控制可以与 **Athena** 一起使用（[Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)）。QuickSight 的 Lake Formation 集成要求数据可通过 Athena 访问；AWS 文档说明，需要使用带有 Lake Formation 的 Athena 验证访问，然后验证 QuickSight 是否可以连接到 Athena，并且 QuickSight 必须有权访问 Amazon Athena 和相关 S3 存储桶（[QuickSight Lake Formation authorization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/lake-formation.html)）。Athena 文档还说明，在使用 Lake Formation 时，可以集中管理权限，而不是为用户配置 IAM policy 以读取数据和元数据（[Athena with Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/security-athena-lake-formation.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **A:** 通过仅选择某些列将数据从 EMR 直接摄取到 SPICE 是一种自定义 ETL 方法，并未使用现有的 Lake Formation 治理模型进行列级授权。与使用 Lake Formation 摄取和权限相比，它还会产生更多运营开销。
* **B:** AWS Glue Studio 可以摄取数据，但针对 QuickSight 用户的 IAM policy 并不是对 Lake Formation 管理的数据实施列级授权的正确机制。Athena 文档说明，Lake Formation 权限可以集中管理访问，而不是为用户配置 IAM policy 以读取数据和元数据（[Athena with Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/security-athena-lake-formation.html)）。
* **C:** S3 bucket policy 不是实施列级权限的合适方式。Lake Formation 是为数据湖提供集中式数据库/表/列/行/单元格级控制的 AWS 服务（[Lake Formation features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/what-is-lake-formation.html)）。因此，使用 Lake Formation blueprint 进行摄取、使用 Lake Formation 列级权限，并将 Athena 作为 QuickSight 数据源，能够以最少的运营开销最好地满足这些要求。

en.question: A transaction processing company has weekly scripted batch jobs that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The number of transactions can vary, but the baseline CPU utilization that is noted on each run is at least 60%. The company needs to provision the capacity 30 minutes before the jobs run. Currently, engineers complete this task by manually modifying the Auto Scaling group parameters. The company does not have the resources to analyze the required capacity trends for the Auto Scaling group counts. The company needs an automated way to modify the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on the CPU utilization metric. Set the target value for the metric to 60%.
options.B: Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Set the appropriate desired capacity, minimum capacity, and maximum capacity. Set the recurrence to weekly. Set the start time to 30 minutes before the batch jobs run.
options.C: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on forecast. Set the scaling metric to CPU utilization. Set the target value for the metric to 60%. In the policy, set the instances to pre-launch 30 minutes before the jobs run.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge event to invoke an AWS Lambda function when the CPU utilization metric value for the Auto Scaling group reaches 60%. Configure the Lambda function to increase the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity and maximum capacity by 20%.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The workload is weekly and therefore has a recurring time pattern, but the transaction volume varies and the company does not want to manually analyze capacity counts. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling predictive scaling is designed for recurring daily/weekly patterns: it analyzes up to 14 days of CloudWatch metric data, generates capacity forecasts, and in **forecast and scale** mode scales out when the forecast expects load to increase. AWS also provides a **Pre-launch instances** / `SchedulingBufferTime` setting so instances can be launched ahead of forecasted demand, which matches the requirement to provision capacity 30 minutes before the jobs run ([How predictive scaling works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/predictive-scaling-policy-overview.html)). Predictive scaling supports predefined metrics including **CPU**, and the target utilization for CPU is the percentage each instance should ideally use; the policy can also be set to scale based on forecast and pre-launch instances ([Create a predictive scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/predictive-scaling-create-policy.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Dynamic/target tracking scaling reacts to current metric utilization. A target value represents optimal average utilization, and the metric should be at or just below the target when normally scaled ([target tracking target value](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)). This does not proactively provision capacity 30 minutes before a known weekly batch job.
- **B:** Scheduled scaling can run weekly and can set desired/min/max capacity at a specified time, but it requires specifying the new desired capacity values ([scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)). The question states the company lacks resources to analyze the required capacity trends/counts, so this is more operational effort and less adaptive than predictive scaling.
- **D:** EventBridge plus Lambda is a custom, reactive solution triggered after CPU reaches 60%. It would not provision capacity 30 minutes before the job, and it adds unnecessary operational overhead compared with the native Auto Scaling predictive scaling policy.

zh.question: 一家交易处理公司有每周运行的脚本化批处理作业，这些作业在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。EC2 实例位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。交易数量可能会变化，但每次运行时记录到的基线 CPU 利用率至少为 60%。公司需要在作业运行前 30 分钟预置容量。目前，工程师通过手动修改 Auto Scaling 组参数来完成此任务。公司没有资源来分析 Auto Scaling 组数量所需的容量趋势。公司需要一种自动化方式来修改 Auto Scaling 组的所需容量。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个动态扩缩策略。将该策略配置为基于 CPU 利用率指标进行扩缩。将该指标的目标值设置为 60%。
options.B: 为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个计划扩缩策略。设置适当的所需容量、最小容量和最大容量。将重复周期设置为每周。将开始时间设置为批处理作业运行前 30 分钟。
options.C: 为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个预测扩缩策略。将该策略配置为基于预测进行扩缩。将扩缩指标设置为 CPU 利用率。将该指标的目标值设置为 60%。在策略中，将实例设置为在作业运行前 30 分钟预启动。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件，在 Auto Scaling 组的 CPU 利用率指标值达到 60% 时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。将 Lambda 函数配置为将 Auto Scaling 组的所需容量和最大容量增加 20%。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 该工作负载是每周一次，因此具有重复的时间模式，但交易量会变化，并且公司不想手动分析容量数量。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling predictive scaling 专为重复的每日/每周模式而设计：它会分析最多 14 天的 CloudWatch 指标数据，生成容量预测，并在 **forecast and scale** 模式下，当预测预计负载会增加时进行扩展。AWS 还提供 **Pre-launch instances** / `SchedulingBufferTime` 设置，以便可以在预测需求到来之前启动实例，这与在作业运行前 30 分钟预置容量的要求相匹配（[How predictive scaling works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/predictive-scaling-policy-overview.html)）。Predictive scaling 支持包括 **CPU** 在内的预定义指标，CPU 的目标利用率是每个实例理想情况下应使用的百分比；该策略还可以设置为基于预测进行扩缩并预启动实例（[Create a predictive scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/predictive-scaling-create-policy.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 动态/目标跟踪扩缩会对当前指标利用率作出反应。目标值表示最佳平均利用率，并且在正常扩缩时，指标应处于或略低于目标值（[target tracking target value](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。这不会在已知的每周批处理作业前 30 分钟主动预置容量。
- **B:** 计划扩缩可以每周运行，并且可以在指定时间设置 desired/min/max capacity，但它需要指定新的所需容量值（[scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。题目说明公司缺乏资源来分析所需的容量趋势/数量，因此与预测扩缩相比，这需要更多运营工作且适应性较差。
- **D:** EventBridge 加 Lambda 是一种自定义的、被动的解决方案，在 CPU 达到 60% 后触发。它不会在作业运行前 30 分钟预置容量，并且与原生 Auto Scaling predictive scaling 策略相比增加了不必要的运营开销。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a company’s disaster recovery (DR) architecture. The company has a MySQL database that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet with scheduled backup. The DR design needs to include multiple AWS Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the MySQL database to multiple EC2 instances. Configure a standby EC2 instance in the DR Region. Turn on replication.
options.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS. Use a Multi-AZ deployment. Turn on read replication for the primary DB instance in the different Availability Zones.
options.C: Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon Aurora global database. Host the primary DB cluster in the primary Region. Host the secondary DB cluster in the DR Region.
options.D: Store the scheduled backup of the MySQL database in an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR). Use the data backup to restore the database in the DR Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Aurora is a fully managed relational database engine that is compatible with MySQL, so it is an appropriate managed migration target for the existing MySQL database. AWS states that Aurora also automates and standardizes database clustering and replication, reducing operational work compared with self-managed MySQL on EC2. An Aurora global database is specifically designed to span multiple AWS Regions: it has one primary Region and up to 10 read-only secondary Regions, and Aurora replicates data to secondary Regions using dedicated infrastructure, typically with sub-second latency. It also supports cross-Region failover, and AWS describes Aurora Global Database as providing recovery from Region-wide outages with lower RTO and RPO than traditional replication solutions. Therefore, hosting the primary cluster in the primary Region and a secondary cluster in the DR Region best meets the multi-Region DR requirement with the least operational overhead ([Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html), [Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html), [Aurora Global Database DR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Running MySQL on multiple EC2 instances and configuring replication is self-managed. The company would operate EC2 instances, database replication, patching, monitoring, and failover logic, which is more operational overhead than using managed Aurora Global Database.
- **B:** RDS Multi-AZ improves high availability within Availability Zones, and RDS read replicas can be used for DR, including cross-Region replicas. However, the option says to turn on read replication in different **Availability Zones**, not different Regions, so it does not satisfy the requirement for a multi-Region DR design. Also, RDS read replicas are manually created and promoted for DR ([RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html), [Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)).
- **D:** S3 Cross-Region Replication can asynchronously copy backup objects across Regions, but this is a backup-and-restore approach. It would require restoring and configuring the database in the DR Region during a disaster, resulting in more operational overhead and a higher RTO than an Aurora global database. S3 replication protects objects, not a continuously replicated running MySQL database ([S3 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/data-protection.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在设计一家公司的灾难恢复 (DR) 架构。该公司有一个 MySQL 数据库，运行在私有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例上，并配置了计划备份。DR 设计需要包含多个 AWS Regions。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到多个 EC2 实例。配置一个位于 DR Region 的备用 EC2 实例。开启复制。
options.B: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS。使用 Multi-AZ 部署。为位于不同 Availability Zones 中的主 DB 实例开启读取复制。
options.C: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora global database。在主 Region 托管主 DB 集群。在 DR Region 托管辅助 DB 集群。
options.D: 将 MySQL 数据库的计划备份存储在配置了 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 的 Amazon S3 bucket 中。使用数据备份在 DR Region 中还原数据库。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** Aurora 是一个完全托管的关系数据库引擎，兼容 MySQL，因此它是现有 MySQL 数据库的合适托管迁移目标。AWS 表示，Aurora 还会自动化并标准化数据库集群和复制，与在 EC2 上自管理 MySQL 相比，可减少运营工作。Aurora global database 专门设计用于跨多个 AWS Regions：它有一个主 Region，最多可有 10 个只读辅助 Regions，并且 Aurora 使用专用基础设施将数据复制到辅助 Regions，通常具有亚秒级延迟。它还支持跨 Region 故障转移，并且 AWS 将 Aurora Global Database 描述为可在 Region 级中断时提供恢复，相比传统复制解决方案具有更低的 RTO 和 RPO。因此，在主 Region 托管主集群，并在 DR Region 托管辅助集群，最能以最少的运营开销满足 multi-Region DR 要求（[Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html), [Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html), [Aurora Global Database DR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 在多个 EC2 实例上运行 MySQL 并配置复制属于自管理方式。公司需要运维 EC2 实例、数据库复制、修补、监控和故障转移逻辑，这比使用托管的 Aurora Global Database 具有更高的运营开销。
- **B:** RDS Multi-AZ 可提升 Availability Zones 内的高可用性，RDS read replicas 也可用于 DR，包括 cross-Region replicas。但是，该选项说的是在不同 **Availability Zones** 中开启读取复制，而不是在不同 Regions 中，因此不满足 multi-Region DR 设计的要求。此外，RDS read replicas 需要为 DR 手动创建并提升（[RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html), [Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Cross-Region Replication 可以将备份对象异步复制到跨 Regions，但这是一种备份和还原方法。在灾难期间，需要在 DR Region 中还原并配置数据库，导致更高的运营开销和比 Aurora global database 更高的 RTO。S3 复制保护的是对象，而不是一个持续复制的正在运行的 MySQL 数据库（[S3 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/data-protection.html)）。
