en.question: A company has a Java application that uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to parse messages. The application cannot parse messages that are larger than 256 KB in size. The company wants to implement a solution to give the application the ability to parse messages as large as 50 MB. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?

options.A: Use the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java to host messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon EventBridge to post large messages from the application instead of Amazon SQS.
options.C: Change the limit in Amazon SQS to handle messages that are larger than 256 KB.
options.D: Store messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Configure Amazon SQS to reference this location in the messages.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

AWS documentation states that the **Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java** is specifically intended for large SQS messages: it stores the message payload in an **Amazon S3 bucket** and sends only a reference to the object in the SQS queue, especially for payloads between **256 KB and 2 GB** ([AWS SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-managing-large-messages.html)). A 50 MB payload is within this supported range. The SQS message quotas page also says the extended library lets an SQS message contain a reference to a payload in Amazon S3, with a maximum payload size of **2 GB** ([AWS SQS message quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/quotas-messages.html)). Because the application is already Java and already uses SQS, this requires the fewest code changes.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: EventBridge is not the minimal-change solution for an existing SQS Java application, and it does not address the documented SQS large-message pattern.
- **C**: The SQS message size quota is fixed in the documented quota table; large payloads are handled by using the Extended Client Library with S3, not by changing an SQS limit ([AWS SQS message quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/quotas-messages.html)).
- **D**: AWS documents S3, not EFS, as the storage backend used by the SQS Extended Client Library for large message payloads ([AWS SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-managing-large-messages.html)). Implementing EFS references manually would require more custom code and is not the standard SQS solution.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Java 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 来解析消息。该应用程序无法解析大小超过 256 KB 的消息。公司希望实施一种解决方案，使该应用程序能够解析最大 50 MB 的消息。哪种解决方案能够在对代码进行最少更改的情况下满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java 将大于 256 KB 的消息托管在 Amazon S3 中。
options.B: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 从应用程序发布大型消息，而不是使用 Amazon SQS。
options.C: 更改 Amazon SQS 中的限制，以处理大于 256 KB 的消息。
options.D: 将大于 256 KB 的消息存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。配置 Amazon SQS 在消息中引用此位置。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

AWS 文档说明，**Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java** 专门用于大型 SQS 消息：它将消息负载存储在 **Amazon S3 bucket** 中，并且只在 SQS 队列中发送对该对象的引用，尤其适用于 **256 KB 到 2 GB** 之间的负载（[AWS SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-managing-large-messages.html)）。50 MB 的负载在此支持范围内。SQS 消息配额页面还说明，扩展库允许一条 SQS 消息包含对 Amazon S3 中负载的引用，最大负载大小为 **2 GB**（[AWS SQS message quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/quotas-messages.html)）。由于该应用程序已经是 Java，并且已经使用 SQS，因此这需要最少的代码更改。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：EventBridge 不是现有 SQS Java 应用程序的最小更改解决方案，并且它没有解决文档中说明的 SQS 大消息模式。
- **C**：SQS 消息大小配额在文档化的配额表中是固定的；大型负载是通过将 Extended Client Library 与 S3 结合使用来处理的，而不是通过更改 SQS 限制来处理（[AWS SQS message quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/quotas-messages.html)）。
- **D**：AWS 文档将 S3（而不是 EFS）列为 SQS Extended Client Library 用于大型消息负载的存储后端（[AWS SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-managing-large-messages.html)）。手动实现 EFS 引用需要更多自定义代码，并且不是标准的 SQS 解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to restrict access to the content of one of its main web applications and to protect the content by using authorization techniques available on AWS. The company wants to implement a serverless architecture and an authentication solution for fewer than 100 users. The solution needs to integrate with the main web application and serve web content globally. The solution must also scale as the company's user base grows while providing the lowest login latency possible. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
options.B: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
options.C: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.
options.D: Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon Cognito user pools are designed for web and mobile app authentication: a user pool is a user directory for authentication and authorization and acts as an OIDC identity provider for the app ([Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)). CloudFront is the right global delivery layer because it delivers static and dynamic web content through a worldwide network of edge locations and routes requests to the edge location with the lowest latency ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). Lambda@Edge is specifically integrated with CloudFront and can run serverless code at the edge; AWS documentation notes that it can help authorize users and control access before CloudFront forwards requests to the origin, with reduced latency ([Ways to use CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)). This combination is serverless, globally distributed, scalable, and avoids the overhead of directory infrastructure for fewer than 100 users.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** AWS Managed Microsoft AD creates managed domain controllers in a VPC and is intended for directory-aware workloads, SSO, group policies, and similar Active Directory use cases—not the most cost-effective lightweight authentication choice for a small web app ([AWS Managed Microsoft AD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_microsoft_ad.html)). Also, an Application Load Balancer is an Availability Zone/Regional load balancing service, not a global web content delivery network; ALBs require at least two Availability Zones, but this does not provide CloudFront-style global edge delivery ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).
- **C:** Amazon Cognito is appropriate, but standard AWS Lambda authorization would run in a Region, not at CloudFront edge locations, so it does not provide the lowest global authorization latency. S3 Transfer Acceleration is mainly for fast transfers/uploads to a centralized S3 bucket over long distances, not for serving protected web content globally ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).
- **D:** AWS Managed Microsoft AD is unnecessary and less cost-effective for fewer than 100 web users. Elastic Beanstalk provisions EC2 instances, configures load balancing, and scales environments, so it is not a serverless global content delivery solution like CloudFront ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望限制对其一个主要 Web 应用程序内容的访问，并使用 AWS 上可用的授权技术来保护内容。该公司希望为少于 100 个用户实施一种无服务器架构和身份验证解决方案。该解决方案需要与主要 Web 应用程序集成，并在全球范围内提供 Web 内容。该解决方案还必须随着公司用户群的增长而扩展，同时提供尽可能低的登录延迟。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证。使用 Lambda@Edge 进行授权。使用 Amazon CloudFront 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。
options.B: 使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 进行身份验证。使用 AWS Lambda 进行授权。使用 Application Load Balancer 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证。使用 AWS Lambda 进行授权。使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。
options.D: 使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 进行身份验证。使用 Lambda@Edge 进行授权。使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

Amazon Cognito 用户池专为 Web 和移动应用身份验证而设计：用户池是用于身份验证和授权的用户目录，并充当应用的 OIDC 身份提供商（[Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)）。CloudFront 是合适的全球交付层，因为它通过遍布全球的边缘站点网络交付静态和动态 Web 内容，并将请求路由到延迟最低的边缘站点（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。Lambda@Edge 专门与 CloudFront 集成，并且可以在边缘运行无服务器代码；AWS 文档指出，它可以在 CloudFront 将请求转发到源站之前帮助授权用户并控制访问，同时降低延迟（[Ways to use CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)）。这种组合是无服务器的、全球分布式的、可扩展的，并且对于少于 100 个用户避免了目录基础设施的开销。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** AWS Managed Microsoft AD 会在 VPC 中创建托管域控制器，适用于目录感知型工作负载、SSO、组策略和类似 Active Directory 使用场景，而不是小型 Web 应用最具成本效益的轻量级身份验证选择（[AWS Managed Microsoft AD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_microsoft_ad.html)）。此外，Application Load Balancer 是 Availability Zone/区域级负载均衡服务，而不是全球 Web 内容分发网络；ALB 至少需要两个 Availability Zones，但这并不能提供 CloudFront 风格的全球边缘交付（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon Cognito 是合适的，但标准 AWS Lambda 授权会在某个 Region 中运行，而不是在 CloudFront 边缘站点运行，因此无法提供最低的全球授权延迟。S3 Transfer Acceleration 主要用于通过长距离快速传输/上传到集中式 S3 存储桶，而不是用于在全球范围内提供受保护的 Web 内容（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。
- **D:** 对于少于 100 个 Web 用户，AWS Managed Microsoft AD 是不必要的且成本效益较低。Elastic Beanstalk 会预置 EC2 实例、配置负载均衡并扩展环境，因此它不是像 CloudFront 那样的无服务器全球内容交付解决方案（[What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company has an aging network-attached storage (NAS) array in its data center. The NAS array presents SMB shares and NFS shares to client workstations. The company does not want to purchase a new NAS array. The company also does not want to incur the cost of renewing the NAS array’s support contract. Some of the data is accessed frequently, but much of the data is inactive. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that migrates the data to Amazon S3, uses S3 Lifecycle policies, and maintains the same look and feel for the client workstations. The solutions architect has identified AWS Storage Gateway as part of the solution. Which type of storage gateway should the solutions architect provision to meet these requirements?

options.A: Volume Gateway
options.B: Tape Gateway
options.C: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.D: Amazon S3 File Gateway

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D. Amazon S3 File Gateway**.

Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed for exactly this pattern: it provides a **file interface into Amazon S3** and lets clients store and retrieve S3 objects through standard **NFS and SMB** file protocols. AWS also states that S3 File Gateway provides access to S3 objects as files or file share mount points, supports NFS and SMB directly, allows S3 data to be managed with **lifecycle policies**, and provides low-latency access through transparent local caching ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). This meets the requirements to migrate NAS data to S3, keep the same file-share experience for workstations, and use S3 Lifecycle policies for inactive data.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Volume Gateway** is not appropriate because it provides cloud-backed storage volumes mounted as **iSCSI** devices, not SMB/NFS file shares for client workstations ([Volume Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **B. Tape Gateway** is for virtual tape storage and archiving backup data to S3 Glacier storage classes, not for replacing NAS SMB/NFS shares ([Tape Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **C. Amazon FSx File Gateway** provides local access to file shares stored in **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server**, and requires an FSx for Windows File Server file system; it is not the gateway type for presenting files backed by Amazon S3 with S3 Lifecycle policies ([FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在其数据中心有一个老旧的网络附加存储 (NAS) 阵列。该 NAS 阵列向客户端工作站提供 SMB 共享和 NFS 共享。公司不想购买新的 NAS 阵列，也不想承担续订该 NAS 阵列支持合同的成本。部分数据被频繁访问，但大量数据处于非活动状态。解决方案架构师需要实施一个解决方案，将数据迁移到 Amazon S3，使用 S3 Lifecycle policies，并为客户端工作站保持相同的外观和使用体验。解决方案架构师已确定 AWS Storage Gateway 是解决方案的一部分。解决方案架构师应预置哪种类型的 storage gateway 来满足这些要求？

options.A: Volume Gateway
options.B: Tape Gateway
options.C: Amazon FSx File Gateway
options.D: Amazon S3 File Gateway

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D. Amazon S3 File Gateway**。

Amazon S3 File Gateway 正是为这种模式而设计的：它提供进入 Amazon S3 的 **文件接口**，并允许客户端通过标准 **NFS 和 SMB** 文件协议存储和检索 S3 对象。AWS 还说明，S3 File Gateway 提供以文件或文件共享挂载点形式访问 S3 对象的能力，直接支持 NFS 和 SMB，允许使用 **lifecycle policies** 管理 S3 数据，并通过透明本地缓存提供低延迟访问（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。这满足了将 NAS 数据迁移到 S3、为工作站保持相同文件共享体验，以及对非活动数据使用 S3 Lifecycle policies 的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Volume Gateway** 不合适，因为它提供作为 **iSCSI** 设备挂载的云支持存储卷，而不是面向客户端工作站的 SMB/NFS 文件共享（[Volume Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **B. Tape Gateway** 用于虚拟磁带存储以及将备份数据归档到 S3 Glacier 存储类别，而不是用于替换 NAS SMB/NFS 共享（[Tape Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **C. Amazon FSx File Gateway** 提供对存储在 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 中的文件共享的本地访问，并且需要 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统；它不是用于呈现由 Amazon S3 支持并使用 S3 Lifecycle policies 的文件的网关类型（[FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)）。

en.question: A company has an application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect has standardized the company on a particular instance family and various instance sizes based on the current needs of the company. The company wants to maximize cost savings for the application over the next 3 years. The company needs to be able to change the instance family and sizes in the next 6 months based on application popularity and usage. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Compute Savings Plan
options.B: EC2 Instance Savings Plan
options.C: Zonal Reserved Instances
options.D: Standard Reserved Instances

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Compute Savings Plan**

A Compute Savings Plan is the most cost-effective option that still meets the required flexibility. AWS states that Savings Plans can be purchased for a **1-year or 3-year period**, and that **Compute Savings Plans provide lower prices on EC2 usage regardless of instance family, instance size, OS, tenancy, or Region** ([What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)). AWS also describes Compute Savings Plans as providing the **most flexibility**, applying automatically regardless of instance family and size, and allowing a workload to move, for example, from `c5` to `m5` while continuing to receive the discounted price ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)). This matches the company’s need to save over 3 years while being able to change instance families and sizes in 6 months.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. EC2 Instance Savings Plan** – This can provide higher savings, but it requires commitment to a **specific instance family in a chosen Region**. It allows changes in instance size only **within the specified family**, so it does not meet the requirement to change instance family ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
- **C. Zonal Reserved Instances** – A zonal Reserved Instance is tied to an Availability Zone and provides a capacity reservation. AWS notes that changing from regional to zonal loses Availability Zone flexibility and instance size flexibility where applicable; Reserved Instance modifications are much more constrained than Compute Savings Plans ([Modify Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-modifying.html)).
- **D. Standard Reserved Instances** – Standard RIs do not provide the needed instance-family flexibility. AWS documentation for RI modification says instance size changes must remain in the **same instance family and generation**; for example, T2 can’t be modified to M2 or T3 ([Modify Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-modifying.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。一名解决方案架构师已根据公司当前需求，将公司标准化为某个特定实例系列以及多种实例大小。公司希望在未来 3 年内最大化该应用程序的成本节省。公司需要能够在未来 6 个月内根据应用程序的受欢迎程度和使用情况更改实例系列和大小。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: Compute Savings Plan
options.B: EC2 Instance Savings Plan
options.C: Zonal Reserved Instances
options.D: Standard Reserved Instances

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Compute Savings Plan**

Compute Savings Plan 是仍然满足所需灵活性的最具成本效益的选项。AWS 表示，Savings Plans 可以按 **1-year or 3-year period** 购买，并且 **Compute Savings Plans provide lower prices on EC2 usage regardless of instance family, instance size, OS, tenancy, or Region**（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。AWS 还将 Compute Savings Plans 描述为提供 **most flexibility**，可自动应用而不受实例系列和大小影响，并允许工作负载例如从 `c5` 移动到 `m5`，同时继续获得折扣价格（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。这符合公司希望在 3 年内节省成本，同时能够在 6 个月后更改实例系列和大小的需求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. EC2 Instance Savings Plan** – 这可以提供更高的节省，但它要求承诺使用 **所选 Region 中的特定实例系列**。它只允许在 **指定系列内** 更改实例大小，因此不满足更改实例系列的要求（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
- **C. Zonal Reserved Instances** – zonal Reserved Instance 绑定到一个 Availability Zone，并提供容量预留。AWS 指出，从 regional 更改为 zonal 会失去 Availability Zone 灵活性以及在适用情况下的实例大小灵活性；Reserved Instance 修改比 Compute Savings Plans 受限得多（[Modify Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-modifying.html)）。
- **D. Standard Reserved Instances** – Standard RIs 不提供所需的实例系列灵活性。AWS 关于 RI 修改的文档说明，实例大小更改必须保持在 **同一实例系列和代系** 内；例如，T2 不能修改为 M2 或 T3（[Modify Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-modifying.html)）。

en.question: A company collects data from a large number of participants who use wearable devices. The company stores the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table and uses applications to analyze the data. The data workload is constant and predictable. The company wants to stay at or below its forecasted budget for DynamoDB. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use provisioned mode and DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA). Reserve capacity for the forecasted workload.
options.B: Use provisioned mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs).
options.C: Use on-demand mode. Set the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) high enough to accommodate changes in the workload.
options.D: Use on-demand mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) with reserved capacity.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The workload is described as **constant and predictable**, and the company wants cost predictability. AWS states that in **provisioned mode** you specify the number of reads and writes per second required, are charged for the provisioned hourly read/write capacity, and this helps you stay at or below a defined request rate for cost predictability. AWS also says provisioned capacity is appropriate for steady workloads with predictable growth and forecastable capacity requirements ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)). For provisioned tables, throughput is specified as RCUs and WCUs ([DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/provisioned-capacity-mode.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Although provisioned mode aligns with the workload, this option combines **DynamoDB Standard-IA** with **reserved capacity**. AWS documentation states reserved capacity is **not available for tables using the DynamoDB Standard-IA table class** ([DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)). Also, Standard-IA is intended for tables where **storage is the dominant cost** and data is **infrequently accessed**, which is not stated in the scenario ([DynamoDB table classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.TableClasses.html)).
- **C:** On-demand mode does not require or allow specifying expected read/write throughput; AWS states that for on-demand tables, you **don't need to specify** how much read and write throughput the application will perform ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)). It is also not the best fit for a constant, predictable workload seeking budget control.
- **D:** This is invalid because on-demand mode does not use specified RCUs/WCUs, and AWS states reserved capacity is **not available** for on-demand capacity mode ([DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司从大量使用可穿戴设备的参与者那里收集数据。该公司将数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，并使用应用程序分析这些数据。数据工作负载是恒定且可预测的。该公司希望 DynamoDB 的成本保持在其预测预算之内或以下。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 provisioned mode 和 DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA)。为预测的工作负载预留容量。
options.B: 使用 provisioned mode。指定读取容量单位 (RCUs) 和写入容量单位 (WCUs)。
options.C: 使用 on-demand mode。将读取容量单位 (RCUs) 和写入容量单位 (WCUs) 设置得足够高，以适应工作负载的变化。
options.D: 使用 on-demand mode。使用预留容量指定读取容量单位 (RCUs) 和写入容量单位 (WCUs)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 该工作负载被描述为**恒定且可预测**，并且公司希望成本可预测。AWS 表示，在 **provisioned mode** 下，你可以指定每秒所需的读取和写入次数，按预置的每小时读/写容量收费，这有助于你保持在定义的请求速率之内或以下，以实现成本可预测性。AWS 还表示，provisioned capacity 适用于具有可预测增长和可预测容量需求的稳定工作负载（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)）。对于预置表，吞吐量以 RCUs 和 WCUs 的形式指定（[DynamoDB provisioned capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/provisioned-capacity-mode.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 虽然 provisioned mode 与该工作负载相符，但此选项将 **DynamoDB Standard-IA** 与 **reserved capacity** 结合在一起。AWS 文档说明，reserved capacity **不适用于使用 DynamoDB Standard-IA table class 的表**（[DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)）。此外，Standard-IA 适用于**存储是主要成本**且数据**不频繁访问**的表，而场景中并未说明这一点（[DynamoDB table classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.TableClasses.html)）。
- **C:** On-demand mode 不需要也不允许指定预期的读/写吞吐量；AWS 表示，对于 on-demand 表，你**不需要指定**应用程序将执行多少读写吞吐量（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)）。对于寻求预算控制的恒定、可预测工作负载，它也不是最佳选择。
- **D:** 这是无效的，因为 on-demand mode 不使用指定的 RCUs/WCUs，并且 AWS 表示 reserved capacity **不适用于** on-demand capacity mode（[DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)）。

en.question: A company stores confidential data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database in the ap-southeast-3 Region. The database is encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. The company was recently acquired and must securely share a backup of the database with the acquiring company’s AWS account in ap-southeast-3. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a database snapshot. Copy the snapshot to a new unencrypted snapshot. Share the new snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.B: Create a database snapshot. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key policy. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
options.C: Create a database snapshot that uses a different AWS managed KMS key. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key alias. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company's AWS account.
options.D: Create a database snapshot. Download the database snapshot. Upload the database snapshot to an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the acquiring company’s AWS account.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The Aurora PostgreSQL backup should remain encrypted and be shared through the RDS snapshot-sharing mechanism. AWS documentation states that encrypted DB snapshots can be shared cross-account, and that for an encrypted snapshot the source account must use a customer managed KMS key and give the target AWS account access to that key. The documented process is to create/use a customer managed key in the same Region, grant the other AWS account access, and then share the snapshot by adding the target AWS account ID to the snapshot permissions ([Sharing encrypted snapshots for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/share-encrypted-snapshot.html)). AWS KMS documentation also confirms that key policies are the primary way to control access to KMS keys and determine who can use them ([Key policies in AWS KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Incorrect. This would make confidential data unencrypted. Also, when copying an encrypted DB snapshot, AWS states that the copy **must** be encrypted; the encryption checkbox is already selected for encrypted snapshots ([Copying a DB snapshot for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CopySnapshot.html)).
- **C:** Incorrect. AWS managed/default KMS keys are not suitable for cross-account encrypted snapshot sharing; AWS specifically says you can't share a snapshot encrypted with the default KMS key of the sharing account ([Sharing encrypted snapshots for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/share-encrypted-snapshot.html)). Also, adding an account to a KMS key **alias** is not how KMS access is granted; access is controlled by key policies, IAM policies, or grants ([Key policies in AWS KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)).
- **D:** Incorrect. Downloading and uploading the snapshot to S3 is not the RDS snapshot-sharing workflow and increases exposure risk. AWS provides native encrypted snapshot sharing by granting KMS key access and sharing the snapshot permissions ([Sharing encrypted snapshots for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/share-encrypted-snapshot.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 ap-southeast-3 Region 的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库中存储机密数据。该数据库使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key 加密。该公司最近被收购，必须与收购公司的 ap-southeast-3 中的 AWS account 安全共享该数据库的备份。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建数据库快照。将该快照复制为新的未加密快照。与收购公司的 AWS account 共享新的快照。
options.B: 创建数据库快照。将收购公司的 AWS account 添加到 KMS key policy。与收购公司的 AWS account 共享该快照。
options.C: 创建使用不同 AWS managed KMS key 的数据库快照。将收购公司的 AWS account 添加到 KMS key alias。与收购公司的 AWS account 共享该快照。
options.D: 创建数据库快照。下载该数据库快照。将该数据库快照上传到 Amazon S3 bucket。更新 S3 bucket policy 以允许来自收购公司的 AWS account 的访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

Aurora PostgreSQL 备份应保持加密，并通过 RDS 快照共享机制进行共享。AWS 文档说明，加密的 DB snapshots 可以跨账户共享；对于加密快照，源账户必须使用 customer managed KMS key，并授予目标 AWS account 对该密钥的访问权限。文档化流程是在同一 Region 中创建/使用 customer managed key，授予另一个 AWS account 访问权限，然后通过将目标 AWS account ID 添加到快照权限来共享该快照（[Sharing encrypted snapshots for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/share-encrypted-snapshot.html)）。AWS KMS 文档还确认，key policies 是控制 KMS keys 访问权限并决定谁可以使用它们的主要方式（[Key policies in AWS KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 不正确。这会使机密数据变为未加密。此外，在复制加密的 DB snapshot 时，AWS 声明该副本**必须**加密；对于加密快照，加密复选框已被选中（[Copying a DB snapshot for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CopySnapshot.html)）。
- **C:** 不正确。AWS managed/default KMS keys 不适合跨账户加密快照共享；AWS 明确表示，你不能共享使用共享账户的默认 KMS key 加密的快照（[Sharing encrypted snapshots for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/share-encrypted-snapshot.html)）。此外，将账户添加到 KMS key **alias** 并不是授予 KMS 访问权限的方式；访问权限由 key policies、IAM policies 或 grants 控制（[Key policies in AWS KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)）。
- **D:** 不正确。下载快照并上传到 S3 不是 RDS 快照共享工作流，并且会增加暴露风险。AWS 提供原生的加密快照共享方式，即授予 KMS key 访问权限并共享快照权限（[Sharing encrypted snapshots for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/share-encrypted-snapshot.html)）。

en.question: A company uses a 100 GB Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server Single-AZ DB instance in the us-east-1 Region to store customer transactions. The company needs high availability and automatic recovery for the DB instance. The company must also run reports on the RDS database several times a year. The report process causes transactions to take longer than usual to post to the customers’ accounts. The company needs a solution that will improve the performance of the report process. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone.
options.C: Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica.
options.D: Migrate the database to RDS Custom.
options.E: Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and C**.

- **A is correct** because converting the RDS for SQL Server instance to a **Multi-AZ deployment** provides the required high availability and automatic recovery. AWS states that RDS for SQL Server Multi-AZ deployments provide increased availability, durability, and fault tolerance, and that RDS automatically fails over to an up-to-date secondary replica during planned maintenance or unplanned disruption without manual intervention ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_SQLServer.html)).
- **C is correct** because the reporting workload is read-heavy and is affecting production transactions. AWS lists business reporting as a read replica use case: reporting queries can run against a read replica instead of the production DB instance. AWS also states that read replicas can scale beyond the compute or I/O capacity of a single DB instance by directing excess read traffic to replicas ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect** because restoring a snapshot to another DB instance creates a point-in-time separate copy, not an automatically updated reporting target. It also does not provide automatic high availability/failover for the original DB instance.
- **D is incorrect** because migrating to RDS Custom does not inherently solve the stated needs. The requirement is standard RDS high availability plus offloading reporting reads; RDS Multi-AZ and read replicas address those directly.
- **E is incorrect** because RDS Proxy is not a reporting offload solution, and limiting reports to a maintenance window does not improve report performance while preserving normal transaction performance. The AWS-documented solution for reporting queries is to run them against a read replica ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 us-east-1 Region 使用一个 100 GB 的 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server Single-AZ DB instance 来存储客户交易。公司需要该 DB instance 具备高可用性和自动恢复能力。公司还必须每年多次在 RDS 数据库上运行报表。报表流程会导致交易过账到客户账户所需时间比平时更长。公司需要一种能够提升报表流程性能的解决方案。哪两个步骤的组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 DB instance 从 Single-AZ DB instance 修改为 Multi-AZ deployment。
options.B: 创建当前 DB instance 的快照。将该快照还原到另一个 Availability Zone 中的新 RDS deployment。
options.C: 在不同的 Availability Zone 中创建该 DB instance 的 read replica。将所有报表请求指向该 read replica。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到 RDS Custom。
options.E: 使用 RDS Proxy 将报表请求限制在维护窗口内。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A and C**。

- **A 正确**，因为将 RDS for SQL Server instance 转换为 **Multi-AZ deployment** 可提供所需的高可用性和自动恢复能力。AWS 表示，RDS for SQL Server Multi-AZ deployments 提供更高的可用性、持久性和容错能力，并且在计划内维护或计划外中断期间，RDS 会自动故障转移到最新的辅助副本，无需人工干预（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_SQLServer.html)）。
- **C 正确**，因为报表工作负载以读取为主，并且正在影响生产交易。AWS 将业务报表列为 read replica 的使用场景：报表查询可以针对 read replica 运行，而不是针对生产 DB instance 运行。AWS 还表示，通过将多余的读取流量定向到副本，read replicas 可以扩展到超过单个 DB instance 的计算或 I/O 容量（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确**，因为将快照还原到另一个 DB instance 会创建一个时间点的独立副本，而不是自动更新的报表目标。它也不会为原始 DB instance 提供自动高可用性/故障转移。
- **D 不正确**，因为迁移到 RDS Custom 并不能从本质上解决题述需求。需求是标准 RDS 高可用性，以及卸载报表读取；RDS Multi-AZ 和 read replicas 可以直接满足这些需求。
- **E 不正确**，因为 RDS Proxy 不是报表卸载解决方案，并且将报表限制在维护窗口内无法在保持正常交易性能的同时提升报表性能。AWS 文档说明的报表查询解决方案是针对 read replica 运行这些查询（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。

en.question: A company is moving its data management application to AWS. The company wants to transition to an event-driven architecture. The architecture needs to be more distributed and to use serverless concepts while performing the different aspects of the workflow. The company also wants to minimize operational overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Build out the workflow in AWS Glue. Use AWS Glue to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.
options.B: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Step Functions to invoke the workflow steps on the EC2 instances.
options.C: Build out the workflow in Amazon EventBridge. Use EventBridge to invoke AWS Lambda functions on a schedule to process the workflow steps.
options.D: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Use Step Functions to create a state machine. Use the state machine to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

AWS Step Functions is designed for this type of workflow orchestration: AWS documentation says Step Functions lets you create workflows, called **state machines**, to build **distributed applications**, automate processes, orchestrate microservices, and create data pipelines. It also states that Step Functions workflows are a series of **event-driven steps**, and that Step Functions can call AWS services such as **Lambda** to perform tasks ([AWS Step Functions Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)). AWS also documents using Step Functions to invoke Lambda functions “as part of an **event-driven serverless application**” ([Invoke an AWS Lambda function with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)). This directly matches the requirements for distributed, serverless, low-operational-overhead workflow processing.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: AWS Glue is primarily for data integration/ETL workflows, not the best general workflow orchestration service for distributed serverless application steps. The Step Functions documentation specifically notes that Step Functions can control services such as AWS Glue for ETL workflows, which reinforces Step Functions as the orchestrator rather than Glue as the workflow engine ([AWS Step Functions Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **B**: Step Functions is appropriate, but deploying the application on **Amazon EC2 instances** adds server management and operational overhead and does not align as well with the requested serverless concepts. Using Lambda with Step Functions is the documented serverless pattern ([Invoke an AWS Lambda function with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)).
- **C**: EventBridge can invoke targets on a schedule, but this option describes scheduled Lambda invocations rather than orchestrating the different workflow steps. AWS documentation describes EventBridge Scheduler as creating schedules with cron/rate expressions or one-time invocations ([Schedule a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)). That is not the same as a stateful workflow with ordered steps, branching, retries, and task orchestration.

Therefore, **D** is the solution that best satisfies the event-driven, distributed, serverless workflow requirement with minimal operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其数据管理应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司希望过渡到事件驱动架构。该架构需要更加分布式，并在执行工作流的不同方面时使用无服务器概念。该公司还希望最大限度地减少运营开销。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Glue 中构建工作流。使用 AWS Glue 调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理工作流步骤。
options.B: 在 AWS Step Functions 中构建工作流。在 Amazon EC2 实例上部署应用程序。使用 Step Functions 调用 EC2 实例上的工作流步骤。
options.C: 在 Amazon EventBridge 中构建工作流。使用 EventBridge 按计划调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理工作流步骤。
options.D: 在 AWS Step Functions 中构建工作流。使用 Step Functions 创建状态机。使用状态机调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理工作流步骤。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

AWS Step Functions 正是为这种工作流编排而设计的：AWS 文档说明，Step Functions 允许你创建称为 **state machines** 的工作流，以构建 **distributed applications**、自动化流程、编排微服务并创建数据管道。文档还说明，Step Functions 工作流是一系列 **event-driven steps**，并且 Step Functions 可以调用 AWS 服务（例如 **Lambda**）来执行任务（[AWS Step Functions Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。AWS 还记录了使用 Step Functions 调用 Lambda 函数，作为 **event-driven serverless application** 的一部分（[Invoke an AWS Lambda function with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)）。这直接符合对分布式、无服务器、低运营开销工作流处理的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：AWS Glue 主要用于数据集成/ETL 工作流，而不是用于分布式无服务器应用程序步骤的最佳通用工作流编排服务。Step Functions 文档特别指出，Step Functions 可以控制 AWS Glue 等服务来处理 ETL 工作流，这进一步说明 Step Functions 是编排器，而不是将 Glue 作为工作流引擎（[AWS Step Functions Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **B**：Step Functions 是合适的，但在 **Amazon EC2 instances** 上部署应用程序会增加服务器管理和运营开销，并且不太符合所要求的无服务器概念。将 Lambda 与 Step Functions 结合使用是文档中说明的无服务器模式（[Invoke an AWS Lambda function with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)）。
- **C**：EventBridge 可以按计划调用目标，但此选项描述的是计划性的 Lambda 调用，而不是编排不同的工作流步骤。AWS 文档将 EventBridge Scheduler 描述为使用 cron/rate 表达式或一次性调用来创建计划（[Schedule a Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)）。这不同于具有有序步骤、分支、重试和任务编排的有状态工作流。因此，**D** 是最能满足事件驱动、分布式、无服务器工作流需求并最大限度降低运营开销的解决方案。

en.question: A company is designing the network for an online multi-player game. The game uses the UDP networking protocol and will be deployed in eight AWS Regions. The network architecture needs to minimize latency and packet loss to give end users a high-quality gaming experience. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Setup a transit gateway in each Region. Create inter-Region peering attachments between each transit gateway.
options.B: Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region.
options.C: Set up Amazon CloudFront with UDP turned on. Configure an origin in each Region.
options.D: Set up a VPC peering mesh between each Region. Turn on UDP for each VPC.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B. Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region.**

AWS Global Accelerator is designed for this scenario: it improves performance for local and global users and, with a standard accelerator, directs traffic over the AWS global network to endpoints in the nearest/optimal Region. AWS states that standard accelerators use the AWS global network to route traffic to the optimal regional endpoint based on health, client location, and policies, and endpoints can be in one or multiple Regions ([What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). AWS also describes the network path as well-monitored, congestion-free, and redundant, with traffic routed over the optimum network path for lower latency and increased throughput ([How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)). Global Accelerator setup includes listeners that process inbound connections based on specified protocol and port, and regional endpoint groups that route listener traffic to endpoints ([How to get started with AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-get-started.html)); the getting started steps include choosing the protocol for the listener and adding endpoint groups by Region ([Getting started with a standard accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/getting-started-standard.html)). This matches the UDP, multi-Region, low-latency gaming requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Transit Gateway inter-Region peering** connects networks/VPCs between Regions, but it is not an edge-based global traffic acceleration service for internet users and does not choose the optimal regional game endpoint for players.
- **C. CloudFront with UDP turned on** is invalid for this use case. CloudFront is for delivering content from origins such as S3 buckets or HTTP servers; AWS describes objects as content that can be served over HTTP ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). It is not a UDP game networking accelerator.
- **D. VPC peering mesh with UDP turned on** is also not a user-facing global acceleration solution. VPC peering connects VPC networks; there is no “turn on UDP” feature that provides low-latency global routing for end users, and a full mesh across eight Regions would add complexity without solving internet path optimization.

zh.question: 一家公司正在为一款在线多人游戏设计网络。该游戏使用 UDP 网络协议，并将部署在八个 AWS Regions 中。网络架构需要尽可能降低延迟和数据包丢失，以便为最终用户提供高质量的游戏体验。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在每个 Region 中设置一个 transit gateway。在每个 transit gateway 之间创建跨 Region 对等连接挂载。
options.B: 设置 AWS Global Accelerator，并在每个 Region 中配置 UDP 侦听器和端点组。
options.C: 设置 Amazon CloudFront 并开启 UDP。在每个 Region 中配置一个源站。
options.D: 在每个 Region 之间设置 VPC 对等连接网格。为每个 VPC 开启 UDP。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B. 设置 AWS Global Accelerator，并在每个 Region 中配置 UDP 侦听器和端点组。**

AWS Global Accelerator 正是为此类场景而设计的：它可以提升本地和全球用户的性能，并且通过标准加速器，将流量经由 AWS 全球网络定向到最近/最佳 Region 中的端点。AWS 表示，标准加速器使用 AWS 全球网络，根据运行状况、客户端位置和策略将流量路由到最佳区域端点，并且端点可以位于一个或多个 Regions 中（[What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。AWS 还将该网络路径描述为受到良好监控、无拥塞且冗余的路径，并通过最佳网络路径路由流量，以降低延迟并提高吞吐量（[How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)）。Global Accelerator 设置包括侦听器和区域端点组，侦听器会根据指定协议和端口处理入站连接，区域端点组会将侦听器流量路由到端点（[How to get started with AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-get-started.html)）；入门步骤包括为侦听器选择协议，以及按 Region 添加端点组（[Getting started with a standard accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/getting-started-standard.html)）。这符合 UDP、多 Region、低延迟游戏的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Transit Gateway 跨 Region 对等连接** 可以连接 Regions 之间的网络/VPC，但它不是面向互联网用户的基于边缘的全球流量加速服务，也不会为玩家选择最佳区域游戏端点。
- **C. 开启 UDP 的 CloudFront** 对于此使用场景无效。CloudFront 用于从 S3 存储桶或 HTTP 服务器等源站交付内容；AWS 将对象描述为可以通过 HTTP 提供的内容（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。它不是 UDP 游戏网络加速器。
- **D. 开启 UDP 的 VPC 对等连接网格** 也不是面向用户的全球加速解决方案。VPC 对等连接用于连接 VPC 网络；不存在能够为最终用户提供低延迟全球路由的“开启 UDP”功能，并且在八个 Regions 之间建立全网格会增加复杂性，却无法解决互联网路径优化问题。

en.question: A company hosts a three-tier web application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. The web application uses a self-managed MySQL database that is hosted on an EC2 instance to store data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The MySQL database currently uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volume. The company expects traffic of 1,000 IOPS for both reads and writes at peak traffic. The company wants to minimize any disruptions, stabilize performance, and reduce costs while retaining the capacity for double the IOPS. The company wants to move the database tier to a fully managed solution that is highly available and fault tolerant. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with an io2 Block Express EBS volume.
options.B: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with a General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers.
options.D: Use two large EC2 instances to host the database in active-passive mode.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The company needs a fully managed MySQL database that is highly available/fault tolerant, can handle peak 1,000 read IOPS and 1,000 write IOPS, and has capacity for double the IOPS cost-effectively. Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments provide high availability and failover by automatically maintaining a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone, helping protect against DB instance failure and Availability Zone disruption ([Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).

For storage, RDS General Purpose SSD gp2 is sufficient and cheaper than Provisioned IOPS for this workload. AWS states that gp2 baseline performance is **3 IOPS per GiB**, and specifically that a **1,000 GiB** gp2 volume has **3,000 IOPS** baseline performance ([Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)). That exceeds the requirement to retain capacity for double the peak 1,000 IOPS workload (2,000 IOPS), so Multi-AZ RDS for MySQL with gp2 is the most cost-effective listed managed solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ with io2 Block Express**: This is fully managed and highly available, but not the most cost-effective for only 2,000 IOPS capacity. Provisioned IOPS storage is intended for I/O-intensive workloads requiring low latency and consistent throughput, and AWS states you are charged for provisioned resources whether or not you use them ([Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)). gp2 already meets the IOPS requirement.
- **C. S3 Intelligent-Tiering**: Amazon S3 is object storage, not a managed relational MySQL database tier, so it does not meet the requirement to move the MySQL database to a fully managed database solution.
- **D. Two large EC2 instances in active-passive mode**: This remains self-managed on EC2, requiring the company to manage database replication, failover, patching, and operations. It does not provide the fully managed RDS Multi-AZ capability described in the AWS documentation.

zh.question: 一家公司在单个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个三层 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序使用托管在 EC2 实例上的自管理 MySQL 数据库，将数据存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。该 MySQL 数据库当前使用 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS 卷。该公司预计在流量高峰时，读取和写入都需要 1,000 IOPS。该公司希望最大限度减少任何中断、稳定性能并降低成本，同时保留双倍 IOPS 的容量。该公司希望将数据库层迁移到一个完全托管且高度可用、具有容错能力的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例的 Multi-AZ 部署，并使用 io2 Block Express EBS 卷。
options.B: 使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例的 Multi-AZ 部署，并使用 General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS 卷。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 访问层。
options.D: 使用两个大型 EC2 实例以主动-被动模式托管数据库。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该公司需要一个完全托管的 MySQL 数据库，该数据库高度可用/具有容错能力，能够处理峰值 1,000 读取 IOPS 和 1,000 写入 IOPS，并且以经济高效的方式具备双倍 IOPS 的容量。Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例部署通过在不同 Availability Zone 中自动维护同步备用副本来提供高可用性和故障转移，有助于防范 DB 实例故障和 Availability Zone 中断（[Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。对于存储，RDS General Purpose SSD gp2 对此工作负载而言足够，并且比 Provisioned IOPS 更便宜。AWS 说明 gp2 基准性能为 **每 GiB 3 IOPS**，并特别指出 **1,000 GiB** gp2 卷具有 **3,000 IOPS** 的基准性能（[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。这超过了为峰值 1,000 IOPS 工作负载保留双倍容量（2,000 IOPS）的要求，因此带有 gp2 的 Multi-AZ RDS for MySQL 是列出的托管解决方案中最具成本效益的方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ with io2 Block Express**：这是完全托管且高度可用的，但对于仅需 2,000 IOPS 容量而言并不是最具成本效益的。Provisioned IOPS 存储面向需要低延迟和一致吞吐量的 I/O 密集型工作负载，并且 AWS 说明无论你是否使用，都会按预置资源收费（[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。gp2 已经满足 IOPS 要求。
- **C. S3 Intelligent-Tiering**：Amazon S3 是对象存储，而不是托管的关系型 MySQL 数据库层，因此不满足将 MySQL 数据库迁移到完全托管数据库解决方案的要求。
- **D. Two large EC2 instances in active-passive mode**：这仍然是在 EC2 上自管理，需要公司管理数据库复制、故障转移、修补和运维。它不提供 AWS 文档中所描述的完全托管 RDS Multi-AZ 能力。

en.question: A company hosts a serverless application on AWS. The application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The company notices an increase in application errors that result from database connection timeouts during times of peak traffic or unpredictable traffic. The company needs a solution that reduces the application failures with the least amount of change to the code. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Reduce the Lambda concurrency rate.
options.B: Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance.
options.C: Resize the RDS DB instance class to accept more connections.
options.D: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand scaling.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance.**

RDS Proxy is designed for this exact serverless/RDS connection-scaling problem. AWS states that RDS Proxy lets applications **pool and share database connections** to improve scalability, handles **unpredictable surges in database traffic**, reuses connections from a pool, and can queue/throttle requests so the application can continue to scale instead of abruptly failing or overwhelming the database. AWS also notes that RDS Proxy can be enabled for most applications with **no code changes**, which matches the requirement for the least amount of code change ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Reduce the Lambda concurrency rate** — This could reduce pressure on the database, but it limits application throughput and can cause Lambda throttling rather than solving connection pooling. RDS Proxy is the AWS-recommended way to manage client/database connections because client connections terminate at the proxy while database connections are managed by RDS Proxy ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)).
- **C. Resize the RDS DB instance class to accept more connections** — Scaling the instance might increase available database resources, but it does not address the core issue of many short-lived or bursty Lambda connections. RDS Proxy specifically avoids the memory and CPU overhead of opening new database connections during traffic surges ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)).
- **D. Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand scaling** — This would require a major database and application redesign from PostgreSQL to a different data model, so it does not meet the “least amount of change to the code” requirement. RDS Proxy is compatible with supported RDS engines and can be enabled for most applications with no code changes ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管一个无服务器应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库。公司注意到，在流量高峰或流量不可预测期间，由于数据库连接超时导致的应用程序错误有所增加。公司需要一种解决方案，以最少的代码更改减少应用程序故障。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 降低 Lambda 并发率。
options.B: 在 RDS DB 实例上启用 RDS Proxy。
options.C: 调整 RDS DB 实例类的大小以接受更多连接。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到具有按需扩展的 Amazon DynamoDB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 在 RDS DB 实例上启用 RDS Proxy。**

RDS Proxy 正是为这种无服务器/RDS 连接扩展问题而设计的。AWS 表示，RDS Proxy 允许应用程序**池化并共享数据库连接**以提高可扩展性，处理**数据库流量中不可预测的激增**，从连接池中复用连接，并且可以对请求进行排队/限流，使应用程序能够继续扩展，而不是突然失败或压垮数据库。AWS 还指出，对于大多数应用程序，可以在**无需代码更改**的情况下启用 RDS Proxy，这符合最少代码更改的要求（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. 降低 Lambda 并发率** — 这可能会减轻数据库压力，但它会限制应用程序吞吐量，并可能导致 Lambda 节流，而不是解决连接池问题。RDS Proxy 是 AWS 推荐的管理客户端/数据库连接的方式，因为客户端连接终止于代理，而数据库连接由 RDS Proxy 管理（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。
- **C. 调整 RDS DB 实例类的大小以接受更多连接** — 扩展实例可能会增加可用数据库资源，但它并不能解决许多短生命周期或突发性 Lambda 连接这一核心问题。RDS Proxy 专门避免在流量激增期间打开新数据库连接所产生的内存和 CPU 开销（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。
- **D. 将数据库迁移到具有按需扩展的 Amazon DynamoDB** — 这需要从 PostgreSQL 到不同数据模型的重大数据库和应用程序重新设计，因此不满足“最少代码更改”的要求。RDS Proxy 与受支持的 RDS 引擎兼容，并且对于大多数应用程序可以在无需代码更改的情况下启用（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating an old application to AWS. The application runs a batch job every hour and is CPU intensive. The batch job takes 15 minutes on average with an on-premises server. The server has 64 virtual CPU (vCPU) and 512 GiB of memory. Which solution will run the batch job within 15 minutes with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda with functional scaling.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate.
options.C: Use Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling.
options.D: Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.**

AWS Batch is designed for batch computing workloads and removes the operational burden of configuring and managing the required infrastructure. AWS states that Batch is a fully managed service that automatically provisions compute resources and optimizes workload distribution based on the quantity and scale of workloads, and that it supports high-scale, compute-intensive workloads on Amazon EC2 instances and Fargate resources ([AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)). With a managed compute environment, AWS Batch can manage the capacity and instance types, and can use EC2 On-Demand or Spot Instances ([managed compute environments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/managed_compute_environments.html)). This best matches an hourly, CPU-intensive batch job that needs EC2-sized resources with low operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Lambda with functional scaling** — Lambda has a maximum function timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)** and AWS warns that setting a timeout close to the average duration increases the risk of unexpected timeout. Also, Lambda function memory is limited to **10,240 MB**, with CPU allocated proportionally, far below a 64 vCPU / 512 GiB server profile ([Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html), [Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)).
- **B. Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate** — Fargate reduces server management, but an individual Fargate task is limited to valid CPU/memory combinations up to **16 vCPU and 120 GB** memory, which is far below the stated 64 vCPU / 512 GiB server profile ([Fargate task CPU and memory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-tasks-services.html)). Meeting the requirement would likely require refactoring/parallelizing the job, adding operational complexity.
- **C. Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling** — Lightsail is not the best fit for managed batch scheduling and automatic provisioning for hourly compute-intensive jobs. Lightsail bundles are fixed instance plans, whereas AWS Batch provides managed job scheduling and compute provisioning for batch workloads ([Lightsail bundles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lightsail/latest/userguide/amazon-lightsail-bundles.html), [AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个旧应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序每小时运行一次批处理作业，并且是 CPU 密集型的。该批处理作业在本地服务器上平均需要 15 分钟。该服务器有 64 个虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 和 512 GiB 内存。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销在 15 分钟内运行该批处理作业？

options.A: 使用带有功能扩展的 AWS Lambda。
options.B: 使用带有 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.C: 使用带有 AWS Auto Scaling 的 Amazon Lightsail。
options.D: 在 Amazon EC2 上使用 AWS Batch。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.**

AWS Batch 专为批处理计算工作负载而设计，并消除了配置和管理所需基础设施的运营负担。AWS 表示，Batch 是一项完全托管的服务，可根据工作负载的数量和规模自动预置计算资源并优化工作负载分布，并且它支持在 Amazon EC2 实例和 Fargate 资源上运行大规模、计算密集型工作负载（[AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)）。借助托管计算环境，AWS Batch 可以管理容量和实例类型，并且可以使用 EC2 On-Demand 或 Spot Instances（[managed compute environments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/managed_compute_environments.html)）。这最符合一个每小时运行一次、CPU 密集型、需要 EC2 级别资源且运营开销低的批处理作业。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. AWS Lambda with functional scaling** — Lambda 的最大函数超时时间为 **900 秒（15 分钟）**，并且 AWS 警告说，将超时时间设置得接近平均持续时间会增加意外超时的风险。此外，Lambda function 内存限制为 **10,240 MB**，CPU 按比例分配，远低于 64 vCPU / 512 GiB 的服务器配置文件（[Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html), [Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)）。
- **B. Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate** — Fargate 减少了服务器管理，但单个 Fargate task 受有效 CPU/内存组合限制，最高为 **16 vCPU 和 120 GB** 内存，远低于所述的 64 vCPU / 512 GiB 服务器配置文件（[Fargate task CPU and memory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-tasks-services.html)）。满足该要求很可能需要重构/并行化作业，从而增加运营复杂性。
- **C. Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling** — Lightsail 并不是用于每小时运行的计算密集型作业的托管批处理调度和自动预置的最佳选择。Lightsail bundles 是固定的实例计划，而 AWS Batch 为批处理工作负载提供托管作业调度和计算预置（[Lightsail bundles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lightsail/latest/userguide/amazon-lightsail-bundles.html), [AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)）。

en.question: A company stores its data objects in Amazon S3 Standard storage. A solutions architect has found that 75% of the data is rarely accessed after 30 days. The company needs all the data to remain immediately accessible with the same high availability and resiliency, but the company wants to minimize storage costs. Which storage solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the data objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.
options.B: Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.C: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.D: Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.**

S3 Standard-IA is designed for long-lived, infrequently accessed data and provides millisecond access similar to S3 Standard. AWS states that S3 Standard-IA stores data redundantly across multiple geographically separated Availability Zones and is resilient to the loss of an Availability Zone, offering greater availability and resiliency than S3 One Zone-IA. It is also suitable for objects stored for at least 30 days, matching the requirement to transition rarely accessed data after 30 days while reducing storage cost ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days** — Incorrect. S3 Glacier Deep Archive is for archival data and is **not available for real-time access**; the comparison table lists retrieval times of hours and says objects must be restored before access, so it does not meet the immediate-access requirement ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **C. S3 One Zone-IA after 30 days** — Incorrect. Although it provides millisecond access and lower cost, AWS states that S3 One Zone-IA stores data in only one Availability Zone, is less available and less resilient than S3 Standard-IA, and is not resilient to physical loss of the Availability Zone. The question requires the same high availability and resiliency ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **D. S3 One Zone-IA immediately** — Incorrect for the same availability/resiliency reason as option C. Additionally, S3 Standard-IA and S3 One Zone-IA have a 30-day minimum storage duration, and the scenario identifies data as rarely accessed only after 30 days ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将其数据对象存储在 Amazon S3 Standard 存储中。一名解决方案架构师发现，75% 的数据在 30 天后很少被访问。公司需要所有数据保持可立即访问，并具有相同的高可用性和弹性，但公司希望尽可能降低存储成本。哪种存储解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 30 天后将数据对象移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.B: 在 30 天后将数据对象移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
options.C: 在 30 天后将数据对象移动到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。
options.D: 立即将数据对象移动到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 在 30 天后将数据对象移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。**

S3 Standard-IA 专为长期存在、不常访问的数据而设计，并提供类似于 S3 Standard 的毫秒级访问。AWS 表示，S3 Standard-IA 会在多个地理位置分隔的 Availability Zones 中冗余存储数据，并且能够抵御一个 Availability Zone 的丢失，相比 S3 One Zone-IA 提供更高的可用性和弹性。它还适用于至少存储 30 天的对象，这与在 30 天后转换很少访问的数据以降低存储成本的要求相匹配（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 30 天后使用 S3 Glacier Deep Archive** — 不正确。S3 Glacier Deep Archive 适用于归档数据，并且**不支持实时访问**；对比表列出的检索时间为数小时，并说明对象必须先还原才能访问，因此不满足立即访问要求（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **C. 30 天后使用 S3 One Zone-IA** — 不正确。尽管它提供毫秒级访问和更低成本，但 AWS 表示 S3 One Zone-IA 仅将数据存储在一个 Availability Zone 中，与 S3 Standard-IA 相比可用性和弹性更低，并且无法抵御 Availability Zone 的物理丢失。题目要求相同的高可用性和弹性（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **D. 立即使用 S3 One Zone-IA** — 不正确，原因与选项 C 相同，都是可用性/弹性不满足要求。此外，S3 Standard-IA 和 S3 One Zone-IA 有 30 天的最短存储期限，并且该场景指出数据只有在 30 天后才被识别为很少访问（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A gaming company is moving its public scoreboard from a data center to the AWS Cloud. The company uses Amazon EC2 Windows Server instances behind an Application Load Balancer to host its dynamic application. The company needs a highly available storage solution for the application. The application consists of static files and dynamic server-side code. Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to cache objects at the edge.
options.B: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache objects at the edge.
options.C: Store the server-side code on Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.D: Store the server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the FSx for Windows File Server volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
options.E: Store the server-side code on a General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and D**.

- **A is correct**: Static files should be offloaded from the EC2 fleet to Amazon S3 and delivered through CloudFront. AWS documentation states that CloudFront speeds up distribution of static and dynamic web content, can use an **Amazon S3 bucket** as an origin, and caches copies of objects in multiple edge locations for increased reliability and availability ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **D is correct**: The application runs on **Windows Server** instances and needs shared, highly available storage for server-side code. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers, native Windows compatibility, SMB access, and is suitable for Windows workloads including web serving. AWS also states that Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server provides high availability and failover support across Availability Zones ([FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect**: ElastiCache is an in-memory data store/cache for application caching, not an edge CDN for static objects. AWS describes ElastiCache as a distributed in-memory data store or cache environment, whereas CloudFront is the AWS service that uses edge locations for content delivery ([ElastiCache](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html), [CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **C is incorrect**: Amazon EFS is mounted with EFS/NFS tooling and AWS’s EC2 mounting procedure is for **EC2 Linux instances**; it is not the best native shared file service for a Windows Server application. FSx for Windows File Server is specifically built for Windows file storage and SMB access ([EFS Linux mount helper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-mount-helper-ec2-linux.html), [FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).
- **E is incorrect**: A gp2 EBS volume is not an appropriate highly available shared file system for multiple EC2 instances. EBS Multi-Attach is limited to Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes, not gp2, and Multi-Attach volumes are limited to instances in the same Availability Zone; standard file systems are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

zh.question: 一家游戏公司正在将其公共计分板从数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 Windows Server 实例来托管其动态应用程序。该公司需要一个用于该应用程序的高可用存储解决方案。该应用程序由静态文件和动态服务器端代码组成。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将静态文件存储在 Amazon S3 上。使用 Amazon CloudFront 在边缘缓存对象。
options.B: 将静态文件存储在 Amazon S3 上。使用 Amazon ElastiCache 在边缘缓存对象。
options.C: 将服务器端代码存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 上。将 EFS 卷挂载到每个 EC2 实例上以共享这些文件。
options.D: 将服务器端代码存储在 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 上。将 FSx for Windows File Server 卷挂载到每个 EC2 实例上以共享这些文件。
options.E: 将服务器端代码存储在 General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上。将 EBS 卷挂载到每个 EC2 实例上以共享这些文件。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A and D**。

- **A is correct**：静态文件应从 EC2 实例群卸载到 Amazon S3，并通过 CloudFront 交付。AWS 文档指出，CloudFront 可以加速静态和动态 Web 内容的分发，可以使用 **Amazon S3 bucket** 作为源，并在多个边缘站点缓存对象副本，以提高可靠性和可用性（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **D is correct**：该应用程序运行在 **Windows Server** 实例上，并且需要用于服务器端代码的共享高可用存储。Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 提供完全托管的 Microsoft Windows 文件服务器、原生 Windows 兼容性、SMB 访问，并适用于包括 Web 服务在内的 Windows 工作负载。AWS 还指出，Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server 提供跨 Availability Zones 的高可用性和故障转移支持（[FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B is incorrect**：ElastiCache 是用于应用程序缓存的内存中数据存储/缓存，而不是用于静态对象的边缘 CDN。AWS 将 ElastiCache 描述为分布式内存中数据存储或缓存环境，而 CloudFront 才是使用边缘站点进行内容交付的 AWS 服务（[ElastiCache](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html), [CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **C is incorrect**：Amazon EFS 使用 EFS/NFS 工具挂载，并且 AWS 的 EC2 挂载过程适用于 **EC2 Linux instances**；它不是 Windows Server 应用程序的最佳原生共享文件服务。FSx for Windows File Server 专为 Windows 文件存储和 SMB 访问而构建（[EFS Linux mount helper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-mount-helper-ec2-linux.html), [FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。
- **E is incorrect**：gp2 EBS 卷并不是适用于多个 EC2 实例的高可用共享文件系统。EBS Multi-Attach 仅限于 Provisioned IOPS SSD 卷，而不包括 gp2，并且 Multi-Attach 卷仅限于同一 Availability Zone 中的实例；标准文件系统并非设计用于多个服务器同时访问（[EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

en.question: A social media company runs its application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB is the origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The application has more than a billion images stored in an Amazon S3 bucket and processes thousands of images each second. The company wants to resize the images dynamically and serve appropriate formats to clients. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Install an external image management library on an EC2 instance. Use the image management library to process the images.
options.B: Create a CloudFront origin request policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.
options.C: Use a Lambda@Edge function with an external image management library. Associate the Lambda@Edge function with the CloudFront behaviors that serve the images.
options.D: Create a CloudFront response headers policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Lambda@Edge is designed to run code in response to CloudFront events and customize the content CloudFront delivers. AWS states that Lambda@Edge functions run closer to viewers **without provisioning or managing servers** and scale automatically from a few requests per day to **thousands per second** ([Customize at the edge with Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-at-the-edge.html)). AWS also identifies Lambda@Edge as appropriate for functions that depend on **third-party libraries** and need more processing resources, and it supports origin request/origin response events in addition to viewer events ([Differences between CloudFront Functions and Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-functions-choosing.html)). Associating the function with CloudFront behaviors that serve images lets the code dynamically resize/transform images and choose formats at the edge.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Running an image library on EC2 would require provisioning, scaling, patching, and managing instances. This is higher operational overhead than Lambda@Edge, which runs without managing servers ([Customize at the edge with Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-at-the-edge.html)).
- **B:** A CloudFront **origin request policy** only controls which viewer request values—headers, cookies, and query strings—CloudFront includes in requests to the origin. It does not execute code or resize images ([Understand origin request policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/origin-request-understand-origin-request-policy.html)).
- **D:** A CloudFront **response headers policy** only specifies HTTP headers that CloudFront adds or removes in responses. It cannot perform image processing or dynamic resizing ([Create response headers policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/creating-response-headers-policies.html)).

zh.question: 一家社交媒体公司在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其应用程序。该 ALB 是 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源站。该应用程序在 Amazon S3 存储桶中存储了超过十亿张图像，并且每秒处理数千张图像。该公司希望动态调整图像大小，并向客户端提供适当的格式。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 EC2 实例上安装外部图像管理库。使用该图像管理库处理图像。
options.B: 创建 CloudFront origin request policy。使用该策略根据请求中的 User-Agent HTTP 标头自动调整图像大小并提供适当的格式。
options.C: 使用带有外部图像管理库的 Lambda@Edge 函数。将该 Lambda@Edge 函数与提供图像的 CloudFront 行为关联。
options.D: 创建 CloudFront response headers policy。使用该策略根据请求中的 User-Agent HTTP 标头自动调整图像大小并提供适当的格式。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Lambda@Edge 旨在响应 CloudFront 事件运行代码，并自定义 CloudFront 交付的内容。AWS 表示，Lambda@Edge 函数在更靠近查看器的位置运行，**无需预置或管理服务器**，并且可从每天少量请求自动扩展到**每秒数千个请求**（[Customize at the edge with Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-at-the-edge.html)）。AWS 还指出，Lambda@Edge 适用于依赖**第三方库**并需要更多处理资源的函数，并且除了查看器事件之外，它还支持源站请求/源站响应事件（[Differences between CloudFront Functions and Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-functions-choosing.html)）。将该函数与提供图像的 CloudFront 行为关联，可让代码在边缘动态调整图像大小/转换图像，并选择格式。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** 在 EC2 上运行图像库需要预置、扩展、修补和管理实例。与无需管理服务器即可运行的 Lambda@Edge 相比，这会带来更高的运营开销（[Customize at the edge with Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-at-the-edge.html)）。
- **B:** CloudFront **origin request policy** 仅控制 CloudFront 在发送到源站的请求中包含哪些查看器请求值——标头、Cookie 和查询字符串。它不会执行代码或调整图像大小（[Understand origin request policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/origin-request-understand-origin-request-policy.html)）。
- **D:** CloudFront **response headers policy** 仅指定 CloudFront 在响应中添加或删除的 HTTP 标头。它无法执行图像处理或动态调整大小（[Create response headers policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/creating-response-headers-policies.html)）。

en.question: A hospital needs to store patient records in an Amazon S3 bucket. The hospital’s compliance team must ensure that all protected health information (PHI) is encrypted in transit and at rest. The compliance team must administer the encryption key for data at rest. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a public SSL/TLS certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Associate the certificate with Amazon S3. Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.
options.B: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Assign the compliance team to manage the SSE-S3 keys.
options.C: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.
options.D: Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Use Amazon Macie to protect the sensitive data that is stored in Amazon S3. Assign the compliance team to manage Macie.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The requirement has two parts: encrypt PHI **in transit** and **at rest**, with the compliance team administering the at-rest key. For in-transit protection, Amazon S3 documentation states that you can enforce HTTPS-only access with an S3 bucket policy using the `aws:SecureTransport` global condition key, which checks whether the request was sent through HTTPS/TLS ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)). For at-rest encryption with administrator-controlled keys, S3 SSE-KMS can use a **customer managed key**; AWS notes that creating a customer managed key gives more flexibility and control, including the ability to create, rotate, disable, define access controls, and audit the key ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)). Therefore, enforcing HTTPS with `aws:SecureTransport` and using SSE-KMS with compliance-team-managed KMS keys meets all requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** ACM certificates are not the mechanism to associate TLS enforcement directly with an S3 bucket for this requirement. S3 documents enforcing encryption in transit through policy mechanisms such as bucket policies and `aws:SecureTransport`, not by associating an ACM public certificate with S3 ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)).
- **B:** `aws:SecureTransport` satisfies encryption in transit, but SSE-S3 uses **Amazon S3 managed keys**. AWS documentation describes SSE-S3 as encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys and the default S3 encryption configuration, not customer-administered keys ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)). This does not meet the requirement for the compliance team to administer the encryption key.
- **D:** Amazon Macie helps discover, monitor, and report on sensitive data and S3 security/access findings; it does not provide the required at-rest encryption key administration for S3 objects ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)).

zh.question: 一家医院需要将患者记录存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。该医院的合规团队必须确保所有受保护的健康信息 (PHI) 在传输中和静态存储时都经过加密。合规团队必须管理用于静态数据的加密密钥。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 中创建一个公共 SSL/TLS 证书。将该证书与 Amazon S3 关联。为每个 S3 bucket 配置默认加密，以使用采用 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。指派合规团队管理 KMS keys。
options.B: 在 S3 bucket policies 上使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件，仅允许通过 HTTPS (TLS) 的加密连接。为每个 S3 bucket 配置默认加密，以使用采用 S3 托管加密密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE-S3)。指派合规团队管理 SSE-S3 keys。
