options.C: 在 S3 bucket policies 上使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件，仅允许通过 HTTPS (TLS) 的加密连接。为每个 S3 bucket 配置默认加密，以使用采用 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。指派合规团队管理 KMS keys。
options.D: 在 S3 bucket policies 上使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件，仅允许通过 HTTPS (TLS) 的加密连接。使用 Amazon Macie 保护存储在 Amazon S3 中的敏感数据。指派合规团队管理 Macie。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

该要求包含两部分：对 PHI 进行**传输中**加密和**静态**加密，并由合规团队管理静态加密密钥。对于传输中保护，Amazon S3 文档说明，你可以使用带有 `aws:SecureTransport` 全局条件键的 S3 bucket policy 来强制仅允许 HTTPS 访问，该条件键会检查请求是否通过 HTTPS/TLS 发送（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)）。对于使用管理员可控密钥的静态加密，S3 SSE-KMS 可以使用 **customer managed key**；AWS 指出，创建 customer managed key 可提供更多灵活性和控制能力，包括创建、轮换、禁用、定义访问控制以及审计该密钥的能力（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)）。因此，使用 `aws:SecureTransport` 强制 HTTPS，并使用由合规团队管理的 KMS keys 的 SSE-KMS，可以满足所有要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** ACM certificates 不是为此要求将 TLS 强制机制直接与 S3 bucket 关联的机制。S3 文档说明通过 bucket policies 和 `aws:SecureTransport` 等策略机制来强制传输中加密，而不是通过将 ACM public certificate 与 S3 关联来实现（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)）。
- **B:** `aws:SecureTransport` 满足传输中加密要求，但 SSE-S3 使用 **Amazon S3 managed keys**。AWS 文档将 SSE-S3 描述为使用 Amazon S3 managed keys 和默认 S3 加密配置的加密，而不是由客户管理的密钥（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)）。这不满足合规团队管理加密密钥的要求。
- **D:** Amazon Macie 帮助发现、监控和报告敏感数据以及 S3 安全/访问发现结果；它不提供 S3 objects 所需的静态加密密钥管理（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。

en.question: A company uses Amazon API Gateway to run a private gateway with two REST APIs in the same VPC. The BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service to ensure that enough funds are available before a stock can be purchased. The company has noticed in the VPC flow logs that the BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service over the internet instead of through the VPC. A solutions architect must implement a solution so that the APIs communicate through the VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?

options.A: Add an X-API-Key header in the HTTP header for authorization.
options.B: Use an interface endpoint.
options.C: Use a gateway endpoint.
options.D: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue between the two REST APIs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use an interface endpoint.**

API Gateway private REST APIs are accessed from an Amazon VPC by using VPC endpoints. AWS specifically documents creating an **interface VPC endpoint** for API Gateway by selecting the `execute-api` service with type **Interface**; the CLI example uses `--vpc-endpoint-type Interface` and `--service-name com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api` ([Create a private API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-api-create.html)). AWS also recommends using a single VPC endpoint to access multiple private APIs and enabling private DNS so the API can be invoked within the VPC without extra headers, minimizing code changes ([Private REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-apis.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A. Add an X-API-Key header** — An API key is for API access control/authorization behavior, not network path selection. It does not force traffic to remain inside the VPC.
- **C. Use a gateway endpoint** — Gateway VPC endpoints are for **Amazon S3 and DynamoDB** connectivity and do not use AWS PrivateLink; they are not the endpoint type used for API Gateway private APIs ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).
- **D. Add an SQS queue between the APIs** — This would change the application communication pattern from synchronous REST calls to asynchronous messaging, requiring more code and architecture changes, and it does not directly solve private invocation of API Gateway REST APIs through the VPC.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 在同一个 VPC 中运行一个包含两个 REST API 的私有网关。BuyStock RESTful Web 服务会调用 CheckFunds RESTful Web 服务，以确保在购买股票之前有足够的资金。该公司在 VPC flow logs 中注意到，BuyStock RESTful Web 服务通过互联网调用 CheckFunds RESTful Web 服务，而不是通过 VPC。解决方案架构师必须实施一种解决方案，使这些 API 通过 VPC 进行通信。哪种解决方案能够以对代码最少的更改满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 HTTP 标头中添加 X-API-Key 标头用于授权。
options.B: 使用 interface endpoint。
options.C: 使用 gateway endpoint。
options.D: 在两个 REST API 之间添加一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 interface endpoint。**

API Gateway private REST APIs 通过使用 VPC endpoints 从 Amazon VPC 访问。AWS 明确记录了通过选择类型为 **Interface** 的 `execute-api` 服务来为 API Gateway 创建 **interface VPC endpoint**；CLI 示例使用 `--vpc-endpoint-type Interface` 和 `--service-name com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api`（[Create a private API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-api-create.html)）。AWS 还建议使用单个 VPC endpoint 访问多个 private APIs，并启用 private DNS，这样 API 就可以在 VPC 内被调用而无需额外标头，从而最大限度减少代码更改（[Private REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-apis.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. Add an X-API-Key header** — API key 用于 API 访问控制/授权行为，而不是用于选择网络路径。它不会强制流量保留在 VPC 内。
- **C. Use a gateway endpoint** — Gateway VPC endpoints 用于 **Amazon S3 and DynamoDB** 连接，并且不使用 AWS PrivateLink；它们不是 API Gateway private APIs 所使用的 endpoint 类型（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。
- **D. Add an SQS queue between the APIs** — 这会将应用程序通信模式从同步 REST 调用更改为异步消息传递，需要更多代码和架构更改，并且不能直接解决通过 VPC 私有调用 API Gateway REST APIs 的问题。

en.question: A company hosts a multiplayer gaming application on AWS. The company wants the application to read data with sub-millisecond latency and run one-time queries on historical data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon RDS for data that is frequently accessed. Run a periodic custom script to export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Store the data directly in an Amazon S3 bucket. Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy to move older data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive for long-term storage. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.
options.C: Use Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for data that is frequently accessed. Export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket by using DynamoDB table export. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.
options.D: Use Amazon DynamoDB for data that is frequently accessed. Turn on streaming to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to read the data from Kinesis Data Streams. Store the records in an Amazon S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

DynamoDB with DAX is the best fit for the low-latency gaming workload: AWS states that DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is a DynamoDB-compatible caching service for demanding/read-heavy applications and can achieve **microsecond** response times for frequently requested data, which satisfies the sub-millisecond read requirement ([DAX prescriptive guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-prescriptive-guidance.html)). For historical/ad hoc analysis, DynamoDB export to S3 is a **fully managed** export feature; it can export DynamoDB data to S3, does not consume RCUs, and has no impact on table performance, and AWS explicitly notes that the exported data can be used for analytics and complex queries with services such as Athena ([DynamoDB export to S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/S3DataExport.HowItWorks.html)). Athena then provides serverless SQL queries directly against data in S3, with no infrastructure to set up or manage ([Athena overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). This combination meets both requirements with low operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** RDS does not inherently provide the DAX-style microsecond cached reads for a read-heavy gaming workload, and a periodic **custom script** to export data adds operational overhead compared with DynamoDB's fully managed S3 export.
- **B:** S3 plus Athena is appropriate for ad hoc queries, but storing the live application data directly in S3 does not meet the requirement for sub-millisecond reads for frequently accessed gaming data. Athena is for interactive analytics on S3, not serving ultra-low-latency application reads ([Athena overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)).
- **D:** DynamoDB alone generally provides single-digit millisecond access rather than the microsecond/sub-millisecond cached reads provided by DAX. This option also introduces DynamoDB Streams, Kinesis Data Streams, and Firehose, increasing moving parts and operational complexity, and it does not include Athena for one-time historical queries.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管一个多人游戏应用程序。该公司希望应用程序以亚毫秒级延迟读取数据，并对历史数据运行一次性查询。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 对频繁访问的数据使用 Amazon RDS。运行定期自定义脚本，将数据导出到 Amazon S3 存储桶。
options.B: 将数据直接存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。实施 S3 Lifecycle 策略，将较旧的数据移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 以进行长期存储。使用 Amazon Athena 对 Amazon S3 中的数据运行一次性查询。
options.C: 对频繁访问的数据使用带有 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 的 Amazon DynamoDB。使用 DynamoDB 表导出将数据导出到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon Athena 对 Amazon S3 中的数据运行一次性查询。
options.D: 对频繁访问的数据使用 Amazon DynamoDB。开启到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 的流式传输。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 从 Kinesis Data Streams 读取数据。将记录存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

带有 DAX 的 DynamoDB 最适合这种低延迟游戏工作负载：AWS 表示，DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 是一种兼容 DynamoDB 的缓存服务，适用于要求苛刻/读取密集型应用程序，并且可以为频繁请求的数据实现**微秒级**响应时间，这满足亚毫秒级读取要求（[DAX prescriptive guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-prescriptive-guidance.html)）。对于历史/即席分析，DynamoDB export to S3 是一项**完全托管**的导出功能；它可以将 DynamoDB 数据导出到 S3，不消耗 RCU，并且不会影响表性能，并且 AWS 明确指出，导出的数据可用于使用 Athena 等服务进行分析和复杂查询（[DynamoDB export to S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/S3DataExport.HowItWorks.html)）。随后，Athena 可直接针对 S3 中的数据提供无服务器 SQL 查询，无需设置或管理基础设施（[Athena overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。这种组合以低运营开销满足了两个要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 对于读取密集型游戏工作负载，RDS 本身并不提供 DAX 风格的微秒级缓存读取，并且使用定期**自定义脚本**导出数据会比 DynamoDB 的完全托管 S3 导出增加运营开销。
- **B:** S3 加 Athena 适合即席查询，但将实时应用程序数据直接存储在 S3 中，无法满足频繁访问的游戏数据的亚毫秒级读取要求。Athena 用于对 S3 进行交互式分析，而不是提供超低延迟的应用程序读取（[Athena overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。
- **D:** DynamoDB 单独使用通常提供个位数毫秒级访问，而不是 DAX 提供的微秒级/亚毫秒级缓存读取。此选项还引入了 DynamoDB Streams、Kinesis Data Streams 和 Firehose，增加了移动部件和运营复杂性，并且它不包含用于一次性历史查询的 Athena。

en.question: A company uses a payment processing system that requires messages for a particular payment ID to be received in the same order that they were sent. Otherwise, the payments might be processed incorrectly. Which actions should a solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.A: Write the messages to an Amazon DynamoDB table with the payment ID as the partition key.
options.B: Write the messages to an Amazon Kinesis data stream with the payment ID as the partition key.
options.C: Write the messages to an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster with the payment ID as the key.
options.D: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Set the message attribute to use the payment ID.
options.E: Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the message group to use the payment ID.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and E**.

- **B. Kinesis Data Streams with the payment ID as the partition key**: Kinesis uses the partition key to determine which shard a record belongs to, and the `PutRecord` API documentation states that “all data records with the same partition key map to the same shard.” Kinesis also assigns sequence numbers, and records cannot be modified or reordered after being written. Therefore, using the payment ID as the partition key keeps records for that payment ID together in shard order for ordered processing. [AWS Kinesis PutRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/APIReference/API_PutRecord.html) and [Kinesis concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html).
- **E. SQS FIFO queue with the payment ID as the message group**: SQS FIFO queues are designed for cases where order is critical. AWS states that FIFO queues strictly preserve the order in which messages are sent and received, and message groups allow multiple ordered message groups in one FIFO queue. AWS also states that messages within the same `MessageGroupId` are processed one at a time, in strict order, and that if strict ordering is required, use a FIFO queue. [SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html) and [SQS MessageGroupId](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/using-messagegroupid-property.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. DynamoDB with payment ID as partition key**: A DynamoDB partition key can retrieve items with the same key, but DynamoDB ordering is based on a **sort key** when one is present; the option does not provide an ordering attribute or queue/stream semantics. AWS documents that Query results are sorted by the sort key value, not merely by partition key. [DynamoDB Query key conditions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Query.KeyConditionExpressions.html).
- **C. ElastiCache for Memcached with payment ID as key**: ElastiCache is an in-memory data store/cache environment, not an ordered messaging service. It does not provide the required message ordering semantics. [What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html).
- **D. Standard SQS queue with payment ID as a message attribute**: Standard queues provide at-least-once delivery and only best-effort ordering; AWS states messages may occasionally arrive out of order. A message attribute does not create FIFO ordering. [SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html).

zh.question: 一家公司使用一个支付处理系统，该系统要求特定支付 ID 的消息必须按照发送时的相同顺序被接收。否则，付款可能会被错误处理。解决方案架构师应采取哪些操作来满足此要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将消息写入 Amazon DynamoDB 表，并将支付 ID 作为分区键。
options.B: 将消息写入 Amazon Kinesis data stream，并将支付 ID 作为分区键。
options.C: 将消息写入 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 集群，并将支付 ID 作为键。
options.D: 将消息写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。将消息属性设置为使用支付 ID。
options.E: 将消息写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列。将消息组设置为使用支付 ID。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 E**。

- **B. Kinesis Data Streams，并将支付 ID 作为分区键**：Kinesis 使用分区键来确定记录属于哪个分片，并且 `PutRecord` API 文档指出，“具有相同分区键的所有数据记录都会映射到同一个分片。”Kinesis 还会分配序列号，并且记录写入后无法被修改或重新排序。因此，使用支付 ID 作为分区键，可以使该支付 ID 的记录按照分片顺序聚集在一起，以便进行有序处理。[AWS Kinesis PutRecord](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesis/latest/APIReference/API_PutRecord.html) 和 [Kinesis concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)。
- **E. SQS FIFO 队列，并将支付 ID 作为消息组**：SQS FIFO 队列专为顺序至关重要的情况而设计。AWS 指出，FIFO 队列会严格保留消息发送和接收的顺序，并且消息组允许在一个 FIFO 队列中存在多个有序消息组。AWS 还指出，同一 `MessageGroupId` 内的消息会一次处理一条，并严格按顺序处理；如果需要严格排序，请使用 FIFO 队列。[SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html) 和 [SQS MessageGroupId](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/using-messagegroupid-property.html)。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. DynamoDB，并将支付 ID 作为分区键**：DynamoDB 分区键可以检索具有相同键的项目，但 DynamoDB 的排序在存在 **sort key** 时基于该排序键；该选项没有提供排序属性或队列/流语义。AWS 文档说明，Query 结果按排序键值排序，而不仅仅按分区键排序。[DynamoDB Query key conditions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Query.KeyConditionExpressions.html)。
- **C. ElastiCache for Memcached，并将支付 ID 作为键**：ElastiCache 是内存数据存储/缓存环境，不是有序消息传递服务。它不提供所需的消息排序语义。[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)。
- **D. Standard SQS 队列，并将支付 ID 作为消息属性**：Standard 队列提供至少一次传递，并且仅提供尽力而为排序；AWS 指出，消息偶尔可能会无序到达。消息属性不会创建 FIFO 排序。[SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)。

en.question: A company is building a game system that needs to send unique events to separate leaderboard, matchmaking, and authentication services concurrently. The company needs an AWS event-driven system that guarantees the order of the events. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon EventBridge event bus
options.B: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topics
options.C: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topics
options.D: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B — Amazon SNS FIFO topics.**

The system must publish each event concurrently to multiple independent services (leaderboard, matchmaking, authentication) and preserve ordering. Amazon SNS is a pub/sub service where publishers send messages to a topic and the topic delivers them to multiple subscribers/endpoints, including SQS, Lambda, HTTP(S), and others ([Amazon SNS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). For ordering, SNS FIFO topics are designed for strict ordering and deduplication; AWS states that SNS FIFO topics integrate with SQS FIFO queues to “ensure strict message ordering and deduplication” ([SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)). SNS FIFO message groups are processed “one by one, in a strict order,” and messages are delivered to all subscribed queues subject to filters ([SNS FIFO message grouping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/fifo-message-grouping.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon EventBridge event bus** — EventBridge can route events to targets, but this option does not provide the FIFO ordering guarantee required by the question. AWS best practices describe using rules/targets for delivery, including duplicating rules when multiple targets need the same events, but not as a FIFO ordered fanout mechanism ([EventBridge rules best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rules-best-practices.html)).
- **C. Amazon SNS standard topics** — Standard SNS topics are suitable for high-throughput pub/sub, but the required guarantee is ordering. SNS FIFO topics, not standard topics, are the SNS feature documented for strict ordering and deduplication ([SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)).
- **D. Amazon SQS FIFO queues** — SQS FIFO queues preserve order and prevent duplicates within a queue ([SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)), but a queue is a point-to-point polling model, not the best single service for concurrently publishing the same event to multiple separate services. The fanout requirement is better met by SNS topics; SNS can send messages to multiple subscribers ([Amazon SNS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个游戏系统，需要将唯一事件同时发送到独立的排行榜、匹配和身份验证服务。该公司需要一个能够保证事件顺序的 AWS 事件驱动系统。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon EventBridge event bus
options.B: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topics
options.C: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topics
options.D: Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B — Amazon SNS FIFO topics。**

该系统必须将每个事件并发发布到多个独立服务（排行榜、匹配、身份验证），并保留顺序。Amazon SNS 是一种 pub/sub 服务，发布者将消息发送到 topic，而 topic 会将消息传递给多个订阅者/端点，包括 SQS、Lambda、HTTP(S) 等（[Amazon SNS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。对于排序，SNS FIFO topics 专为严格排序和去重而设计；AWS 表示 SNS FIFO topics 与 SQS FIFO queues 集成，以“确保严格的消息排序和去重”（[SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)）。SNS FIFO message groups 会“逐个按严格顺序”处理，消息会根据筛选条件传递给所有已订阅的队列（[SNS FIFO message grouping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/fifo-message-grouping.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. Amazon EventBridge event bus** — EventBridge 可以将事件路由到目标，但此选项不提供题目所需的 FIFO 排序保证。AWS 最佳实践描述了使用规则/目标进行交付，包括在多个目标需要相同事件时复制规则，但并不是作为 FIFO 有序 fanout 机制（[EventBridge rules best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rules-best-practices.html)）。
- **C. Amazon SNS standard topics** — Standard SNS topics 适合高吞吐量 pub/sub，但所需的保证是排序。SNS FIFO topics（而不是 standard topics）才是文档中用于严格排序和去重的 SNS 功能（[SNS FIFO topics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-fifo-topics.html)）。
- **D. Amazon SQS FIFO queues** — SQS FIFO queues 会在队列内保留顺序并防止重复（[SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)），但队列是点对点轮询模型，并不是用于将同一事件并发发布到多个独立服务的最佳单一服务。fanout 需求更适合由 SNS topics 满足；SNS 可以将消息发送给多个订阅者（[Amazon SNS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。

en.question: A hospital is designing a new application that gathers symptoms from patients. The hospital has decided to use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) and Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) in the architecture. A solutions architect is reviewing the infrastructure design. Data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Only authorized personnel of the hospital should be able to access the data. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
options.B: Turn on server-side encryption on the SNS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
options.C: Turn on encryption on the SNS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the topic policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.
options.D: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.
options.E: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply an IAM policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **B and D**.

- **B is correct** because Amazon SNS server-side encryption (SSE) protects message contents in encrypted topics using keys managed in AWS KMS. AWS states that SNS SSE encrypts messages when SNS receives them and stores them encrypted. Using a **customer managed KMS key** allows the hospital to define policies controlling who can use the key; AWS KMS documentation says key policies are the primary way to control access to KMS keys and determine who can use them. Also, for SNS topics with SSE enabled, AWS requires all requests to use **HTTPS and Signature Version 4**, satisfying encryption in transit for SNS. See [SNS SSE](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-server-side-encryption.html) and [KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html).

- **D is correct** because Amazon SQS supports SSE-KMS, and AWS states that the KMS key assigned to a queue must have a key policy with permissions for all principals authorized to use the queue. The option also adds a queue policy condition to allow only encrypted TLS connections, which aligns with the requirement for encryption in transit; SQS clients must support TLS 1.2 or later. See [configuring SQS SSE-KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-configure-sse-existing-queue.html) and [SQS infrastructure security](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/infrastructure-security.html).

Incorrect options:

- **A** is incomplete. It addresses SQS encryption at rest and key access, but it does not enforce encrypted connections for SQS and does not address SNS.
- **C** is not the best SNS step. SNS SSE already requires HTTPS and Signature Version 4 when enabled, and the option does not clearly specify using a customer managed KMS key for controllable key access. The stronger SNS answer is B.
- **E** is not as correct as D. AWS KMS documentation states that key policies are the primary way to control access to KMS keys and that IAM policies cannot allow access unless the key policy permits it. Therefore, relying on an IAM policy instead of applying the KMS key policy is not the best answer.

zh.question: 一家医院正在设计一个用于收集患者症状的新应用程序。医院决定在架构中使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 和 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)。一名解决方案架构师正在审查基础设施设计。数据必须在静态和传输过程中加密。只有医院的授权人员应该能够访问这些数据。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 SQS 组件上启用服务器端加密。更新默认密钥策略，将密钥使用限制为一组授权主体。
options.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥在 SNS 组件上启用服务器端加密。应用密钥策略，将密钥使用限制为一组授权主体。
options.C: 在 SNS 组件上启用加密。更新默认密钥策略，将密钥使用限制为一组授权主体。在主题策略中设置条件，仅允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。
options.D: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥在 SQS 组件上启用服务器端加密。应用密钥策略，将密钥使用限制为一组授权主体。在队列策略中设置条件，仅允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。
options.E: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥在 SQS 组件上启用服务器端加密。应用 IAM 策略，将密钥使用限制为一组授权主体。在队列策略中设置条件，仅允许通过 TLS 的加密连接。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **B 和 D**。

- **B 是正确的**，因为 Amazon SNS 服务器端加密 (SSE) 使用 AWS KMS 中管理的密钥来保护加密主题中的消息内容。AWS 说明，SNS SSE 会在 SNS 接收消息时对其进行加密，并以加密形式存储。使用 **客户托管 KMS 密钥** 允许医院定义策略来控制谁可以使用该密钥；AWS KMS 文档说明，密钥策略是控制 KMS 密钥访问的主要方式，并决定谁可以使用这些密钥。此外，对于启用了 SSE 的 SNS 主题，AWS 要求所有请求都使用 **HTTPS and Signature Version 4**，从而满足 SNS 的传输中加密要求。请参阅 [SNS SSE](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-server-side-encryption.html) 和 [KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)。

- **D 是正确的**，因为 Amazon SQS 支持 SSE-KMS，并且 AWS 说明，分配给队列的 KMS 密钥必须具有密钥策略，为所有被授权使用该队列的主体授予权限。该选项还添加了一个队列策略条件，仅允许加密的 TLS 连接，这与传输中加密的要求一致；SQS 客户端必须支持 TLS 1.2 或更高版本。请参阅 [configuring SQS SSE-KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-configure-sse-existing-queue.html) 和 [SQS infrastructure security](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/infrastructure-security.html)。错误选项：

- **A** 不完整。它解决了 SQS 静态加密和密钥访问问题，但没有强制 SQS 使用加密连接，也没有解决 SNS。
- **C** 不是最佳的 SNS 步骤。启用 SNS SSE 后，本身已要求 HTTPS and Signature Version 4，而且该选项没有明确指定使用客户托管 KMS 密钥来实现可控的密钥访问。更强的 SNS 答案是 B。
- **E** 不如 D 正确。AWS KMS 文档说明，密钥策略是控制 KMS 密钥访问的主要方式，并且除非密钥策略允许，否则 IAM 策略无法允许访问。因此，依赖 IAM 策略而不是应用 KMS 密钥策略并不是最佳答案。

en.question: A company runs a web application that is backed by Amazon RDS. A new database administrator caused data loss by accidentally editing information in a database table. To help recover from this type of incident, the company wants the ability to restore the database to its state from 5 minutes before any change within the last 30 days. Which feature should the solutions architect include in the design to meet this requirement?

options.A: Read replicas
options.B: Manual snapshots
options.C: Automated backups
options.D: Multi-AZ deployments

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C. Automated backups**.

Amazon RDS point-in-time recovery is provided through automated backups. AWS states that RDS uploads transaction logs for DB instances to Amazon S3 **every five minutes**, and that you can restore to **any point in time within your backup retention period**. The backup retention period can be configured up to **35 days**, so setting it to 30 days meets the requirement to restore to the state from 5 minutes before an accidental change within the last 30 days ([RDS point-in-time restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIT.html), [backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Read replicas**: Read replicas are primarily for scaling read-heavy workloads and replication; they are not the RDS feature that provides point-in-time restore to an arbitrary time before an accidental data change.
- **B. Manual snapshots**: A manual snapshot restores the database to the time the snapshot was taken, not to any arbitrary point such as 5 minutes before a change.
- **D. Multi-AZ deployments**: Multi-AZ is for high availability and failover using standby infrastructure, not for recovering from logical data loss caused by accidental edits. AWS describes Multi-AZ deployments as providing high availability through synchronous standby replicas and failover support ([RDS Multi-AZ deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运行一个由 Amazon RDS 支持的 Web 应用程序。一名新的数据库管理员意外编辑了数据库表中的信息，导致数据丢失。为帮助从此类事件中恢复，公司希望能够将数据库还原到过去 30 天内任何更改发生前 5 分钟的状态。解决方案架构师应在设计中包含哪项功能以满足此要求？

options.A: 只读副本
options.B: 手动快照
options.C: 自动备份
options.D: Multi-AZ 部署

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C. Automated backups**。

Amazon RDS 时间点恢复通过自动备份提供。AWS 表示，RDS 会**每五分钟**将 DB 实例的事务日志上传到 Amazon S3，并且你可以还原到**备份保留期内的任意时间点**。备份保留期最长可配置为 **35 天**，因此将其设置为 30 天即可满足在过去 30 天内发生意外更改前 5 分钟的状态进行还原的要求（[RDS point-in-time restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIT.html)，[backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Read replicas**：Read replicas 主要用于扩展读取密集型工作负载和复制；它们并不是提供在意外数据更改前任意时间点进行时间点还原的 RDS 功能。
- **B. Manual snapshots**：手动快照会将数据库还原到创建快照时的时间点，而不是还原到任意时间点，例如更改发生前 5 分钟。
- **D. Multi-AZ deployments**：Multi-AZ 用于通过备用基础设施实现高可用性和故障转移，而不是用于从意外编辑导致的逻辑数据丢失中恢复。AWS 将 Multi-AZ 部署描述为通过同步备用副本和故障转移支持提供高可用性（[RDS Multi-AZ deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。

en.question: A company’s web application consists of an Amazon API Gateway API in front of an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB database. The Lambda function handles the business logic, and the DynamoDB table hosts the data. The application uses Amazon Cognito user pools to identify the individual users of the application. A solutions architect needs to update the application so that only users who have a subscription can access premium content. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Enable API caching and throttling on the API Gateway API.
options.B: Set up AWS WAF on the API Gateway API. Create a rule to filter users who have a subscription.
options.C: Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to the premium content in the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Implement API usage plans and API keys to limit the access of users who do not have a subscription.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

API Gateway **usage plans** are designed for the subscription-style use case: a usage plan specifies who can access deployed API stages and methods, uses **API keys** to identify API clients, and can apply throttling and quota limits per key. AWS also describes usage plans as a way to provide API keys to customers and then track and limit usage of API stages and methods for each key ([Usage plans and API keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html), [Control and manage access to REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-to-api.html)). Because the application already uses Cognito to identify users, adding usage plans/API keys for subscribed users is the lowest-overhead option among the choices for gating premium API access. Note: AWS best practices say API keys should not be used as the sole authentication/authorization mechanism; they should be used with mechanisms such as Cognito, IAM, or Lambda authorizers when controlling API access ([Usage plans best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Enable API caching and throttling** — Caching improves latency and reduces calls to the backend; it is not a subscription authorization mechanism ([API Gateway caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html)). Throttling limits request rates but does not determine whether a specific user has a subscription.
- **B. Set up AWS WAF rules** — AWS WAF protects APIs from web exploits and can block/allow requests based on patterns such as IP ranges, countries, headers, query strings, bodies, SQL injection, and XSS. It is not intended to evaluate application subscription state for individual Cognito users ([AWS WAF with API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)).
- **C. Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to DynamoDB** — DynamoDB fine-grained access control can restrict access to items or attributes using IAM condition keys such as `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` and `dynamodb:Attributes` ([DynamoDB fine-grained access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/specifying-conditions.html)). However, this application accesses DynamoDB through a Lambda function, so enforcing per-subscriber access in DynamoDB IAM policies would require additional identity/role mapping or application changes and is not the least-operational-overhead option for API-level subscription access.

zh.question: 一家公司的 Web 应用程序由位于 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon DynamoDB 数据库前端的 Amazon API Gateway API 组成。Lambda 函数处理业务逻辑，DynamoDB 表托管数据。该应用程序使用 Amazon Cognito 用户池来识别应用程序的各个用户。解决方案架构师需要更新该应用程序，以便只有拥有订阅的用户才能访问高级内容。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足此要求？

options.A: 在 API Gateway API 上启用 API 缓存和限流。
options.B: 在 API Gateway API 上设置 AWS WAF。创建一条规则来筛选拥有订阅的用户。
options.C: 对 DynamoDB 表中的高级内容应用细粒度 IAM 权限。
options.D: 实施 API 使用计划和 API 密钥，以限制没有订阅的用户的访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

API Gateway **usage plans** 专为订阅式使用场景而设计：使用计划指定谁可以访问已部署的 API 阶段和方法，使用 **API keys** 来识别 API 客户端，并且可以按密钥应用限流和配额限制。AWS 还将使用计划描述为一种向客户提供 API 密钥，然后跟踪并限制每个密钥对 API 阶段和方法使用量的方式（[Usage plans and API keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)，[Control and manage access to REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-to-api.html)）。由于该应用程序已经使用 Cognito 来识别用户，因此为订阅用户添加使用计划/API 密钥，是这些选项中用于控制高级 API 访问的最低开销方案。注意：AWS 最佳实践指出，API 密钥不应作为唯一的身份验证/授权机制；在控制 API 访问时，应将其与 Cognito、IAM 或 Lambda authorizers 等机制一起使用（[Usage plans best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-api-usage-plans.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. Enable API caching and throttling** — 缓存可改善延迟并减少对后端的调用；它不是订阅授权机制（[API Gateway caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-caching.html)）。限流会限制请求速率，但不会判断特定用户是否拥有订阅。
- **B. Set up AWS WAF rules** — AWS WAF 保护 API 免受 Web 漏洞攻击，并可根据 IP 范围、国家/地区、标头、查询字符串、正文、SQL 注入和 XSS 等模式阻止/允许请求。它并非旨在评估单个 Cognito 用户的应用程序订阅状态（[AWS WAF with API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)）。
- **C. Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to DynamoDB** — DynamoDB 细粒度访问控制可以使用 `dynamodb:LeadingKeys` 和 `dynamodb:Attributes` 等 IAM 条件键来限制对项目或属性的访问（[DynamoDB fine-grained access control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/specifying-conditions.html)）。但是，此应用程序通过 Lambda 函数访问 DynamoDB，因此在 DynamoDB IAM 策略中强制执行按订阅者访问将需要额外的身份/角色映射或应用程序更改，并不是 API 级别订阅访问的最低运营开销选项。

en.question: A company is using Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to its UDP-based application for users around the world. The application is hosted on redundant servers in the company's on-premises data centers in the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company’s compliance requirements state that the application must be hosted on premises. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the application. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on- premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the NLBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.
options.B: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on- premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the ALBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.
options.C: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on- premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three NLBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.
options.D: Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on- premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three ALBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

A UDP-based application needs a Layer 4 solution. Network Load Balancers support **UDP** listeners and target groups, and NLB target groups can use the `ip` target type for **on-premises resources linked to AWS through Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN**, so the application can remain hosted on premises while AWS provides the front-end acceleration/load balancing path ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html), [NLB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)). AWS Global Accelerator is designed to improve performance and availability for global users by routing traffic over the AWS global network to optimal healthy regional endpoints; standard accelerator endpoints can include **Network Load Balancers** in one or multiple Regions ([What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Global Accelerator listeners also support **TCP and UDP**, matching the application protocol ([Global Accelerator listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B**: Application Load Balancers are not appropriate for a UDP application. ALB listeners support only **HTTP and HTTPS**, not UDP ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
* **C**: Although NLBs can support UDP, CloudFront is not a UDP application delivery service. CloudFront is for distributing web content and uses origins such as S3 buckets or **HTTP servers**; its setup describes content that can be served over HTTP ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
* **D**: This combines both problems: ALBs do not support UDP, and CloudFront is for HTTP/web content delivery rather than UDP application traffic ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html), [CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由，为全球用户将请求路由到其基于 UDP 的应用程序。该应用程序托管在公司位于美国、亚洲和欧洲的本地数据中心中的冗余服务器上。公司的合规要求规定该应用程序必须托管在本地。公司希望提高应用程序的性能和可用性。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 在三个 AWS Regions 中配置三个 Network Load Balancers (NLBs)，以指向本地端点。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器，并将这些 NLBs 注册为其端点。通过使用指向加速器 DNS 的 CNAME 来提供对应用程序的访问。
options.B: 在三个 AWS Regions 中配置三个 Application Load Balancers (ALBs)，以指向本地端点。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器，并将这些 ALBs 注册为其端点。通过使用指向加速器 DNS 的 CNAME 来提供对应用程序的访问。
options.C: 在三个 AWS Regions 中配置三个 Network Load Balancers (NLBs)，以指向本地端点。在 Route 53 中，创建一条基于延迟的记录，指向这三个 NLBs，并将其用作 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源站。通过使用指向 CloudFront DNS 的 CNAME 来提供对应用程序的访问。
options.D: 在三个 AWS Regions 中配置三个 Application Load Balancers (ALBs)，以指向本地端点。在 Route 53 中，创建一条基于延迟的记录，指向这三个 ALBs，并将其用作 Amazon CloudFront 分配的源站。通过使用指向 CloudFront DNS 的 CNAME 来提供对应用程序的访问。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。基于 UDP 的应用程序需要第 4 层解决方案。Network Load Balancers 支持 **UDP** 侦听器和目标组，并且 NLB 目标组可以使用 `ip` 目标类型来支持**通过 Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN 连接到 AWS 的本地资源**，因此应用程序可以继续托管在本地，同时由 AWS 提供前端加速/负载均衡路径（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)，[NLB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。AWS Global Accelerator 旨在通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最佳且运行状况良好的区域端点，从而提高全球用户的性能和可用性；标准加速器端点可以包括一个或多个 Regions 中的 **Network Load Balancers**（[What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。Global Accelerator 侦听器还支持 **TCP and UDP**，与应用程序协议相匹配（[Global Accelerator listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **B**：Application Load Balancers 不适用于 UDP 应用程序。ALB 侦听器仅支持 **HTTP and HTTPS**，不支持 UDP（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
* **C**：虽然 NLBs 可以支持 UDP，但 CloudFront 不是 UDP 应用程序交付服务。CloudFront 用于分发 Web 内容，并使用诸如 S3 存储桶或 **HTTP servers** 之类的源站；其设置描述的是可通过 HTTP 提供的内容（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
* **D**：此选项同时包含两个问题：ALBs 不支持 UDP，并且 CloudFront 用于 HTTP/Web 内容交付，而不是 UDP 应用程序流量（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)，[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect wants all new users to have specific complexity requirements and mandatory rotation periods for IAM user passwords. What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?

options.A: Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account.
options.B: Set a password policy for each IAM user in the AWS account.
options.C: Use third-party vendor software to set password requirements.
options.D: Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event to set the password with the appropriate requirements.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account.**

AWS IAM supports an **account-level password policy** for IAM users. A custom password policy can define password complexity requirements such as minimum length, uppercase/lowercase letters, numbers, and nonalphanumeric characters, and it can also enable password expiration/rotation periods from 1 to 1,095 days ([AWS IAM password policy options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)). AWS also states that these password policy settings are enforced for users when passwords are created or changed, and password expiration is enforced immediately according to the configured period ([rules for setting a password policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Set a password policy for each IAM user** — IAM password policy is configured for the **account**, not individually per IAM user. The documentation describes configuring a custom password policy “for your account” and notes that related password-change permissions can be applied at the account level for all users, not by attaching a password policy to each user ([AWS IAM password policy options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)).
- **C. Use third-party vendor software** — This is unnecessary because IAM natively provides password complexity, expiration, and reuse controls through the account password policy ([AWS IAM password policy options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)).
- **D. Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event** — This is not the IAM mechanism for password complexity and rotation. AWS documents using IAM account password policy operations such as `UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy` to create or change the custom account password policy ([AWS IAM password policy API operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)).

zh.question: 解决方案架构师希望所有新用户的 IAM 用户密码都具有特定的复杂性要求和强制轮换周期。解决方案架构师应如何实现这一点？

options.A: 为整个 AWS 账户设置总体密码策略。
options.B: 为 AWS 账户中的每个 IAM 用户设置密码策略。
options.C: 使用第三方供应商软件来设置密码要求。
options.D: 将 Amazon CloudWatch 规则附加到 Create_newuser 事件，以按照相应要求设置密码。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 为整个 AWS 账户设置总体密码策略。**

AWS IAM 支持针对 IAM 用户的**账户级密码策略**。自定义密码策略可以定义密码复杂性要求，例如最小长度、大写/小写字母、数字和非字母数字字符，并且还可以启用 1 到 1,095 天的密码过期/轮换周期（[AWS IAM password policy options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)）。AWS 还说明，这些密码策略设置会在创建或更改密码时对用户强制执行，并且密码过期会根据配置的周期立即强制执行（[rules for setting a password policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Set a password policy for each IAM user** — IAM 密码策略是为**账户**配置的，而不是为每个 IAM 用户单独配置的。文档描述的是“为你的账户”配置自定义密码策略，并指出相关的密码更改权限可以在账户级别应用于所有用户，而不是通过将密码策略附加到每个用户来实现（[AWS IAM password policy options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)）。
- **C. Use third-party vendor software** — 这不是必需的，因为 IAM 原生通过账户密码策略提供密码复杂性、过期和重复使用控制（[AWS IAM password policy options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)）。
- **D. Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event** — 这不是用于密码复杂性和轮换的 IAM 机制。AWS 记录的是使用 IAM 账户密码策略操作，例如 `UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy`，来创建或更改自定义账户密码策略（[AWS IAM password policy API operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_account-policy.html)）。

en.question: A company has migrated an application to Amazon EC2 Linux instances. One of these EC2 instances runs several 1-hour tasks on a schedule. These tasks were written by different teams and have no common programming language. The company is concerned about performance and scalability while these tasks run on a single instance. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to resolve these concerns. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs. Schedule the jobs by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
options.B: Convert the EC2 instance to a container. Use AWS App Runner to create the container on demand to run the tasks as jobs.
options.C: Copy the tasks into AWS Lambda functions. Schedule the Lambda functions by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the EC2 instance that runs the tasks. Create an Auto Scaling group with the AMI to run multiple copies of the instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs and schedule them with EventBridge.**

AWS Batch is designed for this exact pattern: scheduled, batch-style compute work. AWS states that Batch is a fully managed service for batch workloads that can run workloads of any scale, automatically provision compute resources, and optimize workload distribution based on the quantity and scale of the workloads, with no need to install or manage batch computing software ([AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)). AWS also documents that AWS Batch jobs can be EventBridge targets and that EventBridge can schedule automated actions using cron or rate expressions; a common use case is a scheduled AWS Batch job at regular intervals ([AWS Batch jobs as EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/batch-cwe-target.html)). This meets the scalability/performance concern with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. App Runner** is not the best fit. App Runner is for deploying source code or container images as scalable, secure **web applications** and provides deployment pipelines for application services ([App Runner overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apprunner/latest/dg/what-is-apprunner.html)). The question describes scheduled 1-hour batch tasks, not a web application service.
- **C. Lambda** is not suitable because each task runs for about 1 hour. Lambda functions have a maximum timeout of 900 seconds, or 15 minutes ([Lambda timeout configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)). Rewriting tasks in multiple languages into Lambda functions would also add operational and development effort.
- **D. AMI plus Auto Scaling group** would scale instances, but it would still require managing EC2-based scheduling, task coordination, duplicate execution concerns, capacity behavior, and instance lifecycle. AWS Batch is the managed batch service that removes this undifferentiated infrastructure management and automatically provisions resources for submitted jobs ([AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)), so D is not the least-overhead solution.

zh.question: 一家公司已将一个应用程序迁移到 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例。其中一个 EC2 实例按计划运行多个 1 小时任务。这些任务由不同团队编写，并且没有共同的编程语言。公司担心这些任务在单个实例上运行时的性能和可扩展性。解决方案架构师需要实施一个解决方案来解决这些问题。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Batch 将任务作为作业运行。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 调度这些作业。
options.B: 将 EC2 实例转换为容器。使用 AWS App Runner 按需创建容器，将任务作为作业运行。
options.C: 将任务复制到 AWS Lambda 函数中。使用 Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) 调度 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 为运行这些任务的 EC2 实例创建 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，以运行该实例的多个副本。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 使用 AWS Batch 将任务作为作业运行，并使用 EventBridge 调度它们。**

AWS Batch 正是为这种模式而设计的：计划性的、批处理风格的计算工作。AWS 表示，Batch 是一项用于批处理工作负载的完全托管服务，可以运行任意规模的工作负载，自动预置计算资源，并根据工作负载的数量和规模优化工作负载分配，且无需安装或管理批处理计算软件（[AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)）。AWS 还记录了 AWS Batch 作业可以作为 EventBridge 目标，并且 EventBridge 可以使用 cron 或 rate 表达式调度自动化操作；一个常见用例是按固定间隔运行的计划 AWS Batch 作业（[AWS Batch jobs as EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/batch-cwe-target.html)）。这能够以最少的运维开销满足可扩展性/性能方面的担忧。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. App Runner** 不是最佳选择。App Runner 用于将源代码或容器映像部署为可扩展、安全的 **web applications**，并为应用程序服务提供部署管道（[App Runner overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apprunner/latest/dg/what-is-apprunner.html)）。题目描述的是计划运行的 1 小时批处理任务，而不是 Web 应用程序服务。
- **C. Lambda** 不适合，因为每个任务大约运行 1 小时。Lambda 函数的最大超时时间为 900 秒，即 15 分钟（[Lambda timeout configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。将多种语言编写的任务重写为 Lambda 函数也会增加运维和开发工作量。
- **D. AMI plus Auto Scaling group** 可以扩展实例，但仍然需要管理基于 EC2 的调度、任务协调、重复执行问题、容量行为以及实例生命周期。AWS Batch 是托管式批处理服务，可以消除这种无差别的基础设施管理，并为提交的作业自动预置资源（[AWS Batch overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)），因此 D 不是运维开销最少的解决方案。

en.question: A company runs a public three-tier web application in a VPC. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances that run in private subnets need to communicate with a license server over the internet. The company needs a managed solution that minimizes operational maintenance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Provision a NAT instance in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance.
options.B: Provision a NAT instance in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance.
options.C: Provision a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway.
options.D: Provision a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A public NAT gateway is the managed, low-maintenance way for EC2 instances in private subnets to initiate outbound internet connections. AWS states that instances in private subnets can connect to the internet through a **public NAT gateway**, that you create the public NAT gateway in a **public subnet**, and that traffic is routed from the NAT gateway to the VPC internet gateway ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)). AWS also shows the private subnet route table using `0.0.0.0/0` with target `nat-gateway-id` for this use case ([NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)). NAT gateways are preferred over NAT instances because AWS says they provide better availability/bandwidth and require less administration; their maintenance is **managed by AWS** and requires no maintenance by the customer ([Compare NAT gateways and NAT instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-comparison.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A NAT instance in a public subnet can provide outbound internet access, but it is not the best fit because NAT instances are managed by the customer, including software updates and OS patches, whereas the requirement asks for a managed solution that minimizes maintenance ([Compare NAT gateways and NAT instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-comparison.html)).
- **B:** A NAT instance must be in a **public subnet** and have a public IP address or Elastic IP address to access the internet; placing it in a private subnet is incorrect ([NAT instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_NAT_Instance.html)).
- **D:** A private NAT gateway is not for internet access. AWS states that if traffic from a private NAT gateway is routed to an internet gateway, the internet gateway drops the traffic ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)). Therefore, the NAT gateway for internet-bound traffic must be a **public** NAT gateway in a public subnet.

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 中运行一个面向公众的三层 Web 应用程序。该应用程序运行在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 实例上。在私有子网中运行的 EC2 实例需要通过互联网与许可证服务器通信。该公司需要一种可最大限度减少运维维护的托管解决方案。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在公有子网中预置一个 NAT instance。修改每个私有子网的路由表，添加指向该 NAT instance 的默认路由。
options.B: 在私有子网中预置一个 NAT instance。修改每个私有子网的路由表，添加指向该 NAT instance 的默认路由。
options.C: 在公有子网中预置一个 NAT gateway。修改每个私有子网的路由表，添加指向该 NAT gateway 的默认路由。
options.D: 在私有子网中预置一个 NAT gateway。修改每个私有子网的路由表，添加指向该 NAT gateway 的默认路由。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

公有 NAT gateway 是让私有子网中的 EC2 实例发起出站互联网连接的托管、低维护方式。AWS 说明，私有子网中的实例可以通过 **public NAT gateway** 连接到互联网，你需要在 **public subnet** 中创建 public NAT gateway，并且流量会从 NAT gateway 路由到 VPC internet gateway（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。AWS 还展示了此用例中私有子网路由表使用 `0.0.0.0/0` 且目标为 `nat-gateway-id`（[NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)）。相比 NAT instances，更推荐 NAT gateways，因为 AWS 表示它们提供更好的可用性/带宽并且需要更少管理；其维护由 **AWS 托管**，客户无需维护（[Compare NAT gateways and NAT instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-comparison.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 位于公有子网中的 NAT instance 可以提供出站互联网访问，但它不是最佳选择，因为 NAT instances 由客户管理，包括软件更新和 OS 补丁，而题目要求的是一种可最大限度减少维护的托管解决方案（[Compare NAT gateways and NAT instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-comparison.html)）。
- **B:** NAT instance 必须位于 **public subnet** 中，并且具有公有 IP 地址或 Elastic IP 地址才能访问互联网；将其放在私有子网中是不正确的（[NAT instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_NAT_Instance.html)）。
- **D:** Private NAT gateway 不是用于访问互联网。AWS 说明，如果来自 private NAT gateway 的流量被路由到 internet gateway，internet gateway 会丢弃该流量（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。因此，用于互联网出站流量的 NAT gateway 必须是位于公有子网中的 **public** NAT gateway。

en.question: A company needs to create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to host a digital media streaming application. The EKS cluster will use a managed node group that is backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for storage. The company must encrypt all data at rest by using a customer managed key that is stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Which combination of actions will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use a Kubernetes plugin that uses the customer managed key to perform data encryption.
options.B: After creation of the EKS cluster, locate the EBS volumes. Enable encryption by using the customer managed key.
options.C: Enable EBS encryption by default in the AWS Region where the EKS cluster will be created. Select the customer managed key as the default key.
options.D: Create the EKS cluster. Create an IAM role that has a policy that grants permission to the customer managed key. Associate the role with the EKS cluster.
options.E: Store the customer managed key as a Kubernetes secret in the EKS cluster. Use the customer managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **C and D**.

- **C is correct** because Amazon EKS documentation says that, for managed node groups, if you want encrypted Amazon EBS volumes **without using a launch template**, you should “encrypt all new Amazon EBS volumes created in your account” ([Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)). Amazon EBS encryption by default is a Region-specific account setting that enforces encryption of new EBS volumes, including volumes created when launching instances, and the default key can be a symmetric **customer managed** KMS key ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)). This is low operational overhead because new node volumes are encrypted automatically.
- **D is correct** in the sense that the AWS service role that launches the managed node group instances must be allowed to use the customer managed KMS key. EKS managed nodes are provisioned as part of an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group managed by Amazon EKS ([Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)). AWS states that KMS keys must have a key policy that allows Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to launch instances with EBS volumes encrypted with a customer managed key, including permissions such as `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:Decrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey*`, `kms:DescribeKey`, and `kms:CreateGrant` for the Auto Scaling service-linked role ([Required AWS KMS key policy for use with encrypted volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/key-policy-requirements-EBS-encryption.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A** is wrong because EBS volume encryption is natively integrated with AWS KMS and is configured through EBS/EC2 settings or launch templates; adding a Kubernetes encryption plugin would add unnecessary operational overhead and would not be the standard way to encrypt EBS volumes.
- **B** is wrong because EBS encryption by default has **no effect on existing EBS volumes**, and AWS notes that you cannot change the KMS key associated with an existing encrypted volume ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)). The least-overhead approach is to ensure encryption is applied when volumes are created.
- **E** is wrong because storing a KMS customer managed key as a Kubernetes secret is not how AWS KMS keys are used. KMS keys remain in AWS KMS, and AWS services are granted permission to use them; storing key material in the cluster would be insecure and operationally burdensome.

zh.question: 一家公司需要创建一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群来托管数字媒体流式传输应用程序。该 EKS 集群将使用由 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷提供存储支持的托管节点组。公司必须使用存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中的客户托管密钥来加密所有静态数据。哪种操作组合可以在运营开销最少的情况下满足此要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用一个 Kubernetes 插件，该插件使用客户托管密钥来执行数据加密。
options.B: 创建 EKS 集群后，找到 EBS 卷。使用客户托管密钥启用加密。
options.C: 在将创建 EKS 集群的 AWS Region 中默认启用 EBS 加密。选择客户托管密钥作为默认密钥。
options.D: 创建 EKS 集群。创建一个 IAM 角色，该角色具有授予客户托管密钥权限的策略。将该角色与 EKS 集群关联。
options.E: 将客户托管密钥作为 Kubernetes secret 存储在 EKS 集群中。使用客户托管密钥加密 EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C 和 D**。

- **C 正确**，因为 Amazon EKS 文档说明，对于托管节点组，如果你希望在 **不使用启动模板** 的情况下使用加密的 Amazon EBS 卷，应“加密你账户中创建的所有新 Amazon EBS 卷”([Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html))。Amazon EBS 默认加密是特定于 Region 的账户设置，会强制加密新的 EBS 卷，包括启动实例时创建的卷，并且默认密钥可以是对称的 **客户托管** KMS key ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html))。这具有较低的运营开销，因为新的节点卷会自动加密。
- **D 正确**，其含义是启动托管节点组实例的 AWS 服务角色必须被允许使用客户托管 KMS key。EKS 托管节点作为由 Amazon EKS 管理的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group 的一部分进行预置 ([Amazon EKS managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html))。AWS 声明，KMS keys 必须具有一个 key policy，允许 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 启动带有使用客户托管密钥加密的 EBS 卷的实例，其中包括为 Auto Scaling service-linked role 授予 `kms:Encrypt`、`kms:Decrypt`、`kms:GenerateDataKey*`、`kms:DescribeKey` 和 `kms:CreateGrant` 等权限 ([Required AWS KMS key policy for use with encrypted volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/key-policy-requirements-EBS-encryption.html))。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A** 错误，因为 EBS 卷加密与 AWS KMS 原生集成，并通过 EBS/EC2 设置或启动模板进行配置；添加 Kubernetes 加密插件会增加不必要的运营开销，并且不是加密 EBS 卷的标准方式。
- **B** 错误，因为 EBS 默认加密对 **现有 EBS 卷** 没有影响，并且 AWS 指出你无法更改与现有加密卷关联的 KMS key ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html))。开销最小的方法是确保在创建卷时应用加密。
- **E** 错误，因为将 KMS 客户托管密钥作为 Kubernetes secret 存储并不是 AWS KMS keys 的使用方式。KMS keys 保留在 AWS KMS 中，AWS 服务被授予使用它们的权限；将密钥材料存储在集群中既不安全，又会带来运营负担。

en.question: A company wants to migrate an Oracle database to AWS. The database consists of a single table that contains millions of geographic information systems (GIS) images that are high resolution and are identified by a geographic code. When a natural disaster occurs, tens of thousands of images get updated every few minutes. Each geographic code has a single image or row that is associated with it. The company wants a solution that is highly available and scalable during such events. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store the images and geographic codes in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.B: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Use Amazon DynamoDB with the geographic code as the key and the image S3 URL as the value.
options.C: Store the images and geographic codes in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) during times of high load.
options.D: Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Store geographic codes and image S3 URLs in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The most cost-effective design is to store the large, high-resolution GIS images as **Amazon S3 objects** and store only the lookup metadata in **DynamoDB**. Amazon S3 is scalable object storage that can “store and retrieve any amount of data” and stores data redundantly across at least 3 Availability Zones by default, which fits the image storage and availability requirement ([Amazon S3 data inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-data-inventory.html)). DynamoDB is a good fit for the access pattern because each geographic code maps to exactly one image URL, so the geographic code can be the table key. DynamoDB on-demand is serverless, automatically scales, supports workloads that can scale to millions of requests per second, and uses pay-per-request pricing ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Storing millions of high-resolution images directly in an Oracle RDS table is not the most cost-effective or scalable object storage approach. RDS Multi-AZ provides high availability and failover, but AWS notes that the high availability option is not a scaling solution and the standby replica cannot serve read traffic ([RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).
- **C:** DynamoDB should not store the images themselves. DynamoDB items have a maximum size of **400 KB**, which is unsuitable for high-resolution images ([DynamoDB constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)). DAX also would not solve the large-object storage problem.
- **D:** Storing images in S3 is good, but using Oracle on RDS just to store geographic codes and S3 URLs is less cost-effective and less automatically scalable than DynamoDB for a simple key-value lookup pattern. RDS Multi-AZ is primarily for availability/failover, not elastic scaling ([RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将一个 Oracle 数据库迁移到 AWS。该数据库由一个单表组成，其中包含数百万张高分辨率的地理信息系统 (GIS) 图像，并通过地理编码进行标识。当发生自然灾害时，每隔几分钟就会有数万张图像被更新。每个地理编码都有一张与之关联的图像或一行数据。该公司希望获得一种在此类事件期间具有高可用性和可扩展性的解决方案。哪种解决方案最具成本效益地满足这些要求？

options.A: 将图像和地理编码存储在数据库表中。使用在 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance 上运行的 Oracle。
options.B: 将图像存储在 Amazon S3 buckets 中。使用 Amazon DynamoDB，将地理编码作为键，将图像 S3 URL 作为值。
options.C: 将图像和地理编码存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。在高负载期间配置 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。
options.D: 将图像存储在 Amazon S3 buckets 中。将地理编码和图像 S3 URL 存储在数据库表中。使用在 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance 上运行的 Oracle。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

最具成本效益的设计是将大型高分辨率 GIS 图像存储为 **Amazon S3 objects**，并且只在 **DynamoDB** 中存储查找元数据。Amazon S3 是可扩展的对象存储，可以“存储和检索任意数量的数据”，并且默认情况下会跨至少 3 个 Availability Zones 冗余存储数据，这符合图像存储和可用性要求（[Amazon S3 data inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-data-inventory.html)）。DynamoDB 非常适合这种访问模式，因为每个地理编码都精确映射到一个图像 URL，因此地理编码可以作为表键。DynamoDB on-demand 是无服务器的，可自动扩展，支持可扩展到每秒数百万次请求的工作负载，并采用按请求付费定价（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 将数百万张高分辨率图像直接存储在 Oracle RDS 表中，并不是最具成本效益或可扩展性的对象存储方法。RDS Multi-AZ 提供高可用性和故障转移，但 AWS 指出，高可用性选项并不是一种扩展解决方案，并且备用副本不能承担读取流量（[RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。
- **C:** DynamoDB 不应存储图像本身。DynamoDB items 的最大大小为 **400 KB**，不适合高分辨率图像（[DynamoDB constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)）。DAX 也无法解决大对象存储问题。
- **D:** 将图像存储在 S3 中是好的，但仅为了存储地理编码和 S3 URL 而在 RDS 上使用 Oracle，对于简单的键值查找模式来说，比 DynamoDB 成本效益更低，自动扩展能力也更弱。RDS Multi-AZ 主要用于可用性/故障转移，而不是弹性扩展（[RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。

en.question: A company has an application that collects data from IoT sensors on automobiles. The data is streamed and stored in Amazon S3 through Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. The data produces trillions of S3 objects each year. Each morning, the company uses the data from the previous 30 days to retrain a suite of machine learning (ML) models. Four times each year, the company uses the data from the previous 12 months to perform analysis and train other ML models. The data must be available with minimal delay for up to 1 year. After 1 year, the data must be retained for archival purposes. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.B: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically move objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.C: Use the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
options.D: Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days, and then to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The workload has a well-defined access pattern: data is actively used during the first 30 days, then used only quarterly for the rest of the first year, and then retained only for archive. AWS describes **S3 Standard** as the default class for frequently accessed/performance-sensitive data requiring millisecond access, and **S3 Standard-IA** as suitable for long-lived, infrequently accessed data that still requires millisecond access. AWS even gives the pattern of uploading to S3 Standard and using lifecycle configuration to transition older data to S3 Standard-IA. S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to less-expensive storage classes and archive them as their access pattern changes. Finally, **S3 Glacier Deep Archive** is AWS’s lowest-cost storage option for archive data and is not for real-time access, which matches the requirement after 1 year. Therefore, Standard for 30 days, Standard-IA until 1 year, then Deep Archive is the most cost-effective fit. ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html), [S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering is ideal when access patterns are **unknown or changing** and includes a monthly monitoring/automation fee. Here, the access pattern is known, and there are trillions of objects each year, so explicit lifecycle transitions avoid unnecessary Intelligent-Tiering monitoring overhead. ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html))
- **B:** Intelligent-Tiering archive tiers are for data that can be accessed asynchronously; Deep Archive Access has S3 Glacier Deep Archive performance and requires restore before access. That does not match the requirement for minimal-delay access during the first year, and Intelligent-Tiering is not the best choice when the lifecycle is predictable. ([S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html))
- **C:** Starting all objects in S3 Standard-IA is not optimal because the previous 30 days of data are accessed every morning. AWS says Standard-IA is for infrequently accessed data and has retrieval fees, while S3 Standard is appropriate for frequently accessed data. ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html))

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，用于收集汽车上 IoT 传感器的数据。数据通过 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 流式传输并存储在 Amazon S3 中。该数据每年会产生数万亿个 S3 对象。每天早上，公司使用过去 30 天的数据来重新训练一套机器学习 (ML) 模型。每年四次，公司使用过去 12 个月的数据执行分析并训练其他 ML 模型。数据必须在最多 1 年内以最小延迟可用。1 年后，数据必须出于归档目的保留。哪种存储解决方案能够以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类。创建 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在 1 年后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.B: 使用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类。配置 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，在 1 年后自动将对象移动到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 使用 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类。创建 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在 1 年后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.D: 使用 S3 Standard 存储类。创建 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)，然后在 1 年后转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** 该工作负载具有明确定义的访问模式：数据在前 30 天被频繁使用，然后在第一年的剩余时间里仅按季度使用，之后仅为归档而保留。AWS 将 **S3 Standard** 描述为适用于需要毫秒级访问的频繁访问/性能敏感型数据的默认存储类，将 **S3 Standard-IA** 描述为适用于长期保存、访问不频繁但仍需要毫秒级访问的数据。AWS 甚至给出了将数据上传到 S3 Standard，并使用生命周期配置将较旧数据转换到 S3 Standard-IA 的模式。S3 Lifecycle 规则可以在对象访问模式变化时，将对象转换到成本更低的存储类并进行归档。最后，**S3 Glacier Deep Archive** 是 AWS 面向归档数据的最低成本存储选项，并不适用于实时访问，这与 1 年后的要求相匹配。因此，前 30 天使用 Standard，直到 1 年前使用 Standard-IA，然后使用 Deep Archive，是最具成本效益的方案。([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html), [S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html))

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering 适用于访问模式**未知或变化**的情况，并包含每月监控/自动化费用。这里的访问模式是已知的，而且每年有数万亿个对象，因此显式生命周期转换可以避免不必要的 Intelligent-Tiering 监控开销。([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html))
- **B:** Intelligent-Tiering 归档层适用于可以异步访问的数据；Deep Archive Access 具有 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 的性能，并且需要先还原才能访问。这不符合第一年内最小延迟访问的要求，而且在生命周期可预测时，Intelligent-Tiering 并不是最佳选择。([S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html))
- **C:** 将所有对象一开始就放入 S3 Standard-IA 并不是最优选择，因为过去 30 天的数据每天早上都会被访问。AWS 表示 Standard-IA 适用于不频繁访问的数据，并且有检索费用，而 S3 Standard 适用于频繁访问的数据。([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html))

en.question: A company is running several business applications in three separate VPCs within the us-east-1 Region. The applications must be able to communicate between VPCs. The applications also must be able to consistently send hundreds of gigabytes of data each day to a latency-sensitive application that runs in a single on-premises data center. A solutions architect needs to design a network connectivity solution that maximizes cost-effectiveness. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure three AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from the data center to AWS. Establish connectivity by configuring one VPN connection for each VPC.
options.B: Launch a third-party virtual network appliance in each VPC. Establish an IPsec VPN tunnel between the data center and each virtual appliance.
options.C: Set up three AWS Direct Connect connections from the data center to a Direct Connect gateway in us-east-1. Establish connectivity by configuring each VPC to use one of the Direct Connect connections.
options.D: Set up one AWS Direct Connect connection from the data center to AWS. Create a transit gateway, and attach each VPC to the transit gateway. Establish connectivity between the Direct Connect connection and the transit gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Direct Connect is appropriate for the latency-sensitive, high-volume on-premises traffic because it links the internal network to an AWS Direct Connect location over dedicated Ethernet fiber and can bypass internet service providers in the network path ([AWS Direct Connect User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). For the three VPCs, AWS Transit Gateway is designed as a network transit hub to interconnect VPCs and on-premises networks, and its attachments can include one or more VPCs and a Direct Connect gateway ([Amazon VPC Transit Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)). AWS specifically documents the Direct Connect gateway + transit gateway pattern for multiple VPCs in the same Region and says it lets you “manage a single connection for multiple VPCs or VPNs that are in the same Region” ([Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)). This satisfies VPC-to-VPC and on-premises connectivity while minimizing the number of Direct Connect connections.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Three Site-to-Site VPNs would provide IPsec VPN connectivity, but VPN is not the best fit for consistently sending hundreds of GB per day to a latency-sensitive application. AWS describes Site-to-Site VPN as an IPsec connection between VPCs and on-premises networks, whereas Direct Connect provides dedicated connectivity that bypasses internet service providers ([Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html), [Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
- **B:** Third-party appliances add operational complexity and per-VPC appliance cost, and are unnecessary because AWS Transit Gateway natively interconnects VPCs and on-premises networks ([Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)).
- **C:** Three Direct Connect connections are not cost-effective. Direct Connect billing includes port-hour charges determined by capacity and connection type, so using three connections increases fixed connection cost; AWS documents a single Direct Connect gateway associated with a transit gateway as the pattern that allows a single connection for multiple VPCs in the same Region ([Direct Connect pricing elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html), [Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 us-east-1 Region 内的三个独立 VPC 中运行多个业务应用程序。这些应用程序必须能够在 VPC 之间通信。这些应用程序还必须能够每天持续向运行在单个本地数据中心中的延迟敏感型应用程序发送数百 GB 的数据。解决方案架构师需要设计一种网络连接解决方案，以最大限度提高成本效益。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 从数据中心到 AWS 配置三个 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。通过为每个 VPC 配置一个 VPN 连接来建立连接。
options.B: 在每个 VPC 中启动一个第三方虚拟网络设备。在数据中心和每个虚拟设备之间建立 IPsec VPN 隧道。
options.C: 从数据中心到 us-east-1 中的 Direct Connect gateway 设置三个 AWS Direct Connect 连接。通过配置每个 VPC 使用其中一个 Direct Connect 连接来建立连接。
options.D: 从数据中心到 AWS 设置一个 AWS Direct Connect 连接。创建一个 transit gateway，并将每个 VPC 附加到该 transit gateway。建立 Direct Connect 连接与 transit gateway 之间的连接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** AWS Direct Connect 适用于延迟敏感、高流量的本地流量，因为它通过专用以太网光纤将内部网络链接到 AWS Direct Connect 位置，并且可以绕过网络路径中的互联网服务提供商（[AWS Direct Connect User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。对于这三个 VPC，AWS Transit Gateway 被设计为网络传输枢纽，用于互连 VPC 和本地网络，并且其附件可以包括一个或多个 VPC 以及一个 Direct Connect gateway（[Amazon VPC Transit Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。AWS 专门记录了用于同一 Region 中多个 VPC 的 Direct Connect gateway + transit gateway 模式，并说明它让你可以“为位于同一 Region 的多个 VPC 或 VPN 管理单个连接”（[Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。这在满足 VPC 到 VPC 以及本地连接需求的同时，最大限度减少 Direct Connect 连接的数量。

**其他选项错误的原因：**
