- **A:** 三个 Site-to-Site VPN 将提供 IPsec VPN 连接，但对于每天持续向延迟敏感型应用程序发送数百 GB 数据的场景，VPN 不是最佳选择。AWS 将 Site-to-Site VPN 描述为 VPC 与本地网络之间的 IPsec 连接，而 Direct Connect 提供绕过互联网服务提供商的专用连接（[Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html), [Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
- **B:** 第三方设备会增加运营复杂性和每个 VPC 的设备成本，并且没有必要，因为 AWS Transit Gateway 原生支持互连 VPC 和本地网络（[Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。
- **C:** 三个 Direct Connect 连接不具备成本效益。Direct Connect 计费包括由容量和连接类型决定的端口小时费用，因此使用三个连接会增加固定连接成本；AWS 记录了与 transit gateway 关联的单个 Direct Connect gateway 这一模式，该模式允许为同一 Region 中的多个 VPC 使用单个连接（[Direct Connect pricing elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html), [Direct Connect gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company is building a distributed application that involves several serverless functions and AWS services to complete order-processing tasks. These tasks require manual approvals as part of the workflow. A solutions architect needs to design an architecture for the order-processing application. The solution must be able to combine multiple AWS Lambda functions into responsive serverless applications. The solution also must orchestrate data and services that run on Amazon EC2 instances, containers, or on-premises servers. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Step Functions to build the application.
options.B: Integrate all the application components in an AWS Glue job.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to build the application.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions and Amazon EventBridge events to build the application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Use AWS Step Functions to build the application.**

AWS Step Functions is the best fit because it is designed to create workflows/state machines to **build distributed applications**, automate processes, and **orchestrate microservices**. AWS documentation also states that Step Functions can call services such as **AWS Lambda**, control services such as **AWS Glue**, and create long-running workflows for applications that require **human interaction** ([What is Step Functions?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)). Step Functions also supports service integration patterns including **Wait for Callback with a task token**, where the workflow waits until an external callback returns, which supports manual approval workflows ([Integrating with other services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)). AWS provides an example where Step Functions orchestrates several Lambda functions and pauses for a human approval callback using a task token ([Orchestrate AWS Lambda functions with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/sample-lambda-orchestration.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. AWS Glue job** — AWS Glue is an ETL/data integration service, not the primary service for orchestrating a distributed order-processing workflow with manual approvals. AWS documentation describes Step Functions as the service that can control Glue as part of a workflow, which reinforces that Glue is a component Step Functions can orchestrate, not the workflow orchestrator itself ([What is Step Functions?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **C. Amazon SQS** — SQS can decouple components and can be integrated into Step Functions, but it does not by itself provide visual workflow orchestration, state management, branching, retries, or human approval steps. Step Functions documentation lists SQS as an integrated service within Step Functions workflows, not as a replacement for the workflow engine ([Integrating with other services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **D. Lambda and EventBridge** — Lambda and EventBridge can build event-driven applications, but this option would require custom orchestration logic for sequencing, state, callbacks, and manual approvals. Step Functions directly supports invoking Lambda synchronously, asynchronously, and with a callback task token for manual review workflows ([Invoke an AWS Lambda function with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)), resulting in lower operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司正在构建一个分布式应用程序，该应用程序涉及多个无服务器函数和 AWS 服务来完成订单处理任务。这些任务要求将人工审批作为工作流的一部分。解决方案架构师需要为该订单处理应用程序设计一种架构。该解决方案必须能够将多个 AWS Lambda 函数组合成响应式无服务器应用程序。该解决方案还必须编排在 Amazon EC2 实例、容器或本地服务器上运行的数据和服务。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Step Functions 构建该应用程序。
options.B: 在 AWS Glue job 中集成所有应用程序组件。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 构建该应用程序。
options.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon EventBridge 事件构建该应用程序。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 使用 AWS Step Functions 构建该应用程序。**

AWS Step Functions 是最佳选择，因为它旨在创建工作流/状态机，以**构建分布式应用程序**、自动化流程并**编排微服务**。AWS 文档还说明，Step Functions 可以调用 **AWS Lambda** 等服务，控制 **AWS Glue** 等服务，并为需要**人工交互**的应用程序创建长时间运行的工作流（[What is Step Functions?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。Step Functions 还支持包括 **Wait for Callback with a task token** 在内的服务集成模式，在这种模式下，工作流会一直等待，直到外部回调返回，从而支持人工审批工作流（[Integrating with other services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。AWS 提供了一个示例，其中 Step Functions 编排多个 Lambda 函数，并使用任务令牌暂停以等待人工审批回调（[Orchestrate AWS Lambda functions with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/sample-lambda-orchestration.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. AWS Glue job** — AWS Glue 是一项 ETL/数据集成服务，并不是用于编排带有人工审批的分布式订单处理工作流的主要服务。AWS 文档将 Step Functions 描述为可以在工作流中控制 Glue 的服务，这进一步说明 Glue 是 Step Functions 可以编排的组件，而不是工作流编排器本身（[What is Step Functions?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **C. Amazon SQS** — SQS 可以解耦组件，并且可以集成到 Step Functions 中，但它本身不提供可视化工作流编排、状态管理、分支、重试或人工审批步骤。Step Functions 文档将 SQS 列为 Step Functions 工作流中的集成服务，而不是工作流引擎的替代品（[Integrating with other services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **D. Lambda and EventBridge** — Lambda 和 EventBridge 可以构建事件驱动型应用程序，但此选项需要为排序、状态、回调和人工审批编写自定义编排逻辑。Step Functions 直接支持以同步、异步以及使用回调任务令牌的方式调用 Lambda，以实现人工审核工作流（[Invoke an AWS Lambda function with Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/connect-lambda.html)），从而降低运营开销。

en.question: A company has launched an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Most of the connections to the database come from serverless applications. Application traffic to the database changes significantly at random intervals. At times of high demand, users report that their applications experience database connection rejection errors. Which solution will resolve this issue with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a proxy in RDS Proxy. Configure the users’ applications to use the DB instance through RDS Proxy.
options.B: Deploy Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached between the users’ applications and the DB instance.
options.C: Migrate the DB instance to a different instance class that has higher I/O capacity. Configure the users’ applications to use the new DB instance.
options.D: Configure Multi-AZ for the DB instance. Configure the users’ applications to switch between the DB instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** RDS Proxy is designed for this exact pattern: many application connections, especially bursty/serverless traffic, to an RDS database. AWS states that RDS Proxy lets applications **pool and share database connections** to improve scalability, and that it can handle **unpredictable surges in database traffic** that otherwise cause issues from oversubscribed connections or many new connections being created quickly. It establishes and reuses a database connection pool, queues/throttles connections that cannot be served immediately, and can be enabled for most applications with no code changes, which matches the requirement for least operational overhead ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). RDS Proxy connection settings also explicitly manage database connection limits, idle pooled connections, and connection borrow timeouts; for unpredictable workloads, AWS recommends keeping more idle connections so RDS Proxy can accommodate surges without opening many new database connections ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. ElastiCache for Memcached** can help cache repeated/read-heavy or expensive database queries and offload read pressure, but it is not a database connection pooling solution. AWS describes query caching as most effective for read-heavy repeated queries, expensive queries, and offloading reads—not for resolving RDS connection rejection from bursty serverless connections ([Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)).
- **C. A larger DB instance class with higher I/O capacity** might improve I/O performance, but the symptom is connection rejection caused by connection surges. RDS Proxy directly controls and reuses database connections; simply increasing I/O capacity does not provide connection pooling or avoid rapid connection creation.
- **D. Multi-AZ** is primarily for availability/failover. AWS states that a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has a standby instance that provides failover support and **doesn't serve read traffic**; this does not solve connection spikes to the primary DB instance ([Multi-AZ deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司已启动一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance。大多数到数据库的连接都来自无服务器应用程序。到数据库的应用程序流量会在随机间隔发生显著变化。在高需求时段，用户报告其应用程序遇到数据库连接拒绝错误。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销解决此问题？

options.A: 在 RDS Proxy 中创建一个代理。配置用户的应用程序通过 RDS Proxy 使用该 DB instance。
options.B: 在用户的应用程序和 DB instance 之间部署 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached。
options.C: 将 DB instance 迁移到具有更高 I/O 容量的不同实例类别。配置用户的应用程序使用新的 DB instance。
options.D: 为 DB instance 配置 Multi-AZ。配置用户的应用程序在这些 DB instance 之间切换。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** RDS Proxy 正是为这种模式而设计的：许多应用程序连接，尤其是突发性/无服务器流量，连接到 RDS 数据库。AWS 表示，RDS Proxy 使应用程序能够**池化并共享数据库连接**以提高可扩展性，并且它可以处理**数据库流量中不可预测的激增**，否则这些激增会因连接超额订阅或快速创建大量新连接而导致问题。它会建立并重复使用数据库连接池，对无法立即提供服务的连接进行排队/限流，并且对于大多数应用程序可以在无需代码更改的情况下启用，这符合最低运营开销的要求（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。RDS Proxy 连接设置还会明确管理数据库连接限制、空闲池化连接以及连接借用超时；对于不可预测的工作负载，AWS 建议保留更多空闲连接，以便 RDS Proxy 能够在不打开大量新数据库连接的情况下应对流量激增（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. ElastiCache for Memcached** 可以帮助缓存重复/读密集型或成本高昂的数据库查询，并分担读取压力，但它不是数据库连接池解决方案。AWS 将查询缓存描述为最适合读密集型重复查询、成本高昂的查询以及分担读取负载，而不是用于解决突发性无服务器连接导致的 RDS 连接拒绝问题（[Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)）。
- **C. 具有更高 I/O 容量的更大 DB instance class** 可能会提高 I/O 性能，但症状是由连接激增导致的连接拒绝。RDS Proxy 直接控制并重复使用数据库连接；仅仅增加 I/O 容量并不能提供连接池，也不能避免快速创建连接。
- **D. Multi-AZ** 主要用于可用性/故障转移。AWS 表示，Multi-AZ DB instance 部署具有一个提供故障转移支持的备用实例，并且**不提供读取流量服务**；这无法解决到主 DB instance 的连接峰值问题（[Multi-AZ deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)）。

en.question: A company recently deployed a new auditing system to centralize information about operating system versions, patching, and installed software for Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect must ensure all instances provisioned through EC2 Auto Scaling groups successfully send reports to the auditing system as soon as they are launched and terminated. Which solution achieves these goals MOST efficiently?

options.A: Use a scheduled AWS Lambda function and run a script remotely on all EC2 instances to send data to the audit system.
options.B: Use EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to run a custom script to send data to the audit system when instances are launched and terminated.
options.C: Use an EC2 Auto Scaling launch configuration to run a custom script through user data to send data to the audit system when instances are launched and terminated.
options.D: Run a custom script on the instance operating system to send data to the audit system. Configure the script to be invoked by the EC2 Auto Scaling group when the instance starts and is terminated.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks are designed for this exact requirement: they let you perform a custom action when an instance reaches a lifecycle event, and provide wait time for that action to complete before the instance moves to the next state. AWS documents hooks for both scale-out and scale-in: during launch the hook can put the instance in `Pending:Wait` and perform a custom action; during termination it can put the instance in `Terminating:Wait` and perform a custom action before the instance is terminated ([lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html), [how lifecycle hooks work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks-overview.html)). The lifecycle hook availability table also shows hooks are available for both **Instance launching** and **Instance terminating** events ([lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)). This is the most efficient event-driven way to ensure audit reports are sent when Auto Scaling instances launch and terminate.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A scheduled Lambda function is periodic, not directly tied to each launch/termination event. It can miss short-lived instances between runs and is less efficient than using the Auto Scaling lifecycle events directly.
- **C:** User data can run commands when an instance launches, but AWS states that user data scripts run during the boot cycle when the instance is first launched by default ([EC2 user data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)). It does not natively handle the Auto Scaling **termination** event.
- **D:** Auto Scaling groups do not directly invoke arbitrary OS scripts merely because an instance starts or terminates. The supported Auto Scaling mechanism for pausing launch/termination and performing custom actions is lifecycle hooks ([how lifecycle hooks work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks-overview.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近部署了一个新的审计系统，用于集中收集 Amazon EC2 实例的操作系统版本、补丁和已安装软件相关信息。解决方案架构师必须确保所有通过 EC2 Auto Scaling 组预置的实例在启动和终止时都能成功向审计系统发送报告。哪种解决方案能最高效地实现这些目标？

options.A: 使用计划的 AWS Lambda 函数，并在所有 EC2 实例上远程运行脚本，以将数据发送到审计系统。
options.B: 使用 EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks，在实例启动和终止时运行自定义脚本，将数据发送到审计系统。
options.C: 使用 EC2 Auto Scaling launch configuration，通过 user data 运行自定义脚本，在实例启动和终止时将数据发送到审计系统。
options.D: 在实例操作系统上运行自定义脚本，将数据发送到审计系统。配置该脚本，使其在实例启动和终止时由 EC2 Auto Scaling 组调用。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks 正是为此类需求而设计的：它们允许你在实例到达某个生命周期事件时执行自定义操作，并为该操作完成提供等待时间，然后实例才会进入下一个状态。AWS 文档说明 hooks 可用于 scale-out 和 scale-in：在启动期间，hook 可以将实例置于 `Pending:Wait` 并执行自定义操作；在终止期间，它可以将实例置于 `Terminating:Wait` 并在实例终止前执行自定义操作（[lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)，[how lifecycle hooks work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks-overview.html)）。lifecycle hook 可用性表还显示，hooks 可用于 **Instance launching** 和 **Instance terminating** 事件（[lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)）。这是确保 Auto Scaling 实例启动和终止时发送审计报告的最高效事件驱动方式。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 计划的 Lambda 函数是周期性的，并不直接绑定到每个启动/终止事件。它可能会漏掉两次运行之间的短生命周期实例，并且不如直接使用 Auto Scaling 生命周期事件高效。
- **C:** User data 可以在实例启动时运行命令，但 AWS 声明，默认情况下，user data 脚本会在实例首次启动时的启动周期内运行（[EC2 user data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)）。它不能原生处理 Auto Scaling **termination** 事件。
- **D:** Auto Scaling 组不会仅因为实例启动或终止就直接调用任意操作系统脚本。用于暂停启动/终止并执行自定义操作的受支持 Auto Scaling 机制是 lifecycle hooks（[how lifecycle hooks work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks-overview.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing a real-time multiplayer game that uses UDP for communications between the client and servers in an Auto Scaling group. Spikes in demand are anticipated during the day, so the game server platform must adapt accordingly. Developers want to store gamer scores and other non-relational data in a database solution that will scale without intervention. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Use Amazon Route 53 for traffic distribution and Amazon Aurora Serverless for data storage.
options.B: Use a Network Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon DynamoDB on-demand for data storage.
options.C: Use a Network Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon Aurora Global Database for data storage.
options.D: Use an Application Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon DynamoDB global tables for data storage.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

- The game uses **UDP**, so the load balancer must support UDP listeners. AWS documents that **Network Load Balancer** listeners support protocols including **TCP, TLS, UDP, TCP_UDP, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC** on ports 1–65535 ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)). Elastic Load Balancing also automatically distributes incoming traffic across targets and scales load balancer capacity in response to traffic changes ([ELB overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)).
- The data is **non-relational** and must scale without intervention during spikes. DynamoDB on-demand provides a serverless database experience that **automatically scales** without capacity planning, eliminates capacity management, and scales as workload traffic increases ([DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Route 53 is DNS routing, not the appropriate load balancer for distributing real-time UDP game traffic across an Auto Scaling group. Aurora Serverless is an Aurora/RDS relational database option, not the best fit for non-relational gamer score data.
- **C**: A Network Load Balancer is correct for UDP, but **Aurora Global Database** is still an Aurora/RDS relational database solution, not the requested non-relational database that scales without intervention.
- **D**: DynamoDB global tables can support globally replicated DynamoDB data, but the traffic distribution component is wrong: **Application Load Balancer** listeners support only **HTTP and HTTPS**, not UDP ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一款实时多人游戏，该游戏使用 UDP 在客户端与 Auto Scaling group 中的服务器之间进行通信。预计白天会出现需求高峰，因此游戏服务器平台必须能够相应地适应。开发人员希望将玩家分数和其他非关系型数据存储在一个无需人工干预即可扩展的数据库解决方案中。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种解决方案？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Route 53 进行流量分配，并使用 Amazon Aurora Serverless 进行数据存储。
options.B: 使用 Network Load Balancer 进行流量分配，并使用 Amazon DynamoDB on-demand 进行数据存储。
options.C: 使用 Network Load Balancer 进行流量分配，并使用 Amazon Aurora Global Database 进行数据存储。
options.D: 使用 Application Load Balancer 进行流量分配，并使用 Amazon DynamoDB global tables 进行数据存储。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

- 该游戏使用 **UDP**，因此负载均衡器必须支持 UDP 侦听器。AWS 文档说明，**Network Load Balancer** 侦听器支持的协议包括 **TCP, TLS, UDP, TCP_UDP, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC**，端口范围为 1–65535（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。Elastic Load Balancing 还会自动将传入流量分配到目标，并根据流量变化扩展负载均衡器容量（[ELB overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。
- 数据是 **non-relational**，并且必须在高峰期间无需干预即可扩展。DynamoDB on-demand 提供一种无服务器数据库体验，可以在无需容量规划的情况下 **automatically scales**，消除容量管理，并随着工作负载流量增加而扩展（[DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A**：Route 53 是 DNS 路由，并不是用于在 Auto Scaling group 中分配实时 UDP 游戏流量的合适负载均衡器。Aurora Serverless 是 Aurora/RDS 关系型数据库选项，并不最适合非关系型的玩家分数数据。
- **C**：Network Load Balancer 对 UDP 来说是正确的，但 **Aurora Global Database** 仍然是 Aurora/RDS 关系型数据库解决方案，不是所要求的无需干预即可扩展的非关系型数据库。
- **D**：DynamoDB global tables 可以支持全局复制的 DynamoDB 数据，但流量分配组件是错误的：**Application Load Balancer** 侦听器仅支持 **HTTP and HTTPS**，不支持 UDP（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts a frontend application that uses an Amazon API Gateway API backend that is integrated with AWS Lambda. When the API receives requests, the Lambda function loads many libraries. Then the Lambda function connects to an Amazon RDS database, processes the data, and returns the data to the frontend application. The company wants to ensure that response latency is as low as possible for all its users with the fewest number of changes to the company's operations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Establish a connection between the frontend application and the database to make queries faster by bypassing the API.
options.B: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function that handles the requests.
options.C: Cache the results of the queries in Amazon S3 for faster retrieval of similar datasets.
options.D: Increase the size of the database to increase the number of connections Lambda can establish at one time.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function that handles the requests.**

The latency driver described in the question is Lambda initialization work: loading many libraries and establishing runtime state before processing a user request. AWS states that **provisioned concurrency** allocates **pre-initialized execution environments** that are “ready to respond immediately” and is useful for **reducing cold start latencies**, especially for latency-sensitive interactive workloads such as web and mobile applications with user-initiated requests ([AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)). This meets the requirement with minimal operational change: configure the existing Lambda function rather than redesigning the application or data layer.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Direct frontend-to-database connection** — This bypasses the existing API Gateway/Lambda backend and would require a significant application and security architecture change. It also exposes database access concerns to the frontend rather than addressing Lambda cold-start latency.
- **C. Cache query results in Amazon S3** — This would require application changes to write/read cached query results and would only help for repeatable similar datasets. It does not directly address the Lambda initialization latency from loading libraries.
- **D. Increase the database size** — Scaling the database might help database capacity, but the stated latency issue is Lambda startup/initialization. AWS documentation distinguishes concurrency controls: reserved concurrency can limit scaling to avoid overwhelming downstream resources such as database connections, while **provisioned concurrency** is the feature designed for cold-start latency reduction ([AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司托管了一个前端应用程序，该应用程序使用与 AWS Lambda 集成的 Amazon API Gateway API 后端。当 API 收到请求时，Lambda 函数会加载许多库。然后 Lambda 函数连接到 Amazon RDS 数据库，处理数据，并将数据返回给前端应用程序。该公司希望在对公司运营进行最少更改的情况下，确保其所有用户的响应延迟尽可能低。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在前端应用程序和数据库之间建立连接，通过绕过 API 来更快地进行查询。
options.B: 为处理请求的 Lambda 函数配置预置并发。
options.C: 将查询结果缓存在 Amazon S3 中，以便更快地检索类似数据集。
options.D: 增加数据库的大小，以增加 Lambda 一次可以建立的连接数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 为处理请求的 Lambda 函数配置预置并发。**

题目中描述的延迟驱动因素是 Lambda 初始化工作：在处理用户请求之前加载许多库并建立运行时状态。AWS 表示，**预置并发**会分配**预初始化的执行环境**，这些环境“准备好立即响应”，并且有助于**降低冷启动延迟**，尤其适用于对延迟敏感的交互式工作负载，例如由用户发起请求的 Web 和移动应用程序（[AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。这通过最少的运营变更满足要求：配置现有 Lambda 函数，而不是重新设计应用程序或数据层。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 前端直接连接数据库** — 这会绕过现有的 API Gateway/Lambda 后端，并且需要对应用程序和安全架构进行重大更改。它还会将数据库访问相关问题暴露给前端，而不是解决 Lambda 冷启动延迟。
- **C. 在 Amazon S3 中缓存查询结果** — 这需要更改应用程序以写入/读取缓存的查询结果，并且只对可重复的类似数据集有帮助。它并不能直接解决加载库所导致的 Lambda 初始化延迟。
- **D. 增加数据库大小** — 扩展数据库可能有助于提升数据库容量，但题目所述的延迟问题是 Lambda 启动/初始化。AWS 文档区分了并发控制：预留并发可以限制扩展，以避免压垮下游资源（例如数据库连接），而**预置并发**是专为降低冷启动延迟而设计的功能（[AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating its on-premises workload to the AWS Cloud. The company already uses several Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon RDS DB instances. The company wants a solution that automatically starts and stops the EC2 instances and DB instances outside of business hours. The solution must minimize cost and infrastructure maintenance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Scale the EC2 instances by using elastic resize. Scale the DB instances to zero outside of business hours.
options.B: Explore AWS Marketplace for partner solutions that will automatically start and stop the EC2 instances and DB instances on a schedule.
options.C: Launch another EC2 instance. Configure a crontab schedule to run shell scripts that will start and stop the existing EC2 instances and DB instances on a schedule.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that will start and stop the EC2 instances and DB instances. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function on a schedule.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

A Lambda function can contain the AWS SDK/API calls to stop and start the EC2 instances and RDS DB instances, and EventBridge can invoke that Lambda function on a recurring schedule. AWS documents that EventBridge Scheduler is a managed, serverless scheduler that can create schedules with cron/rate expressions and invoke Lambda functions asynchronously on a schedule ([Lambda + EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-eventbridge-scheduler.html)). This minimizes infrastructure maintenance because no scheduling server is required. The target actions are valid: EC2 instances can be stopped/started, and stopped EC2 instances no longer incur instance usage charges, though EBS charges remain ([EC2 stop/start costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-ec2-instance-stop-start-works.html)); RDS DB instances can be stopped temporarily for cost optimization and are not charged for DB instance hours while stopped ([RDS stop DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EC2 resizing changes instance type/capacity; it does not automatically start and stop resources on a schedule. Also, RDS DB instances are stopped temporarily rather than “scaled to zero”; AWS describes stop/start behavior and notes that storage and backup charges still apply while stopped ([RDS stop DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)).
- **B:** A Marketplace partner product might work, but it is not the lowest-maintenance or lowest-cost native approach. The requirement can be met with AWS managed/serverless services: EventBridge Scheduler plus Lambda.
- **C:** Running cron on another EC2 instance adds an extra server to operate, patch, monitor, and pay for. A serverless scheduled Lambda approach avoids that additional infrastructure while still performing the same API-based stop/start actions.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其本地工作负载迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司已经使用了多个 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon RDS DB 实例。该公司希望有一个解决方案，可以在非营业时间自动启动和停止 EC2 实例和 DB 实例。该解决方案必须最大限度地降低成本和基础设施维护。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 elastic resize 扩展 EC2 实例。在非营业时间将 DB 实例扩展到零。
options.B: 在 AWS Marketplace 中探索合作伙伴解决方案，以便按计划自动启动和停止 EC2 实例和 DB 实例。
options.C: 启动另一个 EC2 实例。配置 crontab 计划来运行 shell 脚本，以按计划启动和停止现有的 EC2 实例和 DB 实例。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于启动和停止 EC2 实例和 DB 实例。配置 Amazon EventBridge 按计划调用该 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

Lambda 函数可以包含用于停止和启动 EC2 实例以及 RDS DB 实例的 AWS SDK/API 调用，EventBridge 可以按重复计划调用该 Lambda 函数。AWS 文档说明，EventBridge Scheduler 是一种托管式、无服务器的计划程序，可以使用 cron/rate 表达式创建计划，并按计划异步调用 Lambda 函数（[Lambda + EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-eventbridge-scheduler.html)）。这最大限度地减少了基础设施维护，因为不需要调度服务器。目标操作是有效的：EC2 实例可以被停止/启动，已停止的 EC2 实例不再产生实例使用费用，但仍会产生 EBS 费用（[EC2 stop/start costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-ec2-instance-stop-start-works.html)）；RDS DB 实例可以临时停止以进行成本优化，并且在停止期间不会按 DB 实例小时收费（[RDS stop DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EC2 resizing 会更改实例类型/容量；它不会按计划自动启动和停止资源。此外，RDS DB 实例是临时停止，而不是“扩展到零”；AWS 描述了 stop/start 行为，并指出在停止期间仍会产生存储和备份费用（[RDS stop DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。
- **B:** Marketplace 合作伙伴产品可能可行，但它不是最低维护或最低成本的原生方法。该要求可以通过 AWS 托管式/无服务器服务来满足：EventBridge Scheduler 加 Lambda。
- **C:** 在另一个 EC2 实例上运行 cron 会增加一台需要运维、修补、监控并付费的额外服务器。无服务器的计划 Lambda 方法可以避免这种额外基础设施，同时仍执行相同的基于 API 的停止/启动操作。

en.question: A company hosts a three-tier web application that includes a PostgreSQL database. The database stores the metadata from documents. The company searches the metadata for key terms to retrieve documents that the company reviews in a report each month. The documents are stored in Amazon S3. The documents are usually written only once, but they are updated frequently. The reporting process takes a few hours with the use of relational queries. The reporting process must not prevent any document modifications or the addition of new documents. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to speed up the reporting process. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the application code?

options.A: Set up a new Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) cluster that includes a read replica. Scale the read replica to generate the reports.
options.B: Set up a new Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster that includes an Aurora Replica. Issue queries to the Aurora Replica to generate the reports.
options.C: Set up a new Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Configure the reporting module to query the secondary RDS node so that the reporting module does not affect the primary node.
options.D: Set up a new Amazon DynamoDB table to store the documents. Use a fixed write capacity to support new document entries. Automatically scale the read capacity to support the reports.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The application already uses PostgreSQL and relational queries, so moving to **Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL** requires the least application change. AWS states that Aurora is compatible with PostgreSQL and that existing PostgreSQL code, tools, and applications can be used with Aurora, often without changes to most applications. Aurora Replicas are read-only DB instances; AWS says you can issue queries to them to scale read operations, typically through the reader endpoint, and that write operations are managed by the primary instance while replicas are dedicated to reads. This lets the monthly reporting workload run on an Aurora Replica without blocking document metadata updates or inserts on the writer instance ([Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html), [Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon DocumentDB is MongoDB-compatible, not PostgreSQL-compatible. AWS describes it as a service for MongoDB-compatible databases and MongoDB application code/drivers/tools. Migrating a PostgreSQL relational application and reporting queries to DocumentDB would require significant application and data model changes ([DocumentDB overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/developerguide/what-is.html)).
- **C:** A standard RDS Multi-AZ DB instance is for high availability and failover, not read scaling. AWS explicitly states that the standby replica in a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment **can't serve read traffic**; to serve read-only traffic, use a read replica or Multi-AZ DB cluster instead ([RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).
- **D:** DynamoDB is NoSQL and requires schema design around specific access patterns. AWS notes that DynamoDB data structures are tailored to business use cases and queries are efficient only in a limited number of designed ways. Replacing PostgreSQL relational metadata queries with DynamoDB would not be the least-change solution ([DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司托管了一个三层 Web 应用程序，其中包括一个 PostgreSQL 数据库。该数据库存储来自文档的元数据。公司会搜索元数据中的关键术语，以检索公司每月在报告中审阅的文档。这些文档存储在 Amazon S3 中。这些文档通常只写入一次，但会频繁更新。报告流程使用关系查询需要几个小时。报告流程不得阻止任何文档修改或新增文档。解决方案架构师需要实施一个解决方案来加快报告流程。哪种解决方案能在对应用程序代码改动最少的情况下满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置一个新的 Amazon DocumentDB（兼容 MongoDB）集群，其中包括一个只读副本。扩展该只读副本以生成报告。
options.B: 设置一个新的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库集群，其中包括一个 Aurora Replica。向 Aurora Replica 发出查询以生成报告。
options.C: 设置一个新的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ 数据库实例。配置报告模块查询辅助 RDS 节点，以便报告模块不会影响主节点。
options.D: 设置一个新的 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储文档。使用固定写入容量来支持新的文档条目。自动扩展读取容量以支持报告。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该应用程序已经使用 PostgreSQL 和关系查询，因此迁移到 **Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL** 所需的应用程序更改最少。AWS 表示 Aurora 与 PostgreSQL 兼容，并且现有 PostgreSQL 代码、工具和应用程序可以与 Aurora 一起使用，通常无需更改大多数应用程序。Aurora Replicas 是只读 DB 实例；AWS 表示你可以向它们发出查询以扩展读取操作，通常通过读取器端点进行，并且写入操作由主实例管理，而副本专用于读取。这使每月报告工作负载可以在 Aurora Replica 上运行，而不会阻塞写入器实例上的文档元数据更新或插入（[Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)，[Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon DocumentDB 兼容 MongoDB，而不兼容 PostgreSQL。AWS 将其描述为用于 MongoDB 兼容数据库以及 MongoDB 应用程序代码/驱动程序/工具的服务。将 PostgreSQL 关系型应用程序和报告查询迁移到 DocumentDB 需要进行大量应用程序和数据模型更改（[DocumentDB overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/developerguide/what-is.html)）。
- **C:** 标准 RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例用于高可用性和故障转移，而不是读取扩展。AWS 明确说明，Multi-AZ DB 实例部署中的备用副本 **can't serve read traffic**；若要提供只读流量，应改用只读副本或 Multi-AZ DB 集群（[RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。
- **D:** DynamoDB 是 NoSQL，并且需要围绕特定访问模式进行架构设计。AWS 指出，DynamoDB 数据结构是针对业务用例定制的，查询只有在有限数量的已设计方式下才高效。用 DynamoDB 替换 PostgreSQL 关系型元数据查询并不是改动最少的解决方案（[DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。

en.question: A company has a three-tier application on AWS that ingests sensor data from its users’ devices. The traffic flows through a Network Load Balancer (NLB), then to Amazon EC2 instances for the web tier, and finally to EC2 instances for the application tier. The application tier makes calls to a database. What should a solutions architect do to improve the security of the data in transit?

options.A: Configure a TLS listener. Deploy the server certificate on the NLB.
options.B: Configure AWS Shield Advanced. Enable AWS WAF on the NLB.
options.C: Change the load balancer to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Enable AWS WAF on the ALB.
options.D: Encrypt the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume on the EC2 instances by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Configure a TLS listener. Deploy the server certificate on the NLB.**

A TLS listener directly addresses **data in transit** protection. AWS documentation states that Network Load Balancer listeners support the **TLS** protocol, and that a TLS listener can offload encryption and decryption to the load balancer. If the listener protocol is TLS, at least one SSL server certificate must be deployed on the listener ([Listeners for your Network Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)). AWS also states that a secure NLB listener requires at least one server certificate deployed on the load balancer ([Server certificates for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/tls-listener-certificates.html)). This improves security for traffic between clients/devices and the NLB by using TLS.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Configure AWS Shield Advanced. Enable AWS WAF on the NLB.** Shield Advanced is for DDoS protection, not encryption of data in transit; AWS describes Shield as protection against DDoS attacks at layers 3, 4, and 7 ([How AWS Shield and Shield Advanced work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)). Also, AWS WAF protects resources such as CloudFront, API Gateway, and **Application Load Balancers**; NLB is not listed as an AWS WAF protected resource in the WAF documentation ([AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-chapter.html)).
- **C. Change the load balancer to an ALB. Enable AWS WAF on the ALB.** AWS WAF can protect an ALB, but WAF monitors and controls HTTP(S) requests; it is not the mechanism for encrypting data in transit. The existing NLB already supports TLS listeners, so changing to an ALB for WAF does not best meet the in-transit encryption requirement.
- **D. Encrypt the EBS volume by using AWS KMS.** EBS encryption protects EBS volumes and snapshots and the path between an instance and attached EBS storage, but it does not encrypt application traffic flowing from users through the NLB to the tiers and database ([Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上有一个三层应用程序，用于从其用户的设备摄取传感器数据。流量先经过 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，然后到达 Web 层的 Amazon EC2 实例，最后到达应用程序层的 EC2 实例。应用程序层会调用数据库。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来提高传输中数据的安全性？

options.A: 配置 TLS 侦听器。在 NLB 上部署服务器证书。
options.B: 配置 AWS Shield Advanced。在 NLB 上启用 AWS WAF。
options.C: 将负载均衡器更改为 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。在 ALB 上启用 AWS WAF。
options.D: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密 EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. Configure a TLS listener. Deploy the server certificate on the NLB.**

TLS 侦听器直接满足保护**传输中数据**的要求。AWS 文档说明，Network Load Balancer 侦听器支持 **TLS** 协议，并且 TLS 侦听器可以将加密和解密卸载到负载均衡器。如果侦听器协议是 TLS，则必须在侦听器上部署至少一个 SSL 服务器证书（[Listeners for your Network Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。AWS 还说明，安全的 NLB 侦听器需要在负载均衡器上部署至少一个服务器证书（[Server certificates for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/tls-listener-certificates.html)）。这通过使用 TLS 提高了客户端/设备与 NLB 之间流量的安全性。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Configure AWS Shield Advanced. Enable AWS WAF on the NLB.** Shield Advanced 用于 DDoS 防护，而不是对传输中的数据进行加密；AWS 将 Shield 描述为针对第 3、4 和 7 层 DDoS 攻击的防护（[How AWS Shield and Shield Advanced work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)）。此外，AWS WAF 保护 CloudFront、API Gateway 和 **Application Load Balancers** 等资源；在 WAF 文档中，NLB 未被列为 AWS WAF 受保护资源（[AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-chapter.html)）。
- **C. Change the load balancer to an ALB. Enable AWS WAF on the ALB.** AWS WAF 可以保护 ALB，但 WAF 监控和控制 HTTP(S) 请求；它不是用于加密传输中数据的机制。现有 NLB 已经支持 TLS 侦听器，因此为了 WAF 而更改为 ALB 并不能最佳满足传输中加密的要求。
- **D. Encrypt the EBS volume by using AWS KMS.** EBS 加密保护 EBS 卷和快照，以及实例与挂载的 EBS 存储之间的路径，但它不会加密从用户经过 NLB 流向各层和数据库的应用程序流量（[Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)）。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate a commercial off-the-shelf application from its on-premises data center to AWS. The software has a software licensing model using sockets and cores with predictable capacity and uptime requirements. The company wants to use its existing licenses, which were purchased earlier this year. Which Amazon EC2 pricing option is the MOST cost-effective?

options.A: Dedicated Reserved Hosts
options.B: Dedicated On-Demand Hosts
options.C: Dedicated Reserved Instances
options.D: Dedicated On-Demand Instances

en.explanation:
**Answer: A. Dedicated Reserved Hosts**

Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts are the correct tenancy model because AWS states that Dedicated Hosts let you use existing **per-socket, per-core, or per-VM software licenses**, which matches the application's socket/core licensing requirement and BYOL goal ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)). Because the workload has predictable capacity and uptime requirements, a reservation is more cost-effective than On-Demand: AWS states that **Dedicated Host Reservations provide a billing discount compared to running On-Demand Dedicated Hosts**, with 1-year and 3-year options ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-billing.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. Dedicated On-Demand Hosts**: Dedicated Hosts support the license model, but On-Demand is not the most cost-effective choice for predictable, steady usage because Dedicated Host Reservations provide a discount over On-Demand Dedicated Hosts ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-billing.html)).
- **C. Dedicated Reserved Instances**: Reserved Instances can reduce compute cost, but this option is not a Dedicated Host. The key requirement is using existing per-socket/per-core licenses, which AWS specifically associates with **Dedicated Hosts** ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)).
- **D. Dedicated On-Demand Instances**: This is neither the most cost-effective option for predictable usage nor the documented BYOL fit for per-socket/per-core licensing; Dedicated Hosts are the option AWS documents for those license types ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个商业现成应用程序从其本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该软件采用基于插槽和核心的软件许可模型，并且容量和正常运行时间要求可预测。公司希望使用其今年早些时候购买的现有许可证。哪种 Amazon EC2 定价选项最具成本效益？

options.A: Dedicated Reserved Hosts
options.B: Dedicated On-Demand Hosts
options.C: Dedicated Reserved Instances
options.D: Dedicated On-Demand Instances

zh.explanation:
**答案：A. Dedicated Reserved Hosts**

Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts 是正确的租赁模型，因为 AWS 声明 Dedicated Hosts 允许你使用现有的 **per-socket、per-core 或 per-VM 软件许可证**，这与该应用程序的 socket/core 许可要求和 BYOL 目标相匹配（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)）。由于该工作负载具有可预测的容量和正常运行时间要求，reservation 比 On-Demand 更具成本效益：AWS 声明 **Dedicated Host Reservations provide a billing discount compared to running On-Demand Dedicated Hosts**，并提供 1 年和 3 年选项（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-billing.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B. Dedicated On-Demand Hosts**：Dedicated Hosts 支持该许可模型，但对于可预测、稳定的使用量，On-Demand 不是最具成本效益的选择，因为 Dedicated Host Reservations 相比 On-Demand Dedicated Hosts 提供折扣（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-billing.html)）。
- **C. Dedicated Reserved Instances**：Reserved Instances 可以降低计算成本，但此选项不是 Dedicated Host。关键要求是使用现有的 per-socket/per-core 许可证，而 AWS 明确将其与 **Dedicated Hosts** 关联（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)）。
- **D. Dedicated On-Demand Instances**：对于可预测使用量，这既不是最具成本效益的选项，也不是文档中针对 per-socket/per-core 许可的 BYOL 匹配项；Dedicated Hosts 才是 AWS 文档中针对这些许可证类型说明的选项（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/dedicated-hosts-BYOL.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 Linux instances across multiple Availability Zones. The application needs a storage layer that is highly available and Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX)-compliant. The storage layer must provide maximum data durability and must be shareable across the EC2 instances. The data in the storage layer will be accessed frequently for the first 30 days and will be accessed infrequently after that time. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move infrequently accessed data to S3 Glacier.
options.B: Use the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move infrequently accessed data to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.C: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard storage class. Create a lifecycle management policy to move infrequently accessed data to EFS Standard-Infrequent Access (EFS Standard-IA).
options.D: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone storage class. Create a lifecycle management policy to move infrequently accessed data to EFS One Zone-Infrequent Access (EFS One Zone-IA).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The workload needs shared, POSIX-style file storage for Linux EC2 instances across multiple AZs. Amazon EFS provides shared file storage, supports NFSv4.0/NFSv4.1, is accessible from EC2, provides file-system semantics such as consistency and locking, and supports POSIX permissions ([EFS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)). For high availability and maximum durability, the EFS **Regional/Standard** option is appropriate because Regional file systems store data redundantly across multiple geographically separated Availability Zones and are designed for data requiring the highest durability and availability ([EFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). EFS lifecycle policies can transition files to IA after 30 days since last access, matching the access pattern and reducing cost ([Configuring lifecycle policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/enable-lifecycle-management.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **A and B:** Amazon S3 is an object storage service, not the native shared POSIX-compliant file system required here ([Amazon S3 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). S3 lifecycle policies are cost-effective for object storage, but they do not meet the POSIX-compliant shared file-system requirement.
* **D:** EFS One Zone can be shared, but One Zone file systems store data in a single Availability Zone, and data might be lost if that AZ is damaged or lost; AWS states Regional file systems are recommended for the highest durability and availability ([EFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). Therefore One Zone does not meet the “maximum data durability” and multi-AZ high-availability requirement as well as EFS Standard/Regional.

zh.question: 一家公司在多个 Availability Zones 中的 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例上运行一个应用程序。该应用程序需要一个高可用且符合 Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX) 的存储层。该存储层必须提供最大的数据持久性，并且必须能够在这些 EC2 实例之间共享。存储层中的数据在前 30 天会被频繁访问，之后会被不频繁访问。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 Standard storage class。创建 S3 Lifecycle policy，将不频繁访问的数据移动到 S3 Glacier。
options.B: 使用 Amazon S3 Standard storage class。创建 S3 Lifecycle policy，将不频繁访问的数据移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard storage class。创建 lifecycle management policy，将不频繁访问的数据移动到 EFS Standard-Infrequent Access (EFS Standard-IA)。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone storage class。创建 lifecycle management policy，将不频繁访问的数据移动到 EFS One Zone-Infrequent Access (EFS One Zone-IA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 该工作负载需要为跨多个 AZ 的 Linux EC2 实例提供共享的、POSIX 风格的文件存储。Amazon EFS 提供共享文件存储，支持 NFSv4.0/NFSv4.1，可从 EC2 访问，提供一致性和锁定等文件系统语义，并支持 POSIX 权限（[EFS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)）。为了实现高可用性和最大持久性，EFS **Regional/Standard** 选项是合适的，因为 Regional file systems 会在多个地理上分离的 Availability Zones 中冗余存储数据，并且专为需要最高持久性和可用性的数据而设计（[EFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。EFS lifecycle policies 可以在文件自上次访问起 30 天后将其转换到 IA，这与访问模式相匹配并降低成本（[Configuring lifecycle policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/enable-lifecycle-management.html)）。

**为什么其他选项错误：**

* **A 和 B：** Amazon S3 是对象存储服务，而不是此处所需的原生共享 POSIX-compliant 文件系统（[Amazon S3 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。S3 lifecycle policies 对对象存储具有成本效益，但它们不满足 POSIX-compliant 共享文件系统要求。
* **D：** EFS One Zone 可以共享，但 One Zone file systems 将数据存储在单个 Availability Zone 中，如果该 AZ 受损或丢失，数据可能会丢失；AWS 表示，对于最高的持久性和可用性，建议使用 Regional file systems（[EFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。因此，One Zone 不如 EFS Standard/Regional 那样满足“maximum data durability”和 multi-AZ 高可用性要求。

en.question: A solutions architect is creating a new VPC design. There are two public subnets for the load balancer, two private subnets for web servers, and two private subnets for MySQL. The web servers use only HTTPS. The solutions architect has already created a security group for the load balancer allowing port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Company policy requires that each resource has the least access required to still be able to perform its tasks. Which additional configuration strategy should the solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a security group for the web servers and allow port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Create a security group for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.
options.B: Create a network ACL for the web servers and allow port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Create a network ACL for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.
options.C: Create a security group for the web servers and allow port 443 from the load balancer. Create a security group for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.
options.D: Create a network ACL for the web servers and allow port 443 from the load balancer. Create a network ACL for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

This is a three-tier VPC design, and the least-access configuration is to use **security groups** that reference the security group of the previous tier. AWS explicitly gives this pattern: allow HTTP/HTTPS to the load balancer from the internet, allow HTTP/HTTPS to the web servers **only from the load balancer security group**, and allow database requests to the database servers **from the web server security group** ([Security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)). Security group rules can use another security group ID as the inbound source, and this allows instances associated with the referenced security group to communicate over the specified protocol and port ([Components of a security group rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)). Therefore, web servers should allow TCP 443 from the load balancer security group, and MySQL should allow TCP 3306 from the web server security group.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A**: Opening port 443 on the web server security group to `0.0.0.0/0` gives the web servers direct internet access on HTTPS, which is broader than required. The web tier only needs traffic from the load balancer.
- **B**: Network ACL rules use CIDR ranges for source/destination, not security group references; AWS lists the NACL inbound source as a **CIDR range** ([Network ACL rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-rules.html)). Also, allowing web traffic from `0.0.0.0/0` is not least privilege.
- **D**: This incorrectly uses network ACLs for rules that reference the load balancer or web server security groups. NACLs operate at the **subnet level**, while security groups operate at the **instance level**; security groups are the correct control for per-resource tier-to-tier access ([Differences between network ACLs and security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-examples.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在创建新的 VPC 设计。该设计包含两个用于负载均衡器的公有子网、两个用于 Web 服务器的私有子网，以及两个用于 MySQL 的私有子网。Web 服务器仅使用 HTTPS。解决方案架构师已经为负载均衡器创建了一个安全组，允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 流量。公司策略要求每个资源仅拥有执行其任务所需的最小访问权限。解决方案架构师应使用哪种额外的配置策略来满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Web 服务器创建一个安全组，并允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 流量。为 MySQL 服务器创建一个安全组，并允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 流量。
options.B: 为 Web 服务器创建一个网络 ACL，并允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 流量。为 MySQL 服务器创建一个网络 ACL，并允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 流量。
options.C: 为 Web 服务器创建一个安全组，并允许来自负载均衡器的端口 443 流量。为 MySQL 服务器创建一个安全组，并允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 流量。
options.D: 为 Web 服务器创建一个网络 ACL，并允许来自负载均衡器的端口 443 流量。为 MySQL 服务器创建一个网络 ACL，并允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 流量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

这是一个三层 VPC 设计，最小访问配置是使用引用上一层安全组的 **security groups**。AWS 明确给出了这种模式：允许来自互联网的 HTTP/HTTPS 到负载均衡器，允许 Web 服务器 **仅接收来自负载均衡器安全组** 的 HTTP/HTTPS，并允许数据库服务器接收 **来自 Web 服务器安全组** 的数据库请求（[Security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。安全组规则可以使用另一个安全组 ID 作为入站来源，这允许与被引用安全组关联的实例通过指定的协议和端口进行通信（[Components of a security group rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。因此，Web 服务器应允许来自负载均衡器安全组的 TCP 443，MySQL 应允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的 TCP 3306。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **A**：在 Web 服务器安全组上向 `0.0.0.0/0` 开放端口 443，会使 Web 服务器可通过 HTTPS 被互联网直接访问，这超出了所需范围。Web 层只需要来自负载均衡器的流量。
- **B**：Network ACL 规则使用 CIDR 范围作为源/目标，而不是安全组引用；AWS 将 NACL 入站来源列为 **CIDR range**（[Network ACL rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-rules.html)）。此外，允许来自 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 Web 流量并不符合最小权限原则。
- **D**：此选项错误地使用网络 ACL 来配置引用负载均衡器或 Web 服务器安全组的规则。NACL 在 **subnet level** 运行，而安全组在 **instance level** 运行；对于按资源控制的层到层访问，安全组才是正确的控制方式（[Differences between network ACLs and security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-examples.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company is running a multi-tier application on AWS. The front-end and backend tiers both run on Amazon EC2, and the database runs on Amazon RDS for MySQL. The backend tier communicates with the RDS instance. There are frequent calls to return identical datasets from the database that are causing performance slowdowns. Which action should be taken to improve the performance of the backend?

options.A: Implement Amazon SNS to store the database calls.
options.B: Implement Amazon ElastiCache to cache the large datasets.
options.C: Implement an RDS for MySQL read replica to cache database calls.
options.D: Implement Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the calls to the database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Implement Amazon ElastiCache to cache the large datasets.**

The workload has frequent repeated calls that return **identical datasets** from an RDS for MySQL database. AWS documents that ElastiCache query caching is effective for **read-heavy applications where the same queries are executed repeatedly** and for high-concurrency scenarios where offloading reads to ElastiCache reduces database CPU pressure and improves throughput. It can return cached query results on a cache hit; on a cache miss, it queries the database, stores the result in the cache, and serves future requests from the cache ([Amazon ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon SNS** is for application-to-application messaging: it decouples publishers and subscribers and delivers messages to subscribers such as Lambda, SQS, or HTTP endpoints. It is not a cache for database calls or query results ([Amazon SNS A2A messaging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-system-to-system-messaging.html)).
- **C. RDS for MySQL read replica** can help scale read-heavy database workloads by directing excess read traffic to replicas, but it is still a database replica updated asynchronously, not a cache of repeated identical query results. It does not avoid repeated query execution the way ElastiCache does ([Amazon RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).
- **D. Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose / Amazon Data Firehose** is for delivering real-time streaming data to destinations such as S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, or HTTP endpoints. It is not intended to cache database query results or improve synchronous backend query latency ([Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)).

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司正在 AWS 上运行一个多层应用程序。前端层和后端层都运行在 Amazon EC2 上，数据库运行在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 上。后端层与 RDS 实例通信。频繁调用数据库以返回相同数据集，导致性能下降。应采取哪项操作来提高后端性能？

options.A: 实施 Amazon SNS 来存储数据库调用。
options.B: 实施 Amazon ElastiCache 来缓存大型数据集。
options.C: 实施 RDS for MySQL 只读副本来缓存数据库调用。
options.D: 实施 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将调用流式传输到数据库。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Implement Amazon ElastiCache to cache the large datasets.**

该工作负载存在频繁的重复调用，这些调用从 RDS for MySQL 数据库返回 **identical datasets**。AWS 文档说明，ElastiCache 查询缓存对于 **重复执行相同查询的读密集型应用程序** 以及高并发场景非常有效，在这些场景中，将读取卸载到 ElastiCache 可以降低数据库 CPU 压力并提高吞吐量。缓存命中时，它可以返回缓存的查询结果；缓存未命中时，它会查询数据库，将结果存储在缓存中，并从缓存为未来请求提供服务（[Amazon ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. Amazon SNS** 用于应用程序到应用程序的消息传递：它将发布者和订阅者解耦，并向 Lambda、SQS 或 HTTP 端点等订阅者传递消息。它不是用于数据库调用或查询结果的缓存（[Amazon SNS A2A messaging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-system-to-system-messaging.html)）。
- **C. RDS for MySQL read replica** 可以通过将额外的读取流量定向到副本来帮助扩展读密集型数据库工作负载，但它仍然是异步更新的数据库副本，而不是重复相同查询结果的缓存。它无法像 ElastiCache 那样避免重复执行查询（[Amazon RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。
- **D. Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose / Amazon Data Firehose** 用于将实时流数据传送到 S3、Redshift、OpenSearch 或 HTTP 端点等目标。它并非用于缓存数据库查询结果或改善同步后端查询延迟（[Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。

en.question: A new employee has joined a company as a deployment engineer. The deployment engineer will be using AWS CloudFormation templates to create multiple AWS resources. A solutions architect wants the deployment engineer to perform job activities while following the principle of least privilege. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)

options.A: Have the deployment engineer use AWS account root user credentials for performing AWS CloudFormation stack operations.
options.B: Create a new IAM user for the deployment engineer and add the IAM user to a group that has the PowerUsers IAM policy attached.
options.C: Create a new IAM user for the deployment engineer and add the IAM user to a group that has the AdministratorAccess IAM policy attached.
options.D: Create a new IAM user for the deployment engineer and add the IAM user to a group that has an IAM policy that allows AWS CloudFormation actions only.
options.E: Create an IAM role for the deployment engineer to explicitly define the permissions specific to the AWS CloudFormation stack and launch stacks using that IAM role.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **D and E**.

- **D is correct** because least privilege means granting only the permissions required to perform the task and no additional permissions. AWS IAM documentation defines least privilege this way and notes that IAM policies can define the actions allowed on specific resources under conditions. For a deployment engineer who performs CloudFormation work, a policy limited to CloudFormation actions is the least-privilege starting point for the user's direct permissions. AWS also notes that broad AWS managed policies might not grant least privilege for a specific use case and recommends customer managed policies specific to the use case ([IAM least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html), [CloudFormation managed policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)).
- **E is correct** because a CloudFormation service role lets CloudFormation make calls to stack resources on the user's behalf. AWS states that you can use a service role to explicitly specify the actions CloudFormation can perform, and that the role should grant least privilege. The deployment engineer can be allowed to launch stacks while CloudFormation uses a role with permissions specific to the stack resources ([CloudFormation service role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-iam-servicerole.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A is wrong** because the root user has complete access to all AWS services and resources. AWS strongly recommends not using the root user for everyday tasks and using it only for tasks that require root-level permissions ([AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)).
- **B is wrong** because PowerUsers is a broad job-function policy, not a policy tailored only to the CloudFormation deployment task. AWS warns that AWS managed policies might not grant least-privilege permissions for specific use cases ([IAM least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html)).
- **C is wrong** because AdministratorAccess provides administrative permissions, which are powerful permissions not required for everyday least-privilege task execution. IAM guidance says root, administrative, and emergency access users have powerful permissions that are not required for everyday tasks ([IAM least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html)).

zh.question: 一名新员工以部署工程师的身份加入了一家公司。该部署工程师将使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板来创建多个 AWS 资源。一名解决方案架构师希望部署工程师在遵循最小权限原则的同时执行工作活动。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来实现此目标？（选择两项。）

options.A: 让部署工程师使用 AWS 账户根用户凭证来执行 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈操作。
options.B: 为部署工程师创建一个新的 IAM 用户，并将该 IAM 用户添加到一个附加了 PowerUsers IAM policy 的组中。
options.C: 为部署工程师创建一个新的 IAM 用户，并将该 IAM 用户添加到一个附加了 AdministratorAccess IAM policy 的组中。
options.D: 为部署工程师创建一个新的 IAM 用户，并将该 IAM 用户添加到一个具有仅允许 AWS CloudFormation 操作的 IAM policy 的组中。
options.E: 为部署工程师创建一个 IAM role，以显式定义特定于 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈的权限，并使用该 IAM role 启动堆栈。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D and E**。

- **D 正确**，因为最小权限意味着只授予执行任务所需的权限，不授予任何额外权限。AWS IAM 文档以这种方式定义最小权限，并指出 IAM policies 可以定义在特定条件下允许对特定资源执行的操作。对于执行 CloudFormation 工作的部署工程师而言，限制为 CloudFormation 操作的策略是用户直接权限的最小权限起点。AWS 还指出，宽泛的 AWS managed policies 可能无法针对特定使用场景授予最小权限，并建议使用特定于使用场景的 customer managed policies（[IAM least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html)，[CloudFormation managed policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)）。
- **E 正确**，因为 CloudFormation service role 允许 CloudFormation 代表用户调用堆栈资源。AWS 表示，你可以使用 service role 来显式指定 CloudFormation 可以执行的操作，并且该角色应授予最小权限。可以允许部署工程师启动堆栈，同时 CloudFormation 使用一个具有特定于堆栈资源权限的角色（[CloudFormation service role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-iam-servicerole.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A 错误**，因为根用户对所有 AWS services 和资源拥有完全访问权限。AWS 强烈建议不要将根用户用于日常任务，并且仅将其用于需要根级别权限的任务（[AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)）。
- **B 错误**，因为 PowerUsers 是一个宽泛的 job-function policy，而不是仅针对 CloudFormation 部署任务定制的策略。AWS 警告说，AWS managed policies 可能无法针对特定使用场景授予最小权限（[IAM least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html)）。
- **C 错误**，因为 AdministratorAccess 提供管理权限，这些是日常最小权限任务执行所不需要的强大权限。IAM 指南指出，root、administrative 和 emergency access users 拥有日常任务不需要的强大权限（[IAM least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/getting-started-reduce-permissions.html)）。

en.question: A company is deploying a two-tier web application in a VPC. The web tier is using an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with public subnets that span multiple Availability Zones. The database tier consists of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in separate private subnets. The web tier requires access to the database to retrieve product information. The web application is not working as intended. The web application reports that it cannot connect to the database. The database is confirmed to be up and running. All configurations for the network ACLs, security groups, and route tables are still in their default states. What should a solutions architect recommend to fix the application?

options.A: Add an explicit rule to the private subnet’s network ACL to allow traffic from the web tier’s EC2 instances.
options.B: Add a route in the VPC route table to allow traffic between the web tier’s EC2 instances and the database tier.
options.C: Deploy the web tier's EC2 instances and the database tier’s RDS instance into two separate VPCs, and configure VPC peering.
options.D: Add an inbound rule to the security group of the database tier’s RDS instance to allow traffic from the web tiers security group.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D**.

The web tier and database tier are in the same VPC, so routing between their subnets already exists through the route table’s default **local route**: AWS states that every route table contains a local route for communication within the VPC, added by default to all route tables ([Subnet route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-route-tables.html)). The default network ACL also is not the blocker because AWS states that the default network ACL is configured to allow all traffic in and out of associated subnets ([Default network ACL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/default-network-acl.html)).

The remaining likely blocker is the database security group. Security groups allow only explicitly permitted inbound traffic; AWS states that a newly created security group has no inbound rules, so no inbound traffic is allowed until rules are added ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)). AWS also documents the exact pattern for this architecture: add rules to the database servers’ security group to allow database requests from the web servers, with the source set to the web servers’ security group ([Security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)). Therefore, the RDS security group should allow inbound MySQL traffic from the web tier’s security group.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A** is incorrect because the default network ACL already allows inbound and outbound traffic; adding a private subnet NACL rule is unnecessary ([Default network ACL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/default-network-acl.html)).
* **B** is incorrect because route tables already include the local route for VPC-internal communication between subnets ([Subnet route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-route-tables.html)).
* **C** is incorrect because separating the tiers into different VPCs and using VPC peering adds unnecessary complexity; the issue can be solved within the existing VPC by allowing the correct security group traffic.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 VPC 中部署一个两层 Web 应用程序。Web 层使用一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组，并部署在跨多个可用区的公有子网中。数据库层由位于单独私有子网中的一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例组成。Web 层需要访问数据库以检索产品信息。该 Web 应用程序未按预期工作。Web 应用程序报告无法连接到数据库。已确认数据库已启动并正在运行。网络 ACL、安全组和路由表的所有配置仍处于默认状态。解决方案架构师应建议采取什么措施来修复该应用程序？

options.A: 向私有子网的网络 ACL 添加显式规则，以允许来自 Web 层 EC2 实例的流量。
options.B: 在 VPC 路由表中添加一条路由，以允许 Web 层 EC2 实例与数据库层之间的流量。
options.C: 将 Web 层的 EC2 实例和数据库层的 RDS 实例部署到两个单独的 VPC 中，并配置 VPC peering。
options.D: 向数据库层 RDS 实例的安全组添加入站规则，以允许来自 Web 层安全组的流量。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D**。

Web 层和数据库层位于同一个 VPC 中，因此它们的子网之间已经通过路由表的默认 **local route** 存在路由：AWS 说明每个路由表都包含一条用于 VPC 内通信的本地路由，并且默认添加到所有路由表中（[Subnet route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-route-tables.html)）。默认网络 ACL 也不是阻碍因素，因为 AWS 说明默认网络 ACL 配置为允许关联子网的所有入站和出站流量（[Default network ACL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/default-network-acl.html)）。剩下的最可能阻碍因素是数据库安全组。安全组只允许显式许可的入站流量；AWS 说明新创建的安全组没有入站规则，因此在添加规则之前不允许任何入站流量（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。AWS 还记录了此架构的确切模式：向数据库服务器的安全组添加规则，以允许来自 Web 服务器的数据库请求，并将来源设置为 Web 服务器的安全组（[Security group referencing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。因此，RDS 安全组应允许来自 Web 层安全组的入站 MySQL 流量。其他选项错误的原因：

* **A** 错误，因为默认网络 ACL 已经允许入站和出站流量；添加私有子网 NACL 规则是不必要的（[Default network ACL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/default-network-acl.html)）。
* **B** 错误，因为路由表已经包含用于子网之间 VPC 内部通信的本地路由（[Subnet route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/subnet-route-tables.html)）。
* **C** 错误，因为将各层分离到不同 VPC 并使用 VPC peering 会增加不必要的复杂性；通过允许正确的安全组流量，可以在现有 VPC 内解决该问题。

en.question: A company has a large dataset for its online advertising business stored in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in a single Availability Zone. The company wants business reporting queries to run without impacting the write operations to the production DB instance. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Deploy RDS read replicas to process the business reporting queries.
options.B: Scale out the DB instance horizontally by placing it behind an Elastic Load Balancer.
options.C: Scale up the DB instance to a larger instance type to handle write operations and queries.
options.D: Deploy the DB instance in multiple Availability Zones to process the business reporting queries.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Deploy RDS read replicas to process the business reporting queries.**

Amazon RDS read replicas are specifically intended for read-heavy workloads: AWS says you can direct excess read traffic to one or more read replicas, and explicitly lists **business reporting or data warehousing scenarios** where reporting queries run against a read replica instead of the production DB instance. A read replica is a read-only DB instance that is asynchronously updated from the source DB instance, so reporting reads can be separated from production writes. [AWS RDS read replicas documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Place the DB instance behind an Elastic Load Balancer** — RDS DB instances are not horizontally scaled for SQL reads by putting the database behind an ELB. RDS read scaling is achieved with read replicas, where applications connect to the replica as a DB instance. [AWS RDS read replicas documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)
- **C. Scale up the DB instance** — A larger instance might add capacity, but the reporting queries would still run on the same production DB instance and could still contend with write operations. It does not isolate reporting workload from production writes.
- **D. Deploy Multi-AZ** — Multi-AZ DB instance deployments are for high availability/failover. AWS distinguishes standby replicas from read replicas: a standby replica uses synchronous replication and **can’t serve read traffic**, unlike a read replica. [AWS RDS read replicas documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)

zh.question: 一家公司将其在线广告业务的大型数据集存储在单个可用区中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例中。该公司希望业务报告查询能够运行，而不影响生产 DB 实例的写入操作。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署 RDS 只读副本来处理业务报告查询。
options.B: 通过将 DB 实例置于 Elastic Load Balancer 后面来水平扩展该 DB 实例。
options.C: 将 DB 实例纵向扩展到更大的实例类型，以处理写入操作和查询。
options.D: 在多个可用区中部署 DB 实例来处理业务报告查询。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 部署 RDS 只读副本来处理业务报告查询。**

Amazon RDS 只读副本专门用于读取密集型工作负载：AWS 表示你可以将多余的读取流量定向到一个或多个只读副本，并明确列出了**业务报告或数据仓库场景**，其中报告查询针对只读副本运行，而不是针对生产 DB 实例运行。只读副本是一个只读 DB 实例，它会从源 DB 实例异步更新，因此报告读取可以与生产写入分离。[AWS RDS read replicas documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 将 DB 实例置于 Elastic Load Balancer 后面** — RDS DB 实例并不是通过将数据库放在 ELB 后面来对 SQL 读取进行水平扩展的。RDS 读取扩展是通过只读副本实现的，应用程序会像连接 DB 实例一样连接到副本。[AWS RDS read replicas documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)
- **C. 纵向扩展 DB 实例** — 更大的实例可能会增加容量，但报告查询仍会在同一个生产 DB 实例上运行，并且仍可能与写入操作争用资源。它无法将报告工作负载与生产写入隔离开来。
- **D. 部署 Multi-AZ** — Multi-AZ DB 实例部署用于高可用性/故障转移。AWS 将备用副本与只读副本区分开来：备用副本使用同步复制，并且**不能提供读取流量**，这与只读副本不同。[AWS RDS read replicas documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)

en.question: A company hosts a three-tier ecommerce application on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). All ecommerce data is stored in an Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB instance. The company wants to optimize customer session management during transactions. The application must store session data durably. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Turn on the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) on the ALB.
options.B: Use an Amazon DynamoDB table to store customer session information.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon Cognito user pool to manage user session information.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to store customer session information.
options.E: Use AWS Systems Manager Application Manager in the application to manage user session information.

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **B and D**.

**B. Use an Amazon DynamoDB table to store customer session information** is correct. In a distributed application running on multiple EC2 instances behind an ALB, session data should be stored in a shared backend store rather than on an individual instance. AWS documentation specifically describes using DynamoDB as a session store to move sessions off the local file system and into a shared location, and notes that DynamoDB is fast, scalable, and automatically replicates data ([AWS SDK for PHP DynamoDB session handler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-php/v3/developer-guide/service_dynamodb-session-handler.html)). DynamoDB is also a fully managed, distributed NoSQL database designed for high availability and consistent performance at scale ([DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)). This makes it suitable for durable customer session storage.

**D. Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to store customer session information** is correct. Redis is commonly used as a centralized session store for distributed applications because it provides very low-latency key-value access. AWS documentation identifies in-memory caches such as Redis, provided through Amazon ElastiCache, as popular stores for session data ([Microservices on AWS: Data store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/microservices-on-aws/data-store.html)). ElastiCache for Redis can also be configured for higher availability with Multi-AZ failover, where a replica is promoted if the primary node fails ([ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Redis OSS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html)). In addition, ElastiCache supports snapshots, with backups written to Amazon S3 for durable storage and restore capability ([ElastiCache snapshot and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/backups.html)).

**A. Turn on the sticky sessions feature on the ALB** is incorrect. Sticky sessions route requests from the same client to the same target, but they do not provide durable storage for session data. If the target EC2 instance fails or is terminated by Auto Scaling, any session state stored locally on that instance can be lost. Sticky sessions are a load balancing routing feature, not a durable session data store ([ALB target group attributes: sticky sessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)).

**C. Deploy an Amazon Cognito user pool to manage user session information** is incorrect. Amazon Cognito user pools are used for user authentication, authorization, and identity federation. They manage sign-in and identity-related tokens, but they are not intended to store application transaction session state such as shopping cart or ecommerce workflow data ([Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)).

**E. Use AWS Systems Manager Application Manager in the application to manage user session information** is incorrect. AWS Systems Manager is used to view, manage, and operate nodes and AWS resources at scale. It is not an application session data store and does not provide durable customer session management for ecommerce transactions ([What is AWS Systems Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在一组 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个三层电子商务应用程序。这些实例在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中运行。所有电子商务数据都存储在 Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB 实例中。该公司希望在交易期间优化客户会话管理。应用程序必须持久地存储会话数据。哪些解决方案将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 ALB 上开启粘性会话功能（会话亲和性）。
options.B: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储客户会话信息。
options.C: 部署 Amazon Cognito 用户池来管理用户会话信息。
options.D: 部署 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群来存储客户会话信息。
options.E: 在应用程序中使用 AWS Systems Manager Application Manager 来管理用户会话信息。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B 和 D**。

**B. 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储客户会话信息** 是正确的。在 ALB 后面的多个 EC2 实例上运行的分布式应用程序中，会话数据应存储在共享后端存储中，而不是存储在单个实例上。AWS 文档专门说明了使用 DynamoDB 作为会话存储，将会话从本地文件系统移到共享位置，并指出 DynamoDB 速度快、可扩展，并且会自动复制数据（[AWS SDK for PHP DynamoDB session handler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdk-for-php/v3/developer-guide/service_dynamodb-session-handler.html)）。DynamoDB 也是一种完全托管的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，专为高可用性和大规模一致性能而设计（[DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。这使其适合用于持久的客户会话存储。

**D. 部署 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群来存储客户会话信息** 是正确的。Redis 通常用作分布式应用程序的集中式会话存储，因为它提供极低延迟的键值访问。AWS 文档将通过 Amazon ElastiCache 提供的 Redis 等内存缓存确定为会话数据的常用存储（[Microservices on AWS: Data store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/microservices-on-aws/data-store.html)）。ElastiCache for Redis 还可以通过 Multi-AZ 故障转移配置为更高可用性，即当主节点发生故障时提升副本（[ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Redis OSS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html)）。此外，ElastiCache 支持快照，备份会写入 Amazon S3，以实现持久存储和还原能力（[ElastiCache snapshot and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/backups.html)）。

**A. 在 ALB 上开启粘性会话功能** 是错误的。粘性会话会将来自同一客户端的请求路由到同一目标，但它们不提供会话数据的持久存储。如果目标 EC2 实例发生故障或被 Auto Scaling 终止，则存储在该实例本地的任何会话状态都可能丢失。粘性会话是一种负载均衡路由功能，而不是持久的会话数据存储（[ALB target group attributes: sticky sessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)）。

**C. 部署 Amazon Cognito 用户池来管理用户会话信息** 是错误的。Amazon Cognito 用户池用于用户身份验证、授权和身份联合。它们管理登录和与身份相关的令牌，但并非用于存储应用程序交易会话状态，例如购物车或电子商务工作流数据（[Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)）。
