**E. 在应用程序中使用 AWS Systems Manager Application Manager 来管理用户会话信息** 是错误的。AWS Systems Manager 用于大规模查看、管理和操作节点以及 AWS 资源。它不是应用程序会话数据存储，也不为电子商务交易提供持久的客户会话管理（[What is AWS Systems Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html)）。

en.question: A company needs a backup strategy for its three-tier stateless web application. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group with a dynamic scaling policy that is configured to respond to scaling events. The database tier runs on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The web application does not require temporary local storage on the EC2 instances. The company’s recovery point objective (RPO) is 2 hours. The backup strategy must maximize scalability and optimize resource utilization for this environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Take snapshots of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes of the EC2 instances and database every 2 hours to meet the RPO.
options.B: Configure a snapshot lifecycle policy to take Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS to meet the RPO.
options.C: Retain the latest Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the web and application tiers. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery to meet the RPO.
options.D: Take snapshots of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes of the EC2 instances every 2 hours. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery to meet the RPO.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The EC2 web/application tiers are **stateless** and run in an Auto Scaling group, so the scalable recovery approach is to keep current AMIs for those tiers and let the Auto Scaling group launch replacement instances from those images. AWS states that an AMI provides the software required to set up and boot an EC2 instance, and that you can launch multiple instances from a single AMI or create an AMI from an instance to launch instances with the same configuration ([Amazon EC2 AMIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AMIs.html)). This matches the need to maximize scalability and optimize resource utilization.

For the database tier, Amazon RDS automated backups are appropriate: RDS creates and saves automated backups and can recover the DB instance to **any point in time** during the backup retention period ([RDS automated backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)). RDS point-in-time restore also supports restoring to the latest restorable time or to a custom time ([RDS PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/AutomatedBackups.PiTR.html)), satisfying the 2-hour RPO.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Taking EC2 EBS snapshots every 2 hours is unnecessary for stateless EC2 tiers and is less resource-efficient. Also, relying on periodic database snapshots is less suitable than RDS automated backups with PITR.
- **B**: RDS automated backups are correct, but EBS snapshot lifecycle policies for the EC2 instances add unnecessary backup storage/operations for stateless tiers.
- **D**: RDS automated backups with PITR are correct, but taking EC2 EBS snapshots every 2 hours is unnecessary and does not optimize resource utilization for a stateless Auto Scaling workload.

The note that the application does not require temporary local storage further supports avoiding instance-level data backup. AWS describes EC2 instance store as temporary block-level storage intended for buffers, caches, scratch data, and other temporary content ([EC2 instance store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要为其三层无状态 Web 应用程序制定备份策略。该 Web 应用程序运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上，并配置了动态扩展策略以响应扩展事件。数据库层运行在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 上。该 Web 应用程序不需要在 EC2 实例上使用临时本地存储。公司的恢复点目标 (RPO) 为 2 小时。备份策略必须最大限度提高此环境的可扩展性并优化资源利用率。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 每 2 小时对 EC2 实例和数据库的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷拍摄快照，以满足 RPO。
options.B: 配置快照生命周期策略以拍摄 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快照。在 Amazon RDS 中启用自动备份以满足 RPO。
options.C: 保留 Web 层和应用程序层的最新 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)。在 Amazon RDS 中启用自动备份，并使用时间点恢复来满足 RPO。
options.D: 每 2 小时对 EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷拍摄快照。在 Amazon RDS 中启用自动备份，并使用时间点恢复来满足 RPO。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

EC2 Web/应用程序层是**无状态**的，并且运行在 Auto Scaling 组中，因此可扩展的恢复方法是为这些层保留当前 AMIs，并让 Auto Scaling 组从这些镜像启动替代实例。AWS 表示，AMI 提供设置和启动 EC2 实例所需的软件，并且你可以从单个 AMI 启动多个实例，或从实例创建 AMI 以启动具有相同配置的实例（[Amazon EC2 AMIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AMIs.html)）。这符合最大限度提高可扩展性并优化资源利用率的需求。对于数据库层，Amazon RDS 自动备份是合适的：RDS 会创建并保存自动备份，并且可以在备份保留期内将 DB 实例恢复到**任意时间点**（[RDS automated backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)）。RDS 时间点恢复还支持恢复到最新可恢复时间或自定义时间（[RDS PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/AutomatedBackups.PiTR.html)），从而满足 2 小时 RPO。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：对于无状态 EC2 层，每 2 小时拍摄 EC2 EBS 快照是不必要的，并且资源效率较低。此外，依赖定期数据库快照不如使用带 PITR 的 RDS 自动备份合适。
- **B**：RDS 自动备份是正确的，但针对 EC2 实例的 EBS 快照生命周期策略会为无状态层增加不必要的备份存储/操作。
- **D**：带 PITR 的 RDS 自动备份是正确的，但每 2 小时拍摄 EC2 EBS 快照是不必要的，并且无法为无状态 Auto Scaling 工作负载优化资源利用率。应用程序不需要临时本地存储这一说明进一步支持避免实例级数据备份。AWS 将 EC2 instance store 描述为临时的块级存储，适用于缓冲区、缓存、暂存数据以及其他临时内容（[EC2 instance store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/InstanceStorage.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to deploy a new public web application on AWS. The application includes a web server tier that uses Amazon EC2 instances. The application also includes a database tier that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The application must be secure and accessible for global customers that have dynamic IP addresses. How should a solutions architect configure the security groups to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the security group of the web servers.
options.B: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from the IP addresses of the customers. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the security group of the web servers.
options.C: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from the IP addresses of the customers. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the IP addresses of the customers.
options.D: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

For a public web application serving global customers with dynamic IP addresses, the web tier must accept HTTPS from any public IPv4 address. AWS EC2 security group examples list an inbound web server rule for TCP port **443 (HTTPS)** with source **0.0.0.0/0**, which “allows inbound HTTPS access from any IPv4 address” ([AWS EC2 security group rules reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)).

The database tier should not be exposed directly to customers or the internet. AWS documents database server rules where the source can be “a security group ID for a group of instances that access the database,” and identifies TCP port **3306** as the default port for **MySQL/Aurora** databases, including Amazon RDS examples ([AWS EC2 security group rules reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)). AWS RDS troubleshooting also notes that a DB instance security group must authorize connections from the device or **Amazon EC2 instance where the MySQL application or utility is running** ([Amazon RDS MySQL connection troubleshooting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ConnectToInstance.Troubleshooting.html)). Therefore, the RDS security group should allow MySQL traffic only from the web server security group.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** Customer IP addresses are dynamic and global, so predefining customer IPs would not reliably allow access.
- **C:** This has the same customer-IP problem for the web tier and also incorrectly allows customers to access the database directly.
- **D:** Opening port 3306 from **0.0.0.0/0** exposes the database to the internet, which is less secure than allowing access only from the web server security group.

zh.question: 一家公司希望在 AWS 上部署一个新的公共 Web 应用程序。该应用程序包括一个使用 Amazon EC2 实例的 Web 服务器层。该应用程序还包括一个使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例的数据库层。该应用程序必须安全，并且可供拥有动态 IP 地址的全球客户访问。解决方案架构师应如何配置安全组以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Web 服务器的安全组，允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 入站流量。配置 DB 实例的安全组，允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 入站流量。
options.B: 配置 Web 服务器的安全组，允许来自客户 IP 地址的端口 443 入站流量。配置 DB 实例的安全组，允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 入站流量。
options.C: 配置 Web 服务器的安全组，允许来自客户 IP 地址的端口 443 入站流量。配置 DB 实例的安全组，允许来自客户 IP 地址的端口 3306 入站流量。
options.D: 配置 Web 服务器的安全组，允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 入站流量。配置 DB 实例的安全组，允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 3306 入站流量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

对于面向拥有动态 IP 地址的全球客户的公共 Web 应用程序，Web 层必须接受来自任何公共 IPv4 地址的 HTTPS。AWS EC2 安全组示例列出了一个用于 TCP 端口 **443 (HTTPS)**、源为 **0.0.0.0/0** 的入站 Web 服务器规则，该规则“允许来自任何 IPv4 地址的入站 HTTPS 访问”([AWS EC2 security group rules reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html))。数据库层不应直接暴露给客户或互联网。AWS 文档中的数据库服务器规则说明，源可以是“访问数据库的一组实例的安全组 ID”，并将 TCP 端口 **3306** 标识为 **MySQL/Aurora** 数据库的默认端口，其中包括 Amazon RDS 示例（[AWS EC2 security group rules reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)）。AWS RDS 故障排除还指出，DB 实例安全组必须授权来自运行 MySQL 应用程序或实用工具的设备或 **Amazon EC2 实例**的连接（[Amazon RDS MySQL connection troubleshooting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ConnectToInstance.Troubleshooting.html)）。因此，RDS 安全组应仅允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的 MySQL 流量。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B:** 客户 IP 地址是动态且全球分布的，因此预定义客户 IP 无法可靠地允许访问。
- **C:** 这对 Web 层存在相同的客户 IP 问题，并且还错误地允许客户直接访问数据库。
- **D:** 从 **0.0.0.0/0** 开放端口 3306 会将数据库暴露到互联网，相比仅允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的访问安全性更低。

en.question: A payment processing company records all voice communication with its customers and stores the audio files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to capture the text from the audio files. The company must remove from the text any personally identifiable information (PII) that belongs to customers. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Process the audio files by using Amazon Kinesis Video Streams. Use an AWS Lambda function to scan for known PII patterns.
options.B: When an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket, invoke an AWS Lambda function to start an Amazon Textract task to analyze the call recordings.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Transcribe transcription job with PII redaction turned on. When an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket, invoke an AWS Lambda function to start the transcription job. Store the output in a separate S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an Amazon Connect contact flow that ingests the audio files with transcription turned on. Embed an AWS Lambda function to scan for known PII patterns. Use Amazon EventBridge to start the contact flow when an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon Transcribe is the AWS service designed for this requirement: it takes audio data, including media files stored in an S3 bucket, and converts it to text data; files in S3 are processed as **batch transcriptions** ([Amazon Transcribe data input and output](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/how-input.html)). Amazon Transcribe also supports PII redaction: redaction masks or removes sensitive PII from transcripts, and when redaction is enabled you can generate a redacted transcript ([PII redaction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/pii-redaction.html)). Batch transcript output is stored in Amazon S3, and you can specify your own S3 bucket for the output ([Transcribe output](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/how-input.html)). Finally, S3 can send an event to a Lambda function when an object is created, so Lambda can start the transcription job after upload ([S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Kinesis Video Streams plus custom Lambda pattern scanning is not the managed speech-to-text and PII-redaction solution. The requirement is to transcribe stored audio files and remove PII from the transcript; Amazon Transcribe provides both capabilities directly.
- **B:** Amazon Textract is for document text detection and analysis, such as extracting typed/handwritten text, forms, and tables from documents and image/PDF files—not for transcribing audio recordings ([What is Amazon Textract?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
- **D:** Amazon Connect contact flows are not needed to process existing audio files in S3, and adding Lambda-based PII scanning is a custom approach. Amazon Transcribe already supports batch transcription from S3 with built-in PII redaction and S3 output.

zh.question: 一家支付处理公司记录其与客户的所有语音通信，并将音频文件存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司需要从音频文件中捕获文本。公司必须从文本中移除属于客户的任何个人身份信息（PII）。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Video Streams 处理音频文件。使用 AWS Lambda 函数扫描已知的 PII 模式。
options.B: 当音频文件上传到 S3 存储桶时，调用 AWS Lambda 函数来启动 Amazon Textract 任务以分析通话录音。
options.C: 配置一个启用了 PII 编辑的 Amazon Transcribe 转录作业。当音频文件上传到 S3 存储桶时，调用 AWS Lambda 函数来启动转录作业。将输出存储在单独的 S3 存储桶中。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Connect 联系流，在启用转录的情况下摄取音频文件。嵌入 AWS Lambda 函数以扫描已知的 PII 模式。当音频文件上传到 S3 存储桶时，使用 Amazon EventBridge 启动该联系流。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon Transcribe 是专为此需求设计的 AWS 服务：它接收音频数据，包括存储在 S3 存储桶中的媒体文件，并将其转换为文本数据；S3 中的文件会作为 **批量转录** 进行处理（[Amazon Transcribe data input and output](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/how-input.html)）。Amazon Transcribe 还支持 PII 编辑：编辑会屏蔽或移除转录文本中的敏感 PII，并且在启用编辑时，可以生成经过编辑的转录文本（[PII redaction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/pii-redaction.html)）。批量转录输出存储在 Amazon S3 中，并且你可以为输出指定自己的 S3 存储桶（[Transcribe output](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/how-input.html)）。最后，当创建对象时，S3 可以向 Lambda 函数发送事件，因此 Lambda 可以在上传后启动转录作业（[S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** Kinesis Video Streams 加上自定义 Lambda 模式扫描并不是托管的语音转文本和 PII 编辑解决方案。该需求是转录存储的音频文件并从转录文本中移除 PII；Amazon Transcribe 直接提供这两项功能。
- **B:** Amazon Textract 用于文档文本检测和分析，例如从文档以及图像/PDF 文件中提取打印/手写文本、表单和表格，而不是用于转录音频录音（[What is Amazon Textract?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。
- **D:** 处理 S3 中现有音频文件不需要 Amazon Connect 联系流，并且添加基于 Lambda 的 PII 扫描是一种自定义方法。Amazon Transcribe 已经支持从 S3 进行批量转录，并具有内置的 PII 编辑和 S3 输出。

en.question: A company is running a multi-tier ecommerce web application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances with an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Amazon RDS is configured with the latest generation DB instance with 2,000 GB of storage in a General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The database performance affects the application during periods of high demand. A database administrator analyzes the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs and discovers that the application performance always degrades when the number of read and write IOPS is higher than 20,000. What should a solutions architect do to improve the application performance?

options.A: Replace the volume with a magnetic volume.
options.B: Increase the number of IOPS on the gp3 volume.
options.C: Replace the volume with a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volume.
options.D: Replace the 2,000 GB gp3 volume with two 1,000 GB gp3 volumes.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **B. Increase the number of IOPS on the gp3 volume.**

Amazon RDS DB instances use Amazon EBS volumes for database and log storage, and RDS provides storage types including General Purpose SSD gp3, Provisioned IOPS SSD, and magnetic storage. For Amazon RDS for MySQL, gp3 storage supports provisioning IOPS independently from storage capacity, and a 2,000 GB gp3-backed RDS for MySQL database can be configured for more than 20,000 IOPS. Since the observed bottleneck occurs when read and write IOPS exceed 20,000, the most direct solution is to increase the provisioned IOPS on the existing gp3 storage rather than changing storage architecture or moving to a different storage class. The Amazon RDS storage documentation describes these RDS storage options and notes that DB instances use EBS volumes for database storage ([Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).

**Why B is correct:**

- The workload is already using gp3, which is designed to allow configurable performance.
- The performance issue is specifically tied to IOPS exceeding the currently provisioned level.
- Increasing the gp3 IOPS addresses the bottleneck without replacing the storage type or changing the database deployment.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Replace the volume with a magnetic volume** — Magnetic storage is legacy storage and is not recommended for high-performance workloads. The RDS documentation states that Amazon RDS is deprecating magnetic storage and recommends upgrading magnetic volumes to gp3 or io2, so moving from gp3 to magnetic would reduce performance rather than improve it ([Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).

- **C. Replace the volume with a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volume** — Provisioned IOPS SSD can provide high performance, but it is not necessary here. The current gp3 storage can be provisioned with higher IOPS for this MySQL workload, so replacing the storage type is a more disruptive and typically more expensive change than required.

- **D. Replace the 2,000 GB gp3 volume with two 1,000 GB gp3 volumes** — Amazon RDS manages the underlying EBS storage for DB instances. You do not manually split an RDS DB instance's storage into multiple gp3 volumes as an application-level tuning action. The appropriate RDS configuration change is to adjust the provisioned IOPS for the gp3 storage.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个多层电子商务 Web 应用程序。该应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并使用一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB 实例。Amazon RDS 配置为最新一代 DB 实例，并在 General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中具有 2,000 GB 存储。在高需求期间，数据库性能会影响应用程序。一名数据库管理员分析 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的日志，并发现当读写 IOPS 数量高于 20,000 时，应用程序性能总是下降。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来提高应用程序性能？

options.A: 将该卷替换为磁性卷。
options.B: 增加 gp3 卷上的 IOPS 数量。
options.C: 将该卷替换为 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) 卷。
options.D: 将 2,000 GB gp3 卷替换为两个 1,000 GB gp3 卷。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B. Increase the number of IOPS on the gp3 volume.**

Amazon RDS DB 实例使用 Amazon EBS 卷进行数据库和日志存储，并且 RDS 提供包括 General Purpose SSD gp3、Provisioned IOPS SSD 和 magnetic storage 在内的存储类型。对于 Amazon RDS for MySQL，gp3 存储支持独立于存储容量预置 IOPS，并且一个由 2,000 GB gp3 支持的 RDS for MySQL 数据库可以配置为超过 20,000 IOPS。由于观察到的瓶颈发生在读写 IOPS 超过 20,000 时，最直接的解决方案是增加现有 gp3 存储上的预置 IOPS，而不是更改存储架构或迁移到不同的存储类别。Amazon RDS 存储文档描述了这些 RDS 存储选项，并指出 DB 实例使用 EBS 卷进行数据库存储（[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。

**为什么 B 正确：**

- 该工作负载已经在使用 gp3，而 gp3 旨在允许可配置的性能。
- 性能问题明确与 IOPS 超过当前预置级别有关。
- 增加 gp3 IOPS 可以解决瓶颈，而无需替换存储类型或更改数据库部署。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Replace the volume with a magnetic volume** — Magnetic storage 是旧式存储，不建议用于高性能工作负载。RDS 文档指出 Amazon RDS 正在弃用 magnetic storage，并建议将 magnetic volumes 升级到 gp3 或 io2，因此从 gp3 迁移到 magnetic 会降低性能，而不是提高性能（[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。

- **C. Replace the volume with a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volume** — Provisioned IOPS SSD 可以提供高性能，但在这里并非必要。当前 gp3 存储可以为此 MySQL 工作负载预置更高的 IOPS，因此替换存储类型是一项比所需更具破坏性且通常更昂贵的更改。

- **D. Replace the 2,000 GB gp3 volume with two 1,000 GB gp3 volumes** — Amazon RDS 管理 DB 实例的底层 EBS 存储。你不能将 RDS DB 实例的存储手动拆分为多个 gp3 卷来作为应用程序级别的调优操作。适当的 RDS 配置更改是调整 gp3 存储的预置 IOPS。

en.question: An IAM user made several configuration changes to AWS resources in their company's account during a production deployment last week. A solutions architect learned that a couple of security group rules are not configured as desired. The solutions architect wants to confirm which IAM user was responsible for making changes. Which service should the solutions architect use to find the desired information?

options.A: Amazon GuardDuty
options.B: Amazon Inspector
options.C: AWS CloudTrail
options.D: AWS Config

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C. AWS CloudTrail**.

CloudTrail is designed for auditing account activity: AWS states that actions taken by a user, role, or AWS service are recorded as CloudTrail events, including actions through the console, CLI, SDKs, and APIs ([AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)). CloudTrail Event history also lets you look up creation, modification, or deletion events for resources in the account, and it keeps a searchable 90-day record of management events ([Working with CloudTrail event history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html)). Most importantly for this question, CloudTrail event records include a `userIdentity` element with details about the IAM identity that made the request, including examples for an `IAMUser` with a `userName` ([CloudTrail userIdentity element](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html)). Therefore, CloudTrail is the service to identify which IAM user changed the security group rules.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon GuardDuty**: GuardDuty is a threat detection service that monitors and analyzes data sources to identify suspicious or malicious activity, not the primary audit log for determining which IAM user made a configuration change ([What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)).
- **B. Amazon Inspector**: Inspector is a vulnerability management service that scans workloads for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure; it does not provide the account activity audit trail needed here ([What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).
- **D. AWS Config**: AWS Config tracks resource configurations and how they change over time, including resources such as security groups, but the question asks who made the change. CloudTrail is the service that records the user/API activity and identity information ([What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)).

zh.question: 一名 IAM 用户在上周的一次生产部署期间，对其公司账户中的 AWS 资源进行了多项配置更改。一名解决方案架构师了解到，有几条安全组规则未按预期配置。该解决方案架构师想确认是哪位 IAM 用户负责进行了这些更改。解决方案架构师应使用哪项服务来查找所需信息？

options.A: Amazon GuardDuty
options.B: Amazon Inspector
options.C: AWS CloudTrail
options.D: AWS Config

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C. AWS CloudTrail**。

CloudTrail 专为审计账户活动而设计：AWS 表示，由用户、角色或 AWS 服务执行的操作会被记录为 CloudTrail 事件，包括通过控制台、CLI、SDK 和 API 执行的操作（[AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)）。CloudTrail Event history 还允许你查找账户中资源的创建、修改或删除事件，并保留可搜索的 90 天管理事件记录（[Working with CloudTrail event history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/view-cloudtrail-events.html)）。对于本题最重要的是，CloudTrail 事件记录包含一个 `userIdentity` 元素，其中包含有关发出请求的 IAM 身份的详细信息，包括带有 `userName` 的 `IAMUser` 示例（[CloudTrail userIdentity element](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html)）。因此，CloudTrail 是用于识别哪位 IAM 用户更改了安全组规则的服务。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Amazon GuardDuty**：GuardDuty 是一项威胁检测服务，用于监控和分析数据源以识别可疑或恶意活动，而不是用于确定哪位 IAM 用户进行了配置更改的主要审计日志（[What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)）。
- **B. Amazon Inspector**：Inspector 是一项漏洞管理服务，用于扫描工作负载中的软件漏洞和意外网络暴露；它不提供此处所需的账户活动审计跟踪（[What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。
- **D. AWS Config**：AWS Config 跟踪资源配置以及它们随时间的变化，包括安全组等资源，但问题问的是谁进行了更改。CloudTrail 是记录用户/API 活动和身份信息的服务（[What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。

en.question: A company has implemented a self-managed DNS service on AWS. The solution consists of the following: • Amazon EC2 instances in different AWS Regions • Endpoints of a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator The company wants to protect the solution against DDoS attacks. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the accelerator as a resource to protect.
options.B: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the EC2 instances as resources to protect.
options.C: Create an AWS WAF web ACL that includes a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the accelerator.
options.D: Create an AWS WAF web ACL that includes a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

AWS Shield is the AWS service for DDoS protection; AWS says Shield Standard and Shield Advanced protect AWS resources from DDoS attacks at layers 3/4 and layer 7, and that you can subscribe to Shield Advanced for higher levels of protection ([AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)). For Shield Advanced, AWS explicitly lists **AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerators** as a supported protected resource type, and states that Shield Advanced protects only resources that you specify ([protected resource types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-by-resource-type.html)). Because the company’s internet-facing entry point is a **standard accelerator**, subscribing to Shield Advanced and adding the accelerator as the protected resource is the correct solution.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: Shield Advanced does not protect arbitrary EC2 instances directly; AWS lists EC2 instances as protected **through association to Amazon EC2 Elastic IP addresses**, while it separately lists Global Accelerator standard accelerators as protectable resources ([protected resource types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-by-resource-type.html)). The question specifically includes Global Accelerator endpoints, so the accelerator should be protected.
- **C**: AWS WAF web ACLs are not associated with Global Accelerator. AWS WAF web ACL associations are supported for resources such as API Gateway REST APIs, Application Load Balancers, AppSync APIs, Cognito user pools, App Runner, Verified Access, Amplify, and CloudFront distributions—not Global Accelerator ([WAF web ACL associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html)).
- **D**: AWS WAF web ACLs also cannot be associated directly with EC2 instances; EC2 instances are not in the documented list of supported WAF web ACL association targets ([WAF web ACL associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS 上实施了一项自管理 DNS 服务。该解决方案包括以下内容：• 位于不同 AWS Regions 的 Amazon EC2 实例 • AWS Global Accelerator 中标准加速器的端点该公司希望保护该解决方案免受 DDoS 攻击。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足此要求？

options.A: 订阅 AWS Shield Advanced。将该加速器添加为要保护的资源。
options.B: 订阅 AWS Shield Advanced。将 EC2 实例添加为要保护的资源。
options.C: 创建一个包含基于速率规则的 AWS WAF web ACL。将该 web ACL 与加速器关联。
options.D: 创建一个包含基于速率规则的 AWS WAF web ACL。将该 web ACL 与 EC2 实例关联。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

AWS Shield 是用于 DDoS 防护的 AWS 服务；AWS 表示 Shield Standard 和 Shield Advanced 可在第 3/4 层以及第 7 层保护 AWS 资源免受 DDoS 攻击，并且你可以订阅 Shield Advanced 以获得更高级别的保护（[AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)）。对于 Shield Advanced，AWS 明确将 **AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerators** 列为受支持的受保护资源类型，并说明 Shield Advanced 只保护你指定的资源（[protected resource types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-by-resource-type.html)）。由于该公司的面向 Internet 的入口点是一个 **standard accelerator**，因此订阅 Shield Advanced 并将该加速器添加为受保护资源是正确的解决方案。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：Shield Advanced 不会直接保护任意 EC2 实例；AWS 将 EC2 实例列为通过与 **Amazon EC2 Elastic IP addresses** 关联来受保护，同时将 Global Accelerator standard accelerators 单独列为可保护资源（[protected resource types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-by-resource-type.html)）。题目中特别包含 Global Accelerator 端点，因此应保护该加速器。
- **C**：AWS WAF web ACLs 不能与 Global Accelerator 关联。AWS WAF web ACL 关联支持 API Gateway REST APIs、Application Load Balancers、AppSync APIs、Cognito user pools、App Runner、Verified Access、Amplify 和 CloudFront distributions 等资源，而不支持 Global Accelerator（[WAF web ACL associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html)）。
- **D**：AWS WAF web ACLs 也不能直接与 EC2 实例关联；EC2 实例不在文档所列的受支持 WAF web ACL 关联目标列表中（[WAF web ACL associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl-associating-aws-resource.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company needs to run a scheduled daily job to aggregate and filter sales records for analytics. The company stores the sales records in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each object can be up to 10 GB in size. Based on the number of sales events, the job can take up to an hour to complete. The CPU and memory usage of the job are constant and are known in advance. A solutions architect needs to minimize the amount of operational effort that is needed for the job to run. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that has an Amazon EventBridge notification. Schedule the EventBridge event to run once a day.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API, and integrate the API with the function. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that calls the API and invokes the function.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that launches an ECS task on the cluster to run the job.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an Amazon EC2 launch type and an Auto Scaling group with at least one EC2 instance. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that launches an ECS task on the cluster to run the job.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The job can run for up to **1 hour**, so it is not a good fit for AWS Lambda. AWS Lambda has a maximum function timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)**, and AWS specifically notes that large S3 downloads or longer processing can cause timeout risk ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)).

Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate is the best fit because the workload has known CPU and memory requirements, can be packaged as a container, and needs to run on a daily schedule. ECS task definitions let you specify the container image and the CPU and memory requirements for the task ([Amazon ECS task definitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definitions.html)). EventBridge Scheduler supports recurring cron/rate schedules and can schedule Amazon ECS tasks ([Using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to schedule Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tasks-scheduled-eventbridge-scheduler.html)). Fargate minimizes operational effort because it runs containers without requiring you to manage servers or EC2 clusters, and removes the need to provision, configure, scale, or optimize clusters of virtual machines ([Architect for AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Lambda invoked by EventBridge is simple, but the job can take up to 1 hour, which exceeds Lambda’s 15-minute maximum timeout.
- **B:** Adding API Gateway does not remove the Lambda timeout limit. It also adds unnecessary operational components for a scheduled backend job.
- **D:** ECS on EC2 could run the job, but it requires managing EC2 capacity, an Auto Scaling group, instance patching, scaling, and cluster capacity. Fargate provides the same container task model with less operational effort because there are no EC2 instances or VM clusters to manage.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司需要运行一个按计划每天执行的作业，用于聚合和筛选销售记录以进行分析。该公司将销售记录存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。每个对象的大小最大可达 10 GB。根据销售事件的数量，该作业最多可能需要一小时才能完成。该作业的 CPU 和内存使用量是恒定的，并且已提前知晓。解决方案架构师需要最大限度地减少运行该作业所需的运维工作量。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个具有 Amazon EventBridge 通知的 AWS Lambda 函数。将 EventBridge 事件计划为每天运行一次。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API，并将该 API 与该函数集成。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划事件，用于调用该 API 并调用该函数。
options.C: 创建一个采用 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划事件，用于在该集群上启动 ECS 任务来运行该作业。
options.D: 创建一个采用 Amazon EC2 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群，以及一个至少包含一个 EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划事件，用于在该集群上启动 ECS 任务来运行该作业。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

该作业最多可能运行 **1 小时**，因此不适合使用 AWS Lambda。AWS Lambda 的最大函数超时时间为 **900 秒（15 分钟）**，并且 AWS 特别指出，大型 S3 下载或较长时间的处理可能导致超时风险（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。

Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate 是最佳选择，因为该工作负载具有已知的 CPU 和内存要求，可以打包为容器，并且需要按每日计划运行。ECS 任务定义允许你指定容器映像以及任务的 CPU 和内存要求（[Amazon ECS task definitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_definitions.html)）。EventBridge Scheduler 支持重复的 cron/rate 计划，并且可以计划 Amazon ECS 任务（[Using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to schedule Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tasks-scheduled-eventbridge-scheduler.html)）。Fargate 可以最大限度地减少运维工作量，因为它运行容器时不需要你管理服务器或 EC2 集群，并且消除了预置、配置、扩展或优化虚拟机集群的需要（[Architect for AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 由 EventBridge 调用 Lambda 很简单，但该作业最多可能需要 1 小时，这超过了 Lambda 15 分钟的最大超时时间。
- **B:** 添加 API Gateway 并不能消除 Lambda 超时限制。对于计划执行的后端作业来说，它还增加了不必要的运维组件。
- **D:** ECS on EC2 可以运行该作业，但需要管理 EC2 容量、Auto Scaling 组、实例修补、扩展和集群容量。Fargate 提供相同的容器任务模型，但运维工作量更少，因为无需管理 EC2 实例或 VM 集群。

en.question: A company needs to transfer 600 TB of data from its on-premises network-attached storage (NAS) system to the AWS Cloud. The data transfer must be complete within 2 weeks. The data is sensitive and must be encrypted in transit. The company’s internet connection can support an upload speed of 100 Mbps. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 multi-part upload functionality to transfer the files over HTTPS.
options.B: Create a VPN connection between the on-premises NAS system and the nearest AWS Region. Transfer the data over the VPN connection.
options.C: Use the AWS Snow Family console to order several AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Use the devices to transfer the data to Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection between the company location and the nearest AWS Region. Transfer the data over a VPN connection into the Region to store the data in Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

600 TB over a 100 Mbps upload link cannot finish within 2 weeks: at best, 600 TB × 8 / 100 Mbps is roughly **48 million seconds (~556 days)** before protocol overhead. Online options using the existing internet/VPN bandwidth therefore fail the time requirement.

AWS Snowball Edge is designed for this case: AWS documentation says each Snowball Edge device can transfer data to or from AWS Cloud and can transport data **faster than the internet** by shipping devices, and Snowball Edge supports importing data between local environments and **Amazon S3** with **one or more devices** without using the internet. The documentation also states that encryption is enforced, protecting data at rest and in **physical transit**. Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices provide large capacity, so ordering several devices is the most cost-effective way to move 600 TB within the required timeframe while protecting sensitive data in transit ([AWS Snowball Edge overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. S3 multipart upload over HTTPS**: Multipart upload can improve throughput and resilience by uploading parts in parallel, but AWS recommends it to maximize the use of the **available bandwidth**; it cannot overcome the company’s 100 Mbps upload limit ([S3 multipart upload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)). The transfer would take far longer than 2 weeks.
- **B. VPN connection**: A VPN would still use the company’s 100 Mbps internet connection, so it cannot complete 600 TB in 2 weeks.
- **D. 10 Gbps Direct Connect**: Direct Connect can establish a dedicated network connection and a public virtual interface can access public AWS services such as Amazon S3, but it has port-hour and data-transfer billing and requires provisioning a dedicated high-capacity connection ([Direct Connect components and pricing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). For a one-time 600 TB migration, Snowball Edge is more cost-effective than setting up a 10 Gbps Direct Connect circuit, and the option unnecessarily adds a VPN path.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将 600 TB 数据从其本地网络附加存储 (NAS) 系统传输到 AWS Cloud。数据传输必须在 2 周内完成。数据是敏感的，并且必须在传输过程中加密。该公司的互联网连接可支持 100 Mbps 的上传速度。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 分段上传功能通过 HTTPS 传输文件。
options.B: 在本地 NAS 系统与最近的 AWS Region 之间创建 VPN 连接。通过 VPN 连接传输数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Snow Family 控制台订购多个 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。使用这些设备将数据传输到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 在公司位置与最近的 AWS Region 之间设置 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接。通过 VPN 连接将数据传输到该 Region，以便将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

通过 100 Mbps 上传链路传输 600 TB 无法在 2 周内完成：在最佳情况下，600 TB × 8 / 100 Mbps 约为 **4800 万秒（约 556 天）**，这还未计入协议开销。因此，使用现有互联网/VPN 带宽的在线选项无法满足时间要求。

AWS Snowball Edge 正是为这种场景而设计的：AWS 文档说明，每台 Snowball Edge 设备都可以向 AWS Cloud 传输数据或从 AWS Cloud 传输数据，并且可以通过运输设备以**快于互联网**的速度传输数据；Snowball Edge 支持在本地环境与 **Amazon S3** 之间使用**一台或多台设备**导入数据，而无需使用互联网。文档还指出会强制执行加密，从而保护静态数据以及**物理传输**过程中的数据。Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备提供大容量，因此订购多台设备是在所需时间范围内迁移 600 TB 数据并保护传输中敏感数据的最具成本效益的方式（[AWS Snowball Edge overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A. S3 multipart upload over HTTPS**：Multipart upload 可以通过并行上传分段来提高吞吐量和弹性，但 AWS 建议使用它来最大化利用**可用带宽**；它无法突破该公司 100 Mbps 的上传限制（[S3 multipart upload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)）。传输所需时间会远远超过 2 周。
- **B. VPN connection**：VPN 仍会使用该公司的 100 Mbps 互联网连接，因此无法在 2 周内完成 600 TB 数据传输。
- **D. 10 Gbps Direct Connect**：Direct Connect 可以建立专用网络连接，公共虚拟接口可以访问 Amazon S3 等公共 AWS 服务，但它有端口小时和数据传输计费，并且需要预置专用的高容量连接（[Direct Connect components and pricing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。对于一次性的 600 TB 迁移，Snowball Edge 比设置 10 Gbps Direct Connect 线路更具成本效益，而且该选项还不必要地增加了 VPN 路径。

en.question: A financial company hosts a web application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway Regional API endpoint to give users the ability to retrieve current stock prices. The company’s security team has noticed an increase in the number of API requests. The security team is concerned that HTTP flood attacks might take the application offline. A solutions architect must design a solution to protect the application from this type of attack. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint with a maximum TTL of 24 hours.
options.B: Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the Count metric and alert the security team when the predefined rate is reached.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint. Create an AWS Lambda function to block requests from IP addresses that exceed the predefined rate.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

A Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule associated to the API Gateway stage directly addresses HTTP flood behavior with the least operational overhead. AWS states that AWS WAF protects API Gateway REST APIs and that you can use **rate-based rules** to specify how many web requests are allowed from each client IP in a continuously updated 5-minute period. API Gateway requires a WAFV2 web ACL for a Regional application, and the web ACL can be associated with an API stage in the same Region as the API ([API Gateway AWS WAF integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)). AWS WAF rate-based rules count incoming requests and rate limit requests when they arrive too quickly, based on an evaluation window, request limit, and action settings ([AWS WAF rate-based rule statements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-rate-based.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudFront caching with a 24-hour TTL does not reliably protect a dynamic stock-price API from HTTP flood attacks. It may cache some responses, but it does not rate-limit or block excessive clients. AWS WAF web ACLs are the documented mechanism for fine-grained allow/block control of HTTP(S) requests to protected resources including API Gateway ([AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)).
- **C:** CloudWatch monitoring and alarms can notify the security team, but notification alone does not automatically block or rate-limit flood traffic. The requirement is to protect the application with least operational overhead, which AWS WAF rate-based rules provide directly.
- **D:** CloudFront plus Lambda@Edge could implement custom blocking logic, but it requires building and operating custom code and IP tracking. AWS WAF already provides managed web ACL rule statements that can block or count requests exceeding a configured rate, so this option has higher operational overhead than using WAF directly ([AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)).

zh.question: 一家金融公司在 AWS 上托管一个 Web 应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway Regional API endpoint，使用户能够检索当前股票价格。公司的安全团队注意到 API 请求数量有所增加。安全团队担心 HTTP 洪水攻击可能会使应用程序离线。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案来保护应用程序免受此类攻击。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 API Gateway Regional API endpoint 前面创建一个 Amazon CloudFront distribution，最大 TTL 为 24 小时。
options.B: 创建一个带有基于速率规则的 Regional AWS WAF web ACL。将该 web ACL 与 API Gateway stage 关联。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控 Count 指标，并在达到预定义速率时提醒安全团队。
options.D: 在 API Gateway Regional API endpoint 前面创建一个带有 Lambda@Edge 的 Amazon CloudFront distribution。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来阻止来自超过预定义速率的 IP 地址的请求。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

将带有基于速率规则的 Regional AWS WAF web ACL 关联到 API Gateway stage，可以直接应对 HTTP 洪水行为，并且运营开销最少。AWS 表明 AWS WAF 可保护 API Gateway REST APIs，并且你可以使用 **rate-based rules** 指定在持续更新的 5 分钟期间内允许来自每个客户端 IP 的 Web 请求数量。对于 Regional 应用程序，API Gateway 需要 WAFV2 web ACL，并且该 web ACL 可以与 API 所在同一 Region 中的 API stage 关联（[API Gateway AWS WAF integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-control-access-aws-waf.html)）。AWS WAF 基于速率的规则会统计传入请求，并在请求到达过快时根据评估窗口、请求限制和操作设置对请求进行速率限制（[AWS WAF rate-based rule statements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-rate-based.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用 24 小时 TTL 的 CloudFront 缓存并不能可靠地保护动态股票价格 API 免受 HTTP 洪水攻击。它可能会缓存某些响应，但不会对过量客户端进行速率限制或阻止。AWS WAF web ACLs 是用于对发往受保护资源（包括 API Gateway）的 HTTP(S) 请求进行细粒度允许/阻止控制的文档化机制（[AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)）。
- **C:** CloudWatch 监控和警报可以通知安全团队，但仅通知并不会自动阻止洪水流量或对其进行速率限制。要求是以最少运营开销保护应用程序，而 AWS WAF 基于速率的规则可以直接提供这一能力。
- **D:** CloudFront 加 Lambda@Edge 可以实现自定义阻止逻辑，但需要构建和运营自定义代码以及 IP 跟踪。AWS WAF 已经提供托管式 web ACL 规则语句，可以阻止或统计超过配置速率的请求，因此与直接使用 WAF 相比，此选项具有更高的运营开销（[AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html)）。

en.question: A meteorological startup company has a custom web application to sell weather data to its users online. The company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store its data and wants to build a new service that sends an alert to the managers of four internal teams every time a new weather event is recorded. The company does not want this new service to affect the performance of the current application. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Use DynamoDB transactions to write new event data to the table. Configure the transactions to notify internal teams.
options.B: Have the current application publish a message to four Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Have each team subscribe to one topic.
options.C: Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. Use triggers to write to a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to which the teams can subscribe.
options.D: Add a custom attribute to each record to flag new items. Write a cron job that scans the table every minute for items that are new and notifies an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to which the teams can subscribe.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Enabling **DynamoDB Streams** is the best fit because it captures item-level changes to the DynamoDB table in near real time. AWS states that DynamoDB Streams records table item modifications and can be used by applications to take action based on those changes; importantly, enabling a stream is asynchronous and has **no performance impact on the table** ([DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)). DynamoDB also integrates with **AWS Lambda triggers**, which automatically respond to DynamoDB Streams events and can perform actions such as sending notifications ([DynamoDB Streams and AWS Lambda triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.Lambda.html)). Publishing from that trigger to a single **SNS topic** lets all four teams subscribe to one topic, because SNS topics deliver messages from publishers to multiple subscribers and support endpoints such as email, SMS, Lambda, HTTP/S, and SQS ([Amazon SNS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). This is event-driven, decoupled from the existing application, and low operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** DynamoDB transactions are for coordinated data writes, not for configuring notifications to internal teams. This would also put notification logic in the write path, which could affect the current application.
- **B:** Having the current application publish to four SNS topics requires modifying the existing application and adds unnecessary complexity. A single SNS topic can fan out notifications to multiple subscribers.
- **D:** Scanning the table every minute with a cron job is operationally heavier and inefficient. It also consumes read capacity and is not as near-real-time or event-driven as DynamoDB Streams. Additionally, SQS is a queueing service for consumers to poll; it is not the right mechanism for teams to directly “subscribe” for alerts in the way SNS supports subscriptions.

zh.question: 一家气象初创公司有一个自定义 Web 应用程序，用于在线向用户销售天气数据。该公司使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储数据，并希望构建一项新服务：每当记录到新的天气事件时，就向四个内部团队的经理发送警报。该公司不希望这项新服务影响当前应用程序的性能。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施，以在运营开销最少的情况下满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 DynamoDB transactions 将新的事件数据写入表。配置这些 transactions 以通知内部团队。
options.B: 让当前应用程序向四个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发布消息。让每个团队订阅一个主题。
options.C: 在表上启用 Amazon DynamoDB Streams。使用触发器写入到一个单一的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，团队可以订阅该主题。
options.D: 向每条记录添加一个自定义属性，用于标记新项目。编写一个 cron job，每分钟扫描一次表以查找新项目，并通知一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，团队可以订阅该队列。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

启用 **DynamoDB Streams** 是最合适的选择，因为它可以近乎实时地捕获 DynamoDB 表的项目级更改。AWS 指出，DynamoDB Streams 会记录表项目修改，并且应用程序可以根据这些更改采取操作；重要的是，启用 stream 是异步的，并且对表**没有性能影响**（[DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)）。DynamoDB 还与 **AWS Lambda triggers** 集成，这些触发器会自动响应 DynamoDB Streams 事件，并可以执行发送通知等操作（[DynamoDB Streams and AWS Lambda triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.Lambda.html)）。从该触发器发布到一个单一的 **SNS topic**，可以让所有四个团队订阅同一个主题，因为 SNS topics 会将来自发布者的消息传递给多个订阅者，并支持 email、SMS、Lambda、HTTP/S 和 SQS 等端点（[Amazon SNS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。这是一种事件驱动的方案，与现有应用程序解耦，并且运营开销低。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** DynamoDB transactions 用于协调数据写入，而不是用于配置向内部团队发送通知。这还会把通知逻辑放入写入路径中，可能会影响当前应用程序。
- **B:** 让当前应用程序发布到四个 SNS topics 需要修改现有应用程序，并增加不必要的复杂性。一个单一的 SNS topic 就可以将通知扇出到多个订阅者。
- **D:** 使用 cron job 每分钟扫描一次表会带来更高的运营负担，并且效率低下。它还会消耗读取容量，并且不如 DynamoDB Streams 那样接近实时或事件驱动。此外，SQS 是一种供消费者轮询的队列服务；它不是让团队像 SNS 支持 subscriptions 那样直接“订阅”警报的正确机制。

en.question: A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to make an existing application highly available and resilient. The current version of the application resides in the company's data center. The application recently experienced data loss after a database server crashed because of an unexpected power outage. The company needs a solution that avoids any single points of failure. The solution must give the application the ability to scale to meet user demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ configuration.
options.B: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. Deploy the database on an EC2 instance. Enable EC2 Auto Recovery.
options.C: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance with a read replica in a single Availability Zone. Promote the read replica to replace the primary DB instance if the primary DB instance fails.
options.D: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Deploy the primary and secondary database servers on EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach to create shared storage between the instances.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

- **A is correct** because it removes single points of failure at both tiers and supports demand-based scaling. AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones for geographic redundancy; if one AZ is unhealthy or unavailable, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). For the database tier, an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment automatically provisions and maintains a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone, providing data redundancy and helping protect against DB instance failure or AZ disruption ([Amazon RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).
- **B is incorrect** because the application Auto Scaling group is in only one Availability Zone, so an AZ failure remains a single point of failure. The database is also a self-managed EC2 instance rather than an RDS Multi-AZ deployment, and EC2 Auto Recovery does not provide a cross-AZ synchronous standby database architecture.
- **C is incorrect** because an RDS read replica is primarily for read scaling or disaster recovery, uses asynchronous replication, and promotion is a disaster recovery action rather than automatic high-availability failover ([Amazon RDS read replica documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). A read replica in a single AZ does not provide the same managed, synchronous, Multi-AZ HA protection as RDS Multi-AZ.
- **D is incorrect** because EBS Multi-Attach volumes can be attached only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, not across multiple AZs; additionally, AWS notes that an EBS infrastructure issue can make the Multi-Attach volume unavailable to all attached instances, so it would not eliminate single points of failure ([Amazon EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 AWS Cloud 使现有应用程序实现高可用性和弹性。该应用程序的当前版本位于公司的数据中心。最近，由于意外断电导致数据库服务器崩溃，该应用程序发生了数据丢失。公司需要一种避免任何单点故障的解决方案。该解决方案必须使应用程序能够扩展以满足用户需求。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Amazon EC2 实例来部署应用程序服务器。使用采用 Multi-AZ 配置的 Amazon RDS DB 实例。
options.B: 通过在单个 Availability Zone 中的 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Amazon EC2 实例来部署应用程序服务器。在 EC2 实例上部署数据库。启用 EC2 Auto Recovery。
options.C: 通过在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Amazon EC2 实例来部署应用程序服务器。使用带有位于单个 Availability Zone 中的只读副本的 Amazon RDS DB 实例。如果主 DB 实例发生故障，则提升只读副本以替换主 DB 实例。
options.D: 通过在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组中使用 Amazon EC2 实例来部署应用程序服务器。跨多个 Availability Zones 在 EC2 实例上部署主数据库服务器和辅助数据库服务器。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach 在实例之间创建共享存储。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

- **A 是正确的**，因为它消除了应用层和数据库层的单点故障，并支持基于需求的扩展。AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 Availability Zones 部署以实现地理冗余；如果某个 AZ 不健康或不可用，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。对于数据库层，Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例部署会自动预置并维护位于不同 Availability Zone 中的同步备用副本，从而提供数据冗余，并帮助防范 DB 实例故障或 AZ 中断（[Amazon RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。
- **B 是不正确的**，因为应用程序 Auto Scaling 组仅位于一个 Availability Zone 中，因此 AZ 故障仍然是单点故障。数据库也是自管理的 EC2 实例，而不是 RDS Multi-AZ 部署，并且 EC2 Auto Recovery 不提供跨 AZ 的同步备用数据库架构。
- **C 是不正确的**，因为 RDS 只读副本主要用于读取扩展或灾难恢复，使用异步复制，并且提升副本是一种灾难恢复操作，而不是自动高可用性故障转移（[Amazon RDS read replica documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。位于单个 AZ 中的只读副本无法提供与 RDS Multi-AZ 相同的托管、同步、Multi-AZ HA 保护。
- **D 是不正确的**，因为 EBS Multi-Attach 卷只能附加到位于**同一 Availability Zone** 的实例，不能跨多个 AZ；此外，AWS 指出，EBS 基础设施问题可能会使 Multi-Attach 卷对所有已附加实例都不可用，因此它无法消除单点故障（[Amazon EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to ingest and handle large amounts of streaming data that its application generates. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances and sends data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, which is configured with default settings. Every other day, the application consumes the data and writes the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for business intelligence (BI) processing. The company observes that Amazon S3 is not receiving all the data that the application sends to Kinesis Data Streams. What should a solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Update the Kinesis Data Streams default settings by modifying the data retention period.
options.B: Update the application to use the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to send the data to Kinesis Data Streams.
options.C: Update the number of Kinesis shards to handle the throughput of the data that is sent to Kinesis Data Streams.
options.D: Turn on S3 Versioning within the S3 bucket to preserve every version of every object that is ingested in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The application consumes the stream only **every other day**. Kinesis Data Streams stores records only temporarily: the retention period is the time from when a record is added until it is no longer accessible, and a stream stores records for **24 hours by default**; the retention period can be increased up to 8,760 hours (365 days) using `IncreaseStreamRetentionPeriod` or the console ([AWS Kinesis Data Streams: Change the data retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/kinesis-extended-retention.html)). Because the consumer waits about 48 hours, data older than the default 24-hour retention window can expire before it is written to S3. Increasing the stream retention period resolves the missing-data issue.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Use KPL:** The Kinesis Producer Library can help producers send data efficiently, but the symptom is caused by records expiring before the every-other-day consumer reads them. It does not address the default 24-hour retention window.
- **C. Increase shards:** Shards affect stream throughput. AWS docs state that each shard provides a fixed read/write capacity and that total stream capacity is the sum of shard capacities ([Kinesis terminology: Shard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)). Increasing shards would help if writes or reads were throttled, but it would not prevent records from expiring after 24 hours.
- **D. Turn on S3 Versioning:** S3 Versioning preserves multiple versions of objects after they are stored in S3, but the problem is that some records never reach S3 because they expire in Kinesis first ([S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要摄取并处理其应用程序生成的大量流式数据。该应用程序在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行，并将数据发送到 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams，后者使用默认设置进行配置。每隔一天，该应用程序会消费这些数据，并将数据写入 Amazon S3 存储桶以进行商业智能 (BI) 处理。公司观察到 Amazon S3 没有收到应用程序发送到 Kinesis Data Streams 的所有数据。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来解决此问题？

options.A: 通过修改数据保留期来更新 Kinesis Data Streams 默认设置。
options.B: 更新应用程序以使用 Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) 将数据发送到 Kinesis Data Streams。
options.C: 更新 Kinesis 分片数量，以处理发送到 Kinesis Data Streams 的数据吞吐量。
options.D: 在 S3 存储桶中开启 S3 Versioning，以保留摄取到 S3 存储桶中的每个对象的每个版本。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** 应用程序仅**每隔一天**消费一次流。Kinesis Data Streams 只会临时存储记录：保留期是从记录被添加到不再可访问的时间，流**默认**存储记录 **24 小时**；可以使用 `IncreaseStreamRetentionPeriod` 或控制台将保留期增加到最多 8,760 小时（365 天）（[AWS Kinesis Data Streams: Change the data retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/kinesis-extended-retention.html)）。由于消费者大约等待 48 小时，早于默认 24 小时保留窗口的数据可能会在写入 S3 之前过期。增加流保留期可以解决数据缺失问题。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Use KPL:** Kinesis Producer Library 可以帮助生产者高效发送数据，但该症状是由记录在每隔一天读取的消费者读取之前过期造成的。它不能解决默认的 24 小时保留窗口问题。
- **C. Increase shards:** 分片会影响流吞吐量。AWS 文档说明，每个分片提供固定的读/写容量，并且总流容量是各分片容量之和（[Kinesis terminology: Shard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)）。如果写入或读取被限流，增加分片会有帮助，但它无法防止记录在 24 小时后过期。
- **D. Turn on S3 Versioning:** S3 Versioning 会在对象存储到 S3 后保留对象的多个版本，但问题在于某些记录因为先在 Kinesis 中过期而从未到达 S3（[S3 Versioning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)）。

en.question: A developer has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to upload files to Amazon S3 and needs the required permissions to perform the task. The developer already has an IAM user with valid IAM credentials required for Amazon S3. What should a solutions architect do to grant the permissions?

options.A: Add required IAM permissions in the resource policy of the Lambda function.
options.B: Create a signed request using the existing IAM credentials in the Lambda function.
options.C: Create a new IAM user and use the existing IAM credentials in the Lambda function.
options.D: Create an IAM execution role with the required permissions and attach the IAM role to the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** A Lambda function should receive AWS service permissions through its **execution role**. AWS states that a Lambda function's execution role is an IAM role that grants the function permission to access AWS services and resources, and that Lambda automatically assumes this role when the function is invoked. After creating the role and adding the required permissions, AWS says to attach the execution role to the function ([AWS Lambda execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)). For S3 uploads, the role policy should include the needed S3 actions, such as `s3:PutObject`, scoped to the target bucket/key prefix following least privilege.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A Lambda function resource-based policy is for allowing other AWS services or accounts to **invoke the function**, not for giving the function permissions to call S3. AWS documents resource-based policies in this context as granting a service permission to invoke the function ([Granting Lambda function access to AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/permissions-function-services.html)).
- **B:** Creating signed requests with an existing IAM user's credentials inside the function is not the standard or best-practice way to authorize Lambda. Lambda automatically assumes its execution role, and AWS best practices say to limit the execution role to the permissions the function needs ([AWS Lambda execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html), [Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)).
- **C:** Creating another IAM user and using IAM user credentials in the Lambda function is unnecessary and less secure. The correct identity for Lambda runtime permissions is an IAM execution role attached to the function, not IAM user credentials.

zh.question: 开发人员有一个应用程序，该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数将文件上传到 Amazon S3，并且需要执行该任务所需的权限。开发人员已经有一个 IAM 用户，该用户具有 Amazon S3 所需的有效 IAM 凭证。解决方案架构师应如何授予这些权限？

options.A: 在 Lambda 函数的资源策略中添加所需的 IAM 权限。
options.B: 在 Lambda 函数中使用现有 IAM 凭证创建签名请求。
options.C: 创建一个新的 IAM 用户，并在 Lambda 函数中使用现有 IAM 凭证。
options.D: 创建具有所需权限的 IAM 执行角色，并将该 IAM 角色附加到 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Lambda 函数应通过其 **execution role** 获得 AWS 服务权限。AWS 声明，Lambda 函数的执行角色是一个 IAM 角色，它授予函数访问 AWS 服务和资源的权限，并且 Lambda 在函数被调用时会自动代入此角色。创建角色并添加所需权限后，AWS 表示应将执行角色附加到该函数（[AWS Lambda execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)）。对于 S3 上传，角色策略应包含所需的 S3 操作，例如 `s3:PutObject`，并按照最小权限原则限定到目标存储桶/键前缀。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Lambda 函数基于资源的策略用于允许其他 AWS 服务或账户**调用该函数**，而不是授予该函数调用 S3 的权限。AWS 文档在此上下文中将基于资源的策略描述为授予某项服务调用该函数的权限（[Granting Lambda function access to AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/permissions-function-services.html)）。
- **B:** 在函数内部使用现有 IAM 用户的凭证创建签名请求，并不是授权 Lambda 的标准方式或最佳实践。Lambda 会自动代入其执行角色，并且 AWS 最佳实践建议将执行角色限制为函数所需的权限（[AWS Lambda execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html), [Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)）。
- **C:** 创建另一个 IAM 用户并在 Lambda 函数中使用 IAM 用户凭证是不必要且安全性较低的。用于 Lambda 运行时权限的正确身份是附加到该函数的 IAM 执行角色，而不是 IAM 用户凭证。

en.question: A company has deployed a serverless application that invokes an AWS Lambda function when new documents are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses the Lambda function to process the documents. After a recent marketing campaign, the company noticed that the application did not process many of the documents. What should a solutions architect do to improve the architecture of this application?

options.A: Set the Lambda function's runtime timeout value to 15 minutes.
options.B: Configure an S3 bucket replication policy. Stage the documents in the S3 bucket for later processing.
options.C: Deploy an additional Lambda function. Load balance the processing of the documents across the two Lambda functions.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Send the requests to the queue. Configure the queue as an event source for Lambda.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**. The architecture needs a buffer/decoupling layer for bursts of document uploads. AWS documents that Lambda can process messages from an Amazon SQS queue through an event source mapping; Lambda polls the queue, invokes the function with batches of messages, and deletes messages only after the function successfully processes them ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). AWS also provides an example of configuring an S3 bucket to send object-created notifications to an SQS queue for processing ([Receive and process Amazon S3 event notifications by using an AWS SDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/example_s3_Scenario_ProcessS3EventNotification_section.html)). This lets upload events wait in SQS during traffic spikes instead of relying only on direct S3-to-Lambda asynchronous invocations.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Increasing the Lambda timeout to 15 minutes addresses long-running processing, not missed processing during a burst. The search result confirms 15 minutes is the maximum Lambda timeout, but the problem is throughput/buffering, not per-invocation duration ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)).
- **B**: S3 replication copies objects between buckets; it is not a work queue or event buffer for Lambda processing.
- **C**: Adding another Lambda function and trying to load balance between functions is not the recommended event-driven pattern. Lambda with SQS already provides queue-based polling, batching, and scaling behavior through an event source mapping ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司部署了一个无服务器应用程序，当新文档上传到 Amazon S3 bucket 时会调用 AWS Lambda 函数。该应用程序使用 Lambda 函数处理这些文档。在最近一次营销活动之后，公司注意到该应用程序没有处理许多文档。解决方案架构师应该怎么做来改进此应用程序的架构？

options.A: 将 Lambda 函数的运行时超时值设置为 15 分钟。
options.B: 配置 S3 bucket 复制策略。将文档暂存到 S3 bucket 中以供稍后处理。
options.C: 部署一个额外的 Lambda 函数。在两个 Lambda 函数之间对文档处理进行负载均衡。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。将请求发送到该队列。将该队列配置为 Lambda 的事件源。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。该架构需要一个用于应对文档上传突发流量的缓冲/解耦层。AWS 文档说明，Lambda 可以通过事件源映射处理来自 Amazon SQS 队列的消息；Lambda 轮询队列，使用消息批次调用函数，并且只有在函数成功处理消息后才会删除消息（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。AWS 还提供了一个示例，用于配置 S3 bucket 将对象创建通知发送到 SQS 队列进行处理（[Receive and process Amazon S3 event notifications by using an AWS SDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/example_s3_Scenario_ProcessS3EventNotification_section.html)）。这使得上传事件可以在流量高峰期间等待在 SQS 中，而不是仅依赖直接的 S3 到 Lambda 异步调用。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：将 Lambda 超时时间增加到 15 分钟解决的是长时间运行的处理问题，而不是突发期间遗漏处理的问题。搜索结果确认 15 分钟是 Lambda 超时的最大值，但问题在于吞吐量/缓冲，而不是单次调用持续时间（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。
- **B**：S3 复制会在 bucket 之间复制对象；它不是用于 Lambda 处理的工作队列或事件缓冲区。
- **C**：添加另一个 Lambda 函数并尝试在函数之间进行负载均衡，并不是推荐的事件驱动模式。Lambda 与 SQS 结合已经通过事件源映射提供了基于队列的轮询、批处理和扩展行为（[Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing the architecture for a software demonstration environment. The environment will run on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The system will experience significant increases in traffic during working hours but is not required to operate on weekends. Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to ensure that the system can scale to meet demand? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Auto Scaling to adjust the ALB capacity based on request rate.
options.B: Use AWS Auto Scaling to scale the capacity of the VPC internet gateway.
options.C: Launch the EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions to distribute the load across Regions.
options.D: Use a target tracking scaling policy to scale the Auto Scaling group based on instance CPU utilization.
options.E: Use scheduled scaling to change the Auto Scaling group minimum, maximum, and desired capacity to zero for weekends. Revert to the default values at the start of the week.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **D and E**.

- **D — Correct.** The variable working-hours demand should be handled by scaling the **EC2 Auto Scaling group**, not the load balancer or network gateway. AWS states that target tracking scaling policies automatically scale an Auto Scaling group based on a target metric value, and explicitly gives CPU utilization as an example: an Auto Scaling group can scale out when CPU exceeds the target and scale in when CPU drops below it ([Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).
- **E — Correct.** The environment is not required on weekends, and scheduled scaling is designed for predictable load changes. AWS documentation says scheduled actions can set desired capacity and optionally minimum and maximum capacity at specific times, and that scheduled scaling and scaling policies can be used together so the application has sufficient capacity while avoiding unneeded capacity ([Scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)). Setting min/max/desired to 0 for weekends and restoring them at the start of the week matches this requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A — Incorrect.** The architecture should scale the registered compute targets. Elastic Load Balancing lets you add and remove compute resources as needs change, and Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling increases or decreases the number of instances as demand changes; instances launched or terminated by Auto Scaling are automatically registered or deregistered with the load balancer ([Elastic Load Balancing related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)). There is no need to use Auto Scaling to adjust “ALB capacity.”
- **B — Incorrect.** An internet gateway provides internet routing/NAT functionality for a VPC; the documentation describes attaching it to a VPC and configuring routes for internet-bound traffic, not scaling it for application request load ([Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)).
- **C — Incorrect.** The question already specifies an Auto Scaling group behind an ALB and asks how to meet predictable working-hours demand and weekend shutdown. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling can dynamically adjust the number of instances between minimum and maximum capacity and can also scale on a schedule ([Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)); launching instances in multiple Regions is unnecessary for this stated scaling requirement.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一个软件演示环境设计架构。该环境将在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。系统在工作时间内流量会显著增加，但周末不需要运行。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来确保系统能够扩展以满足需求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Auto Scaling 根据请求速率调整 ALB 容量。
options.B: 使用 AWS Auto Scaling 扩展 VPC internet gateway 的容量。
options.C: 在多个 AWS Regions 中启动 EC2 实例，以跨 Regions 分配负载。
options.D: 使用目标跟踪扩展策略，根据实例 CPU 利用率扩展 Auto Scaling 组。
options.E: 使用计划扩展在周末将 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量、最大容量和期望容量更改为零。在一周开始时恢复为默认值。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D 和 E**。

- **D — 正确。** 工作时间内变化的需求应通过扩展 **EC2 Auto Scaling 组**来处理，而不是扩展负载均衡器或网络网关。AWS 表示，目标跟踪扩展策略会根据目标指标值自动扩展 Auto Scaling 组，并明确以 CPU 利用率为例：当 CPU 超过目标时，Auto Scaling 组可以扩展；当 CPU 低于目标时，可以缩减（[Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。
- **E — 正确。** 该环境周末不需要运行，而计划扩展旨在应对可预测的负载变化。AWS 文档说明，计划操作可以在特定时间设置期望容量，并可选择设置最小容量和最大容量；计划扩展和扩展策略可以结合使用，使应用程序在具备足够容量的同时避免不必要的容量（[Scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。在周末将 min/max/desired 设置为 0，并在一周开始时恢复，符合此需求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A — 不正确。** 该架构应扩展已注册的计算目标。Elastic Load Balancing 允许你随着需求变化添加和移除计算资源，而 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会随着需求变化增加或减少实例数量；由 Auto Scaling 启动或终止的实例会自动向负载均衡器注册或取消注册（[Elastic Load Balancing related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。无需使用 Auto Scaling 来调整 “ALB capacity”。
- **B — 不正确。** internet gateway 为 VPC 提供互联网路由/NAT 功能；文档描述的是将其附加到 VPC 并为发往互联网的流量配置路由，而不是为了应用程序请求负载而扩展它（[Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。
- **C — 不正确。** 题目已指定在 ALB 后面使用 Auto Scaling 组，并询问如何满足可预测的工作时间需求和周末关闭。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 可以在最小容量和最大容量之间动态调整实例数量，也可以按计划扩展（[Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）；对于此处说明的扩展需求，在多个 Regions 中启动实例是不必要的。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a two-tiered architecture that includes a public subnet and a database subnet. The web servers in the public subnet must be open to the internet on port 443. The Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in the database subnet must be accessible only to the web servers on port 3306. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a network ACL for the public subnet. Add a rule to deny outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3306.
options.B: Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to allow traffic from the public subnet CIDR block on port 3306.
options.C: Create a security group for the web servers in the public subnet. Add a rule to allow traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443.
options.D: Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to allow traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.
options.E: Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to deny all traffic except traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **C and D**.

- **C is correct**: The web servers must be reachable from the internet on HTTPS. Security group inbound rules specify allowed protocol/port and source; allowing TCP port **443** from `0.0.0.0/0` meets the public HTTPS requirement. AWS also gives an example of allowing HTTP/HTTPS traffic from the internet with source `0.0.0.0/0` in a public-facing tier ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)).
- **D is correct**: The DB instance should allow MySQL traffic only from the web servers. AWS documentation states that a security group rule source can be another security group, and that referencing a security group allows inbound traffic from instances associated with that referenced security group over the specified protocol and port ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)). Amazon RDS documentation specifically describes creating a DB security group rule that specifies the application/EC2 security group as the source, and notes that TCP port **3306** is used for RDS for MySQL DB instances ([Controlling access with security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: A network ACL deny rule on outbound port 3306 from the public subnet would prevent the web servers from connecting to the database, which is required. It also does not precisely express “only the web servers” as the allowed database clients.
- **B**: Allowing the **public subnet CIDR block** on port 3306 would allow any resource in that subnet, not only the web servers. Referencing the web servers’ security group is more specific and follows least privilege.
- **E**: Security groups do not support deny rules. AWS states that security groups can specify **allow rules, but not deny rules** ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在设计一个两层架构，其中包括一个公有子网和一个数据库子网。公有子网中的 Web 服务器必须在端口 443 上向互联网开放。数据库子网中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例必须只能由 Web 服务器通过端口 3306 访问。解决方案架构师应采取哪组步骤来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 为公有子网创建一个网络 ACL。添加一条规则，拒绝到 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 3306 出站流量。
options.B: 为 DB 实例创建一个安全组。添加一条规则，允许来自公有子网 CIDR 块的端口 3306 流量。
options.C: 为公有子网中的 Web 服务器创建一个安全组。添加一条规则，允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 流量。
options.D: 为 DB 实例创建一个安全组。添加一条规则，允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 流量。
options.E: 为 DB 实例创建一个安全组。添加一条规则，拒绝除来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306 流量之外的所有流量。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C and D**。

- **C 正确**：Web 服务器必须能够通过 HTTPS 从互联网访问。安全组入站规则指定允许的协议/端口和来源；允许来自 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 TCP 端口 **443** 满足公有 HTTPS 要求。AWS 还给出了一个示例，在面向公众的层中允许来自来源 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 HTTP/HTTPS 流量（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。
- **D 正确**：DB 实例应仅允许来自 Web 服务器的 MySQL 流量。AWS 文档指出，安全组规则的来源可以是另一个安全组，并且引用安全组会允许来自与该被引用安全组关联的实例的入站流量，流量使用指定的协议和端口（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。Amazon RDS 文档专门描述了创建 DB 安全组规则，该规则将应用程序/EC2 安全组指定为来源，并指出 TCP 端口 **3306** 用于 RDS for MySQL DB 实例（[Controlling access with security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A**：对公有子网出站端口 3306 设置网络 ACL 拒绝规则，会阻止 Web 服务器连接到数据库，而这是必需的。它也无法精确表达“只有 Web 服务器”作为允许的数据库客户端。
- **B**：允许 **public subnet CIDR block** 上的端口 3306 会允许该子网中的任何资源，而不仅仅是 Web 服务器。引用 Web 服务器的安全组更加具体，并遵循最小权限原则。
- **E**：安全组不支持拒绝规则。AWS 指出，安全组可以指定 **allow rules, but not deny rules**（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。

en.question: A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use Lustre clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
options.B: Create an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system, and configure it to support Lustre. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon FSx for Lustre is the AWS managed service purpose-built for this requirement: AWS says FSx for Lustre lets you launch and run the high-performance Lustre file system, and that, as a **fully managed service**, it removes the complexity of setting up and managing Lustre file systems ([AWS FSx for Lustre](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)). AWS also states that EC2 workloads access an FSx for Lustre file system by using the open-source **Lustre client**, and after it is mounted it works like a local file system ([Accessing FSx for Lustre file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
