- **A. AWS DataSync** is for data movement, not for providing a shared mountable Lustre file system. AWS describes DataSync task execution as preparing, transferring, and verifying data between source and destination locations ([How AWS DataSync works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/how-datasync-transfer-works.html)).
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway file gateway** provides file access to Amazon S3 through industry-standard **NFS and SMB** protocols, not Lustre clients ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **C. Amazon EFS** does not support Lustre. AWS documentation states that EFS file systems are mounted with the EFS mount helper or standard Linux **NFS** client, and EFS supports NFSv4.0 and NFSv4.1 ([Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在为托管在 AWS Cloud 中的游戏应用程序实施共享存储解决方案。该公司需要能够使用 Lustre 客户端访问数据。该解决方案必须是完全托管的。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS DataSync 任务，将数据作为可挂载的文件系统共享。将该文件系统挂载到应用程序服务器。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway file gateway。创建一个使用所需客户端协议的文件共享。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件共享。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，并将其配置为支持 Lustre。将该文件系统附加到源服务器。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件系统。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。将该文件系统附加到源服务器。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件系统。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Amazon FSx for Lustre 是专为此要求构建的 AWS 托管服务：AWS 表示，FSx for Lustre 让你能够启动并运行高性能 Lustre 文件系统，并且作为一项 **fully managed service**，它消除了设置和管理 Lustre 文件系统的复杂性（[AWS FSx for Lustre](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。AWS 还说明，EC2 工作负载通过使用开源 **Lustre client** 访问 FSx for Lustre 文件系统，并且挂载后它的工作方式类似于本地文件系统（[Accessing FSx for Lustre file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS DataSync** 用于数据移动，而不是用于提供共享的可挂载 Lustre 文件系统。AWS 将 DataSync 任务执行描述为在源位置和目标位置之间准备、传输和验证数据（[How AWS DataSync works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/how-datasync-transfer-works.html)）。
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway file gateway** 通过行业标准 **NFS and SMB** 协议提供对 Amazon S3 的文件访问，而不是通过 Lustre 客户端（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **C. Amazon EFS** 不支持 Lustre。AWS 文档说明，EFS 文件系统通过 EFS mount helper 或标准 Linux **NFS** 客户端挂载，并且 EFS 支持 NFSv4.0 和 NFSv4.1（[Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an application that receives data from thousands of geographically dispersed remote devices that use UDP. The application processes the data immediately and sends a message back to the device if necessary. No data is stored. The company needs a solution that minimizes latency for the data transmission from the devices. The solution also must provide rapid failover to another AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the two Regions. Configure the NLB to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the data.
options.B: Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the two Regions as an endpoint. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the NLProcess the data in Amazon ECS.
options.C: Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each of the two Regions as an endpoint. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the ALB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each of the two Regions. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the ALB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The traffic uses **UDP** and must be optimized for geographically dispersed devices with rapid Regional failover. AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerators support **TCP and UDP** listeners, route traffic over the AWS global network to the nearest/optimal Regional endpoint, and can use **Network Load Balancers** as endpoints in multiple Regions ([Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html), [Global Accelerator listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html)). Global Accelerator also fails over to healthy endpoints in other endpoint groups/Regions when endpoints are unhealthy ([failover behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-endpoint-weights.unhealthy-endpoints.html)). Network Load Balancers support UDP listeners and UDP target groups, and ECS services on Fargate can be used behind an NLB by registering tasks as IP targets ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html), [NLB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html), [ECS with NLB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/nlb.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Route 53 failover routing does not provide the same low-latency global edge ingress and rapid health-based traffic shifting as Global Accelerator. Also, the documented NLB target types are `instance`, `ip`, and `alb`; the solution describes invoking Lambda directly from an NLB, which is not a valid NLB target model in the cited NLB target group documentation.
- **C:** Application Load Balancers support only **HTTP and HTTPS** listeners, not UDP, so an ALB is not suitable for devices that use UDP ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
- **D:** This has both problems: Route 53 failover instead of Global Accelerator for the latency/failover requirement, and ALBs do not support UDP traffic ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运行一个应用程序，该应用程序从数千个地理位置分散、使用 UDP 的远程设备接收数据。该应用程序会立即处理数据，并在必要时向设备发送消息。不会存储任何数据。公司需要一种解决方案，以最大限度降低设备数据传输的延迟。该解决方案还必须提供到另一个 AWS Region 的快速故障转移。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Amazon Route 53 故障转移路由策略。在两个 Region 中分别创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。配置 NLB 调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS Global Accelerator。在两个 Region 中分别创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 作为端点。创建一个使用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。在该集群上创建 ECS service。将 ECS service 设置为 NLProcess 的目标。在 Amazon ECS 中处理数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Global Accelerator。在两个 Region 中分别创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 作为端点。创建一个使用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。在该集群上创建 ECS service。将 ECS service 设置为 ALB 的目标。在 Amazon ECS 中处理数据。
options.D: 配置 Amazon Route 53 故障转移路由策略。在两个 Region 中分别创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。创建一个使用 Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。在该集群上创建 ECS service。将 ECS service 设置为 ALB 的目标。在 Amazon ECS 中处理数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 该流量使用 **UDP**，并且必须针对地理位置分散的设备进行优化，同时具备快速的 Regional 故障转移能力。AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerators 支持 **TCP and UDP** 侦听器，可通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最近/最佳的 Regional 端点，并且可以在多个 Region 中使用 **Network Load Balancers** 作为端点（[Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)、[Global Accelerator listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html)）。当端点不健康时，Global Accelerator 还会故障转移到其他端点组/Region 中的健康端点（[failover behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-endpoint-weights.unhealthy-endpoints.html)）。Network Load Balancers 支持 UDP 侦听器和 UDP 目标组，并且 Fargate 上的 ECS services 可以通过将任务注册为 IP 目标的方式在 NLB 后使用（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)、[NLB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)、[ECS with NLB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/nlb.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Route 53 故障转移路由无法提供与 Global Accelerator 相同的低延迟全球边缘入口和基于运行状况的快速流量切换。此外，文档中列出的 NLB 目标类型为 `instance`、`ip` 和 `alb`；该解决方案描述从 NLB 直接调用 Lambda，这不是引用的 NLB 目标组文档中的有效 NLB 目标模型。
- **C:** Application Load Balancers 仅支持 **HTTP and HTTPS** 侦听器，不支持 UDP，因此 ALB 不适合使用 UDP 的设备（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
- **D:** 该选项存在两个问题：对于延迟/故障转移要求，它使用 Route 53 故障转移而不是 Global Accelerator，并且 ALB 不支持 UDP 流量（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect must migrate a Windows Internet Information Services (IIS) web application to AWS. The application currently relies on a file share hosted in the user's on-premises network-attached storage (NAS). The solutions architect has proposed migrating the IIS web servers to Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones that are connected to the storage solution, and configuring an Elastic Load Balancer attached to the instances. Which replacement to the on-premises file share is MOST resilient and durable?

options.A: Migrate the file share to Amazon RDS.
options.B: Migrate the file share to AWS Storage Gateway.
options.C: Migrate the file share to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
options.D: Migrate the file share to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C. Migrate the file share to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server**.

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is purpose-built for Microsoft Windows file shares: AWS states that a Windows file share is made accessible to compute instances with **SMB**, and that FSx for Windows File Server file systems come with a default Windows file share and can be mapped from EC2 Windows instances like a network drive ([FSx: accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)). It also supports resilience requirements: Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server file systems provide high availability and failover across multiple Availability Zones by maintaining a standby file server in a separate AZ; backups are described as file-system-consistent, highly durable, and incremental ([FSx: availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)). This matches a migrated IIS application running on Windows EC2 instances across multiple AZs that needs a resilient shared file system.

Why the other options are not the best:

- **A. Amazon RDS** is a managed **relational database** service, not a replacement for a Windows file share ([Amazon RDS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway** can provide file interfaces such as NFS/SMB to Amazon S3, but AWS describes S3 File Gateway as a service plus virtual appliance commonly deployed in an on-premises environment and as a file-system mount on S3; it is more of a hybrid/on-premises gateway pattern than the most appropriate native shared storage for Windows EC2 IIS servers ([S3 File Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **D. Amazon EFS** is mounted using the EFS mount helper on EC2 **Linux and Mac** instances or using the standard Linux NFS client, and it supports NFSv4; it is not the native SMB Windows file share service for IIS Windows servers ([EFS mounting file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师必须将一个 Windows Internet Information Services (IIS) Web 应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序目前依赖于托管在用户本地网络附加存储 (NAS) 中的文件共享。解决方案架构师已提议将 IIS Web 服务器迁移到多个 Availability Zones 中的 Amazon EC2 实例，这些实例连接到存储解决方案，并配置一个附加到这些实例的 Elastic Load Balancer。哪种本地文件共享的替代方案最具弹性和持久性？

options.A: 将文件共享迁移到 Amazon RDS。
options.B: 将文件共享迁移到 AWS Storage Gateway。
options.C: 将文件共享迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。
options.D: 将文件共享迁移到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C. 将文件共享迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server**。

Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 专为 Microsoft Windows 文件共享而构建：AWS 表示，Windows 文件共享可通过 **SMB** 供计算实例访问，并且 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统带有默认 Windows 文件共享，可以从 EC2 Windows 实例像网络驱动器一样映射（[FSx: accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)）。它还支持弹性要求：Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统通过在单独的 AZ 中维护备用文件服务器，在多个 Availability Zones 之间提供高可用性和故障转移；备份被描述为文件系统一致、高持久性且增量的（[FSx: availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。这与在多个 AZ 中的 Windows EC2 实例上运行、需要弹性共享文件系统的迁移后 IIS 应用程序相匹配。其他选项不是最佳选择的原因：

- **A. Amazon RDS** 是一项托管的**关系数据库**服务，并不是 Windows 文件共享的替代方案（[Amazon RDS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway** 可以向 Amazon S3 提供 NFS/SMB 等文件接口，但 AWS 将 S3 File Gateway 描述为一种服务加虚拟设备，通常部署在本地环境中，并作为 S3 上的文件系统挂载；相比用于 Windows EC2 IIS 服务器的最合适原生共享存储，它更属于混合/本地网关模式（[S3 File Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **D. Amazon EFS** 使用 EFS mount helper 挂载到 EC2 **Linux and Mac** 实例，或使用标准 Linux NFS 客户端，并且它支持 NFSv4；它不是面向 IIS Windows 服务器的原生 SMB Windows 文件共享服务（[EFS mounting file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。

en.question: A company is deploying a new application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application writes data to Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company needs to ensure that all data that is written to the EBS volumes is encrypted at rest. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an IAM role that specifies EBS encryption. Attach the role to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create the EBS volumes as encrypted volumes. Attach the EBS volumes to the EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an EC2 instance tag that has a key of Encrypt and a value of True. Tag all instances that require encryption at the EBS level.
options.D: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key policy that enforces EBS encryption in the account. Ensure that the key policy is active.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon EBS encryption is the native way to protect EBS data at rest. AWS states that EBS encryption uses AWS KMS keys when creating encrypted volumes and snapshots, and that encryption operations secure data at rest between an EC2 instance and its attached EBS storage. The documentation also states that you encrypt EBS volumes by enabling encryption when creating the volume, and that a new encrypted volume is encrypted by the time it is first available, so the data is secured from the start ([Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)). Therefore, creating encrypted EBS volumes and attaching them to the EC2 instances meets the requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An IAM role attached to an EC2 instance grants permissions; it does not itself specify or enable encryption for attached EBS volumes. EBS encryption is enabled on the volume, or by account-level EBS encryption by default, not by an instance role ([Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)).
- **C:** Tags are metadata and do not automatically encrypt EBS volumes. AWS documentation describes enabling encryption during volume creation or using encryption by default; it does not describe EC2 tags as an encryption mechanism ([Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)).
- **D:** AWS KMS keys can be used to encrypt EBS volumes, but a KMS key policy alone does not make existing or new volumes encrypted. EBS encryption must be enabled for the volume creation operation or through EBS encryption by default ([Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上部署一个新应用程序。该应用程序将数据写入 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。公司需要确保写入 EBS 卷的所有数据都在静态时加密。哪种解决方案将满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个指定 EBS 加密的 IAM 角色。将该角色附加到 EC2 实例。
options.B: 将 EBS 卷创建为加密卷。将 EBS 卷附加到 EC2 实例。
options.C: 创建一个 EC2 实例标签，其键为 Encrypt，值为 True。为所有需要在 EBS 级别加密的实例添加标签。
options.D: 创建一个在账户中强制执行 EBS 加密的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥策略。确保该密钥策略处于活动状态。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon EBS encryption 是保护 EBS 静态数据的原生方式。AWS 声明，在创建加密卷和快照时，EBS encryption 使用 AWS KMS keys，并且加密操作会保护 EC2 实例与其附加的 EBS 存储之间的静态数据。文档还说明，你通过在创建卷时启用加密来加密 EBS 卷，并且新的加密卷在首次可用时就已经加密，因此数据从一开始就受到保护（[Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)）。因此，创建加密的 EBS 卷并将其附加到 EC2 实例可以满足该要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 附加到 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色授予权限；它本身并不指定或启用附加 EBS 卷的加密。EBS encryption 是在卷上启用的，或通过账户级别的默认 EBS encryption 启用，而不是通过实例角色启用（[Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)）。
- **C:** 标签是元数据，不会自动加密 EBS 卷。AWS 文档描述的是在创建卷期间启用加密或使用默认加密；并没有将 EC2 标签描述为一种加密机制（[Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)）。
- **D:** AWS KMS keys 可用于加密 EBS 卷，但仅有 KMS key policy 并不会使现有卷或新卷被加密。必须在卷创建操作中启用 EBS encryption，或通过默认 EBS encryption 启用（[Amazon EBS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-encryption.html)）。

en.question: A company has a web application with sporadic usage patterns. There is heavy usage at the beginning of each month, moderate usage at the start of each week, and unpredictable usage during the week. The application consists of a web server and a MySQL database server running inside the data center. The company would like to move the application to the AWS Cloud, and needs to select a cost-effective database platform that will not require database modifications. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon DynamoDB
options.B: Amazon RDS for MySQL
options.C: MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora Serverless
options.D: MySQL deployed on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora Serverless**

Aurora Serverless is designed for exactly this kind of sporadic, variable, and unpredictable database workload. AWS states that Aurora Serverless supports websites and applications with unpredictable workloads, automatically scales database capacity up for peak load and back down afterward, and avoids needing to provision for peak or average capacity. AWS also states that it is cost-effective during low activity because you pay only for the database resources consumed on a per-second basis ([Aurora Serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)). Because the workload currently uses MySQL, the MySQL-compatible Aurora option can be used without changing to a different database model; AWS documentation identifies Aurora MySQL-compatible editions/versions ([Aurora MySQL-compatible documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.MySQL84.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. Amazon DynamoDB** — DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service, and AWS documentation discusses NoSQL design for DynamoDB. Moving a MySQL relational database application to DynamoDB would require database and application data-model changes, violating the “no database modifications” requirement ([NoSQL design for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)).
- **B. Amazon RDS for MySQL** — RDS for MySQL is compatible with MySQL, but a standard provisioned RDS DB instance is not the most cost-effective fit for highly variable/spiky usage because compute capacity is provisioned by DB instance size. RDS storage autoscaling addresses storage capacity, not automatic compute scaling for unpredictable load ([RDS storage autoscaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIOPS.Autoscaling.html)).
- **D. MySQL on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group** — This is not a managed database platform and would add operational complexity for database administration, replication, failover, and stateful scaling. Aurora Serverless is the managed database option that directly provides automatic database capacity scaling for spiky workloads ([Aurora Serverless advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个使用模式不规律的 Web 应用程序。每月月初使用量很高，每周开始时使用量中等，而一周内的使用量不可预测。该应用程序由在数据中心内运行的 Web 服务器和 MySQL 数据库服务器组成。公司希望将该应用程序迁移到 AWS Cloud，并且需要选择一个具有成本效益且不需要修改数据库的数据库平台。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon DynamoDB
options.B: Amazon RDS for MySQL
options.C: MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora Serverless
options.D: 部署在 Auto Scaling group 中的 Amazon EC2 上的 MySQL

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora Serverless**

Aurora Serverless 正是为这种不规律、可变且不可预测的数据库工作负载而设计的。AWS 表示，Aurora Serverless 支持具有不可预测工作负载的网站和应用程序，会针对峰值负载自动向上扩展数据库容量，并在之后向下缩减，同时避免需要按峰值或平均容量进行预置。AWS 还表示，在活动量较低时它具有成本效益，因为你只需按秒为实际消耗的数据库资源付费（[Aurora Serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。由于该工作负载当前使用 MySQL，因此可以使用 MySQL-compatible Aurora 选项，而无需切换到不同的数据库模型；AWS 文档标识了 Aurora MySQL-compatible 版本/版次（[Aurora MySQL-compatible documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraMySQL.MySQL84.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A. Amazon DynamoDB** — DynamoDB 是一种 NoSQL 数据库服务，AWS 文档讨论了 DynamoDB 的 NoSQL 设计。将 MySQL 关系数据库应用程序迁移到 DynamoDB 将需要更改数据库和应用程序数据模型，违反了“无需修改数据库”的要求（[NoSQL design for DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。
- **B. Amazon RDS for MySQL** — RDS for MySQL 与 MySQL 兼容，但标准预置的 RDS DB 实例并不是高度可变/峰值突发使用模式下最具成本效益的选择，因为计算容量是按 DB 实例大小预置的。RDS storage autoscaling 解决的是存储容量问题，而不是针对不可预测负载的自动计算扩展（[RDS storage autoscaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIOPS.Autoscaling.html)）。
- **D. MySQL on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group** — 这不是托管数据库平台，并且会增加数据库管理、复制、故障转移和有状态扩展方面的运维复杂性。Aurora Serverless 是一种托管数据库选项，可直接为峰值突发型工作负载提供自动数据库容量扩展（[Aurora Serverless advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。

en.question: An image-hosting company stores its objects in Amazon S3 buckets. The company wants to avoid accidental exposure of the objects in the S3 buckets to the public. All S3 objects in the entire AWS account need to remain private. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon GuardDuty to monitor S3 bucket policies. Create an automatic remediation action rule that uses an AWS Lambda function to remediate any change that makes the objects public.
options.B: Use AWS Trusted Advisor to find publicly accessible S3 buckets. Configure email notifications in Trusted Advisor when a change is detected. Manually change the S3 bucket policy if it allows public access.
options.C: Use AWS Resource Access Manager to find publicly accessible S3 buckets. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to invoke an AWS Lambda function when a change is detected. Deploy a Lambda function that programmatically remediates the change.
options.D: Use the S3 Block Public Access feature on the account level. Use AWS Organizations to create a service control policy (SCP) that prevents IAM users from changing the setting. Apply the SCP to the account.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

Amazon S3 Block Public Access is the correct preventive control. AWS states that S3 Block Public Access settings can be applied to an **entire AWS account**, override bucket policies/object permissions that would otherwise allow public access, and are enforced regardless of how S3 resources are created. AWS also recommends turning on all four Block Public Access settings for the account to ensure all S3 access points, buckets, and objects have public access blocked; account-level settings apply globally across Regions and to current and future buckets/access points ([Amazon S3 Block Public Access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)). An SCP is appropriate as a guardrail because SCPs specify the maximum permissions available to IAM users and roles in member accounts, and an explicitly denied permission cannot be used even by an account administrator with `AdministratorAccess` ([AWS Organizations SCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

Why the other options are not correct:

- **A**: GuardDuty is primarily detective. AWS describes GuardDuty S3 protection as analyzing CloudTrail events and generating findings when it detects anomalous or potentially malicious activity, not as a native preventive mechanism to ensure all objects remain private ([S3 security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)). A Lambda remediation is reactive and could allow a window of public exposure.
- **B**: Trusted Advisor can inspect S3 implementations, but the option relies on notification and manual remediation. This is detective/manual, not a preventive account-wide control ([S3 security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)).
- **C**: AWS Resource Access Manager is not the service used to find and prevent public S3 bucket/object exposure. The AWS-recommended S3 control for blocking public access is S3 Block Public Access; monitoring/remediation workflows are not as direct or preventive as account-level blocking ([Amazon S3 Block Public Access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)).

zh.question: 一家图片托管公司将其对象存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。该公司希望避免 S3 bucket 中的对象意外暴露给公众。整个 AWS 账户中的所有 S3 对象都需要保持私有。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon GuardDuty 监控 S3 bucket policy。创建一条自动修复操作规则，使用 AWS Lambda 函数修复任何会使对象公开的更改。
options.B: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 查找可公开访问的 S3 bucket。当检测到更改时，在 Trusted Advisor 中配置电子邮件通知。如果 S3 bucket policy 允许公共访问，则手动更改该策略。
options.C: 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 查找可公开访问的 S3 bucket。当检测到更改时，使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 调用 AWS Lambda 函数。部署一个以编程方式修复该更改的 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 在账户级别使用 S3 Block Public Access 功能。使用 AWS Organizations 创建一个 service control policy (SCP)，防止 IAM 用户更改该设置。将该 SCP 应用于该账户。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

Amazon S3 Block Public Access 是正确的预防性控制。AWS 表示，S3 Block Public Access 设置可以应用于**整个 AWS 账户**，会覆盖原本允许公共访问的 bucket policy/对象权限，并且无论 S3 资源如何创建都会强制执行。AWS 还建议在账户中开启所有四项 Block Public Access 设置，以确保所有 S3 access points、bucket 和对象都阻止公共访问；账户级设置会跨 Region 全局应用，并适用于当前和未来的 bucket/access points（[Amazon S3 Block Public Access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)）。SCP 适合作为护栏，因为 SCP 指定成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色可用的最大权限，并且被显式拒绝的权限即使是拥有 `AdministratorAccess` 的账户管理员也无法使用（[AWS Organizations SCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A**：GuardDuty 主要是检测性的。AWS 将 GuardDuty S3 protection 描述为分析 CloudTrail 事件，并在检测到异常或潜在恶意活动时生成发现项，而不是作为一种原生的预防机制来确保所有对象保持私有（[S3 security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)）。Lambda 修复是被动的，可能会留下一个公共暴露窗口。
- **B**：Trusted Advisor 可以检查 S3 实施情况，但该选项依赖通知和手动修复。这是检测性/手动方式，而不是预防性的账户级控制（[S3 security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)）。
- **C**：AWS Resource Access Manager 不是用于查找和防止 S3 bucket/对象公开暴露的服务。AWS 推荐用于阻止公共访问的 S3 控制是 S3 Block Public Access；监控/修复工作流不如账户级阻止那样直接或具有预防性（[Amazon S3 Block Public Access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-control-block-public-access.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company is experiencing an increase in user traffic. The company’s store is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances as a two-tier web application consisting of a web tier and a separate database tier. As traffic increases, the company notices that the architecture is causing significant delays in sending timely marketing and order confirmation email to users. The company wants to reduce the time it spends resolving complex email delivery issues and minimize operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a separate application tier using EC2 instances dedicated to email processing.
options.B: Configure the web instance to send email through Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
options.C: Configure the web instance to send email through Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
options.D: Create a separate application tier using EC2 instances dedicated to email processing. Place the instances in an Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Configure the web instance to send email through Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).**

Amazon SES is the purpose-built AWS service for application email delivery. AWS states that you can send email with SES through the **SMTP interface** or the **Amazon SES API**, and that bulk/application email sending should use one of those programmatic interfaces ([SES email sending setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email.html)). SES also addresses the operational pain in the question: AWS notes that building a large-scale email solution requires managing email servers, network configuration, and IP reputation, and that **Amazon SES eliminates these challenges** by using Amazon’s email infrastructure ([SES benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/Welcome.html)). This directly meets the goals of reducing email-delivery troubleshooting and minimizing operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Separate EC2 application tier for email processing** — This adds more self-managed infrastructure and does not eliminate email server management, network configuration, or IP reputation concerns that SES is designed to handle ([SES benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).
- **C. Amazon SNS** — SNS is a publish/subscribe messaging service where publishers send messages to topics and SNS delivers them to subscribers such as SQS, Lambda, HTTP(S), email, SMS, and mobile push ([SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). Although SNS can send user notifications, SES is the dedicated service for marketing and transactional email delivery through SMTP/API.
- **D. Separate EC2 email tier in an Auto Scaling group** — Auto Scaling may increase compute capacity, but it still leaves the company operating and troubleshooting its own email-processing layer and delivery issues. SES is the managed service that removes those large-scale email infrastructure burdens ([SES benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司正在经历用户流量增加。该公司的商店部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上，是一个两层 Web 应用程序，由 Web 层和独立的数据库层组成。随着流量增加，公司注意到该架构导致向用户及时发送营销邮件和订单确认邮件出现明显延迟。公司希望减少用于解决复杂电子邮件投递问题的时间，并最大限度降低运营开销。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用专用于电子邮件处理的 EC2 实例创建一个单独的应用程序层。
options.B: 配置 Web 实例通过 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 发送电子邮件。
options.C: 配置 Web 实例通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 发送电子邮件。
options.D: 使用专用于电子邮件处理的 EC2 实例创建一个单独的应用程序层。将这些实例放入 Auto Scaling 组中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 配置 Web 实例通过 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 发送电子邮件。**

Amazon SES 是专为应用程序电子邮件投递而构建的 AWS 服务。AWS 表示，你可以通过 **SMTP interface** 或 **Amazon SES API** 使用 SES 发送电子邮件，并且批量/应用程序电子邮件发送应使用这些程序化接口之一（[SES email sending setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/send-email.html)）。SES 还解决了题目中的运营痛点：AWS 指出，构建大规模电子邮件解决方案需要管理电子邮件服务器、网络配置和 IP 声誉，而 **Amazon SES eliminates these challenges**，因为它使用 Amazon 的电子邮件基础设施（[SES benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。这直接满足了减少电子邮件投递故障排查并最大限度降低运营开销的目标。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Separate EC2 application tier for email processing** — 这会增加更多自管理基础设施，并且不能消除 SES 旨在处理的电子邮件服务器管理、网络配置或 IP 声誉方面的顾虑（[SES benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。
- **C. Amazon SNS** — SNS 是一种发布/订阅消息传递服务，发布者将消息发送到主题，SNS 将消息投递给订阅者，例如 SQS、Lambda、HTTP(S)、email、SMS 和 mobile push（[SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。虽然 SNS 可以发送用户通知，但 SES 才是通过 SMTP/API 进行营销和事务性电子邮件投递的专用服务。
- **D. Separate EC2 email tier in an Auto Scaling group** — Auto Scaling 可能会增加计算容量，但它仍然会让公司继续运营并排查自己的电子邮件处理层和投递问题。SES 是可消除这些大规模电子邮件基础设施负担的托管服务（[SES benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ses/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company has a business system that generates hundreds of reports each day. The business system saves the reports to a network share in CSV format. The company needs to store this data in the AWS Cloud in near-real time for analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the files to Amazon S3. Create a scheduled task that runs at the end of each day.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Update the business system to use a new network share from the S3 File Gateway.
options.C: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the files to Amazon S3. Create an application that uses the DataSync API in the automation workflow.
options.D: Deploy an AWS Transfer for SFTP endpoint. Create a script that checks for new files on the network share and uploads the new files by using SFTP.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed for exactly this pattern: it provides a file interface to Amazon S3 using standard file protocols such as NFS and SMB, and the gateway exposes S3 objects as files or file share mount points. AWS also states that S3 File Gateway integrates with existing applications through industry-standard file system protocols and manages data transfer to and from AWS, including buffering and streaming data in parallel ([AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). Creating an S3 File Gateway share and pointing the reporting system at that share lets each CSV be written through a normal network share while the gateway handles storing the data in S3 with minimal custom automation.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A DataSync task scheduled only at the end of each day does not meet the **near-real-time** requirement. DataSync schedules are periodic, and AWS documents daily/hourly/custom schedules with a minimum interval of 1 hour ([DataSync task scheduling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)).
- **C:** DataSync can transfer data for in-cloud processing and automates transfer infrastructure ([DataSync use cases and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)), but this option requires creating an application that uses the DataSync API in the workflow. That adds custom development and operational overhead compared with using a managed file share interface.
- **D:** AWS Transfer Family provides managed SFTP/FTPS/FTP transfers into and out of AWS storage services such as S3 ([AWS Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)), but this option requires deploying an SFTP endpoint plus maintaining a script to poll the network share and upload files. That is more administrative overhead than S3 File Gateway and is not a native network-share replacement for the business system.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个每天生成数百份报告的业务系统。该业务系统以 CSV 格式将报告保存到网络共享中。公司需要近实时地将这些数据存储在 AWS Cloud 中以供分析。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 将文件传输到 Amazon S3。创建一个在每天结束时运行的计划任务。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway。更新业务系统，使其使用来自 S3 File Gateway 的新网络共享。
options.C: 使用 AWS DataSync 将文件传输到 Amazon S3。创建一个在自动化工作流中使用 DataSync API 的应用程序。
options.D: 部署一个 AWS Transfer for SFTP 端点。创建一个脚本，用于检查网络共享上的新文件，并使用 SFTP 上传新文件。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon S3 File Gateway 正是为这种模式而设计的：它使用 NFS 和 SMB 等标准文件协议为 Amazon S3 提供文件接口，并且该网关将 S3 objects 公开为文件或文件共享挂载点。AWS 还说明，S3 File Gateway 通过行业标准文件系统协议与现有应用程序集成，并管理进出 AWS 的数据传输，包括并行缓冲和流式传输数据（[AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。创建一个 S3 File Gateway 共享并将报告系统指向该共享，可以让每个 CSV 通过普通网络共享写入，同时由网关以最少的自定义自动化将数据存储在 S3 中。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 仅在每天结束时调度的 DataSync task 不满足 **near-real-time** 要求。DataSync 调度是周期性的，AWS 文档说明了 daily/hourly/custom schedules，最小间隔为 1 小时（[DataSync task scheduling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)）。
- **C:** DataSync 可以为云内处理传输数据，并自动化传输基础设施（[DataSync use cases and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)），但此选项需要创建一个在工作流中使用 DataSync API 的应用程序。与使用托管文件共享接口相比，这会增加自定义开发和运营开销。
- **D:** AWS Transfer Family 提供托管的 SFTP/FTPS/FTP 传输，用于将数据传入和传出 S3 等 AWS storage services（[AWS Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)），但此选项需要部署 SFTP endpoint，并维护一个脚本来轮询网络共享并上传文件。这比 S3 File Gateway 具有更多管理开销，并且不是业务系统的原生网络共享替代方案。

en.question: A company is storing petabytes of data in Amazon S3 Standard. The data is stored in multiple S3 buckets and is accessed with varying frequency. The company does not know access patterns for all the data. The company needs to implement a solution for each S3 bucket to optimize the cost of S3 usage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.B: Use the S3 storage class analysis tool to determine the correct tier for each object in the S3 bucket. Move each object to the identified storage tier.
options.C: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
options.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** S3 Intelligent-Tiering is specifically designed to optimize storage costs for data with **unknown or changing access patterns**, automatically moving objects at a granular object level to the most cost-effective access tier without performance impact or operational overhead. AWS also states that it monitors access patterns and automatically moves objects to lower-cost tiers, such as Infrequent Access after 30 days and Archive Instant Access after 90 days of no access ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)). Using an S3 Lifecycle configuration is operationally efficient because Lifecycle rules transition objects to other storage classes on your behalf and apply to existing and future objects in the bucket ([Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Storage Class Analysis can help analyze access patterns, but determining and moving each object manually is less operationally efficient than automatic tiering. The requirement says the company does not know access patterns across petabytes of data, which is exactly the use case for S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
- **C:** S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is for long-term data that is **rarely accessed** and requires millisecond retrieval, and Glacier storage classes include retrieval fees/minimum storage duration considerations. The company has varying and unknown access patterns, so forcing all data into this class is not appropriate ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **D:** S3 One Zone-IA is for infrequently accessed data and stores data in only one Availability Zone; AWS recommends it when data can be re-created if the Availability Zone fails. The question does not state that the data is re-creatable or only infrequently accessed, so this is not the best fit ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon S3 Standard 中存储 PB 级数据。数据存储在多个 S3 存储桶中，并且访问频率各不相同。公司并不知道所有数据的访问模式。公司需要为每个 S3 存储桶实施一种解决方案，以优化 S3 使用成本。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，并使用一条规则将 S3 存储桶中的对象转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering。
options.B: 使用 S3 storage class analysis 工具确定 S3 存储桶中每个对象的正确层级。将每个对象移动到已识别的存储层级。
options.C: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，并使用一条规则将 S3 存储桶中的对象转换到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。
options.D: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 配置，并使用一条规则将 S3 存储桶中的对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** S3 Intelligent-Tiering 专门用于优化具有**未知或不断变化的访问模式**的数据的存储成本，它会在精细的对象级别自动将对象移动到最具成本效益的访问层级，而不会影响性能，也不会产生运营开销。AWS 还说明，它会监控访问模式，并在对象 30 天未访问后自动移动到成本更低的层级（例如 Infrequent Access），在 90 天未访问后移动到 Archive Instant Access（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)，[How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。使用 S3 Lifecycle 配置具有运营效率，因为 Lifecycle 规则会代表你将对象转换到其他存储类，并且适用于存储桶中现有和未来的对象（[Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Storage Class Analysis 可以帮助分析访问模式，但确定并手动移动每个对象的运营效率低于自动分层。要求说明该公司不知道 PB 级数据的访问模式，而这正是 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 的典型使用场景。
- **C:** S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 适用于**很少访问**且需要毫秒级检索的长期数据，并且 Glacier 存储类还涉及检索费用/最短存储期限等考虑因素。该公司的访问模式各不相同且未知，因此强制将所有数据放入此存储类并不合适（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **D:** S3 One Zone-IA 适用于不频繁访问的数据，并且仅在一个 Availability Zone 中存储数据；AWS 建议在 Availability Zone 发生故障时可以重新创建数据的情况下使用它。题目并未说明这些数据可以重新创建，或仅为不频繁访问，因此这不是最佳选择（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A rapidly growing global ecommerce company is hosting its web application on AWS. The web application includes static content and dynamic content. The website stores online transaction processing (OLTP) data in an Amazon RDS database The website’s users are experiencing slow page loads. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.B: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution.
options.C: Host the dynamic web content in Amazon S3.
options.D: Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance.
options.E: Configure a Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS DB instance.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **B and D**.

- **B. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution** — CloudFront is designed to speed up delivery of both static and dynamic web content. AWS states that CloudFront routes requests to edge locations with the lowest latency and improves performance with lower latency and higher transfer rates, which directly addresses slow page loads for global users ([Amazon CloudFront Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **D. Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance** — For a growing ecommerce application, database read load can slow dynamic page generation. AWS lists a primary use case for RDS read replicas as scaling beyond the compute or I/O capacity of a single DB instance for read-heavy workloads by directing excess read traffic to one or more read replicas ([Amazon RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Configure an Amazon Redshift cluster** — Redshift is a fully managed petabyte-scale **data warehouse** for analytics and BI querying, not a solution for OLTP web application page-load latency ([Amazon Redshift Management Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)).
- **C. Host the dynamic web content in Amazon S3** — S3 static website hosting is for **static** websites; AWS describes S3 website hosting as serving static content and client-side scripts, not server-side dynamic application processing ([Amazon S3 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)).
- **E. Configure a Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS DB instance** — RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments provide high availability and failover support. AWS explicitly notes that the high availability option is not a scaling solution for read-only scenarios and that a standby replica cannot serve read traffic; use a read replica instead ([Amazon RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).

zh.question: 一家快速增长的全球电子商务公司正在 AWS 上托管其 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序包含静态内容和动态内容。该网站将联机事务处理 (OLTP) 数据存储在 Amazon RDS 数据库中。该网站的用户正在经历页面加载缓慢的问题。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来解决此问题？（选择两项。）

options.A: 配置一个 Amazon Redshift 集群。
options.B: 设置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。
options.C: 在 Amazon S3 中托管动态 Web 内容。
options.D: 为 RDS DB 实例创建一个只读副本。
options.E: 为 RDS DB 实例配置 Multi-AZ 部署。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B 和 D**。

- **B. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution** — CloudFront 旨在加快静态和动态 Web 内容的交付速度。AWS 表示，CloudFront 会将请求路由到延迟最低的边缘站点，并通过更低的延迟和更高的传输速率来提高性能，这直接解决了全球用户页面加载缓慢的问题（[Amazon CloudFront Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **D. Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance** — 对于不断增长的电子商务应用程序，数据库读取负载可能会拖慢动态页面生成。AWS 将 RDS read replicas 的一个主要使用场景列为：对于读取密集型工作负载，通过将过量读取流量定向到一个或多个只读副本，扩展超过单个 DB 实例的计算或 I/O 容量（[Amazon RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Configure an Amazon Redshift cluster** — Redshift 是用于分析和 BI 查询的完全托管的 PB 级 **data warehouse**，不是解决 OLTP Web 应用程序页面加载延迟的方案（[Amazon Redshift Management Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。
- **C. Host the dynamic web content in Amazon S3** — S3 静态网站托管用于 **static** 网站；AWS 将 S3 网站托管描述为提供静态内容和客户端脚本，而不是服务器端动态应用程序处理（[Amazon S3 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。
- **E. Configure a Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS DB instance** — RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例部署提供高可用性和故障转移支持。AWS 明确指出，高可用性选项不是只读场景的扩展解决方案，并且备用副本不能提供读取流量；应改用只读副本（[Amazon RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。

en.question: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Lambda functions to run its application. The company has VPCs with public subnets and private subnets in its AWS account. The EC2 instances run in a private subnet in one of the VPCs. The Lambda functions need direct network access to the EC2 instances for the application to work. The application will run for at least 1 year. The company expects the number of Lambda functions that the application uses to increase during that time. The company wants to maximize its savings on all application resources and to keep network latency between the services low. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan Optimize the Lambda functions’ duration and memory usage and the number of invocations. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnet that contains the EC2 instances.
options.B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan Optimize the Lambda functions' duration and memory usage, the number of invocations, and the amount of data that is transferred. Connect the Lambda functions to a public subnet in the same VPC where the EC2 instances run.
options.C: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Optimize the Lambda functions’ duration and memory usage, the number of invocations, and the amount of data that is transferred. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnet that contains the EC2 instances.
options.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Optimize the Lambda functions’ duration and memory usage, the number of invocations, and the amount of data that is transferred. Keep the Lambda functions in the Lambda service VPC.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

A **Compute Savings Plan** is the right savings mechanism because the workload includes both Amazon EC2 and AWS Lambda and will run for at least 1 year. AWS states that Savings Plans are for a **one- or three-year** commitment, and that **Compute Savings Plans** apply to EC2 usage and also to **AWS Lambda** usage ([What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html), [Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)). For network access, AWS Lambda documentation says that to access private resources, you should connect the function to **private subnets**; when attached to a VPC, the function can access resources available within that VPC ([Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)). This gives the Lambda functions direct private network access to the EC2 instances in the private subnet and keeps traffic local/low-latency. Optimizing Lambda memory and duration is also aligned with AWS guidance to performance-test functions and choose the right memory configuration ([Best practices for working with AWS Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: An **EC2 Instance Savings Plan** applies to EC2 usage in a specified instance family and Region, but it does **not** apply to Lambda usage; the requirement is to maximize savings on **all** application resources, including Lambda ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
- **B**: This also uses an EC2 Instance Savings Plan, so it does not cover Lambda. In addition, AWS specifically notes that to access private resources, Lambda functions should be connected to **private subnets**, and connecting a function to a public subnet does not provide a public IP address or internet access ([Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).
- **D**: A Compute Savings Plan is appropriate, but leaving the functions in the Lambda service VPC does not provide the required direct access to EC2 instances in the company’s private subnet. AWS documents that attaching a Lambda function to the VPC is how it accesses resources in that VPC; when attached, it can access resources available within that VPC ([Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例和 AWS Lambda 函数来运行其应用程序。该公司的 AWS 账户中有包含公有子网和私有子网的 VPC。EC2 实例在其中一个 VPC 的私有子网中运行。Lambda 函数需要对 EC2 实例进行直接网络访问，应用程序才能工作。该应用程序将运行至少 1 年。公司预计该应用程序使用的 Lambda 函数数量在此期间会增加。公司希望最大限度地节省所有应用程序资源的成本，并保持服务之间的网络延迟较低。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。优化 Lambda 函数的持续时间和内存使用量以及调用次数。将 Lambda 函数连接到包含 EC2 实例的私有子网。
options.B: 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。优化 Lambda 函数的持续时间和内存使用量、调用次数以及传输的数据量。将 Lambda 函数连接到运行 EC2 实例的同一 VPC 中的公有子网。
options.C: 购买 Compute Savings Plan。优化 Lambda 函数的持续时间和内存使用量、调用次数以及传输的数据量。将 Lambda 函数连接到包含 EC2 实例的私有子网。
options.D: 购买 Compute Savings Plan。优化 Lambda 函数的持续时间和内存使用量、调用次数以及传输的数据量。将 Lambda 函数保留在 Lambda service VPC 中。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

**Compute Savings Plan** 是正确的节省机制，因为该工作负载同时包括 Amazon EC2 和 AWS Lambda，并且将运行至少 1 年。AWS 表示 Savings Plans 适用于 **一年或三年** 的承诺，并且 **Compute Savings Plans** 适用于 EC2 使用量，也适用于 **AWS Lambda** 使用量（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)，[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。对于网络访问，AWS Lambda 文档说明，要访问私有资源，应将函数连接到 **private subnets**；当连接到 VPC 时，函数可以访问该 VPC 内可用的资源（[Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。这使 Lambda 函数能够通过直接私有网络访问私有子网中的 EC2 实例，并使流量保持本地/低延迟。优化 Lambda 内存和持续时间也符合 AWS 关于对函数进行性能测试并选择正确内存配置的指导（[Best practices for working with AWS Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：**EC2 Instance Savings Plan** 适用于指定实例系列和 Region 中的 EC2 使用量，但它**不**适用于 Lambda 使用量；要求是最大限度地节省**所有**应用程序资源的成本，包括 Lambda（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
- **B**：这同样使用 EC2 Instance Savings Plan，因此不涵盖 Lambda。此外，AWS 明确指出，要访问私有资源，Lambda 函数应连接到 **private subnets**，并且将函数连接到公有子网不会提供公有 IP 地址或互联网访问权限（[Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。
- **D**：Compute Savings Plan 是合适的，但将函数留在 Lambda service VPC 中并不能提供所需的、对公司私有子网中 EC2 实例的直接访问。AWS 文档说明，将 Lambda 函数连接到 VPC 是其访问该 VPC 中资源的方式；连接后，它可以访问该 VPC 内可用的资源（[Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to allow team members to access Amazon S3 buckets in two different AWS accounts: a development account and a production account. The team currently has access to S3 buckets in the development account by using unique IAM users that are assigned to an IAM group that has appropriate permissions in the account. The solutions architect has created an IAM role in the production account. The role has a policy that grants access to an S3 bucket in the production account. Which solution will meet these requirements while complying with the principle of least privilege?

options.A: Attach the Administrator Access policy to the development account users.
options.B: Add the development account as a principal in the trust policy of the role in the production account.
options.C: Turn off the S3 Block Public Access feature on the S3 bucket in the production account.
options.D: Create a user in the production account with unique credentials for each team member.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

A cross-account IAM role is designed for this scenario. AWS states that a cross-account role includes a **trust policy** that allows IAM principals in another AWS account to assume the role, and that this delegates specific permissions from one account to another account ([Cross-account access using roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)). In the AWS cross-account tutorial, the destination account creates the role and specifies the originating account as a trusted entity; the role policy is limited to the required S3 bucket access, aligning with least privilege ([Create a role in the Destination Account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)). AWS also documents that to add principals that can assume a role, you specify them in the role trust policy’s `Principal` element ([Update a role trust policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_update-role-trust-policy.html)).

This is the least-privilege approach because the production account role already grants only the needed S3 bucket permissions, and team members can use temporary role credentials instead of broad or duplicate long-term permissions. AWS defines least privilege as granting only the permissions required to perform a task ([Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)). In practice, the development account’s IAM group/users also must be allowed to call `sts:AssumeRole` for that specific production role; AWS notes that adding the trusted account to the trust policy is only half of the cross-account trust relationship ([Update a role trust policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_update-role-trust-policy.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Attach AdministratorAccess** — This violates least privilege by granting far more permissions than required. AWS recommends granting only the permissions required for the task, not overly broad permissions ([Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).
- **C. Turn off S3 Block Public Access** — Public access is not needed for authenticated cross-account access. Disabling protections would expose the bucket risk and does not establish IAM role trust.
- **D. Create production IAM users for each team member** — This creates additional long-term credentials in the production account and does not use the already-created cross-account role. IAM roles are the recommended mechanism to delegate cross-account permissions with temporary credentials ([Cross-account access using roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要允许团队成员访问两个不同 AWS 账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶：一个开发账户和一个生产账户。该团队目前通过使用唯一的 IAM 用户来访问开发账户中的 S3 存储桶，这些 IAM 用户被分配到一个 IAM 组，该组在该账户中具有适当的权限。解决方案架构师已在生产账户中创建了一个 IAM 角色。该角色具有一项策略，用于授予对生产账户中某个 S3 存储桶的访问权限。哪种解决方案可以在符合最小权限原则的同时满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Administrator Access 策略附加到开发账户用户。
options.B: 在生产账户中该角色的信任策略中，将开发账户添加为主体。
options.C: 关闭生产账户中 S3 存储桶的 S3 Block Public Access 功能。
options.D: 在生产账户中为每个团队成员创建一个具有唯一凭证的用户。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

跨账户 IAM 角色正是为这种场景设计的。AWS 说明，跨账户角色包含一个 **信任策略**，允许另一个 AWS 账户中的 IAM 主体代入该角色，并且这会将特定权限从一个账户委派给另一个账户（[Cross-account access using roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)）。在 AWS 跨账户教程中，目标账户创建角色并将来源账户指定为可信实体；角色策略仅限于所需的 S3 存储桶访问权限，符合最小权限原则（[Create a role in the Destination Account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)）。AWS 还说明，要添加可以代入角色的主体，需要在角色信任策略的 `Principal` 元素中指定它们（[Update a role trust policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_update-role-trust-policy.html)）。这是最小权限方法，因为生产账户角色已经只授予所需的 S3 存储桶权限，并且团队成员可以使用临时角色凭证，而不是使用范围过大的权限或重复的长期权限。AWS 将最小权限定义为仅授予执行任务所需的权限（[Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。在实践中，开发账户的 IAM 组/用户还必须被允许对该特定生产角色调用 `sts:AssumeRole`；AWS 指出，将受信任账户添加到信任策略只是跨账户信任关系的一半（[Update a role trust policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_update-role-trust-policy.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Attach AdministratorAccess** — 这会授予远超所需的权限，违反最小权限原则。AWS 建议仅授予完成任务所需的权限，而不是过于宽泛的权限（[Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。
- **C. Turn off S3 Block Public Access** — 对于经过身份验证的跨账户访问，不需要公共访问。禁用保护会带来存储桶暴露风险，并且不会建立 IAM 角色信任。
- **D. Create production IAM users for each team member** — 这会在生产账户中创建额外的长期凭证，并且没有使用已经创建的跨账户角色。IAM 角色是使用临时凭证委派跨账户权限的推荐机制（[Cross-account access using roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)）。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations with all features enabled and runs multiple Amazon EC2 workloads in the ap-southeast-2 Region. The company has a service control policy (SCP) that prevents any resources from being created in any other Region. A security policy requires the company to encrypt all data at rest. An audit discovers that employees have created Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for EC2 instances without encrypting the volumes. The company wants any new EC2 instances that any IAM user or root user launches in ap-southeast-2 to use encrypted EBS volumes. The company wants a solution that will have minimal effect on employees who create EBS volumes. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: In the Amazon EC2 console, select the EBS encryption account attribute and define a default encryption key.
options.B: Create an IAM permission boundary. Attach the permission boundary to the root organizational unit (OU). Define the boundary to deny the ec2:CreateVolume action when the ec2:Encrypted condition equals false.
options.C: Create an SCP. Attach the SCP to the root organizational unit (OU). Define the SCP to deny the ec2:CreateVolume action whenthe ec2:Encrypted condition equals false.
options.D: Update the IAM policies for each account to deny the ec2:CreateVolume action when the ec2:Encrypted condition equals false.
options.E: In the Organizations management account, specify the Default EBS volume encryption setting.

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **A and C**.

**A. In the Amazon EC2 console, select the EBS encryption account attribute and define a default encryption key.**  
This is correct because Amazon EBS encryption by default can be enabled for an AWS account in a specific Region. After it is enabled, new EBS volumes created in that Region, including volumes created when launching EC2 instances, are encrypted automatically. This has minimal impact on employees because they can continue launching instances and creating volumes normally; encryption is applied by default. AWS documents that you can configure an AWS account to enforce encryption of new EBS volumes and that encryption by default is a Region-specific setting ([AWS EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)).

**C. Create an SCP. Attach the SCP to the root organizational unit (OU). Define the SCP to deny the `ec2:CreateVolume` action when the `ec2:Encrypted` condition equals `false`.**  
This is correct because an SCP attached at the root OU provides an organization-wide preventive guardrail for all accounts under that root. The explicit deny prevents principals in affected member accounts from creating unencrypted EBS volumes, including cases where someone tries to bypass the default encryption behavior. SCPs are designed to centrally control the maximum available permissions in an AWS Organization and are available when all features are enabled ([AWS Organizations SCP documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). SCP evaluation also supports using explicit deny guardrails across the organization hierarchy ([AWS Organizations SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)).

The combination works well: default EBS encryption makes compliant volume creation transparent to users, while the SCP prevents noncompliant unencrypted volume creation.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

**B. Create an IAM permission boundary and attach it to the root OU.**  
This is incorrect because IAM permissions boundaries are attached to IAM users or roles, not to AWS Organizations OUs. They also are not the right mechanism to enforce an organization-wide control across all accounts and root users. SCPs are the appropriate organization-level guardrail.

**D. Update the IAM policies for each account.**  
This is incorrect because it requires modifying IAM policies account by account, which is higher operational effort and easier to misconfigure. It also would not reliably cover every principal, such as root users. The requirement calls for a solution with minimal effect and broad enforcement across the organization, which is better met by an SCP.

**E. In the Organizations management account, specify the Default EBS volume encryption setting.**  
This is incorrect because EBS encryption by default is an account-level, Region-specific EC2/EBS setting. Enabling it in the Organizations management account does not automatically configure the same setting for all member accounts. AWS states that encryption by default is configured for an AWS account and for a specific Region ([AWS EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用已启用所有功能的 AWS Organizations，并在 ap-southeast-2 Region 中运行多个 Amazon EC2 工作负载。该公司有一个 service control policy (SCP)，用于阻止在任何其他 Region 中创建任何资源。一项安全策略要求公司加密所有静态数据。一次审计发现，员工为 EC2 实例创建了 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，但没有加密这些卷。公司希望任何 IAM user 或 root user 在 ap-southeast-2 中启动的任何新 EC2 实例都使用加密的 EBS 卷。公司希望解决方案对创建 EBS 卷的员工影响最小。哪两个步骤的组合将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 Amazon EC2 控制台中，选择 EBS encryption 账户属性并定义默认加密密钥。
options.B: 创建 IAM permission boundary。将 permission boundary 附加到根 organizational unit (OU)。定义该边界，以便在 ec2:Encrypted 条件等于 false 时拒绝 ec2:CreateVolume 操作。
options.C: 创建 SCP。将 SCP 附加到根 organizational unit (OU)。定义 SCP，以便在 ec2:Encrypted 条件等于 false 时拒绝 ec2:CreateVolume 操作。
options.D: 更新每个账户的 IAM policy，以便在 ec2:Encrypted 条件等于 false 时拒绝 ec2:CreateVolume 操作。
options.E: 在 Organizations 管理账户中，指定 Default EBS volume encryption 设置。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A 和 C**。

**A. 在 Amazon EC2 控制台中，选择 EBS encryption 账户属性并定义默认加密密钥。**  
这是正确的，因为可以为特定 Region 中的 AWS 账户启用 Amazon EBS 默认加密。启用后，在该 Region 中创建的新 EBS 卷（包括启动 EC2 实例时创建的卷）会自动加密。这对员工影响最小，因为他们可以继续正常启动实例和创建卷；加密会默认应用。AWS 文档说明，你可以配置 AWS 账户以强制加密新的 EBS 卷，并且默认加密是特定于 Region 的设置（[AWS EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)）。

**C. 创建 SCP。将 SCP 附加到根 organizational unit (OU)。定义 SCP，以便在 `ec2:Encrypted` 条件等于 `false` 时拒绝 `ec2:CreateVolume` 操作。**  
这是正确的，因为附加到根 OU 的 SCP 会为该根下的所有账户提供组织范围的预防性防护栏。显式拒绝会阻止受影响成员账户中的主体创建未加密的 EBS 卷，包括有人尝试绕过默认加密行为的情况。SCP 旨在集中控制 AWS Organization 中最大可用权限，并且在启用所有功能时可用（[AWS Organizations SCP documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。SCP 评估还支持在整个组织层级中使用显式拒绝防护栏（[AWS Organizations SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)）。该组合效果很好：默认 EBS 加密使合规的卷创建对用户透明，而 SCP 防止创建不合规的未加密卷。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

**B. 创建 IAM permission boundary 并将其附加到根 OU。**  
这是不正确的，因为 IAM permissions boundaries 是附加到 IAM users 或 roles 的，而不是附加到 AWS Organizations OUs。它们也不是在所有账户和 root users 上强制执行组织范围控制的正确机制。SCP 才是合适的组织级防护栏。

**D. 更新每个账户的 IAM policies。**  
这是不正确的，因为它需要逐个账户修改 IAM policies，操作工作量更大，也更容易配置错误。它也无法可靠覆盖每个主体，例如 root users。要求需要一个影响最小且能在整个组织中广泛强制执行的解决方案，而 SCP 更能满足这一点。

**E. 在 Organizations 管理账户中，指定 Default EBS volume encryption 设置。**  
这是不正确的，因为 EBS 默认加密是账户级、特定于 Region 的 EC2/EBS 设置。在 Organizations 管理账户中启用它，并不会自动为所有成员账户配置相同设置。AWS 声明默认加密是为 AWS 账户以及特定 Region 配置的（[AWS EBS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to use an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB cluster to simplify time-consuming database administrative tasks for production database workloads. The company wants to ensure that its database is highly available and will provide automatic failover support in most scenarios in less than 40 seconds. The company wants to offload reads off of the primary instance and keep costs as low as possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Create one read replica and point the read workload to the read replica.
options.B: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB duster deployment Create two read replicas and point the read workload to the read replicas.
options.C: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Point the read workload to the secondary instances in the Multi-AZ pair.
options.D: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment Point the read workload to the reader endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** An Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster is designed for this requirement: it has **one writer DB instance and two readable reader DB instances across three AZs**, providing high availability and increased read capacity compared with a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)). The reader DB instances both **serve read traffic** and act as **automatic failover targets**; if the writer has an outage, RDS manages failover to one of the readers ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)). For read offload, a Multi-AZ DB cluster includes a **reader endpoint** that sends read-only connections to the reader DB instances and reduces overhead on the writer instance ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts-connection-management.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment with a separate read replica can offload reads, but it does not meet the failover-time requirement. AWS states that Multi-AZ DB instance failover is typically **60–120 seconds**, which is not less than 40 seconds ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)).
- **B:** A Multi-AZ DB cluster already includes two readable reader DB instances and a reader endpoint for read traffic. Creating two additional read replicas is unnecessary and increases cost, so it does not keep costs as low as possible ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)).
- **C:** In a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment, the standby is for failover, not for serving read traffic; also, its typical failover time is **60–120 seconds**, failing the less-than-40-seconds requirement ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB cluster 来简化生产数据库工作负载中耗时的数据库管理任务。该公司希望确保其数据库具有高可用性，并且在大多数场景下能够在少于 40 秒内提供自动故障转移支持。该公司希望将读取从主实例卸载，并尽可能降低成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment。创建一个只读副本，并将读取工作负载指向该只读副本。
options.B: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB duster deployment 创建两个只读副本，并将读取工作负载指向这些只读副本。
options.C: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment。将读取工作负载指向 Multi-AZ 对中的辅助实例。
options.D: 使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment 将读取工作负载指向 reader endpoint。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster 正是为此需求而设计：它在三个 AZ 中具有 **一个 writer DB instance 和两个可读的 reader DB instances**，与 Multi-AZ DB instance deployment 相比，提供高可用性和更高的读取容量（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。reader DB instances 既**服务读取流量**，又充当**自动故障转移目标**；如果 writer 发生中断，RDS 会管理故障转移到其中一个 reader（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。对于读取卸载，Multi-AZ DB cluster 包含一个 **reader endpoint**，它将只读连接发送到 reader DB instances，并减少 writer instance 上的开销（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts-connection-management.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 带有单独 read replica 的 Multi-AZ DB instance deployment 可以卸载读取，但它不满足故障转移时间要求。AWS 指出 Multi-AZ DB instance 故障转移通常为 **60–120 秒**，这并非少于 40 秒（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。
- **B:** Multi-AZ DB cluster 已经包含两个可读的 reader DB instances 和一个用于读取流量的 reader endpoint。创建两个额外的 read replicas 是不必要的，并且会增加成本，因此不能尽可能降低成本（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。
- **C:** 在 Multi-AZ DB instance deployment 中，standby 用于故障转移，而不是用于服务读取流量；此外，其典型故障转移时间为 **60–120 秒**，不满足少于 40 秒的要求（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。

en.question: A company runs a highly available SFTP service. The SFTP service uses two Amazon EC2 Linux instances that run with elastic IP addresses to accept traffic from trusted IP sources on the internet. The SFTP service is backed by shared storage that is attached to the instances. User accounts are created and managed as Linux users in the SFTP servers. The company wants a serverless option that provides high IOPS performance and highly configurable security. The company also wants to maintain control over user permissions. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a public endpoint that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the EBS volume to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.
options.B: Create an encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with elastic IP addresses and a VPC endpoint that has internet-facing access. Attach a security group to the endpoint that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the EFS volume to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with default encryption enabled. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a public endpoint that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the S3 bucket to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with default encryption enabled. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a VPC endpoint that has internal access in a private subnet. Attach a security group that allows only trusted IP addresses. Attach the S3 bucket to the SFTP service endpoint. Grant users access to the SFTP service.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service for SFTP and can transfer files into and out of **Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS** storage, backed by an auto scaling redundant fleet across up to 3 AZs ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). For the internet-facing, trusted-source-IP requirement, the Transfer Family endpoint matrix says a **VPC - Internet** endpoint supports internet access, can attach **Elastic IP addresses**, and can restrict access by source IP using **security groups** and network ACLs; AWS also specifically recommends using a VPC endpoint with internet-facing access and security groups to allow traffic only from certain client IP addresses ([endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)). For storage and permissions, Transfer Family can use Amazon EFS; when users are configured, an IAM role determines their EFS access, and EFS uses POSIX ownership/permissions with Transfer Family POSIX profiles for granular per-user control ([configure storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/configure-storage.html)). EFS also supports high IOPS configurations; Regional EFS with Elastic throughput can provide very high read/write IOPS, and EFS IOPS scale elastically up to the file system’s limits ([EFS performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Transfer Family storage is Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS, not Amazon EBS ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). Also, the **Public** endpoint type cannot attach static IP addresses and does **not** support source IP allow lists ([endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)).
- **C:** Although S3 is supported, the option uses a **public endpoint** that allegedly allows only trusted IPs. Transfer Family public endpoints do **not** support source IP allow lists and cannot attach static IPs ([endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)). It also does not preserve Linux/POSIX-style permission control as directly as EFS with POSIX profiles.
- **D:** A VPC endpoint with **internal access** is accessible only from within the VPC or VPC-connected environments, not directly from trusted IP sources on the internet ([endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)). Therefore it does not meet the internet-facing SFTP requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司运行一项高度可用的 SFTP 服务。该 SFTP 服务使用两个 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例，这些实例使用弹性 IP 地址来接受来自互联网可信 IP 源的流量。该 SFTP 服务由附加到这些实例的共享存储提供支持。用户账户作为 Linux 用户在 SFTP 服务器中创建和管理。该公司希望采用一种无服务器选项，该选项可提供高 IOPS 性能和高度可配置的安全性。该公司还希望保持对用户权限的控制。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。创建一个具有公共端点的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 服务，该端点仅允许可信 IP 地址。将 EBS 卷附加到 SFTP 服务端点。授予用户访问 SFTP 服务的权限。
options.B: 创建一个加密的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷。创建一个 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 服务，该服务具有弹性 IP 地址以及具有面向互联网访问权限的 VPC 端点。将一个仅允许可信 IP 地址的安全组附加到该端点。将 EFS 卷附加到 SFTP 服务端点。授予用户访问 SFTP 服务的权限。
options.C: 创建一个启用默认加密的 Amazon S3 桶。创建一个具有公共端点的 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 服务，该端点仅允许可信 IP 地址。将 S3 桶附加到 SFTP 服务端点。授予用户访问 SFTP 服务的权限。
options.D: 创建一个启用默认加密的 Amazon S3 桶。创建一个 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 服务，该服务具有位于私有子网中且具有内部访问权限的 VPC 端点。附加一个仅允许可信 IP 地址的安全组。将 S3 桶附加到 SFTP 服务端点。授予用户访问 SFTP 服务的权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Transfer Family 是一项用于 SFTP 的完全托管服务，可以将文件传入和传出 **Amazon S3 或 Amazon EFS** 存储，并由一个可在最多 3 个 AZ 中自动扩缩的冗余机群提供支持（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。对于面向互联网且要求可信源 IP 的需求，Transfer Family 端点矩阵说明 **VPC - Internet** 端点支持互联网访问，可以附加 **Elastic IP addresses**，并且可以使用 **security groups** 和网络 ACL 按源 IP 限制访问；AWS 还特别建议使用具有面向互联网访问权限的 VPC 端点，并使用安全组仅允许来自特定客户端 IP 地址的流量（[endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。对于存储和权限，Transfer Family 可以使用 Amazon EFS；配置用户时，IAM role 决定其 EFS 访问权限，并且 EFS 使用 POSIX 所有权/权限，配合 Transfer Family POSIX 配置文件可实现细粒度的每用户控制（[configure storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/configure-storage.html)）。EFS 还支持高 IOPS 配置；使用 Elastic throughput 的 Regional EFS 可以提供非常高的读/写 IOPS，并且 EFS IOPS 可弹性扩展到文件系统的限制（[EFS performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Transfer Family 存储是 Amazon S3 或 Amazon EFS，而不是 Amazon EBS（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。此外，**Public** 端点类型不能附加静态 IP 地址，并且**不**支持源 IP 允许列表（[endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。
- **C:** 虽然支持 S3，但该选项使用了一个据称只允许可信 IP 的 **public endpoint**。Transfer Family public endpoints **不**支持源 IP 允许列表，也不能附加静态 IP（[endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。与使用 POSIX 配置文件的 EFS 相比，它也无法同样直接地保留 Linux/POSIX 风格的权限控制。
- **D:** 具有 **internal access** 的 VPC 端点只能从 VPC 内部或与 VPC 连接的环境访问，不能直接从互联网上的可信 IP 源访问（[endpoint type matrix](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/sftp-for-transfer-family.html)）。因此，它不满足面向互联网的 SFTP 要求。

en.question: A company is developing a new machine learning (ML) model solution on AWS. The models are developed as independent microservices that fetch approximately 1 GB of model data from Amazon S3 at startup and load the data into memory. Users access the models through an asynchronous API. Users can send a request or a batch of requests and specify where the results should be sent. The company provides models to hundreds of users. The usage patterns for the models are irregular. Some models could be unused for days or weeks. Other models could receive batches of thousands of requests at a time. Which design should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
