options.A: Direct the requests from the API to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Deploy the models as AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by the NLB.
options.B: Direct the requests from the API to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Deploy the models as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use AWS App Mesh to scale the instances of the ECS cluster based on the SQS queue size.
options.C: Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the models as AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by SQS events. Use AWS Auto Scaling to increase the number of vCPUs for the Lambda functions based on the SQS queue size.
options.D: Direct the requests from the API into an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Deploy the models as Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that read from the queue. Enable AWS Auto Scaling on Amazon ECS for both the cluster and copies of the service based on the queue size.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The workload is asynchronous and bursty, and the model microservices are long-running/container-style workers that load about 1 GB of model data into memory. Sending API requests to **Amazon SQS** lets worker services pull and process messages; SQS visibility timeout is designed to coordinate distributed processing and long-running tasks while preventing multiple consumers from working the same message at the same time ([Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)). For asynchronous job processors, AWS states that the proper scaling metric is almost always **queue depth**, and for SQS the recommended metric is `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` ([Optimizing Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-autoscaling-best-practice.html)). Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling can increase or decrease the number of service tasks based on CloudWatch metrics, and ECS cluster auto scaling can manage the EC2 capacity registered to the cluster by scaling out/in the Auto Scaling group capacity provider ([ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html), [ECS cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html)). This matches scaling both the workers and underlying capacity based on queue backlog.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** A Network Load Balancer does not fit the asynchronous queue-based pattern, and Lambda is not ideal for these model workers. Lambda has hard execution/runtime limits such as a **15-minute timeout**, memory up to **10,240 MB**, and specific payload limits ([Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)). Also, official ELB documentation specifically describes using **Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer**, not an NLB ([ALB Lambda targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)).
- **B:** ECS workers are appropriate, but routing requests to an ALB is unnecessary for an asynchronous API that should place work into a queue. The option also says to use **App Mesh** to scale ECS cluster instances, but the AWS-supported scaling mechanisms here are ECS Service Auto Scaling and ECS cluster auto scaling/capacity providers, not App Mesh ([ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html), [ECS cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html)).
- **C:** SQS is appropriate, but Lambda is a poor fit for microservices that load large ML models and may process large batches/long-running jobs. Lambda also does not support “using AWS Auto Scaling to increase the number of vCPUs”; Lambda CPU is tied to the configured memory setting, and the function timeout is limited to 900 seconds ([Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上开发新的机器学习 (ML) 模型解决方案。这些模型作为独立的微服务开发，在启动时会从 Amazon S3 获取大约 1 GB 的模型数据并将数据加载到内存中。用户通过异步 API 访问这些模型。用户可以发送一个请求或一批请求，并指定结果应发送到哪里。该公司向数百名用户提供模型。这些模型的使用模式不规律。有些模型可能数天或数周都未被使用。其他模型可能一次收到数千个请求的批次。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种设计来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将来自 API 的请求直接发送到 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。将模型部署为由 NLB 调用的 AWS Lambda 函数。
options.B: 将来自 API 的请求直接发送到 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将模型部署为 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务，这些服务从 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列读取消息。使用 AWS App Mesh 根据 SQS 队列大小扩展 ECS 集群实例。
options.C: 将来自 API 的请求直接发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。将模型部署为由 SQS 事件调用的 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 AWS Auto Scaling 根据 SQS 队列大小增加 Lambda 函数的 vCPU 数量。
options.D: 将来自 API 的请求直接发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。将模型部署为 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务，这些服务从队列读取消息。根据队列大小，在 Amazon ECS 上为集群和服务副本同时启用 AWS Auto Scaling。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 该工作负载是异步且突发性的，并且模型微服务是长时间运行/容器风格的工作进程，会将约 1 GB 的模型数据加载到内存中。将 API 请求发送到 **Amazon SQS** 可让工作服务拉取并处理消息；SQS visibility timeout 旨在协调分布式处理和长时间运行的任务，同时防止多个使用者同时处理同一条消息（[Amazon SQS visibility timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-visibility-timeout.html)）。对于异步作业处理器，AWS 表示合适的扩展指标几乎总是 **queue depth**，对于 SQS，推荐的指标是 `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible`（[Optimizing Amazon ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-autoscaling-best-practice.html)）。Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling 可以根据 CloudWatch 指标增加或减少服务任务数量，而 ECS cluster auto scaling 可以通过扩展/缩减 Auto Scaling group capacity provider 来管理注册到集群的 EC2 容量（[ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)、[ECS cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html)）。这与根据队列积压同时扩展工作进程和底层容量相匹配。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** Network Load Balancer 不适合基于异步队列的模式，并且 Lambda 并不适合这些模型工作进程。Lambda 有硬性的执行/运行时限制，例如 **15 分钟超时**、最高 **10,240 MB** 内存以及特定的负载限制（[Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)）。此外，官方 ELB 文档明确描述的是将 **Lambda functions as targets of an Application Load Balancer**，而不是 NLB（[ALB Lambda targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)）。
- **B:** ECS 工作进程是合适的，但对于应将工作放入队列的异步 API，将请求路由到 ALB 是不必要的。该选项还说使用 **App Mesh** 来扩展 ECS 集群实例，但此处 AWS 支持的扩展机制是 ECS Service Auto Scaling 和 ECS cluster auto scaling/capacity providers，而不是 App Mesh（[ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)、[ECS cluster auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/cluster-auto-scaling.html)）。
- **C:** SQS 是合适的，但对于加载大型 ML 模型且可能处理大型批次/长时间运行作业的微服务，Lambda 并不适合。Lambda 也不支持“使用 AWS Auto Scaling 来增加 vCPU 数量”；Lambda CPU 与配置的内存设置绑定，并且函数超时限制为 900 秒（[Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)）。

options.A: Role
options.B: Group
options.C: Organization
options.D: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) resource
options.E: Amazon EC2 resource

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **A. Role** and **B. Group**.

AWS states that **identity-based policies** are attached to IAM identities: “users, groups to which users belong, or roles,” and that these policies grant permissions to an identity. It also states that managed identity-based policies can be attached to multiple **users, groups, and roles**, while inline policies can be added directly to a single **user, group, or role** ([Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)). AWS also defines IAM identities as including IAM users, IAM groups, and IAM roles ([IAM Identities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id.html)).

- **A. Role** — Correct. IAM roles are IAM identities, and identity-based policies can be attached to roles.
- **B. Group** — Correct. IAM user groups are IAM identities for policy attachment purposes, and identity-based policies can be attached to groups.
- **C. Organization** — Incorrect. AWS Organizations policies such as SCPs define maximum permissions and do not grant permissions like IAM identity-based policies; an organization is not an IAM identity to which this IAM policy is attached.
- **D. Amazon ECS resource** — Incorrect. ECS resources are resources, not IAM identities for attaching identity-based policies.
- **E. Amazon EC2 resource** — Incorrect. EC2 resources are resources, not IAM identities for attaching identity-based policies.

options.A: 角色
options.B: 组
options.C: 组织
options.D: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 资源
options.E: Amazon EC2 资源

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A. Role** 和 **B. Group**。

AWS 说明，**identity-based policies** 会附加到 IAM 身份：“用户、用户所属的组或角色”，并且这些策略会向身份授予权限。它还说明，托管的基于身份的策略可以附加到多个 **users, groups, and roles**，而内联策略可以直接添加到单个 **user, group, or role**（[Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。AWS 还将 IAM 身份定义为包括 IAM 用户、IAM 组和 IAM 角色（[IAM Identities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id.html)）。

- **A. Role** — 正确。IAM 角色是 IAM 身份，并且基于身份的策略可以附加到角色。
- **B. Group** — 正确。IAM 用户组在策略附加方面属于 IAM 身份，并且基于身份的策略可以附加到组。
- **C. Organization** — 不正确。AWS Organizations 策略（例如 SCP）定义最大权限，并不像 IAM 基于身份的策略那样授予权限；组织不是可附加此 IAM 策略的 IAM 身份。
- **D. Amazon ECS resource** — 不正确。ECS 资源是资源，不是用于附加基于身份的策略的 IAM 身份。
- **E. Amazon EC2 resource** — 不正确。EC2 资源是资源，不是用于附加基于身份的策略的 IAM 身份。

en.question: A company is running a custom application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. The application has frontend nodes that need to run 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and backend nodes that need to run only for a short time based on workload. The number of backend nodes varies during the day. The company needs to scale out and scale in more instances based on workload. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.
options.B: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes.
options.C: Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Reserved Instances for the backend nodes.
options.D: Use Spot Instances for the frontend nodes. Use AWS Fargate for the backend nodes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes.**

The frontend nodes run continuously 24x7, so a committed EC2 pricing model is appropriate. AWS states that **Reserved Instances** reduce EC2 costs by committing to a specific instance configuration for a 1- or 3-year term ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). The backend nodes run only for short periods and vary with workload, so using **Spot Instances** is the most cost-effective EC2 option; AWS describes Spot Instances as unused EC2 capacity that can significantly reduce EC2 costs ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling also supports scaling groups up and down to reduce costs when demand is lower, and supports Spot and On-Demand purchase options to optimize costs through Spot usage ([EC2 Auto Scaling features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)). A mixed/Spot Auto Scaling group can specify percentages of On-Demand and Spot capacity and scale in/out accordingly ([mixed instances group scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/mixed-instances-groups-set-up-overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Reserved Instances for frontend is good, but **AWS Fargate** is for running **containers** without managing EC2 instances or clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). The question describes a custom application on EC2 instances and asks to scale backend **instances**; Spot Instances are the lower-cost EC2 fit.
- **C:** Spot Instances are not suitable for the always-on frontend nodes when Reserved Instances better match continuous, predictable EC2 usage. Reserved Instances for variable, short-lived backend capacity would waste the commitment.
- **D:** This combines both problems: Spot for the 24x7 frontend, and Fargate for backend nodes even though the requirement is to scale EC2 instance-based backend capacity.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 上运行一个自定义应用程序。该应用程序有需要每周 7 天、每天 24 小时运行的前端节点，以及仅需根据工作负载短时间运行的后端节点。后端节点的数量在一天中会变化。公司需要根据工作负载扩展更多实例并缩减实例。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 对前端节点使用 Reserved Instances。对后端节点使用 AWS Fargate。
options.B: 对前端节点使用 Reserved Instances。对后端节点使用 Spot Instances。
options.C: 对前端节点使用 Spot Instances。对后端节点使用 Reserved Instances。
options.D: 对前端节点使用 Spot Instances。对后端节点使用 AWS Fargate。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 对前端节点使用 Reserved Instances。对后端节点使用 Spot Instances。**

前端节点持续 24x7 运行，因此适合使用承诺型 EC2 定价模型。AWS 表示，**Reserved Instances** 通过承诺使用特定实例配置 1 年或 3 年期限来降低 EC2 成本（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。后端节点仅短时间运行，并随工作负载变化，因此使用 **Spot Instances** 是最具成本效益的 EC2 选项；AWS 将 Spot Instances 描述为未使用的 EC2 容量，可以显著降低 EC2 成本（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 还支持向上和向下扩展组，以在需求较低时降低成本，并支持 Spot 和 On-Demand 购买选项，以通过使用 Spot 来优化成本（[EC2 Auto Scaling features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)）。混合/Spot Auto Scaling 组可以指定 On-Demand 和 Spot 容量的百分比，并相应地进行扩展和缩减（[mixed instances group scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/mixed-instances-groups-set-up-overview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 对前端使用 Reserved Instances 是好的，但 **AWS Fargate** 用于在不管理 EC2 instances 或集群的情况下运行 **containers**（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。题目描述的是 EC2 instances 上的自定义应用程序，并要求扩展后端 **instances**；Spot Instances 是成本更低且适合 EC2 的选择。
- **C:** 对于始终在线的前端节点，Spot Instances 不适合，因为 Reserved Instances 更符合连续、可预测的 EC2 使用。将 Reserved Instances 用于可变且短生命周期的后端容量会浪费承诺。
- **D:** 这结合了两个问题：将 Spot 用于 24x7 前端，并且尽管要求是扩展基于 EC2 instance 的后端容量，却将 Fargate 用于后端节点。

en.question: A company uses high block storage capacity to runs its workloads on premises. The company's daily peak input and output transactions per second are not more than 15,000 IOPS. The company wants to migrate the workloads to Amazon EC2 and to provision disk performance independent of storage capacity. Which Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume type will meet these requirements MOST cost- effectively?

options.A: GP2 volume type
options.B: io2 volume type
options.C: GP3 volume type
options.D: io1 volume type

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. GP3 volume type**

Amazon EBS **gp3** is the best fit because AWS describes gp3 as the **lowest cost SSD volume offered by Amazon EBS** and states that it lets you **scale volume performance independently of volume size**, so the company can provision the required IOPS without over-provisioning block storage capacity. gp3 also supports provisioning additional IOPS up to 80,000 IOPS, so a peak requirement of 15,000 IOPS is within its capability ([Amazon EBS General Purpose SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/general-purpose.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. gp2**: gp2 can reach up to 16,000 IOPS, but AWS states that **gp2 performance scales with volume size**; reaching high IOPS requires provisioning a large volume. gp3 is also up to 20% lower priced than gp2, making gp2 less cost-effective for this requirement ([Amazon EBS General Purpose SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/general-purpose.html)).
- **B. io2**: io2 Block Express is intended for workloads needing sub-millisecond latency, sustained IOPS, or more than 80,000 IOPS / 2,000 MiB/s throughput. The workload needs only up to 15,000 IOPS, so io2 is unnecessary and not the most cost-effective option ([Amazon EBS volume types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types.html)).
- **D. io1**: io1 is a Provisioned IOPS SSD option for I/O-intensive workloads or more than 16,000 IOPS. Since 15,000 IOPS is within gp3 capability and gp3 is the lowest-cost SSD option, io1 is not the most cost-effective choice ([Amazon EBS volume types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在本地使用高容量块存储来运行其工作负载。该公司的每日峰值每秒输入和输出事务不超过 15,000 IOPS。该公司希望将工作负载迁移到 Amazon EC2，并希望独立于存储容量来预置磁盘性能。哪种 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷类型能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: GP2 卷类型
options.B: io2 卷类型
options.C: GP3 卷类型
options.D: io1 卷类型

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. GP3 卷类型**

Amazon EBS **gp3** 是最合适的选择，因为 AWS 将 gp3 描述为 **Amazon EBS 提供的成本最低的 SSD 卷**，并说明它允许您**独立于卷大小扩展卷性能**，因此公司可以在不过度预置块存储容量的情况下预置所需的 IOPS。gp3 还支持预置最高 80,000 IOPS 的额外 IOPS，因此 15,000 IOPS 的峰值需求在其能力范围内（[Amazon EBS General Purpose SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/general-purpose.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. gp2**：gp2 最高可达到 16,000 IOPS，但 AWS 表示 **gp2 性能会随卷大小扩展**；要达到高 IOPS 需要预置较大的卷。gp3 的价格也比 gp2 低最高 20%，因此对于此要求，gp2 的成本效益较低（[Amazon EBS General Purpose SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/general-purpose.html)）。
- **B. io2**：io2 Block Express 适用于需要亚毫秒级延迟、持续 IOPS，或超过 80,000 IOPS / 2,000 MiB/s 吞吐量的工作负载。该工作负载只需要最高 15,000 IOPS，因此 io2 没有必要，也不是最具成本效益的选项（[Amazon EBS volume types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types.html)）。
- **D. io1**：io1 是面向 I/O 密集型工作负载或超过 16,000 IOPS 的 Provisioned IOPS SSD 选项。由于 15,000 IOPS 在 gp3 的能力范围内，并且 gp3 是成本最低的 SSD 选项，因此 io1 不是最具成本效益的选择（[Amazon EBS volume types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to store data from its healthcare application. The application’s data frequently changes. A new regulation requires audit access at all levels of the stored data. The company hosts the application on an on-premises infrastructure that is running out of storage capacity. A solutions architect must securely migrate the existing data to AWS while satisfying the new regulation. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events.
options.B: Use AWS Snowcone to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log data events.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

AWS DataSync is designed for this migration scenario: it is a “secure, reliable, high-speed file transfer service” for transferring file or object data to AWS storage services, supports on-premises storage sources, and supports Amazon S3 as a destination. Its documented migration use case includes transferring **active datasets** into AWS storage services with automatic encryption and integrity validation, which fits data that frequently changes and an on-premises environment running out of capacity ([AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).

For the audit requirement, CloudTrail **data events** are required because they record resource operations performed “on or in a resource,” such as reading or writing an S3 object. AWS specifically lists S3 object-level API activity such as `GetObject`, `DeleteObject`, and `PutObject` as CloudTrail data events ([CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html); [S3 CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-logging-s3-info.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

* **B**: Snowcone can move data physically, but the option uses CloudTrail **management events**, which log control-plane/management operations, not object-level data access. That does not satisfy audit access at all levels.
* **C**: S3 Transfer Acceleration helps optimize uploads over long distances or when bandwidth to S3 is underutilized, but it is not the best managed migration service for active on-premises datasets ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).
* **D**: Storage Gateway can integrate on-premises applications with AWS storage, but this option again uses CloudTrail **management events**, which do not provide S3 object-level audit logging. Data events are required for object access auditing.

zh.question: 一家公司需要存储其医疗保健应用程序的数据。该应用程序的数据经常变化。一项新法规要求对已存储数据的所有级别进行访问审计。该公司将该应用程序托管在本地基础设施上，而该基础设施的存储容量即将耗尽。解决方案架构师必须在满足新法规的同时，将现有数据安全地迁移到 AWS。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 将现有数据移动到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录数据事件。
options.B: 使用 AWS Snowcone 将现有数据移动到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录管理事件。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 将现有数据移动到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录数据事件。
options.D: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway 将现有数据移动到 Amazon S3。使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录管理事件。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

AWS DataSync 专为这种迁移场景而设计：它是一项“安全、可靠、高速的文件传输服务”，用于将文件或对象数据传输到 AWS 存储服务，支持本地存储源，并支持 Amazon S3 作为目标位置。其文档中的迁移用例包括将**活动数据集**传输到 AWS 存储服务，并提供自动加密和完整性验证，这符合数据经常变化且本地环境容量不足的情况（[AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。对于审计要求，需要使用 CloudTrail **数据事件**，因为它们会记录“在资源上或资源内”执行的资源操作，例如读取或写入 S3 对象。AWS 明确将 S3 对象级 API 活动（例如 `GetObject`、`DeleteObject` 和 `PutObject`）列为 CloudTrail 数据事件（[CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)；[S3 CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-logging-s3-info.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

* **B**：Snowcone 可以以物理方式移动数据，但该选项使用 CloudTrail **管理事件**，这些事件记录控制平面/管理操作，而不是对象级数据访问。这无法满足所有级别访问审计的要求。
* **C**：S3 Transfer Acceleration 有助于优化长距离上传，或在到 S3 的带宽未充分利用时优化上传，但它并不是用于活动本地数据集的最佳托管迁移服务（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。
* **D**：Storage Gateway 可以将本地应用程序与 AWS 存储集成，但该选项同样使用 CloudTrail **管理事件**，无法提供 S3 对象级审计日志记录。对象访问审计需要数据事件。

en.question: A solutions architect is implementing a complex Java application with a MySQL database. The Java application must be deployed on Apache Tomcat and must be highly available. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application in AWS Lambda. Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to connect with the Lambda functions.
options.B: Deploy the application by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Configure a load-balanced environment and a rolling deployment policy.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon ElastiCache. Configure the ElastiCache security group to allow access from the application.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Install a MySQL server on the EC2 instance. Configure the application on the server. Create an AMI. Use the AMI to create a launch template with an Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Elastic Beanstalk is designed for this requirement: AWS states that Elastic Beanstalk deploys web applications, provisions EC2 instances, configures load balancing, sets up health monitoring, and dynamically scales the environment ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)). It also specifically supports Java applications and has a **Tomcat** platform based on Apache Tomcat for Java servlet/JSP applications ([Deploying Java applications with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/create_deploy_Java.html)). A load-balanced Elastic Beanstalk environment addresses high availability, and a rolling deployment policy deploys to batches while leaving other instances running to serve traffic ([Deployment policies and settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Lambda supports Java runtimes, but the requirement says the application must be deployed on **Apache Tomcat**. Lambda is for functions/runtimes, not a managed Tomcat application server deployment model ([Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)).
- **C:** ElastiCache is a distributed in-memory data store/cache service using engines such as Valkey, Memcached, and Redis OSS; it is not a MySQL database migration target ([What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)).
- **D:** Building EC2 instances, installing MySQL and the application, creating an AMI, and using an Auto Scaling group is more operationally complex and does not directly provide the managed Tomcat platform, health monitoring, load balancing, and deployment policy capabilities that Elastic Beanstalk provides for this scenario ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在实施一个带有 MySQL 数据库的复杂 Java 应用程序。该 Java 应用程序必须部署在 Apache Tomcat 上，并且必须具备高可用性。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 将应用程序部署在 AWS Lambda 中。配置一个 Amazon API Gateway API 以连接 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 部署应用程序。配置负载均衡环境和滚动部署策略。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon ElastiCache。配置 ElastiCache 安全组以允许来自应用程序的访问。
options.D: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例。在该 EC2 实例上安装 MySQL 服务器。在服务器上配置应用程序。创建一个 AMI。使用该 AMI 创建带有 Auto Scaling 组的启动模板。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Elastic Beanstalk 正是为此类需求而设计的：AWS 声明 Elastic Beanstalk 可部署 Web 应用程序、预置 EC2 实例、配置负载均衡、设置运行状况监控，并动态扩展环境（[What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。它还专门支持 Java 应用程序，并且具有基于 Apache Tomcat 的 **Tomcat** 平台，用于 Java servlet/JSP 应用程序（[Deploying Java applications with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/create_deploy_Java.html)）。负载均衡的 Elastic Beanstalk 环境可满足高可用性要求，而滚动部署策略会分批部署，同时让其他实例继续运行以提供流量服务（[Deployment policies and settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Lambda 支持 Java 运行时，但要求说明应用程序必须部署在 **Apache Tomcat** 上。Lambda 用于函数/运行时，而不是托管 Tomcat 应用程序服务器部署模型（[Lambda runtimes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html)）。
- **C:** ElastiCache 是一种分布式内存数据存储/缓存服务，使用 Valkey、Memcached 和 Redis OSS 等引擎；它不是 MySQL 数据库迁移目标（[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。
- **D:** 构建 EC2 实例、安装 MySQL 和应用程序、创建 AMI，并使用 Auto Scaling 组，运营复杂性更高，并且不能直接提供 Elastic Beanstalk 在此场景中提供的托管 Tomcat 平台、运行状况监控、负载均衡和部署策略功能（[What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A serverless application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and Amazon DynamoDB. The Lambda function needs permissions to read and write to the DynamoDB table. Which solution will give the Lambda function access to the DynamoDB table MOST securely?

options.A: Create an IAM user with programmatic access to the Lambda function. Attach a policy to the user that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Store the access_key_id and secret_access_key parameters as part of the Lambda environment variables. Ensure that other AWS users do not have read and write access to the Lambda function configuration.
options.B: Create an IAM role that includes Lambda as a trusted service. Attach a policy to the role that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Update the configuration of the Lambda function to use the new role as the execution role.
options.C: Create an IAM user with programmatic access to the Lambda function. Attach a policy to the user that allows read and write access to the DynamoDB table. Store the access_key_id and secret_access_key parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure string parameters. Update the Lambda function code to retrieve the secure string parameters before connecting to the DynamoDB table.
options.D: Create an IAM role that includes DynamoDB as a trusted service. Attach a policy to the role that allows read and write access from the Lambda function. Update the code of the Lambda function to attach to the new role as an execution role.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

A Lambda function should get permissions through its **execution role**, not through stored IAM user access keys. AWS states that a Lambda execution role is an IAM role that grants the function permission to access AWS services and resources, and that Lambda automatically assumes this role when the function is invoked. The role trust policy must specify the Lambda service principal (`lambda.amazonaws.com`) as a trusted service. AWS also gives DynamoDB access as an example: if the function needs to update entries in DynamoDB, create/use a custom execution role with the necessary permissions and attach it to the function ([AWS Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)). This matches option B.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Incorrect. It uses an IAM user with long-term access keys stored in Lambda environment variables. AWS recommends using environment variables for operational parameters, but recommends using a secrets service rather than environment variables for sensitive values such as credentials ([Lambda environment variables documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)). More importantly, Lambda natively supports execution roles, so embedding access keys is unnecessary and less secure.
- **C:** Incorrect. Storing IAM user keys in Systems Manager Parameter Store as secure strings is better than plain environment variables, but it still relies on long-term IAM user credentials and requires code to retrieve and use them. The more secure native pattern is to grant the Lambda execution role least-privilege DynamoDB permissions ([Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)).
- **D:** Incorrect. The trust relationship is wrong. The role that Lambda uses must trust the **Lambda service principal** (`lambda.amazonaws.com`), because Lambda assumes the execution role when invoking the function. The role should not list DynamoDB as the trusted service for this use case ([Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)). Also, Lambda should not attach/assume the execution role from function code; AWS says Lambda automatically assumes the execution role and you should avoid manually calling `sts:AssumeRole` in function code ([Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)).

zh.question: 一个无服务器应用程序使用 Amazon API Gateway、AWS Lambda 和 Amazon DynamoDB。Lambda 函数需要读取和写入 DynamoDB 表的权限。哪种解决方案能以最安全的方式授予 Lambda 函数访问 DynamoDB 表的权限？

options.A: 创建一个具有对 Lambda 函数编程访问权限的 IAM 用户。为该用户附加一项策略，允许对 DynamoDB 表进行读取和写入访问。将 access_key_id 和 secret_access_key 参数作为 Lambda 环境变量的一部分存储。确保其他 AWS 用户没有对 Lambda 函数配置的读取和写入访问权限。
options.B: 创建一个将 Lambda 包含为受信任服务的 IAM 角色。为该角色附加一项策略，允许对 DynamoDB 表进行读取和写入访问。更新 Lambda 函数的配置，以使用新角色作为执行角色。
options.C: 创建一个具有对 Lambda 函数编程访问权限的 IAM 用户。为该用户附加一项策略，允许对 DynamoDB 表进行读取和写入访问。将 access_key_id 和 secret_access_key 参数作为安全字符串参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。更新 Lambda 函数代码，以便在连接到 DynamoDB 表之前检索这些安全字符串参数。
options.D: 创建一个将 DynamoDB 包含为受信任服务的 IAM 角色。为该角色附加一项策略，允许来自 Lambda 函数的读取和写入访问。更新 Lambda 函数的代码，以附加到新角色作为执行角色。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Lambda 函数应通过其 **执行角色** 获取权限，而不是通过存储的 IAM 用户访问密钥。AWS 说明，Lambda 执行角色是一个 IAM 角色，用于授予函数访问 AWS 服务和资源的权限，并且 Lambda 会在函数被调用时自动代入此角色。该角色信任策略必须将 Lambda 服务主体（`lambda.amazonaws.com`）指定为受信任服务。AWS 还以 DynamoDB 访问为例：如果函数需要更新 DynamoDB 中的条目，则创建/使用具有必要权限的自定义执行角色，并将其附加到函数（[AWS Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)）。这与选项 B 匹配。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 不正确。它使用具有长期访问密钥的 IAM 用户，并将密钥存储在 Lambda 环境变量中。AWS 建议将环境变量用于操作参数，但建议对凭证等敏感值使用密钥服务，而不是环境变量（[Lambda environment variables documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-envvars.html)）。更重要的是，Lambda 原生支持执行角色，因此嵌入访问密钥是不必要的，并且安全性较低。
- **C:** 不正确。将 IAM 用户密钥作为安全字符串存储在 Systems Manager Parameter Store 中比纯环境变量更好，但它仍然依赖长期 IAM 用户凭证，并要求代码检索和使用这些凭证。更安全的原生模式是向 Lambda 执行角色授予最小权限的 DynamoDB 权限（[Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)）。
- **D:** 不正确。信任关系是错误的。Lambda 使用的角色必须信任 **Lambda 服务主体**（`lambda.amazonaws.com`），因为 Lambda 在调用函数时会代入执行角色。对于此用例，该角色不应将 DynamoDB 列为受信任服务（[Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)）。此外，Lambda 不应从函数代码中附加/代入执行角色；AWS 表示 Lambda 会自动代入执行角色，并且应避免在函数代码中手动调用 `sts:AssumeRole`（[Lambda execution role documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)）。

options.A: Group members are permitted any Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region. Statements after the Allow permission are not applied.
options.B: Group members are denied any Amazon EC2 permissions in the us-east-1 Region unless they are logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA).
options.C: Group members are allowed the ec2:StopInstances and ec2:TerminateInstances permissions for all Regions when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action.
options.D: Group members are allowed the ec2:StopInstances and ec2:TerminateInstances permissions for the us-east-1 Region only when logged in with multi-factor authentication (MFA). Group members are permitted any other Amazon EC2 action within the us-east-1 Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

AWS evaluates all applicable policy statements; statements are not skipped because an earlier statement allowed access. By default requests are implicitly denied, requests must be explicitly allowed, and an explicit `Deny` overrides an explicit `Allow` ([IAM policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic_policy-eval-denyallow.html)).

Here, statement 1 explicitly allows `ec2:*` only when `ec2:Region` equals `us-east-1`. Amazon EC2 documents `ec2:Region` as a condition key that “filters access by the name of the AWS Region” ([EC2 condition keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonec2.html)). Therefore, there is no EC2 allow outside `us-east-1`.

Statement 2 explicitly denies only `ec2:StopInstances` and `ec2:TerminateInstances` when `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` is false or absent because AWS recommends the `Deny` + `BoolIfExists` + `false` pattern to deny requests that are not authenticated using MFA ([aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)). Thus, in `us-east-1`, stop and terminate are allowed only when the request is MFA-authenticated; all other EC2 actions are allowed in `us-east-1`.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Incorrect because later statements are evaluated; an explicit deny can override an allow.
- **B:** Incorrect because the deny applies only to `StopInstances` and `TerminateInstances`, not to all EC2 permissions.
- **C:** Incorrect because statement 1 grants EC2 permissions only in `us-east-1`; MFA does not create permissions for all Regions.

options.A: Group 成员被允许在 us-east-1 Region 内执行任何 Amazon EC2 操作。Allow 权限之后的语句不会被应用。
options.B: 除非 group 成员使用多重身份验证 (MFA) 登录，否则他们在 us-east-1 Region 中会被拒绝任何 Amazon EC2 权限。
options.C: 当 group 成员使用多重身份验证 (MFA) 登录时，他们被允许在所有 Regions 中使用 ec2:StopInstances 和 ec2:TerminateInstances 权限。Group 成员被允许执行任何其他 Amazon EC2 操作。
options.D: Group 成员只有在使用多重身份验证 (MFA) 登录时，才被允许在 us-east-1 Region 中使用 ec2:StopInstances 和 ec2:TerminateInstances 权限。Group 成员被允许在 us-east-1 Region 内执行任何其他 Amazon EC2 操作。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

AWS 会评估所有适用的 policy 语句；不会因为较早的语句允许了访问而跳过后续语句。默认情况下，请求会被隐式拒绝；请求必须被显式允许；并且显式 `Deny` 会覆盖显式 `Allow`（[IAM policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic_policy-eval-denyallow.html)）。在这里，语句 1 仅在 `ec2:Region` 等于 `us-east-1` 时显式允许 `ec2:*`。Amazon EC2 文档将 `ec2:Region` 说明为一个 condition key，用于“按 AWS Region 的名称筛选访问”（[EC2 condition keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonec2.html)）。因此，在 `us-east-1` 之外没有 EC2 allow。语句 2 仅在 `aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent` 为 false 或不存在时，显式拒绝 `ec2:StopInstances` 和 `ec2:TerminateInstances`，因为 AWS 建议使用 `Deny` + `BoolIfExists` + `false` 模式来拒绝未使用 MFA 进行身份验证的请求（[aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)）。因此，在 `us-east-1` 中，stop 和 terminate 只有在请求经过 MFA 身份验证时才被允许；所有其他 EC2 操作在 `us-east-1` 中都被允许。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 不正确，因为后续语句也会被评估；显式 deny 可以覆盖 allow。
- **B:** 不正确，因为 deny 仅适用于 `StopInstances` 和 `TerminateInstances`，而不是所有 EC2 权限。
- **C:** 不正确，因为语句 1 仅在 `us-east-1` 中授予 EC2 权限；MFA 不会为所有 Regions 创建权限。

en.question: A manufacturing company has machine sensors that upload .csv files to an Amazon S3 bucket. These .csv files must be converted into images and must be made available as soon as possible for the automatic generation of graphical reports. The images become irrelevant after 1 month, but the .csv files must be kept to train machine learning (ML) models twice a year. The ML trainings and audits are planned weeks in advance. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Launch an Amazon EC2 Spot Instance that downloads the .csv files every hour, generates the image files, and uploads the images to the S3 bucket.
options.B: Design an AWS Lambda function that converts the .csv files into images and stores the images in the S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function when a .csv file is uploaded.
options.C: Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.
options.D: Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Expire the image files after 30 days.
options.E: Create S3 Lifecycle rules for .csv files and image files in the S3 bucket. Transition the .csv files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 1 day after they are uploaded. Keep the image files in Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS).

en.explanation:
**Correct choices: B and C.**

- **B is correct** because the images must be available “as soon as possible” after each CSV upload. AWS Lambda can process S3 event notifications, and Amazon S3 can send an event to a Lambda function when an object is created; S3 invokes the function asynchronously with details about the uploaded object. This event-driven approach avoids running compute continuously or polling on a schedule. See [Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html).
- **C is correct** because S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to less-expensive storage classes, archive them, or delete them. The CSV files are needed only for ML training/audits twice a year, and those activities are planned weeks in advance, so archival storage such as **S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval** is appropriate even though objects must be restored before access. AWS documentation also shows Lifecycle can transition objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval immediately/within a day after creation, and Lifecycle can expire unneeded objects. See [Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html), [Examples of S3 Lifecycle configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html), and [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An EC2 Spot Instance that runs hourly does not make images available as soon as possible. It also introduces instance management and scheduled polling, whereas S3-to-Lambda is natively event-driven.
- **D:** S3 One Zone-IA provides millisecond access, but it stores data in only one Availability Zone and is intended for infrequently accessed, recreatable data. The CSV files must be retained for ML training and audits, and Glacier archival storage is more aligned with rarely accessed, planned retrieval use cases.
- **E:** S3 Standard-IA is for infrequently accessed data that still requires millisecond access, which is not required here because access is planned weeks in advance. Also, Reduced Redundancy Storage is listed by AWS as **not recommended**, so keeping image files in RRS is not an appropriate cost-effective lifecycle choice.

zh.question: 一家制造公司有机器传感器会将 .csv 文件上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。这些 .csv 文件必须转换为图像，并且必须尽快可用于自动生成图形报告。这些图像在 1 个月后变得无关紧要，但 .csv 文件必须保留，以便每年两次用于训练机器学习 (ML) 模型。ML 训练和审计会提前数周计划。哪一组步骤能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 Spot Instance，该实例每小时下载 .csv 文件、生成图像文件，并将图像上传到 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 设计一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将 .csv 文件转换为图像并将图像存储在 S3 存储桶中。当上传 .csv 文件时调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 为 S3 存储桶中的 .csv 文件和图像文件创建 S3 Lifecycle 规则。在 .csv 文件上传 1 天后，将其从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Glacier。30 天后使图像文件过期。
options.D: 为 S3 存储桶中的 .csv 文件和图像文件创建 S3 Lifecycle 规则。在 .csv 文件上传 1 天后，将其从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。30 天后使图像文件过期。
options.E: 为 S3 存储桶中的 .csv 文件和图像文件创建 S3 Lifecycle 规则。在 .csv 文件上传 1 天后，将其从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。将图像文件保留在 Reduced Redundancy Storage (RRS) 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确选项：B 和 C。**

- **B 正确**，因为在每个 CSV 上传后，图像必须“尽快”可用。AWS Lambda 可以处理 S3 event notifications，并且 Amazon S3 可以在创建对象时向 Lambda 函数发送事件；S3 会使用已上传对象的详细信息异步调用该函数。这种事件驱动方法避免了持续运行计算资源或按计划轮询。请参阅 [Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)。
- **C 正确**，因为 S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的存储类、将其归档或删除。CSV 文件仅在每年两次的 ML 训练/审计中需要，并且这些活动会提前数周计划，因此诸如 **S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval** 这样的归档存储是合适的，尽管对象在访问前必须先还原。AWS 文档还显示，Lifecycle 可以在对象创建后立即/一天内将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，并且 Lifecycle 可以使不再需要的对象过期。请参阅 [Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)、[Examples of S3 Lifecycle configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html) 和 [Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 每小时运行一次的 EC2 Spot Instance 无法让图像尽快可用。它还会引入实例管理和计划轮询，而 S3-to-Lambda 原生就是事件驱动的。
- **D:** S3 One Zone-IA 提供毫秒级访问，但它仅将数据存储在一个 Availability Zone 中，并且适用于不频繁访问、可重新创建的数据。CSV 文件必须保留用于 ML 训练和审计，而 Glacier 归档存储更符合很少访问且按计划检索的使用场景。
- **E:** S3 Standard-IA 适用于仍需要毫秒级访问的不频繁访问数据，但这里并不需要，因为访问会提前数周计划。此外，Reduced Redundancy Storage 被 AWS 列为**不推荐**，因此将图像文件保留在 RRS 中并不是合适且具成本效益的生命周期选择。

en.question: A company has developed a new video game as a web application. The application is in a three-tier architecture in a VPC with Amazon RDS for MySQL in the database layer. Several players will compete concurrently online. The game’s developers want to display a top-10 scoreboard in near-real time and offer the ability to stop and restore the game while preserving the current scores. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster to cache the scores for the web application to display.
options.B: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to compute and cache the scores for the web application to display.
options.C: Place an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the web application to cache the scoreboard in a section of the application.
options.D: Create a read replica on Amazon RDS for MySQL to run queries to compute the scoreboard and serve the read traffic to the web application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS is the best fit for a near-real-time gaming leaderboard. AWS documentation specifically identifies **Gaming Leaderboards** as an ElastiCache use case: with Valkey or **Redis OSS sorted sets**, the cluster can handle leaderboard computation; top scores are computationally complex with many concurrent players and changing scores, and sorted sets maintain uniqueness and ordering and rerank entries in real time. The docs also show commands such as `ZADD`, `ZREVRANGEBYSCORE`, and `ZREVRANK` for ranking players by score. This directly matches the top-10 scoreboard requirement. Redis OSS also supports **sorted sets** and **backup and restore**, unlike node-based Memcached, which supports simple data types and does not support sorted sets or backup/restore in the same way according to the ElastiCache engine comparison table ([ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html), [ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. ElastiCache for Memcached**: Memcached is appropriate for simple object caching, but AWS recommends Memcached when you need the simplest model or to cache objects. The ElastiCache comparison shows Memcached has **simple** data types, **no sorted sets**, and for node-based clusters no backup/restore support, so it is not suitable for computing and restoring a ranked leaderboard ([ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)).
- **C. CloudFront**: CloudFront caches requested web objects at edge locations and returns cached objects when available. It does not compute continuously changing leaderboard rankings or provide the application-level sorted-set data structure needed for near-real-time score updates ([CloudFront content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html)).
- **D. RDS for MySQL read replica**: RDS read replicas are for scaling read-heavy database workloads and offloading reporting/read traffic, but they use asynchronous replication and can have stale data. They do not provide the in-memory real-time ranking operations that Redis sorted sets provide for high-concurrency leaderboards ([RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司已将一款新视频游戏开发为 Web 应用程序。该应用程序采用 VPC 中的三层架构，数据库层使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL。多名玩家将同时在线竞争。游戏开发人员希望近实时显示前 10 名记分板，并提供停止和恢复游戏的能力，同时保留当前分数。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 集群来缓存分数，以便 Web 应用程序显示。
options.B: 设置一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群来计算并缓存分数，以便 Web 应用程序显示。
options.C: 在 Web 应用程序前面放置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，以在应用程序的某个部分缓存记分板。
options.D: 在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 上创建一个只读副本，以运行查询来计算记分板，并为 Web 应用程序提供读取流量服务。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS 最适合近实时游戏排行榜。AWS 文档明确将 **Gaming Leaderboards** 标识为 ElastiCache 的一个使用案例：借助 Valkey 或 **Redis OSS sorted sets**，集群可以处理排行榜计算；在大量并发玩家和不断变化的分数情况下，最高分计算在计算上较为复杂，而 sorted sets 可以保持唯一性和顺序，并实时重新排名条目。文档还展示了 `ZADD`、`ZREVRANGEBYSCORE` 和 `ZREVRANK` 等命令，用于按分数对玩家进行排名。这直接匹配前 10 名记分板要求。Redis OSS 还支持 **sorted sets** 以及 **backup and restore**，这不同于基于节点的 Memcached；根据 ElastiCache 引擎比较表，Memcached 支持简单数据类型，并且不以相同方式支持 sorted sets 或 backup/restore（[ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)，[ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. ElastiCache for Memcached**：Memcached 适用于简单对象缓存，但 AWS 建议在需要最简单模型或缓存对象时使用 Memcached。ElastiCache 比较显示，Memcached 具有 **simple** 数据类型、**no sorted sets**，并且对于基于节点的集群不支持 backup/restore，因此不适合计算和恢复带排名的排行榜（[ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)）。
- **C. CloudFront**：CloudFront 在边缘站点缓存请求的 Web 对象，并在可用时返回缓存对象。它不会计算持续变化的排行榜排名，也不提供近实时分数更新所需的应用程序级 sorted-set 数据结构（[CloudFront content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/HowCloudFrontWorks.html)）。
- **D. RDS for MySQL read replica**：RDS read replicas 用于扩展读取密集型数据库工作负载，并卸载报告/读取流量，但它们使用异步复制，可能存在过期数据。它们不提供 Redis sorted sets 为高并发排行榜提供的内存中实时排名操作（[RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company wants to use machine learning (ML) algorithms to build and train models. The company will use the models to visualize complex scenarios and to detect trends in customer data. The architecture team wants to integrate its ML models with a reporting platform to analyze the augmented data and use the data directly in its business intelligence dashboards. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Glue to create an ML transform to build and train models. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to visualize the data.
options.B: Use Amazon SageMaker to build and train models. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
options.C: Use a pre-built ML Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the AWS Marketplace to build and train models. Use Amazon OpenSearch Service to visualize the data.
options.D: Use Amazon QuickSight to build and train models by using calculated fields. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon SageMaker is the AWS managed ML service intended for this workload: AWS documentation states that SageMaker AI is a **fully managed service** with tools to **build, train, and deploy ML models at scale** ([Amazon SageMaker](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/next-generation-sagemaker/latest/userguide/what-is-sagemaker.html)). Amazon QuickSight is the best fit for the reporting/BI requirement because it is a business intelligence service for creating **interactive visualizations, dashboards, and reports** ([Amazon QuickSight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/quick-bi.html)). QuickSight also directly integrates with SageMaker models: it can augment QuickSight Enterprise data with SageMaker ML models, run inferences on SPICE data, and share the resulting insights in **predictive dashboards**; AWS notes that this saves time otherwise spent managing data movement and writing code and uses a serverless approach so you do not need to manage inference or query capacity ([QuickSight SageMaker integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/user/sagemaker-integration.html)). This combination meets the ML, reporting-platform integration, dashboard, and least-operational-overhead requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A:** AWS Glue ML transforms are for cleansing data, such as record matching, not for general-purpose model building/training and BI dashboarding. The Glue documentation says ML transforms can be used to **cleanse your data** and references record matching ([AWS Glue ML transforms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/console-machine-learning-transforms.html)). OpenSearch is not the purpose-built BI dashboard service in this scenario.
* **C:** A pre-built ML AMI on EC2 would require the team to operate instances, environments, scaling, patching, and integrations, so it has more operational overhead than the fully managed SageMaker + QuickSight approach.
* **D:** QuickSight is for BI visualizations, analyses, dashboards, and reports, not for training custom ML models with calculated fields. Calculated fields are data-preparation/analysis constructs, whereas SageMaker is the managed service for building and training ML models at scale.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司希望使用机器学习 (ML) 算法来构建和训练模型。该公司将使用这些模型来可视化复杂场景，并检测客户数据中的趋势。架构团队希望将其 ML 模型与一个报告平台集成，以分析增强后的数据，并在其商业智能仪表板中直接使用这些数据。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Glue 创建 ML transform 来构建和训练模型。使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 可视化数据。
options.B: 使用 Amazon SageMaker 构建和训练模型。使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Marketplace 中预构建的 ML Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 来构建和训练模型。使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 可视化数据。
options.D: 使用 Amazon QuickSight 通过 calculated fields 构建和训练模型。使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon SageMaker 是适用于此工作负载的 AWS 托管 ML 服务：AWS 文档说明 SageMaker AI 是一项**完全托管的服务**，具有用于大规模**构建、训练和部署 ML 模型**的工具（[Amazon SageMaker](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/next-generation-sagemaker/latest/userguide/what-is-sagemaker.html)）。Amazon QuickSight 最适合报告/BI 要求，因为它是一项商业智能服务，用于创建**交互式可视化、仪表板和报告**（[Amazon QuickSight](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/quick-bi.html)）。QuickSight 还可以直接与 SageMaker 模型集成：它可以使用 SageMaker ML 模型增强 QuickSight Enterprise 数据，对 SPICE 数据运行推理，并在**预测性仪表板**中分享生成的见解；AWS 指出，这可以节省原本用于管理数据移动和编写代码的时间，并采用无服务器方法，因此你无需管理推理或查询容量（[QuickSight SageMaker integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/user/sagemaker-integration.html)）。这种组合满足了 ML、报告平台集成、仪表板以及最低运营开销的要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **A:** AWS Glue ML transforms 用于清理数据，例如记录匹配，而不是用于通用模型构建/训练和 BI 仪表板。Glue 文档说明 ML transforms 可用于**清理你的数据**，并提到记录匹配（[AWS Glue ML transforms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/console-machine-learning-transforms.html)）。OpenSearch 不是此场景中专门用于 BI 仪表板的服务。
* **C:** EC2 上预构建的 ML AMI 将要求团队运行实例、环境、扩展、补丁和集成，因此它比完全托管的 SageMaker + QuickSight 方法具有更多运营开销。
* **D:** QuickSight 用于 BI 可视化、分析、仪表板和报告，而不是使用 calculated fields 训练自定义 ML 模型。Calculated fields 是数据准备/分析构造，而 SageMaker 才是用于大规模构建和训练 ML 模型的托管服务。

en.question: A company is running its production and nonproduction environment workloads in multiple AWS accounts. The accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to design a solution that will prevent the modification of cost usage tags. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a custom AWS Config rule to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals.
options.B: Create a custom trail in AWS CloudTrail to prevent tag modification.
options.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals.
options.D: Create custom Amazon CloudWatch logs to prevent tag modification.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Create a service control policy (SCP) to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals.**

The workloads are spread across multiple AWS accounts in AWS Organizations, so the control should be applied centrally at the organization/OU/account level. AWS states that SCPs are permission guardrails that define the **maximum available permissions** for IAM users and roles in member accounts, and that if an action is explicitly denied by an applicable SCP, the user or role cannot perform that action even if IAM permissions otherwise allow it ([AWS Organizations SCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). An SCP can therefore deny tag-modification actions for cost allocation tags while exempting authorized principals with policy conditions.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. AWS Config rule**: AWS Config is used to track, audit, evaluate, and remediate resource configurations; it detects noncompliance but is not the primary preventive guardrail for blocking tag modifications across all accounts ([What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)).
- **B. CloudTrail trail**: CloudTrail records and logs AWS API activity/events; it provides audit visibility, not preventive access control ([Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)).
- **D. CloudWatch Logs**: CloudWatch provides observability and log collection/querying; custom logs do not prevent users from modifying tags ([What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在多个 AWS 账户中运行其生产环境和非生产环境工作负载。这些账户位于 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织内。该公司需要设计一个解决方案，以防止修改成本使用标签。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建自定义 AWS Config 规则，以防止除授权主体之外的主体修改标签。
options.B: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建自定义跟踪，以防止标签修改。
options.C: 创建服务控制策略 (SCP)，以防止除授权主体之外的主体修改标签。
options.D: 创建自定义 Amazon CloudWatch 日志，以防止标签修改。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 创建服务控制策略 (SCP)，以防止除授权主体之外的主体修改标签。**

工作负载分布在 AWS Organizations 中的多个 AWS 账户内，因此控制应在组织/OU/账户级别集中应用。AWS 指出，SCP 是权限护栏，用于定义成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色的**最大可用权限**；如果某个操作被适用的 SCP 显式拒绝，即使 IAM 权限原本允许，该用户或角色也无法执行该操作（[AWS Organizations SCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。因此，SCP 可以拒绝针对成本分配标签的标签修改操作，同时通过策略条件豁免授权主体。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. AWS Config 规则**：AWS Config 用于跟踪、审计、评估和修复资源配置；它可以检测不合规情况，但不是用于在所有账户中阻止标签修改的主要预防性护栏（[What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。
- **B. CloudTrail 跟踪**：CloudTrail 记录并日志化 AWS API 活动/事件；它提供审计可见性，而不是预防性访问控制（[Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)）。
- **D. CloudWatch Logs**：CloudWatch 提供可观测性以及日志收集/查询；自定义日志不能阻止用户修改标签（[What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts its application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer in an Auto Scaling group and with an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company wants to ensure the application can be made available in anotherAWS Region with minimal downtime. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of downtime?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group and a load balancer in the disaster recovery Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances, load balancers, and DynamoDB tables to be launched when needed Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer.
options.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances and a load balancer to be launched when needed. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new disaster recovery Region's load balancer.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group and load balancer in the disaster recovery Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to trigger an AWS Lambda function that updates Amazon Route 53 pointing to the disaster recovery load balancer.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Option A implements a **warm standby / active-passive DR** pattern: the recovery Region already has the load balancer and Auto Scaling group, while DynamoDB is replicated with a global table, and DNS failover sends users to the secondary load balancer. AWS describes warm standby as maintaining a “scaled-down but fully functional” workload in another Region, with duplicated systems always on and data replicated, giving **RTO in minutes**; it also notes that warm standby can handle traffic immediately at reduced capacity, while pilot light requires additional actions first ([AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2024-06-27/framework/rel_planning_for_recovery_disaster_recovery.html)). DynamoDB global tables automatically replicate table data across Regions and are intended for business continuity and high availability through multi-Region deployment; traffic can shift to another Region with low or zero RPO ([DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). Route 53 supports active-passive DNS failover: when the primary resource is unhealthy, Route 53 responds with the secondary record ([Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Creating resources only when needed is closer to backup/restore or pilot light and has more downtime. It also creates DynamoDB tables when needed rather than keeping the data replicated with global tables.
- **C:** This uses a DynamoDB global table, but EC2 instances and the load balancer are launched only during an event. AWS states pilot light requires turning on servers or deploying additional infrastructure, while warm standby is already deployed and running, so C has more downtime than A.
- **D:** The compute and DynamoDB parts match A, but using a CloudWatch alarm and Lambda to update Route 53 is unnecessary custom automation. Route 53 already provides DNS failover based on health and can return the secondary resource when the primary is unhealthy ([Route 53 DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中托管其应用程序。该应用程序在 Auto Scaling 组中、位于 Elastic Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行，并使用一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。该公司希望确保应用程序能够在另一个 AWS Region 中以最短停机时间变为可用。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的停机时间满足这些要求？

options.A: 在灾难恢复 Region 中创建一个 Auto Scaling 组和一个负载均衡器。将 DynamoDB 表配置为全局表。配置 DNS 故障转移，使其指向新的灾难恢复 Region 的负载均衡器。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于在需要时启动 EC2 实例、负载均衡器和 DynamoDB 表。配置 DNS 故障转移，使其指向新的灾难恢复 Region 的负载均衡器。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于在需要时启动 EC2 实例和负载均衡器。将 DynamoDB 表配置为全局表。配置 DNS 故障转移，使其指向新的灾难恢复 Region 的负载均衡器。
options.D: 在灾难恢复 Region 中创建一个 Auto Scaling 组和负载均衡器。将 DynamoDB 表配置为全局表。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报来触发 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数更新 Amazon Route 53，使其指向灾难恢复负载均衡器。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

选项 A 实现了 **warm standby / active-passive DR** 模式：恢复 Region 中已经有负载均衡器和 Auto Scaling 组，同时 DynamoDB 通过全局表进行复制，并且 DNS 故障转移将用户发送到辅助负载均衡器。AWS 将 warm standby 描述为在另一个 Region 中维护一个“缩减规模但功能完整”的工作负载，系统始终重复运行并复制数据，可实现 **RTO in minutes**；它还指出，warm standby 可以立即以较低容量处理流量，而 pilot light 需要先执行额外操作（[AWS Well-Architected Framework](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2024-06-27/framework/rel_planning_for_recovery_disaster_recovery.html)）。DynamoDB global tables 会自动跨 Regions 复制表数据，旨在通过多 Region 部署实现业务连续性和高可用性；流量可以切换到另一个 Region，并实现低或零 RPO（[DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。Route 53 支持 active-passive DNS failover：当主资源不健康时，Route 53 会返回辅助记录（[Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B:** 仅在需要时创建资源更接近 backup/restore 或 pilot light，并且停机时间更长。它还会在需要时创建 DynamoDB 表，而不是使用 global tables 保持数据复制。
- **C:** 该选项使用了 DynamoDB global table，但 EC2 实例和负载均衡器仅在事件发生期间启动。AWS 指出 pilot light 需要开启服务器或部署额外基础设施，而 warm standby 已经部署并正在运行，因此 C 的停机时间比 A 更长。
- **D:** 计算和 DynamoDB 部分与 A 相同，但使用 CloudWatch alarm 和 Lambda 来更新 Route 53 是不必要的自定义自动化。Route 53 已经提供基于健康状况的 DNS failover，并且可以在主资源不健康时返回辅助资源（[Route 53 DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to migrate a MySQL database from its on-premises data center to AWS within 2 weeks. The database is 20 TB in size. The company wants to complete the migration with minimal downtime. Which solution will migrate the database MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with replication of ongoing changes. Send the Snowball Edge device to AWS to finish the migration and continue the ongoing replication.
options.B: Order an AWS Snowmobile vehicle. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with ongoing changes. Send the Snowmobile vehicle back to AWS to finish the migration and continue the ongoing replication.
options.C: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized with GPU device. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with ongoing changes. Send the Snowball device to AWS to finish the migration and continue the ongoing replication
options.D: Order a 1 GB dedicated AWS Direct Connect connection to establish a connection with the data center. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to migrate the database with replication of ongoing changes.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

A 20 TB database is a bulk, terabyte-scale migration with a 2-week deadline and minimal-downtime requirement. Snowball Edge is designed to physically move large datasets between on-premises environments and AWS without relying on the internet; AWS documents that Snowball Edge can import/export data between local environments and Amazon S3 by physically transporting devices, and supports high-speed local transfer protocols for data migration ([Snowball Edge features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)). AWS also describes Snowball as suitable for moving terabytes of data, including databases, especially when network conditions hinder large transfers ([AWS Snow Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-data-lakes/data-ingestion-methods.html)).

To minimize downtime, AWS DMS can perform a full-load migration and then use CDC/ongoing replication to keep the target synchronized: AWS DMS supports “Full load plus CDC,” where the task migrates existing data and then applies changes from the source, and for MySQL it reads changes from row-based binary logs ([AWS DMS CDC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)). AWS DMS also supports self-managed MySQL sources and requires binary logging for CDC ([MySQL source for DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.MySQL.html)). This combination makes Snowball Edge Storage Optimized for the bulk load plus DMS CDC for changes the most cost-effective fit among the options.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **B — Snowmobile:** Snowmobile is for extremely large migrations; AWS describes Snowball Edge and Snowmobile as used for massive data transfers up to 100 PB ([AWS Snow Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-data-lakes/data-ingestion-methods.html)). For only 20 TB, a Snowmobile vehicle is excessive and not cost-effective.
* **C — Snowball Edge Compute Optimized with GPU:** The requirement is bulk database transfer, not GPU or edge compute. AWS states Snowball Edge options vary between storage capacity and compute functionality depending on the job ([Snowball Edge features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)); Storage Optimized is the appropriate choice for data migration.
* **D — 1 Gbps Direct Connect:** Direct Connect is a valid private connectivity service, and dedicated connections support 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps ([Direct Connect options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/connection_options.html)). However, a dedicated connection requires working with a partner or network provider and cross-connect/LOA-CFA steps ([Dedicated Direct Connect connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/dedicated_connection.html)). For a one-time 20 TB migration within 2 weeks, provisioning a dedicated connection is not the most cost-effective choice compared with a Snowball Edge bulk transfer plus DMS CDC.

zh.question: 一家公司需要在 2 周内将一个 MySQL 数据库从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该数据库大小为 20 TB。公司希望以最短停机时间完成迁移。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益迁移该数据库？

options.A: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 和 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)，通过复制持续发生的更改来迁移数据库。将 Snowball Edge 设备寄送到 AWS 以完成迁移，并继续进行持续复制。
options.B: 订购一辆 AWS Snowmobile 车辆。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 和 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)，通过持续发生的更改来迁移数据库。将 Snowmobile 车辆送回 AWS 以完成迁移，并继续进行持续复制。
options.C: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge Compute Optimized with GPU 设备。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 和 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)，通过持续发生的更改来迁移数据库。将 Snowball 设备寄送到 AWS 以完成迁移，并继续进行持续复制
options.D: 订购一条 1 GB 专用 AWS Direct Connect 连接，以建立与数据中心的连接。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 和 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)，通过复制持续发生的更改来迁移数据库。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

20 TB 数据库属于大规模 TB 级迁移，同时有 2 周期限和最短停机时间要求。Snowball Edge 旨在通过物理方式在本地环境和 AWS 之间移动大型数据集，而无需依赖互联网；AWS 文档说明，Snowball Edge 可以通过物理运输设备在本地环境和 Amazon S3 之间导入/导出数据，并支持用于数据迁移的高速本地传输协议（[Snowball Edge features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。AWS 还说明 Snowball 适合移动 TB 级数据（包括数据库），尤其是在网络条件阻碍大规模传输时（[AWS Snow Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-data-lakes/data-ingestion-methods.html)）。为了最大限度减少停机时间，AWS DMS 可以执行全量加载迁移，然后使用 CDC/持续复制来保持目标同步：AWS DMS 支持 “Full load plus CDC”，即任务先迁移现有数据，然后应用来自源的更改；对于 MySQL，它会从基于行的二进制日志中读取更改（[AWS DMS CDC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)）。AWS DMS 还支持自管理 MySQL 源，并且要求为 CDC 启用二进制日志记录（[MySQL source for DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.MySQL.html)）。这种组合使得 Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 用于批量加载，再配合 DMS CDC 处理更改，成为这些选项中最具成本效益的方案。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

* **B — Snowmobile：** Snowmobile 用于极大规模迁移；AWS 将 Snowball Edge 和 Snowmobile 描述为用于最高 100 PB 的海量数据传输（[AWS Snow Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-data-lakes/data-ingestion-methods.html)）。对于仅 20 TB 的数据，使用 Snowmobile 车辆过度且不具成本效益。
* **C — Snowball Edge Compute Optimized with GPU：** 需求是批量数据库传输，而不是 GPU 或边缘计算。AWS 表示 Snowball Edge 选项会根据作业在存储容量和计算功能之间有所不同（[Snowball Edge features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）；Storage Optimized 才是数据迁移的合适选择。
* **D — 1 Gbps Direct Connect：** Direct Connect 是有效的私有连接服务，专用连接支持 1 Gbps、10 Gbps、100 Gbps 和 400 Gbps（[Direct Connect options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/connection_options.html)）。但是，专用连接需要与合作伙伴或网络提供商协作，并完成 cross-connect/LOA-CFA 步骤（[Dedicated Direct Connect connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/dedicated_connection.html)）。对于需要在 2 周内完成的一次性 20 TB 迁移，与 Snowball Edge 批量传输加 DMS CDC 相比，预置一条专用连接并不是最具成本效益的选择。

en.question: A company moved its on-premises PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The company successfully launched a new product. The workload on the database has increased. The company wants to accommodate the larger workload without adding infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance larger.
options.B: Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance a Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.C: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Add another Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance.
options.D: Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance an on-demand DB instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The requirement is to handle a larger workload **without adding infrastructure**. For Amazon RDS, vertical scaling is done by modifying the existing DB instance, and AWS states that you can modify a DB instance to change settings such as **changing the DB instance class** ([Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)). Choosing a larger DB instance class gives the existing PostgreSQL DB instance more compute/memory capacity. Because the workload is now known and ongoing, purchasing Reserved DB Instances for that capacity is the cost-effective billing choice; AWS billing documentation distinguishes reserved DB instance costs from on-demand and notes that when the reserved instance discount expires, the DB instance is charged at the **on-demand rate** ([Viewing the billing for reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/reserved-instances-billing.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Multi-AZ DB instance**: Multi-AZ is primarily for high availability/failover. AWS describes Multi-AZ failover as automatically switching to another DB instance during outages to ensure high availability with minimal disruption ([Failing over a Multi-AZ DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts-failover.html)). It does not directly increase the capacity of the existing writer for a larger workload.
- **C. Buy reserved DB instances and add another RDS PostgreSQL DB instance**: Adding another DB instance adds infrastructure, which violates the requirement. Also, an extra DB instance only helps specific patterns such as read scaling if configured as a read replica; AWS says read replicas reduce load by routing read queries to replicas and are for read-heavy workloads, and replicas are billed as standard DB instances ([Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).
- **D. Make the DB instance an on-demand DB instance**: On-demand billing does not address the larger workload by itself, and it is not the most cost-effective for a stable larger workload compared with Reserved DB Instance pricing/discount behavior documented by AWS ([Viewing the billing for reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/reserved-instances-billing.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将其本地 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到了 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance。该公司成功推出了一款新产品。数据库上的工作负载增加了。该公司希望在不增加基础设施的情况下适应更大的工作负载。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 为总工作负载购买 reserved DB instances。将 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance 调大。
options.B: 将 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance 设为 Multi-AZ DB instance。
options.C: 为总工作负载购买 reserved DB instances。添加另一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance。
options.D: 将 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance 设为 on-demand DB instance。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

要求是在**不增加基础设施**的情况下处理更大的工作负载。对于 Amazon RDS，垂直扩展是通过修改现有 DB instance 来完成的，AWS 表示你可以修改 DB instance 以更改设置，例如**更改 DB instance class**（[Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)）。选择更大的 DB instance class 可以为现有 PostgreSQL DB instance 提供更多计算/内存容量。由于现在工作负载是已知且持续的，为该容量购买 Reserved DB Instances 是具有成本效益的计费选择；AWS 计费文档将 reserved DB instance 成本与 on-demand 区分开来，并指出当 reserved instance 折扣到期时，DB instance 将按 **on-demand rate** 收费（[Viewing the billing for reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/reserved-instances-billing.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Multi-AZ DB instance**：Multi-AZ 主要用于高可用性/故障转移。AWS 将 Multi-AZ failover 描述为在中断期间自动切换到另一个 DB instance，以确保高可用性并最大限度减少中断（[Failing over a Multi-AZ DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts-failover.html)）。它不会直接增加现有写入器处理更大工作负载的容量。
- **C. 购买 reserved DB instances 并添加另一个 RDS PostgreSQL DB instance**：添加另一个 DB instance 会增加基础设施，这违反了要求。此外，额外的 DB instance 只对特定模式有帮助，例如在配置为 read replica 时进行读取扩展；AWS 表示 read replicas 通过将读取查询路由到副本来减少负载，并适用于读取密集型工作负载，而且副本按标准 DB instances 计费（[Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。
- **D. 将 DB instance 设为 on-demand DB instance**：On-demand 计费本身无法解决更大工作负载的问题，并且对于稳定的较大工作负载，与 AWS 记录的 Reserved DB Instance 定价/折扣行为相比，它并非最具成本效益（[Viewing the billing for reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/reserved-instances-billing.html)）。

en.question: A company operates an ecommerce website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in an Auto Scaling group. The site is experiencing performance issues related to a high request rate from illegitimate external systems with changing IP addresses. The security team is worried about potential DDoS attacks against the website. The company must block the illegitimate incoming requests in a way that has a minimal impact on legitimate users. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Deploy Amazon Inspector and associate it with the ALB.
options.B: Deploy AWS WAF, associate it with the ALB, and configure a rate-limiting rule.
options.C: Deploy rules to the network ACLs associated with the ALB to block the incomingtraffic.
options.D: Deploy Amazon GuardDuty and enable rate-limiting protection when configuring GuardDuty.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS WAF is designed to protect web applications at the HTTP/S layer. An Application Load Balancer can be integrated with AWS WAF so that requests are allowed or blocked based on rules in a web ACL ([ALB integrations: AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-integrations.html)). AWS WAF rate-based rules specifically count incoming requests and rate-limit requests that arrive too quickly, aggregating requests according to configured criteria ([Using rate-based rule statements in AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-rate-based.html)). This matches the need to reduce high-rate illegitimate requests while minimizing impact on legitimate users.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon Inspector** is a vulnerability management service that scans workloads such as EC2 instances, container images, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure; it does not filter or rate-limit incoming web requests to an ALB ([What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).
- **C. Network ACL rules** can allow or deny traffic for subnets and are associated with subnets, not directly with an ALB. They also require rule criteria such as source/port/protocol, which is not suitable for changing illegitimate IP addresses and application-layer request-rate control ([Create a network ACL for your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/create-network-acl.html)).
- **D. Amazon GuardDuty** is a threat detection service that monitors and analyzes AWS data sources and logs to identify suspicious activity; it does not provide an ALB request rate-limiting control ([What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Auto Scaling 组中、位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个电子商务网站。该网站正遇到性能问题，原因是来自 IP 地址不断变化的非法外部系统的高请求率。安全团队担心网站可能遭受 DDoS 攻击。公司必须以对合法用户影响最小的方式阻止非法传入请求。解决方案架构师应该建议什么？

options.A: 部署 Amazon Inspector 并将其与 ALB 关联。
options.B: 部署 AWS WAF，将其与 ALB 关联，并配置速率限制规则。
options.C: 向与 ALB 关联的网络 ACL 部署规则，以阻止传入流量。
options.D: 部署 Amazon GuardDuty，并在配置 GuardDuty 时启用速率限制保护。

zh.explanation:
