For a 10-second hourly job, moving the Java code to a scheduled Lambda function better matches the event-driven workload and avoids managing compute infrastructure ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html), [Schedule a AWS Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个基于 Java 的作业。该作业每小时运行一次，运行需要 10 秒。该作业按计划间隔运行，并消耗 1 GB 内存。该实例的 CPU 利用率较低，除了作业使用可用最大 CPU 的短暂突增期间。该公司希望优化运行该作业的成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 将该作业容器化。将该作业作为 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 任务在 AWS Fargate 上运行，配置 0.5 个虚拟 CPU (vCPU) 和 1 GB 内存。
options.B: 将代码复制到具有 1 GB 内存的 AWS Lambda 函数中。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，每小时运行该代码。
options.C: 使用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 将该作业容器化。将容器安装在现有的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 中。确保计划在任务完成时停止容器。
options.D: 配置现有计划，使其在作业完成时停止 EC2 实例，并在下一个作业开始时重新启动 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

一个每小时运行一次、运行 10 秒的 Java 作业非常适合事件驱动的 serverless 函数。AWS Lambda 支持 Java 运行时：Lambda Java 文档说明“You can run Java code in AWS Lambda”，并列出了受支持的 Java 运行时，例如 Java 21、Java 17、Java 11 和 Java 8（[Building Lambda functions with Java](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-java.html)）。Lambda 还会管理计算基础设施，包括服务器和 OS 维护、容量预置以及自动扩展，因此公司不需要为了一个几乎一直处于空闲状态的作业而保持 EC2 实例运行（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。该作业的 1 GB 内存要求在 Lambda 可配置内存范围 128 MB 到 10,240 MB 之内，且 10 秒运行时间远低于 900 秒的 Lambda 超时限制；Lambda 还会按配置的内存比例分配 CPU 能力（[Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)）。EventBridge 可以使用 cron 或 rate 表达式运行计划工作负载，并且可以按计划调用 Lambda（[Schedule a AWS Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. ECS on Fargate**：Fargate 对于容器而言是 serverless 的，并且所提出的 0.5 vCPU/1 GB 组合是有效的，但对于一个非常短的每小时 10 秒作业来说，它增加了容器化和 ECS 任务开销。对于短时间、事件驱动的代码执行，Lambda 是更直接且成本优化的 serverless 选项。Fargate 任务定义需要显式的任务级 CPU 和内存大小设置（[Amazon ECS task definition differences for Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-tasks-services.html)）。
- **C. Container in an existing AMI**：这仍然依赖 EC2 实例/AMI，并不能消除底层实例管理或空闲容量问题。Lambda 将服务器和 OS 维护以及容量预置从客户责任中移除（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **D. Stop and restart the EC2 instance hourly**：这会减少一些空闲计算成本，但仍保留基于 EC2 的架构，增加启动/停止计划的复杂性，并且仍然需要实例管理。对于每小时运行 10 秒的作业，将 Java 代码迁移到计划 Lambda 函数更符合事件驱动型工作负载，并避免管理计算基础设施（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html), [Schedule a AWS Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to implement a backup strategy for Amazon EC2 data and multiple Amazon S3 buckets. Because of regulatory requirements, the company must retain backup files for a specific time period. The company must not alter the files for the duration of the retention period. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in governance mode. Create the required backup plan.
options.B: Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create the required automated snapshot policy.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway to create the backup. Configure the appropriate S3 Lifecycle management.
options.D: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in compliance mode. Create the required backup plan.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The requirement is a centralized backup strategy for **EC2 data and multiple S3 buckets** with regulatory retention, where backups **must not be altered** during the retention period. AWS Backup supports both **Amazon EC2 instances backed by EBS volumes** and **Amazon S3 data** as backup/restore resources, and AWS Backup backup plans can centrally define and apply backup requirements across AWS services ([AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). For S3 specifically, AWS Backup supports centralized backup and restore and can organize backups across services in a centralized encrypted backup vault ([Amazon S3 backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/s3-backups.html)).

AWS Backup Vault Lock in **compliance mode** is the key feature for this regulatory immutability requirement: AWS states that compliance mode is intended for vaults whose contents are expected to **never be deleted or altered until the data retention period is complete**, and once locked it is immutable. AWS also states that a compliance-mode vault lock **cannot be altered or deleted by any user or by AWS** ([AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)). Therefore, creating a backup vault with Vault Lock in compliance mode and using the required backup plan meets the requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Governance mode** is not sufficient because AWS states that a vault locked in governance mode can still be managed or deleted by users with appropriate IAM permissions. That does not satisfy “must not alter” for the retention period ([AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)).
- **B. Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager** automates snapshot lifecycles, but this option does not address multiple S3 bucket backups or the required immutable, non-alterable retention across EC2 and S3.
- **C. S3 File Gateway with S3 Lifecycle management** does not provide a centralized AWS Backup plan for EC2 and S3, and S3 Lifecycle management is for object transition/expiration, not the stated AWS Backup Vault Lock compliance-mode immutability requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司希望为 Amazon EC2 数据和多个 Amazon S3 存储桶实施备份策略。由于监管要求，公司必须将备份文件保留特定时间段。在保留期内，公司不得更改这些文件。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Backup 创建一个具有治理模式 vault lock 的备份保管库。创建所需的备份计划。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 创建所需的自动快照策略。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 File Gateway 创建备份。配置适当的 S3 Lifecycle 管理。
options.D: 使用 AWS Backup 创建一个具有合规模式 vault lock 的备份保管库。创建所需的备份计划。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

要求是为 **EC2 数据和多个 S3 存储桶**提供集中式备份策略，并满足监管保留要求，其中备份在保留期内**不得被更改**。AWS Backup 同时支持**由 EBS 卷支持的 Amazon EC2 实例**和 **Amazon S3 数据**作为备份/还原资源，并且 AWS Backup 备份计划可以在 AWS 服务之间集中定义和应用备份要求（[AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。对于 S3，AWS Backup 明确支持集中式备份和还原，并可以在集中式加密备份保管库中跨服务组织备份（[Amazon S3 backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/s3-backups.html)）。

**合规模式**下的 AWS Backup Vault Lock 是满足此监管不可变性要求的关键功能：AWS 表示，合规模式适用于其内容预期在数据保留期完成之前**永远不会被删除或更改**的保管库，并且一旦锁定便不可变。AWS 还表示，合规模式的 vault lock **不能被任何用户或 AWS 更改或删除**（[AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)）。因此，创建一个在合规模式下启用 Vault Lock 的备份保管库，并使用所需的备份计划，可以满足该要求。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. Governance mode** 不足够，因为 AWS 表示，在治理模式下锁定的保管库仍可由具有适当 IAM 权限的用户管理或删除。这不满足保留期内“不得更改”的要求（[AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)）。
- **B. Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager** 可自动化快照生命周期，但此选项没有解决多个 S3 存储桶备份，也没有解决跨 EC2 和 S3 的所需不可变、不可更改的保留要求。
- **C. S3 File Gateway with S3 Lifecycle management** 不提供面向 EC2 和 S3 的集中式 AWS Backup 计划，并且 S3 Lifecycle 管理用于对象转换/过期，而不是题述所需的 AWS Backup Vault Lock 合规模式不可变性要求。

en.question: A company has resources across multiple AWS Regions and accounts. A newly hired solutions architect discovers a previous employee did not provide details about the resources inventory. The solutions architect needs to build and map the relationship details of the various workloads across all accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory to generate a map view from the detailed view report.
options.B: Use AWS Step Functions to collect workload details. Build architecture diagrams of the workloads manually.
options.C: Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.
options.D: Use AWS X-Ray to view the workload details. Build architecture diagrams with relationships.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.**

Workload Discovery on AWS is designed for exactly this requirement: AWS describes it as a visualization tool that **automatically generates architecture diagrams** of AWS workloads and lets users build detailed workload visualizations from **live data**. It also maintains an inventory of AWS resources **across accounts and Regions**, maps relationships between them, and displays them in a web UI. Its features include viewing resources from multiple accounts and Regions in one place and exploring their relationships in a single UI. This is the most operationally efficient option because it automates both inventory discovery and relationship mapping. [Workload Discovery overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/solutions/latest/workload-discovery-on-aws/solution-overview.html), [features and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/solutions/latest/workload-discovery-on-aws/features-and-benefits.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Systems Manager Inventory** collects metadata from managed nodes on a schedule; AWS notes that Inventory “only collects metadata.” It is not a service for automatically generating multi-account, multi-Region workload architecture diagrams or mapping resource relationships. [Systems Manager Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-about.html)
- **B. Step Functions with manual diagrams** would require custom orchestration and manual diagram creation, which is less operationally efficient than using a purpose-built AWS solution that automatically discovers resources and creates diagrams.
- **D. AWS X-Ray** is for distributed tracing and application performance/troubleshooting. AWS documentation describes using X-Ray traces to find latency, debug errors, optimize workflows, and view trace/service maps for application requests—not to inventory all AWS resources across accounts and Regions or generate workload architecture diagrams. [X-Ray console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray-interface-console.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在多个 AWS Regions 和账户中拥有资源。一名新入职的解决方案架构师发现，前员工没有提供资源清单的详细信息。该解决方案架构师需要构建并映射所有账户中各种工作负载的关系详细信息。哪种解决方案能够以最高运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Inventory 从详细视图报告生成映射视图。
options.B: 使用 AWS Step Functions 收集工作负载详细信息。手动构建工作负载的架构图。
options.C: 使用 Workload Discovery on AWS 生成工作负载的架构图。
options.D: 使用 AWS X-Ray 查看工作负载详细信息。构建包含关系的架构图。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用 Workload Discovery on AWS 生成工作负载的架构图。**

Workload Discovery on AWS 正是为这一需求而设计的：AWS 将其描述为一种可视化工具，可**自动生成 AWS 工作负载的架构图**，并允许用户基于**实时数据**构建详细的工作负载可视化。它还会维护**跨账户和 Regions** 的 AWS 资源清单，映射它们之间的关系，并在 web UI 中显示。其功能包括在一个位置查看来自多个账户和 Regions 的资源，并在单个 UI 中探索它们之间的关系。这是运营效率最高的选项，因为它同时自动化了清单发现和关系映射。[Workload Discovery overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/solutions/latest/workload-discovery-on-aws/solution-overview.html), [features and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/solutions/latest/workload-discovery-on-aws/features-and-benefits.html)

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. Systems Manager Inventory** 按计划从托管节点收集元数据；AWS 指出 Inventory “only collects metadata”。它不是用于自动生成多账户、多 Region 工作负载架构图或映射资源关系的服务。[Systems Manager Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-about.html)
- **B. Step Functions with manual diagrams** 需要自定义编排并手动创建图表，其运营效率低于使用专门构建的 AWS 解决方案来自动发现资源并创建图表。
- **D. AWS X-Ray** 用于分布式跟踪以及应用程序性能/故障排查。AWS 文档描述的是使用 X-Ray traces 来查找延迟、调试错误、优化工作流，并查看应用程序请求的 trace/service maps，而不是对跨账户和 Regions 的所有 AWS 资源进行清单盘点或生成工作负载架构图。[X-Ray console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray-interface-console.html)

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations. The company wants to operate some of its AWS accounts with different budgets. The company wants to receive alerts and automatically prevent provisioning of additional resources on AWS accounts when the allocated budget threshold is met during a specific period. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Cost and Usage Reports section of the required AWS accounts.
options.B: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget. Set the budget amount under the Billing dashboards of the required AWS accounts.
options.C: Create an IAM user for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.
options.D: Create an IAM role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions with the required permissions.
options.E: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate config rule to prevent provisioning of additional resources.
options.F: Add an alert to notify the company when each account meets its budget threshold. Add a budget action that selects the IAM identity created with the appropriate service control policy (SCP) to prevent provisioning of additional resources.

en.explanation:
The correct combination is **B, D, and F**.

- **B is correct**: AWS Budgets is created from the AWS Billing and Cost Management area. The AWS Budgets documentation says single accounts, management accounts, and member accounts in an organization can create budgets, and the console steps are to open the Billing and Cost Management console and choose **Budgets**. AWS Budgets can track costs and usage and send alerts when thresholds are approached or exceeded ([Creating a budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create.html), [Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)).
- **D is correct**: To use budget actions, AWS says you **must create a service role for AWS Budgets**; a service role is an IAM role that the service assumes to perform actions on your behalf ([Setting up a role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-action-role.html)).
- **F is correct**: AWS Budgets actions can apply an **IAM policy or a service control policy (SCP)**, and AWS specifically notes that SCPs can be used so that you do not provision new resources during the budget period. From the management account, an SCP can be applied to another account ([Configuring budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-controls.html)). SCPs restrict the maximum permissions available to IAM users and roles in member accounts, which supports preventing additional provisioning ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Cost and Usage Reports are not where budgets are set. Budgets are created under Billing and Cost Management/Budgets, not under the Cost and Usage Reports section ([Creating a budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create.html)).
- **C**: AWS Budgets requires a **service role**, not an IAM user, to run budget actions ([Setting up a role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-action-role.html)).
- **E**: AWS Budgets actions support IAM policies, SCPs, and targeting EC2/RDS instances; AWS Config rules are not listed as a Budgets action mechanism for preventing provisioning ([Configuring budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-controls.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations。该公司希望为其部分 AWS 账户设置不同的预算。公司希望在特定期间内达到分配的预算阈值时接收提醒，并自动阻止在 AWS 账户上预置额外资源。哪组解决方案可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Budgets 创建预算。在所需 AWS 账户的 Cost and Usage Reports 部分下设置预算金额。
options.B: 使用 AWS Budgets 创建预算。在所需 AWS 账户的 Billing dashboards 下设置预算金额。
options.C: 为 AWS Budgets 创建一个 IAM 用户，以使用所需权限运行预算操作。
options.D: 为 AWS Budgets 创建一个 IAM 角色，以使用所需权限运行预算操作。
options.E: 添加提醒，以便在每个账户达到其预算阈值时通知公司。添加一个预算操作，该操作选择使用适当 config rule 创建的 IAM 身份，以阻止预置额外资源。
options.F: 添加提醒，以便在每个账户达到其预算阈值时通知公司。添加一个预算操作，该操作选择使用适当 service control policy (SCP) 创建的 IAM 身份，以阻止预置额外资源。

zh.explanation:
正确组合是 **B、D 和 F**。

- **B 正确**：AWS Budgets 是从 AWS Billing and Cost Management 区域创建的。AWS Budgets 文档说明，组织中的单个账户、管理账户和成员账户都可以创建预算，控制台步骤是打开 Billing and Cost Management 控制台并选择 **Budgets**。AWS Budgets 可以跟踪成本和使用量，并在接近或超过阈值时发送提醒（[Creating a budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create.html)、[Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)）。
- **D 正确**：要使用预算操作，AWS 表示你**必须为 AWS Budgets 创建一个服务角色**；服务角色是由服务代入以代表你执行操作的 IAM 角色（[Setting up a role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-action-role.html)）。
- **F 正确**：AWS Budgets 操作可以应用 **IAM policy 或 service control policy (SCP)**，并且 AWS 特别指出可以使用 SCP，以便在预算期间不预置新资源。从管理账户，可以将 SCP 应用于另一个账户（[Configuring budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-controls.html)）。SCP 会限制成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色可用的最大权限，这有助于阻止额外预置（[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：Cost and Usage Reports 不是设置预算的位置。预算是在 Billing and Cost Management/Budgets 下创建的，而不是在 Cost and Usage Reports 部分下创建（[Creating a budget](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-create.html)）。
- **C**：AWS Budgets 需要一个**服务角色**来运行预算操作，而不是 IAM 用户（[Setting up a role for AWS Budgets to run budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-action-role.html)）。
- **E**：AWS Budgets 操作支持 IAM policies、SCPs，以及以 EC2/RDS 实例为目标；AWS Config rules 未被列为用于阻止预置的 Budgets 操作机制（[Configuring budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-controls.html)）。

en.question: A company runs applications on Amazon EC2 instances in one AWS Region. The company wants to back up the EC2 instances to a second Region. The company also wants to provision EC2 resources in the second Region and manage the EC2 instances centrally from one AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a disaster recovery (DR) plan that has a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Configure data replication.
options.B: Create point-in-time Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots of the EC2 instances. Copy the snapshots to the second Region periodically.
options.C: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup. Configure cross-Region backup to the second Region for the EC2 instances.
options.D: Deploy a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region. Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data from the source Region to the second Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Backup is designed for this requirement: it provides **centralized backup management** through a console/APIs/CLI and lets you define **policy-based backup plans** for AWS resources. AWS documentation also states that AWS Backup supports **Amazon EC2 instances backed by EBS volumes** and that **cross-Region backup** can copy backups to other AWS Regions automatically as part of a scheduled backup plan ([AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). The feature matrix specifically shows Amazon EC2 supports **Cross-Region backup** and **incremental backup**, which helps minimize backup storage costs compared with full copies every time ([AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)). In a backup plan, the console option **Copy to destination** creates a cross-Region copy for eligible resources ([Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Keeping a similar number of EC2 instances running in the second Region is a warm/active DR approach, not just backup. It adds ongoing compute cost, so it is not the most cost-effective for backups.
- **B:** Periodically copying EBS snapshots can back up volume data, but it is a more manual/native-snapshot approach and does not provide the same centralized, policy-based backup management for EC2 resources that AWS Backup provides. The question explicitly asks for central management and cost-effective cross-Region backup.
- **D:** Deploying a similar number of EC2 instances in the second Region again incurs unnecessary ongoing compute cost. AWS DataSync is for data transfer, not centralized EC2 backup plan management, and it would not be the most cost-effective solution here.

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 AWS Region 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行应用程序。该公司希望将 EC2 实例备份到第二个 Region。该公司还希望在第二个 Region 中预置 EC2 资源，并从一个 AWS 账户集中管理这些 EC2 实例。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个灾难恢复 (DR) 计划，在第二个 Region 中部署数量相近的 EC2 实例。配置数据复制。
options.B: 为 EC2 实例创建时间点 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快照。定期将快照复制到第二个 Region。
options.C: 使用 AWS Backup 创建备份计划。为 EC2 实例配置到第二个 Region 的跨 Region 备份。
options.D: 在第二个 Region 中部署数量相近的 EC2 实例。使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从源 Region 传输到第二个 Region。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Backup 正是为此类需求而设计的：它通过控制台/API/CLI 提供**集中式备份管理**，并允许你为 AWS 资源定义**基于策略的备份计划**。AWS 文档还说明，AWS Backup 支持**由 EBS 卷支持的 Amazon EC2 实例**，并且**跨 Region 备份**可以作为计划备份的一部分，自动将备份复制到其他 AWS Regions（[AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。功能矩阵明确显示 Amazon EC2 支持**跨 Region 备份**和**增量备份**，与每次都进行完整复制相比，这有助于最大限度降低备份存储成本（[AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)）。在备份计划中，控制台选项 **Copy to destination** 会为符合条件的资源创建跨 Region 副本（[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 在第二个 Region 中保持运行数量相近的 EC2 实例是一种温备用/主动式 DR 方法，而不仅仅是备份。它会增加持续的计算成本，因此对于备份来说不是最具成本效益的方案。
- **B:** 定期复制 EBS 快照可以备份卷数据，但这是一种更偏手动/原生快照的方法，并不能提供 AWS Backup 为 EC2 资源提供的同等集中式、基于策略的备份管理。题目明确要求集中管理和具成本效益的跨 Region 备份。
- **D:** 在第二个 Region 中部署数量相近的 EC2 实例同样会产生不必要的持续计算成本。AWS DataSync 用于数据传输，而不是集中式 EC2 备份计划管理，并且在这里也不是最具成本效益的解决方案。

en.question: A company that uses AWS is building an application to transfer data to a product manufacturer. The company has its own identity provider (IdP). The company wants the IdP to authenticate application users while the users use the application to transfer data. The company must use Applicability Statement 2 (AS2) protocol. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.B: Use Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) task for IdP authentication.
options.C: Use AWS Transfer Family to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
options.D: Use AWS Storage Gateway to transfer the data. Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool for IdP authentication.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

AWS Transfer Family is the service that matches the required transfer protocol: the AWS documentation says Transfer Family can transfer files into and out of Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS over several protocols, including **Applicability Statement 2 (AS2)** ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). For authentication, Transfer Family supports using an existing identity provider by integrating it with an **AWS Lambda function**, which authenticates and authorizes users for access to S3 or EFS ([custom identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/custom-idp-intro.html)). The Lambda integration documentation also describes Lambda functions used for authentication and the values Transfer Family accepts from Lambda for custom identity providers ([Lambda custom IdP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/custom-lambda-idp.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. AWS DataSync + Lambda**: Lambda could be used to build custom logic, but this option does not use the AWS service documented for AS2 transfers. Transfer Family is explicitly documented as supporting AS2.
- **B. Amazon AppFlow + ECS**: This does not match the documented Transfer Family AS2 file transfer capability, and ECS is not the documented custom IdP integration mechanism for Transfer Family authentication.
- **D. AWS Storage Gateway + Cognito identity pool**: This does not provide the documented AS2 transfer capability. The documented approach for using an existing IdP with Transfer Family is integration through Lambda, not a Cognito identity pool for this AS2 transfer requirement.

zh.question: 一家使用 AWS 的公司正在构建一个应用程序，用于将数据传输给一家产品制造商。该公司拥有自己的身份提供商 (IdP)。公司希望在用户使用该应用程序传输数据时，由 IdP 对应用程序用户进行身份验证。公司必须使用 Applicability Statement 2 (AS2) 协议。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 传输数据。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数用于 IdP 身份验证。
options.B: 使用 Amazon AppFlow 流传输数据。创建一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 任务用于 IdP 身份验证。
options.C: 使用 AWS Transfer Family 传输数据。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数用于 IdP 身份验证。
options.D: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway 传输数据。创建一个 Amazon Cognito 身份池用于 IdP 身份验证。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

AWS Transfer Family 是符合所需传输协议的服务：AWS 文档说明 Transfer Family 可以通过多种协议在 Amazon S3 或 Amazon EFS 中传入和传出文件，其中包括 **Applicability Statement 2 (AS2)**（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。对于身份验证，Transfer Family 支持通过将现有身份提供商与 **AWS Lambda function** 集成来使用该身份提供商，该函数会对用户进行身份验证和授权，使其能够访问 S3 或 EFS（[custom identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/custom-idp-intro.html)）。Lambda 集成文档还描述了用于身份验证的 Lambda 函数，以及 Transfer Family 从 Lambda 接受的用于自定义身份提供商的值（[Lambda custom IdP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/custom-lambda-idp.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. AWS DataSync + Lambda**：Lambda 可用于构建自定义逻辑，但此选项没有使用 AWS 文档中针对 AS2 传输的服务。Transfer Family 已明确记录为支持 AS2。
- **B. Amazon AppFlow + ECS**：这不符合已记录的 Transfer Family AS2 文件传输功能，并且 ECS 也不是 Transfer Family 身份验证的已记录自定义 IdP 集成机制。
- **D. AWS Storage Gateway + Cognito identity pool**：这不提供已记录的 AS2 传输功能。对于将现有 IdP 与 Transfer Family 配合使用，文档中记录的方法是通过 Lambda 集成，而不是针对这一 AS2 传输要求使用 Cognito identity pool。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a RESTAPI in Amazon API Gateway for a cash payback service. The application requires 1 GB of memory and 2 GB of storage for its computation resources. The application will require that the data is in a relational format. Which additional combination ofAWS services will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Amazon EC2
options.B: AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon RDS
options.D: Amazon DynamoDB
options.E: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS)

en.explanation:
The best combination is **B. AWS Lambda** and **C. Amazon RDS**.

- **B is correct:** API Gateway can front compute logic, and Lambda provides compute with the least server administration because it “runs code without the need to manage servers” and scales automatically. The stated compute needs fit Lambda quotas: memory can be configured from **128 MB to 10,240 MB**, and `/tmp` storage can be configured from **512 MB to 10,240 MB**, so **1 GB memory** and **2 GB storage** are supported ([Lambda overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html), [Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)).
- **C is correct:** The data must be relational. Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service; AWS states that RDS is recommended as the default choice for most relational database deployments and that it manages backups, patching, failure detection, recovery, and other tasks, reducing administrative effort ([Amazon RDS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **A. Amazon EC2:** EC2 could run the application, but it requires more server/OS administration than Lambda. For databases on EC2, AWS notes that you spend more time managing software and hardware compared with RDS ([Amazon RDS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
- **D. Amazon DynamoDB:** DynamoDB is a NoSQL database. AWS contrasts relational database systems with “a NoSQL database such as DynamoDB,” so it does not match the requirement for relational data ([DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)).
- **E. Amazon EKS:** EKS is a managed Kubernetes service, but it adds Kubernetes cluster/container orchestration administration and is not the least-effort compute choice for this API compared with serverless Lambda ([Amazon EKS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在 Amazon API Gateway 中为现金返现服务设计一个 RESTAPI。该应用程序的计算资源需要 1 GB 内存和 2 GB 存储。该应用程序要求数据采用关系型格式。哪两个额外的 AWS 服务组合能够以最少的管理工作满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: Amazon EC2
options.B: AWS Lambda
options.C: Amazon RDS
options.D: Amazon DynamoDB
options.E: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Services (Amazon EKS)

zh.explanation:
最佳组合是 **B. AWS Lambda** 和 **C. Amazon RDS**。

- **B 正确：** API Gateway 可以作为计算逻辑的前端，而 Lambda 提供计算能力，并且由于它“无需管理服务器即可运行代码”且会自动扩展，因此服务器管理工作最少。题目中给出的计算需求符合 Lambda 配额：内存可配置为 **128 MB 到 10,240 MB**，`/tmp` 存储可配置为 **512 MB 到 10,240 MB**，因此支持 **1 GB memory** 和 **2 GB storage**（[Lambda overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)，[Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)）。
- **C 正确：** 数据必须是关系型的。Amazon RDS 是一项托管式关系数据库服务；AWS 表示，RDS 被推荐作为大多数关系数据库部署的默认选择，并且它会管理备份、修补、故障检测、恢复以及其他任务，从而减少管理工作（[Amazon RDS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。错误选项：

- **A. Amazon EC2:** EC2 可以运行该应用程序，但与 Lambda 相比，它需要更多服务器/操作系统管理。对于 EC2 上的数据库，AWS 指出，与 RDS 相比，你需要花更多时间管理软件和硬件（[Amazon RDS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
- **D. Amazon DynamoDB:** DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 数据库。AWS 将关系数据库系统与“a NoSQL database such as DynamoDB”进行对比，因此它不符合关系型数据的要求（[DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。
- **E. Amazon EKS:** EKS 是一项托管式 Kubernetes 服务，但它会增加 Kubernetes 集群/容器编排管理工作；与无服务器 Lambda 相比，它不是此 API 的最低工作量计算选择（[Amazon EKS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)）。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to run workloads within multiple AWS accounts. A tagging policy adds department tags to AWS resources when the company creates tags. An accounting team needs to determine spending on Amazon EC2 consumption. The accounting team must determine which departments are responsible for the costs regardless ofAWS account. The accounting team has access to AWS Cost Explorer for all AWS accounts within the organization and needs to access all reports from Cost Explorer. Which solution meets these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.B: From the Organizations management account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.C: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate a user-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by the tag name, and filter by EC2.
options.D: From the Organizations member account billing console, activate an AWS-defined cost allocation tag named department. Create one cost report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag name, and filter by EC2.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The `department` tag is created and applied by the company/tagging policy, so it is a **user-defined** cost allocation tag, not an AWS-defined/AWS-generated tag. AWS states that user-defined tags are defined, created, and applied by the customer, while AWS-generated tags are created and applied by AWS; both must be activated before they appear in Cost Explorer or cost allocation reports ([AWS Billing cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). AWS also states that after user-defined tags are created and applied, they can be activated for cost allocation, and consistent tag keys help organize costs ([Using user-defined cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/custom-tags.html)).

Because the company uses AWS Organizations and the accounting team needs organization-wide reporting, activation must be done from the **Organizations management account**: AWS notes that only the management account in an organization, and standalone accounts, have access to the cost allocation tags manager in the Billing console ([AWS Billing cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). Cost Explorer supports analyzing cost and usage with filters and groupings ([AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)), and AWS notes that activated cost allocation tags can be used to organize costs and filter views in Cost Explorer ([AWS Billing cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). Therefore, one Cost Explorer report grouped by the `department` tag and filtered to EC2 is the most operationally efficient solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** `department` is not an AWS-defined/AWS-generated tag. It is a company-defined business tag, so it must be activated as a **user-defined** cost allocation tag.
- **C:** Member accounts in an AWS Organization do not have access to the cost allocation tags manager for the organization; activation should be performed in the management account.
- **D:** Incorrect for both reasons: it uses a member account and treats `department` as an AWS-defined tag instead of a user-defined tag.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 在多个 AWS 账户中运行工作负载。标记策略会在公司创建标签时向 AWS 资源添加部门标签。会计团队需要确定 Amazon EC2 使用量的支出。会计团队必须确定哪些部门应对这些成本负责，无论 AWS 账户如何。会计团队可以访问组织内所有 AWS 账户的 AWS Cost Explorer，并且需要访问 Cost Explorer 中的所有报告。哪种解决方案以最高运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 Organizations 管理账户的账单控制台中，激活名为 department 的用户定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一个按标签名称分组并按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。
options.B: 从 Organizations 管理账户的账单控制台中，激活名为 department 的 AWS 定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一个按标签名称分组并按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。
options.C: 从 Organizations 成员账户的账单控制台中，激活名为 department 的用户定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一个按标签名称分组并按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。
options.D: 从 Organizations 成员账户的账单控制台中，激活名为 department 的 AWS 定义成本分配标签。在 Cost Explorer 中创建一个按标签名称分组并按 EC2 筛选的成本报告。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

`department` 标签由公司/标记策略创建并应用，因此它是一个**用户定义**成本分配标签，而不是 AWS 定义/AWS 生成的标签。AWS 说明，用户定义标签由客户定义、创建和应用，而 AWS 生成标签由 AWS 创建和应用；两者都必须先激活，才会显示在 Cost Explorer 或成本分配报告中（[AWS Billing cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。AWS 还说明，在创建并应用用户定义标签后，可以将其激活用于成本分配，并且一致的标签键有助于组织成本（[Using user-defined cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/custom-tags.html)）。由于公司使用 AWS Organizations，且会计团队需要组织范围的报告，因此必须从 **Organizations management account** 执行激活：AWS 指出，只有组织中的管理账户以及独立账户才能访问 Billing 控制台中的成本分配标签管理器（[AWS Billing cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。Cost Explorer 支持使用筛选条件和分组来分析成本和使用情况（[AWS Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)），并且 AWS 指出，已激活的成本分配标签可用于组织成本并在 Cost Explorer 中筛选视图（[AWS Billing cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。因此，创建一个按 `department` 标签分组并筛选到 EC2 的 Cost Explorer 报告，是运营效率最高的解决方案。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** `department` 不是 AWS 定义/AWS 生成的标签。它是公司定义的业务标签，因此必须作为**用户定义**成本分配标签激活。
- **C:** AWS Organization 中的成员账户无法访问组织的成本分配标签管理器；应在管理账户中执行激活。
- **D:** 两个原因都不正确：它使用了成员账户，并且将 `department` 视为 AWS 定义标签，而不是用户定义标签。

en.question: A company wants to securely exchange data between its software as a service (SaaS) application Salesforce account and Amazon S3. The company must encrypt the data at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys (CMKs). The company must also encrypt the data in transit. The company has enabled API access for the Salesforce account.

options.A: Create AWS Lambda functions to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.B: Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Define the task to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.C: Create Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
options.D: Create a custom connector for Salesforce to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Create Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.**

Amazon AppFlow is the managed AWS service designed for this SaaS-to-AWS data transfer use case. The Salesforce connector documentation states that Salesforce is supported as a data source and that a flow using Salesforce as the data source can use **Amazon S3** as a supported destination. It also specifically lists the prerequisite that the Salesforce account must be enabled for API access, matching the scenario ([Salesforce connector for Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/salesforce.html)).

This also satisfies the security requirements: when Amazon S3 is the destination, AppFlow can use an AWS managed CMK or a **customer managed CMK** to encrypt data in the S3 bucket with SSE-KMS, and AppFlow secures all data in transit with **TLS 1.2** ([Data protection in Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/data-protection.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Lambda functions** could be custom-built to call Salesforce APIs and write to S3, but this is unnecessary operational work when Amazon AppFlow already provides a managed Salesforce-to-S3 connector with KMS and TLS support.
- **B. Step Functions** orchestrates workflows; it does not by itself provide a native Salesforce-to-S3 secure data connector. It would still require custom integration tasks.
- **D. Custom connector for Salesforce** is unnecessary because Salesforce is already a supported Amazon AppFlow connector and Amazon S3 is a supported destination for Salesforce flows ([Salesforce connector for Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/salesforce.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望在其软件即服务 (SaaS) 应用程序 Salesforce 账户与 Amazon S3 之间安全地交换数据。该公司必须使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥 (CMKs) 对静态数据进行加密。该公司还必须对传输中的数据进行加密。该公司已为 Salesforce 账户启用 API 访问。

options.A: 创建 AWS Lambda 函数，以便将数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 创建 AWS Step Functions 工作流。定义任务，以便将数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。
options.C: 创建 Amazon AppFlow 流，以便将数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 为 Salesforce 创建自定义连接器，以便将数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 创建 Amazon AppFlow 流，以便将数据从 Salesforce 安全地传输到 Amazon S3。**

Amazon AppFlow 是专为这种 SaaS 到 AWS 数据传输使用场景而设计的托管 AWS 服务。Salesforce 连接器文档说明，Salesforce 受支持作为数据源，并且使用 Salesforce 作为数据源的流可以使用 **Amazon S3** 作为受支持的目标。它还特别列出了先决条件：Salesforce 账户必须启用 API 访问，这与场景相符（[Salesforce connector for Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/salesforce.html)）。这也满足安全要求：当 Amazon S3 是目标时，AppFlow 可以使用 AWS 托管 CMK 或 **客户托管 CMK** 通过 SSE-KMS 对 S3 存储桶中的数据进行加密，并且 AppFlow 使用 **TLS 1.2** 保护所有传输中的数据（[Data protection in Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/data-protection.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. Lambda functions** 可以自定义构建来调用 Salesforce APIs 并写入 S3，但当 Amazon AppFlow 已经提供具有 KMS 和 TLS 支持的托管 Salesforce 到 S3 连接器时，这会带来不必要的运维工作。
- **B. Step Functions** 用于编排工作流；它本身并不提供原生的 Salesforce 到 S3 安全数据连接器。它仍然需要自定义集成任务。
- **D. Custom connector for Salesforce** 是不必要的，因为 Salesforce 已经是受支持的 Amazon AppFlow 连接器，并且 Amazon S3 是 Salesforce 流的受支持目标（[Salesforce connector for Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/salesforce.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing a mobile gaming app in a single AWS Region. The app runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The company stores the app data in Amazon DynamoDB. The app communicates by using TCP traffic and UDP traffic between the users and the servers. The application will be used globally. The company wants to ensure the lowest possible latency for all users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Global Accelerator to create an accelerator. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) behind an accelerator endpoint that uses Global Accelerator integration and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the ALB.
options.B: Use AWS Global Accelerator to create an accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind an accelerator endpoint that uses Global Accelerator integration and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the NLB.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudFront content delivery network (CDN) endpoint. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind the endpoint and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the NLB. Update CloudFront to use the NLB as the origin.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront content delivery network (CDN) endpoint. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) behind the endpoint and listening on the TCP and UDP ports. Update the Auto Scaling group to register instances on the ALB. Update CloudFront to use the ALB as the origin.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Global Accelerator is designed to improve performance for applications used by a global audience by routing traffic over the AWS global network to optimal endpoints based on factors such as client location and endpoint health. Its standard accelerator endpoints can include **Network Load Balancers** and other resources, and its listeners can be configured for **TCP, UDP, or both TCP and UDP** protocols ([Global Accelerator components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-components.html)). A Network Load Balancer supports listener protocols including **TCP, UDP, and TCP_UDP** on ports 1-65535, which matches the mobile gaming app’s TCP and UDP traffic requirements ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)). Elastic Load Balancing also integrates with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling so instances launched by Auto Scaling are automatically registered with the load balancer ([Elastic Load Balancing related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An Application Load Balancer is not suitable because ALB listeners support only **HTTP and HTTPS**, not raw TCP/UDP game traffic ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
- **C:** Although an NLB supports TCP/UDP, CloudFront distributions are for web content origins and communicate with custom origins using **HTTP and/or HTTPS**, not arbitrary UDP/TCP application traffic ([CloudFront origin protocol settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)). Global Accelerator is the correct edge service for non-HTTP TCP/UDP latency optimization.
- **D:** This has both problems: CloudFront is not the right service for arbitrary TCP/UDP traffic, and ALB does not support TCP/UDP listeners; ALB supports only HTTP/HTTPS ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在单个 AWS Region 中开发一款移动游戏应用。该应用在 Auto Scaling group 中的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。该公司将应用数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。该应用在用户和服务器之间使用 TCP 流量和 UDP 流量进行通信。该应用将在全球范围内使用。该公司希望确保所有用户都获得尽可能低的延迟。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器。在使用 Global Accelerator 集成并监听 TCP 和 UDP 端口的加速器端点后面创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。更新 Auto Scaling group 以将实例注册到 ALB。
options.B: 使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器。在使用 Global Accelerator 集成并监听 TCP 和 UDP 端口的加速器端点后面创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。更新 Auto Scaling group 以将实例注册到 NLB。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 内容分发网络 (CDN) 端点。在该端点后面创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，并监听 TCP 和 UDP 端口。更新 Auto Scaling group 以将实例注册到 NLB。更新 CloudFront 以使用 NLB 作为源站。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 内容分发网络 (CDN) 端点。在该端点后面创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，并监听 TCP 和 UDP 端口。更新 Auto Scaling group 以将实例注册到 ALB。更新 CloudFront 以使用 ALB 作为源站。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

AWS Global Accelerator 旨在通过 AWS global network 将流量路由到最佳端点，从而提升面向全球用户的应用程序性能；选择最佳端点时会基于客户端位置和端点运行状况等因素。其标准加速器端点可以包括 **Network Load Balancers** 和其他资源，并且其侦听器可配置为 **TCP、UDP，或同时支持 TCP 和 UDP** 协议（[Global Accelerator components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-components.html)）。Network Load Balancer 支持的侦听器协议包括端口 1-65535 上的 **TCP、UDP 和 TCP_UDP**，这与该移动游戏应用的 TCP 和 UDP 流量要求相匹配（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。Elastic Load Balancing 还与 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 集成，因此由 Auto Scaling 启动的实例会自动注册到负载均衡器（[Elastic Load Balancing related services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Application Load Balancer 不适合，因为 ALB 侦听器仅支持 **HTTP 和 HTTPS**，不支持原始 TCP/UDP 游戏流量（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
- **C:** 尽管 NLB 支持 TCP/UDP，但 CloudFront 分配用于 Web 内容源站，并使用 **HTTP 和/或 HTTPS** 与自定义源站通信，而不是任意 UDP/TCP 应用程序流量（[CloudFront origin protocol settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesOrigin.html)）。Global Accelerator 才是用于非 HTTP TCP/UDP 延迟优化的正确边缘服务。
- **D:** 该选项同时存在两个问题：CloudFront 不是处理任意 TCP/UDP 流量的合适服务，并且 ALB 不支持 TCP/UDP 侦听器；ALB 仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。

en.question: A company has an application that processes customer orders. The company hosts the application on an Amazon EC2 instance that saves the orders to an Amazon Aurora database. Occasionally when traffic is high the workload does not process orders fast enough. What should a solutions architect do to write the orders reliably to the database as quickly as possible?

options.A: Increase the instance size of the EC2 instance when traffic is high. Write orders to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Subscribe the database endpoint to the SNS topic.
options.B: Write orders to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer to read from the SQS queue and process orders into the database.
options.C: Write orders to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Subscribe the database endpoint to the SNS topic. Use EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer to read from the SNS topic.
options.D: Write orders to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue when the EC2 instance reaches CPU threshold limits. Use scheduled scaling of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer to read from the SQS queue and process orders into the database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Writing each order to an Amazon SQS queue decouples order intake from database processing and gives reliable buffering during spikes. AWS states that SQS stores copies of messages on multiple servers for redundancy and high availability, providing at-least-once delivery semantics ([Amazon SQS at-least-once delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues-at-least-once-delivery.html)). Then a fleet of EC2 worker instances can process the queue and write to Aurora. AWS specifically documents scaling an Auto Scaling group in response to load in an SQS queue, with EC2 instances processing messages from the queue and dynamic scaling based on backlog per instance ([Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)). This addresses both requirements: accept/write orders quickly to a durable queue and scale processing capacity when traffic increases.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Increasing one EC2 instance is vertical scaling and does not reliably buffer orders. Also, SNS is publish/subscribe fanout, not a database write queue; AWS lists SNS subscriber endpoint types such as SQS, Lambda, HTTP(S), email, mobile push/SMS, and Firehose—not an Aurora database endpoint ([What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **C:** SNS can fan out to subscribers, but it is not the best service for durable work queuing to database writer workers. The option also incorrectly implies EC2 instances read from an SNS topic; SNS pushes to supported endpoints, whereas SQS is the service designed for workers to poll and process messages.
- **D:** Sending orders to SQS only after a CPU threshold is reached risks slow or failed direct database writes before that threshold. Scheduled scaling is also inappropriate for occasional unpredictable high traffic; AWS recommends dynamic scaling of an Auto Scaling group based on SQS queue backlog/load ([Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个处理客户订单的应用程序。该公司将该应用程序托管在一个 Amazon EC2 实例上，该实例将订单保存到 Amazon Aurora 数据库。偶尔在流量较高时，工作负载处理订单的速度不够快。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施，以尽可能快速且可靠地将订单写入数据库？

options.A: 在流量较高时增加 EC2 实例的实例大小。将订单写入 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)。将数据库端点订阅到 SNS 主题。
options.B: 将订单写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例从 SQS 队列读取并将订单处理到数据库中。
options.C: 将订单写入 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)。将数据库端点订阅到 SNS 主题。使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例从 SNS 主题读取。
options.D: 当 EC2 实例达到 CPU 阈值限制时，将订单写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中 EC2 实例的计划扩展，从 SQS 队列读取并将订单处理到数据库中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 将每个订单写入 Amazon SQS 队列，可以将订单接收与数据库处理解耦，并在流量峰值期间提供可靠的缓冲。AWS 表示，SQS 会在多台服务器上存储消息副本以实现冗余和高可用性，并提供至少一次传输语义（[Amazon SQS at-least-once delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues-at-least-once-delivery.html)）。然后，一组 EC2 工作实例可以处理该队列并写入 Aurora。AWS 明确记录了如何根据 SQS 队列中的负载扩展 Auto Scaling 组，其中 EC2 实例从队列处理消息，并基于每个实例的积压量进行动态扩展（[Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。这同时满足两个要求：快速接受/写入订单到持久队列，并在流量增加时扩展处理能力。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 增加单个 EC2 实例的规格属于垂直扩展，不能可靠地缓冲订单。此外，SNS 是发布/订阅扇出服务，不是数据库写入队列；AWS 列出的 SNS 订阅者端点类型包括 SQS、Lambda、HTTP(S)、电子邮件、移动推送/SMS 和 Firehose，而不是 Aurora 数据库端点（[What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **C:** SNS 可以向订阅者扇出消息，但它并不是面向数据库写入工作进程进行持久工作排队的最佳服务。该选项还错误地暗示 EC2 实例会从 SNS 主题读取；SNS 会推送到受支持的端点，而 SQS 才是为工作进程轮询和处理消息而设计的服务。
- **D:** 只有在达到 CPU 阈值后才将订单发送到 SQS，可能会在达到该阈值之前导致直接数据库写入变慢或失败。计划扩展也不适合偶发且不可预测的高流量；AWS 建议根据 SQS 队列积压/负载对 Auto Scaling 组进行动态扩展（[Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。

en.question: An IoT company is releasing a mattress that has sensors to collect data about a user’s sleep. The sensors will send data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The sensors collect approximately 2 MB of data every night for each mattress. The company must process and summarize the data for each mattress. The results need to be available as soon as possible. Data processing will require 1 GB of memory and will finish within 30 seconds. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use AWS Glue with a Scala job
options.B: Use Amazon EMR with an Apache Spark script
options.C: Use AWS Lambda with a Python script
options.D: Use AWS Glue with a PySpark job

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use AWS Lambda with a Python script.**

Lambda is the best fit because this is a small, event-driven, short-running processing task. Amazon S3 can send an event to a Lambda function when an object is created, and S3 invokes the function asynchronously with details about the object, so processing can start as soon as each nightly data file lands in S3 ([AWS Lambda S3 integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)). The workload requirements also fit Lambda limits: Lambda supports memory allocation from **128 MB to 10,240 MB**, and a function timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)**, which easily covers the required **1 GB memory** and **30-second** runtime ([Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)). Lambda also runs code using language-specific runtimes such as **Python** and manages capacity provisioning and automatic scaling for you ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Glue with a Scala job** – AWS Glue is intended for ETL/data integration jobs and is more heavyweight than necessary for processing ~2 MB per mattress in under 30 seconds. It is not the most cost-effective choice for per-object, low-latency processing.
- **B. Amazon EMR with Apache Spark** – EMR/Spark is designed for distributed big data processing. Running Spark infrastructure for many small 2 MB files would add unnecessary operational and cost overhead.
- **D. AWS Glue with a PySpark job** – Although PySpark can process data in S3, it is also a distributed ETL approach and is excessive for this small, fast, event-driven workload.

Therefore, Lambda triggered by S3 object creation provides the simplest, fastest, and most cost-effective solution.

zh.question: 一家 IoT 公司正在发布一款带有传感器的床垫，用于收集用户睡眠相关数据。传感器会将数据发送到 Amazon S3 存储桶。对于每张床垫，传感器每晚大约收集 2 MB 的数据。公司必须处理并汇总每张床垫的数据。结果需要尽快可用。数据处理将需要 1 GB 内存，并将在 30 秒内完成。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Glue 和 Scala 作业
options.B: 使用 Amazon EMR 和 Apache Spark 脚本
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda 和 Python 脚本
options.D: 使用 AWS Glue 和 PySpark 作业

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用 AWS Lambda 和 Python 脚本。**

Lambda 是最佳选择，因为这是一个小型、事件驱动、运行时间短的处理任务。当对象被创建时，Amazon S3 可以向 Lambda 函数发送事件，并且 S3 会以异步方式调用该函数，同时提供有关对象的详细信息，因此每晚的数据文件一落入 S3，就可以立即开始处理（[AWS Lambda S3 integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)）。该工作负载的需求也符合 Lambda 限制：Lambda 支持从 **128 MB 到 10,240 MB** 的内存分配，并且函数超时时间为 **900 秒（15 分钟）**，这轻松覆盖所需的 **1 GB 内存** 和 **30 秒** 运行时间（[Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)）。Lambda 还可以使用特定语言运行时（例如 **Python**）运行代码，并为你管理容量预置和自动扩展（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Glue with a Scala job** – AWS Glue 适用于 ETL/数据集成作业，对于在 30 秒内处理每张床垫约 2 MB 的数据而言过于重量级。对于按对象、低延迟处理来说，它不是最具成本效益的选择。
- **B. Amazon EMR with Apache Spark** – EMR/Spark 旨在用于分布式大数据处理。为了许多小型 2 MB 文件而运行 Spark 基础设施，会增加不必要的运营和成本开销。
- **D. AWS Glue with a PySpark job** – 虽然 PySpark 可以处理 S3 中的数据，但它同样是一种分布式 ETL 方法，对于这种小型、快速、事件驱动的工作负载而言过于复杂。因此，由 S3 对象创建触发的 Lambda 提供了最简单、最快且最具成本效益的解决方案。

en.question: A company hosts an online shopping application that stores all orders in an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instance. Management wants to eliminate single points of failure and has asked a solutions architect to recommend an approach to minimize database downtime without requiring any changes to the application code. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Convert the existing database instance to a Multi-AZ deployment by modifying the database instance and specifying the Multi-AZ option.
options.B: Create a new RDS Multi-AZ deployment. Take a snapshot of the current RDS instance and restore the new Multi-AZ deployment with the snapshot.
options.C: Create a read-only replica of the PostgreSQL database in another Availability Zone. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted record sets to distribute requests across the databases.
options.D: Place the RDS for PostgreSQL database in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with a minimum group size of two. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted record sets to distribute requests across instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments are designed for high availability and failover. AWS states that RDS automatically provisions and maintains a **synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone**, which helps protect against DB instance failure and Availability Zone disruption. The same documentation says you can convert an existing DB instance to Multi-AZ by **modifying the DB instance and specifying the Multi-AZ option** ([Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). AWS also documents that converting a Single-AZ DB instance to Multi-AZ adds the standby and turns on synchronous replication, and applying the conversion immediately “doesn't cause downtime” although it can have performance impact ([Converting a DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Migrating.html)). This best meets the requirement to eliminate the Single-AZ SPOF and minimize downtime without application code changes.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Restoring a snapshot into a new Multi-AZ deployment would create a separate DB instance and require a migration/cutover to the new database endpoint, increasing operational complexity and likely requiring application configuration changes. The existing instance can be modified directly to Multi-AZ instead.
- **C:** A read replica is not the same as a Multi-AZ standby. AWS states read replicas use **asynchronous** replication and are read-only; they are primarily for read scaling or DR promotion, not transparent high-availability failover for writes. Multi-AZ standby replication is synchronous, and the standby cannot serve read traffic ([Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). Weighted Route 53 records across a primary and read-only replica would not correctly distribute write traffic for an orders database.
- **D:** Amazon RDS DB instances are managed database resources, not EC2 instances that can be placed in an EC2 Auto Scaling group. This option also suggests weighted routing across database instances rather than RDS-managed synchronous standby failover, so it does not meet the no-application-change high availability requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司托管了一个在线购物应用程序，该应用程序将所有订单存储在一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instance 中。管理层希望消除单点故障，并要求解决方案架构师推荐一种方法，在不需要对应用程序代码进行任何更改的情况下最大限度地减少数据库停机时间。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过修改现有数据库实例并指定 Multi-AZ 选项，将现有数据库实例转换为 Multi-AZ 部署。
options.B: 创建一个新的 RDS Multi-AZ 部署。拍摄当前 RDS 实例的快照，并使用该快照还原新的 Multi-AZ 部署。
options.C: 在另一个 Availability Zone 中创建 PostgreSQL 数据库的只读副本。使用 Amazon Route 53 加权记录集在数据库之间分配请求。
options.D: 将 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库放入最小组大小为 2 的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group 中。使用 Amazon Route 53 加权记录集在实例之间分配请求。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance 部署专为高可用性和故障转移而设计。AWS 表示，RDS 会自动预置并维护一个**位于不同 Availability Zone 中的同步备用副本**，这有助于防止 DB instance 故障和 Availability Zone 中断。同一文档还说明，你可以通过**修改 DB instance 并指定 Multi-AZ 选项**将现有 DB instance 转换为 Multi-AZ（[Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。AWS 还记录了将 Single-AZ DB instance 转换为 Multi-AZ 会添加备用实例并启用同步复制，并且立即应用转换“不会导致停机”，尽管可能会产生性能影响（[Converting a DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Migrating.html)）。这最符合消除 Single-AZ SPOF 并在无需更改应用程序代码的情况下最大限度减少停机时间的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 将快照还原到新的 Multi-AZ 部署会创建一个单独的 DB instance，并需要迁移/切换到新的数据库端点，从而增加运维复杂性，并且很可能需要更改应用程序配置。相反，可以直接将现有实例修改为 Multi-AZ。
- **C:** read replica 与 Multi-AZ standby 不同。AWS 表示 read replica 使用**异步**复制且为只读；它们主要用于读取扩展或 DR 提升，而不是用于写入的透明高可用性故障转移。Multi-AZ standby 复制是同步的，并且备用实例不能提供读取流量（[Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。在主数据库和只读副本之间使用加权 Route 53 记录，无法为订单数据库正确分配写入流量。
- **D:** Amazon RDS DB instance 是托管数据库资源，不是可以放入 EC2 Auto Scaling group 的 EC2 实例。此选项还建议在数据库实例之间进行加权路由，而不是使用 RDS 托管的同步备用故障转移，因此不满足无需更改应用程序的高可用性要求。

en.question: A company is developing an application to support customer demands. The company wants to deploy the application on multiple Amazon EC2 Nitro-based instances within the same Availability Zone. The company also wants to give the application the ability to write to multiple block storage volumes in multiple EC2 Nitro-based instances simultaneously to achieve higher application availability. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi- Attach
options.B: Use Throughput Optimized HDD (st1) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach
options.C: Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi- Attach
options.D: Use General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi- Attach

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volumes with Amazon EBS Multi-Attach.**

Amazon EBS Multi-Attach is specifically designed to attach a single EBS volume to multiple EC2 instances in the **same Availability Zone**, with each attached instance having **full read and write permission**. AWS states that this helps achieve higher application availability for applications that manage concurrent write operations. AWS also states that Multi-Attach enabled volumes can be attached to up to **16 Nitro-based instances** in the same Availability Zone, and that Multi-Attach is supported **exclusively on Provisioned IOPS SSD (`io1` and `io2`) volumes**. AWS further recommends `io2` for better performance, consistency, and durability at a lower cost than `io1` in this context ([AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. gp3 with Multi-Attach** — Incorrect. General Purpose SSD `gp3` volumes are not supported for Multi-Attach. AWS says Multi-Attach is supported exclusively on Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` volumes ([AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
- **B. st1 with Multi-Attach** — Incorrect. Throughput Optimized HDD `st1` volumes are not supported for Multi-Attach; the feature is limited to Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` volumes ([AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
- **D. gp2 with Multi-Attach** — Incorrect. General Purpose SSD `gp2` volumes are also not supported for Multi-Attach because AWS limits Multi-Attach to Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` volumes ([AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个应用程序以支持客户需求。该公司希望在同一个 Availability Zone 内的多个基于 Amazon EC2 Nitro 的实例上部署该应用程序。该公司还希望让该应用程序能够同时写入多个基于 EC2 Nitro 的实例中的多个块存储卷，以实现更高的应用程序可用性。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 General Purpose SSD (gp3) EBS 卷与 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi- Attach 结合使用
options.B: 将 Throughput Optimized HDD (st1) EBS 卷与 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach 结合使用
options.C: 将 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS 卷与 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi- Attach 结合使用
options.D: 将 General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS 卷与 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi- Attach 结合使用

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 将 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS 卷与 Amazon EBS Multi-Attach 结合使用。**

Amazon EBS Multi-Attach 专门设计用于将单个 EBS 卷挂载到**同一个 Availability Zone** 中的多个 EC2 实例，并且每个挂载的实例都具有**完整的读写权限**。AWS 表示，这有助于为管理并发写入操作的应用程序实现更高的应用程序可用性。AWS 还表示，启用 Multi-Attach 的卷可以挂载到同一个 Availability Zone 中最多 **16 个基于 Nitro 的实例**，并且 Multi-Attach **仅在 Provisioned IOPS SSD (`io1` and `io2`) 卷上受支持**。AWS 进一步建议在此场景中使用 `io2`，因为与 `io1` 相比，它能以更低成本提供更好的性能、一致性和持久性（[AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. gp3 with Multi-Attach** — 不正确。General Purpose SSD `gp3` 卷不支持 Multi-Attach。AWS 表示 Multi-Attach 仅在 Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` 卷上受支持（[AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
- **B. st1 with Multi-Attach** — 不正确。Throughput Optimized HDD `st1` 卷不支持 Multi-Attach；该功能仅限于 Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` 卷（[AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
- **D. gp2 with Multi-Attach** — 不正确。General Purpose SSD `gp2` 卷也不支持 Multi-Attach，因为 AWS 将 Multi-Attach 限制为 Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` 卷（[AWS EBS Multi-Attach documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

en.question: A company designed a stateless two-tier application that uses Amazon EC2 in a single Availability Zone and an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. New company management wants to ensure the application is highly available. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure the application to use Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling and create an Application Load Balancer
options.B: Configure the application to take snapshots of the EC2 instances and send them to a different AWS Region
options.C: Configure the application to use Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to feed requests to the application
options.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 rules to handle incoming requests and create a Multi-AZ Application Load Balancer

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The database tier is already highly available because Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments provide high availability/failover support, maintain a synchronous standby in a different Availability Zone, and help protect against DB instance failure and AZ disruption ([Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). The remaining weakness is the application tier, which currently runs EC2 in a single AZ. AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attaching a load balancer to distribute incoming traffic across those AZs; if one AZ becomes unhealthy, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). An Application Load Balancer must be enabled in at least two Availability Zones and can route traffic to healthy targets in another AZ if one AZ becomes unavailable or has no healthy targets ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** EC2 snapshots are a backup/restore or migration mechanism, not an active high-availability architecture. They do not automatically keep the stateless application running if the single AZ fails.
- **C:** Route 53 latency-based routing is for routing DNS queries to the AWS Region with the lowest latency ([Latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)). It does not make EC2 instances in a single AZ highly available.
- **D:** Route 53 can route traffic to an ELB load balancer, but this option does not configure the EC2 application tier to run across multiple AZs. The essential HA change is Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling plus an ALB, as in option A.

zh.question: 一家公司设计了一个无状态的双层应用程序，该应用程序在单个 Availability Zone 中使用 Amazon EC2，并使用一个 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance。公司新管理层希望确保该应用程序具有高可用性。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足此要求？

options.A: 配置应用程序使用 Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling，并创建一个 Application Load Balancer
options.B: 配置应用程序对 EC2 实例创建快照，并将其发送到不同的 AWS Region
options.C: 配置应用程序使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由，将请求馈送到该应用程序
options.D: 配置 Amazon Route 53 规则以处理传入请求，并创建一个 Multi-AZ Application Load Balancer

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** 数据库层已经具备高可用性，因为 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance 部署提供高可用性/故障转移支持，在不同的 Availability Zone 中维护同步备用实例，并有助于防范 DB instance 故障和 AZ 中断（[Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。剩余的薄弱点是应用程序层，目前它在单个 AZ 中运行 EC2。AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling group 跨多个 Availability Zones 部署，并附加负载均衡器以在这些 AZ 之间分配传入流量；如果一个 AZ 变为不正常，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。Application Load Balancer 必须至少在两个 Availability Zones 中启用，并且如果一个 AZ 变为不可用或没有正常目标，它可以将流量路由到另一个 AZ 中的正常目标（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** EC2 快照是一种备份/还原或迁移机制，而不是主动的高可用性架构。如果单个 AZ 发生故障，它们不会自动保持无状态应用程序运行。
- **C:** Route 53 基于延迟的路由用于将 DNS 查询路由到延迟最低的 AWS Region（[Latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)）。它不能使单个 AZ 中的 EC2 实例具备高可用性。
- **D:** Route 53 可以将流量路由到 ELB 负载均衡器，但此选项并未配置 EC2 应用程序层跨多个 AZ 运行。关键的 HA 变更是 Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling 加 ALB，如选项 A 所示。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations. A member account has purchased a Compute Savings Plan. Because of changes in the workloads inside the member account, the account no longer receives the full benefit of the Compute Savings Plan commitment. The company uses less than 50% of its purchased compute power.

options.A: Turn on discount sharing from the Billing Preferences section of the account console in the member account that purchased the Compute Savings Plan.
options.B: Turn on discount sharing from the Billing Preferences section of the account console in the company's Organizations management account.
options.C: Migrate additional compute workloads from another AWS account to the account that has the Compute Savings Plan.
options.D: Sell the excess Savings Plan commitment in the Reserved Instance Marketplace.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **B**.

AWS Organizations can share Savings Plans discounts across accounts in the consolidated billing family. AWS states that organization-wide sharing lets commitments benefit the owner account first, and then remaining benefits can be shared with other organization accounts, maximizing overall commitment utilization/discount rates. To activate this, the procedure explicitly says to use **Billing preferences** and to ensure you are signed in to the **management account** of AWS Organizations, then activate Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discount sharing for the accounts ([AWS Billing: Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: A member account is not the right place to control organization-wide RI/Savings Plans sharing. AWS documentation says to sign in to the **management account** to activate sharing in Billing preferences ([AWS Billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)).
- **C**: Moving workloads into the purchasing account could use more of the commitment, but it is unnecessary operational migration. AWS provides discount sharing specifically so unused commitment can apply to other eligible linked accounts in the organization ([AWS Billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)).
- **D**: The Reserved Instance Marketplace is for selling certain **Amazon EC2 Standard Reserved Instances** only; AWS says only Standard regional and zonal RIs can be sold there ([Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-market-general.html)). A Compute Savings Plan is not a Reserved Instance, and AWS states Savings Plans are commitments that “can’t be cancelled during the term” ([Savings Plans User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations。一个成员账户购买了 Compute Savings Plan。由于该成员账户内工作负载发生变化，该账户不再能够充分获得 Compute Savings Plan 承诺带来的全部收益。该公司使用的已购买计算能力不到 50%。

options.A: 在购买 Compute Savings Plan 的成员账户中，从账户控制台的 Billing Preferences 部分开启折扣共享。
options.B: 在公司的 Organizations 管理账户中，从账户控制台的 Billing Preferences 部分开启折扣共享。
options.C: 将额外的计算工作负载从另一个 AWS 账户迁移到拥有 Compute Savings Plan 的账户。
options.D: 在 Reserved Instance Marketplace 中出售多余的 Savings Plan 承诺。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B**。

AWS Organizations 可以在合并账单系列中的账户之间共享 Savings Plans 折扣。AWS 表示，组织范围的共享会让承诺先使所有者账户受益，然后剩余的收益可以与其他组织账户共享，从而最大化整体承诺利用率/折扣率。要激活此功能，操作步骤明确说明要使用 **Billing preferences**，并确保你登录的是 AWS Organizations 的 **management account**，然后为账户激活 Reserved Instance 和 Savings Plans 折扣共享（[AWS Billing: Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：成员账户不是控制组织范围 RI/Savings Plans 共享的正确位置。AWS 文档说明要登录 **management account**，在 Billing preferences 中激活共享（[AWS Billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)）。
- **C**：将工作负载迁移到购买账户可以使用更多承诺，但这是不必要的运营迁移。AWS 专门提供折扣共享，以便未使用的承诺可以应用于组织中其他符合条件的关联账户（[AWS Billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)）。
- **D**：Reserved Instance Marketplace 仅用于出售某些 **Amazon EC2 Standard Reserved Instances**；AWS 表示只有 Standard regional 和 zonal RIs 可以在那里出售（[Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ri-market-general.html)）。Compute Savings Plan 不是 Reserved Instance，而且 AWS 表示 Savings Plans 是“can’t be cancelled during the term”的承诺（[Savings Plans User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing a microservices application that will provide a search catalog for customers. The company must use REST APIs to present the frontend of the application to users. The REST APIs must access the backend services that the company hosts in containers in private VPC subnets. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Design a WebSocket API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a private VPC link for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.B: Design a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a private VPC link for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.C: Design a WebSocket API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a security group for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.
options.D: Design a REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. Host the application in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) in a private subnet. Create a security group for API Gateway to access Amazon ECS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The requirement explicitly says the frontend must be presented through **REST APIs**, and the backend services run in containers in **private VPC subnets**. AWS documentation states that API Gateway **private integrations for REST APIs** are used to expose HTTP/HTTPS resources inside a VPC, and that to create a private integration you **must first create a VPC link**. The same documentation notes that VPC links for REST APIs can connect to Application Load Balancers, which can in turn connect to **Amazon ECS container-based applications** ([Private integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/private-integration.html)). AWS also provides a tutorial where a **REST API** is created for an **Amazon ECS service**, and a **VPC link** is used so clients can access that ECS service through the REST API ([Tutorial: Create a REST API with a private integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-private-integration.html)).

Therefore, using **Amazon API Gateway REST API + Amazon ECS in private subnets + VPC link** meets the requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A and C:** These use a **WebSocket API**, but the question requires **REST APIs**.
- **D:** This uses a REST API and ECS, but a security group alone is not the mechanism for API Gateway REST APIs to privately reach VPC resources. AWS documentation says a private integration requires a **VPC link**; the VPC link is what enables API Gateway to access private resources in the VPC ([Private integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/private-integration.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个微服务应用程序，该应用程序将为客户提供搜索目录。公司必须使用 REST APIs 向用户呈现应用程序的前端。REST APIs 必须访问公司托管在私有 VPC 子网中的容器内的后端服务。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计 WebSocket API。将应用程序托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中。为 API Gateway 创建私有 VPC link 以访问 Amazon ECS。
options.B: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计 REST API。将应用程序托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中。为 API Gateway 创建私有 VPC link 以访问 Amazon ECS。
options.C: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计 WebSocket API。将应用程序托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中。为 API Gateway 创建 security group 以访问 Amazon ECS。
options.D: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 设计 REST API。将应用程序托管在私有子网中的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中。为 API Gateway 创建 security group 以访问 Amazon ECS。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

要求明确说明前端必须通过 **REST APIs** 呈现，并且后端服务运行在 **private VPC subnets** 中的容器内。AWS 文档指出，API Gateway **private integrations for REST APIs** 用于公开 VPC 内部的 HTTP/HTTPS 资源，并且要创建私有集成，你**必须先创建 VPC link**。同一文档还指出，REST APIs 的 VPC links 可以连接到 Application Load Balancers，而后者又可以连接到 **Amazon ECS container-based applications**（[Private integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/private-integration.html)）。AWS 还提供了一个教程，其中为 **Amazon ECS service** 创建了 **REST API**，并使用 **VPC link**，以便客户端可以通过 REST API 访问该 ECS 服务（[Tutorial: Create a REST API with a private integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-private-integration.html)）。因此，使用 **Amazon API Gateway REST API + Amazon ECS in private subnets + VPC link** 能够满足这些要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 和 C：** 这些选项使用 **WebSocket API**，但题目要求 **REST APIs**。
