- **D：** 该选项使用 REST API 和 ECS，但仅靠 security group 并不是让 API Gateway REST APIs 私下访问 VPC 资源的机制。AWS 文档指出，私有集成需要 **VPC link**；VPC link 才是使 API Gateway 能够访问 VPC 中私有资源的机制（[Private integrations for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/private-integration.html)）。

en.question: A company stores raw collected data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data is used for several types of analytics on behalf of the company's customers. The type of analytics requested determines the access pattern on the S3 objects. The company cannot predict or control the access pattern. The company wants to reduce its S3 costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use S3 replication to transition infrequently accessed objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.B: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.C: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.D: Use S3 Inventory to identify and transition objects that have not been accessed from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The access pattern is unpredictable, so the best fit is **S3 Intelligent-Tiering**. AWS states that S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed to optimize costs by automatically moving data to the most cost-effective access tier as access patterns change, and is the ideal storage class for data with **unknown or changing access patterns** with no retrieval fees ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to another storage class, including Intelligent-Tiering, to manage objects cost-effectively ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** S3 replication is for copying objects between buckets/locations, not for choosing cheaper storage based on access patterns. Also, Standard-IA is for infrequently accessed data, which the company cannot predict.
- **B:** Standard-IA is designed for long-lived, infrequently accessed data and has retrieval fees; it is not ideal when access might become frequent or unpredictable ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **D:** S3 Inventory produces daily or weekly reports listing objects and metadata for analysis; it does not itself transition objects. Lifecycle rules are the native mechanism for transitions ([S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html), [S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将原始采集数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中。该数据用于代表公司客户执行多种类型的分析。请求的分析类型决定了对 S3 对象的访问模式。公司无法预测或控制该访问模式。公司希望降低其 S3 成本。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 S3 replication 将不频繁访问的对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.B: 使用 S3 Lifecycle rules 将对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
options.C: 使用 S3 Lifecycle rules 将对象从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.D: 使用 S3 Inventory 识别未被访问的对象，并将其从 S3 Standard 转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** 访问模式不可预测，因此最适合的是 **S3 Intelligent-Tiering**。AWS 指出，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在随着访问模式变化，通过自动将数据移动到最具成本效益的访问层来优化成本，并且是具有**未知或变化访问模式**的数据的理想存储类，且不收取检索费用（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。S3 Lifecycle rules 可以将对象转换到另一个存储类，包括 Intelligent-Tiering，从而以经济高效的方式管理对象（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** S3 replication 用于在 buckets/locations 之间复制对象，而不是根据访问模式选择更便宜的存储。此外，Standard-IA 适用于不频繁访问的数据，而公司无法预测这一点。
- **B:** Standard-IA 专为长期存在且不频繁访问的数据而设计，并且有检索费用；当访问可能变得频繁或不可预测时，它并不理想（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Inventory 会生成每日或每周报告，列出对象和元数据以供分析；它本身不会转换对象。Lifecycle rules 是进行转换的原生机制（[S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html), [S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

en.question: A company has applications hosted on Amazon EC2 instances with IPv6 addresses. The applications must initiate communications with other external applications using the internet. However the company’s security policy states that any external service cannot initiate a connection to the EC2 instances. What should a solutions architect recommend to resolve this issue?

options.A: Create a NAT gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.B: Create an internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.C: Create a virtual private gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table
options.D: Create an egress-only internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D**.

- **D. Create an egress-only internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table** — Correct. The workloads use **IPv6** and need to initiate outbound internet communication while preventing internet resources from initiating connections back to the instances. AWS states that because IPv6 addresses are public by default, if an instance must access the internet but internet resources must not initiate communication with it, you can use an **egress-only internet gateway**. AWS also says to add a route for IPv6 traffic, such as `::/0`, to the egress-only internet gateway, and that the gateway is stateful and returns response traffic to the instances ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/egress-only-internet-gateway.html)). AWS also documents the route table step: specify `::/0` as the destination and select the egress-only internet gateway as the target ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/egress-only-internet-gateway-working-with.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. NAT gateway** — A NAT gateway can provide outbound-only connectivity, but the standard NAT gateway pattern is for IPv4; AWS identifies an egress-only internet gateway as the option for outbound-only internet communication over IPv6 ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)).
- **B. Internet gateway** — An internet gateway route makes the subnet a public subnet and supports IPv6 internet communication, but it does not provide the specific outbound-only behavior required. AWS distinguishes this from an egress-only internet gateway, which prevents internet resources from initiating communication with the instance ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html), [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/egress-only-internet-gateway.html)).
- **C. Virtual private gateway** — A virtual private gateway is used for VPN connectivity to remote networks, such as Site-to-Site VPN, not for general outbound IPv6 internet access ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在具有 IPv6 地址的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管了应用程序。这些应用程序必须使用互联网与其他外部应用程序发起通信。但是，该公司的安全策略规定，任何外部服务都不能向这些 EC2 实例发起连接。解决方案架构师应建议什么来解决此问题？

options.A: 创建 NAT gateway，并将其设为子网路由表的目标
options.B: 创建 internet gateway，并将其设为子网路由表的目标
options.C: 创建 virtual private gateway，并将其设为子网路由表的目标
options.D: 创建 egress-only internet gateway，并将其设为子网路由表的目标

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D**。

- **D. Create an egress-only internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table** — 正确。工作负载使用 **IPv6**，并且需要发起出站互联网通信，同时防止互联网资源向实例发起连接。AWS 表示，由于 IPv6 地址默认是公有的，如果实例必须访问互联网，但互联网资源不得向其发起通信，则可以使用 **egress-only internet gateway**。AWS 还说明，应为 IPv6 流量添加一条路由，例如 `::/0`，指向 egress-only internet gateway，并且该网关是有状态的，会将响应流量返回给实例（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/egress-only-internet-gateway.html)）。AWS 还记录了路由表步骤：将 `::/0` 指定为目标，并选择 egress-only internet gateway 作为目标（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/egress-only-internet-gateway-working-with.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. NAT gateway** — NAT gateway 可以提供仅出站连接，但标准 NAT gateway 模式适用于 IPv4；AWS 将 egress-only internet gateway 标识为通过 IPv6 进行仅出站互联网通信的选项（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。
- **B. Internet gateway** — internet gateway 路由会使子网成为公有子网，并支持 IPv6 互联网通信，但它不提供所需的特定仅出站行为。AWS 将其与 egress-only internet gateway 区分开来，后者可防止互联网资源向实例发起通信（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html), [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/egress-only-internet-gateway.html)）。
- **C. Virtual private gateway** — virtual private gateway 用于连接到远程网络的 VPN 连接，例如 Site-to-Site VPN，而不是用于通用的出站 IPv6 互联网访问（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)）。

en.question: A company is creating an application that runs on containers in a VPC. The application stores and accesses data in an Amazon S3 bucket. During the development phase, the application will store and access 1 TB of data in Amazon S3 each day. The company wants to minimize costs and wants to prevent traffic from traversing the internet whenever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable S3 Intelligent-Tiering for the S3 bucket
options.B: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration for the S3 bucket
options.C: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC
options.D: Create an interface endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** A gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 is the best fit for containers running inside a VPC that need to access S3 privately and at minimum cost. AWS states that an S3 gateway endpoint lets you access S3 from your VPC, can be added as a target in route tables for S3-bound traffic, does not require an internet gateway or NAT device, and has **no additional charge** ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). AWS also describes gateway endpoints as accessing S3 from the VPC over the AWS network and lists them as **not billed**, while interface endpoints are **billed** ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). Associating the gateway endpoint with all relevant route tables ensures S3 traffic from the VPC uses the endpoint path instead of an internet/NAT path.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering** optimizes *storage* costs for data with unknown or changing access patterns, but it does not address keeping VPC-to-S3 network traffic off the internet ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **B. S3 Transfer Acceleration** is intended for faster transfers over long distances, across continents, or when internet bandwidth is underutilized; it does not minimize cost or keep VPC traffic off the internet ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).
- **D. S3 interface endpoint** can keep traffic on the AWS network, but AWS documents that interface endpoints for S3 are **billed**, whereas gateway endpoints are **not billed**; interface endpoints are more appropriate for scenarios such as on-premises access or cross-Region VPC access, which are not required here ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在创建一个在 VPC 中的容器上运行的应用程序。该应用程序在 Amazon S3 存储桶中存储和访问数据。在开发阶段，该应用程序每天将在 Amazon S3 中存储和访问 1 TB 数据。公司希望尽可能降低成本，并希望尽可能防止流量经过互联网。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该 S3 存储桶启用 S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.B: 为该 S3 存储桶启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration
options.C: 为 Amazon S3 创建一个网关 VPC 端点。将此端点与 VPC 中的所有路由表关联
options.D: 在 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 创建一个接口端点。将此端点与 VPC 中的所有路由表关联

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** 用于 Amazon S3 的网关 VPC 端点最适合在 VPC 内运行、需要以私有方式且以最低成本访问 S3 的容器。AWS 表示，S3 网关端点允许你从 VPC 访问 S3，可以作为 S3 目标流量的路由表目标添加，不需要 internet gateway 或 NAT 设备，并且**不收取额外费用**（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。AWS 还说明，网关端点通过 AWS 网络从 VPC 访问 S3，并将其列为**不计费**，而接口端点是**计费**的（[Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。将网关端点与所有相关路由表关联，可确保来自 VPC 的 S3 流量使用端点路径，而不是 internet/NAT 路径。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. S3 Intelligent-Tiering** 会针对访问模式未知或变化的数据优化*存储*成本，但它不能解决让 VPC 到 S3 的网络流量避开互联网的问题（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **B. S3 Transfer Acceleration** 旨在用于跨长距离、跨大陆或互联网带宽利用不足时实现更快传输；它不会最大限度降低成本，也不会让 VPC 流量避开互联网（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。
- **D. S3 interface endpoint** 可以让流量保留在 AWS 网络上，但 AWS 文档说明 S3 的接口端点是**计费**的，而网关端点是**不计费**的；接口端点更适合本地访问或跨 Region VPC 访问等场景，而这些在此处并非必需（[Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

en.question: A company has a mobile chat application with a data store based in Amazon DynamoDB. Users would like new messages to be read with as little latency as possible. A solutions architect needs to design an optimal solution that requires minimal application changes. Which method should the solutions architect select?

options.A: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for the new messages table. Update the code to use the DAX endpoint.
options.B: Add DynamoDB read replicas to handle the increased read load. Update the application to point to the read endpoint for the read replicas.
options.C: Double the number of read capacity units for the new messages table in DynamoDB. Continue to use the existing DynamoDB endpoint.
options.D: Add an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache to the application stack. Update the application to point to the Redis cache endpoint instead of DynamoDB.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** DAX is the purpose-built accelerator for DynamoDB read latency. AWS states that DAX provides access to DynamoDB tables with **microsecond latency** and is ideal for applications that require the fastest possible read response time; it also supports AWS-provided DAX clients for common languages ([DAX use cases and usage notes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). AWS also describes DAX as a **DynamoDB-compatible caching service** for read-heavy applications, so changing the application to use the DAX client/endpoint is a minimal-change way to reduce read latency ([DAX prescriptive guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-prescriptive-guidance.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** DynamoDB does not use same-Region “read replicas” with a separate read endpoint like some relational databases. DynamoDB already delivers consistent single-digit millisecond performance at scale ([DynamoDB characteristics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)); the AWS-managed low-latency read accelerator for DynamoDB is DAX, not read replicas.
- **C:** Increasing read capacity units can help handle more read throughput, but it does not provide the requested lowest possible read latency. AWS explicitly contrasts increasing provisioned read throughput with offloading read activity to a DAX cluster for read-intensive workloads ([DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)).
- **D:** ElastiCache is a general distributed in-memory data store/cache environment ([What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)). It could be used to build a caching layer, but it is not DynamoDB-compatible in the way DAX is, so it would require more application and data-access changes than using DAX.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个移动聊天应用程序，其数据存储基于 Amazon DynamoDB。用户希望以尽可能低的延迟读取新消息。解决方案架构师需要设计一个需要最少应用程序更改的最佳解决方案。解决方案架构师应选择哪种方法？

options.A: 为新消息表配置 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)。更新代码以使用 DAX endpoint。
options.B: 添加 DynamoDB read replicas 以处理增加的读取负载。更新应用程序，使其指向 read replicas 的读取 endpoint。
options.C: 将 DynamoDB 中新消息表的 read capacity units 数量加倍。继续使用现有的 DynamoDB endpoint。
options.D: 向应用程序堆栈添加 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 缓存。更新应用程序，使其指向 Redis 缓存 endpoint，而不是 DynamoDB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** DAX 是专为 DynamoDB 读取延迟而构建的加速器。AWS 表示，DAX 以 **微秒级延迟** 提供对 DynamoDB 表的访问，非常适合需要尽可能最快读取响应时间的应用程序；它还支持 AWS 提供的适用于常见语言的 DAX 客户端（[DAX use cases and usage notes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。AWS 还将 DAX 描述为面向读取密集型应用程序的 **DynamoDB-compatible caching service**，因此将应用程序更改为使用 DAX client/endpoint 是一种以最少更改降低读取延迟的方法（[DAX prescriptive guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/dax-prescriptive-guidance.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** DynamoDB 不使用像某些关系数据库那样带有单独读取 endpoint 的同一 Region “read replicas”。DynamoDB 已经能够在规模化场景下提供稳定的个位数毫秒性能（[DynamoDB characteristics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）；AWS 托管的 DynamoDB 低延迟读取加速器是 DAX，而不是 read replicas。
- **C:** 增加 read capacity units 可以帮助处理更多读取吞吐量，但不能提供所要求的尽可能低的读取延迟。AWS 明确将增加预置读取吞吐量与针对读取密集型工作负载将读取活动卸载到 DAX 集群进行了对比（[DAX use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。
- **D:** ElastiCache 是一种通用的分布式内存数据存储/缓存环境（[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)）。它可用于构建缓存层，但它不像 DAX 那样与 DynamoDB 兼容，因此与使用 DAX 相比，它需要更多的应用程序和数据访问更改。

en.question: A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website serves static content. Website traffic is increasing, and the company is concerned about a potential increase in cost.

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to cache state files at edge locations
options.B: Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Connect the ALB to the ElastiCache cluster to serve cached files
options.C: Create an AWS WAF web ACL and associate it with the ALB. Add a rule to the web ACL to cache static files
options.D: Create a second ALB in an alternative AWS Region. Route user traffic to the closest Region to minimize data transfer costs

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon CloudFront is designed for this use case. AWS states that CloudFront can speed up delivery of static content such as images, style sheets, and JavaScript by using CloudFront edge servers, and that a distribution uses edge locations/POPs where CloudFront caches copies of files. CloudFront can also use an HTTP server running on Amazon EC2 as a custom origin, and with AWS origins such as Elastic Load Balancing, data transfer from the origin to CloudFront is free; you are billed for outbound transfer from CloudFront to viewers. This reduces requests and traffic served directly by the EC2/ALB origin and is the best cost/performance choice for increasing static website traffic ([CloudFront static content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html), [CloudFront distribution/origins/pricing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An ALB does not “connect to ElastiCache” to serve cached static files. Elastic Load Balancing routes a request by selecting a healthy registered target from a target group; it is not a CDN/static file cache in front of a website ([ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).
- **C:** AWS WAF web ACLs inspect HTTP(S) requests and apply actions such as allow, block, count, CAPTCHA, or challenge. WAF rules are for request filtering/protection, not caching static content ([How AWS WAF works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works.html)).
- **D:** A second ALB in another Region adds infrastructure and does not cache static objects. It would require duplicating/regionalizing the application and does not address origin offload as directly or cost-effectively as CloudFront edge caching.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管了一个网站。该网站提供静态内容。网站流量正在增加，公司担心成本可能会上升。

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，以在边缘站点缓存状态文件
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。将 ALB 连接到 ElastiCache 集群以提供缓存文件
options.C: 创建一个 AWS WAF web ACL 并将其与 ALB 关联。向该 web ACL 添加一条规则以缓存静态文件
options.D: 在另一个 AWS Region 中创建第二个 ALB。将用户流量路由到最近的 Region，以最大限度地降低数据传输成本

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** Amazon CloudFront 正是为此类用例而设计的。AWS 说明，CloudFront 可以通过使用 CloudFront 边缘服务器来加速图像、样式表和 JavaScript 等静态内容的交付，并且分配会使用边缘站点/POP，CloudFront 会在这些位置缓存文件副本。CloudFront 还可以使用在 Amazon EC2 上运行的 HTTP 服务器作为自定义源站，并且对于 Elastic Load Balancing 等 AWS 源站，从源站到 CloudFront 的数据传输是免费的；你需要为从 CloudFront 到查看者的出站传输付费。这减少了由 EC2/ALB 源站直接处理的请求和流量，是应对不断增长的静态网站流量的最佳成本/性能选择（[CloudFront static content](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html), [CloudFront distribution/origins/pricing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** ALB 不会“连接到 ElastiCache”来提供缓存的静态文件。Elastic Load Balancing 通过从目标组中选择一个运行状况良好的已注册目标来路由请求；它不是位于网站前面的 CDN/静态文件缓存（[ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。
- **C:** AWS WAF web ACL 会检查 HTTP(S) 请求，并应用允许、阻止、计数、CAPTCHA 或质询等操作。WAF 规则用于请求筛选/保护，而不是缓存静态内容（[How AWS WAF works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works.html)）。
- **D:** 在另一个 Region 中创建第二个 ALB 会增加基础设施，并且不会缓存静态对象。它需要复制应用程序或使应用程序区域化，并且在源站卸载方面不如 CloudFront 边缘缓存直接或具有成本效益。

en.question: A company has multiple VPCs across AWS Regions to support and run workloads that are isolated from workloads in other Regions. Because of a recent application launch requirement, the company’s VPCs must communicate with all other VPCs across all Regions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of administrative effort?

options.A: Use VPC peering to manage VPC communication in a single Region. Use VPC peering across Regions to manage VPC communications.
options.B: Use AWS Direct Connect gateways across all Regions to connect VPCs across regions and manage VPC communications.
options.C: Use AWS Transit Gateway to manage VPC communication in a single Region and Transit Gateway peering across Regions to manage VPC communications.
options.D: Use AWS PrivateLink across all Regions to connect VPCs across Regions and manage VPC communications

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

AWS Transit Gateway is intended for hub-and-spoke connectivity at scale: it is a network transit hub used to interconnect VPCs, and AWS notes that as infrastructure expands globally, **inter-Region peering connects transit gateways together** using AWS Global Infrastructure ([AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)). AWS also states that Transit Gateway can connect **thousands of VPCs within the same Region**, commonly with one transit gateway per Region, and that Transit Gateway peering can peer transit gateways in the same or multiple Regions and route traffic between them; this simplifies management because VPCs connect to the transit gateway instead of requiring many individual connections ([AWS whitepaper: Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)). Therefore, a Transit Gateway per Region plus inter-Region Transit Gateway peering meets the requirement with the least administrative effort.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A. VPC peering** can connect VPCs, including across Regions, but it is point-to-point between two VPCs ([VPC peering overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/what-is-vpc-peering.html)). For many VPCs across many Regions, this creates a large number of peering relationships and route-table updates, so it is more administrative effort than Transit Gateway.
- **B. Direct Connect gateways** are for hybrid connectivity with Direct Connect and can be attached to a transit gateway, but they are not the least-effort service for VPC-to-VPC communication across Regions; Transit Gateway is the hub for interconnecting VPCs ([AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)).
- **D. AWS PrivateLink** establishes private connectivity from VPCs to supported services, endpoint services, AWS Marketplace services, or supported resources via VPC endpoints, not general all-to-all VPC routing across Regions ([AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在多个 AWS Regions 中拥有多个 VPC，用于支持和运行与其他 Regions 中工作负载隔离的工作负载。由于最近的应用程序发布要求，该公司的 VPC 必须能够与所有 Regions 中的所有其他 VPC 通信。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 VPC peering 管理单个 Region 内的 VPC 通信。使用跨 Regions 的 VPC peering 管理 VPC 通信。
options.B: 在所有 Regions 中使用 AWS Direct Connect gateways 来连接跨 regions 的 VPC 并管理 VPC 通信。
options.C: 使用 AWS Transit Gateway 管理单个 Region 内的 VPC 通信，并使用跨 Regions 的 Transit Gateway peering 管理 VPC 通信。
options.D: 在所有 Regions 中使用 AWS PrivateLink 来连接跨 Regions 的 VPC 并管理 VPC 通信

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

AWS Transit Gateway 旨在实现大规模的中心辐射型连接：它是一个用于互连 VPCs 的网络传输枢纽，并且 AWS 指出，随着基础设施在全球范围内扩展，**inter-Region peering connects transit gateways together** 使用 AWS Global Infrastructure（[AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。AWS 还说明，Transit Gateway 可以连接**同一 Region 内的数千个 VPCs**，通常每个 Region 使用一个 transit gateway，并且 Transit Gateway peering 可以在相同或多个 Regions 中对等连接 transit gateways，并在它们之间路由流量；这简化了管理，因为 VPCs 连接到 transit gateway，而不需要许多单独的连接（[AWS whitepaper: Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。因此，每个 Region 一个 Transit Gateway 加上 inter-Region Transit Gateway peering，可以以最少的管理工作量满足该要求。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. VPC peering** 可以连接 VPCs，包括跨 Regions 连接，但它是两个 VPCs 之间的点对点连接（[VPC peering overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/what-is-vpc-peering.html)）。对于跨许多 Regions 的许多 VPCs，这会产生大量 peering 关系和 route-table 更新，因此比 Transit Gateway 需要更多管理工作。
- **B. Direct Connect gateways** 用于通过 Direct Connect 实现混合连接，并且可以附加到 transit gateway，但它们不是跨 Regions 的 VPC-to-VPC 通信的最低工作量服务；Transit Gateway 才是互连 VPCs 的枢纽（[AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。
- **D. AWS PrivateLink** 通过 VPC endpoints 建立从 VPCs 到受支持服务、endpoint services、AWS Marketplace services 或受支持资源的私有连接，而不是跨 Regions 的通用全互通 VPC 路由（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing a containerized application that will use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The application needs to access a shared file system that is highly durable and can recover data to another AWS Region with a recovery point objective (RPO) of 8 hours. The file system needs to provide a mount target m each Availability Zone within a Region. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Backup to manage the replication to another Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ deployment
options.B: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP with a Multi-AZ deployment
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with the Standard storage class
options.D: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Amazon EFS with the Standard storage class**

Amazon EFS is the best fit because it is a shared NFS file system suitable for containerized/Linux workloads, and **EFS Standard** is a Regional storage class designed for active data with 99.999999999% durability and Regional availability across at least three AZs. AWS also states that Regional EFS file systems store data redundantly across multiple geographically separated AZs in the same Region ([EFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). For access, EFS lets you create mount targets; AWS recommends creating a mount target in each AZ from which you need access, and for EFS Regional storage classes you can add mount targets for the file system ([Creating mount targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/manage-fs-access-create-delete-mount-targets.html)). AWS Backup supports **Amazon EFS** for cross-Region backup, and a backup plan can use **Copy to destination** to store a copy in another Region ([AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html), [Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)). A scheduled backup frequency can be configured to meet an 8-hour RPO.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ**: A Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server file system requires **two subnets** in two different AZs and has two ENIs, not mount targets in every AZ in the Region ([FSx for Windows Multi-AZ resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/high-availability-multiAZ.html)).
- **B. FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ**: FSx for ONTAP Multi-AZ also uses two subnets/ENIs, one for the preferred file server and one for standby, rather than mount targets in each AZ. In addition, AWS Backup’s feature matrix does **not** show cross-Region backup support for FSx for ONTAP ([FSx for ONTAP deployment/network resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html), [AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)).
- **D. FSx for OpenZFS**: Multi-AZ FSx for OpenZFS is a HA pair spread across **two** AZs and uses two subnets/ENIs, not a mount target in each AZ within the Region ([FSx for OpenZFS availability and resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/OpenZFSGuide/availability-durability.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一个将使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 的容器化应用程序。该应用程序需要访问一个共享文件系统，该文件系统高度持久，并且能够将数据恢复到另一个 AWS Region，恢复点目标 (RPO) 为 8 小时。该文件系统需要在一个 Region 内的每个 Availability Zone 中提供一个挂载目标。解决方案架构师希望使用 AWS Backup 来管理到另一个 Region 的复制。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 采用 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
options.B: 采用 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
options.C: 使用 Standard 存储类的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.D: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用 Standard 存储类的 Amazon EFS**

Amazon EFS 是最佳选择，因为它是一个适用于容器化/Linux 工作负载的共享 NFS 文件系统，并且 **EFS Standard** 是一种 Regional 存储类，专为活动数据而设计，具有 99.999999999% 的持久性，并在至少三个 AZ 中提供 Regional 可用性。AWS 还说明，Regional EFS 文件系统会在同一 Region 中多个地理位置分离的 AZ 之间冗余存储数据（[EFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。对于访问，EFS 允许你创建挂载目标；AWS 建议在需要访问的每个 AZ 中创建一个挂载目标，并且对于 EFS Regional 存储类，你可以为该文件系统添加挂载目标（[Creating mount targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/manage-fs-access-create-delete-mount-targets.html)）。AWS Backup 支持 **Amazon EFS** 的跨 Region 备份，并且备份计划可以使用 **Copy to destination** 将副本存储在另一个 Region（[AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)，[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。可以配置计划备份频率以满足 8 小时 RPO。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. FSx for Windows File Server Multi-AZ**：Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统需要位于两个不同 AZ 中的 **two subnets**，并且有两个 ENI，而不是在 Region 中的每个 AZ 都有挂载目标（[FSx for Windows Multi-AZ resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/high-availability-multiAZ.html)）。
- **B. FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ**：FSx for ONTAP Multi-AZ 也使用两个子网/ENI，一个用于首选文件服务器，一个用于备用文件服务器，而不是在每个 AZ 中都有挂载目标。此外，AWS Backup 的功能矩阵并**未**显示 FSx for ONTAP 支持跨 Region 备份（[FSx for ONTAP deployment/network resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html)，[AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)）。
- **D. FSx for OpenZFS**：Multi-AZ FSx for OpenZFS 是跨 **two** 个 AZ 的 HA 对，并使用两个子网/ENI，而不是在 Region 内的每个 AZ 中都有挂载目标（[FSx for OpenZFS availability and resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/OpenZFSGuide/availability-durability.html)）。

en.question: A company is expecting rapid growth in the near future. A solutions architect needs to configure existing users and grant permissions to new users on AWS. The solutions architect has decided to create IAM groups. The solutions architect will add the new users to IAM groups based on department. Which additional action is the MOST secure way to grant permissions to the new users?

options.A: Apply service control policies (SCPs) to manage access permissions
options.B: Create IAM roles that have least privilege permission. Attach the roles to the IAM groups
options.C: Create an IAM policy that grants least privilege permission. Attach the policy to the IAM groups
options.D: Create IAM roles. Associate the roles with a permissions boundary that defines the maximum permissions

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The architect is creating IAM user groups by department, so the most secure way to grant permissions is to create least-privilege IAM policies and attach those policies to the appropriate IAM groups. AWS states that identity-based policies are attached to IAM identities, including “users, groups to which users belong, or roles,” and that these policies grant permissions to the identity. AWS also specifically documents attaching policies to an IAM group through the IAM console, CLI `attach-group-policy`, or API `AttachGroupPolicy` ([IAM policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html), [Attach a policy to an IAM user group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_groups_manage_attach-policy.html)). AWS best practice is to grant **least privilege**: grant only the permissions required to perform a task ([Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. SCPs** are not the right mechanism to grant permissions to users. AWS says SCPs define the **maximum** permissions for IAM users and roles in AWS Organizations accounts; they limit permissions and **do not grant permissions** ([Policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).
- **B. IAM roles attached to IAM groups** is not the normal IAM permission model for departmental IAM groups. Policies are attached to users, groups, or roles; roles are identities with their own policies and trust policies, not permissions objects that are attached to IAM groups ([Policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).
- **D. Permissions boundaries** also do not grant permissions. AWS describes permissions boundaries as defining the **maximum permissions** that identity-based policies can grant to a user or role, so an identity still needs an identity-based policy granting the actual permissions ([Policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司预计在不久的将来会快速增长。解决方案架构师需要在 AWS 上配置现有用户并向新用户授予权限。解决方案架构师已决定创建 IAM groups。解决方案架构师将根据部门把新用户添加到 IAM groups。哪项额外操作是向新用户授予权限的最安全方式？

options.A: 应用 service control policies (SCPs) 来管理访问权限
options.B: 创建具有最小权限的 IAM roles。将这些 roles 附加到 IAM groups
options.C: 创建一个授予最小权限的 IAM policy。将该 policy 附加到 IAM groups
options.D: 创建 IAM roles。将这些 roles 与定义最大权限的 permissions boundary 关联

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** 架构师正在按部门创建 IAM user groups，因此授予权限的最安全方式是创建最小权限 IAM policies，并将这些 policies 附加到相应的 IAM groups。AWS 表示，基于身份的 policies 会附加到 IAM identities，包括“users, groups to which users belong, or roles”，并且这些 policies 会向该 identity 授予权限。AWS 还专门记录了通过 IAM console、CLI `attach-group-policy` 或 API `AttachGroupPolicy` 将 policies 附加到 IAM group（[IAM policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)，[Attach a policy to an IAM user group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_groups_manage_attach-policy.html)）。AWS 最佳实践是授予 **least privilege**：仅授予执行任务所需的权限（[Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. SCPs** 不是向用户授予权限的正确机制。AWS 表示，SCPs 定义 AWS Organizations accounts 中 IAM users 和 roles 的 **maximum** 权限；它们限制权限，并且 **do not grant permissions**（[Policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。
- **B. IAM roles attached to IAM groups** 不是部门级 IAM groups 的常规 IAM 权限模型。Policies 会附加到 users、groups 或 roles；roles 是具有自身 policies 和 trust policies 的 identities，而不是附加到 IAM groups 的权限对象（[Policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。
- **D. Permissions boundaries** 也不会授予权限。AWS 将 permissions boundaries 描述为定义基于身份的 policies 可授予 user 或 role 的 **maximum permissions**，因此 identity 仍然需要一个授予实际权限的基于身份的 policy（[Policy types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。

options.A:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:*Object"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```
options.B:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:*"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```
options.C:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:DeleteObject"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```
options.D:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:DeleteObject"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D**.

The existing statement grants `s3:ListBucket` on the bucket ARN (`arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name`), which is appropriate for a bucket-level operation. However, `s3:DeleteObject` is an **object** operation, and AWS states that object operations such as `GetObject`, `PutObject`, and `DeleteObject` require the S3 **object ARN** format, for example `arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket/*`; AWS also notes that the object ARN must include a forward slash after the bucket name ([Amazon S3 IAM policy actions/resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security_iam_service-with-iam.html)). AWS policy examples likewise place `s3:DeleteObject` on `arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket1/*`, while `s3:ListBucket` is on the bucket ARN without `/*` ([S3 identity-based policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-policies-s3.html)).

Therefore, the administrator should add only `s3:DeleteObject` for `arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*`.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: `s3:*Object` grants more object permissions than required, violating least privilege.
- **B**: `s3:*` grants all S3 actions on the object ARN, far beyond delete access and not least privilege.
- **C**: `arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name*` is not the correct object ARN pattern for objects in the bucket; AWS requires the forward slash format `bucket-name/*` for object operations.
- **D**: Correctly grants only `s3:DeleteObject` on all objects in the bucket using `arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*`.

options.A:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:*Object"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```
options.B:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:*"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```
options.C:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:DeleteObject"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```
options.D:
```json
"Action": [
  "s3:DeleteObject"
],
"Resource": [
  "arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*"
],
"Effect": "Allow"
```

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D**。现有语句授予了对存储桶 ARN (`arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name`) 的 `s3:ListBucket` 权限，这对于存储桶级别操作是合适的。但是，`s3:DeleteObject` 是一个**对象**操作，AWS 说明诸如 `GetObject`、`PutObject` 和 `DeleteObject` 之类的对象操作需要 S3 **对象 ARN** 格式，例如 `arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket/*`；AWS 还指出，对象 ARN 必须在存储桶名称后包含一个正斜杠 ([Amazon S3 IAM policy actions/resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security_iam_service-with-iam.html))。AWS policy 示例同样将 `s3:DeleteObject` 放在 `arn:aws:s3:::amzn-s3-demo-bucket1/*` 上，而 `s3:ListBucket` 放在不带 `/*` 的存储桶 ARN 上 ([S3 identity-based policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-policies-s3.html))。因此，管理员应仅为 `arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*` 添加 `s3:DeleteObject`。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：`s3:*Object` 授予的对象权限超过所需权限，违反最小权限原则。
- **B**：`s3:*` 授予对象 ARN 上的所有 S3 操作权限，远超删除访问所需权限，并非最小权限。
- **C**：`arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name*` 不是存储桶中对象的正确对象 ARN 模式；AWS 要求对象操作使用正斜杠格式 `bucket-name/*`。
- **D**：使用 `arn:aws:s3:::bucket-name/*` 正确地仅授予对存储桶中所有对象的 `s3:DeleteObject` 权限。

en.question: A law firm needs to share information with the public. The information includes hundreds of files that must be publicly readable. Modifications or deletions of the files by anyone before a designated future date are prohibited. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure way?

options.A: Upload all files to an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for static website hosting. Grant read- only IAM permissions to any AWS principals that access the S3 bucket until the designated date.
options.B: Create a new Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning enabled. Use S3 Object Lock with a retention period in accordance with the designated date. Configure the S3 bucket for static website hosting. Set an S3 bucket policy to allow read-only access to the objects.
options.C: Create a new Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning enabled. Configure an event trigger to run an AWS Lambda function in case of object modification or deletion. Configure the Lambda function to replace the objects with the original versions from a private S3 bucket.
options.D: Upload all files to an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for static website hosting. Select the folder that contains the files. Use S3 Object Lock with a retention period in accordance with the designated date. Grant read-only IAM permissions to any AWS principals that access the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon S3 Object Lock is the correct control because it uses a write-once-read-many (WORM) model and can prevent an object from being deleted or overwritten for a fixed period of time. AWS states that before locking objects, you must enable **S3 Versioning and Object Lock** on the bucket, and then set a retention period or legal hold. AWS also notes that Object Lock works only with versioned buckets ([Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)). Configuring the bucket for static website hosting makes the files available through a website endpoint, and an S3 bucket policy can grant public read access with only `s3:GetObject` ([Tutorial: Configuring a static website on Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/HostingWebsiteOnS3Setup.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A:** Static website hosting and read-only permissions allow public reading, but this option does **not** include Object Lock or a retention period, so it does not securely prohibit modification or deletion before the future date.
- **C:** A Lambda function that restores changed or deleted objects is reactive, not preventive. It does not prohibit modification or deletion; it only attempts remediation after an event. Object Lock is the AWS-native preventive WORM control.
- **D:** This option does not state that S3 Versioning and Object Lock are enabled on the bucket before locking objects. AWS requires both before objects can be locked ([Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)). Also, public website access is normally granted through a bucket policy for public read access, not by granting IAM permissions to “any AWS principals” ([Examples of Amazon S3 bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)).

zh.question: 一家律师事务所需要向公众共享信息。该信息包括数百个必须可公开读取的文件。在指定的未来日期之前，禁止任何人修改或删除这些文件。哪种解决方案将以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有文件上传到一个配置为静态网站托管的 Amazon S3 bucket。向在指定日期之前访问该 S3 bucket 的任何 AWS principals 授予只读 IAM 权限。
options.B: 创建一个启用了 S3 Versioning 的新 Amazon S3 bucket。使用 S3 Object Lock，并根据指定日期设置保留期。将该 S3 bucket 配置为静态网站托管。设置 S3 bucket policy 以允许对对象进行只读访问。
options.C: 创建一个启用了 S3 Versioning 的新 Amazon S3 bucket。配置事件触发器，以便在对象被修改或删除时运行 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数，用来自私有 S3 bucket 的原始版本替换这些对象。
options.D: 将所有文件上传到一个配置为静态网站托管的 Amazon S3 bucket。选择包含这些文件的文件夹。使用 S3 Object Lock，并根据指定日期设置保留期。向访问该 S3 bucket 的任何 AWS principals 授予只读 IAM 权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon S3 Object Lock 是正确的控制措施，因为它使用一次写入多次读取（WORM）模型，可以防止对象在固定时间段内被删除或覆盖。AWS 说明，在锁定对象之前，必须在 bucket 上启用 **S3 Versioning and Object Lock**，然后设置保留期或法定保留。AWS 还指出，Object Lock 仅适用于启用了版本控制的 bucket（[Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)）。将 bucket 配置为静态网站托管可使文件通过网站端点可用，而 S3 bucket policy 可以仅使用 `s3:GetObject` 授予公共读取访问权限（[Tutorial: Configuring a static website on Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/HostingWebsiteOnS3Setup.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A:** 静态网站托管和只读权限允许公众读取，但此选项**不**包含 Object Lock 或保留期，因此无法在未来日期之前安全地禁止修改或删除。
- **C:** 用于恢复已更改或已删除对象的 Lambda 函数是响应式的，而不是预防性的。它不会禁止修改或删除；它只是在事件发生后尝试补救。Object Lock 是 AWS 原生的预防性 WORM 控制措施。
- **D:** 此选项没有说明在锁定对象之前已在 bucket 上启用 S3 Versioning and Object Lock。AWS 要求在对象可以被锁定之前必须同时启用二者（[Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)）。此外，公共网站访问通常通过 bucket policy 授予公共读取访问权限，而不是通过向“any AWS principals”授予 IAM 权限（[Examples of Amazon S3 bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies.html)）。

en.question: A company is making a prototype of the infrastructure for its new website by manually provisioning the necessary infrastructure. This infrastructure includes an Auto Scaling group, an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon RDS database. After the configuration has been thoroughly validated, the company wants the capability to immediately deploy the infrastructure for development and production use in two Availability Zones in an automated fashion. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Systems Manager to replicate and provision the prototype infrastructure in two Availability Zones
options.B: Define the infrastructure as a template by using the prototype infrastructure as a guide. Deploy the infrastructure with AWS CloudFormation.
options.C: Use AWS Config to record the inventory of resources that are used in the prototype infrastructure. Use AWS Config to deploy the prototype infrastructure into two Availability Zones.
options.D: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk and configure it to use an automated reference to the prototype infrastructure to automatically deploy new environments in two Availability Zones.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The requirement is to turn a manually validated prototype into repeatable, automated infrastructure for dev and production. AWS CloudFormation is designed for this: a template describes resources and properties, and a CloudFormation stack provisions resources such as an Auto Scaling group, load balancer, and RDS database. AWS also states that you can reuse a CloudFormation template to provision the same resources consistently and repeatedly ([CloudFormation: Simplify infrastructure management / Quickly replicate your infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Systems Manager** is primarily for operational management of nodes and tasks, such as visibility, patching, remote commands, and automation of common administration tasks—not for defining and deploying a complete infrastructure stack from a prototype ([Systems Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html)).
- **C. AWS Config** records and evaluates resource configurations. It provides a view of AWS resource configuration history and relationships, but it is not the service used to deploy infrastructure into Availability Zones ([What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)).
- **D. AWS Elastic Beanstalk** is for deploying web applications; it provisions resources needed to run application code, such as EC2 instances, load balancing, health monitoring, and scaling. It is not the best fit for reproducing an arbitrary validated infrastructure prototype consisting of ASG, ALB, and RDS as infrastructure as code ([What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在通过手动预置必要的基础设施，为其新网站制作基础设施原型。该基础设施包括一个 Auto Scaling group、一个 Application Load Balancer 和一个 Amazon RDS 数据库。在配置经过全面验证后，公司希望能够以自动化方式立即在两个 Availability Zones 中部署该基础设施，用于开发和生产环境。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 在两个 Availability Zones 中复制并预置原型基础设施
options.B: 使用原型基础设施作为指南，将基础设施定义为模板。使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署该基础设施。
options.C: 使用 AWS Config 记录原型基础设施中使用的资源清单。使用 AWS Config 将原型基础设施部署到两个 Availability Zones 中。
options.D: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk，并将其配置为使用对原型基础设施的自动化引用，以便在两个 Availability Zones 中自动部署新环境。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 要求是将手动验证过的原型转换为可重复、自动化的基础设施，用于开发和生产。AWS CloudFormation 正是为此而设计的：模板描述资源和属性，而 CloudFormation stack 会预置诸如 Auto Scaling group、load balancer 和 RDS database 等资源。AWS 还说明，你可以重复使用 CloudFormation template，以一致且可重复的方式预置相同资源（[CloudFormation: Simplify infrastructure management / Quickly replicate your infrastructure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Systems Manager** 主要用于节点和任务的运维管理，例如可见性、修补、远程命令以及常见管理任务的自动化，而不是用于从原型定义和部署完整的基础设施 stack（[Systems Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html)）。
- **C. AWS Config** 记录并评估资源配置。它提供 AWS 资源配置历史和关系的视图，但它不是用于将基础设施部署到 Availability Zones 的服务（[What is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。
- **D. AWS Elastic Beanstalk** 用于部署 Web 应用程序；它会预置运行应用程序代码所需的资源，例如 EC2 instances、load balancing、health monitoring 和 scaling。对于将由 ASG、ALB 和 RDS 组成的任意已验证基础设施原型以 infrastructure as code 的方式复现而言，它并不是最佳选择（[What is AWS Elastic Beanstalk?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A business application is hosted on Amazon EC2 and uses Amazon S3 for encrypted object storage. The chief information security officer has directed that no application traffic between the two services should traverse the public internet. Which capability should the solutions architect use to meet the compliance requirements?

options.A: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)
options.B: VPC endpoint
options.C: Private subnet
options.D: Virtual private gateway

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. VPC endpoint**

A VPC endpoint is the capability that lets resources in a VPC privately reach supported AWS services such as Amazon S3. AWS documentation states that for Amazon S3, gateway endpoints and interface endpoints can be used to access S3 from a VPC, and that in both cases the network traffic remains on the AWS network; it also states that requests to S3 over interface endpoints stay on the Amazon network ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). AWS PrivateLink documentation also explains that private connectivity to supported AWS services does not require an internet gateway, NAT device, Direct Connect connection, or Site-to-Site VPN, and keeps traffic confined within the AWS network ([Connect your VPC to services using AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS KMS**: KMS manages encryption keys and helps protect data, but it does not provide a private network path between EC2 and S3.
- **C. Private subnet**: Placing EC2 instances in a private subnet does not by itself create private connectivity to S3. Without a VPC endpoint, S3 access might require NAT/internet routing.
- **D. Virtual private gateway**: A virtual private gateway is used for VPN connectivity to external/on-premises networks, not for privately accessing S3 from EC2 within a VPC. AWS PrivateLink/VPC endpoints are the documented mechanism for private connectivity to supported AWS services without VPN or internet routing.

zh.question: 一个业务应用程序托管在 Amazon EC2 上，并使用 Amazon S3 进行加密对象存储。首席信息安全官要求两个服务之间的任何应用程序流量都不应经过公共互联网。解决方案架构师应使用哪项能力来满足合规性要求？

options.A: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS)
options.B: VPC endpoint
options.C: 私有子网
options.D: 虚拟私有网关

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. VPC endpoint**

VPC endpoint 是一种能力，可让 VPC 中的资源私密访问受支持的 AWS 服务，例如 Amazon S3。AWS 文档说明，对于 Amazon S3，可以使用 gateway endpoints 和 interface endpoints 从 VPC 访问 S3，并且在这两种情况下，网络流量都保留在 AWS 网络上；文档还说明，通过 interface endpoints 发送到 S3 的请求会保留在 Amazon 网络上（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。AWS PrivateLink 文档还解释说，到受支持 AWS 服务的私有连接不需要 internet gateway、NAT device、Direct Connect connection 或 Site-to-Site VPN，并会将流量限制在 AWS 网络内（[Connect your VPC to services using AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS KMS**：KMS 管理加密密钥并帮助保护数据，但它不提供 EC2 与 S3 之间的私有网络路径。
- **C. Private subnet**：将 EC2 实例放置在私有子网中本身并不会创建到 S3 的私有连接。如果没有 VPC endpoint，访问 S3 可能需要 NAT/互联网路由。
- **D. Virtual private gateway**：virtual private gateway 用于连接到外部/本地网络的 VPN 连接，而不是用于从 VPC 内的 EC2 私密访问 S3。AWS PrivateLink/VPC endpoints 是文档中说明的机制，用于在不使用 VPN 或互联网路由的情况下与受支持的 AWS 服务建立私有连接。

en.question: A company hosts a three-tier web application in the AWS Cloud. A Multi-AZAmazon RDS for MySQL server forms the database layer Amazon ElastiCache forms the cache layer. The company wants a caching strategy that adds or updates data in the cache when a customer adds an item to the database. The data in the cache must always match the data in the database. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement the lazy loading caching strategy
options.B: Implement the write-through caching strategy
options.C: Implement the adding TTL caching strategy
options.D: Implement the AWS AppConfig caching strategy

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Implement the write-through caching strategy.**

AWS ElastiCache documentation states that the **write-through** strategy “adds data or updates data in the cache whenever data is written to the database,” and that because the cache is updated every time data is written to the database, “the data in the cache is always current” ([AWS ElastiCache caching strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html)). This directly matches the requirement to add or update cache data when a customer adds an item to the database and to keep cache data matching the database.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Lazy loading**: Lazy loading populates the cache only when data is requested after a cache miss. AWS notes that lazy loading can result in **stale data** because the cache is not updated when data changes in the database ([AWS ElastiCache caching strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html)).
- **C. Adding TTL**: TTL expires keys after a period of time. AWS states that TTL “doesn’t guarantee that a value isn’t stale”; it only keeps data from getting “too stale” by forcing periodic refreshes from the database ([AWS ElastiCache caching strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html)).
- **D. AWS AppConfig caching strategy**: AWS AppConfig is for deploying and managing application configurations, not for synchronizing application data between Amazon RDS and ElastiCache; AWS documentation describes AppConfig deployment in terms of deploying configuration profiles/configurations ([AWS AppConfig deploying a configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-deploying.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中托管一个三层 Web 应用程序。一个 Multi-AZAmazon RDS for MySQL 服务器构成数据库层，Amazon ElastiCache 构成缓存层。该公司希望采用一种缓存策略，当客户向数据库添加项目时，在缓存中添加或更新数据。缓存中的数据必须始终与数据库中的数据匹配。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 实施 lazy loading 缓存策略
options.B: 实施 write-through 缓存策略
options.C: 实施添加 TTL 缓存策略
options.D: 实施 AWS AppConfig 缓存策略

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 实施 write-through 缓存策略。**

AWS ElastiCache 文档指出，**write-through** 策略“每当数据写入数据库时，就在缓存中添加数据或更新数据”，并且由于每次将数据写入数据库时都会更新缓存，“缓存中的数据始终是最新的” ([AWS ElastiCache caching strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html))。这直接符合以下要求：当客户向数据库添加项目时添加或更新缓存数据，并保持缓存数据与数据库匹配。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Lazy loading**：Lazy loading 仅在缓存未命中后请求数据时填充缓存。AWS 指出，lazy loading 可能导致**过期数据**，因为当数据库中的数据发生变化时，缓存不会被更新 ([AWS ElastiCache caching strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html))。
- **C. Adding TTL**：TTL 会在一段时间后使键过期。AWS 表示 TTL “不能保证某个值不是过期的”；它只是通过强制定期从数据库刷新，防止数据变得“过于陈旧” ([AWS ElastiCache caching strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html))。
- **D. AWS AppConfig caching strategy**：AWS AppConfig 用于部署和管理应用程序配置，而不是用于在 Amazon RDS 和 ElastiCache 之间同步应用程序数据；AWS 文档以部署配置文件/配置的方式描述 AppConfig 部署 ([AWS AppConfig deploying a configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-deploying.html))。

en.question: A company wants to migrate 100 GB of historical data from an on-premises location to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has a 100 megabits per second (Mbps) internet connection on premises. The company needs to encrypt the data in transit to the S3 bucket. The company will store new data directly in Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use the s3 sync command in the AWS CLI to move the data directly to an S3 bucket
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the on-premises location to an S3 bucket
options.C: Use AWS Snowball to move the data to an S3 bucket
options.D: Set up an IPsec VPN from the on-premises location to AWS. Use the s3 cp command in the AWS CLI to move the data directly to an S3 bucket

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the on-premises location to an S3 bucket.**

AWS DataSync is the best fit because it is designed to migrate data over the network into AWS storage services. AWS documentation lists **migrate data** as a DataSync use case and states that DataSync includes **automatic encryption** and data integrity validation. It also says DataSync **automates both the management of data-transfer processes and the infrastructure required for high performance and secure data transfers**, which directly addresses the requirement for the least operational overhead. DataSync encryption-in-transit documentation further states that DataSync encrypts all network traffic between locations with **mutual TLS 1.3** during transfer. [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [AWS DataSync encryption in transit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/encryption-in-transit.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS CLI `s3 sync`**: This can copy local data to S3, and Amazon S3 supports HTTPS with TLS for AWS CLI connections, but it is a manual command-line transfer. It does not provide the same managed transfer automation, integrity validation, and migration workflow that DataSync provides. [AWS CLI s3 sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/s3/sync.html), [Protecting data in transit with encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)
- **C. AWS Snowball**: Snowball Edge can import data from on premises to S3, but it is intended for transferring large amounts of data using a physical device and shipping process. For only 100 GB over a 100 Mbps internet connection, this adds unnecessary operational overhead. [Upload large amounts of data for Amazon EMR with AWS Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)
- **D. IPsec VPN plus AWS CLI `s3 cp`**: A VPN is not required to encrypt traffic to S3 because S3 supports TLS for HTTPS connections, and AWS CLI connections can use TLS automatically. Creating and managing an IPsec VPN adds unnecessary setup and operational overhead. [Protecting data in transit with encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)

zh.question: 一家公司希望将 100 GB 的历史数据从本地位置迁移到一个 Amazon S3 bucket。该公司的本地互联网连接带宽为 100 megabits per second (Mbps)。公司需要在传输到 S3 bucket 的过程中加密数据。公司将把新数据直接存储在 Amazon S3 中。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CLI 中的 s3 sync 命令将数据直接移动到 S3 bucket
options.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从本地位置迁移到 S3 bucket
options.C: 使用 AWS Snowball 将数据移动到 S3 bucket
options.D: 从本地位置到 AWS 设置 IPsec VPN。使用 AWS CLI 中的 s3 cp 命令将数据直接移动到 S3 bucket

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据从本地位置迁移到 S3 bucket。**

AWS DataSync 是最佳选择，因为它旨在通过网络将数据迁移到 AWS 存储服务中。AWS 文档将 **migrate data** 列为 DataSync 的使用案例，并说明 DataSync 包含 **automatic encryption** 和数据完整性验证。文档还说明，DataSync **自动化管理数据传输过程以及实现高性能和安全数据传输所需的基础设施**，这直接满足了最少运营开销的要求。DataSync 传输中加密文档进一步说明，DataSync 在传输期间使用 **mutual TLS 1.3** 加密各位置之间的所有网络流量。[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [AWS DataSync encryption in transit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/encryption-in-transit.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS CLI `s3 sync`**：这可以将本地数据复制到 S3，并且 Amazon S3 支持 AWS CLI 连接使用带 TLS 的 HTTPS，但它是手动命令行传输。它不提供 DataSync 所提供的同等级托管传输自动化、完整性验证和迁移工作流。[AWS CLI s3 sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/reference/s3/sync.html), [Protecting data in transit with encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)
- **C. AWS Snowball**：Snowball Edge 可以将数据从本地导入到 S3，但它旨在通过物理设备和寄送流程传输大量数据。对于通过 100 Mbps 互联网连接传输仅 100 GB 数据的情况，这会增加不必要的运营开销。[Upload large amounts of data for Amazon EMR with AWS Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)
- **D. IPsec VPN plus AWS CLI `s3 cp`**：不需要 VPN 来加密到 S3 的流量，因为 S3 支持 HTTPS 连接使用 TLS，并且 AWS CLI 连接可以自动使用 TLS。创建和管理 IPsec VPN 会增加不必要的设置和运营开销。[Protecting data in transit with encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)

en.question: A company containerized a Windows job that runs on .NET 6 Framework under a Windows container. The company wants to run this job in the AWS Cloud. The job runs every 10 minutes. The job’s runtime varies between 1 minute and 3 minutes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function based on the container image of the job. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the function every 10 minutes.
options.B: Use AWS Batch to create a job that uses AWS Fargate resources. Configure the job scheduling to run every 10 minutes.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate to run the job. Create a scheduled task based on the container image of the job to run every 10 minutes.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate to run the job. Create a standalone task based on the container image of the job. Use Windows task scheduler to run the job every 10 minutes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The workload is already a **Windows container** and needs to run briefly every 10 minutes. Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate is a good fit because Fargate lets you run containers without provisioning or managing EC2 instances, and ECS Fargate explicitly supports Microsoft Windows Server Full and Core platform versions for Windows containers ([ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). For the schedule, Amazon ECS tasks can be scheduled through EventBridge Scheduler with recurring rate-based or cron-based schedules ([ECS scheduled tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tasks-scheduled-eventbridge-scheduler.html)). This runs the task only when needed, which is cost-effective for a 1–3 minute job every 10 minutes.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Lambda container images are not suitable for this Windows container because AWS Lambda documentation states that Lambda supports **only Linux-based container images** ([Lambda container image requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)).
- **B:** AWS Batch can run Fargate jobs and EventBridge can schedule Batch jobs, but this adds an unnecessary batch job queue/compute-environment layer for a simple fixed-interval ECS task. Also, the AWS Batch Fargate job-definition documentation describes Fargate-specific job constraints and platform versions, but it does not establish Windows container support for Batch on Fargate in the way ECS Fargate does ([AWS Batch Fargate job definitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/fargate-job-definitions.html)). ECS scheduled tasks are the more direct choice.
- **D:** A standalone ECS task is appropriate for one-time work, and AWS documentation says that if a task must run on a rate-based or cron-based schedule, you should create a schedule with EventBridge Scheduler ([ECS standalone tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/standalone-tasks.html)). Keeping a container running just to use Windows Task Scheduler would pay for idle runtime and is not the most cost-effective approach.

zh.question: 一家公司将一个在 Windows 容器下运行于 .NET 6 Framework 的 Windows 作业进行了容器化。该公司希望在 AWS Cloud 中运行此作业。该作业每 10 分钟运行一次。该作业的运行时间在 1 分钟到 3 分钟之间变化。哪种解决方案将以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 基于该作业的容器映像创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Amazon EventBridge 每 10 分钟调用该函数。
options.B: 使用 AWS Batch 创建一个使用 AWS Fargate 资源的作业。配置作业调度每 10 分钟运行一次。
options.C: 使用 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 运行该作业。基于该作业的容器映像创建一个计划任务，每 10 分钟运行一次。
options.D: 使用 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 运行该作业。基于该作业的容器映像创建一个独立任务。使用 Windows task scheduler 每 10 分钟运行该作业。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

该工作负载已经是一个 **Windows container**，并且需要每 10 分钟短暂运行一次。AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon ECS 非常适合，因为 Fargate 允许你在无需预置或管理 EC2 实例的情况下运行容器，并且 ECS Fargate 明确支持用于 Windows 容器的 Microsoft Windows Server Full 和 Core 平台版本（[ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。对于调度，Amazon ECS 任务可以通过 EventBridge Scheduler 使用基于 rate 的或基于 cron 的重复计划进行调度（[ECS scheduled tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tasks-scheduled-eventbridge-scheduler.html)）。这会使任务仅在需要时运行，对于每 10 分钟运行 1–3 分钟的作业而言具有成本效益。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** Lambda 容器映像不适合这个 Windows 容器，因为 AWS Lambda 文档说明 Lambda **仅支持基于 Linux 的容器映像**（[Lambda container image requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)）。
- **B:** AWS Batch 可以运行 Fargate 作业，并且 EventBridge 可以调度 Batch 作业，但对于简单的固定间隔 ECS 任务来说，这增加了不必要的 batch 作业队列/计算环境层。此外，AWS Batch Fargate 作业定义文档描述了 Fargate 特定的作业约束和平台版本，但它并没有像 ECS Fargate 那样确立 Batch on Fargate 对 Windows 容器的支持（[AWS Batch Fargate job definitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/fargate-job-definitions.html)）。ECS scheduled tasks 是更直接的选择。
- **D:** 独立 ECS 任务适用于一次性工作，并且 AWS 文档说明，如果任务必须按基于 rate 或基于 cron 的计划运行，则应使用 EventBridge Scheduler 创建计划（[ECS standalone tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/standalone-tasks.html)）。让容器保持运行只是为了使用 Windows Task Scheduler，会为闲置运行时间付费，并不是最具成本效益的方法。

en.question: A company wants to move from many standalone AWS accounts to a consolidated, multi-account architecture. The company plans to create many new AWS accounts for different business units. The company needs to authenticate access to these AWS accounts by using a centralized corporate directory service. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations with all features turned on. Create the new AWS accounts in the organization.
options.B: Set up an Amazon Cognito identity pool. Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to accept Amazon Cognito authentication.
options.C: Configure a service control policy (SCP) to manage the AWS accounts. Add AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to AWS Directory Service.
options.D: Create a new organization in AWS Organizations. Configure the organization's authentication mechanism to use AWS Directory Service directly.
options.E: Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) in the organization. Configure IAM Identity Center, and integrate it with the company's corporate directory service.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and E**.

- **A is correct** because AWS Organizations is the AWS service for a consolidated multi-account architecture. The documentation says a multi-account environment is a recommended best practice when scaling and that Organizations can simplify account creation and group accounts into OUs. It also specifically states that you can create AWS accounts within your organization, and when using IAM Identity Center with an existing organization, all AWS Organizations features should be enabled. [AWS Organizations overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html), [Creating a member account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create.html), [IAM Identity Center prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-prerequisites.html)
- **E is correct** because IAM Identity Center is designed to centralize workforce access to AWS accounts. AWS states that IAM Identity Center lets you connect an existing identity provider and synchronize users and groups, and that multi-account permissions provide a single place to assign permissions to users across multiple AWS accounts. For external/corporate IdPs, IAM Identity Center enables users to sign in with corporate credentials and access assigned accounts. [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html), [External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect** because Amazon Cognito identity pools are not the recommended mechanism for workforce single sign-on to many AWS accounts through IAM Identity Center. IAM Identity Center integrates with workforce identity sources such as external SAML/SCIM IdPs or directories for AWS account access. [External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)
- **C is incorrect** because SCPs do not authenticate users. SCPs are permission guardrails: AWS states that an SCP never grants permissions and only specifies maximum available permissions for IAM users and roles in an organization. Also, the integration should be configured in IAM Identity Center with the corporate directory/IdP, not by “adding IAM Identity Center to AWS Directory Service.” [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)
- **D is incorrect** because AWS Organizations itself does not have an authentication mechanism that directly uses AWS Directory Service. Organizations manages accounts, OUs, policies, and billing; centralized user authentication and AWS account access should be handled through IAM Identity Center. [AWS Organizations overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html), [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)

zh.question: 一家公司希望从许多独立的 AWS 账户迁移到整合的多账户架构。该公司计划为不同的业务部门创建许多新的 AWS 账户。该公司需要使用集中式企业目录服务来对这些 AWS 账户的访问进行身份验证。解决方案架构师应建议哪组操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个启用所有功能的新组织。在该组织中创建新的 AWS 账户。
options.B: 设置一个 Amazon Cognito identity pool。配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 以接受 Amazon Cognito 身份验证。
options.C: 配置 service control policy (SCP) 来管理 AWS 账户。将 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 添加到 AWS Directory Service。
options.D: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个新组织。配置该组织的身份验证机制以直接使用 AWS Directory Service。
options.E: 在该组织中设置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。配置 IAM Identity Center，并将其与公司的企业目录服务集成。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A and E**。

- **A is correct**，因为 AWS Organizations 是用于整合多账户架构的 AWS 服务。文档指出，在扩展时，多账户环境是一项推荐的最佳实践，并且 Organizations 可以简化账户创建并将账户分组到 OUs 中。它还明确说明你可以在组织内创建 AWS 账户；并且在将 IAM Identity Center 与现有组织一起使用时，应启用所有 AWS Organizations 功能。[AWS Organizations overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html), [Creating a member account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create.html), [IAM Identity Center prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-prerequisites.html)
- **E is correct**，因为 IAM Identity Center 旨在集中管理员工对 AWS 账户的访问。AWS 表示，IAM Identity Center 允许你连接现有身份提供商并同步用户和组，并且多账户权限提供了一个单一位置，用于跨多个 AWS 账户向用户分配权限。对于外部/企业 IdPs，IAM Identity Center 使用户能够使用企业凭证登录并访问分配的账户。[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html), [External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B is incorrect**，因为 Amazon Cognito identity pools 不是通过 IAM Identity Center 为许多 AWS 账户提供员工单点登录的推荐机制。IAM Identity Center 与员工身份来源集成，例如外部 SAML/SCIM IdPs 或目录，用于 AWS 账户访问。[External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)
- **C is incorrect**，因为 SCPs 不对用户进行身份验证。SCPs 是权限护栏：AWS 表示，SCP 从不授予权限，只指定组织中 IAM 用户和角色可用的最大权限。此外，集成应在 IAM Identity Center 中与企业目录/IdP 配置，而不是通过“将 IAM Identity Center 添加到 AWS Directory Service”来配置。[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)
- **D is incorrect**，因为 AWS Organizations 本身没有直接使用 AWS Directory Service 的身份验证机制。Organizations 管理账户、OUs、策略和账单；集中式用户身份验证和 AWS 账户访问应通过 IAM Identity Center 处理。[AWS Organizations overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_introduction.html), [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)

en.question: A company is looking for a solution that can store video archives in AWS from old news footage. The company needs to minimize costs and will rarely need to restore these files. When the files are needed, they must be available in a maximum of five minutes. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.A: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Glacier and use Expedited retrievals.
options.B: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Glacier and use Standard retrievals.
options.C: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.D: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The workload is long-term video archiving with rare restores, but any needed restore must complete within **a maximum of 5 minutes**. AWS documents that S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is for long-lived archive data accessed rarely, with retrieval times of minutes to hours, and that **Expedited retrieval** typically makes objects available within **1–5 minutes** ([Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html); [S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)). Therefore, S3 Glacier with Expedited retrievals is the most cost-effective option among the choices that satisfies the 5-minute requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. S3 Glacier with Standard retrievals**: Standard retrievals typically finish in **3–5 hours**, so they do not meet the maximum 5-minute restore requirement ([Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)).
- **C. S3 Standard-IA**: This provides millisecond access and is for infrequently accessed data, but it is intended for data accessed about once a month, whereas S3 Glacier storage classes are specifically designed for low-cost, long-term archival storage and rarely accessed data ([Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). It meets the access-time requirement but is not the most cost-effective archive choice here.
- **D. S3 One Zone-IA**: Like Standard-IA, it provides millisecond access but is for infrequently accessed data and stores data in only one Availability Zone, making it not resilient to the physical loss of that AZ ([Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). It is not the best archival option for old news footage when Glacier Expedited can meet the restore-time requirement at lower archive storage cost.

zh.question: 一家公司正在寻找一种解决方案，用于在 AWS 中存储旧新闻素材的视频档案。公司需要尽量降低成本，并且很少需要恢复这些文件。当需要这些文件时，它们必须在最多五分钟内可用。最具成本效益的解决方案是什么？

options.A: 将视频档案存储在 Amazon S3 Glacier 中，并使用 Expedited retrievals。
options.B: 将视频档案存储在 Amazon S3 Glacier 中，并使用 Standard retrievals。
options.C: 将视频档案存储在 Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 中。
options.D: 将视频档案存储在 Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

该工作负载是长期视频归档，恢复需求很少，但任何需要的恢复都必须在 **最多 5 分钟** 内完成。AWS 文档说明，S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 适用于很少访问的长期归档数据，检索时间为几分钟到几小时，并且 **Expedited retrieval** 通常会在 **1–5 分钟** 内使对象可用（[Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)；[S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。因此，在满足 5 分钟要求的选项中，使用 Expedited retrievals 的 S3 Glacier 是最具成本效益的选择。其他选项为何不正确：

- **B. S3 Glacier with Standard retrievals**：Standard retrievals 通常在 **3–5 小时** 内完成，因此不满足最多 5 分钟的恢复要求（[Understanding archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)）。
- **C. S3 Standard-IA**：它提供毫秒级访问，适用于不频繁访问的数据，但其目标是大约每月访问一次的数据，而 S3 Glacier 存储类专门为低成本、长期归档存储和很少访问的数据而设计（[Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。它满足访问时间要求，但在这里不是最具成本效益的归档选择。
- **D.
