S3 One Zone-IA**：与 Standard-IA 一样，它提供毫秒级访问，但适用于不频繁访问的数据，并且仅将数据存储在一个 Availability Zone 中，因此无法抵御该 AZ 的物理丢失（[Understanding and managing Amazon S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。当 Glacier Expedited 可以以更低的归档存储成本满足恢复时间要求时，它并不是旧新闻素材的最佳归档选项。

en.question: A company is building a three-tier application on AWS. The presentation tier will serve a static website The logic tier is a containerized application. This application will store data in a relational database. The company wants to simplify deployment and to reduce operational costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudFront to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.C: Use Amazon S3 to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with AWS Fargate for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.
options.D: Use Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances to host static content. Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 for compute power. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for the database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

A three-tier design that minimizes deployment complexity and operational cost should use managed/serverless components where possible. Amazon S3 directly supports static website hosting: AWS states that “you can use Amazon S3 to host a static website” with static content and client-side scripts ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). For the containerized logic tier, Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate is the simplest operational model because Fargate runs containers “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances” and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). For the data tier, Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service responsible for most management tasks, including backups, software patching, failure detection, and recovery ([Amazon RDS advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** CloudFront is not the static content host; it is a CDN that speeds up delivery and retrieves content from an origin such as an S3 bucket or HTTP server ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). Also, ECS on EC2 requires managing EC2 capacity, unlike Fargate.
- **C:** S3, Fargate, and RDS are appropriate, but Amazon EKS introduces Kubernetes cluster management and additional EKS pricing considerations. AWS describes EKS as a managed Kubernetes service and notes per-cluster pricing and separate charges for resources used to run applications ([Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)). ECS with Fargate is simpler for a generic containerized application.
- **D:** Hosting static content on EC2 Reserved Instances and running EKS on EC2 increases operational overhead because EC2 instances and Kubernetes worker capacity must be managed. It is less simple than S3 static hosting plus ECS Fargate.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个三层应用程序。表示层将提供一个静态网站。逻辑层是一个容器化应用程序。该应用程序会将数据存储在关系数据库中。该公司希望简化部署并降低运营成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 托管静态内容。使用带有 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 提供计算能力。使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群作为数据库。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudFront 托管静态内容。使用带有 Amazon EC2 的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 提供计算能力。使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群作为数据库。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 托管静态内容。使用带有 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 提供计算能力。使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群作为数据库。
options.D: 使用 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances 托管静态内容。使用带有 Amazon EC2 的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 提供计算能力。使用托管的 Amazon RDS 集群作为数据库。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

一种能够最大限度降低部署复杂性和运营成本的三层设计，应尽可能使用托管/无服务器组件。Amazon S3 直接支持静态网站托管：AWS 声明“you can use Amazon S3 to host a static website”，用于静态内容和客户端脚本（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。对于容器化逻辑层，带有 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon ECS 是最简单的运营模型，因为 Fargate 可以运行容器，“without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances”，并且无需预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。对于数据层，Amazon RDS 是一种托管关系数据库服务，负责大多数管理任务，包括备份、软件修补、故障检测和恢复（[Amazon RDS advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** CloudFront 不是静态内容主机；它是一个 CDN，用于加速交付，并从源（例如 S3 bucket 或 HTTP server）检索内容（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。此外，在 EC2 上运行 ECS 需要管理 EC2 容量，而 Fargate 不需要。
- **C:** S3、Fargate 和 RDS 是合适的，但 Amazon EKS 会引入 Kubernetes 集群管理以及额外的 EKS 定价考虑因素。AWS 将 EKS 描述为托管 Kubernetes 服务，并说明了按集群计价以及运行应用程序所用资源的单独收费（[Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)）。对于通用容器化应用程序，带有 Fargate 的 ECS 更简单。
- **D:** 在 EC2 Reserved Instances 上托管静态内容，并在 EC2 上运行 EKS，会增加运营开销，因为必须管理 EC2 实例和 Kubernetes worker 容量。它不如 S3 静态托管加 ECS Fargate 简单。

en.question: A company seeks a storage solution for its application. The solution must be highly available and scalable. The solution also must function as a file system be mountable by multiple Linux instances in AWS and on premises through native protocols, and have no minimum size requirements. The company has set up a Site-to-Site VPN for access from its on-premises network to its VPC. Which storage solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon FSx Multi-AZ deployments
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach volumes
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with multiple mount targets
options.D: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a single mount target and multiple access points

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Amazon EFS with multiple mount targets**

Amazon EFS is the service that matches all requirements. AWS describes EFS as **serverless, fully elastic file storage** that lets users share file data **without provisioning storage capacity**, scales on demand to petabytes, and grows/shrinks automatically as files are added or removed. EFS also supports **NFSv4.1 and NFSv4.0**, the native Linux file protocol, and is designed to be highly scalable, highly available, and highly durable ([What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)). EFS can be accessed concurrently from **multiple NFS clients**, including EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones, and you can mount EFS from on-premises data center servers when connected to the VPC with **AWS Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN** ([How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). For a Regional EFS file system, AWS says you can create **one mount target in each Availability Zone**; EC2 instances in that AZ share the mount target ([Managing mount targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/accessing-fs.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon FSx Multi-AZ deployments** — Amazon FSx is not the best fit as stated because the option does not identify an FSx file system type/protocol, and the question specifically requires fully elastic file storage with no minimum size/provisioning requirement. EFS is explicitly documented as elastic storage without provisioning capacity ([What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)).
- **B. Amazon EBS Multi-Attach volumes** — EBS is block storage attached to EC2 instances, not an NFS file system for native Linux file sharing with on-premises clients. AWS also notes that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers and that Multi-Attach volumes are limited to instances in the same Availability Zone ([EBS Multi-Attach considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
- **D. EFS with a single mount target and multiple access points** — Access points do not replace mount targets for Availability Zone-level access. For a Regional EFS design, AWS shows/recommends mount targets in each Availability Zone, and a single mount target is characteristic of One Zone file systems rather than a highly available Regional deployment ([How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html), [Managing mount targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/accessing-fs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在为其应用程序寻找一种存储解决方案。该解决方案必须高度可用且可扩展。该解决方案还必须作为文件系统运行，能够通过原生协议被 AWS 中和本地的多个 Linux 实例挂载，并且没有最低大小要求。该公司已设置 Site-to-Site VPN，用于从其本地网络访问其 VPC。哪种存储解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon FSx Multi-AZ 部署
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach 卷
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)，具有多个挂载目标
options.D: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)，具有单个挂载目标和多个访问点

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Amazon EFS with multiple mount targets**

Amazon EFS 是符合所有要求的服务。AWS 将 EFS 描述为 **serverless, fully elastic file storage**，可让用户在 **without provisioning storage capacity** 的情况下共享文件数据，按需扩展到 PB 级，并随着文件的添加或删除自动增长/缩减。EFS 还支持 **NFSv4.1 and NFSv4.0**，这是原生 Linux 文件协议，并且旨在实现高度可扩展、高可用和高持久性（[What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)）。EFS 可以被 **multiple NFS clients** 并发访问，包括多个 Availability Zones 中的 EC2 实例；当通过 **AWS Direct Connect or Site-to-Site VPN** 连接到 VPC 时，也可以从本地数据中心服务器挂载 EFS（[How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。对于 Regional EFS 文件系统，AWS 表示你可以在每个 Availability Zone 中创建 **one mount target**；该 AZ 中的 EC2 实例共享该挂载目标（[Managing mount targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/accessing-fs.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon FSx Multi-AZ deployments** — 按题干所述，Amazon FSx 并不是最佳匹配，因为该选项没有标识 FSx 文件系统类型/协议，并且题目明确要求没有最低大小/预置要求的完全弹性文件存储。EFS 明确记录为无需预置容量的弹性存储（[What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)）。
- **B. Amazon EBS Multi-Attach volumes** — EBS 是附加到 EC2 实例的块存储，不是用于与本地客户端进行原生 Linux 文件共享的 NFS 文件系统。AWS 还指出，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多个服务器同时访问而设计，并且 Multi-Attach 卷仅限于同一 Availability Zone 中的实例（[EBS Multi-Attach considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
- **D. EFS with a single mount target and multiple access points** — 访问点不能替代用于 Availability Zone 级访问的挂载目标。对于 Regional EFS 设计，AWS 展示/建议在每个 Availability Zone 中使用挂载目标，而单个挂载目标是 One Zone 文件系统的特征，并非高可用 Regional 部署的特征（[How Amazon EFS works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html), [Managing mount targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/accessing-fs.html)）。

en.question: A 4-year-old media company is using the AWS Organizations all features feature set to organize its AWS accounts. According to the company's finance team, the billing information on the member accounts must not be accessible to anyone, including the root user of the member accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add all finance team users to an IAM group. Attach an AWS managed policy named Billing to the group.
options.B: Attach an identity-based policy to deny access to the billing information to all users, including the root user.
options.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) to deny access to the billing information. Attach the SCP to the root organizational unit (OU).
options.D: Convert from the Organizations all features feature set to the Organizations consolidated billing feature set.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The company already uses AWS Organizations with **all features**, which supports organization policies. AWS defines a service control policy (SCP) as a central guardrail that sets the **maximum available permissions** for principals in member accounts, and SCPs can specify which services/actions identities can access ([AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)). AWS also states that an SCP restricts permissions in **member accounts, including the member account's root user**, and that SCPs affect all users and roles in attached accounts, **including the root user** ([Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). An explicit `Deny` in any SCP from the root through the OU path denies that permission for accounts underneath it ([SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)). Therefore, attaching an SCP that denies billing-related actions at the organization root/OU level meets the requirement for all member accounts.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A** is wrong because attaching the AWS managed **Billing** policy to a finance IAM group would grant billing access to those users, not prevent access for everyone in member accounts.
- **B** is wrong because identity-based policies are attached to IAM identities such as users, roles, and groups; they are not an organization-wide guardrail and do not solve the requirement to restrict even the **member account root user**. Billing documentation describes identity-based policies as policies that account administrators attach to IAM identities to grant Billing permissions ([Identity-based policy with AWS Billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html)).
- **D** is wrong because consolidated billing lacks the advanced AWS Organizations capabilities needed here. AWS states that consolidated billing provides shared billing functionality but does **not** include policies to restrict what users and roles in different accounts can do ([AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家成立 4 年的媒体公司正在使用 AWS Organizations all features 功能集来组织其 AWS 账户。根据公司财务团队的要求，成员账户上的账单信息不得被任何人访问，包括成员账户的根用户。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有财务团队用户添加到一个 IAM 组。将名为 Billing 的 AWS 托管策略附加到该组。
options.B: 附加一个基于身份的策略，以拒绝所有用户（包括根用户）访问账单信息。
options.C: 创建一个服务控制策略 (SCP) 以拒绝访问账单信息。将该 SCP 附加到根组织单位 (OU)。
options.D: 从 Organizations all features 功能集转换为 Organizations consolidated billing 功能集。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

该公司已经使用启用了 **all features** 的 AWS Organizations，该功能支持组织策略。AWS 将服务控制策略 (SCP) 定义为一种集中式防护机制，用于为成员账户中的主体设置**最大可用权限**，并且 SCP 可以指定身份可以访问哪些服务/操作（[AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)）。AWS 还说明，SCP 会限制**成员账户，包括成员账户的根用户**中的权限，并且 SCP 会影响所附加账户中的所有用户和角色，**包括根用户**（[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。从根到 OU 路径中的任何 SCP 中的显式 `Deny` 都会拒绝其下账户的该权限（[SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)）。因此，在组织根/OU 级别附加一个拒绝账单相关操作的 SCP，可以满足所有成员账户的要求。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A** 错误，因为将 AWS 托管的 **Billing** 策略附加到财务 IAM 组会向这些用户授予账单访问权限，而不是阻止成员账户中的所有人访问。
- **B** 错误，因为基于身份的策略附加到 IAM 身份，例如用户、角色和组；它们不是组织范围的防护机制，也无法满足限制甚至**成员账户根用户**的要求。Billing 文档将基于身份的策略描述为账户管理员附加到 IAM 身份以授予 Billing 权限的策略（[Identity-based policy with AWS Billing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html)）。
- **D** 错误，因为 consolidated billing 缺少这里所需的高级 AWS Organizations 功能。AWS 表示 consolidated billing 提供共享账单功能，但**不**包括用于限制不同账户中的用户和角色可以执行哪些操作的策略（[AWS Organizations concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_getting-started_concepts.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company runs an application in the AWS Cloud that is integrated with an on-premises warehouse solution. The company uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send order messages to an on-premises HTTPS endpoint so the warehouse application can process the orders. The local data center team has detected that some of the order messages were not received. A solutions architect needs to retain messages that are not delivered and analyze the messages for up to 14 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream target with a retention period of 14 days.
options.B: Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue with a retention period of 14 days between the application and Amazon SNS.
options.C: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) target with a retention period of 14 days.
options.D: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon DynamoDB target with a TTL attribute set for a retention period of 14 days.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon SNS supports attaching a dead-letter queue at the **subscription** level for messages that cannot be delivered to the subscribed endpoint. AWS states that if SNS cannot access an endpoint or exhausts retries, it discards the message **unless a dead-letter queue is attached to the subscription**; this directly matches the failed HTTPS delivery scenario. AWS also states that an SNS subscription dead-letter queue is an **ordinary Amazon SQS queue**, and recommends setting the maximum retention period for dead-letter queues to **14 days**. Messages are moved to the DLQ with a redrive policy whose `deadLetterTargetArn` **must point to an Amazon SQS queue** in the same account and Region as the SNS subscription ([Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)). This requires only SNS subscription/DLQ configuration, so it is the least development effort.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Incorrect. An Amazon SNS dead-letter queue target must be an **Amazon SQS queue**, not a Kinesis Data Stream ([Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)).
- **B:** Incorrect. Placing SQS between the application and SNS changes the message flow and does not specifically retain messages that SNS fails to deliver to the on-premises HTTPS subscription. The AWS-supported mechanism for failed SNS subscription delivery is an SNS subscription DLQ ([Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)).
- **D:** Incorrect. An SNS DLQ target must be an **SQS queue**, not DynamoDB; DynamoDB TTL is not the SNS DLQ mechanism ([Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)).

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个应用程序，该应用程序与本地仓库解决方案集成。该公司使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 将订单消息发送到本地 HTTPS 端点，以便仓库应用程序可以处理订单。本地数据中心团队检测到一些订单消息未被接收。解决方案架构师需要保留未送达的消息，并对这些消息进行最长 14 天的分析。哪种解决方案能以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个 Amazon SNS 死信队列，该队列具有一个保留期为 14 天的 Amazon Kinesis Data Stream 目标。
options.B: 在应用程序和 Amazon SNS 之间添加一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，并将保留期设置为 14 天。
options.C: 配置一个 Amazon SNS 死信队列，该队列具有一个保留期为 14 天的 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 目标。
options.D: 配置一个 Amazon SNS 死信队列，该队列具有一个 Amazon DynamoDB 目标，并将 TTL 属性设置为 14 天的保留期。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon SNS 支持在**订阅**级别附加死信队列，用于存放无法交付到订阅端点的消息。AWS 说明，如果 SNS 无法访问某个端点或重试耗尽，它会丢弃该消息，**除非该订阅附加了死信队列**；这与 HTTPS 交付失败的场景直接匹配。AWS 还说明，SNS 订阅死信队列是一个**普通的 Amazon SQS 队列**，并建议将死信队列的最大保留期设置为 **14 天**。消息会通过 redrive policy 移动到 DLQ，其中 `deadLetterTargetArn` **必须指向与 SNS 订阅位于同一账户和 Region 的 Amazon SQS 队列**（[Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)）。这只需要进行 SNS 订阅/DLQ 配置，因此开发工作量最少。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 不正确。Amazon SNS 死信队列目标必须是 **Amazon SQS 队列**，而不是 Kinesis Data Stream（[Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)）。
- **B:** 不正确。将 SQS 放在应用程序和 SNS 之间会改变消息流，并且不能专门保留 SNS 未能交付到本地 HTTPS 订阅的消息。AWS 支持的用于 SNS 订阅交付失败的机制是 SNS 订阅 DLQ（[Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)）。
- **D:** 不正确。SNS DLQ 目标必须是 **SQS 队列**，而不是 DynamoDB；DynamoDB TTL 不是 SNS DLQ 机制（[Amazon SNS dead-letter queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-dead-letter-queues.html)）。

en.question: A gaming company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store user information such as geographic location, player data, and leaderboards. The company needs to configure continuous backups to an Amazon S3 bucket with a minimal amount of coding. The backups must not affect availability of the application and must not affect the read capacity units (RCUs) that are defined for the table. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon EMR cluster. Create an Apache Hive job to back up the data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Export the data directly from DynamoDB to Amazon S3 with continuous backups. Turn on point-in- time recovery for the table.
options.C: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Streams. Create an AWS Lambda function to consume the stream and export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to export the data from the database tables to Amazon S3 on a regular basis. Turn on point-in-time recovery for the table.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** DynamoDB export to S3 is the managed feature designed for this requirement. AWS states that DynamoDB export to S3 is a **fully managed solution** that can export DynamoDB data to an S3 bucket from any time in the table’s **point-in-time recovery (PITR)** window, and that PITR must be enabled to use the export functionality. The same documentation says exports can be full or incremental, are asynchronous, **do not consume RCUs**, and have **no impact on table performance and availability**. PITR itself provides automatic continuous backups that are fully managed by DynamoDB. Therefore, enabling PITR and exporting directly to S3 meets the minimal-coding, no-availability-impact, and no-RCU-impact requirements ([DynamoDB export to S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/S3DataExport.HowItWorks.html), [DynamoDB PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Point-in-time-recovery.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An EMR/Hive backup job is not the minimal-coding/managed DynamoDB backup-to-S3 approach. Reading the table for export would typically involve table scans, and DynamoDB `Scan` operations consume read capacity units from the table’s provisioned read capacity, which violates the RCU requirement ([Scan capacity consumption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Scan.html)).
- **C:** DynamoDB Streams can capture item-level changes and can be processed by applications, but stream records are retained only up to 24 hours and using Lambda to transform/write records to S3 requires custom code and operational handling. It is not the native managed export-from-continuous-backups solution ([DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)).
- **D:** A scheduled Lambda export requires custom code and would need to read/scan the DynamoDB tables, which consumes RCUs; enabling PITR alone does not make this Lambda-based export non-impacting. Direct DynamoDB export to S3 is the managed feature that avoids RCU consumption and performance impact ([DynamoDB export to S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/S3DataExport.HowItWorks.html), [Scan capacity consumption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Scan.html)).

zh.question: 一家游戏公司使用 Amazon DynamoDB 存储用户信息，例如地理位置、玩家数据和排行榜。该公司需要以最少的编码量配置到 Amazon S3 bucket 的连续备份。备份不得影响应用程序的可用性，并且不得影响为该表定义的读取容量单位 (RCUs)。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EMR 集群。创建一个 Apache Hive 作业，将数据备份到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 使用连续备份将数据直接从 DynamoDB 导出到 Amazon S3。为该表开启时间点恢复。
options.C: 配置 Amazon DynamoDB Streams。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来消费该流并将数据导出到 Amazon S3 bucket。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期将数据从数据库表导出到 Amazon S3。为该表开启时间点恢复。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** DynamoDB export to S3 是为此需求设计的托管功能。AWS 说明，DynamoDB export to S3 是一种**完全托管的解决方案**，可以从表的**时间点恢复 (PITR)** 窗口内的任意时间将 DynamoDB 数据导出到 S3 bucket，并且必须启用 PITR 才能使用导出功能。同一文档还说明，导出可以是完整导出或增量导出，是异步的，**不消耗 RCUs**，并且**不会影响表性能和可用性**。PITR 本身提供由 DynamoDB 完全托管的自动连续备份。因此，启用 PITR 并直接导出到 S3 满足最少编码、无可用性影响和无 RCU 影响的要求（[DynamoDB export to S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/S3DataExport.HowItWorks.html)，[DynamoDB PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Point-in-time-recovery.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EMR/Hive 备份作业不是最少编码/托管式的 DynamoDB 到 S3 备份方法。读取表以进行导出通常会涉及表扫描，而 DynamoDB `Scan` 操作会消耗表的预置读取容量中的读取容量单位，这违反了 RCU 要求（[Scan capacity consumption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Scan.html)）。
- **C:** DynamoDB Streams 可以捕获项目级别的变更并可由应用程序处理，但流记录最多只保留 24 小时，而且使用 Lambda 转换/写入记录到 S3 需要自定义代码和运维处理。它不是从连续备份进行原生托管导出的解决方案（[DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)）。
- **D:** 计划触发的 Lambda 导出需要自定义代码，并且需要读取/扫描 DynamoDB 表，这会消耗 RCUs；仅启用 PITR 并不会让这种基于 Lambda 的导出变成无影响。直接 DynamoDB export to S3 才是避免 RCU 消耗和性能影响的托管功能（[DynamoDB export to S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/S3DataExport.HowItWorks.html)，[Scan capacity consumption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Scan.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing an asynchronous application to process credit card data validation requests for a bank. The application must be secure and be able to process each request at least once. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda event source mapping. Set Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queues as the event source. Use AWS Key Management Service (SSE-KMS) for encryption. Add the kms:Decrypt permission for the Lambda execution role.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda event source mapping. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the event source. Use SQS managed encryption keys (SSE-SQS) for encryption. Add the encryption key invocation permission for the Lambda function.
options.C: Use the AWS Lambda event source mapping. Set Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the event source. Use AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Add the kms:Decrypt permission for the Lambda execution role.
options.D: Use the AWS Lambda event source mapping. Set Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queues as the event source. Use AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for encryption. Add the encryption key invocation permission for the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

A standard SQS queue is the best fit because AWS documents that standard queues “ensure at-least-once message delivery” and specifically lists “handling a high volume of credit card validation requests” as a standard-queue use case ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)). Lambda can poll SQS by using an event source mapping, and for an encrypted SQS queue AWS says to add the required `kms:Decrypt` permission to the Lambda function’s **execution role** ([Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)). Therefore, standard SQS + SSE-KMS + `kms:Decrypt` on the Lambda execution role matches the security and at-least-once requirements.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: FIFO queues are intended for cases where ordering is critical or duplicates cannot be tolerated, and provide exactly-once processing semantics; AWS also notes FIFO queues have limited TPS ([Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)). The question asks only for at-least-once processing, for which standard queues are the documented fit. Also, “encryption key invocation permission for the Lambda function” is not the documented permission model.
- **C**: Uses FIFO queues, adding ordering/exactly-once behavior not required for this question. Standard queues are the documented at-least-once solution and even include credit card validation as an example use case ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)).
- **D**: The queue choice and SSE-KMS concept are correct, but the permission is wrong. AWS states that when using an encrypted SQS queue with Lambda, `kms:Decrypt` must be added to the Lambda **execution role**, not as an “encryption key invocation permission” on the function ([Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一家银行设计一个异步应用程序，用于处理信用卡数据验证请求。该应用程序必须安全，并且能够至少处理每个请求一次。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列设置为事件源。使用 AWS Key Management Service (SSE-KMS) 进行加密。为 Lambda 执行角色添加 kms:Decrypt 权限。
options.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列作为事件源。使用 SQS 托管加密密钥 (SSE-SQS) 进行加密。为 Lambda 函数添加加密密钥调用权限。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列设置为事件源。使用 AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS)。为 Lambda 执行角色添加 kms:Decrypt 权限。
options.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 事件源映射。将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列设置为事件源。使用 AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) 进行加密。为 Lambda 函数添加加密密钥调用权限。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

标准 SQS 队列最合适，因为 AWS 文档说明标准队列“ensure at-least-once message delivery”，并明确将“handling a high volume of credit card validation requests”列为标准队列的使用场景（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。Lambda 可以通过使用事件源映射轮询 SQS，并且对于加密的 SQS 队列，AWS 表示要将所需的 `kms:Decrypt` 权限添加到 Lambda 函数的**执行角色**（[Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)）。因此，标准 SQS + SSE-KMS + Lambda 执行角色上的 `kms:Decrypt` 符合安全性和至少一次处理的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：FIFO 队列适用于排序很关键或无法容忍重复的情况，并提供 exactly-once 处理语义；AWS 还指出 FIFO 队列具有有限的 TPS（[Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)）。题目只要求 at-least-once 处理，而标准队列是文档中对应的合适选择。此外，“encryption key invocation permission for the Lambda function”不是文档中说明的权限模型。
- **C**：使用 FIFO 队列，增加了本题不需要的排序/exactly-once 行为。标准队列是文档中说明的 at-least-once 解决方案，甚至将信用卡验证作为示例使用场景（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。
- **D**：队列选择和 SSE-KMS 概念是正确的，但权限是错误的。AWS 说明，当 Lambda 使用加密的 SQS 队列时，必须将 `kms:Decrypt` 添加到 Lambda **执行角色**，而不是作为函数上的“encryption key invocation permission”（[Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)）。

en.question: A company has multiple AWS accounts for development work. Some staff consistently use oversized Amazon EC2 instances, which causes the company to exceed the yearly budget for the development accounts. The company wants to centrally restrict the creation of AWS resources in these accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Develop AWS Systems Manager templates that use an approved EC2 creation process. Use the approved Systems Manager templates to provision EC2 instances.
options.B: Use AWS Organizations to organize the accounts into organizational units (OUs). Define and attach a service control policy (SCP) to control the usage of EC2 instance types.
options.C: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function when an EC2 instance is created. Stop disallowed EC2 instance types.
options.D: Set up AWS Service Catalog products for the staff to create the allowed EC2 instance types. Ensure that staff can deploy EC2 instances only by using the Service Catalog products.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Organizations is designed for centralized governance of multiple AWS accounts. AWS documentation states that an SCP attached to an organization, OU, or account provides “central control over the maximum available permissions” for accounts, and SCPs restrict permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts even if local administrators grant broad IAM permissions ([SCP examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_examples.html), [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). Amazon EC2 supports policy condition keys such as `ec2:InstanceType`, so an SCP can deny `ec2:RunInstances` for oversized instance types across the development OU ([Amazon EC2 authorization reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonec2.html)). This meets the requirement to **centrally restrict creation** with the least development effort.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Systems Manager templates would create an approved provisioning process, but this does not by itself centrally prevent users in multiple accounts from launching oversized instances through other paths. It also requires building and enforcing a custom process.
- **C:** EventBridge plus Lambda is reactive: the oversized instance is created first, then stopped. It also requires custom code and operations, so it is not the least development effort and does not truly restrict creation.
- **D:** AWS Service Catalog can centrally manage approved IT services and can restrict the instance type used in products ([Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)). However, it requires creating products/portfolios and ensuring users cannot bypass Service Catalog with direct EC2 permissions. An SCP is the simpler account-wide guardrail for multiple AWS accounts.

zh.question: 一家公司有多个用于开发工作的 AWS 账户。一些员工经常使用规格过大的 Amazon EC2 实例，导致公司超出开发账户的年度预算。公司希望集中限制这些账户中 AWS 资源的创建。哪种解决方案能以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 开发使用已批准 EC2 创建流程的 AWS Systems Manager 模板。使用已批准的 Systems Manager 模板来预置 EC2 实例。
options.B: 使用 AWS Organizations 将账户组织到组织单位 (OUs) 中。定义并附加服务控制策略 (SCP)，以控制 EC2 实例类型的使用。
options.C: 配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在创建 EC2 实例时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。停止不允许的 EC2 实例类型。
options.D: 为员工设置 AWS Service Catalog 产品，以创建允许的 EC2 实例类型。确保员工只能使用 Service Catalog 产品部署 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Organizations 专为多个 AWS 账户的集中治理而设计。AWS 文档说明，附加到组织、OU 或账户的 SCP 可为账户提供“对最大可用权限的集中控制”，并且即使本地管理员授予了广泛的 IAM 权限，SCP 也会限制成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色的权限（[SCP examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_examples.html)，[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。Amazon EC2 支持诸如 `ec2:InstanceType` 之类的策略条件键，因此 SCP 可以在整个开发 OU 中针对规格过大的实例类型拒绝 `ec2:RunInstances`（[Amazon EC2 authorization reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/service-authorization/latest/reference/list_amazonec2.html)）。这以最少的开发工作量满足了**集中限制创建**的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Systems Manager 模板可以创建已批准的预置流程，但这本身并不能集中阻止多个账户中的用户通过其他路径启动规格过大的实例。它还需要构建并强制执行自定义流程。
- **C:** EventBridge 加 Lambda 是被动响应式的：规格过大的实例会先被创建，然后才被停止。它还需要自定义代码和运维，因此不是最少开发工作量，也不能真正限制创建。
- **D:** AWS Service Catalog 可以集中管理已批准的 IT 服务，并且可以限制产品中使用的实例类型（[Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)）。但是，它需要创建产品/产品组合，并确保用户无法使用直接 EC2 权限绕过 Service Catalog。对于多个 AWS 账户，SCP 是更简单的账户级防护机制。

en.question: A company wants to use artificial intelligence (AI) to determine the quality of its customer service calls. The company currently manages calls in four different languages, including English. The company will offer new languages in the future. The company does not have the resources to regularly maintain machine learning (ML) models. The company needs to create written sentiment analysis reports from the customer service call recordings. The customer service call recording text must be translated into English. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use Amazon Comprehend to translate the audio recordings into English.
options.B: Use Amazon Lex to create the written sentiment analysis reports.
options.C: Use Amazon Polly to convert the audio recordings into text.
options.D: Use Amazon Transcribe to convert the audio recordings in any language into text.
options.E: Use Amazon Translate to translate text in any language to English.
options.F: Use Amazon Comprehend to create the sentiment analysis reports.

en.explanation:
The correct combination is **D, E, and F**.

- **D — Amazon Transcribe** is the right first step because it is an automatic speech recognition service that uses ML models to **convert audio to text** and supports both streaming and batch transcription, with supported languages listed by transcription type in AWS documentation ([Amazon Transcribe](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is-transcribe.html)).
- **E — Amazon Translate** is the right second step because it is a **text translation service** for translating unstructured text and building multilingual applications; AWS specifically describes using it to enable language-independent processing with other services ([Amazon Translate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/what-is.html)). After transcription, the call text can be translated to English.
- **F — Amazon Comprehend** is the right final step because it uses NLP to extract insights from documents and includes **sentiment** analysis. AWS also states that Comprehend provides **pre-trained models**, so the company does not need to maintain its own ML models ([Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **A** is wrong because Amazon Comprehend analyzes text documents for insights such as sentiment; it does **not** translate audio recordings into English ([Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
- **B** is wrong because Amazon Lex is for building **conversational interfaces and chatbots** using voice and text, not for generating sentiment analysis reports from recordings ([Amazon Lex V2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lexv2/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
- **C** is wrong because Amazon Polly converts **text into lifelike speech**; it is text-to-speech, not speech-to-text ([Amazon Polly](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用人工智能 (AI) 来确定其客户服务通话的质量。该公司目前以四种不同语言管理通话，其中包括英语。该公司未来将提供新的语言。该公司没有资源定期维护机器学习 (ML) 模型。该公司需要根据客户服务通话录音创建书面情感分析报告。客户服务通话录音文本必须翻译成英语。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 将音频录音翻译成英语。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Lex 创建书面情感分析报告。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Polly 将音频录音转换为文本。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Transcribe 将任何语言的音频录音转换为文本。
options.E: 使用 Amazon Translate 将任何语言的文本翻译成英语。
options.F: 使用 Amazon Comprehend 创建情感分析报告。

zh.explanation:
正确组合是 **D、E 和 F**。

- **D — Amazon Transcribe** 是正确的第一步，因为它是一项自动语音识别服务，使用 ML 模型将**音频转换为文本**，并且支持流式和批量转录，AWS 文档中按转录类型列出了支持的语言（[Amazon Transcribe](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/what-is-transcribe.html)）。
- **E — Amazon Translate** 是正确的第二步，因为它是一项用于翻译非结构化文本和构建多语言应用程序的**文本翻译服务**；AWS 明确描述了使用它与其他服务一起实现与语言无关的处理（[Amazon Translate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/translate/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。转录后，可以将通话文本翻译成英语。
- **F — Amazon Comprehend** 是正确的最后一步，因为它使用 NLP 从文档中提取洞察，并包含**情感**分析。AWS 还说明 Comprehend 提供**预训练模型**，因此该公司不需要维护自己的 ML 模型（[Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。错误选项：

- **A** 错误，因为 Amazon Comprehend 分析文本文档以获取情感等洞察；它**不会**将音频录音翻译成英语（[Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。
- **B** 错误，因为 Amazon Lex 用于使用语音和文本构建**对话界面和聊天机器人**，而不是从录音生成情感分析报告（[Amazon Lex V2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lexv2/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。
- **C** 错误，因为 Amazon Polly 将**文本转换为逼真的语音**；它是文本转语音，而不是语音转文本（[Amazon Polly](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。

options.A: The EC2 instance has a resource-based policy with a Deny statement.
options.B: The principal has not been specified in the policy statement.
options.C: The "Action" field does not grant the actions that are required to terminate the EC2 instance.
options.D: The request to terminate the EC2 instance does not originate from the CIDR blocks 192.0.2.0/24 or 203.0.113.0/24.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D**.

The role policy contains an explicit `Allow` for `ec2:TerminateInstances`, but it also contains an explicit `Deny` for the same action when the request source IP is **not** in `192.0.2.0/24` or `203.0.113.0/24`. AWS documents this exact `NotIpAddress` + `Deny` pattern: requests are denied unless they originate from those CIDR ranges, and when a principal makes a request from outside the IP range, the request is denied ([AWS: Denies access to AWS based on the source IP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_aws_deny-ip.html)). AWS policy evaluation also states that an explicit deny overrides an explicit allow ([How AWS enforcement code logic evaluates requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic_policy-eval-denyallow.html)). Therefore, the CLI request is failing because it originates outside the allowed CIDR blocks.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** is incorrect: The scenario shows an identity-based policy attached to an IAM role. There is no indication that an EC2 resource-based policy is causing the denial.
- **B** is incorrect: For an IAM permissions policy attached to a user or role, the `Principal` element is not included; the principal is implied as that user or role ([Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).
- **C** is incorrect: The policy explicitly allows `ec2:TerminateInstances`, which is the relevant action. The failure is caused by the explicit deny condition, not by a missing action.

options.A: 该 EC2 实例具有包含 Deny 语句的基于资源的策略。
options.B: 策略语句中未指定主体。
options.C: "Action" 字段未授予终止该 EC2 实例所需的操作。
options.D: 终止该 EC2 实例的请求并非来自 CIDR 块 192.0.2.0/24 或 203.0.113.0/24。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D**。该角色策略包含对 `ec2:TerminateInstances` 的显式 `Allow`，但它也包含针对同一操作的显式 `Deny`，条件是请求源 IP **不在** `192.0.2.0/24` 或 `203.0.113.0/24` 中。AWS 记录了这个完全相同的 `NotIpAddress` + `Deny` 模式：除非请求来自这些 CIDR 范围，否则请求会被拒绝；当主体从 IP 范围之外发出请求时，该请求会被拒绝（[AWS: Denies access to AWS based on the source IP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_aws_deny-ip.html)）。AWS 策略评估还说明，显式拒绝会覆盖显式允许（[How AWS enforcement code logic evaluates requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic_policy-eval-denyallow.html)）。因此，CLI 请求失败是因为它来自允许的 CIDR 块之外。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A** 错误：该场景显示的是附加到 IAM 角色的基于身份的策略。没有迹象表明 EC2 基于资源的策略导致了拒绝。
- **B** 错误：对于附加到用户或角色的 IAM 权限策略，不包含 `Principal` 元素；主体被隐含为该用户或角色（[Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。
- **C** 错误：该策略显式允许 `ec2:TerminateInstances`，这是相关操作。失败是由显式拒绝条件导致的，而不是因为缺少操作。

en.question: A company is conducting an internal audit. The company wants to ensure that the data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is associated with the company’s AWS Lake Formation data lake does not contain sensitive customer or employee data. The company wants to discover personally identifiable information (PII) or financial information, including passport numbers and credit card numbers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Audit Manager on the account. Select the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS) for auditing.
options.B: Configure Amazon S3 Inventory on the S3 bucket Configure Amazon Athena to query the inventory.
options.C: Configure Amazon Macie to run a data discovery job that uses managed identifiers for the required data types.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 Select to run a report across the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon Macie is designed for this requirement: AWS states that Macie helps discover, monitor, and protect sensitive data in **Amazon S3**, and that sensitive data discovery jobs provide targeted analysis of specified S3 buckets. Macie managed data identifiers can detect sensitive data types including **PII** and **financial information** ([Macie features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)). The recommended managed identifiers explicitly include **credit card number** under financial information and **passport number** under PII ([recommended managed identifiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-mdis-recommended.html)); Macie also documents passport-number managed identifiers for multiple countries/regions ([PII managed identifiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/mdis-reference-pii.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** AWS Audit Manager with a PCI DSS framework supports audit preparation and evidence collection, but it is not a service for scanning S3 object contents to discover PII/passport numbers. The question asks for sensitive data discovery in an S3 bucket, not a compliance evidence assessment.
- **B:** S3 Inventory with Athena lets you query inventory files about S3 objects, but inventory is object metadata/reporting, not inspection of object contents for PII or financial data.
- **D:** S3 Select can query/filter data from S3 objects with SQL, but it is not a managed sensitive-data discovery/classification service and would not automatically detect PII such as passport numbers or credit card numbers across the bucket.

zh.question: 一家公司正在进行内部审计。该公司希望确保与其 AWS Lake Formation 数据湖关联的 Amazon S3 存储桶中的数据不包含敏感的客户或员工数据。该公司希望发现个人身份信息（PII）或财务信息，包括护照号码和信用卡号码。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在账户上配置 AWS Audit Manager。选择 Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards (PCI DSS) 进行审计。
options.B: 在 S3 存储桶上配置 Amazon S3 Inventory。配置 Amazon Athena 以查询该清单。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Macie 运行数据发现作业，该作业使用所需数据类型的托管标识符。
options.D: 使用 Amazon S3 Select 在整个 S3 存储桶中运行报告。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon Macie 专为此要求而设计：AWS 表示，Macie 可帮助发现、监控和保护 **Amazon S3** 中的敏感数据，并且敏感数据发现作业可对指定的 S3 存储桶进行有针对性的分析。Macie 托管数据标识符可以检测敏感数据类型，包括 **PII** 和 **financial information**（[Macie features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。推荐的托管标识符明确包括财务信息下的 **credit card number** 和 PII 下的 **passport number**（[recommended managed identifiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-mdis-recommended.html)）；Macie 还记录了适用于多个国家/地区的护照号码托管标识符（[PII managed identifiers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/mdis-reference-pii.html)）。

**为什么其他选项错误：**

- **A:** 使用 PCI DSS 框架的 AWS Audit Manager 支持审计准备和证据收集，但它不是用于扫描 S3 对象内容以发现 PII/护照号码的服务。题目要求的是在 S3 存储桶中进行敏感数据发现，而不是合规性证据评估。
- **B:** S3 Inventory 与 Athena 可让您查询有关 S3 对象的清单文件，但清单是对象元数据/报告，而不是检查对象内容以发现 PII 或财务数据。
- **D:** S3 Select 可以使用 SQL 从 S3 对象查询/筛选数据，但它不是托管的敏感数据发现/分类服务，也不会自动在整个存储桶中检测护照号码或信用卡号码等 PII。

en.question: A company uses on-premises servers to host its applications. The company is running out of storage capacity. The applications use both block storage and NFS storage. The company needs a high- performing solution that supports local caching without re-architecting its existing applications. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Mount Amazon S3 as a file system to the on-premises servers.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to replace NFS storage.
options.C: Deploy AWS Snowball Edge to provision NFS mounts to on-premises servers.
options.D: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway to replace the block storage.
options.E: Deploy Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volumes and mount them to on-premises servers.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and D**.

- **B. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to replace NFS storage** — Amazon S3 File Gateway supports standard file protocols including **NFS v3 and v4.1**, can be deployed in the on-premises environment, and provides **low-latency access through transparent local caching**. This fits the existing NFS applications without re-architecting them. [AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html) also states that local disks are used as cache to provide low-latency access to recently accessed data. [Managing local disks for File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/ManagingLocalStorage-common.html)
- **D. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway to replace the block storage** — Volume Gateway provides cloud-backed storage volumes that on-premises application servers mount as **iSCSI devices**, which is appropriate for block storage. Its cached volume configuration stores data in S3 while retaining frequently accessed data locally for low-latency access and reduced on-premises storage scaling. [What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** is not the right approach because Amazon S3 is object storage; AWS provides S3 File Gateway specifically to expose S3 through file protocols such as NFS/SMB with local caching, rather than simply mounting S3 directly as a filesystem. [S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)
- **C** is not the best fit. Snowball Edge can support NFS for **data migration** and physical transfer to/from S3, but the requirement is ongoing high-performing storage with local caching for existing block and NFS workloads. [Snowball Edge features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)
- **E** can mount EFS from on-premises, but AWS documentation lists an existing **Direct Connect or VPN connection** as a prerequisite, and it does not address the company’s block storage requirement or the stated local-caching need. [Mounting EFS with on-premises Linux clients](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-mount-helper-direct.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用本地服务器托管其应用程序。该公司存储容量即将耗尽。这些应用程序同时使用块存储和 NFS 存储。公司需要一种高性能解决方案，支持本地缓存，并且无需重新架构现有应用程序。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 Amazon S3 作为文件系统挂载到本地服务器。
options.B: 部署 AWS Storage Gateway file gateway 来替换 NFS 存储。
options.C: 部署 AWS Snowball Edge，为本地服务器预置 NFS 挂载。
options.D: 部署 AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway 来替换块存储。
options.E: 部署 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷，并将其挂载到本地服务器。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 D**。

- **B. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to replace NFS storage** — Amazon S3 File Gateway 支持标准文件协议，包括 **NFS v3 and v4.1**，可以部署在本地环境中，并通过透明的本地缓存提供**低延迟访问**。这适合现有 NFS 应用程序，无需重新架构它们。[AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html) 还说明，本地磁盘用作缓存，以便为最近访问的数据提供低延迟访问。[Managing local disks for File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/ManagingLocalStorage-common.html)
- **D. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway to replace the block storage** — Volume Gateway 提供由云支持的存储卷，本地应用程序服务器可将其挂载为 **iSCSI devices**，这适用于块存储。其 cached volume 配置将数据存储在 S3 中，同时将频繁访问的数据保留在本地，以实现低延迟访问并减少本地存储扩展需求。[What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A** 不是正确方法，因为 Amazon S3 是对象存储；AWS 提供 S3 File Gateway，专门用于通过 NFS/SMB 等文件协议公开 S3，并带有本地缓存，而不是简单地将 S3 直接挂载为文件系统。[S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)
- **C** 不是最佳选择。Snowball Edge 可以支持用于**数据迁移**以及与 S3 之间物理传输的 NFS，但要求是为现有块存储和 NFS 工作负载提供持续的高性能存储并具备本地缓存。[Snowball Edge features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)
- **E** 可以从本地挂载 EFS，但 AWS 文档将现有 **Direct Connect or VPN connection** 列为先决条件，并且它无法满足公司的块存储要求或所述的本地缓存需求。[Mounting EFS with on-premises Linux clients](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-mount-helper-direct.html)

en.question: A company has a service that reads and writes large amounts of data from an Amazon S3 bucket in the same AWS Region. The service is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances within the private subnet of a VPC. The service communicates with Amazon S3 over a NAT gateway in the public subnet. However, the company wants a solution that will reduce the data output costs. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Provision a dedicated EC2 NAT instance in the public subnet. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use the elastic network interface of this instance as the destination for all S3 traffic.
options.B: Provision a dedicated EC2 NAT instance in the private subnet. Configure the route table for the public subnet to use the elastic network interface of this instance as the destination for all S3 traffic.
options.C: Provision a VPC gateway endpoint. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use the gateway endpoint as the route for all S3 traffic.
options.D: Provision a second NAT gateway. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use this NAT gateway as the destination for all S3 traffic.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 is the most cost-effective solution. AWS states that after creating an S3 gateway endpoint, you can add it as a target in the VPC route table for traffic destined to Amazon S3, and that there is **no additional charge** for using gateway endpoints. The same documentation also states that S3 can be accessed from a VPC through a gateway endpoint **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device** and with no additional cost ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). This directly fits EC2 instances in private subnets accessing an S3 bucket in the same Region.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A:** A NAT instance in a public subnet is still a NAT device and would add EC2 instance cost, scaling/availability management, and would not be as cost-effective as a no-additional-charge S3 gateway endpoint. AWS specifically recommends considering interface or gateway endpoints when most NAT gateway traffic is to supported AWS services to reduce NAT gateway data transfer costs ([Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)).
- **B:** A NAT instance placed in a private subnet is not the appropriate architecture for providing outbound access for public/private subnet traffic, and it would not provide the direct private S3 routing that a gateway endpoint provides.
- **D:** Adding another NAT gateway would increase NAT gateway hourly charges and data processing charges. AWS documents that NAT gateways are charged per hour and per gigabyte processed ([Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)), so this does not reduce costs compared with routing S3 traffic through a gateway endpoint.

zh.question: 一家公司有一项服务，会从同一 AWS Region 中的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶读取和写入大量数据。该服务部署在 VPC 的私有子网内的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该服务通过公有子网中的 NAT gateway 与 Amazon S3 通信。但是，该公司希望采用一种能够降低数据输出成本的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在公有子网中预置一个专用的 EC2 NAT instance。配置私有子网的路由表，使用该实例的 elastic network interface 作为所有 S3 流量的目标。
options.B: 在私有子网中预置一个专用的 EC2 NAT instance。配置公有子网的路由表，使用该实例的 elastic network interface 作为所有 S3 流量的目标。
options.C: 预置一个 VPC gateway endpoint。配置私有子网的路由表，使用该 gateway endpoint 作为所有 S3 流量的路由。
options.D: 预置第二个 NAT gateway。配置私有子网的路由表，使用此 NAT gateway 作为所有 S3 流量的目标。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

用于 Amazon S3 的 VPC gateway endpoint 是最具成本效益的解决方案。AWS 说明，在创建 S3 gateway endpoint 后，你可以将其作为 VPC 路由表中发往 Amazon S3 的流量目标，并且使用 gateway endpoint **不收取额外费用**。同一文档还说明，可以通过 gateway endpoint 从 VPC 访问 S3，**无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device**，且没有额外费用（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。这直接适用于私有子网中的 EC2 实例访问同一 Region 中的 S3 存储桶。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A:** 公有子网中的 NAT instance 仍然是 NAT device，并且会增加 EC2 实例成本、扩展/可用性管理开销，而且不如不收取额外费用的 S3 gateway endpoint 具有成本效益。AWS 特别建议，当大多数 NAT gateway 流量流向受支持的 AWS 服务时，应考虑使用 interface 或 gateway endpoint，以降低 NAT gateway 数据传输成本（[Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)）。
- **B:** 放置在私有子网中的 NAT instance 并不是为公有/私有子网流量提供出站访问的合适架构，并且它无法提供 gateway endpoint 所提供的直接私有 S3 路由。
- **D:** 添加另一个 NAT gateway 会增加 NAT gateway 小时费用和数据处理费用。AWS 文档说明，NAT gateway 按小时和处理的每 GB 计费（[Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)），因此与通过 gateway endpoint 路由 S3 流量相比，这并不能降低成本。

en.question: A company uses Amazon S3 to store high-resolution pictures in an S3 bucket. To minimize application changes, the company stores the pictures as the latest version of an S3 object. The company needs to retain only the two most recent versions of the pictures. The company wants to reduce costs. The company has identified the S3 bucket as a large expense. Which solution will reduce the S3 costs with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use S3 Lifecycle to delete expired object versions and retain the two most recent versions.
options.B: Use an AWS Lambda function to check for older versions and delete all but the two most recent versions.
options.C: Use S3 Batch Operations to delete noncurrent object versions and retain only the two most recent versions.
options.D: Deactivate versioning on the S3 bucket and retain the two most recent versions.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Use an **S3 Lifecycle** rule with `NoncurrentVersionExpiration` to automatically remove older noncurrent versions. AWS documentation states that for a versioning-enabled bucket, S3 Lifecycle can retain a specified number of newer noncurrent versions, and Amazon S3 will permanently delete additional noncurrent versions beyond that number when the configured conditions are met ([S3 Lifecycle configuration examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html)). AWS also explicitly recommends using S3 Versioning with S3 Lifecycle to customize retention and control storage costs ([S3 Versioning with S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)). This is automated and has the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Lambda function** — A Lambda-based cleanup process would require custom code, scheduling/event handling, testing, monitoring, and error handling. S3 Lifecycle provides the native automated mechanism for this use case.
- **C. S3 Batch Operations** — Batch Operations can perform bulk actions, but it is job-oriented and not the lowest-overhead continuous retention mechanism. S3 Lifecycle is designed to automatically expire noncurrent versions over time.
- **D. Deactivate versioning** — S3 versioning cannot be fully deactivated after it has been enabled; it can only be suspended. AWS states that after a bucket is version-enabled, it can never return to an unversioned state, and suspending versioning does not change existing objects ([S3 Versioning states](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)). This also would not automatically retain only the two most recent versions.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 将高分辨率图片存储在一个 S3 bucket 中。为了尽量减少应用程序变更，该公司将图片存储为 S3 object 的最新版本。该公司只需要保留图片最近的两个版本。公司希望降低成本，并已确定该 S3 bucket 是一项较大的开支。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销降低 S3 成本？

options.A: 使用 S3 Lifecycle 删除过期的对象版本，并保留最近的两个版本。
options.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数检查较旧版本，并删除除最近两个版本之外的所有版本。
options.C: 使用 S3 Batch Operations 删除非当前对象版本，并仅保留最近的两个版本。
options.D: 停用 S3 bucket 上的版本控制，并保留最近的两个版本。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

使用带有 `NoncurrentVersionExpiration` 的 **S3 Lifecycle** 规则来自动删除较旧的非当前版本。AWS 文档说明，对于启用了版本控制的 bucket，S3 Lifecycle 可以保留指定数量的较新的非当前版本，并且当满足配置的条件时，Amazon S3 将永久删除超出该数量的其他非当前版本（[S3 Lifecycle configuration examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-configuration-examples.html)）。AWS 还明确建议将 S3 Versioning 与 S3 Lifecycle 结合使用，以自定义保留策略并控制存储成本（[S3 Versioning with S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)）。这是自动化的，并且运营开销最少。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. Lambda function** — 基于 Lambda 的清理流程需要自定义代码、调度/事件处理、测试、监控和错误处理。S3 Lifecycle 为此用例提供了原生的自动化机制。
- **C. S3 Batch Operations** — Batch Operations 可以执行批量操作，但它是面向作业的，并不是开销最低的持续保留机制。S3 Lifecycle 旨在随着时间推移自动使非当前版本过期。
- **D. Deactivate versioning** — S3 versioning 一旦启用后无法完全停用；只能暂停。AWS 说明，在 bucket 启用版本控制后，它永远无法返回到未启用版本控制的状态，并且暂停版本控制不会改变现有对象（[S3 Versioning states](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)）。这也不会自动仅保留最近的两个版本。

en.question: A company needs to minimize the cost of its 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection. The company's average connection utilization is less than 10%. A solutions architect must recommend a solution that will reduce the cost without compromising security. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up a new 1 Gbps Direct Connect connection. Share the connection with another AWS account.
options.B: Set up a new 200 Mbps Direct Connect connection in the AWS Management Console.
options.C: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 1 Gbps connection. Share the connection with another AWS account.
options.D: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 200 Mbps hosted connection for an existing AWS account.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Direct Connect port-hour pricing is determined by **capacity and connection type** (dedicated vs. hosted), so reducing an underutilized 1 Gbps connection to a lower-capacity connection can reduce cost ([AWS Direct Connect pricing section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). AWS documents that **dedicated connections** are available at 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps, while **hosted connections** include **200 Mbps** and are obtained by working with an AWS Direct Connect Partner ([connection options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/connection_options.html)). AWS also states that you **can't request a hosted connection through the Direct Connect console**; an AWS Direct Connect Partner creates and configures it for you ([hosted connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/hosted_connection.html)). Therefore, ordering a 200 Mbps hosted connection through a Direct Connect Partner best matches the low utilization and cost-minimization requirement without needing to share the connection.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A:** A new **1 Gbps** dedicated connection does not reduce the provisioned capacity, and pricing depends on capacity and connection type. Sharing it with another AWS account also is not the direct cost-minimizing design for this company's low utilization.
* **B:** A **200 Mbps** Direct Connect connection is a hosted-connection speed, but AWS states hosted connections cannot be requested through the Direct Connect console; they must be created by a Direct Connect Partner.
* **C:** Although a Direct Connect Partner can provide connections, ordering another **1 Gbps** connection does not reduce the capacity to match less than 10% utilization, so it does not minimize cost as well as a 200 Mbps hosted connection.

zh.question: 一家公司需要将其 1 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接的成本降至最低。该公司的平均连接利用率低于 10%。解决方案架构师必须推荐一种在不影响安全性的情况下降低成本的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置新的 1 Gbps Direct Connect 连接。与另一个 AWS 账户共享该连接。
options.B: 在 AWS Management Console 中设置新的 200 Mbps Direct Connect 连接。
options.C: 联系 AWS Direct Connect Partner 订购 1 Gbps 连接。与另一个 AWS 账户共享该连接。
options.D: 联系 AWS Direct Connect Partner，为现有 AWS 账户订购 200 Mbps 托管连接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** AWS Direct Connect 端口小时定价由**容量和连接类型**（专用与托管）决定，因此，将利用率不足的 1 Gbps 连接降低为较低容量的连接可以降低成本（[AWS Direct Connect pricing section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。AWS 文档说明，**专用连接**提供 1 Gbps、10 Gbps、100 Gbps 和 400 Gbps，而**托管连接**包括 **200 Mbps**，并且需要通过与 AWS Direct Connect Partner 合作来获取（[connection options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/connection_options.html)）。AWS 还说明，你**不能通过 Direct Connect console 请求托管连接**；AWS Direct Connect Partner 会为你创建并配置该连接（[hosted connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/hosted_connection.html)）。因此，通过 Direct Connect Partner 订购 200 Mbps 托管连接，最符合低利用率和成本最小化要求，并且不需要共享连接。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A:** 新的 **1 Gbps** 专用连接不会降低预置容量，而定价取决于容量和连接类型。与另一个 AWS 账户共享该连接，也不是针对该公司低利用率情况的直接成本最小化设计。
* **B:** **200 Mbps** Direct Connect 连接属于托管连接速度，但 AWS 表示不能通过 Direct Connect console 请求托管连接；它们必须由 Direct Connect Partner 创建。
* **C:** 尽管 Direct Connect Partner 可以提供连接，但订购另一个 **1 Gbps** 连接并不会将容量降低到匹配低于 10% 利用率的水平，因此它不像 200 Mbps 托管连接那样能够更好地最小化成本。

en.question: A company has multiple Windows file servers on premises. The company wants to migrate and consolidate its files into an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. File permissions must be preserved to ensure that access rights do not change. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy AWS DataSync agents on premises. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.B: Copy the shares on each file server into Amazon S3 buckets by using the AWS CLI. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.C: Remove the drives from each file server. Ship the drives to AWS for import into Amazon S3. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.D: Order an AWS Snowcone device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Launch AWS DataSync agents on the device. Schedule DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.
options.E: Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Connect the device to the on-premises network. Copy data to the device by using the AWS CLI. Ship the device back to AWS for import into Amazon S3. Schedule AWS DataSync tasks to transfer the data to the FSx for Windows File Server file system.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and D**.

- **A is correct** because migrating directly from on-premises SMB/Windows file servers to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with AWS DataSync is the path that can preserve Windows file permissions. AWS says a DataSync agent is needed when transferring between AWS storage services and on-premises storage, and DataSync supports FSx for Windows File Server as a transfer location. For SMB-to-FSx Windows transfers, DataSync can copy file owner SIDs and NTFS DACLs/SACLs, which are the Windows permissions/access-control metadata required to preserve access rights. DataSync also documents the required FSx Windows permissions needed to copy object ownership and Windows ACLs. ([Do I need a DataSync agent?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/do-i-need-datasync-agent.html), [FSx for Windows File Server locations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html), [DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))
- **D is correct** because it still uses DataSync to perform the transfer from the on-premises environment to the FSx for Windows File Server destination. The key requirement is that the data is transferred as an SMB/FSx Windows transfer by DataSync, where NTFS ACLs can be copied. A Snowcone/Snow device can provide an on-premises edge environment for the DataSync agent while the transfer task writes to FSx for Windows File Server. ([DataSync agent requirement for on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/do-i-need-datasync-agent.html), [DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))

Why the other options are wrong:

- **B is wrong** because it first copies Windows file shares into Amazon S3. DataSync documentation states that when copying from SMB/FSx Windows to Amazon S3 or other non-Windows targets, Windows-based metadata such as ACLs is **not preserved**; when copying from S3 to SMB/FSx Windows, permissions are inherited from the parent directory rather than restored from the original Windows ACLs. ([DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))
- **C is wrong** for the same reason: importing the drives into S3 introduces S3 as an intermediate object store, which does not preserve the Windows ACLs needed for unchanged access rights when later transferring to FSx for Windows File Server. ([DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))
- **E is wrong** because copying to a Snowball Edge device and importing into S3 with the AWS CLI also stages the data in S3. That path does not preserve Windows ACLs end-to-end to FSx for Windows File Server; S3-to-FSx Windows transfers result in permissions inherited from the destination parent directory. ([DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))

zh.question: 一家公司在本地有多台 Windows 文件服务器。该公司希望将其文件迁移并整合到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统中。必须保留文件权限，以确保访问权限不发生变化。哪些解决方案可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在本地部署 AWS DataSync 代理。计划 DataSync 任务，将数据传输到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。
options.B: 使用 AWS CLI 将每台文件服务器上的共享复制到 Amazon S3 存储桶中。计划 AWS DataSync 任务，将数据传输到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。
options.C: 从每台文件服务器中移除驱动器。将驱动器运送到 AWS，以导入到 Amazon S3。计划 AWS DataSync 任务，将数据传输到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。
options.D: 订购一台 AWS Snowcone 设备。将该设备连接到本地网络。在该设备上启动 AWS DataSync 代理。计划 DataSync 任务，将数据传输到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。
options.E: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备。将该设备连接到本地网络。使用 AWS CLI 将数据复制到该设备。将该设备运回 AWS，以导入到 Amazon S3。计划 AWS DataSync 任务，将数据传输到 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A and D**。

- **A is correct**，因为使用 AWS DataSync 直接从本地 SMB/Windows 文件服务器迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server，是可以保留 Windows 文件权限的路径。AWS 表示，在 AWS 存储服务与本地存储之间传输时需要 DataSync 代理，并且 DataSync 支持将 FSx for Windows File Server 作为传输位置。对于 SMB 到 FSx Windows 的传输，DataSync 可以复制文件所有者 SID 以及 NTFS DACL/SACL，这些都是保留访问权限所需的 Windows 权限/访问控制元数据。DataSync 还记录了复制对象所有权和 Windows ACL 所需的 FSx Windows 权限。([Do I need a DataSync agent?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/do-i-need-datasync-agent.html), [FSx for Windows File Server locations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html), [DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))
- **D is correct**，因为它仍然使用 DataSync 执行从本地环境到 FSx for Windows File Server 目标位置的传输。关键要求是数据通过 DataSync 以 SMB/FSx Windows 传输方式进行传输，在这种情况下可以复制 NTFS ACL。Snowcone/Snow 设备可以为 DataSync 代理提供本地边缘环境，同时传输任务写入 FSx for Windows File Server。([DataSync agent requirement for on-premises transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/do-i-need-datasync-agent.html), [DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))

其他选项错误的原因：

- **B is wrong**，因为它先将 Windows 文件共享复制到 Amazon S3。DataSync 文档说明，当从 SMB/FSx Windows 复制到 Amazon S3 或其他非 Windows 目标时，基于 Windows 的元数据（例如 ACL）**不会被保留**；当从 S3 复制到 SMB/FSx Windows 时，权限会从父目录继承，而不是从原始 Windows ACL 恢复。([DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))
- **C is wrong**，原因相同：将驱动器导入到 S3 会引入 S3 作为中间对象存储，而 S3 不会保留之后传输到 FSx for Windows File Server 时保持访问权限不变所需的 Windows ACL。([DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))
- **E is wrong**，因为使用 AWS CLI 复制到 Snowball Edge 设备并导入到 S3，也会将数据暂存到 S3。该路径无法端到端地将 Windows ACL 保留到 FSx for Windows File Server；S3 到 FSx Windows 的传输会导致权限从目标父目录继承。([DataSync metadata handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/metadata-copied.html))

en.question: A company wants to ingest customer payment data into the company's data lake in Amazon S3. The company receives payment data every minute on average. The company wants to analyze the payment data in real time. Then the company wants to ingest the data into the data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time.
options.B: Use AWS Glue to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time.
options.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time.
options.D: Use Amazon API Gateway to ingest data. Use AWS Lambda to analyze the data in real time.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon Data Firehose is a fully managed service for delivering real-time streaming data to destinations such as Amazon S3, and AWS states that with Firehose you do not need to write applications or manage resources; producers send data to Firehose and Firehose automatically delivers it to the configured destination ([Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)). Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics applications continuously read and process streaming data in real time, and their input can be either a Kinesis data stream or a Firehose delivery stream; application output can then be persisted to an external destination, including a Firehose delivery stream that writes to S3 ([Kinesis Data Analytics: How It Works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/how-it-works.html)). This managed Firehose + Kinesis Data Analytics pattern best matches real-time analysis followed by ingestion into an S3 data lake with the least operational burden.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda** can process streaming records: Lambda can process records from Kinesis Data Streams, and Kinesis Data Streams supports real-time collection and processing ([Lambda with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html), [Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). However, this requires custom Lambda processing and custom delivery/archival logic to S3, so it is less operationally efficient than the managed Firehose delivery plus Kinesis Data Analytics solution.
- **B. AWS Glue + Kinesis Data Analytics** is not the best fit for ingestion here. AWS Glue streaming ETL jobs are continuous jobs that consume streaming sources such as Kinesis Data Streams, Kafka, or MSK, cleanse/transform data, and load results to S3; they also bill while running and are ETL-oriented rather than the most direct managed ingestion path ([AWS Glue streaming ETL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-job-streaming.html)).
- **D. API Gateway + Lambda** is for creating, publishing, maintaining, monitoring, and securing REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs, not a purpose-built streaming ingestion and analytics service for a data lake ([API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)). It would require more custom logic and operations than the Kinesis managed services.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将客户付款数据摄取到公司位于 Amazon S3 的数据湖中。该公司平均每分钟接收一次付款数据。公司希望实时分析付款数据。然后公司希望将数据摄取到数据湖中。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 摄取数据。使用 AWS Lambda 实时分析数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS Glue 摄取数据。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 实时分析数据。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 摄取数据。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 实时分析数据。
options.D: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 摄取数据。使用 AWS Lambda 实时分析数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon Data Firehose 是一项完全托管的服务，用于将实时流数据交付到 Amazon S3 等目标位置，并且 AWS 表示，使用 Firehose 时无需编写应用程序或管理资源；生产者将数据发送到 Firehose，Firehose 会自动将其交付到配置的目标位置（[Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)）。Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 应用程序会持续实时读取和处理流数据，其输入可以是 Kinesis data stream 或 Firehose delivery stream；然后应用程序输出可以持久化到外部目标位置，包括写入 S3 的 Firehose delivery stream（[Kinesis Data Analytics: How It Works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/how-it-works.html)）。这种托管的 Firehose + Kinesis Data Analytics 模式最符合实时分析后再摄取到 S3 数据湖的需求，并且运营负担最低。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda** 可以处理流式记录：Lambda 可以处理来自 Kinesis Data Streams 的记录，而 Kinesis Data Streams 支持实时收集和处理（[Lambda with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)，[Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。但是，这需要自定义 Lambda 处理以及自定义交付/归档逻辑到 S3，因此其运营效率低于托管的 Firehose 交付加 Kinesis Data Analytics 解决方案。
- **B. AWS Glue + Kinesis Data Analytics** 在这里并不是摄取的最佳选择。AWS Glue streaming ETL 作业是持续运行的作业，会消费 Kinesis Data Streams、Kafka 或 MSK 等流式源，清洗/转换数据，并将结果加载到 S3；它们在运行期间也会计费，并且更偏向 ETL，而不是最直接的托管摄取路径（[AWS Glue streaming ETL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-job-streaming.html)）。
- **D. API Gateway + Lambda** 用于创建、发布、维护、监控和保护 REST、HTTP 和 WebSocket API，并不是面向数据湖的专用流式摄取和分析服务（[API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)）。与 Kinesis 托管服务相比，它需要更多自定义逻辑和运维工作。

en.question: A company runs a website that uses a content management system (CMS) on Amazon EC2. The CMS runs on a single EC2 instance and uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance for the data tier. Website images are stored on an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that is mounted inside the EC2 instance. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to improve the performance and resilience of the website? (Choose two.)

options.A: Move the website images into an Amazon S3 bucket that is mounted on every EC2 instance
options.B: Share the website images by using an NFS share from the primary EC2 instance. Mount this share on the other EC2 instances.
options.C: Move the website images onto an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that is mounted on every EC2 instance.
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator for the website
options.E: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the existing EC2 instance. Use the AMI to provision new instances behind an Application Load Balancer as part of an Auto Scaling group. Configure the Auto Scaling group to maintain a minimum of two instances. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the website.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **C and E**.

- **C is correct** because the CMS currently stores shared images on an EBS volume attached to one EC2 instance, which prevents resilient horizontal scaling.
