Amazon EFS is appropriate shared file storage for multiple web servers: AWS documents that you can mount EFS file systems to multiple Amazon EC2 instances, with standard EFS mount commands such as `sudo mount -t efs ...` [Mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html).
- **E is correct** because creating an AMI and using an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer improves resilience and scalability. AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attaching a load balancer to distribute traffic for geographic redundancy; if one AZ becomes unhealthy, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ [Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html). CloudFront is also the better edge service for this website because it can speed delivery of static content such as images by using the AWS backbone and CloudFront edge servers [Accelerate static website content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html).

Incorrect options:

- **A is wrong** because Amazon S3 is object storage: buckets are containers for objects, and objects are the fundamental entities stored in S3 [Amazon S3 data inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-data-inventory.html). The option specifically says to mount an S3 bucket on every EC2 instance, which is not the native shared file-system approach needed here; EFS is the AWS file system designed to be mounted by multiple EC2 instances.
- **B is wrong** because exporting an NFS share from the primary EC2 instance keeps the primary instance as a dependency and potential single point of failure/bottleneck. EFS provides the managed shared file system capability instead [Mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html).
- **D is wrong** because the ALB/Auto Scaling portion is useful, but Global Accelerator is not the best fit for improving delivery of website images/static content. CloudFront specifically accelerates static website content, including images, using edge servers [Ways to use CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 上运行一个使用内容管理系统 (CMS) 的网站。该 CMS 运行在单个 EC2 实例上，并使用 Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance 作为数据层。网站图片存储在一个挂载到该 EC2 实例内部的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来提高网站的性能和弹性？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将网站图片移入一个挂载到每个 EC2 实例上的 Amazon S3 bucket
options.B: 通过来自主 EC2 实例的 NFS 共享来共享网站图片。将此共享挂载到其他 EC2 实例上。
options.C: 将网站图片移到一个挂载到每个 EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system。
options.D: 从现有 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 在 Application Load Balancer 后面预置新实例，作为 Auto Scaling group 的一部分。配置 Auto Scaling group，使其保持至少两个实例。为该网站在 AWS Global Accelerator 中配置一个 accelerator
options.E: 从现有 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 在 Application Load Balancer 后面预置新实例，作为 Auto Scaling group 的一部分。配置 Auto Scaling group，使其保持至少两个实例。为该网站配置一个 Amazon CloudFront distribution。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **C 和 E**。

- **C 正确**，因为 CMS 当前将共享图片存储在附加到一个 EC2 实例的 EBS 卷上，这会阻碍具有弹性的水平扩展。Amazon EFS 适合作为多个 Web 服务器的共享文件存储：AWS 文档说明你可以将 EFS file systems 挂载到多个 Amazon EC2 实例，并使用标准 EFS 挂载命令，例如 `sudo mount -t efs ...` [Mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html)。
- **E 正确**，因为创建 AMI 并在 Application Load Balancer 后面使用 Auto Scaling group 可提高弹性和可扩展性。AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling group 跨多个 Availability Zones 部署，并附加 load balancer 来分发流量以实现地理冗余；如果一个 AZ 变得不健康，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例 [Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)。CloudFront 也是该网站更合适的边缘服务，因为它可以使用 AWS backbone 和 CloudFront edge servers 加速图片等静态内容的交付 [Accelerate static website content delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)。错误选项：

- **A 错误**，因为 Amazon S3 是对象存储：bucket 是对象的容器，而对象是存储在 S3 中的基本实体 [Amazon S3 data inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-data-inventory.html)。该选项明确说要将 S3 bucket 挂载到每个 EC2 实例上，这不是此处所需的原生共享文件系统方法；EFS 才是 AWS 中设计用于由多个 EC2 实例挂载的文件系统。
- **B 错误**，因为从主 EC2 实例导出 NFS 共享会使主实例成为依赖项和潜在的单点故障/瓶颈。EFS 则提供托管的共享文件系统能力 [Mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html)。
- **D 错误**，因为 ALB/Auto Scaling 部分是有用的，但 Global Accelerator 并不是改善网站图片/静态内容交付的最佳选择。CloudFront 专门使用 edge servers 加速包括图片在内的静态网站内容 [Ways to use CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)。

en.question: A company runs an infrastructure monitoring service. The company is building a new feature that will enable the service to monitor data in customer AWS accounts. The new feature will call AWS APIs in customer accounts to describe Amazon EC2 instances and read Amazon CloudWatch metrics. What should the company do to obtain access to customer accounts in the MOST secure way?

options.A: Ensure that the customers create an IAM role in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions and a trust policy to the company’s account.
options.B: Create a serverless API that implements a token vending machine to provide temporary AWS credentials for a role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions.
options.C: Ensure that the customers create an IAM user in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store customer access and secret keys in a secrets management system.
options.D: Ensure that the customers create an Amazon Cognito user in their account to use an IAM role with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions. Encrypt and store the Amazon Cognito user and password in a secrets management system.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS recommends using **IAM roles for third-party cross-account access**. The customer creates a role in the customer account, grants only the required permissions, and configures the role trust policy so the monitoring company’s AWS account can assume it. AWS states that with IAM roles, third parties can access resources **without sharing AWS security credentials**, and instead assume a role created in the customer account. The trust policy uses the third party’s AWS account ID as the principal, and the permissions policy defines what actions/resources the third party can access ([AWS IAM: Access to AWS accounts owned by third parties](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)). This also aligns with least privilege: grant only the EC2 read/describe and CloudWatch read permissions required for the monitoring task ([AWS IAM: Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B**: A token vending machine does not by itself establish secure access into each **customer** account. The AWS-documented pattern for a third-party service accessing customer accounts is for each customer to create an IAM role that the third party assumes with AWS STS, receiving temporary credentials ([cross-account roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)). A custom credential-vending API adds unnecessary complexity and credential distribution.
- **C**: IAM users use long-term access keys. AWS explicitly says not to give a third party an IAM user and long-term credentials; use an IAM role and temporary security credentials instead ([third-party access scenario](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)). Encrypting and storing the keys does not make this the most secure option.
- **D**: Amazon Cognito is intended for application/user identity federation scenarios such as mobile or web applications, not for a backend monitoring provider assuming access into many customer AWS accounts. Storing usernames and passwords is also inferior to role-based temporary credentials. AWS lists roles for cross-account access as the temporary-credential pattern for accessing resources in other accounts ([temporary credentials scenarios](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运行一项基础设施监控服务。该公司正在构建一项新功能，使该服务能够监控客户 AWS 账户中的数据。新功能将调用客户账户中的 AWS APIs，以描述 Amazon EC2 实例并读取 Amazon CloudWatch 指标。该公司应如何以最安全的方式获得对客户账户的访问权限？

options.A: 确保客户在其账户中创建一个 IAM role，该角色具有只读 EC2 和 CloudWatch 权限，并具有信任该公司账户的 trust policy。
options.B: 创建一个 serverless API，实现 token vending machine，为具有只读 EC2 和 CloudWatch 权限的角色提供临时 AWS 凭证。
options.C: 确保客户在其账户中创建一个 IAM user，该用户具有只读 EC2 和 CloudWatch 权限。加密并将客户访问密钥和秘密密钥存储在机密管理系统中。
options.D: 确保客户在其账户中创建一个 Amazon Cognito user，以使用具有只读 EC2 和 CloudWatch 权限的 IAM role。加密并将 Amazon Cognito 用户名和密码存储在机密管理系统中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

AWS 建议使用 **IAM roles for third-party cross-account access**。客户在客户账户中创建一个角色，仅授予所需权限，并配置角色 trust policy，使监控公司的 AWS 账户可以代入该角色。AWS 说明，使用 IAM roles 时，第三方可以访问资源，而**无需共享 AWS 安全凭证**，而是代入在客户账户中创建的角色。trust policy 使用第三方的 AWS 账户 ID 作为主体，permissions policy 定义第三方可以访问哪些操作/资源（[AWS IAM: Access to AWS accounts owned by third parties](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。这也符合最小权限原则：仅授予监控任务所需的 EC2 读取/描述权限和 CloudWatch 读取权限（[AWS IAM: Grant least privilege](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B**：token vending machine 本身并不能建立对每个**客户**账户的安全访问。AWS 文档记录的第三方服务访问客户账户的模式是：每个客户创建一个 IAM role，第三方使用 AWS STS 代入该角色并接收临时凭证（[cross-account roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)）。自定义的凭证分发 API 会增加不必要的复杂性和凭证分发风险。
- **C**：IAM users 使用长期访问密钥。AWS 明确表示不要向第三方提供 IAM user 和长期凭证；应改用 IAM role 和临时安全凭证（[third-party access scenario](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。加密并存储密钥并不能使其成为最安全的选项。
- **D**：Amazon Cognito 旨在用于应用程序/用户身份联合场景，例如移动或 Web 应用程序，而不是用于后端监控提供商代入访问许多客户 AWS 账户。存储用户名和密码也不如基于角色的临时凭证。AWS 将跨账户访问角色列为访问其他账户中资源的临时凭证模式（[temporary credentials scenarios](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to connect several VPCs in the us-east-1 Region that span hundreds of AWS accounts. The company's networking team has its own AWS account to manage the cloud network. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution to connect the VPCs?

options.A: Set up VPC peering connections between each VPC. Update each associated subnet’s route table
options.B: Configure a NAT gateway and an internet gateway in each VPC to connect each VPC through the internet
options.C: Create an AWS Transit Gateway in the networking team’s AWS account. Configure static routes from each VPC.
options.D: Deploy VPN gateways in each VPC. Create a transit VPC in the networking team’s AWS account to connect to each VPC.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Transit Gateway is designed for this scenario: the AWS whitepaper states that Transit Gateway provides a **hub-and-spoke design** for connecting VPCs, can connect **thousands of VPCs**, and simplifies management/reduces operational costs because VPCs connect only to the transit gateway. It is also a **Regional resource** that can connect thousands of VPCs in the same Region, and AWS specifically recommends placing the organization’s transit gateway in a **Network Services account** and using AWS RAM to share it for connecting VPCs across multiple accounts in the same Region ([AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)). Transit gateway route tables also support routing between VPC attachments and allow static routes ([Transit gateway route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** VPC peering is point-to-point. AWS documentation says each peering connection requires the VPC owners to manually add routes to route tables for the peer VPC ([VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)). Across hundreds of accounts and many VPCs, this becomes operationally inefficient compared with a centralized transit gateway.
- **B:** NAT gateways and internet gateways provide internet/outbound connectivity, not private many-to-many VPC interconnection. AWS describes NAT gateways as enabling private subnet outbound connectivity, and internet gateways as enabling internet access for a VPC, not as a scalable VPC-to-VPC hub ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html), [Internet gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)).
- **D:** A VPN/transit VPC design requires VPN gateways and overlay connectivity. AWS explicitly notes that Transit Gateway provides this hub-and-spoke connectivity as a fully managed service with **no VPN overlay required** ([AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)), making option D less operationally efficient.

zh.question: 一家公司需要连接 us-east-1 Region 中跨越数百个 AWS 账户的多个 VPC。该公司的网络团队拥有自己的 AWS 账户来管理云网络。连接这些 VPC 的最具运营效率的解决方案是什么？

options.A: 在每个 VPC 之间设置 VPC peering connections。更新每个关联子网的路由表
options.B: 在每个 VPC 中配置 NAT gateway 和 internet gateway，以通过互联网连接每个 VPC
options.C: 在网络团队的 AWS 账户中创建 AWS Transit Gateway。配置来自每个 VPC 的静态路由。
options.D: 在每个 VPC 中部署 VPN gateways。在网络团队的 AWS 账户中创建 transit VPC 以连接到每个 VPC。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Transit Gateway 正是为此场景而设计：AWS 白皮书指出，Transit Gateway 为连接 VPC 提供了 **hub-and-spoke design**，可以连接 **thousands of VPCs**，并且由于 VPC 只需连接到 transit gateway，因此可简化管理/降低运营成本。它也是一种 **Regional resource**，可以连接同一 Region 中的数千个 VPC，并且 AWS 明确建议将组织的 transit gateway 放置在 **Network Services account** 中，并使用 AWS RAM 共享它，以便连接同一 Region 中跨多个账户的 VPC（[AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。Transit gateway route tables 还支持在 VPC attachments 之间路由，并允许静态路由（[Transit gateway route tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-route-tables.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** VPC peering 是点对点的。AWS 文档说明，每个 peering connection 都要求 VPC 所有者手动将到对等 VPC 的路由添加到路由表中（[VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。在数百个账户和许多 VPC 的情况下，与集中式 transit gateway 相比，这会变得运营效率低下。
- **B:** NAT gateways 和 internet gateways 提供互联网/出站连接，而不是私有的多对多 VPC 互连。AWS 将 NAT gateways 描述为使私有子网能够进行出站连接，将 internet gateways 描述为为 VPC 启用互联网访问，而不是作为可扩展的 VPC-to-VPC 枢纽（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html), [Internet gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。
- **D:** VPN/transit VPC 设计需要 VPN gateways 和叠加连接。AWS 明确指出，Transit Gateway 以完全托管服务的形式提供这种 hub-and-spoke 连接，且 **no VPN overlay required**（[AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)），因此选项 D 的运营效率较低。

en.question: A company has Amazon EC2 instances that run nightly batch jobs to process data. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group that uses On-Demand billing. If a job fails on one instance, another instance will reprocess the job. The batch jobs run between 12:00 AM and 06:00 AM local time every day. Which solution will provide EC2 instances to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Purchase a 1-year Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 that covers the instance family of the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses.
options.B: Purchase a 1-year Reserved Instance for the specific instance type and operating system of the instances in the Auto Scaling group that the batch job uses.
options.C: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Set the instances to Spot Instances. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage.
options.D: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Increase the instance size. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The workload is a nightly, time-bounded batch process, and failed jobs can be reprocessed on another instance. That makes it fault-tolerant and suitable for Spot Instances. AWS states that Spot Instances use unused EC2 capacity and can reduce EC2 costs significantly, while Savings Plans and Reserved Instances require 1- or 3-year usage commitments ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). AWS also recommends architecting Spot workloads to be fault-tolerant and notes that Auto Scaling groups can launch and maintain target Spot capacity and automatically request replacements for disrupted instances ([Spot best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)). Therefore, configuring the Auto Scaling group launch template to use Spot Instances is the most cost-effective fit.

- **A is incorrect:** A Savings Plan can reduce costs, but it requires a commitment to a consistent amount of compute usage per hour for 1 or 3 years ([Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)). This workload runs only 6 hours per day, and Spot is typically more cost-effective for interruptible batch work.
- **B is incorrect:** Reserved Instances require a commitment to a specific instance configuration for 1 or 3 years ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). They are less flexible and not the best cost option for an interruptible nightly batch workload.
- **D is incorrect:** Increasing instance size does not use a lower-cost purchase model and can increase cost. It also does not address the cost-optimization opportunity provided by Spot Instances.

zh.question: 一家公司有运行夜间批处理作业以处理数据的 Amazon EC2 实例。这些 EC2 实例在使用 On-Demand 计费的 Auto Scaling group 中运行。如果某个作业在一个实例上失败，另一个实例将重新处理该作业。批处理作业每天当地时间 12:00 AM 到 06:00 AM 之间运行。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式提供满足这些要求的 EC2 实例？

options.A: 为 Amazon EC2 购买 1 年期 Savings Plan，覆盖批处理作业使用的 Auto Scaling group 的实例系列。
options.B: 为批处理作业使用的 Auto Scaling group 中实例的特定实例类型和操作系统购买 1 年期 Reserved Instance。
options.C: 为 Auto Scaling group 创建新的启动模板。将实例设置为 Spot Instances。设置基于 CPU 使用率进行扩展的策略。
options.D: 为 Auto Scaling group 创建新的启动模板。增大实例大小。设置基于 CPU 使用率进行扩展的策略。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

该工作负载是夜间运行、有时间边界的批处理流程，并且失败的作业可以在另一个实例上重新处理。这使其具备容错性，并且适合使用 Spot Instances。AWS 表示，Spot Instances 使用未使用的 EC2 容量，并且可以显著降低 EC2 成本，而 Savings Plans 和 Reserved Instances 需要 1 年或 3 年的使用承诺（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。AWS 还建议将 Spot 工作负载设计为容错，并指出 Auto Scaling groups 可以启动并维持目标 Spot 容量，并自动为受中断影响的实例请求替换实例（[Spot best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-best-practices.html)）。因此，将 Auto Scaling group 启动模板配置为使用 Spot Instances 是最具成本效益的匹配方案。

- **A 不正确：** Savings Plan 可以降低成本，但它要求对每小时固定数量的计算使用量做出 1 年或 3 年承诺（[Savings Plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。该工作负载每天只运行 6 小时，而对于可中断的批处理工作，Spot 通常更具成本效益。
- **B 不正确：** Reserved Instances 需要对特定实例配置做出 1 年或 3 年承诺（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。它们灵活性较低，并且不是可中断夜间批处理工作负载的最佳成本选项。
- **D 不正确：** 增大实例大小并未使用更低成本的购买模式，并且可能会增加成本。它也没有利用 Spot Instances 所提供的成本优化机会。

en.question: A social media company is building a feature for its website. The feature will give users the ability to upload photos. The company expects significant increases in demand during large events and must ensure that the website can handle the upload traffic from users. Which solution meets these requirements with the MOST scalability?

options.A: Upload files from the user's browser to the application servers. Transfer the files to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Provision an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file gateway.
options.C: Generate Amazon S3 presigned URLs in the application. Upload files directly from the user's browser into an S3 bucket.
options.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Upload files directly from the user's browser to the file system.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Generate presigned URLs in the application and have the browser upload directly to Amazon S3. AWS documentation states that presigned URLs can be used to allow someone to **upload an object to an S3 bucket** without giving that party AWS credentials, and that S3 creates the object when the URL is used for upload ([Uploading objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/PresignedUrlUploadObject.html)). This keeps the application servers responsible only for generating short-lived URLs, while the high-volume upload traffic goes directly to S3. Amazon S3 is designed for high request-rate workloads and automatically scales; AWS documents at least 3,500 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE requests per second per partitioned prefix and no limit on prefixes in a bucket ([Optimizing Amazon S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Uploading through the application servers makes the application tier handle all photo-upload bandwidth and requests before transferring to S3. This introduces a scaling bottleneck compared with direct-to-S3 browser uploads.
- **B:** S3 File Gateway provides an NFS/SMB file interface to S3 and is deployed as a virtual appliance or hardware appliance, commonly for file-protocol access and caching ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). It is not the most scalable public web-browser upload path for bursty internet traffic.
- **D:** Amazon EFS is mounted using the EFS mount helper or NFS clients, and AWS describes mounting it on EC2 Linux/Mac instances or via NFS ([Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)). Browsers do not directly mount EFS, and routing uploads through servers to EFS would not offload upload traffic as effectively as direct S3 uploads.

zh.question: 一家社交媒体公司正在为其网站构建一项功能。该功能将使用户能够上传照片。公司预计在大型活动期间需求会显著增加，并且必须确保网站能够处理来自用户的上传流量。哪种解决方案以最高的可扩展性满足这些要求？

options.A: 从用户的浏览器将文件上传到应用程序服务器。再将文件传输到 Amazon S3 存储桶。
options.B: 预置一个 AWS Storage Gateway 文件网关。直接从用户的浏览器将文件上传到文件网关。
options.C: 在应用程序中生成 Amazon S3 预签名 URL。直接从用户的浏览器将文件上传到 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 预置一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。直接从用户的浏览器将文件上传到该文件系统。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 在应用程序中生成预签名 URL，并让浏览器直接上传到 Amazon S3。AWS 文档说明，预签名 URL 可用于允许某人将**对象上传到 S3 存储桶**，而无需向该方提供 AWS 凭证，并且当该 URL 用于上传时，S3 会创建该对象（[Uploading objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/PresignedUrlUploadObject.html)）。这样，应用程序服务器只负责生成短期有效的 URL，而高容量上传流量会直接进入 S3。Amazon S3 专为高请求速率工作负载而设计，并会自动扩展；AWS 文档说明，每个分区前缀至少支持每秒 3,500 个 PUT/COPY/POST/DELETE 请求，并且存储桶中的前缀数量没有限制（[Optimizing Amazon S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 通过应用程序服务器上传会使应用程序层在传输到 S3 之前处理所有照片上传带宽和请求。与浏览器直接上传到 S3 相比，这会引入扩展瓶颈。
- **B:** S3 File Gateway 为 S3 提供 NFS/SMB 文件接口，并作为虚拟设备或硬件设备部署，通常用于文件协议访问和缓存（[What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。对于突发性互联网流量，它不是最具可扩展性的公共 Web 浏览器上传路径。
- **D:** Amazon EFS 使用 EFS mount helper 或 NFS 客户端进行挂载，AWS 描述了在 EC2 Linux/Mac 实例上或通过 NFS 挂载它（[Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。浏览器不会直接挂载 EFS，并且将上传通过服务器路由到 EFS 不会像直接上传到 S3 那样有效地卸载上传流量。

en.question: A company has a web application for travel ticketing. The application is based on a database that runs in a single data center in North America. The company wants to expand the application to serve a global user base. The company needs to deploy the application to multiple AWS Regions. Average latency must be less than 1 second on updates to the reservation database. The company wants to have separate deployments of its web platform across multiple Regions. However, the company must maintain a single primary reservation database that is globally consistent. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Deploy Aurora Read Replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Deploy MySQL read replicas in each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment for access to the database.
options.D: Migrate the application to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Deploy instances of the database to each Region. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment to access the database. Use AWS Lambda functions to process event streams in each Region to synchronize the databases.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon DynamoDB global tables are designed for globally distributed applications: they are a fully managed, multi-Region feature that automatically replicates table data across AWS Regions and provides **fast local read and write performance**; any replica can serve reads and writes through the standard Regional DynamoDB endpoints ([Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). For the update-latency requirement, AWS states that changes in a DynamoDB global table are replicated to other replicas **typically within a second** ([DynamoDB read consistency: global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadConsistency.html)). For global consistency requirements, DynamoDB global tables support both multi-Region eventual consistency and **multi-Region strong consistency (MRSC)** as a configurable consistency mode ([Global tables: consistency modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). Therefore, converting the reservation table to DynamoDB and using a global table with the correct Regional endpoint is the best fit among the options.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Aurora MySQL with Aurora Read Replicas** – This option describes read replicas, not an Aurora Global Database. Amazon RDS read replicas are created as **read-only** instances and are updated using the DB engine’s **asynchronous replication** method ([RDS read replicas: how they work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). They do not provide local write capability in every Region or a globally consistent writable reservation database.
- **C. RDS for MySQL read replicas** – Same issue as B: read replicas are for scaling read-heavy workloads, can contain stale data, and are read-only/asynchronously replicated ([RDS read replicas overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). This does not meet the global update/consistency requirement.
- **D. Aurora Serverless in each Region with Lambda synchronization** – This creates separate databases and a custom synchronization mechanism, not a single managed primary reservation database. It would also introduce asynchronous/eventual synchronization complexity, whereas DynamoDB global tables provide built-in multi-Region replication without custom replication code ([Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个用于旅行票务的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序基于一个在北美单个数据中心运行的数据库。公司希望扩展该应用程序以服务全球用户群。公司需要将应用程序部署到多个 AWS Regions。对预订数据库的更新平均延迟必须小于 1 秒。公司希望在多个 Regions 中分别部署其 Web 平台。但是，公司必须维护一个全球一致的单一主预订数据库。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种解决方案来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将应用程序转换为使用 Amazon DynamoDB。对中心预订表使用 global table。在每个 Regional 部署中使用正确的 Regional endpoint。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库。在每个 Region 中部署 Aurora Read Replicas。在每个 Regional 部署中使用正确的 Regional endpoint 来访问数据库。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库。在每个 Region 中部署 MySQL read replicas。在每个 Regional 部署中使用正确的 Regional endpoint 来访问数据库。
options.D: 将应用程序迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless 数据库。将数据库实例部署到每个 Region。使用每个 Regional 部署中的正确 Regional endpoint 来访问数据库。使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理每个 Region 中的事件流以同步数据库。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon DynamoDB global tables 专为全球分布式应用程序而设计：它们是一项完全托管的 multi-Region 功能，可跨 AWS Regions 自动复制表数据，并提供**快速的本地读写性能**；任何副本都可以通过标准 Regional DynamoDB endpoints 提供读取和写入服务（[Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。对于更新延迟要求，AWS 表示 DynamoDB global table 中的更改会被复制到其他副本，**通常在一秒内**完成（[DynamoDB read consistency: global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadConsistency.html)）。对于全局一致性要求，DynamoDB global tables 支持 multi-Region eventual consistency 和 **multi-Region strong consistency (MRSC)** 两种可配置的一致性模式（[Global tables: consistency modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。因此，将预订表转换为 DynamoDB 并使用 global table，同时使用正确的 Regional endpoint，是这些选项中最合适的方案。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. Aurora MySQL with Aurora Read Replicas** – 此选项描述的是 read replicas，而不是 Aurora Global Database。Amazon RDS read replicas 被创建为**只读**实例，并使用数据库引擎的**异步复制**方法进行更新（[RDS read replicas: how they work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。它们无法在每个 Region 提供本地写入能力，也无法提供全球一致的可写预订数据库。
- **C. RDS for MySQL read replicas** – 与 B 存在相同问题：read replicas 用于扩展读密集型工作负载，可能包含陈旧数据，并且是只读/异步复制的（[RDS read replicas overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。这不满足全局更新/一致性要求。
- **D. Aurora Serverless in each Region with Lambda synchronization** – 这会创建多个独立数据库和一个自定义同步机制，而不是单一托管的主预订数据库。它还会引入异步/最终同步复杂性，而 DynamoDB global tables 提供内置的 multi-Region 复制，无需自定义复制代码（[Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。

en.question: A company has migrated multiple Microsoft Windows Server workloads to Amazon EC2 instances that run in the us-west-1 Region. The company manually backs up the workloads to create an image as needed. In the event of a natural disaster in the us-west-1 Region, the company wants to recover workloads quickly in the us-west-2 Region. The company wants no more than 24 hours of data loss on the EC2 instances. The company also wants to automate any backups of the EC2 instances. Which solutions will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Copy the image on demand.
options.B: Create an Amazon EC2-backed Amazon Machine Image (AMI) lifecycle policy to create a backup based on tags. Schedule the backup to run twice daily. Configure the copy to the us-west-2 Region.
options.C: Create backup vaults in us-west-1 and in us-west-2 by using AWS Backup. Create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Create an AWS Lambda function to run as a scheduled job to copy the backup data to us-west-2.
options.D: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Define the destination for the copy as us-west-2. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily.
options.E: Create a backup vault by using AWS Backup. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan for the EC2 instances based on tag values. Specify the backup schedule to run twice daily. Copy on demand to us- west-2.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **B and D**.

**B is correct.** Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager can automate creation of **EBS-backed AMIs** and enforce a regular backup schedule. The AWS docs state that it can automate creation, retention, deletion of EBS snapshots and EBS-backed AMIs, and can create disaster recovery backup policies that back up data to isolated Regions or accounts ([Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)). An AMI lifecycle policy can select target instances by **target resource tags**, configure policy schedules, and enable **cross-Region copy** for AMIs created by the schedule ([Create an AMI lifecycle policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ami-policy.html)). Scheduling twice daily gives an RPO of no more than 24 hours and copying to `us-west-2` supports regional disaster recovery.

**D is correct.** AWS Backup supports Amazon EC2 instances backed by EBS volumes ([What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). AWS Backup provides policy-based backup plans and tag-based backup policies, so resources can be selected by tags ([What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). A backup plan lets you set the backup frequency and use **Copy to destination** to create a cross-Region copy in another Region ([Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)). Running the plan twice daily and defining `us-west-2` as the copy destination meets the RPO and automation requirements with little administrative effort.

**A is incorrect** because although the AMI lifecycle policy can automate AMI creation, “copy the image on demand” does not automate the cross-Region copy to `us-west-2`, adding manual effort and weakening disaster recovery readiness.

**C is incorrect** because AWS Backup can automatically copy backups to another Region as part of a scheduled backup plan; adding a scheduled Lambda function is unnecessary administrative overhead ([Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)).

**E is incorrect** because copying on demand to `us-west-2` is not an automated cross-Region backup solution. AWS Backup supports automatic cross-Region copy as part of the scheduled backup plan, which is the lower-effort approach ([What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司已将多个 Microsoft Windows Server 工作负载迁移到在 us-west-1 Region 中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司根据需要手动备份工作负载以创建映像。如果 us-west-1 Region 发生自然灾害，该公司希望在 us-west-2 Region 中快速恢复工作负载。该公司希望 EC2 实例上的数据丢失不超过 24 小时。该公司还希望自动执行 EC2 实例的任何备份。哪些解决方案能够以最少的管理工作满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon EC2 支持的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 生命周期策略，以基于标签创建备份。将备份计划设置为每天运行两次。按需复制映像。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon EC2 支持的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 生命周期策略，以基于标签创建备份。将备份计划设置为每天运行两次。配置复制到 us-west-2 Region。
options.C: 使用 AWS Backup 在 us-west-1 和 us-west-2 中创建备份保管库。基于标签值为 EC2 实例创建备份计划。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数作为计划任务运行，以将备份数据复制到 us-west-2。
options.D: 使用 AWS Backup 创建备份保管库。使用 AWS Backup 基于标签值为 EC2 实例创建备份计划。将副本的目标定义为 us-west-2。指定备份计划每天运行两次。
options.E: 使用 AWS Backup 创建备份保管库。使用 AWS Backup 基于标签值为 EC2 实例创建备份计划。指定备份计划每天运行两次。按需复制到 us- west-2。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B 和 D**。

**B 是正确的。** Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 可以自动创建 **EBS-backed AMIs** 并强制定期备份计划。AWS 文档说明，它可以自动创建、保留、删除 EBS 快照和 EBS-backed AMIs，并且可以创建灾难恢复备份策略，将数据备份到隔离的 Regions 或账户（[Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)）。AMI 生命周期策略可以通过 **target resource tags** 选择目标实例，配置策略计划，并为该计划创建的 AMIs 启用 **cross-Region copy**（[Create an AMI lifecycle policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ami-policy.html)）。每天计划运行两次可提供不超过 24 小时的 RPO，并且复制到 `us-west-2` 支持区域灾难恢复。

**D 是正确的。** AWS Backup 支持由 EBS 卷支持的 Amazon EC2 实例（[What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。AWS Backup 提供基于策略的备份计划和基于标签的备份策略，因此可以通过标签选择资源（[What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。备份计划允许你设置备份频率，并使用 **Copy to destination** 在另一个 Region 中创建跨区域副本（[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。每天运行该计划两次并将 `us-west-2` 定义为复制目标，能够以较少的管理工作满足 RPO 和自动化要求。

**A 是错误的**，因为尽管 AMI 生命周期策略可以自动化 AMI 创建，但“按需复制映像”并不会自动化到 `us-west-2` 的跨区域复制，这会增加手动工作并削弱灾难恢复就绪性。

**C 是错误的**，因为 AWS Backup 可以作为计划备份计划的一部分自动将备份复制到另一个 Region；添加计划运行的 Lambda 函数是不必要的管理开销（[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。

**E 是错误的**，因为按需复制到 `us-west-2` 不是自动化的跨区域备份解决方案。AWS Backup 支持作为计划备份计划的一部分进行自动跨区域复制，这是工作量更低的方法（[What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。

en.question: A company operates a two-tier application for image processing. The application uses two Availability Zones, each with one public subnet and one private subnet. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) for the web tier uses the public subnets. Amazon EC2 instances for the application tier use the private subnets. Users report that the application is running more slowly than expected. A security audit of the web server log files shows that the application is receiving millions of illegitimate requests from a small number of IP addresses. A solutions architect needs to resolve the immediate performance problem while the company investigates a more permanent solution. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Modify the inbound security group for the web tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.B: Modify the network ACL for the web tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.C: Modify the inbound security group for the application tier. Add a deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
options.D: Modify the network ACL for the application tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The immediate need is to block a small set of abusive source IP addresses before their traffic reaches the web tier. AWS documents that a network ACL is associated with subnets and can be used to **allow or deny specific inbound or outbound traffic at the subnet level**; each NACL rule can either allow or deny traffic and is evaluated when traffic enters or leaves the subnet ([Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)). Therefore, adding inbound deny rules to the NACL associated with the **public web-tier subnets** is the appropriate quick mitigation.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A** is wrong because security groups do not support deny rules. AWS compares NACLs and security groups: NACLs support **allow and deny rules**, while security groups support **allow rules only** ([Differences between network ACLs and security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-examples.html)).
- **C** is wrong for the same reason: security groups cannot add deny rules. Also, the abusive requests are hitting the web tier first, not the private application tier.
- **D** is wrong because blocking at the application-tier private subnets is not the best immediate control point. The illegitimate internet requests should be denied at the public web-tier subnet boundary before consuming web-tier/ALB-facing resources. NACL rules apply at the subnet level and changes affect associated subnets after a short period ([Network ACL rules considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-rules.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运行一个用于图像处理的两层应用程序。该应用程序使用两个 Availability Zones，每个 Availability Zone 都有一个公有子网和一个私有子网。Web 层的 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 使用公有子网。应用程序层的 Amazon EC2 实例使用私有子网。用户报告该应用程序的运行速度比预期更慢。对 Web 服务器日志文件的安全审计显示，该应用程序正在从少量 IP 地址接收数百万个非法请求。在公司调查更永久的解决方案期间，解决方案架构师需要解决当前的性能问题。解决方案架构师应推荐什么来满足此要求？

options.A: 修改 Web 层的入站安全组。为正在消耗资源的 IP 地址添加拒绝规则。
options.B: 修改 Web 层子网的 network ACL。为正在消耗资源的 IP 地址添加入站拒绝规则。
options.C: 修改应用程序层的入站安全组。为正在消耗资源的 IP 地址添加拒绝规则。
options.D: 修改应用程序层子网的 network ACL。为正在消耗资源的 IP 地址添加入站拒绝规则。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

当前的需求是在一小组滥用的源 IP 地址的流量到达 Web 层之前将其阻止。AWS 文档说明，network ACL 与子网关联，可用于在**子网级别允许或拒绝特定入站或出站流量**；每条 NACL 规则都可以允许或拒绝流量，并在流量进入或离开子网时进行评估（[Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)）。因此，向与**公有 Web 层子网**关联的 NACL 添加入站拒绝规则是合适的快速缓解措施。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A** 错误，因为 security groups 不支持拒绝规则。AWS 对比了 NACLs 和 security groups：NACLs 支持**允许和拒绝规则**，而 security groups 仅支持**允许规则**（[Differences between network ACLs and security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-examples.html)）。
- **C** 错误，原因相同：security groups 无法添加拒绝规则。此外，滥用请求首先命中的是 Web 层，而不是私有应用程序层。
- **D** 错误，因为在应用程序层私有子网进行阻止并不是最佳的即时控制点。非法的 Internet 请求应在公有 Web 层子网边界被拒绝，以免消耗 Web 层/面向 ALB 的资源。NACL 规则在子网级别应用，并且更改会在短时间后影响关联的子网（[Network ACL rules considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nacl-rules.html)）。

en.question: A global marketing company has applications that run in the ap-southeast-2 Region and the eu-west-1 Region. Applications that run in a VPC in eu-west-1 need to communicate securely with databases that run in a VPC in ap-southeast-2. Which network design will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a VPC peering connection between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap-southeast-2 VPC. Create an inbound rule in the eu-west-1 application security group that allows traffic from the database server IP addresses in the ap-southeast-2 security group.
options.B: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPC. Update the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1.
options.C: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPUpdate the subnet route tables. Create an inbound rule in the ap-southeast-2 database security group that allows traffic from the eu-west-1 application server IP addresses.
options.D: Create a transit gateway with a peering attachment between the eu-west-1 VPC and the ap- southeast-2 VPC. After the transit gateways are properly peered and routing is configured, create an inbound rule in the database security group that references the security group ID of the application servers in eu-west-1.

en.explanation:
**Answer: C**

A VPC peering connection is appropriate because AWS states that VPC peering enables secure, direct/private communication between VPCs, including VPCs in **different AWS Regions**, and that traffic between peered VPCs does not traverse the public internet ([Amazon VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)). For VPC peering to work, the subnet route tables for the communicating resources must include routes to the peer VPC CIDR with the VPC peering connection as the target ([VPC peering routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-routing.html)). Because the VPCs are in different Regions, the database security group cannot reference the application security group; AWS explicitly says that you **can't reference the security group of a peer VPC that's in a different Region** and must use the peer VPC CIDR block instead ([VPC peering security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-security-groups.html)). Therefore, allowing traffic from the application server IP addresses/CIDR in the database security group is the valid design.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** The inbound rule is placed on the **application** security group and allows traffic from database IPs, but the required flow is applications in `eu-west-1` connecting to databases in `ap-southeast-2`; the inbound permission must be on the **database** security group. It also omits the required route table updates for peering.
- **B:** Updating route tables is correct, but referencing the `eu-west-1` application security group in an `ap-southeast-2` database security group is not supported for inter-Region VPC peering; AWS requires CIDR/IP-based rules instead.
- **D:** A transit gateway peering design is unnecessary for a simple two-VPC connection, and the option still uses an inter-Region security group reference, which is not valid for the required security group rule pattern across Regions.

zh.question: 一家全球营销公司有在 ap-southeast-2 Region 和 eu-west-1 Region 中运行的应用程序。在 eu-west-1 中某个 VPC 内运行的应用程序需要与在 ap-southeast-2 中某个 VPC 内运行的数据库安全通信。哪种网络设计可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 eu-west-1 VPC 和 ap-southeast-2 VPC 之间创建 VPC peering connection。在 eu-west-1 应用程序 security group 中创建一条 inbound rule，允许来自 ap-southeast-2 security group 中数据库服务器 IP 地址的流量。
options.B: 在 ap-southeast-2 VPC 和 eu-west-1 VPC 之间配置 VPC peering connection。更新 subnet route tables。在 ap-southeast-2 数据库 security group 中创建一条 inbound rule，该规则引用 eu-west-1 中应用程序服务器的 security group ID。
options.C: 在 ap-southeast-2 VPC 和 eu-west-1 VPUpdate 之间配置 VPC peering connection。更新 subnet route tables。在 ap-southeast-2 数据库 security group 中创建一条 inbound rule，允许来自 eu-west-1 应用程序服务器 IP 地址的流量。
options.D: 创建一个 transit gateway，并在 eu-west-1 VPC 和 ap- southeast-2 VPC 之间创建 peering attachment。在 transit gateways 正确对等连接并配置路由后，在数据库 security group 中创建一条 inbound rule，该规则引用 eu-west-1 中应用程序服务器的 security group ID。

zh.explanation:
**答案：C**

VPC peering connection 是合适的，因为 AWS 说明 VPC peering 支持 VPC 之间安全、直接/私有通信，包括位于**不同 AWS Regions** 的 VPC，并且对等 VPC 之间的流量不会穿越公共互联网（[Amazon VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。要使 VPC peering 正常工作，通信资源的 subnet route tables 必须包含到 peer VPC CIDR 的路由，并以 VPC peering connection 作为目标（[VPC peering routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-routing.html)）。由于这些 VPC 位于不同 Regions，数据库 security group 不能引用应用程序 security group；AWS 明确说明你**不能引用位于不同 Region 的对等 VPC 的 security group**，而必须改用 peer VPC CIDR block（[VPC peering security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-security-groups.html)）。因此，在数据库 security group 中允许来自应用程序服务器 IP 地址/CIDR 的流量是有效的设计。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A:** inbound rule 被放在**应用程序** security group 上，并允许来自数据库 IP 的流量，但所需流向是 `eu-west-1` 中的应用程序连接到 `ap-southeast-2` 中的数据库；inbound permission 必须位于**数据库** security group 上。它还遗漏了 peering 所需的 route table 更新。
- **B:** 更新 route tables 是正确的，但在 `ap-southeast-2` 数据库 security group 中引用 `eu-west-1` 应用程序 security group 不受 inter-Region VPC peering 支持；AWS 要求改用基于 CIDR/IP 的规则。
- **D:** 对于简单的两个 VPC 连接，transit gateway peering 设计是不必要的，并且该选项仍然使用 inter-Region security group 引用，这对于跨 Regions 所需的 security group 规则模式无效。

en.question: A company is developing software that uses a PostgreSQL database schema. The company needs to configure multiple development environments and databases for the company's developers. On average, each development environment is used for half of the 8-hour workday. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database
options.B: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instances
options.C: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora On-Demand PostgreSQL- Compatible database
options.D: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon S3 bucket by using Amazon S3 Object Select

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible can meet the PostgreSQL schema requirement, and the on-demand/serverless Aurora model is designed for intermittent dev/test use. AWS states that Aurora serverless supports workloads including **development and testing environments** and, for dev/test, DB instances can use a low minimum capacity and **scale down when the database isn't in use to avoid unnecessary charges**. AWS also describes Aurora serverless as cost-effective during low activity because you **pay only for the database resources that you consume**, measured per second ([Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)). This matches multiple developer environments that are used only about half of the workday.

Why the other options are not best:

- **A. Aurora PostgreSQL database**: A standard provisioned Aurora database can run PostgreSQL-compatible workloads, but without the on-demand/serverless behavior it is less cost-effective for many intermittently used development databases because capacity is provisioned rather than scaled down automatically.
- **B. RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instances**: RDS for PostgreSQL can work, and AWS allows non-production RDS DB instances to be stopped for cost optimization; while stopped, there is no charge for DB instance hours. However, that requires explicit stop/start management, has limits such as automatic restart after 7 days, and still incurs storage/backup charges ([Stopping an Amazon RDS DB instance temporarily](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)). The option does not include a stop/start automation strategy, so it is less aligned with the intermittent-use requirement than Aurora on-demand/serverless.
- **D. S3 bucket with S3 Object Select**: S3 Select is for querying data in S3 with a limited SQL feature set, not for running a PostgreSQL database/schema; AWS also notes S3 Select is no longer available to new customers ([SQL reference for Amazon S3 Select](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-select-sql-reference.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发使用 PostgreSQL 数据库架构的软件。该公司需要为公司的开发人员配置多个开发环境和数据库。平均而言，每个开发环境在 8 小时工作日中使用半天。哪种解决方案将以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个开发环境配置其自己的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库
options.B: 为每个开发环境配置其自己的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB 实例
options.C: 为每个开发环境配置其自己的 Amazon Aurora On-Demand PostgreSQL- Compatible 数据库
options.D: 通过使用 Amazon S3 Object Select 为每个开发环境配置其自己的 Amazon S3 存储桶

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible 可以满足 PostgreSQL 架构要求，并且 on-demand/serverless Aurora 模型专为间歇性 dev/test 使用而设计。AWS 表示，Aurora serverless 支持包括 **development and testing environments** 在内的工作负载，并且对于 dev/test，DB 实例可以使用较低的最小容量，并在 **数据库未使用时缩减规模以避免不必要的费用**。AWS 还将 Aurora serverless 描述为在低活动期间具有成本效益，因为你 **只需为实际消耗的数据库资源付费**，并按秒计量（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。这与多个开发人员环境仅在大约半个工作日内使用的情况相匹配。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A. Aurora PostgreSQL database**：标准预置的 Aurora 数据库可以运行 PostgreSQL-compatible 工作负载，但如果没有 on-demand/serverless 行为，对于许多间歇性使用的开发数据库而言，其成本效益较低，因为容量是预置的，而不是自动缩减的。
- **B. RDS for PostgreSQL Single-AZ DB instances**：RDS for PostgreSQL 可以工作，并且 AWS 允许停止非生产 RDS DB 实例以优化成本；停止期间不会收取 DB 实例小时费用。但是，这需要显式的停止/启动管理，并且存在一些限制，例如 7 天后自动重启，同时仍会产生存储/备份费用（[Stopping an Amazon RDS DB instance temporarily](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_StopInstance.html)）。该选项不包含停止/启动自动化策略，因此与 Aurora on-demand/serverless 相比，它不太符合间歇性使用要求。
- **D. S3 bucket with S3 Object Select**：S3 Select 用于在 S3 中使用有限的 SQL 功能集查询数据，而不是用于运行 PostgreSQL 数据库/架构；AWS 还指出 S3 Select 不再向新客户开放（[SQL reference for Amazon S3 Select](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-select-sql-reference.html)）。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations with resources tagged by account. The company also uses AWS Backup to back up its AWS infrastructure resources. The company needs to back up all AWS resources. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Config to identify all untagged resources. Tag the identified resources programmatically. Use tags in the backup plan.
options.B: Use AWS Config to identify all resources that are not running. Add those resources to the backup vault.
options.C: Require all AWS account owners to review their resources to identify the resources that need to be backed up.
options.D: Use Amazon Inspector to identify all noncompliant resources.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS Backup supports policy-based backup plans and tag-based backup policies. AWS documentation states that backup plans can be applied to resources across AWS services, and that tagging lets you quickly apply a backup plan to groups of resources so they are backed up consistently and compliantly ([AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). When assigning resources to an AWS Backup plan, you can refine the selection by tags; resources matching the tag criteria are assigned to the plan ([Assign resources using the AWS Backup console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/assigning-resources-console.html)). AWS Config can evaluate resource configurations continuously and flag noncompliant resources; its `required-tags` managed rule checks whether resources have specified tags and can be used to find resources that were not launched with the desired tags, with remediation actions possible for tagging mistakes ([AWS Config required-tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html), [What Is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)). Therefore, using AWS Config to find untagged resources, programmatically tagging them, and using those tags in AWS Backup plans provides automated coverage with the least operational overhead among the options.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Whether a resource is “not running” is not a valid criterion for ensuring all resources are backed up. Also, backup vaults store and secure backups; resources are assigned to backup **plans**, not simply added to a vault ([AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)).
- **C:** Requiring every account owner to manually review resources creates significant operational overhead and is less scalable than AWS Config evaluation plus tag-based AWS Backup assignment.
- **D:** Amazon Inspector is for vulnerability and network exposure scanning and produces security findings; it does not identify resources that need AWS Backup coverage or enforce backup tagging ([What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations，并按账户为资源打标签。该公司还使用 AWS Backup 备份其 AWS 基础设施资源。该公司需要备份所有 AWS 资源。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Config 识别所有未打标签的资源。以编程方式为识别出的资源打标签。在备份计划中使用标签。
options.B: 使用 AWS Config 识别所有未运行的资源。将这些资源添加到备份保管库。
options.C: 要求所有 AWS 账户所有者审查其资源，以识别需要备份的资源。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Inspector 识别所有不合规的资源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** AWS Backup 支持基于策略的备份计划和基于标签的备份策略。AWS 文档说明，备份计划可以应用于跨 AWS 服务的资源，并且打标签使你能够快速将备份计划应用于资源组，以便这些资源以一致且合规的方式进行备份（[AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。在将资源分配给 AWS Backup 计划时，你可以通过标签细化选择；符合标签条件的资源会被分配到该计划（[Assign resources using the AWS Backup console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/assigning-resources-console.html)）。AWS Config 可以持续评估资源配置并标记不合规资源；其 `required-tags` 托管规则会检查资源是否具有指定标签，可用于查找未使用所需标签启动的资源，并且可针对标签错误执行修复操作（[AWS Config required-tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html)，[What Is AWS Config?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。因此，使用 AWS Config 查找未打标签的资源，以编程方式为其打标签，并在 AWS Backup 计划中使用这些标签，可在各选项中以最少的运营开销提供自动化覆盖。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **B:** 资源是否“未运行”不是确保所有资源都得到备份的有效标准。此外，备份保管库存储并保护备份；资源会被分配给备份**计划**，而不是简单地添加到保管库中（[AWS Backup feature overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。
- **C:** 要求每个账户所有者手动审查资源会产生大量运营开销，并且不如 AWS Config 评估加基于标签的 AWS Backup 分配那样可扩展。
- **D:** Amazon Inspector 用于漏洞和网络暴露扫描并生成安全发现；它不会识别需要 AWS Backup 覆盖的资源，也不会强制执行备份标签（[What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。

en.question: A social media company wants to allow its users to upload images in an application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs a solution that automatically resizes the images so that the images can be displayed on multiple device types. The application experiences unpredictable traffic patterns throughout the day. The company is seeking a highly available solution that maximizes scalability. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a static website hosted in Amazon S3 that invokes AWS Lambda functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a static website hosted in Amazon CloudFront that invokes AWS Step Functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon RDS database.
options.C: Create a dynamic website hosted on a web server that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure a process that runs on the EC2 instance to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a dynamic website hosted on an automatically scaling Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that creates a resize job in Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Set up an image-resizing program that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance to process the resize jobs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

A serverless design using Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda best matches the need for high availability and maximum scalability with unpredictable traffic. Amazon S3 can host a static website, and static pages can include client-side scripts, which can interact with backend services for uploads or processing ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)). S3 is also appropriate for storing image objects because S3 Standard is designed for 99.999999999% durability and 99.99% availability, storing objects redundantly across multiple Availability Zones ([S3 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/DataDurability.html)). When images are uploaded, S3 can publish **new object created** event notifications to an **AWS Lambda function** ([S3 event notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). Lambda is explicitly suitable for file processing when files are uploaded to S3, runs without managing servers, and automatically scales up and down on high-availability infrastructure ([AWS Lambda overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** CloudFront is a content delivery service, not where the static website is “hosted” in the same sense as S3 static website hosting. Step Functions orchestrates workflows but is unnecessary for simple image resizing, and Amazon RDS is not the right scalable object store for image files.
- **C:** A single EC2 web server and local resize process is not highly available and does not maximize scalability for unpredictable traffic. It introduces server management and a compute bottleneck.
- **D:** Although ECS Auto Scaling and SQS can be useful, the resize program runs on an EC2 instance, creating operational overhead and a potential availability/scaling bottleneck. This is less scalable and less serverless than S3-triggered Lambda processing.

zh.question: 一家社交媒体公司希望允许其用户在托管于 AWS Cloud 的应用程序中上传图像。该公司需要一种解决方案，能够自动调整图像大小，以便图像可以在多种设备类型上显示。该应用程序全天的流量模式不可预测。该公司正在寻求一种高可用且最大化可扩展性的解决方案。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个托管在 Amazon S3 中的静态网站，该网站调用 AWS Lambda 函数来调整图像大小，并将图像存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.B: 创建一个托管在 Amazon CloudFront 中的静态网站，该网站调用 AWS Step Functions 来调整图像大小，并将图像存储在 Amazon RDS 数据库中。
options.C: 创建一个托管在运行于 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 服务器上的动态网站。配置一个在 EC2 实例上运行的进程来调整图像大小，并将图像存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.D: 创建一个托管在自动扩展的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群上的动态网站，该网站在 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 中创建调整大小作业。设置一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的图像调整大小程序来处理这些调整大小作业。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

使用 Amazon S3 和 AWS Lambda 的无服务器设计最符合在流量不可预测时对高可用性和最大可扩展性的需求。Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站，静态页面可以包含客户端脚本，这些脚本可以与后端服务交互以进行上传或处理（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。S3 也适合存储图像对象，因为 S3 Standard 旨在提供 99.999999999% 的持久性和 99.99% 的可用性，并跨多个 Availability Zones 冗余存储对象（[S3 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/DataDurability.html)）。上传图像时，S3 可以将 **new object created** 事件通知发布到 **AWS Lambda function**（[S3 event notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。Lambda 明确适用于文件上传到 S3 时的文件处理，无需管理服务器即可运行，并会在高可用基础设施上自动向上和向下扩展（[AWS Lambda overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** CloudFront 是内容分发服务，并不是与 S3 静态网站托管同等意义上的静态网站“托管”位置。Step Functions 用于编排工作流，但对于简单的图像调整大小是不必要的，而 Amazon RDS 也不是用于图像文件的合适可扩展对象存储。
- **C:** 单个 EC2 Web 服务器和本地调整大小进程并不具备高可用性，也不能为不可预测的流量最大化可扩展性。它会引入服务器管理工作和计算瓶颈。
- **D:** 虽然 ECS Auto Scaling 和 SQS 可能有用，但调整大小程序运行在 EC2 实例上，会产生运营开销，并可能形成可用性/扩展瓶颈。与 S3 触发的 Lambda 处理相比，这种方案可扩展性更低，也不如其无服务器化。

en.question: A company is running a microservices application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to migrate the application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster for scalability. The company must configure the Amazon EKS control plane with endpoint private access set to true and endpoint public access set to false to maintain security compliance. The company must also put the data plane in private subnets. However, the company has received error notifications because the node cannot join the cluster. Which solution will allow the node to join the cluster?

options.A: Grant the required permission in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to the AmazonEKSNodeRole IAM role.
options.B: Create interface VPC endpoints to allow nodes to access the control plane.
options.C: Recreate nodes in the public subnet. Restrict security groups for EC2 nodes.
options.D: Allow outbound traffic in the security group of the nodes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

With the EKS API server public endpoint disabled, communication to the Kubernetes API server must occur privately. AWS states that enabling the cluster private endpoint keeps communication between nodes and the API server within the VPC, and that if public access is disabled the API server is accessible only from within the VPC or a connected network ([Cluster API server endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cluster-endpoint.html)). For a private/no-internet EKS deployment, AWS also lists VPC interface endpoints for required AWS services, including **Amazon EKS** (`com.amazonaws.region-code.eks`), and says self-managed nodes must be deployed to subnets that have the required VPC interface endpoints ([Deploy private clusters with limited internet access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/private-clusters.html)). Therefore, creating the needed interface VPC endpoints lets private-subnet nodes reach the required EKS/AWS APIs during bootstrap and registration while keeping public endpoint access disabled.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Grant IAM permissions to AmazonEKSNodeRole** — Nodes do need an IAM role with policies such as `AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy` and `AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryPullOnly` ([Amazon EKS node IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/create-node-role.html)), but the scenario emphasizes a private-only endpoint and private subnets. The likely failure is network/API reachability, not missing IAM permissions.
- **C. Recreate nodes in a public subnet** — This violates the requirement that the data plane must be in private subnets and weakens the private architecture.
- **D. Allow outbound traffic in the node security group** — Outbound rules alone do not provide private connectivity to required AWS service APIs. Private subnets still need a path such as the appropriate VPC interface endpoints for a private EKS deployment.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个微服务应用程序。该公司希望将该应用程序迁移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群以实现可扩展性。为保持安全合规性，该公司必须将 Amazon EKS 控制平面配置为 endpoint private access 设置为 true，并将 endpoint public access 设置为 false。该公司还必须将数据平面放在私有子网中。但是，该公司收到错误通知，因为节点无法加入集群。哪种解决方案将允许该节点加入集群？

options.A: 在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中向 AmazonEKSNodeRole IAM 角色授予所需权限。
options.B: 创建 interface VPC endpoints，以允许节点访问控制平面。
options.C: 在公有子网中重新创建节点。限制 EC2 节点的安全组。
options.D: 允许节点安全组中的出站流量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

在禁用 EKS API server 公有端点的情况下，与 Kubernetes API server 的通信必须私下进行。AWS 指出，启用集群私有端点会将节点与 API server 之间的通信保持在 VPC 内，并且如果禁用公有访问，则 API server 只能从 VPC 内或已连接的网络访问（[Cluster API server endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cluster-endpoint.html)）。对于私有/无互联网的 EKS 部署，AWS 还列出了所需 AWS services 的 VPC interface endpoints，包括 **Amazon EKS** (`com.amazonaws.region-code.eks`)，并说明自管理节点必须部署到具有所需 VPC interface endpoints 的子网中（[Deploy private clusters with limited internet access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/private-clusters.html)）。因此，创建所需的 interface VPC endpoints 可让私有子网中的节点在 bootstrap 和注册期间访问所需的 EKS/AWS APIs，同时保持禁用公有端点访问。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. Grant IAM permissions to AmazonEKSNodeRole** — 节点确实需要带有 `AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy` 和 `AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryPullOnly` 等策略的 IAM 角色（[Amazon EKS node IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/create-node-role.html)），但该场景强调仅私有端点和私有子网。可能的故障是网络/API 可达性，而不是缺少 IAM 权限。
- **C. Recreate nodes in a public subnet** — 这违反了数据平面必须位于私有子网中的要求，并削弱了私有架构。
- **D. Allow outbound traffic in the node security group** — 仅出站规则并不能提供到所需 AWS service APIs 的私有连接。对于私有 EKS 部署，私有子网仍然需要一条路径，例如适当的 VPC interface endpoints。

en.question: A company is migrating an on-premises application to AWS. The company wants to use Amazon Redshift as a solution. Which use cases are suitable for Amazon Redshift in this scenario? (Choose three.)

options.A: Supporting data APIs to access data with traditional, containerized, and event-driven applications
options.B: Supporting client-side and server-side encryption
options.C: Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active
options.D: Caching data to reduce the pressure on the backend database
options.E: Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute
options.F: Creating a secondary replica of the cluster by using the AWS Management Console

en.explanation:
The suitable use cases for Amazon Redshift are **B, C, and E**.

**B. Supporting client-side and server-side encryption — Correct.** Amazon Redshift supports encryption for protecting data in transit and at rest. The documentation states that data in transit can be protected by SSL or client-side encryption, and that data at rest can be protected with either **server-side encryption** or **client-side encryption**. With server-side encryption, Redshift encrypts data before saving it to disks; with client-side encryption, the customer encrypts the data before loading it into Redshift. See [Amazon Redshift data encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/security-encryption.html).

**C. Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active — Correct.** Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse designed for SQL analytics and BI workloads. It is appropriate for running analytical workloads separately from the main application workload, including during scheduled or off-peak periods. Redshift provisioned clusters can also be paused and resumed, and scheduled actions can be used to pause and resume clusters when they only need to be available at specific times. See [What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html) and [Pausing and resuming a cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/rs-mgmt-pause-resume-cluster.html).

**E. Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute — Correct.** Amazon Redshift is designed for large-scale analytics and is described as a **fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service**. Redshift Serverless can automatically provision resources and scale data warehouse capacity for demanding and unpredictable workloads, and Redshift provides fast query performance for very large datasets. See [What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html).

The other options are not suitable Redshift use cases:

**A. Supporting data APIs to access data with traditional, containerized, and event-driven applications — Incorrect.** Amazon Redshift does provide a Data API that allows SQL statements to be run through a secure HTTP endpoint without managing persistent database connections. However, this option describes application data API access patterns rather than the primary data warehousing and analytics use cases for which Redshift is selected. See [Using the Amazon Redshift Data API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/data-api.html).

**D. Caching data to reduce the pressure on the backend database — Incorrect.** Redshift is a data warehouse for analytics, not a caching layer for an operational backend database. For query caching to reduce database latency and offload repeated reads from a backend database, AWS documentation describes Amazon ElastiCache as the appropriate service. See [Caching database query results with ElastiCache](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html).

**F. Creating a secondary replica of the cluster by using the AWS Management Console — Incorrect.** Creating a secondary replica is not a standard Redshift cluster use case. Redshift clusters are created as data warehouses, and high availability options such as Multi-AZ deployments are configured differently from creating a traditional read replica or secondary replica. See [Creating a cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/create-cluster.html) and [Setting up Multi-AZ when creating a new cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/create-cluster-multi-az.html).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将本地应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司希望使用 Amazon Redshift 作为解决方案。在此场景中，哪些使用案例适合 Amazon Redshift？（选择三项。）

options.A: 支持数据 API，以便通过传统应用程序、容器化应用程序和事件驱动型应用程序访问数据
options.B: 支持客户端和服务器端加密
options.C: 在指定时间以及应用程序不活跃时构建分析工作负载
options.D: 缓存数据以减轻后端数据库的压力
options.E: 在全球范围内扩展，以支持 PB 级数据和每分钟数千万个请求
options.F: 使用 AWS Management Console 创建集群的辅助副本

zh.explanation:
Amazon Redshift 的合适使用案例是 **B、C 和 E**。

**B. Supporting client-side and server-side encryption — 正确。** Amazon Redshift 支持加密以保护传输中和静态数据。文档指出，传输中的数据可以通过 SSL 或客户端加密进行保护，静态数据可以通过 **server-side encryption** 或 **client-side encryption** 进行保护。使用服务器端加密时，Redshift 会在将数据保存到磁盘之前对其进行加密；使用客户端加密时，客户会在将数据加载到 Redshift 之前对其进行加密。请参阅 [Amazon Redshift data encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/security-encryption.html)。

**C. Building analytics workloads during specified hours and when the application is not active — 正确。** Amazon Redshift 是一种完全托管的 PB 级数据仓库，专为 SQL 分析和 BI 工作负载而设计。它适合将分析工作负载与主应用程序工作负载分开运行，包括在计划时间段或非高峰时段运行。Redshift 预置集群还可以暂停和恢复，并且可以使用计划操作在集群仅需在特定时间可用时暂停和恢复集群。请参阅 [What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html) 和 [Pausing and resuming a cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/rs-mgmt-pause-resume-cluster.html)。

**E. Scaling globally to support petabytes of data and tens of millions of requests per minute — 正确。** Amazon Redshift 专为大规模分析而设计，并被描述为一种 **fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service**。Redshift Serverless 可以自动预置资源并扩展数据仓库容量，以应对要求苛刻且不可预测的工作负载；Redshift 可为超大型数据集提供快速查询性能。请参阅 [What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)。其他选项不是合适的 Redshift 使用案例：

**A. Supporting data APIs to access data with traditional, containerized, and event-driven applications — 不正确。** Amazon Redshift 确实提供 Data API，允许通过安全的 HTTP 端点运行 SQL 语句，而无需管理持久数据库连接。但是，此选项描述的是应用程序数据 API 访问模式，而不是选择 Redshift 的主要数据仓库和分析使用案例。请参阅 [Using the Amazon Redshift Data API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/data-api.html)。

**D. Caching data to reduce the pressure on the backend database — 不正确。** Redshift 是用于分析的数据仓库，而不是用于运营后端数据库的缓存层。对于通过查询缓存来降低数据库延迟并卸载后端数据库重复读取的需求，AWS 文档将 Amazon ElastiCache 描述为合适的服务。请参阅 [Caching database query results with ElastiCache](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)。

**F. Creating a secondary replica of the cluster by using the AWS Management Console — 不正确。** 创建辅助副本不是标准的 Redshift 集群使用案例。Redshift 集群是作为数据仓库创建的，而 Multi-AZ 部署等高可用性选项的配置方式不同于创建传统只读副本或辅助副本。请参阅 [Creating a cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/create-cluster.html) 和 [Setting up Multi-AZ when creating a new cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/create-cluster-multi-az.html)。

en.question: A company provides an API interface to customers so the customers can retrieve their financial information. Еhe company expects a larger number of requests during peak usage times of the year. The company requires the API to respond consistently with low latency to ensure customer satisfaction. The company needs to provide a compute host for the API. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use an Application Load Balancer and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).
options.B: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency.
options.C: Use an Application Load Balancer and an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster.
options.D: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with reserved concurrency.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency.**

API Gateway is appropriate for exposing an API endpoint to customers; AWS documents that API Gateway supports HTTP/REST APIs that invoke Lambda functions, including HTTP APIs described as “lightweight, low-latency RESTful API[s]” ([AWS Lambda + API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)). This combination is also serverless: API Gateway with Lambda forms the app-facing part of AWS serverless infrastructure, and Lambda runs code on highly available compute infrastructure while performing the execution and administration of compute resources ([API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html), [Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

Provisioned concurrency is the key requirement match for **consistent low latency during peaks**. AWS states that provisioned concurrency allocates **pre-initialized execution environments** that are ready to respond immediately, reduces cold start latency, and is designed for **double-digit millisecond response times** for interactive workloads ([Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)). It can also be managed with Application Auto Scaling on a schedule or based on utilization, which fits predictable seasonal peak usage ([Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. ALB + Amazon ECS**: This can run an API, but it introduces more operational overhead than API Gateway + Lambda because it requires container services and cluster/capacity decisions. AWS notes ECS cluster options include EC2 instances where you manage instance selection, configuration, and maintenance, or other ECS capacity models that still involve container orchestration choices ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)). It also does not directly address Lambda-style cold-start latency with provisioned concurrency.
- **C. ALB + Amazon EKS**: EKS adds Kubernetes cluster and node operational overhead. AWS EKS documentation shows managed node groups require deploying/managing EC2 instances and securing, maintaining, and patching the OS; self-managed nodes require even more manual maintenance ([Amazon EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html)). This is not the least operational overhead.
- **D. API Gateway + Lambda reserved concurrency**: Reserved concurrency is not the same as provisioned concurrency. AWS states reserved concurrency reserves capacity and acts as both a lower and upper bound, useful for ensuring critical functions have concurrency and limiting scaling; provisioned concurrency specifically pre-initializes environments to reduce cold starts and provide low-latency responses ([Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html), [Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)). Therefore reserved concurrency alone does not meet the consistent low-latency requirement as well as provisioned concurrency.

zh.question: 一家公司向客户提供一个 API 接口，以便客户可以检索其财务信息。该公司预计在一年中的使用高峰期会有更多请求。该公司要求 API 始终以低延迟响应，以确保客户满意度。该公司需要为 API 提供一个计算主机。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Application Load Balancer 和 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.B: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 和配置了预置并发的 AWS Lambda 函数。
options.C: 使用 Application Load Balancer 和 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。
options.D: 使用 Amazon API Gateway 和配置了预留并发的 AWS Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 Amazon API Gateway 和配置了预置并发的 AWS Lambda 函数。**

API Gateway 适合向客户公开 API 端点；AWS 文档说明 API Gateway 支持调用 Lambda 函数的 HTTP/REST API，包括被描述为“轻量级、低延迟 RESTful API”的 HTTP API ([AWS Lambda + API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html))。这种组合也是无服务器的：API Gateway 与 Lambda 构成面向应用的 AWS 无服务器基础设施部分，而 Lambda 在高可用的计算基础设施上运行代码，同时执行计算资源的运行和管理 ([API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html), [Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html))。预置并发是满足**高峰期一致低延迟**这一关键要求的匹配项。AWS 表示，预置并发会分配**预初始化的执行环境**，这些环境已准备好立即响应，可减少冷启动延迟，并且专为交互式工作负载提供**两位数毫秒级响应时间**而设计 ([Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html))。它还可以通过 Application Auto Scaling 按计划或基于利用率进行管理，这适合可预测的季节性使用高峰 ([Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. ALB + Amazon ECS**：这可以运行 API，但与 API Gateway + Lambda 相比，它会引入更多运营开销，因为它需要容器服务以及集群/容量方面的决策。AWS 指出，ECS 集群选项包括 EC2 实例，在这种情况下你需要管理实例选择、配置和维护；或者其他 ECS 容量模型，但仍然涉及容器编排选择 ([Amazon ECS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html))。它也没有像预置并发那样直接解决 Lambda 风格的冷启动延迟问题。
- **C. ALB + Amazon EKS**：EKS 会增加 Kubernetes 集群和节点的运营开销。AWS EKS 文档显示，托管节点组需要部署/管理 EC2 实例，并保护、维护和修补 OS；自管理节点则需要更多手动维护 ([Amazon EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html))。这不是运营开销最少的方案。
- **D. API Gateway + Lambda reserved concurrency**：预留并发与预置并发不同。AWS 表示，预留并发会保留容量，并同时作为下限和上限，适用于确保关键函数具有并发能力并限制扩展；预置并发则专门预初始化环境，以减少冷启动并提供低延迟响应 ([Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html), [Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html))。因此，仅使用预留并发无法像预置并发那样好地满足一致低延迟要求。
