- **D 正确**，因为对于 Regional API Gateway 自定义域名，ACM 证书必须是特定于 Region 的，并且与 API 位于同一 Region。与通配符自定义域名匹配的通配符 ACM 证书可以高效地保护所有客户子域名（[Regional custom domain considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-regional-api-custom-domain-create.html)）。
- **F 正确**，因为 API Gateway 必须为 REST API 配置自定义域名，并且该自定义域名使用来自 ACM 的 SSL/TLS 证书。AWS 说明，在设置自定义域名之前，你必须在 ACM 中准备好 SSL/TLS 证书，并且可以为该域名引用 ACM 证书 ARN（[API Gateway custom domain prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-custom-domains.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **B 不正确**，因为对于 Regional API，不应在不同的 Region 中请求证书。AWS 说明，Regional 自定义域名的 ACM 证书必须与 API 位于同一 Region（[Regional custom domain considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-regional-api-custom-domain-create.html)）。
- **C 不正确**，因为为每个客户创建单独的托管区域和记录会增加运营开销。通配符自定义域名正是用于高效支持大量按客户划分的域名（[Wildcard custom domain names](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-custom-domains.html)）。
- **E 不正确**，因为没有必要为每个客户创建单独的 API 端点。API Gateway 通配符自定义域名和路由规则可以将许多客户子域名的请求路由到 API，而无需为每个客户创建单独的端点（[Wildcard custom domain names](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-custom-domains.html)）。

en.question: A company stores data in Amazon S3. According to regulations, the data must not contain personally identifiable information (PII). The company recently discovered that S3 buckets have some objects that contain PII. The company needs to automatically detect PII in S3 buckets and to notify the company’s security team. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team.
options.B: Use Amazon GuardDuty. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification to the security team.
options.C: Use Amazon Macie. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal event type from Macie findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team.
options.D: Use Amazon GuardDuty. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to filter the CRITICAL event type from GuardDuty findings and to send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) notification to the security team.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

Amazon Macie is the AWS service designed for this requirement: it can automate discovery of sensitive data in Amazon S3, and AWS documentation explicitly says Macie managed data identifiers can detect multiple types of PII. When Macie detects sensitive data in an S3 object, it creates a sensitive data finding ([Macie features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)). Macie finding types include `SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal`, which covers PII, and also `SensitiveData:S3Object/Multiple` when an object contains personal information plus other sensitive data ([Macie finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-types.html)).

Macie publishes findings to Amazon EventBridge, and AWS documentation says EventBridge rules can be tailored to send only findings that match selected criteria from the Macie event schema. It also gives the relevant notification pattern: sending findings to an Amazon SNS topic to notify an incident response team ([Processing Macie findings with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-monitor-events-eventbridge.html)). Therefore, using Macie with an EventBridge rule for sensitive data findings and an SNS notification meets both requirements: automatic PII detection in S3 and notification of the security team.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B and D:** Amazon GuardDuty is for threat detection, such as suspicious activity, data exfiltration/destruction attempts, malware, and other security threats. Its S3 Protection identifies potential security risks such as data exfiltration and destruction attempts, not PII discovery in S3 objects ([GuardDuty features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)).
- **C:** It correctly uses Macie, but Amazon SQS is a queue, not a direct notification mechanism for a security team. Also, filtering only `SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal` could miss objects where PII appears with other sensitive data and Macie reports `SensitiveData:S3Object/Multiple` ([Macie finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-types.html)). SNS is the appropriate target for notifying a team, as described in the Macie/EventBridge documentation ([Processing Macie findings with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-monitor-events-eventbridge.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。根据法规要求，数据不得包含个人身份信息 (PII)。该公司最近发现 S3 存储桶中有一些对象包含 PII。该公司需要自动检测 S3 存储桶中的 PII，并通知公司的安全团队。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Macie。创建 Amazon EventBridge 规则，从 Macie 发现结果中过滤 SensitiveData 事件类型，并向安全团队发送 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。
options.B: 使用 Amazon GuardDuty。创建 Amazon EventBridge 规则，从 GuardDuty 发现结果中过滤 CRITICAL 事件类型，并向安全团队发送 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Macie。创建 Amazon EventBridge 规则，从 Macie 发现结果中过滤 SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal 事件类型，并向安全团队发送 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 通知。
options.D: 使用 Amazon GuardDuty。创建 Amazon EventBridge 规则，从 GuardDuty 发现结果中过滤 CRITICAL 事件类型，并向安全团队发送 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 通知。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

Amazon Macie 是专为此需求设计的 AWS 服务：它可以自动发现 Amazon S3 中的敏感数据，并且 AWS 文档明确说明 Macie 托管数据标识符可以检测多种类型的 PII。当 Macie 在 S3 对象中检测到敏感数据时，它会创建敏感数据发现结果（[Macie features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。Macie 发现结果类型包括 `SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal`，它涵盖 PII；还包括当对象包含个人信息以及其他敏感数据时的 `SensitiveData:S3Object/Multiple`（[Macie finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-types.html)）。

Macie 会将发现结果发布到 Amazon EventBridge，并且 AWS 文档说明 EventBridge 规则可以进行定制，只发送符合 Macie 事件架构中所选条件的发现结果。它还给出了相关的通知模式：将发现结果发送到 Amazon SNS 主题以通知事件响应团队（[Processing Macie findings with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-monitor-events-eventbridge.html)）。因此，使用 Macie 配合针对敏感数据发现结果的 EventBridge 规则以及 SNS 通知，可以同时满足两个要求：自动检测 S3 中的 PII，并通知安全团队。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B and D:** Amazon GuardDuty 用于威胁检测，例如可疑活动、数据泄露/破坏尝试、恶意软件以及其他安全威胁。其 S3 Protection 可识别潜在安全风险，例如数据泄露和破坏尝试，而不是发现 S3 对象中的 PII（[GuardDuty features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)）。
- **C:** 它正确使用了 Macie，但 Amazon SQS 是队列，不是面向安全团队的直接通知机制。此外，仅过滤 `SensitiveData:S3Object/Personal` 可能会漏掉 PII 与其他敏感数据同时出现、且 Macie 报告为 `SensitiveData:S3Object/Multiple` 的对象（[Macie finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-types.html)）。SNS 是通知团队的合适目标，正如 Macie/EventBridge 文档中所述（[Processing Macie findings with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/findings-monitor-events-eventbridge.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to build a logging solution for its multiple AWS accounts. The company currently stores the logs from all accounts in a centralized account. The company has created an Amazon S3 bucket in the centralized account to store the VPC flow logs and AWS CloudTrail logs. All logs must be highly available for 30 days for frequent analysis, retained for an additional 60 days for backup purposes, and deleted 90 days after creation. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Transition objects to the S3 Standard storage class 30 days after creation. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.
options.B: Transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class 30 days after creation. Move all objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 90 days. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.
options.C: Transition objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class 30 days after creation. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.
options.D: Transition objects to the S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) storage class 30 days after creation. Move all objects to the S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval storage class after 90 days. Write an expiration action that directs Amazon S3 to delete objects after 90 days.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

For the first 30 days, the logs can remain in **S3 Standard**, which AWS identifies as the default storage class for frequently accessed, millisecond-access data and is designed for 99.99% availability across at least three Availability Zones ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). After that period, the data is needed only for backup retention, so an S3 Lifecycle rule can transition the objects to a lower-cost archive class and then expire them. AWS states that S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to less-expensive storage classes, archive them, and delete them; AWS specifically gives examples of logs/data being frequently accessed for an initial period and then archived or deleted later ([Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is designed for low-cost archive storage, and Lifecycle can transition objects to it for archiving ([Transitioning objects using S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)). Therefore, transitioning at day 30 and expiring at day 90 matches the required 30-day frequent-analysis period plus 60-day backup retention.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: S3 Standard is already the default storage class if no storage class is specified on upload, and it is intended for frequently accessed data. Keeping all data in S3 Standard for the full 90 days is not the most cost-effective backup/archival approach ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **B**: Moving to S3 Standard-IA at day 30 could support infrequent backup access, but moving to Glacier at day 90 while also deleting at day 90 is unnecessary and has no retention benefit. It is also less cost-optimized than archiving the data directly after the frequent-analysis period.
- **D**: S3 One Zone-IA stores data in only one Availability Zone and is less available and less resilient; AWS recommends it for data that can be re-created if an Availability Zone fails. This does not fit a centralized backup log-retention requirement as well as multi-AZ storage classes. Also, the Glacier transition at day 90 is unnecessary because the objects are deleted then ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

Note: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval has a 90-day minimum storage duration and early deletion charges can apply if archived objects are deleted sooner; however, among the provided choices, **C** is the only one that cleanly implements the required lifecycle of analyze for 30 days, retain for 60 more days as backup, and delete at 90 days while using an archive storage class for the backup period ([S3 Lifecycle transition considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望为其多个 AWS 账户构建日志记录解决方案。该公司目前将所有账户的日志存储在一个集中式账户中。该公司已在集中式账户中创建了一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，用于存储 VPC flow logs 和 AWS CloudTrail logs。所有日志都必须在 30 天内保持高可用以便频繁分析，再额外保留 60 天用于备份目的，并在创建 90 天后删除。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在创建 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard 存储类。编写一个过期操作，指示 Amazon S3 在 90 天后删除对象。
options.B: 在创建 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类。在 90 天后将所有对象移动到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 存储类。编写一个过期操作，指示 Amazon S3 在 90 天后删除对象。
options.C: 在创建 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 存储类。编写一个过期操作，指示 Amazon S3 在 90 天后删除对象。
options.D: 在创建 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 存储类。在 90 天后将所有对象移动到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 存储类。编写一个过期操作，指示 Amazon S3 在 90 天后删除对象。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。在前 30 天，日志可以保留在 **S3 Standard** 中，AWS 将其定义为用于频繁访问、毫秒级访问数据的默认存储类，并设计为在至少三个 Availability Zones 中提供 99.99% 的可用性（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。在该期限之后，数据仅用于备份保留，因此可以使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则将对象转换到成本更低的归档类，然后使其过期。AWS 说明 S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的存储类、将其归档并删除；AWS 还专门给出了日志/数据在初始时期被频繁访问，然后稍后归档或删除的示例（[Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 专为低成本归档存储而设计，Lifecycle 可以将对象转换到其中进行归档（[Transitioning objects using S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。因此，在第 30 天转换并在第 90 天过期，符合所需的 30 天频繁分析期加上 60 天备份保留期。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：如果上传时未指定存储类，S3 Standard 已经是默认存储类，并且它用于频繁访问的数据。将所有数据在完整 90 天内都保留在 S3 Standard 中，并不是最具成本效益的备份/归档方法（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **B**：在第 30 天移动到 S3 Standard-IA 可以支持不频繁的备份访问，但在第 90 天移动到 Glacier 同时又在第 90 天删除是不必要的，并且没有保留收益。它也不如在频繁分析期结束后直接归档数据那样成本优化。
- **D**：S3 One Zone-IA 仅将数据存储在一个 Availability Zone 中，可用性和弹性较低；AWS 建议将其用于在 Availability Zone 发生故障时可以重新创建的数据。与多 AZ 存储类相比，这不太适合集中式备份日志保留要求。此外，第 90 天的 Glacier 转换是不必要的，因为对象届时会被删除（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。注意：S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 具有 90 天最短存储期限，如果归档对象更早删除，则可能产生提前删除费用；但是，在给定选项中，**C** 是唯一一个清晰实现所需生命周期的选项：分析 30 天，再作为备份保留 60 天，并在第 90 天删除，同时在备份期使用归档存储类（[S3 Lifecycle transition considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。

en.question: A company is building an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster for its workloads. All secrets that are stored in Amazon EKS must be encrypted in the Kubernetes etcd key-value store. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage, rotate, and store all secrets in Amazon EKS.
options.B: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key. Enable Amazon EKS KMS secrets encryption on the Amazon EKS cluster.
options.C: Create the Amazon EKS cluster with default options. Use the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver as an add-on.
options.D: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key with the alias/aws/ebs alias. Enable default Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume encryption for the account.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon EKS supports using **AWS KMS keys to provide envelope encryption of Kubernetes secrets stored in EKS**. The EKS documentation shows creating or enabling a cluster with `secretsEncryption` and a KMS key ARN, and states that enabling KMS encryption re-encrypts existing Kubernetes secrets using the new KMS key. The EKS best practices guide specifically says that with the KMS plugin, **all Kubernetes secrets are stored in etcd in ciphertext instead of plain text** and can be decrypted only by the Kubernetes API server. Therefore, creating a KMS key and enabling EKS KMS secrets encryption on the cluster meets the requirement to encrypt secrets in the Kubernetes etcd key-value store ([KMS Envelope Encryption for EKS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/kms-encryption.html), [Data encryption and secrets management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/data-encryption-and-secrets-management.html)). AWS Config also evaluates this requirement by checking whether an EKS cluster has `encryptionConfig` for Kubernetes `secrets` using AWS KMS ([eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Secrets Manager can store and manage secrets and expose them to EKS pods through the Secrets Store CSI Driver, but that is for retrieving/mounting external Secrets Manager secrets into workloads. It does not enable encryption of Kubernetes Secret objects stored in the cluster's etcd store ([Use AWS Secrets Manager secrets with Amazon EKS Pods](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/manage-secrets.html)).
- **C:** The Amazon EBS CSI driver is for Kubernetes persistent volume storage. EBS encryption applies to EBS volumes, not specifically to Kubernetes Secret objects in etcd. The EKS best practices guide distinguishes storage encryption with EBS/EFS/FSx from KMS envelope encryption for Kubernetes secrets in etcd ([Data encryption and secrets management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/data-encryption-and-secrets-management.html)).
- **D:** Default EBS volume encryption encrypts EBS volumes, but the requirement is to encrypt Kubernetes secrets stored in etcd. EKS secrets encryption requires the EKS cluster `encryptionConfig`/KMS secrets encryption configuration, not just account-level EBS encryption ([eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在为其工作负载构建 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。存储在 Amazon EKS 中的所有密钥都必须在 Kubernetes etcd 键值存储中加密。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 管理、轮换并存储 Amazon EKS 中的所有密钥。
options.B: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key。在 Amazon EKS 集群上启用 Amazon EKS KMS 密钥加密。
options.C: 使用默认选项创建 Amazon EKS 集群。将 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver 用作附加组件。
options.D: 创建一个带有 alias/aws/ebs 别名的新 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key。为该账户启用默认 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷加密。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon EKS 支持使用 **AWS KMS keys 为存储在 EKS 中的 Kubernetes 密钥提供信封加密**。EKS 文档展示了如何使用 `secretsEncryption` 和 KMS key ARN 创建或启用集群，并说明启用 KMS 加密会使用新的 KMS key 对现有 Kubernetes 密钥重新加密。EKS 最佳实践指南明确指出，使用 KMS 插件时，**所有 Kubernetes 密钥都以密文而非明文形式存储在 etcd 中**，并且只能由 Kubernetes API server 解密。因此，创建 KMS key 并在集群上启用 EKS KMS 密钥加密，可以满足在 Kubernetes etcd 键值存储中加密密钥的要求（[KMS Envelope Encryption for EKS clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/kms-encryption.html)，[Data encryption and secrets management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/data-encryption-and-secrets-management.html)）。AWS Config 也通过检查 EKS 集群是否具有针对 Kubernetes `secrets` 且使用 AWS KMS 的 `encryptionConfig` 来评估此要求（[eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS Secrets Manager 可以存储和管理密钥，并通过 Secrets Store CSI Driver 将其公开给 EKS pods，但这是为了将外部 Secrets Manager 密钥检索/挂载到工作负载中。它不会启用对存储在集群 etcd 存储中的 Kubernetes Secret 对象的加密（[Use AWS Secrets Manager secrets with Amazon EKS Pods](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/manage-secrets.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon EBS CSI driver 用于 Kubernetes 持久卷存储。EBS 加密适用于 EBS volumes，而不是专门适用于 etcd 中的 Kubernetes Secret 对象。EKS 最佳实践指南将使用 EBS/EFS/FSx 的存储加密与针对 etcd 中 Kubernetes 密钥的 KMS 信封加密区分开来（[Data encryption and secrets management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/data-encryption-and-secrets-management.html)）。
- **D:** 默认 EBS 卷加密会加密 EBS volumes，但要求是加密存储在 etcd 中的 Kubernetes 密钥。EKS 密钥加密需要 EKS 集群 `encryptionConfig`/KMS 密钥加密配置，而不仅仅是账户级别的 EBS 加密（[eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/eks-cluster-secrets-encrypted.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to provide data scientists with near real-time read-only access to the company's production Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The database is currently configured as a Single-AZ database. The data scientists use complex queries that will not affect the production database. The company needs a solution that is highly available. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Scale the existing production database in a maintenance window to provide enough power for the data scientists.
options.B: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ instance deployment with a larger secondary standby instance. Provide the data scientists access to the secondary instance.
options.C: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ instance deployment. Provide two additional read replicas for the data scientists.
options.D: Change the setup from a Single-AZ to a Multi-AZ cluster deployment with two readable standby instances. Provide read endpoints to the data scientists.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

A Multi-AZ DB cluster is designed for this exact combination of requirements: high availability plus read scaling. AWS states that a Multi-AZ DB cluster is a semisynchronous, high-availability deployment with **one writer and two readable replica DB instances in three separate Availability Zones**, and that it provides **increased capacity for read workloads** compared with Multi-AZ DB instance deployments ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)). The reader DB instances both act as automatic failover targets and can **serve read traffic**, allowing read-only workloads to run away from the writer ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)). AWS also provides a built-in **reader endpoint** for read-only connections that sends connections to available reader DB instances and is recommended for read-only connections when high availability is important ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts-connection-management.html)). This meets near real-time read-only access, protects production from complex read queries, and is more cost-effective than adding separate read replicas on top of a Multi-AZ instance deployment.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Scaling the existing Single-AZ production database does not isolate the data scientists' complex queries from production and does not provide the requested high availability.
- **B:** A Multi-AZ DB **instance** deployment has a synchronous standby for HA, but AWS explicitly says the standby replica **can't serve read traffic** and that Multi-AZ is not a scaling solution for read-only scenarios ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). Therefore, data scientists cannot use the secondary standby instance.
- **C:** Read replicas can offload read-heavy/reporting workloads, but RDS DB instance read replicas use **asynchronous replication** ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). This option also requires a Multi-AZ instance deployment plus two additional read replicas, while the Multi-AZ DB cluster in option D provides HA and two readable standby instances in a single three-instance architecture, making D the more cost-effective fit.

zh.question: 一家公司希望为数据科学家提供对公司生产 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库的近实时只读访问权限。该数据库目前配置为 Single-AZ 数据库。数据科学家使用复杂查询，这些查询不会影响生产数据库。公司需要一个高可用的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在维护窗口中扩展现有生产数据库，以便为数据科学家提供足够的性能。
options.B: 将设置从 Single-AZ 更改为 Multi-AZ 实例部署，并使用更大的辅助备用实例。向数据科学家提供对辅助实例的访问权限。
options.C: 将设置从 Single-AZ 更改为 Multi-AZ 实例部署。为数据科学家提供两个额外的只读副本。
options.D: 将设置从 Single-AZ 更改为具有两个可读备用实例的 Multi-AZ 集群部署。向数据科学家提供读取端点。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

Multi-AZ DB cluster 正是为这种需求组合而设计的：高可用性加读取扩展。AWS 表示，Multi-AZ DB cluster 是一种半同步、高可用部署，具有**一个写入器和三个独立 Availability Zones 中的两个可读副本 DB 实例**，并且与 Multi-AZ DB instance deployments 相比，它为读取工作负载提供了**更高的容量**（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。这些读取器 DB 实例既充当自动故障转移目标，也可以**提供读取流量**，从而允许只读工作负载在写入器之外运行（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。AWS 还为只读连接提供内置的 **reader endpoint**，它会将连接发送到可用的读取器 DB 实例；当高可用性很重要时，建议将其用于只读连接（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts-connection-management.html)）。这满足了近实时只读访问的要求，使生产环境免受复杂读取查询的影响，并且比在 Multi-AZ 实例部署之上再添加单独的只读副本更具成本效益。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 扩展现有 Single-AZ 生产数据库无法将数据科学家的复杂查询与生产环境隔离，也无法提供所需的高可用性。
- **B:** Multi-AZ DB **instance** deployment 具有用于 HA 的同步备用实例，但 AWS 明确表示备用副本**不能提供读取流量**，并且 Multi-AZ 不是只读场景的扩展解决方案（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。因此，数据科学家无法使用辅助备用实例。
- **C:** Read replicas 可以卸载读取密集型/报告工作负载，但 RDS DB instance read replicas 使用**异步复制**（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。此选项还需要一个 Multi-AZ 实例部署外加两个额外的只读副本，而选项 D 中的 Multi-AZ DB cluster 在单一三实例架构中提供 HA 和两个可读备用实例，因此 D 是更具成本效益的匹配方案。

en.question: A company runs a three-tier web application in the AWS Cloud that operates across three Availability Zones. The application architecture has an Application Load Balancer, an Amazon EC2 web server that hosts user session states, and a MySQL database that runs on an EC2 instance. The company expects sudden increases in application traffic. The company wants to be able to scale to meet future application capacity demands and to ensure high availability across all three Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.B: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.C: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon DynamoDB Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache reads. Store the session data in DynamoDB. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.
options.D: Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL in a single Availability Zone. Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis with high availability to store session data and to cache reads. Migrate the web server to an Auto Scaling group that is in three Availability Zones.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The architecture must remove state from a single EC2 web server, scale the web tier across three AZs, and make the database and session/cache layer highly available.

* **RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster** is appropriate for the MySQL database. AWS states that a Multi-AZ DB cluster has a writer and reader DB instances, replicates data to the readers, uses the reader DB instances as automatic failover targets, and the readers can also serve read traffic to increase read throughput ([RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)).
* **ElastiCache for Redis OSS with Multi-AZ/high availability** is appropriate for shared session state and caching. ElastiCache Multi-AZ for Redis OSS automatically fails over to a read replica and improves fault tolerance when the primary becomes unreachable or fails ([ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Redis OSS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html)). AWS’s engine comparison also shows Redis OSS supports high availability through replication and automatic failover, while Memcached does not ([ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)).
* **EC2 Auto Scaling across three AZs** meets the web-tier scaling and HA requirement. AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones for geographic redundancy, and Auto Scaling can launch instances in unaffected AZs if one AZ becomes unhealthy ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). Target tracking can automatically increase capacity when load rises ([target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B**: Memcached is not the best fit for a highly available session store. AWS’s comparison shows Memcached has **no** high availability replication and **no** automatic failover, whereas Redis OSS supports both ([ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)).
* **C**: DynamoDB/DAX can be scalable, but the workload is a MySQL relational database. The option changes the database engine/model instead of using the managed MySQL-compatible HA option. RDS Multi-AZ DB clusters are specifically designed to provide failover targets and read throughput for relational databases such as MySQL ([RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)).
* **D**: A single-AZ RDS deployment does not satisfy the requirement for high availability across three Availability Zones. The correct database choice is Multi-AZ, where RDS maintains reader instances as automatic failover targets ([RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个跨三个 Availability Zones 的三层 Web 应用程序。该应用程序架构包含一个 Application Load Balancer、一个托管用户会话状态的 Amazon EC2 Web 服务器，以及一个运行在 EC2 实例上的 MySQL 数据库。公司预计应用程序流量会突然增加。公司希望能够扩展以满足未来的应用程序容量需求，并确保在所有三个 Availability Zones 中实现高可用性。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL，并使用 Multi-AZ DB cluster 部署。使用具有高可用性的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 来存储会话数据并缓存读取。将 Web 服务器迁移到位于三个 Availability Zones 中的 Auto Scaling group。
options.B: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL，并使用 Multi-AZ DB cluster 部署。使用具有高可用性的 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 来存储会话数据并缓存读取。将 Web 服务器迁移到位于三个 Availability Zones 中的 Auto Scaling group。
options.C: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB 使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 来缓存读取。将会话数据存储在 DynamoDB 中。将 Web 服务器迁移到位于三个 Availability Zones 中的 Auto Scaling group。
options.D: 将 MySQL 数据库迁移到单个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。使用具有高可用性的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 来存储会话数据并缓存读取。将 Web 服务器迁移到位于三个 Availability Zones 中的 Auto Scaling group。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

该架构必须将状态从单个 EC2 Web 服务器中移除，将 Web 层扩展到三个 AZ，并使数据库和会话/缓存层具备高可用性。

* **RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster** 适用于 MySQL 数据库。AWS 表示，Multi-AZ DB cluster 具有一个写入器和多个读取器 DB 实例，会将数据复制到读取器，使用读取器 DB 实例作为自动故障转移目标，并且读取器还可以提供读取流量以提高读取吞吐量（[RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。
* **ElastiCache for Redis OSS with Multi-AZ/high availability** 适用于共享会话状态和缓存。ElastiCache Multi-AZ for Redis OSS 会在主节点不可达或发生故障时自动故障转移到读取副本，并提高容错能力（[ElastiCache Multi-AZ with Redis OSS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html)）。AWS 的引擎比较也显示，Redis OSS 通过复制和自动故障转移支持高可用性，而 Memcached 不支持（[ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)）。
* **EC2 Auto Scaling across three AZs** 满足 Web 层扩展和 HA 要求。AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling group 跨多个 Availability Zones 部署以实现地理冗余；如果一个 AZ 变得不健康，Auto Scaling 可以在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。Target tracking 可以在负载上升时自动增加容量（[target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B**：Memcached 并不最适合作为高可用会话存储。AWS 的比较显示，Memcached **没有** 高可用性复制，也**没有** 自动故障转移，而 Redis OSS 同时支持这两者（[ElastiCache engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)）。
* **C**：DynamoDB/DAX 可以具备可扩展性，但该工作负载是 MySQL 关系数据库。该选项改变了数据库引擎/模型，而不是使用托管的 MySQL 兼容 HA 选项。RDS Multi-AZ DB clusters 专门用于为 MySQL 等关系数据库提供故障转移目标和读取吞吐量（[RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。
* **D**：单 AZ RDS 部署不满足跨三个 Availability Zones 实现高可用性的要求。正确的数据库选择是 Multi-AZ，其中 RDS 维护读取器实例作为自动故障转移目标（[RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。

en.question: A global video streaming company uses Amazon CloudFront as a content distribution network (CDN). The company wants to roll out content in a phased manner across multiple countries. The company needs to ensure that viewers who are outside the countries to which the company rolls out content are not able to view the content. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add geographic restrictions to the content in CloudFront by using an allow list. Set up a custom error message.
options.B: Set up a new URL tor restricted content. Authorize access by using a signed URL and cookies. Set up a custom error message.
options.C: Encrypt the data for the content that the company distributes. Set up a custom error message.
options.D: Create a new URL for restricted content. Set up a time-restricted access policy for signed URLs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** CloudFront geographic restrictions (geo blocking) are designed for this exact requirement: they can prevent users in specific geographic locations from accessing content distributed through a CloudFront distribution. AWS states that CloudFront can grant access only to users in approved countries on an **allowlist**, and block requests from countries where the company is not authorized to distribute the content; CloudFront returns `403 (Forbidden)` and can optionally return a custom error message ([CloudFront geographic restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/georestrictions.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Signed URLs and signed cookies are for serving private content to **authorized users** via trusted signers/key groups, not for phased rollout by country. They do not by themselves enforce country-level availability ([Serve private content with signed URLs and signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)).
- **C:** Encrypting the content protects confidentiality, but encryption is not a CloudFront country-level access control mechanism. It would not prevent viewers outside rollout countries from requesting the content through CloudFront.
- **D:** Time-restricted signed URLs control **when** a URL is valid. AWS documentation notes signed URL policies can specify expiration dates/times and, with custom policies, IP address ranges, but this is not the country-level geo restriction required for phased rollout across countries ([Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)).

zh.question: 一家全球视频流媒体公司使用 Amazon CloudFront 作为内容分发网络 (CDN)。该公司希望以分阶段的方式在多个国家/地区推出内容。该公司需要确保位于其推出内容的国家/地区之外的观看者无法查看这些内容。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过使用允许列表在 CloudFront 中为内容添加地理限制。设置自定义错误消息。
options.B: 为受限内容设置一个新的 URL。通过使用签名 URL 和 Cookie 授权访问。设置自定义错误消息。
options.C: 加密公司分发的内容数据。设置自定义错误消息。
options.D: 为受限内容创建一个新的 URL。为签名 URL 设置有时间限制的访问策略。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** CloudFront 地理限制（地理封锁）正是为这一需求而设计的：它们可以阻止特定地理位置的用户访问通过 CloudFront 分配分发的内容。AWS 表示，CloudFront 可以仅向已批准国家/地区的用户授予访问权限（使用 **allowlist**），并阻止来自公司无权分发该内容的国家/地区的请求；CloudFront 返回 `403 (Forbidden)`，并且可以选择返回自定义错误消息（[CloudFront geographic restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/georestrictions.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 签名 URL 和签名 Cookie 用于通过可信签名者/密钥组向**授权用户**提供私有内容，而不是按国家/地区进行分阶段推出。它们本身并不强制执行国家/地区级别的可用性（[Serve private content with signed URLs and signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/PrivateContent.html)）。
- **C:** 加密内容可以保护机密性，但加密并不是 CloudFront 的国家/地区级别访问控制机制。它无法阻止推出国家/地区之外的观看者通过 CloudFront 请求内容。
- **D:** 有时间限制的签名 URL 控制 URL 在**何时**有效。AWS 文档指出，签名 URL 策略可以指定过期日期/时间，并且在使用自定义策略时可以指定 IP 地址范围，但这不是跨国家/地区分阶段推出所需的国家/地区级别地理限制（[Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to improve its on-premises disaster recovery (DR) configuration. The company's core production business application uses Microsoft SQL Server Standard, which runs on a virtual machine (VM). The application has a recovery point objective (RPO) of 30 seconds or fewer and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 60 minutes. The DR solution needs to minimize costs wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure a multi-site active/active setup between the on-premises server and AWS by using Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise with Always On availability groups.
options.B: Configure a warm standby Amazon RDS for SQL Server database on AWS. Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to use change data capture (CDC).
options.C: Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery configured to replicate disk changes to AWS as a pilot light.
options.D: Use third-party backup software to capture backups every night. Store a secondary set of backups in Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C**.

**C. Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery configured to replicate disk changes to AWS as a pilot light.**

AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery is designed for this exact type of scenario: protecting on-premises workloads by continuously replicating server data into AWS while using low-cost staging resources. AWS states that Elastic Disaster Recovery minimizes downtime and data loss for on-premises applications by using "affordable storage" and "minimal compute" in a staging area, and that recovery instances can be launched in AWS within minutes using the most up-to-date server state or a previous point in time ([AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/what-is-drs.html)).

This meets the requirements because:

- The existing workload is a **Microsoft SQL Server Standard database running on a VM**, so full server and disk-level replication preserves the operating system, SQL Server installation, application dependencies, and configuration.
- AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery provides a low-cost pilot-light style architecture because it maintains replication with minimal compute rather than running a full warm standby production environment.
- Elastic Disaster Recovery has an RTO typically measured in minutes, with Windows recovery often depending on boot time, which can fit within the required **60-minute RTO** ([Elastic Disaster Recovery RTO/RPO concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/CloudEndure-Concepts.html)).
- Continuous block-level replication is appropriate for a very low **RPO of 30 seconds or fewer**, while still minimizing cost compared with maintaining a fully running standby database environment.

The other options are not the best fit:

**A. Configure a multi-site active/active setup between the on-premises server and AWS by using Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise with Always On availability groups.**  
This would likely meet very aggressive RPO and RTO targets, but it does not minimize cost. It requires SQL Server Enterprise licensing and an active/active architecture, which is significantly more expensive and complex than necessary for a 60-minute RTO. The workload currently uses SQL Server Standard, so requiring an Enterprise edition upgrade conflicts with the cost-minimization requirement.

**B. Configure a warm standby Amazon RDS for SQL Server database on AWS. Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to use change data capture (CDC).**  
A warm standby RDS database can provide strong recovery characteristics, but it is more expensive than a pilot-light Elastic Disaster Recovery design because it requires an already-running database environment. Also, AWS DMS is primarily a migration and replication service for database data, not a full VM disaster recovery service. The source database may be SQL Server on any computer in the network, and DMS can migrate or replicate supported database data ([AWS DMS SQL Server source documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.SQLServer.html)), but this does not replicate the entire VM, operating system, application stack, or all server-level dependencies. For a production application running SQL Server on a VM, full server recovery with Elastic Disaster Recovery is a better fit.

**D. Use third-party backup software to capture backups every night. Store a secondary set of backups in Amazon S3.**  
Nightly backups cannot meet an **RPO of 30 seconds or fewer** because up to a full day of data could be lost. Backup and restore is generally the lowest-cost DR strategy, but it is suitable only when much longer RPO and RTO values are acceptable. AWS describes DR strategies as ranging from low-cost backup and restore to more advanced active/passive and active/active approaches, with each strategy providing different RPO/RTO tradeoffs ([AWS disaster recovery options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)).

Therefore, **AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery with a pilot-light configuration** is the best solution because it satisfies the low RPO and 60-minute RTO requirements while minimizing cost.

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 AWS Cloud 来改进其本地灾难恢复 (DR) 配置。该公司的核心生产业务应用程序使用 Microsoft SQL Server Standard，该数据库运行在虚拟机 (VM) 上。该应用程序的恢复点目标 (RPO) 为 30 秒或更少，恢复时间目标 (RTO) 为 60 分钟。DR 解决方案需要尽可能降低成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过使用带有 Always On 可用性组的 Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise，在本地服务器和 AWS 之间配置多站点主动/主动设置。
options.B: 在 AWS 上配置一个暖备用 Amazon RDS for SQL Server 数据库。配置 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 以使用变更数据捕获 (CDC)。
options.C: 使用 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery，并将其配置为以 pilot light 方式将磁盘更改复制到 AWS。
options.D: 使用第三方备份软件每晚捕获备份。将第二组备份存储在 Amazon S3 中。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C**。

**C. Use AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery configured to replicate disk changes to AWS as a pilot light.**

AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 正是为这类场景而设计：通过持续将服务器数据复制到 AWS，同时使用低成本的暂存资源来保护本地工作负载。AWS 表示，Elastic Disaster Recovery 通过在暂存区使用 "affordable storage" 和 "minimal compute"，最大限度地减少本地应用程序的停机时间和数据丢失，并且可以使用最新的服务器状态或之前的某个时间点，在数分钟内在 AWS 中启动恢复实例（[AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/what-is-drs.html)）。这满足要求，因为：

- 现有工作负载是一个**运行在 VM 上的 Microsoft SQL Server Standard 数据库**，因此完整的服务器级和磁盘级复制可以保留操作系统、SQL Server 安装、应用程序依赖项和配置。
- AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery 提供低成本的 pilot-light 风格架构，因为它使用最少计算资源维持复制，而不是运行完整的暖备用生产环境。
- Elastic Disaster Recovery 的 RTO 通常以分钟计，Windows 恢复通常取决于启动时间，这可以符合所需的 **60-minute RTO**（[Elastic Disaster Recovery RTO/RPO concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/drs/latest/userguide/CloudEndure-Concepts.html)）。
- 连续块级复制适用于非常低的 **RPO of 30 seconds or fewer**，同时与维护一个完全运行的备用数据库环境相比仍能最大限度降低成本。其他选项并不是最佳选择：

**A. Configure a multi-site active/active setup between the on-premises server and AWS by using Microsoft SQL Server Enterprise with Always On availability groups.**  
这很可能可以满足非常激进的 RPO 和 RTO 目标，但它不能最小化成本。它需要 SQL Server Enterprise 许可和主动/主动架构，与 60 分钟 RTO 所需相比明显更昂贵且更复杂。当前工作负载使用 SQL Server Standard，因此要求升级到 Enterprise 版本与成本最小化要求相冲突。

**B. Configure a warm standby Amazon RDS for SQL Server database on AWS. Configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to use change data capture (CDC).**  
暖备用 RDS 数据库可以提供强大的恢复特性，但它比 pilot-light Elastic Disaster Recovery 设计更昂贵，因为它需要一个已经运行的数据库环境。此外，AWS DMS 主要是用于数据库数据的迁移和复制服务，而不是完整的 VM 灾难恢复服务。源数据库可以是网络中任何计算机上的 SQL Server，DMS 可以迁移或复制受支持的数据库数据（[AWS DMS SQL Server source documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.SQLServer.html)），但这并不会复制整个 VM、操作系统、应用程序堆栈或所有服务器级依赖项。对于运行在 VM 上的生产应用程序及其 SQL Server，使用 Elastic Disaster Recovery 进行完整服务器恢复更合适。

**D. Use third-party backup software to capture backups every night. Store a secondary set of backups in Amazon S3.**  
每晚备份无法满足 **RPO of 30 seconds or fewer**，因为最多可能丢失一整天的数据。备份和还原通常是成本最低的 DR 策略，但仅在可以接受更长 RPO 和 RTO 值时才适用。AWS 将 DR 策略描述为从低成本备份和还原到更高级的主动/被动和主动/主动方法不等，每种策略都提供不同的 RPO/RTO 权衡（[AWS disaster recovery options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/disaster-recovery-workloads-on-aws/disaster-recovery-options-in-the-cloud.html)）。因此，**采用 pilot-light 配置的 AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery** 是最佳解决方案，因为它在满足低 RPO 和 60 分钟 RTO 要求的同时最大限度地降低成本。

en.question: A company has an on-premises server that uses an Oracle database to process and store customer information. The company wants to use an AWS database service to achieve higher availability and to improve application performance. The company also wants to offload reporting from its primary database system. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to create an Amazon RDS DB instance in multiple AWS Regions. Point the reporting functions toward a separate DB instance from the primary DB instance.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS in a Single-AZ deployment to create an Oracle database. Create a read replica in the same zone as the primary DB instance. Direct the reporting functions to the read replica.
options.C: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ cluster deployment to create an Oracle database. Direct the reporting functions to use the reader instance in the cluster deployment.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS deployed in a Multi-AZ instance deployment to create an Amazon Aurora database. Direct the reporting functions to the reader instances.

en.explanation:
**Answer: D**

Amazon Aurora is the best fit among the options because an Aurora DB cluster can have a primary writer and up to 15 Aurora Replicas. AWS states that Aurora Replicas should be placed in separate Availability Zones for high availability, can be automatically promoted if the primary becomes unavailable, and can offload read workloads from the primary instance. The Aurora reader endpoint is specifically intended for read-only operations such as **reporting**, and it balances read-only connections across Aurora Replicas, reducing overhead on the primary instance ([Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html), [Aurora reader endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)).

Why the other options are not the best:

- **A**: Creating RDS instances in multiple Regions with AWS DMS is more operationally complex than necessary for the stated requirements. The question asks for higher availability, better performance, and reporting offload—not multi-Region DR. Aurora provides built-in read scaling and high availability without manually managing separate regional database instances.
- **B**: A Single-AZ RDS deployment does not satisfy the higher availability requirement. Also, placing the read replica in the same Availability Zone does not protect against an AZ disruption.
- **C**: This option is invalid for Oracle. AWS documentation states that Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB clusters are **not available** for RDS for Oracle ([supported engines for Multi-AZ DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.RDS_Fea_Regions_DB-eng.Feature.MultiAZDBClusters.html)).

Note: Standard RDS Multi-AZ **DB instance** deployments use a standby for failover, but that standby does **not** serve read traffic; AWS says to use a Multi-AZ DB cluster or read replica for read-only traffic ([RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)). Aurora’s reader instances/reader endpoint therefore best meet the reporting offload requirement in the most operationally efficient way.

zh.question: 一家公司有一台本地服务器，使用 Oracle 数据库处理和存储客户信息。该公司希望使用 AWS 数据库服务来实现更高的可用性并提升应用程序性能。该公司还希望将报告工作负载从其主数据库系统卸载出去。哪种解决方案能以最高运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 在多个 AWS Regions 中创建 Amazon RDS DB 实例。将报告功能指向与主 DB 实例分开的单独 DB 实例。
options.B: 使用 Single-AZ 部署中的 Amazon RDS 创建 Oracle 数据库。在与主 DB 实例相同的区域中创建只读副本。将报告功能定向到该只读副本。
options.C: 使用部署在 Multi-AZ cluster deployment 中的 Amazon RDS 创建 Oracle 数据库。将报告功能定向为使用集群部署中的 reader instance。
options.D: 使用部署在 Multi-AZ instance deployment 中的 Amazon RDS 创建 Amazon Aurora 数据库。将报告功能定向到 reader instances。

zh.explanation:
**答案：D**

在这些选项中，Amazon Aurora 最合适，因为 Aurora DB cluster 可以有一个主 writer 和最多 15 个 Aurora Replicas。AWS 说明，Aurora Replicas 应放置在不同的 Availability Zones 中以实现高可用性；如果主实例不可用，可以自动提升副本；并且可以从主实例卸载读取工作负载。Aurora reader endpoint 专门用于只读操作，例如 **reporting**，并且会在 Aurora Replicas 之间平衡只读连接，从而降低主实例的开销（[Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html), [Aurora reader endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)）。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A**：使用 AWS DMS 在多个 Regions 中创建 RDS 实例，对于题目所述要求来说运营复杂度高于必要水平。题目要求更高可用性、更好性能以及报告卸载，而不是多 Region DR。Aurora 提供内置的读取扩展和高可用性，无需手动管理单独的区域数据库实例。
- **B**：Single-AZ RDS 部署不满足更高可用性的要求。此外，将只读副本放在同一个 Availability Zone 中无法防范 AZ 中断。
- **C**：此选项对于 Oracle 无效。AWS 文档说明，Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB clusters **不适用于** RDS for Oracle（[supported engines for Multi-AZ DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.RDS_Fea_Regions_DB-eng.Feature.MultiAZDBClusters.html)）。注意：标准 RDS Multi-AZ **DB instance** 部署使用 standby 进行故障转移，但该 standby **不**提供读取流量服务；AWS 表示，对于只读流量应使用 Multi-AZ DB cluster 或 read replica（[RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。因此，Aurora 的 reader instances/reader endpoint 能以最高运营效率最好地满足报告卸载要求。

en.question: A company wants to build a web application on AWS. Client access requests to the website are not predictable and can be idle for a long time. Only customers who have paid a subscription fee can have the ability to sign in and use the web application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to retrieve user information from Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service behind an Application Load Balancer to retrieve user information from Amazon RDS. Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to accept RESTful APIs. Send the API calls to the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool to authenticate users.
options.D: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool to authenticate users.
options.E: Use AWS Amplify to serve the frontend web content with HTML, CSS, and JS. Use an integrated Amazon CloudFront configuration.
options.F: Use Amazon S3 static web hosting with PHP, CSS, and JS. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the frontend web content.

en.explanation:
The best combination is **A, C, and E**.

- **A is correct**: For unpredictable traffic that can be idle for long periods, a serverless backend is the most cost-effective fit. AWS documents the API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB pattern: API Gateway routes the request to Lambda, and Lambda interacts with DynamoDB and returns the response. This is described as a **serverless API** pattern in the API Gateway tutorial for Lambda and DynamoDB ([API Gateway Lambda/DynamoDB tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)). Lambda also manages compute resources such as capacity provisioning and automatic scaling, so the company does not manage servers ([AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **C is correct**: Amazon Cognito **user pools** are specifically for web and mobile app authentication and authorization and act as an OIDC identity provider for application sign-in ([Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)). This matches the requirement that only paid subscribers can sign in and use the application.
- **E is correct**: AWS Amplify can deploy and host single-page web applications or static sites with serverless backends ([Deploy a Web App on AWS Amplify](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/hands-on/latest/deploy-webapp-amplify/deploy-webapp-amplify.html)). AWS also recommends Amplify Hosting for static website content because it deploys content to a globally available CDN powered by Amazon CloudFront and provides secure static website hosting ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B is incorrect**: An ECS service behind an ALB with RDS is a heavier always-running container/database architecture and is not the most cost-effective choice for a workload that can be idle for a long time. AWS documents the simpler serverless API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB approach for this type of web API pattern ([API Gateway Lambda/DynamoDB tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)).
- **D is incorrect**: Cognito identity pools are mainly for exchanging identities for temporary AWS credentials and assigning IAM-based access to AWS resources, including guest access. They are not the primary user sign-in directory for the web app; user pools are the correct authentication component ([Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)).
- **F is incorrect**: Amazon S3 static website hosting serves static content and can include client-side scripts, but PHP is a server-side technology and does not fit S3 static website hosting. AWS recommends Amplify Hosting with a CloudFront-powered CDN for secure static website hosting ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司想在 AWS 上构建一个 Web 应用程序。客户端对网站的访问请求不可预测，并且可能长时间处于空闲状态。只有已支付订阅费的客户才可以登录并使用该 Web 应用程序。哪组步骤能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，从 Amazon DynamoDB 检索用户信息。创建一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点以接受 RESTful APIs。将 API 调用发送到 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在 Application Load Balancer 后面创建一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务，从 Amazon RDS 检索用户信息。创建一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点以接受 RESTful APIs。将 API 调用发送到 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Cognito user pool 来对用户进行身份验证。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Cognito identity pool 来对用户进行身份验证。
options.E: 使用 AWS Amplify 通过 HTML、CSS 和 JS 提供前端 Web 内容。使用集成的 Amazon CloudFront 配置。
options.F: 使用 Amazon S3 静态网站托管，包含 PHP、CSS 和 JS。使用 Amazon CloudFront 提供前端 Web 内容。

zh.explanation:
最佳组合是 **A、C 和 E**。

- **A 正确**：对于不可预测且可能长时间空闲的流量，serverless 后端是最具成本效益的选择。AWS 文档说明了 API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB 模式：API Gateway 将请求路由到 Lambda，Lambda 与 DynamoDB 交互并返回响应。在 API Gateway 的 Lambda 和 DynamoDB 教程中，这被描述为一种 **serverless API** 模式（[API Gateway Lambda/DynamoDB tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)）。Lambda 还会管理计算资源，例如容量预置和自动扩展，因此公司无需管理服务器（[AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **C 正确**：Amazon Cognito **user pools** 专门用于 Web 和移动应用程序的身份验证与授权，并作为应用程序登录的 OIDC 身份提供商（[Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)）。这与只有付费订阅者才能登录并使用应用程序的要求相匹配。
- **E 正确**：AWS Amplify 可以部署和托管单页 Web 应用程序或带有 serverless 后端的静态站点（[Deploy a Web App on AWS Amplify](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/hands-on/latest/deploy-webapp-amplify/deploy-webapp-amplify.html)）。AWS 还建议将 Amplify Hosting 用于静态网站内容，因为它会将内容部署到由 Amazon CloudFront 提供支持的全球可用 CDN，并提供安全的静态网站托管（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。错误选项：

- **B 错误**：ALB 后面的 ECS 服务加 RDS 是一种更重的、始终运行的容器/数据库架构，对于可能长时间空闲的工作负载而言并不是最具成本效益的选择。AWS 文档针对这类 Web API 模式说明了更简单的 serverless API Gateway + Lambda + DynamoDB 方法（[API Gateway Lambda/DynamoDB tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-dynamo-db.html)）。
- **D 错误**：Cognito identity pools 主要用于将身份交换为临时 AWS 凭证，并分配对 AWS 资源的基于 IAM 的访问权限，包括访客访问。它们不是 Web 应用的主要用户登录目录；user pools 才是正确的身份验证组件（[Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)）。
- **F 错误**：Amazon S3 静态网站托管提供静态内容，并且可以包含客户端脚本，但 PHP 是服务器端技术，不适合 S3 静态网站托管。AWS 建议使用带有 CloudFront 支持的 CDN 的 Amplify Hosting 来实现安全的静态网站托管（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。

en.question: A media company uses an Amazon CloudFront distribution to deliver content over the internet. The company wants only premium customers to have access to the media streams and file content. The company stores all content in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company also delivers content on demand to customers for a specific purpose, such as movie rentals or music downloads. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Generate and provide S3 signed cookies to premium customers.
options.B: Generate and provide CloudFront signed URLs to premium customers.
options.C: Use origin access control (OAC) to limit the access of non-premium customers.
options.D: Generate and activate field-level encryption to block non-premium customers.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Generate and provide CloudFront signed URLs to premium customers.**

CloudFront signed URLs are designed to serve private content only to authorized users. AWS describes the flow as: the application verifies that the user is entitled to access the file, such as because the user has paid for access, creates and returns a signed URL, and the signed URL allows the user to download or stream the content ([Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)). This matches premium customers receiving time-limited access for on-demand rentals or downloads. AWS also says to use signed URLs when you want to restrict access to individual files ([Decide to use signed URLs or signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-choosing-signed-urls-cookies.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A. S3 signed cookies** — S3 does not provide “signed cookies” for controlling CloudFront access. CloudFront signed cookies exist, but AWS recommends signed cookies when providing access to multiple restricted files or when you do not want to change URLs; this option specifically says **S3** signed cookies, and the scenario is on-demand access to specific content ([Decide to use signed URLs or signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-choosing-signed-urls-cookies.html)).
- **C. Origin access control (OAC)** — OAC restricts access to the **S3 origin** so CloudFront can access the bucket, using a bucket policy that allows the CloudFront service principal. It does not distinguish premium from non-premium viewers at the CloudFront edge ([Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)).
- **D. Field-level encryption** — Field-level encryption encrypts specified data fields in requests based on a configuration and cache behavior; it is for protecting sensitive submitted data, not authorizing viewer access to media content ([Use field-level encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/field-level-encryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家媒体公司使用 Amazon CloudFront 分配通过互联网交付内容。该公司希望只有高级客户能够访问媒体流和文件内容。该公司将所有内容存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司还会按需向客户交付用于特定目的的内容，例如电影租赁或音乐下载。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 生成 S3 签名 Cookie 并提供给高级客户。
options.B: 生成 CloudFront 签名 URL 并提供给高级客户。
options.C: 使用 origin access control (OAC) 限制非高级客户的访问。
options.D: 生成并激活字段级加密以阻止非高级客户。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 生成 CloudFront 签名 URL 并提供给高级客户。**

CloudFront signed URLs 旨在仅向授权用户提供私有内容。AWS 将该流程描述为：应用程序验证用户是否有权访问该文件，例如因为用户已为访问付费，创建并返回 signed URL，而该 signed URL 允许用户下载或流式传输内容（[Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)）。这与高级客户获得用于按需租赁或下载的限时访问权限相匹配。AWS 还表示，当你想限制对单个文件的访问时，应使用 signed URLs（[Decide to use signed URLs or signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-choosing-signed-urls-cookies.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A. S3 签名 Cookie** — S3 不提供用于控制 CloudFront 访问的 “signed cookies”。CloudFront signed cookies 是存在的，但 AWS 建议在提供对多个受限文件的访问，或你不想更改 URL 时使用 signed cookies；此选项明确说的是 **S3** signed cookies，而场景是对特定内容的按需访问（[Decide to use signed URLs or signed cookies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-choosing-signed-urls-cookies.html)）。
- **C. Origin access control (OAC)** — OAC 限制对 **S3 origin** 的访问，以便 CloudFront 可以访问该存储桶，方法是使用允许 CloudFront 服务主体的存储桶策略。它不会在 CloudFront 边缘区分高级与非高级查看者（[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。
- **D. Field-level encryption** — Field-level encryption 根据配置和缓存行为加密请求中的指定数据字段；它用于保护提交的敏感数据，而不是授权查看者访问媒体内容（[Use field-level encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/field-level-encryption.html)）。

en.question: A company runs Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS accounts that are individually bled. The company recently purchased a Savings Pian. Because of changes in the company’s business requirements, the company has decommissioned a large number of EC2 instances. The company wants to use its Savings Plan discounts on its other AWS accounts. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: From the AWS Account Management Console of the management account, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section.
options.B: From the AWS Account Management Console of the account that purchased the existing Savings Plan, turn on discount sharing from the billing preferences section. Include all accounts.
options.C: From the AWS Organizations management account, use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the Savings Plan with other accounts.
options.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in a new payer account. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account.
options.E: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the existing AWS account with the existing EC2 instances and Savings Plan. Invite the other AWS accounts to join the organization from the management account.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and D**.

- **A is correct** because Savings Plans discounts are shared through the AWS Billing and Cost Management **Billing preferences** of the **AWS Organizations management account**. AWS documentation says to sign in to the management account, go to **Billing preferences**, and activate Reserved Instance and Savings Plans discount sharing for the selected accounts; it also notes you can **Activate All** accounts. AWS also states that Savings Plans can be shared across the consolidated billing family, and that both the purchasing account and benefit-receiving accounts must have sharing activated. [Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)
- **D is correct** because the separately billed accounts must be placed into one AWS Organizations consolidated billing family before the Savings Plan can benefit other accounts. AWS Organizations supports inviting existing AWS accounts from the organization’s management account. Using a **new payer/management account** also aligns with AWS best practices to keep workloads and resources out of the management account. [Sending account invitations with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_invite-account.html), [Best practices for the management account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_best-practices_mgmt-acct.html)

Incorrect options:

- **B is incorrect** because discount sharing is configured from the **management account** of the organization, not merely from the member account that purchased the Savings Plan. [Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)
- **C is incorrect** because Savings Plans discounts are not shared with AWS Resource Access Manager. The AWS documented method is discount sharing through AWS Billing preferences within an AWS Organizations consolidated billing family. [Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)
- **E is incorrect** because making the existing workload/Savings Plan account the organization management account is not the best design. AWS recommends using the management account only for tasks that require it and storing AWS resources in other member accounts; it also specifically says to avoid deploying workloads to the organization’s management account. [Best practices for the management account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_best-practices_mgmt-acct.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在多个单独计费的 AWS 账户中运行 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司最近购买了一个 Savings Plan。由于公司业务需求发生变化，公司已停用了大量 EC2 实例。公司希望在其其他 AWS 账户上使用 Savings Plan 折扣。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 从管理账户的 AWS Account Management Console 中，在 billing preferences 部分开启 discount sharing。
options.B: 从购买现有 Savings Plan 的账户的 AWS Account Management Console 中，在 billing preferences 部分开启 discount sharing。包括所有账户。
options.C: 从 AWS Organizations 管理账户中，使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 将 Savings Plan 共享给其他账户。
options.D: 在新的付款方账户中创建一个 AWS Organizations 组织。从管理账户邀请其他 AWS 账户加入该组织。
options.E: 在拥有现有 EC2 实例和 Savings Plan 的现有 AWS 账户中创建一个 AWS Organizations 组织。从管理账户邀请其他 AWS 账户加入该组织。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A 和 D**。

- **A 正确**，因为 Savings Plans 折扣是通过 **AWS Organizations management account** 的 AWS Billing and Cost Management **Billing preferences** 进行共享的。AWS 文档说明，应登录管理账户，进入 **Billing preferences**，并为所选账户激活 Reserved Instance 和 Savings Plans discount sharing；文档还指出可以 **Activate All** 账户。AWS 还说明，Savings Plans 可以在整合账单系列中共享，并且购买账户和接收权益的账户都必须激活 sharing。[Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)
- **D 正确**，因为这些单独计费的账户必须先放入同一个 AWS Organizations 整合账单系列中，Savings Plan 才能使其他账户受益。AWS Organizations 支持从组织的管理账户邀请现有 AWS 账户。使用一个 **新的付款方/管理账户** 也符合 AWS 最佳实践，即将工作负载和资源排除在管理账户之外。[Sending account invitations with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_invite-account.html), [Best practices for the management account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_best-practices_mgmt-acct.html)

错误选项：

- **B 错误**，因为 discount sharing 是从组织的 **management account** 配置的，而不是仅从购买 Savings Plan 的成员账户配置。[Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)
- **C 错误**，因为 Savings Plans 折扣不是通过 AWS Resource Access Manager 共享的。AWS 文档记录的方法是在 AWS Organizations 整合账单系列中通过 AWS Billing preferences 进行 discount sharing。[Reserved Instances and Savings Plans discount sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/ri-turn-off.html)
- **E 错误**，因为让现有工作负载/Savings Plan 账户成为组织管理账户不是最佳设计。AWS 建议仅将管理账户用于必须由其执行的任务，并将 AWS 资源存放在其他成员账户中；它还特别说明应避免将工作负载部署到组织的管理账户。[Best practices for the management account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_best-practices_mgmt-acct.html)

en.question: A retail company uses a regional Amazon API Gateway API for its public REST APIs. The API Gateway endpoint is a custom domain name that points to an Amazon Route 53 alias record. A solutions architect needs to create a solution that has minimal effects on customers and minimal data loss to release the new version of APIs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a canary release deployment stage for API Gateway. Deploy the latest API version. Point an appropriate percentage of traffic to the canary stage. After API verification, promote the canary stage to the production stage.
options.B: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI YAML file format. Use the import-to-update operation in merge mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage.
options.C: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with a new version of the API in OpenAPI JSON file format. Use the import-to-update operation in overwrite mode into the API in API Gateway. Deploy the new version of the API to the production stage.
options.D: Create a new API Gateway endpoint with new versions of the API definitions. Create a custom domain name for the new API Gateway API. Point the Route 53 alias record to the new API Gateway API custom domain name.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** API Gateway canary releases are designed for exactly this type of low-risk API rollout. AWS states that a canary release keeps the base version deployed as the production release on the **same stage**, while routing a configured percentage of total API traffic to the canary release. Typically the canary receives a small percentage of traffic, and the percentage can be adjusted. AWS also notes that keeping canary traffic small means most users are not adversely affected by potential bugs, and after metrics pass, the canary can be promoted to production, making the new features available in the production stage ([API Gateway canary releases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)). This provides minimal customer impact and minimizes risk/data loss during release.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Importing an updated OpenAPI definition in merge mode and deploying it directly to the production stage is not a phased rollout. API Gateway documentation says API updates must be redeployed to an existing or new stage, and canary deployment is the feature that lets clients access both production and updated versions on the **same stage** ([Deploy REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-deploy-api.html)). Direct production deployment increases blast radius.
- **C:** Overwrite mode followed by production deployment is even more disruptive because it replaces API definitions and still does not provide gradual traffic shifting or validation before full exposure.
- **D:** Creating a new API/custom domain and changing the Route 53 alias is a cutover approach, not a controlled API Gateway canary rollout. It can affect all customers at once and does not provide the built-in same-stage percentage-based traffic split and promotion workflow described for API Gateway canary releases ([API Gateway canary releases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)).

zh.question: 一家零售公司将区域性 Amazon API Gateway API 用于其公共 REST APIs。该 API Gateway 端点是一个自定义域名，指向一个 Amazon Route 53 别名记录。解决方案架构师需要创建一个解决方案，以最小化对客户的影响并最小化数据丢失，从而发布新版本的 APIs。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 API Gateway 创建一个金丝雀发布部署阶段。部署最新的 API 版本。将适当比例的流量指向金丝雀阶段。在 API 验证之后，将金丝雀阶段提升到生产阶段。
options.B: 创建一个新的 API Gateway 端点，其中包含采用 OpenAPI YAML 文件格式的新版本 API。使用 merge 模式的 import-to-update 操作将其导入到 API Gateway 中的 API。将新版本的 API 部署到生产阶段。
options.C: 创建一个新的 API Gateway 端点，其中包含采用 OpenAPI JSON 文件格式的新版本 API。使用 overwrite 模式的 import-to-update 操作将其导入到 API Gateway 中的 API。将新版本的 API 部署到生产阶段。
options.D: 创建一个新的 API Gateway 端点，其中包含新版本的 API 定义。为新的 API Gateway API 创建一个自定义域名。将 Route 53 别名记录指向新的 API Gateway API 自定义域名。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** API Gateway 金丝雀发布正是为这种低风险 API 推出场景而设计的。AWS 表示，金丝雀发布会将基础版本作为生产发布部署在**同一阶段**，同时将配置比例的总 API 流量路由到金丝雀发布。通常，金丝雀会接收一小部分流量，并且可以调整该百分比。AWS 还指出，保持较小的金丝雀流量意味着大多数用户不会受到潜在 bug 的不利影响；当指标通过后，可以将金丝雀提升到生产环境，使新功能在生产阶段可用（[API Gateway canary releases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)）。这可以在发布期间最大限度地减少客户影响，并降低风险/数据丢失。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 以 merge 模式导入更新后的 OpenAPI 定义并直接部署到生产阶段，并不是分阶段推出。API Gateway 文档说明，API 更新必须重新部署到现有或新的阶段，而金丝雀部署才是允许客户端在**同一阶段**访问生产版本和更新版本的功能（[Deploy REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/how-to-deploy-api.html)）。直接部署到生产会增加影响范围。
- **C:** overwrite 模式之后再部署到生产更具破坏性，因为它会替换 API 定义，并且仍然不能在完全暴露之前提供逐步流量切换或验证。
- **D:** 创建新的 API/自定义域名并更改 Route 53 别名是一种切换方法，而不是受控的 API Gateway 金丝雀推出。它可能一次性影响所有客户，并且不提供 API Gateway 金丝雀发布所描述的内置同阶段、基于百分比的流量拆分和提升工作流（[API Gateway canary releases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to direct its users to a backup static error page if the company's primary website is unavailable. The primary website's DNS records are hosted in Amazon Route 53. The domain is pointing to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company needs a solution that minimizes changes and infrastructure overhead. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the Route 53 records to use a latency routing policy. Add a static error page that is hosted in an Amazon S3 bucket to the records so that the traffic is sent to the most responsive endpoints.
options.B: Set up a Route 53 active-passive failover configuration. Direct traffic to a static error page that is hosted in an Amazon S3 bucket when Route 53 health checks determine that the ALB endpoint is unhealthy.
options.C: Set up a Route 53 active-active configuration with the ALB and an Amazon EC2 instance that hosts a static error page as endpoints. Configure Route 53 to send requests to the instance only if the health checks fail for the ALB.
options.D: Update the Route 53 records to use a multivalue answer routing policy. Create a health check. Direct traffic to the website if the health check passes. Direct traffic to a static error page that is hosted in Amazon S3 if the health check does not pass.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Route 53 **active-passive failover** is designed for exactly this pattern: keep a primary resource active, keep a secondary resource on standby, and have Route 53 return the secondary record when the primary becomes unhealthy. AWS states that for one primary and one secondary resource, you specify the **Failover** routing policy; when the primary is healthy Route 53 answers with the primary record, and when the primary is unhealthy it answers with the secondary record. AWS also explicitly describes a common configuration where the primary is a web resource and the secondary is an **Amazon S3 bucket configured as a website endpoint** containing a simple “temporarily unavailable” message, using a failover alias record for the secondary resource ([Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)). Route 53 can also route traffic to an S3 bucket configured for static website hosting by using an alias to an S3 website endpoint ([Route 53 routing to S3 bucket](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/RoutingToS3Bucket.html)). This minimizes infrastructure overhead because the backup is a static S3 website, not additional compute.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Latency-based routing chooses the AWS Region/resource with the lowest latency for the user; it is for improving performance when an application is hosted in multiple Regions, not for active-passive failover to an error page ([Latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)).
- **C:** Active-active failover keeps all resources active and Route 53 can answer with any healthy record; it is not the best match for a standby-only error page. It also adds EC2 infrastructure, increasing operational overhead compared with S3 static hosting ([Active-active failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)).
- **D:** Multivalue answer routing returns multiple healthy records and is a DNS-based availability/load-balancing feature; AWS notes it is **not a substitute for a load balancer** and, when all records are unhealthy, Route 53 can still return unhealthy records. It is not the proper active-passive failover mechanism for sending users to a backup static error page only when the ALB is unhealthy ([Multivalue answer routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望在其主网站不可用时，将用户引导到备用的静态错误页面。主网站的 DNS 记录托管在 Amazon Route 53 中。该域名指向一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。公司需要一种能够最大限度减少变更和基础设施开销的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新 Route 53 记录以使用延迟路由策略。将托管在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的静态错误页面添加到记录中，以便将流量发送到响应最快的端点。
options.B: 设置 Route 53 主动-被动故障转移配置。当 Route 53 运行状况检查确定 ALB 端点不正常时，将流量引导到托管在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的静态错误页面。
options.C: 使用 ALB 和托管静态错误页面的 Amazon EC2 实例作为端点，设置 Route 53 主动-主动配置。配置 Route 53，使其仅在 ALB 的运行状况检查失败时才将请求发送到该实例。
options.D: 更新 Route 53 记录以使用多值应答路由策略。创建运行状况检查。如果运行状况检查通过，则将流量引导到网站。如果运行状况检查未通过，则将流量引导到托管在 Amazon S3 中的静态错误页面。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Route 53 **主动-被动故障转移**正是为这种模式而设计的：保持主资源处于活动状态，保持辅助资源处于备用状态，并在主资源变为不正常时让 Route 53 返回辅助记录。AWS 说明，对于一个主资源和一个辅助资源，需要指定 **Failover** 路由策略；当主资源正常时，Route 53 使用主记录进行应答，而当主资源不正常时，它使用辅助记录进行应答。AWS 还明确描述了一种常见配置，其中主资源是 Web 资源，辅助资源是配置为网站端点的 **Amazon S3 bucket**，其中包含简单的“temporarily unavailable”消息，并为辅助资源使用故障转移别名记录（[Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。Route 53 还可以通过使用指向 S3 网站端点的别名，将流量路由到配置为静态网站托管的 S3 存储桶（[Route 53 routing to S3 bucket](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/RoutingToS3Bucket.html)）。这最大限度地减少了基础设施开销，因为备用方案是静态 S3 网站，而不是额外的计算资源。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 基于延迟的路由会选择对用户延迟最低的 AWS Region/资源；它用于在应用程序托管于多个 Regions 时提升性能，而不是用于主动-被动故障转移到错误页面（[Latency-based routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-latency.html)）。
- **C:** 主动-主动故障转移会保持所有资源处于活动状态，Route 53 可以使用任何正常记录进行应答；它并不最适合仅作为备用的错误页面。它还会增加 EC2 基础设施，与 S3 静态托管相比会增加运营开销（[Active-active failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。
- **D:** 多值应答路由返回多个正常记录，是一种基于 DNS 的可用性/负载均衡功能；AWS 指出它**不能替代负载均衡器**，并且当所有记录都不正常时，Route 53 仍可能返回不正常的记录。它不是在 ALB 不正常时才将用户发送到备用静态错误页面的正确主动-被动故障转移机制（[Multivalue answer routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)）。

en.question: A recent analysis of a company's IT expenses highlights the need to reduce backup costs. The company's chief information officer wants to simplify the on-premises backup infrastructure and reduce costs by eliminating the use of physical backup tapes. The company must preserve the existing investment in the on-premises backup applications and workflows. What should a solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Set up AWS Storage Gateway to connect with the backup applications using the NFS interface.
options.B: Set up an Amazon EFS file system that connects with the backup applications using the NFS interface.
options.C: Set up an Amazon EFS file system that connects with the backup applications using the iSCSI interface.
options.D: Set up AWS Storage Gateway to connect with the backup applications using the iSCSI-virtual tape library (VTL) interface.
