Enable auto scaling for the PostgreSQL database on the EC2 instance** — Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling adjusts **EC2 instance capacity** in an Auto Scaling group, not the capacity of a self-managed PostgreSQL database running on a single EC2 instance ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)). This would not provide managed database capacity scaling or solve database connection/capacity issues in the same way.
- **C. Migrate to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL with a larger instance type** — A larger provisioned RDS instance requires choosing fixed capacity. AWS contrasts this with Aurora Serverless: provisioned clusters are better for steady workloads, and overprovisioning for variable usage can result in higher costs ([How Aurora serverless works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html)). This is less cost-effective for unpredictable spikes.
- **D. Migrate to Amazon Redshift** — Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale **data warehouse** for analytics and BI querying, not the appropriate transactional PostgreSQL database replacement for an ecommerce OLTP application ([What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一个电子商务应用程序使用在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的 PostgreSQL 数据库。在每月一次的销售活动期间，数据库使用量增加，并导致应用程序出现数据库连接问题。后续每月销售活动的流量不可预测，这会影响销售预测。公司需要在流量出现不可预测增长时保持性能。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式解决此问题？

options.A: 将 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless v2。
options.B: 为 EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 数据库启用自动扩展，以适应增加的使用量。
options.C: 将 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL，并使用更大的实例类型。
options.D: 将 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift，以适应增加的使用量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 将 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless v2。**

Aurora Serverless 专为**高度可变且不可预测的工作负载**而设计，包括具有定期促销活动的零售/电子商务网站。AWS 表示，对于会突然出现不可预测增长的可变工作负载，Aurora Serverless 会自动扩展容量以满足峰值负载，并在流量激增后自动缩减；你不需要为峰值或平均容量进行预置。它也具有成本效益，因为它避免了过度预置，并且你只需为所消耗的数据库资源付费，按秒计量（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。Aurora Serverless 扩展是自动、精细且不中断的，并且 AWS 指出 Aurora 会自动管理连接，而不需要更改应用程序连接字符串（[How Aurora serverless works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html)）。这直接符合不可预测的每月销售峰值以及对具有成本效益的性能的需求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 为 EC2 实例上的 PostgreSQL 数据库启用自动扩展** — Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 调整的是 Auto Scaling group 中的 **EC2 实例容量**，而不是在单个 EC2 实例上运行的自管理 PostgreSQL 数据库的容量（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）。这不会以同样的方式提供托管数据库容量扩展，也无法解决数据库连接/容量问题。
- **C. 迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL，并使用更大的实例类型** — 更大的预置 RDS 实例需要选择固定容量。AWS 将其与 Aurora Serverless 进行了对比：预置集群更适合稳定工作负载，而为可变使用量进行过度预置可能会导致更高成本（[How Aurora serverless works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html)）。对于不可预测的峰值，这种方式成本效益较低。
- **D. 迁移到 Amazon Redshift** — Amazon Redshift 是一种完全托管、PB 级的**数据仓库**，用于分析和 BI 查询，并不适合作为电子商务 OLTP 应用程序的事务型 PostgreSQL 数据库替代方案（[What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts an internal serverless application on AWS by using Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The company’s employees report issues with high latency when they begin using the application each day. The company wants to reduce latency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the API Gateway throttling limit.
options.B: Set up a scheduled scaling to increase Lambda provisioned concurrency before employees begin to use the application each day.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to initiate a Lambda function as a target for the alarm at the beginning of each day.
options.D: Increase the Lambda function memory.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The latency happens when employees first start using the application each day, which strongly indicates Lambda cold starts after a period of low or no activity. AWS explains that during a cold start Lambda prepares a new execution environment, downloads code, starts the environment, and runs initialization code, and that this **adds latency** to the invocation. AWS also states that **Provisioned Concurrency** is the recommended solution for predictable start times and lowest latency because it pre-initializes execution environments and reduces cold starts ([Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html)). For predictable traffic patterns, AWS Lambda documentation says you can use Application Auto Scaling to manage provisioned concurrency **on a schedule**, and specifically recommends scheduled scaling for predictable traffic patterns ([Configuring provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)). Therefore, scheduling increased provisioned concurrency before employees begin work directly addresses the daily startup latency.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Increase the API Gateway throttling limit** — API Gateway throttling settings are intended to prevent APIs/accounts from being overwhelmed by too many requests and are applied as rate/burst controls ([API Gateway request throttling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)). This does not pre-initialize Lambda execution environments or reduce cold-start latency.
- **C. Create a CloudWatch alarm to invoke a Lambda function each day** — Invoking the function on a schedule or from an alarm is not the documented recommended method for predictable low-latency Lambda starts. AWS recommends Provisioned Concurrency for predictable start times, and scheduled scaling of provisioned concurrency for predictable traffic patterns ([Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html), [Configuring provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)).
- **D. Increase the Lambda function memory** — Increasing memory might help a function that is CPU/memory constrained, but the stated pattern is latency at the beginning of each day. AWS documentation identifies cold starts as latency added when Lambda prepares a new environment and identifies Provisioned Concurrency—not memory increase—as the recommended solution for predictable start times and lowest latency ([Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 在 AWS 上托管一个内部无服务器应用程序。该公司的员工报告说，他们每天开始使用该应用程序时会遇到高延迟问题。公司希望降低延迟。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 提高 API Gateway 节流限制。
options.B: 设置计划扩展，在员工每天开始使用应用程序之前增加 Lambda 预置并发。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，在每天开始时将一个 Lambda 函数作为该警报的目标来启动。
options.D: 增加 Lambda 函数内存。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 当员工每天首次开始使用应用程序时发生延迟，这强烈表明 Lambda 在一段低活动或无活动期后发生了冷启动。AWS 解释说，在冷启动期间，Lambda 会准备新的执行环境、下载代码、启动环境并运行初始化代码，并且这会为调用**增加延迟**。AWS 还指出，**Provisioned Concurrency** 是实现可预测启动时间和最低延迟的推荐解决方案，因为它会预先初始化执行环境并减少冷启动（[Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html)）。对于可预测的流量模式，AWS Lambda 文档说明你可以使用 Application Auto Scaling **按计划**管理预置并发，并且明确建议对可预测的流量模式使用计划扩展（[Configuring provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。因此，在员工开始工作之前计划增加预置并发，可以直接解决每日启动延迟问题。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 提高 API Gateway 节流限制** — API Gateway 节流设置旨在防止 API/账户因过多请求而不堪重负，并作为速率/突发控制来应用（[API Gateway request throttling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-request-throttling.html)）。这不会预先初始化 Lambda 执行环境，也不会降低冷启动延迟。
- **C. 创建一个 CloudWatch 警报每天调用 Lambda 函数** — 按计划或通过警报调用函数，并不是文档中推荐的、用于实现可预测低延迟 Lambda 启动的方法。AWS 建议使用 Provisioned Concurrency 来实现可预测启动时间，并建议针对可预测流量模式使用预置并发的计划扩展（[Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html), [Configuring provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。
- **D. 增加 Lambda 函数内存** — 增加内存可能有助于 CPU/内存受限的函数，但题目描述的模式是每天开始时出现延迟。AWS 文档指出，冷启动是在 Lambda 准备新环境时增加的延迟，并将 Provisioned Concurrency（而不是增加内存）确定为实现可预测启动时间和最低延迟的推荐解决方案（[Lambda execution environment lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtime-environment.html)）。

en.question: A research company uses on-premises devices to generate data for analysis. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to analyze the data. The devices generate .csv files and support writing the data to an SMB file share. Company analysts must be able to use SQL commands to query the data. The analysts will run queries periodically throughout the day. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon S3 File Gateway mode.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway on premises in Amazon FSx File Gateway made.
options.C: Set up an AWS Glue crawler to create a table based on the data that is in Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an Amazon EMR cluster with EMR File System (EMRFS) to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.E: Set up an Amazon Redshift cluster to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.
options.F: Setup Amazon Athena to query the data that is in Amazon S3. Provide access to analysts.

en.explanation:
The best combination is **A, C, and F**.

- **A. Deploy S3 File Gateway**: The devices can write only to an SMB file share. Amazon S3 File Gateway supports storing and retrieving objects in Amazon S3 using standard file protocols including **SMB**, and is deployed into the on-premises environment. It also lets AWS services access the resulting data directly in S3, making it the right ingestion path for the CSV files. [AWS Storage Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)
- **C. Set up an AWS Glue crawler**: Athena needs table metadata/schema for querying data. AWS Glue crawlers discover dataset schemas, register them as tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog, can crawl an Amazon S3 data location, and the crawled tables can be queried from Athena. [Athena crawler docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/schema-crawlers.html)
- **F. Use Amazon Athena**: Athena is designed to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. It is serverless, requires no infrastructure to manage, and charges only for queries run, which fits periodic queries throughout the day and is more cost-effective than maintaining analytics clusters. [Athena docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. FSx File Gateway** is for low-latency access from on premises to **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** file shares, and requires an FSx for Windows File Server file system. The target architecture needs data in S3 for Athena analysis, not FSx. [FSx File Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)
- **D. Amazon EMR with EMRFS** can process data in S3, but EMR is a managed cluster platform for big data frameworks such as Hadoop and Spark. Maintaining an EMR cluster for periodic SQL queries is not the most cost-effective fit compared with serverless Athena. [Amazon EMR docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)
- **E. Amazon Redshift cluster** provides SQL analytics, but a provisioned Redshift cluster introduces data warehouse cluster infrastructure. For directly querying CSV data in S3 periodically, Athena’s serverless, pay-per-query model is the more cost-effective choice. [Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/working-with-clusters.html)

zh.question: 一家研究公司使用本地设备生成用于分析的数据。该公司希望使用 AWS Cloud 来分析这些数据。这些设备会生成 .csv 文件，并支持将数据写入 SMB 文件共享。公司分析师必须能够使用 SQL 命令查询数据。分析师将在一天中定期运行查询。哪组步骤的组合能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在本地以 Amazon S3 File Gateway 模式部署 AWS Storage Gateway。
options.B: 在本地以 Amazon FSx File Gateway made 部署 AWS Storage Gateway。
options.C: 设置 AWS Glue 爬网程序，以基于 Amazon S3 中的数据创建表。
options.D: 设置包含 EMR File System (EMRFS) 的 Amazon EMR 集群，以查询 Amazon S3 中的数据。向分析师提供访问权限。
options.E: 设置 Amazon Redshift 集群，以查询 Amazon S3 中的数据。向分析师提供访问权限。
options.F: 设置 Amazon Athena，以查询 Amazon S3 中的数据。向分析师提供访问权限。

zh.explanation:
最佳组合是 **A、C 和 F**。

- **A. 部署 S3 File Gateway**：这些设备只能写入 SMB 文件共享。Amazon S3 File Gateway 支持使用包括 **SMB** 在内的标准文件协议在 Amazon S3 中存储和检索对象，并部署在本地环境中。它还允许 AWS 服务直接访问 S3 中生成的数据，因此是 CSV 文件的正确摄取路径。[AWS Storage Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)
- **C. 设置 AWS Glue 爬网程序**：Athena 需要表元数据/架构来查询数据。AWS Glue 爬网程序可发现数据集架构，将其作为表注册到 AWS Glue Data Catalog，可以爬取 Amazon S3 数据位置，并且爬取到的表可以从 Athena 查询。[Athena crawler docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/schema-crawlers.html)
- **F. 使用 Amazon Athena**：Athena 旨在使用标准 SQL 直接分析 Amazon S3 中的数据。它是无服务器的，无需管理基础设施，并且仅对运行的查询收费，这适合一天中定期执行的查询，并且比维护分析集群更具成本效益。[Athena docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. FSx File Gateway** 用于从本地对 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 文件共享进行低延迟访问，并且需要 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。目标架构需要数据位于 S3 中以便进行 Athena 分析，而不是位于 FSx 中。[FSx File Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)
- **D. 带有 EMRFS 的 Amazon EMR** 可以处理 S3 中的数据，但 EMR 是用于 Hadoop 和 Spark 等大数据框架的托管集群平台。与无服务器 Athena 相比，为定期 SQL 查询维护 EMR 集群并不是最具成本效益的选择。[Amazon EMR docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)
- **E. Amazon Redshift 集群** 提供 SQL 分析，但预置的 Redshift 集群会引入数据仓库集群基础设施。对于定期直接查询 S3 中的 CSV 数据，Athena 的无服务器、按查询付费模型是更具成本效益的选择。[Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/working-with-clusters.html)

en.question: A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) clusters and Amazon RDS DB instances to build and run a payment processing application. The company will run the application in its on-premises data center for compliance purposes. A solutions architect wants to use AWS Outposts as part of the solution. The solutions architect is working with the company's operational team to build the application. Which activities are the responsibility of the company's operational team? (Choose three.)

options.A: Providing resilient power and network connectivity to the Outposts racks
options.B: Managing the virtualization hypervisor, storage systems, and the AWS services that run on Outposts
options.C: Physical security and access controls of the data center environment
options.D: Availability of the Outposts infrastructure including the power supplies, servers, and networking equipment within the Outposts racks
options.E: Physical maintenance of Outposts components
options.F: Providing extra capacity for Amazon ECS clusters to mitigate server failures and maintenance events

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **A, C, and F**.

- **A. Providing resilient power and network connectivity** — The customer site must provide the required power and networking for the rack. AWS also recommends dual power sources and redundant network connectivity for resilience, and the maintenance guidance states that the facility must meet the minimum power and network requirements because an Outposts rack operates correctly only when power and network connectivity are uninterrupted ([Resilience in AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html), [Outposts rack maintenance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outpost-maintenance.html)).
- **C. Physical security and access controls of the data center environment** — An Outpost site is the **customer-managed physical building** where AWS installs the Outpost, and the site must meet facility requirements ([What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html), [Site requirements for Outposts racks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outposts-requirements.html)). Because it is the customer's facility, the customer's operational team is responsible for physical security and access controls for that environment.
- **F. Providing extra capacity for ECS clusters to mitigate failures and maintenance events** — Outpost capacity is finite and must be planned. AWS recommends allocating sufficient additional capacity for mission-critical applications to support recovery and failover if an underlying host issue occurs. During hardware maintenance, if there is no additional Outpost capacity, affected instances can remain stopped; the Outpost owner can free capacity or request more capacity ([Resilience in AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html), [Outposts rack maintenance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outpost-maintenance.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B** is wrong because AWS Outposts is a **fully managed service** that extends AWS managed infrastructure to customer premises, and Outpost equipment is owned and managed by AWS ([AWS Outposts API Reference Welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html), [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html)).
- **D** is wrong because the power supplies, servers, switches, and rack elements are part of the Outpost equipment, which AWS owns and manages ([What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html)).
- **E** is wrong because AWS performs physical maintenance: when hardware maintenance is required, the AWS installation team visits the site and replaces unhealthy hosts, switches, or rack elements ([Outposts rack maintenance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outpost-maintenance.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群和 Amazon RDS DB 实例来构建并运行一个支付处理应用程序。出于合规目的，该公司将在其本地数据中心运行该应用程序。解决方案架构师希望将 AWS Outposts 作为解决方案的一部分。解决方案架构师正在与公司的运营团队合作构建该应用程序。哪些活动是公司运营团队的责任？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为 Outposts 机架提供具备弹性的电力和网络连接
options.B: 管理虚拟化虚拟机监控程序、存储系统以及在 Outposts 上运行的 AWS 服务
options.C: 数据中心环境的物理安全和访问控制
options.D: Outposts 基础设施的可用性，包括 Outposts 机架内的电源、服务器和网络设备
options.E: Outposts 组件的物理维护
options.F: 为 Amazon ECS 集群提供额外容量，以缓解服务器故障和维护事件的影响

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A, C, and F**。

- **A. Providing resilient power and network connectivity** — 客户站点必须为机架提供所需的电力和网络。AWS 还建议使用双电源和冗余网络连接以实现弹性，并且维护指南说明设施必须满足最低电力和网络要求，因为 Outposts 机架只有在电力和网络连接不中断时才能正常运行（[Resilience in AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html), [Outposts rack maintenance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outpost-maintenance.html)）。
- **C. Physical security and access controls of the data center environment** — Outpost 站点是 AWS 安装 Outpost 的 **customer-managed physical building**，并且该站点必须满足设施要求（[What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html), [Site requirements for Outposts racks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outposts-requirements.html)）。由于它是客户的设施，客户的运营团队负责该环境的物理安全和访问控制。
- **F. Providing extra capacity for ECS clusters to mitigate failures and maintenance events** — Outpost 容量是有限的，必须进行规划。AWS 建议为关键任务应用程序分配足够的额外容量，以便在底层主机出现问题时支持恢复和故障转移。在硬件维护期间，如果没有额外的 Outpost 容量，受影响的实例可能会保持停止状态；Outpost 所有者可以释放容量或请求更多容量（[Resilience in AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html), [Outposts rack maintenance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outpost-maintenance.html)）。错误选项：

- **B** 错误，因为 AWS Outposts 是一种 **fully managed service**，可将 AWS 托管基础设施扩展到客户场所，并且 Outpost 设备由 AWS 拥有和管理（[AWS Outposts API Reference Welcome](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/APIReference/Welcome.html), [What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html)）。
- **D** 错误，因为电源、服务器、交换机和机架元件都是 Outpost 设备的一部分，由 AWS 拥有和管理（[What is AWS Outposts?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/server-userguide/what-is-outposts.html)）。
- **E** 错误，因为 AWS 执行物理维护：当需要硬件维护时，AWS 安装团队会访问该站点并更换不健康的主机、交换机或机架元件（[Outposts rack maintenance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/outpost-maintenance.html)）。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate a TCP-based application into the company's VPC. The application is publicly accessible on a nonstandard TCP port through a hardware appliance in the company's data center. This public endpoint can process up to 3 million requests per second with low latency. The company requires the same level of performance for the new public endpoint in AWS. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?

options.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Configure the ALB to be publicly accessible over the TCP port that the application requires.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that listens on the TCP port that the application requires. Use an Application Load Balancer as the origin.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon API Gateway API that is configured with the TCP port that the application requires. Configure AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency to process the requests.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**. The application is TCP-based, public, uses a nonstandard TCP port, and must sustain millions of requests per second with low latency. AWS documentation states that a Network Load Balancer operates at OSI layer 4, supports target groups using TCP, and “can handle millions of requests per second” while forwarding using the configured protocol and port ([Network Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)). It can also be created as **internet-facing**, which “routes requests from clients to targets over the internet” ([Create a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/create-network-load-balancer.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. Application Load Balancer**: ALB is layer 7; its listeners support **HTTP and HTTPS** protocols, not arbitrary TCP application traffic ([ALB listener configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
- **C. CloudFront with ALB origin**: CloudFront is for HTTP/S content delivery. AWS describes CloudFront viewer/origin communication in terms of HTTPS and custom origins such as HTTP/S servers, not arbitrary TCP listeners on custom ports ([Use HTTPS with CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https.html)).
- **D. API Gateway with Lambda**: API Gateway REST APIs and HTTP APIs are RESTful/HTTP API products, not a service for exposing arbitrary TCP applications on a custom TCP port ([Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个基于 TCP 的应用程序迁移到公司的 VPC 中。该应用程序目前通过公司数据中心中的一个硬件设备，在一个非标准 TCP 端口上对外公开访问。这个公共端点可以以低延迟每秒处理多达 300 万个请求。公司要求 AWS 中新的公共端点具备相同级别的性能。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足此要求？

options.A: 部署 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。将 NLB 配置为可通过应用程序所需的 TCP 端口公开访问。
options.B: 部署 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 ALB 配置为可通过应用程序所需的 TCP 端口公开访问。
options.C: 部署一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，使其侦听应用程序所需的 TCP 端口。使用 Application Load Balancer 作为源站。
options.D: 部署一个 Amazon API Gateway API，并将其配置为使用应用程序所需的 TCP 端口。配置具有预置并发的 AWS Lambda 函数来处理请求。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。该应用程序基于 TCP、面向公网、使用非标准 TCP 端口，并且必须以低延迟支撑每秒数百万个请求。AWS 文档说明，Network Load Balancer 在 OSI 第 4 层运行，支持使用 TCP 的目标组，并且“can handle millions of requests per second”，同时使用配置的协议和端口进行转发（[Network Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。它还可以创建为 **internet-facing**，即“routes requests from clients to targets over the internet”（[Create a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/create-network-load-balancer.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. Application Load Balancer**：ALB 是第 7 层；其侦听器支持 **HTTP and HTTPS** 协议，而不是任意 TCP 应用程序流量（[ALB listener configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
- **C. CloudFront with ALB origin**：CloudFront 用于 HTTP/S 内容分发。AWS 在描述 CloudFront 查看器/源站通信时使用的是 HTTPS 以及 HTTP/S 服务器等自定义源站，而不是自定义端口上的任意 TCP 侦听器（[Use HTTPS with CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-https.html)）。
- **D. API Gateway with Lambda**：API Gateway REST APIs 和 HTTP APIs 是 RESTful/HTTP API 产品，并不是用于在自定义 TCP 端口上公开任意 TCP 应用程序的服务（[Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)）。

en.question: A company runs its critical database on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The company wants to migrate to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL with minimal downtime and data loss. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a DB snapshot of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance to populate a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.B: Create an Aurora read replica of the RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Promote the Aurora read replicate to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.C: Use data import from Amazon S3 to migrate the database to an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.D: Use the pg_dump utility to back up the RDS for PostgreSQL database. Restore the backup to a new Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Creating an **Aurora read replica** of the existing RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance is the best fit for **minimal downtime and data loss with the least operational overhead**. AWS documents this exact migration path: create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica of the RDS for PostgreSQL source, let replication catch up, and when replica lag is **zero**, stop writes/replication and promote the replica to a standalone Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster for reads and writes ([AWS Aurora migration options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.html), [Aurora read replica migration procedure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.RDSPostgreSQL.Replica.html)). The promotion process makes the replica cluster a standalone Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster with a writer instance containing the source data ([promoting an Aurora read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.RDSPostgreSQL.Replica.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Snapshot migration** can migrate data from an RDS for PostgreSQL snapshot to Aurora PostgreSQL, but it is a point-in-time copy. It does not continuously replicate ongoing changes while the new cluster is being created, so it generally requires more cutover downtime or risks missing changes after the snapshot ([AWS Aurora migration options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.html)).
- **C. Import from Amazon S3** is for importing data from S3 into Aurora PostgreSQL tables. The source database is running on RDS, so this would require additional export/staging/import steps and more operational overhead than managed replication ([AWS Aurora migration options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.html)).
- **D. pg_dump and restore** is a manual logical backup/restore approach. It requires dumping, transferring, and restoring data, and it does not inherently keep the target synchronized with ongoing source changes, resulting in more overhead and more downtime than an Aurora read replica migration.

Therefore, **B** is the best solution.

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB 实例上运行其关键数据库。该公司希望迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL，并尽可能减少停机时间和数据丢失。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 RDS for PostgreSQL DB 实例的 DB 快照，以填充新的 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群。
options.B: 创建 RDS for PostgreSQL DB 实例的 Aurora 只读副本。将 Aurora 只读副本提升为新的 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群。
options.C: 使用从 Amazon S3 导入数据的方式将数据库迁移到 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群。
options.D: 使用 pg_dump 实用程序备份 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库。将备份还原到新的 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

为现有 RDS for PostgreSQL DB 实例创建 **Aurora 只读副本**，最符合以**最少运营开销实现最少停机时间和数据丢失**的要求。AWS 文档记录了这条确切的迁移路径：为 RDS for PostgreSQL 源创建 Aurora PostgreSQL 只读副本，让复制追上进度，并在副本延迟为 **zero** 时，停止写入/复制，并将该副本提升为独立的 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群，以用于读取和写入（[AWS Aurora migration options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.html)，[Aurora read replica migration procedure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.RDSPostgreSQL.Replica.html)）。提升过程会使该副本集群成为一个独立的 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群，其中包含带有源数据的写入器实例（[promoting an Aurora read replica](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.RDSPostgreSQL.Replica.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 快照迁移** 可以将数据从 RDS for PostgreSQL 快照迁移到 Aurora PostgreSQL，但它是一个时间点副本。在新集群创建期间，它不会持续复制正在发生的变更，因此通常需要更多切换停机时间，或者存在遗漏快照之后变更的风险（[AWS Aurora migration options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.html)）。
- **C. 从 Amazon S3 导入** 用于将 S3 中的数据导入 Aurora PostgreSQL 表。源数据库运行在 RDS 上，因此这需要额外的导出/暂存/导入步骤，并且比托管复制带来更多运营开销（[AWS Aurora migration options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/AuroraPostgreSQL.Migrating.html)）。
- **D. pg_dump 和还原** 是一种手动逻辑备份/还原方法。它需要转储、传输和还原数据，并且本身不会使目标与源端持续发生的变更保持同步，因此相比 Aurora 只读副本迁移，会导致更多开销和更多停机时间。因此，**B** 是最佳解决方案。

en.question: A company's infrastructure consists of hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. A solutions architect must ensure that every EC2 instance can be recovered after a disaster. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of effort?

options.A: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Create an AWS CloudFormation template to launch new EC2 instances from the EBS storage.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to set the environment based on the EC2 template and attach the EBS storage.
options.C: Use AWS Backup to set up a backup plan for the entire group of EC2 instances. Use the AWS Backup API or the AWS CLI to speed up the restore process for multiple EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function to take a snapshot of the EBS storage that is attached to each EC2 instance and copy the Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). Create another Lambda function to perform the restores with the copied AMIs and attach the EBS storage.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Backup is the managed service designed for this scenario. It supports backing up and restoring **Amazon EC2 instances backed by Amazon EBS volumes** and Amazon EBS volumes. It also provides centralized backup management through a console, APIs, and the AWS CLI, and lets you create policy-based **backup plans** that can be applied to resources at scale, including by tags/groups. This is the least-effort approach for hundreds of instances because one backup plan can protect the fleet instead of manually snapshotting each instance/volume. AWS Backup can restore an **entire EC2 instance from a single recovery point**, including root volume, data volumes, and some instance configuration settings, and the CLI `start-restore-job` restore workflow supports EC2 recovery point metadata for automated restores. See [What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html), [Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html), and [Restore an Amazon EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-ec2.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Taking individual EBS snapshots and building CloudFormation templates for hundreds of instances is operationally heavy. It also focuses on EBS storage, whereas AWS Backup can restore the whole EC2 instance from a recovery point, including volumes and selected instance settings.
- **B:** Elastic Beanstalk is not a disaster recovery/backup orchestration service for restoring fleets of existing EC2 instances with EBS volumes. AWS Backup specifically provides backup plans and restore capabilities for EC2/EBS resources.
- **D:** Custom Lambda automation to snapshot volumes, copy AMIs, and restore instances is unnecessary undifferentiated work. AWS Backup already provides centralized backup policies, APIs/CLI management, and EC2 restore capabilities, so it meets the requirement with less effort.

zh.question: 一家公司的基础设施由数百个使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储的 Amazon EC2 实例组成。解决方案架构师必须确保每个 EC2 实例在灾难发生后都可以恢复。解决方案架构师应如何以最少的工作量满足此要求？

options.A: 为附加到每个 EC2 实例的 EBS 存储创建快照。创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，以从 EBS 存储启动新的 EC2 实例。
options.B: 为附加到每个 EC2 实例的 EBS 存储创建快照。使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 基于 EC2 模板设置环境，并附加 EBS 存储。
options.C: 使用 AWS Backup 为整组 EC2 实例设置备份计划。使用 AWS Backup API 或 AWS CLI 加快多个 EC2 实例的还原过程。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，为附加到每个 EC2 实例的 EBS 存储创建快照，并复制 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)。创建另一个 Lambda 函数，使用复制的 AMIs 执行还原并附加 EBS 存储。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Backup 是为此场景设计的托管服务。它支持备份和还原**由 Amazon EBS 卷支持的 Amazon EC2 实例**以及 Amazon EBS 卷。它还通过控制台、API 和 AWS CLI 提供集中式备份管理，并允许你创建基于策略的**备份计划**，这些计划可以大规模应用于资源，包括通过标签/组应用。对于数百个实例来说，这是工作量最少的方法，因为一个备份计划就可以保护整个实例队列，而不需要手动为每个实例/卷创建快照。AWS Backup 可以从单个恢复点还原**整个 EC2 实例**，包括根卷、数据卷以及某些实例配置设置，并且 CLI `start-restore-job` 还原工作流支持用于自动还原的 EC2 恢复点元数据。请参阅 [What is AWS Backup?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)、[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html) 和 [Restore an Amazon EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-ec2.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 为数百个实例创建单独的 EBS 快照并构建 CloudFormation 模板在运维上非常繁重。它还侧重于 EBS 存储，而 AWS Backup 可以从恢复点还原整个 EC2 实例，包括卷和选定的实例设置。
- **B:** Elastic Beanstalk 不是用于还原带有 EBS 卷的现有 EC2 实例队列的灾难恢复/备份编排服务。AWS Backup 专门为 EC2/EBS 资源提供备份计划和还原功能。
- **D:** 自定义 Lambda 自动化来创建卷快照、复制 AMIs 并还原实例，是不必要的无差异化工作。AWS Backup 已经提供集中式备份策略、APIs/CLI 管理和 EC2 还原功能，因此可以用更少的工作量满足要求。

en.question: A company recently migrated to the AWS Cloud. The company wants a serverless solution for large-scale parallel on-demand processing of a semistructured dataset. The data consists of logs, media files, sales transactions, and IoT sensor data that is stored in Amazon S3. The company wants the solution to process thousands of items in the dataset in parallel. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Inline mode to process the data in parallel.
options.B: Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Distributed mode to process the data in parallel.
options.C: Use AWS Glue to process the data in parallel.
options.D: Use several AWS Lambda functions to process the data in parallel.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B. Use the AWS Step Functions Map state in Distributed mode.**

AWS Step Functions Distributed Map is designed for this exact pattern: AWS states that it can orchestrate **large-scale parallel workloads** for tasks such as **on-demand processing of semi-structured data**, concurrently processing large data sources stored in **Amazon S3**, including a large set of S3 objects. In Distributed mode, the Map state processes items as child workflow executions and, if not otherwise configured, can run **10,000 parallel child workflow executions**. This meets the requirement to process thousands of S3 dataset items in parallel with high operational efficiency because Step Functions handles the orchestration and scaling of the parallel workflow ([Using Map state in Distributed mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map-distributed.html)).

Why the other options are not the best:

- **A. Inline Map mode** is not appropriate for large-scale parallel processing. AWS documentation says Inline mode accepts only a JSON array as input and supports only **up to 40 concurrent iterations**. Distributed mode is recommended when you need more than 40 concurrent iterations, have large datasets, or need to avoid event-history limits ([Map state processing modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map.html)).
- **C. AWS Glue** can process data, but the question asks for on-demand processing of thousands of heterogeneous S3 items with the most operationally efficient serverless parallel orchestration. The AWS Step Functions documentation specifically identifies Distributed Map for on-demand semi-structured data processing from S3 and high-concurrency child workflows, making it the closer fit ([Using Map state in Distributed mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map-distributed.html)).
- **D. Several Lambda functions** could process items, but using separate Lambda functions directly would require custom coordination, batching, concurrency control, tracking, and error handling. Distributed Map provides the managed orchestration model and monitoring for large-scale parallel item processing, including Map Runs and CloudWatch metrics ([Map state processing modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近迁移到了 AWS Cloud。该公司希望为大规模并行按需处理半结构化数据集提供一种无服务器解决方案。数据包括日志、媒体文件、销售交易和 IoT 传感器数据，这些数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。该公司希望该解决方案能够并行处理数据集中的数千个项目。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Inline mode 的 AWS Step Functions Map state 并行处理数据。
options.B: 使用 Distributed mode 的 AWS Step Functions Map state 并行处理数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Glue 并行处理数据。
options.D: 使用多个 AWS Lambda functions 并行处理数据。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B. 使用 Distributed mode 的 AWS Step Functions Map state。**

AWS Step Functions Distributed Map 正是为这种模式而设计的：AWS 表示，它可以为诸如**按需处理半结构化数据**之类的任务编排**大规模并行工作负载**，并发处理存储在 **Amazon S3** 中的大型数据源，包括大量 S3 对象。在 Distributed mode 中，Map state 会将项目作为子工作流执行来处理；如果未另行配置，则可以运行 **10,000 个并行子工作流执行**。这满足了并行处理数千个 S3 数据集项目的要求，并且具有较高的运营效率，因为 Step Functions 会处理并行工作流的编排和扩展（[Using Map state in Distributed mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map-distributed.html)）。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A. Inline Map mode** 不适合大规模并行处理。AWS 文档说明，Inline mode 仅接受 JSON array 作为输入，并且仅支持**最多 40 个并发迭代**。当你需要超过 40 个并发迭代、拥有大型数据集，或需要避免事件历史记录限制时，建议使用 Distributed mode（[Map state processing modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map.html)）。
- **C. AWS Glue** 可以处理数据，但该问题要求以最高运营效率对数千个异构 S3 项目进行按需无服务器并行编排。AWS Step Functions 文档明确指出 Distributed Map 适用于从 S3 按需处理半结构化数据以及高并发子工作流，因此它更契合需求（[Using Map state in Distributed mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map-distributed.html)）。
- **D. Several Lambda functions** 可以处理项目，但直接使用多个单独的 Lambda functions 将需要自定义协调、批处理、并发控制、跟踪和错误处理。Distributed Map 为大规模并行项目处理提供托管编排模型和监控，包括 Map Runs 和 CloudWatch metrics（[Map state processing modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/state-map.html)）。

en.question: A company will migrate 10 PB of data to Amazon S3 in 6 weeks. The current data center has a 500 Mbps uplink to the internet. Other on-premises applications share the uplink. The company can use 80% of the internet bandwidth for this one-time migration task. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon S3 and to automatically verify the data.
options.B: Use rsync to transfer the data directly to Amazon S3.
options.C: Use the AWS CLI and multiple copy processes to send the data directly to Amazon S3.
options.D: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices. Copy the data to the devices. Send the devices to AWS to copy the data to Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The effective bandwidth available for the migration is only 80% of 500 Mbps = **400 Mbps**. Moving 10 PB over that link would take years, not 6 weeks, even before considering protocol overhead or the fact that other applications share the uplink. AWS Snowball Edge is designed for this type of offline bulk transfer: AWS states that Snowball Edge can transfer “hundreds of terabytes or petabytes of data” between on-premises data centers and Amazon S3, and that it transfers large amounts of data between S3 and onsite storage at “faster-than-internet speeds” through import jobs to S3 ([Snow Family getting started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snow/latest/swsbe-pack/getting-started.html), [Upload large amounts of data with Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)). Because a storage-optimized Snowball Edge device provides **210 TB usable** capacity, multiple devices can be ordered in parallel to meet a 10 PB migration window ([Snowball Edge device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. DataSync** can migrate data to AWS storage and includes integrity validation, but it is still a **network** transfer service; AWS describes DataSync as transferring datasets “over the network” and requiring network connectivity between the on-premises environment and AWS ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [Connecting your network for AWS DataSync transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)). The 400 Mbps usable uplink cannot move 10 PB within 6 weeks.
- **B. rsync directly to S3** is not appropriate for this petabyte-scale deadline and is constrained by the same insufficient internet uplink.
- **C. AWS CLI with multiple copy processes** can parallelize uploads, but it cannot exceed the available 400 Mbps uplink; it still would not meet the 6-week requirement.

Therefore, the only solution that meets the time and scale requirements is to use **multiple AWS Snowball devices** and import the data to Amazon S3.

zh.question: 一家公司将在 6 周内将 10 PB 数据迁移到 Amazon S3。当前数据中心有一条 500 Mbps 的互联网上行链路。其他本地应用程序也共享该上行链路。该公司可以将 80% 的互联网带宽用于这项一次性迁移任务。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS DataSync 将数据迁移到 Amazon S3，并自动验证数据。
options.B: 使用 rsync 将数据直接传输到 Amazon S3。
options.C: 使用 AWS CLI 和多个复制进程将数据直接发送到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 订购多个 AWS Snowball 设备。将数据复制到这些设备。将设备发送给 AWS，以便将数据复制到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 可用于迁移的有效带宽仅为 500 Mbps 的 80% = **400 Mbps**。通过该链路移动 10 PB 数据将需要数年，而不是 6 周，这还未考虑协议开销或其他应用程序共享上行链路这一事实。AWS Snowball Edge 专为这种离线批量传输类型而设计：AWS 表示，Snowball Edge 可以在本地数据中心和 Amazon S3 之间传输“数百 TB 或 PB 级数据”，并且通过导入作业到 S3，以“快于互联网的速度”在 S3 和现场存储之间传输大量数据（[Snow Family getting started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snow/latest/swsbe-pack/getting-started.html)，[Upload large amounts of data with Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)）。由于存储优化型 Snowball Edge 设备提供 **210 TB usable** 容量，因此可以并行订购多个设备以满足 10 PB 迁移窗口（[Snowball Edge device configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. DataSync** 可以将数据迁移到 AWS 存储并包含完整性验证，但它仍然是一个**网络**传输服务；AWS 将 DataSync 描述为“通过网络”传输数据集，并且需要本地环境与 AWS 之间具有网络连接（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)，[Connecting your network for AWS DataSync transfers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/networking-datasync.html)）。400 Mbps 的可用上行链路无法在 6 周内移动 10 PB。
- **B. rsync directly to S3** 不适合这个 PB 级规模的期限，并且同样受到不足的互联网上行链路限制。
- **C. AWS CLI with multiple copy processes** 可以并行化上传，但无法超过可用的 400 Mbps 上行链路；它仍然无法满足 6 周要求。因此，唯一满足时间和规模要求的解决方案是使用**多个 AWS Snowball 设备**并将数据导入 Amazon S3。

en.question: A company has several on-premises Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (ISCSI) network storage servers. The company wants to reduce the number of these servers by moving to the AWS Cloud. A solutions architect must provide low-latency access to frequently used data and reduce the dependency on on-premises servers with a minimal number of infrastructure changes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an Amazon S3 File Gateway.
options.B: Deploy Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage with backups to Amazon S3.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with stored volumes.
options.D: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with cached volumes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway that is configured with cached volumes.**

Volume Gateway is the right service because it provides cloud-backed storage volumes that on-premises application servers can mount as **iSCSI devices**. In the cached-volumes configuration, AWS says data is stored in **Amazon S3** while a local copy of frequently accessed data subsets is retained, which “minimize[s] the need to scale your storage on-premises” and retains “low-latency access to your frequently accessed data” ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). This matches the requirement to reduce on-premises iSCSI storage servers with minimal infrastructure changes while keeping low latency for hot data.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon S3 File Gateway** is not the best fit because it provides a **file interface** to S3 using NFS and SMB protocols, not iSCSI block volumes ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). The existing environment is iSCSI block storage.
- **B. Amazon EBS with backups to S3** does not directly replace on-premises iSCSI storage with minimal changes. EBS is persistent block storage for **Amazon EC2 instances**, not an on-premises iSCSI target replacement ([Amazon EBS persistent block storage for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)).
- **C. Volume Gateway with stored volumes** supports iSCSI, but stored volumes keep **all** data locally and only back up snapshots to S3. AWS recommends stored volumes when low-latency access is needed to the **entire dataset**, which does not reduce on-premises storage dependency as much as cached volumes ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司拥有多个本地 Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (ISCSI) 网络存储服务器。该公司希望通过迁移到 AWS Cloud 来减少这些服务器的数量。解决方案架构师必须提供对频繁使用数据的低延迟访问，并以最少的基础设施变更减少对本地服务器的依赖。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署 Amazon S3 File Gateway。
options.B: 部署 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储，并备份到 Amazon S3。
options.C: 部署配置了存储卷的 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。
options.D: 部署配置了缓存卷的 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 部署配置了缓存卷的 AWS Storage Gateway 卷网关。**

Volume Gateway 是正确的服务，因为它提供由云支持的存储卷，本地应用程序服务器可以将其挂载为 **iSCSI 设备**。在缓存卷配置中，AWS 表示数据存储在 **Amazon S3** 中，同时会保留频繁访问的数据子集的本地副本，这可以“minimize[s] the need to scale your storage on-premises”，并保留“low-latency access to your frequently accessed data” ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html))。这符合以最少的基础设施变更减少本地 iSCSI 存储服务器，同时保持热数据低延迟访问的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon S3 File Gateway** 不是最合适的选择，因为它使用 NFS 和 SMB 协议提供到 S3 的**文件接口**，而不是 iSCSI 块卷 ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html))。现有环境是 iSCSI 块存储。
- **B. Amazon EBS with backups to S3** 不能以最少的变更直接替换本地 iSCSI 存储。EBS 是用于 **Amazon EC2 instances** 的持久性块存储，而不是本地 iSCSI 目标的替代品 ([Amazon EBS persistent block storage for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html))。
- **C. Volume Gateway with stored volumes** 支持 iSCSI，但存储卷会将**所有**数据保留在本地，并且只将快照备份到 S3。AWS 建议在需要对**整个数据集**进行低延迟访问时使用存储卷，这并不像缓存卷那样减少对本地存储的依赖 ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html))。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing an application that will allow business users to upload objects to Amazon S3. The solution needs to maximize object durability. Objects also must be readily available at any time and for any length of time. Users will access objects frequently within the first 30 days after the objects are uploaded, but users are much less likely to access objects that are older than 30 days. Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 30 days.
options.B: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
options.C: Store all the objects in S3 Standard with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
options.D: Store all the objects in S3 Intelligent-Tiering with an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Store new uploads in **S3 Standard** for the first 30 days because they are accessed frequently and need millisecond access. After 30 days, transition them with an S3 Lifecycle rule to **S3 Standard-IA**, which AWS describes as suitable for “older data that is accessed infrequently, but that still requires millisecond access,” including the pattern of uploading to S3 Standard and then using lifecycle configuration to transition to S3 Standard-IA or S3 One Zone-IA. S3 Standard-IA is designed for 99.999999999% durability, 99.9% availability, and storage across **3 or more Availability Zones**, and AWS recommends S3 Standard-IA for the “primary or only copy of data that can't be re-created.” This best satisfies durability, readiness, and cost-effectiveness after access drops beyond 30 days. [AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is for archives and is **not available for real-time access**; objects must be restored before access. That violates the requirement that objects be readily available at any time. [AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)
- **C:** S3 One Zone-IA is less expensive, but it stores data in only **one Availability Zone** and is **not resilient to the physical loss of the Availability Zone**. AWS recommends it when data can be re-created, not for the primary/only copy when maximizing resiliency is required. [AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)
- **D:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering is intended for **unknown, changing, or unpredictable** access patterns and has monitoring/automation fees. Here the access pattern is known: frequent for 30 days, then infrequent. Also, the proposed lifecycle transition from Intelligent-Tiering to Standard-IA adds unnecessary complexity and cost compared with directly using S3 Standard then S3 Standard-IA. [AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在设计一个应用程序，该应用程序将允许业务用户将对象上传到 Amazon S3。该解决方案需要最大限度地提高对象持久性。对象还必须在任何时间、任意时长内都能随时可用。用户在对象上传后的前 30 天内会频繁访问对象，但用户访问超过 30 天的对象的可能性要低得多。哪种解决方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有对象存储在 S3 Standard 中，并使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则在 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier。
options.B: 将所有对象存储在 S3 Standard 中，并使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则在 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。
options.C: 将所有对象存储在 S3 Standard 中，并使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则在 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。
options.D: 将所有对象存储在 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中，并使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则在 30 天后将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

在前 30 天将新上传的对象存储在 **S3 Standard** 中，因为它们会被频繁访问并且需要毫秒级访问。30 天后，使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则将它们转换到 **S3 Standard-IA**，AWS 将其描述为适用于“较旧且不频繁访问、但仍需要毫秒级访问的数据”，包括先上传到 S3 Standard，然后使用生命周期配置转换到 S3 Standard-IA 或 S3 One Zone-IA 的模式。S3 Standard-IA 旨在提供 99.999999999% 的持久性、99.9% 的可用性，并跨 **3 个或更多 Availability Zones** 存储；AWS 建议将 S3 Standard-IA 用于“无法重新创建的数据的主副本或唯一副本”。这最能满足在 30 天后访问频率下降时对持久性、随时可用性和成本效益的要求。[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 用于归档，并且**不能用于实时访问**；必须先还原对象才能访问。这违反了对象必须在任何时间随时可用的要求。[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)
- **C:** S3 One Zone-IA 成本较低，但它仅将数据存储在**一个 Availability Zone** 中，并且**无法抵御该 Availability Zone 的物理丢失**。AWS 建议在数据可以重新创建时使用它，而不是在需要最大化弹性时用于主副本/唯一副本。[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)
- **D:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering 适用于**未知、变化或不可预测**的访问模式，并且会产生监控/自动化费用。这里的访问模式是已知的：前 30 天频繁访问，之后不频繁访问。此外，与直接使用 S3 Standard 然后转换到 S3 Standard-IA 相比，所提出的从 Intelligent-Tiering 到 Standard-IA 的生命周期转换增加了不必要的复杂性和成本。[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)

en.question: A company has migrated a two-tier application from its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. The data tier is a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for Oracle with 12 TB of General Purpose SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage. The application is designed to process and store documents in the database as binary large objects (blobs) with an average document size of 6 MB. The database size has grown over time, reducing the performance and increasing the cost of storage. The company must improve the database performance and needs a solution that is highly available and resilient. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Reduce the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiB. Change the storage type to Magnetic.
options.B: Increase the RDS DB instance size. Increase the storage capacity to 24 TiChange the storage type to Provisioned IOPS.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the application to store documents in the S3 bucket. Store the object metadata in the existing database.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Update the application to use DynamoDB. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate data from the Oracle database to DynamoDB.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Storing large documents as database BLOBs makes the RDS database larger, which can increase storage cost and reduce database performance. Amazon S3 is purpose-built object storage: S3 Standard is designed for frequently accessed data with millisecond access, stores data across **at least 3 Availability Zones**, and provides **99.999999999% durability** and **99.99% availability**. AWS also states that S3 Standard and several other S3 classes are designed to sustain the loss of an entire Availability Zone ([S3 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/DataDurability.html), [S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). Therefore, moving the 6 MB documents to S3 and keeping only object metadata/pointers in the Oracle database reduces database size and I/O load while keeping a highly available and resilient storage layer.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Reducing the DB instance size would likely worsen performance. Also, RDS magnetic storage is legacy/not recommended, limited to **3 TiB**, and limited to **1,000 IOPS**, so it cannot support the proposed 24 TiB configuration and is not a performance-improving option ([RDS storage types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).
- **B:** Increasing the DB instance size and moving to Provisioned IOPS can improve I/O performance, but it keeps the large BLOBs in the database and increases provisioned RDS storage/IOPS cost. AWS notes that with Provisioned IOPS storage, you are charged for provisioned resources whether or not you use them ([RDS Provisioned IOPS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)). This is not the most cost-effective way to solve the root cause: storing large documents in the database.
- **D:** DynamoDB is not suitable for storing the 6 MB documents directly because the maximum DynamoDB item size is **400 KB** ([DynamoDB constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)). Migrating the whole Oracle database to DynamoDB also does not match the requirement as cost-effectively as offloading only the documents to S3.

zh.question: 一家公司已将一个两层应用程序从其本地数据中心迁移到 AWS Cloud。数据层是 Amazon RDS for Oracle 的 Multi-AZ 部署，使用 12 TB 的 General Purpose SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储。该应用程序设计为在数据库中以二进制大对象 (blobs) 的形式处理和存储文档，平均文档大小为 6 MB。随着时间推移，数据库大小不断增长，导致性能下降并增加了存储成本。公司必须提高数据库性能，并且需要一个高度可用且具有弹性的解决方案。哪种解决方案将以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 减小 RDS DB 实例大小。将存储容量增加到 24 TiB。将存储类型更改为 Magnetic。
options.B: 增加 RDS DB 实例大小。将存储容量增加到 24 TiChange 将存储类型更改为 Provisioned IOPS。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。更新应用程序以将文档存储在 S3 存储桶中。将对象元数据存储在现有数据库中。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。更新应用程序以使用 DynamoDB。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据从 Oracle 数据库迁移到 DynamoDB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

将大型文档作为数据库 BLOBs 存储会使 RDS 数据库变大，这可能会增加存储成本并降低数据库性能。Amazon S3 是专为对象存储构建的：S3 Standard 专为频繁访问的数据而设计，具有毫秒级访问能力，会跨 **至少 3 个 Availability Zones** 存储数据，并提供 **99.999999999% 持久性**和 **99.99% 可用性**。AWS 还说明，S3 Standard 以及其他几个 S3 存储类旨在承受整个 Availability Zone 丢失的情况（[S3 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/DataDurability.html)，[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。因此，将 6 MB 文档移动到 S3，并在 Oracle 数据库中仅保留对象元数据/指针，可以减少数据库大小和 I/O 负载，同时保持一个高度可用且具有弹性的存储层。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 减小 DB 实例大小可能会使性能进一步恶化。此外，RDS magnetic storage 是旧式/不推荐的，限制为 **3 TiB**，并且限制为 **1,000 IOPS**，因此它无法支持所提出的 24 TiB 配置，也不是一个提升性能的选项（[RDS storage types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。
- **B:** 增加 DB 实例大小并迁移到 Provisioned IOPS 可以提高 I/O 性能，但它仍将大型 BLOBs 保留在数据库中，并增加预置的 RDS 存储/IOPS 成本。AWS 指出，对于 Provisioned IOPS 存储，无论是否使用，都会按预置资源收费（[RDS Provisioned IOPS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。这不是解决根本原因（在数据库中存储大型文档）的最具成本效益的方式。
- **D:** DynamoDB 不适合直接存储 6 MB 文档，因为 DynamoDB item 的最大大小为 **400 KB**（[DynamoDB constraints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)）。将整个 Oracle 数据库迁移到 DynamoDB 也不如仅将文档卸载到 S3 那样以高成本效益满足要求。

en.question: A company has an application that serves clients that are deployed in more than 20.000 retail storefront locations around the world. The application consists of backend web services that are exposed over HTTPS on port 443. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The retail locations communicate with the web application over the public internet. The company allows each retail location to register the IP address that the retail location has been allocated by its local ISP. The company's security team recommends to increase the security of the application endpoint by restricting access to only the IP addresses registered by the retail locations. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the ALB. Use IP rule sets on the ALB to filter traffic. Update the IP addresses in the rule to include the registered IP addresses.
options.B: Deploy AWS Firewall Manager to manage the ALConfigure firewall rules to restrict traffic to the ALModify the firewall rules to include the registered IP addresses.
options.C: Store the IP addresses in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure an AWS Lambda authorization function on the ALB to validate that incoming requests are from the registered IP addresses.
options.D: Configure the network ACL on the subnet that contains the public interface of the ALB. Update the ingress rules on the network ACL with entries for each of the registered IP addresses.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS WAF is designed to protect web applications by associating a web ACL with supported resources, including an **Application Load Balancer**. AWS documentation states that AWS WAF can protect regional resources such as an **Application Load Balancer** by associating a web ACL with the resource ([AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)). An AWS WAF **IP set match rule statement** inspects the source IP address of a web request and can be used to **allow or block web requests based on the IP addresses that the requests originate from**; each IP set can contain up to **10,000 IP addresses or ranges**, and updated IP sets automatically update the rules that reference them ([IP set match rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-ipset-match.html)). AWS WAF quotas also show 100 IP sets per account per Region and 10,000 IP addresses per IP set, which supports scaling to more than 20,000 registered storefront addresses by using multiple IP sets/rules as needed ([AWS WAF quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/limits.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B:** AWS Firewall Manager is for centralized policy management, but this option is incomplete and does not specify the required AWS WAF web ACL/IP set configuration on the ALB. For a single ALB endpoint, directly associating an AWS WAF web ACL with IP set rules is the correct implementation.
* **C:** An ALB can use Lambda functions as **targets**, but the documented ALB/Lambda integration is for invoking registered Lambda targets, not for attaching a Lambda authorization function in front of an existing EC2-backed ALB listener ([Lambda functions as ALB targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)). This would also let requests reach the load balancer before custom validation and is not the native IP-restriction control.
* **D:** Network ACLs are not suitable for thousands of storefront IP addresses. Amazon VPC quotas list **20 rules per network ACL** by default, adjustable only up to **40 inbound and 40 outbound rules**, far below the more than 20,000 locations in the scenario ([Amazon VPC quotas: Network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/amazon-vpc-limits.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，为部署在全球超过 20.000 个零售门店位置的客户端提供服务。该应用程序由后端 Web 服务组成，这些服务通过端口 443 上的 HTTPS 对外公开。该应用程序托管在位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。零售位置通过公有互联网与该 Web 应用程序通信。公司允许每个零售位置注册其本地 ISP 分配给该零售位置的 IP 地址。公司的安全团队建议通过将访问限制为仅允许零售位置注册的 IP 地址来提高应用程序端点的安全性。解决方案架构师应怎么做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS WAF web ACL 与 ALB 关联。在 ALB 上使用 IP 规则集来筛选流量。更新规则中的 IP 地址，以包含已注册的 IP 地址。
options.B: 部署 AWS Firewall Manager 来管理 ALConfigure 防火墙规则，以限制到 ALModify 的流量。修改防火墙规则，以包含已注册的 IP 地址。
options.C: 将 IP 地址存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。在 ALB 上配置 AWS Lambda 授权函数，以验证传入请求是否来自已注册的 IP 地址。
options.D: 在包含 ALB 公有接口的子网上配置 network ACL。使用每个已注册 IP 地址的条目更新 network ACL 上的入站规则。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** AWS WAF 旨在通过将 web ACL 与受支持的资源关联来保护 Web 应用程序，其中包括 **Application Load Balancer**。AWS 文档说明，AWS WAF 可以通过将 web ACL 与资源关联来保护区域性资源，例如 **Application Load Balancer**（[AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。AWS WAF **IP set match rule statement** 会检查 Web 请求的源 IP 地址，并可用于**根据请求来源的 IP 地址允许或阻止 Web 请求**；每个 IP set 最多可包含 **10,000 个 IP 地址或范围**，并且更新后的 IP sets 会自动更新引用它们的规则（[IP set match rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-ipset-match.html)）。AWS WAF 配额还显示每个账户每个 Region 有 100 个 IP sets，并且每个 IP set 有 10,000 个 IP 地址，这支持按需使用多个 IP sets/规则来扩展到超过 20,000 个已注册门店地址（[AWS WAF quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/limits.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B:** AWS Firewall Manager 用于集中式策略管理，但此选项不完整，并且没有指定在 ALB 上所需的 AWS WAF web ACL/IP set 配置。对于单个 ALB 端点，直接将 AWS WAF web ACL 与 IP set 规则关联才是正确实现。
* **C:** ALB 可以使用 Lambda functions 作为**目标**，但记录在文档中的 ALB/Lambda 集成是用于调用已注册的 Lambda 目标，而不是在现有由 EC2 支持的 ALB listener 前面附加 Lambda 授权函数（[Lambda functions as ALB targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)）。这还会让请求在自定义验证之前到达负载均衡器，并且不是原生的 IP 限制控制。
* **D:** Network ACLs 不适合数千个门店 IP 地址。Amazon VPC 配额列出，默认情况下每个 network ACL 有 **20 条规则**，最多只能调整到 **40 条入站规则和 40 条出站规则**，远低于场景中的超过 20,000 个位置（[Amazon VPC quotas: Network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/amazon-vpc-limits.html)）。

en.question: A company is building a data analysis platform on AWS by using AWS Lake Formation. The platform will ingest data from different sources such as Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS. The company needs a secure solution to prevent access to portions of the data that contain sensitive information. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an IAM role that includes permissions to access Lake Formation tables.
options.B: Create data filters to implement row-level security and cell-level security.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that removes sensitive information before Lake Formation ingests the data.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically queries and removes sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Lake Formation has a built-in data filtering feature specifically for this requirement. The documentation states that you can implement **column-level, row-level, and cell-level security by creating data filters**, and that these filters are selected when granting `SELECT` Lake Formation permissions on tables. It also explains that a row filter expression controls which rows are included in query results, and that combining column inclusion/exclusion with a row filter establishes **cell-level security**. This directly prevents access to sensitive portions of data with minimal operational overhead because it uses native Lake Formation access controls rather than custom processing code. [Data filtering and cell-level security in Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/data-filtering.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create an IAM role that includes permissions to access Lake Formation tables.** IAM/Lake Formation table permissions can grant table access, but this option does not provide the required fine-grained restriction to sensitive rows or cells. The AWS documentation identifies **data filters** as the mechanism for row-level and cell-level security when granting `SELECT` permissions. [Data filtering and cell-level security in Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/data-filtering.html)
- **C. Create an AWS Lambda function that removes sensitive information before Lake Formation ingests the data.** This would require custom code, integration, testing, and maintenance. It also changes or removes data rather than using Lake Formation’s native access-control mechanism.
- **D. Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically queries and removes sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.** This adds operational overhead and is not as secure or direct as enforcing access controls at query time. It also removes data instead of preventing unauthorized access to sensitive portions.

Therefore, the least-operational-overhead solution is to use **Lake Formation data filters for row-level and cell-level security**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Lake Formation 在 AWS 上构建数据分析平台。该平台将从不同来源摄取数据，例如 Amazon S3 和 Amazon RDS。公司需要一种安全的解决方案，以防止访问包含敏感信息的数据部分。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 IAM 角色，其中包含访问 Lake Formation 表的权限。
options.B: 创建数据筛选器以实现行级安全性和单元格级安全性。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在 Lake Formation 摄取数据之前移除敏感信息。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，定期查询并从 Lake Formation 表中移除敏感信息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.** AWS Lake Formation 具有专门针对这一要求的内置数据筛选功能。文档说明，你可以通过创建数据筛选器来实现 **列级、行级和单元格级安全性**，并且在授予表的 `SELECT` Lake Formation 权限时会选择这些筛选器。文档还解释了行筛选器表达式会控制查询结果中包含哪些行，并且将列包含/排除与行筛选器相结合可建立 **单元格级安全性**。这可以直接防止访问数据中的敏感部分，并且运营开销最小，因为它使用原生 Lake Formation 访问控制，而不是自定义处理代码。[Data filtering and cell-level security in Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/data-filtering.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Create an IAM role that includes permissions to access Lake Formation tables.** IAM/Lake Formation 表权限可以授予表访问权限，但此选项无法提供所需的对敏感行或单元格的细粒度限制。AWS 文档将 **数据筛选器** 确定为在授予 `SELECT` 权限时实现行级和单元格级安全性的机制。[Data filtering and cell-level security in Lake Formation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lake-formation/latest/dg/data-filtering.html)
- **C. Create an AWS Lambda function that removes sensitive information before Lake Formation ingests the data.** 这将需要自定义代码、集成、测试和维护。它还会更改或移除数据，而不是使用 Lake Formation 的原生访问控制机制。
- **D. Create an AWS Lambda function that periodically queries and removes sensitive information from Lake Formation tables.** 这会增加运营开销，并且不如在查询时强制执行访问控制那样安全或直接。它还会移除数据，而不是防止未经授权访问敏感部分。因此，运营开销最少的解决方案是使用 **Lake Formation 数据筛选器实现行级和单元格级安全性**。

en.question: A company deploys Amazon EC2 instances that run in a VPC. The EC2 instances load source data into Amazon S3 buckets so that the data can be processed in the future. According to compliance laws, the data must not be transmitted over the public internet. Servers in the company's on-premises data center will consume the output from an application that runs on the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint for Amazon EC2. Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.B: Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and the VPC.
options.C: Set up an AWS Transit Gateway connection from the VPC to the S3 buckets. Create an AWS Site- to-Site VPN connection between the company and the VPC.
options.D: Set up proxy EC2 instances that have routes to NAT gateways. Configure the proxy EC2 instances to fetch S3 data and feed the application instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The requirement has two separate private-connectivity needs:

1. **EC2 instances in the VPC must load data to Amazon S3 without using the public internet.** A gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 is designed for this: AWS states that gateway endpoints provide connectivity to Amazon S3 without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device, and S3 gateway endpoints let you access S3 from your VPC by adding the endpoint as a route-table target for S3 traffic ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html), [Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).
2. **On-premises servers must consume output from an application running on EC2 without using the public internet.** AWS Direct Connect links an internal network to AWS over a standard Ethernet fiber-optic cable and can create a private virtual interface to a VPC, "bypassing internet service providers in your network path" ([What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

Therefore, an **S3 gateway endpoint + Direct Connect** satisfies both the VPC-to-S3 and on-premises-to-VPC private connectivity requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An interface VPC endpoint for **Amazon EC2** does not provide private access from EC2 instances to **Amazon S3**; the needed endpoint is for S3. Also, Site-to-Site VPN is an IPsec VPN connection between on-premises and a VPC ([What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)), but the option still lacks the required S3 private path.
- **C:** A transit gateway is for interconnecting VPCs and on-premises networks; it is not a direct connection mechanism "from the VPC to the S3 buckets." AWS specifically notes that S3 **gateway endpoint** connections cannot be extended through a transit gateway ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).
- **D:** Proxy instances with routes to NAT gateways would not be the intended private S3 access pattern. Gateway endpoints avoid the need for an internet gateway or NAT device for VPC-to-S3 connectivity ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)). This option also does not provide a private on-premises-to-VPC connection for consuming the EC2 application output.

zh.question: 一家公司部署了在 VPC 中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例。这些 EC2 实例将源数据加载到 Amazon S3 存储桶中，以便将来处理这些数据。根据合规法规，数据不得通过公共互联网传输。公司本地数据中心中的服务器将使用在 EC2 实例上运行的应用程序的输出。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Amazon EC2 部署一个接口 VPC 终端节点。在公司与 VPC 之间创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。
options.B: 为 Amazon S3 部署一个网关 VPC 终端节点。在本地网络与 VPC 之间设置 AWS Direct Connect 连接。
options.C: 从 VPC 到 S3 存储桶设置 AWS Transit Gateway 连接。在公司与 VPC 之间创建 AWS Site- to-Site VPN 连接。
options.D: 设置具有到 NAT 网关路由的代理 EC2 实例。配置这些代理 EC2 实例以获取 S3 数据并馈送给应用程序实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该要求包含两个独立的私有连接需求：

1. **VPC 中的 EC2 实例必须在不使用公共互联网的情况下将数据加载到 Amazon S3。** Amazon S3 的网关 VPC 终端节点正是为此而设计的：AWS 说明，网关终端节点无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device 即可提供到 Amazon S3 的连接，并且 S3 网关终端节点允许你通过将该终端节点添加为 S3 流量的路由表目标，从 VPC 访问 S3（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)，[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。
2. **本地服务器必须在不使用公共互联网的情况下使用在 EC2 上运行的应用程序的输出。** AWS Direct Connect 通过标准以太网光纤电缆将内部网络连接到 AWS，并且可以创建到 VPC 的私有虚拟接口，"bypassing internet service providers in your network path"（[What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。因此，**S3 网关终端节点 + Direct Connect** 同时满足 VPC 到 S3 以及本地到 VPC 的私有连接要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 面向 **Amazon EC2** 的接口 VPC 终端节点并不能为 EC2 实例提供到 **Amazon S3** 的私有访问；所需的终端节点应面向 S3。此外，Site-to-Site VPN 是本地环境与 VPC 之间的 IPsec VPN 连接（[What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)），但该选项仍然缺少所需的 S3 私有路径。
- **C:** transit gateway 用于互连 VPC 和本地网络；它不是“从 VPC 到 S3 存储桶”的直接连接机制。AWS 明确指出，S3 **gateway endpoint** 连接不能通过 transit gateway 扩展（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。
- **D:** 具有到 NAT 网关路由的代理实例并不是预期的私有 S3 访问模式。对于 VPC 到 S3 的连接，网关终端节点避免了对 internet gateway 或 NAT device 的需求（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。此选项也没有为使用 EC2 应用程序输出提供本地到 VPC 的私有连接。

en.question: A company has an application with a REST-based interface that allows data to be received in near-real time from a third-party vendor. Once received, the application processes and stores the data for further analysis. The application is running on Amazon EC2 instances. The third-party vendor has received many 503 Service Unavailable Errors when sending data to the application. When the data volume spikes, the compute capacity reaches its maximum limit and the application is unable to process all requests. Which design should a solutions architect recommend to provide a more scalable solution?

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest the data. Process the data using AWS Lambda functions.
options.B: Use Amazon API Gateway on top of the existing application. Create a usage plan with a quota limit for the third-party vendor.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to ingest the data. Put the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.D: Repackage the application as a container. Deploy the application using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) using the EC2 launch type with an Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is designed for rapid, continuous data intake and real-time processing; AWS docs note that producers can push data directly into a stream and that records can be available for processing in seconds. Kinesis also provides durability and elasticity, with typical put-to-get delay under 1 second, and can scale so records are not lost before expiration ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). Lambda integrates directly with Kinesis: Lambda reads records from the stream in batches and invokes the function to process them; it can keep processing until it catches up, use enhanced fan-out to minimize latency/maximize throughput, and increase processing throughput with parallelization ([Using Lambda with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)). This directly addresses spikes in near-real-time ingestion and removes the EC2 capacity bottleneck.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** API Gateway usage plans and quotas are for monitoring/limiting client usage and throttling requests, not for increasing the back-end application’s processing capacity. A quota would reduce or throttle the vendor’s requests rather than ingest and process spikes scalably ([API Gateway usage plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-usage-plan-manage-usage.html)).
- **C:** Amazon SNS is a pub/sub messaging service where publishers send messages to topics for delivery to subscribers such as SQS, Lambda, HTTP(S), email, and others ([Amazon SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)). SNS plus EC2 Auto Scaling may help distribute notifications and add instances, but it is not the best fit for near-real-time streaming data ingestion and processing compared with Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda.
- **D:** Containerizing the existing application on ECS with the EC2 launch type improves deployment/management but still relies on EC2 capacity and does not add a streaming ingestion buffer or serverless event processing layer. It does not directly solve burst ingestion the way Kinesis Data Streams and Lambda do.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个带有基于 REST 的接口的应用程序，该接口允许从第三方供应商近乎实时地接收数据。数据一经接收，应用程序就会处理并存储这些数据，以便进一步分析。该应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。第三方供应商在向该应用程序发送数据时收到了许多 503 Service Unavailable Errors。当数据量激增时，计算容量达到其最大限制，应用程序无法处理所有请求。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种设计来提供更具可扩展性的解决方案？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 摄取数据。使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理数据。
options.B: 在现有应用程序之上使用 Amazon API Gateway。为第三方供应商创建带有配额限制的使用计划。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 摄取数据。将 EC2 实例放入位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中。
options.D: 将应用程序重新打包为容器。使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 通过带有 Auto Scaling 组的 EC2 启动类型部署应用程序。

zh.explanation:
