**正确答案：A.** Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 专为快速、持续的数据摄取和实时处理而设计；AWS 文档指出，生产者可以将数据直接推送到流中，并且记录可在数秒内用于处理。Kinesis 还提供持久性和弹性，典型的 put-to-get 延迟低于 1 秒，并且可以扩展以确保记录在过期前不会丢失（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。Lambda 可直接与 Kinesis 集成：Lambda 从流中批量读取记录并调用函数进行处理；它可以持续处理直到追赶上进度，使用增强型扇出以最大限度降低延迟/最大化吞吐量，并通过并行化提高处理吞吐量（[Using Lambda with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)）。这直接解决了近乎实时摄取中的峰值问题，并消除了 EC2 容量瓶颈。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** API Gateway 使用计划和配额用于监控/限制客户端使用量以及限流请求，而不是增加后端应用程序的处理能力。配额会减少或限制供应商的请求，而不是以可扩展方式摄取和处理峰值流量（[API Gateway usage plans](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-usage-plan-manage-usage.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon SNS 是一种 pub/sub 消息传递服务，发布者将消息发送到主题，以便传递给 SQS、Lambda、HTTP(S)、email 等订阅者（[Amazon SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。SNS 加 EC2 Auto Scaling 可能有助于分发通知并添加实例，但与 Kinesis Data Streams + Lambda 相比，它并不是近乎实时流式数据摄取和处理的最佳选择。
- **D:** 使用 EC2 启动类型将现有应用程序容器化并部署在 ECS 上可以改善部署/管理，但仍然依赖 EC2 容量，并且不会增加流式摄取缓冲区或无服务器事件处理层。它不像 Kinesis Data Streams 和 Lambda 那样直接解决突发摄取问题。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. The application needs to process sensitive information from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application must not use the internet to connect to the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an internet gateway. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the internet gateway. Update the application to use the new internet gateway.
options.B: Configure a VPN connection. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPN connection. Update the application to use the new VPN connection.
options.C: Configure a NAT gateway. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the NAT gateway. Update the application to use the new NAT gateway.
options.D: Configure a VPC endpoint. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the VPC endpoint. Update the application to use the new VPC endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Configure a VPC endpoint.**

Amazon S3 supports VPC endpoints for private access from a VPC. AWS documents that an S3 **gateway endpoint** is specified in a route table to access S3 from a VPC **over the AWS network**, and that for both S3 gateway and interface endpoints, “your network traffic remains on the AWS network” ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). AWS also provides bucket policy examples that restrict access to a bucket **only from a specific VPC endpoint** using the `aws:SourceVpce` condition key ([Controlling access from VPC endpoints with bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)). This meets the requirement that EC2 instances in a private subnet access sensitive S3 data without using the internet.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Internet gateway** — An internet gateway is for internet connectivity. AWS states that a subnet with a route to an internet gateway is a public subnet, and communication over an internet gateway is communication with the internet ([Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)). This violates the “must not use the internet” requirement.
- **B. VPN connection** — AWS VPN is for connecting a VPC to remote networks or users, such as an on-premises network or VPN clients ([Connect your VPC to remote networks using AWS Virtual Private Network](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)). It is not the native solution for private EC2-to-S3 access within AWS.
- **C. NAT gateway** — A public NAT gateway enables instances in a private subnet to send outbound traffic to the **internet** ([NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)). Therefore it does not satisfy the requirement to avoid internet connectivity to S3.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在私有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的应用程序。该应用程序需要处理来自 Amazon S3 存储桶的敏感信息。该应用程序不得使用互联网连接到 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 internet gateway。更新 S3 存储桶策略，以允许来自 internet gateway 的访问。更新应用程序以使用新的 internet gateway。
options.B: 配置 VPN connection。更新 S3 存储桶策略，以允许来自 VPN connection 的访问。更新应用程序以使用新的 VPN connection。
options.C: 配置 NAT gateway。更新 S3 存储桶策略，以允许来自 NAT gateway 的访问。更新应用程序以使用新的 NAT gateway。
options.D: 配置 VPC endpoint。更新 S3 存储桶策略，以允许来自 VPC endpoint 的访问。更新应用程序以使用新的 VPC endpoint。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 配置 VPC endpoint。**

Amazon S3 支持 VPC endpoints，用于从 VPC 进行私有访问。AWS 文档说明，S3 **gateway endpoint** 在路由表中指定，用于从 VPC **通过 AWS network** 访问 S3，并且对于 S3 gateway 和 interface endpoints，“你的网络流量会保留在 AWS network 上” ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html))。AWS 还提供了存储桶策略示例，使用 `aws:SourceVpce` 条件键将对存储桶的访问限制为**仅来自特定 VPC endpoint** ([Controlling access from VPC endpoints with bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html))。这满足了私有子网中的 EC2 实例在不使用互联网的情况下访问敏感 S3 数据的要求。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. Internet gateway** — Internet gateway 用于互联网连接。AWS 声明，具有到 internet gateway 的路由的子网是公有子网，并且通过 internet gateway 的通信是与互联网的通信 ([Enable internet access for a VPC using an internet gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html))。这违反了“不得使用互联网”的要求。
- **B. VPN connection** — AWS VPN 用于将 VPC 连接到远程网络或用户，例如本地网络或 VPN 客户端 ([Connect your VPC to remote networks using AWS Virtual Private Network](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html))。它不是 AWS 内部 EC2 到 S3 私有访问的原生解决方案。
- **C. NAT gateway** — 公有 NAT gateway 使私有子网中的实例能够向**互联网**发送出站流量 ([NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html))。因此，它不满足避免通过互联网连接到 S3 的要求。

en.question: A company uses Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to run a container application. The EKS cluster stores sensitive information in the Kubernetes secrets object. The company wants to ensure that the information is encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use the container application to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.B: Enable secrets encryption in the EKS cluster by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.C: Implement an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to encrypt the information by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Enable secrets encryption in the EKS cluster by using AWS KMS.**

Amazon EKS directly supports using AWS KMS keys to provide envelope encryption for Kubernetes secrets stored in EKS. The documentation states that this adds a customer-managed encryption layer for application secrets or user data in a Kubernetes cluster, and encryption can be enabled on an EKS cluster at creation time or on an existing cluster. This meets the requirement with the least operational overhead because encryption is handled by the EKS control plane/KMS integration rather than by custom application or automation code. AWS also documents that EKS uses AWS KMS for envelope encryption before Kubernetes API data is persisted in etcd, and newer EKS versions provide a managed default envelope-encryption experience that “doesn’t require any action” for supported clusters ([EKS KMS Envelope Encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/kms-encryption.html), [Default envelope encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/envelope-encryption.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Use the container application to encrypt the information by using AWS KMS** — This would require application changes and ongoing code/permission management. EKS already provides native KMS envelope encryption for Kubernetes secrets, so application-level encryption is higher overhead.
- **C. Implement an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the information by using AWS KMS** — A Lambda-based encryption workflow would be custom automation outside the Kubernetes secrets storage path and would add operational complexity. Native EKS secrets encryption is the simpler managed approach.
- **D. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to encrypt the information by using AWS KMS** — Parameter Store can encrypt `SecureString` parameters with KMS, but that encrypts Parameter Store parameters, not the Kubernetes secrets objects already stored in the EKS cluster ([Parameter Store SecureString KMS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/secure-string-parameter-kms-encryption.html)). It would also require changing how the application stores/retrieves secrets rather than enabling encryption for Kubernetes secrets in EKS.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 运行容器应用程序。该 EKS 集群将敏感信息存储在 Kubernetes secrets 对象中。该公司希望确保这些信息被加密。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用容器应用程序通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密这些信息。
options.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 在 EKS 集群中启用 secrets 加密。
options.C: 实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密这些信息。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 通过 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密这些信息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Enable secrets encryption in the EKS cluster by using AWS KMS.**

Amazon EKS 直接支持使用 AWS KMS keys 为存储在 EKS 中的 Kubernetes secrets 提供信封加密。文档说明，这会为 Kubernetes 集群中的应用程序 secrets 或用户数据增加一个客户托管的加密层，并且可以在创建 EKS 集群时或在现有集群上启用加密。这能以最少的运营开销满足要求，因为加密由 EKS control plane/KMS 集成来处理，而不是由自定义应用程序或自动化代码来处理。AWS 还记录说明，在 Kubernetes API 数据持久化到 etcd 之前，EKS 会使用 AWS KMS 进行信封加密，并且较新的 EKS 版本为受支持的集群提供托管的默认信封加密体验，“doesn’t require any action”（[EKS KMS Envelope Encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/kms-encryption.html), [Default envelope encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/envelope-encryption.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Use the container application to encrypt the information by using AWS KMS** — 这需要更改应用程序，并持续进行代码/权限管理。EKS 已经为 Kubernetes secrets 提供原生 KMS 信封加密，因此应用程序级加密的开销更高。
- **C. Implement an AWS Lambda function to encrypt the information by using AWS KMS** — 基于 Lambda 的加密工作流将是 Kubernetes secrets 存储路径之外的自定义自动化，会增加运营复杂性。原生 EKS secrets 加密是更简单的托管方法。
- **D. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to encrypt the information by using AWS KMS** — Parameter Store 可以使用 KMS 加密 `SecureString` 参数，但这加密的是 Parameter Store 参数，而不是已经存储在 EKS 集群中的 Kubernetes secrets 对象（[Parameter Store SecureString KMS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/secure-string-parameter-kms-encryption.html)）。它还需要更改应用程序存储/检索 secrets 的方式，而不是为 EKS 中的 Kubernetes secrets 启用加密。

en.question: A company is designing a new multi-tier web application that consists of the following components: • Web and application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances as part of Auto Scaling groups • An Amazon RDS DB instance for data storage A solutions architect needs to limit access to the application servers so that only the web servers can access them. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS PrivateLink in front of the application servers. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.B: Deploy a VPC endpoint in front of the application servers. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.C: Deploy a Network Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the network ACL to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.
options.D: Deploy an Application Load Balancer with a target group that contains the application servers' Auto Scaling group. Configure the security group to allow only the web servers to access the application servers.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Deploy an **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** for the application tier and attach the application servers' Auto Scaling group through an ELB target group. AWS documents that, for Application/Network/Gateway Load Balancers, an Auto Scaling group is attached by choosing a **target group**, and the instances are automatically registered to the load balancer. Elastic Load Balancing also distributes traffic across targets such as EC2 instances and routes only to healthy targets. For access control, security groups are the right mechanism: they act as an instance-level firewall, and a rule can use another security group as the source, affecting all instances associated with that source security group. Therefore, the application tier can be protected so that only traffic from the web tier/load-balancer path is allowed. AWS also recommends configuring ALB security groups to accept traffic only from specific clients and configuring EC2 instance security groups to accept traffic only from the load balancer. ([Auto Scaling target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html), [ELB behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html), [EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-security-group.html), [ELB traffic control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/infrastructure-security.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** is incorrect. AWS PrivateLink/VPC endpoints are for private connectivity to supported AWS services, services in other accounts, Marketplace services, or endpoint services/resources—not the normal pattern for isolating tiers inside the same application VPC. Also, network ACLs operate at the **subnet level**, not as precise instance-tier controls. ([PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html), [Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html))
* **B** is incorrect. A VPC endpoint is not the appropriate front end for EC2 application servers in a multi-tier app. AWS describes PrivateLink endpoints as entry points for traffic destined to a service or resource, not as a replacement for an application-tier load balancer. ([PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html))
* **C** is incorrect. Although a Network Load Balancer can use target groups with Auto Scaling, this option uses **network ACLs** for restriction. NACLs filter traffic only when it enters or leaves a subnet and are stateless; security groups are the intended stateful, instance-level control for allowing only the required tier. ([Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html), [EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-security-group.html))

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一个新的多层 Web 应用程序，该应用程序包含以下组件：• 作为 Auto Scaling 组一部分运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 和应用程序服务器 • 用于数据存储的 Amazon RDS DB 实例解决方案架构师需要限制对应用程序服务器的访问，使只有 Web 服务器可以访问它们。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在应用程序服务器前面部署 AWS PrivateLink。配置网络 ACL，以仅允许 Web 服务器访问应用程序服务器。
options.B: 在应用程序服务器前面部署 VPC endpoint。配置安全组，以仅允许 Web 服务器访问应用程序服务器。
options.C: 部署一个 Network Load Balancer，其目标组包含应用程序服务器的 Auto Scaling 组。配置网络 ACL，以仅允许 Web 服务器访问应用程序服务器。
options.D: 部署一个 Application Load Balancer，其目标组包含应用程序服务器的 Auto Scaling 组。配置安全组，以仅允许 Web 服务器访问应用程序服务器。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

为应用程序层部署一个 **Application Load Balancer (ALB)**，并通过 ELB 目标组附加应用程序服务器的 Auto Scaling 组。AWS 文档说明，对于 Application/Network/Gateway Load Balancers，通过选择一个 **target group** 来附加 Auto Scaling 组，并且实例会自动注册到负载均衡器。Elastic Load Balancing 还会在 EC2 实例等目标之间分发流量，并且仅路由到运行状况良好的目标。对于访问控制，安全组是正确的机制：它们充当实例级防火墙，并且规则可以使用另一个安全组作为源，从而影响与该源安全组关联的所有实例。因此，可以保护应用程序层，使其仅允许来自 Web 层/负载均衡器路径的流量。AWS 还建议将 ALB 安全组配置为仅接受来自特定客户端的流量，并将 EC2 实例安全组配置为仅接受来自负载均衡器的流量。([Auto Scaling target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html), [ELB behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html), [EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-security-group.html), [ELB traffic control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/infrastructure-security.html))

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

* **A** 不正确。AWS PrivateLink/VPC endpoints 用于与受支持的 AWS 服务、其他账户中的服务、Marketplace 服务或端点服务/资源进行私有连接——这不是在同一个应用程序 VPC 内隔离各层的常规模式。此外，网络 ACL 在 **subnet level** 运行，而不是精确的实例层控制。([PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html), [Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html))
* **B** 不正确。对于多层应用中的 EC2 应用程序服务器，VPC endpoint 不是合适的前端。AWS 将 PrivateLink endpoints 描述为发往某个服务或资源的流量入口点，而不是应用程序层负载均衡器的替代品。([PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html))
* **C** 不正确。虽然 Network Load Balancer 可以使用带 Auto Scaling 的目标组，但该选项使用 **network ACLs** 进行限制。NACLs 仅在流量进入或离开子网时过滤流量，并且是无状态的；安全组才是预期用于仅允许所需层访问的有状态、实例级控制机制。([Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html), [EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-security-group.html))

en.question: A company runs a critical, customer-facing application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The application has a microservices architecture. The company needs to implement a solution that collects, aggregates, and summarizes metrics and logs from the application in a centralized location. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Run the Amazon CloudWatch agent in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console.
options.B: Run AWS App Mesh in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the App Mesh console.
options.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to capture data events. Query CloudTrail by using Amazon OpenSearch Service.
options.D: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights in the existing EKS cluster. View the metrics and logs in the CloudWatch console.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights is designed for exactly this use case: AWS states that it is used to “collect, aggregate, and summarize metrics and logs from your containerized applications and microservices,” and that it is available for **Amazon EKS**. The same documentation explains that Container Insights creates aggregated metrics at the cluster, node, pod, task, and service levels and makes them available in CloudWatch dashboards and the CloudWatch console ([Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudWatch agent only** — Container Insights may use a containerized CloudWatch agent in EKS, but simply “run the CloudWatch agent” is not the named EKS container observability solution that collects, aggregates, and summarizes container/microservice metrics and logs. The required capability is specifically CloudWatch **Container Insights** ([Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)).
- **B. AWS App Mesh** — App Mesh is a service mesh for controlling and monitoring service-to-service communication, not the centralized CloudWatch solution for collecting, aggregating, and summarizing all EKS container metrics and logs. Its documentation focuses on service mesh components and Envoy metrics rather than replacing Container Insights ([What Is AWS App Mesh?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/app-mesh/latest/userguide/what-is-app-mesh.html)).
- **C. CloudTrail data events with OpenSearch** — CloudTrail records AWS API activity for audit, governance, compliance, and security monitoring; CloudTrail data events are not application/container performance metrics and logs for EKS microservices ([What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html), [Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上运行一个面向客户的关键应用程序。该应用程序采用微服务架构。公司需要实施一个解决方案，用于在集中位置收集、聚合并汇总来自该应用程序的指标和日志。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在现有 EKS 集群中运行 Amazon CloudWatch agent。在 CloudWatch 控制台中查看指标和日志。
options.B: 在现有 EKS 集群中运行 AWS App Mesh。在 App Mesh 控制台中查看指标和日志。
options.C: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 以捕获数据事件。使用 Amazon OpenSearch Service 查询 CloudTrail。
options.D: 在现有 EKS 集群中配置 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights。在 CloudWatch 控制台中查看指标和日志。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 正是为这一用例而设计：AWS 表示它用于“从容器化应用程序和微服务中收集、聚合并汇总指标和日志”，并且可用于 **Amazon EKS**。同一文档还说明，Container Insights 会在集群、节点、pod、任务和服务级别创建聚合指标，并使其可在 CloudWatch dashboards 和 CloudWatch 控制台中使用（[Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 仅 CloudWatch agent** — Container Insights 可能会在 EKS 中使用容器化的 CloudWatch agent，但仅仅“运行 CloudWatch agent”并不是用于收集、聚合并汇总容器/微服务指标和日志的具名 EKS 容器可观测性解决方案。所需的能力具体是 CloudWatch **Container Insights**（[Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)）。
- **B. AWS App Mesh** — App Mesh 是一个用于控制和监控服务到服务通信的服务网格，而不是用于收集、聚合并汇总所有 EKS 容器指标和日志的集中式 CloudWatch 解决方案。其文档侧重于服务网格组件和 Envoy 指标，而不是替代 Container Insights（[What Is AWS App Mesh?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/app-mesh/latest/userguide/what-is-app-mesh.html)）。
- **C. CloudTrail data events with OpenSearch** — CloudTrail 记录用于审计、治理、合规性和安全监控的 AWS API 活动；CloudTrail data events 不是用于 EKS 微服务的应用程序/容器性能指标和日志（[What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html), [Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)）。

en.question: A company has deployed its newest product on AWS. The product runs in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer. The company stores the product’s objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company recently experienced malicious attacks against its systems. The company needs a solution that continuously monitors for malicious activity in the AWS account, workloads, and access patterns to the S3 bucket. The solution must also report suspicious activity and display the information on a dashboard. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Macie to monitor and report findings to AWS Config.
options.B: Configure Amazon Inspector to monitor and report findings to AWS CloudTrail.
options.C: Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor and report findings to AWS Security Hub.
options.D: Configure AWS Config to monitor and report findings to Amazon EventBridge.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor and report findings to AWS Security Hub.**

Amazon GuardDuty is the service that matches the requirement for continuous threat detection: AWS describes it as “a threat detection service that continuously monitors, analyzes, and processes AWS data sources and logs” and uses threat intelligence and ML to identify “suspicious and potentially malicious activity” in the AWS environment. GuardDuty covers account-level activity and workloads, including CloudTrail management events, VPC Flow Logs from EC2 instances, DNS logs, and protection plans for S3 data events and runtime monitoring across EC2/ECS/EKS. Its S3 Protection identifies risks such as data exfiltration and destruction attempts in S3 buckets. [Amazon GuardDuty documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)

AWS Security Hub is the appropriate reporting/dashboard service because it collects security data across AWS accounts and services, receives findings from services including Amazon GuardDuty, and provides a “single pane of glass” into security-related issues. [AWS Security Hub documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A. Macie to AWS Config** — Amazon Macie focuses on S3 data security posture and sensitive data discovery, such as finding sensitive data or public bucket exposure. It does not provide broad malicious-activity monitoring across AWS accounts and workloads, and AWS Config is not the right findings dashboard target. [Amazon Macie documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)
* **B. Inspector to CloudTrail** — Amazon Inspector is a vulnerability management service that scans EC2 instances, ECR container images, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure. It is not a continuous malicious-activity detection service for accounts, workloads, and S3 access patterns; CloudTrail records API activity rather than serving as the security findings dashboard. [Amazon Inspector documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)
* **D. AWS Config to EventBridge** — AWS Config provides a detailed view of AWS resource configurations and configuration history. It is used for configuration tracking/compliance, not threat detection for malicious activity or suspicious S3 access patterns. [AWS Config documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS 上部署其最新产品。该产品在 Network Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling group 中运行。公司将该产品的对象存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。公司最近遭遇了针对其系统的恶意攻击。公司需要一种解决方案，能够持续监控 AWS 账户、工作负载以及对 S3 bucket 的访问模式中的恶意活动。该解决方案还必须报告可疑活动，并在仪表板上显示相关信息。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Amazon Macie 进行监控，并将发现结果报告给 AWS Config。
options.B: 配置 Amazon Inspector 进行监控，并将发现结果报告给 AWS CloudTrail。
options.C: 配置 Amazon GuardDuty 进行监控，并将发现结果报告给 AWS Security Hub。
options.D: 配置 AWS Config 进行监控，并将发现结果报告给 Amazon EventBridge。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor and report findings to AWS Security Hub.**

Amazon GuardDuty 是符合持续威胁检测要求的服务：AWS 将其描述为“一种威胁检测服务，可持续监控、分析和处理 AWS 数据源和日志”，并使用威胁情报和 ML 来识别 AWS 环境中的“可疑和潜在恶意活动”。GuardDuty 覆盖账户级活动和工作负载，包括 CloudTrail 管理事件、来自 EC2 实例的 VPC Flow Logs、DNS logs，以及面向 S3 data events 的保护计划和跨 EC2/ECS/EKS 的 runtime monitoring。其 S3 Protection 可识别 S3 buckets 中的数据外泄和破坏尝试等风险。[Amazon GuardDuty documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)

AWS Security Hub 是合适的报告/仪表板服务，因为它会跨 AWS 账户和服务收集安全数据，接收来自包括 Amazon GuardDuty 在内的服务的发现结果，并提供对安全相关问题的“single pane of glass”视图。[AWS Security Hub documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

* **A. Macie to AWS Config** — Amazon Macie 侧重于 S3 数据安全态势和敏感数据发现，例如查找敏感数据或公开 bucket 暴露。它不提供跨 AWS 账户和工作负载的广泛恶意活动监控，而 AWS Config 也不是合适的发现结果仪表板目标。[Amazon Macie documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)
* **B. Inspector to CloudTrail** — Amazon Inspector 是一种漏洞管理服务，可扫描 EC2 实例、ECR 容器映像和 Lambda 函数，以查找软件漏洞和非预期的网络暴露。它不是用于账户、工作负载和 S3 访问模式的持续恶意活动检测服务；CloudTrail 记录 API 活动，而不是作为安全发现结果仪表板。[Amazon Inspector documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)
* **D. AWS Config to EventBridge** — AWS Config 提供 AWS 资源配置和配置历史记录的详细视图。它用于配置跟踪/合规性，而不是用于恶意活动或可疑 S3 访问模式的威胁检测。[AWS Config documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)

en.question: A company wants to migrate an on-premises data center to AWS. The data center hosts a storage server that stores data in an NFS-based file system. The storage server holds 200 GB of data. The company needs to migrate the data without interruption to existing services. Multiple resources in AWS must be able to access the data by using the NFS protocol. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to receive the data.
options.D: Manually use an operating system copy command to push the data into the AWS destination.
options.E: Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center. Use a DataSync task between the on-premises location and AWS.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **B and E**.

- **B. Create an Amazon EFS file system** — The workload requires an AWS file system that multiple AWS resources can access using NFS. Amazon EFS fits this requirement: AWS documentation states that EFS can be mounted using a standard Linux NFS client and supports NFSv4.0 and NFSv4.1, and it also documents mounting EFS file systems to multiple EC2 instances. See [Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html) and [Mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html).
- **E. Install an AWS DataSync agent and create a DataSync task** — DataSync is designed for online data migration from on-premises storage to AWS storage services. AWS documentation says DataSync transfers files between on-premises/self-managed storage and AWS services including **Amazon EFS**, and specifically includes transfers with an **NFS file server**. DataSync also automates transfer management and provides high-performance, secure transfers, making it more appropriate and cost-effective than manual copying for a no-interruption migration. See [Transferring to or from on-premises storage with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html) and [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon FSx for Lustre** is not the best fit for a general NFS-based shared file system requirement. The question asks for NFS access by multiple AWS resources; EFS directly supports NFS for this use case.
- **C. Amazon S3** is object storage, not an NFS file system endpoint for multiple resources. Choosing S3 would not satisfy the stated requirement for NFS protocol access.
- **D. Manual OS copy commands** are less suitable for a migration that must avoid interruption. DataSync is the managed AWS service for migrating active datasets and automating secure, high-speed transfers.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该数据中心托管了一台存储服务器，该服务器在基于 NFS 的文件系统中存储数据。该存储服务器保存了 200 GB 数据。公司需要在不中断现有服务的情况下迁移数据。AWS 中的多个资源必须能够使用 NFS 协议访问这些数据。哪种步骤组合能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来接收数据。
options.D: 手动使用操作系统复制命令将数据推送到 AWS 目标位置。
options.E: 在本地数据中心安装 AWS DataSync 代理。在本地位置和 AWS 之间使用 DataSync 任务。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B 和 E**。

- **B. 创建一个 Amazon EFS 文件系统** — 该工作负载需要一个 AWS 文件系统，使多个 AWS 资源能够使用 NFS 访问。Amazon EFS 符合此要求：AWS 文档说明 EFS 可以使用标准 Linux NFS 客户端挂载，并支持 NFSv4.0 和 NFSv4.1，同时也记录了将 EFS 文件系统挂载到多个 EC2 实例的方法。请参阅 [Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html) 和 [Mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html)。
- **E. 安装 AWS DataSync 代理并创建 DataSync 任务** — DataSync 专为从本地存储到 AWS 存储服务的在线数据迁移而设计。AWS 文档说明 DataSync 在本地/自管理存储与包括 **Amazon EFS** 在内的 AWS 服务之间传输文件，并且明确包括与 **NFS file server** 之间的传输。DataSync 还可自动化传输管理，并提供高性能、安全的传输，因此对于需要不中断的迁移来说，它比手动复制更合适且更具成本效益。请参阅 [Transferring to or from on-premises storage with AWS DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-on-premises-storage.html) 和 [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Amazon FSx for Lustre** 并不是通用的基于 NFS 的共享文件系统需求的最佳选择。题目要求多个 AWS 资源通过 NFS 访问；EFS 直接支持此用例的 NFS。
- **C. Amazon S3** 是对象存储，而不是供多个资源使用的 NFS 文件系统端点。选择 S3 无法满足题目中提出的 NFS 协议访问要求。
- **D. Manual OS copy commands** 不太适合必须避免中断的迁移。DataSync 是用于迁移活动数据集并自动执行安全、高速传输的 AWS 托管服务。

en.question: A company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server for its Amazon EC2 instances that have an SMB file share mounted as a volume in the us-east-1 Region. The company has a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes for planned system maintenance or unplanned service disruptions. The company needs to replicate the file system to the us-west-2 Region. The replicated data must not be deleted by any user for 5 years. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us- west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.B: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us-west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.C: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Multi-AZ deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode for a target vault in us- west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.
options.D: Create an FSx for Windows File Server file system in us-east-1 that has a Single-AZ 2 deployment type. Use AWS Backup to create a daily backup plan that includes a backup rule that copies the backup to us-west-2. Configure AWS Backup Vault Lock in governance mode for a target vault in us- west-2. Configure a minimum duration of 5 years.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The file system should use **Multi-AZ** because the workload has a tight RPO for planned maintenance or unplanned service disruptions. AWS recommends Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server for most production workloads, while Single-AZ is for workloads with relaxed availability/RPO needs that can tolerate up to 20 minutes of temporary unavailability and, rarely, data loss since the most recent backup. Multi-AZ file systems automatically fail over for AZ outages, unavailable preferred file servers, and planned maintenance; failover typically completes in less than 30 seconds ([FSx for Windows File Server availability and failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/high-availability-multiAZ.html)).

AWS Backup is suitable for the cross-Region backup copy because FSx for Windows File Server supports **Cross-Region backup**, and backup plans can use **Copy to destination** to store a copy in another AWS Region ([AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html), [Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)).

For the 5-year non-deletion requirement, the target vault must use **AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode**. AWS states that compliance mode is intended for backups that should never be deleted or altered until the retention period is complete, and once locked it cannot be altered or deleted by any user or AWS. Governance mode can still be managed or deleted by users with appropriate IAM permissions ([AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A**: Uses compliance mode, but **Single-AZ 2** does not meet the tight availability/RPO requirement for maintenance or unplanned disruptions.
- **B**: Uses Multi-AZ, but **governance mode** does not satisfy “must not be deleted by any user” because privileged users can manage or delete the vault lock.
- **D**: Wrong on both counts: **Single-AZ 2** is not appropriate for the RPO requirement, and **governance mode** does not provide immutable protection from all users.

Therefore, **Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server + AWS Backup cross-Region copy + Vault Lock compliance mode with a 5-year minimum retention** is the best fit.

zh.question: 一家公司希望为其位于 us-east-1 Region、已将 SMB 文件共享挂载为卷的 Amazon EC2 实例使用 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。该公司针对计划内系统维护或计划外服务中断的恢复点目标 (RPO) 为 5 分钟。该公司需要将文件系统复制到 us-west-2 Region。复制的数据在 5 年内不得被任何用户删除。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统，其部署类型为 Single-AZ 2。使用 AWS Backup 创建每日备份计划，其中包含将备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us- west-2 中的目标保管库配置合规模式的 AWS Backup Vault Lock。配置最短持续时间为 5 年。
options.B: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统，其部署类型为 Multi-AZ。使用 AWS Backup 创建每日备份计划，其中包含将备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us-west-2 中的目标保管库配置治理模式的 AWS Backup Vault Lock。配置最短持续时间为 5 年。
options.C: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统，其部署类型为 Multi-AZ。使用 AWS Backup 创建每日备份计划，其中包含将备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us- west-2 中的目标保管库配置合规模式的 AWS Backup Vault Lock。配置最短持续时间为 5 年。
options.D: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统，其部署类型为 Single-AZ 2。使用 AWS Backup 创建每日备份计划，其中包含将备份复制到 us-west-2 的备份规则。为 us- west-2 中的目标保管库配置治理模式的 AWS Backup Vault Lock。配置最短持续时间为 5 年。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

文件系统应使用 **Multi-AZ**，因为该工作负载对于计划内维护或计划外服务中断有严格的 RPO。AWS 建议大多数生产工作负载使用 Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server，而 Single-AZ 适用于可用性/RPO 需求较宽松的工作负载，这类工作负载可以容忍最多 20 分钟的临时不可用，并且在极少数情况下可能会丢失自最近一次备份以来的数据。Multi-AZ 文件系统会在 AZ 中断、首选文件服务器不可用以及计划内维护时自动故障转移；故障转移通常在 30 秒内完成（[FSx for Windows File Server availability and failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/high-availability-multiAZ.html)）。

AWS Backup 适合用于跨 Region 备份副本，因为 FSx for Windows File Server 支持 **Cross-Region backup**，并且备份计划可以使用 **Copy to destination** 将副本存储到另一个 AWS Region（[AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)，[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。对于 5 年不得删除的要求，目标保管库必须使用 **AWS Backup Vault Lock in compliance mode**。AWS 表示，合规模式适用于在保留期结束前绝不应被删除或更改的备份；一旦锁定，任何用户或 AWS 都无法更改或删除它。治理模式仍可由拥有相应 IAM 权限的用户管理或删除（[AWS Backup Vault Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vault-lock.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A**：使用了合规模式，但 **Single-AZ 2** 不满足维护或计划外中断场景下严格的可用性/RPO 要求。
- **B**：使用了 Multi-AZ，但 **governance mode** 不满足“不得被任何用户删除”的要求，因为特权用户可以管理或删除 vault lock。
- **D**：两个方面都错误：**Single-AZ 2** 不适合该 RPO 要求，并且 **governance mode** 不能提供防止所有用户删除的不可变保护。因此，**Multi-AZ FSx for Windows File Server + AWS Backup cross-Region copy + Vault Lock compliance mode with a 5-year minimum retention** 是最合适的方案。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a security solution for a company that wants to provide developers with individual AWS accounts through AWS Organizations, while also maintaining standard security controls. Because the individual developers will have AWS account root user-level access to their own accounts, the solutions architect wants to ensure that the mandatory AWS CloudTrail configuration that is applied to new developer accounts is not modified. Which action meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM policy that prohibits changes to CloudTrail. and attach it to the root user.
options.B: Create a new trail in CloudTrail from within the developer accounts with the organization trails option enabled.
options.C: Create a service control policy (SCP) that prohibits changes to CloudTrail, and attach it the developer accounts.
options.D: Create a service-linked role for CloudTrail with a policy condition that allows changes only from an Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the management account.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A **service control policy (SCP)** is the right organization-level guardrail. AWS Organizations documentation states that SCPs specify the maximum available permissions for principals in member accounts, and that an SCP restricts permissions in member accounts **including the member account root user**. It also states that SCPs affect all users and roles in attached accounts, **including the root user**. Therefore, an SCP with explicit denies for CloudTrail modification actions can prevent developers—even with root user-level access in their own member accounts—from changing the mandatory CloudTrail configuration. See [Service control policies (SCPs) - AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect.** You cannot attach identity-based IAM policies to the AWS account root user. IAM documentation says, “You cannot attach identity-based policies to the root user,” while root users in AWS Organizations member accounts are affected by SCPs. See [Policies and permissions in AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html).
- **B is incorrect.** An organization trail is created or managed by the organization management account or a delegated administrator, not from ordinary developer member accounts. CloudTrail documentation states that you must sign in with the management account or a delegated administrator account to create an organization trail. See [Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html).
- **D is incorrect.** A CloudTrail service-linked role is for CloudTrail to perform organization-trail tasks, not for restricting developers’ user actions. CloudTrail creates this role automatically for organization trails, and AWS documentation says CloudTrail does not allow you to edit the `AWSServiceRoleForCloudTrail` service-linked role. See [Using roles for creating and managing CloudTrail organization trails and CloudTrail Lake organization event data stores in CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/using-service-linked-roles-create-slr-for-org-trails.html).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一家公司设计安全解决方案。该公司希望通过 AWS Organizations 为开发人员提供个人 AWS 账户，同时也保持标准安全控制。由于各个开发人员将拥有其自己账户的 AWS 账户根用户级别访问权限，解决方案架构师希望确保应用于新开发人员账户的强制性 AWS CloudTrail 配置不会被修改。哪项操作满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个禁止更改 CloudTrail 的 IAM policy，并将其附加到根用户。
options.B: 在开发人员账户内创建一个新的 CloudTrail trail，并启用组织 trail 选项。
options.C: 创建一个禁止更改 CloudTrail 的 service control policy (SCP)，并将其附加到开发人员账户。
options.D: 为 CloudTrail 创建一个 service-linked role，并使用 policy condition 仅允许来自管理账户中 Amazon Resource Name (ARN) 的更改。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

**service control policy (SCP)** 是正确的组织级 guardrail。AWS Organizations 文档说明，SCP 指定成员账户中主体可用权限的上限，并且 SCP 会限制成员账户中的权限，**包括成员账户根用户**。文档还说明，SCP 会影响所附加账户中的所有用户和角色，**包括根用户**。因此，带有针对 CloudTrail 修改操作的显式拒绝的 SCP，可以防止开发人员——即使他们在自己的成员账户中拥有根用户级别访问权限——更改强制性的 CloudTrail 配置。请参阅 [Service control policies (SCPs) - AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A 错误。** 你不能将基于身份的 IAM policies 附加到 AWS 账户根用户。IAM 文档说明：“You cannot attach identity-based policies to the root user,” 而 AWS Organizations 成员账户中的根用户会受 SCP 影响。请参阅 [Policies and permissions in AWS Identity and Access Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)。
- **B 错误。** 组织 trail 由组织管理账户或委派管理员创建或管理，而不是由普通开发人员成员账户创建或管理。CloudTrail 文档说明，你必须使用管理账户或委派管理员账户登录，才能创建组织 trail。请参阅 [Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html)。
- **D 错误。** CloudTrail service-linked role 用于让 CloudTrail 执行组织 trail 任务，而不是用于限制开发人员的用户操作。CloudTrail 会为组织 trail 自动创建此角色，并且 AWS 文档说明 CloudTrail 不允许你编辑 `AWSServiceRoleForCloudTrail` service-linked role。请参阅 [Using roles for creating and managing CloudTrail organization trails and CloudTrail Lake organization event data stores in CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/using-service-linked-roles-create-slr-for-org-trails.html)。

en.question: A company is planning to deploy a business-critical application in the AWS Cloud. The application requires durable storage with consistent, low-latency performance. Which type of storage should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Instance store volume
options.B: Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster
options.C: Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
options.D: Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon EBS volume**

Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes are specifically described by AWS as the **highest performance Amazon EBS storage volumes** for **critical**, IOPS-intensive workloads that **require low latency**, and they deliver provisioned IOPS performance 99.9% of the time. For `io2` Block Express, AWS also states it is designed for **highest durability**, **lowest latency**, and mission-critical workloads, with 99.999% volume durability and consistent sub-millisecond latency characteristics. This directly matches the requirement for durable storage with consistent, low-latency performance. [Amazon EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/provisioned-iops.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Instance store volume** — Instance store is not suitable for durable, business-critical storage. AWS states an instance store volume exists only for the lifetime of the instance and data does not persist when the instance is stopped, hibernated, or terminated; AWS explicitly says not to rely on instance store volumes for valuable, long-term data. [Data persistence for Amazon EC2 instance store volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)
- **B. Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster** — ElastiCache for Memcached is a caching service, not durable block storage for an application’s primary persistent data. AWS documentation describes ElastiCache as supporting caching engines such as Memcached, not as durable storage. [What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)
- **D. Throughput Optimized HDD EBS volume** — Throughput Optimized HDD (`st1`) is optimized for **large streaming workloads** where the dominant performance attribute is throughput, with use cases such as big data, data warehouses, and log processing. It is not the best fit for consistent low-latency IOPS performance. [Amazon EBS volume types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types.html)

zh.question: 一家公司计划在 AWS Cloud 中部署一个业务关键型应用程序。该应用程序需要具有一致、低延迟性能的持久存储。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种类型的存储来满足这些要求？

options.A: Instance store volume
options.B: Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster
options.C: Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume
options.D: Throughput Optimized HDD Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Provisioned IOPS SSD Amazon EBS volume**

AWS 明确将 Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes 描述为面向**关键**、IOPS 密集型且**需要低延迟**的工作负载的**最高性能 Amazon EBS storage volumes**，并且在 99.9% 的时间内提供预置 IOPS 性能。对于 `io2` Block Express，AWS 还说明它专为**最高持久性**、**最低延迟**和任务关键型工作负载而设计，具有 99.999% 的卷持久性以及一致的亚毫秒级延迟特性。这直接符合对具有一致、低延迟性能的持久存储的要求。[Amazon EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/provisioned-iops.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Instance store volume** — Instance store 不适合用于持久的业务关键型存储。AWS 说明，instance store volume 仅在实例的生命周期内存在，并且当实例停止、休眠或终止时，数据不会保留；AWS 明确表示不要依赖 instance store volumes 来保存有价值的长期数据。[Data persistence for Amazon EC2 instance store volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)
- **B. Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster** — ElastiCache for Memcached 是一种缓存服务，并不是用于应用程序主要持久数据的持久块存储。AWS 文档将 ElastiCache 描述为支持 Memcached 等缓存引擎，而不是持久存储。[What is Amazon ElastiCache?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.html)
- **D. Throughput Optimized HDD EBS volume** — Throughput Optimized HDD (`st1`) 针对**大型流式工作负载**进行了优化，在这些工作负载中主要的性能属性是吞吐量，使用场景包括大数据、数据仓库和日志处理。它并不是实现一致低延迟 IOPS 性能的最佳选择。[Amazon EBS volume types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volume-types.html)

en.question: An online photo-sharing company stores its photos in an Amazon S3 bucket that exists in the us-west-1 Region. The company needs to store a copy of all new photos in the us-east-1 Region. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) configuration of the existing S3 bucket. Specify us- east-1 in the CORS rule's AllowedOrigin element.
options.C: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1 across multiple Availability Zones. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to save photos into the second S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a second S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure S3 event notifications on object creation and update events to invoke an AWS Lambda function to copy photos from the existing S3 bucket to the second S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) is the managed S3 feature designed to copy objects between buckets in **different AWS Regions**. AWS states that S3 replication can keep object copies stored across multiple Regions, and specifically that **CRR is used to copy objects across Amazon S3 buckets in different AWS Regions**. For live replication, CRR supports replicating objects between different AWS Regions, including new objects written to S3, with minimal operational effort compared with custom code ([S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** CORS is for permitting cross-origin browser access to an S3 bucket, not for copying objects to another Region. The S3 CORS documentation describes CORS as enabling cross-origin bucket access through allowed origins and methods, not replication ([S3 CORS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cors.html)).
- **C:** S3 Lifecycle rules transition or expire objects over time; they are not used to copy objects into another bucket in another Region. AWS describes S3 Lifecycle transitions as moving objects between storage classes, not between buckets ([S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)). Also, S3 buckets are regional and already store data across multiple Availability Zones by default, so “create a bucket across multiple AZs” is not a separate configuration needed here.
- **D:** S3 event notifications can invoke Lambda for object events, but this requires building, securing, monitoring, and maintaining custom copy logic. AWS documents event notifications as a way to send events to destinations such as Lambda, whereas CRR is the native managed feature for cross-Region object replication ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).

zh.question: 一家在线照片分享公司将其照片存储在位于 us-west-1 Region 的 Amazon S3 bucket 中。该公司需要在 us-east-1 Region 中存储所有新照片的副本。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营工作量满足此要求？

options.A: 在 us-east-1 中创建第二个 S3 bucket。使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication 将照片从现有 S3 bucket 复制到第二个 S3 bucket。
options.B: 为现有 S3 bucket 创建跨源资源共享 (CORS) 配置。在 CORS 规则的 AllowedOrigin 元素中指定 us- east-1。
options.C: 在 us-east-1 中跨多个 Availability Zones 创建第二个 S3 bucket。创建 S3 Lifecycle 规则以将照片保存到第二个 S3 bucket 中。
options.D: 在 us-east-1 中创建第二个 S3 bucket。在对象创建和更新事件上配置 S3 event notifications，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数将照片从现有 S3 bucket 复制到第二个 S3 bucket。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 是一项托管的 S3 功能，旨在在**不同 AWS Regions** 中的 bucket 之间复制对象。AWS 表示，S3 replication 可以在多个 Regions 中保留对象副本，并且明确指出 **CRR 用于在不同 AWS Regions 中的 Amazon S3 bucket 之间复制对象**。对于实时复制，CRR 支持在不同 AWS Regions 之间复制对象，包括写入 S3 的新对象，与自定义代码相比运营工作量最少（[S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **B:** CORS 用于允许浏览器跨源访问 S3 bucket，而不是用于将对象复制到另一个 Region。S3 CORS 文档将 CORS 描述为通过允许的源和方法启用跨源 bucket 访问，而不是复制（[S3 CORS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/cors.html)）。
- **C:** S3 Lifecycle 规则会随时间转换对象的存储类或使对象过期；它们不用于将对象复制到另一个 Region 中的另一个 bucket。AWS 将 S3 Lifecycle 转换描述为在存储类之间移动对象，而不是在 bucket 之间移动对象（[S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)）。此外，S3 bucket 是区域级的，并且默认已经跨多个 Availability Zones 存储数据，因此“跨多个 AZs 创建 bucket”在此处并不是需要的单独配置。
- **D:** S3 event notifications 可以针对对象事件调用 Lambda，但这需要构建、保护、监控和维护自定义复制逻辑。AWS 文档将 event notifications 描述为一种将事件发送到 Lambda 等目标的方式，而 CRR 是用于跨 Region 对象复制的原生托管功能（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。

en.question: A company is creating a new web application for its subscribers. The application will consist of a static single page and a persistent database layer. The application will have millions of users for 4 hours in the morning, but the application will have only a few thousand users during the rest of the day. The company's data architects have requested the ability to rapidly evolve their schema. Which solutions will meet these requirements and provide the MOST scalability? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Provision on-demand capacity.
options.B: Deploy Amazon Aurora as the database solution. Choose the serverless DB engine mode.
options.C: Deploy Amazon DynamoDB as the database solution. Ensure that DynamoDB auto scaling is enabled.
options.D: Deploy the static content into an Amazon S3 bucket. Provision an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin.
options.E: Deploy the web servers for static content across a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups. Configure the instances to periodically refresh the content from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and D.**

- **A. DynamoDB with on-demand capacity** is the best database choice for the most scalability and rapid schema evolution. DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database that supports key-value and document data models, which provides more flexibility than a traditional relational schema. AWS states that DynamoDB is built for consistent performance at any scale and can serve applications with “100 or 100 million users.” Its on-demand capacity mode “instantly scales up or down” with zero administration and can instantly accommodate up to double the previous peak traffic, making it well suited for the short daily surge to millions of users. ([DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html), [DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html))
- **D. S3 with CloudFront** is the best static content solution. AWS documents that Amazon S3 can host static websites, and a CloudFront distribution with an S3 origin serves cached objects from CloudFront edge locations; only cache misses go back to S3. This is more scalable and operationally efficient for a static single-page application than running web servers. ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [CloudFront secure static website overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/getting-started-secure-static-website-cloudformation-template.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Aurora Serverless** can scale database capacity for variable workloads, but Aurora is a relational database engine. The question emphasizes rapid schema evolution and **most** scalability; DynamoDB’s NoSQL model and documented at-scale performance are a better fit. ([Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html), [DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html))
- **C. DynamoDB with auto scaling** is scalable, but it is for **provisioned** throughput. AWS states that auto scaling changes provisioned throughput only after workload changes remain elevated or depressed for several minutes, based on CloudWatch alarms and scaling policies. On-demand capacity is a better match for the most scalable handling of sharp usage changes. ([DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html), [DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html))
- **E. EC2 Auto Scaling with EFS** adds server fleet management and content synchronization for a static page. S3 plus CloudFront is the managed static-content pattern and serves cached content from edge locations, so it provides greater scalability with less operational overhead. ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [CloudFront secure static website overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/getting-started-secure-static-website-cloudformation-template.html))

zh.question: 一家公司正在为其订阅用户创建一个新的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序将包含一个静态单页和一个持久数据库层。该应用程序在早晨 4 小时内将有数百万用户，但在一天中的其余时间只有几千用户。公司的数据架构师要求能够快速演进其架构。哪些解决方案将满足这些要求并提供最高的可扩展性？（选择两个。）

options.A: 部署 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库解决方案。预置按需容量。
options.B: 部署 Amazon Aurora 作为数据库解决方案。选择 serverless DB 引擎模式。
options.C: 部署 Amazon DynamoDB 作为数据库解决方案。确保启用 DynamoDB auto scaling。
options.D: 将静态内容部署到 Amazon S3 bucket 中。预置一个以该 S3 bucket 作为源站的 Amazon CloudFront distribution。
options.E: 在 Auto Scaling groups 中跨一组 Amazon EC2 实例部署用于静态内容的 Web 服务器。配置这些实例定期从 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷刷新内容。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 D。**

- **A. 使用按需容量的 DynamoDB** 是实现最高可扩展性和快速架构演进的最佳数据库选择。DynamoDB 是一种完全托管的 NoSQL 数据库，支持键值和文档数据模型，这比传统关系型架构提供了更高的灵活性。AWS 表示，DynamoDB 旨在在任何规模下都提供一致性能，并且可以为拥有“100 or 100 million users”的应用程序提供服务。其按需容量模式可以在零管理的情况下“instantly scales up or down”，并且可以立即容纳高达先前峰值流量两倍的流量，因此非常适合每天短时间激增到数百万用户的场景。([DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html), [DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html))
- **D. S3 与 CloudFront** 是最佳静态内容解决方案。AWS 文档说明 Amazon S3 可以托管静态网站，并且以 S3 为源站的 CloudFront distribution 会从 CloudFront 边缘站点提供缓存对象；只有缓存未命中才会返回 S3。对于静态单页应用程序而言，这比运行 Web 服务器更具可扩展性且运营效率更高。([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [CloudFront secure static website overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/getting-started-secure-static-website-cloudformation-template.html))

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. Aurora Serverless** 可以针对可变工作负载扩展数据库容量，但 Aurora 是关系型数据库引擎。题目强调快速架构演进和**最高**可扩展性；DynamoDB 的 NoSQL 模型以及文档中说明的大规模性能更适合。([Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html), [DynamoDB introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html))
- **C. 使用 auto scaling 的 DynamoDB** 具有可扩展性，但它适用于**预置**吞吐量。AWS 表示，auto scaling 只有在工作负载变化基于 CloudWatch 警报和扩展策略持续升高或降低数分钟后，才会更改预置吞吐量。按需容量更适合以最高可扩展性处理剧烈的使用量变化。([DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html), [DynamoDB on-demand capacity mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/on-demand-capacity-mode.html))
- **E. 使用 EFS 的 EC2 Auto Scaling** 会为静态页面增加服务器队列管理和内容同步。S3 加 CloudFront 是托管式静态内容模式，并且从边缘站点提供缓存内容，因此它能以更少的运营开销提供更高的可扩展性。([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html), [CloudFront secure static website overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/getting-started-secure-static-website-cloudformation-template.html))

en.question: A company uses Amazon API Gateway to manage its REST APIs that third-party service providers access. The company must protect the REST APIs from SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Shield.
options.B: Configure AWS WAF.
options.C: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS Shield in CloudFront.
options.D: Set up API Gateway with an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure AWS WAF in CloudFront.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Configure AWS WAF.**

AWS WAF is specifically designed to inspect HTTP/HTTPS web requests and protect web applications from common web attacks. The AWS WAF documentation lists **Amazon API Gateway REST API** as a resource type that AWS WAF can protect, and it explicitly includes detection criteria for the **presence of SQL code likely to be malicious (SQL injection)** and the **presence of malicious scripts (cross-site scripting)**. Therefore, directly associating an AWS WAF web ACL with the API Gateway REST API is the most operationally efficient solution because it meets the requirement without adding unnecessary services. [AWS WAF overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html) [Resources protected by AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Configure AWS Shield** — AWS Shield Advanced is for DDoS protection, including network/transport layer and application-layer DDoS attacks. It is not the service intended to inspect requests for SQL injection or cross-site scripting patterns. [AWS WAF/Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)
- **C. Set up API Gateway with CloudFront and configure AWS Shield in CloudFront** — This still uses Shield, which does not address the SQL injection/XSS requirement. Adding CloudFront also increases operational complexity unnecessarily.
- **D. Set up API Gateway with CloudFront and configure AWS WAF in CloudFront** — AWS WAF can be associated with CloudFront distributions, but AWS documentation also supports protecting **API Gateway REST APIs directly** as regional resources. Since the question only requires protecting existing REST APIs from SQL injection and XSS, adding a CloudFront distribution is unnecessary and less operationally efficient than configuring AWS WAF directly on API Gateway. [Resources protected by AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 来管理其 REST APIs，供第三方服务提供商访问。该公司必须保护这些 REST APIs 免受 SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击。哪种解决方案在满足这些要求的同时具有最高的运营效率？

options.A: 配置 AWS Shield。
options.B: 配置 AWS WAF。
options.C: 将 API Gateway 与 Amazon CloudFront 分配一起设置。在 CloudFront 中配置 AWS Shield。
options.D: 将 API Gateway 与 Amazon CloudFront 分配一起设置。在 CloudFront 中配置 AWS WAF。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 配置 AWS WAF。**

AWS WAF 专门用于检查 HTTP/HTTPS Web 请求，并保护 Web 应用程序免受常见 Web 攻击。AWS WAF 文档将 **Amazon API Gateway REST API** 列为 AWS WAF 可以保护的资源类型，并且明确包含对**可能具有恶意的 SQL 代码的存在（SQL 注入）**以及**恶意脚本的存在（跨站脚本）**的检测条件。因此，直接将 AWS WAF web ACL 与 API Gateway REST API 关联是运营效率最高的解决方案，因为它在不添加不必要服务的情况下满足要求。[AWS WAF overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html) [Resources protected by AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Configure AWS Shield** — AWS Shield Advanced 用于 DDoS 防护，包括网络/传输层和应用层 DDoS 攻击。它不是用于检查请求中 SQL 注入或跨站脚本模式的服务。[AWS WAF/Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)
- **C. Set up API Gateway with CloudFront and configure AWS Shield in CloudFront** — 这仍然使用 Shield，而 Shield 无法满足 SQL 注入/XSS 的要求。添加 CloudFront 还会不必要地增加运营复杂性。
- **D. Set up API Gateway with CloudFront and configure AWS WAF in CloudFront** — AWS WAF 可以与 CloudFront 分配关联，但 AWS 文档也支持将 **API Gateway REST APIs 直接**作为区域资源进行保护。由于题目只要求保护现有 REST APIs 免受 SQL 注入和 XSS 攻击，因此添加 CloudFront 分配是不必要的，并且比直接在 API Gateway 上配置 AWS WAF 的运营效率更低。[Resources protected by AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)

en.question: A company wants to provide users with access to AWS resources. The company has 1,500 users and manages their access to on-premises resources through Active Directory user groups on the corporate network. However, the company does not want users to have to maintain another identity to access the resources. A solutions architect must manage user access to the AWS resources while preserving access to the on-premises resources. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM user for each user in the company. Attach the appropriate policies to each user.
options.B: Use Amazon Cognito with an Active Directory user pool. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached.
options.C: Define cross-account roles with the appropriate policies attached. Map the roles to the Active Directory groups.
options.D: Configure Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2 0-based federation. Create roles with the appropriate policies attached Map the roles to the Active Directory groups.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Configure SAML 2.0-based federation, create IAM roles with appropriate policies, and map the roles to Active Directory groups.**

The company wants its 1,500 existing corporate Active Directory users to access AWS resources without maintaining separate AWS identities. AWS IAM supports this pattern with **SAML 2.0 federation**: the organization uses a SAML 2.0 identity provider such as **Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS)**, creates an IAM SAML identity provider, creates IAM roles whose permission policies define what users can do, and then maps users or groups in the organization to those IAM roles. AWS documentation explicitly says that in the organization's IdP, you define assertions that **map users or groups to IAM roles**, and different groups can map to different roles ([SAML 2.0 federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_saml.html)). This also follows IAM best practice: human users should use federation with an identity provider and assume roles that provide temporary credentials, rather than using long-term IAM user credentials ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create an IAM user for each user** — This creates and manages another identity for every employee, directly violating the requirement. AWS recommends using IAM users only for use cases not supported by identity federation ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)).
- **B. Use Amazon Cognito with an Active Directory user pool** — Amazon Cognito user pools are primarily user directories for **web and mobile app authentication and authorization**, not the standard solution for workforce access to AWS accounts and AWS resources through IAM roles ([Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)). The requirement is corporate AWS resource access integrated with existing AD groups, which IAM SAML federation addresses directly.
- **C. Define cross-account roles** — Cross-account roles are for granting access between AWS accounts. They do not by themselves federate on-premises Active Directory identities or map AD groups to AWS access. The needed mechanism is a SAML IdP trust and SAML assertions to IAM roles.

Therefore, **D** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司希望为用户提供对 AWS 资源的访问权限。该公司有 1,500 名用户，并通过公司网络上的 Active Directory 用户组管理他们对本地资源的访问权限。但是，公司不希望用户为了访问这些资源而维护另一个身份。解决方案架构师必须在保留对本地资源访问权限的同时，管理用户对 AWS 资源的访问权限。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 为公司中的每个用户创建一个 IAM 用户。将适当的策略附加到每个用户。
options.B: 将 Amazon Cognito 与 Active Directory 用户池结合使用。创建附加了适当策略的角色。
options.C: 定义附加了适当策略的跨账户角色。将这些角色映射到 Active Directory 组。
options.D: 配置基于 Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 2 0 的联合身份验证。创建附加了适当策略的角色。将这些角色映射到 Active Directory 组。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。配置基于 SAML 2.0 的联合身份验证，创建具有适当策略的 IAM 角色，并将这些角色映射到 Active Directory 组。**

该公司希望其 1,500 名现有企业 Active Directory 用户能够访问 AWS 资源，而无需维护单独的 AWS 身份。AWS IAM 通过 **SAML 2.0 federation** 支持这种模式：组织使用一个 SAML 2.0 身份提供商，例如 **Microsoft Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS)**，创建一个 IAM SAML 身份提供商，创建 IAM 角色并通过其权限策略定义用户可以执行的操作，然后将组织中的用户或组映射到这些 IAM 角色。AWS 文档明确说明，在组织的 IdP 中，你可以定义断言来**将用户或组映射到 IAM 角色**，并且不同的组可以映射到不同的角色（[SAML 2.0 federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_saml.html)）。这也符合 IAM 最佳实践：人类用户应使用与身份提供商的联合身份验证，并代入提供临时凭证的角色，而不是使用长期 IAM 用户凭证（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 为每个用户创建一个 IAM 用户** — 这会为每名员工创建并管理另一个身份，直接违反了要求。AWS 建议仅在身份联合不支持的用例中使用 IAM 用户（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)）。
- **B. 将 Amazon Cognito 与 Active Directory 用户池结合使用** — Amazon Cognito 用户池主要是用于 **Web 和移动应用程序身份验证和授权**的用户目录，并不是通过 IAM 角色为员工提供对 AWS 账户和 AWS 资源访问权限的标准解决方案（[Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)）。要求是与现有 AD 组集成的企业 AWS 资源访问，而 IAM SAML federation 可以直接满足这一要求。
- **C. 定义跨账户角色** — 跨账户角色用于在 AWS 账户之间授予访问权限。它们本身不会联合本地 Active Directory 身份，也不会将 AD 组映射到 AWS 访问权限。所需机制是 SAML IdP 信任以及到 IAM 角色的 SAML 断言。因此，**D** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company is hosting a website behind multiple Application Load Balancers. The company has different distribution rights for its content around the world. A solutions architect needs to ensure that users are served the correct content without violating distribution rights. Which configuration should the solutions architect choose to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon CloudFront with AWS WAF.
options.B: Configure Application Load Balancers with AWS WAF
options.C: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation policy
options.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geoproximity routing policy

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation policy.**

Route 53 **geolocation routing** is designed to choose resources based on the geographic location of users. AWS explicitly states that geolocation routing can be used “to restrict distribution of content to only the locations in which you have distribution rights” and can route users from specific continents, countries, or US states to different resources such as load balancers ([Route 53 geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html)). Because the website is behind **multiple Application Load Balancers** and users must receive region-appropriate content, geolocation DNS records are the best fit.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudFront with AWS WAF** – CloudFront has a separate **geographic restrictions** feature that can block or allow countries, but the option specifies CloudFront with AWS WAF, not CloudFront geographic restrictions. Also, the requirement is to route users to the correct content behind multiple ALBs, not simply block access. CloudFront geo restrictions are mainly for preventing access to content in specific countries ([CloudFront geographic restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/georestrictions.html)).
- **B. Application Load Balancers with AWS WAF** – AWS WAF can protect ALBs and control access to web content based on request criteria, but this does not provide DNS-level routing of users to different ALBs based on distribution-right geography ([AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-chapter.html)).
- **D. Route 53 geoproximity routing policy** – Geoproximity routing sends traffic based on the locations of users **and resources**, routing to the closest available resource and optionally using bias ([Route 53 geoproximity routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geoproximity.html)). That is for proximity-based traffic steering, not explicit distribution-right boundaries by country/region.

Therefore, **Route 53 geolocation routing** is the configuration that directly matches the requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在多个 Application Load Balancers 后面托管一个网站。该公司在全球不同地区拥有不同的内容分发权。解决方案架构师需要确保用户获得正确的内容，同时不违反分发权。解决方案架构师应选择哪种配置来满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置带有 AWS WAF 的 Amazon CloudFront。
options.B: 配置带有 AWS WAF 的 Application Load Balancers
options.C: 配置带有地理位置策略的 Amazon Route 53
options.D: 配置带有地理邻近路由策略的 Amazon Route 53

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Configure Amazon Route 53 with a geolocation policy.**

Route 53 **geolocation routing** 旨在根据用户的地理位置选择资源。AWS 明确说明，geolocation routing 可用于“to restrict distribution of content to only the locations in which you have distribution rights”，并且可以将来自特定洲、国家/地区或美国州的用户路由到不同资源，例如负载均衡器（[Route 53 geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html)）。由于该网站位于 **multiple Application Load Balancers** 后面，并且用户必须接收适合其区域的内容，因此 geolocation DNS 记录最为合适。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. CloudFront with AWS WAF** – CloudFront 有一个单独的 **geographic restrictions** 功能，可以阻止或允许国家/地区，但该选项指定的是 CloudFront with AWS WAF，而不是 CloudFront geographic restrictions。此外，需求是将用户路由到多个 ALB 后面的正确内容，而不仅仅是阻止访问。CloudFront geo restrictions 主要用于防止特定国家/地区访问内容（[CloudFront geographic restrictions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/georestrictions.html)）。
- **B. Application Load Balancers with AWS WAF** – AWS WAF 可以保护 ALB，并根据请求条件控制对 Web 内容的访问，但这不能提供基于分发权地理范围将用户以 DNS 级别路由到不同 ALB 的能力（[AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-chapter.html)）。
- **D. Route 53 geoproximity routing policy** – Geoproximity routing 根据用户**和资源**的位置发送流量，将流量路由到最近的可用资源，并可选择使用偏置（[Route 53 geoproximity routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geoproximity.html)）。这适用于基于邻近性的流量引导，而不是按国家/地区或区域明确划定分发权边界。因此，**Route 53 geolocation routing** 是直接符合该需求的配置。

en.question: A company stores its data on premises. The amount of data is growing beyond the company's available capacity. The company wants to migrate its data from the on-premises location to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs a solution that will automatically validate the integrity of the data after the transfer. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Order an AWS Snowball Edge device. Configure the Snowball Edge device to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket
options.B: Deploy an AWS DataSync agent on premises. Configure the DataSync agent to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises Configure the S3 File Gateway to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket
options.D: Configure an accelerator in Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration on premises. Configure the accelerator to perform the online data transfer to an S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS DataSync is designed to migrate on-premises datasets over the network into AWS storage services, and the AWS documentation states that DataSync includes **automatic encryption and data integrity validation** to ensure data arrives intact. For verification, DataSync can calculate checksums at the source and, at the end of the transfer, compare them with checksums at the destination; it also offers an option to verify that the source and destination are fully synchronized after transfer ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [Configuring how AWS DataSync verifies data integrity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-data-verification-options.html)). Therefore, deploying a DataSync agent on premises and configuring it to transfer to S3 meets both the migration and automatic integrity-validation requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Snowball Edge is primarily for physical/offline import/export; AWS describes physically transporting data between local environments and Amazon S3 without using the internet. The option also incorrectly describes it as an online transfer solution, and it is not the best fit for automatic post-transfer validation in an online migration ([What is Snowball Edge?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)).
- **C:** Amazon S3 File Gateway provides an NFS/SMB file interface to S3 and local caching for applications, but it is not the migration service specifically called out for automatic end-to-end data integrity validation after transfer ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **D:** S3 Transfer Acceleration improves upload performance to S3 over long distances by using accelerated endpoints, but the cited S3 documentation describes speed/endpoint requirements, not automatic integrity validation after a migration ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将其数据存储在本地。数据量的增长已经超出了公司的可用容量。公司希望将其数据从本地位置迁移到一个 Amazon S3 bucket。公司需要一个解决方案，在传输后自动验证数据的完整性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 订购一台 AWS Snowball Edge 设备。配置 Snowball Edge 设备执行到 S3 bucket 的在线数据传输
options.B: 在本地部署 AWS DataSync agent。配置 DataSync agent 执行到 S3 bucket 的在线数据传输。
options.C: 在本地创建一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway 配置 S3 File Gateway 执行到 S3 bucket 的在线数据传输
options.D: 在本地配置 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 中的加速器。配置该加速器执行到 S3 bucket 的在线数据传输。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS DataSync 旨在通过网络将本地数据集迁移到 AWS 存储服务中，并且 AWS 文档说明 DataSync 包含**自动加密和数据完整性验证**，以确保数据完整到达。对于验证，DataSync 可以在源端计算校验和，并在传输结束时将其与目标端的校验和进行比较；它还提供一个选项，用于验证传输后源端和目标端是否已完全同步（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html), [Configuring how AWS DataSync verifies data integrity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-data-verification-options.html)）。因此，在本地部署 DataSync agent 并将其配置为传输到 S3，同时满足迁移和自动完整性验证要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Snowball Edge 主要用于物理/离线导入/导出；AWS 将其描述为在本地环境和 Amazon S3 之间物理运输数据，而不使用互联网。该选项还错误地将其描述为在线传输解决方案，并且它并不是在线迁移中自动传输后验证的最佳选择（[What is Snowball Edge?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon S3 File Gateway 为 S3 提供 NFS/SMB 文件接口，并为应用程序提供本地缓存，但它并不是专门用于传输后自动端到端数据完整性验证的迁移服务（[What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Transfer Acceleration 通过使用加速端点来提升远距离上传到 S3 的性能，但引用的 S3 文档描述的是速度/端点要求，而不是迁移后的自动完整性验证（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to migrate two DNS servers to AWS. The servers host a total of approximately 200 zones and receive 1 million requests each day on average. The company wants to maximize availability while minimizing the operational overhead that is related to the management of the two servers.
