Therefore it does not satisfy the requirement for both NFS and SMB ([FSx for OpenZFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/OpenZFSGuide/what-is-fsx.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用本地网络附加存储 (NAS) 系统为其高性能计算 (HPC) 工作负载提供文件共享。该公司希望将其对延迟敏感的 HPC 工作负载及其存储迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司必须能够从文件系统提供 NFS 和 SMB 多协议访问。哪种解决方案能够以最低延迟满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将计算优化型 EC2 实例部署到集群置放群组中。
options.B: 将计算优化型 EC2 实例部署到分区置放群组中。
options.C: 将 EC2 实例挂载到 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。
options.D: 将 EC2 实例挂载到 Amazon FSx for OpenZFS 文件系统。
options.E: 将 EC2 实例挂载到 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 E**。

- **A. Deploy compute optimized EC2 instances into a cluster placement group** — 正确。对于对延迟敏感的 HPC 工作负载，EC2 集群置放群组专为需要**低网络延迟、高网络吞吐量，或二者兼具**的实例而设计，并将实例放置在高双向带宽的网络段中。这直接满足了计算层“最低延迟”的要求（[AWS EC2 placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。
- **E. Attach the EC2 instances to an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system** — 正确。存储要求是同时具备 **NFS 和 SMB** 的多协议文件访问。FSx for ONTAP 支持使用 **NFS, SMB, iSCSI, and NVMe** 进行多协议访问，并且 AWS 说明可以通过 NFS 和 SMB 从 Linux、Windows 或 macOS 客户端同时访问数据（[FSx for ONTAP features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html)，[how FSx for ONTAP works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/how-it-works-fsx-ontap.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. Partition placement group** — 不正确。分区置放群组用于通过将实例分布到不同机架来减少相关硬件故障，适用于 HDFS、HBase 和 Cassandra 等分布式复制系统。它不是针对最低延迟优化的置放策略（[AWS EC2 placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。
- **C. FSx for Lustre** — 不正确。FSx for Lustre 性能很高，但 AWS 文档说明其访问方式是从 EC2/EKS/ECS 通过**开源 Lustre 客户端**访问，而不是 SMB/NFS 多协议访问。因此它不满足所需的 NFS 和 SMB 访问要求（[FSx for Lustre access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。
- **D. FSx for OpenZFS** — 不正确。FSx for OpenZFS 支持通过 **NFS 协议**访问；其记录的功能列表未提供 SMB 多协议访问。因此它不满足同时需要 NFS 和 SMB 的要求（[FSx for OpenZFS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/OpenZFSGuide/what-is-fsx.html)）。

en.question: A company is relocating its data center and wants to securely transfer 50 TB of data to AWS within 2 weeks. The existing data center has a Site-to-Site VPN connection to AWS that is 90% utilized. Which AWS service should a solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint
options.B: AWS Direct Connect
options.C: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized**

Snowball Edge is the best fit because the company must move **50 TB** quickly while its existing Site-to-Site VPN is already **90% utilized**, making an online transfer risky for the 2-week requirement. AWS describes Snowball Edge as a service for transferring large amounts of data between onsite storage and Amazon S3 at **faster-than-internet speeds**, with devices that secure and protect data during transport and are protected by AWS KMS ([AWS EMR Snowball Edge documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)). The Snowball Edge guide also states that devices can import data between local environments and Amazon S3 by physically transporting devices **without using the internet**, and that encryption is enforced for data at rest and in physical transit ([AWS Snowball Edge Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)). AWS also notes that Snowball is useful when network conditions hinder large transfers and that Storage Optimized Snowball Edge can securely and efficiently migrate bulk data from on-premises platforms ([AWS data ingestion methods whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-data-lakes/data-ingestion-methods.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint** — DataSync is an **online** data transfer service for moving data between on-premises storage and AWS storage ([AWS DataSync documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)). Because the existing VPN is already heavily utilized, relying on online transfer over available network capacity is not the best way to guarantee 50 TB within 2 weeks.
- **B. AWS Direct Connect** — Direct Connect provides dedicated network connectivity, but the question asks what to use to meet an immediate 2-week migration requirement with existing network saturation. Establishing a new dedicated connection is not the most suitable choice compared with an AWS physical transfer service designed for bulk migrations. Direct Connect documentation focuses on ordering and using dedicated connections, not offline bulk seeding ([AWS Direct Connect documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/dedicated_connection.html)).
- **D. AWS Storage Gateway** — Storage Gateway is for hybrid cloud storage access, such as file/volume gateway use cases, not for rapid one-time offline migration of tens of TB when bandwidth is constrained ([AWS Storage Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在迁移其数据中心，并希望在 2 周内将 50 TB 数据安全传输到 AWS。现有数据中心与 AWS 之间有一条 Site-to-Site VPN 连接，利用率已达 90%。解决方案架构师应使用哪项 AWS 服务来满足这些要求？

options.A: AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint
options.B: AWS Direct Connect
options.C: AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized**

Snowball Edge 是最合适的选择，因为该公司必须快速迁移 **50 TB** 数据，而其现有 Site-to-Site VPN 已经 **90% utilized**，这使得在线传输很难保证满足 2 周的要求。AWS 将 Snowball Edge 描述为一种用于在现场存储和 Amazon S3 之间以**快于互联网的速度**传输大量数据的服务，其设备可在传输过程中保护数据并由 AWS KMS 保护（[AWS EMR Snowball Edge documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)）。Snowball Edge 指南还说明，设备可以通过物理运输设备在本地环境和 Amazon S3 之间导入数据，**无需使用互联网**，并且会强制对静态数据和物理运输中的数据进行加密（[AWS Snowball Edge Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。AWS 还指出，当网络条件阻碍大规模传输时，Snowball 很有用，并且 Storage Optimized Snowball Edge 可以安全高效地从本地平台迁移批量数据（[AWS data ingestion methods whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-data-lakes/data-ingestion-methods.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS DataSync with a VPC endpoint** — DataSync 是一种**在线**数据传输服务，用于在本地存储和 AWS 存储之间移动数据（[AWS DataSync documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。由于现有 VPN 已经被大量使用，依赖可用网络容量进行在线传输并不是保证在 2 周内传输 50 TB 的最佳方式。
- **B. AWS Direct Connect** — Direct Connect 提供专用网络连接，但题目问的是在现有网络已接近饱和的情况下，使用什么来满足紧迫的 2 周迁移要求。与专为批量迁移设计的 AWS 物理传输服务相比，建立新的专用连接并不是最合适的选择。Direct Connect 文档侧重于订购和使用专用连接，而不是离线批量播种（[AWS Direct Connect documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/dedicated_connection.html)）。
- **D. AWS Storage Gateway** — Storage Gateway 用于混合云存储访问，例如 file/volume gateway 使用场景；当带宽受限时，它并不适用于数十 TB 数据的快速一次性离线迁移（[AWS Storage Gateway documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts an application on Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group. Application peak hours occur at the same time each day. Application users report slow application performance at the start of peak hours. The application performs normally 2-3 hours after peak hours begin. The company wants to ensure that the application works properly at the start of peak hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic properly to the instances.
options.B: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on memory utilization.
options.C: Configure a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on CPU utilization.
options.D: Configure a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to launch new instances before peak hours.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The workload peak occurs at the same time every day, so the capacity need is predictable. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling uses scheduled actions that perform scaling activities at specific times; at the specified time, Auto Scaling can scale out by adding instances to the specified desired capacity. Scheduled actions can also be configured on a recurring schedule, which fits a daily peak pattern ([Scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)). Launching instances before peak hours ensures capacity is already available when users arrive.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An Application Load Balancer can distribute traffic, but it does not by itself increase EC2 capacity before a predictable surge. The issue is insufficient ready capacity at the start of peak hours.
- **B:** Dynamic scaling based on memory could react after utilization increases, but the requirement is to work properly at the **start** of peak hours. Also, target tracking requires a valid utilization metric that changes proportionally with group capacity ([Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).
- **C:** CPU-based dynamic scaling is a valid reactive scaling metric, but it still responds after demand begins. AWS notes newly launched instances have a warmup period before they are counted in aggregated metrics, which can delay effective scaling ([Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)). Scheduled scaling is better for predictable daily peaks.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 上托管一个应用程序。应用程序的高峰时段每天都在同一时间发生。应用程序用户报告在高峰时段开始时应用程序性能缓慢。高峰时段开始 2-3 小时后，应用程序运行正常。公司希望确保应用程序在高峰时段开始时正常工作。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Application Load Balancer，以将流量正确分配到实例。
options.B: 为 Auto Scaling 组配置动态扩展策略，以根据内存利用率启动新实例。
options.C: 为 Auto Scaling 组配置动态扩展策略，以根据 CPU 利用率启动新实例。
options.D: 为 Auto Scaling 组配置计划扩展策略，以在高峰时段之前启动新实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 工作负载高峰每天都在同一时间发生，因此容量需求是可预测的。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 计划扩展使用计划操作，在特定时间执行扩展活动；在指定时间，Auto Scaling 可以通过向指定的所需容量添加实例来横向扩展。计划操作还可以配置为按重复计划运行，这适合每日高峰模式（[Scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。在高峰时段之前启动实例可确保用户到达时容量已经可用。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** Application Load Balancer 可以分配流量，但它本身不会在可预测的流量激增之前增加 EC2 容量。问题是在高峰时段开始时没有足够的就绪容量。
- **B:** 基于内存的动态扩展可以在利用率增加后做出反应，但要求是在高峰时段**开始**时正常工作。此外，目标跟踪需要一个有效的利用率指标，该指标会随组容量按比例变化（[Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。
- **C:** 基于 CPU 的动态扩展是一个有效的响应式扩展指标，但它仍然是在需求开始后才响应。AWS 指出，新启动的实例在计入聚合指标之前有一个预热期，这可能会延迟有效扩展（[Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。对于可预测的每日高峰，计划扩展更合适。

en.question: A company runs applications on AWS that connect to the company's Amazon RDS database. The applications scale on weekends and at peak times of the year. The company wants to scale the database more effectively for its applications that connect to the database. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon DynamoDB with connection pooling with a target group configuration for the database. Change the applications to use the DynamoDB endpoint.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy with a target group for the database. Change the applications to use the RDS Proxy endpoint.
options.C: Use a custom proxy that runs on Amazon EC2 as an intermediary to the database. Change the applications to use the custom proxy endpoint.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function to provide connection pooling with a target group configuration for the database. Change the applications to use the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon RDS Proxy is designed for this exact problem: AWS says it lets applications “pool and share database connections to improve their ability to scale,” handles unpredictable surges in database traffic, establishes and reuses a database connection pool, and can queue/throttle excess application connections so the application can continue to scale without overwhelming the database ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). AWS also documents that application connections terminate at RDS Proxy while database connections are managed within RDS Proxy, and RDS Proxy target-group settings such as `MaxConnectionsPercent`, `MaxIdleConnectionsPercent`, and `ConnectionBorrowTimeout` control the proxy’s connection pool for the target RDS DB instance ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)). This is the lowest-operational-overhead option because it uses the managed RDS Proxy service rather than building and operating a custom pooling layer.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. DynamoDB with connection pooling** is not appropriate because the company already has an **Amazon RDS** relational database. DynamoDB is a different NoSQL database service; moving applications from RDS to DynamoDB would require a database and application migration, not simply scaling RDS connections. RDS Proxy is the documented RDS feature for pooling and sharing database connections ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)).
- **C. Custom proxy on EC2** could theoretically proxy connections, but it would require provisioning, scaling, patching, monitoring, and making the proxy highly available. That is more operational overhead than using RDS Proxy, which already provides connection pooling and traffic-surge handling for RDS ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)).
- **D. Lambda function for connection pooling** is not the appropriate managed RDS connection-pooling solution. RDS Proxy is the AWS-documented service that terminates client connections and manages database connections and target-group pool settings for RDS ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行的应用程序会连接到该公司的 Amazon RDS 数据库。这些应用程序会在周末以及一年中的高峰时段扩展。该公司希望针对连接到数据库的应用程序，更有效地扩展数据库。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 对数据库使用 Amazon DynamoDB，并通过目标组配置进行连接池化。将应用程序改为使用 DynamoDB 端点。
options.B: 对数据库使用带有目标组的 Amazon RDS Proxy。将应用程序改为使用 RDS Proxy 端点。
options.C: 使用在 Amazon EC2 上运行的自定义代理作为数据库的中介。将应用程序改为使用自定义代理端点。
options.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数通过数据库的目标组配置提供连接池化。将应用程序改为使用该 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon RDS Proxy 正是为解决这个问题而设计的：AWS 表示它允许应用程序“池化并共享数据库连接以提高其扩展能力”，处理数据库流量中不可预测的激增，建立并复用数据库连接池，并且可以对过多的应用程序连接进行排队/限流，使应用程序能够继续扩展而不会压垮数据库（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。AWS 还说明，应用程序连接会终止于 RDS Proxy，而数据库连接则在 RDS Proxy 内部进行管理；RDS Proxy 目标组设置（例如 `MaxConnectionsPercent`、`MaxIdleConnectionsPercent` 和 `ConnectionBorrowTimeout`）用于控制目标 RDS DB 实例的代理连接池（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。这是运营开销最低的选项，因为它使用托管的 RDS Proxy 服务，而不是构建和运行自定义连接池层。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. DynamoDB with connection pooling** 不合适，因为该公司已经拥有一个 **Amazon RDS** 关系数据库。DynamoDB 是另一种 NoSQL 数据库服务；将应用程序从 RDS 迁移到 DynamoDB 需要进行数据库和应用程序迁移，而不是简单地扩展 RDS 连接。RDS Proxy 是文档中用于池化并共享数据库连接的 RDS 功能（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。
- **C. Custom proxy on EC2** 理论上可以代理连接，但它需要预置、扩展、修补、监控，并使该代理具备高可用性。这比使用 RDS Proxy 的运营开销更大，因为 RDS Proxy 已经为 RDS 提供连接池化和流量激增处理能力（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。
- **D. Lambda function for connection pooling** 不是合适的托管 RDS 连接池化解决方案。RDS Proxy 是 AWS 文档中说明的服务，它会终止客户端连接，并管理 RDS 的数据库连接和目标组池设置（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。

en.question: A company uses AWS Cost Explorer to monitor its AWS costs. The company notices that Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage and snapshot costs increase every month. However, the company does not purchase additional EBS storage every month. The company wants to optimize monthly costs for its current storage usage. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs to monitor the storage utilization of Amazon EBS. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.B: Use a custom script to monitor space usage. Use Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes to reduce the size of the EBS volumes.
options.C: Delete all expired and unused snapshots to reduce snapshot costs.
options.D: Delete all nonessential snapshots. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager to create and manage the snapshots according to the company's snapshot policy requirements.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The cost trend is monthly growth in **EBS storage and snapshot costs** without buying more EBS volume capacity, which strongly points to accumulated snapshots and retained snapshot data. AWS states that you can automate the **creation, retention, and deletion** of EBS snapshots with AWS Backup or **Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager**, and that Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager creates lifecycle policies to automate snapshot management for EBS volumes and EC2 instances with no additional charge for the service itself ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/snapshot-lifecycle.html)). Therefore, deleting nonessential snapshots and then using Data Lifecycle Manager to enforce the required snapshot retention policy is the lowest-overhead ongoing solution.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudWatch Logs monitoring of storage utilization does not address the main issue of growing snapshot costs. Also, Elastic Volumes is not a solution for shrinking EBS volumes: AWS describes Elastic Volumes as supporting dynamic **increase** of volume size, increase/decrease of performance, and volume type changes—not reducing volume size ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/requesting-ebs-volume-modifications.html)).
- **B:** A custom script adds operational overhead and still relies on Elastic Volumes to reduce volume size, which is not the appropriate capability. It also does not provide managed snapshot lifecycle control.
- **C:** Deleting expired and unused snapshots can help, and AWS documents that snapshots can be deleted when no longer needed ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-deleting-snapshot.html)). However, this is only a manual/point-in-time cleanup. It does not prevent future monthly snapshot accumulation and therefore does not meet the requirement with the **least operational overhead** compared with automated lifecycle management.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Cost Explorer 监控其 AWS 成本。该公司注意到 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储和快照成本每月都在增加。但是，该公司并没有每月购买额外的 EBS 存储。该公司希望针对其当前存储使用量优化月度成本。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的日志来监控 Amazon EBS 的存储利用率。使用 Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes 减小 EBS 卷的大小。
options.B: 使用自定义脚本监控空间使用情况。使用 Amazon EBS Elastic Volumes 减小 EBS 卷的大小。
options.C: 删除所有已过期和未使用的快照，以降低快照成本。
options.D: 删除所有非必要快照。使用 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 根据公司的快照策略要求创建和管理快照。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

成本趋势是 **EBS 存储和快照成本** 每月增长，但并未购买更多 EBS 卷容量，这强烈表明存在累积的快照和保留的快照数据。AWS 表示，你可以使用 AWS Backup 或 **Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager** 自动化 EBS 快照的**创建、保留和删除**，并且 Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 会创建生命周期策略，以自动化管理 EBS 卷和 EC2 实例的快照，且该服务本身不收取额外费用（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/snapshot-lifecycle.html)）。因此，删除非必要快照，然后使用 Data Lifecycle Manager 执行所需的快照保留策略，是运营开销最低的持续性解决方案。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用 CloudWatch Logs 监控存储利用率并不能解决快照成本增长的主要问题。此外，Elastic Volumes 不是缩小 EBS 卷的解决方案：AWS 将 Elastic Volumes 描述为支持动态**增加**卷大小、增加/降低性能以及更改卷类型，而不是减少卷大小（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/requesting-ebs-volume-modifications.html)）。
- **B:** 自定义脚本会增加运营开销，并且仍依赖 Elastic Volumes 来减小卷大小，而这并不是其适用的能力。它也无法提供托管的快照生命周期控制。
- **C:** 删除已过期和未使用的快照可能会有所帮助，并且 AWS 文档说明不再需要快照时可以将其删除（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-deleting-snapshot.html)）。但是，这只是一次性的手动/时间点清理。它无法防止未来每月的快照继续累积，因此与自动化生命周期管理相比，不能以**最少运营开销**满足要求。

en.question: A company is developing a new application on AWS. The application consists of an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster, an Amazon S3 bucket that contains assets for the application, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database that contains the dataset for the application. The dataset contains sensitive information. The company wants to ensure that only the ECS cluster can access the data in the RDS for MySQL database and the data in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the KMS key policy includes encrypt and decrypt permissions for the ECS task execution role.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS for MySQL database. Ensure that the S3 bucket policy specifies the ECS task execution role as a user.
options.C: Create an S3 bucket policy that restricts bucket access to the ECS task execution role. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in.
options.D: Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from only the S3 VPC endpoint.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **D**.

**D. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS for MySQL security group to allow access from only the subnets that the ECS cluster will generate tasks in. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from only the S3 VPC endpoint.**

This solution applies network-level access controls to both data stores. For Amazon RDS, VPC security groups control which sources can connect to a DB instance. AWS documentation states that security group rules can allow access from a specific IP range or another security group, and that network access to a DB instance is controlled through these rules ([Amazon RDS security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)). Restricting the RDS security group to the ECS task subnets limits database connectivity to the network locations where ECS tasks run.

For Amazon S3, an S3 VPC endpoint provides private connectivity from the VPC to S3 without using the public internet. AWS documentation states that bucket policies can control access to S3 buckets from specific VPC endpoints or VPCs, and that a VPC endpoint creates a private connection between the VPC and another AWS service without requiring internet access, NAT, VPN, or Direct Connect ([S3 bucket policies for VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)). By allowing access only from the S3 VPC endpoint, the bucket is restricted to requests that come through the approved private path used by the ECS environment.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Create a customer managed KMS key to encrypt both the S3 bucket and the RDS database, and grant encrypt/decrypt permissions to the ECS task execution role.**

Encryption with AWS KMS protects data at rest, but it does not by itself ensure that only the ECS cluster can access the RDS database or the S3 bucket. Amazon RDS encryption protects underlying storage, logs, backups, replicas, and snapshots, and RDS handles decryption transparently for authorized database access ([Amazon RDS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)). It is not a network or resource access control mechanism. Also, the ECS **task execution role** is used by the ECS agent for actions such as pulling images and sending logs, not by the application code in the container to access services such as S3 ([ECS task execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_execution_IAM_role.html)).

**B. Create an AWS managed KMS key to encrypt both resources, and configure the S3 bucket policy for the ECS task execution role.**

This option has multiple issues. First, like option A, KMS encryption does not restrict who can connect to the RDS database or access the S3 bucket. Second, it does not provide any meaningful access restriction for the RDS database. Third, it refers to the ECS task execution role rather than the ECS task role used by application code. AWS documentation distinguishes the task role, which grants permissions to containers running in the task, from the task execution role, which is used by the ECS agent ([ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html), [ECS task execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_execution_IAM_role.html)).

**C. Create an S3 bucket policy that restricts bucket access to the ECS task execution role. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon RDS for MySQL. Update the RDS security group to allow access only from the ECS task subnets.**

This option addresses RDS network access but does not provide the same private network restriction for S3 as option D. It relies on an IAM principal in the bucket policy and specifically names the ECS task execution role, which is not the role that application code should use to access AWS services. AWS documentation states that the ECS task role is the role whose permissions are vended to containers for access to services such as Amazon S3 ([ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)). Option D is more complete because it adds an S3 VPC endpoint and restricts the bucket to that endpoint, ensuring S3 access occurs only through the approved private path.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上开发一个新应用程序。该应用程序由一个 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群、一个包含应用程序资产的 Amazon S3 存储桶，以及一个包含应用程序数据集的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库组成。该数据集包含敏感信息。公司希望确保只有 ECS 集群可以访问 RDS for MySQL 数据库中的数据以及 S3 存储桶中的数据。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥，用于同时加密 S3 存储桶和 RDS for MySQL 数据库。确保 KMS 密钥策略包含 ECS task execution role 的加密和解密权限。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS 托管密钥，用于同时加密 S3 存储桶和 RDS for MySQL 数据库。确保 S3 存储桶策略将 ECS task execution role 指定为用户。
options.C: 创建一个 S3 存储桶策略，将存储桶访问限制为 ECS task execution role。为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 创建一个 VPC endpoint。更新 RDS for MySQL security group，使其仅允许来自 ECS 集群将在其中生成任务的子网的访问。
options.D: 为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 创建一个 VPC endpoint。更新 RDS for MySQL security group，使其仅允许来自 ECS 集群将在其中生成任务的子网的访问。为 Amazon S3 创建一个 VPC endpoint。更新 S3 存储桶策略，使其仅允许来自 S3 VPC endpoint 的访问。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D**。

**D. 为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 创建一个 VPC endpoint。更新 RDS for MySQL security group，使其仅允许来自 ECS 集群将在其中生成任务的子网的访问。为 Amazon S3 创建一个 VPC endpoint。更新 S3 存储桶策略，使其仅允许来自 S3 VPC endpoint 的访问。**

此解决方案对两个数据存储都应用了网络级访问控制。对于 Amazon RDS，VPC security groups 控制哪些来源可以连接到 DB instance。AWS 文档指出，security group rules 可以允许来自特定 IP 范围或另一个 security group 的访问，并且对 DB instance 的网络访问是通过这些规则控制的（[Amazon RDS security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.RDSSecurityGroups.html)）。将 RDS security group 限制为 ECS task 子网，可以将数据库连接限制在 ECS tasks 运行的网络位置。对于 Amazon S3，S3 VPC endpoint 可提供从 VPC 到 S3 的私有连接，而无需使用公共互联网。AWS 文档指出，bucket policies 可以控制来自特定 VPC endpoints 或 VPCs 的 S3 buckets 访问，并且 VPC endpoint 会在 VPC 与另一个 AWS service 之间创建私有连接，而无需互联网访问、NAT、VPN 或 Direct Connect（[S3 bucket policies for VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/example-bucket-policies-vpc-endpoint.html)）。通过仅允许来自 S3 VPC endpoint 的访问，该存储桶被限制为只能接收通过 ECS 环境所使用的已批准私有路径发出的请求。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 创建一个客户托管 KMS key 来同时加密 S3 bucket 和 RDS database，并向 ECS task execution role 授予 encrypt/decrypt 权限。**

使用 AWS KMS 加密可以保护静态数据，但它本身并不能确保只有 ECS 集群可以访问 RDS database 或 S3 bucket。Amazon RDS encryption 会保护底层存储、日志、备份、副本和快照，并且 RDS 会为已授权的数据库访问透明地处理解密（[Amazon RDS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。它不是一种网络或资源访问控制机制。此外，ECS **task execution role** 由 ECS agent 用于拉取镜像和发送日志等操作，而不是由容器中的应用程序代码用于访问 S3 等服务（[ECS task execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_execution_IAM_role.html)）。

**B. 创建一个 AWS managed KMS key 来加密这两个资源，并为 ECS task execution role 配置 S3 bucket policy。**

此选项存在多个问题。首先，与选项 A 一样，KMS 加密并不会限制谁可以连接到 RDS database 或访问 S3 bucket。其次，它没有为 RDS database 提供任何有意义的访问限制。第三，它引用的是 ECS task execution role，而不是应用程序代码使用的 ECS task role。AWS 文档区分了 task role 与 task execution role：task role 向 task 中运行的容器授予权限，而 task execution role 由 ECS agent 使用（[ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)，[ECS task execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task_execution_IAM_role.html)）。

**C. 创建一个 S3 bucket policy，将 bucket 访问限制为 ECS task execution role。为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 创建一个 VPC endpoint。更新 RDS security group，使其仅允许来自 ECS task 子网的访问。**

此选项解决了 RDS 网络访问问题，但没有像选项 D 那样为 S3 提供相同的私有网络限制。它依赖 bucket policy 中的 IAM principal，并且明确指定 ECS task execution role，而这不是应用程序代码应用于访问 AWS services 的角色。AWS 文档指出，ECS task role 是其权限被提供给容器以访问 Amazon S3 等服务的角色（[ECS task IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-iam-roles.html)）。选项 D 更完整，因为它添加了 S3 VPC endpoint，并将 bucket 限制为只能通过该 endpoint 访问，从而确保 S3 访问仅通过已批准的私有路径进行。

en.question: A company has a web application that runs on premises. The application experiences latency issues during peak hours. The latency issues occur twice each month. At the start of a latency issue, the application's CPU utilization immediately increases to 10 times its normal amount. The company wants to migrate the application to AWS to improve latency. The company also wants to scale the application automatically when application demand increases. The company will use AWS Elastic Beanstalk for application deployment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale based on requests.
options.B: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale based on requests.
options.C: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use compute optimized instances. Configure the environment to scale on a schedule.
options.D: Configure an Elastic Beanstalk environment to use burstable performance instances in unlimited mode. Configure the environment to scale on predictive metrics.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The workload is a web application with infrequent, sudden CPU spikes only twice per month. EC2 burstable performance (T) instances are designed for general-purpose workloads with low-to-moderate average CPU usage and spikes above baseline; AWS states that T instances provide baseline CPU performance with the ability to burst above baseline, and that they fit workloads such as web servers and business-critical applications ([EC2 burstable performance instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/burstable-performance-instances.html)). In **unlimited** mode, a burstable instance can sustain high CPU utilization whenever required ([Unlimited mode for burstable performance instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/burstable-performance-instances-unlimited-mode.html)). Elastic Beanstalk also supports load-based Auto Scaling: in a load-balanced environment, Auto Scaling adds or removes instances as needed based on load, and Elastic Beanstalk scaling triggers can use metrics including **request count** ([Auto Scaling your Elastic Beanstalk environment instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html), [Auto Scaling triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-autoscaling-triggers.html)). Therefore, burstable unlimited instances plus scaling based on requests best matches sudden demand increases and latency reduction.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B**: Compute optimized instances can help consistently CPU-intensive workloads, but the scenario describes rare spikes, not sustained high CPU demand. Burstable instances are the better documented fit for low-to-moderate workloads with occasional spikes.
* **C**: Scheduled scaling is intended for **predictable** peak traffic periods, such as recurring daily/weekly traffic or known one-time events ([Elastic Beanstalk scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)). The problem says the CPU utilization immediately increases at the start of the issue and asks to scale automatically when demand increases, so request-based dynamic scaling is more appropriate than a schedule.
* **D**: The burstable instance choice is appropriate, but Elastic Beanstalk documentation describes CloudWatch-alarm scaling triggers such as latency, disk I/O, CPU utilization, and request count, and scheduled actions; it does not present “predictive metrics” as an Elastic Beanstalk scaling option in these configuration choices ([Auto Scaling triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-autoscaling-triggers.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在本地运行的 Web 应用程序。该应用程序在高峰时段会出现延迟问题。延迟问题每月发生两次。在延迟问题开始时，应用程序的 CPU 利用率会立即增加到正常水平的 10 倍。公司希望将应用程序迁移到 AWS 以改善延迟。公司还希望在应用程序需求增加时自动扩展应用程序。公司将使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 进行应用程序部署。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，以使用处于 unlimited mode 的 burstable performance instances。配置该环境基于请求进行扩展。
options.B: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，以使用 compute optimized instances。配置该环境基于请求进行扩展。
options.C: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，以使用 compute optimized instances。配置该环境按计划进行扩展。
options.D: 配置一个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境，以使用处于 unlimited mode 的 burstable performance instances。配置该环境基于 predictive metrics 进行扩展。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** 该工作负载是一个 Web 应用程序，每月只有两次不频繁的、突然的 CPU 峰值。EC2 burstable performance (T) instances 专为平均 CPU 使用率较低到中等、并会出现高于基准的峰值的通用型工作负载而设计；AWS 表示，T instances 提供基准 CPU 性能，并能够突增到基准之上，而且适合 Web 服务器和业务关键型应用程序等工作负载（[EC2 burstable performance instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/burstable-performance-instances.html)）。在 **unlimited** mode 下，burstable instance 可以在需要时维持高 CPU 利用率（[Unlimited mode for burstable performance instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/burstable-performance-instances-unlimited-mode.html)）。Elastic Beanstalk 还支持基于负载的 Auto Scaling：在负载均衡环境中，Auto Scaling 会根据负载按需添加或移除实例，并且 Elastic Beanstalk scaling triggers 可以使用包括 **request count** 在内的指标（[Auto Scaling your Elastic Beanstalk environment instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)，[Auto Scaling triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-autoscaling-triggers.html)）。因此，burstable unlimited instances 加上基于请求的扩展，最符合突然的需求增加和降低延迟的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B**：Compute optimized instances 可以帮助持续 CPU 密集型工作负载，但场景描述的是罕见峰值，而不是持续的高 CPU 需求。对于具有偶发峰值的低到中等工作负载，burstable instances 是文档中更合适的选择。
* **C**：Scheduled scaling 适用于**可预测的**高峰流量时段，例如反复出现的每日/每周流量或已知的一次性事件（[Elastic Beanstalk scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.managing.as.html)）。题目说 CPU 利用率在问题开始时立即增加，并要求在需求增加时自动扩展，因此基于请求的动态扩展比按计划扩展更合适。
* **D**：burstable instance 的选择是合适的，但 Elastic Beanstalk 文档描述的是 CloudWatch-alarm scaling triggers，例如 latency、disk I/O、CPU utilization 和 request count，以及 scheduled actions；在这些配置选项中，它并未将 “predictive metrics” 作为 Elastic Beanstalk scaling option 提供（[Auto Scaling triggers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/environments-cfg-autoscaling-triggers.html)）。

en.question: A company has customers located across the world. The company wants to use automation to secure its systems and network infrastructure. The company's security team must be able to track and audit all incremental changes to the infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.
options.B: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.
options.C: Use AWS Organizations to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes.
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Service Catalog to track changes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use AWS CloudFormation to set up the infrastructure. Use AWS Config to track changes.**

AWS CloudFormation is the best fit for automating infrastructure setup. AWS states that a CloudFormation template describes the resources and properties, and CloudFormation provisions the resources for you; templates can also be reused to provision the same resources consistently across multiple Regions, which fits a global customer base and automated infrastructure deployment ([AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

AWS Config is the correct service for tracking and auditing changes. AWS Config can notify you when resources are created, modified, or deleted, continuously evaluates resources as they change, and provides historical configurations for auditing and compliance ([AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Organizations can centrally manage accounts and permissions guardrails, but it is not the service used to define and provision infrastructure as code. CloudFormation is the appropriate automation service.
- **C:** This combines the wrong provisioning service with the wrong change-tracking service. AWS Service Catalog is for creating and managing catalogs of approved IT services for self-service provisioning, not for auditing all incremental infrastructure changes ([AWS Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)).
- **D:** CloudFormation is appropriate for infrastructure setup, but Service Catalog is not the primary service for configuration change tracking and audit history. AWS Config provides that capability.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有遍布全球的客户。该公司希望使用自动化来保护其系统和网络基础设施。公司的安全团队必须能够跟踪和审计基础设施的所有增量变更。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Organizations 来设置基础设施。使用 AWS Config 跟踪变更。
options.B: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 来设置基础设施。使用 AWS Config 跟踪变更。
options.C: 使用 AWS Organizations 来设置基础设施。使用 AWS Service Catalog 跟踪变更。
options.D: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 来设置基础设施。使用 AWS Service Catalog 跟踪变更。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 AWS CloudFormation 来设置基础设施。使用 AWS Config 跟踪变更。**

AWS CloudFormation 最适合用于自动化基础设施设置。AWS 表示，CloudFormation 模板描述资源和属性，CloudFormation 会为你预置这些资源；模板还可以重复使用，以便在多个 Region 中一致地预置相同资源，这符合全球客户群和自动化基础设施部署的需求（[AWS CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

AWS Config 是用于跟踪和审计变更的正确服务。AWS Config 可以在资源被创建、修改或删除时通知你，在资源发生变化时持续评估资源，并提供历史配置以用于审计和合规性（[AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS Organizations 可以集中管理账户和权限护栏，但它不是用于将基础设施定义和预置为代码的服务。CloudFormation 才是合适的自动化服务。
- **C:** 该选项将错误的预置服务与错误的变更跟踪服务组合在一起。AWS Service Catalog 用于创建和管理经批准的 IT 服务目录，以便进行自助式预置，而不是用于审计所有增量基础设施变更（[AWS Service Catalog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/servicecatalog/latest/adminguide/introduction.html)）。
- **D:** CloudFormation 适合用于基础设施设置，但 Service Catalog 不是用于配置变更跟踪和审计历史记录的主要服务。AWS Config 提供该能力。

en.question: A startup company is hosting a website for its customers on an Amazon EC2 instance. The website consists of a stateless Python application and a MySQL database. The website serves only a small amount of traffic. The company is concerned about the reliability of the instance and needs to migrate to a highly available architecture. The company cannot modify the application code. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to achieve high availability for the website? (Choose two.)

options.A: Provision an internet gateway in each Availability Zone in use.
options.B: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance.
options.C: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB, and enable DynamoDB auto scaling.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to synchronize the database data across multiple EC2 instances.
options.E: Create an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic to an Auto Scaling group of EC2 instances that are distributed across two Availability Zones.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: B and E.**

- **B. Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance** — The current database is MySQL and the company cannot modify application code, so moving the database tier to the compatible managed MySQL service with Multi-AZ is the appropriate HA choice. AWS states that if a planned or unplanned outage affects a Multi-AZ DB instance, Amazon RDS automatically switches to a standby replica in another Availability Zone, and RDS handles failovers automatically without administrative intervention ([RDS Multi-AZ failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)).
- **E. Create an Application Load Balancer to distribute traffic to an Auto Scaling group across two AZs** — The application is stateless, so it can run on multiple EC2 instances. AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attaching a load balancer to distribute incoming traffic across those AZs; if one AZ becomes unavailable, EC2 Auto Scaling can launch instances in an unaffected AZ ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming traffic across EC2 instances, and with an Auto Scaling group, launched instances are automatically registered and terminated instances are deregistered ([Use Elastic Load Balancing with Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A** — Internet gateways are VPC-level connectivity components, not per-AZ high-availability mechanisms for an EC2-hosted application. They do not replace failed application instances or database instances.
- **C** — DynamoDB is not a MySQL-compatible relational database. Because the company cannot modify application code, migrating a MySQL-backed application to DynamoDB is not an appropriate lift-and-shift HA action.
- **D** — AWS DataSync is not a database HA/failover solution. Synchronizing files across EC2 instances would not provide managed MySQL failover or a reliable database tier; RDS Multi-AZ is the AWS-managed HA approach for this MySQL database use case.

zh.question: 一家初创公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上为其客户托管一个网站。该网站由一个无状态的 Python 应用程序和一个 MySQL 数据库组成。该网站只处理少量流量。公司担心该实例的可靠性，需要迁移到高可用架构。公司无法修改应用程序代码。解决方案架构师应采取哪组操作来实现网站的高可用性？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在每个正在使用的 Availability Zone 中预置一个 internet gateway。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB，并启用 DynamoDB auto scaling。
options.D: 使用 AWS DataSync 在多个 EC2 实例之间同步数据库数据。
options.E: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer，将流量分发到分布在两个 Availability Zones 中的 EC2 实例 Auto Scaling group。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B 和 E。**

- **B. 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance** — 当前数据库是 MySQL，并且公司无法修改应用程序代码，因此将数据库层迁移到兼容的托管 MySQL 服务并启用 Multi-AZ，是合适的 HA 选择。AWS 表示，如果计划内或计划外中断影响 Multi-AZ DB instance，Amazon RDS 会自动切换到另一个 Availability Zone 中的备用副本，并且 RDS 会自动处理故障转移，无需管理员干预（[RDS Multi-AZ failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。
- **E. 创建一个 Application Load Balancer，将流量分发到跨两个 AZs 的 Auto Scaling group** — 该应用程序是无状态的，因此可以在多个 EC2 实例上运行。AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling group 跨多个 Availability Zones 部署，并附加一个负载均衡器，以便在这些 AZs 之间分发传入流量；如果一个 AZ 不可用，EC2 Auto Scaling 可以在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。Elastic Load Balancing 会在 EC2 实例之间分发传入流量，并且与 Auto Scaling group 配合使用时，已启动的实例会自动注册，已终止的实例会注销（[Use Elastic Load Balancing with Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A** — Internet gateways 是 VPC 级别的连接组件，不是针对托管在 EC2 上的应用程序的按 AZ 高可用机制。它们不能替代发生故障的应用程序实例或数据库实例。
- **C** — DynamoDB 不是与 MySQL 兼容的关系数据库。由于公司无法修改应用程序代码，将基于 MySQL 的应用程序迁移到 DynamoDB 并不是合适的直接迁移式 HA 操作。
- **D** — AWS DataSync 不是数据库 HA/故障转移解决方案。在 EC2 实例之间同步文件无法提供托管的 MySQL 故障转移或可靠的数据库层；对于此 MySQL 数据库使用场景，RDS Multi-AZ 才是 AWS 托管的 HA 方法。

en.question: A company is moving its data and applications to AWS during a multiyear migration project. The company wants to securely access data on Amazon S3 from the company's AWS Region and from the company's on-premises location. The data must not traverse the internet. The company has established an AWS Direct Connect connection between its Region and its on-premises location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create gateway endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the gateway endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.B: Create a gateway in AWS Transit Gateway to access Amazon S3 securely from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.C: Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3. Use the interface endpoints to securely access the data from the Region and the on-premises location.
options.D: Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key to access the data securely from the Region and the on-premises location.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3.**

Amazon S3 supports both gateway endpoints and interface endpoints. For this scenario, access is required both from AWS and from an on-premises location over AWS Direct Connect, with traffic not traversing the internet. AWS states that S3 **interface VPC endpoints** are directly accessible from on-premises applications over **VPN and Direct Connect**, and that requests to S3 over interface endpoints stay on the Amazon network ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). The same documentation says interface endpoints use private IP addresses to route requests to S3 from within a VPC and from on premises, and the comparison table says gateway endpoints “Do not allow access from on premises” while interface endpoints “Allow access from on premises” ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html#types-of-vpc-endpoints-for-s3)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3** — Gateway endpoints can provide private S3 access from within a VPC, but they cannot be used from on-premises networks. AWS explicitly states that gateway endpoints do not allow access from on-premises networks and that resources across a Direct Connect connection cannot use a gateway endpoint to communicate with S3 ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).
- **B. Transit Gateway gateway to access S3** — Transit Gateway is not the S3 endpoint type. AWS documentation specifically says interface endpoints, not gateway endpoints, are used when access is needed from on premises or through Transit Gateway scenarios ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).
- **D. AWS KMS key** — AWS KMS can help encrypt and control access to data, but it does not provide a private network path to Amazon S3. It does not satisfy the requirement that S3 traffic from on premises must avoid the internet.

Therefore, **interface endpoints for Amazon S3** are the solution that meets the private on-premises and AWS Region access requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司正在一项多年迁移项目中将其数据和应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司希望从公司的 AWS Region 以及公司的本地位置安全地访问 Amazon S3 上的数据。数据不得穿越互联网。该公司已在其 Region 与本地位置之间建立了 AWS Direct Connect 连接。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Amazon S3 创建网关端点。使用这些网关端点从该 Region 和本地位置安全地访问数据。
options.B: 在 AWS Transit Gateway 中创建一个网关，以便从该 Region 和本地位置安全地访问 Amazon S3。
options.C: 为 Amazon S3 创建接口端点。使用这些接口端点从该 Region 和本地位置安全地访问数据。
options.D: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥从该 Region 和本地位置安全地访问数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. Create interface endpoints for Amazon S3.**

Amazon S3 同时支持网关端点和接口端点。在此场景中，需要从 AWS 以及通过 AWS Direct Connect 从本地位置进行访问，并且流量不得穿越互联网。AWS 表示，S3 **interface VPC endpoints** 可由本地应用程序通过 **VPN and Direct Connect** 直接访问，并且通过接口端点发送到 S3 的请求会保留在 Amazon 网络上（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。同一文档还说明，接口端点使用私有 IP 地址从 VPC 内部和本地将请求路由到 S3，并且比较表说明网关端点“Do not allow access from on premises”，而接口端点“Allow access from on premises”（[Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html#types-of-vpc-endpoints-for-s3)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3** — 网关端点可以从 VPC 内部提供对 S3 的私有访问，但不能从本地网络使用。AWS 明确说明，网关端点不允许来自本地网络的访问，并且跨 Direct Connect 连接的资源不能使用网关端点与 S3 通信（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。
- **B. Transit Gateway gateway to access S3** — Transit Gateway 不是 S3 端点类型。AWS 文档明确说明，当需要从本地访问或通过 Transit Gateway 场景访问时，应使用接口端点，而不是网关端点（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。
- **D. AWS KMS key** — AWS KMS 可以帮助加密并控制对数据的访问，但它不提供到 Amazon S3 的私有网络路径。它不能满足来自本地的 S3 流量必须避开互联网的要求。因此，**interface endpoints for Amazon S3** 是满足私有本地访问和 AWS Region 访问要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company created a new organization in AWS Organizations. The organization has multiple accounts for the company's development teams. The development team members use AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to access the accounts. For each of the company's applications, the development teams must use a predefined application name to tag resources that are created. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that gives the development team the ability to create resources only if the application name tag has an approved value. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM group that has a conditional Allow policy that requires the application name tag to be specified for resources to be created.
options.B: Create a cross-account role that has a Deny policy for any resource that has the application name tag.
options.C: Create a resource group in AWS Resource Groups to validate that the tags are applied to all resources in all accounts.
options.D: Create a tag policy in Organizations that has a list of allowed application names.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

AWS Organizations **tag policies** are designed to standardize tags across accounts in an organization. AWS states that a tag policy can define the required tag key case and **acceptable tag values**, and can also **enforce** compliance so that noncompliant tagging requests for specified resource types are prevented from completing ([Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)). The tag policy syntax explicitly supports a `tag_value` list of acceptable values and an optional `enforced_for` setting to prevent noncompliant operations; AWS examples show a policy where a tag key can only have specified values such as `Prod` or `Non-prod` ([Tag policy syntax and examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_example-tag-policies.html)). Therefore, an Organizations tag policy with the approved application names is the right centralized solution.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: An IAM group policy would not be the best organization-wide control for multiple AWS accounts accessed through IAM Identity Center, and it would need to be managed per identity/account. The requirement is for centralized allowed tag values across the organization, which is what tag policies provide.
- **B**: A cross-account role with a Deny policy for any resource that has the tag is the opposite of the requirement; the company wants to allow creation only when the application tag has an approved value, not deny all tagged resources.
- **C**: AWS Resource Groups can be used to view/manage **compliance** with tag policies, but AWS says Organizations is used to manage tag policies and attach them to organization entities. Resource Groups by itself does not define or enforce the approved tag values ([Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中创建了一个新组织。该组织为公司的开发团队拥有多个账户。开发团队成员使用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 访问这些账户。对于公司的每个应用程序，开发团队必须使用预定义的应用程序名称来标记所创建的资源。解决方案架构师需要设计一个解决方案，使开发团队只有在应用程序名称标签具有已批准的值时才能创建资源。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 IAM 组，该组具有条件 Allow 策略，要求在创建资源时必须指定应用程序名称标签。
options.B: 创建一个跨账户角色，该角色具有针对任何带有应用程序名称标签的资源的 Deny 策略。
options.C: 在 AWS Resource Groups 中创建一个资源组，以验证标签是否已应用于所有账户中的所有资源。
options.D: 在 Organizations 中创建一个标签策略，其中包含允许的应用程序名称列表。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

AWS Organizations **tag policies** 旨在标准化组织中各账户的标签。AWS 表示，标签策略可以定义所需的标签键大小写和**可接受的标签值**，并且还可以**强制执行**合规性，以便阻止指定资源类型的非合规标签请求完成（[Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)）。标签策略语法明确支持可接受值的 `tag_value` 列表以及可选的 `enforced_for` 设置来阻止非合规操作；AWS 示例展示了一个策略，其中某个标签键只能具有指定值，例如 `Prod` 或 `Non-prod`（[Tag policy syntax and examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_example-tag-policies.html)）。因此，包含已批准应用程序名称的 Organizations 标签策略是正确的集中式解决方案。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：IAM 组策略并不是针对通过 IAM Identity Center 访问的多个 AWS 账户进行组织范围控制的最佳方式，并且需要按身份/账户进行管理。要求是在整个组织范围内集中管理允许的标签值，而这正是标签策略所提供的功能。
- **B**：带有 Deny 策略的跨账户角色会拒绝任何带有该标签的资源，这与要求相反；公司希望仅在应用程序标签具有已批准的值时允许创建，而不是拒绝所有带标签的资源。
- **C**：AWS Resource Groups 可用于查看/管理与标签策略相关的**合规性**，但 AWS 表示 Organizations 用于管理标签策略并将其附加到组织实体。Resource Groups 本身不会定义或强制执行已批准的标签值（[Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)）。

en.question: A company runs its databases on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company wants a secure solution to manage the master user password by rotating the password every 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule a custom AWS Lambda function to rotate the password every 30 days.
options.B: Use the modify-db-instance command in the AWS CLI to change the password.
options.C: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.
options.D: Integrate AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Integrate AWS Secrets Manager with Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to automate password rotation.**

Amazon RDS has a native integration with AWS Secrets Manager for managing master user passwords for RDS DB instances. When RDS manages the master user password in Secrets Manager, RDS generates and stores the password as a secret, manages the secret settings, and rotates the secret automatically; AWS also states that the rotation schedule can be modified, which supports a 30-day rotation requirement ([Amazon RDS password management with Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)). Secrets Manager rotation updates credentials in both the secret and the database/service, and automatic rotation can be configured ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). This is the least operational overhead because RDS and Secrets Manager provide the managed integration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EventBridge plus a custom Lambda function could rotate a password, but AWS Secrets Manager supports managed rotation, where the service configures and manages rotation and does not use a Lambda function for managed secrets ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). Building and maintaining custom Lambda logic adds operational overhead.
- **B:** Using `modify-db-instance` from the AWS CLI can rotate a master user password secret immediately, but it is an operational/manual mechanism rather than an automated 30-day management solution ([RDS rotating the master user password secret](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)).
- **D:** Systems Manager Parameter Store can store parameters, but the documented native RDS integration for master user password management and automated rotation is with **AWS Secrets Manager**, not Parameter Store ([Amazon RDS password management with Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 上运行其数据库。该公司希望通过每 30 天轮换一次密码，以安全地管理主用户密码。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 计划一个自定义 AWS Lambda 函数，每 30 天轮换一次密码。
options.B: 使用 AWS CLI 中的 modify-db-instance 命令更改密码。
options.C: 将 AWS Secrets Manager 与 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 集成，以自动执行密码轮换。
options.D: 将 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 与 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 集成，以自动执行密码轮换。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 将 AWS Secrets Manager 与 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 集成，以自动执行密码轮换。**

Amazon RDS 与 AWS Secrets Manager 具有原生集成，可用于管理 RDS DB 实例的主用户密码。当 RDS 在 Secrets Manager 中管理主用户密码时，RDS 会生成密码并将其存储为密钥，管理密钥设置，并自动轮换该密钥；AWS 还声明可以修改轮换计划，这支持 30 天轮换要求（[Amazon RDS password management with Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)）。Secrets Manager 轮换会同时更新密钥和数据库/服务中的凭证，并且可以配置自动轮换（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。这是运营开销最少的方案，因为 RDS 和 Secrets Manager 提供托管集成。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EventBridge 加自定义 Lambda 函数可以轮换密码，但 AWS Secrets Manager 支持托管轮换，其中服务会配置和管理轮换，并且对于托管密钥不使用 Lambda 函数（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。构建和维护自定义 Lambda 逻辑会增加运营开销。
- **B:** 使用 AWS CLI 中的 `modify-db-instance` 可以立即轮换主用户密码密钥，但它是一种运营/手动机制，而不是自动化的 30 天管理解决方案（[RDS rotating the master user password secret](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)）。
- **D:** Systems Manager Parameter Store 可以存储参数，但用于主用户密码管理和自动轮换的已记录原生 RDS 集成是与 **AWS Secrets Manager** 集成，而不是 Parameter Store（[Amazon RDS password management with Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)）。

en.question: A company performs tests on an application that uses an Amazon DynamoDB table. The tests run for 4 hours once a week. The company knows how many read and write operations the application performs to the table each second during the tests. The company does not currently use DynamoDB for any other use case. A solutions architect needs to optimize the costs for the table. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Choose on-demand mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
options.B: Choose provisioned mode. Update the read and write capacity units appropriately.
options.C: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 1-year term.
options.D: Purchase DynamoDB reserved capacity for a 3-year term.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Choose provisioned mode and update the read and write capacity units appropriately.**

DynamoDB **provisioned mode** is the right fit because the workload is scheduled and the company **knows the read and write operations per second** during the tests. AWS states that in provisioned mode you specify the reads and writes per second required by the application, and that this mode is appropriate when you can reliably forecast capacity requirements; billing is based on the hourly read/write capacity provisioned, giving cost predictability ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)). The company can provision the known capacity for the test window and adjust it afterward to optimize cost.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. On-demand mode** is not the best match as written. On-demand is pay-per-request and does not require capacity planning, but AWS specifically says that for on-demand tables you **do not specify** how much read/write throughput you expect ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)). Therefore, “update the read and write capacity units” is not applicable to on-demand mode.
- **C and D. Reserved capacity** require a 1-year or 3-year commitment to a minimum amount of provisioned throughput. AWS states that with reserved capacity you pay for the entire committed provisioned usage regardless of actual usage, so savings are closely tied to sustained use ([DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)). A table used only 4 hours per week for testing does not justify that commitment.

zh.question: 一家公司对一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 表的应用程序执行测试。测试每周运行一次，每次 4 小时。公司知道在测试期间应用程序每秒对该表执行多少次读取和写入操作。公司目前没有将 DynamoDB 用于任何其他用例。解决方案架构师需要优化该表的成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 选择按需模式。适当地更新读取和写入容量单位。
options.B: 选择预置模式。适当地更新读取和写入容量单位。
options.C: 购买 1 年期的 DynamoDB 预留容量。
options.D: 购买 3 年期的 DynamoDB 预留容量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。选择预置模式，并适当地更新读取和写入容量单位。**

DynamoDB **预置模式**是正确选择，因为该工作负载是按计划运行的，并且公司**知道测试期间每秒的读取和写入操作数**。AWS 表示，在预置模式下，你可以指定应用程序所需的每秒读取和写入次数，并且当你能够可靠地预测容量需求时，此模式是合适的；计费基于按小时预置的读/写容量，从而提供成本可预测性（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)）。公司可以为测试窗口预置已知容量，并在之后进行调整以优化成本。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 按需模式**按题干表述并不是最佳匹配。按需模式按请求付费，并且不需要容量规划，但 AWS 明确说明，对于按需表，你**不指定**预期的读/写吞吐量（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html)）。因此，“更新读取和写入容量单位”不适用于按需模式。
- **C 和 D. 预留容量**需要对最低数量的预置吞吐量做出 1 年或 3 年承诺。AWS 表示，使用预留容量时，无论实际使用情况如何，你都需要为整个承诺的预置使用量付费，因此节省与持续使用密切相关（[DynamoDB reserved capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/reserved-capacity.html)）。一个每周仅用于测试 4 小时的表无法证明这种承诺是合理的。

en.question: A company runs its applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company performs periodic financial assessments of its AWS costs. The company recently identified unusual spending. The company needs a solution to prevent unusual spending. The solution must monitor costs and notify responsible stakeholders in the event of unusual spending. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an AWS Budgets template to create a zero spend budget.
options.B: Create an AWS Cost Anomaly Detection monitor in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console.
options.C: Create AWS Pricing Calculator estimates for the current running workload pricing details.
options.D: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor costs and to identify unusual spending.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Cost Anomaly Detection is specifically designed for this requirement: it “uses machine learning models to detect and alert on anomalous spend patterns” in deployed AWS services. It can monitor cost anomalies and send alerts by email or Amazon SNS, and it lets you configure what costs to evaluate, including all AWS services or specific accounts/tags/categories ([AWS Cost Anomaly Detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/manage-ad.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Budgets zero spend budget** — AWS Budgets can track costs/usage and alert when defined thresholds are approached or exceeded, but a zero-spend budget is a threshold-based budget pattern, not the best fit for detecting unusual spending patterns using historical/seasonal behavior ([AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)).
- **C. AWS Pricing Calculator** — Pricing Calculator is a planning tool for creating cost estimates, modeling solutions, exploring prices, and planning spend. It does not monitor actual AWS usage or notify stakeholders about anomalous spending ([AWS Pricing Calculator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/what-is-pricing-calculator.html)).
- **D. Amazon CloudWatch** — CloudWatch billing alarms can monitor estimated charges and alert when billing exceeds a specified threshold, but AWS documentation states this is threshold-based and “doesn't use projections.” It is not the purpose-built anomaly detection solution for unusual spending ([CloudWatch billing alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/monitor_estimated_charges_with_cloudwatch.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其应用程序。该公司会定期对其 AWS 成本进行财务评估。该公司最近发现了异常支出。公司需要一种解决方案来防止异常支出。该解决方案必须监控成本，并在发生异常支出时通知相关负责人。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Budgets 模板创建零支出预算。
options.B: 在 AWS Billing and Cost Management 控制台中创建 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 监控器。
options.C: 为当前正在运行的工作负载定价详细信息创建 AWS Pricing Calculator 估算。
options.D: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控成本并识别异常支出。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 专为此要求而设计：它在已部署的 AWS 服务中“uses machine learning models to detect and alert on anomalous spend patterns”。它可以监控成本异常，并通过电子邮件或 Amazon SNS 发送提醒，还允许你配置要评估的成本范围，包括所有 AWS 服务或特定账户/标签/类别（[AWS Cost Anomaly Detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/manage-ad.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Budgets zero spend budget** — AWS Budgets 可以跟踪成本/使用量，并在接近或超过定义的阈值时发出提醒，但零支出预算是一种基于阈值的预算模式，并不是使用历史/季节性行为来检测异常支出模式的最佳选择（[AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)）。
- **C. AWS Pricing Calculator** — Pricing Calculator 是一种规划工具，用于创建成本估算、建模解决方案、探索价格以及规划支出。它不会监控实际 AWS 使用量，也不会就异常支出通知利益相关者（[AWS Pricing Calculator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pricing-calculator/latest/userguide/what-is-pricing-calculator.html)）。
- **D. Amazon CloudWatch** — CloudWatch billing alarms 可以监控预估费用，并在账单超过指定阈值时发出提醒，但 AWS 文档说明这是基于阈值的，并且“doesn't use projections”。它不是专门用于异常支出的异常检测解决方案（[CloudWatch billing alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/monitor_estimated_charges_with_cloudwatch.html)）。

en.question: A marketing company receives a large amount of new clickstream data in Amazon S3 from a marketing campaign. The company needs to analyze the clickstream data in Amazon S3 quickly. Then the company needs to determine whether to process the data further in the data pipeline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create external tables in a Spark catalog. Configure jobs in AWS Glue to query the data.
options.B: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.C: Create external tables in a Hive metastore. Configure Spark jobs in Amazon EMR to query the data.
options.D: Configure an AWS Glue crawler to crawl the data. Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to use SQL to query the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon Athena is the lowest-operational-overhead choice for quickly analyzing data that is already in Amazon S3 because it can run SQL queries against data sources registered in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. AWS documents that Athena uses the Glue Data Catalog to store table and column metadata for data in S3, and that AWS Glue crawlers can automatically infer database and table schema from S3 data. This directly matches the requirement: crawl the new clickstream data, create/update the schema, and query it with Athena to decide whether further pipeline processing is needed ([Athena: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to connect to your data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/data-sources-glue.html), [Athena: Run SQL queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Glue jobs with Spark can process/query data, but creating external tables in a Spark catalog and running Glue jobs is more of an ETL/processing approach. It adds job configuration and execution overhead compared with using a Glue crawler plus Athena for ad hoc SQL analysis of S3 data.
- **C:** Amazon EMR supports Spark and big data analytics, but AWS describes EMR as a managed **cluster** platform for frameworks such as Hadoop and Spark. Managing/using EMR clusters and a Hive metastore has more operational overhead than serverless Athena for quick S3 analysis ([Amazon EMR: What is Amazon EMR?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)).
- **D:** Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL is intended for continuously reading and processing **streaming data** in near real time. The question’s data is already stored in Amazon S3 as clickstream data to be analyzed quickly, so Athena is the better fit. Kinesis Data Analytics would be appropriate for streaming applications and real-time dashboards, not the least-overhead query of S3-resident data ([Kinesis Data Analytics: When should I use it?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家营销公司从一次营销活动中在 Amazon S3 接收了大量新的点击流数据。该公司需要快速分析 Amazon S3 中的点击流数据。然后，该公司需要确定是否在数据管道中进一步处理这些数据。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Spark catalog 中创建外部表。配置 AWS Glue 中的作业来查询数据。
options.B: 配置 AWS Glue crawler 来爬取数据。配置 Amazon Athena 来查询数据。
options.C: 在 Hive metastore 中创建外部表。配置 Amazon EMR 中的 Spark 作业来查询数据。
options.D: 配置 AWS Glue crawler 来爬取数据。配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics 使用 SQL 来查询数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon Athena 是快速分析已在 Amazon S3 中的数据时运营开销最低的选择，因为它可以对注册在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中的数据源运行 SQL 查询。AWS 文档说明，Athena 使用 Glue Data Catalog 来存储 S3 中数据的表和列元数据，并且 AWS Glue crawler 可以从 S3 数据中自动推断数据库和表 schema。这直接符合要求：爬取新的点击流数据，创建/更新 schema，并使用 Athena 查询数据，以决定是否需要进一步的管道处理（[Athena: Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to connect to your data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/data-sources-glue.html), [Athena: Run SQL queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS Glue jobs with Spark 可以处理/查询数据，但在 Spark catalog 中创建外部表并运行 Glue jobs 更像是一种 ETL/处理方法。与使用 Glue crawler 加 Athena 对 S3 数据进行临时 SQL 分析相比，它增加了作业配置和执行开销。
- **C:** Amazon EMR 支持 Spark 和大数据分析，但 AWS 将 EMR 描述为用于 Hadoop 和 Spark 等框架的托管 **cluster** 平台。与使用无服务器 Athena 进行快速 S3 分析相比，管理/使用 EMR clusters 和 Hive metastore 具有更多运营开销（[Amazon EMR: What is Amazon EMR?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)）。
- **D:** Kinesis Data Analytics for SQL 旨在近实时地持续读取和处理 **streaming data**。题目中的数据已经作为点击流数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，需要快速分析，因此 Athena 更适合。Kinesis Data Analytics 适用于流式应用程序和实时仪表板，而不是以最低开销查询驻留在 S3 中的数据（[Kinesis Data Analytics: When should I use it?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisanalytics/latest/dev/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that the company frequently accesses for up to 7 days after the file creation date. After 7 days, the company needs to be able to access the files with a maximum retrieval time of 24 hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.
options.C: Create an Amazon FSx File Gateway to increase the company's storage space. Create an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data after 7 days.
options.D: Configure access to Amazon S3 for each user. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed for this hybrid SMB-file-server pattern: it lets on-premises clients store and retrieve data in Amazon S3 through standard file protocols, including **SMB**, provides local caching for low-latency access, and lets the S3 data be managed with S3 lifecycle policies ([S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). An S3 Lifecycle rule can transition objects to lower-cost archive storage after the first 7 days ([S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). S3 Glacier Deep Archive supports a Standard retrieval tier that typically restores objects within 12 hours, which satisfies the 24-hour retrieval requirement ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** DataSync can transfer SMB data to AWS and can be used to archive cold data, but this option only says to copy data older than 7 days. It does not provide an SMB file interface backed by expandable S3 storage for the first 7 days of frequent access, nor does it define the archive storage class/retrieval behavior ([DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **C:** FSx File Gateway is for low-latency access to **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** file shares, not for using S3 lifecycle policies on S3 objects. It requires an FSx for Windows File Server file system and maps local shares to remote FSx file shares ([FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)).
- **D:** This uses S3 directly for each user rather than preserving the existing SMB file-share access pattern. Although S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval can meet the retrieval-time requirement, the option does not provide the SMB file server extension/integration that the scenario requires ([S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在其数据中心运行一台 SMB 文件服务器。该文件服务器存储大型文件，公司在文件创建日期后的最多 7 天内会频繁访问这些文件。7 天后，公司需要能够访问这些文件，最大检索时间为 24 小时。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS DataSync 将早于 7 天的数据从 SMB 文件服务器复制到 AWS。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway 以增加公司的存储空间。创建一个 S3 Lifecycle policy，在 7 天后将数据转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon FSx File Gateway 以增加公司的存储空间。创建一个 Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy，在 7 天后转换数据。
options.D: 为每个用户配置对 Amazon S3 的访问。创建一个 S3 Lifecycle policy，在 7 天后将数据转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon S3 File Gateway 专为这种混合 SMB 文件服务器模式而设计：它允许本地客户端通过标准文件协议（包括 **SMB**）在 Amazon S3 中存储和检索数据，提供本地缓存以实现低延迟访问，并允许使用 S3 lifecycle policies 管理 S3 数据（[S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。S3 Lifecycle rule 可以在前 7 天后将对象转换到成本更低的归档存储（[S3 Lifecycle](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。S3 Glacier Deep Archive 支持 Standard retrieval tier，通常可在 12 小时内还原对象，满足 24 小时检索要求（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** DataSync 可以将 SMB 数据传输到 AWS，并可用于归档冷数据，但此选项只说明复制早于 7 天的数据。它没有提供由可扩展 S3 存储支持的 SMB 文件接口，以满足前 7 天频繁访问的需求，也没有定义归档存储类/检索行为（[DataSync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **C:** FSx File Gateway 用于低延迟访问 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 文件共享，而不是用于对 S3 对象使用 S3 lifecycle policies。它需要一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统，并将本地共享映射到远程 FSx 文件共享（[FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)）。
- **D:** 这会让每个用户直接使用 S3，而不是保留现有的 SMB 文件共享访问模式。尽管 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 可以满足检索时间要求，但该选项没有提供场景所需的 SMB 文件服务器扩展/集成（[S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。

en.question: A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses a database that runs on an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The application performs slowly when traffic increases. The database experiences a heavy read load during periods of high traffic. Which actions should a solutions architect take to resolve these performance issues? (Choose two.)

options.A: Turn on auto scaling for the DB instance.
options.B: Create a read replica for the DB instance. Configure the application to send read traffic to the read replica.
options.C: Convert the DB instance to a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment. Configure the application to send read traffic to the standby DB instance.
options.D: Create an Amazon ElastiCache cluster. Configure the application to cache query results in the ElastiCache cluster.
options.E: Configure the Auto Scaling group subnets to ensure that the EC2 instances are provisioned in the same Availability Zone as the DB instance.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and D**.

- **B is correct**: An RDS for PostgreSQL read replica is a read-only copy of the source DB instance, and AWS explicitly states that read replicas can be created from high-traffic DB instances to **offload read-only queries**. This directly addresses the heavy read load during high traffic. [AWS RDS PostgreSQL read replica configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.Configuration.html)
- **D is correct**: ElastiCache query caching is specifically effective for **read-heavy applications**, expensive repeated queries, and high-concurrency scenarios where offloading reads to ElastiCache reduces database CPU pressure and improves throughput. [AWS ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)

Incorrect options:

- **A is wrong**: RDS storage autoscaling manages storage capacity, not read-query throughput or CPU pressure from a heavy read workload. [AWS RDS storage autoscaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIOPS.Autoscaling.html)
- **C is wrong**: A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment is for high availability and failover. AWS states that the high availability option is **not a scaling solution for read-only scenarios** and that you **can't use a standby replica to serve read traffic**. [AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)
- **E is wrong**: Placing EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone as the DB instance might reduce some network latency, but it does not reduce the database's heavy read load. It also weakens the availability benefits of spreading an Auto Scaling group across subnets/AZs and does not solve the stated bottleneck.
