zh.question: 一家公司在 Auto Scaling group 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用程序。该应用程序使用一个运行在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance 上的数据库。当流量增加时，应用程序运行缓慢。在高流量期间，数据库承受很重的读取负载。解决方案架构师应采取哪些措施来解决这些性能问题？（选择两项。）

options.A: 为该 DB instance 开启 auto scaling。
options.B: 为该 DB instance 创建一个只读副本。配置应用程序将读取流量发送到该只读副本。
options.C: 将该 DB instance 转换为 Multi-AZ DB instance deployment。配置应用程序将读取流量发送到备用 DB instance。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。配置应用程序将查询结果缓存在 ElastiCache 集群中。
options.E: 配置 Auto Scaling group 子网，以确保 EC2 实例预置在与 DB instance 相同的 Availability Zone 中。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 D**。

- **B 正确**：RDS for PostgreSQL 只读副本是源 DB instance 的只读副本，AWS 明确说明可以从高流量 DB instance 创建只读副本，以 **卸载只读查询**。这直接解决了高流量期间的繁重读取负载。[AWS RDS PostgreSQL read replica configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.Configuration.html)
- **D 正确**：ElastiCache 查询缓存特别适用于 **读密集型应用程序**、昂贵的重复查询以及高并发场景，在这些场景中，将读取卸载到 ElastiCache 可以降低数据库 CPU 压力并提高吞吐量。[AWS ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)

错误选项：

- **A 错误**：RDS storage autoscaling 管理的是存储容量，而不是读取查询吞吐量，也不是繁重读取工作负载带来的 CPU 压力。[AWS RDS storage autoscaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIOPS.Autoscaling.html)
- **C 错误**：Multi-AZ DB instance deployment 用于高可用性和故障转移。AWS 说明高可用性选项 **不是只读场景的扩展解决方案**，并且你 **不能使用备用副本来提供读取流量**。[AWS RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)
- **E 错误**：将 EC2 实例放置在与 DB instance 相同的 Availability Zone 中可能会降低一些网络延迟，但不会减少数据库的繁重读取负载。它还会削弱将 Auto Scaling group 分布在多个子网/AZ 中所带来的可用性优势，并且不能解决题目所述的瓶颈。

en.question: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to run an application. The company creates one snapshot of each EBS volume every day to meet compliance requirements. The company wants to implement an architecture that prevents the accidental deletion of EBS volume snapshots. The solution must not change the administrative rights of the storage administrator user. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative effort?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has permission to delete snapshots. Attach the role to a new EC2 instance. Use the AWS CLI from the new EC2 instance to delete snapshots.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that denies snapshot deletion. Attach the policy to the storage administrator user.
options.C: Add tags to the snapshots. Create retention rules in Recycle Bin for EBS snapshots that have the tags.
options.D: Lock the EBS snapshots to prevent deletion.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Lock the EBS snapshots to prevent deletion.**

Amazon EBS snapshot lock is designed for this requirement: AWS states that you can lock EBS snapshots to protect them against accidental or malicious deletions, and that while a snapshot is locked, it **can't be deleted by any user, regardless of their IAM permissions**. This satisfies the requirement without changing the storage administrator user's administrative rights and is the most direct/least-effort control for preventing deletion. See [Amazon EBS snapshot lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-snapshot-lock.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Create an IAM role and delete snapshots from an EC2 instance** — This describes a way to perform deletions, not prevent accidental deletion. It does not meet the protection requirement.
- **B. Attach an IAM deny policy to the storage administrator user** — An explicit deny could prevent deletion, but it changes the administrator user's effective permissions, which the question explicitly says must not be changed.
- **C. Use Recycle Bin retention rules for tagged EBS snapshots** — Recycle Bin helps recover accidentally deleted EBS snapshots by retaining deleted resources for a specified period before permanent deletion; it does **not** stop the snapshot from being deleted in the first place. AWS describes Recycle Bin as a data recovery feature that lets you restore accidentally deleted EBS volumes, snapshots, and AMIs before the retention period expires. See [Recover deleted EBS volumes, EBS snapshots, and EBS-backed AMIs with Recycle Bin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html). Snapshot lock is the more direct answer because it prevents deletion regardless of IAM permissions.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷来运行一个应用程序。该公司每天为每个 EBS 卷创建一个快照，以满足合规性要求。该公司希望实施一种架构，防止意外删除 EBS 卷快照。该解决方案不得更改存储管理员用户的管理权限。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个具有删除快照权限的 IAM 角色。将该角色附加到一个新的 EC2 实例。使用新 EC2 实例上的 AWS CLI 删除快照。
options.B: 创建一个拒绝删除快照的 IAM policy。将该 policy 附加到存储管理员用户。
options.C: 向快照添加标签。为具有这些标签的 EBS 快照在 Recycle Bin 中创建保留规则。
options.D: 锁定 EBS 快照以防止删除。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 锁定 EBS 快照以防止删除。**

Amazon EBS snapshot lock 正是为此要求而设计的：AWS 表示，你可以锁定 EBS 快照，以保护它们免受意外或恶意删除；并且当快照被锁定时，**任何用户都无法删除它，无论其 IAM 权限如何**。这满足了要求，而且无需更改存储管理员用户的管理权限，是防止删除的最直接/最省力的控制措施。请参阅 [Amazon EBS snapshot lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-snapshot-lock.html)。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. 创建 IAM 角色并从 EC2 实例删除快照** — 这描述的是一种执行删除的方法，而不是防止意外删除。它不满足保护要求。
- **B. 将 IAM deny policy 附加到存储管理员用户** — 显式拒绝可以防止删除，但它会更改管理员用户的有效权限，而题目明确说明不得更改这些权限。
- **C. 对带标签的 EBS 快照使用 Recycle Bin 保留规则** — Recycle Bin 通过在永久删除前将已删除资源保留一段指定时间，帮助恢复意外删除的 EBS 快照；它并**不会**从一开始就阻止快照被删除。AWS 将 Recycle Bin 描述为一种数据恢复功能，可让你在保留期到期之前还原意外删除的 EBS 卷、快照和 AMI。请参阅 [Recover deleted EBS volumes, EBS snapshots, and EBS-backed AMIs with Recycle Bin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)。Snapshot lock 是更直接的答案，因为它可以无论 IAM 权限如何都防止删除。

en.question: A company's application uses Network Load Balancers, Auto Scaling groups, Amazon EC2 instances, and databases that are deployed in an Amazon VPC. The company wants to capture information about traffic to and from the network interfaces in near real time in its Amazon VPC. The company wants to send the information to Amazon OpenSearch Service for analysis. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
options.B: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the log group. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the log group to OpenSearch Service.
options.C: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.
options.D: Create a trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure VPC Flow Logs to send the log data to the trail. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the logs from the trail to OpenSearch Service.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** VPC Flow Logs is the right source because AWS states that it captures information about IP traffic going to and from network interfaces in a VPC, and that flow log data can be published to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, Amazon S3, or Amazon Data Firehose ([VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)). From a CloudWatch Logs log group, a subscription filter can send matching incoming log events to an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream, and AWS notes that this immediately starts the flow of real-time log data to Firehose ([CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)). Firehose also supports Amazon OpenSearch Service as a destination, where the OpenSearch Service domain is the destination to which data is delivered ([Firehose destination settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)). This matches the requirement to analyze near-real-time VPC network interface traffic in OpenSearch Service.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudWatch Logs can send data to Kinesis Data Streams, but the option does not include a consumer/processor to write the stream into OpenSearch. AWS documentation says that sources such as Kinesis Data Streams use AWS Lambda functions as event handlers to process and stream data to an OpenSearch domain, while Amazon Data Firehose and CloudWatch Logs have built-in support for OpenSearch Service ([OpenSearch integrations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/integrations.html)).
- **C:** CloudTrail is not the correct place for VPC Flow Logs. CloudTrail records actions taken by users, roles, or AWS services, including console, CLI, SDK, and API activity, for auditing and governance ([CloudTrail overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)). It is not the destination for VPC Flow Logs network-interface traffic.
- **D:** This has the same CloudTrail problem as option C. Although Firehose can deliver to OpenSearch, VPC Flow Logs should be published to CloudWatch Logs, S3, or Firehose—not to a CloudTrail trail ([VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序使用 Network Load Balancers、Auto Scaling groups、Amazon EC2 实例以及部署在 Amazon VPC 中的数据库。该公司希望近乎实时地捕获其 Amazon VPC 中进出网络接口的流量信息。该公司希望将这些信息发送到 Amazon OpenSearch Service 进行分析。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中创建一个日志组。配置 VPC Flow Logs 将日志数据发送到该日志组。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 将日志从该日志组流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。
options.B: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中创建一个日志组。配置 VPC Flow Logs 将日志数据发送到该日志组。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将日志从该日志组流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。
options.C: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一个跟踪。配置 VPC Flow Logs 将日志数据发送到该跟踪。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 将日志从该跟踪流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。
options.D: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建一个跟踪。配置 VPC Flow Logs 将日志数据发送到该跟踪。使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将日志从该跟踪流式传输到 OpenSearch Service。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** VPC Flow Logs 是正确的数据源，因为 AWS 表示它会捕获有关进出 VPC 中网络接口的 IP 流量信息，并且流日志数据可以发布到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs、Amazon S3 或 Amazon Data Firehose（[VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)）。从 CloudWatch Logs 日志组中，订阅筛选条件可以将匹配的传入日志事件发送到 Amazon Data Firehose 传输流，并且 AWS 指出这会立即开始将实时日志数据流向 Firehose（[CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)）。Firehose 还支持将 Amazon OpenSearch Service 作为目标，其中 OpenSearch Service 域是数据传送到的目标（[Firehose destination settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。这符合在 OpenSearch Service 中分析近乎实时的 VPC 网络接口流量的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** CloudWatch Logs 可以将数据发送到 Kinesis Data Streams，但该选项未包含用于将流写入 OpenSearch 的使用者/处理器。AWS 文档指出，Kinesis Data Streams 等来源使用 AWS Lambda 函数作为事件处理程序来处理数据并将其流式传输到 OpenSearch 域，而 Amazon Data Firehose 和 CloudWatch Logs 对 OpenSearch Service 具有内置支持（[OpenSearch integrations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/integrations.html)）。
- **C:** CloudTrail 不是 VPC Flow Logs 的正确位置。CloudTrail 记录用户、角色或 AWS 服务所执行的操作，包括控制台、CLI、SDK 和 API 活动，用于审计和治理（[CloudTrail overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)）。它不是 VPC Flow Logs 网络接口流量的目标。
- **D:** 这与选项 C 存在相同的 CloudTrail 问题。尽管 Firehose 可以传送到 OpenSearch，但 VPC Flow Logs 应发布到 CloudWatch Logs、S3 或 Firehose，而不是发布到 CloudTrail 跟踪（[VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing an application that will run on a production Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The EKS cluster has managed node groups that are provisioned with On-Demand Instances. The company needs a dedicated EKS cluster for development work. The company will use the development cluster infrequently to test the resiliency of the application. The EKS cluster must manage all the nodes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a managed node group that contains only Spot Instances.
options.B: Create two managed node groups. Provision one node group with On-Demand Instances. Provision the second node group with Spot Instances.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a launch configuration that uses Spot Instances. Configure the user data to add the nodes to the EKS cluster.
options.D: Create a managed node group that contains only On-Demand Instances.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **A**.

The company needs a **dedicated development EKS cluster** that will be used **infrequently** for resiliency testing, and it wants the **most cost-effective** solution while ensuring that **EKS manages all nodes**.

**A. Create a managed node group that contains only Spot Instances.**

This meets all requirements. Amazon EKS managed node groups automate the provisioning and lifecycle management of EC2 worker nodes for EKS clusters, so the nodes are managed by EKS rather than manually provisioned or registered. AWS states that with managed node groups, you do not need to separately provision or register the EC2 instances, and that EKS manages the associated Auto Scaling group for you ([AWS EKS managed node groups documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)).

Using **Spot Instances** is the most cost-effective choice for an infrequently used development and resiliency testing environment. Spot Instances use spare EC2 capacity and are available at steep discounts compared with On-Demand pricing. They are appropriate when workloads are flexible and can tolerate interruption ([AWS EC2 Spot Instances documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)). Resiliency testing is also a good fit for interruption-tolerant capacity.

Therefore, a single EKS managed node group using only Spot Instances is the lowest-cost option that still allows EKS to manage the nodes.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

**B. Create two managed node groups. Provision one node group with On-Demand Instances. Provision the second node group with Spot Instances.**

This would allow EKS to manage the nodes, but it is not the **most cost-effective** solution. Adding an On-Demand managed node group increases cost. The question describes an infrequently used development cluster for resiliency testing, so there is no stated requirement for always-available On-Demand capacity.

**C. Create an Auto Scaling group that has a launch configuration that uses Spot Instances. Configure the user data to add the nodes to the EKS cluster.**

This is a self-managed node approach. It would require manually configuring the Auto Scaling group and bootstrap/user data to join the EKS cluster. The requirement says the EKS cluster must manage all the nodes. EKS managed node groups are the AWS-managed way to provision and manage EKS worker nodes ([AWS EKS managed node groups documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)).

**D. Create a managed node group that contains only On-Demand Instances.**

This would satisfy the EKS-managed node requirement, but it is not the most cost-effective option. On-Demand Instances cost more than Spot Instances, and the workload is described as infrequent and suitable for resiliency testing, making Spot Instances the better cost-optimized choice.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个将在生产 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群上运行的应用程序。该 EKS 集群具有使用 On-Demand Instances 预置的托管节点组。该公司需要一个专用于开发工作的 EKS 集群。公司将不频繁地使用该开发集群来测试应用程序的弹性。EKS 集群必须管理所有节点。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个仅包含 Spot Instances 的托管节点组。
options.B: 创建两个托管节点组。使用 On-Demand Instances 预置一个节点组。使用 Spot Instances 预置第二个节点组。
options.C: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组，该组具有使用 Spot Instances 的启动配置。配置用户数据以将节点添加到 EKS 集群。
options.D: 创建一个仅包含 On-Demand Instances 的托管节点组。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A**。该公司需要一个**专用的开发 EKS 集群**，该集群将被**不频繁地**用于弹性测试，并且希望在确保 **EKS 管理所有节点**的同时获得**最具成本效益**的解决方案。

**A. Create a managed node group that contains only Spot Instances.**

这满足所有要求。Amazon EKS managed node groups 会自动为 EKS 集群预置和管理 EC2 工作节点的生命周期，因此节点由 EKS 管理，而不是手动预置或注册。AWS 表示，使用 managed node groups 时，你不需要单独预置或注册 EC2 实例，并且 EKS 会为你管理关联的 Auto Scaling group（[AWS EKS managed node groups documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)）。使用 **Spot Instances** 是针对不频繁使用的开发和弹性测试环境的最具成本效益选择。Spot Instances 使用闲置 EC2 容量，与 On-Demand 定价相比可提供大幅折扣。当工作负载具有灵活性并且能够容忍中断时，它们是合适的选择（[AWS EC2 Spot Instances documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)）。弹性测试也非常适合可容忍中断的容量。因此，仅使用 Spot Instances 的单个 EKS managed node group 是成本最低的选项，同时仍允许 EKS 管理节点。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

**B. Create two managed node groups. Provision one node group with On-Demand Instances. Provision the second node group with Spot Instances.**

这将允许 EKS 管理节点，但它不是**最具成本效益**的解决方案。添加 On-Demand managed node group 会增加成本。题目描述的是一个不频繁使用、用于弹性测试的开发集群，因此没有说明需要始终可用的 On-Demand 容量。

**C. Create an Auto Scaling group that has a launch configuration that uses Spot Instances. Configure the user data to add the nodes to the EKS cluster.**

这是一种自管理节点方法。它需要手动配置 Auto Scaling group 和 bootstrap/user data，以加入 EKS 集群。要求说明 EKS 集群必须管理所有节点。EKS managed node groups 是由 AWS 管理的、用于预置和管理 EKS 工作节点的方式（[AWS EKS managed node groups documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html)）。

**D. Create a managed node group that contains only On-Demand Instances.**

这会满足 EKS 管理节点的要求，但它不是最具成本效益的选项。On-Demand Instances 的成本高于 Spot Instances，并且该工作负载被描述为不频繁且适合弹性测试，因此 Spot Instances 是更好的成本优化选择。

en.question: A company stores sensitive data in Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to create an encryption solution. The company needs to fully control the ability of users to create, rotate, and disable encryption keys with minimal effort for any data that must be encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use default server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3) to store the sensitive data.
options.B: Create a customer managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.C: Create an AWS managed key by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Use the new key to encrypt the S3 objects by using server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.D: Download S3 objects to an Amazon EC2 instance. Encrypt the objects by using customer managed keys. Upload the encrypted objects back into Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Use **SSE-KMS with a customer managed AWS KMS key**. Amazon S3 documentation says that with SSE-KMS you can specify a customer managed key, and that creating a customer managed key gives more flexibility and control, including the ability to **create, rotate, and disable** customer managed keys, define access controls, and audit usage ([S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)). AWS KMS documentation also states that customer managed keys are recommended when customers want full control over the lifecycle and usage of their keys, and that customer managed keys can be used with AWS services that encrypt data on your behalf ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). This meets both requirements: full key lifecycle control and minimal operational effort through managed server-side encryption.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** SSE-S3 uses Amazon S3 managed encryption keys. It provides encryption, but it does not give the company full control over KMS key creation, rotation, disabling, key policies, and auditing.
- **C:** AWS managed KMS keys do not meet the control requirement. AWS KMS documentation states that customers **cannot change properties, rotate, change key policies, or schedule deletion** for AWS managed keys, and their rotation schedule cannot be changed ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)).
- **D:** Downloading objects to EC2, encrypting them manually, and uploading them back is unnecessary operational overhead and does not satisfy the “minimal effort” requirement. S3 already supports server-side encryption with AWS KMS, where S3 and KMS perform envelope encryption for objects ([S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将敏感数据存储在 Amazon S3 中。解决方案架构师需要创建一个加密解决方案。对于任何必须加密的数据，公司需要能够以最少的工作量完全控制用户创建、轮换和禁用加密密钥的能力。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用默认的服务器端加密以及 Amazon S3 托管的加密密钥 (SSE-S3) 来存储敏感数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建客户托管密钥。使用该新密钥通过使用 AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密来加密 S3 对象。
options.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 创建 AWS 托管密钥。使用该新密钥通过使用 AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) 的服务器端加密来加密 S3 对象。
options.D: 将 S3 对象下载到 Amazon EC2 实例。使用客户托管密钥加密这些对象。将加密后的对象上传回 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

使用**带客户托管 AWS KMS key 的 SSE-KMS**。Amazon S3 文档说明，使用 SSE-KMS 时可以指定客户托管密钥，并且创建客户托管密钥可提供更高的灵活性和控制力，包括能够**创建、轮换和禁用**客户托管密钥、定义访问控制以及审计使用情况（[S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)）。AWS KMS 文档还指出，当客户希望完全控制其密钥的生命周期和使用时，建议使用客户托管密钥，并且客户托管密钥可与代表你加密数据的 AWS 服务一起使用（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。这同时满足两个要求：完全的密钥生命周期控制，以及通过托管服务器端加密实现最少的运维工作量。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** SSE-S3 使用 Amazon S3 托管的加密密钥。它提供加密，但不会让公司完全控制 KMS key 的创建、轮换、禁用、密钥策略和审计。
- **C:** AWS 托管的 KMS keys 不满足控制要求。AWS KMS 文档说明，对于 AWS 托管密钥，客户**不能更改属性、轮换、更改密钥策略或计划删除**，并且其轮换计划不能更改（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。
- **D:** 将对象下载到 EC2、手动加密再上传回去会产生不必要的运维开销，并且不满足“最少的工作量”要求。S3 已经支持使用 AWS KMS 的服务器端加密，其中 S3 和 KMS 会对对象执行信封加密（[S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to back up its on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to AWS. The company's backup solution exports on-premises backups to an Amazon S3 bucket as objects. The S3 backups must be retained for 30 days and must be automatically deleted after 30 days. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an S3 bucket that has S3 Object Lock enabled.
options.B: Create an S3 bucket that has object versioning enabled.
options.C: Configure a default retention period of 30 days for the objects.
options.D: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to protect the objects for 30 days.
options.E: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to expire the objects after 30 days.
options.F: Configure the backup solution to tag the objects with a 30-day retention period

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A, C, and E**.

- **A is correct**: To ensure the backups are retained and cannot be deleted before the retention period, use **S3 Object Lock**. AWS states that Object Lock works only with versioned buckets, and enabling Object Lock when creating the bucket includes enabling bucket versioning as part of that setup ([Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)).
- **C is correct**: A default retention period on an Object Lock-enabled bucket specifies how long to protect every object version placed in the bucket. Setting this to **30 days** locks new backup objects for 30 days ([Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)).
- **E is correct**: S3 Lifecycle expiration actions define when objects expire, and Amazon S3 deletes expired objects on your behalf. A lifecycle rule with expiration after 30 days meets the automatic deletion requirement ([Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B is not selected**: Versioning is required for Object Lock, but the step to create an Object Lock-enabled bucket already includes/depends on enabling versioning. Selecting B separately does not add the required retention behavior.
- **D is incorrect**: S3 Lifecycle policies can transition or expire/delete objects; they do not “protect” objects for a retention period. Protection is provided by Object Lock, not Lifecycle ([Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).
- **F is incorrect**: Object tags are key-value metadata for categorization/cost allocation; tagging objects with a “30-day retention period” does not by itself enforce retention or deletion ([Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其本地虚拟机 (VMs) 备份到 AWS。该公司的备份解决方案会将本地备份作为对象导出到一个 Amazon S3 bucket。S3 备份必须保留 30 天，并且必须在 30 天后自动删除。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个启用了 S3 Object Lock 的 S3 bucket。
options.B: 创建一个启用了对象版本控制的 S3 bucket。
options.C: 为对象配置 30 天的默认保留期。
options.D: 配置 S3 Lifecycle policy 以保护对象 30 天。
options.E: 配置 S3 Lifecycle policy 以在 30 天后使对象过期。
options.F: 配置备份解决方案，为对象添加带有 30 天保留期的标签

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A、C 和 E**。

- **A 正确**：为确保备份被保留且在保留期之前不能被删除，请使用 **S3 Object Lock**。AWS 声明 Object Lock 仅适用于启用版本控制的 bucket，并且在创建 bucket 时启用 Object Lock 会将启用 bucket 版本控制作为该设置的一部分包含进去（[Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)）。
- **C 正确**：在启用了 Object Lock 的 bucket 上设置默认保留期，可以指定要保护放入该 bucket 的每个对象版本多长时间。将其设置为 **30 天** 会将新的备份对象锁定 30 天（[Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)）。
- **E 正确**：S3 Lifecycle 过期操作定义对象何时过期，Amazon S3 会代表你删除过期对象。设置一条 30 天后过期的 lifecycle rule 可满足自动删除要求（[Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。错误选项：

- **B 未选择**：Object Lock 需要版本控制，但创建启用了 Object Lock 的 bucket 这一步已经包含/依赖于启用版本控制。单独选择 B 并不会增加所需的保留行为。
- **D 错误**：S3 Lifecycle policies 可以转换对象或使对象过期/删除；它们不会在保留期内“保护”对象。保护由 Object Lock 提供，而不是 Lifecycle（[Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。
- **F 错误**：对象标签是用于分类/成本分配的键值元数据；为对象添加“30-day retention period”标签本身不会强制执行保留或删除（[Configuring S3 Object Lock](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock-configure.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to copy files from an Amazon S3 bucket to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and another S3 bucket. The files must be copied continuously. New files are added to the original S3 bucket consistently. The copied files should be overwritten only if the source file changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer only data that has changed.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Mount the file system to the function. Set up an S3 event notification to invoke the function when files are created and changed in Amazon S3. Configure the function to copy files to the file system and the destination S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS DataSync location for both the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Create a task for the destination S3 bucket and the EFS file system. Set the transfer mode to transfer all data.
options.D: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in the same VPC as the file system. Mount the file system. Create a script to routinely synchronize all objects that changed in the origin S3 bucket to the destination S3 bucket and the mounted file system.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS DataSync is the lowest-operational-overhead managed service for this use case. DataSync supports transfers between AWS storage services such as Amazon S3 and Amazon EFS; AWS documentation describes DataSync copying data from a supported AWS storage service to another supported AWS storage service, and notes that no agent is required for transfers between AWS storage services in the same account/partition ([AWS DataSync transfer architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/how-datasync-transfer-works.html)). You create DataSync locations for the source S3 bucket and for each destination—the other S3 bucket and the EFS file system—and create scheduled tasks. DataSync task scheduling can periodically transfer data between storage locations ([task scheduling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)).

The key requirement is to overwrite copied files only when the source changes. DataSync has a **Transfer only data that has changed** mode; after the initial full transfer, it copies only data and metadata that differs between source and destination. DataSync also has an **Overwrite files** option that modifies destination data when the source data or metadata has changed ([DataSync transfer mode and overwrite options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-metadata.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B:** A Lambda function with EFS mounted and S3 event notifications could be built, but it requires custom code, error handling, retries, scaling, and ongoing operations. DataSync provides managed locations, tasks, schedules, changed-data transfer, and overwrite behavior without custom synchronization logic.
* **C:** `Transfer all data` is explicitly documented as copying everything from source to destination without comparing differences between the locations, so it does not meet the requirement to overwrite only if the source changes ([DataSync transfer mode options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-metadata.html)).
* **D:** Running an EC2 instance and custom synchronization scripts adds operational overhead for instance management, patching, monitoring, retries, and script maintenance. DataSync is the managed alternative and supports S3 and EFS transfer locations ([S3 location](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html), [EFS location](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-efs-location.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要将文件从一个 Amazon S3 存储桶复制到一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统和另一个 S3 存储桶。文件必须持续复制。新文件会不断添加到原始 S3 存储桶中。只有当源文件发生更改时，才应覆盖已复制的文件。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 为目标 S3 存储桶和 EFS 文件系统分别创建 AWS DataSync 位置。为目标 S3 存储桶和 EFS 文件系统创建任务。将传输模式设置为仅传输已更改的数据。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。将文件系统挂载到该函数。设置 S3 事件通知，以便在 Amazon S3 中创建和更改文件时调用该函数。配置该函数将文件复制到文件系统和目标 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 为目标 S3 存储桶和 EFS 文件系统分别创建 AWS DataSync 位置。为目标 S3 存储桶和 EFS 文件系统创建任务。将传输模式设置为传输所有数据。
options.D: 在与文件系统相同的 VPC 中启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例。挂载该文件系统。创建一个脚本，定期将源 S3 存储桶中发生更改的所有对象同步到目标 S3 存储桶和已挂载的文件系统。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS DataSync 是此使用场景中运营开销最低的托管服务。DataSync 支持在 Amazon S3 和 Amazon EFS 等 AWS 存储服务之间进行传输；AWS 文档说明 DataSync 可将数据从受支持的 AWS 存储服务复制到另一个受支持的 AWS 存储服务，并指出在同一账户/分区中的 AWS 存储服务之间传输时无需代理（[AWS DataSync transfer architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/how-datasync-transfer-works.html)）。你需要为源 S3 存储桶以及每个目标（另一个 S3 存储桶和 EFS 文件系统）创建 DataSync 位置，并创建计划任务。DataSync 任务计划可以定期在存储位置之间传输数据（[task scheduling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/task-scheduling.html)）。关键要求是仅在源发生更改时覆盖已复制的文件。DataSync 具有 **Transfer only data that has changed** 模式；在初始完整传输之后，它只复制源和目标之间不同的数据和元数据。DataSync 还具有 **Overwrite files** 选项，可在源数据或元数据发生更改时修改目标数据（[DataSync transfer mode and overwrite options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-metadata.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B:** 可以构建一个挂载 EFS 并使用 S3 事件通知的 Lambda 函数，但这需要自定义代码、错误处理、重试、扩展和持续运营。DataSync 提供托管的位置、任务、计划、已更改数据传输和覆盖行为，而无需自定义同步逻辑。
* **C:** `Transfer all data` 明确记录为将所有内容从源复制到目标，而不比较各位置之间的差异，因此它不满足仅在源发生更改时才覆盖的要求（[DataSync transfer mode options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/configure-metadata.html)）。
* **D:** 运行 EC2 实例和自定义同步脚本会增加实例管理、补丁、监控、重试和脚本维护方面的运营开销。DataSync 是托管替代方案，并支持 S3 和 EFS 传输位置（[S3 location](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html), [EFS location](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-efs-location.html)）。

en.question: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and stores data on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company must ensure that all data is encrypted at rest by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). The company must be able to control rotation of the encryption keys. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a customer managed key. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.B: Use an AWS managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes. Use the key to configure automatic key rotation.
options.C: Create an external KMS key with imported key material. Use the key to encrypt the EBS volumes.
options.D: Use an AWS owned key to encrypt the EBS volumes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The requirement is not only to encrypt EBS data at rest with AWS KMS, but also for the company to **control key rotation** with the least operational overhead. AWS documentation for EBS says that for EBS encryption you can create new cryptographic material by either creating a new customer managed key or enabling automatic key rotation for an existing customer managed key; automatic rotation lets AWS KMS generate new key material while EBS volumes and snapshots remain usable without code changes ([Amazon EBS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/kms-key-rotation.html)). AWS KMS documentation also states that customer managed keys are created, owned, and managed by the customer and provide full control, including rotating their cryptographic material ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). This meets the control requirement with relatively low overhead because rotation can be enabled for an eligible customer managed key.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** AWS managed keys are automatically rotated, but AWS states that you cannot change their properties or rotate them, and that their rotation schedule cannot be changed ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). This does not meet the requirement to control rotation.
- **C:** Imported/external key material adds operational overhead. Also, EBS documentation notes that automatic key rotation is supported only for symmetric customer managed keys with key material that AWS KMS creates ([Amazon EBS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/kms-key-rotation.html)). Therefore this is not the least-operational-overhead approach.
- **D:** AWS owned keys are owned and managed by AWS services and are not in the customer account; AWS documentation says they are appropriate only when you are not required to audit or control the encryption key, and their rotation varies by service ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). This does not provide the required control.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例，并将数据存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷上。该公司必须确保所有静态数据都使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 进行加密。该公司必须能够控制加密密钥的轮换。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建客户托管密钥。使用该密钥加密 EBS 卷。
options.B: 使用 AWS 托管密钥加密 EBS 卷。使用该密钥配置自动密钥轮换。
options.C: 创建一个包含导入密钥材料的外部 KMS 密钥。使用该密钥加密 EBS 卷。
options.D: 使用 AWS 拥有的密钥加密 EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

要求不仅是使用 AWS KMS 对 EBS 静态数据进行加密，还要求公司能够以最少的运营开销**控制密钥轮换**。关于 EBS 加密的 AWS 文档说明，对于 EBS 加密，你可以通过创建新的客户托管密钥，或为现有客户托管密钥启用自动密钥轮换来创建新的加密材料；自动轮换让 AWS KMS 生成新的密钥材料，同时 EBS 卷和快照无需代码更改即可继续使用（[Amazon EBS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/kms-key-rotation.html)）。AWS KMS 文档还说明，客户托管密钥由客户创建、拥有和管理，并提供完全控制，包括轮换其加密材料（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。这满足了控制要求，并且运营开销相对较低，因为可以为符合条件的客户托管密钥启用轮换。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B:** AWS 托管密钥会自动轮换，但 AWS 声明你不能更改其属性或轮换它们，并且其轮换计划无法更改（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。这不满足控制轮换的要求。
- **C:** 导入/外部密钥材料会增加运营开销。此外，EBS 文档指出，自动密钥轮换仅支持具有由 AWS KMS 创建的密钥材料的对称客户托管密钥（[Amazon EBS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/kms-key-rotation.html)）。因此，这不是运营开销最少的方法。
- **D:** AWS 拥有的密钥由 AWS 服务拥有和管理，并且不在客户账户中；AWS 文档说明，只有在你不需要审计或控制加密密钥时，它们才适用，并且其轮换因服务而异（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。这无法提供所需的控制。

en.question: A company needs a solution to enforce data encryption at rest on Amazon EC2 instances. The solution must automatically identify noncompliant resources and enforce compliance policies on findings. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use an IAM policy that allows users to create only encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Config and AWS Systems Manager to automate the detection and remediation of unencrypted EBS volumes.
options.B: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to manage access to encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Lambda and Amazon EventBridge to automate the detection and remediation of unencrypted EBS volumes.
options.C: Use Amazon Macie to detect unencrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Systems Manager Automation rules to automatically encrypt existing and new EBS volumes.
options.D: Use Amazon inspector to detect unencrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Use AWS Systems Manager Automation rules to automatically encrypt existing and new EBS volumes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Config is the lowest-administration fit for automatically identifying and remediating noncompliant EBS encryption findings. AWS provides a managed Config rule, **ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES**, that checks whether attached Amazon EBS volumes are encrypted and marks them **NON_COMPLIANT** if they are unencrypted or not encrypted with the specified KMS key ([AWS Config encrypted-volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/encrypted-volumes.html)). AWS Config can then remediate noncompliant resources evaluated by Config rules by using **AWS Systems Manager Automation documents** ([Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)), and Config supports **automatic remediation** by associating remediation actions with Config rules ([Setting Up Auto Remediation for AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/setup-autoremediation.html)). The IAM policy portion is also appropriate because AWS documentation shows that IAM conditions can allow `ec2:CreateVolume` only when `ec2:Encrypted` is `true` ([Example IAM policies for Amazon EBS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** KMS is required for EBS encryption keys, but KMS itself does not provide the managed compliance detection/remediation workflow. Building detection and remediation with Lambda and EventBridge is a custom implementation and has more administrative overhead than AWS Config managed rules plus Config remediation.
- **C:** Amazon Macie is focused on discovering, monitoring, and protecting **sensitive data in Amazon S3**, not detecting unencrypted EBS volumes ([What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)).
- **D:** Amazon Inspector continuously scans eligible resources for **vulnerabilities and network exposure** and produces vulnerability findings, not EBS encryption compliance findings ([What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要一个解决方案，用于在 Amazon EC2 实例上强制执行静态数据加密。该解决方案必须自动识别不合规资源，并根据发现结果强制执行合规策略。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 IAM policy，仅允许用户创建加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。使用 AWS Config 和 AWS Systems Manager 自动检测和修复未加密的 EBS 卷。
options.B: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 管理对加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷的访问。使用 AWS Lambda 和 Amazon EventBridge 自动检测和修复未加密的 EBS 卷。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Macie 检测未加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。使用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 规则自动加密现有和新的 EBS 卷。
options.D: 使用 Amazon inspector 检测未加密的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。使用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 规则自动加密现有和新的 EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS Config 是以最低管理开销自动识别和修复不合规 EBS 加密发现结果的合适选择。AWS 提供了一个托管 Config 规则，**ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES**，用于检查已挂载的 Amazon EBS 卷是否已加密；如果它们未加密，或未使用指定的 KMS key 加密，则将其标记为 **NON_COMPLIANT**（[AWS Config encrypted-volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/encrypted-volumes.html)）。然后，AWS Config 可以使用 **AWS Systems Manager Automation documents** 修复由 Config 规则评估出的不合规资源（[Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)），并且 Config 支持通过将修复操作与 Config 规则关联来进行 **automatic remediation**（[Setting Up Auto Remediation for AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/setup-autoremediation.html)）。IAM policy 部分也很合适，因为 AWS 文档显示，IAM 条件可以仅在 `ec2:Encrypted` 为 `true` 时允许 `ec2:CreateVolume`（[Example IAM policies for Amazon EBS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** KMS 是 EBS 加密密钥所必需的，但 KMS 本身并不提供托管的合规性检测/修复工作流。使用 Lambda 和 EventBridge 构建检测和修复属于自定义实现，相比 AWS Config 托管规则加 Config 修复，会产生更多管理开销。
- **C:** Amazon Macie 专注于发现、监控和保护 **Amazon S3 中的敏感数据**，而不是检测未加密的 EBS 卷（[What is Amazon Macie?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。
- **D:** Amazon Inspector 持续扫描符合条件的资源，以查找 **漏洞和网络暴露**，并生成漏洞发现结果，而不是 EBS 加密合规性发现结果（[What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating its multi-tier on-premises application to AWS. The application consists of a single-node MySQL database and a multi-node web tier. The company must minimize changes to the application during the migration. The company wants to improve application resiliency after the migration. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployment.
options.D: Migrate the web tier to an AWS Lambda function.
options.E: Migrate the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and C**.

- **A is correct** because the web tier is already multi-node, so moving it to **EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer** minimizes application changes while improving resilience. AWS documentation states that Elastic Load Balancing automatically distributes incoming application traffic across EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group, that instances launched by the group are automatically registered, and that ELB health checks can help Auto Scaling identify and replace unhealthy instances. It also states that an Application Load Balancer routes and load balances at the HTTP/HTTPS application layer to registered EC2 targets ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)).
- **C is correct** because the existing database is MySQL, and **Amazon RDS for MySQL** lets applications use standard MySQL utilities and applications, which helps minimize changes. AWS also states that Amazon RDS supports **Multi-AZ deployments for MySQL as a high-availability, failover solution** ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_MySQL.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B is incorrect** because placing MySQL database EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind a Network Load Balancer is not an appropriate minimal-change HA design for a single-node relational database. The AWS docs describe a Network Load Balancer as Layer 4 traffic distribution, while RDS Multi-AZ is the documented MySQL high-availability/failover solution ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html), [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_MySQL.html)).
- **D is incorrect** because migrating the web tier to Lambda would change the application architecture to a serverless function model rather than a straightforward lift-and-shift to EC2. Lambda runs code without managing servers and is event/function based, so this would not minimize application changes ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **E is incorrect** because DynamoDB is a NoSQL database with a different data modeling approach from an RDBMS. AWS documentation explains that relational databases and DynamoDB differ in query and schema design, so moving a MySQL database to DynamoDB would require significant redesign rather than minimal migration changes ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其多层本地应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序由一个单节点 MySQL 数据库和一个多节点 Web 层组成。公司必须在迁移期间尽量减少对应用程序的更改。公司希望在迁移后提高应用程序的弹性。以下哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 Web 层迁移到 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到 Network Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 部署。
options.D: 将 Web 层迁移到 AWS Lambda 函数。
options.E: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB 表。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 C**。

- **A 正确**，因为 Web 层已经是多节点，因此将其迁移到 **Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例** 可以在尽量减少应用程序更改的同时提高弹性。AWS 文档指出，Elastic Load Balancing 会自动将传入的应用程序流量分配到 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例，组启动的实例会自动注册，并且 ELB 运行状况检查可以帮助 Auto Scaling 识别并替换不正常的实例。文档还指出，Application Load Balancer 在 HTTP/HTTPS 应用层对注册的 EC2 目标进行路由和负载均衡 ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html))。
- **C 正确**，因为现有数据库是 MySQL，而 **Amazon RDS for MySQL** 允许应用程序使用标准 MySQL 工具和应用程序，这有助于尽量减少更改。AWS 还指出，Amazon RDS 支持 **Multi-AZ deployments for MySQL as a high-availability, failover solution** ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_MySQL.html))。错误选项：

- **B 错误**，因为将 MySQL 数据库 EC2 实例放在 Network Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中，并不是适用于单节点关系数据库的恰当的最小更改 HA 设计。AWS 文档将 Network Load Balancer 描述为第 4 层流量分配，而 RDS Multi-AZ 是文档记录的 MySQL 高可用性/故障转移解决方案 ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html), [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_MySQL.html))。
- **D 错误**，因为将 Web 层迁移到 Lambda 会把应用程序架构更改为无服务器函数模型，而不是直接 lift-and-shift 到 EC2。Lambda 在无需管理服务器的情况下运行代码，并且基于事件/函数，因此这不会尽量减少应用程序更改 ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html))。
- **E 错误**，因为 DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 数据库，其数据建模方式与 RDBMS 不同。AWS 文档说明，关系数据库和 DynamoDB 在查询和架构设计方面有所不同，因此将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 DynamoDB 将需要重大重新设计，而不是最小迁移更改 ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html))。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its web applications from on premises to AWS. The company is located close to the eu-central-1 Region. Because of regulations, the company cannot launch some of its applications in eu-central-1. The company wants to achieve single-digit millisecond latency. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to an edge location in Amazon CloudFront.
options.B: Deploy the applications in AWS Local Zones by extending the company's VPC from eu-central-1 to the chosen Local Zone.
options.C: Deploy the applications in eu-central-1. Extend the company’s VPC from eu-central-1 to the regional edge caches in Amazon CloudFront.
options.D: Deploy the applications in AWS Wavelength Zones by extending the company’s VPC from eu- central-1 to the chosen Wavelength Zone.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Local Zones are designed for this scenario: a Local Zone is an extension of an AWS Region in geographic proximity to users, and you create a subnet in the Local Zone and launch resources in that Local Zone subnet to serve applications that require low latency ([AWS Local Zones - How AWS Local Zones work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/local-zones/latest/ug/how-local-zones-work.html)). AWS also states that a VPC can span Availability Zones, Local Zones, and Wavelength Zones, and that supported AWS resources can be deployed in Local Zone subnets; the Local Zone's specific geography can help meet regulatory and compliance requirements ([AWS Local Zones concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/local-zones/latest/ug/concepts-local-zones.html)). Therefore, extending the company's VPC from `eu-central-1` to an appropriate Local Zone and deploying the applications there meets the regulatory and low-latency requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A and C:** Both deploy the applications in `eu-central-1`, which the question says is not allowed for some applications. Also, CloudFront is a content delivery service that routes requests to edge locations and retrieves content from an origin such as S3 or an HTTP server; it does not extend a VPC to edge locations or regional edge caches for deploying the application itself ([Amazon CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).
- **D:** AWS Wavelength can extend a VPC to Wavelength Zones, but Wavelength is specifically deployed at the edge of communications service providers' networks for applications needing low latency to mobile devices/end users ([What is AWS Wavelength?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wavelength/latest/developerguide/what-is-wavelength.html)). For a general web application migration with regulatory location constraints near a Region, Local Zones are the better fit.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其 Web 应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。该公司位于靠近 eu-central-1 Region 的位置。由于法规要求，该公司不能在 eu-central-1 中启动其部分应用程序。该公司希望实现个位数毫秒级延迟。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 eu-central-1 中部署应用程序。将公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 扩展到 Amazon CloudFront 中的边缘站点。
options.B: 通过将公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 扩展到所选 Local Zone，在 AWS Local Zones 中部署应用程序。
options.C: 在 eu-central-1 中部署应用程序。将公司的 VPC 从 eu-central-1 扩展到 Amazon CloudFront 中的区域边缘缓存。
options.D: 通过将公司的 VPC 从 eu- central-1 扩展到所选 Wavelength Zone，在 AWS Wavelength Zones 中部署应用程序。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Local Zones 正是为此场景而设计的：Local Zone 是 AWS Region 在地理上靠近用户位置的扩展，你可以在 Local Zone 中创建子网，并在该 Local Zone 子网中启动资源，以服务需要低延迟的应用程序（[AWS Local Zones - How AWS Local Zones work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/local-zones/latest/ug/how-local-zones-work.html)）。AWS 还说明，VPC 可以跨越 Availability Zones、Local Zones 和 Wavelength Zones，并且受支持的 AWS 资源可以部署在 Local Zone 子网中；Local Zone 的特定地理位置有助于满足监管和合规要求（[AWS Local Zones concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/local-zones/latest/ug/concepts-local-zones.html)）。因此，将公司的 VPC 从 `eu-central-1` 扩展到合适的 Local Zone 并在那里部署应用程序，可以满足监管和低延迟要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A 和 C：** 两者都将应用程序部署在 `eu-central-1` 中，而题目说明某些应用程序不允许这样做。此外，CloudFront 是一种内容分发服务，它将请求路由到边缘站点，并从诸如 S3 或 HTTP 服务器之类的源站检索内容；它不会将 VPC 扩展到边缘站点或区域边缘缓存来部署应用程序本身（[Amazon CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。
- **D：** AWS Wavelength 可以将 VPC 扩展到 Wavelength Zones，但 Wavelength 专门部署在通信服务提供商网络的边缘，用于需要向移动设备/最终用户提供低延迟的应用程序（[What is AWS Wavelength?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wavelength/latest/developerguide/what-is-wavelength.html)）。对于具有靠近某个 Region 的监管位置约束的一般 Web 应用程序迁移，Local Zones 更合适。

en.question: A company’s ecommerce website has unpredictable traffic and uses AWS Lambda functions to directly access a private Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. The company wants to maintain predictable database performance and ensure that the Lambda invocations do not overload the database with too many connections. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Point the client driver at an RDS custom endpoint. Deploy the Lambda functions inside a VPC.
options.B: Point the client driver at an RDS proxy endpoint. Deploy the Lambda functions inside a VPC.
options.C: Point the client driver at an RDS custom endpoint. Deploy the Lambda functions outside a VPC.
options.D: Point the client driver at an RDS proxy endpoint. Deploy the Lambda functions outside a VPC.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Use an **RDS Proxy endpoint** and deploy the Lambda functions **inside the VPC**.

RDS Proxy is designed for this exact pattern: AWS states that RDS Proxy lets applications **pool and share database connections** to improve scalability, handle **unpredictable surges in database traffic**, reuse connections, and control the number of database connections created to protect the database from oversubscription. It can also queue/throttle excess application connections while maintaining predictable database performance for supported load ([Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). Also, RDS Proxy connection settings such as `MaxConnectionsPercent` limit how many connections the proxy can establish to the target database ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)). For connectivity, AWS documentation states that a Lambda function connecting to an RDS DB instance **must exist in the same VPC as the DB instance** ([Automatically connecting a Lambda function and a DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)); Lambda documentation also says to access private resources, connect the function to private subnets in a VPC ([Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A and C:** An RDS custom endpoint does not provide RDS Proxy’s connection pooling, throttling, or database connection limit controls. It would not prevent unpredictable Lambda concurrency from overloading PostgreSQL with too many direct connections.
- **C and D:** Deploying the Lambda functions outside the VPC is not appropriate for direct access to a private RDS DB instance. The Lambda function must be in the same VPC as the DB instance, and private resources require VPC-connected Lambda functions.
- **D:** Although it uses an RDS Proxy endpoint, the Lambda functions are outside the VPC, so it fails the private RDS connectivity requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司的电子商务网站流量不可预测，并使用 AWS Lambda 函数直接访问私有 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB 实例。公司希望保持可预测的数据库性能，并确保 Lambda 调用不会因过多连接而使数据库过载。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将客户端驱动程序指向 RDS 自定义端点。将 Lambda 函数部署在 VPC 内。
options.B: 将客户端驱动程序指向 RDS proxy endpoint。将 Lambda 函数部署在 VPC 内。
options.C: 将客户端驱动程序指向 RDS 自定义端点。将 Lambda 函数部署在 VPC 外。
options.D: 将客户端驱动程序指向 RDS proxy endpoint。将 Lambda 函数部署在 VPC 外。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 使用 **RDS Proxy endpoint**，并将 Lambda 函数部署在 **VPC 内**。

RDS Proxy 正是为这种模式设计的：AWS 表示，RDS Proxy 允许应用程序**池化并共享数据库连接**，以提高可扩展性、处理**数据库流量中不可预测的突增**、复用连接，并控制创建的数据库连接数量，从而保护数据库免于过度订阅。在受支持的负载下，它还可以对过量的应用程序连接进行排队/限流，同时保持可预测的数据库性能（[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。此外，RDS Proxy 连接设置（例如 `MaxConnectionsPercent`）会限制代理可以建立到目标数据库的连接数量（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。对于连接性，AWS 文档指出，连接到 RDS DB 实例的 Lambda 函数**必须与该 DB 实例位于同一 VPC 中**（[Automatically connecting a Lambda function and a DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/lambda-rds-connect.html)）；Lambda 文档还说明，要访问私有资源，需要将函数连接到 VPC 中的私有子网（[Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A 和 C：** RDS 自定义端点不提供 RDS Proxy 的连接池、限流或数据库连接限制控制。它无法防止不可预测的 Lambda 并发因过多直接连接而使 PostgreSQL 过载。
- **C 和 D：** 将 Lambda 函数部署在 VPC 外不适合直接访问私有 RDS DB 实例。Lambda 函数必须与 DB 实例位于同一 VPC 中，并且私有资源需要连接到 VPC 的 Lambda 函数。
- **D：** 虽然它使用 RDS Proxy endpoint，但 Lambda 函数位于 VPC 外，因此不满足私有 RDS 连接性要求。

en.question: A company is creating an application. The company stores data from tests of the application in multiple on-premises locations. The company needs to connect the on-premises locations to VPCs in an AWS Region in the AWS Cloud. The number of accounts and VPCs will increase during the next year. The network architecture must simplify the administration of new connections and must provide the ability to scale. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Create a VPN connection between the VPCs and the on-premises locations.
options.B: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. On the instance, include VPN software that uses a VPN connection to connect all VPCs and on-premises locations.
options.C: Create a transit gateway. Create VPC attachments for the VPC connections. Create VPN attachments for the on-premises connections.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises locations and a central VPC. Connect the central VPC to other VPCs by using peering connections.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Transit Gateway is designed for this scenario: it is a network transit hub that interconnects VPCs and on-premises networks, and it supports attachments for one or more VPCs and VPN connections to the transit gateway ([AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)). AWS also describes Transit Gateway as a fully managed hub-and-spoke service where AWS manages high availability and scalability; it can connect thousands of VPCs, consolidate VPN/Direct Connect hybrid connectivity to a single gateway, and simplify management because VPCs connect only to the transit gateway to reach connected networks ([AWS Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)). Creating VPC attachments and VPN attachments therefore meets the scaling and low-administration requirements ([VPC attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpc-attachments.html), [VPN attachment creation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/create-vpn-attachment.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** VPC peering is point-to-point and requires each peering request to be accepted and routes to be manually added in each VPC route table, which becomes administratively expensive as accounts and VPCs grow ([VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)). Adding separate VPN connections to VPCs further increases overhead.
- **B:** Running VPN software on an EC2 instance requires provisioning and managing a third-party/self-managed virtual appliance. AWS documentation contrasts Transit Gateway with this approach by noting that Transit Gateway is fully managed and does not require provisioning third-party virtual appliances ([AWS Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)).
- **D:** Direct Connect can be attached to a transit gateway, but this option uses a central VPC plus VPC peering. That still depends on VPC peering, which requires manual route management per peering relationship and does not provide the same hub-and-spoke simplification as Transit Gateway ([VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在创建一个应用程序。该公司将应用程序测试产生的数据存储在多个本地位置。公司需要将这些本地位置连接到 AWS Cloud 中某个 AWS Region 内的 VPC。账户和 VPC 的数量将在明年增加。网络架构必须简化新连接的管理，并且必须具备扩展能力。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 VPC 之间创建对等连接。在 VPC 和本地位置之间创建 VPN 连接。
options.B: 启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例。在该实例上包含使用 VPN 连接来连接所有 VPC 和本地位置的 VPN 软件。
options.C: 创建一个 transit gateway。为 VPC 连接创建 VPC attachments。为本地连接创建 VPN attachments。
options.D: 在本地位置和一个中央 VPC 之间创建 AWS Direct Connect 连接。使用对等连接将中央 VPC 连接到其他 VPC。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Transit Gateway 专为这种场景而设计：它是一个网络传输枢纽，用于互连 VPC 和本地网络，并且支持将一个或多个 VPC 以及 VPN 连接附加到 transit gateway（[AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。AWS 还将 Transit Gateway 描述为一种完全托管的中心辐射型服务，其中 AWS 管理高可用性和可扩展性；它可以连接数千个 VPC，将 VPN/Direct Connect 混合连接整合到单个网关，并简化管理，因为 VPC 只需连接到 transit gateway 即可访问已连接的网络（[AWS Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。因此，创建 VPC attachments 和 VPN attachments 可以满足扩展和低管理要求（[VPC attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpc-attachments.html)，[VPN attachment creation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/create-vpn-attachment.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** VPC peering 是点对点的，并且需要接受每个对等连接请求，还需要在每个 VPC 路由表中手动添加路由；随着账户和 VPC 增加，这会带来很高的管理成本（[VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。向 VPC 添加单独的 VPN 连接会进一步增加开销。
- **B:** 在 EC2 实例上运行 VPN 软件需要预置并管理第三方/自管理的虚拟设备。AWS 文档通过指出 Transit Gateway 是完全托管的，并且不需要预置第三方虚拟设备，将 Transit Gateway 与这种方法进行了对比（[AWS Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。
- **D:** Direct Connect 可以附加到 transit gateway，但此选项使用中央 VPC 加 VPC peering。这仍然依赖 VPC peering，而 VPC peering 需要针对每个对等关系进行手动路由管理，并且无法提供与 Transit Gateway 相同的中心辐射式简化（[VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。

en.question: A company that uses AWS needs a solution to predict the resources needed for manufacturing processes each month. The solution must use historical values that are currently stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has no machine learning (ML) experience and wants to use a managed service for the training and predictions. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy an Amazon SageMaker model. Create a SageMaker endpoint for inference.
options.B: Use Amazon SageMaker to train a model by using the historical data in the S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure an AWS Lambda function with a function URL that uses Amazon SageMaker endpoints to create predictions based on the inputs.
options.D: Configure an AWS Lambda function with a function URL that uses an Amazon Forecast predictor to create a prediction based on the inputs.
options.E: Train an Amazon Forsecast predictor by using the historical data in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
The correct answers are **D and E**.

**E. Train an Amazon Forecast predictor by using the historical data in the S3 bucket** is correct. The workload is a monthly resource prediction problem, which is a time-series forecasting use case. Amazon Forecast is a fully managed forecasting service that uses statistical and machine learning algorithms to generate forecasts from historical time-series data and is designed to require no machine learning experience. The Amazon Forecast getting started workflow includes importing training data, creating a predictor, and generating a forecast, and Forecast documentation describes a predictor as a model trained from time-series datasets that can be used to generate forecasts ([Amazon Forecast overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/what-is-forecast.html), [Training Predictors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/howitworks-predictor.html), [Getting Started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/getting-started.html)).

**D. Configure an AWS Lambda function with a function URL that uses an Amazon Forecast predictor to create a prediction based on the inputs** is correct. After the Forecast predictor and forecast are created, an application can query the forecast results. The Amazon Forecast `QueryForecast` API retrieves a forecast filtered by criteria such as an item identifier and date range ([QueryForecast API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/API_forecastquery_QueryForecast.html)). A Lambda function URL provides a simple HTTPS endpoint for invoking a Lambda function, so it can expose a lightweight HTTP interface that calls Amazon Forecast and returns the prediction results ([Lambda function URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/urls-invocation.html)).

**A. Deploy an Amazon SageMaker model. Create a SageMaker endpoint for inference** is incorrect. Although SageMaker can host models for inference, this option only addresses deployment and inference. It does not train the model, and SageMaker is a general ML platform rather than the purpose-built, no-ML-experience time-series forecasting service required by the scenario.

**B. Use Amazon SageMaker to train a model by using the historical data in the S3 bucket** is incorrect. SageMaker can train ML models from S3 data, but this option alone does not provide a prediction interface. More importantly, the question emphasizes no ML experience and monthly forecasting from historical values, which aligns better with Amazon Forecast’s managed time-series forecasting workflow.

**C. Configure an AWS Lambda function with a function URL that uses Amazon SageMaker endpoints to create predictions based on the inputs** is incorrect. This step depends on a SageMaker model endpoint, but the correct managed forecasting workflow uses an Amazon Forecast predictor rather than a SageMaker endpoint. It also does not address training the forecasting model from the historical data.

zh.question: 一家使用 AWS 的公司需要一个解决方案，用于预测每个月制造流程所需的资源。该解决方案必须使用当前存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中的历史值。该公司没有机器学习 (ML) 经验，并希望使用托管服务来进行训练和预测。哪一组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 部署一个 Amazon SageMaker 模型。创建一个用于推理的 SageMaker endpoint。
options.B: 使用 Amazon SageMaker 通过 S3 bucket 中的历史数据来训练模型。
options.C: 配置一个带有 function URL 的 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用 Amazon SageMaker endpoints 根据输入创建预测。
options.D: 配置一个带有 function URL 的 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用 Amazon Forecast predictor 根据输入创建预测。
options.E: 使用 S3 bucket 中的历史数据训练一个 Amazon Forsecast predictor。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **D 和 E**。

**E. Train an Amazon Forecast predictor by using the historical data in the S3 bucket** 是正确的。该工作负载是一个月度资源预测问题，属于时间序列预测用例。Amazon Forecast 是一项完全托管的预测服务，它使用统计和机器学习算法从历史时间序列数据生成预测，并且设计上不要求具备机器学习经验。Amazon Forecast 入门工作流包括导入训练数据、创建 predictor 和生成 forecast，并且 Forecast 文档将 predictor 描述为从时间序列数据集训练得到的模型，可用于生成 forecast（[Amazon Forecast overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/what-is-forecast.html), [Training Predictors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/howitworks-predictor.html), [Getting Started](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/getting-started.html)）。

**D. Configure an AWS Lambda function with a function URL that uses an Amazon Forecast predictor to create a prediction based on the inputs** 是正确的。创建 Forecast predictor 和 forecast 后，应用程序可以查询 forecast 结果。Amazon Forecast `QueryForecast` API 会检索按条件筛选的 forecast，例如 item identifier 和 date range（[QueryForecast API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/API_forecastquery_QueryForecast.html)）。Lambda function URL 为调用 Lambda 函数提供了一个简单的 HTTPS endpoint，因此它可以暴露一个轻量级 HTTP 接口，用于调用 Amazon Forecast 并返回预测结果（[Lambda function URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/urls-invocation.html)）。

**A. Deploy an Amazon SageMaker model. Create a SageMaker endpoint for inference** 是不正确的。尽管 SageMaker 可以托管用于推理的模型，但此选项仅解决部署和推理问题。它没有训练模型，并且 SageMaker 是一个通用 ML 平台，而不是该场景所需的专门构建、无需 ML 经验的时间序列预测服务。

**B. Use Amazon SageMaker to train a model by using the historical data in the S3 bucket** 是不正确的。SageMaker 可以从 S3 数据训练 ML 模型，但仅此选项并不提供预测接口。更重要的是，题目强调没有 ML 经验以及从历史值进行月度预测，这更符合 Amazon Forecast 的托管时间序列预测工作流。

**C. Configure an AWS Lambda function with a function URL that uses Amazon SageMaker endpoints to create predictions based on the inputs** 是不正确的。此步骤依赖于 SageMaker model endpoint，但正确的托管预测工作流使用 Amazon Forecast predictor，而不是 SageMaker endpoint。它也没有解决如何从历史数据训练预测模型的问题。

en.question: A company manages AWS accounts in AWS Organizations. AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign- On) and AWS Control Tower are configured for the accounts. The company wants to manage multiple user permissions across all the accounts. The permissions will be used by multiple IAM users and must be split between the developer and administrator teams. Each team requires different permissions. The company wants a solution that includes new users that are hired on both teams. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create individual users in IAM Identity Center for each account. Create separate developer and administrator groups in IAM Identity Center. Assign the users to the appropriate groups. Create a custom IAM policy for each group to set fine-grained permissions.
options.B: Create individual users in IAM Identity Center for each account. Create separate developer and administrator groups in IAM Identity Center. Assign the users to the appropriate groups. Attach AWS managed IAM policies to each user as needed for fine-grained permissions.
options.C: Create individual users in IAM Identity Center. Create new developer and administrator groups in IAM Identity Center. Create new permission sets that include the appropriate IAM policies for each group. Assign the new groups to the appropriate accounts. Assign the new permission sets to the new groups. When new users are hired, add them to the appropriate group.
options.D: Create individual users in IAM Identity Center. Create new permission sets that include the appropriate IAM policies for each user. Assign the users to the appropriate accounts. Grant additional IAM permissions to the users from within specific accounts. When new users are hired, add them to IAM Identity Center and assign them to the accounts.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

IAM Identity Center is designed to provide “one place to assign permissions to multiple AWS accounts,” including assigning permissions to **groups of users** across accounts. AWS also states that permission sets are templates containing IAM policies and that they simplify AWS account access assignment for **users and groups** in an organization. When a permission set is assigned, IAM Identity Center creates and manages the corresponding IAM roles in the target accounts and attaches the policies from the permission set to those roles ([Manage AWS accounts with permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html); [What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)).

Option **C** uses the intended low-overhead model: create developer and administrator groups, create permission sets with the required policies, assign those permission sets to the groups for the appropriate AWS accounts, and add new hires to the correct group. AWS specifically recommends assigning access directly to **groups rather than individual users** to simplify administration; moving or adding a user to a group automatically gives the needed permissions ([Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** and **B** are wrong because they create individual users “for each account,” which defeats centralized multi-account access management in IAM Identity Center and increases operational overhead. Also, permissions should be applied through IAM Identity Center permission sets for account access, not by separately managing IAM policies per account/user.
- **D** is wrong because it assigns permission sets per user and then grants additional IAM permissions inside specific accounts. That is higher overhead and less centralized than assigning permission sets to groups through IAM Identity Center.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中管理 AWS 账户。已为这些账户配置了 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign- On) 和 AWS Control Tower。公司希望在所有账户中管理多个用户权限。这些权限将由多个 IAM 用户使用，并且必须在开发人员团队和管理员团队之间划分。每个团队都需要不同的权限。公司希望该解决方案能够涵盖两个团队中新聘用的用户。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 IAM Identity Center 中为每个账户创建单独的用户。在 IAM Identity Center 中创建单独的开发人员组和管理员组。将用户分配到相应的组。为每个组创建自定义 IAM 策略以设置精细化权限。
options.B: 在 IAM Identity Center 中为每个账户创建单独的用户。在 IAM Identity Center 中创建单独的开发人员组和管理员组。将用户分配到相应的组。根据需要将 AWS 托管 IAM 策略附加到每个用户，以实现精细化权限。
options.C: 在 IAM Identity Center 中创建单独的用户。在 IAM Identity Center 中创建新的开发人员组和管理员组。创建新的权限集，其中包含适用于每个组的相应 IAM 策略。将新组分配到相应账户。将新的权限集分配给新组。当新用户入职时，将他们添加到相应的组。
options.D: 在 IAM Identity Center 中创建单独的用户。创建新的权限集，其中包含适用于每个用户的相应 IAM 策略。将用户分配到相应账户。从特定账户内部向用户授予额外的 IAM 权限。当新用户入职时，将他们添加到 IAM Identity Center 并将他们分配到账户。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

IAM Identity Center 旨在提供“一个位置来为多个 AWS 账户分配权限”，包括跨账户向**用户组**分配权限。AWS 还说明，权限集是包含 IAM 策略的模板，并且它们简化了组织中对**用户和组**的 AWS 账户访问权限分配。当分配权限集时，IAM Identity Center 会在目标账户中创建并管理相应的 IAM 角色，并将权限集中的策略附加到这些角色（[Manage AWS accounts with permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)；[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。选项 **C** 使用了预期的低开销模型：创建开发人员组和管理员组，创建包含所需策略的权限集，将这些权限集分配给相应 AWS 账户中的组，并将新员工添加到正确的组。AWS 明确建议将访问权限直接分配给**组而不是单个用户**，以简化管理；将用户移动到某个组或添加到某个组会自动授予所需权限（[Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A** 和 **B** 错误，因为它们“为每个账户”创建单独的用户，这违背了 IAM Identity Center 中集中式多账户访问管理的目的，并增加了运营开销。此外，账户访问的权限应通过 IAM Identity Center 权限集应用，而不是按账户/用户分别管理 IAM 策略。
- **D** 错误，因为它按用户分配权限集，然后在特定账户内部授予额外的 IAM 权限。与通过 IAM Identity Center 将权限集分配给组相比，这种方式开销更高，集中化程度更低。

en.question: A company wants to standardize its Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume encryption strategy. The company also wants to minimize the cost and configuration effort required to operate the volume encryption check. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Write API calls to describe the EBS volumes and to confirm the EBS volumes are encrypted. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule an AWS Lambda function to run the API calls.
options.B: Write API calls to describe the EBS volumes and to confirm the EBS volumes are encrypted. Run the API calls on an AWS Fargate task.
options.C: Create an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) policy that requires the use of tags on EBS volumes. Use AWS Cost Explorer to display resources that are not properly tagged. Encrypt the untagged resources manually.
options.D: Create an AWS Config rule for Amazon EBS to evaluate if a volume is encrypted and to flag the volume if it is not encrypted.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Config is the best fit because it provides managed, predefined, customizable rules to evaluate whether AWS resources comply with common best practices; AWS explicitly gives assessing whether **Amazon EBS volumes are encrypted** as an example use case for managed rules ([AWS Config Managed Rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_use-managed-rules.html)). The specific managed rule **ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES** checks attached Amazon EBS volumes and marks the resource **NON_COMPLIANT** if the volume is unencrypted, with `AWS::EC2::Volume` as the resource type and configuration changes as the trigger ([encrypted-volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/encrypted-volumes.html)). This minimizes custom development and operational effort compared with building and running your own checks.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A scheduled Lambda function with custom API calls could work technically, but it requires custom code, scheduling, monitoring, and maintenance. AWS Config already provides this evaluation as a managed rule.
- **B:** Running custom API checks on Fargate adds even more operational and cost overhead than Lambda and still duplicates AWS Config managed-rule functionality.
- **C:** Tags and Cost Explorer do not evaluate whether EBS volumes are encrypted. Cost Explorer is not a compliance engine for EBS encryption, and manually encrypting untagged resources does not standardize or automatically flag encryption compliance.

zh.question: 一家公司希望标准化其 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷加密策略。该公司还希望最大限度地降低运行卷加密检查所需的成本和配置工作量。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 编写 API 调用来描述 EBS 卷并确认 EBS 卷已加密。使用 Amazon EventBridge 调度 AWS Lambda 函数来运行这些 API 调用。
options.B: 编写 API 调用来描述 EBS 卷并确认 EBS 卷已加密。在 AWS Fargate 任务上运行这些 API 调用。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 策略，要求在 EBS 卷上使用标签。使用 AWS Cost Explorer 显示未正确标记的资源。手动加密未标记的资源。
options.D: 为 Amazon EBS 创建一个 AWS Config 规则，以评估卷是否已加密，并在卷未加密时标记该卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** AWS Config 是最合适的选择，因为它提供托管的、预定义的、可自定义的规则，用于评估 AWS 资源是否符合常见最佳实践；AWS 明确将评估 **Amazon EBS volumes are encrypted** 作为托管规则的示例用例（[AWS Config Managed Rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_use-managed-rules.html)）。具体的托管规则 **ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES** 会检查已挂载的 Amazon EBS 卷，如果卷未加密，则将该资源标记为 **NON_COMPLIANT**，其资源类型为 `AWS::EC2::Volume`，触发器为配置更改（[encrypted-volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/encrypted-volumes.html)）。与构建和运行自己的检查相比，这可以最大限度地减少自定义开发和运维工作量。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用自定义 API 调用的计划 Lambda 函数在技术上可以工作，但它需要自定义代码、调度、监控和维护。AWS Config 已经以托管规则的形式提供了此评估。
- **B:** 在 Fargate 上运行自定义 API 检查会比 Lambda 增加更多的运维和成本开销，并且仍然是在重复 AWS Config 托管规则的功能。
- **C:** 标签和 Cost Explorer 不会评估 EBS 卷是否已加密。Cost Explorer 不是用于 EBS 加密的合规性引擎，而手动加密未标记的资源也无法标准化或自动标记加密合规性。

en.question: A company regularly uploads GB-sized files to Amazon S3. After the company uploads the files, the company uses a fleet of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances to transcode the file format. The company needs to scale throughput when the company uploads data from the on-premises data center to Amazon S3 and when the company downloads data from Amazon S3 to the EC2 instances. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the S3 bucket access point instead of accessing the S3 bucket directly.
options.B: Upload the files into multiple S3 buckets.
options.C: Use S3 multipart uploads.
options.D: Fetch multiple byte-ranges of an object in parallel.
options.E: Add a random prefix to each object when uploading the files.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: C and D.**

- **C. Use S3 multipart uploads** — For GB-sized files, multipart upload is the appropriate upload optimization. AWS states that multipart upload uploads a single object as a set of parts and that, in general, when an object reaches **100 MB**, you should consider multipart uploads instead of a single upload operation ([Amazon S3 multipart upload limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/qfacts.html)). The multipart upload process uploads individual parts and then S3 assembles them into the final object ([Uploading and copying objects using multipart upload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)).
- **D.
