Fetch multiple byte-ranges of an object in parallel** — For downloads from S3 to EC2, AWS recommends byte-range fetches: using the `Range` header, applications can fetch different byte ranges from the same object over concurrent connections, which helps achieve higher aggregate throughput than a single whole-object request ([Performance guidelines for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 bucket access point** — Access points simplify and control access to shared S3 data through named endpoints and policies; they are not a throughput-scaling mechanism for large object transfers ([Managing access to shared datasets with access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html)).
- **B. Multiple S3 buckets** — S3 performance can be scaled by issuing multiple concurrent requests and spreading them over connections; AWS states S3 has no limit on the number of connections made to a bucket, so multiple buckets are not required for this throughput goal ([Performance guidelines for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)).
- **E. Random prefix for each object** — Prefix parallelization can increase request-rate performance, but this option does not directly optimize transfer throughput for each GB-sized object. The targeted AWS guidance for large-object upload/download throughput is multipart upload and parallel byte-range GETs, not randomizing each object key prefix ([Best practices design patterns: optimizing Amazon S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司定期将 GB 级大小的文件上传到 Amazon S3。公司上传文件后，会使用一组 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 对文件格式进行转码。公司需要在从本地数据中心向 Amazon S3 上传数据时，以及从 Amazon S3 向 EC2 实例下载数据时扩展吞吐量。哪些解决方案可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 S3 存储桶接入点，而不是直接访问 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 将文件上传到多个 S3 存储桶中。
options.C: 使用 S3 分段上传。
options.D: 并行获取对象的多个字节范围。
options.E: 上传文件时，为每个对象添加随机前缀。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C 和 D。**

- **C. 使用 S3 分段上传** — 对于 GB 级大小的文件，分段上传是合适的上传优化方式。AWS 表示，分段上传会将单个对象作为一组分段进行上传，并且通常当对象达到 **100 MB** 时，你应考虑使用分段上传，而不是单次上传操作（[Amazon S3 multipart upload limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/qfacts.html)）。分段上传过程会上传各个分段，然后由 S3 将它们组装成最终对象（[Uploading and copying objects using multipart upload](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mpuoverview.html)）。
- **D. 并行获取对象的多个字节范围** — 对于从 S3 下载到 EC2，AWS 建议使用字节范围获取：通过使用 `Range` 标头，应用程序可以通过并发连接从同一对象获取不同的字节范围，这有助于实现比单个完整对象请求更高的聚合吞吐量（[Performance guidelines for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. S3 存储桶接入点** — 接入点通过命名端点和策略来简化并控制对共享 S3 数据的访问；它们不是用于大型对象传输的吞吐量扩展机制（[Managing access to shared datasets with access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html)）。
- **B. 多个 S3 存储桶** — 可以通过发出多个并发请求并将其分布到多个连接上来扩展 S3 性能；AWS 表示 S3 对连接到某个存储桶的连接数量没有限制，因此为了实现此吞吐量目标并不需要多个存储桶（[Performance guidelines for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)）。
- **E. 为每个对象使用随机前缀** — 前缀并行化可以提高请求速率性能，但此选项并不能直接优化每个 GB 级对象的传输吞吐量。针对大型对象上传/下载吞吐量的 AWS 指导是分段上传和并行字节范围 GET，而不是随机化每个对象键前缀（[Best practices design patterns: optimizing Amazon S3 performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a shared storage solution for a web application that is deployed across multiple Availability Zones. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The company plans to make frequent changes to the content. The solution must have strong consistency in returning the new content as soon as the changes occur. Which solutions meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) block storage that is mounted to the individual EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system on the individual EC2 instances.
options.C: Create a shared Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on the individual EC2 instances.
options.D: Use AWS DataSync to perform continuous synchronization of data between EC2 hosts in the Auto Scaling group.
options.E: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the web content. Set the metadata for the Cache-Control header to no-cache. Use Amazon CloudFront to deliver the content.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: B and E.**

- **B. Amazon EFS** is appropriate because it is a shared file system that multiple EC2 instances can mount across Availability Zones. AWS shows Regional EFS file systems with multiple EC2 instances accessing a file system configured for multiple AZs, with mount targets in each AZ. Regional EFS stores data redundantly across multiple AZs, and EFS provides NFS close-to-open consistency; for synchronous, non-appending writes it can provide read-after-write consistency for data access. This matches shared storage for an Auto Scaling web tier with frequent content changes. ([How EFS works with EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html), [EFS features and consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html))
- **E. Amazon S3 with CloudFront and `Cache-Control: no-cache`** can also meet the requirement for web content. S3 provides strong read-after-write consistency for PUT and DELETE operations, including overwrites, and a read after a successful PUT returns the data written. CloudFront TTL settings work with `Cache-Control` headers to determine when cached objects remain valid; with `no-cache` and an appropriate cache policy that does not force a positive minimum TTL, CloudFront checks with the origin instead of serving stale content. ([S3 data consistency model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html), [CloudFront cache policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cache-key-understand-cache-policy.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Volume Gateway** is not the best fit for a shared multi-AZ EC2 web application. AWS describes Volume Gateway as cloud-backed iSCSI volumes mounted from **on-premises application servers**; it is primarily a hybrid/on-premises storage gateway pattern, not a native shared file store for an Auto Scaling web tier. ([Volume Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html))
- **C. Shared EBS volume** does not meet the multi-AZ shared-storage requirement. EBS Multi-Attach volumes can attach only to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, and standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers; applications must manage write ordering for consistency. ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html))
- **D. DataSync** is a data transfer/replication service for migrations, archiving, replication, and in-cloud processing workflows. It is not a continuously consistent shared storage layer for EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. ([DataSync use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html))

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一个跨多个 Availability Zones 部署的 Web 应用程序设计共享存储解决方案。该 Web 应用程序运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司计划频繁更改内容。该解决方案必须在更改发生后立即返回新内容，并具有强一致性。哪些解决方案满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) 块存储，并将其挂载到各个 EC2 实例。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。将 EFS 文件系统挂载到各个 EC2 实例。
options.C: 创建一个共享的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。将 EBS 卷挂载到各个 EC2 实例。
options.D: 使用 AWS DataSync 在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 主机之间执行数据的持续同步。
options.E: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储 Web 内容。将 Cache-Control 标头的元数据设置为 no-cache。使用 Amazon CloudFront 交付内容。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B 和 E。**

- **B. Amazon EFS** 是合适的，因为它是一个共享文件系统，多个 EC2 实例可以跨 Availability Zones 挂载它。AWS 展示了 Regional EFS 文件系统，其中多个 EC2 实例访问配置为跨多个 AZ 使用的文件系统，并且每个 AZ 中都有挂载目标。Regional EFS 将数据冗余存储在多个 AZ 中，并且 EFS 提供 NFS close-to-open 一致性；对于同步、非追加写入，它可以为数据访问提供写后读一致性。这符合具有频繁内容变更的 Auto Scaling Web 层的共享存储需求。([How EFS works with EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html), [EFS features and consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html))
- **E. Amazon S3 with CloudFront and `Cache-Control: no-cache`** 也可以满足 Web 内容的要求。S3 为 PUT 和 DELETE 操作（包括覆盖写入）提供强写后读一致性，并且成功 PUT 之后的读取会返回写入的数据。CloudFront TTL 设置与 `Cache-Control` 标头配合，用于确定缓存对象何时仍然有效；在使用 `no-cache` 并配合不会强制正的最小 TTL 的适当缓存策略时，CloudFront 会向源站检查，而不是提供过期内容。([S3 data consistency model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html), [CloudFront cache policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cache-key-understand-cache-policy.html))

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Volume Gateway** 不适合共享的多 AZ EC2 Web 应用程序。AWS 将 Volume Gateway 描述为从**本地应用程序服务器**挂载的云支持 iSCSI 卷；它主要是一种混合/本地存储网关模式，而不是用于 Auto Scaling Web 层的原生共享文件存储。([Volume Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html))
- **C. Shared EBS volume** 不满足多 AZ 共享存储要求。EBS Multi-Attach 卷只能附加到**同一个 Availability Zone** 中的实例，并且 XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并不是为多个服务器同时访问而设计的；应用程序必须管理写入顺序以确保一致性。([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html))
- **D. DataSync** 是一种用于迁移、归档、复制和云内处理工作流的数据传输/复制服务。它不是用于 Auto Scaling 组中 EC2 实例的持续一致共享存储层。([DataSync use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html))

en.question: A company is deploying an application in three AWS Regions using an Application Load Balancer. Amazon Route 53 will be used to distribute traffic between these Regions. Which Route 53 configuration should a solutions architect use to provide the MOST high-performing experience?

options.A: Create an A record with a latency policy.
options.B: Create an A record with a geolocation policy.
options.C: Create a CNAME record with a failover policy.
options.D: Create a CNAME record with a geoproximity policy.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A. Create an A record with a latency policy.**

Route 53 **latency routing** is specifically intended for architectures with resources in **multiple AWS Regions** when you want to route users to the Region that provides the **best latency**. AWS states that latency routing is used “when you have resources in multiple AWS Regions and you want to route traffic to the Region that provides the best latency” ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)). For an Application Load Balancer target, Route 53 should route to the load balancer using an **alias record**, and AWS’s ELB routing procedure uses record type **A – IPv4 address** with an alias to the Application Load Balancer ([Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. A record with geolocation policy**: Geolocation routing routes based on the **geographic location of users**, such as routing Europe users to a Frankfurt Region load balancer. It is useful for localization, distribution-right restrictions, or predictable location-based routing, not necessarily for the lowest latency/highest performance experience ([Geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html)).
- **C. CNAME record with failover policy**: Failover routing is for **active-passive failover**, not for optimizing performance across three active Regions ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)). Also, for ELB load balancers, AWS recommends a Route 53 **alias record**; alias records are similar to CNAMEs but can be used for both root domains and subdomains, while CNAME records can be created only for subdomains ([Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)).
- **D. CNAME record with geoproximity policy**: Geoproximity routing routes based on the location of resources and can shift traffic using bias; it is not the policy AWS identifies for best latency across multiple Regions ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)). The CNAME issue for load balancer targets also makes this less appropriate than an A/alias-style record to the ALB.

Therefore, the most high-performing Route 53 configuration is an **A record using latency-based routing**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 Application Load Balancer 在三个 AWS Regions 中部署一个应用程序。将使用 Amazon Route 53 在这些 Regions 之间分配流量。解决方案架构师应使用哪种 Route 53 配置来提供最高性能的体验？

options.A: 创建一条使用延迟策略的 A 记录。
options.B: 创建一条使用地理位置策略的 A 记录。
options.C: 创建一条使用故障转移策略的 CNAME 记录。
options.D: 创建一条使用地理邻近性策略的 CNAME 记录。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A. 创建一条使用延迟策略的 A 记录。**

Route 53 **latency routing** 专门用于在 **multiple AWS Regions** 中具有资源的架构，当你希望将用户路由到提供 **best latency** 的 Region 时使用。AWS 表示，latency routing 用于“当你在多个 AWS Regions 中拥有资源，并且希望将流量路由到提供最佳延迟的 Region 时” ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html))。对于 Application Load Balancer 目标，Route 53 应使用 **alias record** 路由到负载均衡器，并且 AWS 的 ELB 路由过程使用记录类型 **A – IPv4 address**，并通过别名指向 Application Load Balancer ([Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html))。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B. A record with geolocation policy**：Geolocation routing 根据**用户的地理位置**进行路由，例如将欧洲用户路由到 Frankfurt Region 的负载均衡器。它适用于本地化、分发权限制或可预测的基于位置的路由，但不一定适用于最低延迟/最高性能体验 ([Geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html))。
- **C. CNAME record with failover policy**：Failover routing 用于 **active-passive failover**，而不是用于在三个活动 Regions 之间优化性能 ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html))。此外，对于 ELB load balancers，AWS 建议使用 Route 53 **alias record**；alias records 类似于 CNAMEs，但可用于根域名和子域名，而 CNAME records 只能为子域名创建 ([Routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html))。
- **D. CNAME record with geoproximity policy**：Geoproximity routing 根据资源位置进行路由，并可以使用 bias 转移流量；它不是 AWS 指定用于在多个 Regions 之间实现最佳延迟的策略 ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html))。负载均衡器目标的 CNAME 问题也使其不如指向 ALB 的 A/alias-style record 合适。因此，最高性能的 Route 53 配置是使用基于延迟路由的 **A record**。

en.question: A company has a web application that includes an embedded NoSQL database. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. A recent increase in traffic requires the application to be highly available and for the database to be eventually consistent. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances.
options.B: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
options.C: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Maintain the embedded NoSQL database with its replication service on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Modify the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. Migrate the embedded NoSQL database to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The application tier is currently in a single Availability Zone, so it must be expanded across multiple AZs. AWS documentation states that to use geographic redundancy, you should span an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attach a load balancer to distribute traffic; if one AZ becomes unhealthy, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). For the database, DynamoDB is the lowest-operational-overhead fit: it is serverless and fully managed, requiring no server provisioning, patching, software maintenance, or operation, and it handles high availability and hardware provisioning ([What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)). DynamoDB also automatically replicates data across three Availability Zones for durability and availability ([What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)). The eventual consistency requirement is met because eventual consistency is the default read consistency model for DynamoDB reads ([DynamoDB read consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadConsistency.html)). AWS DMS can be used to migrate data to DynamoDB, and AWS documents DynamoDB as a DMS target; DMS supports relational databases or MongoDB as sources for this target ([Using an Amazon DynamoDB database as a target for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.DynamoDB.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Replacing the ALB with an NLB does not solve the single-AZ Auto Scaling group problem and does not reduce database operational overhead. Keeping an embedded database and managing replication on EC2 remains operationally intensive compared with a fully managed service.
- **B:** Migrating to DynamoDB helps the database layer, but this option does not modify the Auto Scaling group to run across multiple Availability Zones, so the application tier remains vulnerable to an AZ failure.
- **C:** Running EC2 instances across three AZs improves application availability, but maintaining an embedded NoSQL database and its replication service on EC2 has more operational overhead than using fully managed DynamoDB, which handles availability, maintenance, and scaling.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Web 应用程序，其中包含一个嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库。该应用程序在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。这些实例在单个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中运行。最近流量增加，要求该应用程序具备高可用性，并且数据库具备最终一致性。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 ALB 替换为 Network Load Balancer。在 EC2 实例上维护嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库及其复制服务。
options.B: 将 ALB 替换为 Network Load Balancer。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。
options.C: 修改 Auto Scaling 组，使其在三个 Availability Zones 中使用 EC2 实例。在 EC2 实例上维护嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库及其复制服务。
options.D: 修改 Auto Scaling 组，使其在三个 Availability Zones 中使用 EC2 实例。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

应用程序层目前位于单个 Availability Zone 中，因此必须扩展到多个 AZ。AWS 文档指出，要使用地理冗余，应将 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 Availability Zones 部署，并附加负载均衡器来分发流量；如果一个 AZ 变得不正常，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。对于数据库，DynamoDB 是运营开销最低的合适选择：它是 serverless 且完全托管的，不需要服务器预置、修补、软件维护或运营，并且会处理高可用性和硬件预置（[What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。DynamoDB 还会自动跨三个 Availability Zones 复制数据，以实现持久性和可用性（[What is Amazon DynamoDB?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Introduction.html)）。最终一致性要求也能得到满足，因为最终一致性是 DynamoDB 读取的默认读取一致性模型（[DynamoDB read consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/HowItWorks.ReadConsistency.html)）。AWS DMS 可用于将数据迁移到 DynamoDB，并且 AWS 文档将 DynamoDB 记录为 DMS 目标；对于此目标，DMS 支持关系数据库或 MongoDB 作为源（[Using an Amazon DynamoDB database as a target for AWS DMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.DynamoDB.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 将 ALB 替换为 NLB 无法解决 Auto Scaling 组位于单个 AZ 的问题，也不能降低数据库运营开销。与完全托管服务相比，保留嵌入式数据库并在 EC2 上管理复制仍然需要大量运营工作。
- **B:** 迁移到 DynamoDB 有助于数据库层，但此选项没有修改 Auto Scaling 组以跨多个 Availability Zones 运行，因此应用程序层仍然容易受到 AZ 故障影响。
- **C:** 跨三个 AZ 运行 EC2 实例可以提高应用程序可用性，但在 EC2 上维护嵌入式 NoSQL 数据库及其复制服务，比使用完全托管的 DynamoDB 具有更高的运营开销；DynamoDB 会处理可用性、维护和扩展。

en.question: A company is building a shopping application on AWS. The application offers a catalog that changes once each month and needs to scale with traffic volume. The company wants the lowest possible latency from the application. Data from each user's shopping cart needs to be highly available. User session data must be available even if the user is disconnected and reconnects. What should a solutions architect do to ensure that the shopping cart data is preserved at all times?

options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer to enable the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) for access to the catalog in Amazon Aurora.
options.B: Configure Amazon ElastiCache for Redis to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session.
options.C: Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service to cache catalog data from Amazon DynamoDB and shopping cart data from the user's session.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage for the catalog and shopping cart. Configure automated snapshots.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B**

Amazon ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey is the best fit because it provides an in-memory, low-latency data store for frequently accessed data and is commonly used for session data. AWS states that an in-memory key-value store provides **ultrafast (submillisecond latency)** access and that data that is relatively static and frequently accessed is a good caching candidate—matching a product catalog that changes monthly ([ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)). AWS also documents adding an **ElastiCache caching layer in front of DynamoDB** and lists features such as automatic failover, automatic scaling, global replication, backup support, and a 99.99% SLA ([DynamoDB and ElastiCache integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/dynamodb-elasticache-integration/introduction.html)). For session persistence, AWS notes that popular stores for session data are in-memory caches such as **Memcached or Redis**, available through Amazon ElastiCache, and that caches can improve latency ([Microservices data store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/microservices-on-aws/data-store.html)). Therefore, Redis can keep shopping cart/session data available independently of any single application server connection.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A**: ALB sticky sessions only route a user to the same target; Elastic Load Balancing is for distributing traffic to targets and routing only to healthy targets, not for preserving shopping cart data ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). If the target fails or the user reconnects differently, application-local session data can be lost.
* **C**: Amazon OpenSearch Service is designed for searching documents and improving the search experience, not for caching session/shopping cart state ([Searching data in OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/searching.html)).
* **D**: A single EC2 instance with EBS is not an elastic, highly available session store. EBS snapshots are **point-in-time backups**, so automated snapshots would not preserve the cart continuously or provide the lowest-latency scalable architecture ([Amazon EBS persistent block storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个购物应用程序。该应用程序提供一个每月更改一次的目录，并且需要随流量规模扩展。公司希望应用程序具有尽可能低的延迟。每个用户购物车中的数据需要具备高可用性。即使用户断开连接后重新连接，用户会话数据也必须可用。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来确保购物车数据始终得到保留？

options.A: 配置 Application Load Balancer，为访问 Amazon Aurora 中的目录启用粘性会话功能（会话亲和性）。
options.B: 配置 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis，以缓存来自 Amazon DynamoDB 的目录数据以及来自用户会话的购物车数据。
options.C: 配置 Amazon OpenSearch Service，以缓存来自 Amazon DynamoDB 的目录数据以及来自用户会话的购物车数据。
options.D: 配置一个带有 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 存储的 Amazon EC2 实例，用于目录和购物车。配置自动快照。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B**

Amazon ElastiCache for Redis/Valkey 是最佳选择，因为它为频繁访问的数据提供内存中的低延迟数据存储，并且通常用于会话数据。AWS 说明，内存中的键值存储可提供 **超快速（亚毫秒延迟）** 访问，并且相对静态且频繁访问的数据是良好的缓存候选对象——这与每月更改一次的产品目录相匹配（[ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)）。AWS 还记录了在 **DynamoDB 前添加 ElastiCache 缓存层**，并列出了自动故障转移、自动扩展、全球复制、备份支持以及 99.99% SLA 等功能（[DynamoDB and ElastiCache integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/dynamodb-elasticache-integration/introduction.html)）。对于会话持久性，AWS 指出，会话数据的常用存储是内存缓存，例如 **Memcached or Redis**，可通过 Amazon ElastiCache 使用，并且缓存可以改善延迟（[Microservices data store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/microservices-on-aws/data-store.html)）。因此，Redis 可以独立于任何单个应用程序服务器连接，保持购物车/会话数据可用。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **A**：ALB 粘性会话只会将用户路由到同一个目标；Elastic Load Balancing 用于将流量分发到目标，并且仅路由到健康目标，而不是用于保留购物车数据（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。如果目标发生故障，或用户以不同方式重新连接，应用程序本地的会话数据可能会丢失。
* **C**：Amazon OpenSearch Service 旨在搜索文档并改善搜索体验，而不是用于缓存会话/购物车状态（[Searching data in OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/searching.html)）。
* **D**：带有 EBS 的单个 EC2 实例并不是弹性的、高可用的会话存储。EBS 快照是 **时间点备份**，因此自动快照无法持续保留购物车，也无法提供最低延迟的可扩展架构（[Amazon EBS persistent block storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)）。

en.question: A company is building a microservices-based application that will be deployed on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The microservices will interact with each other. The company wants to ensure that the application is observable to identify performance issues in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the application to use Amazon ElastiCache to reduce the number of requests that are sent to the microservices.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to collect metrics from the EKS clusters. Configure AWS X-Ray to trace the requests between the microservices.
options.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to review the API calls. Build an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to observe the microservice interactions.
options.D: Use AWS Trusted Advisor to understand the performance of the application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

CloudWatch Container Insights is designed for this EKS/container observability requirement: AWS states that it collects, aggregates, and summarizes metrics and logs from containerized applications and microservices, including Amazon EKS, and creates metrics at cluster, node, pod, task, and service levels in CloudWatch dashboards and metrics views ([Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)). AWS X-Ray complements this by collecting request data and showing calls to downstream resources, **microservices**, databases, and APIs; its trace map helps identify bottlenecks, latency spikes, and other performance issues ([What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)). Together, these provide metrics/log observability plus distributed tracing between microservices.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** ElastiCache can improve application performance by caching, but caching does not provide cluster metrics, logs, or distributed traces for observing microservice interactions.
- **C:** CloudTrail records actions taken by users, roles, or AWS services for auditing, governance, and compliance; it is focused on AWS account/API activity, not application-level microservice performance tracing ([What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)). QuickSight dashboards over CloudTrail data would not show request paths or latency between services.
- **D:** Trusted Advisor inspects the AWS environment and makes best-practice recommendations for cost, availability, performance, and security, but it is not an application observability or distributed tracing solution for EKS microservices ([AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个基于微服务的应用程序，该应用程序将部署在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上。微服务将彼此交互。公司希望确保该应用程序具备可观测性，以便将来识别性能问题。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置应用程序使用 Amazon ElastiCache，以减少发送到微服务的请求数量。
options.B: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 以从 EKS 集群收集指标。配置 AWS X-Ray 以跟踪微服务之间的请求。
options.C: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 以审查 API 调用。构建 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板以观察微服务交互。
options.D: 使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 来了解应用程序的性能。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

CloudWatch Container Insights 是为这种 EKS/容器可观测性需求而设计的：AWS 表示，它会从容器化应用程序和微服务（包括 Amazon EKS）收集、聚合并汇总指标和日志，并在 CloudWatch 控制面板和指标视图中创建集群、节点、pod、任务和服务级别的指标（[Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)）。AWS X-Ray 通过收集请求数据并显示对下游资源、**microservices**、数据库和 API 的调用来补充这一能力；其跟踪映射有助于识别瓶颈、延迟峰值和其他性能问题（[What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)）。两者结合，可提供指标/日志可观测性以及微服务之间的分布式跟踪。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** ElastiCache 可以通过缓存提升应用程序性能，但缓存不会提供用于观察微服务交互的集群指标、日志或分布式跟踪。
- **C:** CloudTrail 记录用户、角色或 AWS 服务为审计、治理和合规而执行的操作；它侧重于 AWS 账户/API 活动，而不是应用程序级别的微服务性能跟踪（[What Is AWS CloudTrail?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-user-guide.html)）。基于 CloudTrail 数据的 QuickSight 控制面板不会显示服务之间的请求路径或延迟。
- **D:** Trusted Advisor 会检查 AWS 环境，并针对成本、可用性、性能和安全性提出最佳实践建议，但它不是用于 EKS 微服务的应用程序可观测性或分布式跟踪解决方案（[AWS Trusted Advisor](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awssupport/latest/user/trusted-advisor.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to provide customers with secure access to its data. The company processes customer data and stores the results in an Amazon S3 bucket. All the data is subject to strong regulations and security requirements. The data must be encrypted at rest. Each customer must be able to access only their data from their AWS account. Company employees must not be able to access the data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client- side. In the private certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.B: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In the S3 bucket policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.C: Provision a separate AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key for each customer. Encrypt the data server-side. In each KMS key policy, deny decryption of data for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.
options.D: Provision an AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificate for each customer. Encrypt the data client- side. In the public certificate policy, deny access to the certificate for all principals except an IAM role that the customer provides.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon S3 server-side encryption with AWS KMS (SSE-KMS) is appropriate for encrypting regulated S3 data at rest. AWS states that with SSE-KMS, S3 uses AWS KMS envelope encryption to protect data, and that customer managed KMS keys provide more control, including defining access controls and auditing key use. For cross-account sharing of SSE-KMS objects, AWS specifically says to use a **customer managed key** and configure that key policy to allow access from another account ([Amazon S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)). AWS KMS also states that key policies are the primary way to control access to KMS keys and determine who can use the key and how ([AWS KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)). Therefore, a separate customer managed KMS key per customer, with each key policy allowing only that customer's IAM role to decrypt, best enforces customer isolation and prevents company employees from decrypting the data.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A and D:** AWS Certificate Manager is for provisioning, managing, and deploying **SSL/TLS certificates**, not for enforcing encryption at rest for S3 objects or controlling KMS decryption permissions ([ACM exportable public certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-exportable-certificates.html)). Also, “public certificate policy” / “private certificate policy” is not the right mechanism for restricting S3 object decryption.
- **B:** An S3 bucket policy controls access to S3 resources, but the requirement is specifically to prevent unauthorized **decryption** of SSE-KMS data. AWS KMS key policies are the primary control for who can use a KMS key, and no principal has KMS permissions unless explicitly allowed and not denied by a key policy, IAM policy, or grant ([AWS KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)). Therefore, the decryption restriction belongs in the KMS key policy, not only in the S3 bucket policy.

zh.question: 一家公司需要为客户提供对其数据的安全访问。该公司处理客户数据，并将结果存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。所有数据都受严格的法规和安全要求约束。数据必须进行静态加密。每个客户必须只能从其 AWS 账户访问自己的数据。公司员工不得访问这些数据。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个客户预置一个 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 证书。在客户端对数据进行加密。在私有证书策略中，拒绝除客户提供的 IAM 角色之外的所有主体访问该证书。
options.B: 为每个客户预置一个单独的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。在服务器端对数据进行加密。在 S3 存储桶策略中，拒绝除客户提供的 IAM 角色之外的所有主体解密数据。
options.C: 为每个客户预置一个单独的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。在服务器端对数据进行加密。在每个 KMS 密钥策略中，拒绝除客户提供的 IAM 角色之外的所有主体解密数据。
options.D: 为每个客户预置一个 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 证书。在客户端对数据进行加密。在公共证书策略中，拒绝除客户提供的 IAM 角色之外的所有主体访问该证书。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon S3 使用 AWS KMS 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 适用于对受监管的 S3 静态数据进行加密。AWS 声明，使用 SSE-KMS 时，S3 使用 AWS KMS 信封加密来保护数据，并且客户托管 KMS 密钥可提供更多控制能力，包括定义访问控制和审计密钥使用情况。对于跨账户共享 SSE-KMS 对象，AWS 明确说明应使用 **customer managed key**，并配置该密钥策略以允许来自另一个账户的访问（[Amazon S3 SSE-KMS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)）。AWS KMS 还说明，密钥策略是控制 KMS 密钥访问权限的主要方式，并决定谁可以使用该密钥以及如何使用（[AWS KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)）。因此，为每个客户使用一个单独的客户托管 KMS 密钥，并在每个密钥策略中仅允许该客户的 IAM 角色进行解密，最能强制实施客户隔离，并防止公司员工解密数据。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A 和 D：** AWS Certificate Manager 用于预置、管理和部署 **SSL/TLS certificates**，不是用于对 S3 对象强制实施静态加密，也不是用于控制 KMS 解密权限（[ACM exportable public certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-exportable-certificates.html)）。此外，“public certificate policy” / “private certificate policy” 不是限制 S3 对象解密的正确机制。
- **B：** S3 存储桶策略控制对 S3 资源的访问，但该要求明确是防止对 SSE-KMS 数据进行未经授权的 **decryption**。AWS KMS 密钥策略是控制谁可以使用 KMS 密钥的主要控制手段，并且除非由密钥策略、IAM 策略或授权明确允许且未被拒绝，否则任何主体都没有 KMS 权限（[AWS KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)）。因此，解密限制应放在 KMS 密钥策略中，而不仅仅放在 S3 存储桶策略中。

en.question: A solutions architect creates a VPC that includes two public subnets and two private subnets. A corporate security mandate requires the solutions architect to launch all Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. However, when the solutions architect launches an EC2 instance that runs a web server on ports 80 and 443 in a private subnet, no external internet traffic can connect to the server. What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue?

options.A: Attach the EC2 instance to an Auto Scaling group in a private subnet. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the Auto Scaling group identifier.
options.B: Provision an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a public subnet. Add the EC2 instance to the target group that is associated with the ALEnsure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the ALB.
options.C: Launch a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Update the route table for the private subnets to add a default route to the NAT gateway. Attach a public Elastic IP address to the NAT gateway.
options.D: Ensure that the security group that is attached to the EC2 instance allows HTTP traffic on port 80 and HTTPS traffic on port 443. Ensure that the DNS record for the website resolves to the public IP address of the EC2 instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** An internet-facing Application Load Balancer is the appropriate entry point for external HTTP/HTTPS traffic while keeping EC2 instances in private subnets. AWS states that an internet-facing load balancer has public IP addresses and can route requests from clients over the internet; it also states that both internet-facing and internal load balancers route requests to targets using private IP addresses, so targets do **not** need public IP addresses to receive requests through the load balancer ([Elastic Load Balancing: Load balancer scheme](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). AWS also explains that the load balancer DNS name is what clients resolve, and the load balancer sends the request to a healthy registered target using its private IP address ([Elastic Load Balancing: Request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). Therefore, deploy an internet-facing ALB in the public subnets, register the private EC2 instance in the ALB target group, and point the website DNS record to the ALB.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An Auto Scaling group can manage instance capacity, but it is not an internet-facing endpoint and DNS does not resolve to an Auto Scaling group identifier for web access. This does not solve inbound internet connectivity to private instances.
- **C:** A NAT gateway solves the opposite traffic direction. AWS says NAT gateways let instances in private subnets connect to services outside the VPC, but external services cannot initiate connections with those instances; public NAT gateways also must be created in a **public** subnet, not a private subnet ([Amazon VPC: NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)).
- **D:** Opening ports 80 and 443 in the instance security group is necessary but not sufficient. A private subnet has no route to an internet gateway; AWS states that instances in a private subnet cannot communicate with the internet even if they have public IP addresses, and internet communication over IPv4 requires a public IPv4 address plus appropriate internet gateway routing ([Amazon VPC: Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)). Pointing DNS directly to the private instance is therefore not the correct design under the mandate.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师创建了一个 VPC，其中包含两个公有子网和两个私有子网。公司安全要求规定，解决方案架构师必须在私有子网中启动所有 Amazon EC2 实例。然而，当解决方案架构师在私有子网中启动一台在端口 80 和 443 上运行 Web 服务器的 EC2 实例时，外部互联网流量无法连接到该服务器。解决方案架构师应如何解决此问题？

options.A: 将 EC2 实例附加到私有子网中的 Auto Scaling 组。确保网站的 DNS 记录解析到 Auto Scaling 组标识符。
options.B: 在公有子网中预置面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。将 EC2 实例添加到与 ALB 关联的目标组。确保网站的 DNS 记录解析到 ALB。
options.C: 在私有子网中启动 NAT gateway。更新私有子网的路由表，添加一条指向 NAT gateway 的默认路由。将公有 Elastic IP 地址附加到 NAT gateway。
options.D: 确保附加到 EC2 实例的安全组允许端口 80 上的 HTTP 流量和端口 443 上的 HTTPS 流量。确保网站的 DNS 记录解析到 EC2 实例的公有 IP 地址。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer 是外部 HTTP/HTTPS 流量的适当入口点，同时可以将 EC2 实例保留在私有子网中。AWS 说明，面向互联网的负载均衡器具有公有 IP 地址，并且可以通过互联网路由来自客户端的请求；AWS 还说明，面向互联网和内部负载均衡器都会使用私有 IP 地址将请求路由到目标，因此目标**不**需要公有 IP 地址即可通过负载均衡器接收请求（[Elastic Load Balancing: Load balancer scheme](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。AWS 还解释说，客户端解析的是负载均衡器 DNS 名称，负载均衡器会使用其私有 IP 地址将请求发送到健康的已注册目标（[Elastic Load Balancing: Request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。因此，应在公有子网中部署面向互联网的 ALB，将私有 EC2 实例注册到 ALB 目标组，并将网站 DNS 记录指向 ALB。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** Auto Scaling 组可以管理实例容量，但它不是面向互联网的端点，并且用于 Web 访问的 DNS 不会解析到 Auto Scaling 组标识符。这无法解决到私有实例的入站互联网连接问题。
- **C:** NAT gateway 解决的是相反方向的流量。AWS 表示，NAT gateways 允许私有子网中的实例连接到 VPC 外部的服务，但外部服务无法主动与这些实例建立连接；公有 NAT gateways 也必须创建在**公有**子网中，而不是私有子网中（[Amazon VPC: NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。
- **D:** 在实例安全组中开放端口 80 和 443 是必要的，但并不充分。私有子网没有到 internet gateway 的路由；AWS 说明，即使实例具有公有 IP 地址，私有子网中的实例也无法与互联网通信，并且通过 IPv4 进行互联网通信需要公有 IPv4 地址以及适当的 internet gateway 路由（[Amazon VPC: Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。因此，在该要求下，将 DNS 直接指向私有实例并不是正确的设计。

en.question: A company is deploying a new application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with an AWS Fargate cluster. The application needs a storage solution for data persistence. The solution must be highly available and fault tolerant. The solution also must be shared between multiple application containers. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the volumes in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use EBS Multi-Attach to share the data between containers.
options.B: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Register the file system in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same file system for all containers.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Register the volume in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Use the same volume for all containers.
options.D: Create Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file systems in the same Availability Zones where EKS worker nodes are placed. Register the file systems in a StorageClass object on an EKS cluster. Create an AWS Lambda function to synchronize the data between file systems.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**. Amazon EFS is the AWS managed file storage service intended for shared file data: AWS states that EFS provides serverless, elastic file storage so you can **share file data without provisioning or managing storage capacity and performance**, and that it is accessible from Amazon EKS and AWS Fargate. A Regional EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones and provides continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable, meeting the high availability and fault tolerance requirements with low operational overhead ([What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html), [Features of Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). Amazon EKS also documents use of the Amazon EFS CSI driver for persistent volumes, including support for Fargate nodes through static provisioning ([Use elastic file system storage with Amazon EFS - Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/efs-csi.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A** is incorrect. Amazon EBS is block storage and the EKS EBS CSI documentation explicitly says you **can’t mount Amazon EBS volumes to Fargate Pods**. Also, EBS Multi-Attach is limited to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, and standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers; clustered file systems and application write ordering are needed, increasing operational overhead ([Use Kubernetes volume storage with Amazon EBS - Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/ebs-csi.html), [Attach an EBS volume to multiple EC2 instances using Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
* **C** is incorrect. A single EBS volume is not a shared, multi-container file system across Fargate Pods, and EKS Fargate Pods cannot mount EBS volumes ([Use Kubernetes volume storage with Amazon EBS - Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/ebs-csi.html)).
* **D** is incorrect. Creating multiple EFS file systems and synchronizing them with Lambda adds unnecessary custom synchronization logic and operational overhead. A single Regional EFS file system already stores data redundantly across multiple AZs for continuous availability ([Features of Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个新应用程序部署到使用 AWS Fargate 集群的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。该应用程序需要一个用于数据持久化的存储解决方案。该解决方案必须具有高可用性和容错能力。该解决方案还必须能在多个应用程序容器之间共享。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在放置 EKS worker nodes 的相同 Availability Zones 中创建 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 对象中注册这些卷。使用 EBS Multi-Attach 在容器之间共享数据。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 对象中注册该文件系统。对所有容器使用同一个文件系统。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 对象中注册该卷。对所有容器使用同一个卷。
options.D: 在放置 EKS worker nodes 的相同 Availability Zones 中创建 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。在 EKS 集群上的 StorageClass 对象中注册这些文件系统。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来在文件系统之间同步数据。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。Amazon EFS 是 AWS 托管的文件存储服务，专为共享文件数据而设计：AWS 表示，EFS 提供无服务器、弹性的文件存储，因此你可以在**无需预置或管理存储容量和性能的情况下共享文件数据**，并且它可从 Amazon EKS 和 AWS Fargate 访问。Regional EFS 文件系统会在多个 Availability Zones 中冗余存储数据，即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用，也能提供持续可用性，从而以较低的运营开销满足高可用性和容错要求（[What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html), [Features of Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。Amazon EKS 还记录了使用 Amazon EFS CSI driver 来实现持久卷，包括通过静态预置支持 Fargate nodes（[Use elastic file system storage with Amazon EFS - Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/efs-csi.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **A** 不正确。Amazon EBS 是块存储，并且 EKS EBS CSI 文档明确说明你**不能将 Amazon EBS volumes 挂载到 Fargate Pods**。此外，EBS Multi-Attach 仅限于**同一个 Availability Zone** 中的实例，并且 XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非设计用于由多个服务器同时访问；需要集群文件系统和应用程序写入排序，这会增加运营开销（[Use Kubernetes volume storage with Amazon EBS - Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/ebs-csi.html), [Attach an EBS volume to multiple EC2 instances using Multi-Attach](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
* **C** 不正确。单个 EBS volume 并不是跨 Fargate Pods 的共享、多容器文件系统，并且 EKS Fargate Pods 不能挂载 EBS volumes（[Use Kubernetes volume storage with Amazon EBS - Amazon EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/ebs-csi.html)）。
* **D** 不正确。创建多个 EFS file systems 并使用 Lambda 同步它们，会增加不必要的自定义同步逻辑和运营开销。单个 Regional EFS file system 已经会在多个 AZs 中冗余存储数据以实现持续可用性（[Features of Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。

en.question: A company has an application that uses Docker containers in its local data center. The application runs on a container host that stores persistent data in a volume on the host. The container instances use the stored persistent data. The company wants to move the application to a fully managed service because the company does not want to manage any servers or storage infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with self-managed nodes. Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume attached to an Amazon EC2 instance. Use the EBS volume as a persistent volume mounted in the containers.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Map the S3 bucket as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Add the EFS volume as a persistent storage volume mounted in the containers.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS is designed to run containers “without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances,” and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). For persistent container storage, Amazon ECS supports **Amazon EFS** for **Fargate**, with **persistent** storage; AWS describes EFS volumes as simple, scalable, persistent shared file storage for ECS tasks that grows and shrinks automatically and supports concurrent access ([Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)). This matches the need for a fully managed container service and persistent data mounted in containers.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EKS with self-managed nodes and an EC2-attached EBS volume requires managing EC2 worker nodes and storage attachment, so it does not meet the “does not want to manage any servers” requirement.
- **C:** An S3 bucket is not the same as specifying the supported ECS storage option in the answer. ECS documentation distinguishes **Amazon S3 Files** as a specific ECS volume type with a dedicated `s3filesVolumeConfiguration` and a file system ARN, not merely creating and mapping an S3 bucket ([Configuring S3 Files for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/s3files-volumes.html)). EFS is the appropriate persistent mounted file storage option given in the choices.
- **D:** ECS with the **Amazon EC2 launch type** requires EC2 container instances, which means managing servers. Fargate is the option that avoids managing EC2 instances ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在本地数据中心使用 Docker 容器的应用程序。该应用程序在一个容器主机上运行，该主机将持久性数据存储在主机上的一个卷中。容器实例使用这些已存储的持久性数据。该公司希望将该应用程序迁移到完全托管式服务，因为公司不想管理任何服务器或存储基础设施。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 和自管理节点。创建一个附加到 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。将该 EBS 卷用作挂载到容器中的持久卷。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 AWS Fargate 启动类型。创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷。将该 EFS 卷作为挂载到容器中的持久存储卷添加。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 AWS Fargate 启动类型。创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将该 S3 存储桶映射为挂载到容器中的持久存储卷。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 Amazon EC2 启动类型。创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷。将该 EFS 卷作为挂载到容器中的持久存储卷添加。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 用于 Amazon ECS 的 AWS Fargate 旨在运行容器，“without having to manage servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances”，并且无需预置、配置或扩缩 VM 集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。对于持久性容器存储，Amazon ECS 支持将 **Amazon EFS** 用于 **Fargate**，并提供**持久性**存储；AWS 将 EFS 卷描述为适用于 ECS 任务的简单、可扩展、持久的共享文件存储，它可以自动增长和收缩，并支持并发访问（[Storage options for Amazon ECS tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/using_data_volumes.html)）。这符合对完全托管式容器服务以及挂载到容器中的持久性数据的需求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用带自管理节点的 EKS 和附加到 EC2 的 EBS 卷需要管理 EC2 工作节点和存储附加，因此不满足“不想管理任何服务器”的要求。
- **C:** S3 存储桶并不等同于在答案中指定受支持的 ECS 存储选项。ECS 文档将 **Amazon S3 Files** 区分为一种特定的 ECS 卷类型，它具有专用的 `s3filesVolumeConfiguration` 和文件系统 ARN，而不仅仅是创建并映射一个 S3 存储桶（[Configuring S3 Files for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/s3files-volumes.html)）。在给出的选项中，EFS 是合适的持久挂载文件存储选项。
- **D:** 使用 **Amazon EC2 launch type** 的 ECS 需要 EC2 容器实例，这意味着要管理服务器。Fargate 是避免管理 EC2 实例的选项（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

en.question: A gaming company wants to launch a new internet-facing application in multiple AWS Regions. The application will use the TCP and UDP protocols for communication. The company needs to provide high availability and minimum latency for global users. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create internal Network Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.
options.B: Create external Application Load Balancers in front of the application in each Region.
options.C: Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator to route traffic to the load balancers in each Region.
options.D: Configure Amazon Route 53 to use a geolocation routing policy to distribute the traffic.
options.E: Configure Amazon CloudFront to handle the traffic and route requests to the application in each Region

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and C.**

- **A. Create internal Network Load Balancers in each Region** — The application uses **TCP and UDP**, and Network Load Balancer listeners support **TCP, UDP, and TCP_UDP** protocols, whereas ALB listeners support only HTTP/HTTPS. NLBs also provide high availability by routing only to healthy targets across enabled Availability Zones. Although an internal load balancer normally routes only to clients that have VPC access, AWS Global Accelerator explicitly supports **Network Load Balancer endpoints that are internet-facing or internal**, so internal NLBs can be used behind the accelerator. [NLB listener protocols](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html), [Global Accelerator endpoint requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html), [ELB high availability/health routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)
- **C. Create an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator** — Global Accelerator is designed to improve availability and performance for internet applications used by a global audience. It routes traffic over the AWS global network to the optimal regional endpoint based on health, client location, and configured policies, and standard accelerator endpoints can include NLBs in one or multiple Regions. [What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B** is incorrect because Application Load Balancers support **HTTP and HTTPS** listeners, not arbitrary TCP and UDP traffic required by the gaming application. [ALB listener protocols](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)
- **D** is incorrect because Route 53 geolocation routing chooses responses based on user geography, not necessarily the lowest-latency healthy regional endpoint. The requirement for minimum latency and high availability across Regions is better met by Global Accelerator, which routes based on health and client location over the AWS global network. [Global Accelerator behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)
- **E** is incorrect because CloudFront is for accelerating content delivery, especially HTTP/HTTPS-based web content, and is not the appropriate service for a gaming application that needs generic TCP and UDP communication. [What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)

zh.question: 一家游戏公司希望在多个 AWS Regions 中启动一个新的面向互联网的应用程序。该应用程序将使用 TCP 和 UDP 协议进行通信。公司需要为全球用户提供高可用性和最低延迟。解决方案架构师应采取哪两项操作组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在每个 Region 中，在应用程序前面创建内部 Network Load Balancers。
options.B: 在每个 Region 中，在应用程序前面创建外部 Application Load Balancers。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器，将流量路由到每个 Region 中的负载均衡器。
options.D: 配置 Amazon Route 53 使用地理位置路由策略来分发流量。
options.E: 配置 Amazon CloudFront 处理流量，并将请求路由到每个 Region 中的应用程序

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 C。**

- **A. 在每个 Region 中创建内部 Network Load Balancers** — 该应用程序使用 **TCP 和 UDP**，Network Load Balancer 侦听器支持 **TCP, UDP, and TCP_UDP** 协议，而 ALB 侦听器仅支持 HTTP/HTTPS。NLBs 还通过仅将流量路由到已启用 Availability Zones 中的健康目标来提供高可用性。虽然内部负载均衡器通常只向具有 VPC 访问权限的客户端路由，但 AWS Global Accelerator 明确支持**面向互联网或内部的 Network Load Balancer 端点**，因此内部 NLBs 可以在加速器后面使用。[NLB listener protocols](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html), [Global Accelerator endpoint requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html), [ELB high availability/health routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)
- **C. 创建一个 AWS Global Accelerator 加速器** — Global Accelerator 旨在提升面向全球受众的互联网应用程序的可用性和性能。它会根据运行状况、客户端位置以及配置的策略，通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最佳的区域端点，并且标准加速器端点可以包含一个或多个 Regions 中的 NLBs。[What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B** 错误，因为 Application Load Balancers 支持 **HTTP and HTTPS** 侦听器，而不支持游戏应用程序所需的任意 TCP 和 UDP 流量。[ALB listener protocols](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)
- **D** 错误，因为 Route 53 地理位置路由是根据用户地理位置选择响应，并不一定选择延迟最低且健康的区域端点。跨 Regions 的最低延迟和高可用性要求更适合由 Global Accelerator 满足，它会基于运行状况和客户端位置，通过 AWS 全球网络进行路由。[Global Accelerator behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)
- **E** 错误，因为 CloudFront 用于加速内容交付，尤其是基于 HTTP/HTTPS 的 Web 内容，并不适合需要通用 TCP 和 UDP 通信的游戏应用程序。[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)

en.question: A city has deployed a web application running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application's users have reported sporadic performance, which appears to be related to DDoS attacks originating from random IP addresses. The city needs a solution that requires minimal configuration changes and provides an audit trail for the DDoS sources. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the ALB, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources.
options.B: Subscribe to Amazon Inspector. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
options.C: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Engage the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to integrate mitigating controls into the service.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the application, and set the ALB as the origin. Enable an AWS WAF web ACL on the distribution, and configure rules to block traffic from unknown sources

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Shield Advanced is the purpose-built managed DDoS protection service. AWS states that Shield/Shield Advanced protects AWS resources against DDoS attacks at layers 3/4 and layer 7, and that customers can subscribe to Shield Advanced for higher levels of protection ([AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)). An Application Load Balancer is a supported Shield Advanced protected resource type ([protected resources list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-advanced-summary-protected-resources.html)). For response support, AWS documentation says Shield Advanced customers can contact support for mitigation help, and critical/urgent cases are routed directly to DDoS experts; proactive engagement lets the Shield Response Team triage events and create/apply AWS WAF mitigations with consent ([responding to DDoS events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-responding.html)). Shield Advanced also provides CloudWatch DDoS metrics including detection, mitigation, and **top contributor** dimensions such as `SourceIp`, which supports an audit trail of attack sources ([Shield Advanced metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/shield-metrics.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS WAF can be associated with an ALB and can block requests based on criteria such as source IP, but the scenario says the DDoS sources are random. WAF alone requires the city to define effective match criteria/rules and does not provide the Shield Advanced DDoS expert response and DDoS event visibility described above ([AWS WAF overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)).
- **B:** Amazon Inspector is for vulnerability and network exposure scanning, producing findings with vulnerability details and remediation recommendations; it is not a DDoS mitigation service ([Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).
- **D:** Adding CloudFront plus a WAF web ACL changes the application architecture more than necessary and still depends on configuring WAF rules. The application is already behind an ALB, which can be protected directly by Shield Advanced, making C the lower-configuration DDoS-focused answer ([protected resources list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-advanced-summary-protected-resources.html)).

zh.question: 某城市已部署一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序的用户报告性能时好时坏，这似乎与来自随机 IP 地址的 DDoS 攻击有关。该城市需要一种解决方案，要求配置更改最少，并能为 DDoS 来源提供审计跟踪。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 ALB 上启用 AWS WAF web ACL，并配置规则以阻止来自未知来源的流量。
options.B: 订阅 Amazon Inspector。联系 AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT)，将缓解控制集成到该服务中。
options.C: 订阅 AWS Shield Advanced。联系 AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT)，将缓解控制集成到该服务中。
options.D: 为该应用程序创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 ALB 设置为源站。在该分配上启用 AWS WAF web ACL，并配置规则以阻止来自未知来源的流量

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Shield Advanced 是专为 DDoS 防护而构建的托管服务。AWS 表示，Shield/Shield Advanced 可保护 AWS 资源免受第 3/4 层和第 7 层的 DDoS 攻击，并且客户可以订阅 Shield Advanced 以获得更高级别的保护（[AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)）。Application Load Balancer 是 Shield Advanced 支持的受保护资源类型（[protected resources list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-advanced-summary-protected-resources.html)）。对于响应支持，AWS 文档说明 Shield Advanced 客户可以联系支持以获得缓解帮助，并且关键/紧急案例会直接路由给 DDoS 专家；主动参与可让 Shield Response Team 对事件进行分诊，并在获得同意后创建/应用 AWS WAF 缓解措施（[responding to DDoS events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-responding.html)）。Shield Advanced 还提供 CloudWatch DDoS 指标，包括检测、缓解以及 **top contributor** 维度，例如 `SourceIp`，这支持对攻击来源进行审计跟踪（[Shield Advanced metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/shield-metrics.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** AWS WAF 可以与 ALB 关联，并可根据源 IP 等条件阻止请求，但场景说明 DDoS 来源是随机的。单独使用 WAF 需要该城市定义有效的匹配条件/规则，并且不提供上述 Shield Advanced 的 DDoS 专家响应和 DDoS 事件可见性（[AWS WAF overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。
- **B:** Amazon Inspector 用于漏洞和网络暴露扫描，生成包含漏洞详细信息和修复建议的发现；它不是 DDoS 缓解服务（[Amazon Inspector features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。
- **D:** 添加 CloudFront 加 WAF web ACL 对应用程序架构的更改超过必要程度，并且仍依赖于配置 WAF 规则。该应用程序已经位于 ALB 后面，而 ALB 可以直接由 Shield Advanced 保护，因此 C 是配置更少且聚焦于 DDoS 的答案（[protected resources list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-advanced-summary-protected-resources.html)）。

en.question: A company copies 200 TB of data from a recent ocean survey onto AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The company has a high performance computing (HPC) cluster that is hosted on AWS to look for oil and gas deposits. A solutions architect must provide the cluster with consistent sub- millisecond latency and high-throughput access to the data on the Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. The company is sending the devices back to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to use the S3 bucket. Access the file gateway from the HPC cluster instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system, and integrate it with the S3 bucket. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Import the data into the S3 bucket. Copy the data from the S3 bucket to the EFS file system. Access the EFS file system from the HPC cluster instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Import the data directly into the FSx for Lustre file system. Access the FSx for Lustre file system from the HPC cluster instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Snowball Edge import jobs import the data into **Amazon S3**: AWS says that with an import job, data is copied to the Snowball Edge device and, after import, files become objects in Amazon S3 and directories become prefixes; when all data has been imported, it is in the specified S3 buckets in the AWS Cloud ([Snowball Edge import jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/importtype.html)). For the HPC cluster, Amazon FSx for Lustre is the right high-performance file system: AWS states that Lustre is used for workloads such as **HPC**, provides **sub-millisecond latencies**, multiple TBps of throughput, and millions of IOPS ([What is Amazon FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)). FSx for Lustre is also natively integrated with Amazon S3; when linked to an S3 bucket, it can present S3 objects as files for processing with the Lustre file system ([Using data repositories with Amazon FSx for Lustre](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/fsx-data-repositories.html)). SSD FSx for Lustre also provides consistent sub-millisecond latency access to the full dataset and scales to multiple TBps of throughput ([FSx for Lustre performance characteristics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/ssd-storage.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** S3 plus Storage Gateway file gateway does not provide the Lustre HPC file system performance required for consistent sub-millisecond latency and high throughput. It also adds an unnecessary gateway layer instead of using FSx for Lustre’s native S3 integration.
- **C:** Amazon EFS is not the best fit for this HPC requirement. The question specifically requires consistent sub-millisecond latency and high throughput for a large HPC dataset, which AWS documents for FSx for Lustre.
- **D:** Snowball Edge import jobs import data into **Amazon S3**, not directly into an FSx for Lustre file system. The supported pattern here is Snowball Edge → S3 → FSx for Lustre linked to the S3 data repository.

zh.question: 一家公司将最近一次海洋勘测产生的 200 TB 数据复制到 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备上。该公司有一个托管在 AWS 上的高性能计算 (HPC) 集群，用于寻找石油和天然气储藏。解决方案架构师必须为该集群提供对 Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备上数据的一致亚毫秒级延迟和高吞吐量访问。该公司正在将这些设备寄回 AWS。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将数据导入 S3 存储桶。配置 AWS Storage Gateway file gateway 以使用该 S3 存储桶。从 HPC 集群实例访问该 file gateway。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。将数据导入 S3 存储桶。配置一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统，并将其与该 S3 存储桶集成。从 HPC 集群实例访问该 FSx for Lustre 文件系统。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶和一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。将数据导入 S3 存储桶。将数据从 S3 存储桶复制到 EFS 文件系统。从 HPC 集群实例访问该 EFS 文件系统。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Lustre 文件系统。将数据直接导入 FSx for Lustre 文件系统。从 HPC 集群实例访问该 FSx for Lustre 文件系统。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Snowball Edge 导入作业会将数据导入到 **Amazon S3**：AWS 表示，通过导入作业，数据会被复制到 Snowball Edge 设备上，导入后，文件会成为 Amazon S3 中的对象，目录会成为前缀；当所有数据都已导入后，数据会位于 AWS Cloud 中指定的 S3 存储桶内（[Snowball Edge import jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/importtype.html)）。对于 HPC 集群，Amazon FSx for Lustre 是合适的高性能文件系统：AWS 声明 Lustre 用于 **HPC** 等工作负载，提供**亚毫秒级延迟**、多个 TBps 的吞吐量以及数百万 IOPS（[What is Amazon FSx for Lustre?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。FSx for Lustre 还与 Amazon S3 原生集成；当链接到 S3 存储桶时，它可以将 S3 对象呈现为文件，以便使用 Lustre 文件系统进行处理（[Using data repositories with Amazon FSx for Lustre](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/fsx-data-repositories.html)）。SSD FSx for Lustre 还可为完整数据集提供一致的亚毫秒级延迟访问，并扩展到多个 TBps 的吞吐量（[FSx for Lustre performance characteristics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/ssd-storage.html)）。

**为什么其他选项错误：**

- **A:** S3 加 Storage Gateway file gateway 无法提供一致亚毫秒级延迟和高吞吐量所需的 Lustre HPC 文件系统性能。它还增加了不必要的网关层，而不是使用 FSx for Lustre 的原生 S3 集成。
- **C:** Amazon EFS 并不是此 HPC 要求的最佳选择。题目明确要求对大型 HPC 数据集提供一致的亚毫秒级延迟和高吞吐量，而 AWS 文档中说明这是 FSx for Lustre 的能力。
- **D:** Snowball Edge 导入作业会将数据导入到 **Amazon S3**，而不是直接导入到 FSx for Lustre 文件系统。这里受支持的模式是 Snowball Edge → S3 → FSx for Lustre 链接到 S3 数据存储库。

en.question: A company has NFS servers in an on-premises data center that need to periodically back up small amounts of data to Amazon S3. Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST cost-effective?

options.A: Set up AWS Glue to copy the data from the on-premises servers to Amazon S3.
options.B: Set up an AWS DataSync agent on the on-premises servers, and sync the data to Amazon S3.
options.C: Set up an SFTP sync using AWS Transfer for SFTP to sync data from on premises to Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises data center and a VPC, and copy the data to Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B.** AWS DataSync is the best fit because it is specifically designed to transfer file/object data between on-premises storage and AWS storage. AWS documentation states that DataSync supports on-premises storage systems including **Network File System (NFS)** and AWS storage services including **Amazon S3**; its use cases include copying data into Amazon S3 storage classes and automating data movement between storage systems and services ([AWS DataSync overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)). DataSync also has explicit support for transfers to or from AWS storage services such as Amazon S3 ([DataSync transfers with AWS storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-aws-storage.html)).

- **A is incorrect:** AWS Glue is a serverless data integration/ETL service for discovering, preparing, transforming, and integrating data for analytics workflows, not the most direct service for periodic NFS-to-S3 backup copies ([AWS Glue overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)).
- **C is incorrect:** AWS Transfer Family supports SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2 transfers into and out of AWS storage, but it is for file-transfer-protocol workflows and managed transfer endpoints, not native NFS backup synchronization from on-premises servers ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)).
- **D is incorrect:** AWS Direct Connect can provide connectivity, but it has port-hour and data transfer billing, making it unnecessary and less cost-effective for periodically backing up small amounts of data to S3 ([Direct Connect pricing section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在本地数据中心有 NFS 服务器，需要定期将少量数据备份到 Amazon S3。哪种解决方案满足这些要求并且最具成本效益？

options.A: 设置 AWS Glue，将数据从本地服务器复制到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 在本地服务器上设置 AWS DataSync agent，并将数据同步到 Amazon S3。
options.C: 使用 AWS Transfer for SFTP 设置 SFTP 同步，以将数据从本地同步到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 在本地数据中心和 VPC 之间设置 AWS Direct Connect 连接，并将数据复制到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B。** AWS DataSync 是最合适的选择，因为它专门设计用于在本地存储和 AWS 存储之间传输文件/对象数据。AWS 文档说明，DataSync 支持包括 **Network File System (NFS)** 在内的本地存储系统，以及包括 **Amazon S3** 在内的 AWS 存储服务；其使用场景包括将数据复制到 Amazon S3 存储类，以及在存储系统和服务之间自动化数据移动（[AWS DataSync overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。DataSync 还明确支持与 Amazon S3 等 AWS 存储服务之间进行传输（[DataSync transfers with AWS storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/transferring-aws-storage.html)）。

- **A 不正确：** AWS Glue 是一种无服务器数据集成/ETL 服务，用于发现、准备、转换和集成数据以支持分析工作流，并不是用于定期进行 NFS 到 S3 备份复制的最直接服务（[AWS Glue overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)）。
- **C 不正确：** AWS Transfer Family 支持通过 SFTP/FTPS/FTP/AS2 在 AWS 存储中导入和导出文件，但它面向文件传输协议工作流和托管传输端点，而不是从本地服务器进行原生 NFS 备份同步（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。
- **D 不正确：** AWS Direct Connect 可以提供连接，但它会产生端口小时和数据传输计费，因此对于定期将少量数据备份到 S3 来说是不必要的，并且成本效益较低（[Direct Connect pricing section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: An online video game company must maintain ultra-low latency for its game servers. The game servers run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs a solution that can handle millions of UDP internet traffic requests each second. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Application Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
options.B: Configure a Gateway Load Balancer for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
options.C: Configure a Network Load Balancer with the required protocol and ports for the internet traffic. Specify the EC2 instances as the targets.
options.D: Launch an identical set of game servers on EC2 instances in separate AWS Regions. Route internet traffic to both sets of EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** A Network Load Balancer is designed for this requirement: it operates at OSI layer 4, can handle **millions of requests per second**, distributes requests to targets such as **EC2 instances**, and Network Load Balancer target groups support **UDP** (as well as TCP, TCP_UDP, TLS, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC). AWS also documents how NLB routes **UDP traffic** using a flow hash, making it the right load balancer type for ultra-low-latency UDP game traffic ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Application Load Balancer** — Incorrect. An Application Load Balancer operates at the **application layer (Layer 7)** and is intended for application-level routing, not raw UDP traffic. The requirement is millions of UDP requests with ultra-low latency, which matches NLB, not ALB ([Application Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)).
- **B. Gateway Load Balancer** — Incorrect. Gateway Load Balancer is intended to deploy, scale, and manage **virtual appliances** such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and deep packet inspection systems. It exchanges traffic with appliance instances using the **GENEVE** protocol on port 6081, so it is not the most appropriate or cost-effective way to directly load balance game server UDP traffic to EC2 instances ([Gateway Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)).
- **D. Multi-Region EC2 deployment** — Incorrect. Launching duplicate game server fleets in multiple Regions increases infrastructure cost and does not by itself provide the required UDP load balancing. Since NLB already supports UDP, EC2 targets, and millions of requests per second, a multi-Region duplicate deployment is unnecessary for the stated requirement ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家在线视频游戏公司必须为其游戏服务器保持超低延迟。游戏服务器运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。该公司需要一种每秒可处理数百万个 UDP 互联网流量请求的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 为互联网流量配置具有所需协议和端口的 Application Load Balancer。将 EC2 实例指定为目标。
options.B: 为互联网流量配置 Gateway Load Balancer。将 EC2 实例指定为目标。
options.C: 为互联网流量配置具有所需协议和端口的 Network Load Balancer。将 EC2 实例指定为目标。
options.D: 在单独的 AWS Regions 中的 EC2 实例上启动一组相同的游戏服务器。将互联网流量路由到两组 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Network Load Balancer 正是为此类需求而设计的：它在 OSI 第 4 层运行，能够处理**每秒数百万个请求**，将请求分发到诸如 **EC2 实例**之类的目标，并且 Network Load Balancer 目标组支持 **UDP**（以及 TCP、TCP_UDP、TLS、QUIC 和 TCP_QUIC）。AWS 还记录了 NLB 如何使用流哈希路由 **UDP 流量**，因此它是超低延迟 UDP 游戏流量的正确负载均衡器类型（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Application Load Balancer** — 不正确。Application Load Balancer 在**应用层（第 7 层）**运行，用于应用级路由，而不是原始 UDP 流量。该需求是以超低延迟处理数百万个 UDP 请求，这与 NLB 匹配，而不是 ALB（[Application Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。
- **B. Gateway Load Balancer** — 不正确。Gateway Load Balancer 用于部署、扩展和管理**虚拟设备**，例如防火墙、入侵检测/防御系统和深度数据包检测系统。它使用端口 6081 上的 **GENEVE** 协议与设备实例交换流量，因此它不是将游戏服务器 UDP 流量直接负载均衡到 EC2 实例的最合适或最具成本效益的方式（[Gateway Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)）。
- **D. Multi-Region EC2 deployment** — 不正确。在多个 Regions 中启动重复的游戏服务器队列会增加基础设施成本，并且其本身并不能提供所需的 UDP 负载均衡。由于 NLB 已经支持 UDP、EC2 目标以及每秒数百万个请求，因此对于题述需求而言，重复的多 Region 部署是不必要的（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。

en.question: A company runs a three-tier application in a VPC. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. The company plans to migrate the RDS for MySQL DB instance to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company needs a solution that replicates the data changes that happen during the migration to the new database. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to transform the database objects.
options.B: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) Schema Conversion to create an Aurora PostgreSQL read replica on the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
options.C: Configure an Aurora MySQL read replica for the RDS for MySQL DB instance.
options.D: Define an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) task with change data capture (CDC) to migrate the data.
options.E: Promote the Aurora PostgreSQL read replica to a standalone Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster when the replica lag is zero.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and D**.

- **A is correct** because this is a heterogeneous migration from MySQL to PostgreSQL-compatible Aurora. AWS documentation states that DMS Schema Conversion can use MySQL as a migration source and can convert database code objects from MySQL to **PostgreSQL** and **Aurora PostgreSQL** targets ([AWS DMS Schema Conversion for MySQL sources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/sc-data-providers-mysql.html)).
- **D is correct** because the requirement is to replicate data changes that occur during the migration. AWS DMS supports tasks that capture ongoing changes from the source data store while migrating data; this is called ongoing replication or change data capture (CDC).
