AWS states that Transfer Acceleration provides fast transfers over long distances between a client and an S3 bucket, uses globally distributed CloudFront edge locations, and then routes data to S3 over an optimized network path; it is also useful when customers upload to a centralized bucket from all over the world ([S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html), [S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)). This directly matches the requirement to optimize **content upload** latency for mobile users worldwide.

**Why the other options are not best:**

- **A:** CloudFront can be configured to forward upload-related methods such as PUT and POST to an origin, but CloudFront is primarily described as speeding **distribution of content** to users and caching copies in edge locations ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). For S3 upload acceleration, S3 Transfer Acceleration is the purpose-built feature.
- **C:** Uploading first to EC2 and then copying to S3 adds an extra processing and transfer step. AWS recommends accessing S3 from EC2 in the **same Region** to reduce latency and transfer costs for EC2-to-S3 communication, but that does not optimize the mobile client’s initial upload path globally ([S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)).
- **D:** Multiple CloudFront distributions are not the right mechanism for lowest-latency S3 uploads. CloudFront can forward PUT/POST, but it does not cache non-GET/HEAD methods, and its documented main benefit is content delivery/caching near viewers ([CloudFront cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html), [CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一款新的移动应用。世界各地的用户都可以查看他们所选择主题的本地新闻。用户也可以从应用内发布照片和视频。内容发布后的最初几分钟内，用户会频繁访问该内容。新内容会迅速替代较旧内容，然后较旧内容会消失。新闻的本地属性意味着用户会在内容上传所在的 AWS Region 内消费 90% 的内容。哪种解决方案将通过为内容上传提供最低延迟来优化用户体验？

options.A: 将内容上传并存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon CloudFront 进行上传。
options.B: 将内容上传并存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 进行上传。
options.C: 将内容上传到最接近用户的 Region 中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据复制到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 在最接近用户的 Region 中将内容上传并存储到 Amazon S3。使用多个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 专门用于加速来自地理位置分散的客户端到 S3 的上传。AWS 表示，Transfer Acceleration 可在客户端与 S3 bucket 之间提供跨长距离的快速传输，使用全球分布式 CloudFront 边缘站点，然后通过优化的网络路径将数据路由到 S3；当客户从世界各地上传到集中式 bucket 时，它也很有用（[S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html), [S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。这直接符合为全球移动用户优化**内容上传**延迟的要求。

**为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：**

- **A:** CloudFront 可以配置为将与上传相关的方法（例如 PUT 和 POST）转发到源站，但 CloudFront 主要被描述为加速向用户**分发内容**并在边缘站点缓存副本（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。对于 S3 上传加速，S3 Transfer Acceleration 是专门构建的功能。
- **C:** 先上传到 EC2，然后再复制到 S3，会增加额外的处理和传输步骤。AWS 建议从**同一 Region** 中的 EC2 访问 S3，以降低 EC2 到 S3 通信的延迟和传输成本，但这并不能优化移动客户端在全球范围内的初始上传路径（[S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)）。
- **D:** 多个 CloudFront 分配并不是实现最低延迟 S3 上传的正确机制。CloudFront 可以转发 PUT/POST，但它不会缓存非 GET/HEAD 方法，并且其文档中说明的主要优势是在查看者附近进行内容交付/缓存（[CloudFront cache behavior settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistValuesCacheBehavior.html), [CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

en.question: A company is building a new application that uses serverless architecture. The architecture will consist of an Amazon API Gateway REST API and AWS Lambda functions to manage incoming requests. The company wants to add a service that can send messages received from the API Gateway REST API to multiple target Lambda functions for processing. The service must offer message filtering that gives the target Lambda functions the ability to receive only the messages the functions need. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.
options.B: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda functions.
options.C: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK). Configure Amazon MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions.
options.D: Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **A**.

**A. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to an Amazon SNS topic. Subscribe Amazon SQS queues to the SNS topic. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.**

Amazon SNS is a fully managed publish/subscribe messaging service that lets a publisher send messages to a topic and deliver those messages to multiple subscribers, including Amazon SQS queues and Lambda functions. AWS specifically documents the SNS-to-SQS fanout pattern, where messages published to one SNS topic are delivered to multiple SQS queues for asynchronous processing. This decouples the API from the processing Lambda functions and allows each function to process messages from its own queue.

The key requirement is **message filtering** so that each target receives only the messages it needs. Amazon SNS supports subscription filter policies. A subscriber can assign a filter policy to a topic subscription so that SNS delivers only matching messages to that subscriber. SNS filtering can operate on message attributes or on the message body when the payload is valid JSON. Therefore, each SQS subscription can have its own filter policy, and each Lambda function processes only the messages delivered to its corresponding SQS queue. See the Amazon SNS documentation on [message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html) and the SNS-to-SQS [fanout pattern](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html).

Lambda can process messages from SQS by using an event source mapping, which is a managed integration for invoking Lambda from queue messages. AWS documents that Lambda supports processing messages in SQS queues through this integration. This keeps the solution serverless and operationally simple. See [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

**B. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon EventBridge. Configure EventBridge to invoke the target Lambda functions.**

EventBridge is a serverless event routing service that can ingest, filter, transform, and deliver events, and it supports event patterns for filtering. However, this option does not provide the same message-oriented fanout and per-subscriber queue-based decoupling described in the requirement. EventBridge rules route events to targets, but each rule can define only up to five targets, and the option does not include durable per-consumer queues for each Lambda target. The requirement is specifically for sending messages from an API to multiple processing Lambda functions with filtering so each processor receives only the messages it needs. SNS with filtered SQS subscriptions is the more direct managed pub/sub messaging pattern for this use case. EventBridge event patterns are documented in [Creating Amazon EventBridge event patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-patterns.html), and the target limit is documented in [Event bus targets in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html).

**C. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to Amazon MSK. Configure Amazon MSK to publish the messages to the target Lambda functions.**

Amazon MSK is a managed Apache Kafka service. Although Lambda can integrate with MSK, this introduces significantly more operational complexity than SNS and SQS. Kafka topics, partitions, brokers, consumer behavior, and streaming configuration are unnecessary for this simple serverless fanout-and-filtering requirement. AWS documents that the Lambda integration with MSK uses an event source mapping that polls for messages from Kafka topics, which is more complex than the managed SNS/SQS serverless messaging pattern. See [AWS Lambda integration with Amazon MSK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/msk/latest/developerguide/integrations-lambda.html).

**D. Send the requests from the API Gateway REST API to multiple Amazon SQS queues. Configure the target Lambda functions to poll the different SQS queues.**

Sending directly from API Gateway to multiple SQS queues does not provide a single managed pub/sub service with built-in subscription filtering. The application or API integration would need logic to determine which queues should receive each message, increasing operational overhead and coupling the API layer to the processing targets. SQS is a queueing service, not a publish/subscribe fanout service. SNS provides the fanout and filtering layer, while SQS provides durable per-consumer buffering.

Therefore, **Option A** is the best fit because it uses Amazon SNS for managed pub/sub fanout and message filtering, Amazon SQS for decoupled per-consumer queues, and Lambda event source mappings for serverless processing.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个使用无服务器架构的新应用程序。该架构将由一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 和 AWS Lambda 函数组成，用于管理传入请求。公司希望添加一项服务，该服务可以将从 API Gateway REST API 接收的消息发送到多个目标 Lambda 函数进行处理。该服务必须提供消息筛选功能，使目标 Lambda 函数能够只接收这些函数所需的消息。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列订阅到该 SNS 主题。配置目标 Lambda 函数轮询不同的 SQS 队列。
options.B: 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到 Amazon EventBridge。配置 EventBridge 调用目标 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到 Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)。配置 Amazon MSK 将消息发布到目标 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到多个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置目标 Lambda 函数轮询不同的 SQS 队列。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A**。

**A. 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到一个 Amazon SNS 主题。将 Amazon SQS 队列订阅到该 SNS 主题。配置目标 Lambda 函数轮询不同的 SQS 队列。**

Amazon SNS 是一项完全托管的发布/订阅消息服务，允许发布者向主题发送消息，并将这些消息交付给多个订阅者，包括 Amazon SQS 队列和 Lambda 函数。AWS 专门记录了 SNS-to-SQS 扇出模式，在该模式中，发布到一个 SNS 主题的消息会被交付到多个 SQS 队列以进行异步处理。这将 API 与处理 Lambda 函数解耦，并允许每个函数从自己的队列处理消息。关键要求是 **message filtering**，以便每个目标只接收其所需的消息。Amazon SNS 支持订阅筛选策略。订阅者可以为主题订阅分配筛选策略，这样 SNS 只会向该订阅者交付匹配的消息。当有效负载是有效 JSON 时，SNS 筛选可以基于消息属性或消息正文进行操作。因此，每个 SQS 订阅都可以有自己的筛选策略，并且每个 Lambda 函数只处理交付到其对应 SQS 队列的消息。请参阅 Amazon SNS 关于 [message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html) 和 SNS-to-SQS [fanout pattern](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-sqs-as-subscriber.html) 的文档。

Lambda 可以通过使用事件源映射来处理来自 SQS 的消息，这是一种用于从队列消息调用 Lambda 的托管集成。AWS 文档说明 Lambda 支持通过此集成处理 SQS 队列中的消息。这使解决方案保持无服务器且运营简单。请参阅 [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

**B. 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到 Amazon EventBridge。配置 EventBridge 调用目标 Lambda 函数。**

EventBridge 是一项无服务器事件路由服务，可以摄取、筛选、转换和交付事件，并支持用于筛选的事件模式。但是，此选项并不提供需求中描述的相同的面向消息的扇出和基于每个订阅者队列的解耦。EventBridge 规则将事件路由到目标，但每条规则最多只能定义五个目标，并且该选项不包括为每个 Lambda 目标提供的持久化每消费者队列。需求明确是将消息从 API 发送到多个处理 Lambda 函数，并进行筛选，以便每个处理器只接收其所需的消息。带有筛选 SQS 订阅的 SNS 是此用例更直接的托管发布/订阅消息模式。EventBridge 事件模式记录在 [Creating Amazon EventBridge event patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-patterns.html) 中，目标限制记录在 [Event bus targets in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html) 中。

**C. 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到 Amazon MSK。配置 Amazon MSK 将消息发布到目标 Lambda 函数。**

Amazon MSK 是一项托管 Apache Kafka 服务。虽然 Lambda 可以与 MSK 集成，但与 SNS 和 SQS 相比，这会引入显著更多的运营复杂性。对于这种简单的无服务器扇出和筛选需求，Kafka 主题、分区、代理、消费者行为和流式传输配置都是不必要的。AWS 文档说明，Lambda 与 MSK 的集成使用事件源映射从 Kafka 主题轮询消息，这比托管 SNS/SQS 无服务器消息传递模式更复杂。请参阅 [AWS Lambda integration with Amazon MSK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/msk/latest/developerguide/integrations-lambda.html)。

**D. 将请求从 API Gateway REST API 发送到多个 Amazon SQS 队列。配置目标 Lambda 函数轮询不同的 SQS 队列。**

直接从 API Gateway 发送到多个 SQS 队列并不提供一个具有内置订阅筛选功能的单一托管发布/订阅服务。应用程序或 API 集成需要逻辑来确定哪些队列应接收每条消息，这会增加运营开销，并将 API 层与处理目标耦合。SQS 是队列服务，而不是发布/订阅扇出服务。SNS 提供扇出和筛选层，而 SQS 提供持久的每消费者缓冲。因此，**Option A** 是最佳选择，因为它使用 Amazon SNS 进行托管发布/订阅扇出和消息筛选，使用 Amazon SQS 提供解耦的每消费者队列，并使用 Lambda 事件源映射进行无服务器处理。

en.question: A company migrated millions of archival files to Amazon S3. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that will encrypt all the archival data by using a customer-provided key. The solution must encrypt existing unencrypted objects and future objects. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering an Amazon S3 Inventory report. Configure an S3 Batch Operations job to encrypt the objects from the list with a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C). Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C).
options.B: Use S3 Storage Lens metrics to identify unencrypted S3 buckets. Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.C: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Configure an AWS Batch job to encrypt the objects from the list with a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).
options.D: Create a list of unencrypted objects by filtering the AWS usage report for Amazon S3. Configure the S3 default encryption feature to use a server-side encryption with a customer-provided key (SSE-C).

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

A is the best match because it uses the scalable S3-native mechanisms needed for **millions of existing objects**: Amazon S3 Inventory can produce an object list and include the optional **Encryption** field, and S3 Batch Operations can use an Inventory/CSV manifest to perform bulk operations on very large object sets. AWS documentation states that S3 Batch Operations can perform operations on lists of objects, can use S3 Inventory reports as manifests, and can copy/update encryption for objects at scale; another S3 Batch Operations example states that existing unencrypted objects can be copied back to the same bucket as encrypted objects. SSE-C is the encryption mode that uses customer-provided keys: S3 encrypts data using the key provided in the request, and the customer manages that key. SSE-C is supported for write operations such as `PutObject` and `CopyObject` when the required SSE-C headers are supplied. [S3 Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html), [Batch Operations encryption example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops-copy-example-bucket-key.html), [SSE-C overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html), [SSE-C request requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/specifying-s3-c-encryption.html)

**Important current-docs nuance:** AWS documentation now says `PutBucketEncryption` **does not support setting SSE-C as a default encryption method**; SSE-C is object-level and requires the customer-provided key in each upload/copy request. For future objects, the documented way to require SSE-C is to enforce uploads with a bucket policy that denies `PutObject` requests that lack the SSE-C header. Therefore, the exam intent of option A is correct for using S3 Inventory + S3 Batch Operations + SSE-C, but in current AWS docs the “default encryption to use SSE-C” wording should be interpreted as enforcing/allowing SSE-C for future writes rather than automatic default SSE-C. [SSE-C request requirements and enforcement policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/specifying-s3-c-encryption.html)

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B**: SSE-KMS uses AWS KMS keys, not SSE-C customer-provided keys, and Storage Lens identifies metrics/trends rather than producing the object-level manifest needed to re-encrypt millions of specific unencrypted objects.
- **C**: Uses AWS usage reports/AWS Batch rather than the S3 Inventory + S3 Batch Operations approach, and it uses SSE-KMS instead of customer-provided keys.
- **D**: Does not encrypt existing unencrypted objects at all, and current S3 docs do not support SSE-C as automatic bucket default encryption; SSE-C must be specified on each write/copy request or enforced with a bucket policy.

zh.question: 一家公司将数百万个归档文件迁移到了 Amazon S3。解决方案架构师需要实施一个解决方案，使用客户提供的密钥来加密所有归档数据。该解决方案必须加密现有的未加密对象和未来的对象。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过筛选 Amazon S3 Inventory 报告来创建未加密对象的列表。配置一个 S3 Batch Operations 作业，使用服务器端加密和客户提供的密钥 (SSE-C) 对列表中的对象进行加密。配置 S3 默认加密功能，以使用服务器端加密和客户提供的密钥 (SSE-C)。
options.B: 使用 S3 Storage Lens 指标来识别未加密的 S3 存储桶。配置 S3 默认加密功能，以使用带有 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。
options.C: 通过筛选 Amazon S3 的 AWS 使用情况报告来创建未加密对象的列表。配置一个 AWS Batch 作业，使用带有 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 对列表中的对象进行加密。配置 S3 默认加密功能，以使用带有 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。
options.D: 通过筛选 Amazon S3 的 AWS 使用情况报告来创建未加密对象的列表。配置 S3 默认加密功能，以使用服务器端加密和客户提供的密钥 (SSE-C)。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

A 是最匹配的选项，因为它使用了针对**数百万个现有对象**所需的可扩展 S3 原生机制：Amazon S3 Inventory 可以生成对象列表并包含可选的 **Encryption** 字段，而 S3 Batch Operations 可以使用 Inventory/CSV 清单对非常大的对象集执行批量操作。AWS 文档指出，S3 Batch Operations 可以对对象列表执行操作，可以使用 S3 Inventory 报告作为清单，并且可以大规模复制/更新对象的加密；另一个 S3 Batch Operations 示例指出，现有未加密对象可以被复制回同一存储桶并成为加密对象。SSE-C 是使用客户提供的密钥的加密模式：S3 使用请求中提供的密钥来加密数据，并由客户管理该密钥。SSE-C 支持 `PutObject` 和 `CopyObject` 等写入操作，前提是提供了所需的 SSE-C 标头。[S3 Batch Operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html), [Batch Operations encryption example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops-copy-example-bucket-key.html), [SSE-C overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html), [SSE-C request requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/specifying-s3-c-encryption.html)

**当前文档中的重要细节：** AWS 文档现在说明 `PutBucketEncryption` **不支持将 SSE-C 设置为默认加密方法**；SSE-C 是对象级别的，并且要求在每次上传/复制请求中提供客户提供的密钥。对于未来对象，文档中要求 SSE-C 的方式是使用存储桶策略强制执行：拒绝缺少 SSE-C 标头的 `PutObject` 请求。因此，选项 A 的考试意图在于使用 S3 Inventory + S3 Batch Operations + SSE-C，这一点是正确的；但在当前 AWS 文档中，“default encryption to use SSE-C”的表述应理解为对未来写入强制/允许使用 SSE-C，而不是自动默认 SSE-C。[SSE-C request requirements and enforcement policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/specifying-s3-c-encryption.html)

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B**：SSE-KMS 使用 AWS KMS keys，而不是 SSE-C 客户提供的密钥；并且 Storage Lens 用于识别指标/趋势，而不是生成重新加密数百万个特定未加密对象所需的对象级清单。
- **C**：使用的是 AWS usage reports/AWS Batch，而不是 S3 Inventory + S3 Batch Operations 方法，并且使用 SSE-KMS 而不是客户提供的密钥。
- **D**：完全没有加密现有未加密对象，并且当前 S3 文档不支持将 SSE-C 作为自动存储桶默认加密；SSE-C 必须在每个写入/复制请求中指定，或通过存储桶策略强制执行。

en.question: The DNS provider that hosts a company's domain name records is experiencing outages that cause service disruption for a website running on AWS. The company needs to migrate to a more resilient managed DNS service and wants the service to run on AWS. What should a solutions architect do to rapidly migrate the DNS hosting service?

options.A: Create an Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone file containing the domain records hosted by the previous provider.
options.B: Create an Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone for the domain name. Import the zone file containing the domain records hosted by the previous provider.
options.C: Create a Simple AD directory in AWS. Enable zone transfer between the DNS provider and AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for the domain records.
options.D: Create an Amazon Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint in the VPC. Specify the IP addresses that the provider's DNS will forward DNS queries to. Configure the provider's DNS to forward DNS queries for the domain to the IP addresses that are specified in the inbound endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The website’s domain needs publicly resolvable DNS, so the appropriate managed AWS DNS service is an **Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone**. AWS documentation says that when migrating DNS for a domain in use, you create a hosted zone with the same name as the domain, keep the default type **Public hosted zone**, and Route 53 creates NS/SOA records; to make Route 53 the DNS service, you update the domain’s name servers to the Route 53 name servers. The same migration guide states that importing a zone file is the easiest way to create records when you obtain a zone file from the current DNS provider ([Route 53 migration steps](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/migrate-dns-domain-in-use.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A private hosted zone is not appropriate for an internet-facing website. Route 53 documentation distinguishes hosted zone types: **public hosted zones** route traffic on the internet, while **private hosted zones** route traffic in an Amazon VPC ([Working with hosted zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/hosted-zones-working-with.html)).
- **C:** AWS Directory Service is for using Microsoft Active Directory/LDAP-aware applications and managing users, groups, devices, and access, not for rapidly migrating public authoritative DNS hosting for a website ([What is AWS Directory Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/what_is.html)).
- **D:** Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoints are for forwarding DNS queries **from your network to Route 53 VPC Resolver** in a VPC; they are not the standard way to migrate public authoritative DNS hosting for an internet domain ([Resolver inbound endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-overview-forward-network-to-vpc.html)).

zh.question: 托管某公司域名记录的 DNS 提供商正在发生中断，导致在 AWS 上运行的网站服务中断。该公司需要迁移到更具弹性的托管 DNS 服务，并希望该服务在 AWS 上运行。解决方案架构师应如何快速迁移 DNS 托管服务？

options.A: 为该域名创建一个 Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone。导入包含由之前提供商托管的域记录的区域文件。
options.B: 为该域名创建一个 Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone。导入包含由之前提供商托管的域记录的区域文件。
options.C: 在 AWS 中创建一个 Simple AD 目录。为域记录启用 DNS 提供商与 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 之间的区域传送。
options.D: 在 VPC 中创建一个 Amazon Route 53 Resolver 入站终端节点。指定提供商的 DNS 将 DNS 查询转发到的 IP 地址。配置提供商的 DNS，将该域的 DNS 查询转发到入站终端节点中指定的 IP 地址。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** 该网站的域名需要可公开解析的 DNS，因此合适的 AWS 托管 DNS 服务是 **Amazon Route 53 public hosted zone**。AWS 文档说明，在迁移正在使用的域的 DNS 时，需要创建一个与域同名的 hosted zone，保留默认类型 **Public hosted zone**，Route 53 会创建 NS/SOA 记录；要让 Route 53 成为 DNS 服务，需要将该域的名称服务器更新为 Route 53 名称服务器。同一迁移指南还指出，当你从当前 DNS 提供商获取区域文件时，导入区域文件是创建记录的最简单方法（[Route 53 migration steps](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/migrate-dns-domain-in-use.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B:** private hosted zone 不适用于面向互联网的网站。Route 53 文档区分了 hosted zone 类型：**public hosted zones** 在互联网上路由流量，而 **private hosted zones** 在 Amazon VPC 中路由流量（[Working with hosted zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/hosted-zones-working-with.html)）。
- **C:** AWS Directory Service 用于使用 Microsoft Active Directory/LDAP 感知型应用程序，以及管理用户、组、设备和访问权限，并不是用于快速迁移网站的公共权威 DNS 托管（[What is AWS Directory Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/what_is.html)）。
- **D:** Route 53 Resolver 入站终端节点用于将 DNS 查询**从你的网络转发到 VPC 中的 Route 53 VPC Resolver**；它不是迁移互联网域的公共权威 DNS 托管的标准方式（[Resolver inbound endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resolver-overview-forward-network-to-vpc.html)）。

en.question: A company is building an application on AWS that connects to an Amazon RDS database. The company wants to manage the application configuration and to securely store and retrieve credentials for the database and other services. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use AWS AppConfig to store and manage the application configuration. Use AWS Secrets Manager to store and retrieve the credentials.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda to store and manage the application configuration. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to store and retrieve the credentials.
options.C: Use an encrypted application configuration file. Store the file in Amazon S3 for the application configuration. Create another S3 file to store and retrieve the credentials.
options.D: Use AWS AppConfig to store and manage the application configuration. Use Amazon RDS to store and retrieve the credentials.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS AppConfig is the appropriate managed service for application configuration: AWS says AppConfig feature flags and dynamic configurations let builders “quickly and securely adjust application behavior” without full code deployments, and one of its use cases is **centralized configuration storage** to keep configuration data organized and consistent across workloads ([What is AWS AppConfig?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/what-is-appconfig.html)). Its hosted configuration store also reduces administration because you do not need to set up S3 or Parameter Store, do not need to configure IAM permissions for the store, and can store configuration as YAML, JSON, or text ([AWS AppConfig hosted configuration store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-creating-configuration-and-profile-about-hosted-store.html)).

AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built for the credentials requirement: it helps you “manage, retrieve, and rotate database credentials, application credentials, OAuth tokens, API keys, and other secrets,” replaces hard-coded credentials with runtime retrieval, and supports automatic rotation ([What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). AWS also documents multiple ways applications can retrieve secret values from Secrets Manager ([Get secrets from AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/retrieving-secrets.html)). This combination best meets both requirements with the least administrative overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B:** Lambda is a compute service, not a managed application configuration service. Parameter Store can be used for parameters, but this option does not use AppConfig for configuration management, and Secrets Manager is the AWS service specifically documented for managing, retrieving, and rotating database credentials.
* **C:** Storing encrypted configuration and credentials as S3 files requires custom encryption, access, retrieval, and rotation logic. AppConfig’s hosted store avoids the need to set up S3 for configuration, and Secrets Manager avoids hard-coded or file-based secrets by retrieving credentials dynamically.
* **D:** AppConfig is suitable for configuration, but Amazon RDS is the database service being accessed, not a secrets management service. Storing credentials in RDS would not provide the Secrets Manager lifecycle features such as secure retrieval and automatic rotation of database credentials.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个连接到 Amazon RDS 数据库的应用程序。该公司希望管理应用程序配置，并安全地存储和检索数据库及其他服务的凭证。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS AppConfig 存储和管理应用程序配置。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 存储和检索凭证。
options.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 存储和管理应用程序配置。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 存储和检索凭证。
options.C: 使用加密的应用程序配置文件。将该文件存储在 Amazon S3 中用于应用程序配置。创建另一个 S3 文件来存储和检索凭证。
options.D: 使用 AWS AppConfig 存储和管理应用程序配置。使用 Amazon RDS 存储和检索凭证。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS AppConfig 是适用于应用程序配置的托管服务：AWS 表示，AppConfig 功能标志和动态配置让构建者能够在无需完整代码部署的情况下“quickly and securely adjust application behavior”，其用例之一是 **集中式配置存储**，用于保持配置数据在各工作负载之间有序且一致（[What is AWS AppConfig?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/what-is-appconfig.html)）。其托管配置存储还减少了管理工作，因为你不需要设置 S3 或 Parameter Store，不需要为该存储配置 IAM 权限，并且可以将配置存储为 YAML、JSON 或文本（[AWS AppConfig hosted configuration store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appconfig/latest/userguide/appconfig-creating-configuration-and-profile-about-hosted-store.html)）。

AWS Secrets Manager 是专为凭证需求而构建的：它帮助你“manage, retrieve, and rotate database credentials, application credentials, OAuth tokens, API keys, and other secrets”，用运行时检索替代硬编码凭证，并支持自动轮换（[What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。AWS 还记录了应用程序可从 Secrets Manager 检索密钥值的多种方式（[Get secrets from AWS Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/retrieving-secrets.html)）。这种组合能够以最少的管理开销最好地满足两个要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **B:** Lambda 是计算服务，而不是托管的应用程序配置服务。Parameter Store 可用于参数，但此选项没有使用 AppConfig 进行配置管理，并且 Secrets Manager 才是 AWS 明确用于管理、检索和轮换数据库凭证的服务。
* **C:** 将加密的配置和凭证作为 S3 文件存储，需要自定义加密、访问、检索和轮换逻辑。AppConfig 的托管存储避免了为配置设置 S3 的需要，而 Secrets Manager 通过动态检索凭证，避免了硬编码或基于文件的密钥。
* **D:** AppConfig 适用于配置，但 Amazon RDS 是被访问的数据库服务，不是密钥管理服务。将凭证存储在 RDS 中无法提供 Secrets Manager 的生命周期功能，例如安全检索和数据库凭证的自动轮换。

en.question: To meet security requirements, a company needs to encrypt all of its application data in transit while communicating with an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. A recent security audit revealed that encryption at rest is enabled using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS), but data in transit is not enabled. What should a solutions architect do to satisfy the security requirements?

options.A: Enable IAM database authentication on the database.
options.B: Provide self-signed certificates. Use the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance.
options.C: Take a snapshot of the RDS instance. Restore the snapshot to a new instance with encryption enabled.
options.D: Download AWS-provided root certificates. Provide the certificates in all connections to the RDS instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** To encrypt application traffic to an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance, configure the application connections to use SSL/TLS and validate the RDS server certificate with the AWS-provided CA/root certificate bundle. AWS states that SSL/TLS can be used from an application to encrypt connections to MySQL databases, and the process includes choosing the CA, downloading the certificate bundle, and connecting using the DB engine’s SSL/TLS process ([Using SSL/TLS to encrypt a connection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.SSL.html)). For RDS MySQL specifically, Amazon RDS creates and installs an SSL/TLS certificate on the DB instance when it provisions the instance, and the certificate is signed by a certificate authority ([SSL/TLS support for MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/MySQL.Concepts.SSLSupport.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. Enable IAM database authentication** — IAM database authentication changes how clients authenticate, using an IAM-generated token instead of a password; it is not the direct required action to configure all application connections for in-transit encryption. The docs describe IAM DB authentication as an authentication method, while SSL/TLS configuration is the documented mechanism for encrypting database connections ([IAM database authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)).
- **B. Provide self-signed certificates** — RDS already uses certificates signed by Amazon RDS certificate authorities. The documented approach is to use the AWS/RDS CA certificate bundle, not customer-created self-signed certificates ([Using SSL/TLS to encrypt a connection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.SSL.html)).
- **C. Restore a snapshot with encryption enabled** — This addresses encryption at rest, which the question says is already enabled with AWS KMS. It does not enable SSL/TLS encryption for data moving between the application and the DB instance.

zh.question: 为了满足安全要求，一家公司需要在与 Amazon RDS MySQL DB 实例通信时，对其所有应用程序传输中的数据进行加密。最近的一次安全审计显示，已使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 启用静态加密，但未启用传输中数据加密。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来满足安全要求？

options.A: 在数据库上启用 IAM 数据库身份验证。
options.B: 提供自签名证书。在所有连接到 RDS 实例的连接中使用这些证书。
options.C: 创建 RDS 实例的快照。将该快照还原到启用了加密的新实例。
options.D: 下载 AWS 提供的根证书。在所有连接到 RDS 实例的连接中提供这些证书。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 要加密发往 Amazon RDS MySQL DB 实例的应用程序流量，请配置应用程序连接以使用 SSL/TLS，并使用 AWS 提供的 CA/根证书捆绑包验证 RDS 服务器证书。AWS 说明，可以从应用程序使用 SSL/TLS 来加密到 MySQL 数据库的连接，并且该过程包括选择 CA、下载证书捆绑包，以及使用 DB 引擎的 SSL/TLS 流程进行连接（[Using SSL/TLS to encrypt a connection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.SSL.html)）。对于 RDS MySQL，Amazon RDS 在预置实例时会在 DB 实例上创建并安装 SSL/TLS 证书，并且该证书由证书颁发机构签名（[SSL/TLS support for MySQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/MySQL.Concepts.SSLSupport.html)）。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A. Enable IAM database authentication** — IAM 数据库身份验证会改变客户端的身份验证方式，使用 IAM 生成的令牌而不是密码；它不是配置所有应用程序连接以实现传输中加密所需的直接操作。文档将 IAM DB 身份验证描述为一种身份验证方法，而 SSL/TLS 配置才是用于加密数据库连接的已记录机制（[IAM database authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.IAMDBAuth.html)）。
- **B. Provide self-signed certificates** — RDS 已使用由 Amazon RDS 证书颁发机构签名的证书。文档化的方法是使用 AWS/RDS CA 证书捆绑包，而不是客户创建的自签名证书（[Using SSL/TLS to encrypt a connection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/UsingWithRDS.SSL.html)）。
- **C. Restore a snapshot with encryption enabled** — 这解决的是静态加密，而题目说明已使用 AWS KMS 启用静态加密。它不会为应用程序与 DB 实例之间移动的数据启用 SSL/TLS 加密。

en.question: A company is designing a new web service that will run on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer. However, many of the web service clients can only reach IP addresses authorized on their firewalls. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet the clients’ needs?

options.A: A Network Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.
options.B: An Application Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.
options.C: An A record in an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone pointing to an Elastic IP address.
options.D: An EC2 instance with a public IP address running as a proxy in front of the load balancer.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. A Network Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address.**

Clients that can connect only to pre-authorized firewall IP addresses need a stable, allow-listable public IP. AWS documentation states that for a Network Load Balancer, each load balancer node uses a static IP address, and for an internet-facing NLB you can optionally associate **one Elastic IP address per subnet**. AWS also lists “support for static IP addresses” and the ability to assign one Elastic IP address per subnet as NLB benefits ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. Application Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address** — An ALB is an application-layer load balancer, but the cited AWS NLB documentation specifically identifies Elastic IP/static IP support for **Network Load Balancers**, not ALBs. ALBs are accessed through the load balancer DNS name and are not the option for assigning client-allow-listed Elastic IPs.
- **C. Route 53 A record pointing to an Elastic IP address** — A DNS record to an Elastic IP by itself does not provide ELB load balancing across the EC2 fleet. Route 53 supports A records for IPv4 addresses, but this option points to a single Elastic IP rather than solving the requirement for an ELB-backed service with stable load balancer IPs ([Route 53 supported record types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/ResourceRecordTypes.html)).
- **D. EC2 instance with a public IP as a proxy** — This adds an unmanaged single proxy layer in front of the load balancer, creating operational overhead and potential single point of failure. ELB/NLB is designed to be the single point of contact for clients and distribute traffic to EC2 targets ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一项新的 Web 服务，该服务将在 Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) 负载均衡器后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。但是，许多 Web 服务客户端只能访问其防火墙上已授权的 IP 地址。解决方案架构师应建议什么来满足客户端的需求？

options.A: 一个关联了 Elastic IP 地址的 Network Load Balancer。
options.B: 一个关联了 Elastic IP 地址的 Application Load Balancer。
options.C: Amazon Route 53 托管区域中指向 Elastic IP 地址的 A 记录。
options.D: 一个具有公有 IP 地址、作为负载均衡器前端代理运行的 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 一个关联了 Elastic IP 地址的 Network Load Balancer。**

只能连接到预先授权的防火墙 IP 地址的客户端需要一个稳定、可加入允许列表的公有 IP。AWS 文档说明，对于 Network Load Balancer，每个负载均衡器节点都使用静态 IP 地址；对于面向互联网的 NLB，你可以选择为**每个子网关联一个 Elastic IP 地址**。AWS 还将“支持静态 IP 地址”以及能够为每个子网分配一个 Elastic IP 地址列为 NLB 的优势（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. Application Load Balancer with an associated Elastic IP address** — ALB 是应用层负载均衡器，但引用的 AWS NLB 文档专门指出 **Network Load Balancers** 支持 Elastic IP/静态 IP，而不是 ALBs。ALBs 通过负载均衡器 DNS 名称访问，并不是用于分配客户端允许列表 Elastic IPs 的选项。
- **C. Route 53 A record pointing to an Elastic IP address** — 仅将 DNS 记录指向某个 Elastic IP 本身，并不能为 EC2 队列提供 ELB 负载均衡。Route 53 支持用于 IPv4 地址的 A 记录，但此选项指向的是单个 Elastic IP，而不是解决由 ELB 支持的服务需要稳定负载均衡器 IPs 的要求（[Route 53 supported record types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/ResourceRecordTypes.html)）。
- **D. EC2 instance with a public IP as a proxy** — 这会在负载均衡器前面增加一个非托管的单一代理层，造成运维开销和潜在单点故障。ELB/NLB 的设计目的就是作为客户端的单一联系点，并将流量分发到 EC2 目标（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。

en.question: A company has established a new AWS account. The account is newly provisioned and no changes have been made to the default settings. The company is concerned about the security of the AWS account root user. What should be done to secure the root user?

options.A: Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Disable the root user.
options.B: Create IAM users for daily administrative tasks. Enable multi-factor authentication on the root user.
options.C: Generate an access key for the root user. Use the access key for daily administration tasks instead of the AWS Management Console.
options.D: Provide the root user credentials to the most senior solutions architect. Have the solutions architect use the root user for daily administration tasks.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS states that the root user has complete access to all AWS services and resources, and strongly recommends not using the root user for everyday tasks; instead, use it only for tasks that require root-level permissions and follow root-user best practices ([AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)). AWS also says it is crucial to add MFA for the root user because the root user can perform privileged actions ([Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)). Therefore, creating IAM users for daily administration and enabling MFA on the root user is the best choice.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Creating IAM users for daily tasks is appropriate, but you generally cannot simply “disable” the root user in a newly provisioned standalone account. The AWS guidance is to safeguard the root credentials and use the root user only for tasks that require it ([AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)).
- **C:** AWS strongly recommends that you **do not create access keys for the root user**, because the root user has full access to all services and resources in the account ([Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)).
- **D:** AWS strongly recommends that you **don’t use the root user for everyday tasks** and also says not to share root user credentials except for strict business need ([AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html), [Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司已建立一个新的 AWS 账户。该账户是新预置的，且未对默认设置进行任何更改。公司担心 AWS 账户 root 用户的安全性。应采取什么措施来保护 root 用户？

options.A: 为日常管理任务创建 IAM 用户。禁用 root 用户。
options.B: 为日常管理任务创建 IAM 用户。在 root 用户上启用多重身份验证。
options.C: 为 root 用户生成访问密钥。使用该访问密钥执行日常管理任务，而不是使用 AWS Management Console。
options.D: 将 root 用户凭证提供给最高级别的解决方案架构师。让该解决方案架构师使用 root 用户执行日常管理任务。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS 指出，root 用户对所有 AWS 服务和资源拥有完全访问权限，并强烈建议不要将 root 用户用于日常任务；相反，仅应将其用于需要 root 级权限的任务，并遵循 root 用户最佳实践（[AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)）。AWS 还表示，为 root 用户添加 MFA 至关重要，因为 root 用户可以执行特权操作（[Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。因此，为日常管理创建 IAM 用户，并在 root 用户上启用 MFA，是最佳选择。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** 为日常任务创建 IAM 用户是合适的，但在新预置的独立账户中，通常不能简单地“禁用” root 用户。AWS 指南是保护 root 凭证，并且仅在需要时才使用 root 用户执行需要其权限的任务（[AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)）。
- **C:** AWS 强烈建议你**不要为 root 用户创建访问密钥**，因为 root 用户对账户中的所有服务和资源拥有完全访问权限（[Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。
- **D:** AWS 强烈建议你**不要将 root 用户用于日常任务**，并且还说明除非有严格的业务需要，否则不要共享 root 用户凭证（[AWS account root user](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html), [Root user best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/root-user-best-practices.html)）。

en.question: A company is deploying an application that processes streaming data in near-real time. The company plans to use Amazon EC2 instances for the workload. The network architecture must be configurable to provide the lowest possible latency between nodes. Which combination of network solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Enable and configure enhanced networking on each EC2 instance.
options.B: Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts.
options.C: Run the EC2 instances in a cluster placement group.
options.D: Attach multiple elastic network interfaces to each EC2 instance.
options.E: Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) optimized instance types.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and C.**

- **A. Enable and configure enhanced networking on each EC2 instance** — Enhanced networking is designed for high-performance EC2 networking. AWS states that it provides higher bandwidth, higher packet-per-second performance, and **consistently lower latency between instances** by using SR-IOV on supported instance types ([Enhanced networking on Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/enhanced-networking.html)).
- **C. Run the EC2 instances in a cluster placement group** — A cluster placement group places instances in a high-bisection-bandwidth network segment within a single Availability Zone. AWS recommends cluster placement groups for applications that benefit from **low network latency, high network throughput, or both**, and specifically says that to provide the lowest latency and highest packet-per-second performance, you should choose an instance type that supports enhanced networking ([Placement strategies: Cluster placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Group the EC2 instances in separate accounts** — Separate AWS accounts do not reduce inter-node network latency. The relevant AWS guidance is to place instances physically/network-topologically closer by using a cluster placement group, not to separate them by account.
- **D. Attach multiple elastic network interfaces to each EC2 instance** — Multiple ENIs are for adding primary/secondary network interfaces, but AWS explicitly states that attaching another network interface, such as for NIC teaming, **cannot increase or double network bandwidth** to or from the instance ([Network interface attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/network-interface-attachments.html)). This does not meet the lowest-latency requirement.
- **E. Use Amazon EBS optimized instance types** — EBS optimization is about storage I/O performance between EC2 and Amazon EBS. AWS describes EBS-optimized performance in terms of EBS throughput and IOPS limits, not inter-instance network latency ([Get the maximum Amazon EBS optimized performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-optimization-performance.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在部署一个近实时处理流数据的应用程序。该公司计划使用 Amazon EC2 实例来承载该工作负载。网络架构必须可配置，以在节点之间提供尽可能低的延迟。哪种网络解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在每个 EC2 实例上启用并配置增强联网。
options.B: 将 EC2 实例分组到不同的账户中。
options.C: 在集群置放群组中运行 EC2 实例。
options.D: 将多个弹性网络接口附加到每个 EC2 实例。
options.E: 使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 优化的实例类型。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 C。**

- **A. 在每个 EC2 实例上启用并配置增强联网** — 增强联网专为高性能 EC2 网络而设计。AWS 表示，它通过在受支持的实例类型上使用 SR-IOV，提供更高的带宽、更高的每秒数据包性能，以及**实例之间始终更低的延迟**（[Enhanced networking on Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/enhanced-networking.html)）。
- **C. 在集群置放群组中运行 EC2 实例** — 集群置放群组会将实例放置在单个 Availability Zone 内的高对分带宽网络段中。AWS 建议将集群置放群组用于可从**低网络延迟、高网络吞吐量或两者兼具**中受益的应用程序，并明确说明，要提供最低延迟和最高每秒数据包性能，应选择支持增强联网的实例类型（[Placement strategies: Cluster placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B. 将 EC2 实例分组到不同的账户中** — 不同的 AWS 账户不会降低节点间网络延迟。相关的 AWS 指导是通过使用集群置放群组，使实例在物理/网络拓扑上更接近，而不是按账户将它们分开。
- **D. 将多个弹性网络接口附加到每个 EC2 实例** — 多个 ENI 用于添加主/辅助网络接口，但 AWS 明确说明，附加另一个网络接口（例如用于 NIC teaming）**无法增加或加倍实例的入站或出站网络带宽**（[Network interface attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/network-interface-attachments.html)）。这不满足最低延迟要求。
- **E. 使用 Amazon EBS 优化的实例类型** — EBS 优化关注的是 EC2 与 Amazon EBS 之间的存储 I/O 性能。AWS 对 EBS 优化性能的描述是基于 EBS 吞吐量和 IOPS 限制，而不是实例间网络延迟（[Get the maximum Amazon EBS optimized performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ebs-optimization-performance.html)）。

en.question: A financial services company wants to shut down two data centers and migrate more than 100 TB of data to AWS. The data has an intricate directory structure with millions of small files stored in deep hierarchies of subfolders. Most of the data is unstructured, and the company’s file storage consists of SMB-based storage types from multiple vendors. The company does not want to change its applications to access the data after migration. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Direct Connect to migrate the data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Lustre.
options.C: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
options.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to migrate the data on-premises file storage to an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.**

AWS DataSync is designed for high-speed migration of file/object data and explicitly supports on-premises **SMB** storage as a source and **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** as an AWS destination. AWS states that DataSync can transfer active datasets into AWS storage services and automates the transfer process and infrastructure needed for high-performance transfers ([DataSync overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)). For FSx for Windows File Server, DataSync connects with the **Server Message Block (SMB) protocol** and can access files, folders, and file metadata, including Windows ACLs when properly configured ([DataSync FSx for Windows location](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)).

FSx for Windows File Server is the right target because it provides fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers, native Windows file system features, and native support for the industry-standard **SMB** protocol. AWS also notes that existing Windows code, applications, and tools can continue to work unchanged, which directly matches the requirement not to change applications after migration ([FSx for Windows overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)). Clients access FSx for Windows file shares using SMB and can use mapped file shares as if they are local files and folders ([FSx file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A. Direct Connect to Amazon S3** — Direct Connect is only connectivity, not a managed file migration workflow. More importantly, Amazon S3 is **object storage**, not an SMB file system, so applications that expect SMB file shares and deep file hierarchies would need changes or an additional file-access layer ([Amazon S3 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).
* **B. DataSync to Amazon FSx for Lustre** — DataSync can work with FSx for Lustre, but the requirement is to preserve SMB-based file access without application changes. FSx for Windows File Server is the AWS file service documented for native SMB access and unchanged Windows application/tool compatibility ([FSx for Windows overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).
* **D. Direct Connect to Storage Gateway Volume Gateway** — Volume Gateway presents cloud-backed storage volumes as **iSCSI** devices from on-premises application servers, which is block storage rather than the required SMB file-share interface. It also keeps gateway infrastructure in the architecture, adding operational overhead compared with a managed FSx file system ([Volume Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

zh.question: 一家金融服务公司希望关闭两个数据中心，并将超过 100 TB 的数据迁移到 AWS。该数据具有复杂的目录结构，包含数百万个小文件，这些文件存储在多层子文件夹的深层层次结构中。大部分数据是非结构化数据，并且该公司的文件存储由来自多个供应商的基于 SMB 的存储类型组成。公司不希望在迁移后更改其应用程序来访问数据。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施，以在满足这些要求的同时实现最少的运维开销？

options.A: 使用 AWS Direct Connect 将数据迁移到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据迁移到 Amazon FSx for Lustre。
options.C: 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。
options.D: 使用 AWS Direct Connect 将本地文件存储中的数据迁移到 AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据迁移到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。**

AWS DataSync 专为文件/对象数据的高速迁移而设计，并明确支持将本地 **SMB** 存储作为源，将 **Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** 作为 AWS 目标。AWS 表示，DataSync 可以将活动数据集传输到 AWS 存储服务中，并自动化实现高性能传输所需的传输流程和基础设施（[DataSync overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。对于 FSx for Windows File Server，DataSync 使用 **Server Message Block (SMB) protocol** 进行连接，并且可以访问文件、文件夹和文件元数据，包括在正确配置时访问 Windows ACLs（[DataSync FSx for Windows location](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-fsx-location.html)）。

FSx for Windows File Server 是正确的目标，因为它提供完全托管的 Microsoft Windows file servers、原生 Windows file system 功能，以及对行业标准 **SMB** 协议的原生支持。AWS 还指出，现有 Windows 代码、应用程序和工具可以继续保持不变地运行，这直接符合迁移后不更改应用程序的要求（[FSx for Windows overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。客户端使用 SMB 访问 FSx for Windows file shares，并且可以像使用本地文件和文件夹一样使用映射的文件共享（[FSx file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A. Direct Connect to Amazon S3** — Direct Connect 只是连接方式，而不是托管的文件迁移工作流。更重要的是，Amazon S3 是**对象存储**，不是 SMB 文件系统，因此期望使用 SMB file shares 和深层文件层次结构的应用程序将需要更改或额外的文件访问层（[Amazon S3 overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。
* **B. DataSync to Amazon FSx for Lustre** — DataSync 可以与 FSx for Lustre 配合使用，但要求是在不更改应用程序的情况下保留基于 SMB 的文件访问。FSx for Windows File Server 是 AWS 文档中支持原生 SMB 访问以及 Windows 应用程序/工具兼容性保持不变的文件服务（[FSx for Windows overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。
* **D. Direct Connect to Storage Gateway Volume Gateway** — Volume Gateway 将云支持的存储卷作为 **iSCSI** 设备呈现给本地应用程序服务器，这是块存储，而不是所需的 SMB 文件共享接口。与托管的 FSx 文件系统相比，它还会在架构中保留网关基础设施，从而增加运维开销（[Volume Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage AWS accounts that contain applications. The company sets up a dedicated monitoring member account in the organization. The company wants to query and visualize observability data across the accounts by using Amazon CloudWatch. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable CloudWatch cross-account observability for the monitoring account. Deploy an AWS CloudFormation template provided by the monitoring account in each AWS account to share the data with the monitoring account.
options.B: Set up service control policies (SCPs) to provide access to CloudWatch in the monitoring account under the Organizations root organizational unit (OU).
options.C: Configure a new IAM user in the monitoring account. In each AWS account, configure an IAM policy to have access to query and visualize the CloudWatch data in the account. Attach the new IAM policy to the new IAM user.
options.D: Create a new IAM user in the monitoring account. Create cross-account IAM policies in each AWS account. Attach the IAM policies to the new IAM user.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon CloudWatch cross-account observability is designed for exactly this use case: a central **monitoring account** can search, visualize, and analyze observability data from linked **source accounts**, including CloudWatch metrics and logs, without account boundaries. AWS also recommends creating a dedicated monitoring account, then setting it up and linking source accounts; after that, the monitoring account can view the source accounts’ observability data ([CloudWatch cross-account observability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account.html), [setup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account-Setup.html)). The setup documentation states that CloudWatch provides a CloudFormation template to link an entire AWS Organization or individual accounts, and the template downloaded from the monitoring account can be deployed to source accounts or by StackSets for the organization ([link source accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account-Setup.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** SCPs do not grant access to CloudWatch data. AWS Organizations documentation states that an SCP “never grants permissions”; it only sets maximum available permissions, and users/roles still need IAM permissions ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). SCPs also do not create CloudWatch observability links.
- **C:** Creating an IAM user and policies is not the CloudWatch cross-account observability mechanism. The CloudWatch documentation requires linking source accounts to a monitoring account using Observability Access Manager links/sinks; IAM permissions alone do not share observability telemetry into the monitoring account ([CloudWatch cross-account observability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account.html)).
- **D:** Similarly, cross-account IAM policies for a new user do not establish CloudWatch cross-account observability links or enable centralized querying/visualization of shared metrics, logs, and traces. The documented solution is to configure a monitoring account and link source accounts, optionally with the CloudFormation template CloudWatch provides ([link monitoring accounts with source accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account-Setup.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的组织来管理包含应用程序的 AWS 账户。该公司在组织中设置了一个专用的监控成员账户。该公司希望使用 Amazon CloudWatch 跨账户查询和可视化可观测性数据。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为监控账户启用 CloudWatch 跨账户可观测性。在每个 AWS 账户中部署由监控账户提供的 AWS CloudFormation 模板，以便与监控账户共享数据。
options.B: 设置服务控制策略 (SCP)，在 Organizations 根组织单位 (OU) 下为监控账户提供对 CloudWatch 的访问权限。
options.C: 在监控账户中配置一个新的 IAM 用户。在每个 AWS 账户中，配置一个 IAM policy，使其具有查询和可视化该账户中 CloudWatch 数据的访问权限。将新的 IAM policy 附加到新的 IAM 用户。
options.D: 在监控账户中创建一个新的 IAM 用户。在每个 AWS 账户中创建跨账户 IAM policy。将这些 IAM policy 附加到新的 IAM 用户。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon CloudWatch 跨账户可观测性正是为此用例而设计的：一个中心化的 **监控账户** 可以从已链接的 **源账户** 中搜索、可视化和分析可观测性数据，包括 CloudWatch 指标和日志，而不受账户边界限制。AWS 还建议创建一个专用的监控账户，然后对其进行设置并链接源账户；之后，监控账户就可以查看源账户的可观测性数据（[CloudWatch cross-account observability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account.html)，[setup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account-Setup.html)）。设置文档说明，CloudWatch 提供了一个 CloudFormation 模板，用于链接整个 AWS Organization 或单个账户，并且从监控账户下载的模板可以部署到源账户，或通过 StackSets 部署到组织中（[link source accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account-Setup.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B:** SCP 不会授予对 CloudWatch 数据的访问权限。AWS Organizations 文档说明，SCP “绝不会授予权限”；它只设置最大可用权限，用户/角色仍然需要 IAM 权限（[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。SCP 也不会创建 CloudWatch 可观测性链接。
- **C:** 创建 IAM 用户和策略并不是 CloudWatch 跨账户可观测性机制。CloudWatch 文档要求使用 Observability Access Manager 链接/接收器将源账户链接到监控账户；仅靠 IAM 权限不会将可观测性遥测数据共享到监控账户中（[CloudWatch cross-account observability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account.html)）。
- **D:** 同样，为新用户配置跨账户 IAM policy 并不会建立 CloudWatch 跨账户可观测性链接，也不会启用对共享指标、日志和跟踪的集中查询/可视化。文档化的解决方案是配置一个监控账户并链接源账户，可选地使用 CloudWatch 提供的 CloudFormation 模板（[link monitoring accounts with source accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Unified-Cross-Account-Setup.html)）。

en.question: A company’s website is used to sell products to the public. The site runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). There is also an Amazon CloudFront distribution, and AWS WAF is being used to protect against SQL injection attacks. The ALB is the origin for the CloudFront distribution. A recent review of security logs revealed an external malicious IP that needs to be blocked from accessing the website. What should a solutions architect do to protect the application?

options.A: Modify the network ACL on the CloudFront distribution to add a deny rule for the malicious IP address.
options.B: Modify the configuration of AWS WAF to add an IP match condition to block the malicious IP address.
options.C: Modify the network ACL for the EC2 instances in the target groups behind the ALB to deny the malicious IP address.
options.D: Modify the security groups for the EC2 instances in the target groups behind the ALB to deny the malicious IP address.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

AWS WAF is already in use with the CloudFront distribution, and AWS states that WAF can protect CloudFront distributions and origin servers by **blocking requests before they reach your servers**. A WAF web ACL provides fine-grained control over HTTP(S) requests and can allow or block requests based on criteria including the **IP address origin of the request**. An IP set match statement is specifically used by choosing or creating an IP set for matching request IP addresses. Therefore, adding the malicious IP address to an AWS WAF IP set and configuring a block rule is the correct solution. [CloudFront: Use AWS WAF protections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-web-awswaf.html), [AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html), [AWS WAF IP set match rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-ipset-match.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: CloudFront distributions do not have VPC network ACLs. Network ACLs are associated with **subnets in a VPC** and allow or deny traffic at the subnet level, not at the CloudFront distribution level. [Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)
- **C**: Network ACLs are subnet-level controls, not target-group-specific controls. Although NACLs can allow or deny traffic, applying a subnet NACL behind the ALB is not the right layer when AWS WAF can block the malicious HTTP(S) request at CloudFront before it reaches the origin servers. [Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html), [CloudFront: Use AWS WAF protections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-web-awswaf.html)
- **D**: Security groups cannot be used to add a deny rule. AWS documentation states that security groups support **allow rules, but not deny rules**. [Security group rule basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)

zh.question: 一家公司的网站用于向公众销售产品。该站点运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。还有一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并且正在使用 AWS WAF 防护 SQL 注入攻击。ALB 是 CloudFront 分配的源站。最近对安全日志的审查发现了一个外部恶意 IP，需要阻止其访问该网站。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来保护该应用程序？

options.A: 修改 CloudFront 分配上的网络 ACL，添加一条针对该恶意 IP 地址的拒绝规则。
options.B: 修改 AWS WAF 的配置，添加一个 IP 匹配条件以阻止该恶意 IP 地址。
options.C: 修改 ALB 后面目标组中 EC2 实例的网络 ACL，以拒绝该恶意 IP 地址。
options.D: 修改 ALB 后面目标组中 EC2 实例的安全组，以拒绝该恶意 IP 地址。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

AWS WAF 已经与 CloudFront 分配一起使用，并且 AWS 表示 WAF 可以通过**在请求到达服务器之前阻止请求**来保护 CloudFront 分配和源服务器。WAF web ACL 可对 HTTP(S) 请求提供细粒度控制，并且可以根据包括**请求的 IP 地址来源**在内的条件允许或阻止请求。IP set match statement 专门通过选择或创建 IP set 来匹配请求 IP 地址。因此，将该恶意 IP 地址添加到 AWS WAF IP set 并配置阻止规则是正确的解决方案。[CloudFront: Use AWS WAF protections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-web-awswaf.html), [AWS WAF web ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/web-acl.html), [AWS WAF IP set match rule statement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/waf-rule-statement-type-ipset-match.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**: CloudFront distributions 没有 VPC network ACLs。Network ACLs 与 **VPC 中的子网**相关联，并在子网级别允许或拒绝流量，而不是在 CloudFront distribution 级别。[Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)
- **C**: Network ACLs 是子网级别的控制，而不是针对目标组的控制。尽管 NACLs 可以允许或拒绝流量，但当 AWS WAF 可以在恶意 HTTP(S) 请求到达源服务器之前在 CloudFront 处阻止它时，在 ALB 后面应用子网 NACL 并不是正确的层级。[Network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html), [CloudFront: Use AWS WAF protections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/distribution-web-awswaf.html)
- **D**: Security groups 不能用于添加拒绝规则。AWS 文档说明 security groups 支持**允许规则，但不支持拒绝规则**。[Security group rule basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)

en.question: A company sets up an organization in AWS Organizations that contains 10 AWS accounts. A solutions architect must design a solution to provide access to the accounts for several thousand employees. The company has an existing identity provider (IdP). The company wants to use the existing IdP for authentication to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create IAM users for the employees in the required AWS accounts. Connect IAM users to the existing IdP. Configure federated authentication for the IAM users.
options.B: Set up AWS account root users with user email addresses and passwords that are synchronized from the existing IdP.
options.C: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Connect IAM Identity Center to the existing IdP. Provision users and groups from the existing IdP.
options.D: Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share access to the AWS accounts with the users in the existing IdP.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

AWS recommends IAM Identity Center for centralized workforce access management across AWS accounts. The IAM best practices documentation says to require human users to use federation with an identity provider and, for centralized access management, to use **AWS IAM Identity Center** to manage access to accounts and permissions; it also states you can manage access permissions for identities in IAM Identity Center from an external identity provider ([AWS IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). IAM Identity Center specifically supports connecting existing workforce identities from external IdPs through SAML 2.0 and SCIM, enabling users to sign in with corporate credentials and navigate to assigned AWS accounts and roles; users and groups from an external IdP must be provisioned into IAM Identity Center before account/application assignments ([External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)). For an AWS Organizations environment, AWS recommends enabling IAM Identity Center with Organizations because an organization instance provides central management capabilities ([IAM Identity Center and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-and-orgs.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Creating IAM users for several thousand employees across required accounts is not the recommended centralized federation model. AWS recommends federating human users with temporary credentials and using IAM Identity Center for centralized access management, not creating IAM users in each account ([AWS IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **B:** Root users are not for workforce access. AWS says to safeguard root user credentials as highly sensitive credentials, not synchronize employee passwords to root users for daily access ([AWS IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **D:** AWS RAM shares **resources** with accounts, OUs, organizations, or IAM principals; it does not provide workforce authentication or account sign-in using an external IdP. RAM resource shares grant access to specified shared resources, while account access and permissions for users are the IAM Identity Center use case ([AWS RAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中设置了一个包含 10 个 AWS 账户的组织。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案，为数千名员工提供对这些账户的访问权限。该公司已有现有的身份提供商 (IdP)。该公司希望使用现有 IdP 对 AWS 进行身份验证。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在所需的 AWS 账户中为员工创建 IAM 用户。将 IAM 用户连接到现有 IdP。为 IAM 用户配置联合身份验证。
options.B: 使用从现有 IdP 同步的用户电子邮件地址和密码设置 AWS 账户根用户。
options.C: 配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。将 IAM Identity Center 连接到现有 IdP。从现有 IdP 预置用户和组。
options.D: 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 与现有 IdP 中的用户共享对 AWS 账户的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

AWS 建议使用 IAM Identity Center 在多个 AWS 账户中集中管理员工访问。IAM 最佳实践文档指出，应要求人类用户通过身份提供商使用联合身份，并且对于集中式访问管理，应使用 **AWS IAM Identity Center** 来管理对账户和权限的访问；该文档还说明，你可以从外部身份提供商管理 IAM Identity Center 中身份的访问权限（[AWS IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。IAM Identity Center 专门支持通过 SAML 2.0 和 SCIM 连接来自外部 IdP 的现有员工身份，使用户能够使用公司凭证登录并导航到已分配的 AWS 账户和角色；来自外部 IdP 的用户和组必须先预置到 IAM Identity Center 中，然后才能进行账户/应用程序分配（[External identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)）。对于 AWS Organizations 环境，AWS 建议将 IAM Identity Center 与 Organizations 一起启用，因为组织实例提供集中管理功能（[IAM Identity Center and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-and-orgs.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 在所需账户中为数千名员工创建 IAM 用户并不是推荐的集中式联合身份模型。AWS 建议使用临时凭证对人类用户进行联合身份验证，并使用 IAM Identity Center 进行集中式访问管理，而不是在每个账户中创建 IAM 用户（[AWS IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **B:** 根用户不适用于员工访问。AWS 表示应将根用户凭证作为高度敏感凭证进行保护，而不是将员工密码同步到根用户用于日常访问（[AWS IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **D:** AWS RAM 与账户、OUs、组织或 IAM 主体共享**资源**；它不提供使用外部 IdP 进行员工身份验证或账户登录的功能。RAM 资源共享会授予对指定共享资源的访问权限，而用户的账户访问和权限是 IAM Identity Center 的使用场景（[AWS RAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing an AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) authorization model for a company's AWS account. The company has designated five specific employees to have full access to AWS services and resources in the AWS account. The solutions architect has created an IAM user for each of the five designated employees and has created an IAM user group. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Attach the AdministratorAccess resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.B: Attach the SystemAdministrator identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.C: Attach the AdministratorAccess identity-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.
options.D: Attach the SystemAdministrator resource-based policy to the IAM user group. Place each of the five designated employee IAM users in the IAM user group.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C**.

AWS states that **identity-based policies are attached to an IAM user, group, or role** and define what that identity can do. In contrast, **resource-based policies are attached to a resource**, not to an IAM user group ([IAM identity-based vs. resource-based policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_identity-vs-resource.html)). Because the solutions architect has created an IAM user group and wants the five users in that group to receive permissions, the policy must be an identity-based policy attached to the group.

`AdministratorAccess` is the AWS managed policy that **“provides full access to AWS services and resources”** and AWS says it can be attached to **users, groups, and roles**. Its policy document allows `"Action": "*"` on `"Resource": "*"` ([AdministratorAccess](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AdministratorAccess.html)). Therefore, attaching the `AdministratorAccess` identity-based policy to the IAM user group and adding the five IAM users to that group meets the requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Incorrect because `AdministratorAccess` should be attached as an **identity-based** managed policy to the IAM group, not as a resource-based policy. Resource-based policies are attached to resources.
- **B**: Incorrect because `SystemAdministrator` is not full access to all AWS services and resources. AWS describes it as granting full access permissions necessary for application and development operations, and its JSON policy lists specific allowed actions rather than `Action: "*"` on all resources ([SystemAdministrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/SystemAdministrator.html)).
- **D**: Incorrect for both reasons: `SystemAdministrator` is not full administrator access, and resource-based policies are not attached to IAM user groups.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为公司的 AWS 账户设计 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 授权模型。公司指定了五名特定员工，使其对该 AWS 账户中的 AWS 服务和资源拥有完全访问权限。解决方案架构师已为这五名指定员工分别创建了一个 IAM 用户，并创建了一个 IAM 用户组。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AdministratorAccess 基于资源的策略附加到 IAM 用户组。将这五名指定员工的 IAM 用户分别放入该 IAM 用户组。
options.B: 将 SystemAdministrator 基于身份的策略附加到 IAM 用户组。将这五名指定员工的 IAM 用户分别放入该 IAM 用户组。
options.C: 将 AdministratorAccess 基于身份的策略附加到 IAM 用户组。将这五名指定员工的 IAM 用户分别放入该 IAM 用户组。
options.D: 将 SystemAdministrator 基于资源的策略附加到 IAM 用户组。将这五名指定员工的 IAM 用户分别放入该 IAM 用户组。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C**。

AWS 说明，**基于身份的策略附加到 IAM 用户、组或角色**，并定义该身份可以执行的操作。相比之下，**基于资源的策略附加到资源**，而不是附加到 IAM 用户组（[IAM identity-based vs. resource-based policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_identity-vs-resource.html)）。由于解决方案架构师已创建 IAM 用户组，并希望该组中的五个用户获得权限，因此该策略必须是附加到该组的基于身份的策略。

`AdministratorAccess` 是 AWS 托管策略，**“provides full access to AWS services and resources”**，并且 AWS 表示它可以附加到 **users, groups, and roles**。其策略文档允许对 `"Resource": "*"` 执行 `"Action": "*"`（[AdministratorAccess](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AdministratorAccess.html)）。因此，将 `AdministratorAccess` 基于身份的策略附加到 IAM 用户组，并将这五个 IAM 用户添加到该组，可以满足要求。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A**：错误，因为 `AdministratorAccess` 应作为**基于身份的**托管策略附加到 IAM 组，而不是作为基于资源的策略。基于资源的策略附加到资源。
- **B**：错误，因为 `SystemAdministrator` 并不是对所有 AWS 服务和资源的完全访问权限。AWS 将其描述为授予应用程序和开发运营所需的完全访问权限，并且其 JSON 策略列出的是特定允许的操作，而不是对所有资源使用 `Action: "*"`（[SystemAdministrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/SystemAdministrator.html)）。
- **D**：错误原因有两个：`SystemAdministrator` 不是完全管理员访问权限，并且基于资源的策略不会附加到 IAM 用户组。

en.question: A company has a multi-tier payment processing application that is based on virtual machines (VMs). The communication between the tiers occurs asynchronously through a third-party middleware solution that guarantees exactly-once delivery. The company needs a solution that requires the least amount of infrastructure management. The solution must guarantee exactly-once delivery for application messaging. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Lambda for the compute layers in the architecture.
options.B: Use Amazon EC2 instances for the compute layers in the architecture.
options.C: Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) as the messaging component between the compute layers.
options.D: Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues as the messaging component between the compute layers.
options.E: Use containers that are based on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) for the compute layers in the architecture.

en.explanation:
The best combination is **A and D**.

- **A. Use AWS Lambda for the compute layers** — Lambda is the lowest-management compute choice among the options. AWS states that Lambda “runs code without the need to manage servers” and that with Lambda you are responsible only for code while Lambda manages compute resources, server/OS maintenance, capacity provisioning, automatic scaling, and logging ([AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). This fits the requirement for the least infrastructure management.
- **D. Use Amazon SQS FIFO queues for messaging** — SQS FIFO queues are specifically designed for cases where duplicates cannot be tolerated. AWS documents FIFO queues as providing FIFO delivery and **exactly-once processing**, where messages are delivered once, remain unavailable until processed and deleted, and duplicates are not introduced into the queue ([Amazon SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)). This meets the exactly-once messaging requirement.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. EC2 instances** — EC2 instances are virtual servers where you have full control and can configure the OS, install updates, and install applications ([Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Instances.html)). That implies more infrastructure management than Lambda.
- **C. Amazon SNS** — SNS is a fully managed publish/subscribe messaging service, but the option does not specify SNS FIFO. AWS documentation shows exactly-once delivery for SNS only in the context of **SNS FIFO topics with subscribed SQS FIFO queues** and additional conditions; it still depends on an SQS FIFO queue consumer processing and deleting the message before visibility timeout expires ([Amazon SNS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/fifo-message-dedup.html)). The direct fit for the required exactly-once queueing component is SQS FIFO.
- **E. Amazon EKS containers** — EKS can reduce some Kubernetes management, but it still involves Kubernetes nodes and container orchestration. AWS documentation describes nodes as machines running containerized applications and shows that some EKS compute options require deploying/managing EC2 instances and securing, maintaining, and patching their operating systems ([Amazon EKS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html)). This is more infrastructure management than Lambda.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个基于虚拟机 (VMs) 的多层支付处理应用程序。各层之间通过第三方中间件解决方案进行异步通信，该方案保证 exactly-once delivery。公司需要一个需要最少基础设施管理的解决方案。该解决方案必须保证应用程序消息传递的 exactly-once delivery。哪组操作组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在架构的计算层使用 AWS Lambda。
options.B: 在架构的计算层使用 Amazon EC2 实例。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 作为计算层之间的消息传递组件。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列作为计算层之间的消息传递组件。
options.E: 在架构的计算层使用基于 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 的容器。

zh.explanation:
最佳组合是 **A 和 D**。

- **A. 在计算层使用 AWS Lambda** — 在这些选项中，Lambda 是管理工作量最低的计算选择。AWS 表示，Lambda “无需管理服务器即可运行代码”，并且使用 Lambda 时，您只负责代码，而 Lambda 管理计算资源、服务器/OS 维护、容量预置、自动扩展和日志记录 ([AWS Lambda Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html))。这符合最少基础设施管理的要求。
- **D. 使用 Amazon SQS FIFO 队列进行消息传递** — SQS FIFO 队列专为无法容忍重复的场景而设计。AWS 文档说明 FIFO 队列提供 FIFO 交付和 **exactly-once processing**，其中消息只交付一次，在处理和删除之前保持不可用，并且不会向队列中引入重复消息 ([Amazon SQS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html))。这满足 exactly-once 消息传递要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. EC2 实例** — EC2 实例是虚拟服务器，您可以完全控制并配置 OS、安装更新以及安装应用程序 ([Amazon EC2 User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Instances.html))。这意味着与 Lambda 相比需要更多的基础设施管理。
- **C. Amazon SNS** — SNS 是一种完全托管的发布/订阅消息传递服务，但该选项没有指定 SNS FIFO。AWS 文档表明，SNS 的 exactly-once delivery 仅在 **SNS FIFO topics with subscribed SQS FIFO queues** 以及其他附加条件的上下文中提供；它仍然依赖 SQS FIFO 队列消费者在可见性超时到期之前处理并删除消息 ([Amazon SNS Developer Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/fifo-message-dedup.html))。对于所需的 exactly-once 排队组件，直接匹配的是 SQS FIFO。
- **E. Amazon EKS 容器** — EKS 可以减少部分 Kubernetes 管理工作，但它仍然涉及 Kubernetes 节点和容器编排。AWS 文档将节点描述为运行容器化应用程序的机器，并显示某些 EKS 计算选项需要部署/管理 EC2 实例，并保护、维护和修补其操作系统 ([Amazon EKS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html))。这比 Lambda 需要更多的基础设施管理。

en.question: A company has a nightly batch processing routine that analyzes report files that an on-premises file system receives daily through SFTP.
