The company wants to move the solution to the AWS Cloud. The solution must be highly available and resilient. The solution also must minimize operational effort. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Amazon EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation.
options.B: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance that runs Linux and an SFTP service. Use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system for storage. Use an Auto Scaling group with the minimum number of instances and desired number of instances set to 1.
options.D: Deploy AWS Transfer for SFTP and an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. Modify the application to pull the batch files from Amazon S3 to an Amazon EC2 instance for processing. Use an EC2 instance in an Auto Scaling group with a scheduled scaling policy to run the batch operation.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Transfer Family is the best fit for receiving the daily SFTP uploads because it is a **fully managed** file transfer service that supports **SFTP** and can transfer files directly into **Amazon EFS** or Amazon S3. AWS also states that Transfer Family supports up to 3 Availability Zones and uses an auto scaling, redundant fleet for connection and transfer requests, which supports the HA/resiliency requirement ([AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). For storage, a Regional Amazon EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones and provides continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable ([EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). The nightly EC2 processing instance can mount the EFS file system, and EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled actions can run capacity on a recurring schedule for the nightly batch window ([EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)). This preserves a file-system-based workflow with minimal operational effort.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Running and maintaining an SFTP service on EC2 increases operational effort compared with managed AWS Transfer Family. Amazon EBS is also AZ-scoped: EBS volumes are replicated only within their Availability Zone and can be attached to EC2 instances in the same AZ, so this is not as resilient as Regional EFS across multiple AZs ([EBS data availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/EBSFeatures.html)).
- **C:** EFS is appropriate storage, but the SFTP endpoint is still a self-managed EC2 instance with only one desired instance. That does not minimize operational effort and is less highly available than AWS Transfer Family’s managed, redundant service.
- **D:** Transfer Family with S3 can work, but the option requires modifying the application to pull objects from S3 to EC2 for processing. Also, AWS notes that S3 can mimic a hierarchical file system but can behave differently because directories are not first-class resources ([Transfer Family storage configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/configure-storage.html)). Compared with A, this adds application changes and extra operational complexity for a workflow that is originally file-system based.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个每晚运行的批处理例程，用于分析本地文件系统每天通过 SFTP 接收的报告文件。该公司希望将该解决方案迁移到 AWS Cloud。该解决方案必须具有高可用性和弹性。该解决方案还必须最大限度地减少运维工作量。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署 AWS Transfer for SFTP 和一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统用于存储。使用 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例，并配置计划扩展策略来运行批处理操作。
options.B: 部署一个运行 Linux 和 SFTP 服务的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷用于存储。使用 Auto Scaling 组，并将最小实例数和所需实例数设置为 1。
options.C: 部署一个运行 Linux 和 SFTP 服务的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统用于存储。使用 Auto Scaling 组，并将最小实例数和所需实例数设置为 1。
options.D: 部署 AWS Transfer for SFTP 和一个 Amazon S3 存储桶用于存储。修改应用程序，使其从 Amazon S3 拉取批处理文件到 Amazon EC2 实例进行处理。使用 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例，并配置计划扩展策略来运行批处理操作。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS Transfer Family 最适合接收每日 SFTP 上传，因为它是一个**完全托管**的文件传输服务，支持 **SFTP**，并且可以将文件直接传输到 **Amazon EFS** 或 Amazon S3。AWS 还说明，Transfer Family 支持最多 3 个 Availability Zones，并使用自动扩展的冗余队列来处理连接和传输请求，这支持高可用性/弹性要求（[AWS Transfer Family overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。对于存储，Regional Amazon EFS 文件系统会跨多个 Availability Zones 冗余存储数据，并且即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用也能提供持续可用性（[EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。每晚运行的 EC2 处理实例可以挂载 EFS 文件系统，并且 EC2 Auto Scaling 计划操作可以按重复计划为夜间批处理窗口运行容量（[EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)）。这以最小的运维工作量保留了基于文件系统的工作流。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** 在 EC2 上运行和维护 SFTP 服务会比托管的 AWS Transfer Family 增加运维工作量。Amazon EBS 也限定在 AZ 范围内：EBS 卷仅在其 Availability Zone 内复制，并且只能附加到同一 AZ 中的 EC2 实例，因此它不如跨多个 AZ 的 Regional EFS 具有弹性（[EBS data availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/EBSFeatures.html)）。
- **C:** EFS 是合适的存储，但 SFTP 端点仍然是一个自管理的 EC2 实例，并且所需实例数只有一个。这不能最大限度地减少运维工作量，并且可用性不如 AWS Transfer Family 的托管冗余服务。
- **D:** 将 Transfer Family 与 S3 结合使用可以工作，但该选项要求修改应用程序，使其从 S3 拉取对象到 EC2 进行处理。此外，AWS 指出 S3 可以模拟分层文件系统，但由于目录不是一等资源，其行为可能会有所不同（[Transfer Family storage configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/configure-storage.html)）。与 A 相比，这为原本基于文件系统的工作流增加了应用程序更改和额外的运维复杂性。

en.question: A company has users all around the world accessing its HTTP-based application deployed on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. The company wants to improve the availability and performance of the application. The company also wants to protect the application against common web exploits that may affect availability, compromise security, or consume excessive resources. Static IP addresses are required. What should a solutions architect recommend to accomplish this?

options.A: Put the EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the NLBs. Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator and register the NLBs as endpoints.
options.B: Put the EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the ALBs. Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator and register the ALBs as endpoints.
options.C: Put the EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in each Region. Deploy AWS WAF on the NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the NLBs.
options.D: Put the EC2 instances behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the ALBs. Deploy AWS WAF on the CloudFront distribution.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The application is HTTP-based, so an **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** is the appropriate regional load balancer: ALB operates at OSI layer 7 and routes based on application traffic, and it can route to EC2 targets and use health checks to send traffic only to healthy targets ([ALB overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)). AWS WAF can be associated with an ALB to allow or block requests using a web ACL, and AWS documentation lists **Application Load Balancer** as a regional resource type that AWS WAF can protect ([AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)). Global Accelerator is designed to improve performance and availability for global users, supports endpoints in multiple Regions, provides static anycast IP addresses by default, and supports ALB endpoints ([What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Therefore, ALBs + AWS WAF + Global Accelerator satisfies HTTP routing, web exploit protection, multi-Region performance/availability, and static IP requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A and C:** They use **Network Load Balancers** and propose deploying AWS WAF on the NLBs. AWS WAF protected regional resource types include ALB and other Layer 7 services, but not NLB ([AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)).
- **D:** CloudFront with AWS WAF can improve web performance and block common web exploits, but the option does not explicitly provide the required static IP addresses. CloudFront static anycast IPs are a separate feature that must be requested, created, and associated with distributions ([Request Anycast static IPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/request-static-ips.html)). The option also omits Global Accelerator, which AWS specifically documents as using static IP addresses as fixed endpoints and distributing traffic across load balancers in one or more Regions for availability and performance ([ALB integrations: AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-integrations.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在多个 AWS Region 中部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上的基于 HTTP 的应用程序，全球各地的用户都在访问该应用程序。该公司希望提高应用程序的可用性和性能。该公司还希望保护应用程序免受可能影响可用性、危及安全性或消耗过多资源的常见 Web 漏洞攻击。需要静态 IP 地址。解决方案架构师应建议什么来实现这一目标？

options.A: 将 EC2 实例放在每个 Region 中的 Network Load Balancers (NLBs) 后面。在 NLBs 上部署 AWS WAF。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器，并将 NLBs 注册为端点。
options.B: 将 EC2 实例放在每个 Region 中的 Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 后面。在 ALBs 上部署 AWS WAF。使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器，并将 ALBs 注册为端点。
options.C: 将 EC2 实例放在每个 Region 中的 Network Load Balancers (NLBs) 后面。在 NLBs 上部署 AWS WAF。创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，其源站使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由将请求路由到 NLBs。
options.D: 将 EC2 实例放在每个 Region 中的 Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 后面。创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，其源站使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由将请求路由到 ALBs。在 CloudFront 分配上部署 AWS WAF。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该应用程序基于 HTTP，因此 **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** 是合适的区域负载均衡器：ALB 在 OSI 第 7 层运行，并基于应用程序流量进行路由，而且它可以路由到 EC2 目标，并使用运行状况检查仅将流量发送到运行状况良好的目标（[ALB overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。AWS WAF 可以与 ALB 关联，以使用 Web ACL 允许或阻止请求，并且 AWS 文档将 **Application Load Balancer** 列为 AWS WAF 可以保护的一种区域资源类型（[AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。Global Accelerator 旨在为全球用户提高性能和可用性，支持多个 Regions 中的端点，默认提供静态任播 IP 地址，并支持 ALB 端点（[What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。因此，ALBs + AWS WAF + Global Accelerator 满足 HTTP 路由、Web 漏洞攻击防护、多 Region 性能/可用性以及静态 IP 要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A and C:** 它们使用 **Network Load Balancers**，并建议在 NLBs 上部署 AWS WAF。AWS WAF 受保护的区域资源类型包括 ALB 和其他第 7 层服务，但不包括 NLB（[AWS WAF protected resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。
- **D:** CloudFront 与 AWS WAF 可以提升 Web 性能并阻止常见 Web 漏洞攻击，但该选项没有明确提供所需的静态 IP 地址。CloudFront 静态任播 IP 是一项单独的功能，必须请求、创建并与分配关联（[Request Anycast static IPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/request-static-ips.html)）。该选项还省略了 Global Accelerator，而 AWS 明确在文档中说明 Global Accelerator 使用静态 IP 地址作为固定端点，并在一个或多个 Regions 中跨负载均衡器分配流量以实现可用性和性能（[ALB integrations: AWS Global Accelerator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-integrations.html)）。

en.question: A company’s data platform uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The database has multiple read replicas and multiple DB instances across different Availability Zones. Users have recently reported errors from the database that indicate that there are too many connections. The company wants to reduce the failover time by 20% when a read replica is promoted to primary writer. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Switch from Aurora to Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ cluster deployment.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS Proxy in front of the Aurora database.
options.C: Switch to Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for read connections.
options.D: Switch to Amazon Redshift with relocation capability.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use Amazon RDS Proxy in front of the Aurora database.**

Amazon RDS Proxy directly addresses both symptoms in the question. For Aurora, RDS Proxy lets applications **pool and share database connections**, handles traffic surges that could otherwise oversubscribe connections, and reuses pooled connections instead of opening a new database connection each time. It also improves resilience by automatically connecting to a standby DB instance while **preserving application connections** during database failures ([Amazon RDS Proxy for Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.html)). The connection settings also support limiting database connections and reserving capacity for **fast failover, traffic routing, and internal operations** ([RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Switch from Aurora to Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ cluster deployment** — The existing Aurora cluster already has multiple DB instances across AZs and Aurora Replicas. Aurora Replicas can scale reads and can be promoted automatically as the new writer if the writer becomes unavailable ([Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)). Switching away from Aurora does not solve the “too many connections” problem as directly as RDS Proxy.
- **C. Switch to Amazon DynamoDB with DAX** — DAX is an in-memory accelerator for DynamoDB read workloads, not a connection-pooling or failover solution for an Aurora MySQL database ([DAX](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)).
- **D. Switch to Amazon Redshift with relocation capability** — Amazon Redshift relocation is for moving a Redshift cluster across Availability Zones, not for reducing Aurora MySQL connection pressure or Aurora writer failover time ([Relocating a cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/managing-cluster-recovery.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的数据平台使用 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库。该数据库具有多个只读副本，并且在不同 Availability Zones 中有多个 DB 实例。用户最近报告了来自数据库的错误，表明连接数过多。公司希望在只读副本提升为主写入实例时，将故障转移时间减少 20%。哪种解决方案将满足此要求？

options.A: 从 Aurora 切换到采用 Multi-AZ 集群部署的 Amazon RDS。
options.B: 在 Aurora 数据库前使用 Amazon RDS Proxy。
options.C: 切换到 Amazon DynamoDB，并使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 处理读取连接。
options.D: 切换到具有重定位功能的 Amazon Redshift。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 在 Aurora 数据库前使用 Amazon RDS Proxy。**

Amazon RDS Proxy 直接解决了题目中的两个症状。对于 Aurora，RDS Proxy 使应用程序能够**池化并共享数据库连接**，处理可能导致连接数超额的流量激增，并重用池化连接，而不是每次都打开新的数据库连接。它还通过在数据库故障期间自动连接到备用 DB 实例并**保留应用程序连接**来提高弹性（[Amazon RDS Proxy for Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.html)）。连接设置还支持限制数据库连接，并为**快速故障转移、流量路由和内部操作**预留容量（[RDS Proxy connection considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. 从 Aurora 切换到采用 Multi-AZ 集群部署的 Amazon RDS** — 现有 Aurora 集群已经在多个 AZ 中拥有多个 DB 实例和 Aurora Replicas。Aurora Replicas 可以扩展读取，并且在写入实例不可用时可以自动提升为新的写入实例（[Aurora Replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。与 RDS Proxy 相比，切换离开 Aurora 并不能同样直接地解决“连接数过多”问题。
- **C. 切换到 Amazon DynamoDB，并使用 DAX** — DAX 是用于 DynamoDB 读取工作负载的内存加速器，而不是针对 Aurora MySQL 数据库的连接池化或故障转移解决方案（[DAX](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。
- **D. 切换到具有重定位功能的 Amazon Redshift** — Amazon Redshift 重定位用于在 Availability Zones 之间移动 Redshift 集群，而不是用于降低 Aurora MySQL 连接压力或缩短 Aurora 写入实例故障转移时间（[Relocating a cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/managing-cluster-recovery.html)）。

en.question: A company stores text files in Amazon S3. The text files include customer chat messages, date and time information, and customer personally identifiable information (PII). The company needs a solution to provide samples of the conversations to an external service provider for quality control. The external service provider needs to randomly pick sample conversations up to the most recent conversation. The company must not share the customer PII with the external service provider. The solution must scale when the number of customer conversations increases. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Object Lambda Access Point. Create an AWS Lambda function that redacts the PII when the function reads the file. Instruct the external service provider to access the Object Lambda Access Point.
options.B: Create a batch process on an Amazon EC2 instance that regularly reads all new files, redacts the PII from the files, and writes the redacted files to a different S3 bucket. Instruct the external service provider to access the bucket that does not contain the PII.
options.C: Create a web application on an Amazon EC2 instance that presents a list of the files, redacts the PII from the files, and allows the external service provider to download new versions of the files that have the PII redacted.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create an AWS Lambda function that reads only the data in the files that does not contain PII. Configure the Lambda function to store the non-PII data in the DynamoDB table when a new file is written to Amazon S3. Grant the external service provider access to the DynamoDB table.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** S3 Object Lambda is designed for this pattern: an Object Lambda Access Point can invoke a Lambda function directly from an S3 `GetObject` request so the function can process data retrieved from S3, including redacting PII, before returning it to the requester. AWS specifically documents that S3 Object Lambda invokes the Lambda function to redact PII and returns the transformed/redacted data as the response to the standard S3 `GetObject` call ([S3 PII redaction tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/tutorial-s3-object-lambda-redact-pii.html)). Lambda also automatically scales execution environments as request volume increases, which supports scaling with more conversation retrieval requests ([Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)). This avoids maintaining separate compute hosts, duplicate redacted datasets, or a custom download application.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A recurring EC2 batch process requires server management, scheduling, monitoring, and a second S3 bucket of derived files. It can work, but it has more operational overhead and may lag behind the most recent conversation.
- **C:** A custom EC2-hosted web application adds even more operational overhead: instance maintenance, application development, scaling, and availability management. S3 Object Lambda can instead be used directly with existing S3 retrieval semantics; AWS notes applications can retrieve transformed data from the S3 Object Lambda Access Point ([S3 Object Lambda transform tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/tutorial-s3-object-lambda-uppercase.html)).
- **D:** Copying selected non-PII data into DynamoDB changes the data model and requires ingestion logic for every new object. It does not naturally provide the original conversation samples as redacted S3 objects and adds unnecessary storage and pipeline management.

zh.question: 一家公司将文本文件存储在 Amazon S3 中。这些文本文件包含客户聊天消息、日期和时间信息以及客户个人身份信息 (PII)。该公司需要一种解决方案，用于向外部服务提供商提供对话样本以进行质量控制。外部服务提供商需要随机选择样本对话，范围一直到最新的对话。公司不得与外部服务提供商共享客户 PII。当客户对话数量增加时，该解决方案必须能够扩展。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Object Lambda Access Point。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在该函数读取文件时对 PII 进行编辑遮蔽。指示外部服务提供商访问该 Object Lambda Access Point。
options.B: 在 Amazon EC2 实例上创建一个批处理流程，定期读取所有新文件，从文件中编辑遮蔽 PII，并将编辑遮蔽后的文件写入另一个 S3 存储桶。指示外部服务提供商访问不包含 PII 的存储桶。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 实例上创建一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序显示文件列表，从文件中编辑遮蔽 PII，并允许外部服务提供商下载已编辑遮蔽 PII 的新版本文件。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数仅读取文件中不包含 PII 的数据。配置该 Lambda 函数，以便在新文件写入 Amazon S3 时将非 PII 数据存储到 DynamoDB 表中。授予外部服务提供商访问 DynamoDB 表的权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** S3 Object Lambda 专为这种模式而设计：Object Lambda Access Point 可以直接从 S3 `GetObject` 请求调用 Lambda 函数，因此该函数可以处理从 S3 检索的数据，包括在将其返回给请求者之前编辑遮蔽 PII。AWS 明确记录了 S3 Object Lambda 会调用 Lambda 函数来编辑遮蔽 PII，并将转换/编辑遮蔽后的数据作为标准 S3 `GetObject` 调用的响应返回（[S3 PII redaction tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/tutorial-s3-object-lambda-redact-pii.html)）。Lambda 还会随着请求量增加自动扩展执行环境，这支持随着更多对话检索请求而进行扩展（[Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)）。这避免了维护单独的计算主机、重复的编辑遮蔽数据集或自定义下载应用程序。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 定期运行的 EC2 批处理流程需要服务器管理、调度、监控以及存放派生文件的第二个 S3 存储桶。它可以工作，但运营开销更高，并且可能落后于最新的对话。
- **C:** 自定义 EC2 托管的 Web 应用程序会增加更多运营开销：实例维护、应用程序开发、扩展和可用性管理。相反，可以直接将 S3 Object Lambda 与现有 S3 检索语义一起使用；AWS 指出，应用程序可以从 S3 Object Lambda Access Point 检索转换后的数据（[S3 Object Lambda transform tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/tutorial-s3-object-lambda-uppercase.html)）。
- **D:** 将选定的非 PII 数据复制到 DynamoDB 会改变数据模型，并且需要为每个新对象提供摄取逻辑。它无法自然地以经过编辑遮蔽的 S3 对象形式提供原始对话样本，并且增加了不必要的存储和管道管理。

en.question: A company is running a legacy system on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application code cannot be modified, and the system cannot run on more than one instance. A solutions architect must design a resilient solution that can improve the recovery time for the system. What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable termination protection for the EC2 instance.
options.B: Configure the EC2 instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to recover the EC2 instance in case of failure.
options.D: Launch the EC2 instance with two Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes that use RAID configurations for storage redundancy.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to recover the EC2 instance in case of failure.**

AWS documents that CloudWatch action-based recovery is designed to restore EC2 instance availability when AWS detects an underlying hardware or software issue that causes a system status check failure. It can automatically restore availability by moving the instance from the affected host to a different host, and it works by creating a CloudWatch alarm on the `StatusCheckFailed_System` metric with a recover action. AWS also notes this provides faster recovery attempts with to-the-minute recovery response granularity ([EC2 CloudWatch action based recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/cloudwatch-recovery.html)). This fits the constraints: the legacy application cannot be modified and cannot run on more than one instance, so recovering the same individual instance is the most appropriate way to improve RTO.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Enable termination protection** — Termination protection only prevents accidental termination through the EC2 API/console. It does not recover the instance from hardware/software failure, and AWS states it does not prevent all termination scenarios such as AWS scheduled termination events ([termination protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Using_ChangingDisableAPITermination.html)).
- **B. Configure the EC2 instance for Multi-AZ deployment** — Multi-AZ resilience for EC2 generally requires distributing instances across multiple Availability Zones so another instance can handle requests if one fails. AWS describes this as launching/distributing EC2 instances across multiple AZs ([Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-regions-availability-zones.html)). The requirement says the system cannot run on more than one instance.
- **D. Use two EBS volumes with RAID** — EBS RAID is a storage configuration, not an EC2 instance recovery mechanism. AWS notes RAID 0 is for performance and loss of one volume causes complete data loss, while RAID 1 is not recommended for EBS and provides no write performance improvement ([EBS RAID configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/raid-config.html)). RAID does not address recovery of a failed EC2 host or improve instance recovery time.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个遗留系统。应用程序代码无法修改，并且该系统不能在多个实例上运行。解决方案架构师必须设计一个具有弹性的解决方案，以缩短该系统的恢复时间。解决方案架构师应推荐什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该 EC2 实例启用终止保护。
options.B: 将该 EC2 实例配置为 Multi-AZ 部署。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，以便在发生故障时恢复该 EC2 实例。
options.D: 使用两个采用 RAID 配置以实现存储冗余的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷来启动该 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to recover the EC2 instance in case of failure.**

AWS 文档说明，基于 CloudWatch 操作的恢复旨在当 AWS 检测到底层硬件或软件问题导致系统状态检查失败时，恢复 EC2 实例可用性。它可以通过将实例从受影响的主机移动到其他主机来自动恢复可用性，并且它通过在 `StatusCheckFailed_System` 指标上创建带有 recover 操作的 CloudWatch 警报来工作。AWS 还指出，这可以提供更快的恢复尝试，并具有精确到分钟的恢复响应粒度（[EC2 CloudWatch action based recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/cloudwatch-recovery.html)）。这符合约束条件：遗留应用程序无法修改，并且不能在多个实例上运行，因此恢复同一个单独实例是改善 RTO 的最合适方式。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Enable termination protection** — 终止保护只会防止通过 EC2 API/控制台意外终止实例。它不会从硬件/软件故障中恢复实例，并且 AWS 声明它不能阻止所有终止场景，例如 AWS 计划的终止事件（[termination protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Using_ChangingDisableAPITermination.html)）。
- **B. Configure the EC2 instance for Multi-AZ deployment** — EC2 的 Multi-AZ 弹性通常需要将实例分布在多个 Availability Zones 中，以便当一个实例发生故障时，另一个实例可以处理请求。AWS 将其描述为在多个 AZ 中启动/分布 EC2 实例（[Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-regions-availability-zones.html)）。要求说明该系统不能在多个实例上运行。
- **D. Use two EBS volumes with RAID** — EBS RAID 是一种存储配置，而不是 EC2 实例恢复机制。AWS 指出 RAID 0 用于性能，一个卷丢失会导致数据完全丢失，而 RAID 1 不建议用于 EBS，并且不会带来写入性能提升（[EBS RAID configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/raid-config.html)）。RAID 无法解决 EC2 主机故障后的恢复问题，也无法缩短实例恢复时间。

en.question: A company wants to deploy its containerized application workloads to a VPC across three Availability Zones. The company needs a solution that is highly available across Availability Zones. The solution must require minimal changes to the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3. Set the task placement strategy type to spread with an Availability Zone attribute.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) self-managed nodes. Configure Application Auto Scaling to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Launch three EC2 instances in a spread placement group. Configure an Auto Scaling group to use target tracking scaling. Set the minimum capacity to 3.
options.D: Use an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to connect to a VPC. Configure Application Auto Scaling to use Lambda as a scalable target. Set the minimum capacity to 3.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

Amazon ECS is the best fit for an existing **containerized** workload with the least operational overhead. ECS Service Auto Scaling supports target tracking; AWS states that target tracking is the easiest ECS scaling mode because you set a target metric value and the auto scaler manages the number of tasks needed to meet it. ECS also honors a configured minimum capacity, scaling desired task count up to the minimum when needed. For multi-AZ availability, ECS task placement supports `type: spread` with `field: attribute:ecs.availability-zone`, which distributes tasks evenly across Availability Zones. Setting the minimum capacity to 3 and spreading by Availability Zone meets the three-AZ HA requirement with minimal application changes. [ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html), [ECS task placement examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/strategy-examples.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** EKS can run containers, but **self-managed nodes** add operational overhead. AWS notes that self-managed nodes require “a lot more manual maintenance,” and EKS compute options show responsibilities such as managing EC2 instances and patching/maintaining operating systems. This is not the least operational overhead. [EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html)
- **C:** EC2 instances in a spread placement group can improve hardware failure isolation, but this is an infrastructure-level approach, not a managed container orchestration solution. It requires managing EC2 instances and container deployment yourself. Also, spread placement groups are intended for a small number of critical instances and have limits such as a maximum of seven running instances per AZ per group. [EC2 spread placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)
- **D:** Lambda automatically scales execution environments as requests increase, but this option would require changing the workload to the Lambda execution model rather than simply running the existing containerized application as tasks. The described “Application Auto Scaling with Lambda as a scalable target” and minimum capacity of 3 is not the ECS-style task scaling model required here. [Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其容器化应用程序工作负载部署到跨三个可用区的 VPC 中。该公司需要一个跨可用区高度可用的解决方案。该解决方案必须尽量减少对应用程序的更改。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。配置 Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling 使用目标跟踪扩展。将最小容量设置为 3。将任务放置策略类型设置为 spread，并使用可用区属性。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 自管理节点。配置 Application Auto Scaling 使用目标跟踪扩展。将最小容量设置为 3。
options.C: 使用 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances。在 spread placement group 中启动三个 EC2 实例。配置 Auto Scaling group 使用目标跟踪扩展。将最小容量设置为 3。
options.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数连接到 VPC。配置 Application Auto Scaling 使用 Lambda 作为可扩展目标。将最小容量设置为 3。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

Amazon ECS 最适合现有的**容器化**工作负载，并且运营开销最低。ECS Service Auto Scaling 支持目标跟踪；AWS 表示，目标跟踪是最简单的 ECS 扩展模式，因为你只需设置目标指标值，自动扩展器会管理满足该目标所需的任务数量。ECS 还会遵循配置的最小容量，在需要时将期望任务数扩展到该最小值。对于多可用区可用性，ECS 任务放置支持使用 `field: attribute:ecs.availability-zone` 的 `type: spread`，这会在各可用区之间均匀分布任务。将最小容量设置为 3，并按可用区进行分散放置，可以以最少的应用程序更改满足三个可用区的高可用要求。[ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html), [ECS task placement examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/strategy-examples.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** EKS 可以运行容器，但**自管理节点**会增加运营开销。AWS 指出，自管理节点需要“大量更多的手动维护”，并且 EKS 计算选项显示了诸如管理 EC2 实例以及修补/维护操作系统等职责。这不是运营开销最少的方案。[EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html)
- **C:** spread placement group 中的 EC2 实例可以改善硬件故障隔离，但这是一种基础设施级方法，而不是托管的容器编排解决方案。它需要你自行管理 EC2 实例和容器部署。此外，spread placement groups 适用于少量关键实例，并且有限制，例如每个 AZ 每个组最多七个正在运行的实例。[EC2 spread placement groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)
- **D:** Lambda 会随着请求增加自动扩展执行环境，但此选项需要将工作负载更改为 Lambda 执行模型，而不是简单地将现有容器化应用程序作为任务运行。所描述的“Application Auto Scaling with Lambda as a scalable target”和最小容量 3 不是此处所需的 ECS 风格任务扩展模型。[Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)

en.question: A media company stores movies in Amazon S3. Each movie is stored in a single video file that ranges from 1 GB to 10 GB in size. The company must be able to provide the streaming content of a movie within 5 minutes of a user purchase. There is higher demand for movies that are less than 20 years old than for movies that are more than 20 years old. The company wants to minimize hosting service costs based on demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store all media content in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move media data into the Infrequent Access tier when the demand for a movie decreases.
options.B: Store newer movie video files in S3 Standard. Store older movie video files in S3 Standard- infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using standard retrieval.
options.C: Store newer movie video files in S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Store older movie video files in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using expedited retrieval.
options.D: Store newer movie video files in S3 Standard. Store older movie video files in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. When a user orders an older movie, retrieve the video file by using bulk retrieval.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Newer movies have higher demand, so S3 Standard is appropriate for frequently accessed, performance-sensitive data with millisecond access. Older movies are still purchasable and must be streamable within 5 minutes; S3 Standard-IA is designed for long-lived, infrequently accessed data and provides millisecond access similar to S3 Standard, with lower storage cost and a retrieval fee. AWS explicitly gives “older data that is accessed infrequently, but that still requires millisecond access” as a use case for S3 Standard-IA ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Lifecycle transitions to an IA class can be useful, but this option is less directly aligned with the stated, known demand pattern: newer movies are higher demand and older movies are lower demand. The best solution explicitly places newer content in S3 Standard and older content in S3 Standard-IA.
- **C:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering is ideal for data with unknown, changing, or unpredictable access patterns, but the access pattern is known by movie age. Also, S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is archival and not available for real-time access; expedited retrieval typically takes 1–5 minutes but is subject to demand unless provisioned capacity is purchased ([S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html), [archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)).
- **D:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval bulk retrieval typically restores objects within 5–12 hours, which does not meet the requirement to provide streaming content within 5 minutes ([S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

zh.question: 一家媒体公司将电影存储在 Amazon S3 中。每部电影都存储在一个大小为 1 GB 到 10 GB 的单个视频文件中。公司必须能够在用户购买后的 5 分钟内提供电影的流媒体内容。与 20 年以上的电影相比，20 年以内的电影需求更高。公司希望根据需求尽量降低托管服务成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有媒体内容存储在 Amazon S3 中。当某部电影的需求下降时，使用 S3 Lifecycle 策略将媒体数据移动到 Infrequent Access 层。
options.B: 将较新的电影视频文件存储在 S3 Standard 中。将较旧的电影视频文件存储在 S3 Standard- infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 中。当用户订购较旧电影时，使用标准检索来检索视频文件。
options.C: 将较新的电影视频文件存储在 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中。将较旧的电影视频文件存储在 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 中。当用户订购较旧电影时，使用加急检索来检索视频文件。
options.D: 将较新的电影视频文件存储在 S3 Standard 中。将较旧的电影视频文件存储在 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 中。当用户订购较旧电影时，使用批量检索来检索视频文件。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 较新的电影需求更高，因此 S3 Standard 适用于频繁访问、对性能敏感且需要毫秒级访问的数据。较旧的电影仍可购买，并且必须在 5 分钟内可进行流式播放；S3 Standard-IA 专为长期保存、访问频率较低的数据而设计，并提供类似于 S3 Standard 的毫秒级访问，同时存储成本更低但收取检索费用。AWS 明确将“访问频率较低但仍需要毫秒级访问的较旧数据”作为 S3 Standard-IA 的用例（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** Lifecycle 转换到 IA 类可能有用，但此选项与题目中已知的既定需求模式不够直接匹配：较新的电影需求更高，较旧的电影需求更低。最佳解决方案会明确将较新的内容放在 S3 Standard 中，将较旧的内容放在 S3 Standard-IA 中。
- **C:** S3 Intelligent-Tiering 非常适合访问模式未知、变化或不可预测的数据，但此处访问模式按电影年龄已知。此外，S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 是归档型存储，不能用于实时访问；加急检索通常需要 1–5 分钟，但会受需求影响，除非购买了预置容量（[S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html), [archive retrieval options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/restoring-objects-retrieval-options.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 批量检索通常会在 5–12 小时内还原对象，这不满足在 5 分钟内提供流媒体内容的要求（[S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to design the architecture for an application that a vendor provides as a Docker container image. The container needs 50 GB of storage available for temporary files. The infrastructure must be serverless. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Docker container image with an Amazon S3 mounted volume that has more than 50 GB of space.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Docker container image with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has more than 50 GB of space.
options.C: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type. Create a task definition for the container image with an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Create a service with that task definition.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that uses the Amazon EC2 launch type with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume that has more than 50 GB of space. Create a task definition for the container image. Create a service with that task definition.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate is the best fit because it runs containers **without managing servers or clusters of Amazon EC2 instances**; AWS states that with Fargate you do not need to provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines to run containers ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). ECS task definitions for Fargate support task storage options including **Amazon EFS volumes for persistent storage** ([Fargate task storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-tasks-services.html)), and ECS documentation shows that an EFS file system volume and container mount point can be specified directly in the task definition ([Specify an Amazon EFS file system in an Amazon ECS task definition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specify-efs-config.html)). This provides the required container-based, serverless infrastructure with storage well beyond 50 GB and low operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Lambda can use container images, but Lambda container images must run with a read-only file system and only a writable `/tmp` directory of **512 MB to 10,240 MB** ([Lambda container image requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)). Lambda ephemeral storage is also limited to **10,240 MB**, far below 50 GB ([Lambda ephemeral storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)). An “Amazon S3 mounted volume” is not the appropriate native Lambda solution for this requirement.
- **B:** Lambda does not meet the 50 GB temporary storage requirement because its writable `/tmp` storage is limited to 10,240 MB ([Lambda ephemeral storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)). Also, the documented Lambda file system option for mounted file storage is not EBS.
- **D:** ECS with the EC2 launch type requires Amazon EC2 capacity and EBS volume management. The requirement says the infrastructure must be serverless and have the least operational overhead; Fargate specifically avoids managing EC2 instances and clusters ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要为一个应用程序设计架构，该应用程序由供应商以 Docker 容器映像的形式提供。该容器需要 50 GB 的存储空间用于临时文件。基础设施必须是无服务器的。哪种解决方案以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用 Docker 容器映像，并挂载一个具有超过 50 GB 空间的 Amazon S3 卷。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数使用 Docker 容器映像，并挂载一个具有超过 50 GB 空间的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。
options.C: 创建一个使用 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。为该容器映像创建一个带有 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 卷的任务定义。使用该任务定义创建一个服务。
options.D: 创建一个使用 Amazon EC2 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群，并使用一个具有超过 50 GB 空间的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。为该容器映像创建一个任务定义。使用该任务定义创建一个服务。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon ECS 最适合，因为它运行容器时**无需管理服务器或 Amazon EC2 instances 集群**；AWS 说明，使用 Fargate 时，你无需预置、配置或扩展虚拟机集群来运行容器（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。适用于 Fargate 的 ECS 任务定义支持任务存储选项，包括用于持久存储的 **Amazon EFS volumes**（[Fargate task storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-tasks-services.html)），并且 ECS 文档显示，可以直接在任务定义中指定 EFS 文件系统卷和容器挂载点（[Specify an Amazon EFS file system in an Amazon ECS task definition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/specify-efs-config.html)）。这提供了所需的基于容器的无服务器基础设施，存储容量远超 50 GB，并且运营开销低。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Lambda 可以使用容器映像，但 Lambda 容器映像必须在只读文件系统中运行，并且只有一个可写的 `/tmp` 目录，大小为 **512 MB 到 10,240 MB**（[Lambda container image requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)）。Lambda 临时存储也限制为 **10,240 MB**，远低于 50 GB（[Lambda ephemeral storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)）。对于此要求，“Amazon S3 mounted volume” 不是合适的原生 Lambda 解决方案。
- **B:** Lambda 不满足 50 GB 临时存储要求，因为其可写的 `/tmp` 存储限制为 10,240 MB（[Lambda ephemeral storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)）。此外，文档中用于挂载文件存储的 Lambda 文件系统选项不是 EBS。
- **D:** 使用 EC2 启动类型的 ECS 需要 Amazon EC2 容量和 EBS 卷管理。要求说明基础设施必须是无服务器的，并且运营开销最少；Fargate 专门避免管理 EC2 instances 和集群（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to use its on-premises LDAP directory service to authenticate its users to the AWS Management Console. The directory service is not compatible with Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML). Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) between AWS and the on-premises LDAP.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that uses AWS credentials, and integrate the policy into LDAP.
options.C: Set up a process that rotates the IAM credentials whenever LDAP credentials are updated.
options.D: Develop an on-premises custom identity broker application or process that uses AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to get short-lived credentials.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

AWS explicitly documents this exact pattern: if an identity store is **not compatible with SAML 2.0**, you can build a **custom identity broker application**. The broker authenticates users against the existing corporate identity system, which AWS notes might use **LDAP**, then requests **temporary security credentials** from AWS and can provide users a temporary URL for AWS Management Console access. The broker calls AWS STS APIs such as `AssumeRole` or `GetFederationToken` to obtain the temporary credentials ([AWS IAM identity federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_federated-users.html); [requesting temporary credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_request.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. IAM Identity Center with on-premises LDAP**: IAM Identity Center external IdP integration uses **SAML 2.0** and SCIM protocols for existing workforce identities. The question states that the LDAP directory is **not SAML-compatible**, so this does not meet the requirement ([IAM Identity Center external IdPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)).
- **B. Create an IAM policy that uses AWS credentials, and integrate the policy into LDAP**: IAM policies define AWS permissions; they do not authenticate LDAP users or integrate AWS credentials into LDAP for console sign-in. The documented federation approach for non-SAML identity stores is a custom broker that obtains temporary credentials from AWS STS, not embedding IAM policies in LDAP ([AWS IAM identity federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_federated-users.html)).
- **C. Rotate IAM credentials whenever LDAP credentials are updated**: This would require long-term IAM credentials for users and does not provide federated authentication to the console. AWS documentation recommends the broker approach with **temporary** STS credentials that expire and are renewed as needed ([requesting temporary credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_request.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要使用其本地 LDAP 目录服务来对用户登录 AWS Management Console 进行身份验证。该目录服务与 Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) 不兼容。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS 与本地 LDAP 之间启用 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。
options.B: 创建一个使用 AWS 凭证的 IAM policy，并将该策略集成到 LDAP 中。
options.C: 设置一个流程，在 LDAP 凭证更新时轮换 IAM 凭证。
options.D: 开发一个本地自定义身份代理应用程序或流程，使用 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 获取短期凭证。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.**

AWS 明确记录了这种确切模式：如果身份存储与 **SAML 2.0** **不兼容**，你可以构建一个**自定义身份代理应用程序**。该代理会根据现有的企业身份系统对用户进行身份验证，AWS 指出该系统可能使用 **LDAP**，然后从 AWS 请求**临时安全凭证**，并可以为用户提供用于访问 AWS Management Console 的临时 URL。该代理调用 AWS STS API，例如 `AssumeRole` 或 `GetFederationToken`，以获取临时凭证（[AWS IAM identity federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_federated-users.html)；[requesting temporary credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_request.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. IAM Identity Center with on-premises LDAP**：IAM Identity Center 外部 IdP 集成使用 **SAML 2.0** 和 SCIM 协议来处理现有员工身份。题目说明 LDAP 目录**不兼容 SAML**，因此这不满足要求（[IAM Identity Center external IdPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html)）。
- **B. Create an IAM policy that uses AWS credentials, and integrate the policy into LDAP**：IAM policies 定义 AWS 权限；它们不会对 LDAP 用户进行身份验证，也不会将 AWS 凭证集成到 LDAP 中用于控制台登录。针对非 SAML 身份存储的文档化联合身份方法是使用自定义代理从 AWS STS 获取临时凭证，而不是将 IAM policies 嵌入 LDAP（[AWS IAM identity federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_federated-users.html)）。
- **C. Rotate IAM credentials whenever LDAP credentials are updated**：这将需要为用户提供长期 IAM 凭证，并且无法为控制台提供联合身份验证。AWS 文档建议采用代理方法，使用会过期并可按需续期的**临时** STS 凭证（[requesting temporary credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_request.html)）。

en.question: A company stores multiple Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) in an AWS account to launch its Amazon EC2 instances. The AMIs contain critical data and configurations that are necessary for the company’s operations. The company wants to implement a solution that will recover accidentally deleted AMIs quickly and efficiently. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots of the AMIs. Store the snapshots in a separate AWS account.
options.B: Copy all AMIs to another AWS account periodically.
options.C: Create a retention rule in Recycle Bin.
options.D: Upload the AMIs to an Amazon S3 bucket that has Cross-Region Replication.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Create a retention rule in Recycle Bin.**

AWS Recycle Bin is specifically designed to recover accidentally deleted **EBS-backed AMIs**: AWS states that Recycle Bin lets you restore accidentally deleted EBS volumes, EBS snapshots, and **EBS-backed AMIs**, retaining matching deleted resources for a specified period before permanent deletion. It also says you can restore a resource any time before the retention period expires, helping protect business-critical data against accidental deletion ([Recycle Bin overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)). A retention rule can be created for the AMI resource type, with supported retention periods for EBS-backed AMIs from 1 to 365 days ([Create a Recycle Bin retention rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-create-rule.html)). When an AMI is restored from Recycle Bin, it is immediately available for use again ([Restore AMIs from the Recycle Bin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-working-with-amis.html)). This directly meets the need with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Create EBS snapshots and store them in a separate account** — This would require additional snapshot creation/copy/account-management processes and does not directly provide the built-in AMI recovery workflow. Recycle Bin already supports deleted EBS-backed AMIs directly ([Recycle Bin overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)).
- **B. Copy all AMIs to another AWS account periodically** — This could provide a backup copy, but it adds ongoing operational overhead for scheduling, permissions, copying, and lifecycle management. A Recycle Bin retention rule is the native, lower-overhead solution.
- **D. Upload the AMIs to an S3 bucket with Cross-Region Replication** — AMIs are EC2 image resources, not objects that are normally protected by uploading them to S3 for direct EC2 recovery. The AWS-documented recovery feature for accidentally deleted EBS-backed AMIs is Recycle Bin, not S3 replication ([Recover deleted AMIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-working-with-amis.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 AWS 账户中存储了多个 Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)，用于启动其 Amazon EC2 实例。这些 AMIs 包含公司运营所必需的关键数据和配置。公司希望实施一种解决方案，能够快速高效地恢复意外删除的 AMIs。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 AMIs 的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 快照。将快照存储在单独的 AWS 账户中。
options.B: 定期将所有 AMIs 复制到另一个 AWS 账户。
options.C: 在 Recycle Bin 中创建保留规则。
options.D: 将 AMIs 上传到启用了 Cross-Region Replication 的 Amazon S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 在 Recycle Bin 中创建保留规则。**

AWS Recycle Bin 专门用于恢复意外删除的 **EBS-backed AMIs**：AWS 表示，Recycle Bin 允许你还原意外删除的 EBS 卷、EBS 快照和 **EBS-backed AMIs**，并在永久删除之前将匹配的已删除资源保留指定时间。它还说明，你可以在保留期到期之前的任何时间还原资源，从而帮助保护业务关键型数据免遭意外删除（[Recycle Bin overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)）。可以为 AMI 资源类型创建保留规则，EBS-backed AMIs 支持的保留期为 1 到 365 天（[Create a Recycle Bin retention rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-create-rule.html)）。当 AMI 从 Recycle Bin 还原后，它会立即再次可用（[Restore AMIs from the Recycle Bin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-working-with-amis.html)）。这以最少的运营开销直接满足了需求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 创建 EBS 快照并将其存储在单独的账户中** — 这需要额外的快照创建/复制/账户管理流程，并且不能直接提供内置的 AMI 恢复工作流。Recycle Bin 已经直接支持已删除的 EBS-backed AMIs（[Recycle Bin overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)）。
- **B. 定期将所有 AMIs 复制到另一个 AWS 账户** — 这可以提供备份副本，但会增加调度、权限、复制和生命周期管理方面的持续运营开销。Recycle Bin 保留规则是原生且开销更低的解决方案。
- **D. 将 AMIs 上传到启用了 Cross-Region Replication 的 S3 存储桶** — AMIs 是 EC2 镜像资源，并不是通常通过上传到 S3 来实现直接 EC2 恢复保护的对象。AWS 文档中用于恢复意外删除的 EBS-backed AMIs 的功能是 Recycle Bin，而不是 S3 复制（[Recover deleted AMIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-working-with-amis.html)）。

en.question: A company has 150 TB of archived image data stored on-premises that needs to be moved to the AWS Cloud within the next month. The company’s current network connection allows up to 100 Mbps uploads for this purpose during the night only. What is the MOST cost-effective mechanism to move this data and meet the migration deadline?

options.A: Use AWS Snowmobile to ship the data to AWS.
options.B: Order multiple AWS Snowball devices to ship the data to AWS.
options.C: Enable Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration and securely upload the data.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 VPC endpoint and establish a VPN to upload the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Order multiple AWS Snowball devices to ship the data to AWS.**

AWS Snowball Edge is intended for transferring large amounts of data between on-premises storage and Amazon S3 at **faster-than-internet speeds**, using physical devices that are protected in transit ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)). Snowball Edge also supports importing data between local environments and Amazon S3 by physically transporting **one or more devices without using the internet** ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)). A Snowball Edge storage-optimized device provides **210 TB of usable storage** for object and NFS data transfer, enough for the 150 TB dataset in current device configurations ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)). This avoids the company’s constrained 100 Mbps, night-only upload window and can meet the one-month requirement cost-effectively.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **A. Snowmobile** — Snowmobile is unnecessary for 150 TB. Since Snowball Edge devices can handle large transfers and a storage-optimized device has 210 TB usable capacity, Snowball is the more appropriate and cost-effective offline transfer mechanism for this dataset.
- **C. S3 Transfer Acceleration** — Transfer Acceleration can help when uploading over the internet, especially when you cannot use all available bandwidth or transfer gigabytes to terabytes across continents ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)). However, it still depends on internet upload capacity. At 100 Mbps, transferring 150 TB would take far longer than a month even if the link were available continuously, and the question says uploads are allowed only at night.
- **D. S3 VPC endpoint with VPN** — A Site-to-Site VPN creates an IPsec VPN connection between a VPC and a remote network ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)), but it does not remove the 100 Mbps on-premises upload bottleneck. It is therefore not suitable for the deadline.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地存储了 150 TB 的归档图像数据，需要在下个月内迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司当前的网络连接仅允许在夜间为此目的进行最高 100 Mbps 的上传。迁移这些数据并满足迁移截止期限的最具成本效益的机制是什么？

options.A: 使用 AWS Snowmobile 将数据运送到 AWS。
options.B: 订购多台 AWS Snowball 设备将数据运送到 AWS。
options.C: 启用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 并安全地上传数据。
options.D: 创建 Amazon S3 VPC endpoint 并建立 VPN 以上传数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 订购多台 AWS Snowball 设备将数据运送到 AWS。**

AWS Snowball Edge 旨在用于在本地存储与 Amazon S3 之间传输大量数据，通过使用在运输过程中受到保护的物理设备，以**快于互联网的速度**进行传输（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html)）。Snowball Edge 还支持通过物理运输**一台或多台设备且不使用互联网**，在本地环境与 Amazon S3 之间导入数据（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html)）。一台 Snowball Edge storage-optimized 设备为对象和 NFS 数据传输提供 **210 TB 的可用存储**，在当前设备配置下足以容纳 150 TB 数据集（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html)）。这避免了该公司受限的 100 Mbps、仅夜间可用的上传窗口，并能以具有成本效益的方式满足一个月的要求。为什么其他选项是错误的：

- **A. Snowmobile** — 对于 150 TB 来说，Snowmobile 并非必要。由于 Snowball Edge 设备可以处理大规模传输，并且一台 storage-optimized 设备具有 210 TB 的可用容量，因此对于此数据集，Snowball 是更合适且更具成本效益的离线传输机制。
- **C. S3 Transfer Acceleration** — Transfer Acceleration 可以在通过互联网上传时提供帮助，尤其是在无法使用全部可用带宽，或需要跨洲传输从 GB 到 TB 级别数据时（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。但是，它仍然依赖互联网上传容量。在 100 Mbps 下，即使链路可以连续可用，传输 150 TB 也会远远超过一个月，而且题目说明只允许在夜间上传。
- **D. S3 VPC endpoint with VPN** — Site-to-Site VPN 会在 VPC 与远程网络之间创建 IPsec VPN 连接（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)），但它无法消除本地 100 Mbps 上传瓶颈。因此，它不适合满足该截止期限。

en.question: A company wants to migrate its three-tier application from on premises to AWS. The web tier and the application tier are running on third-party virtual machines (VMs). The database tier is running on MySQL. The company needs to migrate the application by making the fewest possible changes to the architecture. The company also needs a database solution that can restore data to a specific point in time. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets.
options.B: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in private subnets.
options.C: Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets.
options.D: Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in public subnets.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **B**.

**B. Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in private subnets.**

This matches the typical three-tier AWS architecture with the least operational overhead:

- The **web tier** is placed in **public subnets** so it can receive internet-facing traffic.
- The **application tier** is placed in **private subnets**, limiting direct internet exposure.
- The **database tier** is placed in **private subnets**, which is the appropriate placement for backend databases.
- Amazon Aurora is a fully managed relational database engine that is **compatible with MySQL**, so existing MySQL applications, tools, and code can generally be used with Aurora with minimal changes. AWS documentation states that Aurora is compatible with MySQL and that the code, tools, and applications used with existing MySQL databases can be used with Aurora ([AWS Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)).
- Aurora provides automated, continuous backups and supports restoring a DB cluster to a **specific point in time** within the backup retention period. Aurora uploads log records continuously to Amazon S3 and supports point-in-time restore ([Aurora point-in-time restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-pitr.html)).

Therefore, option B provides the correct subnet placement, MySQL compatibility, point-in-time recovery, and a highly managed database platform with low operational overhead.

### Why the other options are incorrect

**A. Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets.**

This places the **web tier in private subnets**, which is not appropriate for an internet-facing web tier unless additional components such as a public load balancer or proxy layer are introduced. The standard AWS pattern places web-facing resources in public subnets and backend resources, such as databases, in private subnets ([AWS VPC web/database example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-example-web-database-servers.html)). This option does not best match the stated three-tier migration with the fewest architectural changes.

**C. Migrate the web tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the application tier to EC2 instances in private subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon RDS for MySQL in private subnets.**

This option uses appropriate subnet placement, and Amazon RDS for MySQL does support point-in-time restore. AWS documentation states that RDS can restore a DB instance to a specific point in time within the backup retention period ([Amazon RDS point-in-time restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIT.html)). However, compared with Aurora MySQL, Aurora provides a more automated managed database architecture with continuous log backups, automatic storage growth, and managed clustering and replication capabilities, reducing operational overhead ([AWS Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)). Therefore, B is the better answer for the least operational overhead.

**D. Migrate the web tier and the application tier to Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Migrate the database tier to Amazon Aurora MySQL in public subnets.**

This option places both the **application tier and database tier in public subnets**, which increases exposure and does not follow the recommended architecture. Backend application components and databases should be isolated in private subnets, with only the web-facing layer exposed through public subnets or public load balancers. AWS documentation illustrates this separation by placing web servers in public subnets and database servers in private subnets ([AWS VPC web/database example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-example-web-database-servers.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其三层应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。Web 层和应用程序层运行在第三方虚拟机 (VMs) 上。数据库层运行在 MySQL 上。公司需要在尽可能少地更改架构的情况下迁移应用程序。公司还需要一种可以将数据还原到特定时间点的数据库解决方案。哪种解决方案能以最低的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Web 层和应用程序层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。
options.B: 将 Web 层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将应用程序层迁移到私有子网中的 EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon Aurora MySQL。
options.C: 将 Web 层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将应用程序层迁移到私有子网中的 EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。
options.D: 将 Web 层和应用程序层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon Aurora MySQL。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B**。

**B. 将 Web 层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将应用程序层迁移到私有子网中的 EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon Aurora MySQL。**

这符合典型的三层 AWS 架构，并且运营开销最低：

- **Web 层** 放置在 **公有子网** 中，以便能够接收面向互联网的流量。
- **应用程序层** 放置在 **私有子网** 中，从而限制直接暴露于互联网。
- **数据库层** 放置在 **私有子网** 中，这是后端数据库的合适放置方式。
- Amazon Aurora 是一种完全托管的关系数据库引擎，**兼容 MySQL**，因此现有的 MySQL 应用程序、工具和代码通常可以在 Aurora 中使用，并且只需最少更改。AWS 文档说明 Aurora 兼容 MySQL，并且与现有 MySQL 数据库一起使用的代码、工具和应用程序可以与 Aurora 一起使用（[AWS Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。
- Aurora 提供自动化的连续备份，并支持在备份保留期内将 DB 集群还原到 **特定时间点**。Aurora 会持续将日志记录上传到 Amazon S3，并支持时间点还原（[Aurora point-in-time restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-pitr.html)）。因此，选项 B 提供了正确的子网放置、MySQL 兼容性、时间点恢复，以及低运营开销的高度托管数据库平台。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

**A. 将 Web 层和应用程序层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。**

此选项将 **Web 层放置在私有子网中**，对于面向互联网的 Web 层来说并不合适，除非引入公有负载均衡器或代理层等额外组件。标准 AWS 模式会将面向 Web 的资源放置在公有子网中，并将后端资源（例如数据库）放置在私有子网中（[AWS VPC web/database example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-example-web-database-servers.html)）。此选项并不能最好地匹配题目所述的、以最少架构更改进行三层迁移的要求。

**C. 将 Web 层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将应用程序层迁移到私有子网中的 EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到私有子网中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL。**

此选项使用了适当的子网放置，并且 Amazon RDS for MySQL 确实支持时间点还原。AWS 文档说明 RDS 可以在备份保留期内将 DB 实例还原到特定时间点（[Amazon RDS point-in-time restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PIT.html)）。但是，与 Aurora MySQL 相比，Aurora 提供更自动化的托管数据库架构，具有连续日志备份、自动存储增长以及托管集群和复制功能，从而降低运营开销（[AWS Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。因此，对于最低运营开销，B 是更好的答案。

**D. 将 Web 层和应用程序层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库层迁移到公有子网中的 Amazon Aurora MySQL。**

此选项将 **应用程序层和数据库层都放置在公有子网中**，这会增加暴露面，并且不符合推荐架构。后端应用程序组件和数据库应隔离在私有子网中，只有面向 Web 的层通过公有子网或公有负载均衡器暴露。AWS 文档通过将 Web 服务器放置在公有子网中、将数据库服务器放置在私有子网中来说明这种分离（[AWS VPC web/database example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-example-web-database-servers.html)）。

en.question: A development team is collaborating with another company to create an integrated product. The other company needs to access an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue that is contained in the development team's account. The other company wants to poll the queue without giving up its own account permissions to do so. How should a solutions architect provide access to the SQS queue?

options.A: Create an instance profile that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.
options.C: Create an SQS access policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) access policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Create an SQS access policy that provides the other company access to the SQS queue.**

Amazon SQS supports resource-based queue access policies. AWS documentation states that you can use an Amazon SQS policy with a queue to specify which AWS accounts have access to the queue and what type of access they have, such as `ReceiveMessage` for polling the queue. It also explicitly says that for cross-account access, the queue's access policy must allow the cross-account principal and that IAM identity-based policies alone are not sufficient for cross-account access to SQS queues ([Overview of managing access in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-overview-of-managing-access.html)). AWS also provides an example SQS policy that grants another AWS account permission to send to and receive from a queue owned by a different account ([Custom Amazon SQS Access Policy Language examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-creating-custom-policies-access-policy-examples.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Instance profile**: An instance profile is for granting permissions to an EC2 instance role. It does not directly grant an external company cross-account access to an SQS queue.
- **B. IAM policy**: IAM identity-based policies are attached to identities such as users, groups, or roles. For SQS cross-account access, AWS says the queue access policy must allow the cross-account principal; IAM identity-based policies alone are not sufficient ([Overview of managing access in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-overview-of-managing-access.html)).
- **D. SNS access policy**: Amazon SNS policies control access to SNS topics, not SQS queues. The resource that needs access control here is the SQS queue, so the policy must be an SQS queue access policy.

zh.question: 一个开发团队正在与另一家公司合作创建一个集成产品。另一家公司需要访问开发团队账户中包含的 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。另一家公司希望轮询该队列，同时不放弃其自身账户权限。解决方案架构师应如何提供对该 SQS 队列的访问权限？

options.A: 创建一个实例配置文件，为另一家公司提供对 SQS 队列的访问权限。
options.B: 创建一个 IAM policy，为另一家公司提供对 SQS 队列的访问权限。
options.C: 创建一个 SQS 访问策略，为另一家公司提供对 SQS 队列的访问权限。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 访问策略，为另一家公司提供对 SQS 队列的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 创建一个 SQS 访问策略，为另一家公司提供对 SQS 队列的访问权限。**

Amazon SQS 支持基于资源的队列访问策略。AWS 文档指出，你可以将 Amazon SQS policy 与队列一起使用，以指定哪些 AWS accounts 可以访问该队列以及它们拥有何种访问类型，例如用于轮询队列的 `ReceiveMessage`。文档还明确说明，对于跨账户访问，队列的访问策略必须允许跨账户主体，并且仅靠 IAM identity-based policies 不足以对 SQS queues 进行跨账户访问（[Overview of managing access in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-overview-of-managing-access.html)）。AWS 还提供了一个 SQS policy 示例，用于授予另一个 AWS account 向由不同账户拥有的队列发送消息以及从该队列接收消息的权限（[Custom Amazon SQS Access Policy Language examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-creating-custom-policies-access-policy-examples.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Instance profile**：实例配置文件用于向 EC2 instance role 授予权限。它不会直接向外部公司授予对 SQS 队列的跨账户访问权限。
- **B. IAM policy**：IAM identity-based policies 附加到 identities，例如 users、groups 或 roles。对于 SQS 跨账户访问，AWS 表示队列访问策略必须允许跨账户主体；仅靠 IAM identity-based policies 不足够（[Overview of managing access in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-overview-of-managing-access.html)）。
- **D. SNS access policy**：Amazon SNS policies 控制对 SNS topics 的访问，而不是 SQS queues。这里需要访问控制的资源是 SQS 队列，因此该策略必须是 SQS queue access policy。

en.question: A company’s developers want a secure way to gain SSH access on the company's Amazon EC2 instances that run the latest version of Amazon Linux. The developers work remotely and in the corporate office. The company wants to use AWS services as a part of the solution. The EC2 instances are hosted in a VPC private subnet and access the internet through a NAT gateway that is deployed in a public subnet. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a bastion host in the same subnet as the EC2 instances. Grant the ec2:CreateVpnConnection IAM permission to the developers. Install EC2 Instance Connect so that the developers can connect to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the corporate network and the VPC. Instruct the developers to use the Site-to-Site VPN connection to access the EC2 instances when the developers are on the corporate network. Instruct the developers to set up another VPN connection for access when they work remotely.
options.C: Create a bastion host in the public subnet of the VPConfigure the security groups and SSH keys of the bastion host to only allow connections and SSH authentication from the developers’ corporate and remote networks. Instruct the developers to connect through the bastion host by using SSH to reach the EC2 instances.
options.D: Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore IAM policy to an IAM role that is associated with the EC2 instances. Instruct the developers to use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to access the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

AWS Systems Manager Session Manager is the best fit because it provides secure access to EC2 instances using IAM-based controls, without requiring inbound SSH exposure, bastion hosts, jump boxes, or SSH key management. AWS documentation states that Session Manager lets you close inbound SSH ports and eliminates the need to manage SSH keys, bastion hosts, and jump boxes; it also provides console/CLI access and IAM access control to managed nodes ([Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)). For EC2 instances, there is no additional charge to connect by using Session Manager ([Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)), making it the most cost-effective option. Attaching an instance profile whose permissions include `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` is also an AWS-documented requirement/check for Systems Manager-managed EC2 instances ([managed node IAM instance profile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/fleet-manager-troubleshooting-managed-nodes.html)). The instances already have outbound internet access through a NAT gateway, which can satisfy the required outbound HTTPS connectivity to Systems Manager endpoints ([service endpoint connectivity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/fleet-manager-troubleshooting-managed-nodes.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A bastion host in the same private subnet would not solve remote SSH reachability, and `ec2:CreateVpnConnection` is unrelated to EC2 Instance Connect access. EC2 Instance Connect requires either internet-reachable instances in a public subnet or private network connectivity to the VPC, plus inbound SSH rules ([EC2 Instance Connect prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-connect-prerequisites.html)).
- **B:** Site-to-Site VPN can provide private connectivity, but using VPNs for corporate and remote users is more complex and costly than Session Manager. Session Manager provides access to EC2 instances without additional EC2 connection charge and without requiring VPN infrastructure ([Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).
- **C:** A public bastion host can work technically, but it adds an EC2 instance to operate, patch, secure, and pay for, and still requires managing SSH access. Session Manager specifically removes the need for bastion hosts and SSH keys and allows inbound SSH ports to remain closed ([Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的开发人员希望以安全的方式，在运行最新版 Amazon Linux 的公司 Amazon EC2 实例上获得 SSH 访问权限。开发人员既远程办公，也在公司办公室办公。公司希望将 AWS 服务作为解决方案的一部分。EC2 实例托管在 VPC 私有子网中，并通过部署在公有子网中的 NAT gateway 访问互联网。解决方案架构师应如何以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在与 EC2 实例相同的子网中创建一个堡垒主机。向开发人员授予 ec2:CreateVpnConnection IAM 权限。安装 EC2 Instance Connect，以便开发人员可以连接到 EC2 实例。
options.B: 在公司网络和 VPC 之间创建 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。指示开发人员在公司网络上时使用 Site-to-Site VPN 连接访问 EC2 实例。指示开发人员在远程工作时设置另一个 VPN 连接以进行访问。
options.C: 在 VPConfigure 的公有子网中创建一个堡垒主机。配置堡垒主机的安全组和 SSH 密钥，使其仅允许来自开发人员公司网络和远程网络的连接与 SSH 身份验证。指示开发人员使用 SSH 通过堡垒主机连接，以访问 EC2 实例。
options.D: 将 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore IAM policy 附加到与 EC2 实例关联的 IAM role。指示开发人员使用 AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 访问 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 是最合适的选择，因为它使用基于 IAM 的控制提供对 EC2 实例的安全访问，而无需暴露入站 SSH、堡垒主机、跳板机或 SSH 密钥管理。AWS 文档说明，Session Manager 允许你关闭入站 SSH 端口，并消除管理 SSH 密钥、堡垒主机和跳板机的需要；它还提供控制台/CLI 访问以及对托管节点的 IAM 访问控制（[Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。对于 EC2 实例，使用 Session Manager 连接不收取额外费用（[Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)），因此它是最具成本效益的选项。附加一个权限包含 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 的实例配置文件，也是 AWS 文档中针对 Systems Manager 托管的 EC2 实例所列的要求/检查项（[managed node IAM instance profile](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/fleet-manager-troubleshooting-managed-nodes.html)）。这些实例已经通过 NAT gateway 具有出站互联网访问能力，这可以满足连接到 Systems Manager endpoints 所需的出站 HTTPS 连接（[service endpoint connectivity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/fleet-manager-troubleshooting-managed-nodes.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 位于同一私有子网中的堡垒主机无法解决远程 SSH 可达性问题，并且 `ec2:CreateVpnConnection` 与 EC2 Instance Connect 访问无关。EC2 Instance Connect 要求实例位于公有子网且可从互联网访问，或者具有到 VPC 的私有网络连接，并且还需要入站 SSH 规则（[EC2 Instance Connect prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-connect-prerequisites.html)）。
- **B:** Site-to-Site VPN 可以提供私有连接，但为公司用户和远程用户使用 VPN 比 Session Manager 更复杂且成本更高。Session Manager 可以访问 EC2 实例，而无需额外的 EC2 连接费用，也无需 VPN 基础设施（[Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。
- **C:** 公有堡垒主机在技术上可以工作，但它会增加一个需要运行、修补、保护并付费的 EC2 实例，并且仍然需要管理 SSH 访问。Session Manager 明确消除了对堡垒主机和 SSH 密钥的需求，并允许入站 SSH 端口保持关闭（[Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。

en.question: A pharmaceutical company is developing a new drug. The volume of data that the company generates has grown exponentially over the past few months. The company's researchers regularly require a subset of the entire dataset to be immediately available with minimal lag. However, the entire dataset does not need to be accessed on a daily basis. All the data currently resides in on-premises storage arrays, and the company wants to reduce ongoing capital expenses. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Run AWS DataSync as a scheduled cron job to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket on an ongoing basis.
options.B: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway with an Amazon S3 bucket as the target storage. Migrate the data to the Storage Gateway appliance.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway with cached volumes with an Amazon S3 bucket as the target storage. Migrate the data to the Storage Gateway appliance.
options.D: Configure an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection from the on-premises environment to AWS. Migrate data to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A **Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes** is designed for exactly this pattern: keep the full dataset in Amazon S3 as primary storage while retaining frequently accessed subsets locally. AWS states that cached volumes let you “store your data in Amazon S3 and retain a copy of frequently accessed data subsets locally,” providing “substantial cost savings on primary storage” and “low-latency access” to frequently accessed data ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). AWS further explains that cached volumes use S3 as primary storage, minimize the need to scale on-premises storage, and check the local cache before S3 when an application requests data ([How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html)). This meets the requirements to reduce on-premises capital expense while keeping the researchers’ active subset immediately available with minimal lag.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. DataSync to S3 on a schedule**: DataSync can transfer data to or from an S3 bucket, but this is a migration/transfer mechanism, not a local caching storage layer for immediate low-latency access to hot data ([Configuring AWS DataSync transfers with Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html)).
- **B. S3 File Gateway**: S3 File Gateway provides NFS/SMB access to S3 and transparent local caching, and is useful for file-based access ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). However, the question’s wording maps most directly to **cached volumes**, which AWS specifically describes as storing the full data in S3 while retaining frequently accessed subsets locally and reducing the need to scale on-premises primary storage.
- **D. Site-to-Site VPN with Amazon EFS**: This would place data in an EFS file system accessed over the network/VPN. It does not provide the Storage Gateway local cache model needed for minimal-lag access to a frequently used subset while offloading the full dataset to low-cost S3-backed storage.

Therefore, **C** is the best fit.

zh.question: 一家制药公司正在开发一种新药。该公司生成的数据量在过去几个月中呈指数级增长。公司的研究人员经常需要整个数据集的一个子集能够立即可用，并且延迟最小。但是，整个数据集并不需要每天访问。所有数据目前都驻留在本地存储阵列中，公司希望降低持续的资本支出。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种存储解决方案来满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS DataSync 作为计划的 cron 作业运行，以持续将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 bucket。
options.B: 部署 AWS Storage Gateway file gateway，并将 Amazon S3 bucket 作为目标存储。将数据迁移到 Storage Gateway appliance。
