options.C: 部署 AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway，并使用 cached volumes，将 Amazon S3 bucket 作为目标存储。将数据迁移到 Storage Gateway appliance。
options.D: 配置从本地环境到 AWS 的 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。将数据迁移到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

**Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes** 正是为这种模式而设计的：将完整数据集保存在 Amazon S3 中作为主存储，同时在本地保留经常访问的子集。AWS 表示，cached volumes 让你可以“store your data in Amazon S3 and retain a copy of frequently accessed data subsets locally”，从而为经常访问的数据提供“substantial cost savings on primary storage”和“low-latency access”([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html))。AWS 进一步说明，cached volumes 使用 S3 作为主存储，最大限度减少扩展本地存储的需求，并且当应用程序请求数据时，会先检查本地缓存，再检查 S3 ([How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html))。这满足了降低本地资本支出，同时让研究人员的活跃子集能够以最小延迟立即可用的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 按计划使用 DataSync 到 S3**：DataSync 可以将数据传输到 S3 bucket 或从 S3 bucket 传出，但这是一种迁移/传输机制，而不是用于对热数据进行即时低延迟访问的本地缓存存储层 ([Configuring AWS DataSync transfers with Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html))。
- **B. S3 File Gateway**：S3 File Gateway 提供对 S3 的 NFS/SMB 访问和透明本地缓存，并且适用于基于文件的访问 ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html))。但是，题目措辞最直接对应的是 **cached volumes**，AWS 明确将其描述为在 S3 中存储完整数据，同时在本地保留经常访问的子集，并减少扩展本地主存储的需求。
- **D. Site-to-Site VPN with Amazon EFS**：这会将数据放在通过网络/VPN 访问的 EFS file system 中。它不提供所需的 Storage Gateway 本地缓存模型，无法在将完整数据集卸载到低成本 S3 支持的存储的同时，为经常使用的子集提供最小延迟访问。因此，**C** 是最佳选择。

en.question: A company has a business-critical application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application stores data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company must be able to revert the table to any point within the last 24 hours. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure point-in-time recovery for the table.
options.B: Use AWS Backup for the table.
options.C: Use an AWS Lambda function to make an on-demand backup of the table every hour.
options.D: Turn on streams on the table to capture a log of all changes to the table in the last 24 hours. Store a copy of the stream in an Amazon S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Configure point-in-time recovery for the table.**

DynamoDB point-in-time recovery (PITR) is designed for exactly this requirement. AWS states that PITR provides **automatic continuous backups**, is **fully managed by DynamoDB**, and provides recovery points at **per-second granularity** for up to 35 days. It also says that with PITR, you do **not** need to create, maintain, or schedule on-demand backups. Since the company needs to revert the table to any point within the last 24 hours with the least operational overhead, enabling PITR is the best fit ([DynamoDB PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Point-in-time-recovery.html), [DynamoDB backup and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Backup-and-Restore.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Use AWS Backup for the table** — AWS Backup can be used to manage DynamoDB on-demand backups, but on-demand backups are snapshot backups that restore the table to the state it was in when the backup was created. The requirement is to restore to **any point** within the last 24 hours; native DynamoDB PITR is the direct, fully managed solution with the least overhead ([DynamoDB backup and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Backup-and-Restore.html)).
- **C. Use a Lambda function to make an on-demand backup every hour** — Hourly snapshots would not allow restore to *any* point in time, only to hourly backup times. It also adds operational overhead for scheduling, monitoring, and maintaining the Lambda function. PITR avoids this because no backup scheduling is required ([DynamoDB PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Point-in-time-recovery.html)).
- **D. Turn on streams and store a copy in S3** — DynamoDB Streams captures item-level changes and retains stream records for up to 24 hours, but it is a change-data-capture mechanism, not a managed point-in-time table restore solution. Building a restore process from streams and S3 would require significant custom operational work ([DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的业务关键型应用程序。该应用程序将数据存储在一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。公司必须能够将该表恢复到过去 24 小时内的任意时间点。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该表配置时间点恢复。
options.B: 对该表使用 AWS Backup。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数每小时对该表进行一次按需备份。
options.D: 在该表上开启流，以捕获过去 24 小时内对该表的所有更改日志。将该流的一份副本存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 为该表配置时间点恢复。**

DynamoDB 时间点恢复（PITR）正是为此类需求而设计的。AWS 表示，PITR 提供**自动连续备份**，由 **DynamoDB 完全托管**，并以**秒级粒度**提供最长 35 天的恢复点。它还说明，使用 PITR 时，你**不**需要创建、维护或计划按需备份。由于公司需要以最少的运营开销将表恢复到过去 24 小时内的任意时间点，启用 PITR 是最合适的选择（[DynamoDB PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Point-in-time-recovery.html)，[DynamoDB backup and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Backup-and-Restore.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 对该表使用 AWS Backup** — AWS Backup 可用于管理 DynamoDB 按需备份，但按需备份是快照备份，会将表恢复到备份创建时的状态。要求是恢复到过去 24 小时内的**任意时间点**；原生 DynamoDB PITR 是直接的、完全托管且开销最少的解决方案（[DynamoDB backup and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Backup-and-Restore.html)）。
- **C. 使用 Lambda 函数每小时进行一次按需备份** — 每小时快照无法恢复到*任意*时间点，只能恢复到每小时的备份时间点。它还会增加用于计划、监控和维护 Lambda 函数的运营开销。PITR 避免了这一点，因为不需要备份计划（[DynamoDB PITR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Point-in-time-recovery.html)）。
- **D. 开启流并在 S3 中存储一份副本** — DynamoDB Streams 捕获项目级更改，并将流记录保留最长 24 小时，但它是一种变更数据捕获机制，而不是托管的时间点表恢复解决方案。基于流和 S3 构建恢复流程将需要大量自定义运营工作（[DynamoDB Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Streams.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts an application used to upload files to an Amazon S3 bucket. Once uploaded, the files are processed to extract metadata, which takes less than 5 seconds. The volume and frequency of the uploads varies from a few files each hour to hundreds of concurrent uploads. The company has asked a solutions architect to design a cost-effective architecture that will meet these requirements. What should the solutions architect recommend?

options.A: Configure AWS CloudTrail trails to log S3 API calls. Use AWS AppSync to process the files.
options.B: Configure an object-created event notification within the S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the files.
options.C: Configure Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to process and send data to Amazon S3. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the files.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to process the files uploaded to Amazon S3. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the files.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon S3 event notifications support **new object created events** and can send those notifications directly to an **AWS Lambda function** as a destination ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). AWS Lambda documentation also states that S3 can send an event to a Lambda function when an object is created, and S3 invokes the function asynchronously with details about the object ([Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)). This is cost-effective and event-driven for variable upload rates, and Lambda can scale for bursts; its concurrency scaling rate is 1,000 execution environments every 10 seconds per function, sufficient for hundreds of concurrent uploads in this scenario ([Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** CloudTrail logs S3 API calls for auditing, but it is not the right event-driven file-processing mechanism. AppSync is not a file metadata processing service, and this design adds unnecessary components.
- **C:** Kinesis Data Streams is for streaming data ingestion/processing. The files are already uploaded to S3, so introducing Kinesis to send data to S3 is unnecessary and less cost-effective than an S3 event directly invoking Lambda.
- **D:** S3 can send notifications to SNS, but SNS itself does not process the files. If Lambda is still doing the processing, adding SNS between S3 and Lambda is unnecessary for this single-processing workflow; S3 can invoke Lambda directly ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司托管了一个用于将文件上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶的应用程序。文件上传后，会对其进行处理以提取元数据，该过程耗时少于 5 秒。上传的数量和频率各不相同，从每小时几个文件到数百个并发上传不等。该公司要求解决方案架构师设计一个经济高效的架构来满足这些要求。解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

options.A: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪以记录 S3 API 调用。使用 AWS AppSync 处理文件。
options.B: 在 S3 存储桶中配置对象创建事件通知，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理文件。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 来处理数据并将数据发送到 Amazon S3。调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理文件。
options.D: 配置 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题来处理上传到 Amazon S3 的文件。调用 AWS Lambda 函数来处理文件。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon S3 事件通知支持**新对象创建事件**，并且可以将这些通知直接发送到 **AWS Lambda 函数**作为目标（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。AWS Lambda 文档还说明，当对象被创建时，S3 可以向 Lambda 函数发送事件，并且 S3 会异步调用该函数，同时提供有关该对象的详细信息（[Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)）。对于可变的上传速率，这种方式经济高效且由事件驱动，并且 Lambda 可以针对突发流量进行扩展；其并发扩展速率为每个函数每 10 秒 1,000 个执行环境，足以应对本场景中的数百个并发上传（[Lambda scaling behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/scaling-behavior.html)）。

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **A:** CloudTrail 会记录 S3 API 调用以用于审计，但它不是合适的事件驱动文件处理机制。AppSync 不是文件元数据处理服务，并且该设计增加了不必要的组件。
- **C:** Kinesis Data Streams 用于流式数据摄取/处理。文件已经上传到 S3，因此引入 Kinesis 将数据发送到 S3 是不必要的，并且不如由 S3 事件直接调用 Lambda 经济高效。
- **D:** S3 可以向 SNS 发送通知，但 SNS 本身不处理文件。如果仍然由 Lambda 执行处理，那么对于这种单一处理工作流，在 S3 和 Lambda 之间添加 SNS 是不必要的；S3 可以直接调用 Lambda（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。

en.question: A company’s application is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances and uses AWS Lambda functions for an event-driven architecture. The company uses nonproduction development environments in a different AWS account to test new features before the company deploys the features to production. The production instances show constant usage because of customers in different time zones. The company uses nonproduction instances only during business hours on weekdays. The company does not use the nonproduction instances on the weekends. The company wants to optimize the costs to run its application on AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use On-Demand Instances for the production instances. Use Dedicated Hosts for the nonproduction instances on weekends only.
options.B: Use Reserved Instances for the production instances and the nonproduction instances. Shut down the nonproduction instances when not in use.
options.C: Use Compute Savings Plans for the production instances. Use On-Demand Instances for the nonproduction instances. Shut down the nonproduction instances when not in use.
options.D: Use Dedicated Hosts for the production instances. Use EC2 Instance Savings Plans for the nonproduction instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The production workload has **constant usage** and includes both EC2 instances and Lambda functions. A **Compute Savings Plan** is designed for a consistent hourly compute commitment and can reduce costs for EC2, Fargate, and **Lambda** usage; AWS states that Compute Savings Plans automatically reduce cost on “EC2 instance usage, Fargate, and Lambda” and apply broadly across instance family, size, OS, tenancy, and Region ([Savings Plans: Compute Savings Plans and Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)). For the nonproduction environment, usage is intermittent, so **On-Demand Instances** are appropriate because they have “no long-term commitments or upfront payments” and charge only for instances used ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). Shutting down nonproduction instances when not in use also saves cost because AWS says stopped instances do not incur instance usage or data transfer charges, though EBS storage charges still apply ([EC2 stop/start costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-ec2-instance-stop-start-works.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A:** On-Demand for constantly used production instances is less cost-effective than a commitment-based discount. Dedicated Hosts for nonproduction on weekends is also illogical because the instances are not used on weekends, and Dedicated Hosts are primarily for a fully dedicated physical server, existing server-bound licenses, or compliance requirements ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)).
- **B:** Reserved Instances can reduce EC2 costs, but they require a 1- or 3-year commitment to a **specific instance configuration** ([Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)). Applying that commitment to intermittent nonproduction instances is not the most cost-effective choice, and RIs do not cover Lambda in the way Compute Savings Plans do.
- **D:** Dedicated Hosts for production are unnecessary without license or compliance requirements. EC2 Instance Savings Plans for nonproduction still require a commitment and apply only to EC2 usage within an instance family/Region, whereas the nonproduction environment is used only during business hours on weekdays and should instead use On-Demand with shutdowns ([Savings Plans comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将其应用程序部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并使用 AWS Lambda 函数来实现事件驱动架构。该公司在另一个 AWS 账户中使用非生产开发环境，以便在将新功能部署到生产环境之前进行测试。由于客户分布在不同时区，生产实例显示为持续使用。该公司仅在工作日的营业时间使用非生产实例。该公司在周末不使用非生产实例。该公司希望优化在 AWS 上运行其应用程序的成本。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 对生产实例使用 On-Demand Instances。仅在周末对非生产实例使用 Dedicated Hosts。
options.B: 对生产实例和非生产实例使用 Reserved Instances。在不使用非生产实例时将其关闭。
options.C: 对生产实例使用 Compute Savings Plans。对非生产实例使用 On-Demand Instances。在不使用非生产实例时将其关闭。
options.D: 对生产实例使用 Dedicated Hosts。对非生产实例使用 EC2 Instance Savings Plans。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

生产工作负载具有**持续使用**特征，并且同时包含 EC2 实例和 Lambda 函数。**Compute Savings Plan** 专为一致的每小时计算承诺而设计，可以降低 EC2、Fargate 和 **Lambda** 使用成本；AWS 表示，Compute Savings Plans 会自动降低“EC2 instance usage, Fargate, and Lambda”的成本，并可广泛适用于不同的实例系列、大小、操作系统、租赁属性和 Region（[Savings Plans: Compute Savings Plans and Reserved Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)）。对于非生产环境，使用是间歇性的，因此 **On-Demand Instances** 是合适的，因为它们“no long-term commitments or upfront payments”，并且只对所使用的实例收费（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。在不使用时关闭非生产实例也能节省成本，因为 AWS 表示，已停止的实例不会产生实例使用费或数据传输费，不过仍会产生 EBS 存储费用（[EC2 stop/start costs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-ec2-instance-stop-start-works.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A:** 对持续使用的生产实例使用 On-Demand 不如基于承诺的折扣具有成本效益。周末对非生产环境使用 Dedicated Hosts 也不合理，因为这些实例在周末不使用，而且 Dedicated Hosts 主要用于完全专用的物理服务器、现有的绑定服务器许可证或合规性要求（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。
- **B:** Reserved Instances 可以降低 EC2 成本，但它们要求对**特定实例配置**做出 1 年或 3 年承诺（[Amazon EC2 pricing options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/concepts.html)）。将这种承诺应用于间歇性使用的非生产实例并不是最具成本效益的选择，而且 RIs 不像 Compute Savings Plans 那样覆盖 Lambda。
- **D:** 如果没有许可证或合规性要求，则生产环境不需要 Dedicated Hosts。用于非生产环境的 EC2 Instance Savings Plans 仍然需要承诺，并且仅适用于某个实例系列/Region 内的 EC2 使用，而非生产环境仅在工作日营业时间使用，因此应改用 On-Demand 并配合关闭实例（[Savings Plans comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/sp-ris.html)）。

en.question: A company stores data in an on-premises Oracle relational database. The company needs to make the data available in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL for analysis. The company uses an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection to connect its on-premises network to AWS. The company must capture the changes that occur to the source database during the migration to Aurora PostgreSQL. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to convert the Oracle schema to Aurora PostgreSQL schema. Use the AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) full-load migration task to migrate the data.
options.B: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the S3 data to Aurora PostgreSQL by using the Aurora PostgreSQL aws_s3 extension.
options.C: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to convert the Oracle schema to Aurora PostgreSQL schema. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the existing data and replicate the ongoing changes.
options.D: Use an AWS Snowball device to migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Import the S3 data to Aurora PostgreSQL by using the Aurora PostgreSQL aws_s3 extension.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** The migration is heterogeneous (Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL), so the schema must be converted before moving the data. AWS documentation says that for a different database engine you can use DMS Schema Conversion, or download **AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)**, to convert source schemas; after applying the converted schema, **AWS DMS** can migrate data and can either perform one-time migrations or **replicate ongoing changes** to keep source and target in sync ([AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). AWS DMS CDC specifically supports a task that captures ongoing changes from the source data store **while migrating data**, and for Oracle it reads ongoing changes from Oracle redo logs using LogMiner or binary reader APIs ([DMS ongoing replication/CDC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**
- **A:** A full-load-only DMS task migrates existing data but does not satisfy the requirement to capture changes that occur during migration. The requirement needs full load plus ongoing replication/CDC.
- **B:** AWS DataSync to S3 and importing with the `aws_s3` extension is a file/object transfer and bulk import pattern; it does not convert an Oracle schema to PostgreSQL or capture ongoing database changes during migration.
- **D:** Snowball to S3 is for offline bulk data transfer. It does not provide database schema conversion or ongoing change capture/replication from the Oracle source.

zh.question: 一家公司将数据存储在本地 Oracle 关系数据库中。该公司需要使这些数据可在 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 中用于分析。该公司使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接将其本地网络连接到 AWS。该公司必须捕获在迁移到 Aurora PostgreSQL 期间源数据库中发生的更改。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 将 Oracle 架构转换为 Aurora PostgreSQL 架构。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 全量加载迁移任务来迁移数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS DataSync 将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Aurora PostgreSQL aws_s3 扩展将 S3 数据导入到 Aurora PostgreSQL。
options.C: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 将 Oracle 架构转换为 Aurora PostgreSQL 架构。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 迁移现有数据并复制持续发生的更改。
options.D: 使用 AWS Snowball 设备将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Aurora PostgreSQL aws_s3 扩展将 S3 数据导入到 Aurora PostgreSQL。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 该迁移是异构迁移（Oracle 到 Aurora PostgreSQL），因此在移动数据之前必须转换架构。AWS 文档说明，对于不同的数据库引擎，可以使用 DMS Schema Conversion，或下载 **AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT)**，来转换源架构；应用转换后的架构后，**AWS DMS** 可以迁移数据，并且可以执行一次性迁移，或**复制持续发生的更改**以保持源和目标同步（[AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。AWS DMS CDC 专门支持一种任务，可在**迁移数据的同时**从源数据存储捕获持续发生的更改；对于 Oracle，它使用 LogMiner 或二进制读取器 API 从 Oracle redo logs 读取持续发生的更改（[DMS ongoing replication/CDC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Task.CDC.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**
- **A:** 仅全量加载的 DMS 任务会迁移现有数据，但不满足捕获迁移期间发生的更改这一要求。该要求需要全量加载加持续复制/CDC。
- **B:** AWS DataSync 到 S3 并使用 `aws_s3` 扩展导入是一种文件/对象传输和批量导入模式；它不会将 Oracle 架构转换为 PostgreSQL，也不会在迁移期间捕获持续发生的数据库更改。
- **D:** Snowball 到 S3 用于离线批量数据传输。它不提供数据库架构转换，也不提供从 Oracle 源进行持续更改捕获/复制。

en.question: A company built an application with Docker containers and needs to run the application in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use a managed service to host the application. The solution must scale in and out appropriately according to demand on the individual container services. The solution also must not result in additional operational overhead or infrastructure to manage. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with AWS Fargate.
options.C: Provision an Amazon API Gateway API. Connect the API to AWS Lambda to run the containers.
options.D: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes.
options.E: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and B**.

- **A. Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate** is correct. AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS runs containers without requiring the company to manage servers or EC2 clusters; AWS states that with Fargate you do not need to provision, configure, or scale clusters of virtual machines to run containers ([Amazon ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling can automatically increase or decrease the desired number of tasks, using metrics such as CPU and memory, to scale out for high demand and scale in during low utilization ([ECS Service Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)).
- **B. Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate** is correct. Amazon EKS on Fargate runs Kubernetes Pods on on-demand, right-sized compute capacity for containers, and AWS says you do not have to provision, configure, or scale groups of virtual machines or node groups yourself ([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)). EKS is a fully managed Kubernetes service that supports scaling to meet changing workload demand ([What is Amazon EKS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **C** is wrong. Lambda can use container images as a deployment package, but it is a function runtime, not a managed container orchestration service for hosting independently scalable container services ([Lambda container images](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)). Lambda functions also have a maximum runtime of 900 seconds, so this is not the intended solution for hosting general containerized services ([Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)).
- **D** is wrong. ECS with EC2 worker nodes requires managing EC2 capacity/instances, which conflicts with the requirement for no additional operational overhead or infrastructure to manage. The Fargate documentation specifically contrasts this by removing the need to manage EC2 clusters ([Amazon ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).
- **E** is wrong. EKS with EC2 worker nodes also requires node/instance management. AWS documentation shows that node-based compute options can require deploying/managing EC2 instances and securing, maintaining, and patching their operating systems ([EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Docker 容器构建了一个应用程序，并需要在 AWS Cloud 中运行该应用程序。公司希望使用托管服务来托管该应用程序。该解决方案必须能够根据各个容器服务的需求适当地向内和向外扩展。该解决方案还不得导致额外的运营开销或需要管理的基础设施。哪些解决方案将满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 AWS Fargate。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 AWS Fargate。
options.C: 预置一个 Amazon API Gateway API。将该 API 连接到 AWS Lambda 以运行容器。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 工作节点。
options.E: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 搭配 Amazon EC2 工作节点。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 B**。

- **A. Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate** 是正确的。用于 Amazon ECS 的 AWS Fargate 可以运行容器，而无需公司管理服务器或 EC2 集群；AWS 表示，使用 Fargate 时，你无需预置、配置或扩展虚拟机集群来运行容器（[Amazon ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。Amazon ECS Service Auto Scaling 可以使用 CPU 和内存等指标，自动增加或减少所需任务数量，以便在高需求时向外扩展，并在利用率较低时向内扩展（[ECS Service Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)）。
- **B. Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate** 是正确的。Amazon EKS on Fargate 在按需、大小合适的容器计算容量上运行 Kubernetes Pods，并且 AWS 表示，你无需自行预置、配置或扩展虚拟机组或节点组（[EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)）。EKS 是一项完全托管的 Kubernetes 服务，支持扩展以满足不断变化的工作负载需求（[What is Amazon EKS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/what-is-eks.html)）。错误选项：

- **C** 是错误的。Lambda 可以使用容器镜像作为部署包，但它是函数运行时，而不是用于托管可独立扩展容器服务的托管容器编排服务（[Lambda container images](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/images-create.html)）。Lambda 函数还有 900 秒的最长运行时间，因此这并不是托管通用容器化服务的预期解决方案（[Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。
- **D** 是错误的。ECS 搭配 EC2 工作节点需要管理 EC2 容量/实例，这与不得有额外运营开销或需要管理的基础设施这一要求相冲突。Fargate 文档通过消除管理 EC2 集群的需要，明确体现了这一对比（[Amazon ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。
- **E** 是错误的。EKS 搭配 EC2 工作节点同样需要节点/实例管理。AWS 文档显示，基于节点的计算选项可能需要部署/管理 EC2 实例，并保护、维护和修补其操作系统（[EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company is running a seasonal online sale. The company hosts its website on Amazon EC2 instances spanning multiple Availability Zones. The company wants its website to manage sudden traffic increases during the sale. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that is large enough to handle peak traffic load. Stop half of the Amazon EC2 instances. Configure the Auto Scaling group to use the stopped instances to scale out when traffic increases.
options.B: Create an Auto Scaling group for the website. Set the minimum size of the Auto Scaling group so that it can handle high traffic volumes without the need to scale out.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudFront and Amazon ElastiCache to cache dynamic content with an Auto Scaling group set as the origin. Configure the Auto Scaling group with the instances necessary to populate CloudFront and ElastiCache. Scale in after the cache is fully populated.
options.D: Configure an Auto Scaling group to scale out as traffic increases. Create a launch template to start new instances from a preconfigured Amazon Machine Image (AMI).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling is designed for this exact variable-demand web application scenario. AWS states that Auto Scaling can add instances only when necessary and terminate them when no longer needed, so you pay only for the instances you use, creating a cost-effective architecture while maintaining customer experience ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-benefits.html)). Auto Scaling groups can also use scaling policies to dynamically increase or decrease instances between the configured minimum and maximum capacity values as conditions change ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)). A launch template is appropriate because an Auto Scaling group can use it as the configuration template for instances, including the AMI ID, instance type, security groups, and block device mappings ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/create-auto-scaling-groups-launch-template.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Auto Scaling groups launch and terminate instances as needed; maintaining a pool of stopped instances is not how an Auto Scaling group scales out. This also requires pre-provisioning peak capacity, which is not the most cost-effective approach.
- **B:** Setting the minimum size large enough for high traffic means running excess capacity even when traffic is lower. AWS explicitly notes that always having enough servers for peak demand leaves unused capacity and raises costs ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-benefits.html)).
- **C:** CloudFront and ElastiCache might help in some architectures, but this option adds services and operational complexity and does not directly address the requirement to automatically handle sudden EC2 traffic increases. Scaling in after cache population also risks insufficient origin capacity for uncached or changing requests. The most direct and cost-effective solution is dynamic EC2 Auto Scaling.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司正在进行季节性线上促销。该公司将其网站托管在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该公司希望其网站能够在促销期间应对突发流量增长。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个足够大、能够处理峰值流量负载的 Auto Scaling 组。停止一半的 Amazon EC2 实例。配置 Auto Scaling 组在流量增加时使用这些已停止的实例进行扩展。
options.B: 为该网站创建一个 Auto Scaling 组。将 Auto Scaling 组的最小大小设置为能够处理高流量，而无需进行扩展。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon ElastiCache 缓存动态内容，并将 Auto Scaling 组设置为源站。为 Auto Scaling 组配置填充 CloudFront 和 ElastiCache 所需的实例。缓存完全填充后进行缩减。
options.D: 配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，使其随着流量增加而扩展。创建一个启动模板，以从预配置的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) 启动新实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 正是为这种需求可变的 Web 应用程序场景而设计的。AWS 表示，Auto Scaling 可以仅在必要时添加实例，并在不再需要时终止实例，因此你只需为使用的实例付费，在保持客户体验的同时构建具有成本效益的架构（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-benefits.html)）。Auto Scaling 组还可以使用扩缩策略，在条件变化时，在配置的最小容量和最大容量值之间动态增加或减少实例（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）。启动模板是合适的，因为 Auto Scaling 组可以将其用作实例的配置模板，包括 AMI ID、实例类型、安全组和块设备映射（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/create-auto-scaling-groups-launch-template.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Auto Scaling 组会根据需要启动和终止实例；维护一组已停止的实例并不是 Auto Scaling 组进行扩展的方式。这也要求预置峰值容量，并不是最具成本效益的方法。
- **B:** 将最小大小设置为足以处理高流量，意味着即使流量较低也要运行多余容量。AWS 明确指出，始终拥有足以满足峰值需求的服务器会留下未使用的容量并增加成本（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-benefits.html)）。
- **C:** CloudFront 和 ElastiCache 在某些架构中可能有帮助，但此选项增加了服务和运维复杂性，并且没有直接满足自动处理突发 EC2 流量增长的要求。在缓存填充后进行缩减，也可能导致源站容量不足，无法处理未缓存或不断变化的请求。最直接且最具成本效益的解决方案是动态 EC2 Auto Scaling。

en.question: A solutions architect must provide an automated solution for a company's compliance policy that states security groups cannot include a rule that allows SSH from 0.0.0.0/0. The company needs to be notified if there is any breach in the policy. A solution is needed as soon as possible. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Write an AWS Lambda script that monitors security groups for SSH being open to 0.0.0.0/0 addresses and creates a notification every time it finds one.
options.B: Enable the restricted-ssh AWS Config managed rule and generate an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification when a noncompliant rule is created.
options.C: Create an IAM role with permissions to globally open security groups and network ACLs. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to generate a notification every time the role is assumed by a user.
options.D: Configure a service control policy (SCP) that prevents non-administrative users from creating or editing security groups. Create a notification in the ticketing system when a user requests a rule that needs administrator permissions.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The AWS Config managed rule **restricted-ssh** is purpose-built for this requirement. AWS documents that this rule checks incoming SSH traffic for security groups and marks a security group **NON_COMPLIANT** if SSH is allowed from `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`; it applies to `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup` and is triggered by configuration changes and periodically ([AWS Config restricted-ssh](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/restricted-ssh.html)). AWS Config can also stream notifications to an Amazon SNS topic, including notifications about the compliance state of resources and whether they are compliant with rules ([AWS Config SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/notifications-for-AWS-Config.html)). This is the fastest and lowest-operational-overhead solution because it uses a managed rule and managed notification integration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A custom Lambda monitor would require writing, testing, deploying, and maintaining code. AWS Config already provides a managed rule for exactly this SSH exposure condition, so Lambda adds unnecessary operational overhead.
- **C:** Notifying when an IAM role is assumed does not detect whether a security group rule actually allows SSH from `0.0.0.0/0`. It also describes overly broad permissions rather than compliance evaluation.
- **D:** An SCP can restrict who changes security groups, but it does not directly evaluate existing or newly created rules for the specific noncompliant SSH CIDR condition, nor does it provide the requested compliance notification with the least overhead.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师必须为一家公司的合规策略提供自动化解决方案，该策略规定安全组不能包含允许从 0.0.0.0/0 进行 SSH 访问的规则。如果策略发生任何违规，公司需要收到通知。需要尽快提供解决方案。解决方案架构师应怎么做才能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 脚本，用于监控安全组是否向 0.0.0.0/0 地址开放 SSH，并在每次发现时创建通知。
options.B: 启用 restricted-ssh AWS Config 托管规则，并在创建不合规规则时生成 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM 角色，使其具有全局开放安全组和网络 ACL 的权限。创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便每次该角色被用户代入时生成通知。
options.D: 配置一个 service control policy (SCP)，防止非管理员用户创建或编辑安全组。当用户请求需要管理员权限的规则时，在工单系统中创建通知。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Config 托管规则 **restricted-ssh** 是专门为此要求而设计的。AWS 文档说明，此规则会检查安全组的入站 SSH 流量；如果允许从 `0.0.0.0/0` 或 `::/0` 进行 SSH 访问，则将安全组标记为 **NON_COMPLIANT**；它适用于 `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup`，并由配置更改以及定期触发（[AWS Config restricted-ssh](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/restricted-ssh.html)）。AWS Config 还可以将通知流式传输到 Amazon SNS 主题，包括有关资源合规状态以及资源是否符合规则的通知（[AWS Config SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/notifications-for-AWS-Config.html)）。这是最快且运营开销最低的解决方案，因为它使用托管规则和托管通知集成。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 自定义 Lambda 监控器需要编写、测试、部署和维护代码。AWS Config 已经为这种 SSH 暴露条件提供了专门的托管规则，因此 Lambda 会增加不必要的运营开销。
- **C:** 在 IAM 角色被代入时发送通知，并不能检测安全组规则是否实际允许从 `0.0.0.0/0` 进行 SSH 访问。它描述的也是过于宽泛的权限，而不是合规性评估。
- **D:** SCP 可以限制谁能更改安全组，但它不会直接针对特定的不合规 SSH CIDR 条件评估现有或新创建的规则，也无法以最少开销提供所请求的合规通知。

en.question: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with Amazon EC2 worker nodes. A company has deployed an application in an AWS account. The application consists of microservices that run on AWS Lambda and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). A separate team supports each microservice. The company has multiple AWS accounts and wants to give each team its own account for its microservices. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that will provide service-to-service communication over HTTPS (port 443). The solution also must provide a service registry for service discovery. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Create an inspection VPC. Deploy an AWS Network Firewall firewall to the inspection VPC. Attach the inspection VPC to a new transit gateway. Route VPC-to-VPC traffic to the inspection VPC. Apply firewall rules to allow only HTTPS communication.
options.B: Create a VPC Lattice service network. Associate the microservices with the service network. Define HTTPS listeners for each service. Register microservice compute resources as targets. Identify VPCs that need to communicate with the services. Associate those VPCs with the service network.
options.C: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with an HTTPS listener and target groups for each microservice. Create an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service for each microservice. Create an interface VPC endpoint in each VPC that needs to consume that microservice.
options.D: Create peering connections between VPCs that contain microservices. Create a prefix list for each service that requires a connection to a client. Create route tables to route traffic to the appropriate VPC. Create security groups to allow only HTTPS communication.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

Amazon VPC Lattice is purpose-built for this scenario: it is a fully managed application networking service that can connect, secure, and monitor services **across multiple accounts and VPCs**, including Amazon EKS environments ([Amazon EKS VPC Lattice integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/integration-vpc-lattice.html)). A VPC Lattice service can run on EC2, EKS/ECS/Fargate containers, or Lambda functions, and uses target groups, listeners, and rules; supported target types include Lambda functions and Kubernetes Pods ([VPC Lattice key components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc-lattice/latest/ug/what-is-vpc-lattice.html)). A service network is a logical boundary where associated VPCs and services can communicate, and VPC Lattice provides a service directory and DNS-based service discovery for service-to-service traffic ([VPC Lattice features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc-lattice/latest/ug/what-is-vpc-lattice.html)). It also supports HTTPS listeners where you choose HTTPS and a port, and route to a VPC Lattice target group ([HTTPS listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc-lattice/latest/ug/https-listeners.html)). This directly matches the need for least-overhead HTTPS service-to-service communication and service discovery.

Why the other options are not best:

- **A**: AWS Network Firewall with an inspection VPC and transit gateway can inspect and control network traffic, but it does not provide an application service registry or service discovery for microservices. It also adds significant network routing and firewall administration.
- **C**: AWS PrivateLink can provide private connectivity, but an endpoint service requires a provider load balancer, and consumers create VPC endpoints to connect to endpoint services ([AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)). Doing this per microservice and per consuming VPC is more operationally complex and does not provide the same integrated service network/service registry model as VPC Lattice.
- **D**: VPC peering, route tables, prefix lists, and security groups provide network connectivity, but they do not provide a managed service registry or application-layer service discovery. Peering also creates high administrative overhead as the number of accounts/VPCs and microservices grows.

Therefore, **B** meets the requirements with the least administrative overhead.

zh.question: 将 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 与 Amazon EC2 工作节点结合使用。一家公司已在一个 AWS 账户中部署了一个应用程序。该应用程序由运行在 AWS Lambda 和 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上的微服务组成。每个微服务都由一个单独的团队支持。该公司有多个 AWS 账户，并希望为每个团队的微服务提供其自己的账户。解决方案架构师需要设计一个解决方案，通过 HTTPS（端口 443）提供服务到服务的通信。该解决方案还必须提供用于服务发现的服务注册表。哪种解决方案能以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个检查 VPC。将 AWS Network Firewall 防火墙部署到该检查 VPC。将该检查 VPC 附加到新的 transit gateway。将 VPC 到 VPC 的流量路由到该检查 VPC。应用防火墙规则，仅允许 HTTPS 通信。
options.B: 创建一个 VPC Lattice 服务网络。将微服务与该服务网络关联。为每个服务定义 HTTPS 侦听器。将微服务计算资源注册为目标。确定需要与这些服务通信的 VPC。将这些 VPC 与该服务网络关联。
options.C: 为每个微服务创建一个带有 HTTPS 侦听器和目标组的 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。为每个微服务创建一个 AWS PrivateLink 终端节点服务。在每个需要使用该微服务的 VPC 中创建一个接口 VPC 终端节点。
options.D: 在包含微服务的 VPC 之间创建对等连接。为每个需要连接到客户端的服务创建一个前缀列表。创建路由表以将流量路由到相应的 VPC。创建安全组以仅允许 HTTPS 通信。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

Amazon VPC Lattice 专为此场景而构建：它是一项完全托管的应用程序联网服务，可以连接、保护和监控**跨多个账户和 VPC** 的服务，包括 Amazon EKS 环境（[Amazon EKS VPC Lattice integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/integration-vpc-lattice.html)）。VPC Lattice 服务可以运行在 EC2、EKS/ECS/Fargate 容器或 Lambda 函数上，并使用目标组、侦听器和规则；支持的目标类型包括 Lambda 函数和 Kubernetes Pods（[VPC Lattice key components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc-lattice/latest/ug/what-is-vpc-lattice.html)）。服务网络是一个逻辑边界，关联的 VPC 和服务可在其中通信，并且 VPC Lattice 为服务到服务流量提供服务目录和基于 DNS 的服务发现（[VPC Lattice features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc-lattice/latest/ug/what-is-vpc-lattice.html)）。它还支持 HTTPS 侦听器，你可以在其中选择 HTTPS 和端口，并路由到 VPC Lattice 目标组（[HTTPS listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc-lattice/latest/ug/https-listeners.html)）。这直接满足了以最低开销实现 HTTPS 服务到服务通信和服务发现的需求。其他选项不是最佳选择的原因：

- **A**：使用检查 VPC 和 transit gateway 的 AWS Network Firewall 可以检查和控制网络流量，但它不提供应用程序服务注册表或微服务的服务发现。它还会增加大量网络路由和防火墙管理工作。
- **C**：AWS PrivateLink 可以提供私有连接，但终端节点服务需要提供方负载均衡器，并且使用方需要创建 VPC 终端节点来连接到终端节点服务（[AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)）。按每个微服务和每个使用方 VPC 执行此操作会带来更高的运维复杂性，并且不提供与 VPC Lattice 相同的集成式服务网络/服务注册表模型。
- **D**：VPC 对等连接、路由表、前缀列表和安全组可提供网络连接，但它们不提供托管服务注册表或应用层服务发现。随着账户/VPC 和微服务数量的增长，对等连接也会产生很高的管理开销。因此，**B** 以最少的管理开销满足这些要求。

en.question: A company has a mobile game that reads most of its metadata from an Amazon RDS DB instance. As the game increased in popularity, developers noticed slowdowns related to the game's metadata load times. Performance metrics indicate that simply scaling the database will not help. A solutions architect must explore all options that include capabilities for snapshots, replication, and sub-millisecond response times. What should the solutions architect recommend to solve these issues?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora with Aurora Replicas.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with global tables.
options.C: Add an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis layer in front of the database.
options.D: Add an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached layer in front of the database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Add an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis layer in front of the database.**

The workload is read-heavy for game metadata, and AWS states that an in-memory key-value cache provides **ultrafast submillisecond latency** and is appropriate when data is slow/expensive to get, accessed often, and relatively static. Caching query results lets the application retrieve the data repeatedly without re-executing database queries ([Common ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)). ElastiCache for Redis OSS also supports the required operational capabilities: replication with read replicas, Multi-AZ options, and backup/restore; AWS specifically notes that replication is available for Valkey/Redis OSS and not Memcached ([ElastiCache components and features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.Components.html)). ElastiCache snapshots/backups can be used to restore or seed a cache, and node-based backups are available for Redis OSS but not Memcached ([Snapshot and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/backups.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Aurora with Aurora Replicas**: This scales the database read layer, but the question says simply scaling the database will not help. It also does not provide the cache-based sub-millisecond metadata access pattern that AWS recommends for frequently accessed data.
- **B. DynamoDB with global tables**: DynamoDB could be fast and replicated, but this would require migrating the data model from an RDS relational database. The scenario asks for a solution to metadata load slowdowns where database scaling is not the answer; AWS guidance points to caching frequently accessed, relatively static database results.
- **D. ElastiCache for Memcached**: Memcached can be used as a cache, but it does not meet all stated requirements for this node-based cache use case. AWS documents that ElastiCache replication is available for Valkey/Redis OSS **not Memcached**, and that node-based backups are available for Redis OSS but **not** ElastiCache for Memcached.

zh.question: 一家公司有一款移动游戏，其大部分元数据都从一个 Amazon RDS DB instance 读取。随着游戏越来越受欢迎，开发人员注意到与游戏元数据加载时间相关的性能下降。性能指标表明，单纯扩展数据库并不能解决问题。解决方案架构师必须探索所有包含快照、复制和亚毫秒响应时间能力的选项。解决方案架构师应建议什么来解决这些问题？

options.A: 将数据库迁移到带有 Aurora Replicas 的 Amazon Aurora。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到带有 global tables 的 Amazon DynamoDB。
options.C: 在数据库前添加一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 层。
options.D: 在数据库前添加一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 层。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 在数据库前添加一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 层。**

该工作负载对于游戏元数据是读密集型的，并且 AWS 表示，内存中的键值缓存可提供 **ultrafast submillisecond latency**，适用于数据获取缓慢/昂贵、访问频繁且相对静态的情况。缓存查询结果可让应用程序反复检索数据，而无需重新执行数据库查询（[Common ElastiCache use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)）。ElastiCache for Redis OSS 还支持所需的运维能力：使用只读副本进行复制、Multi-AZ 选项以及备份/还原；AWS 特别指出，复制适用于 Valkey/Redis OSS，而不适用于 Memcached（[ElastiCache components and features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.Components.html)）。ElastiCache 快照/备份可用于还原或预置缓存，并且基于节点的备份适用于 Redis OSS，但不适用于 Memcached（[Snapshot and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/backups.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Aurora with Aurora Replicas**：这会扩展数据库读取层，但题目说明单纯扩展数据库并不能解决问题。它也没有提供 AWS 针对频繁访问数据所推荐的、基于缓存的亚毫秒元数据访问模式。
- **B. DynamoDB with global tables**：DynamoDB 可能很快并且支持复制，但这需要将数据模型从 RDS 关系数据库迁移出去。该场景要求为元数据加载缓慢提供解决方案，而数据库扩展并不是答案；AWS 指南指向缓存频繁访问、相对静态的数据库结果。
- **D. ElastiCache for Memcached**：Memcached 可以用作缓存，但对于这种基于节点的缓存用例，它不满足所有给定要求。AWS 文档说明 ElastiCache 复制适用于 Valkey/Redis OSS，**不适用于 Memcached**，并且基于节点的备份适用于 Redis OSS，但**不适用于** ElastiCache for Memcached。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations for its multi-account AWS setup. The security organizational unit (OU) of the company needs to share approved Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) with the development OU. The AMIs are created by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted snapshots. Which solution will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add the development team's OU Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to the launch permission list for the AMIs.
options.B: Add the Organizations root Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to the launch permission list for the AMIs.
options.C: Update the key policy to allow the development team's OU to use the AWS KMS keys that are used to decrypt the snapshots.
options.D: Add the development team’s account Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to the launch permission list for the AMIs.
options.E: Recreate the AWS KMS key. Add a key policy to allow the Organizations root Amazon Resource Name (ARN) to use the AWS KMS key.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and C**.

- **A is correct** because EC2 supports sharing an AMI directly with an AWS Organizations organization or OU by adding the full organization/OU ARN to the AMI launch permissions. The AWS CLI example grants launch permissions to a specified OU using `OrganizationalUnitArn` in `modify-image-attribute` ([Manage AMI sharing with an organization or OU](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/share-amis-org-ou-manage.html)).
- **C is correct** because the AMIs are backed by KMS-encrypted snapshots. AWS states that when sharing an AMI backed by encrypted snapshots, you must also allow the target organizations or OUs to use the KMS keys that encrypted those snapshots. The key policy can use `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` to allow specific OUs permissions such as `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:CreateGrant` ([Allow organizations and OUs to use a KMS key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/allow-org-ou-to-use-key.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **B** would share the AMI with the entire AWS Organizations root, not only the development OU. That is broader than required.
- **D** is not the best solution because the requirement is to share with the development **OU**, and AWS provides OU-based AMI sharing. Sharing account by account would not satisfy the OU-level sharing requirement as directly and would be less scalable.
- **E** is incorrect because there is no need to recreate the KMS key. The required action is to update the existing key policy to allow the appropriate OU to use the key; allowing the whole organization root would also be broader than required.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 进行其多账户 AWS 设置。该公司的安全组织单位（OU）需要与开发 OU 共享已批准的 Amazon Machine Images（AMIs）。这些 AMIs 是使用 AWS Key Management Service（AWS KMS）加密快照创建的。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将开发团队的 OU Amazon Resource Name（ARN）添加到 AMIs 的启动权限列表中。
options.B: 将 Organizations 根 Amazon Resource Name（ARN）添加到 AMIs 的启动权限列表中。
options.C: 更新密钥策略，以允许开发团队的 OU 使用用于解密快照的 AWS KMS keys。
options.D: 将开发团队的账户 Amazon Resource Name（ARN）添加到 AMIs 的启动权限列表中。
options.E: 重新创建 AWS KMS key。添加密钥策略，以允许 Organizations 根 Amazon Resource Name（ARN）使用 AWS KMS key。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A 和 C**。

- **A 正确**，因为 EC2 支持通过将完整的组织/OU ARN 添加到 AMI 启动权限中，直接与 AWS Organizations 组织或 OU 共享 AMI。AWS CLI 示例在 `modify-image-attribute` 中使用 `OrganizationalUnitArn` 向指定 OU 授予启动权限（[Manage AMI sharing with an organization or OU](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/share-amis-org-ou-manage.html)）。
- **C 正确**，因为这些 AMIs 由 KMS 加密快照支持。AWS 声明，在共享由加密快照支持的 AMI 时，还必须允许目标 organizations 或 OUs 使用加密这些快照的 KMS keys。密钥策略可以使用 `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` 来允许特定 OUs 拥有诸如 `kms:Decrypt` 和 `kms:CreateGrant` 等权限（[Allow organizations and OUs to use a KMS key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/allow-org-ou-to-use-key.html)）。错误选项：

- **B** 会将 AMI 共享给整个 AWS Organizations 根，而不仅仅是开发 OU。这比要求的范围更广。
- **D** 不是最佳解决方案，因为要求是与开发 **OU** 共享，并且 AWS 提供基于 OU 的 AMI 共享。逐个账户共享不能像 OU 级别共享那样直接满足要求，并且可扩展性较差。
- **E** 错误，因为无需重新创建 KMS key。所需操作是更新现有密钥策略，以允许适当的 OU 使用该密钥；允许整个组织根使用也会比要求的范围更广。

en.question: A data analytics company has 80 offices that are distributed globally. Each office hosts 1 PB of data and has between 1 and 2 Gbps of internet bandwidth. The company needs to perform a one-time migration of a large amount of data from its offices to Amazon S3. The company must complete the migration within 4 weeks. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Establish a new 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection to each office. Transfer the data to Amazon S3.
options.B: Use multiple AWS Snowball Edge storage-optimized devices to store and transfer the data to Amazon S3.
options.C: Use an AWS Snowmobile to store and transfer the data to Amazon S3.
options.D: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway to transfer the data to Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use multiple AWS Snowball Edge storage-optimized devices.**

Each office has **1 PB** and only **1–2 Gbps** of bandwidth. Even at 2 Gbps, transferring 1 PB over the network would take longer than 4 weeks in ideal conditions, and doing this across 80 offices would be operationally risky. AWS Snowball Edge is designed for this situation: AWS states that Snowball Edge transfers large amounts of data between onsite storage and Amazon S3 at **faster-than-internet speeds**, and that import jobs move data from an on-premises source to an S3 bucket. Snowball Edge can also import/export data between local environments and S3 by physically transporting **one or more devices without using the internet**. The storage-optimized Snowball Edge device provides **210 TB usable capacity**, so each 1 PB office can use multiple devices in parallel.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. Direct Connect to each office** – Provisioning a new 10 Gbps Direct Connect connection for **80 globally distributed offices** for a one-time migration is not the most cost-effective or practical approach. The requirement is a temporary bulk migration, and Snowball Edge avoids dependence on internet/WAN transfer by physically transporting devices to S3.
- **C. Snowmobile** – Snowmobile is not the best fit for data distributed across 80 offices. The Snowball Edge documentation specifically supports using **one or more devices** for local-environment-to-S3 transfers, which matches many distributed sites much better than a single large transport approach.
- **D. Storage Gateway Volume Gateway** – Volume Gateway is for iSCSI-backed cached or stored volumes. AWS notes that cached volumes can total up to **1 PiB per gateway**, but the data is stored as gateway volumes and snapshots; AWS also states that gateway data and snapshot data stored in S3 **cannot be accessed with the Amazon S3 API or S3 console**. That does not meet the requirement to perform a one-time migration of data into Amazon S3 objects, and it still depends on the office network bandwidth.

Sources: [Snowball Edge overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html), [Snowball Edge device hardware information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html), [Upload large amounts of data with Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html), [How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html).

zh.question: 一家数据分析公司在全球分布有 80 个办公室。每个办公室托管 1 PB 数据，并且有 1 到 2 Gbps 的互联网带宽。该公司需要执行一次性迁移，将大量数据从各办公室迁移到 Amazon S3。公司必须在 4 周内完成迁移。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个办公室建立一条新的 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect 连接。将数据传输到 Amazon S3。
options.B: 使用多个 AWS Snowball Edge 存储优化型设备来存储数据并将数据传输到 Amazon S3。
options.C: 使用 AWS Snowmobile 来存储数据并将数据传输到 Amazon S3。
options.D: 设置 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway 将数据传输到 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Use multiple AWS Snowball Edge storage-optimized devices.**

每个办公室都有 **1 PB** 数据，并且只有 **1–2 Gbps** 的带宽。即使在 2 Gbps 下，通过网络传输 1 PB 数据在理想条件下也会超过 4 周，而在 80 个办公室同时这样做会带来运营风险。AWS Snowball Edge 正是为这种情况而设计的：AWS 表示，Snowball Edge 能以**快于互联网的速度**在现场存储和 Amazon S3 之间传输大量数据，并且导入作业会将数据从本地源移动到 S3 bucket。Snowball Edge 还可以通过物理运输**一个或多个设备而不使用互联网**，在本地环境和 S3 之间导入/导出数据。存储优化型 Snowball Edge 设备提供 **210 TB usable capacity**，因此每个 1 PB 的办公室可以并行使用多个设备。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A. Direct Connect to each office** – 为 **80 个全球分布的办公室**分别预置新的 10 Gbps Direct Connect 连接来进行一次性迁移，并不是最具成本效益或最实际的方法。该要求是临时批量迁移，而 Snowball Edge 通过将设备物理运输到 S3，避免了对互联网/WAN 传输的依赖。
- **C. Snowmobile** – Snowmobile 并不最适合分布在 80 个办公室的数据。Snowball Edge 文档明确支持使用**一个或多个设备**在本地环境与 S3 之间进行传输，这比单一大型运输方式更适合许多分布式站点。
- **D. Storage Gateway Volume Gateway** – Volume Gateway 用于基于 iSCSI 的缓存卷或存储卷。AWS 指出，缓存卷总计最高可达 **1 PiB per gateway**，但数据会作为网关卷和快照存储；AWS 还表示，存储在 S3 中的网关数据和快照数据**无法通过 Amazon S3 API 或 S3 console 访问**。这不满足将数据一次性迁移为 Amazon S3 objects 的要求，并且仍然依赖办公室网络带宽。来源：[Snowball Edge overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html), [Snowball Edge device hardware information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/device-differences.html), [Upload large amounts of data with Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-plan-input-snowball.html), [How Volume Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/StorageGatewayConcepts.html).

en.question: A company has an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that contains a reference dataset. The company has applications on Amazon EC2 instances that need to read the dataset. However, the applications must not be able to change the dataset. The company wants to use IAM access control to prevent the applications from being able to modify or delete the dataset. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Mount the EFS file system in read-only mode from within the EC2 instances.
options.B: Create a resource policy for the EFS file system that denies the elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite action to the IAM roles that are attached to the EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an identity policy for the EFS file system that denies the elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite action on the EFS file system.
options.D: Create an EFS access point for each application. Use Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX) file permissions to allow read-only access to files in the root directory.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon EFS supports IAM authorization for NFS clients through a **file system policy**. AWS lists `elasticfilesystem:ClientMount` as providing **read-only access** and `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite` as providing **write permissions** to a file system in an EFS file system policy ([Using IAM to control access to file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/iam-access-control-nfs-efs.html)). AWS also provides an EFS resource-based policy example that grants only `ClientMount` to an IAM role for read-only access ([Resource-based policy examples for Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/security_iam_resource-based-policy-examples.html)). Therefore, creating an EFS resource policy that denies `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite` to the EC2 instance roles uses IAM access control to prevent modifying or deleting the dataset.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Mounting the file system read-only is a client-side mount configuration, not IAM access control. It does not centrally enforce the requirement through IAM policy.
- **C:** IAM **identity-based policies** are attached to an IAM user, group, or role, while **resource-based policies** are attached to a resource and specify who can access it and what actions they can perform ([Identity-based policies and resource-based policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_identity-vs-resource.html)). The option describes creating an identity policy “for the EFS file system,” which is not the right policy type for the EFS resource itself.
- **D:** POSIX file permissions and EFS access points are not IAM access control for `ClientWrite`. The question specifically asks to use IAM access control to prevent modifications/deletions, making an EFS file system policy the appropriate solution.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，其中包含一个参考数据集。该公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的应用程序需要读取该数据集。但是，这些应用程序不得更改该数据集。公司希望使用 IAM 访问控制来防止应用程序修改或删除该数据集。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 EC2 实例内部以只读模式挂载 EFS 文件系统。
options.B: 为 EFS 文件系统创建一个资源策略，拒绝附加到 EC2 实例的 IAM 角色执行 elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite 操作。
options.C: 为 EFS 文件系统创建一个身份策略，拒绝对该 EFS 文件系统执行 elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite 操作。
options.D: 为每个应用程序创建一个 EFS 接入点。使用 Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX) 文件权限，允许对根目录中的文件进行只读访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon EFS 通过 **file system policy** 支持对 NFS 客户端进行 IAM 授权。AWS 在 EFS 文件系统策略中将 `elasticfilesystem:ClientMount` 列为提供**只读访问**，并将 `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite` 列为提供对文件系统的**写入权限**（[Using IAM to control access to file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/iam-access-control-nfs-efs.html)）。AWS 还提供了一个 EFS 基于资源的策略示例，该示例仅向 IAM 角色授予 `ClientMount` 以实现只读访问（[Resource-based policy examples for Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/security_iam_resource-based-policy-examples.html)）。因此，创建一个 EFS 资源策略来拒绝 EC2 实例角色执行 `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite`，就是使用 IAM 访问控制来防止修改或删除数据集。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 以只读方式挂载文件系统是客户端侧的挂载配置，不是 IAM 访问控制。它不能通过 IAM 策略集中强制执行该要求。
- **C:** IAM **基于身份的策略**附加到 IAM 用户、组或角色，而**基于资源的策略**附加到资源，并指定谁可以访问该资源以及可以执行哪些操作（[Identity-based policies and resource-based policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_identity-vs-resource.html)）。该选项描述的是“为 EFS 文件系统”创建身份策略，这并不是 EFS 资源本身所需的正确策略类型。
- **D:** POSIX 文件权限和 EFS 接入点并不是针对 `ClientWrite` 的 IAM 访问控制。题目明确要求使用 IAM 访问控制来防止修改/删除，因此 EFS 文件系统策略才是合适的解决方案。

en.question: A company has hired an external vendor to perform work in the company’s AWS account. The vendor uses an automated tool that is hosted in an AWS account that the vendor owns. The vendor does not have IAM access to the company’s AWS account. The company needs to grant the vendor access to the company’s AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Create an IAM role in the company’s account to delegate access to the vendor’s IAM role. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the role for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.B: Create an IAM user in the company’s account with a password that meets the password complexity requirements. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.C: Create an IAM group in the company’s account. Add the automated tool’s IAM user from the vendor account to the group. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the group for the permissions that the vendor requires.
options.D: Create an IAM user in the company’s account that has a permission boundary that allows the vendor’s account. Attach the appropriate IAM policies to the user for the permissions that the vendor requires.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The most secure approach is to create an IAM role in the company account with a trust policy that allows the vendor’s AWS account or specific vendor IAM role to assume it, and attach only the permissions the vendor needs. AWS describes delegation as creating an IAM role in the trusting account with a permissions policy for the required access and a trust policy specifying which trusted account members can assume the role. AWS also states that roles are the primary way to grant cross-account access and provide temporary security credentials instead of long-term credentials ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)). For third-party vendors, AWS specifically says not to give the third party an IAM user with long-term credentials; instead, use an IAM role and temporary security credentials, optionally requiring an external ID to protect against the confused deputy problem ([third-party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Creating an IAM user in the company account gives the vendor long-term credentials. AWS explicitly says for third-party account access, do **not** give the third party access to an IAM user and long-term credentials; use an IAM role instead ([third-party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)).
- **C:** You cannot add an IAM user from another AWS account to an IAM group in the company account. Cross-account access is delegated by creating a role in the trusting account and allowing the trusted account to assume it ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)).
- **D:** A permissions boundary limits the maximum permissions of an IAM identity; it does not “allow” an external account to access the company account. This option also still creates an IAM user with long-term credentials, which is not the recommended secure pattern for this AWS-hosted vendor tool scenario ([IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html), [third-party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司聘请了一家外部供应商在该公司的 AWS 账户中执行工作。该供应商使用一个托管在供应商自有 AWS 账户中的自动化工具。供应商没有对该公司 AWS 账户的 IAM 访问权限。公司需要授予供应商访问该公司 AWS 账户的权限。哪种解决方案能够以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在公司账户中创建一个 IAM 角色，以将访问权限委派给供应商的 IAM 角色。将适当的 IAM 策略附加到该角色，以授予供应商所需的权限。
options.B: 在公司账户中创建一个 IAM 用户，并设置符合密码复杂性要求的密码。将适当的 IAM 策略附加到该用户，以授予供应商所需的权限。
options.C: 在公司账户中创建一个 IAM 组。将供应商账户中自动化工具的 IAM 用户添加到该组。将适当的 IAM 策略附加到该组，以授予供应商所需的权限。
options.D: 在公司账户中创建一个 IAM 用户，并为其设置一个允许供应商账户的权限边界。将适当的 IAM 策略附加到该用户，以授予供应商所需的权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

最安全的方法是在公司账户中创建一个 IAM 角色，并配置一个信任策略，允许供应商的 AWS 账户或特定的供应商 IAM 角色代入该角色，同时只附加供应商所需的权限。AWS 将委派描述为：在信任账户中创建一个 IAM 角色，并为所需访问权限配置权限策略，同时配置信任策略来指定哪些受信任账户成员可以代入该角色。AWS 还说明，角色是授予跨账户访问权限的主要方式，并提供临时安全凭证，而不是长期凭证（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)）。对于第三方供应商，AWS 明确表示不要向第三方提供带有长期凭证的 IAM 用户；应改用 IAM 角色和临时安全凭证，并可选择要求外部 ID，以防范 confused deputy problem（[third-party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 在公司账户中创建 IAM 用户会向供应商提供长期凭证。AWS 明确表示，对于第三方账户访问，不要向第三方提供 IAM 用户和长期凭证；应改用 IAM 角色（[third-party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。
- **C:** 你不能将另一个 AWS 账户中的 IAM 用户添加到公司账户中的 IAM 组。跨账户访问是通过在信任账户中创建角色并允许受信任账户代入该角色来委派的（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html)）。
- **D:** 权限边界用于限制 IAM 身份的最大权限；它不会“允许”外部账户访问公司账户。此选项仍然创建了带有长期凭证的 IAM 用户，这并不是此 AWS 托管供应商工具场景中推荐的安全模式（[IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles.html), [third-party access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to run its experimental workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company has a budget for cloud spending. The company's CFO is concerned about cloud spending accountability for each department. The CFO wants to receive notification when the spending threshold reaches 60% of the budget. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use cost allocation tags on AWS resources to label owners. Create usage budgets in AWS Budgets. Add an alert threshold to receive notification when spending exceeds 60% of the budget.
options.B: Use AWS Cost Explorer forecasts to determine resource owners. Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection to create alert threshold notifications when spending exceeds 60% of the budget.
options.C: Use cost allocation tags on AWS resources to label owners. Use AWS Support API on AWS Trusted Advisor to create alert threshold notifications when spending exceeds 60% of the budget.
options.D: Use AWS Cost Explorer forecasts to determine resource owners. Create usage budgets in AWS Budgets. Add an alert threshold to receive notification when spending exceeds 60% of the budget.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Cost accountability by department or owner is addressed with **cost allocation tags**. AWS states that tags are labels assigned to resources and that cost allocation tags let you track AWS costs in detail; tags can represent business categories such as **cost centers, application names, or owners** to organize costs across services ([AWS Billing: cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). For threshold notifications, **AWS Budgets** is the right service: AWS Budgets can track costs and usage, and cost budgets set spending limits and send alerts when costs approach or exceed a defined threshold; notifications can be sent by email or Amazon SNS ([AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)). Therefore, tagging resources by owner/department and configuring an AWS Budgets alert at 60% meets both accountability and notification requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Cost Explorer can analyze historical costs and forecast future spend, but it does not “determine resource owners.” Owners/departments should be identified with tags. Cost Anomaly Detection is for detecting anomalous spend, not for a fixed 60% budget threshold.
- **C:** Cost allocation tags are appropriate, but AWS Trusted Advisor/AWS Support API is not the service for budget threshold notifications. AWS Budgets provides budget alerts.
- **D:** AWS Budgets is appropriate for alerts, but Cost Explorer forecasts do not determine resource owners. Resource ownership/accountability should come from cost allocation tags, not forecasts ([Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望在 AWS Cloud 中运行其实验性工作负载。该公司有云支出预算。公司的 CFO 关注每个部门的云支出责任归属。CFO 希望在支出阈值达到预算的 60% 时收到通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS 资源上使用成本分配标签来标记所有者。在 AWS Budgets 中创建使用量预算。添加一个警报阈值，以便在支出超过预算的 60% 时收到通知。
options.B: 使用 AWS Cost Explorer 预测来确定资源所有者。使用 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 创建警报阈值通知，以便在支出超过预算的 60% 时收到通知。
options.C: 在 AWS 资源上使用成本分配标签来标记所有者。使用 AWS Trusted Advisor 上的 AWS Support API 创建警报阈值通知，以便在支出超过预算的 60% 时收到通知。
options.D: 使用 AWS Cost Explorer 预测来确定资源所有者。在 AWS Budgets 中创建使用量预算。添加一个警报阈值，以便在支出超过预算的 60% 时收到通知。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

按部门或所有者进行成本责任归属可通过 **cost allocation tags** 来实现。AWS 表示，标签是分配给资源的标记，而成本分配标签可让你详细跟踪 AWS 成本；标签可以表示业务类别，例如 **cost centers, application names, or owners**，用于跨服务组织成本（[AWS Billing: cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。对于阈值通知，**AWS Budgets** 是合适的服务：AWS Budgets 可以跟踪成本和使用量，成本预算可以设置支出限制，并在成本接近或超过定义的阈值时发送警报；通知可以通过电子邮件或 Amazon SNS 发送（[AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)）。因此，按所有者/部门为资源打标签，并在 AWS Budgets 中配置 60% 的警报，可以同时满足责任归属和通知要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** Cost Explorer 可以分析历史成本并预测未来支出，但它不会“确定资源所有者”。所有者/部门应通过标签来识别。Cost Anomaly Detection 用于检测异常支出，而不是用于固定的 60% 预算阈值。
- **C:** 成本分配标签是合适的，但 AWS Trusted Advisor/AWS Support API 不是用于预算阈值通知的服务。AWS Budgets 提供预算警报。
- **D:** AWS Budgets 适用于警报，但 Cost Explorer 预测不会确定资源所有者。资源所有权/责任归属应来自成本分配标签，而不是预测（[Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to deploy an internal web application on AWS. The web application must be accessible only from the company's office. The company needs to download security patches for the web application from the internet. The company has created a VPC and has configured an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection to the company's office. A solutions architect must design a secure architecture for the web application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the web application on Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets behind a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). Attach an internet gateway to the VPC. Set the inbound source of the ALB's security group to 0.0.0.0/0.
options.B: Deploy the web application on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets behind an internal Application Load Balancer (ALB). Deploy NAT gateways in public subnets. Attach an internet gateway to the VPC. Set the inbound source of the ALB's security group to the company's office network CIDR block.
options.C: Deploy the web application on Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets behind an internal Application Load Balancer (ALB). Deploy NAT gateways in private subnets. Attach an internet gateway to the VPSet the outbound destination of the ALB’s security group to the company's office network CIDR block.
options.D: Deploy the web application on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets behind a public Application Load Balancer (ALB). Attach an internet gateway to the VPC. Set the outbound destination of the ALB’s security group to 0.0.0.0/0.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The application must be reachable only from the company office, but the EC2 instances also need outbound internet access for patch downloads. An **internal ALB** is appropriate because AWS states that internal load balancer nodes have only private IP addresses and can route requests only from clients that have access to the VPC; the existing Site-to-Site VPN provides private connectivity between the office network and the VPC ([Elastic Load Balancing: load balancer scheme](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). Placing EC2 instances in **private subnets** keeps them from being directly internet-accessible. For patching, AWS documents that a **public NAT gateway** enables instances in a private subnet to send outbound traffic to the internet while preventing the internet from initiating connections to those instances; the NAT gateway is placed in a public subnet and uses an internet gateway for internet access ([NAT gateway use case: private subnet internet access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)). Restricting the ALB security group inbound source to the office CIDR is also valid because security group inbound rules specify the allowed source CIDR, and security groups have no inbound access until rules are added ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A public ALB with inbound source `0.0.0.0/0` exposes the application to the internet, violating the requirement that it be accessible only from the office.
- **C:** NAT gateways for internet egress from private resources should be in public subnets with a route to an internet gateway; this option places NAT gateways in private subnets. It also puts the web instances in public subnets and incorrectly focuses on the ALB outbound rule instead of restricting inbound client access.
- **D:** A public ALB is internet-facing, so it does not satisfy the “office only” access requirement. Also, merely attaching an internet gateway does not give private-subnet instances outbound internet access; private subnets need routing through a NAT gateway for IPv4 internet egress. AWS defines a subnet with an internet-gateway route as public and a subnet without one as private ([Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望在 AWS 上部署一个内部 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序必须只能从公司的办公室访问。公司需要从互联网为该 Web 应用程序下载安全补丁。公司已经创建了一个 VPC，并已配置从 AWS 到公司办公室的 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。解决方案架构师必须为该 Web 应用程序设计一个安全架构。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Web 应用程序部署在 public subnets 中、位于 public Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。将 internet gateway 附加到 VPC。将 ALB 的 security group 的入站来源设置为 0.0.0.0/0。
options.B: 将 Web 应用程序部署在 private subnets 中、位于 internal Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。在 public subnets 中部署 NAT gateways。将 internet gateway 附加到 VPC。将 ALB 的 security group 的入站来源设置为公司的办公网络 CIDR 块。
options.C: 将 Web 应用程序部署在 public subnets 中、位于 internal Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。在 private subnets 中部署 NAT gateways。将 internet gateway 附加到 VPSet 将 ALB’s security group 的出站目标设置为公司的办公网络 CIDR 块。
options.D: 将 Web 应用程序部署在 private subnets 中、位于 public Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。将 internet gateway 附加到 VPC。将 ALB’s security group 的出站目标设置为 0.0.0.0/0。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该应用程序必须只能从公司办公室访问，但 EC2 实例还需要出站互联网访问来下载补丁。**internal ALB** 是合适的，因为 AWS 说明 internal load balancer 节点只有私有 IP 地址，并且只能从有权访问 VPC 的客户端路由请求；现有的 Site-to-Site VPN 在办公网络和 VPC 之间提供私有连接（[Elastic Load Balancing: load balancer scheme](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。将 EC2 实例放在 **private subnets** 中，可以防止它们直接从互联网访问。对于打补丁，AWS 文档说明 **public NAT gateway** 使 private subnet 中的实例能够向互联网发送出站流量，同时防止互联网向这些实例发起连接；NAT gateway 放置在 public subnet 中，并使用 internet gateway 进行互联网访问（[NAT gateway use case: private subnet internet access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)）。将 ALB security group 的入站来源限制为办公室 CIDR 也是有效的，因为 security group 入站规则指定允许的来源 CIDR，并且在添加规则之前，security groups 没有任何入站访问（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 使用入站来源 `0.0.0.0/0` 的 public ALB 会将应用程序暴露给互联网，违反了只能从办公室访问的要求。
- **C:** 用于 private 资源互联网出站的 NAT gateways 应位于 public subnets 中，并具有到 internet gateway 的路由；此选项将 NAT gateways 放在 private subnets 中。它还将 Web 实例放在 public subnets 中，并且错误地关注 ALB 出站规则，而不是限制入站客户端访问。
- **D:** public ALB 是面向互联网的，因此不满足“仅办公室”访问要求。此外，仅附加 internet gateway 并不会为 private-subnet 实例提供出站互联网访问；private subnets 需要通过 NAT gateway 路由来进行 IPv4 互联网出站。AWS 将具有 internet-gateway 路由的子网定义为 public，将没有该路由的子网定义为 private（[Internet gateway basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/VPC_Internet_Gateway.html)）。

en.question: A company maintains its accounting records in a custom application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to migrate the data to an AWS managed service for development and maintenance of the application data. The solution must require minimal operational support and provide immutable, cryptographically verifiable logs of data changes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Copy the records from the application into an Amazon Redshift cluster.
options.B: Copy the records from the application into an Amazon Neptune cluster.
options.C: Copy the records from the application into an Amazon Timestream database.
options.D: Copy the records from the application into an Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) ledger.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Copy the records into an Amazon QLDB ledger.**

Amazon QLDB is the service that directly matches the key requirements: AWS documentation describes it as a **fully managed ledger database** that provides a **transparent, immutable, and cryptographically verifiable transaction log**, and that tracks application data changes while maintaining a complete, verifiable history over time ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/serverless-multi-tier-architectures-api-gateway-lambda/serverless-data-storage-options.html)). This fits accounting records and minimizes operational support because it is managed by AWS.

Why the other options are not the best fit:

- **A. Amazon Redshift** is a data warehouse for analytics; AWS describes it as a petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse for fast SQL query performance ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). It does not natively provide an immutable, cryptographically verifiable ledger of data changes.
- **B. Amazon Neptune** is a fully managed graph database for highly connected datasets ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/choosing-an-aws-nosql-database/amazon-neptune.html)). It is not designed as a cryptographically verifiable accounting ledger.
- **C. Amazon Timestream** is a managed time series database for time-stamped data such as IoT and operational logs ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/choosing-an-aws-nosql-database/amazon-timestream.html)). It does not provide QLDB’s immutable and cryptographically verifiable transaction log capability.

zh.question: 一家公司在运行于 Amazon EC2 实例上的自定义应用程序中维护其会计记录。该公司需要将数据迁移到一项 AWS 托管服务，以便对应用程序数据进行开发和维护。该解决方案必须需要最少的运维支持，并提供不可变且可通过加密方式验证的数据更改日志。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将记录从应用程序复制到 Amazon Redshift 集群中。
options.B: 将记录从应用程序复制到 Amazon Neptune 集群中。
options.C: 将记录从应用程序复制到 Amazon Timestream 数据库中。
options.D: 将记录从应用程序复制到 Amazon Quantum Ledger Database (Amazon QLDB) 账本中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 将记录复制到 Amazon QLDB 账本中。**

Amazon QLDB 是直接匹配关键要求的服务：AWS 文档将其描述为一种**完全托管的账本数据库**，可提供**透明、不可变且可通过加密方式验证的事务日志**，并且能够跟踪应用程序数据更改，同时随时间维护完整且可验证的历史记录（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/serverless-multi-tier-architectures-api-gateway-lambda/serverless-data-storage-options.html)）。这适用于会计记录，并且由于它由 AWS 托管，因此可最大限度减少运维支持。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A. Amazon Redshift** 是用于分析的数据仓库；AWS 将其描述为 PB 级云数据仓库，可提供快速 SQL 查询性能（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。它并不原生提供不可变且可通过加密方式验证的数据更改账本。
- **B. Amazon Neptune** 是一种完全托管的图数据库，用于高度互联的数据集（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/choosing-an-aws-nosql-database/amazon-neptune.html)）。它并非设计为可通过加密方式验证的会计账本。
- **C. Amazon Timestream** 是一种托管的时间序列数据库，用于带时间戳的数据，例如 IoT 和运营日志（[AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/choosing-an-aws-nosql-database/amazon-timestream.html)）。它不提供 QLDB 的不可变且可通过加密方式验证的事务日志能力。
