Amazon S3 Event Notifications are appropriate because S3 can publish notifications for **new object created events** and can send those notifications directly to an **AWS Lambda function** ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). The Lambda function can then call Amazon Comprehend. Amazon Comprehend is designed for text analysis: it uses NLP to extract insights from documents, including **entities** and **key phrases**, and it can use **pre-trained models** so there is no need to provide training data ([What is Amazon Comprehend?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)). Comprehend entity detection returns detected entity objects with confidence scores, which the application can tolerate because it can handle non-food records and errors ([Entities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/how-entities.html)). This is the most cost-effective, serverless, managed approach among the options.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Amazon Forecast is not a text extraction/NLP service. Its predictors train models from **time series datasets** to generate forecasts and predictions ([Amazon Forecast Algorithms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/aws-forecast-choosing-recipes.html)). It is not suitable for extracting ingredient names from recipe text.
- **C:** Amazon Polly/text-to-speech plus employee review is a manual workflow, adds unnecessary operational overhead, and is not cost-effective compared with automated NLP using Comprehend.
- **D:** Amazon SageMaker is for authoring and managing ML workflows, such as pipelines in SageMaker Studio ([Pipelines actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/pipelines-build.html)). Using SageMaker would require building or managing a custom ML inference solution, which conflicts with the requirement that the company has no ML expertise and is less cost-effective than using Comprehend’s managed NLP capabilities.

zh.question: 一家公司需要从存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中、以文本文件形式保存的食谱记录中提取食材名称。一个 Web 应用程序将使用这些食材名称查询 Amazon DynamoDB 表并确定营养评分。该应用程序能够处理非食品记录和错误。该公司没有具备机器学习知识的员工来开发此解决方案。哪种解决方案能以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使用 Amazon Comprehend 分析对象并提取食材名称。将 Amazon Comprehend 输出存储在 DynamoDB 表中。
options.B: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使用 Amazon Forecast 分析对象以提取食材名称。将 Forecast 输出存储在 DynamoDB 表中。
options.C: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon Polly 为食谱记录创建音频录音。将音频文件保存在 S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 将 URL 作为消息发送给员工。指示员工收听音频文件并计算营养评分。将食材名称存储在 DynamoDB 表中。
options.D: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则在发生 PutObject 请求时调用 AWS Lambda 函数。编写 Lambda 函数，使用 Amazon SageMaker 分析对象并提取食材名称。将来自 SageMaker 端点的推理输出存储在 DynamoDB 表中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon S3 Event Notifications 是合适的，因为 S3 可以针对**新对象创建事件**发布通知，并且可以将这些通知直接发送到 **AWS Lambda function**（[Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。然后 Lambda 函数可以调用 Amazon Comprehend。Amazon Comprehend 专为文本分析而设计：它使用 NLP 从文档中提取洞察，包括**实体**和**关键短语**，并且可以使用**预训练模型**，因此无需提供训练数据（[What is Amazon Comprehend?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。Comprehend 实体检测会返回检测到的实体对象以及置信度分数，应用程序可以容忍这一点，因为它能够处理非食品记录和错误（[Entities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/how-entities.html)）。这是这些选项中最具成本效益的无服务器托管方法。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Amazon Forecast 不是文本提取/NLP 服务。它的预测器从**时间序列数据集**训练模型，以生成预测和预报（[Amazon Forecast Algorithms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/forecast/latest/dg/aws-forecast-choosing-recipes.html)）。它不适合从食谱文本中提取食材名称。
- **C:** Amazon Polly/文本转语音加上员工审核是一个手动工作流，会增加不必要的运营开销，并且与使用 Comprehend 进行自动化 NLP 相比不具成本效益。
- **D:** Amazon SageMaker 用于创建和管理 ML 工作流，例如 SageMaker Studio 中的管道（[Pipelines actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/latest/dg/pipelines-build.html)）。使用 SageMaker 将需要构建或管理自定义 ML 推理解决方案，这与公司没有 ML 专业知识的要求相冲突，并且不如使用 Comprehend 的托管 NLP 功能具有成本效益。

en.question: A company needs to create an AWS Lambda function that will run in a VPC in the company's primary AWS account. The Lambda function needs to access files that the company stores in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. The EFS file system is located in a secondary AWS account. As the company adds files to the file system, the solution must scale to meet the demand. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a new EFS file system in the primary account. Use AWS DataSync to copy the contents of the original EFS file system to the new EFS file system.
options.B: Create a VPC peering connection between the VPCs that are in the primary account and the secondary account.
options.C: Create a second Lambda function in the secondary account that has a mount that is configured for the file system. Use the primary account's Lambda function to invoke the secondary account's Lambda function.
options.D: Move the contents of the file system to a Lambda layer. Configure the Lambda layer's permissions to allow the company's secondary account to use the Lambda layer.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

AWS Lambda can mount Amazon EFS so that function code can access shared files, and AWS states that EFS is a serverless file system that **scales automatically with workloads** and supports safe shared access at high concurrency ([Configuring Amazon EFS file system access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html)). For a Lambda function that needs access to a resource in another account through VPC networking, AWS documents using a **VPC peering connection** between the function VPC and the resource VPC, including creating the peering request and adding routes for the peer VPC CIDR ([Giving Lambda functions access to a resource in an Amazon VPC in another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-cross-account.html)). The Lambda EFS documentation also explicitly discusses charges only when the function VPC is **peered to another VPC with a file system**, confirming this as the intended cross-VPC pattern ([Configuring Amazon EFS file system access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html)). This avoids duplicating storage or adding extra Lambda indirection, so it is the most cost-effective option.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Creating another EFS file system and using DataSync duplicates the storage environment and requires ongoing synchronization as files are added. This adds unnecessary storage and transfer/operational cost when the Lambda function can access the existing EFS file system through VPC connectivity.
- **C**: A second Lambda function in the secondary account adds extra compute, invocation, and operational complexity. It also does not provide direct file-system access to the primary Lambda function; VPC peering is the documented way to give the function access to a VPC resource in another account.
- **D**: Lambda layers are not a scalable file-storage solution for continuously added files. The requirement is to access files in EFS, and AWS documents EFS as the scalable shared file system for Lambda workloads, not layers.

zh.question: 一家公司需要创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将在公司主 AWS 账户中的 VPC 内运行。该 Lambda 函数需要访问公司存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中的文件。该 EFS 文件系统位于一个辅助 AWS 账户中。随着公司向文件系统添加文件，该解决方案必须能够扩展以满足需求。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 在主账户中创建一个新的 EFS 文件系统。使用 AWS DataSync 将原始 EFS 文件系统的内容复制到新的 EFS 文件系统。
options.B: 在主账户和辅助账户中的 VPC 之间创建 VPC peering connection。
options.C: 在辅助账户中创建第二个 Lambda 函数，并为该文件系统配置挂载。使用主账户的 Lambda 函数来调用辅助账户的 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 将文件系统的内容移动到 Lambda layer。配置该 Lambda layer 的权限，以允许公司的辅助账户使用该 Lambda layer。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

AWS Lambda 可以挂载 Amazon EFS，以便函数代码访问共享文件，并且 AWS 表示 EFS 是一种 serverless 文件系统，**会随工作负载自动扩展**，并支持在高并发情况下进行安全的共享访问（[Configuring Amazon EFS file system access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html)）。对于需要通过 VPC 网络访问另一个账户中资源的 Lambda 函数，AWS 文档说明应在函数 VPC 和资源 VPC 之间使用 **VPC peering connection**，包括创建 peering 请求并为对等 VPC CIDR 添加路由（[Giving Lambda functions access to a resource in an Amazon VPC in another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-cross-account.html)）。Lambda EFS 文档还明确讨论了仅当函数 VPC **peered to another VPC with a file system** 时产生的费用，从而确认这是预期的跨 VPC 模式（[Configuring Amazon EFS file system access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html)）。这避免了重复存储或添加额外的 Lambda 间接调用，因此它是最具成本效益的选项。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：创建另一个 EFS 文件系统并使用 DataSync 会复制存储环境，并且在添加文件时需要持续同步。当 Lambda 函数可以通过 VPC 连接访问现有 EFS 文件系统时，这会增加不必要的存储以及传输/运营成本。
- **C**：在辅助账户中创建第二个 Lambda 函数会增加额外的计算、调用和运营复杂性。它也不能为主 Lambda 函数提供直接的文件系统访问；VPC peering 是文档中说明的、用于让函数访问另一个账户中 VPC 资源的方式。
- **D**：Lambda layers 不是适用于持续添加文件的可扩展文件存储解决方案。要求是访问 EFS 中的文件，而 AWS 文档将 EFS 定位为适用于 Lambda 工作负载的可扩展共享文件系统，而不是 layers。

en.question: A financial company needs to handle highly sensitive data. The company will store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to ensure that the data is encrypted in transit and at rest. The company must manage the encryption keys outside the AWS Cloud. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE) that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.
options.B: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with server-side encryption (SSE) that uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key.
options.C: Encrypt the data in the S3 bucket with the default server-side encryption (SSE).
options.D: Encrypt the data at the company's data center before storing the data in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Encrypting the data at the company’s data center before uploading it to Amazon S3 is client-side/local encryption. AWS states that client-side encryption is “encrypting your data locally” and helps ensure security “in transit and at rest”; with this approach, S3 receives the objects already encrypted and “does not play a role in encrypting or decrypting” them, so the company can manage the keys outside AWS ([Amazon S3 client-side encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingClientSideEncryption.html)). Encryption in transit to S3 can also be enforced with HTTPS/TLS; S3 documentation says HTTPS encrypts data using TLS and that HTTPS-only communication can be enforced with policies ([Amazon S3 encryption in transit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. SSE-KMS with a customer managed key** encrypts data at rest using AWS KMS, but the key is managed in AWS KMS, not outside the AWS Cloud. AWS describes SSE-KMS as server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys for more control over key rotation and access policies ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)).
- **B. SSE-KMS with an AWS managed key** also uses AWS KMS and therefore does not meet the requirement to manage keys outside AWS.
- **C. Default server-side encryption** uses Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) by default, so the encryption keys are managed by AWS/S3, not by the company outside AWS ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家金融公司需要处理高度敏感的数据。公司将把数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司需要确保数据在传输中和静态存储时都经过加密。公司必须在 AWS Cloud 外部管理加密密钥。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用采用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE) 对 S3 存储桶中的数据进行加密。
options.B: 使用采用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS 托管密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE) 对 S3 存储桶中的数据进行加密。
options.C: 使用默认服务器端加密 (SSE) 对 S3 存储桶中的数据进行加密。
options.D: 在将数据存储到 S3 存储桶之前，先在公司的数据中心对数据进行加密。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 在将数据上传到 Amazon S3 之前，先在公司的数据中心对数据进行加密，这是客户端/本地加密。AWS 表示，客户端加密是“在本地加密你的数据”，并有助于确保“传输中和静态存储时”的安全；采用这种方法时，S3 接收到的对象已经加密，并且“不会参与加密或解密”它们，因此公司可以在 AWS 外部管理密钥（[Amazon S3 client-side encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingClientSideEncryption.html)）。传输到 S3 过程中的加密也可以通过 HTTPS/TLS 强制执行；S3 文档说明 HTTPS 使用 TLS 加密数据，并且可以通过策略强制仅使用 HTTPS 通信（[Amazon S3 encryption in transit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. 使用客户托管密钥的 SSE-KMS** 使用 AWS KMS 对静态数据进行加密，但密钥是在 AWS KMS 中管理的，而不是在 AWS Cloud 外部管理。AWS 将 SSE-KMS 描述为使用 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密，以便更好地控制密钥轮换和访问策略（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。
- **B. 使用 AWS 托管密钥的 SSE-KMS** 也使用 AWS KMS，因此不满足在 AWS 外部管理密钥的要求。
- **C. 默认服务器端加密** 默认使用 Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)，因此加密密钥由 AWS/S3 管理，而不是由公司在 AWS 外部管理（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to run its payment application on AWS. The application receives payment notifications from mobile devices. Payment notifications require a basic validation before they are sent for further processing. The backend processing application is long running and requires compute and memory to be adjusted. The company does not want to manage the infrastructure. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Integrate the queue with an Amazon EventBridge rule to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Configure the rule to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) Anywhere. Create a standalone cluster.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Integrate the API with an AWS Step Functions state machine to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Invoke the state machine to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Configure an EKS cluster with self-managed nodes.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Integrate the queue with an Amazon EventBridge rule to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Configure the rule to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Configure a Spot Fleet with a default allocation strategy.
options.D: Create an Amazon API Gateway API. Integrate the API with AWS Lambda to receive payment notifications from mobile devices. Invoke a Lambda function to validate payment notifications and send the notifications to the backend application. Deploy the backend application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon ECS with an AWS Fargate launch type.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

API Gateway plus Lambda is appropriate for receiving mobile/API requests and doing lightweight validation with minimal operations. AWS says API Gateway and Lambda form the app-facing part of AWS serverless infrastructure, and API Gateway supports streamlined proxy integrations with Lambda; Lambda runs code without managing servers and automatically handles compute resource administration such as capacity provisioning and scaling ([API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html), [Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). For the long-running backend, Amazon ECS is a fully managed container orchestration service, and ECS services are intended for long-running stateless applications. With the Fargate launch type, containers run without managing servers or EC2 clusters, and you specify CPU and memory requirements per task ([Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html), [AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). This best matches the need to adjust compute/memory while avoiding infrastructure management.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EventBridge rules are for matching/filtering events and routing them to targets, not for performing application validation logic ([EventBridge rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rules.html)). Also, EKS Anywhere/standalone clusters would introduce Kubernetes cluster operations rather than the least operational overhead.
- **B:** API Gateway and Step Functions can be serverless, but the backend is deployed on Amazon EKS with **self-managed nodes**, which requires more operational management than ECS on Fargate. This does not minimize operational overhead.
- **C:** EC2 Spot Instances/Spot Fleet require managing EC2 capacity and are interruptible. AWS notes that with EC2 capacity for ECS, you choose the instance type, number of instances, and manage capacity, whereas Fargate avoids server and capacity planning ([Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望在 AWS 上运行其支付应用程序。该应用程序从移动设备接收支付通知。支付通知在发送以进行进一步处理之前需要进行基本验证。后端处理应用程序运行时间较长，并且需要能够调整计算和内存。该公司不希望管理基础设施。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。将该队列与 Amazon EventBridge 规则集成，以从移动设备接收支付通知。配置该规则以验证支付通知并将通知发送到后端应用程序。将后端应用程序部署在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) Anywhere 上。创建一个独立集群。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway API。将该 API 与 AWS Step Functions 状态机集成，以从移动设备接收支付通知。调用该状态机以验证支付通知并将通知发送到后端应用程序。将后端应用程序部署在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上。配置一个带有自管理节点的 EKS 集群。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。将该队列与 Amazon EventBridge 规则集成，以从移动设备接收支付通知。配置该规则以验证支付通知并将通知发送到后端应用程序。将后端应用程序部署在 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 上。使用默认分配策略配置一个 Spot Fleet。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway API。将该 API 与 AWS Lambda 集成，以从移动设备接收支付通知。调用一个 Lambda 函数来验证支付通知并将通知发送到后端应用程序。将后端应用程序部署在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上。使用 AWS Fargate 启动类型配置 Amazon ECS。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

API Gateway 加 Lambda 适合接收移动/API 请求并以最少运维执行轻量级验证。AWS 表示 API Gateway 和 Lambda 构成了 AWS 无服务器基础设施中面向应用程序的部分，并且 API Gateway 支持与 Lambda 的简化代理集成；Lambda 可以在无需管理服务器的情况下运行代码，并自动处理计算资源管理，例如容量预置和扩展（[API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/welcome.html)，[Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。对于长时间运行的后端，Amazon ECS 是一项完全托管的容器编排服务，ECS 服务适用于长时间运行的无状态应用程序。使用 Fargate 启动类型时，容器可以在无需管理服务器或 EC2 集群的情况下运行，并且你可以为每个任务指定 CPU 和内存要求（[Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html)，[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。这最符合在避免基础设施管理的同时调整计算/内存的需求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EventBridge 规则用于匹配/筛选事件并将事件路由到目标，而不是用于执行应用程序验证逻辑（[EventBridge rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rules.html)）。此外，EKS Anywhere/独立集群会引入 Kubernetes 集群运维，而不是最少的运营开销。
- **B:** API Gateway 和 Step Functions 可以是无服务器的，但后端部署在带有 **self-managed nodes** 的 Amazon EKS 上，这比在 Fargate 上运行 ECS 需要更多运营管理。这不能最小化运营开销。
- **C:** EC2 Spot Instances/Spot Fleet 需要管理 EC2 容量，并且可能被中断。AWS 指出，使用 ECS 的 EC2 容量时，你需要选择实例类型、实例数量并管理容量，而 Fargate 可避免服务器和容量规划（[Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a user authentication solution for a company. The solution must invoke two-factor authentication for users that log in from inconsistent geographical locations, IP addresses, or devices. The solution must also be able to scale up to accommodate millions of users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Cognito user pools for user authentication. Enable the risk-based adaptive authentication feature with multifactor authentication (MFA).
options.B: Configure Amazon Cognito identity pools for user authentication. Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA).
options.C: Configure AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) users for user authentication. Attach an IAM policy that allows the AllowManageOwnUserMFA action.
options.D: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) authentication for user authentication. Configure the permission sets to require multi-factor authentication (MFA).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon Cognito **user pools** are the correct service for application user authentication: AWS says to create a user pool when you want to authenticate and authorize users to an app or API, and user pools can issue authenticated JWTs directly to an app/API ([Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html)). Cognito user pools support MFA and security monitoring/response, and AWS specifically documents that **adaptive authentication** assigns a risk level to each user session and can be configured to **Require MFA** at selected risk levels ([Working with adaptive authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pool-settings-adaptive-authentication.html)). AWS also documents that adaptive authentication can use session context including the user’s **IP address** and a unique **device identifier**, and can calculate risk based on user endpoint characteristics ([Working with adaptive authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pool-settings-adaptive-authentication.html)). This matches the requirement for conditional two-factor authentication based on inconsistent locations/IPs/devices and is the managed customer-identity option appropriate for very large user populations.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B. Cognito identity pools** are not the primary user-authentication directory. AWS describes identity pools as a way to exchange identities/tokens for **temporary AWS credentials**, while the comparison table shows user pools provide the authentication frontend, user directory, MFA, and security monitoring features; identity pools provide IAM web identity authorization and temporary credential brokering ([Amazon Cognito user pools and identity pools comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html), [Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)).
* **C. IAM users** are for access to AWS accounts/resources through AWS Management Console passwords and access keys, with permissions to perform AWS operations; IAM MFA is not adaptive/risk-based application authentication for millions of end users ([IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_users.html)).
* **D. IAM Identity Center** is intended to streamline **workforce** access to AWS accounts and applications and assign permissions across AWS accounts; it does not provide Cognito user-pool adaptive authentication based on endpoint risk such as geography/IP/device ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在为一家公司设计用户身份验证解决方案。该解决方案必须对从不一致的地理位置、IP 地址或设备登录的用户调用双因素身份验证。该解决方案还必须能够扩展以容纳数百万用户。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为用户身份验证配置 Amazon Cognito user pools。启用带有多重身份验证 (MFA) 的基于风险的自适应身份验证功能。
options.B: 为用户身份验证配置 Amazon Cognito identity pools。启用多重身份验证 (MFA)。
options.C: 为用户身份验证配置 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 用户。附加允许 AllowManageOwnUserMFA 操作的 IAM policy。
options.D: 为用户身份验证配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 身份验证。配置 permission sets 以要求多重身份验证 (MFA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon Cognito **user pools** 是用于应用程序用户身份验证的正确服务：AWS 表示，当你想要对应用程序或 API 的用户进行身份验证和授权时，应创建 user pool，并且 user pools 可以直接向应用程序/API 颁发经过身份验证的 JWT ([Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html))。Cognito user pools 支持 MFA 以及安全监控/响应，并且 AWS 明确记录了 **adaptive authentication** 会为每个用户会话分配风险级别，并且可以配置为在选定的风险级别**要求 MFA** ([Working with adaptive authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pool-settings-adaptive-authentication.html))。AWS 还记录了 adaptive authentication 可以使用会话上下文，包括用户的 **IP address** 和唯一的 **device identifier**，并且可以基于用户端点特征计算风险 ([Working with adaptive authentication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pool-settings-adaptive-authentication.html))。这符合基于不一致的位置/IP/设备进行条件双因素身份验证的要求，并且是适合非常大规模用户群体的托管客户身份选项。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B. Cognito identity pools** 不是主要的用户身份验证目录。AWS 将 identity pools 描述为一种将身份/令牌交换为**临时 AWS 凭证**的方式，而比较表显示 user pools 提供身份验证前端、用户目录、MFA 和安全监控功能；identity pools 提供 IAM Web 身份授权和临时凭证代理 ([Amazon Cognito user pools and identity pools comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/what-is-amazon-cognito.html), [Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html))。
* **C. IAM users** 用于通过 AWS Management Console 密码和访问密钥访问 AWS 账户/资源，并具有执行 AWS 操作的权限；IAM MFA 不是面向数百万最终用户的自适应/基于风险的应用程序身份验证 ([IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_users.html))。
* **D. IAM Identity Center** 旨在简化**员工**对 AWS 账户和应用程序的访问，并在 AWS 账户之间分配权限；它不提供 Cognito user-pool 基于端点风险（例如地理位置/IP/设备）的自适应身份验证 ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html))。

en.question: A company has an Amazon S3 data lake. The company needs a solution that transforms the data from the data lake and loads the data into a data warehouse every day. The data warehouse must have massively parallel processing (MPP) capabilities. Data analysts then need to create and train machine learning (ML) models by using SQL commands on the data. The solution must use serverless AWS services wherever possible. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models.
options.B: Run a daily Amazon EMR job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Aurora Serverless. Use Amazon Aurora ML to create and train the ML models.
options.C: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Redshift Serverless. Use Amazon Redshift ML to create and train the ML models.
options.D: Run a daily AWS Glue job to transform the data and load the data into Amazon Athena tables. Use Amazon Athena ML to create and train the ML models.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

AWS Glue is the best ETL choice because it is a **serverless data integration service** for preparing, moving, and integrating data, and AWS states that it supports ETL/ELT workloads with no infrastructure to manage ([AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html)). AWS Glue can also write transformed data to **Amazon Redshift clusters and Amazon Redshift Serverless environments** ([AWS Glue Redshift connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-connect-redshift-home.html)). Amazon Redshift Serverless is a serverless data warehouse option that automatically provisions and scales capacity for analytics workloads ([Amazon Redshift Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/working-with-serverless.html)). Redshift also meets the MPP/data warehouse requirement: its architecture uses a leader node that distributes work to compute nodes, and compute nodes run compiled query code in parallel ([Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_high_level_system_architecture.html)). Finally, Redshift ML supports SQL-based model creation with the `CREATE MODEL` statement, and AWS notes that Redshift ML uses SageMaker AI to train models ([CREATE MODEL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/r_CREATE_MODEL.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon EMR can transform and move large amounts of data, but the option says a daily **Amazon EMR job**, not EMR Serverless; AWS describes Amazon EMR as a managed **cluster** platform ([Amazon EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)). It also uses Amazon Redshift but not **Redshift Serverless**, so it does not use serverless services wherever possible.
- **B:** Aurora Serverless is not an MPP data warehouse like Redshift. Aurora ML integrates an Aurora DB cluster with services such as Bedrock, Comprehend, and SageMaker AI for ML use cases ([Aurora ML](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-ml.html)), but this option does not satisfy the data warehouse/MPP requirement.
- **D:** Athena is serverless, but Athena ML is for running **ML inference** from SQL against a SageMaker AI endpoint, not creating and training models with SQL ([Athena ML](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-mlmodel.html)). Athena tables also do not provide the Redshift MPP data warehouse target required by the question.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个 Amazon S3 数据湖。该公司需要一个解决方案，每天从数据湖转换数据并将数据加载到数据仓库中。该数据仓库必须具备大规模并行处理 (MPP) 能力。然后，数据分析师需要使用 SQL 命令基于这些数据创建和训练机器学习 (ML) 模型。该解决方案必须尽可能使用无服务器 AWS 服务。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 运行每日 Amazon EMR 作业来转换数据，并将数据加载到 Amazon Redshift 中。使用 Amazon Redshift ML 创建和训练 ML 模型。
options.B: 运行每日 Amazon EMR 作业来转换数据，并将数据加载到 Amazon Aurora Serverless 中。使用 Amazon Aurora ML 创建和训练 ML 模型。
options.C: 运行每日 AWS Glue 作业来转换数据，并将数据加载到 Amazon Redshift Serverless 中。使用 Amazon Redshift ML 创建和训练 ML 模型。
options.D: 运行每日 AWS Glue 作业来转换数据，并将数据加载到 Amazon Athena 表中。使用 Amazon Athena ML 创建和训练 ML 模型。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

AWS Glue 是最佳 ETL 选择，因为它是一个用于准备、移动和集成数据的 **serverless data integration service**，并且 AWS 表示它支持 ETL/ELT 工作负载且无需管理基础设施 ([AWS Glue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/what-is-glue.html))。AWS Glue 还可以将转换后的数据写入 **Amazon Redshift clusters and Amazon Redshift Serverless environments** ([AWS Glue Redshift connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/aws-glue-programming-etl-connect-redshift-home.html))。Amazon Redshift Serverless 是一种无服务器数据仓库选项，可为分析工作负载自动预置和扩展容量 ([Amazon Redshift Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/working-with-serverless.html))。Redshift 也满足 MPP/数据仓库要求：其架构使用 leader node 将工作分发到 compute nodes，compute nodes 并行运行编译后的查询代码 ([Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_high_level_system_architecture.html))。最后，Redshift ML 支持使用 `CREATE MODEL` 语句进行基于 SQL 的模型创建，并且 AWS 指出 Redshift ML 使用 SageMaker AI 来训练模型 ([CREATE MODEL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/r_CREATE_MODEL.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon EMR 可以转换和移动大量数据，但该选项说的是每日 **Amazon EMR job**，而不是 EMR Serverless；AWS 将 Amazon EMR 描述为托管 **cluster** 平台 ([Amazon EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html))。它还使用 Amazon Redshift，但不是 **Redshift Serverless**，因此并未尽可能使用无服务器服务。
- **B:** Aurora Serverless 不是像 Redshift 那样的 MPP 数据仓库。Aurora ML 将 Aurora DB cluster 与 Bedrock、Comprehend 和 SageMaker AI 等服务集成，用于 ML 用例 ([Aurora ML](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-ml.html))，但该选项不满足数据仓库/MPP 要求。
- **D:** Athena 是无服务器的，但 Athena ML 用于通过 SQL 针对 SageMaker AI endpoint 运行 **ML inference**，而不是使用 SQL 创建和训练模型 ([Athena ML](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-mlmodel.html))。Athena tables 也不提供题目所要求的 Redshift MPP 数据仓库目标。

en.question: A company runs containers in a Kubernetes environment in the company's local data center. The company wants to use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and other AWS managed services. Data must remain locally in the company's data center and cannot be stored in any remote site or cloud to maintain compliance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy AWS Local Zones in the company's data center.
options.B: Use an AWS Snowmobile in the company's data center.
options.C: Install an AWS Outposts rack in the company's data center.
options.D: Install an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized node in the data center.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Install an AWS Outposts rack in the company's data center.**

AWS Outposts is the best fit because it is a fully managed service that extends AWS infrastructure, services, APIs, and tools **to customer premises**, using local compute and storage resources for local data processing needs. AWS documentation also states that an Outpost is AWS compute and storage capacity **deployed at a customer site** and that AWS operates and manages it as part of an AWS Region. The Outposts resources list includes **Amazon EKS nodes on racks**. In addition, AWS provides a reference architecture for **local clusters for Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts**, and notes that deploying a local Amazon EKS cluster is available through the **AWS Outposts Rack** offering. Therefore, an Outposts rack meets the requirements for Amazon EKS and AWS managed services while keeping workloads and data local in the company's data center. [AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html), [Local Clusters for Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/architecture-diagrams/latest/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Local Zones**: Local Zones are extensions of an AWS Region that are geographically close to users. They are not deployed inside the company's own data center, so they do not satisfy the requirement that data remain locally in the company's data center. [Local Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.RegionsAndAvailabilityZones.html)
- **B. AWS Snowmobile**: Snowmobile is not the service for running Amazon EKS or AWS managed services locally; this scenario requires ongoing local AWS infrastructure, which AWS Outposts provides. [AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)
- **D. Snowball Edge Storage Optimized**: Snowball Edge is a device for local storage/compute and data transfer to or from AWS; it supports EKS Anywhere for Kubernetes workloads, not Amazon EKS local clusters as an AWS managed EKS solution. The EKS local cluster architecture is specifically documented for AWS Outposts Rack. [Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html), [Local Clusters for Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/architecture-diagrams/latest/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts.html)

zh.question: 一家公司在其本地数据中心的 Kubernetes 环境中运行容器。该公司希望使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 和其他 AWS 托管服务。为保持合规性，数据必须保留在公司数据中心本地，不能存储在任何远程站点或云中。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在公司的数据中心部署 AWS Local Zones。
options.B: 在公司的数据中心使用 AWS Snowmobile。
options.C: 在公司的数据中心安装 AWS Outposts 机架。
options.D: 在数据中心安装 AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 节点。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 在公司的数据中心安装 AWS Outposts 机架。**

AWS Outposts 是最合适的选择，因为它是一项完全托管的服务，可将 AWS 基础设施、服务、API 和工具扩展到**客户场所**，并使用本地计算和存储资源来满足本地数据处理需求。AWS 文档还说明，Outpost 是部署在**客户站点**的 AWS 计算和存储容量，并且 AWS 将其作为 AWS Region 的一部分进行运营和管理。Outposts 资源列表包括**机架上的 Amazon EKS 节点**。此外，AWS 为 **AWS Outposts 上的 Amazon EKS 本地集群**提供了参考架构，并指出部署本地 Amazon EKS 集群可通过 **AWS Outposts Rack** 产品实现。因此，Outposts 机架能够满足使用 Amazon EKS 和 AWS 托管服务的要求，同时将工作负载和数据保留在公司的数据中心本地。[AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html), [Local Clusters for Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/architecture-diagrams/latest/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts.html)

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. AWS Local Zones**：Local Zones 是 AWS Region 的扩展，在地理位置上靠近用户。它们并不部署在公司自己的数据中心内，因此不满足数据必须保留在公司数据中心本地的要求。[Local Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.RegionsAndAvailabilityZones.html)
- **B. AWS Snowmobile**：Snowmobile 不是用于在本地运行 Amazon EKS 或 AWS 托管服务的服务；此场景需要持续运行的本地 AWS 基础设施，而这是 AWS Outposts 提供的能力。[AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/outposts/latest/userguide/what-is-outposts.html)
- **D. Snowball Edge Storage Optimized**：Snowball Edge 是用于本地存储/计算以及与 AWS 之间进行数据传输的设备；它支持用于 Kubernetes 工作负载的 EKS Anywhere，而不是作为 AWS 托管 EKS 解决方案的 Amazon EKS 本地集群。EKS 本地集群架构在文档中专门针对 AWS Outposts Rack 进行了说明。[Snowball Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/whatisedge.html), [Local Clusters for Amazon EKS on AWS Outposts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/architecture-diagrams/latest/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts/local-clusters-for-amazon-eks-on-aws-outposts.html)

en.question: A social media company has workloads that collect and process data. The workloads store the data in on- premises NFS storage. The data store cannot scale fast enough to meet the company’s expanding business needs. The company wants to migrate the current data store to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class.
options.B: Set up an AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway. Use an Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to the appropriate storage class.
options.C: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy.
options.D: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) storage class. Activate the infrequent access lifecycle policy.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The workload currently uses on-premises **NFS** storage and needs a scalable, cost-effective AWS-backed data store. Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed for this exact pattern: it provides a file interface to Amazon S3 and lets applications store and retrieve objects in S3 using standard file protocols including **NFS** and SMB. AWS also states that S3 File Gateway integrates with existing applications through file protocols and provides a **cost-effective alternative to on-premises storage**, with local caching; the same page notes that S3 data can be managed with lifecycle policies ([AWS Storage Gateway: What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to lower-cost storage classes and archive or delete them to save storage costs ([Amazon S3: Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Volume Gateway** is not the best fit because Volume Gateway provides cloud-backed storage volumes mounted as **iSCSI** devices, and AWS distinguishes it as a volume-based solution rather than a file-based gateway. The source workload is NFS file storage, so S3 File Gateway is the appropriate Storage Gateway type ([AWS Storage Gateway: What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **C. EFS Standard-IA** can store infrequently accessed file data, but EFS is a managed file system mounted from EC2/VPC environments, not the most cost-effective migration target described for replacing on-premises NFS storage at scale with S3-backed lifecycle management. EFS IA is specifically for less frequently accessed data and has higher latency characteristics than EFS Standard ([Amazon EFS performance: Storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)).
- **D. EFS One Zone-IA** is also an EFS file system option, but One Zone file systems have a single mount target in one Availability Zone, and cross-AZ access can incur additional data access charges; it still does not provide the S3-backed File Gateway pattern with S3 Lifecycle policies requested by the answer set ([Amazon EFS: How Amazon EFS works with Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)).

zh.question: 一家社交媒体公司有用于收集和处理数据的工作负载。这些工作负载将数据存储在本地 NFS 存储中。该数据存储无法足够快速地扩展，以满足公司不断扩大的业务需求。公司希望将当前数据存储迁移到 AWS。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway。使用 Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy 将数据转换到适当的存储类。
options.B: 设置 AWS Storage Gateway Amazon S3 File Gateway。使用 Amazon S3 Lifecycle policy 将数据转换到适当的存储类。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard-Infrequent Access (Standard-IA) 存储类。激活不频繁访问生命周期策略。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) 存储类。激活不频繁访问生命周期策略。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.** 该工作负载当前使用本地 **NFS** 存储，并且需要一个可扩展、具有成本效益的 AWS 支持的数据存储。Amazon S3 File Gateway 正是为这种模式而设计的：它为 Amazon S3 提供文件接口，并允许应用程序使用包括 **NFS** 和 SMB 在内的标准文件协议在 S3 中存储和检索对象。AWS 还说明，S3 File Gateway 通过文件协议与现有应用程序集成，并通过本地缓存提供一种**具有成本效益的本地存储替代方案**；同一页面还指出，可以使用生命周期策略管理 S3 数据（[AWS Storage Gateway: What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的存储类，并对其进行归档或删除以节省存储成本（[Amazon S3: Managing the lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Volume Gateway** 不是最合适的选择，因为 Volume Gateway 提供挂载为 **iSCSI** 设备的云支持存储卷，AWS 将其区分为基于卷的解决方案，而不是基于文件的网关。源工作负载是 NFS 文件存储，因此 S3 File Gateway 是适当的 Storage Gateway 类型（[AWS Storage Gateway: What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **C. EFS Standard-IA** 可以存储不频繁访问的文件数据，但 EFS 是从 EC2/VPC 环境挂载的托管文件系统，并不是题目所描述的、用于以 S3 支持的生命周期管理大规模替代本地 NFS 存储的最具成本效益的迁移目标。EFS IA 专门用于访问频率较低的数据，并且与 EFS Standard 相比具有更高的延迟特性（[Amazon EFS performance: Storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。
- **D. EFS One Zone-IA** 也是一个 EFS 文件系统选项，但 One Zone 文件系统在一个 Availability Zone 中只有一个挂载目标，跨 AZ 访问可能会产生额外的数据访问费用；它仍然不能提供答案集中所要求的、带有 S3 Lifecycle 策略的 S3 支持 File Gateway 模式（[Amazon EFS: How Amazon EFS works with Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。

en.question: A company uses high concurrency AWS Lambda functions to process a constantly increasing number of messages in a message queue during marketing events. The Lambda functions use CPU intensive code to process the messages. The company wants to reduce the compute costs and to maintain service latency for its customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions.
options.B: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.
options.C: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Decrease the memory allocated to the Lambda functions.
options.D: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.**

For CPU-intensive Lambda code, increasing memory can improve performance because Lambda allocates CPU in proportion to memory: AWS states that “any increase in memory size triggers an equivalent increase in CPU available to your function” ([AWS Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)). AWS Compute Optimizer specifically evaluates Lambda memory and proportional CPU as under- or over-provisioned and generates recommendations that can provide “better performance or cost,” including estimated monthly savings from moving to the recommended memory setting ([Compute Optimizer Lambda recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-lambda-recommendations.html)).

Provisioned concurrency is the best concurrency feature for maintaining latency during marketing events because Lambda “pre-initializes that execution environment so that it's available ahead of invocation requests” ([AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)). It can also be managed with Application Auto Scaling; when provisioned concurrency utilization rises, Application Auto Scaling allocates more provisioned concurrency, and when utilization drops it reduces it ([AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)). This addresses the latency requirement while Compute Optimizer-guided memory sizing addresses CPU performance and cost efficiency.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Decreasing memory is inappropriate for CPU-intensive functions because less memory also means less CPU. Reserved concurrency also only reserves concurrency from the account pool; it does not pre-initialize execution environments for lower latency.
- **B:** Increasing memory according to Compute Optimizer is good, but reserved concurrency is not the best latency-control mechanism. AWS describes reserved concurrency as reserving concurrency from the available account pool and affecting what is available to other functions ([AWS Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)); it does not provide the pre-initialized environments that provisioned concurrency provides.
- **C:** Provisioned concurrency helps latency, but decreasing memory conflicts with the CPU-intensive nature of the workload and reduces the proportional CPU available to the function.

zh.question: 一家公司使用高并发 AWS Lambda 函数，在营销活动期间处理消息队列中不断增加的消息数量。这些 Lambda 函数使用 CPU 密集型代码来处理消息。公司希望降低计算成本，并为其客户保持服务延迟。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Lambda 函数配置 reserved concurrency。减少分配给 Lambda 函数的内存。
options.B: 为 Lambda 函数配置 reserved concurrency。根据 AWS Compute Optimizer 建议增加内存。
options.C: 为 Lambda 函数配置 provisioned concurrency。减少分配给 Lambda 函数的内存。
options.D: 为 Lambda 函数配置 provisioned concurrency。根据 AWS Compute Optimizer 建议增加内存。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda functions. Increase the memory according to AWS Compute Optimizer recommendations.**

对于 CPU 密集型 Lambda 代码，增加内存可以提升性能，因为 Lambda 会按内存比例分配 CPU：AWS 表示，“any increase in memory size triggers an equivalent increase in CPU available to your function”（[AWS Lambda best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)）。AWS Compute Optimizer 会专门评估 Lambda 内存和按比例分配的 CPU 是否配置不足或过度配置，并生成可提供“better performance or cost”的建议，包括迁移到建议内存设置后的估算月度节省（[Compute Optimizer Lambda recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-lambda-recommendations.html)）。

Provisioned concurrency 是在营销活动期间保持延迟的最佳并发功能，因为 Lambda 会“pre-initializes that execution environment so that it's available ahead of invocation requests”（[AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。它还可以通过 Application Auto Scaling 管理；当 provisioned concurrency 利用率上升时，Application Auto Scaling 会分配更多 provisioned concurrency，而当利用率下降时会减少它（[AWS Lambda provisioned concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/provisioned-concurrency.html)）。这满足了延迟要求，而 Compute Optimizer 指导的内存大小设置则解决了 CPU 性能和成本效率问题。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 对于 CPU 密集型函数，减少内存并不合适，因为更少的内存也意味着更少的 CPU。Reserved concurrency 也只是从账户池中预留并发；它不会预初始化执行环境以降低延迟。
- **B:** 根据 Compute Optimizer 增加内存是好的，但 reserved concurrency 并不是最佳的延迟控制机制。AWS 将 reserved concurrency 描述为从可用账户池中预留并发，并影响其他函数可用的并发（[AWS Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-concurrency.html)）；它不提供 provisioned concurrency 所提供的预初始化环境。
- **C:** Provisioned concurrency 有助于延迟，但减少内存与该工作负载的 CPU 密集型特性相冲突，并会减少函数可用的按比例分配的 CPU。

en.question: A company runs its workloads on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). The container images that the ECS task definition uses need to be scanned for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs). New container images that are created also need to be scanned. Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the workloads?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository to store the container images. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR basic scan.
options.B: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to scan the images. Use an S3 Event Notification to initiate a Macie scan for every event with an s3:ObjectCreated:Put event type.
options.C: Deploy the workloads to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) as a private image repository. Specify scan on push filters for the ECR enhanced scan.
options.D: Store the container images in an Amazon S3 bucket that has versioning enabled. Configure an S3 Event Notification for s3:ObjectCreated:* events to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to initiate an Amazon Inspector scan.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon ECR is the native private container image registry for ECS workloads: an ECS task definition can directly reference an image hosted in an ECR private repository using the full ECR image URI format ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/ECR_on_ECS.html)). Amazon ECR image scanning is designed to identify software vulnerabilities in container images; **basic scanning uses the CVE database** to scan for operating system vulnerabilities and supports **scan on push** ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html)). AWS also documents that basic scanning can be configured with **scan on push filters** for all or selected repositories ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html)). This meets the requirement to scan existing/new container images with the fewest workload changes.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B** is wrong because Amazon Macie is for discovering and protecting **sensitive data in Amazon S3**, not scanning container images for CVEs ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)).
* **C** is wrong because migrating workloads from **ECS to EKS** is unnecessary and does not represent the fewest changes. ECR enhanced scanning can scan images, but the EKS migration is not required for ECR image scanning.
* **D** is wrong because storing container images in S3 and building an S3/Lambda/Inspector workflow is unnecessary and more complex. ECR already provides native scan-on-push image scanning; Amazon Inspector integration for container image scanning is through ECR enhanced scanning of repositories, not a custom S3 object workflow ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上运行其工作负载。ECS 任务定义使用的容器映像需要扫描 Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs)。新创建的容器映像也需要扫描。哪种解决方案能以对工作负载进行最少更改来满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 作为私有映像存储库来存储容器映像。为 ECR basic scan 指定 scan on push filters。
options.B: 将容器映像存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon Macie 扫描这些映像。使用 S3 Event Notification 为每个具有 s3:ObjectCreated:Put 事件类型的事件启动 Macie 扫描。
options.C: 将工作负载部署到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。使用 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 作为私有映像存储库。为 ECR enhanced scan 指定 scan on push filters。
options.D: 将容器映像存储在启用了版本控制的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。为 s3:ObjectCreated:* 事件配置 S3 Event Notification 以调用 AWS Lambda 函数。配置 Lambda 函数以启动 Amazon Inspector 扫描。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon ECR 是 ECS 工作负载的原生私有容器映像注册表：ECS 任务定义可以使用完整的 ECR 映像 URI 格式，直接引用托管在 ECR 私有存储库中的映像（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/ECR_on_ECS.html)）。Amazon ECR 映像扫描旨在识别容器映像中的软件漏洞；**basic scanning uses the CVE database** 来扫描操作系统漏洞，并支持 **scan on push**（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html)）。AWS 还记录了 basic scanning 可以为所有或选定的存储库配置 **scan on push filters**（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html)）。这满足了以最少工作负载更改来扫描现有/新的容器映像的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **B** 错误，因为 Amazon Macie 用于发现和保护 **Amazon S3 中的敏感数据**，而不是扫描容器映像中的 CVEs（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。
* **C** 错误，因为将工作负载从 **ECS to EKS** 迁移是不必要的，并不代表最少更改。ECR enhanced scanning 可以扫描映像，但 ECR 映像扫描并不需要迁移到 EKS。
* **D** 错误，因为将容器映像存储在 S3 中并构建 S3/Lambda/Inspector 工作流是不必要且更复杂的。ECR 已经提供原生的 scan-on-push 映像扫描；用于容器映像扫描的 Amazon Inspector 集成是通过 ECR enhanced scanning of repositories 实现的，而不是自定义的 S3 对象工作流（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html)）。

en.question: A company uses an AWS Batch job to run its end-of-day sales process. The company needs a serverless solution that will invoke a third-party reporting application when the AWS Batch job is successful. The reporting application has an HTTP API interface that uses username and password authentication. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure the third-party API as an EventBridge API destination with a username and password. Set the API destination as the EventBridge rule target.
options.B: Configure Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to match incoming AWS Batch job SUCCEEDED events. Configure an AWS Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password. Set the Lambda function as the EventBridge rule target.
options.C: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure an HTTP proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password.
options.D: Configure an AWS Batch job to publish job SUCCEEDED events to an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure a proxy integration on the API Gateway REST API to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to invoke the third-party API by using a username and password.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Batch automatically creates job state change events whenever an existing job changes state, and the event includes `source: "aws.batch"`, `detail-type: "Batch Job State Change"`, and a `detail.status` field that can be matched for `SUCCEEDED` ([AWS Batch job state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/batch_job_events.html)). EventBridge event patterns are specifically used to select events by source, event type, and event detail values; when a pattern matches, EventBridge sends the event to the target ([EventBridge event patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-patterns.html)).

EventBridge API destinations are designed for this exact integration: an API destination lets you specify an HTTP endpoint as the target of a rule, and EventBridge uses the associated connection authorization information to authorize against that endpoint ([Create an API destination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-api-destination-create.html)). EventBridge connections support **Basic** authorization, and for Basic authorization EventBridge populates the required authorization headers for you ([Authorization methods for connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-target-connection-auth.html)). Therefore, matching the AWS Batch `SUCCEEDED` event and sending it directly to a third-party HTTPS API with username/password authentication meets the serverless requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** EventBridge Scheduler is for time-based schedules using cron/rate expressions or one-time invocations, not for matching incoming AWS Batch state change events ([EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/using-eventbridge-scheduler.html)). Also, adding Lambda is unnecessary because EventBridge API destinations can invoke the HTTP API directly.
- **C:** AWS Batch job state changes are documented as EventBridge events, not as events that the Batch job publishes to an API Gateway REST API ([AWS Batch job state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/batch_job_events.html)). This option also does not provide the native EventBridge connection/basic-auth handling for the third-party API.
- **D:** Like C, this incorrectly depends on the Batch job publishing success events to API Gateway instead of using the native EventBridge event stream. It also adds API Gateway and Lambda when EventBridge rules can route matching events directly to an API destination ([EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Batch 作业来运行其日终销售流程。该公司需要一个无服务器解决方案，在 AWS Batch 作业成功时调用第三方报告应用程序。该报告应用程序具有一个使用用户名和密码身份验证的 HTTP API 接口。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Amazon EventBridge 规则以匹配传入的 AWS Batch 作业 SUCCEEDED 事件。将第三方 API 配置为带有用户名和密码的 EventBridge API 目标。将该 API 目标设置为 EventBridge 规则目标。
options.B: 配置 Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 以匹配传入的 AWS Batch 作业 SUCCEEDED 事件。配置 AWS Lambda 函数，以使用用户名和密码调用第三方 API。将该 Lambda 函数设置为 EventBridge 规则目标。
options.C: 配置 AWS Batch 作业，将作业 SUCCEEDED 事件发布到 Amazon API Gateway REST API。在 API Gateway REST API 上配置 HTTP 代理集成，以使用用户名和密码调用第三方 API。
options.D: 配置 AWS Batch 作业，将作业 SUCCEEDED 事件发布到 Amazon API Gateway REST API。在 API Gateway REST API 上配置到 AWS Lambda 函数的代理集成。配置该 Lambda 函数，以使用用户名和密码调用第三方 API。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

每当现有作业更改状态时，AWS Batch 都会自动创建作业状态更改事件，并且该事件包含 `source: "aws.batch"`、`detail-type: "Batch Job State Change"` 以及可用于匹配 `SUCCEEDED` 的 `detail.status` 字段（[AWS Batch job state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/batch_job_events.html)）。EventBridge 事件模式专门用于按源、事件类型和事件详细信息值选择事件；当模式匹配时，EventBridge 会将事件发送到目标（[EventBridge event patterns](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-patterns.html)）。

EventBridge API destinations 正是为这种集成而设计的：API destination 允许你将 HTTP 端点指定为规则的目标，并且 EventBridge 使用关联的连接授权信息对该端点进行授权（[Create an API destination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-api-destination-create.html)）。EventBridge connections 支持 **Basic** 授权，并且对于 Basic 授权，EventBridge 会为你填充所需的授权标头（[Authorization methods for connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-target-connection-auth.html)）。因此，匹配 AWS Batch `SUCCEEDED` 事件并将其直接发送到使用用户名/密码身份验证的第三方 HTTPS API，满足无服务器要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** EventBridge Scheduler 用于基于时间的计划，使用 cron/rate 表达式或一次性调用，而不是用于匹配传入的 AWS Batch 状态更改事件（[EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/using-eventbridge-scheduler.html)）。此外，添加 Lambda 是不必要的，因为 EventBridge API destinations 可以直接调用 HTTP API。
- **C:** AWS Batch 作业状态更改被记录为 EventBridge 事件，而不是 Batch 作业发布到 API Gateway REST API 的事件（[AWS Batch job state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/batch_job_events.html)）。此选项也没有为第三方 API 提供原生 EventBridge connection/basic-auth 处理。
- **D:** 与 C 一样，此选项错误地依赖 Batch 作业将成功事件发布到 API Gateway，而不是使用原生 EventBridge 事件流。它还增加了 API Gateway 和 Lambda，而 EventBridge 规则可以将匹配事件直接路由到 API destination（[EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)）。

en.question: A company collects and processes data from a vendor. The vendor stores its data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database in the vendor's own AWS account. The company’s VPC does not have an internet gateway, an AWS Direct Connect connection, or an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. The company needs to access the data that is in the vendor database. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Instruct the vendor to sign up for the AWS Hosted Connection Direct Connect Program. Use VPC peering to connect the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC.
options.B: Configure a client VPN connection between the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. Use VPC peering to connect the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC.
options.C: Instruct the vendor to create a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Place the NLB in front of the Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Use AWS PrivateLink to integrate the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC.
options.D: Use AWS Transit Gateway to integrate the company's VPC and the vendor's VPC. Use VPC peering to connect the company’s VPC and the vendor's VPC.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

AWS PrivateLink is designed for this exact pattern: private connectivity from one VPC to a service hosted in another AWS account, without requiring an internet gateway, NAT device, Direct Connect connection, or Site-to-Site VPN connection. AWS states that PrivateLink establishes private connectivity to “services hosted by other AWS accounts” and that you do **not** need an internet gateway, Direct Connect, or Site-to-Site VPN to communicate with the service ([AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)). For a customer/provider endpoint service, AWS documentation says endpoint services require a **Network Load Balancer** or Gateway Load Balancer, and the load balancer receives requests from service consumers and routes them to the service ([Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)). Network Load Balancer target groups can register AWS resources addressable by IP address and port, including “databases,” when using IP targets ([NLB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)). Therefore, the vendor can expose the database access path privately through an NLB-backed PrivateLink endpoint service, and the company can consume it through an interface endpoint in its VPC.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Direct Connect Hosted Connection is unnecessary and contradicts the requirement context that the company has no Direct Connect connection. Also, the option combines Direct Connect with VPC peering without explaining a need for Direct Connect; VPC peering itself is a separate private VPC-to-VPC mechanism ([VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)).
- **B**: AWS Client VPN is a managed **client-based** VPN service for users to establish TLS VPN sessions to access AWS or on-premises resources; it is not the appropriate service-to-service VPC integration method between two VPCs/accounts for database access ([VPN connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)).
- **D**: Transit Gateway could integrate VPCs, and VPC peering could connect two VPCs, but using both is redundant and does not match the question’s most direct requirement for vendor-provided private service access. PrivateLink is specifically documented for private access to services hosted by other AWS accounts without internet gateways, Direct Connect, or VPN ([AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司从某个供应商收集并处理数据。该供应商将其数据存储在供应商自己的 AWS 账户中的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库里。该公司的 VPC 没有 internet gateway、AWS Direct Connect 连接或 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。该公司需要访问供应商数据库中的数据。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 指示供应商注册 AWS Hosted Connection Direct Connect Program。使用 VPC peering 连接公司的 VPC 和供应商的 VPC。
options.B: 在公司的 VPC 和供应商的 VPC 之间配置 client VPN 连接。使用 VPC peering 连接公司的 VPC 和供应商的 VPC。
options.C: 指示供应商创建 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。将 NLB 放置在 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库前面。使用 AWS PrivateLink 集成公司的 VPC 和供应商的 VPC。
options.D: 使用 AWS Transit Gateway 集成公司的 VPC 和供应商的 VPC。使用 VPC peering 连接公司的 VPC 和供应商的 VPC。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

AWS PrivateLink 正是为这种模式而设计的：从一个 VPC 私密连接到托管在另一个 AWS 账户中的服务，而不需要 internet gateway、NAT device、Direct Connect 连接或 Site-to-Site VPN 连接。AWS 表示，PrivateLink 可与“由其他 AWS 账户托管的服务”建立私有连接，并且你**不**需要 internet gateway、Direct Connect 或 Site-to-Site VPN 即可与该服务通信（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。对于客户/提供方 endpoint service，AWS 文档说明 endpoint services 需要 **Network Load Balancer** 或 Gateway Load Balancer，并且 load balancer 接收来自服务使用者的请求并将其路由到服务（[Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)）。Network Load Balancer target groups 可以注册可通过 IP 地址和端口寻址的 AWS 资源，包括使用 IP targets 时的“databases”（[NLB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。因此，供应商可以通过由 NLB 支持的 PrivateLink endpoint service 私密地公开数据库访问路径，而该公司可以通过其 VPC 中的 interface endpoint 使用它。其他选项为什么不正确：

- **A**：Direct Connect Hosted Connection 没有必要，并且与题目背景中公司没有 Direct Connect 连接的条件相矛盾。此外，该选项将 Direct Connect 与 VPC peering 结合在一起，却没有说明需要 Direct Connect 的原因；VPC peering 本身是一种独立的私有 VPC 到 VPC 机制（[VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。
- **B**：AWS Client VPN 是一种托管的**基于客户端**的 VPN 服务，供用户建立 TLS VPN 会话以访问 AWS 或本地资源；它不是用于两个 VPC/账户之间进行数据库访问的合适服务到服务 VPC 集成方法（[VPN connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)）。
- **D**：Transit Gateway 可以集成 VPC，VPC peering 也可以连接两个 VPC，但同时使用两者是冗余的，并且不符合题目中对供应商提供的私有服务访问的最直接要求。PrivateLink 在文档中明确用于在没有 internet gateways、Direct Connect 或 VPN 的情况下私密访问由其他 AWS 账户托管的服务（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to set up Amazon Managed Grafana as its visualization tool. The company wants to visualize data from its Amazon RDS database as one data source. The company needs a secure solution that will not expose the data over the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without a VPC. Create a public endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the public endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.
options.B: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in a VPC. Create a private endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the private endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.
options.C: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without a VPCreate an AWS PrivateLink endpoint to establish a connection between Amazon Managed Grafana and Amazon RDS. Set up Amazon RDS as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.
options.D: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in a VPC. Create a public endpoint for the RDS database. Configure the public endpoint as a data source in Amazon Managed Grafana.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Amazon Managed Grafana must be connected to the VPC that hosts private data sources. AWS states that to use Amazon Managed Grafana with resources in a VPC, you create a VPC connection for the workspace; after it is configured, **all traffic to or from the workspace flows through the VPC**, including data source connectivity ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc.html)). The FAQ also says you need to configure a VPC in Amazon Managed Grafana when connecting to a data source that is only available in a private VPC and is not publicly accessible ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc-faq.html)). Therefore, using an Amazon Managed Grafana VPC connection and an RDS private endpoint meets the requirement to avoid exposing data over the internet.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Uses a Grafana workspace without VPC connectivity and a public RDS endpoint. AWS states that internet access to an RDS DB instance requires the DB instance to be publicly accessible and communication through the internet ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.ScenariosForAccess.html)), which violates the requirement.
- **C:** An Amazon Managed Grafana workspace without VPC connectivity is not the right way to reach a private RDS data source. AWS says VPC configuration is needed for data sources that are only available in a private VPC ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc-faq.html)). The documented Amazon Managed Grafana interface VPC endpoints/PrivateLink are for private access from a VPC to the Amazon Managed Grafana API or workspace endpoint, not for making a non-VPC Grafana workspace reach an RDS database data source ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/VPC-endpoints.html)).
- **D:** Although the Grafana workspace has VPC connectivity, it still uses a public RDS endpoint. Public database access is unnecessary and exposes the data path over the internet, contrary to the requirement; RDS internet access requires the DB instance to be publicly accessible ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.ScenariosForAccess.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将 Amazon Managed Grafana 设置为其可视化工具。该公司希望将其 Amazon RDS 数据库中的数据作为一个数据源进行可视化。公司需要一个安全的解决方案，不会通过互联网暴露数据。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个不带 VPC 的 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区。为 RDS 数据库创建一个公有端点。将该公有端点配置为 Amazon Managed Grafana 中的数据源。
options.B: 在 VPC 中创建一个 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区。为 RDS 数据库创建一个私有端点。将该私有端点配置为 Amazon Managed Grafana 中的数据源。
options.C: 创建一个不带 VPCreate 的 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区，创建一个 AWS PrivateLink 端点以在 Amazon Managed Grafana 和 Amazon RDS 之间建立连接。将 Amazon RDS 设置为 Amazon Managed Grafana 中的数据源。
options.D: 在 VPC 中创建一个 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区。为 RDS 数据库创建一个公有端点。将该公有端点配置为 Amazon Managed Grafana 中的数据源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

Amazon Managed Grafana 必须连接到托管私有数据源的 VPC。AWS 声明，要将 Amazon Managed Grafana 与 VPC 中的资源一起使用，需要为工作区创建 VPC 连接；配置完成后，**进出该工作区的所有流量都会通过 VPC**，包括数据源连接（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc.html)）。FAQ 还说明，当连接到仅在私有 VPC 中可用且不可公开访问的数据源时，需要在 Amazon Managed Grafana 中配置 VPC（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc-faq.html)）。因此，使用 Amazon Managed Grafana VPC 连接和 RDS 私有端点，可以满足避免通过互联网暴露数据的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用没有 VPC 连接的 Grafana 工作区和公有 RDS 端点。AWS 声明，对 RDS DB instance 的互联网访问要求该 DB instance 可公开访问，并通过互联网进行通信（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.ScenariosForAccess.html)），这违反了要求。
- **C:** 没有 VPC 连接的 Amazon Managed Grafana 工作区并不是访问私有 RDS 数据源的正确方式。AWS 表示，对于仅在私有 VPC 中可用的数据源，需要 VPC 配置（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/AMG-configure-vpc-faq.html)）。文档中说明的 Amazon Managed Grafana interface VPC endpoints/PrivateLink 用于从 VPC 私有访问 Amazon Managed Grafana API 或工作区端点，而不是让非 VPC Grafana 工作区访问 RDS database 数据源（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/grafana/latest/userguide/VPC-endpoints.html)）。
- **D:** 尽管 Grafana 工作区具有 VPC 连接，但它仍然使用公有 RDS 端点。公有数据库访问是不必要的，并且会通过互联网暴露数据路径，这与要求相违背；RDS 互联网访问要求 DB instance 可公开访问（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.ScenariosForAccess.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts a data lake on Amazon S3. The data lake ingests data in Apache Parquet format from various data sources. The company uses multiple transformation steps to prepare the ingested data. The steps include filtering of anomalies, normalizing of data to standard date and time values, and generation of aggregates for analyses. The company must store the transformed data in S3 buckets that data analysts access. The company needs a prebuilt solution for data transformation that does not require code. The solution must provide data lineage and data profiling. The company needs to share the data transformation steps with employees throughout the company. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an AWS Glue Studio visual canvas to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using AWS Glue jobs.
options.B: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using EMR Serverless jobs.
options.C: Configure AWS Glue DataBrew to transform the data. Share the transformation steps with employees by using DataBrew recipes.
options.D: Create Amazon Athena tables for the data. Write Athena SQL queries to transform the data. Share the Athena SQL queries with employees.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Configure AWS Glue DataBrew and share the steps as DataBrew recipes.**

AWS Glue DataBrew is specifically described as a **visual data preparation tool** that lets users clean and normalize data **without writing any code**. AWS also states that DataBrew provides **250+ ready-made transformations** for tasks such as **filtering anomalies** and converting data to standard formats, and that after running a recipe the output can be stored in **Amazon S3** ([What is AWS Glue DataBrew?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/what-is.html)). DataBrew also supports the required governance features: **data lineage** visually tracks where data came from, how it was influenced, and where it was stored; **data profiles** summarize the shape, structure, and relationships in the dataset ([Core concepts and terms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/core-concepts-and-terms.html)). Recipes are the right sharing/reuse mechanism because a DataBrew **recipe** is a set of transformation instructions/steps that can be downloaded, reused in other projects, and versioned ([Core concepts and terms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/core-concepts-and-terms.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS Glue Studio visual canvas:** Glue Studio visual ETL jobs can build drag-and-drop workflows, but AWS describes them as visual ETL jobs that use a serverless Apache Spark engine with generated PySpark scripts ([Building visual ETL jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/author-job-glue.html)). This option does not directly satisfy the requirement for a prebuilt no-code data-preparation solution with DataBrew-style recipes, profiling, and lineage.
- **B. Amazon EMR Serverless:** EMR Serverless is for running analytics applications/jobs such as Spark jobs; it is not the no-code data-preparation tool with built-in recipes, profiling, and lineage required here. The EMR Serverless tutorial flow includes writing/submitting Spark jobs, which does not match the no-code requirement ([Run Spark jobs using Amazon EMR Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/tutorial-run-spark-with-emr-serverless.html)).
- **D. Amazon Athena SQL queries:** Athena is a SQL query service over data, and creating Athena tables/SQL queries would require writing and sharing SQL rather than using prebuilt point-and-click transformations. It also does not provide the DataBrew recipe, data lineage, and data profiling capabilities required by the scenario ([Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon S3 上托管一个数据湖。该数据湖从各种数据源摄取 Apache Parquet 格式的数据。公司使用多个转换步骤来准备摄取的数据。这些步骤包括筛选异常、将数据规范化为标准日期和时间值，以及生成用于分析的聚合数据。公司必须将转换后的数据存储在数据分析师访问的 S3 存储桶中。公司需要一个用于数据转换的预构建解决方案，并且不需要编写代码。该解决方案必须提供数据沿袭和数据分析画像。公司需要与全公司员工共享这些数据转换步骤。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS Glue Studio 可视化画布来转换数据。使用 AWS Glue 作业与员工共享转换步骤。
options.B: 配置 Amazon EMR Serverless 来转换数据。使用 EMR Serverless 作业与员工共享转换步骤。
options.C: 配置 AWS Glue DataBrew 来转换数据。使用 DataBrew recipes 与员工共享转换步骤。
options.D: 为数据创建 Amazon Athena 表。编写 Athena SQL 查询来转换数据。与员工共享 Athena SQL 查询。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 配置 AWS Glue DataBrew，并将步骤作为 DataBrew recipes 共享。**

AWS Glue DataBrew 被明确描述为一种 **visual data preparation tool**，可让用户在 **不编写任何代码** 的情况下清理和规范化数据。AWS 还说明，DataBrew 提供 **250+ ready-made transformations**，可用于 **filtering anomalies** 和将数据转换为标准格式等任务，并且在运行 recipe 后，输出可以存储在 **Amazon S3** 中（[What is AWS Glue DataBrew?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。DataBrew 还支持所需的治理功能：**data lineage** 以可视方式跟踪数据来自哪里、如何受到影响以及存储在何处；**data profiles** 汇总数据集的形状、结构和关系（[Core concepts and terms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/core-concepts-and-terms.html)）。Recipes 是正确的共享/重用机制，因为 DataBrew **recipe** 是一组转换指令/步骤，可以下载、在其他项目中重用并进行版本控制（[Core concepts and terms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/databrew/latest/dg/core-concepts-and-terms.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS Glue Studio visual canvas:** Glue Studio 可视化 ETL 作业可以构建拖放式工作流，但 AWS 将其描述为使用 serverless Apache Spark 引擎并生成 PySpark 脚本的可视化 ETL 作业（[Building visual ETL jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/author-job-glue.html)）。此选项不能直接满足对预构建无代码数据准备解决方案的要求，该解决方案还需要具备 DataBrew 风格的 recipes、profiling 和 lineage。
- **B. Amazon EMR Serverless:** EMR Serverless 用于运行分析应用程序/作业，例如 Spark 作业；它不是这里所需的、具有内置 recipes、profiling 和 lineage 的无代码数据准备工具。EMR Serverless 教程流程包括编写/提交 Spark 作业，这不符合无代码要求（[Run Spark jobs using Amazon EMR Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/tutorial-run-spark-with-emr-serverless.html)）。
- **D. Amazon Athena SQL queries:** Athena 是一种面向数据的 SQL 查询服务，创建 Athena 表/SQL 查询需要编写和共享 SQL，而不是使用预构建的点击式转换。它也不提供此场景所需的 DataBrew recipe、data lineage 和 data profiling 功能（[Create tables in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/creating-tables.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect runs a web application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances that are in individual target groups behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Users can reach the application through a public website. The solutions architect wants to allow engineers to use a development version of the website to access one specific development EC2 instance to test new features for the application. The solutions architect wants to use an Amazon Route 53 hosted zone to give the engineers access to the development instance. The solution must automatically route to the development instance even if the development instance is replaced. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB that forwards requests for the development website to the target group that contains the development instance.
options.B: Recreate the development instance with a public IP address. Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the public IP address of the development instance.
options.C: Create an A Record for the development website that has the value set to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect requests for the development website to the public IP address of the development instance.
options.D: Place all the instances in the same target group. Create an A Record for the development website. Set the value to the ALB. Create a listener rule on the ALB that forwards requests for the development website to the target group.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

Create the development DNS name in Route 53 as an **A alias record** that points to the ALB. AWS documents that Route 53 can route a domain/subdomain to an ELB load balancer by creating a record with **Record type: A – IPv4 address** and **Value/Route traffic to: Alias to Application and Classic Load Balancer** ([Route 53: routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)). Then configure an ALB listener rule for the development host name. ALB listener rules support conditions such as `host-header`, and a `forward` action routes requests to a target group ([Listener rules for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html); [Action types: Forward actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)).
