This isolates the development hostname and forwards it to the target group that contains the development instance; if that instance is replaced, the target group registration can be updated without changing Route 53.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **B**: Pointing DNS directly to the instance public IP is not resilient to replacement. AWS states that public IP addresses are released when an instance is stopped, hibernated, or terminated, and a new public IP is assigned later; public IPs are not associated with the AWS account and cannot be reused after release ([EC2 public IPv4 addresses](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-instance-addressing.html)).
- **C**: A redirect sends the client to another URL, not to a target group. AWS defines `redirect` as redirecting client requests from one URL to another, whereas `forward` routes requests to a target group ([Action types: Redirect and Forward actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)). Redirecting to the instance public IP also has the same non-persistent-IP problem as option B.
- **D**: Putting all instances in one target group does not ensure access to the specific development instance. For an ALB, the load balancer evaluates the listener rule and then selects a target from the target group for that rule action ([ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)), so a shared target group could route development requests to non-development instances.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师在多个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个 Web 应用程序，这些实例位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的各自目标组中。用户可以通过公共网站访问该应用程序。该解决方案架构师希望允许工程师使用该网站的开发版本访问一个特定的开发 EC2 实例，以测试该应用程序的新功能。该解决方案架构师希望使用 Amazon Route 53 托管区域为工程师提供对开发实例的访问权限。该解决方案必须在开发实例被替换时也能自动路由到开发实例。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为开发网站创建一个 A Record，并将其值设置为 ALB。在 ALB 上创建一条侦听器规则，将发往开发网站的请求转发到包含开发实例的目标组。
options.B: 使用公有 IP 地址重新创建开发实例。为开发网站创建一个 A Record，并将其值设置为开发实例的公有 IP 地址。
options.C: 为开发网站创建一个 A Record，并将其值设置为 ALB。在 ALB 上创建一条侦听器规则，将发往开发网站的请求重定向到开发实例的公有 IP 地址。
options.D: 将所有实例放在同一个目标组中。为开发网站创建一个 A Record。将其值设置为 ALB。在 ALB 上创建一条侦听器规则，将发往开发网站的请求转发到该目标组。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

在 Route 53 中将开发 DNS 名称创建为指向 ALB 的 **A alias record**。AWS 文档说明，Route 53 可以通过创建一条记录将域名/子域名路由到 ELB 负载均衡器，其中 **Record type: A – IPv4 address**，并且 **Value/Route traffic to: Alias to Application and Classic Load Balancer**（[Route 53: routing traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)）。然后为开发主机名配置一条 ALB 侦听器规则。ALB 侦听器规则支持诸如 `host-header` 的条件，并且 `forward` 操作会将请求路由到目标组（[Listener rules for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)；[Action types: Forward actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)）。这会隔离开发主机名，并将其转发到包含开发实例的目标组；如果该实例被替换，可以更新目标组注册，而无需更改 Route 53。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B**：将 DNS 直接指向实例公有 IP 对替换不具备弹性。AWS 表示，当实例停止、休眠或终止时，公有 IP 地址会被释放，并且稍后会分配新的公有 IP；公有 IP 不与 AWS 账户关联，释放后无法重复使用（[EC2 public IPv4 addresses](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-instance-addressing.html)）。
- **C**：重定向会将客户端发送到另一个 URL，而不是发送到目标组。AWS 将 `redirect` 定义为把客户端请求从一个 URL 重定向到另一个 URL，而 `forward` 会将请求路由到目标组（[Action types: Redirect and Forward actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)）。重定向到实例公有 IP 也存在与选项 B 相同的非持久 IP 问题。
- **D**：将所有实例放入一个目标组并不能确保访问到特定的开发实例。对于 ALB，负载均衡器会评估侦听器规则，然后从该规则操作的目标组中选择一个目标（[ELB request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)），因此共享目标组可能会将开发请求路由到非开发实例。

en.question: A company runs a container application on a Kubernetes cluster in the company's data center. The application uses Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP) to communicate with a message queue. The data center cannot scale fast enough to meet the company’s expanding business needs. The company wants to migrate the workloads to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages.
options.B: Migrate the container application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages.
options.C: Use highly available Amazon EC2 instances to run the application. Use Amazon MQ to retrieve the messages.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions to run the application. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to retrieve the messages.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The existing workload is already a Kubernetes-based container application and it communicates with its queue by using **AMQP**. Amazon EKS is the closest managed migration target because AWS states that EKS is a **managed Kubernetes service** that runs upstream Kubernetes, supports Kubernetes APIs, and that existing upstream Kubernetes applications are compatible with EKS. EKS also automatically manages the availability and scalability of the Kubernetes control plane nodes, reducing operational overhead compared with self-managing Kubernetes or EC2 instances ([Amazon EKS control plane](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/control-plane.html)). For the queue, Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ supports AMQP 0-9-1 and AMQP 1.0, matching the application’s protocol requirement ([Amazon MQ supported protocols](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazon-mq/latest/developer-guide/rabbitmq-supported-protocols.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. ECS + SQS:** Amazon ECS could run containers, but the application is currently Kubernetes-based, so moving to ECS would require more platform changes than EKS. More importantly, Amazon SQS API examples use HTTP GET/POST requests with query or form parameters, not AMQP ([SQS query API requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-making-api-requests-xml.html)). This does not meet the AMQP compatibility requirement with minimal change.
- **C. EC2 + Amazon MQ:** Amazon MQ satisfies the AMQP requirement, but running the application on highly available EC2 instances adds more operational overhead for instance provisioning, scaling, patching, and application availability than using managed Kubernetes with EKS.
- **D. Lambda + SQS:** This would require the largest application re-architecture away from a Kubernetes container workload, and SQS still does not provide the AMQP-compatible broker interface required by the existing application.

Therefore, **Amazon EKS with Amazon MQ** best preserves both the Kubernetes runtime model and AMQP messaging while minimizing operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司在公司数据中心的 Kubernetes 集群上运行一个容器应用程序。该应用程序使用 Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP) 与消息队列通信。该数据中心无法足够快速地扩展以满足公司不断增长的业务需求。公司希望将工作负载迁移到 AWS。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将容器应用程序迁移到 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 检索消息。
options.B: 将容器应用程序迁移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。使用 Amazon MQ 检索消息。
options.C: 使用高可用的 Amazon EC2 实例运行该应用程序。使用 Amazon MQ 检索消息。
options.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数运行该应用程序。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 检索消息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

现有工作负载已经是一个基于 Kubernetes 的容器应用程序，并且它使用 **AMQP** 与其队列通信。Amazon EKS 是最接近的托管迁移目标，因为 AWS 表示 EKS 是一项运行上游 Kubernetes、支持 Kubernetes APIs 的 **managed Kubernetes service**，并且现有的上游 Kubernetes 应用程序与 EKS 兼容。EKS 还会自动管理 Kubernetes 控制平面节点的可用性和可扩展性，与自行管理 Kubernetes 或 EC2 实例相比，可降低运维开销（[Amazon EKS control plane](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/control-plane.html)）。对于队列，Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ 支持 AMQP 0-9-1 和 AMQP 1.0，符合该应用程序的协议要求（[Amazon MQ supported protocols](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazon-mq/latest/developer-guide/rabbitmq-supported-protocols.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. ECS + SQS:** Amazon ECS 可以运行容器，但该应用程序当前是基于 Kubernetes 的，因此迁移到 ECS 会比迁移到 EKS 需要更多平台变更。更重要的是，Amazon SQS API 示例使用带有查询参数或表单参数的 HTTP GET/POST 请求，而不是 AMQP（[SQS query API requests](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-making-api-requests-xml.html)）。这无法以最小变更满足 AMQP 兼容性要求。
- **C. EC2 + Amazon MQ:** Amazon MQ 满足 AMQP 要求，但在高可用 EC2 实例上运行应用程序，会在实例预置、扩展、修补和应用程序可用性方面带来比使用 EKS 托管 Kubernetes 更多的运维开销。
- **D. Lambda + SQS:** 这将需要最大程度地将应用程序从 Kubernetes 容器工作负载重新架构出去，并且 SQS 仍然不提供现有应用程序所需的 AMQP 兼容代理接口。因此，**Amazon EKS with Amazon MQ** 能最好地保留 Kubernetes 运行时模型和 AMQP 消息传递，同时最大限度地减少运维开销。

en.question: An online gaming company hosts its platform on Amazon EC2 instances behind Network Load Balancers (NLBs) across multiple AWS Regions. The NLBs can route requests to targets over the internet. The company wants to improve the customer playing experience by reducing end-to-end load time for its global customer base. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in each Region to replace the existing NLBs. Register the existing EC2 instances as targets for the ALBs in each Region.
options.B: Configure Amazon Route 53 to route equally weighted traffic to the NLBs in each Region.
options.C: Create additional NLBs and EC2 instances in other Regions where the company has large customer bases.
options.D: Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Configure the existing NLBs as target endpoints.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

AWS Global Accelerator is designed for this exact type of global, latency-sensitive application. AWS states that a **standard accelerator** improves availability for internet applications used by a global audience and directs traffic over the **AWS global network** to endpoints in the nearest Region to the client. It also explicitly supports **Network Load Balancers** as standard accelerator endpoints in one or multiple Regions ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). AWS also lists gaming as a latency-sensitive use case: Global Accelerator routes users to the nearest application endpoint, reduces internet latency and jitter, uses Anycast to get traffic to the closest edge location, and then uses the AWS global network to reach the closest regional endpoint ([Global Accelerator use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-benefits-of-migrating.html)). Therefore, configuring the existing NLBs as endpoints for a standard accelerator directly meets the requirement to reduce end-to-end load time for global players.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A**: Replacing NLBs with ALBs changes the load balancer type but does not by itself route global users over the AWS global network or optimize for the nearest healthy Regional endpoint. The existing NLBs are already valid Global Accelerator endpoints.
* **B**: Route 53 weighted routing distributes traffic according to configured weights; with equal weights, it sends roughly equal proportions of traffic to each resource, not necessarily to the lowest-latency or nearest Region ([Route 53 weighted routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html)). This does not specifically reduce global end-to-end latency.
* **C**: Adding more Regions and NLBs could help some customer groups, but it is not the most direct solution and still does not provide Anycast edge ingress or routing over the AWS global network. Global Accelerator can use the existing multi-Region NLBs and optimize traffic routing globally.

zh.question: 一家在线游戏公司将其平台托管在跨多个 AWS Region 的 Network Load Balancers (NLBs) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些 NLBs 可以通过互联网将请求路由到目标。该公司希望通过减少其全球客户群的端到端加载时间来改善客户的游戏体验。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在每个 Region 中创建 Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 以替换现有的 NLBs。将现有 EC2 实例注册为每个 Region 中 ALBs 的目标。
options.B: 配置 Amazon Route 53，将等权重流量路由到每个 Region 中的 NLBs。
options.C: 在该公司拥有大量客户群的其他 Region 中创建额外的 NLBs 和 EC2 实例。
options.D: 在 AWS Global Accelerator 中创建一个 standard accelerator。将现有 NLBs 配置为目标端点。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

AWS Global Accelerator 正是为这种全球性的、对延迟敏感的应用程序而设计的。AWS 表示，**standard accelerator** 可提高全球受众使用的互联网应用程序的可用性，并通过 **AWS global network** 将流量引导到距离客户端最近的 Region 中的端点。它还明确支持将 **Network Load Balancers** 作为一个或多个 Region 中的 standard accelerator 端点（[AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。AWS 还将游戏列为对延迟敏感的使用场景：Global Accelerator 将用户路由到最近的应用程序端点，减少互联网延迟和抖动，使用 Anycast 将流量送达最近的边缘站点，然后使用 AWS global network 到达最近的区域端点（[Global Accelerator use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-benefits-of-migrating.html)）。因此，将现有 NLBs 配置为 standard accelerator 的端点，直接满足了为全球玩家减少端到端加载时间的要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **A**：用 ALBs 替换 NLBs 会更改负载均衡器类型，但其本身不会通过 AWS global network 路由全球用户，也不会针对最近的健康 Regional endpoint 进行优化。现有 NLBs 已经是有效的 Global Accelerator 端点。
* **B**：Route 53 weighted routing 会根据配置的权重分配流量；使用相等权重时，它会将大致相同比例的流量发送到每个资源，而不一定发送到延迟最低或最近的 Region（[Route 53 weighted routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html)）。这并不能专门降低全球端到端延迟。
* **C**：添加更多 Region 和 NLBs 可能会帮助某些客户群体，但这不是最直接的解决方案，并且仍然无法提供 Anycast 边缘入口或通过 AWS global network 进行路由。Global Accelerator 可以使用现有的多 Region NLBs，并在全球范围内优化流量路由。

en.question: A company has an on-premises application that uses SFTP to collect financial data from multiple vendors. The company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company has created an application that uses Amazon S3 APIs to upload files from vendors. Some vendors run their systems on legacy applications that do not support S3 APIs. The vendors want to continue to use SFTP-based applications to upload data. The company wants to use managed services for the needs of the vendors that use legacy applications. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) instance to replicate data from the storage of the vendors that use legacy applications to Amazon S3. Provide the vendors with the credentials to access the AWS DMS instance.
options.B: Create an AWS Transfer Family endpoint for vendors that use legacy applications.
options.C: Configure an Amazon EC2 instance to run an SFTP server. Instruct the vendors that use legacy applications to use the SFTP server to upload data.
options.D: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway for vendors that use legacy applications to upload files to an SMB file share.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Transfer Family is the managed service designed for this scenario: it provides managed file transfer into and out of Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS, including **SFTP**, and supports standard file transfer clients. The documentation states that Transfer Family is a **fully managed AWS service** for transferring files to and from **Amazon S3** over protocols including **SFTP**; it is also backed by an auto-scaling, redundant fleet. This lets legacy vendors keep using SFTP while the company stores uploads in S3 with the least operational overhead ([AWS Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. AWS DMS** is for migrating data from supported **database sources** to targets such as S3; when S3 is a target, DMS writes database full-load and CDC data as CSV or Parquet files. It is not a managed SFTP endpoint for vendors to upload arbitrary files ([AWS DMS with S3 target](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.S3.html)).
- **C. EC2 SFTP server** could support SFTP, but the company would need to provision, secure, patch, scale, and operate the server. That is more operational overhead than the fully managed Transfer Family service.
- **D. S3 File Gateway** exposes Amazon S3 through file protocols such as **NFS** and **SMB**, and requires deploying a gateway appliance/VM. It does not meet the requirement for vendors to continue using SFTP-based applications ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个本地应用程序，使用 SFTP 从多个供应商收集财务数据。该公司正在迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司已经创建了一个使用 Amazon S3 APIs 从供应商上传文件的应用程序。一些供应商在不支持 S3 APIs 的旧版应用程序上运行其系统。这些供应商希望继续使用基于 SFTP 的应用程序来上传数据。该公司希望针对使用旧版应用程序的供应商需求使用托管服务。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 实例，将使用旧版应用程序的供应商的存储中的数据复制到 Amazon S3。向供应商提供访问 AWS DMS 实例的凭证。
options.B: 为使用旧版应用程序的供应商创建一个 AWS Transfer Family 端点。
options.C: 配置一个 Amazon EC2 实例来运行 SFTP 服务器。指示使用旧版应用程序的供应商使用该 SFTP 服务器上传数据。
options.D: 为使用旧版应用程序的供应商配置一个 Amazon S3 File Gateway，以便将文件上传到 SMB 文件共享。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.** AWS Transfer Family 是为此场景设计的托管服务：它提供进出 Amazon S3 或 Amazon EFS 的托管文件传输，包括 **SFTP**，并支持标准文件传输客户端。文档说明，Transfer Family 是一项用于通过包括 **SFTP** 在内的协议向 **Amazon S3** 传输文件或从 **Amazon S3** 传输文件的 **fully managed AWS service**；它还由自动扩缩、冗余的机群提供支持。这使旧版供应商能够继续使用 SFTP，同时公司将上传内容存储在 S3 中，并且运营开销最小 ([AWS Transfer Family](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. AWS DMS** 用于将数据从受支持的 **database sources** 迁移到 S3 等目标；当 S3 作为目标时，DMS 会将数据库全量加载和 CDC 数据写入为 CSV 或 Parquet 文件。它不是供供应商上传任意文件的托管 SFTP 端点 ([AWS DMS with S3 target](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Target.S3.html))。
- **C. EC2 SFTP server** 可以支持 SFTP，但公司需要预置、保护、修补、扩展和运维该服务器。这比完全托管的 Transfer Family 服务带来更多运营开销。
- **D. S3 File Gateway** 通过 **NFS** 和 **SMB** 等文件协议公开 Amazon S3，并且需要部署网关设备/VM。它不满足供应商继续使用基于 SFTP 的应用程序这一要求 ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).

en.question: A marketing team wants to build a campaign for an upcoming multi-sport event. The team has news reports from the past five years in PDF format. The team needs a solution to extract insights about the content and the sentiment of the news reports. The solution must use Amazon Textract to process the news reports. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Provide the extracted insights to Amazon Athena for analysis. Store the extracted insights and analysis in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Store the extracted insights in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon SageMaker to build a sentiment model.
options.C: Provide the extracted insights to Amazon Comprehend for analysis. Save the analysis to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Store the extracted insights in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize and analyze the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon Textract is the required service to process the PDF news reports: AWS states that Textract can detect and extract text from documents, including PDF files, and that a common use case is providing extracted text for NLP applications ([Amazon Textract](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)). For the requested content and sentiment insights with the least operational overhead, Amazon Comprehend is the managed NLP service designed for this: it uses a pre-trained model, so there is no need to provide training data, and it analyzes entities, key phrases, sentiment, targeted sentiment, language, and syntax ([Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)). Saving the Comprehend analysis to Amazon S3 is a simple managed storage target.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Athena can query data in S3, but it does not provide built-in NLP sentiment or content insight extraction. It would not meet the sentiment-analysis requirement by itself.
- **B:** Storing results in DynamoDB and building a sentiment model in SageMaker adds unnecessary ML development, training, deployment, and operational overhead. Comprehend already provides pre-trained sentiment and content analysis.
- **D:** QuickSight is primarily for BI dashboards and visualization. It does not extract NLP insights such as sentiment, entities, or key phrases from text; it could visualize results after analysis, but it is not the analysis solution required here.

zh.question: 一个营销团队想要为即将举行的多项运动赛事构建一个活动。该团队拥有过去五年的 PDF 格式新闻报道。团队需要一种解决方案来提取有关新闻报道内容和情绪的洞察。该解决方案必须使用 Amazon Textract 来处理新闻报道。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将提取的洞察提供给 Amazon Athena 进行分析。将提取的洞察和分析存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.B: 将提取的洞察存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。使用 Amazon SageMaker 构建情绪模型。
options.C: 将提取的洞察提供给 Amazon Comprehend 进行分析。将分析结果保存到 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.D: 将提取的洞察存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化和分析数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon Textract 是处理 PDF 新闻报道所需的服务：AWS 表明 Textract 可以检测并提取文档中的文本，包括 PDF 文件，并且一个常见用例是为 NLP 应用程序提供提取的文本（[Amazon Textract](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。对于所需的内容和情绪洞察，并且要实现最少的运营开销，Amazon Comprehend 是为此设计的托管式 NLP 服务：它使用预训练模型，因此无需提供训练数据，并且可以分析实体、关键短语、情绪、定向情绪、语言和语法（[Amazon Comprehend](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/what-is.html)）。将 Comprehend 分析结果保存到 Amazon S3 是一个简单的托管式存储目标。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Athena 可以查询 S3 中的数据，但它不提供内置的 NLP 情绪或内容洞察提取功能。仅靠它本身无法满足情绪分析要求。
- **B:** 将结果存储在 DynamoDB 中并在 SageMaker 中构建情绪模型，会增加不必要的 ML 开发、训练、部署和运营开销。Comprehend 已经提供预训练的情绪和内容分析。
- **D:** QuickSight 主要用于 BI 控制面板和可视化。它不会从文本中提取 NLP 洞察，例如情绪、实体或关键短语；它可以在分析之后可视化结果，但不是此处所需的分析解决方案。

en.question: A company's application runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are in multiple Availability Zones. The application needs to ingest real-time data from third-party applications. The company needs a data ingestion solution that places the ingested raw data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create Amazon Kinesis data streams for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume the Kinesis data streams. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams.
options.B: Create database migration tasks in AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Specify replication instances of the EC2 instances as the source endpoints. Specify the S3 bucket as the target endpoint. Set the migration type to migrate existing data and replicate ongoing changes.
options.C: Create and configure AWS DataSync agents on the EC2 instances. Configure DataSync tasks to transfer data from the EC2 instances to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection to the application for data ingestion. Create Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams to consume direct PUT operations from the application. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery streams.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The requirement is real-time ingestion from applications and storing the raw stream in Amazon S3. Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is designed for “rapid and continuous data intake,” with real-time intake and processing, and supports producers pushing data directly into a stream within seconds ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). Amazon Data Firehose can use a Kinesis data stream as its source; AWS documentation says to choose an existing **Kinesis data stream** as the source for a Firehose stream, and that Firehose reads records from the Kinesis stream ([Firehose source settings for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-kinesis-streams.html)). Firehose also supports Amazon S3 as a destination by specifying an **S3 bucket** where streaming data should be delivered ([Firehose destination settings for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)). Therefore, Kinesis Data Streams plus Firehose to S3 matches the real-time ingestion and S3 raw-data landing requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** AWS DMS is for migrating and replicating databases/data stores, including one-time migrations and ongoing replication, not for general real-time ingestion from third-party applications running against EC2 application tiers ([AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).
- **C:** AWS DataSync is a high-speed file/object transfer service for moving file or object data to, from, and between storage services such as Amazon S3; it is not the appropriate streaming ingestion service for real-time application events ([DataSync overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **D:** AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated network connection between an internal network and AWS; it is connectivity, not an ingestion pipeline. Also, the question does not require a private dedicated connection, and Direct Connect does not itself ingest or deliver stream records to S3 ([Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序运行在位于多个可用区的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序需要从第三方应用程序摄取实时数据。公司需要一种数据摄取解决方案，将摄取的原始数据放入 Amazon S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建用于数据摄取的 Amazon Kinesis data streams。创建 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams 以使用 Kinesis data streams。将 S3 存储桶指定为 delivery streams 的目标。
options.B: 在 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 中创建数据库迁移任务。将 EC2 实例的复制实例指定为源端点。将 S3 存储桶指定为目标端点。将迁移类型设置为迁移现有数据并复制持续更改。
options.C: 在 EC2 实例上创建并配置 AWS DataSync 代理。配置 DataSync 任务，将数据从 EC2 实例传输到 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 为应用程序创建 AWS Direct Connect 连接以进行数据摄取。创建 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams，以使用来自应用程序的直接 PUT 操作。将 S3 存储桶指定为 delivery streams 的目标。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

要求是从应用程序进行实时摄取，并将原始流存储在 Amazon S3 中。Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 专为“快速且持续的数据接收”而设计，支持实时接收和处理，并支持生产者在数秒内将数据直接推送到流中（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。Amazon Data Firehose 可以使用 Kinesis data stream 作为其源；AWS 文档说明，应选择现有的 **Kinesis data stream** 作为 Firehose 流的源，并且 Firehose 会从 Kinesis 流读取记录（[Firehose source settings for Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/writing-with-kinesis-streams.html)）。Firehose 还支持将 Amazon S3 作为目标，方法是指定应将流式数据传输到的 **S3 bucket**（[Firehose destination settings for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/create-destination.html)）。因此，Kinesis Data Streams 加上 Firehose 到 S3，符合实时摄取和 S3 原始数据落地的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** AWS DMS 用于迁移和复制数据库/数据存储，包括一次性迁移和持续复制，而不是用于从针对 EC2 应用程序层运行的第三方应用程序进行通用实时摄取（[AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。
- **C:** AWS DataSync 是一种高速文件/对象传输服务，用于将文件或对象数据传输到 Amazon S3 等存储服务、从这些服务传出以及在这些服务之间传输；它并不是适用于实时应用程序事件的流式摄取服务（[DataSync overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **D:** AWS Direct Connect 在内部网络和 AWS 之间提供专用网络连接；它是连接方式，而不是摄取管道。此外，题目并不要求私有专用连接，并且 Direct Connect 本身不会摄取流记录或将其传输到 S3（[Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company’s application is receiving data from multiple data sources. The size of the data varies and is expected to increase over time. The current maximum size is 700 KB. The data volume and data size continue to grow as more data sources are added. The company decides to use Amazon DynamoDB as the primary database for the application. A solutions architect needs to identify a solution that handles the large data sizes. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to filter the data that exceeds DynamoDB item size limits. Store the larger data in an Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) database.
options.B: Store the large data as objects in an Amazon S3 bucket. In a DynamoDB table, create an item that has an attribute that points to the S3 URL of the data.
options.C: Split all incoming large data into a collection of items that have the same partition key. Write the data to a DynamoDB table in a single operation by using the BatchWriteItem API operation.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses gzip compression to compress the large objects as they are written to a DynamoDB table.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** DynamoDB has a hard maximum item size of **400 KB** including attribute names and values, so the current 700 KB payloads cannot be stored as single DynamoDB items ([DynamoDB constraints: item size](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)). AWS specifically recommends handling large attributes by storing the large value as an **Amazon S3 object** and storing the **S3 object identifier** in the DynamoDB item ([Best practices for storing large items and attributes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)). This is operationally efficient because S3 is designed for object storage, while DynamoDB stores the metadata/reference.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Adding Amazon DocumentDB introduces another database to operate and does not follow the DynamoDB best-practice pattern for large attributes. S3 is the recommended external store for large values that cannot fit in a DynamoDB item.
- **C:** Vertical partitioning is listed as an alternative, but it adds application complexity by splitting and reassembling item collections. Also, `BatchWriteItem` still writes individual items that are limited to 400 KB, and a batch write is not fully atomic as a whole ([BatchWriteItem](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_BatchWriteItem.html)). This is less operationally efficient than storing large objects in S3.
- **D:** Compression can sometimes reduce attribute size, but it does not guarantee that growing or already-large payloads will fit within the 400 KB DynamoDB item limit. AWS notes compression as an option, but also notes compressed attributes are not useful for filtering ([Best practices for storing large items and attributes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序正在从多个数据源接收数据。数据大小各不相同，并且预计会随着时间推移而增加。当前最大大小为 700 KB。随着添加更多数据源，数据量和数据大小持续增长。公司决定使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为应用程序的主数据库。解决方案架构师需要确定一个能够处理大数据大小的解决方案。哪种解决方案能以最高运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来筛选超过 DynamoDB 项目大小限制的数据。将较大的数据存储在 Amazon DocumentDB（兼容 MongoDB）数据库中。
options.B: 将大数据作为对象存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。在 DynamoDB 表中，创建一个项目，该项目具有一个指向数据的 S3 URL 的属性。
options.C: 将所有传入的大数据拆分为一组具有相同分区键的项目。使用 BatchWriteItem API 操作，通过单个操作将数据写入 DynamoDB 表。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，使用 gzip 压缩在大对象写入 DynamoDB 表时对其进行压缩。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** DynamoDB 的项目大小有一个硬性最大限制，为 **400 KB**，包括属性名称和值，因此当前 700 KB 的负载不能作为单个 DynamoDB 项目存储（[DynamoDB constraints: item size](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/Constraints.html)）。AWS 明确建议通过将大值存储为 **Amazon S3 object**，并在 DynamoDB 项目中存储 **S3 object identifier** 来处理大型属性（[Best practices for storing large items and attributes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)）。这在运营上很高效，因为 S3 专为对象存储而设计，而 DynamoDB 存储元数据/引用。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 添加 Amazon DocumentDB 会引入另一个需要运维的数据库，并且不符合 DynamoDB 针对大型属性的最佳实践模式。对于无法放入 DynamoDB 项目的大值，S3 是推荐的外部存储。
- **C:** 垂直分区被列为一种替代方案，但它会通过拆分和重新组装项目集合来增加应用程序复杂性。此外，`BatchWriteItem` 仍然写入受 400 KB 限制的单个项目，并且批量写入作为一个整体并非完全原子操作（[BatchWriteItem](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/APIReference/API_BatchWriteItem.html)）。这比将大对象存储在 S3 中的运营效率更低。
- **D:** 压缩有时可以减少属性大小，但它不能保证不断增长或已经很大的负载能够适配 400 KB 的 DynamoDB 项目限制。AWS 将压缩列为一种选项，但也指出压缩后的属性不适用于筛选（[Best practices for storing large items and attributes in DynamoDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-use-s3-too.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating a legacy application from an on-premises data center to AWS. The application relies on hundreds of cron jobs that run between 1 and 20 minutes on different recurring schedules throughout the day. The company wants a solution to schedule and run the cron jobs on AWS with minimal refactoring. The solution must support running the cron jobs in response to an event in the future. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks as AWS Lambda functions.
options.B: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use AWS Batch on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with a scheduling policy to run the cron jobs.
options.C: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Use Amazon EventBridge Scheduler to create a recurring schedule. Run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Create a container image for the cron jobs. Create a workflow in AWS Step Functions that uses a Wait state to run the cron jobs at a specified time. Use the RunTask action to run the cron job tasks on AWS Fargate.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

Amazon EventBridge Scheduler supports the scheduling requirement directly: it provides **rate-based, cron-based, and one-time schedules**; rate and cron schedules are recurring, and a one-time schedule invokes a target once at a specified future date/time ([Schedule types in EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/scheduler/latest/UserGuide/schedule-types.html)). EventBridge Scheduler also supports **Amazon ECS `RunTask`** as a templated target ([Using templated targets in EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/scheduler/latest/UserGuide/managing-targets-templated.html)). Running those containerized cron jobs as ECS tasks on **AWS Fargate** minimizes infrastructure management because Fargate runs containers without managing servers or EC2 clusters ([Architect for AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Lambda is not suitable for all jobs because Lambda has a maximum timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)**, while some jobs run up to 20 minutes ([Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)).
- **B**: AWS Batch can run containerized batch jobs, but a Batch “scheduling policy” is for fair-share/job-queue resource allocation, not for defining hundreds of cron/one-time future schedules ([Fair-share scheduling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/job_scheduling.html)).
- **D**: Step Functions Wait states can delay workflow execution, but this adds workflow orchestration/refactoring that is unnecessary. EventBridge Scheduler already provides recurring cron/rate and one-time schedules and can invoke ECS `RunTask` directly.

Therefore, containerize the jobs and use **EventBridge Scheduler to run ECS tasks on Fargate**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个旧版应用程序从本地数据中心迁移到 AWS。该应用程序依赖数百个 cron 作业，这些作业全天按照不同的重复计划运行，运行时间在 1 到 20 分钟之间。公司希望使用一种解决方案，在 AWS 上以最少的重构来调度和运行这些 cron 作业。该解决方案必须支持在未来响应某个事件来运行 cron 作业。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 cron 作业创建一个容器镜像。使用 Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 创建重复计划。将 cron 作业任务作为 AWS Lambda 函数运行。
options.B: 为 cron 作业创建一个容器镜像。使用基于 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 的 AWS Batch，并通过调度策略来运行 cron 作业。
options.C: 为 cron 作业创建一个容器镜像。使用 Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 创建重复计划。在 AWS Fargate 上运行 cron 作业任务。
options.D: 为 cron 作业创建一个容器镜像。在 AWS Step Functions 中创建一个使用 Wait 状态在指定时间运行 cron 作业的工作流。使用 RunTask 操作在 AWS Fargate 上运行 cron 作业任务。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 直接支持调度需求：它提供 **基于 rate、基于 cron 以及一次性计划**；rate 和 cron 计划是重复计划，而一次性计划会在指定的未来日期/时间调用一次目标（[Schedule types in EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/scheduler/latest/UserGuide/schedule-types.html)）。EventBridge Scheduler 还支持 **Amazon ECS `RunTask`** 作为模板化目标（[Using templated targets in EventBridge Scheduler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/scheduler/latest/UserGuide/managing-targets-templated.html)）。将这些容器化的 cron 作业作为 **AWS Fargate** 上的 ECS 任务运行，可以最大限度减少基础设施管理，因为 Fargate 可以在无需管理服务器或 EC2 集群的情况下运行容器（[Architect for AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：Lambda 并不适合所有作业，因为 Lambda 的最大超时时间为 **900 秒（15 分钟）**，而有些作业最长运行 20 分钟（[Configure Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。
- **B**：AWS Batch 可以运行容器化的批处理作业，但 Batch 的“调度策略”用于公平共享/作业队列资源分配，而不是用于定义数百个 cron/一次性未来计划（[Fair-share scheduling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/job_scheduling.html)）。
- **D**：Step Functions Wait 状态可以延迟工作流执行，但这会增加不必要的工作流编排/重构。EventBridge Scheduler 已经提供重复的 cron/rate 计划和一次性计划，并且可以直接调用 ECS `RunTask`。因此，应将作业容器化，并使用 **EventBridge Scheduler 在 Fargate 上运行 ECS 任务**。

en.question: A company uses Salesforce. The company needs to load existing data and ongoing data changes from Salesforce to Amazon Redshift for analysis. The company does not want the data to travel over the public internet. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Establish a VPN connection from the VPC to Salesforce. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to transfer data.
options.B: Establish an AWS Direct Connect connection from the VPC to Salesforce. Use AWS Glue DataBrew to transfer data.
options.C: Create an AWS PrivateLink connection in the VPC to Salesforce. Use Amazon AppFlow to transfer data.
options.D: Create a VPC peering connection to Salesforce. Use Amazon AppFlow to transfer data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon AppFlow is the least-development option because it is a fully managed integration service for exchanging data between SaaS applications such as **Salesforce** and AWS services such as **Amazon Redshift**, and AWS states that you can create flows in minutes **without writing code** and run them on demand or on a schedule to keep data in sync ([Amazon AppFlow overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/what-is-appflow.html)). AppFlow specifically supports Salesforce as a data source, and when Salesforce is the source, **Amazon Redshift** is a supported destination ([Salesforce connector for Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/salesforce.html)). For the private-network requirement, AppFlow private flows use **AWS PrivateLink** to route data over AWS infrastructure without exposing it to the public internet, and Salesforce is listed as an SaaS application integrated with PrivateLink ([Private Amazon AppFlow flows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/private-flows.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A** is incorrect. AWS Site-to-Site VPN is described as a connection between a VPC and an on-premises/customer network using IPsec VPN tunnels, not as the managed Salesforce-to-Redshift integration pattern; it also would require more integration work than AppFlow ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)).
* **B** is incorrect. AWS Direct Connect requires establishing a network connection at a Direct Connect location or through a partner/provider and meeting physical/network requirements such as fiber, VLAN, and BGP support, so it is not the least-effort solution for a Salesforce SaaS ingestion use case ([Direct Connect components and requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
* **D** is incorrect. VPC peering is a private networking connection **between two VPCs**; it is not the right mechanism to connect a VPC privately to the Salesforce SaaS service ([VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Salesforce。该公司需要将 Salesforce 中的现有数据和持续的数据变更加载到 Amazon Redshift 中进行分析。该公司不希望数据通过公共互联网传输。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 VPC 到 Salesforce 建立 VPN 连接。使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 传输数据。
options.B: 从 VPC 到 Salesforce 建立 AWS Direct Connect 连接。使用 AWS Glue DataBrew 传输数据。
options.C: 在 VPC 中创建到 Salesforce 的 AWS PrivateLink 连接。使用 Amazon AppFlow 传输数据。
options.D: 创建到 Salesforce 的 VPC 对等连接。使用 Amazon AppFlow 传输数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon AppFlow 是开发工作量最少的选项，因为它是一项完全托管的集成服务，用于在 **Salesforce** 等 SaaS 应用程序与 **Amazon Redshift** 等 AWS 服务之间交换数据，并且 AWS 表示你可以在几分钟内创建流，**无需编写代码**，并可按需或按计划运行这些流以保持数据同步（[Amazon AppFlow overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/what-is-appflow.html)）。AppFlow 明确支持 Salesforce 作为数据源，并且当 Salesforce 是源时，**Amazon Redshift** 是受支持的目标（[Salesforce connector for Amazon AppFlow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/salesforce.html)）。对于私有网络要求，AppFlow 私有流使用 **AWS PrivateLink** 通过 AWS 基础设施路由数据，而不会将其暴露到公共互联网，并且 Salesforce 被列为与 PrivateLink 集成的 SaaS 应用程序（[Private Amazon AppFlow flows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/private-flows.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A** 不正确。AWS Site-to-Site VPN 被描述为使用 IPsec VPN 隧道在 VPC 与本地/客户网络之间建立连接，而不是托管的 Salesforce 到 Redshift 集成模式；它也比 AppFlow 需要更多集成工作（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。
* **B** 不正确。AWS Direct Connect 需要在 Direct Connect 位置或通过合作伙伴/提供商建立网络连接，并满足光纤、VLAN 和 BGP 支持等物理/网络要求，因此对于 Salesforce SaaS 摄取用例而言，它不是工作量最少的解决方案（[Direct Connect components and requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
* **D** 不正确。VPC 对等连接是**两个 VPC 之间**的私有网络连接；它不是将 VPC 私有连接到 Salesforce SaaS 服务的正确机制（[VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。

en.question: A company recently migrated its application to AWS. The application runs on Amazon EC2 Linux instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The application stores data in an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that uses EFS Standard-Infrequent Access storage. The application indexes the company's files. The index is stored in an Amazon RDS database. The company needs to optimize storage costs with some application and services changes. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses an Intelligent-Tiering lifecycle policy. Copy all files to the S3 bucket. Update the application to use Amazon S3 API to store and retrieve files.
options.B: Deploy Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file shares. Update the application to use CIFS protocol to store and retrieve files.
options.C: Deploy Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system shares. Update the application to use the new mount point to store and retrieve files.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket that uses S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval. Copy all files to the S3 bucket. Update the application to use Amazon S3 API to store and retrieve files as standard retrievals.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering is the most cost-effective fit because the application stores and indexes company files, and the question allows application changes to use the S3 API. AWS states that **S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed to optimize storage costs by automatically moving data to the most cost-effective access tier as access patterns change**, with no operational overhead or performance impact, and that it is recommended for **unknown, changing, or unpredictable access patterns**. It also provides low-latency/high-throughput tiers and **has no retrieval charges** for objects in its frequent/infrequent tiers ([AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering.html)). This makes moving the file data from EFS to S3 Intelligent-Tiering the best cost-optimization choice when the application can be modified.

Why the other options are wrong:

- **B. FSx for Windows File Server / CIFS**: The application runs on Linux EC2 instances and currently uses a Linux-compatible shared file system. Moving to Windows file shares and CIFS/SMB does not target the core cost issue as effectively as object storage, and introduces an unnecessary protocol/platform change.
- **C. FSx for OpenZFS**: This remains a managed file-system approach. It may reduce some operational burden or provide ZFS features, but it does not provide the automatic object-tiering cost optimization that S3 Intelligent-Tiering provides.
- **D. S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval**: Glacier Flexible Retrieval is for archive data accessed only one or two times per year and **does not provide real-time access**. AWS says objects must be restored before access, with standard retrieval typically taking **3–5 hours**; the class is archival and recommended for data that does not require immediate access ([AWS S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)). That is not appropriate for an application that stores/retrieves files for indexing and ongoing use.

EFS IA is already a cost-optimized EFS storage class for data accessed only a few times each quarter, but S3 Intelligent-Tiering is more cost-effective when the application can be changed from file-system access to S3 object access ([EFS lifecycle management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/lifecycle-management-efs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近将其应用程序迁移到了 AWS。该应用程序在跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling group 中的 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例上运行。该应用程序将数据存储在使用 EFS Standard-Infrequent Access 存储的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。该应用程序会为公司的文件建立索引。索引存储在 Amazon RDS 数据库中。该公司需要通过一些应用程序和服务变更来优化存储成本。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个使用 Intelligent-Tiering 生命周期策略的 Amazon S3 bucket。将所有文件复制到该 S3 bucket。更新应用程序以使用 Amazon S3 API 来存储和检索文件。
options.B: 部署 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件共享。更新应用程序以使用 CIFS 协议来存储和检索文件。
options.C: 部署 Amazon FSx for OpenZFS 文件系统共享。更新应用程序以使用新的挂载点来存储和检索文件。
options.D: 创建一个使用 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 的 Amazon S3 bucket。将所有文件复制到该 S3 bucket。更新应用程序以使用 Amazon S3 API 将文件作为标准检索来存储和检索。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是最具成本效益的选择，因为该应用程序存储并索引公司文件，并且题目允许通过应用程序变更来使用 S3 API。AWS 表示，**S3 Intelligent-Tiering 旨在通过在访问模式变化时自动将数据移动到最具成本效益的访问层来优化存储成本**，没有运营开销或性能影响，并且建议用于**未知、变化或不可预测的访问模式**。它还提供低延迟/高吞吐量层，并且其频繁/不频繁访问层中的对象**没有检索费用**（[AWS S3 Intelligent-Tiering documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering.html)）。因此，当应用程序可以修改时，将文件数据从 EFS 移动到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 是最佳的成本优化选择。其他选项错误的原因：

- **B. FSx for Windows File Server / CIFS**：该应用程序运行在 Linux EC2 实例上，并且当前使用与 Linux 兼容的共享文件系统。迁移到 Windows 文件共享和 CIFS/SMB 并不能像对象存储那样有效地解决核心成本问题，而且会引入不必要的协议/平台变更。
- **C. FSx for OpenZFS**：这仍然是一种托管文件系统方法。它可能会减少一些运营负担或提供 ZFS 功能，但它不提供 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 所提供的自动对象分层成本优化。
- **D. S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval**：Glacier Flexible Retrieval 适用于每年只访问一两次的归档数据，并且**不提供实时访问**。AWS 表示，对象必须先还原才能访问，标准检索通常需要 **3–5 小时**；该存储类属于归档类，建议用于不需要立即访问的数据（[AWS S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。这不适合用于需要存储/检索文件以进行索引和持续使用的应用程序。

EFS IA 已经是针对每季度只访问几次的数据而设计的成本优化型 EFS 存储类，但当应用程序可以从文件系统访问变更为 S3 对象访问时，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 更具成本效益（[EFS lifecycle management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/lifecycle-management-efs.html)）。

en.question: A robotics company is designing a solution for medical surgery. The robots will use advanced sensors, cameras, and AI algorithms to perceive their environment and to complete surgeries. The company needs a public load balancer in the AWS Cloud that will ensure seamless communication with backend services. The load balancer must be capable of routing traffic based on the query strings to different target groups. The traffic must also be encrypted. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a Network Load Balancer with a certificate attached from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Use query parameter-based routing.
options.B: Use a Gateway Load Balancer. Import a generated certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach the certificate to the load balancer. Use HTTP path-based routing.
options.C: Use an Application Load Balancer with a certificate attached from AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Use query parameter-based routing.
options.D: Use a Network Load Balancer. Import a generated certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Attach the certificate to the load balancer. Use query parameter-based routing.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** An Application Load Balancer is the appropriate public, Layer 7 load balancer for this requirement. ALB listener rules support the `query-string` condition, which routes based on key/value pairs or values in the query string, and listener rules can use a `forward` action to send matching requests to target groups ([ALB listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html), [ALB condition types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-condition-types.html)). For encrypted traffic, an ALB HTTPS listener requires a security policy and certificate, and the certificate can be selected **From ACM** ([Create an HTTPS listener for an ALB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/create-https-listener.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A** and **D**: Network Load Balancers support transport-level protocols such as TCP, TLS, UDP, TCP_UDP, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC, and their default listener action forwards to target groups; the NLB listener documentation does not provide HTTP listener rule conditions such as query-string routing ([NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)). Query-string inspection is an ALB listener rule feature, not an NLB feature.
- **B**: Gateway Load Balancers listen for all IP packets across all ports and forward to a target group; you cannot specify protocol/port, and they are designed for appliance-style packet forwarding rather than HTTP path/query routing or TLS certificate termination as described in the option ([Gateway Load Balancer listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/gateway-listeners.html)). Also, the requirement is query-string routing, not path-based routing.

zh.question: 一家机器人公司正在为医疗手术设计解决方案。这些机器人将使用先进的传感器、摄像头和 AI 算法来感知其环境并完成手术。该公司需要在 AWS Cloud 中使用一个公有负载均衡器，以确保与后端服务的无缝通信。该负载均衡器必须能够根据查询字符串将流量路由到不同的目标组。流量还必须加密。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Network Load Balancer，并附加来自 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 的证书。使用基于查询参数的路由。
options.B: 使用 Gateway Load Balancer。在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中导入生成的证书。将证书附加到负载均衡器。使用基于 HTTP 路径的路由。
options.C: 使用 Application Load Balancer，并附加来自 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 的证书。使用基于查询参数的路由。
options.D: 使用 Network Load Balancer。在 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 中导入生成的证书。将证书附加到负载均衡器。使用基于查询参数的路由。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Application Load Balancer 是满足此要求的合适公有第 7 层负载均衡器。ALB 侦听器规则支持 `query-string` 条件，该条件可根据查询字符串中的键/值对或值进行路由，并且侦听器规则可以使用 `forward` 操作将匹配的请求发送到目标组（[ALB listener rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/listener-rules.html)，[ALB condition types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-condition-types.html)）。对于加密流量，ALB HTTPS 侦听器需要安全策略和证书，并且证书可以选择 **From ACM**（[Create an HTTPS listener for an ALB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/create-https-listener.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A** 和 **D**：Network Load Balancers 支持传输层协议，例如 TCP、TLS、UDP、TCP_UDP、QUIC 和 TCP_QUIC，并且其默认侦听器操作会转发到目标组；NLB 侦听器文档未提供 HTTP 侦听器规则条件，例如查询字符串路由（[NLB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。查询字符串检查是 ALB 侦听器规则功能，而不是 NLB 功能。
- **B**：Gateway Load Balancers 侦听所有端口上的所有 IP 数据包并转发到目标组；你无法指定协议/端口，并且它们是为设备式数据包转发而设计的，而不是为选项中描述的 HTTP 路径/查询路由或 TLS 证书终止而设计的（[Gateway Load Balancer listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/gateway-listeners.html)）。此外，要求是查询字符串路由，而不是基于路径的路由。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The application uses a MySQL database that runs on the same EC2 instance. The company needs a highly available and automatically scalable solution to handle increased traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon Redshift cluster that has multiple MySQL-compatible nodes.
options.B: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that are configured as a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon RDS for MySQL cluster that has multiple instances.
options.C: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL cluster for the database layer.
options.D: Deploy the application to EC2 instances that are configured as a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster that uses the MySQL connector.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The application tier must be both highly available and automatically scalable. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling can place instances across multiple Availability Zones, replace unhealthy instances, and add/remove capacity for peak and low demand. It also integrates with Elastic Load Balancing so that instances launched or terminated by the Auto Scaling group are automatically registered or deregistered, and the group can scale based on ALB metrics such as request count per target ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html), [ELB with Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)). For the database tier, Aurora Serverless is an on-demand, autoscaling Aurora configuration that automatically adjusts database capacity based on application demand, and Aurora clusters provide storage across multiple Availability Zones and support Aurora MySQL-Compatible clusters ([Aurora Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html), [Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** The application tier is appropriate, but Amazon Redshift is a data warehouse service, not a MySQL-compatible OLTP replacement; AWS docs state Redshift is based on PostgreSQL and is used with ETL, BI, reporting, data mining, and analytics tools ([Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_high_level_system_architecture.html)).
- **B:** An ALB target group alone does not provide automatic scaling of EC2 instances. The EC2 instances must be in an Auto Scaling group to add/remove capacity automatically and maintain availability ([ELB with Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)).
- **D:** ElastiCache for Redis is an in-memory cache, not a MySQL database replacement. AWS documents ElastiCache as a cache for frequently accessed data and as supporting Valkey, Memcached, and Redis OSS engines—not MySQL ([ElastiCache cache engines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.corecomponents.html)). It also lacks an Auto Scaling group for the application tier.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个在单个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的应用程序。该应用程序使用一个在同一 EC2 实例上运行的 MySQL 数据库。该公司需要一个高可用且可自动扩展的解决方案来处理增加的流量。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将应用程序部署到在 Application Load Balancer 后方的 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 EC2 实例上。创建一个包含多个 MySQL 兼容节点的 Amazon Redshift 集群。
options.B: 将应用程序部署到配置为 Application Load Balancer 后方目标组的 EC2 实例上。创建一个包含多个实例的 Amazon RDS for MySQL 集群。
options.C: 将应用程序部署到在 Application Load Balancer 后方的 Auto Scaling 组中运行的 EC2 实例上。为数据库层创建一个 Amazon Aurora Serverless MySQL 集群。
options.D: 将应用程序部署到配置为 Application Load Balancer 后方目标组的 EC2 实例上。创建一个使用 MySQL 连接器的 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

应用程序层必须同时具备高可用性和自动扩展能力。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 可以将实例放置在多个 Availability Zones 中，替换运行状况不佳的实例，并根据峰值和低需求添加/移除容量。它还与 Elastic Load Balancing 集成，因此由 Auto Scaling 组启动或终止的实例会自动注册或注销，并且该组可以基于 ALB 指标进行扩展，例如每个目标的请求计数（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)，[ELB with Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。对于数据库层，Aurora Serverless 是一种按需、自动扩展的 Aurora 配置，可根据应用程序需求自动调整数据库容量，并且 Aurora 集群在多个 Availability Zones 中提供存储，并支持 Aurora MySQL-Compatible 集群（[Aurora Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)，[Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 应用程序层是合适的，但 Amazon Redshift 是一种数据仓库服务，而不是 MySQL 兼容的 OLTP 替代方案；AWS 文档说明 Redshift 基于 PostgreSQL，并用于 ETL、BI、报告、数据挖掘和分析工具（[Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_high_level_system_architecture.html)）。
- **B:** 仅有 ALB 目标组并不能提供 EC2 实例的自动扩展。EC2 实例必须位于 Auto Scaling 组中，才能自动添加/移除容量并保持可用性（[ELB with Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。
- **D:** ElastiCache for Redis 是内存缓存，而不是 MySQL 数据库替代品。AWS 文档将 ElastiCache 描述为用于频繁访问数据的缓存，并支持 Valkey、Memcached 和 Redis OSS 引擎，而不支持 MySQL（[ElastiCache cache engines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/WhatIs.corecomponents.html)）。它还缺少用于应用程序层的 Auto Scaling 组。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted at rest within the S3 bucket. The encryption key must be rotated automatically every year. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE- S3). Use the built-in key rotation behavior of SSE-S3 encryption keys.
options.B: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Enable automatic key rotation. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Set the S3 bucket's default encryption behavior to use the customer managed KMS key. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Manually rotate the KMS key every year.
options.D: Use customer key material to encrypt the data. Migrate the data to the S3 bucket. Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key without key material. Import the customer key material into the KMS key. Enable automatic key rotation.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Create a customer managed AWS KMS key, enable automatic rotation, configure the S3 bucket default encryption to use that KMS key, and then migrate the data. Amazon S3 default encryption can be configured to use SSE-KMS when you need more control over encryption keys, including key rotation and access policy grants ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)). AWS KMS states that when automatic key rotation is enabled, the default rotation period is every year/365 days, and AWS KMS performs the rotation automatically without application changes ([KMS automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** SSE-S3 encrypts new S3 objects by default, but AWS documentation says to use SSE-KMS if you need more control over encryption keys, such as managing key rotation ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)). The requirement is specifically automatic annual key rotation, which is directly supported by AWS KMS configuration.
- **C:** Manually rotating the KMS key every year does not meet the “automatically every year” requirement and has more operational overhead. AWS KMS can rotate eligible customer managed keys automatically ([KMS automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)).
- **D:** KMS keys with imported key material cannot use automatic key rotation; AWS says you cannot enable automatic key rotation for a KMS key with imported key material ([imported key material considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/importing-keys-considerations.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将数据迁移到一个 Amazon S3 bucket。数据必须在该 S3 bucket 内静态加密。加密密钥必须每年自动轮换。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据迁移到 S3 bucket。使用采用 Amazon S3 托管密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE- S3)。使用 SSE-S3 加密密钥的内置密钥轮换行为。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥。启用自动密钥轮换。将 S3 bucket 的默认加密行为设置为使用该客户托管 KMS key。将数据迁移到 S3 bucket。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥。将 S3 bucket 的默认加密行为设置为使用该客户托管 KMS key。将数据迁移到 S3 bucket。每年手动轮换 KMS key。
options.D: 使用客户密钥材料加密数据。将数据迁移到 S3 bucket。创建一个不含密钥材料的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key。将客户密钥材料导入到该 KMS key。启用自动密钥轮换。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 创建一个客户托管 AWS KMS key，启用自动轮换，配置 S3 bucket 默认加密以使用该 KMS key，然后迁移数据。当你需要对加密密钥进行更多控制（包括密钥轮换和访问策略授权）时，可以将 Amazon S3 默认加密配置为使用 SSE-KMS（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。AWS KMS 说明，启用自动密钥轮换后，默认轮换周期为每年/365 天，并且 AWS KMS 会自动执行轮换，无需更改应用程序（[KMS automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** SSE-S3 默认会加密新的 S3 对象，但 AWS 文档指出，如果你需要对加密密钥进行更多控制（例如管理密钥轮换），应使用 SSE-KMS（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。要求明确是自动年度密钥轮换，而这是由 AWS KMS 配置直接支持的。
- **C:** 每年手动轮换 KMS key 不满足“每年自动”的要求，并且具有更多运营开销。AWS KMS 可以自动轮换符合条件的客户托管密钥（[KMS automatic key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotating-keys-enable.html)）。
- **D:** 使用导入密钥材料的 KMS keys 不能使用自动密钥轮换；AWS 表示，你不能为包含导入密钥材料的 KMS key 启用自动密钥轮换（[imported key material considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/importing-keys-considerations.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating applications from an on-premises Microsoft Active Directory that the company manages to AWS. The company deploys the applications in multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage the accounts centrally. The company's security team needs a single sign-on solution across all the company's AWS accounts. The company must continue to manage users and groups that are in the on-premises Active Directory. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Enterprise Edition Active Directory in AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory. Configure the Active Directory to be the identity source for AWS IAM Identity Center.
options.B: Enable AWS IAM Identity Center. Configure a two-way forest trust relationship to connect the company's self-managed Active Directory with IAM Identity Center by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.
options.C: Use AWS Directory Service and create a two-way trust relationship with the company's self- managed Active Directory.
options.D: Deploy an identity provider (IdP) on Amazon EC2. Link the IdP as an identity source within AWS IAM Identity Center.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

IAM Identity Center is the AWS service designed to provide workforce SSO and centralized permissions across AWS accounts. AWS documentation states that IAM Identity Center provides “one place” to assign permissions to users and groups in **multiple AWS accounts**, and an organization instance gives a single point to manage user access across AWS accounts ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)). AWS also recommends enabling IAM Identity Center with AWS Organizations to create an organization instance with central management capabilities ([IAM Identity Center and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-and-orgs.html)).

For users that remain in a self-managed/on-premises Active Directory, AWS documents that users in a self-managed AD can have SSO access to AWS accounts and applications by creating a **two-way trust relationship** between **AWS Managed Microsoft AD** and the self-managed AD. IAM Identity Center requires the two-way trust so it can read and synchronize user and group metadata while trusting the domain for authentication ([Connect a self-managed directory in Active Directory to IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/connectonpremad.html)). Therefore, enabling IAM Identity Center and connecting the on-premises AD through AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory with a two-way forest trust meets all requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Creating a new Enterprise Edition AWS Managed Microsoft AD and making it the identity source does not, by itself, keep users and groups managed in the existing on-premises AD. AWS Managed Microsoft AD Standard/Enterprise creates new managed AD domains; the required pattern for existing AD identities is a trust relationship so users can use existing credentials while identities stay in the existing AD domains ([AWS Managed Microsoft AD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_microsoft_ad.html)).
- **C:** A Directory Service trust relationship alone does not provide the required SSO and centralized multi-account access management. IAM Identity Center is the service that provides centralized assignments to multiple AWS accounts ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)).
- **D:** Deploying a custom IdP on EC2 is unnecessary operational overhead and is not the documented managed integration for self-managed AD in this scenario. AWS specifically documents connecting self-managed AD to IAM Identity Center through AWS Managed Microsoft AD with a two-way trust or AD Connector ([Connect a self-managed directory in Active Directory to IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/connectonpremad.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将应用程序从公司自行管理的本地 Microsoft Active Directory 迁移到 AWS。该公司将应用程序部署在多个 AWS 账户中。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 集中管理这些账户。公司的安全团队需要一个跨公司所有 AWS 账户的单点登录解决方案。公司必须继续管理位于本地 Active Directory 中的用户和组。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 中创建一个 Enterprise Edition Active Directory。将该 Active Directory 配置为 AWS IAM Identity Center 的身份源。
options.B: 启用 AWS IAM Identity Center。通过使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory，配置双向林信任关系，以将公司的自托管 Active Directory 与 IAM Identity Center 连接起来。
options.C: 使用 AWS Directory Service，并与公司的自托管 Active Directory 创建双向信任关系。
options.D: 在 Amazon EC2 上部署身份提供商 (IdP)。将该 IdP 作为 AWS IAM Identity Center 中的身份源进行链接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

IAM Identity Center 是 AWS 服务，旨在跨 AWS 账户提供员工 SSO 和集中式权限管理。AWS 文档说明，IAM Identity Center 提供“一个位置”，用于向 **多个 AWS 账户** 中的用户和组分配权限，并且组织实例提供一个单点来管理跨 AWS 账户的用户访问权限（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。AWS 还建议结合 AWS Organizations 启用 IAM Identity Center，以创建具有集中管理能力的组织实例（[IAM Identity Center and AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-and-orgs.html)）。对于仍保留在自托管/本地 Active Directory 中的用户，AWS 文档说明，通过在 **AWS Managed Microsoft AD** 与自托管 AD 之间创建 **双向信任关系**，自托管 AD 中的用户可以获得对 AWS 账户和应用程序的 SSO 访问权限。IAM Identity Center 需要这种双向信任，以便在信任该域进行身份验证的同时，读取并同步用户和组元数据（[Connect a self-managed directory in Active Directory to IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/connectonpremad.html)）。因此，启用 IAM Identity Center，并通过 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 使用双向林信任连接本地 AD，可以满足所有要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 创建新的 Enterprise Edition AWS Managed Microsoft AD 并将其作为身份源，本身并不能让用户和组继续在现有本地 AD 中进行管理。AWS Managed Microsoft AD Standard/Enterprise 会创建新的托管 AD 域；对于现有 AD 身份，所需模式是建立信任关系，使用户能够使用现有凭证，同时身份仍保留在现有 AD 域中（[AWS Managed Microsoft AD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_microsoft_ad.html)）。
- **C:** 仅有 Directory Service 信任关系并不能提供所需的 SSO 和集中式多账户访问管理。IAM Identity Center 才是向多个 AWS 账户提供集中式分配的服务（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。
- **D:** 在 EC2 上部署自定义 IdP 会带来不必要的运维开销，并且不是此场景中针对自托管 AD 的文档化托管集成方式。AWS 明确记录了通过 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 使用双向信任或 AD Connector 将自托管 AD 连接到 IAM Identity Center 的方法（[Connect a self-managed directory in Active Directory to IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/connectonpremad.html)）。

en.question: A company is planning to deploy its application on an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster. The application will receive large amounts of traffic. The company wants to optimize the storage performance of the cluster as the load on the application increases. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the cluster to use the Aurora Standard storage configuration.
options.B: Configure the cluster storage type as Provisioned IOPS.
options.C: Configure the cluster storage type as General Purpose.
options.D: Configure the cluster to use the Aurora I/O-Optimized storage configuration.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D. Configure the cluster to use the Aurora I/O-Optimized storage configuration.**

AWS documentation states that Amazon Aurora has **two DB cluster storage configurations**: **Aurora I/O-Optimized** and **Aurora Standard**. Aurora I/O-Optimized provides “improved price performance and predictability for I/O-intensive applications” and has **no additional charges for read and write I/O operations**. AWS also says it is the best choice when I/O spending is 25% or more of total Aurora database spending. For an application expecting large amounts of traffic and needing storage performance to scale cost-effectively as load increases, I/O-Optimized is the appropriate choice ([AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A. Aurora Standard** — Aurora Standard is cost-effective for applications with **moderate I/O usage**, and AWS charges per 1 million I/O requests in addition to storage and usage. That is not the most cost-effective fit for a high-traffic, I/O-intensive workload ([AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)).
* **B. Provisioned IOPS** — Provisioned IOPS is not one of the two Aurora DB cluster storage configurations listed by AWS for Aurora clusters. Aurora storage configuration choices are Aurora Standard and Aurora I/O-Optimized ([AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)).
* **C. General Purpose** — General Purpose is also not one of the two Aurora DB cluster storage configurations. AWS lists only Aurora Standard and Aurora I/O-Optimized for Aurora clusters ([AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将其应用程序部署在 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 集群上。该应用程序将接收大量流量。公司希望随着应用程序负载增加，优化集群的存储性能。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将集群配置为使用 Aurora Standard 存储配置。
options.B: 将集群存储类型配置为 Provisioned IOPS。
options.C: 将集群存储类型配置为 General Purpose。
options.D: 将集群配置为使用 Aurora I/O-Optimized 存储配置。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D. Configure the cluster to use the Aurora I/O-Optimized storage configuration.**

AWS 文档说明，Amazon Aurora 有 **两种 DB 集群存储配置**：**Aurora I/O-Optimized** 和 **Aurora Standard**。Aurora I/O-Optimized 为“I/O 密集型应用程序”提供“更好的性价比和可预测性”，并且对**读写 I/O 操作不收取额外费用**。AWS 还表示，当 I/O 支出占 Aurora 数据库总支出的 25% 或更多时，它是最佳选择。对于预期会有大量流量，并且需要随着负载增加以具成本效益的方式扩展存储性能的应用程序，I/O-Optimized 是合适的选择（[AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **A. Aurora Standard** — Aurora Standard 对于 **I/O 使用量适中** 的应用程序具有成本效益，AWS 除了存储和使用量之外，还会按每 100 万次 I/O 请求收费。这并不是高流量、I/O 密集型工作负载最具成本效益的选择（[AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)）。
* **B. Provisioned IOPS** — Provisioned IOPS 不是 AWS 为 Aurora 集群列出的两种 Aurora DB 集群存储配置之一。Aurora 存储配置选项是 Aurora Standard 和 Aurora I/O-Optimized（[AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)）。
* **C. General Purpose** — General Purpose 也不是两种 Aurora DB 集群存储配置之一。AWS 仅为 Aurora 集群列出 Aurora Standard 和 Aurora I/O-Optimized（[AWS Aurora storage configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.StorageReliability.html)）。

en.question: A financial services company that runs on AWS has designed its security controls to meet industry standards. The industry standards include the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS). The company's third-party auditors need proof that the designed controls have been implemented and are functioning correctly. The company has hundreds of AWS accounts in a single organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to monitor the current state of the controls across accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Designate one account as the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator account from the Organizations management account. Integrate Inspector with Organizations to discover and scan resources across all AWS accounts. Enable Inspector industry standards for NIST and PCI DSS.
options.B: Designate one account as the Amazon GuardDuty delegated administrator account from the Organizations management account. In the designated GuardDuty administrator account, enable GuardDuty to protect all member accounts. Enable GuardDuty industry standards for NIST and PCI DSS.
options.C: Configure an AWS CloudTrail organization trail in the Organizations management account. Designate one account as the compliance account. Enable CloudTrail security standards for NIST and PCI DSS in the compliance account.
options.D: Designate one account as the AWS Security Hub delegated administrator account from the Organizations management account. In the designated Security Hub administrator account, enable Security Hub for all member accounts. Enable Security Hub standards for NIST and PCI DSS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Security Hub CSPM is the service intended for centralized security posture and compliance monitoring. AWS states that Security Hub CSPM provides “a comprehensive view of your security state” and assesses AWS environments against security industry standards and best practices, collecting security data across AWS accounts and services ([Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)). It explicitly supports external frameworks including **PCI DSS** and **NIST**, runs checks against security controls, and generates findings to help assess compliance ([Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)). AWS also documents that Security Hub maps standards to controls and runs security checks to evaluate whether requirements are being met, and lists **NIST SP 800-53**, **NIST SP 800-171**, and **PCI DSS** as supported standards ([Standards reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/standards-reference.html)). For a multi-account organization, the AWS Organizations management account can designate a delegated administrator for Security Hub ([Designating a delegated administrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/securityhub-v2-set-da.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **A — Amazon Inspector** is primarily for vulnerability management/scanning. Security Hub can receive findings from Inspector, but Inspector is not the service that enables NIST and PCI DSS standards across accounts for compliance posture monitoring; Security Hub is the standards/control assessment service ([Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)).
* **B — Amazon GuardDuty** is a threat detection service. Security Hub can receive GuardDuty findings, but GuardDuty does not provide Security Hub’s NIST/PCI DSS standards and control checks ([Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)).
* **C — AWS CloudTrail** records API activity and can be a data source for controls, but it does not provide “CloudTrail security standards” for NIST and PCI DSS. Security Hub includes controls such as CloudTrail-related checks within standards like PCI DSS ([PCI DSS in Security Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/pci-standard.html)), but CloudTrail itself is not the compliance monitoring solution.

zh.question: 一家在 AWS 上运行的金融服务公司已设计其安全控制措施以满足行业标准。这些行业标准包括 National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 和 Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)。公司的第三方审计员需要证明所设计的控制措施已经实施并且正常运行。该公司在 AWS Organizations 的单个组织中拥有数百个 AWS 账户。公司需要跨账户监控这些控制措施的当前状态。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 从 Organizations 管理账户将一个账户指定为 Amazon Inspector 委派管理员账户。将 Inspector 与 Organizations 集成，以发现并扫描所有 AWS 账户中的资源。启用 Inspector 针对 NIST 和 PCI DSS 的行业标准。
options.B: 从 Organizations 管理账户将一个账户指定为 Amazon GuardDuty 委派管理员账户。在指定的 GuardDuty 管理员账户中，启用 GuardDuty 以保护所有成员账户。启用 GuardDuty 针对 NIST 和 PCI DSS 的行业标准。
options.C: 在 Organizations 管理账户中配置 AWS CloudTrail 组织跟踪。将一个账户指定为合规账户。在合规账户中启用 CloudTrail 针对 NIST 和 PCI DSS 的安全标准。
options.D: 从 Organizations 管理账户将一个账户指定为 AWS Security Hub 委派管理员账户。在指定的 Security Hub 管理员账户中，为所有成员账户启用 Security Hub。启用 Security Hub 针对 NIST 和 PCI DSS 的标准。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** AWS Security Hub CSPM 是用于集中式安全态势和合规性监控的服务。AWS 表示，Security Hub CSPM 提供“a comprehensive view of your security state”，并根据安全行业标准和最佳实践评估 AWS 环境，跨 AWS 账户和服务收集安全数据（[Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)）。它明确支持包括 **PCI DSS** 和 **NIST** 在内的外部框架，针对安全控制运行检查，并生成发现结果以帮助评估合规性（[Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)）。AWS 还记录了 Security Hub 会将标准映射到控制项，并运行安全检查以评估是否满足要求，同时列出 **NIST SP 800-53**、**NIST SP 800-171** 和 **PCI DSS** 作为支持的标准（[Standards reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/standards-reference.html)）。对于多账户组织，AWS Organizations 管理账户可以为 Security Hub 指定委派管理员（[Designating a delegated administrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/securityhub-v2-set-da.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **A — Amazon Inspector** 主要用于漏洞管理/扫描。Security Hub 可以接收来自 Inspector 的发现结果，但 Inspector 不是用于跨账户启用 NIST 和 PCI DSS 标准以进行合规态势监控的服务；Security Hub 才是标准/控制评估服务（[Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)）。
* **B — Amazon GuardDuty** 是一项威胁检测服务。Security Hub 可以接收 GuardDuty 发现结果，但 GuardDuty 不提供 Security Hub 的 NIST/PCI DSS 标准和控制检查（[Security Hub introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-is-securityhub.html)）。
* **C — AWS CloudTrail** 记录 API 活动，并且可以作为控制项的数据源，但它不提供针对 NIST 和 PCI DSS 的“CloudTrail security standards”。Security Hub 在 PCI DSS 等标准中包含 CloudTrail 相关检查等控制项（[PCI DSS in Security Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/pci-standard.html)），但 CloudTrail 本身不是合规性监控解决方案。
