en.question: A company uses an Amazon S3 bucket as its data lake storage platform. The S3 bucket contains a massive amount of data that is accessed randomly by multiple teams and hundreds of applications. The company wants to reduce the S3 storage costs and provide immediate availability for frequently accessed objects. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to transition objects to the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class.
options.B: Store objects in Amazon S3 Glacier. Use S3 Select to provide applications with access to the data.
options.C: Use data from S3 storage class analysis to create S3 Lifecycle rules to automatically transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class.
options.D: Transition objects to the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an AWS Lambda function to transition objects to the S3 Standard storage class when they are accessed by an application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed for data with **unknown or changing access patterns**, which matches a data lake with random access by many teams and applications. AWS states that S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects to the most cost-effective access tier **without performance impact or operational overhead**, and it provides automatic cost savings as access patterns change. It also has low-latency/high-throughput tiers and no retrieval fees, which supports immediate availability for frequently accessed objects ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html), [How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)). A Lifecycle rule can transition existing objects into this storage class, and S3 Lifecycle rules are an AWS-managed way to transition objects to lower-cost storage classes ([S3 Lifecycle management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is for archive data that is accessed infrequently and **doesn't require immediate access**. Objects in this class are archived and not available for real-time access; retrieval can take minutes to hours ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)). This does not meet the immediate-availability requirement.
- **C:** S3 Standard-IA is intended for **long-lived, infrequently accessed** data and has retrieval charges, so it is not the best fit for massive randomly accessed data where access patterns change unpredictably ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). It also requires analysis and lifecycle tuning, which is less operationally efficient than Intelligent-Tiering.
- **D:** Moving everything to Standard-IA and using Lambda to move objects back to Standard on access adds custom operational complexity. Standard-IA is suitable for infrequently accessed data and charges retrieval fees, while Intelligent-Tiering already automates movement based on access patterns without operational overhead ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为其数据湖存储平台。该 S3 存储桶包含大量数据，这些数据由多个团队和数百个应用程序随机访问。公司希望降低 S3 存储成本，并为频繁访问的对象提供即时可用性。哪种解决方案在满足这些要求的同时，运营效率最高？

options.A: 创建 S3 Lifecycle 规则，将对象转换到 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存储类。
options.B: 将对象存储在 Amazon S3 Glacier 中。使用 S3 Select 为应用程序提供对数据的访问。
options.C: 使用来自 S3 storage class analysis 的数据创建 S3 Lifecycle 规则，自动将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类。
options.D: 将对象转换到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 存储类。创建 AWS Lambda 函数，在应用程序访问对象时将对象转换到 S3 Standard 存储类。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

S3 Intelligent-Tiering 专为具有**未知或不断变化的访问模式**的数据而设计，这与由许多团队和应用程序随机访问的数据湖相匹配。AWS 表示，S3 Intelligent-Tiering 会自动将对象移动到最具成本效益的访问层，且**不会产生性能影响或运营开销**，并会随着访问模式变化自动节省成本。它还具有低延迟/高吞吐量层且无检索费用，这支持频繁访问对象的即时可用性（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)，[How S3 Intelligent-Tiering works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。Lifecycle 规则可以将现有对象转换到此存储类，而 S3 Lifecycle 规则是 AWS 托管的方式，可将对象转换到成本更低的存储类（[S3 Lifecycle management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 适用于不频繁访问且**不需要即时访问**的归档数据。此类中的对象已归档，无法用于实时访问；检索可能需要数分钟到数小时（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。这不满足即时可用性要求。
- **C:** S3 Standard-IA 旨在用于**长期保存、不频繁访问**的数据，并且会产生检索费用，因此不最适合访问模式不可预测地变化的大规模随机访问数据（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。它还需要分析和生命周期调优，其运营效率低于 Intelligent-Tiering。
- **D:** 将所有内容移动到 Standard-IA，并使用 Lambda 在访问时将对象移回 Standard，会增加自定义运营复杂性。Standard-IA 适合不频繁访问的数据并收取检索费用，而 Intelligent-Tiering 已经能够基于访问模式自动移动对象且无运营开销（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A company has 5 TB of datasets. The datasets consist of 1 million user profiles and 10 million connections. The user profiles have connections as many-to-many relationships. The company needs a performance efficient way to find mutual connections up to five levels. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the datasets. Use Amazon Athena to perform SQL JOIN queries to find connections.
options.B: Use Amazon Neptune to store the datasets with edges and vertices. Query the data to find connections.
options.C: Use an Amazon S3 bucket to store the datasets. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize connections.
options.D: Use Amazon RDS to store the datasets with multiple tables. Perform SQL JOIN queries to find connections.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

Amazon Neptune is purpose-built for this type of problem: AWS describes Neptune as a fully managed **graph database** for applications that work with **highly connected datasets**, optimized for storing **billions of relationships** and querying graphs with millisecond latency. Neptune supports graph query languages such as Gremlin and openCypher, which are designed to efficiently navigate connected data such as user profiles and many-to-many relationships up to multiple hops ([Amazon Neptune intro](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)). Neptune’s graph data model also directly represents relationships between vertices using source vertex, target vertex, and edge label values ([Neptune graph data model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/feature-overview-data-model.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. S3 + Athena**: Athena can run SQL queries over data, including tables defined on S3 data ([Athena SQL queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)), but repeated multi-level relationship traversal would require complex recursive/self-join-style processing and is not the most performance-efficient fit for graph traversal.
- **C. S3 + QuickSight**: QuickSight is for visualizing data, reports, and dashboards ([QuickSight visuals](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/working-with-visuals.html)); it is not a graph database or traversal engine for finding mutual connections.
- **D. RDS + SQL JOINs**: Amazon RDS is a managed relational database service ([Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). Relational tables and SQL joins can model relationships, but multi-hop many-to-many connection discovery is a graph traversal workload, for which Neptune is the purpose-built and more performance-efficient choice.

zh.question: 一家公司有 5 TB 的数据集。这些数据集包含 100 万个用户资料和 1000 万个连接。用户资料之间的连接是多对多关系。该公司需要一种性能高效的方式来查找最多五层的共同连接。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 bucket 存储数据集。使用 Amazon Athena 执行 SQL JOIN 查询以查找连接。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Neptune 通过边和顶点存储数据集。查询数据以查找连接。
options.C: 使用 Amazon S3 bucket 存储数据集。使用 Amazon QuickSight 可视化连接。
options.D: 使用 Amazon RDS 通过多个表存储数据集。执行 SQL JOIN 查询以查找连接。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

Amazon Neptune 专为此类问题而构建：AWS 将 Neptune 描述为一种完全托管的 **图数据库**，适用于处理 **高度连接数据集** 的应用程序，经过优化可存储 **数十亿个关系**，并以毫秒级延迟查询图。Neptune 支持 Gremlin 和 openCypher 等图查询语言，这些语言旨在高效遍历连接数据，例如用户资料和最多多个跳数的多对多关系（[Amazon Neptune intro](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。Neptune 的图数据模型还使用源顶点、目标顶点和边标签值来直接表示顶点之间的关系（[Neptune graph data model](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/neptune/latest/userguide/feature-overview-data-model.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. S3 + Athena**：Athena 可以对数据运行 SQL 查询，包括在 S3 数据上定义的表（[Athena SQL queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/querying-athena-tables.html)），但重复的多层关系遍历需要复杂的递归/自连接式处理，并不是图遍历在性能效率方面最合适的选择。
- **C. S3 + QuickSight**：QuickSight 用于可视化数据、报告和控制面板（[QuickSight visuals](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/working-with-visuals.html)）；它不是用于查找共同连接的图数据库或遍历引擎。
- **D. RDS + SQL JOINs**：Amazon RDS 是一种托管式关系数据库服务（[Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。关系表和 SQL 连接可以对关系建模，但多跳多对多连接发现是一种图遍历工作负载，Neptune 是专为此类场景构建且性能效率更高的选择。

en.question: A company needs a secure connection between its on-premises environment and AWS. This connection does not need high bandwidth and will handle a small amount of traffic. The connection should be set up quickly. What is the MOST cost-effective method to establish this type of connection?

options.A: Implement a client VPN.
options.B: Implement AWS Direct Connect.
options.C: Implement a bastion host on Amazon EC2.
options.D: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection.**

AWS Site-to-Site VPN is designed for a secure network-to-network connection between an on-premises environment and AWS: AWS defines a VPN connection as “a secure connection between your on-premises equipment and your VPCs,” with encrypted VPN tunnels, and states that Site-to-Site VPN supports IPsec VPN connections ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). Because it uses VPN over the internet rather than a dedicated private circuit, it is the most cost-effective and quick-to-establish option for low-bandwidth, small-volume traffic.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Client VPN** — AWS Client VPN is a *client-based* VPN for users connecting from any location using an OpenVPN-based client ([AWS Client VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/what-is.html)). The question asks for a company site/on-premises environment connected to AWS, not individual remote-user access.
- **B. AWS Direct Connect** — Direct Connect establishes a network connection from premises to an AWS Region through a Direct Connect location, and pricing includes port-hour charges based on capacity and connection type ([AWS Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). This is generally more appropriate for dedicated connectivity and higher/consistent bandwidth needs, not the fastest or most cost-effective choice for small traffic volumes.
- **C. Bastion host on EC2** — A bastion host pattern provides administrative access to instances, not a secure site-to-site network connection between an on-premises network and AWS. EC2 connection documentation focuses on connecting to Linux instances, such as through EC2 Instance Connect or SSH ([Amazon EC2 connection methods](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-connect-methods.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要在其本地环境与 AWS 之间建立安全连接。此连接不需要高带宽，并且只会处理少量流量。该连接应快速设置。建立这种连接的最具成本效益的方法是什么？

options.A: 实施 client VPN。
options.B: 实施 AWS Direct Connect。
options.C: 在 Amazon EC2 上实施堡垒主机。
options.D: 实施 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 实施 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 连接。**

AWS Site-to-Site VPN 专为本地环境与 AWS 之间的安全网络到网络连接而设计：AWS 将 VPN 连接定义为“你的本地设备与 VPC 之间的安全连接”，具有加密的 VPN 隧道，并说明 Site-to-Site VPN 支持 IPsec VPN 连接（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。由于它通过互联网使用 VPN，而不是专用私有线路，因此对于低带宽、小流量场景，它是最具成本效益且可快速建立的选项。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Client VPN** — AWS Client VPN 是一种*基于客户端*的 VPN，用于用户从任何位置使用基于 OpenVPN 的客户端进行连接（[AWS Client VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/clientvpn-admin/what-is.html)）。题目要求的是将公司站点/本地环境连接到 AWS，而不是单个远程用户访问。
- **B. AWS Direct Connect** — Direct Connect 通过 Direct Connect location 从本地到 AWS Region 建立网络连接，定价包括基于容量和连接类型的端口小时费用（[AWS Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。这通常更适合专用连接以及更高/稳定带宽的需求，而不是小流量场景下最快或最具成本效益的选择。
- **C. Bastion host on EC2** — 堡垒主机模式提供对实例的管理访问，而不是在本地网络与 AWS 之间建立安全的站点到站点网络连接。EC2 连接文档侧重于连接到 Linux 实例，例如通过 EC2 Instance Connect 或 SSH（[Amazon EC2 connection methods](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-connect-methods.html)）。

en.question: A company has an on-premises SFTP file transfer solution. The company is migrating to the AWS Cloud to scale the file transfer solution and to optimize costs by using Amazon S3. The company's employees will use their credentials for the on-premises Microsoft Active Directory (AD) to access the new solution. The company wants to keep the current authentication and file access mechanisms. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an S3 File Gateway. Create SMB file shares on the file gateway that use the existing Active Directory to authenticate.
options.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group with Amazon EC2 instances to run an SFTP solution. Configure the group to scale up at 60% CPU utilization.
options.C: Create an AWS Transfer Family server with SFTP endpoints. Choose the AWS Directory Service option as the identity provider. Use AD Connector to connect the on-premises Active Directory.
options.D: Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP endpoint. Configure the endpoint to use the AWS Directory Service option as the identity provider to connect to the existing Active Directory.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**. AWS Transfer Family is a fully managed service for transferring files into and out of Amazon S3 and supports SFTP; it is backed by an auto scaling, redundant fleet, which minimizes operational overhead compared with self-managed servers ([AWS Transfer Family: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)). For on-premises Microsoft AD, the Transfer Family documentation specifically says to set up AWS Directory Service using **AD Connector**, then create a Transfer Family server with the **SFTP protocol** and identity provider type **AWS Directory Service**, selecting the directory that was added ([Connecting to on-prem Microsoft Active Directory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/directory-services-users.html)). AD Connector is a directory gateway that redirects directory requests to on-premises Microsoft Active Directory without caching information in the cloud, allowing users to use existing corporate credentials ([AD Connector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_ad_connector.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: S3 File Gateway with SMB shares changes the access protocol to SMB. The requirement is to keep the current **SFTP** authentication and file access mechanisms.
- **B**: Running SFTP on EC2 in an Auto Scaling group is self-managed and requires OS, application, scaling, availability, and patching operations. It does not provide the least operational overhead.
- **D**: This is incomplete for an existing on-premises AD. Transfer Family can use AWS Directory Service as the identity provider, but the AWS docs specify that connecting to on-premises Microsoft AD requires setting up **AD Connector** first, then selecting that directory for the Transfer Family server ([Connecting to on-prem Microsoft Active Directory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/directory-services-users.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个本地 SFTP 文件传输解决方案。该公司正在迁移到 AWS Cloud，以扩展文件传输解决方案，并通过使用 Amazon S3 来优化成本。该公司的员工将使用其本地 Microsoft Active Directory (AD) 的凭证来访问新解决方案。该公司希望保留当前的身份验证和文件访问机制。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 S3 File Gateway。在该文件网关上创建使用现有 Active Directory 进行身份验证的 SMB 文件共享。
options.B: 配置一个包含 Amazon EC2 实例的 Auto Scaling 组来运行 SFTP 解决方案。将该组配置为在 CPU 利用率达到 60% 时扩展。
options.C: 创建一个带有 SFTP 端点的 AWS Transfer Family 服务器。选择 AWS Directory Service 选项作为身份提供商。使用 AD Connector 连接本地 Active Directory。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Transfer Family SFTP 端点。将该端点配置为使用 AWS Directory Service 选项作为身份提供商，以连接到现有 Active Directory。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。AWS Transfer Family 是一项完全托管的服务，用于将文件传入和传出 Amazon S3，并支持 SFTP；它由自动扩展的冗余机群提供支持，与自管理服务器相比，可最大限度地减少运营开销（[AWS Transfer Family: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/what-is-aws-transfer-family.html)）。对于本地 Microsoft AD，Transfer Family 文档明确说明应使用 **AD Connector** 设置 AWS Directory Service，然后创建一个采用 **SFTP protocol** 且 identity provider type 为 **AWS Directory Service** 的 Transfer Family 服务器，并选择已添加的目录（[Connecting to on-prem Microsoft Active Directory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/directory-services-users.html)）。AD Connector 是一个目录网关，可将目录请求重定向到本地 Microsoft Active Directory，而不会在云中缓存信息，从而允许用户使用现有的企业凭证（[AD Connector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_ad_connector.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：带有 SMB 共享的 S3 File Gateway 会将访问协议更改为 SMB。要求是保留当前的 **SFTP** 身份验证和文件访问机制。
- **B**：在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 上运行 SFTP 是自管理方式，并且需要操作系统、应用程序、扩展、可用性和补丁管理等运维工作。它不能提供最少的运营开销。
- **D**：对于现有的本地 AD 来说，此选项不完整。Transfer Family 可以使用 AWS Directory Service 作为身份提供商，但 AWS 文档明确指出，连接到本地 Microsoft AD 需要先设置 **AD Connector**，然后为 Transfer Family 服务器选择该目录（[Connecting to on-prem Microsoft Active Directory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transfer/latest/userguide/directory-services-users.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing an event-driven order processing system. Each order requires multiple validation steps after the order is created. An idempotent AWS Lambda function performs each validation step. Each validation step is independent from the other validation steps. Individual validation steps need only a subset of the order event information. The company wants to ensure that each validation step Lambda function has access to only the information from the order event that the function requires. The components of the order processing system should be loosely coupled to accommodate future business changes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for each validation step. Create a new Lambda function to transform the order data to the format that each validation step requires and to publish the messages to the appropriate SQS queues. Subscribe each validation step Lambda function to its corresponding SQS queue.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe the validation step Lambda functions to the SNS topic. Use message body filtering to send only the required data to each subscribed Lambda function.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge event bus. Create an event rule for each validation step. Configure the input transformer to send only the required data to each target validation step Lambda function.
options.D: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create a new Lambda function to subscribe to the SQS queue and to transform the order data to the format that each validation step requires. Use the new Lambda function to perform synchronous invocations of the validation step Lambda functions in parallel on separate threads.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

Amazon EventBridge fits the required event-driven, loosely coupled design. AWS identifies an **event bus** pattern as **Amazon EventBridge**, and recommends using AWS services instead of custom code for common distributed-architecture patterns. AWS Lambda design guidance also says functions should handle the event passed to them with no knowledge of the overall workflow, which minimizes coupling ([Designing Lambda applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-application-design.html)).

With EventBridge rules, each validation step can have its own rule and Lambda target. Most importantly, EventBridge input transformers can process matching events **before sending them to the target**. AWS states that variables can reference fields from the original event and that the generated transformed output is the information EventBridge passes to the target **in place of the original source event** ([Configuring an input transformer when creating a rule in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-transform-input-rule.html)). Therefore, each validation Lambda can receive only the subset of order data that it requires.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: SQS queues per validation step could decouple consumers, but this option adds a custom Lambda function to transform and route messages. AWS guidance recommends using managed service patterns instead of custom code where possible ([Designing Lambda applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-application-design.html)). EventBridge provides the required routing and transformation directly.
- **B**: SNS message filtering controls **whether** a subscriber receives a message. AWS states that SNS compares message attributes or message body properties to the filter policy and then sends or does not send the message to the subscriber ([Amazon SNS message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html)). It does not transform the payload so each Lambda receives only selected fields.
- **D**: A Lambda function that synchronously invokes other Lambda functions in parallel creates tighter coupling and custom orchestration logic. This conflicts with the requirement for loosely coupled components and with Lambda guidance to minimize coupling between functions ([Designing Lambda applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-application-design.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一个事件驱动的订单处理系统。每个订单在创建后都需要多个验证步骤。一个幂等的 AWS Lambda 函数执行每个验证步骤。每个验证步骤都独立于其他验证步骤。单个验证步骤只需要订单事件信息的一个子集。该公司希望确保每个验证步骤 Lambda 函数只能访问该函数所需的订单事件信息。订单处理系统的组件应松耦合，以适应未来的业务变化。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个验证步骤创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。创建一个新的 Lambda 函数，将订单数据转换为每个验证步骤所需的格式，并将消息发布到相应的 SQS 队列。将每个验证步骤 Lambda 函数订阅到其对应的 SQS 队列。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。将验证步骤 Lambda 函数订阅到 SNS 主题。使用消息正文筛选，仅将所需数据发送到每个已订阅的 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge event bus。为每个验证步骤创建一条事件规则。配置 input transformer，仅将所需数据发送到每个目标验证步骤 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。创建一个新的 Lambda 函数来订阅 SQS 队列，并将订单数据转换为每个验证步骤所需的格式。使用新的 Lambda 函数在单独的线程上并行同步调用验证步骤 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

Amazon EventBridge 符合所需的事件驱动、松耦合设计。AWS 将 **event bus** 模式标识为 **Amazon EventBridge**，并建议对常见的分布式架构模式使用 AWS 服务，而不是自定义代码。AWS Lambda 设计指南还指出，函数应处理传递给它们的事件，而无需了解整体工作流，这可以最大限度地减少耦合（[Designing Lambda applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-application-design.html)）。使用 EventBridge 规则时，每个验证步骤都可以有自己的规则和 Lambda 目标。最重要的是，EventBridge input transformers 可以在将匹配事件**发送到目标之前**对其进行处理。AWS 指出，变量可以引用原始事件中的字段，并且生成的转换输出是 EventBridge **替代原始源事件**传递给目标的信息（[Configuring an input transformer when creating a rule in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-transform-input-rule.html)）。因此，每个验证 Lambda 只能接收其所需的订单数据子集。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：为每个验证步骤使用 SQS 队列可以解耦使用者，但此选项增加了一个自定义 Lambda 函数来转换和路由消息。AWS 指南建议在可能的情况下使用托管服务模式，而不是自定义代码（[Designing Lambda applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-application-design.html)）。EventBridge 可以直接提供所需的路由和转换。
- **B**：SNS 消息筛选控制订阅者**是否**接收消息。AWS 指出，SNS 会将消息属性或消息正文属性与筛选策略进行比较，然后向订阅者发送或不发送该消息（[Amazon SNS message filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-message-filtering.html)）。它不会转换负载，使每个 Lambda 只接收选定字段。
- **D**：一个同步调用其他 Lambda 函数并使其并行运行的 Lambda 函数会创建更紧密的耦合和自定义编排逻辑。这与松耦合组件的要求相冲突，也与 Lambda 关于尽量减少函数之间耦合的指南相冲突（[Designing Lambda applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-application-design.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating a three-tier application to AWS. The application requires a MySQL database. In the past, the application users reported poor application performance when creating new entries. These performance issues were caused by users generating different real-time reports from the application during working hours. Which solution will improve the performance of the application when it is moved to AWS?

options.A: Import the data into an Amazon DynamoDB table with provisioned capacity. Refactor the application to use DynamoDB for reports.
options.B: Create the database on a compute optimized Amazon EC2 instance. Ensure compute resources exceed the on-premises database.
options.C: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster with multiple read replicas. Configure the application to use the reader endpoint for reports.
options.D: Create an Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB cluster. Configure the application to use the backup instance of the cluster as an endpoint for the reports.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

The performance problem is caused by real-time reporting queries competing with new-entry writes on the MySQL database. In Aurora, the **primary/writer** instance handles writes, while **Aurora Replicas** are reader instances that support read-only operations and can offload read workloads from the primary instance. AWS states that an Aurora DB cluster can have up to 15 replicas and that replicas can offload read workloads from the primary DB instance ([Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)). The Aurora **reader endpoint** is specifically intended for read-only operations such as reporting; it balances read-only connections across Aurora Replicas, reducing overhead on the primary instance and helping query-intensive workloads scale with the number of replicas ([Reader endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: DynamoDB is not MySQL-compatible and would require refactoring the reporting path to a different database model. The requirement is for a MySQL database, and the issue can be solved by separating reads from writes in Aurora.
- **B**: Running MySQL on a larger compute-optimized EC2 instance is not the best managed or scalable architecture. It does not inherently separate reporting reads from write activity, so reports can still contend with writes.
- **D**: Aurora does not provide a separate “backup instance” endpoint for reporting. Aurora has a cluster/writer endpoint for write operations and a reader endpoint for read-only traffic. The cluster endpoint connects to the current primary DB instance and is used for writes such as inserts, updates, deletes, and DDL changes ([Cluster endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Cluster.html)); reports should use the reader endpoint instead.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个三层应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序需要一个 MySQL 数据库。过去，应用程序用户报告在创建新条目时应用程序性能较差。这些性能问题是由于用户在工作时间从应用程序生成不同的实时报表造成的。将应用程序迁移到 AWS 后，哪种解决方案将提高应用程序的性能？

options.A: 将数据导入到具有预置容量的 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。重构应用程序以使用 DynamoDB 生成报表。
options.B: 在计算优化型 Amazon EC2 实例上创建数据库。确保计算资源超过本地数据库。
options.C: 创建一个具有多个只读副本的 Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB 集群。配置应用程序使用读取器端点生成报表。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB 集群。配置应用程序使用集群的备份实例作为报表的端点。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。性能问题是由实时报表查询与 MySQL 数据库上的新条目写入相互竞争造成的。在 Aurora 中，**primary/writer** 实例处理写入，而 **Aurora Replicas** 是支持只读操作的读取器实例，可以从主实例卸载读取工作负载。AWS 表示，一个 Aurora DB 集群最多可以有 15 个副本，并且副本可以从主 DB 实例卸载读取工作负载（[Amazon Aurora DB clusters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.html)）。Aurora **reader endpoint** 专门用于只读操作，例如报表；它会在 Aurora Replicas 之间平衡只读连接，减少主实例上的开销，并帮助查询密集型工作负载随副本数量扩展（[Reader endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：DynamoDB 与 MySQL 不兼容，并且需要将报表路径重构为不同的数据库模型。要求是 MySQL 数据库，而该问题可以通过在 Aurora 中分离读取和写入来解决。
- **B**：在更大的计算优化型 EC2 实例上运行 MySQL 不是最佳的托管式或可扩展架构。它并不会从根本上将报表读取与写入活动分离，因此报表仍可能与写入产生争用。
- **D**：Aurora 不提供用于报表的单独“备份实例”端点。Aurora 有用于写入操作的集群/写入器端点，以及用于只读流量的读取器端点。集群端点连接到当前主 DB 实例，并用于写入，例如插入、更新、删除和 DDL 更改（[Cluster endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Cluster.html)）；报表应改用读取器端点。

en.question: A company is expanding a secure on-premises network to the AWS Cloud by using an AWS Direct Connect connection. The on-premises network has no direct internet access. An application that runs on the on-premises network needs to use an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a public virtual interface (VIF). Route the AWS traffic over the public VIF.
options.B: Create a VPC and a NAT gateway. Route the AWS traffic from the on-premises network to the NAT gateway.
options.C: Create a VPC and an Amazon S3 interface endpoint. Route the AWS traffic from the on-premises network to the S3 interface endpoint.
options.D: Create a VPC peering connection between the on-premises network and Direct Connect. Route the AWS traffic over the peering connection.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **A**.

A **public virtual interface (VIF)** on AWS Direct Connect is the most cost-effective way for an on-premises network to access Amazon S3 when the on-premises network has no direct internet access. AWS Direct Connect supports creating virtual interfaces directly to public AWS services such as Amazon S3, bypassing internet service providers in the network path. AWS documentation states that a public VIF can access all AWS public services using public IP addresses, including Amazon S3 and AWS service API endpoints ([Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html), [What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

Using a public VIF does not require the on-premises network to have general internet access. The traffic is routed over the Direct Connect connection to AWS public service endpoints. This avoids the additional cost and complexity of creating a VPC, deploying endpoints, or using NAT infrastructure.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. Create a VPC and a NAT gateway** — A NAT gateway is used so that resources such as instances in private subnets can initiate connections to services outside the VPC. It is not the appropriate mechanism for an on-premises application to access Amazon S3 through Direct Connect, and it would add unnecessary hourly and data processing costs ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)).

- **C. Create a VPC and an Amazon S3 interface endpoint** — An S3 interface endpoint can be accessed from on-premises over Direct Connect, and traffic remains on the AWS network. However, it requires creating and operating interface endpoint ENIs in a VPC and incurs PrivateLink interface endpoint charges. Since the requirement is specifically to access Amazon S3 from on premises over Direct Connect in the most cost-effective way, a public VIF is simpler and lower cost ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

- **D. Create a VPC peering connection between the on-premises network and Direct Connect** — VPC peering connects two VPCs. It is not a mechanism to peer an on-premises network with Direct Connect, and it does not provide direct access to Amazon S3 public service endpoints ([VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Direct Connect 连接将安全的本地网络扩展到 AWS Cloud。本地网络没有直接的互联网访问权限。在本地网络上运行的一个应用程序需要使用一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案将以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个公共虚拟接口 (VIF)。通过公共 VIF 路由 AWS 流量。
options.B: 创建一个 VPC 和一个 NAT gateway。将来自本地网络的 AWS 流量路由到 NAT gateway。
options.C: 创建一个 VPC 和一个 Amazon S3 interface endpoint。将来自本地网络的 AWS 流量路由到 S3 interface endpoint。
options.D: 在本地网络和 Direct Connect 之间创建 VPC peering connection。通过对等连接路由 AWS 流量。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **A**。

AWS Direct Connect 上的 **public virtual interface (VIF)** 是在本地网络没有直接互联网访问权限时，让本地网络访问 Amazon S3 的最具成本效益方式。AWS Direct Connect 支持直接创建到公共 AWS 服务（例如 Amazon S3）的虚拟接口，从而绕过网络路径中的互联网服务提供商。AWS 文档说明，public VIF 可以使用公共 IP 地址访问所有 AWS 公共服务，包括 Amazon S3 和 AWS 服务 API 端点（[Direct Connect virtual interfaces](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/WorkingWithVirtualInterfaces.html)，[What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。使用 public VIF 不要求本地网络具有通用互联网访问权限。流量通过 Direct Connect 连接路由到 AWS 公共服务端点。这避免了创建 VPC、部署端点或使用 NAT 基础设施所带来的额外成本和复杂性。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B. Create a VPC and a NAT gateway** — NAT gateway 用于让私有子网中的实例等资源能够发起到 VPC 外部服务的连接。它不是让本地应用程序通过 Direct Connect 访问 Amazon S3 的合适机制，并且会增加不必要的按小时和数据处理成本（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。

- **C. Create a VPC and an Amazon S3 interface endpoint** — 可以通过 Direct Connect 从本地访问 S3 interface endpoint，并且流量会保留在 AWS 网络上。但是，它需要在 VPC 中创建和运行 interface endpoint ENIs，并会产生 PrivateLink interface endpoint 费用。由于要求明确是在最具成本效益的情况下从本地通过 Direct Connect 访问 Amazon S3，因此 public VIF 更简单且成本更低（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

- **D. Create a VPC peering connection between the on-premises network and Direct Connect** — VPC peering 连接两个 VPC。它不是将本地网络与 Direct Connect 对等互连的机制，也不会提供对 Amazon S3 公共服务端点的直接访问（[VPC peering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-peering.html)）。

en.question: A company serves its website by using an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The website does not require a database. The company is expanding, and the company's engineering team deploys the website to a second Region. The company wants to distribute traffic across both Regions to accommodate growth and for disaster recovery purposes. The solution should not serve traffic from a Region in which the website is unhealthy. Which policy or resource should the company use to meet these requirements?

options.A: An Amazon Route 53 simple routing policy
options.B: An Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy
options.C: An Application Load Balancer in one Region with a target group that specifies the EC2 instance IDs from both Regions
options.D: An Application Load Balancer in one Region with a target group that specifies the IP addresses of the EC2 instances from both Regions

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. An Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy**

Route 53 multivalue answer routing is designed to return multiple records, such as IP addresses for web servers, and can associate health checks with those records. AWS states that multivalue answer routing lets Route 53 “check the health of each resource” and return “only values for healthy resources,” improving DNS availability and load balancing ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)). This matches the requirement to distribute traffic across resources in both Regions while avoiding an unhealthy Region/resource. The Route 53 routing policy overview also describes multivalue answer routing as returning up to eight healthy records selected at random ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Simple routing policy** — Simple routing is intended for a single resource that performs a function for the domain, not for distributing traffic across multiple regional deployments with health-aware responses ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)).
- **C. ALB with target group using EC2 instance IDs from both Regions** — ALB target groups can use `instance` targets by instance ID, but AWS notes that instances in peered VPCs, including same-Region or different-Region peering, cannot be registered by instance ID; they must be registered by IP address ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)). Also, a single ALB in one Region is not an appropriate multi-Region disaster recovery traffic distribution point.
- **D. ALB with target group using EC2 IP addresses from both Regions** — Although ALB target groups with `ip` targets can register private IPs from peered VPCs in another Region, AWS also says publicly routable IP addresses cannot be specified ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)). More importantly, using one ALB in one Region creates dependency on that Region and does not provide DNS-level multi-Region failover/distribution for regional disaster recovery. Route 53 health-aware routing is the better fit.

zh.question: 一家公司使用单个 AWS Region 中由 Amazon EC2 实例组成的 Auto Scaling group 来提供其网站服务。该网站不需要数据库。公司正在扩展，公司的工程团队将网站部署到第二个 Region。公司希望在两个 Region 之间分配流量，以适应增长并用于灾难恢复。该解决方案不应从网站不健康的 Region 提供流量。公司应使用哪种策略或资源来满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon Route 53 simple routing policy
options.B: Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy
options.C: 一个 Region 中的 Application Load Balancer，其 target group 指定来自两个 Region 的 EC2 实例 ID
options.D: 一个 Region 中的 Application Load Balancer，其 target group 指定来自两个 Region 的 EC2 实例的 IP 地址

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. An Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy**

Route 53 multivalue answer routing 旨在返回多条记录，例如 Web 服务器的 IP 地址，并且可以将健康检查与这些记录关联起来。AWS 表示，multivalue answer routing 允许 Route 53 “check the health of each resource” 并返回 “only values for healthy resources”，从而提高 DNS 可用性和负载均衡能力（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-multivalue.html)）。这符合在两个 Region 中的资源之间分配流量，同时避免不健康的 Region/资源的要求。Route 53 路由策略概述还将 multivalue answer routing 描述为最多返回八条随机选择的健康记录（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. Simple routing policy** — Simple routing 适用于为域执行某项功能的单个资源，而不是用于在多个区域部署之间分配流量并提供具备健康感知能力的响应（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)）。
- **C. ALB with target group using EC2 instance IDs from both Regions** — ALB target group 可以使用按实例 ID 指定的 `instance` 目标，但 AWS 指出，位于对等 VPC 中的实例，包括同一 Region 或不同 Region 的对等连接，不能通过实例 ID 注册；它们必须通过 IP 地址注册（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。此外，单个 Region 中的单个 ALB 并不适合作为多 Region 灾难恢复流量分配点。
- **D. ALB with target group using EC2 IP addresses from both Regions** — 尽管使用 `ip` 目标的 ALB target group 可以注册另一个 Region 中对等 VPC 的私有 IP，但 AWS 也说明不能指定可公开路由的 IP 地址（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。更重要的是，在一个 Region 中使用一个 ALB 会形成对该 Region 的依赖，无法为区域级灾难恢复提供 DNS 级别的多 Region 故障转移/分配。具备健康感知能力的 Route 53 routing 更适合。

en.question: A company runs its applications on Amazon EC2 instances that are backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). The EC2 instances run the most recent Amazon Linux release. The applications are experiencing availability issues when the company's employees store and retrieve files that are 25 GB or larger. The company needs a solution that does not require the company to transfer files between EC2 instances. The files must be available across many EC2 instances and across multiple Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate all the files to an Amazon S3 bucket. Instruct the employees to access the files from the S3 bucket.
options.B: Take a snapshot of the existing EBS volume. Mount the snapshot as an EBS volume across the EC2 instances. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances.
options.C: Mount an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system across all the EC2 instances. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instances. Configure new EC2 instances from the AMI that use an instance store volume. Instruct the employees to access the files from the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon EFS is the AWS managed shared file system designed for this scenario. AWS documents that EFS file systems can be mounted on EC2 Linux instances using the EFS mount helper or NFS, and that you can mount EFS to **multiple EC2 instances**. A Regional EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple geographically separated Availability Zones and provides continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable. This satisfies the need for the same large files to be available from many EC2 instances across multiple AZs without copying files between instances ([EFS mounting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html), [mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html), [EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon S3 bucket**: S3 can store and download large objects, but the option instructs users to access files from the bucket rather than providing a shared file system mounted by the EC2 instances. AWS documents S3 object downloads through the console, CLI, SDKs, or REST API, which is a different access model than a shared EC2-mounted file system ([S3 downloading objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/download-objects.html)).
- **B. EBS snapshot mounted across EC2 instances**: EBS snapshots are used to create volumes, but EBS Multi-Attach has strict limitations: it supports only Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes and attached instances must be in the **same Availability Zone**. Standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are also not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers. This does not meet the multi-AZ shared-file requirement ([EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).
- **D. AMI with instance store**: Instance store volumes are tied to the lifetime of a single instance, cannot be detached and attached to another instance, and data does not persist when the instance is stopped, hibernated, or terminated. This is not a highly available shared storage solution ([EC2 instance store persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在由 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 支持的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其应用程序。这些 EC2 实例运行最新的 Amazon Linux 版本。当公司的员工存储和检索 25 GB 或更大的文件时，应用程序遇到可用性问题。公司需要一种不要求在 EC2 实例之间传输文件的解决方案。这些文件必须可供许多 EC2 实例访问，并且跨多个 Availability Zones 可用。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将所有文件迁移到 Amazon S3 bucket。指示员工从 S3 bucket 访问这些文件。
options.B: 为现有 EBS 卷创建快照。将该快照作为 EBS 卷挂载到多个 EC2 实例上。指示员工从 EC2 实例访问这些文件。
options.C: 在所有 EC2 实例上挂载 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。指示员工从 EC2 实例访问这些文件。
options.D: 从 EC2 实例创建 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。从该 AMI 配置使用实例存储卷的新 EC2 实例。指示员工从 EC2 实例访问这些文件。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon EFS 是 AWS 托管的共享文件系统，专为这种场景而设计。AWS 文档说明，EFS 文件系统可以使用 EFS mount helper 或 NFS 挂载到 EC2 Linux 实例上，并且你可以将 EFS 挂载到 **multiple EC2 instances**。Regional EFS 文件系统会在多个地理位置分离的 Availability Zones 中冗余存储数据，即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用，也能提供持续可用性。这满足了让相同的大文件可从跨多个 AZ 的许多 EC2 实例访问且无需在实例之间复制文件的需求（[EFS mounting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)、[mounting EFS to multiple EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-multiple-ec2-instances.html)、[EFS availability and durability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon S3 bucket**：S3 可以存储和下载大型对象，但该选项指示用户从 bucket 访问文件，而不是提供由 EC2 实例挂载的共享文件系统。AWS 文档说明可通过控制台、CLI、SDK 或 REST API 下载 S3 对象，这是一种不同于共享 EC2 挂载文件系统的访问模型（[S3 downloading objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/download-objects.html)）。
- **B. EBS snapshot mounted across EC2 instances**：EBS 快照用于创建卷，但 EBS Multi-Attach 有严格限制：它仅支持 Provisioned IOPS SSD 卷，并且所附加的实例必须位于**同一个 Availability Zone**。XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统也不是为多个服务器同时访问而设计的。这不满足跨多 AZ 的共享文件要求（[EBS Multi-Attach limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。
- **D. AMI with instance store**：实例存储卷与单个实例的生命周期绑定，不能分离后附加到另一个实例，并且当实例停止、休眠或终止时，数据不会持久保留。这不是一种高可用的共享存储解决方案（[EC2 instance store persistence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-store-lifetime.html)）。

en.question: A company is running a highly sensitive application on Amazon EC2 backed by an Amazon RDS database. Compliance regulations mandate that all personally identifiable information (PII) be encrypted at rest. Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of changes to the infrastructure?

options.A: Deploy AWS Certificate Manager to generate certificates. Use the certificates to encrypt the database volume.
options.B: Deploy AWS CloudHSM, generate encryption keys, and use the keys to encrypt database volumes.
options.C: Configure SSL encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt database volumes.
options.D: Configure Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) encryption and Amazon RDS encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to encrypt instance and database volumes.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The requirement is encryption **at rest** for both the EC2-backed application storage and the RDS database. AWS documentation states that Amazon EBS encryption is the encryption solution for EBS volumes and snapshots and that it uses AWS KMS keys; this covers EC2 instance volumes backed by EBS ([EC2 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/data-protection.html)). Amazon RDS encrypted DB instances protect data on the underlying storage for compliance with encryption-at-rest requirements, and RDS uses an AWS KMS key to encrypt these resources ([RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)). Therefore, enabling EBS encryption and RDS encryption with KMS keys is the native, least-change approach.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Certificate Manager manages SSL/TLS X.509 certificates for websites and applications, not database volume encryption at rest ([ACM overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html)).
- **B:** AWS CloudHSM would introduce additional key-management infrastructure and operational changes. The native services in this scenario already support at-rest encryption with AWS KMS: EBS encryption uses KMS keys, and RDS encryption uses KMS keys ([EC2 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/data-protection.html), [RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).
- **C:** SSL/TLS encryption addresses encryption **in transit**, not encryption of volumes at rest. The RDS documentation separates encryption at rest from “Encryption in transit,” and the at-rest mechanism for RDS is RDS encryption with KMS keys ([RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 上运行一个高度敏感的应用程序，该应用程序由 Amazon RDS 数据库提供支持。合规法规要求所有个人身份信息（PII）都必须进行静态加密。解决方案架构师应推荐哪种解决方案，以在对基础设施进行最少更改的情况下满足此要求？

options.A: 部署 AWS Certificate Manager 以生成证书。使用这些证书加密数据库卷。
options.B: 部署 AWS CloudHSM，生成加密密钥，并使用这些密钥加密数据库卷。
options.C: 使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys 配置 SSL 加密，以加密数据库卷。
options.D: 配置 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 加密和 Amazon RDS 加密，并使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys 加密实例卷和数据库卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 要求是对 EC2 支撑的应用程序存储和 RDS 数据库进行**静态**加密。AWS 文档说明，Amazon EBS 加密是用于 EBS 卷和快照的加密解决方案，并且使用 AWS KMS keys；这涵盖由 EBS 支撑的 EC2 实例卷（[EC2 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/data-protection.html)）。Amazon RDS 加密的 DB 实例可保护底层存储上的数据，以满足静态加密合规要求，并且 RDS 使用 AWS KMS key 加密这些资源（[RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。因此，使用 KMS keys 启用 EBS 加密和 RDS 加密是原生且更改最少的方法。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS Certificate Manager 管理用于网站和应用程序的 SSL/TLS X.509 证书，而不是数据库卷的静态加密（[ACM overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html)）。
- **B:** AWS CloudHSM 会引入额外的密钥管理基础设施和运维变更。此场景中的原生服务已经支持使用 AWS KMS 进行静态加密：EBS 加密使用 KMS keys，RDS 加密使用 KMS keys（[EC2 data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/data-protection.html), [RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。
- **C:** SSL/TLS 加密解决的是**传输中**加密，而不是静态卷加密。RDS 文档将静态加密与“Encryption in transit”区分开来，而 RDS 的静态加密机制是使用 KMS keys 的 RDS 加密（[RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an AWS Lambda function in private subnets in a VPC. The subnets have a default route to the internet through an Amazon EC2 NAT instance. The Lambda function processes input data and saves its output as an object to Amazon S3. Intermittently, the Lambda function times out while trying to upload the object because of saturated traffic on the NAT instance's network. The company wants to access Amazon S3 without traversing the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Replace the EC2 NAT instance with an AWS managed NAT gateway.
options.B: Increase the size of the EC2 NAT instance in the VPC to a network optimized instance type.
options.C: Provision a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPUpdate the route tables of the subnets accordingly.
options.D: Provision a transit gateway. Place transit gateway attachments in the private subnets where the Lambda function is running.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** A gateway VPC endpoint is the intended solution for private VPC access to Amazon S3. AWS states that gateway VPC endpoints provide reliable connectivity to **Amazon S3 and DynamoDB without requiring an internet gateway or a NAT device** for the VPC. For gateway endpoint access, traffic from the VPC to S3 is routed to the gateway endpoint, and each relevant subnet route table must have a route that sends service-destined traffic to the endpoint; when you create the endpoint, AWS adds an endpoint route to the selected route tables using the AWS-managed prefix list and the gateway endpoint as the target ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)). This removes S3 uploads from the saturated NAT instance path and avoids traversing the internet/NAT route.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Replace the NAT instance with a NAT gateway** — A NAT gateway can enable outbound internet access from private subnets, but AWS describes this use case as private subnet resources reaching the internet through a NAT gateway in a public subnet ([NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)). It does not meet the requirement to access S3 without using NAT/internet traversal.
- **B. Increase the NAT instance size** — This may reduce saturation, but it still keeps S3 traffic traversing the NAT device, contrary to the requirement. Gateway endpoints specifically avoid needing a NAT device for S3 ([Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)).
- **D. Provision a transit gateway** — A transit gateway is for connecting VPCs and other networks, not for providing direct private access from a VPC subnet to Amazon S3 ([Connect your VPC to other VPCs and networks using a transit gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/extend-tgw.html)). It does not solve the S3-specific NAT bottleneck.

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 的私有子网中运行一个 AWS Lambda 函数。这些子网有一条默认路由，通过 Amazon EC2 NAT instance 访问互联网。该 Lambda 函数处理输入数据，并将其输出作为对象保存到 Amazon S3。由于 NAT instance 的网络流量饱和，Lambda 函数在尝试上传对象时会间歇性超时。该公司希望在不经过互联网的情况下访问 Amazon S3。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 EC2 NAT instance 替换为 AWS 托管的 NAT gateway。
options.B: 将 VPC 中的 EC2 NAT instance 扩展为网络优化型实例类型。
options.C: 在 VPC 中为 Amazon S3 预置一个 gateway endpoint。相应地更新子网的路由表。
options.D: 预置一个 transit gateway。将 transit gateway attachments 放置在 Lambda 函数运行所在的私有子网中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** gateway VPC endpoint 是用于从私有 VPC 访问 Amazon S3 的预期解决方案。AWS 表示，gateway VPC endpoints 可为 VPC 提供到 **Amazon S3 and DynamoDB without requiring an internet gateway or a NAT device** 的可靠连接。对于 gateway endpoint 访问，从 VPC 到 S3 的流量会被路由到 gateway endpoint，并且每个相关子网路由表都必须有一条路由，将发往该服务的流量发送到该 endpoint；创建 endpoint 时，AWS 会使用 AWS 托管的前缀列表以及作为目标的 gateway endpoint，向所选路由表添加一条 endpoint 路由（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。这会将 S3 上传从饱和的 NAT instance 路径中移除，并避免经过互联网/NAT 路由。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. Replace the NAT instance with a NAT gateway** — NAT gateway 可以让私有子网中的资源进行出站互联网访问，但 AWS 将此用例描述为私有子网资源通过公有子网中的 NAT gateway 访问互联网（[NAT gateway use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-scenarios.html)）。它不满足在不使用 NAT/互联网传输的情况下访问 S3 的要求。
- **B. Increase the NAT instance size** — 这可能会减少饱和，但仍然会使 S3 流量经过 NAT 设备，与要求相反。Gateway endpoints 专门用于避免 S3 需要 NAT 设备（[Gateway endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/gateway-endpoints.html)）。
- **D. Provision a transit gateway** — transit gateway 用于连接 VPC 和其他网络，而不是为从 VPC 子网到 Amazon S3 的访问提供直接私有访问（[Connect your VPC to other VPCs and networks using a transit gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/extend-tgw.html)）。它无法解决 S3 特定的 NAT 瓶颈。

en.question: A news company that has reporters all over the world is hosting its broadcast system on AWS. The reporters send live broadcasts to the broadcast system. The reporters use software on their phones to send live streams through the Real Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP). A solutions architect must design a solution that gives the reporters the ability to send the highest quality streams. The solution must provide accelerated TCP connections back to the broadcast system. What should the solutions architect use to meet these requirements?

options.A: Amazon CloudFront
options.B: AWS Global Accelerator
options.C: AWS Client VPN
options.D: Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Elastic IP addresses

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. AWS Global Accelerator**

AWS Global Accelerator is designed for this requirement: global clients connect to static anycast IP addresses at the nearest AWS edge location, and traffic then enters the AWS global network. AWS states that Global Accelerator routes traffic over the AWS global network to the optimal endpoint and that it **terminates TCP connections from clients at AWS edge locations** and establishes new TCP connections to endpoints, providing **lower latency and increased throughput**—exactly the requirement for accelerated TCP connections for RTMP ingest back to the broadcast system ([How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)). It also supports endpoints such as Network Load Balancers, Application Load Balancers, EC2 instances, and Elastic IP addresses ([What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon CloudFront** — CloudFront is primarily a CDN for distributing/cacheing web content from origins to viewers. Its live streaming use case focuses on HTTP-based streaming formats and caching media fragments at the edge, not accelerating arbitrary RTMP/TCP ingest from reporters to an origin system ([Ways to use CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)).
- **C. AWS Client VPN** — A VPN would provide private remote access, not a globally optimized TCP acceleration service for public RTMP stream ingest.
- **D. Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Elastic IP addresses** — EC2 instances with Elastic IPs provide fixed endpoints, but by themselves they do not move client traffic onto the AWS global network at the nearest edge or terminate/optimize TCP connections the way Global Accelerator does ([How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)).

zh.question: 一家新闻公司在全球各地都有记者，并在 AWS 上托管其广播系统。记者会向广播系统发送实时广播。记者使用手机上的软件通过 Real Time Messaging Protocol (RTMP) 发送直播流。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案，使记者能够发送最高质量的流。该解决方案必须为返回广播系统的 TCP 连接提供加速。解决方案架构师应使用什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon CloudFront
options.B: AWS Global Accelerator
options.C: AWS Client VPN
options.D: Amazon EC2 实例和 AWS Elastic IP 地址

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. AWS Global Accelerator**

AWS Global Accelerator 正是为此类要求而设计的：全球客户端连接到最近 AWS 边缘站点的静态 anycast IP 地址，然后流量进入 AWS 全球网络。AWS 表示，Global Accelerator 会通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最佳端点，并且它会在 **AWS 边缘站点终止来自客户端的 TCP 连接**，再建立到端点的新 TCP 连接，从而提供**更低的延迟和更高的吞吐量**——这正好满足为 RTMP 摄取返回广播系统的 TCP 连接提供加速的要求（[How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)）。它还支持 Network Load Balancers、Application Load Balancers、EC2 实例和 Elastic IP 地址等端点（[What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon CloudFront** — CloudFront 主要是一个 CDN，用于从源站向查看者分发/缓存 Web 内容。它的直播用例侧重于基于 HTTP 的流媒体格式，并在边缘缓存媒体片段，而不是加速从记者到源系统的任意 RTMP/TCP 摄取（[Ways to use CloudFront](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/IntroductionUseCases.html)）。
- **C. AWS Client VPN** — VPN 会提供私有远程访问，但不是用于公共 RTMP 流摄取的全球优化 TCP 加速服务。
- **D. Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Elastic IP addresses** — 带有 Elastic IPs 的 EC2 实例可以提供固定端点，但仅靠它们本身，并不会像 Global Accelerator 那样在最近的边缘站点将客户端流量移入 AWS 全球网络，也不会终止/优化 TCP 连接（[How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)）。

en.question: A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) to run its self- managed database. The company has 350 TB of data spread across all EBS volumes. The company takes daily EBS snapshots and keeps the snapshots for 1 month. The daily change rate is 5% of the EBS volumes. Because of new regulations, the company needs to keep the monthly snapshots for 7 years. The company needs to change its backup strategy to comply with the new regulations and to ensure that data is available with minimal administrative effort. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier for 1 month. Copy the monthly snapshot to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive with a 7-year retention period.
options.B: Continue with the current EBS snapshot policy. Add a new policy to move the monthly snapshot to Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive with a 7-year retention period.
options.C: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier for 1 month. Keep the monthly snapshot in the standard tier for 7 years. Use incremental snapshots.
options.D: Keep the daily snapshot in the EBS snapshot standard tier. Use EBS direct APIs to take snapshots of all the EBS volumes every month. Store the snapshots in an Amazon S3 bucket in the Infrequent Access tier for 7 years.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive is specifically designed for low-cost, long-term storage of rarely accessed EBS snapshots. AWS states that snapshots in the standard tier are incremental, and when archived they are converted to full snapshots and moved to the EBS Snapshots Archive tier; archived snapshots can later be restored to the standard tier and used like other EBS snapshots. AWS also says EBS Snapshots Archive offers up to 75% lower storage costs for snapshots stored 90 days or longer and lists monthly/quarterly/yearly snapshots and compliance retention as typical use cases ([Archive Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-archive.html)). AWS explicitly recommends archiving monthly, quarterly, or yearly snapshots, and says EBS Snapshots Archive is cost-effective for full snapshots retained for several years for compliance reasons ([Considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-archive-considerations.html), [Guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/archiving-guidelines.html)). Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager can automate EBS snapshot creation, retention, and deletion to retain backups for compliance and reduce storage costs, which meets the minimal administrative effort requirement ([Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EBS snapshots are stored in Amazon S3 buckets that customers cannot access directly, and AWS says you cannot access EBS snapshots by using the Amazon S3 console or Amazon S3 API ([Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-snapshots.html)). Therefore, “copy the monthly snapshot to S3 Glacier Deep Archive” is not a native, low-administration EBS snapshot lifecycle action.
- **C:** Keeping monthly snapshots in the EBS Snapshot Standard tier for 7 years is less cost-effective. Standard-tier snapshots are incremental, but EBS Snapshots Archive provides up to 75% lower storage costs for long-term, rarely accessed snapshots ([Archive Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-archive.html)).
- **D:** EBS direct APIs are intended to read/write snapshot contents and track changed blocks, especially for backup software workflows, but using them to build a process that stores data in S3 IA would add operational complexity ([Use EBS direct APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-accessing-snapshot.html)). It also does not use the native EBS snapshot archive tier that is designed for long-term compliance retention.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 来运行其自托管数据库。该公司有 350 TB 数据分布在所有 EBS 卷上。该公司每天创建 EBS 快照，并将快照保留 1 个月。每日变更率为 EBS 卷的 5%。由于新法规要求，该公司需要将每月快照保留 7 年。该公司需要更改其备份策略，以符合新法规，并确保数据可用且管理工作量最小。哪种解决方案将以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 将每日快照保留在 EBS snapshot standard tier 中 1 个月。将每月快照复制到 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive，并设置 7 年保留期。
options.B: 继续使用当前的 EBS 快照策略。添加一项新策略，将每月快照移动到 Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive，并设置 7 年保留期。
options.C: 将每日快照保留在 EBS snapshot standard tier 中 1 个月。将每月快照保留在 standard tier 中 7 年。使用增量快照。
options.D: 将每日快照保留在 EBS snapshot standard tier 中。使用 EBS direct APIs 每月对所有 EBS 卷创建快照。将快照存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 的 Infrequent Access tier 中 7 年。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon EBS Snapshots Archive 专为很少访问的 EBS 快照的低成本长期存储而设计。AWS 表示，standard tier 中的快照是增量的，归档时会转换为完整快照并移动到 EBS Snapshots Archive tier；已归档快照之后可以还原到 standard tier，并像其他 EBS 快照一样使用。AWS 还表示，对于存储 90 天或更长时间的快照，EBS Snapshots Archive 可提供最高 75% 的存储成本节省，并将每月/每季度/每年快照以及合规性保留列为典型用例（[Archive Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-archive.html)）。AWS 明确建议归档每月、每季度或每年的快照，并表示出于合规原因保留数年的完整快照，EBS Snapshots Archive 具有成本效益（[Considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-archive-considerations.html)，[Guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/archiving-guidelines.html)）。Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager 可以自动执行 EBS 快照创建、保留和删除，以保留用于合规的备份并降低存储成本，这满足最小管理工作量要求（[Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-lifecycle-dlm.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** EBS 快照存储在客户无法直接访问的 Amazon S3 buckets 中，并且 AWS 表示你无法使用 Amazon S3 console 或 Amazon S3 API 访问 EBS 快照（[Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-snapshots.html)）。因此，“将每月快照复制到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive”并不是原生的、低管理工作量的 EBS 快照生命周期操作。
- **C:** 将每月快照保留在 EBS Snapshot Standard tier 中 7 年成本效益较低。Standard-tier 快照是增量的，但 EBS Snapshots Archive 可为长期、很少访问的快照提供最高 75% 的存储成本节省（[Archive Amazon EBS snapshots](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/snapshot-archive.html)）。
- **D:** EBS direct APIs 旨在读取/写入快照内容并跟踪已更改的块，尤其适用于备份软件工作流，但使用它们构建将数据存储在 S3 IA 中的流程会增加运营复杂性（[Use EBS direct APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-accessing-snapshot.html)）。它也没有使用为长期合规保留而设计的原生 EBS snapshot archive tier。

en.question: A company runs an application on several Amazon EC2 instances that store persistent data on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. The company needs to replicate the data to another AWS Region by using an AWS managed service solution. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use the EFS-to-EFS backup solution to replicate the data to an EFS file system in another Region.
options.B: Run a nightly script to copy data from the EFS file system to an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable S3 Cross-Region Replication on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Create a VPC in another Region. Establish a cross-Region VPC peer. Run a nightly rsync to copy data from the original Region to the new Region.
options.D: Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan with a rule that takes a daily backup and replicates it to another Region. Assign the EFS file system resource to the backup plan.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Backup is the AWS managed service for centralized, policy-based backups. It supports **Amazon EFS file systems** as a protected resource, and AWS Backup can copy backups to other AWS Regions either on demand or automatically as part of a scheduled backup plan ([AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). When creating a backup plan, AWS documents the **Copy to destination** option to create a cross-Region copy of eligible backups ([Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)). For EFS specifically, AWS Backup performs incremental backups after the first full backup, which reduces duplicated storage and helps make this the most cost-effective managed option ([Backing up EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/awsbackup.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** The EFS-to-EFS backup solution is not the best choice here because the requirement is an AWS managed service solution with cost effectiveness. AWS Backup is the native managed backup service and provides policy-based plans, cross-Region backup copies, and incremental EFS backups.
- **B:** Copying EFS data to S3 with a nightly script is not a managed EFS replication/backup solution. It requires custom scripting and uses S3 replication rather than an AWS Backup policy for the EFS resource.
- **C:** Cross-Region VPC peering plus nightly `rsync` is also a custom, self-managed replication approach. It adds operational overhead and does not use AWS Backup’s managed backup plans or cross-Region copy capability.

zh.question: 一家公司在多台 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序，这些实例将持久数据存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统上。该公司需要使用 AWS 托管服务解决方案将数据复制到另一个 AWS Region。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 EFS-to-EFS backup solution 将数据复制到另一个 Region 中的 EFS 文件系统。
options.B: 运行每晚脚本，将数据从 EFS 文件系统复制到 Amazon S3 存储桶。在该 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 Cross-Region Replication。
options.C: 在另一个 Region 中创建 VPC。建立跨 Region VPC 对等连接。运行每晚 rsync，将数据从原始 Region 复制到新 Region。
options.D: 使用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份计划，其中包含一条规则：执行每日备份并将其复制到另一个 Region。将 EFS 文件系统资源分配给该备份计划。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** AWS Backup 是用于集中式、基于策略备份的 AWS 托管服务。它支持将 **Amazon EFS file systems** 作为受保护资源，并且 AWS Backup 可以按需或作为计划备份计划的一部分自动将备份复制到其他 AWS Regions（[AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。在创建备份计划时，AWS 文档说明了 **Copy to destination** 选项，用于创建符合条件备份的跨 Region 副本（[Create a backup plan](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/creating-a-backup-plan.html)）。对于 EFS，AWS Backup 在第一次完整备份之后执行增量备份，这减少了重复存储，并有助于使其成为最具成本效益的托管选项（[Backing up EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/awsbackup.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** EFS-to-EFS backup solution 在这里不是最佳选择，因为要求是具有成本效益的 AWS 托管服务解决方案。AWS Backup 是原生托管备份服务，并提供基于策略的计划、跨 Region 备份副本以及增量 EFS 备份。
- **B:** 使用每晚脚本将 EFS 数据复制到 S3 不是托管的 EFS 复制/备份解决方案。它需要自定义脚本，并且使用 S3 复制，而不是针对 EFS 资源的 AWS Backup 策略。
- **C:** 跨 Region VPC 对等连接加上每晚 `rsync` 也是一种自定义的自托管复制方法。它增加了运维开销，并且没有使用 AWS Backup 的托管备份计划或跨 Region 复制功能。

en.question: An ecommerce company is migrating its on-premises workload to the AWS Cloud. The workload currently consists of a web application and a backend Microsoft SQL database for storage. The company expects a high volume of customers during a promotional event. The new infrastructure in the AWS Cloud must be highly available and scalable. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Migrate the web application to two Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server with read replicas in both Availability Zones.
options.B: Migrate the web application to an Amazon EC2 instance that runs in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to two EC2 instances across separate AWS Regions with database replication.
options.C: Migrate the web application to Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon RDS with Multi-AZ deployment.
options.D: Migrate the web application to three Amazon EC2 instances across three Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to three EC2 instances across three Availability Zones.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**. The web tier uses EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across two Availability Zones behind an Application Load Balancer, which addresses both scaling for promotional traffic and high availability. AWS documentation says to span an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attach a load balancer to distribute incoming traffic; if one AZ becomes unavailable, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)). The database tier uses Amazon RDS Multi-AZ, which is the lowest-administration HA choice for a Microsoft SQL Server database: RDS supports Multi-AZ for SQL Server, provides increased availability and fault tolerance, automatically fails over to an up-to-date secondary replica, and RDS handles the primary, witness, and standby for you ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_SQLServer.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Two fixed EC2 instances behind an ALB provide some availability, but they do not provide automatic scaling for high customer volume. Also, read replicas are for read scaling, not the same as a managed Multi-AZ HA failover design.
- **B**: The web tier is scalable, but running Microsoft SQL Server on EC2 instances with cross-Region database replication adds significant administrative overhead compared with Amazon RDS Multi-AZ.
- **D**: Fixed EC2 capacity is not automatically scalable, and self-managing three database EC2 instances across AZs creates high administrative overhead for replication, patching, failover, and recovery.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司正在将其本地工作负载迁移到 AWS Cloud。该工作负载目前由一个 Web 应用程序和一个用于存储的后端 Microsoft SQL 数据库组成。公司预计在促销活动期间会有大量客户访问。AWS Cloud 中的新基础设施必须具备高可用性和可扩展性。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Web 应用程序迁移到跨两个 Availability Zones、位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的两个 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server，并在两个 Availability Zones 中配置只读副本。
options.B: 将 Web 应用程序迁移到一个 Amazon EC2 实例，该实例在跨两个 Availability Zones、位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling group 中运行。将数据库迁移到跨不同 AWS Regions 的两个 EC2 实例，并配置数据库复制。
options.C: 将 Web 应用程序迁移到在跨两个 Availability Zones、位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling group 中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库迁移到采用 Multi-AZ deployment 的 Amazon RDS。
options.D: 将 Web 应用程序迁移到跨三个 Availability Zones、位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的三个 Amazon EC2 实例。将数据库迁移到跨三个 Availability Zones 的三个 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。Web 层使用跨两个 Availability Zones、位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling group 中的 EC2 实例，这同时解决了促销流量的扩展和高可用性问题。AWS 文档说明应将 Auto Scaling group 跨多个 Availability Zones 部署，并附加负载均衡器来分配传入流量；如果一个 AZ 不可用，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。数据库层使用 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ，这是 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库最低管理开销的 HA 选择：RDS 支持 SQL Server 的 Multi-AZ，提供更高的可用性和容错能力，自动故障转移到最新的辅助副本，并且 RDS 会为你处理主副本、见证节点和备用副本（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_SQLServer.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：ALB 后面的两个固定 EC2 实例提供了一定的可用性，但它们无法针对高客户流量进行自动扩展。此外，只读副本用于读取扩展，并不等同于托管的 Multi-AZ HA 故障转移设计。
- **B**：Web 层具有可扩展性，但在 EC2 实例上运行 Microsoft SQL Server 并进行跨 Region 数据库复制，与 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 相比会增加显著的管理开销。
- **D**：固定的 EC2 容量无法自动扩展，并且自行管理跨 AZ 的三个数据库 EC2 实例会在复制、修补、故障转移和恢复方面产生很高的管理开销。

en.question: A company has an on-premises business application that generates hundreds of files each day. These files are stored on an SMB file share and require a low-latency connection to the application servers. A new company policy states all application-generated files must be copied to AWS. There is already a VPN connection to AWS. The application development team does not have time to make the necessary code modifications to move the application to AWS. Which service should a solutions architect recommend to allow the application to copy files to AWS?

options.A: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.B: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
options.C: AWS Snowball
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D — AWS Storage Gateway.**

AWS Storage Gateway, specifically **Amazon S3 File Gateway**, is designed for this hybrid on-premises use case. AWS states that S3 File Gateway lets you store and retrieve objects in Amazon S3 using standard file protocols including **SMB**, can be deployed **in the on-premises environment**, and provides **low-latency access through transparent local caching** while managing data transfer to and from AWS ([AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). This allows the application servers to continue using an SMB file interface with minimal/no application code changes while files are copied into AWS-backed storage.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Amazon EFS** — EFS is not the best fit because it is accessed through **NFSv4**, not SMB, according to the EFS documentation ([Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). The existing application uses an SMB file share.
- **B. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** — FSx for Windows File Server does support SMB, but AWS describes it as fully managed Windows file storage optimized for enterprise applications **in the AWS Cloud** ([Amazon FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)). Directly using an in-cloud SMB file system over VPN does not provide the same on-premises low-latency cached file gateway behavior requested here. Storage Gateway is the service purpose-built to integrate existing on-premises applications with AWS storage using SMB and local caching.
- **C. AWS Snowball** — Snowball/Snowball Edge is for physical/offline or edge transfer scenarios, not continuous daily copying from an on-premises SMB share over an existing VPN. AWS’s Snowball documentation contrasts online transfers with physical transfer options and notes that online transfer services are used to copy data from SMB/NFS shares to AWS storage ([AWS Snowball Edge availability change](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/snowball-edge-availability-change.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个本地业务应用程序，每天会生成数百个文件。这些文件存储在 SMB 文件共享上，并且需要与应用程序服务器之间保持低延迟连接。新的公司策略规定，所有应用程序生成的文件都必须复制到 AWS。当前已经有到 AWS 的 VPN 连接。应用程序开发团队没有时间进行必要的代码修改以将应用程序迁移到 AWS。解决方案架构师应推荐哪项服务，以允许该应用程序将文件复制到 AWS？

options.A: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.B: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
options.C: AWS Snowball
options.D: AWS Storage Gateway

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D — AWS Storage Gateway。**

AWS Storage Gateway，特别是 **Amazon S3 File Gateway**，专为这种混合本地使用场景而设计。AWS 表示，S3 File Gateway 允许你使用包括 **SMB** 在内的标准文件协议在 Amazon S3 中存储和检索对象，可以部署在 **in the on-premises environment**，并通过透明本地缓存提供 **low-latency access**，同时管理与 AWS 之间的数据传输（[AWS Storage Gateway S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。这使应用程序服务器能够继续使用 SMB 文件接口，并且只需很少或无需更改应用程序代码，同时将文件复制到由 AWS 支持的存储中。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Amazon EFS** — EFS 不是最佳选择，因为根据 EFS 文档，它通过 **NFSv4** 访问，而不是 SMB（[Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。现有应用程序使用的是 SMB 文件共享。
- **B. Amazon FSx for Windows File Server** — FSx for Windows File Server 确实支持 SMB，但 AWS 将其描述为针对 **in the AWS Cloud** 的企业应用程序优化的完全托管 Windows 文件存储（[Amazon FSx for Windows File Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。直接通过 VPN 使用云中的 SMB 文件系统，并不能提供此处所需的同等本地低延迟缓存文件网关行为。Storage Gateway 是专门构建的服务，用于通过 SMB 和本地缓存将现有本地应用程序与 AWS 存储集成。
- **C. AWS Snowball** — Snowball/Snowball Edge 用于物理/离线或边缘传输场景，而不是通过现有 VPN 从本地 SMB share 进行持续的每日复制。AWS 的 Snowball 文档将在线传输与物理传输选项进行对比，并指出在线传输服务用于将数据从 SMB/NFS shares 复制到 AWS 存储（[AWS Snowball Edge availability change](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/snowball/latest/developer-guide/snowball-edge-availability-change.html)）。

en.question: A company has 15 employees. The company stores employee start dates in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company wants to send an email message to each employee on the day of the employee's work anniversary. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a script that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Use a cron job to run this script every day on an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.B: Create a script that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Use a cron job to run this script every day on an Amazon EC2 instance.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Schedule this Lambda function to run every day.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans the DynamoDB table and uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to send email messages to employees when necessary. Schedule this Lambda function to run every day.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.
