AWS recommends RDS **Provisioned IOPS SSD** for production applications that require fast, consistent I/O and for I/O-intensive/latency-sensitive workloads; it also states that if a workload is I/O constrained, Provisioned IOPS can increase concurrent I/O processing, reduce latency, and improve database throughput ([Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)). RDS also provides CloudWatch metrics such as `WriteIOPS`, `WriteLatency`, and `WriteThroughput`, and AWS documentation says to consider increasing Provisioned IOPS when IOPS approaches the provisioned value ([Amazon CloudWatch metrics for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-metrics.html); [Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** ElastiCache query caching is most effective for **read-heavy** applications, repeated queries, and offloading reads; it is not the primary solution for a high-volume **write** bottleneck. General Purpose SSD is also less appropriate when the workload is latency/performance sensitive; AWS notes General Purpose storage is acceptable for most workloads that are not latency or performance sensitive, and Provisioned IOPS is recommended for minimum latency/consistent performance ([Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html); [Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).
- **C:** Amazon DocumentDB is a MongoDB-compatible document database, not a MySQL-compatible relational database target for relocating an on-premises MySQL database ([What is Amazon DocumentDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/what-is.html)).
- **D:** Amazon EFS is a file system service, not a managed MySQL database service, so it does not address relocating and operating a MySQL database workload on AWS ([What is Amazon Elastic File System?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其本地 MySQL 数据库迁移到 AWS。该数据库会定期接受来自面向客户端的应用程序的导入，这会导致大量写入操作。该公司担心流量大小可能会导致应用程序内出现性能问题。解决方案架构师应如何在 AWS 上设计该架构？

options.A: 预置一个使用 Provisioned IOPS SSD 存储的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控写入操作指标。如有必要，调整预置的 IOPS。
options.B: 预置一个使用 General Purpose SSD 存储的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例。在该 DB 实例前放置一个 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。将应用程序配置为改为查询 ElastiCache。
options.C: 预置一个使用内存优化实例类型的 Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) 实例。监控 Amazon CloudWatch 以发现与性能相关的问题。如有必要，更改实例类别。
options.D: 在 General Purpose 性能模式下预置一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。监控 Amazon CloudWatch 以发现 IOPS 瓶颈。如有必要，切换到 Provisioned Throughput 性能模式。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** 该工作负载是迁移后的 **MySQL** 数据库，并且有大量 **写入操作**，因此 Amazon RDS for MySQL 是合适的托管关系数据库服务，并且存储应针对可预测的 I/O 进行优化。AWS 建议将 RDS **Provisioned IOPS SSD** 用于需要快速、一致 I/O 的生产应用程序，以及 I/O 密集型/延迟敏感型工作负载；AWS 还说明，如果工作负载受到 I/O 限制，Provisioned IOPS 可以增加并发 I/O 处理、降低延迟并提高数据库吞吐量（[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。RDS 还提供 CloudWatch 指标，例如 `WriteIOPS`、`WriteLatency` 和 `WriteThroughput`，并且 AWS 文档说明，当 IOPS 接近预置值时，应考虑增加 Provisioned IOPS（[Amazon CloudWatch metrics for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-metrics.html)；[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **B:** ElastiCache 查询缓存对于**读取密集型**应用程序、重复查询以及卸载读取最有效；它不是解决大量**写入**瓶颈的主要方案。当工作负载对延迟/性能敏感时，General Purpose SSD 也不太合适；AWS 指出，General Purpose 存储适用于大多数并非延迟或性能敏感的工作负载，而对于最低延迟/一致性能，建议使用 Provisioned IOPS（[Caching database query results](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)；[Amazon RDS DB instance storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon DocumentDB 是兼容 MongoDB 的文档数据库，并不是用于迁移本地 MySQL 数据库的 MySQL 兼容关系数据库目标（[What is Amazon DocumentDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/what-is.html)）。
- **D:** Amazon EFS 是文件系统服务，不是托管 MySQL 数据库服务，因此无法解决在 AWS 上迁移和运行 MySQL 数据库工作负载的问题（[What is Amazon Elastic File System?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an application in the AWS Cloud that generates sensitive archival data files. The company wants to rearchitect the application's data storage. The company wants to encrypt the data files and to ensure that third parties do not have access to the data before the data is encrypted and sent to AWS. The company has already created an Amazon S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the S3 bucket to use client-side encryption with an Amazon S3 managed encryption key. Configure the application to use the S3 bucket to store the archival files.
options.B: Configure the S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the application to use the S3 bucket to store the archival files.
options.C: Configure the S3 bucket to use dual-layer server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure the application to use the S3 bucket to store the archival files.
options.D: Configure the application to use client-side encryption with a key stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure the application to store the archival files in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The requirement is that third parties must not have access to the data **before the data is encrypted and sent to AWS**. AWS documentation states that Amazon S3 client-side encryption encrypts data locally before upload; in this mode, objects are not exposed to any third party, including AWS, and S3 receives the objects already encrypted. The S3 Encryption Client can use a KMS key as a wrapping key while encrypting/decrypting as part of `PutObject`/`GetObject` requests ([Protecting data by using client-side encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingClientSideEncryption.html)).

- **A is incorrect** because Amazon S3 managed keys are used for **server-side encryption** (SSE-S3), not for encrypting data locally before it is sent to AWS. AWS states that S3 buckets automatically encrypt objects using server-side encryption with S3 managed keys ([Setting default server-side encryption behavior for Amazon S3 buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)).
- **B is incorrect** because SSE-KMS is server-side encryption. With server-side encryption, Amazon S3 encrypts the object before saving it to disk, meaning the object is sent to S3 before S3 performs the encryption ([Setting default server-side encryption behavior for Amazon S3 buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)).
- **C is incorrect** because dual-layer SSE-KMS is still server-side encryption, so it does not satisfy the requirement to encrypt before sending the data to AWS.
- **D is correct** because the application performs client-side encryption before storing the files in S3, using AWS KMS for key protection, which matches the requirement that AWS and other third parties receive only already-encrypted data.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行一个应用程序，该应用程序会生成敏感的归档数据文件。公司希望重新架构该应用程序的数据存储。公司希望加密这些数据文件，并确保第三方在数据被加密并发送到 AWS 之前无法访问这些数据。公司已经创建了一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 S3 存储桶配置为使用带有 Amazon S3 托管加密密钥的客户端加密。配置应用程序使用该 S3 存储桶来存储归档文件。
options.B: 将 S3 存储桶配置为使用 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。配置应用程序使用该 S3 存储桶来存储归档文件。
options.C: 将 S3 存储桶配置为使用 AWS KMS keys 的双层服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。配置应用程序使用该 S3 存储桶来存储归档文件。
options.D: 配置应用程序使用客户端加密，并使用存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中的密钥。配置应用程序将归档文件存储在 S3 存储桶中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 要求是第三方不得在数据**被加密并发送到 AWS 之前**访问这些数据。AWS 文档说明，Amazon S3 客户端加密会在上传前在本地加密数据；在这种模式下，对象不会暴露给任何第三方，包括 AWS，S3 接收到的对象已经是加密后的对象。S3 Encryption Client 可以使用 KMS key 作为包装密钥，并在 `PutObject`/`GetObject` 请求过程中进行加密/解密（[Protecting data by using client-side encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingClientSideEncryption.html)）。

- **A 不正确**，因为 Amazon S3 托管密钥用于**服务器端加密** (SSE-S3)，而不是在数据发送到 AWS 之前在本地加密数据。AWS 说明，S3 存储桶会使用带有 S3 托管密钥的服务器端加密自动加密对象（[Setting default server-side encryption behavior for Amazon S3 buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)）。
- **B 不正确**，因为 SSE-KMS 是服务器端加密。使用服务器端加密时，Amazon S3 会在将对象保存到磁盘之前对其进行加密，这意味着对象会先发送到 S3，然后 S3 执行加密（[Setting default server-side encryption behavior for Amazon S3 buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html)）。
- **C 不正确**，因为双层 SSE-KMS 仍然是服务器端加密，因此不满足在将数据发送到 AWS 之前加密的要求。
- **D 正确**，因为应用程序在将文件存储到 S3 之前执行客户端加密，并使用 AWS KMS 进行密钥保护，这符合 AWS 和其他第三方只接收已加密数据的要求。

en.question: A company uses Amazon RDS with default backup settings for its database tier. The company needs to make a daily backup of the database to meet regulatory requirements. The company must retain the backups for 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Write an AWS Lambda function to create an RDS snapshot every day.
options.B: Modify the RDS database to have a retention period of 30 days for automated backups.
options.C: Use AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows to modify the RDS backup retention period.
options.D: Create a manual snapshot every day by using the AWS CLI. Modify the RDS backup retention period.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Amazon RDS automated backups already run daily: “Automated backups occur daily during the preferred backup window” ([AWS RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ManagingAutomatedBackups.html)). RDS also allows the backup retention period to be modified after the DB is created, and for a DB instance it can be set to **0–35 days**; therefore setting it to **30 days** meets the regulatory retention requirement with the least operational overhead ([AWS RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)).

- **A is incorrect** because writing and operating a Lambda function to create snapshots duplicates native RDS automated backup functionality and adds operational overhead.
- **C is incorrect** because Systems Manager Maintenance Windows are unnecessary; the requirement is simply to modify the RDS automated backup retention period.
- **D is incorrect** because creating manual snapshots every day with the AWS CLI is operationally heavier than using RDS automated backups. AWS also notes that manual snapshot limits do not apply to automated backups, reinforcing that automated backups are the appropriate managed mechanism ([AWS RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在其数据库层使用 Amazon RDS，并采用默认备份设置。该公司需要每天对数据库进行一次备份以满足监管要求。公司必须将备份保留 30 天。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每天创建一个 RDS 快照。
options.B: 修改 RDS 数据库，将自动备份的保留期设置为 30 天。
options.C: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows 修改 RDS 备份保留期。
options.D: 使用 AWS CLI 每天创建一个手动快照。修改 RDS 备份保留期。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon RDS 自动备份本来就会每日运行：“Automated backups occur daily during the preferred backup window”（[AWS RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ManagingAutomatedBackups.html)）。RDS 还允许在创建 DB 后修改备份保留期，并且对于 DB 实例，可将其设置为 **0–35 天**；因此，将其设置为 **30 天** 可以以最少的运营开销满足监管保留要求（[AWS RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)）。

- **A 不正确**，因为编写和运维 Lambda 函数来创建快照会重复原生 RDS 自动备份功能，并增加运营开销。
- **C 不正确**，因为 Systems Manager Maintenance Windows 并非必要；该要求只是修改 RDS 自动备份保留期。
- **D 不正确**，因为每天使用 AWS CLI 创建手动快照比使用 RDS 自动备份具有更高的运营负担。AWS 还指出，手动快照限制不适用于自动备份，这进一步说明自动备份是合适的托管机制（[AWS RDS User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)）。

en.question: A company that runs its application on AWS uses an Amazon Aurora DB cluster as its database. During peak usage hours when multiple users access and read the data, the monitoring system shows degradation of database performance for the write queries. The company wants to increase the scalability of the application to meet peak usage demands. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a second Aurora DB cluster. Configure a copy job to replicate the users’ data to the new database. Update the application to use the second database to read the data.
options.B: Create an Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster in front of the existing Aurora DB cluster. Update the application to use the DAX cluster for read-only queries. Write data directly to the Aurora DB cluster.
options.C: Create an Aurora read replica in the existing Aurora DB cluster. Update the application to use the replica endpoint for read-only queries and to use the cluster endpoint for write queries.
options.D: Create an Amazon Redshift cluster. Copy the users' data to the Redshift cluster. Update the application to connect to the Redshift cluster and to perform read-only queries on the Redshift cluster.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The workload is read-heavy during peaks, and read activity is degrading write performance on the Aurora primary/writer. Aurora provides a **reader endpoint** specifically for read-only connections. AWS states that the reader endpoint processes read statements on read-only Aurora Replicas, **reduces overhead on the primary instance**, and helps the cluster scale simultaneous `SELECT` queries in proportion to the number of Aurora Replicas ([Reader endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)). Writes should continue to use the **cluster/writer endpoint**, which AWS states connects to the primary DB instance and is used for inserts, updates, deletes, and DDL changes ([Cluster endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Cluster.html)). Therefore, adding an Aurora read replica and routing reads to the replica/reader endpoint is the most cost-effective, purpose-built scaling solution.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Creating a second Aurora DB cluster and building a copy job adds unnecessary duplication, operational complexity, and cost. Aurora already supports scaling read-only query workloads with Aurora Replicas behind the reader endpoint ([Reader endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)).
- **B:** DAX is for **DynamoDB**, not Aurora. AWS describes DAX as providing microsecond-latency access to data from **DynamoDB tables** and as a cache for DynamoDB read-intensive workloads ([In-memory acceleration with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)). It cannot be placed in front of an Aurora relational database cluster as described.
- **D:** Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale **data warehouse** service for analytics/BI querying, not the most cost-effective way to offload normal application reads from an Aurora OLTP database ([What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)). It would also require copying data and maintaining another system.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行其应用程序，并使用 Amazon Aurora DB cluster 作为数据库。在高峰使用时段，当多个用户访问并读取数据时，监控系统显示写入查询的数据库性能下降。公司希望提高应用程序的可扩展性，以满足高峰使用需求。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建第二个 Aurora DB cluster。配置一个复制作业，将用户数据复制到新数据库。更新应用程序以使用第二个数据库来读取数据。
options.B: 在现有 Aurora DB cluster 前面创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster。更新应用程序以使用 DAX cluster 执行只读查询。将数据直接写入 Aurora DB cluster。
options.C: 在现有 Aurora DB cluster 中创建一个 Aurora read replica。更新应用程序以使用副本端点执行只读查询，并使用集群端点执行写入查询。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Redshift cluster。将用户数据复制到 Redshift cluster。更新应用程序以连接到 Redshift cluster，并在 Redshift cluster 上执行只读查询。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

该工作负载在高峰期间以读取为主，并且读取活动正在降低 Aurora primary/writer 上的写入性能。Aurora 提供了专门用于只读连接的 **reader endpoint**。AWS 表示，reader endpoint 会在只读 Aurora Replicas 上处理读取语句，**减少主实例上的开销**，并帮助集群按 Aurora Replicas 的数量成比例地扩展并发 `SELECT` 查询（[Reader endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)）。写入应继续使用 **cluster/writer endpoint**，AWS 表示该端点连接到主 DB 实例，并用于插入、更新、删除和 DDL 更改（[Cluster endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Cluster.html)）。因此，添加 Aurora read replica 并将读取路由到 replica/reader endpoint，是最具成本效益且专为此目的构建的扩展解决方案。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 创建第二个 Aurora DB cluster 并构建复制作业会增加不必要的数据重复、运维复杂性和成本。Aurora 已经支持通过 reader endpoint 后面的 Aurora Replicas 来扩展只读查询工作负载（[Reader endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Reader.html)）。
- **B:** DAX 用于 **DynamoDB**，而不是 Aurora。AWS 将 DAX 描述为可为来自 **DynamoDB tables** 的数据提供微秒级延迟访问，并作为 DynamoDB 读密集型工作负载的缓存（[In-memory acceleration with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/DAX.html)）。它不能像描述的那样放在 Aurora 关系数据库集群前面。
- **D:** Amazon Redshift 是一种完全托管、PB 级的 **data warehouse** 服务，用于分析/BI 查询，并不是从 Aurora OLTP 数据库卸载普通应用程序读取的最具成本效益方式（[What is Amazon Redshift?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/welcome.html)）。它还需要复制数据并维护另一个系统。

en.question: A company's near-real-time streaming application is running on AWS. As the data is ingested, a job runs on the data and takes 30 minutes to complete. The workload frequently experiences high latency due to large amounts of incoming data. A solutions architect needs to design a scalable and serverless solution to enhance performance. Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest the data.
options.B: Use AWS Lambda with AWS Step Functions to process the data.
options.C: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to ingest the data.
options.D: Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to process the data.
options.E: Use AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to process the data.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and E**.

- **A. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest the data** — Amazon Data Firehose is a fully managed service for delivering real-time streaming data. AWS states that producers send records to a Firehose stream and Firehose automatically delivers the data to the configured destination, without needing to manage resources. This matches the need for scalable, serverless streaming ingestion. [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)
- **E. Use AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS to process the data** — The processing job takes **30 minutes**, so it needs a serverless compute option that is not constrained by Lambda’s 15-minute limit. AWS Fargate runs Amazon ECS containers without managing servers or EC2 clusters, and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters. [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B. AWS Lambda with Step Functions** — Lambda is serverless, but a Lambda function can run for a maximum of **900 seconds (15 minutes)**. A 30-minute processing job would exceed a single Lambda invocation’s supported timeout, making Fargate a better fit for this workload. [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)
- **C. AWS DMS** — AWS DMS is for database migration/change data capture use cases, not the general ingestion layer for a near-real-time streaming application. The question needs streaming ingestion, which Firehose is designed for.
- **D. EC2 Auto Scaling group** — EC2 instances can scale, but they are not serverless and require managing instances/clusters. The requirement explicitly asks for a scalable and serverless solution, which Fargate satisfies instead. [AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

zh.question: 一家公司的近实时流式处理应用程序正在 AWS 上运行。随着数据被摄取，一个作业会在数据上运行，并需要 30 分钟才能完成。由于大量传入数据，该工作负载经常出现高延迟。解决方案架构师需要设计一种可扩展且无服务器的解决方案来提升性能。解决方案架构师应采取哪一组步骤？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 来摄取数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS Lambda 与 AWS Step Functions 来处理数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 来摄取数据。
options.D: 使用 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例来处理数据。
options.E: 使用 AWS Fargate 与 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 来处理数据。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 E**。

- **A. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest the data** — Amazon Data Firehose 是一项完全托管的服务，用于传输实时流式数据。AWS 表示，生产者将记录发送到 Firehose stream，Firehose 会自动将数据传送到配置的目标位置，而无需管理资源。这符合可扩展、无服务器流式摄取的需求。[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/what-is-this-service.html)
- **E. Use AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS to process the data** — 处理作业需要 **30 分钟**，因此需要一种不受 Lambda 15 分钟限制约束的无服务器计算选项。AWS Fargate 可以在不管理服务器或 EC2 集群的情况下运行 Amazon ECS 容器，并且无需预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群。[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

为什么其他选项不正确：

- **B. AWS Lambda with Step Functions** — Lambda 是无服务器的，但一个 Lambda 函数最多只能运行 **900 秒（15 分钟）**。一个 30 分钟的处理作业会超过单次 Lambda 调用支持的超时时间，因此 Fargate 更适合此工作负载。[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)
- **C. AWS DMS** — AWS DMS 用于数据库迁移/变更数据捕获用例，而不是近实时流式处理应用程序的通用摄取层。题目需要流式摄取，而 Firehose 正是为此设计的。
- **D. EC2 Auto Scaling group** — EC2 实例可以扩展，但它们不是无服务器的，并且需要管理实例/集群。要求明确提出需要一种可扩展且无服务器的解决方案，而 Fargate 能满足这一点。[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)

en.question: A company runs a web application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC. The application needs to write sensitive data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The data cannot be sent over the public internet. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Create a route in the VPC route table to the endpoint.
options.B: Create an internal Network Load Balancer that has the S3 bucket as the target.
options.C: Deploy the S3 bucket inside the VPCreate a route in the VPC route table to the bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC and an S3 regional endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** A gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 is designed for this requirement. AWS states that you can access Amazon S3 from a VPC using gateway VPC endpoints and then add the endpoint as a target in the VPC route table for traffic destined to S3. AWS also states that with a gateway endpoint, you can access S3 from your VPC **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device**. The S3 documentation further explains that a gateway endpoint is specified in the route table to access S3 from the VPC over the AWS network, and that this traffic remains on the AWS network ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html), [Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An internal Network Load Balancer cannot use an S3 bucket as a target. This also does not describe the AWS-supported private connectivity pattern for EC2-to-S3 access.
- **C:** You do not deploy an S3 bucket inside a VPC or route directly to a bucket. S3 is accessed through S3 endpoints; for this scenario, AWS documents using a gateway endpoint and route table entry.
- **D:** Direct Connect is for connecting external/on-premises networks to AWS, not for private traffic from EC2 instances already inside a VPC to S3. AWS specifically documents that a gateway endpoint provides VPC-to-S3 access without an internet gateway or NAT device, which directly meets the requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 中的多个 Amazon EC2 instances 上运行一个 Web application。该 application 需要将敏感数据写入 Amazon S3 bucket。数据不能通过 public internet 发送。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Amazon S3 创建 gateway VPC endpoint。在 VPC route table 中创建到该 endpoint 的 route。
options.B: 创建一个 internal Network Load Balancer，并将 S3 bucket 作为 target。
options.C: 将 S3 bucket 部署在 VPC 内。在 VPC route table 中创建到该 bucket 的 route。
options.D: 在 VPC 和 S3 regional endpoint 之间创建 AWS Direct Connect connection。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon S3 的 gateway VPC endpoint 正是为此要求而设计的。AWS 说明，你可以使用 gateway VPC endpoints 从 VPC 访问 Amazon S3，然后在 VPC route table 中将该 endpoint 添加为发往 S3 的流量的 target。AWS 还说明，使用 gateway endpoint 时，你可以从 VPC 访问 S3，**无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device**。S3 文档进一步解释，gateway endpoint 在 route table 中指定，用于通过 AWS network 从 VPC 访问 S3，并且该流量会保留在 AWS network 上（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)，[Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** internal Network Load Balancer 不能将 S3 bucket 用作 target。这也没有描述 AWS 支持的 EC2 到 S3 访问的私有连接模式。
- **C:** 你不能将 S3 bucket 部署在 VPC 内，也不能直接 route 到 bucket。S3 通过 S3 endpoints 访问；对于此场景，AWS 文档说明应使用 gateway endpoint 和 route table 条目。
- **D:** Direct Connect 用于将外部/本地网络连接到 AWS，而不是用于已经位于 VPC 内的 EC2 instances 到 S3 的私有流量。AWS 明确记录了 gateway endpoint 可在无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device 的情况下提供 VPC 到 S3 的访问，这直接满足要求。

en.question: A company runs its production workload on Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. A solutions architect needs to analyze the current EBS volume cost and to recommend optimizations. The recommendations need to include estimated monthly saving opportunities. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon Inspector reporting to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization.
options.B: Use AWS Systems Manager reporting to determine EBS volume recommendations for optimization.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics reporting to determine EBS volume recommendations for optimization.
options.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Use AWS Compute Optimizer to generate EBS volume recommendations for optimization.**

AWS Compute Optimizer is the service that directly provides **Amazon EBS volume recommendations**. For EBS volumes, it classifies volumes as optimized or not optimized; a volume is **Not optimized** when Compute Optimizer identifies a volume type, size, or IOPS specification that can provide better performance or cost. It also provides **Estimated monthly savings** and **Savings opportunity (%)** for migrating from current EBS specifications to recommended specifications, and it calculates savings based on the current volume running hours and the rate difference between current and recommended specifications ([AWS Compute Optimizer EBS recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ebs-recommendations.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon Inspector** is for automated vulnerability scanning and risk findings, not EBS cost/right-sizing recommendations. AWS describes it as a vulnerability scanning service for resources such as EC2, container images, and Lambda functions ([Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).
- **B. AWS Systems Manager** centralizes operational visibility and automates operational tasks, but it is not the service for EBS volume cost optimization recommendations with estimated savings ([AWS Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html)).
- **C. Amazon CloudWatch** provides observability through metrics, logs, alarms, and dashboards; although Compute Optimizer can use utilization metrics, CloudWatch itself does not generate EBS optimization recommendations with estimated monthly savings ([Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在带有 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行其生产工作负载。一名解决方案架构师需要分析当前的 EBS 卷成本并推荐优化方案。这些建议需要包含预计的每月节省机会。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Inspector 报告来生成用于优化的 EBS 卷建议。
options.B: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 报告来确定用于优化的 EBS 卷建议。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标报告来确定用于优化的 EBS 卷建议。
options.D: 使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 来生成用于优化的 EBS 卷建议。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 来生成用于优化的 EBS 卷建议。**

AWS Compute Optimizer 是直接提供 **Amazon EBS 卷建议**的服务。对于 EBS 卷，它会将卷分类为已优化或未优化；当 Compute Optimizer 识别出某个卷类型、大小或 IOPS 规格可以提供更好的性能或成本时，该卷为**未优化**。它还会提供从当前 EBS 规格迁移到建议规格的**预计每月节省额**和**节省机会 (%)**，并根据当前卷运行小时数以及当前规格与建议规格之间的费率差异来计算节省额（[AWS Compute Optimizer EBS recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ebs-recommendations.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Amazon Inspector** 用于自动化漏洞扫描和风险发现，而不是 EBS 成本/适当规模调整建议。AWS 将其描述为一种漏洞扫描服务，适用于 EC2、容器镜像和 Lambda 函数等资源（[Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。
- **B. AWS Systems Manager** 可集中运营可见性并自动执行运营任务，但它并不是用于提供带有预计节省额的 EBS 卷成本优化建议的服务（[AWS Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/what-is-systems-manager.html)）。
- **C. Amazon CloudWatch** 通过指标、日志、警报和控制面板提供可观测性；虽然 Compute Optimizer 可以使用利用率指标，但 CloudWatch 本身不会生成带有预计每月节省额的 EBS 优化建议（[Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)）。

en.question: A global company runs its workloads on AWS. The company's application uses Amazon S3 buckets across AWS Regions for sensitive data storage and analysis. The company stores millions of objects in multiple S3 buckets daily. The company wants to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an AWS CloudTrail event that has a rule to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning- enabled across Regions.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.C: Enable IAM Access Analyzer for S3 to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens.**

Amazon S3 Storage Lens is designed for organization/account-wide storage analytics. AWS states that it provides organization-wide visibility, can scope dashboards by **AWS Region, bucket, and account**, and includes drill-downs at organization, account, Region, and bucket level. Its **data-protection metrics** provide insight into features such as encryption and **S3 Versioning**, and AWS explicitly says you can use them to identify buckets that are not following best practices, including not using **S3 Versioning** ([Understanding Amazon S3 Storage Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens_basics_metrics_recommendations.html)). This directly matches identifying non-versioned S3 buckets across Regions.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudTrail event rule** — CloudTrail records API activity: who made a request, when, source IP, and request details. It is for auditing actions, not for producing a cross-Region analytics view of all buckets whose current versioning status is disabled ([Logging and monitoring in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)).
- **C. IAM Access Analyzer for S3** — IAM Access Analyzer for S3 identifies buckets with public or cross-account external access findings, and reports access-related fields such as shared-through, status, access level, and external principal. It does not evaluate S3 Versioning configuration ([Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html)).
- **D. S3 Multi-Region Access Point** — Multi-Region Access Points provide a global endpoint and route application traffic to S3 buckets in multiple Regions for multi-Region applications and failover; they are not a configuration-auditing or analytics tool for versioning status ([Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)).

zh.question: 一家全球性公司在 AWS 上运行其工作负载。该公司的应用程序使用跨 AWS Regions 的 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储和分析敏感数据。该公司每天在多个 S3 存储桶中存储数百万个对象。该公司希望识别所有未启用版本控制的 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置一个 AWS CloudTrail 事件，该事件具有一条规则，用于识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 使用 Amazon S3 Storage Lens 识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 为 S3 启用 IAM Access Analyzer，以识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 创建一个 S3 Multi-Region Access Point，以识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 Amazon S3 Storage Lens。**

Amazon S3 Storage Lens 专为组织/账户范围的存储分析而设计。AWS 表示，它提供组织范围的可见性，可以按 **AWS Region、bucket, and account** 确定控制面板范围，并包含组织、账户、Region 和存储桶级别的下钻。它的 **data-protection metrics** 可提供对加密和 **S3 Versioning** 等功能的洞察，AWS 明确表示你可以使用这些指标来识别未遵循最佳实践的存储桶，包括未使用 **S3 Versioning** 的存储桶（[Understanding Amazon S3 Storage Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens_basics_metrics_recommendations.html)）。这直接符合识别跨 Regions 的未启用版本控制的 S3 存储桶这一需求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. CloudTrail event rule** — CloudTrail 记录 API 活动：谁发出了请求、何时发出、源 IP 以及请求详细信息。它用于审计操作，而不是生成所有当前版本控制状态为禁用的存储桶的跨 Region 分析视图（[Logging and monitoring in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/monitoring-overview.html)）。
- **C. IAM Access Analyzer for S3** — IAM Access Analyzer for S3 识别具有公开访问或跨账户外部访问发现结果的存储桶，并报告与访问相关的字段，例如 shared-through、status、access level 和 external principal。它不会评估 S3 Versioning 配置（[Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html)）。
- **D. S3 Multi-Region Access Point** — Multi-Region Access Points 提供一个全局端点，并将应用程序流量路由到多个 Regions 中的 S3 存储桶，用于多 Region 应用程序和故障转移；它们不是用于版本控制状态的配置审计或分析工具（[Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to enhance its ecommerce order-processing application that is deployed on AWS. The application must process each order exactly once without affecting the customer experience during unpredictable traffic surges. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Put all the orders in the SQS queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topic. Publish all the orders to the SNS standard topic. Configure the application as a notification target.
options.C: Create a flow by using Amazon AppFlow. Send the orders to the flow. Configure an AWS Lambda function as the target to process the orders.
options.D: Configure AWS X-Ray in the application to track the order requests. Configure the application to process the orders by pulling the orders from Amazon CloudWatch.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon SQS FIFO queues are designed for workflows where duplicates cannot be tolerated and provide FIFO delivery and **exactly-once processing**; AWS also lists an “e-commerce order management system” as a FIFO queue use case. FIFO messages are delivered once and remain unavailable until the consumer processes and deletes them, and duplicates are not introduced into the queue ([Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)). Using Lambda as the consumer is appropriate because Lambda can process messages from an SQS FIFO queue while respecting FIFO ordering, and it can scale across different message groups for workload bursts ([Amazon SQS FIFO queue and Lambda concurrency behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/fifo-queue-lambda-behavior.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** An SNS standard topic is for pub/sub fanout to subscribers, not a queue-based exactly-once order processor. SNS can deliver messages to multiple endpoints for parallel processing, which is not the same as exactly-once processing of each order ([What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **C:** Amazon AppFlow is a managed integration service for exchanging data between SaaS applications and AWS services, such as transferring Salesforce data to Amazon S3 or Redshift. It is not the best fit for buffering ecommerce order requests during unpredictable traffic surges with exactly-once processing semantics ([What is Amazon AppFlow?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/what-is-appflow.html)).
- **D:** AWS X-Ray is for tracing/instrumenting application requests, not for durable order queuing or order processing. CloudWatch is also not a service from which an application pulls orders for exactly-once processing. This option does not meet the processing requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司希望增强其部署在 AWS 上的电子商务订单处理应用程序。该应用程序必须在不可预测的流量激增期间，在不影响客户体验的情况下，对每个订单仅处理一次。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列。将所有订单放入 SQS 队列。将一个 AWS Lambda 函数配置为目标来处理订单。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 标准主题。将所有订单发布到 SNS 标准主题。将该应用程序配置为通知目标。
options.C: 使用 Amazon AppFlow 创建一个流。将订单发送到该流。将一个 AWS Lambda 函数配置为目标来处理订单。
options.D: 在应用程序中配置 AWS X-Ray 以跟踪订单请求。配置应用程序通过从 Amazon CloudWatch 拉取订单来处理订单。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon SQS FIFO 队列专为无法容忍重复项的工作流而设计，并提供 FIFO 传输和**仅处理一次**；AWS 还将“电子商务订单管理系统”列为 FIFO 队列用例。FIFO 消息只会被传输一次，并且在使用者处理并删除它们之前保持不可用，队列中也不会引入重复项（[Amazon SQS FIFO queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-fifo-queues.html)）。使用 Lambda 作为使用者是合适的，因为 Lambda 可以在遵循 FIFO 顺序的同时处理来自 SQS FIFO 队列的消息，并且可以跨不同的消息组扩展以应对工作负载突增（[Amazon SQS FIFO queue and Lambda concurrency behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/fifo-queue-lambda-behavior.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** SNS 标准主题用于向订阅者进行发布/订阅扇出，而不是基于队列的、仅处理一次的订单处理器。SNS 可以将消息传递到多个端点以进行并行处理，这与对每个订单进行仅处理一次并不相同（[What is Amazon SNS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon AppFlow 是一项托管集成服务，用于在 SaaS 应用程序和 AWS 服务之间交换数据，例如将 Salesforce 数据传输到 Amazon S3 或 Redshift。对于在不可预测的流量激增期间缓冲电子商务订单请求并提供仅处理一次语义，它并不是最佳选择（[What is Amazon AppFlow?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/appflow/latest/userguide/what-is-appflow.html)）。
- **D:** AWS X-Ray 用于跟踪/检测应用程序请求，而不是用于持久化订单排队或订单处理。CloudWatch 也不是应用程序可从中拉取订单以进行仅处理一次处理的服务。此选项不满足处理要求。

en.question: A company has two AWS accounts: Production and Development. The company needs to push code changes in the Development account to the Production account. In the alpha phase, only two senior developers on the development team need access to the Production account. In the beta phase, more developers will need access to perform testing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create two policy documents by using the AWS Management Console in each account. Assign the policy to developers who need access.
options.B: Create an IAM role in the Development account. Grant the IAM role access to the Production account. Allow developers to assume the role.
options.C: Create an IAM role in the Production account. Define a trust policy that specifies the Development account. Allow developers to assume the role.
options.D: Create an IAM group in the Production account. Add the group as a principal in a trust policy that specifies the Production account. Add developers to the group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** For cross-account access, the role must be created in the account that owns the resources to be accessed. AWS’s cross-account role tutorial says to create the role in the **Destination** account and specify the **Originating** account as the trusted entity; this establishes trust between the accounts and defines what users who switch to the role can do. Then, in the originating account, grant selected users/developers permission for `sts:AssumeRole` on that destination-account role. This fits the alpha/beta requirement because the Production account role can trust the Development account, while access can be expanded over time by granting additional Development-account developers permission to assume the role. AWS also notes that the result is access using temporary credentials. [IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Creating separate policy documents in each account does not by itself establish the required cross-account trust/assume-role mechanism. AWS states that, for cross-account resource access, adding a cross-account principal is only half of the trust relationship and the principal also needs an identity-based policy; the standard pattern is the role/trust policy plus `sts:AssumeRole` permission. [Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)
- **B:** The role is in the wrong account. The AWS tutorial explicitly creates the role in the **Destination** account—the account being accessed—and trusts the originating account. Here, Production is the destination, so the role should be in Production, not Development. [IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)
- **D:** IAM groups are not valid principals in role trust policies. AWS documentation says trust policies define which principal entities—**accounts, users, roles, and federated users**—can assume the role. Groups are used for identity-based permissions, not as principals in a role trust policy. [Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)

zh.question: 一家公司有两个 AWS 账户：Production 和 Development。该公司需要将 Development 账户中的代码更改推送到 Production 账户。在 alpha 阶段，开发团队中只有两名高级开发人员需要访问 Production 账户。在 beta 阶段，将有更多开发人员需要访问以执行测试。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在每个账户中使用 AWS Management Console 创建两个策略文档。将策略分配给需要访问权限的开发人员。
options.B: 在 Development 账户中创建一个 IAM 角色。授予该 IAM 角色访问 Production 账户的权限。允许开发人员代入该角色。
options.C: 在 Production 账户中创建一个 IAM 角色。定义一个指定 Development 账户的信任策略。允许开发人员代入该角色。
options.D: 在 Production 账户中创建一个 IAM 组。将该组作为主体添加到指定 Production 账户的信任策略中。将开发人员添加到该组。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 对于跨账户访问，必须在拥有要访问资源的账户中创建角色。AWS 的跨账户角色教程说明，应在 **Destination** 账户中创建角色，并将 **Originating** 账户指定为可信实体；这会在账户之间建立信任，并定义切换到该角色的用户可以执行哪些操作。然后，在 originating 账户中，授予选定的用户/开发人员对该 destination-account 角色的 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。这符合 alpha/beta 要求，因为 Production 账户角色可以信任 Development 账户，同时可以通过向更多 Development-account 开发人员授予代入该角色的权限来逐步扩展访问。AWS 还指出，其结果是使用临时凭证进行访问。[IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 在每个账户中创建单独的策略文档本身并不会建立所需的跨账户信任/代入角色机制。AWS 表示，对于跨账户资源访问，添加跨账户主体只是信任关系的一半，该主体还需要基于身份的策略；标准模式是角色/信任策略加上 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。[Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)
- **B:** 角色位于错误的账户中。AWS 教程明确是在 **Destination** 账户（即被访问的账户）中创建角色，并信任 originating 账户。这里 Production 是 destination，因此角色应位于 Production 中，而不是 Development 中。[IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)
- **D:** IAM 组不是角色信任策略中的有效主体。AWS 文档说明，信任策略定义哪些主体实体（**accounts, users, roles, and federated users**）可以代入该角色。组用于基于身份的权限，而不是作为角色信任策略中的主体。[Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)

en.question: A company wants to restrict access to the content of its web application. The company needs to protect the content by using authorization techniques that are available on AWS. The company also wants to implement a serverless architecture for authorization and authentication that has low login latency. The solution must integrate with the web application and serve web content globally. The application currently has a small user base, but the company expects the application's user base to increase. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure Amazon Cognito for authentication. Implement Lambda@Edge for authorization. Configure Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
options.B: Configure AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Implement AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
options.C: Configure Amazon Cognito for authentication. Implement AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.
options.D: Configure AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Implement Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

- **A is correct:** Amazon Cognito is intended to integrate authentication and authorization with web and mobile apps; AWS docs describe Cognito managed login as a ready-to-use web sign-in application where Cognito handles the authentication flow and returns the outcome to the application ([Amazon Cognito app integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-integrate-apps.html)). Lambda@Edge integrates with CloudFront and can inspect headers or authorization tokens and insert headers to control access before CloudFront forwards the request to the origin ([Ways to use Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-edge-ways-to-use.html)). CloudFront serves static and dynamic web content through a worldwide edge-location network and routes requests to the edge location with the lowest latency ([What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). This matches serverless authentication/authorization, low-latency edge authorization, and global web content delivery.
- **B is wrong:** AWS Managed Microsoft AD is a managed Active Directory service for directory-aware workloads, users/groups, SSO, group policies, and EC2 connectivity—not the simplest serverless, low-latency web-app authentication pattern for a growing public web user base ([AWS Managed Microsoft AD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_microsoft_ad.html)). Also, an Application Load Balancer is built around enabled Availability Zones in a Region, not CloudFront-style global edge delivery ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).
- **C is wrong:** Although Cognito fits authentication, standard regional AWS Lambda for authorization does not provide the edge authorization latency benefits of Lambda@Edge with CloudFront. S3 Transfer Acceleration is for faster uploads/transfers to a centralized S3 bucket from around the world, not for globally serving protected web application content ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).
- **D is wrong:** It uses Managed Microsoft AD rather than Cognito for scalable web-app authentication, and Elastic Beanstalk is not the global edge content-delivery service. Lambda@Edge is specifically used with CloudFront distributions, which this option omits ([Ways to use Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-edge-ways-to-use.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望限制对其 Web 应用程序内容的访问。该公司需要使用 AWS 上可用的授权技术来保护内容。该公司还希望为授权和身份验证实现一种无服务器架构，并且登录延迟较低。该解决方案必须与 Web 应用程序集成，并在全球范围内提供 Web 内容。该应用程序目前的用户群较小，但公司预计该应用程序的用户群会增加。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证。实施 Lambda@Edge 进行授权。配置 Amazon CloudFront 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。
options.B: 配置 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 进行身份验证。实施 AWS Lambda 进行授权。使用 Application Load Balancer 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Cognito 进行身份验证。实施 AWS Lambda 进行授权。使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。
options.D: 配置 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 进行身份验证。实施 Lambda@Edge 进行授权。使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在全球范围内提供 Web 应用程序。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

- **A 是正确的：** Amazon Cognito 旨在将身份验证和授权与 Web 和移动应用程序集成；AWS 文档将 Cognito 托管登录描述为一个即用型 Web 登录应用程序，其中 Cognito 处理身份验证流程并将结果返回给应用程序（[Amazon Cognito app integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-integrate-apps.html)）。Lambda@Edge 与 CloudFront 集成，可以检查标头或授权令牌，并插入标头以在 CloudFront 将请求转发到源站之前控制访问（[Ways to use Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-edge-ways-to-use.html)）。CloudFront 通过全球边缘站点网络提供静态和动态 Web 内容，并将请求路由到延迟最低的边缘站点（[What is Amazon CloudFront?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。这符合无服务器身份验证/授权、低延迟边缘授权以及全球 Web 内容交付的要求。
- **B 是错误的：** AWS Managed Microsoft AD 是一种托管 Active Directory 服务，适用于目录感知型工作负载、用户/组、SSO、组策略和 EC2 连接；它不是面向不断增长的公共 Web 用户群的最简单无服务器、低延迟 Web 应用身份验证模式（[AWS Managed Microsoft AD](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_microsoft_ad.html)）。此外，Application Load Balancer 围绕某个 Region 中已启用的 Availability Zones 构建，而不是 CloudFront 风格的全球边缘交付（[How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。
- **C 是错误的：** 虽然 Cognito 适合身份验证，但用于授权的标准区域性 AWS Lambda 无法提供 Lambda@Edge 与 CloudFront 结合使用时的边缘授权延迟优势。S3 Transfer Acceleration 用于从世界各地更快地上传/传输到集中式 S3 存储桶，而不是用于在全球范围内提供受保护的 Web 应用程序内容（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。
- **D 是错误的：** 它使用 Managed Microsoft AD 而不是 Cognito 来进行可扩展的 Web 应用身份验证，并且 Elastic Beanstalk 不是全球边缘内容交付服务。Lambda@Edge 专门与 CloudFront 分配结合使用，而此选项省略了 CloudFront（[Ways to use Lambda@Edge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/lambda-edge-ways-to-use.html)）。

en.question: A development team uses multiple AWS accounts for its development, staging, and production environments. Team members have been launching large Amazon EC2 instances that are underutilized. A solutions architect must prevent large instances from being launched in all accounts. How can the solutions architect meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Update the IAM policies to deny the launch of large EC2 instances. Apply the policies to all users.
options.B: Define a resource in AWS Resource Access Manager that prevents the launch of large EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an IAM role in each account that denies the launch of large EC2 instances. Grant the developers IAM group access to the role.
options.D: Create an organization in AWS Organizations in the management account with the default policy. Create a service control policy (SCP) that denies the launch of large EC2 instances, and apply it to the AWS accounts.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

AWS Organizations service control policies (SCPs) are designed for centralized guardrails across accounts. AWS states that an SCP, when attached to an organization, OU, or account, provides **central control over the maximum available permissions for all accounts** in that scope, and SCPs can use a deny-list strategy with the default `FullAWSAccess` policy in place ([SCP examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_examples.html)). SCPs also restrict permissions for IAM users and roles in member accounts; if an action is explicitly denied by an SCP, the user or role cannot perform it even if it has an IAM policy such as `AdministratorAccess` ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). EC2 launch permissions can be controlled by the `ec2:InstanceType` condition key, and AWS shows policies that deny `ec2:RunInstances` for disallowed instance types ([EC2 RunInstances instance type policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ExamplePolicies_EC2.html)). Therefore, creating one SCP that denies launching large instance types and attaching it to the accounts/OUs is the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** IAM policies can restrict `RunInstances` by instance type, but applying and maintaining those policies across all users in multiple accounts is higher operational overhead than one centralized SCP. Also, account administrators could potentially alter IAM permissions, whereas an SCP sets the account-level maximum permissions.
- **B:** AWS Resource Access Manager is for creating resource shares: you add resources to share, select managed permissions, and specify principals ([AWS RAM resource share process](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/getting-started-sharing.html)). It is not a mechanism to prevent EC2 instance launches.
- **C:** Creating IAM roles in every account and granting developers access to those roles is not centralized and adds per-account role management. IAM roles are not the lowest-overhead way to impose an organization-wide guardrail; SCPs are the intended central control for member accounts.

zh.question: 一个开发团队为其开发、预发布和生产环境使用多个 AWS 账户。团队成员一直在启动大型 Amazon EC2 实例，而这些实例利用率不足。解决方案架构师必须防止在所有账户中启动大型实例。解决方案架构师如何以最少的运营开销满足此要求？

options.A: 更新 IAM 策略以拒绝启动大型 EC2 实例。将这些策略应用于所有用户。
options.B: 在 AWS Resource Access Manager 中定义一个资源，以防止启动大型 EC2 实例。
options.C: 在每个账户中创建一个 IAM 角色，用于拒绝启动大型 EC2 实例。授予开发人员 IAM 组对该角色的访问权限。
options.D: 在管理账户中使用默认策略在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个组织。创建一个拒绝启动大型 EC2 实例的服务控制策略 (SCP)，并将其应用于这些 AWS 账户。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

AWS Organizations 服务控制策略 (SCPs) 旨在为跨账户提供集中式护栏。AWS 表示，当 SCP 附加到组织、OU 或账户时，它会为该范围内所有账户提供**对最大可用权限的集中控制**，并且 SCPs 可以在保留默认 `FullAWSAccess` 策略的情况下使用拒绝列表策略（[SCP examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_examples.html)）。SCPs 还会限制成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色的权限；如果某个操作被 SCP 显式拒绝，即使用户或角色具有诸如 `AdministratorAccess` 之类的 IAM 策略，也无法执行该操作（[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。EC2 启动权限可以通过 `ec2:InstanceType` 条件键进行控制，并且 AWS 展示了拒绝对不允许实例类型执行 `ec2:RunInstances` 的策略（[EC2 RunInstances instance type policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ExamplePolicies_EC2.html)）。因此，创建一个拒绝启动大型实例类型的 SCP，并将其附加到账户/OUs，是运营开销最少的做法。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** IAM 策略可以按实例类型限制 `RunInstances`，但在多个账户中为所有用户应用和维护这些策略，比一个集中式 SCP 具有更高的运营开销。此外，账户管理员可能会更改 IAM 权限，而 SCP 会设置账户级别的最大权限。
- **B:** AWS Resource Access Manager 用于创建资源共享：你添加要共享的资源、选择托管权限并指定主体（[AWS RAM resource share process](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/getting-started-sharing.html)）。它不是用于防止 EC2 实例启动的机制。
- **C:** 在每个账户中创建 IAM 角色并授予开发人员对这些角色的访问权限并不是集中式做法，并且会增加按账户进行角色管理的工作。IAM 角色不是施加组织范围护栏的最低开销方式；SCPs 才是用于成员账户的预期集中控制方式。

en.question: A company has migrated a fleet of hundreds of on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to Amazon EC2 instances. The instances run a diverse fleet of Windows Server versions along with several Linux distributions. The company wants a solution that will automate inventory and updates of the operating systems. The company also needs a summary of common vulnerabilities of each instance for regular monthly reviews. What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to manage all the EC2 instances. Configure AWS Security Hub to produce monthly reports.
options.B: Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to manage all the EC2 instances. Deploy Amazon Inspector, and configure monthly reports.
options.C: Set up AWS Shield Advanced, and configure monthly reports. Deploy AWS Config to automate patch installations on the EC2 instances.
options.D: Set up Amazon GuardDuty in the account to monitor all EC2 instances. Deploy AWS Config to automate patch installations on the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Use **AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager** for the operating system update requirement and **Amazon Inspector** for vulnerability summaries. Patch Manager is designed to automate patching of managed nodes with security and other updates, can scan or install missing patches, supports multiple OSs including Windows Server and Linux distributions, and provides patch compliance reporting ([AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)). Amazon Inspector continuously scans eligible EC2 resources, collects software/package inventory through SSM for agent-based scanning, evaluates the inventory, and generates findings for detected vulnerabilities, including CVEs ([Scanning Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2.html)). Inspector also supports findings reports in CSV or JSON for review, including fields such as severity, resource ID, affected packages, remediation, vulnerability ID, and scoring details ([Exporting Amazon Inspector findings reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-managing-exporting-reports.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Patch Manager is appropriate, but **Security Hub** is not the primary service that scans EC2 instances for OS/package vulnerabilities. Security Hub provides security posture visibility and correlates findings from other services such as Amazon Inspector; it does not replace Inspector for vulnerability scanning ([What are Security Hub and Security Hub CSPM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-are-securityhub-services.html)).
- **C:** **AWS Shield Advanced** is for expanded DDoS protection, not OS inventory, patching, or vulnerability summaries ([What is AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)). **AWS Config** can check Systems Manager patch compliance status after patch installation, but it is not the service that automates patch installation ([AWS Config managed rule for SSM patch compliance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-managedinstance-patch-compliance-status-check.html)).
- **D:** **Amazon GuardDuty** detects potential threats and malicious/suspicious activity from logs and data sources; it is not the service for OS patch automation or common vulnerability/CVE reporting for installed packages ([What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)). AWS Config also does not automate patch installation.

Therefore, **Patch Manager + Amazon Inspector** best satisfies automated OS updates, inventory-based vulnerability detection, and regular vulnerability reporting.

zh.question: 一家公司已将数百台本地虚拟机 (VM) 迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。这些实例运行着多种 Windows Server 版本以及若干 Linux 发行版。该公司希望采用一种解决方案来自动执行操作系统的清单管理和更新。该公司还需要在定期每月审查中获得每个实例的常见漏洞摘要。解决方案架构师应推荐什么来满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager 来管理所有 EC2 实例。配置 AWS Security Hub 以生成月度报告。
options.B: 设置 AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager 来管理所有 EC2 实例。部署 Amazon Inspector，并配置月度报告。
options.C: 设置 AWS Shield Advanced，并配置月度报告。部署 AWS Config 以自动在 EC2 实例上安装补丁。
options.D: 在账户中设置 Amazon GuardDuty 以监控所有 EC2 实例。部署 AWS Config 以自动在 EC2 实例上安装补丁。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

使用 **AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager** 满足操作系统更新要求，并使用 **Amazon Inspector** 生成漏洞摘要。Patch Manager 旨在自动为托管节点安装安全和其他更新补丁，可以扫描或安装缺失的补丁，支持包括 Windows Server 和 Linux 发行版在内的多个 OS，并提供补丁合规性报告（[AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)）。Amazon Inspector 会持续扫描符合条件的 EC2 资源，通过 SSM 为基于代理的扫描收集软件/软件包清单，评估该清单，并针对检测到的漏洞（包括 CVE）生成发现项（[Scanning Amazon EC2 instances with Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-ec2.html)）。Inspector 还支持以 CSV 或 JSON 格式导出发现项报告以供审查，其中包括严重性、资源 ID、受影响的软件包、修复措施、漏洞 ID 和评分详细信息等字段（[Exporting Amazon Inspector findings reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-managing-exporting-reports.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** Patch Manager 是合适的，但 **Security Hub** 不是用于扫描 EC2 实例 OS/软件包漏洞的主要服务。Security Hub 提供安全态势可见性，并关联来自其他服务（如 Amazon Inspector）的发现项；它不能取代 Inspector 进行漏洞扫描（[What are Security Hub and Security Hub CSPM?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/what-are-securityhub-services.html)）。
- **C:** **AWS Shield Advanced** 用于增强的 DDoS 防护，而不是 OS 清单管理、打补丁或漏洞摘要（[What is AWS Shield Advanced?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。**AWS Config** 可以在补丁安装后检查 Systems Manager 补丁合规性状态，但它不是自动安装补丁的服务（[AWS Config managed rule for SSM patch compliance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-managedinstance-patch-compliance-status-check.html)）。
- **D:** **Amazon GuardDuty** 从日志和数据源中检测潜在威胁以及恶意/可疑活动；它不是用于 OS 补丁自动化或已安装软件包常见漏洞/CVE 报告的服务（[What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)）。AWS Config 也不会自动安装补丁。因此，**Patch Manager + Amazon Inspector** 最能满足自动化 OS 更新、基于清单的漏洞检测以及定期漏洞报告的要求。

en.question: A company hosts its application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) load balancer. The application connects to an Amazon DynamoDB table. For disaster recovery (DR) purposes, the company wants to ensure that the application is available from another AWS Region with minimal downtime. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST downtime?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group and an ELB in the DR Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances, ELBs, and DynamoDB tables to be launched when necessary. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB.
options.C: Create an AWS CloudFormation template to create EC2 instances and an ELB to be launched when necessary. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Configure DNS failover to point to the new DR Region's ELB.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group and an ELB in the DR Region. Configure the DynamoDB table as a global table. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm with an evaluation period of 10 minutes to invoke an AWS Lambda function that updates Amazon Route 53 to point to the DR Region's ELB.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

For the least downtime, the DR Region must already have the application tier ready to receive traffic, and the data tier must already be replicated. DynamoDB global tables are a fully managed, multi-Region, multi-active feature that automatically replicates table data across Regions and are intended for business continuity and high availability; AWS notes that any replica can serve reads and writes and that applications can shift traffic to another Region with low or zero RPO if processing is interrupted in one Region ([DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). Route 53 active-passive failover is designed for a primary resource group with a secondary resource group on standby; when the primary is unhealthy, Route 53 responds with the healthy secondary resource ([Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)). Therefore, pre-creating the Auto Scaling group and ELB in the DR Region, using DynamoDB global tables, and configuring DNS failover provides the lowest-downtime failover among the options.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Creating EC2 instances, ELBs, and DynamoDB tables only when needed means the compute, load balancing, and data tier are not already available in the DR Region. This increases recovery time compared with having standby resources and already replicated DynamoDB data.
- **C:** Although it uses DynamoDB global tables, it still creates EC2 instances and the ELB only when necessary. That delays application availability compared with a pre-provisioned Auto Scaling group and ELB in the DR Region.
- **D:** It has the needed standby infrastructure and global table, but it adds a CloudWatch alarm with a 10-minute evaluation period and a Lambda-based Route 53 update. Route 53 already supports DNS failover based on resource health, responding with secondary resources when primary resources are unhealthy ([Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)), so the extra 10-minute alarm/Lambda process would not provide the least downtime.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中托管其应用程序。该应用程序在 Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) 负载均衡器后面的 Auto Scaling group 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。该应用程序连接到一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。出于灾难恢复 (DR) 目的，该公司希望确保应用程序能够以最短停机时间从另一个 AWS Region 提供服务。哪种解决方案将以最少的停机时间满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 DR Region 中创建一个 Auto Scaling group 和一个 ELB。将 DynamoDB 表配置为 global table。配置 DNS failover 以指向新的 DR Region 的 ELB。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于在必要时启动 EC2 实例、ELB 和 DynamoDB 表。配置 DNS failover 以指向新的 DR Region 的 ELB。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于在必要时启动 EC2 实例和一个 ELB。将 DynamoDB 表配置为 global table。配置 DNS failover 以指向新的 DR Region 的 ELB。
options.D: 在 DR Region 中创建一个 Auto Scaling group 和一个 ELB。将 DynamoDB 表配置为 global table。创建一个评估周期为 10 分钟的 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，以调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数更新 Amazon Route 53 以指向 DR Region 的 ELB。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

为了实现最短停机时间，DR Region 必须已经具备可接收流量的应用程序层，并且数据层必须已经完成复制。DynamoDB global tables 是一种完全托管的、多 Region、多活功能，可自动跨 Region 复制表数据，并用于业务连续性和高可用性；AWS 指出，任何副本都可以提供读写服务，并且如果某个 Region 中的处理被中断，应用程序可以将流量转移到另一个 Region，并实现低 RPO 或零 RPO（[DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。Route 53 active-passive failover 专为主资源组和处于待命状态的辅助资源组而设计；当主资源不健康时，Route 53 会以健康的辅助资源进行响应（[Route 53 active-passive failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-types.html)）。因此，预先在 DR Region 中创建 Auto Scaling group 和 ELB，使用 DynamoDB global tables，并配置 DNS failover，在这些选项中可提供停机时间最低的故障转移。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 仅在需要时创建 EC2 实例、ELB 和 DynamoDB 表，意味着计算、负载均衡和数据层在 DR Region 中尚未可用。与拥有待命资源和已复制的 DynamoDB 数据相比，这会增加恢复时间。
- **C:** 尽管它使用 DynamoDB global tables，但仍然只在必要时创建 EC2 实例和 ELB。与在 DR Region 中预置 Auto Scaling group 和 ELB 相比，这会延迟应用程序可用性。
- **D:** 它具备所需的待命基础设施和 global table，但增加了一个 10 分钟评估周期的 CloudWatch 警报以及基于 Lambda 的 Route 53 更新。Route 53 已支持基于资源健康状况的 DNS failover，在主资源不健康时使用辅助资源进行响应（[Configuring DNS failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/dns-failover-configuring.html)），因此额外的 10 分钟警报/Lambda 流程无法提供最短停机时间。

en.question: A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances in a private subnet. The application needs to store and retrieve data in Amazon S3 buckets. According to regulatory requirements, the data must not travel across the public internet. What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy a NAT gateway to access the S3 buckets.
options.B: Deploy AWS Storage Gateway to access the S3 buckets.
options.C: Deploy an S3 interface endpoint to access the S3 buckets.
options.D: Deploy an S3 gateway endpoint to access the S3 buckets.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D. Deploy an S3 gateway endpoint**.

Amazon S3 supports both gateway endpoints and interface endpoints. AWS states that an **S3 gateway endpoint** is specified in a VPC route table to access Amazon S3 **from your VPC over the AWS network**, and that for both S3 gateway and interface endpoints, network traffic remains on the AWS network. The same AWS comparison also states that S3 gateway endpoints are **not billed**, while S3 interface endpoints are **billed**. Therefore, for EC2 instances in a private subnet that need private, cost-effective access to S3, the gateway endpoint is the most cost-effective choice ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. NAT gateway** — A public NAT gateway lets instances in private subnets connect to the internet and routes traffic through an internet gateway. That does not best satisfy the “must not travel across the public internet” requirement and is not as cost-effective as a free S3 gateway endpoint ([NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)).
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway** — S3 File Gateway is for accessing S3 through file protocols such as NFS or SMB and is commonly deployed as a gateway appliance/VM. It is unnecessary for EC2 instances that simply need application access to S3 APIs from a VPC ([What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **C. S3 interface endpoint** — This also keeps traffic on the AWS network, but AWS documents that S3 interface endpoints are billed, whereas S3 gateway endpoints are not billed. Since the question asks for the **most cost-effective** solution and access is from within the same VPC, the gateway endpoint is preferred ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在私有子网中的 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。该应用程序需要在 Amazon S3 存储桶中存储和检索数据。根据监管要求，数据不得经过公共互联网传输。解决方案架构师应如何以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 部署 NAT gateway 以访问 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 部署 AWS Storage Gateway 以访问 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 部署 S3 interface endpoint 以访问 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 部署 S3 gateway endpoint 以访问 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D. Deploy an S3 gateway endpoint**。

Amazon S3 同时支持 gateway endpoints 和 interface endpoints。AWS 说明，**S3 gateway endpoint** 是在 VPC 路由表中指定的，用于**通过 AWS 网络从你的 VPC** 访问 Amazon S3；并且对于 S3 gateway 和 interface endpoints，网络流量都会保留在 AWS 网络上。同一份 AWS 对比还说明，S3 gateway endpoints **不计费**，而 S3 interface endpoints **会计费**。因此，对于位于私有子网中、需要以私有且具有成本效益的方式访问 S3 的 EC2 实例，gateway endpoint 是最具成本效益的选择（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. NAT gateway** — 公有 NAT gateway 允许私有子网中的实例连接到互联网，并通过 internet gateway 路由流量。这不能最好地满足“不得经过公共互联网传输”的要求，并且不如免费的 S3 gateway endpoint 具有成本效益（[NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-nat-gateway.html)）。
- **B. AWS Storage Gateway** — S3 File Gateway 用于通过 NFS 或 SMB 等文件协议访问 S3，并且通常作为网关设备/VM 部署。对于只需要从 VPC 访问 S3 APIs 的 EC2 实例应用程序来说，这是不必要的（[What is Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **C. S3 interface endpoint** — 这同样会使流量保留在 AWS 网络上，但 AWS 文档说明 S3 interface endpoints 会计费，而 S3 gateway endpoints 不计费。由于题目要求的是**最具成本效益**的解决方案，并且访问来自同一 VPC 内部，因此首选 gateway endpoint（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts an application on Amazon EC2 instances that run in a single Availability Zone. The application is accessible by using the transport layer of the Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) model. The company needs the application architecture to have high availability. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure new EC2 instances in a different Availability Zone. Use Amazon Route 53 to route traffic to all instances.
options.B: Configure a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.C: Configure a Network Load Balancer for TCP traffic to the instances. Configure an Application Load Balancer for HTTP and HTTPS traffic to the instances.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances. Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to run application health checks on the instances.
options.E: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm. Configure the alarm to restart EC2 instances that transition to a stopped state.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and D**.

- **B is correct** because the application is accessed at the transport layer. AWS documentation states that a **Network Load Balancer routes and load balances at the transport layer (TCP/UDP Layer 4)**, while an Application Load Balancer is for the application layer HTTP/HTTPS traffic. A load balancer also increases application availability and fault tolerance by distributing traffic across compute resources and sending requests only to healthy targets ([Elastic Load Balancing types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html), [Load balancer benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)).
- **D is correct** because an Auto Scaling group spanning multiple Availability Zones provides geographic redundancy. AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and attaching a load balancer; if one Availability Zone becomes unhealthy or unavailable, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected Availability Zone. Auto Scaling can also use Elastic Load Balancing health checks to mark instances unhealthy and replace them ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html), [Health checks overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **A**: Adding instances in another Availability Zone helps, but using Route 53 to route to all instances is not the most appropriate layer-4 load balancing architecture here. Elastic Load Balancing is designed to distribute traffic to healthy targets, and AWS recommends attaching a load balancer when spanning Auto Scaling groups across Availability Zones ([Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)).
- **C**: This adds both an NLB and an ALB. The ALB is unnecessary because the requirement is transport-layer access, and ALBs load balance at HTTP/HTTPS application layer, making this less cost-effective than using only an NLB ([Elastic Load Balancing types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)).
- **E**: A CloudWatch alarm that restarts stopped instances does not provide multi-AZ high availability, traffic distribution, or application-level/ELB health-based replacement. Auto Scaling with ELB health checks is the documented mechanism for replacing unhealthy instances ([Health checks overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在运行于单个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个应用程序。该应用程序可通过 Open Systems Interconnection (OSI) 模型的传输层进行访问。公司需要应用程序架构具备高可用性。以下哪组步骤组合能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在不同的 Availability Zone 中配置新的 EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Route 53 将流量路由到所有实例。
options.B: 在 EC2 实例前配置 Network Load Balancer。
options.C: 为到实例的 TCP 流量配置 Network Load Balancer。为到实例的 HTTP 和 HTTPS 流量配置 Application Load Balancer。
options.D: 为 EC2 实例创建 Auto Scaling group。配置 Auto Scaling group 使用多个 Availability Zones。配置 Auto Scaling group 对实例运行应用程序运行状况检查。
options.E: 创建 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。配置该警报以重启转换为 stopped 状态的 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 D**。

- **B 正确**，因为该应用程序在传输层被访问。AWS 文档指出，**Network Load Balancer 在传输层（TCP/UDP Layer 4）进行路由和负载均衡**，而 Application Load Balancer 用于应用层 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。负载均衡器还通过在计算资源之间分发流量并仅向运行状况良好的目标发送请求，来提高应用程序可用性和容错能力（[Elastic Load Balancing types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)、[Load balancer benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。
- **D 正确**，因为跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling group 提供地理冗余。AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling group 跨多个 Availability Zones 扩展并附加负载均衡器；如果一个 Availability Zone 变为不正常或不可用，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 Availability Zone 中启动实例。Auto Scaling 还可以使用 Elastic Load Balancing 运行状况检查将实例标记为不正常并替换它们（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)、[Health checks overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)）。错误选项：

- **A**：在另一个 Availability Zone 中添加实例有所帮助，但在此处使用 Route 53 将流量路由到所有实例并不是最合适的第 4 层负载均衡架构。Elastic Load Balancing 旨在将流量分发到运行状况良好的目标，并且 AWS 建议在跨 Availability Zones 扩展 Auto Scaling groups 时附加负载均衡器（[Add an Availability Zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。
- **C**：这同时添加了 NLB 和 ALB。ALB 是不必要的，因为要求是传输层访问，而 ALB 在 HTTP/HTTPS 应用层进行负载均衡，因此与仅使用 NLB 相比，这种做法成本效益更低（[Elastic Load Balancing types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。
- **E**：重启 stopped 实例的 CloudWatch 警报不提供多 AZ 高可用性、流量分发，也不提供基于应用程序级别/ELB 运行状况的替换。带有 ELB 运行状况检查的 Auto Scaling 才是文档中用于替换不正常实例的机制（[Health checks overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)）。

en.question: A company uses Amazon S3 to host its static website. The company wants to add a contact form to the webpage. The contact form will have dynamic server-side components for users to input their name, email address, phone number, and user message. The company expects fewer than 100 site visits each month. The contact form must notify the company by email when a customer fills out the form. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Host the dynamic contact form in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to connect to a third-party email provider.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that returns the contact form from an AWS Lambda function. Configure another Lambda function on the API Gateway to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.C: Host the website by using AWS Amplify Hosting for static content and dynamic content. Use server-side scripting to build the contact form. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to deliver the message to the company.
options.D: Migrate the website from Amazon S3 to Amazon EC2 instances that run Windows Server. Use Internet Information Services (IIS) for Windows Server to host the webpage. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** For a site with fewer than 100 visits per month, a serverless, pay-per-use design is the most cost-effective. AWS Lambda runs code without managing servers, scales automatically, and uses pay-per-use pricing; it is also appropriate for web applications and API request processing ([AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). API Gateway can integrate with Lambda so the Lambda function receives request data such as headers, query parameters, and body content, which fits a dynamic contact form submission ([API Gateway Lambda integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-lambda-integration.html)).
