Amazon SNS topics deliver published messages to subscribers, including **Email** endpoints, and SNS email subscriptions are explicitly supported ([Amazon SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html), [SNS email subscription setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Amazon ECS would require container hosting/orchestration and is unnecessarily complex and less cost-effective for a very low-traffic contact form. SES can send email, but the option’s ECS-based dynamic hosting is overkill.
- **C:** SQS is a queue for application-to-application processing, not a direct email notification mechanism. SNS, not SQS, is the service documented for delivering messages directly to email subscribers ([Amazon SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **D:** Migrating to EC2 Windows Server/IIS introduces continuously running server costs and management, which is not cost-effective for low traffic. Also, client-side scripting alone does not provide the required dynamic server-side processing.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 托管其静态网站。该公司希望在网页中添加一个联系表单。该联系表单将具有动态服务器端组件，供用户输入姓名、电子邮件地址、电话号码和用户留言。该公司预计每月网站访问量少于 100 次。当客户填写表单时，联系表单必须通过电子邮件通知公司。哪种解决方案将以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中托管动态联系表单。设置 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 以连接到第三方电子邮件提供商。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点，该端点从 AWS Lambda 函数返回联系表单。在 API Gateway 上配置另一个 Lambda 函数，以将消息发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。
options.C: 使用 AWS Amplify Hosting 托管网站的静态内容和动态内容。使用服务器端脚本构建联系表单。配置 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 将消息传递给公司。
options.D: 将网站从 Amazon S3 迁移到运行 Windows Server 的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用适用于 Windows Server 的 Internet Information Services (IIS) 托管网页。使用客户端脚本构建联系表单。将该表单与 Amazon WorkMail 集成。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 对于每月访问量少于 100 次的网站，无服务器、按使用量付费的设计最具成本效益。AWS Lambda 可在无需管理服务器的情况下运行代码，自动扩展，并采用按使用量付费的定价；它也适用于 Web 应用程序和 API 请求处理（[AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。API Gateway 可以与 Lambda 集成，使 Lambda 函数接收请求数据，例如标头、查询参数和正文内容，这符合动态联系表单提交的需求（[API Gateway Lambda integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/getting-started-with-lambda-integration.html)）。Amazon SNS 主题将已发布的消息传递给订阅者，包括 **Email** 端点，并且 SNS 明确支持电子邮件订阅（[Amazon SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)，[SNS email subscription setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-email-notifications.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Amazon ECS 需要容器托管/编排，对于流量非常低的联系表单来说不必要地复杂，且成本效益较低。SES 可以发送电子邮件，但该选项基于 ECS 的动态托管过于繁重。
- **C:** SQS 是用于应用程序到应用程序处理的队列，并不是直接的电子邮件通知机制。文档中用于将消息直接传递给电子邮件订阅者的服务是 SNS，而不是 SQS（[Amazon SNS how it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **D:** 迁移到 EC2 Windows Server/IIS 会引入持续运行的服务器成本和管理开销，对于低流量场景不具成本效益。此外，仅使用客户端脚本无法提供所需的动态服务器端处理。

en.question: A company creates dedicated AWS accounts in AWS Organizations for its business units. Recently, an important notification was sent to the root user email address of a business unit account instead of the assigned account owner. The company wants to ensure that all future notifications can be sent to different employees based on the notification categories of billing, operations, or security. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Configure each AWS account to use a single email address that the company manages. Ensure that all account owners can access the email account to receive notifications. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit.
options.B: Configure each AWS account to use a different email distribution list for each business unit that the company manages. Configure each distribution list with administrator email addresses that can respond to alerts. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit.
options.C: Configure each AWS account root user email address to be the individual company managed email address of one person from each business unit. Configure alternate contacts for each AWS account with corresponding distribution lists for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team for each business unit.
options.D: Configure each AWS account root user to use email aliases that go to a centralized mailbox. Configure alternate contacts for each account by using a single business managed email distribution list each for the billing team, the security team, and the operations team.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

AWS Account Management supports **alternate contacts** specifically for **Billing**, **Operations**, and **Security**. AWS states that an alternate contact does not have to be an individual person and can be an **email distribution list** for teams that manage billing, operations, and security issues; these contacts are in addition to the root user email, and the primary/root account contact still receives root-account email communications ([AWS Account Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-update-contact-alternate.html)). AWS Security Incident Response also recommends using email distribution lists for these contact categories because distribution lists remove dependency on one person and help ensure the right stakeholders receive notifications ([AWS Security Incident Response User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security-ir/latest/userguide/update-account-contact-info.html)).

Option **D** is most secure because it keeps root-user email access centralized through aliases to a controlled mailbox while using business-managed distribution lists for category-specific notifications. This matters because AWS notes that a person with access to a member account’s root-user email inbox can reset the root user password during recovery, so root email inbox access should be tightly controlled ([IAM User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A**: Giving all account owners access to a single shared root email mailbox increases the number of people who can access root-account email, which is less secure, especially because root email access can be used in account recovery.
* **B**: A distribution list per business unit for the root user email still exposes root-account email to multiple administrators. The alternate contacts are appropriate, but root email access is less tightly controlled than in D.
* **C**: Using an individual employee’s email address for the root user is not a best practice. AWS recommends company contact information rather than an individual for business accounts, and distribution lists avoid dependency on one person ([AWS Account Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-update-contact-alternate.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中为其业务部门创建专用 AWS 账户。最近，一条重要通知被发送到了某个业务部门账户的根用户电子邮件地址，而不是指定的账户所有者。公司希望确保未来所有通知都能根据账单、运营或安全等通知类别发送给不同员工。哪种解决方案能够以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将每个 AWS 账户配置为使用公司管理的单一电子邮件地址。确保所有账户所有者都可以访问该电子邮件账户以接收通知。为每个 AWS 账户配置备用联系人，并为每个业务部门的账单团队、安全团队和运营团队配置对应的分发列表。
options.B: 将每个 AWS 账户配置为使用公司管理的、每个业务部门不同的电子邮件分发列表。为每个分发列表配置可响应警报的管理员电子邮件地址。为每个 AWS 账户配置备用联系人，并为每个业务部门的账单团队、安全团队和运营团队配置对应的分发列表。
options.C: 将每个 AWS 账户根用户电子邮件地址配置为每个业务部门中某个人的、由公司管理的个人电子邮件地址。为每个 AWS 账户配置备用联系人，并为每个业务部门的账单团队、安全团队和运营团队配置对应的分发列表。
options.D: 将每个 AWS 账户根用户配置为使用转到集中式邮箱的电子邮件别名。通过为账单团队、安全团队和运营团队分别使用单个业务管理的电子邮件分发列表，为每个账户配置备用联系人。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

AWS Account Management 支持专门用于 **Billing**、**Operations** 和 **Security** 的 **alternate contacts**。AWS 说明，alternate contact 不必是个人，可以是负责管理账单、运营和安全问题的团队的 **email distribution list**；这些联系人是 root user email 之外的联系人，并且 primary/root 账户联系人仍会接收 root-account 电子邮件通信（[AWS Account Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-update-contact-alternate.html)）。AWS Security Incident Response 也建议为这些联系人类别使用 email distribution lists，因为 distribution lists 可消除对单个人的依赖，并帮助确保正确的利益相关方收到通知（[AWS Security Incident Response User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security-ir/latest/userguide/update-account-contact-info.html)）。选项 **D** 最安全，因为它通过指向受控邮箱的别名集中管理 root-user email 访问，同时使用业务管理的 distribution lists 发送按类别划分的通知。这一点很重要，因为 AWS 指出，能够访问成员账户 root-user email 收件箱的人可以在恢复过程中重置 root user 密码，因此应严格控制 root email 收件箱访问权限（[IAM User Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_root-user.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **A**：让所有账户所有者都能访问单个共享 root email 邮箱，会增加可访问 root-account 电子邮件的人数，这样安全性较低，尤其是因为 root email 访问权限可用于账户恢复。
* **B**：为 root user email 按业务部门使用分发列表，仍会将 root-account 电子邮件暴露给多个管理员。alternate contacts 是合适的，但与 D 相比，root email 访问控制不够严格。
* **C**：将个人员工的电子邮件地址用于 root user 并不是最佳实践。AWS 建议业务账户使用公司联系信息而不是个人联系信息，并且 distribution lists 可避免对单个人的依赖（[AWS Account Management](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/accounts/latest/reference/manage-acct-update-contact-alternate.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an ecommerce application on AWS. Amazon EC2 instances process purchases and store the purchase details in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. Customers are experiencing application timeouts during times of peak usage. A solutions architect needs to rearchitect the application so that the application can scale to meet peak usage demands. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances to retry the purchases until the processing is complete. Update the applications to connect to the DB cluster by using Amazon RDS Proxy.
options.B: Configure the application to use an Amazon ElastiCache cluster in front of the Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster.
options.C: Update the application to send the purchase requests to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an Auto Scaling group of new EC2 instances that read from the SQS queue.
options.D: Configure an AWS Lambda function to retry the ticket purchases until the processing is complete.
options.E: Configure an Amazon AP! Gateway REST API with a usage plan.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and C**.

- **A is correct** because the current synchronous EC2-to-Aurora design can hit database connection pressure during peak traffic. AWS states that RDS Proxy provides connection pooling and multiplexing, translating many client connections into fewer backend DB connections, which reduces connection overhead and database contention for PostgreSQL; it can also handle connection surges more gracefully instead of returning immediate client-facing errors when the DB connection limit is reached ([RDS Proxy application scalability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)). An Auto Scaling group adds compute capacity for peak purchase processing.
- **C is correct** because SQS decouples live user requests from backend processing and supports very high request rates. AWS lists standard queues as suitable for decoupling live user requests from background work, allocating tasks to multiple worker nodes, and batching entries to be added to a database later ([SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)). AWS also documents using an Auto Scaling group to process messages from an SQS queue and scaling based on backlog per instance to match demand and acceptable latency ([EC2 Auto Scaling with SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)).

Why the other options are not best:

- **B is incorrect** because ElastiCache query caching is most effective for read-heavy, repeated, infrequently changing queries and is not recommended where strong consistency or read-after-write consistency is required ([ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)). Purchase processing is primarily a write/transaction workflow, so caching in front of Aurora would not reliably solve peak purchase timeouts.
- **D is incorrect** because simply adding a Lambda function to retry purchases does not decouple incoming requests with a durable queue, does not provide worker fleet scaling based on backlog, and does not address Aurora connection pressure as directly as SQS plus RDS Proxy.
- **E is incorrect** because an API Gateway usage plan would throttle/limit client usage rather than increase backend processing capacity or database connection scalability, so it does not meet the requirement to scale for peak demand most cost-effectively.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行一个电子商务应用程序。Amazon EC2 实例处理购买请求，并将购买详细信息存储在一个 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群中。客户在使用高峰期间遇到应用程序超时。解决方案架构师需要重新设计该应用程序，使其能够扩展以满足高峰使用需求。哪组操作组合能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 配置一个由新 EC2 实例组成的 Auto Scaling 组，以重试购买请求，直到处理完成。更新应用程序，使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 连接到 DB 集群。
options.B: 配置应用程序在 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群前使用 Amazon ElastiCache 集群。
options.C: 更新应用程序，将购买请求发送到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置一个由新 EC2 实例组成的 Auto Scaling 组，从 SQS 队列读取消息。
options.D: 配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数来重试票务购买，直到处理完成。
options.E: 配置一个带有使用计划的 Amazon AP! Gateway REST API。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 C**。

- **A 正确**，因为当前同步的 EC2 到 Aurora 设计在高峰流量期间可能会遇到数据库连接压力。AWS 表示，RDS Proxy 提供连接池和多路复用，将许多客户端连接转换为更少的后端 DB 连接，从而减少 PostgreSQL 的连接开销和数据库争用；它还可以更优雅地处理连接激增，而不是在达到 DB 连接限制时立即返回面向客户端的错误（[RDS Proxy application scalability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy-best-practices.usage-scenarios.html)）。Auto Scaling 组为高峰购买处理增加计算容量。
- **C 正确**，因为 SQS 将实时用户请求与后端处理解耦，并支持非常高的请求速率。AWS 将 standard queues 列为适合将实时用户请求与后台工作解耦、将任务分配给多个 worker 节点，以及对条目进行批处理以便稍后添加到数据库的场景（[SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。AWS 还记录了使用 Auto Scaling 组处理来自 SQS 队列的消息，并根据每个实例的积压量进行扩展，以匹配需求和可接受延迟（[EC2 Auto Scaling with SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **B 不正确**，因为 ElastiCache 查询缓存对于读取密集、重复且不频繁变化的查询最有效，并且不建议用于需要强一致性或写后读一致性的场景（[ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)）。购买处理主要是写入/事务工作流，因此在 Aurora 前面使用缓存无法可靠地解决高峰购买超时问题。
- **D 不正确**，因为仅添加一个 Lambda 函数来重试购买，并不能通过持久队列解耦传入请求，不能提供基于积压量的 worker fleet 扩展，也不能像 SQS 加 RDS Proxy 那样直接解决 Aurora 连接压力。
- **E 不正确**，因为 API Gateway 使用计划会限制/限流客户端使用，而不是提高后端处理容量或数据库连接可扩展性，因此它不能以最具成本效益的方式满足针对高峰需求进行扩展的要求。

en.question: A company that uses AWS Organizations runs 150 applications across 30 different AWS accounts. The company used AWS Cost and Usage Report to create a new report in the management account. The report is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket that is replicated to a bucket in the data collection account. The company’s senior leadership wants to view a custom dashboard that provides NAT gateway costs each day starting at the beginning of the current month. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.B: Share an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure QuickSight to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.
options.C: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use AWS DataSync to query the new report.
options.D: Share an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that includes the requested table visual. Configure CloudWatch to use Amazon Athena to query the new report.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The report is delivered as AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) data in Amazon S3, and AWS explicitly documents that CUR can be queried with **Amazon Athena**; Athena is a serverless query service for analyzing CUR data in S3 with standard SQL, which fits filtering NAT gateway costs by day from the start of the current month ([Querying Cost and Usage Reports using Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-query-athena.html)). For executive reporting, **Amazon QuickSight** is the appropriate dashboard/BI layer: AWS cost and usage dashboarding is powered by QuickSight ([Understanding the Cost and Usage Dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-dashboard-info.html)), and QuickSight supports dashboard permissions for sharing dashboards ([Dashboard permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/developerguide/dashboard-permissions.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A**: QuickSight is appropriate, but **AWS DataSync is not a query engine**. AWS defines DataSync as a high-speed file/object data transfer service, not a service for querying CUR data in S3 ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **C**: This combines two mismatches. CloudWatch dashboards are for operational visibility over metrics and logs, not BI-style cost reporting from CUR data in S3; DataSync also does not query data ([What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html), [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **D**: Athena is the right query service, but **CloudWatch dashboards** are designed to visualize metrics and logs for operational monitoring, not to serve a custom leadership cost dashboard from CUR data ([What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)).

zh.question: 一家使用 AWS Organizations 的公司在 30 个不同的 AWS 账户中运行 150 个应用程序。该公司使用 AWS Cost and Usage Report 在管理账户中创建了一份新报告。该报告会交付到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，并复制到数据收集账户中的一个存储桶。公司的高级领导层希望查看一个自定义仪表板，该仪表板提供从当前月初开始每天的 NAT gateway 成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 共享一个包含所请求表格可视化的 Amazon QuickSight 仪表板。配置 QuickSight 使用 AWS DataSync 查询新报告。
options.B: 共享一个包含所请求表格可视化的 Amazon QuickSight 仪表板。配置 QuickSight 使用 Amazon Athena 查询新报告。
options.C: 共享一个包含所请求表格可视化的 Amazon CloudWatch 仪表板。配置 CloudWatch 使用 AWS DataSync 查询新报告。
options.D: 共享一个包含所请求表格可视化的 Amazon CloudWatch 仪表板。配置 CloudWatch 使用 Amazon Athena 查询新报告。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 该报告作为 AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) 数据交付到 Amazon S3 中，并且 AWS 明确说明 CUR 可以使用 **Amazon Athena** 进行查询；Athena 是一种无服务器查询服务，可使用标准 SQL 分析 S3 中的 CUR 数据，这适合按天筛选从当前月初开始的 NAT gateway 成本（[Querying Cost and Usage Reports using Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-query-athena.html)）。对于高管报告，**Amazon QuickSight** 是合适的仪表板/BI 层：AWS 成本和用量仪表板由 QuickSight 提供支持（[Understanding the Cost and Usage Dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/dataexports-dashboard-info.html)），并且 QuickSight 支持用于共享仪表板的仪表板权限（[Dashboard permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/developerguide/dashboard-permissions.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A**：QuickSight 是合适的，但 **AWS DataSync 不是查询引擎**。AWS 将 DataSync 定义为高速文件/对象数据传输服务，而不是用于查询 S3 中 CUR 数据的服务（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **C**：这结合了两个不匹配之处。CloudWatch dashboards 用于对指标和日志进行运营可见性展示，而不是从 S3 中的 CUR 数据进行 BI 风格的成本报告；DataSync 也不查询数据（[What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html), [What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **D**：Athena 是正确的查询服务，但 **CloudWatch dashboards** 旨在可视化用于运营监控的指标和日志，而不是从 CUR 数据提供自定义领导层成本仪表板（[What is Amazon CloudWatch?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)）。

en.question: A company is hosting a high-traffic static website on Amazon S3 with an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has a default TTL of 0 seconds. The company wants to implement caching to improve performance for the website. However, the company also wants to ensure that stale content is not served for more than a few minutes after a deployment. Which combination of caching methods should a solutions architect implement to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Set the CloudFront default TTL to 2 minutes.
options.B: Set a default TTL of 2 minutes on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Add a Cache-Control private directive to the objects in Amazon S3.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda@Edge function to add an Expires header to HTTP responses. Configure the function to run on viewer response.
options.E: Add a Cache-Control max-age directive of 24 hours to the objects in Amazon S3. On deployment, create a CloudFront invalidation to clear any changed files from edge caches.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and E**.

- **A is correct** because CloudFront can cache objects based on TTL settings in a cache behavior. AWS states that you can control how long CloudFront keeps an object by setting minimum, maximum, and default TTL values, and that when the origin does not send `Cache-Control: max-age`, CloudFront caches the object for the CloudFront **Default TTL**. Setting the default TTL to 2 minutes ensures objects without origin cache headers are not served stale for longer than a few minutes. [AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)
- **E is correct** because `Cache-Control: max-age` on S3 objects tells CloudFront how long to keep an object in cache, and AWS shows S3 object metadata can include `Cache-Control: max-age=86400`. For changed files, AWS says that if you need to remove a file from CloudFront edge caches before it expires, you can invalidate the file; the next viewer request causes CloudFront to fetch the latest version from the origin. This provides strong caching for performance while deployments can clear changed files quickly. [AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html), [AWS CloudFront invalidation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Invalidation.html)

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect** because TTL is a CloudFront cache behavior setting, not a default TTL setting on an S3 bucket. S3 objects can have `Cache-Control` or `Expires` metadata, but the documentation describes adding those headers to objects, not configuring a bucket default TTL. [AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)
- **C is incorrect** because `Cache-Control: private` is not appropriate for improving shared edge caching. AWS documents that when an origin adds `no-cache`, `no-store`, and/or `private`, CloudFront and browsers respect those headers when the minimum TTL is 0, which works against the goal of effective CloudFront caching. [AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)
- **D is incorrect** because using Lambda@Edge on viewer response to add an `Expires` header is unnecessary and not the recommended method. AWS recommends `Cache-Control: max-age` instead of `Expires` to control object caching, and CloudFront already supports TTL settings and origin cache headers directly. [AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon S3 上托管一个高流量静态网站，并使用默认 TTL 为 0 秒的 Amazon CloudFront 分配。该公司希望实现缓存以提升网站性能。但是，该公司还希望确保部署后过期内容不会被提供超过几分钟。解决方案架构师应实施哪种缓存方法组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 CloudFront 默认 TTL 设置为 2 分钟。
options.B: 在 S3 存储桶上设置 2 分钟的默认 TTL。
options.C: 向 Amazon S3 中的对象添加 Cache-Control private 指令。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda@Edge 函数，向 HTTP 响应添加 Expires 标头。将该函数配置为在 viewer response 上运行。
options.E: 向 Amazon S3 中的对象添加 24 小时的 Cache-Control max-age 指令。在部署时，创建 CloudFront invalidation 以从边缘缓存中清除任何已更改的文件。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 E**。

- **A 正确**，因为 CloudFront 可以根据缓存行为中的 TTL 设置来缓存对象。AWS 说明，你可以通过设置 minimum、maximum 和 default TTL 值来控制 CloudFront 保留对象的时长，并且当源站未发送 `Cache-Control: max-age` 时，CloudFront 会按照 CloudFront **Default TTL** 缓存对象。将默认 TTL 设置为 2 分钟，可确保没有源站缓存标头的对象不会作为过期内容被提供超过几分钟。[AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)
- **E 正确**，因为 S3 对象上的 `Cache-Control: max-age` 会告诉 CloudFront 将对象保留在缓存中的时长，并且 AWS 展示了 S3 对象元数据可以包含 `Cache-Control: max-age=86400`。对于已更改的文件，AWS 表示如果你需要在文件过期之前将其从 CloudFront 边缘缓存中移除，可以 invalidate 该文件；下一次查看器请求会使 CloudFront 从源站获取最新版本。这为性能提供了强缓存，同时部署可以快速清除已更改的文件。[AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html), [AWS CloudFront invalidation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Invalidation.html)

其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确**，因为 TTL 是 CloudFront 缓存行为设置，而不是 S3 存储桶上的默认 TTL 设置。S3 对象可以具有 `Cache-Control` 或 `Expires` 元数据，但文档描述的是将这些标头添加到对象，而不是配置存储桶默认 TTL。[AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)
- **C 不正确**，因为 `Cache-Control: private` 不适合提升共享边缘缓存效果。AWS 文档说明，当源站添加 `no-cache`、`no-store` 和/或 `private` 时，如果 minimum TTL 为 0，CloudFront 和浏览器会遵循这些标头，这与实现有效 CloudFront 缓存的目标相悖。[AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)
- **D 不正确**，因为在 viewer response 上使用 Lambda@Edge 添加 `Expires` 标头是不必要的，也不是推荐方法。AWS 建议使用 `Cache-Control: max-age` 而不是 `Expires` 来控制对象缓存，并且 CloudFront 已经直接支持 TTL 设置和源站缓存标头。[AWS CloudFront expiration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Expiration.html)

en.question: A company runs its application by using Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Lambda functions. The EC2 instances run in private subnets of a VPC. The Lambda functions need direct network access to the EC2 instances for the application to work. The application will run for 1 year. The number of Lambda functions that the application uses will increase during the 1-year period. The company must minimize costs on all application resources. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances.
options.B: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to new public subnets in the same VPC where the EC2 instances run.
options.C: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Connect the Lambda functions to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances.
options.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan. Keep the Lambda functions in the Lambda service VPC.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

A **Compute Savings Plan** is the best cost-optimization choice because it applies to both EC2 instance usage and **Lambda** usage; AWS states that Compute Savings Plans automatically apply to EC2 usage and “also apply to your Fargate and Lambda usage” for a 1- or 3-year commitment model ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)). Because the application runs for 1 year and Lambda usage will increase, this plan type can discount both compute components.

For networking, the Lambda functions need direct access to EC2 instances in private subnets. AWS Lambda documentation says that to access private resources, you should connect the function to **private subnets**, and that when a function is attached to a VPC it can access resources available within that VPC ([Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)). Therefore, connecting Lambda to the private subnets that contain the EC2 instances meets the direct network access requirement.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** An **EC2 Instance Savings Plan** is limited to a specific EC2 instance family in a chosen Region; the AWS documentation does not include Lambda in its coverage. Since Lambda usage will increase, this does not minimize costs across all application resources as well as a Compute Savings Plan ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
- **B:** Same Savings Plan issue as A. Also, placing Lambda in public subnets is not the right approach for accessing private resources; AWS specifically says to connect Lambda functions to **private subnets** to access private resources, and connecting a function to a public subnet does not give it a public IP address ([Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).
- **D:** A Compute Savings Plan is appropriate, but keeping Lambda in the Lambda service VPC does not satisfy the requirement for direct network access to EC2 instances in the company VPC. Lambda must be attached to the VPC/private subnets to access those private resources ([Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 实例和 AWS Lambda 函数运行其应用程序。EC2 实例在 VPC 的私有子网中运行。Lambda 函数需要对 EC2 实例进行直接网络访问，应用程序才能正常工作。该应用程序将运行 1 年。在这 1 年期间，应用程序使用的 Lambda 函数数量将会增加。公司必须最大限度降低所有应用程序资源的成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。将 Lambda 函数连接到包含 EC2 实例的私有子网。
options.B: 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。将 Lambda 函数连接到 EC2 实例运行所在同一 VPC 中的新公有子网。
options.C: 购买 Compute Savings Plan。将 Lambda 函数连接到包含 EC2 实例的私有子网。
options.D: 购买 Compute Savings Plan。将 Lambda 函数保留在 Lambda service VPC 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

**Compute Savings Plan** 是最佳的成本优化选择，因为它同时适用于 EC2 实例使用量和 **Lambda** 使用量；AWS 表示，对于 1 年或 3 年承诺模式，Compute Savings Plans 会自动应用于 EC2 使用量，并且“also apply to your Fargate and Lambda usage”（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。由于应用程序运行 1 年，并且 Lambda 使用量会增加，此计划类型可以为两个计算组件提供折扣。在网络方面，Lambda 函数需要直接访问私有子网中的 EC2 实例。AWS Lambda 文档说明，要访问私有资源，应将函数连接到**私有子网**，并且当函数附加到 VPC 时，它可以访问该 VPC 中可用的资源（[Giving Lambda functions access to resources in an Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。因此，将 Lambda 连接到包含 EC2 实例的私有子网可满足直接网络访问要求。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** **EC2 Instance Savings Plan** 仅限于所选 Region 中的特定 EC2 实例系列；AWS 文档并未将 Lambda 纳入其覆盖范围。由于 Lambda 使用量会增加，因此与 Compute Savings Plan 相比，这无法在所有应用程序资源上最大限度降低成本（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
- **B:** 与 A 存在相同的 Savings Plan 问题。此外，将 Lambda 放在公有子网中并不是访问私有资源的正确方法；AWS 明确表示，应将 Lambda 函数连接到**私有子网**以访问私有资源，并且将函数连接到公有子网不会为其提供公有 IP 地址（[Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。
- **D:** Compute Savings Plan 是合适的，但将 Lambda 保留在 Lambda service VPC 中无法满足对公司 VPC 中 EC2 实例进行直接网络访问的要求。Lambda 必须附加到 VPC/私有子网，才能访问这些私有资源（[Lambda VPC configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)）。

en.question: A company has deployed a multi-account strategy on AWS by using AWS Control Tower. The company has provided individual AWS accounts to each of its developers. The company wants to implement controls to limit AWS resource costs that the developers incur. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Instruct each developer to tag all their resources with a tag that has a key of CostCenter and a value of the developer's name. Use the required-tags AWS Config managed rule to check for the tag. Create an AWS Lambda function to terminate resources that do not have the tag. Configure AWS Cost Explorer to send a daily report to each developer to monitor their spending.
options.B: Use AWS Budgets to establish budgets for each developer account. Set up budget alerts for actual and forecast values to notify developers when they exceed or expect to exceed their assigned budget. Use AWS Budgets actions to apply a DenyAll policy to the developer's IAM role to prevent additional resources from being launched when the assigned budget is reached.
options.C: Use AWS Cost Explorer to monitor and report on costs for each developer account. Configure Cost Explorer to send a daily report to each developer to monitor their spending. Use AWS Cost Anomaly Detection to detect anomalous spending and provide alerts.
options.D: Use AWS Service Catalog to allow developers to launch resources within a limited cost range. Create AWS Lambda functions in each AWS account to stop running resources at the end of each work day. Configure the Lambda functions to resume the resources at the start of each work day.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Budgets is designed for this use case: it can track AWS costs and usage, send notifications for both **actual** spend and **forecasted** spend, and take automated actions. AWS documentation states that a monthly cost budget can alert on actual and forecasted spend, and that you can apply an action such as automatically applying a custom IAM policy that denies the ability to provision additional resources within an account ([Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)). AWS also documents that budget actions can run automatically when a cost or usage threshold is exceeded, including applying an IAM policy or SCP; from the management account, an SCP can be applied to another account ([Configuring budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-controls.html)). This meets the requirement with the least operational overhead because it uses native budget alerts and native automated controls per developer account.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** This requires every developer to tag all resources correctly, AWS Config to check compliance, and custom Lambda automation to terminate untagged resources. It is more operationally complex and does not directly establish or enforce per-account budget limits.
- **C:** Cost Explorer and Cost Anomaly Detection provide monitoring and alerts, but they do not by themselves prevent developers from launching more resources when a budget is reached. AWS Budgets specifically supports budget thresholds, notifications, and automated policy actions, which Cost Explorer reporting alone does not provide.
- **D:** AWS Service Catalog can standardize approved products, and scheduled Lambda functions could stop/start resources, but this requires building and maintaining portfolios plus per-account automation. It also does not directly enforce per-developer account spending limits as simply as AWS Budgets actions.

zh.question: 一家公司已通过使用 AWS Control Tower 在 AWS 上部署了多账户策略。该公司已为每位开发人员提供了单独的 AWS 账户。公司希望实施控制措施，以限制开发人员产生的 AWS 资源成本。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 指示每位开发人员使用标签标记其所有资源，该标签的键为 CostCenter，值为开发人员的姓名。使用 required-tags AWS Config 托管规则检查该标签。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来终止没有该标签的资源。配置 AWS Cost Explorer 向每位开发人员发送每日报告，以监控其支出。
options.B: 使用 AWS Budgets 为每个开发人员账户建立预算。为实际值和预测值设置预算警报，以便在开发人员超过或预计会超过其分配的预算时通知他们。使用 AWS Budgets actions 将 DenyAll policy 应用于开发人员的 IAM role，以在达到分配的预算时防止启动更多资源。
options.C: 使用 AWS Cost Explorer 监控并报告每个开发人员账户的成本。配置 Cost Explorer 向每位开发人员发送每日报告，以监控其支出。使用 AWS Cost Anomaly Detection 检测异常支出并提供警报。
options.D: 使用 AWS Service Catalog 允许开发人员在有限的成本范围内启动资源。在每个 AWS 账户中创建 AWS Lambda 函数，以在每个工作日结束时停止正在运行的资源。配置 Lambda 函数在每个工作日开始时恢复这些资源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

AWS Budgets 正是为这种使用场景而设计的：它可以跟踪 AWS 成本和使用量，为**实际**支出和**预测**支出发送通知，并执行自动化操作。AWS 文档说明，月度成本预算可以针对实际和预测支出发出警报，并且你可以应用某个操作，例如自动应用自定义 IAM policy，以拒绝在账户内预置更多资源的能力（[Managing your costs with AWS Budgets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-managing-costs.html)）。AWS 还说明，当超过成本或使用量阈值时，预算操作可以自动运行，包括应用 IAM policy 或 SCP；从管理账户中，可以将 SCP 应用于另一个账户（[Configuring budget actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/budgets-controls.html)）。这以最少的运营开销满足了要求，因为它对每个开发人员账户使用原生预算警报和原生自动化控制。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 这要求每位开发人员正确标记所有资源，要求 AWS Config 检查合规性，并要求自定义 Lambda 自动化来终止未标记的资源。它在运营上更复杂，并且不会直接建立或强制执行按账户的预算限制。
- **C:** Cost Explorer 和 Cost Anomaly Detection 提供监控和警报，但它们本身不会在达到预算时阻止开发人员启动更多资源。AWS Budgets 专门支持预算阈值、通知和自动化策略操作，而仅靠 Cost Explorer 报告无法提供这些功能。
- **D:** AWS Service Catalog 可以标准化已批准的产品，计划的 Lambda 函数可以停止/启动资源，但这需要构建和维护产品组合以及按账户的自动化。它也不像 AWS Budgets actions 那样简单地直接强制执行按开发人员账户的支出限制。

en.question: A solutions architect is designing a three-tier web application. The architecture consists of an internet- facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) and a web tier that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The application tier with the business logic runs on EC2 instances in private subnets. The database tier consists of Microsoft SQL Server that runs on EC2 instances in private subnets. Security is a high priority for the company. Which combination of security group configurations should the solutions architect use? (Choose three.)

options.A: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the security group for the ALB.
options.B: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic to 0.0.0.0/0.
options.C: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound Microsoft SQL Server traffic from the security group for the application tier.
options.D: Configure the security group for the database tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic and Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the security group for the web tier.
options.E: Configure the security group for the application tier to allow inbound HTTPS traffic from the security group for the web tier.
options.F: Configure the security group for the application tier to allow outbound HTTPS traffic and Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the security group for the web tier.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A, C, and E**.

Security groups act as instance-level firewalls controlling inbound and outbound traffic, and rules can use another security group as the source/destination. AWS also states that when a security group is specified as a rule source, incoming traffic is allowed based on the private IPs of instances associated with that source security group ([Create a security group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-security-group.html)). In a tiered application, the least-privilege pattern is to allow only the next upstream tier into each downstream tier:

- **A is correct**: The web tier should allow inbound HTTPS only from the ALB security group, not from the internet directly.
- **E is correct**: The application tier should allow inbound HTTPS only from the web tier security group.
- **C is correct**: The database tier should allow inbound Microsoft SQL Server traffic only from the application tier security group. AWS lists TCP port **1433** as the default Microsoft SQL Server database access port and says database access can use a security group ID for the group of instances that access the database ([Security group rules for different use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)).

The outbound-rule options are not the best choices for this question. Security groups are **stateful**: responses to allowed inbound traffic can flow out regardless of outbound rules, and response traffic for requests from an instance is allowed back in regardless of inbound rules ([Amazon EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html)). Therefore:

- **B is wrong**: Allowing the web tier outbound HTTPS to `0.0.0.0/0` is broader than necessary and does not define the required tier-to-tier inbound access.
- **D is wrong**: The database tier does not need to initiate HTTPS or SQL Server traffic to the web tier; the required flow is application tier to database tier.
- **F is wrong**: The application tier should not send Microsoft SQL Server traffic to the web tier; SQL Server traffic should go from the application tier to the database tier, and the key least-privilege rule is the database tier inbound rule from the application tier.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在设计一个三层 Web 应用程序。该架构由一个面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 和一个托管在私有子网中 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 层组成。包含业务逻辑的应用程序层运行在私有子网中的 EC2 实例上。数据库层由运行在私有子网中 EC2 实例上的 Microsoft SQL Server 组成。安全性对公司来说是高优先级。解决方案架构师应使用哪种安全组配置组合？（选择三项。）

options.A: 配置 Web 层的安全组，以允许来自 ALB 安全组的入站 HTTPS 流量。
options.B: 配置 Web 层的安全组，以允许到 0.0.0.0/0 的出站 HTTPS 流量。
options.C: 配置数据库层的安全组，以允许来自应用程序层安全组的入站 Microsoft SQL Server 流量。
options.D: 配置数据库层的安全组，以允许到 Web 层安全组的出站 HTTPS 流量和 Microsoft SQL Server 流量。
options.E: 配置应用程序层的安全组，以允许来自 Web 层安全组的入站 HTTPS 流量。
options.F: 配置应用程序层的安全组，以允许到 Web 层安全组的出站 HTTPS 流量和 Microsoft SQL Server 流量。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A、C 和 E**。

Security groups 充当实例级防火墙，用于控制入站和出站流量，并且规则可以使用另一个 security group 作为源/目标。AWS 还说明，当将 security group 指定为规则源时，会基于与该源 security group 关联的实例的私有 IP 允许传入流量（[Create a security group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-security-group.html)）。在分层应用程序中，最小权限模式是只允许每个下游层接收来自其上游相邻层的流量：

- **A 正确**：Web 层应仅允许来自 ALB security group 的入站 HTTPS，而不是直接来自互联网。
- **E 正确**：应用程序层应仅允许来自 Web 层 security group 的入站 HTTPS。
- **C 正确**：数据库层应仅允许来自应用程序层 security group 的入站 Microsoft SQL Server 流量。AWS 将 TCP 端口 **1433** 列为默认 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库访问端口，并说明数据库访问可以为访问数据库的实例组使用 security group ID（[Security group rules for different use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules-reference.html)）。出站规则选项并不是本题的最佳选择。Security groups 是 **stateful**：对已允许入站流量的响应可以不受出站规则限制地流出，并且来自实例请求的响应流量也会不受入站规则限制地被允许返回（[Amazon EC2 security groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-security-groups.html)）。因此：

- **B 错误**：允许 Web 层向 `0.0.0.0/0` 发送出站 HTTPS 流量范围过宽，且没有定义所需的层间入站访问。
- **D 错误**：数据库层不需要向 Web 层发起 HTTPS 或 SQL Server 流量；所需流向是从应用程序层到数据库层。
- **F 错误**：应用程序层不应向 Web 层发送 Microsoft SQL Server 流量；SQL Server 流量应从应用程序层流向数据库层，关键的最小权限规则是数据库层允许来自应用程序层的入站规则。

en.question: A company has released a new version of its production application. The company's workload uses Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, AWS Fargate, and Amazon SageMaker. The company wants to cost optimize the workload now that usage is at a steady state. The company wants to cover the most services with the fewest savings plans. Which combination of savings plans will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 and SageMaker.
options.B: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for Amazon EC2, Lambda, and SageMaker.
options.C: Purchase a SageMaker Savings Plan.
options.D: Purchase a Compute Savings Plan for Lambda, Fargate, and Amazon EC2.
options.E: Purchase an EC2 Instance Savings Plan for Amazon EC2 and Fargate.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **C and D**.

AWS documentation lists the Savings Plans types and their coverage. **Compute Savings Plans** automatically apply to **Amazon EC2 instance usage** and also apply to **AWS Fargate and AWS Lambda usage**. **SageMaker AI Savings Plans** separately apply to **SageMaker AI instance usage** across instance family, size, Region, and component. Therefore, the fewest plans that cover the workload's four services are one **Compute Savings Plan** for EC2/Lambda/Fargate and one **SageMaker Savings Plan** for SageMaker ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** is incorrect: EC2 Instance Savings Plans apply only to EC2 usage in a specific instance family and Region; they do **not** cover SageMaker usage ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
- **B** is incorrect: Compute Savings Plans cover EC2, Lambda, and Fargate, but not SageMaker. SageMaker requires SageMaker AI Savings Plans ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).
- **E** is incorrect: EC2 Instance Savings Plans cover EC2 instance usage only within the chosen family/Region; they do **not** cover Fargate ([Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司发布了其生产应用程序的新版本。该公司的工作负载使用 Amazon EC2、AWS Lambda、AWS Fargate 和 Amazon SageMaker。由于使用量现在已处于稳定状态，该公司希望对该工作负载进行成本优化。公司希望用最少的 savings plans 覆盖最多的服务。哪种 savings plans 组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 为 Amazon EC2 和 SageMaker 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。
options.B: 为 Amazon EC2、Lambda 和 SageMaker 购买 Compute Savings Plan。
options.C: 购买 SageMaker Savings Plan。
options.D: 为 Lambda、Fargate 和 Amazon EC2 购买 Compute Savings Plan。
options.E: 为 Amazon EC2 和 Fargate 购买 EC2 Instance Savings Plan。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **C 和 D**。

AWS 文档列出了 Savings Plans 类型及其覆盖范围。**Compute Savings Plans** 会自动应用于 **Amazon EC2 instance usage**，并且也适用于 **AWS Fargate 和 AWS Lambda usage**。**SageMaker AI Savings Plans** 单独适用于跨实例系列、大小、Region 和组件的 **SageMaker AI instance usage**。因此，覆盖该工作负载四项服务所需的最少计划是：一个用于 EC2/Lambda/Fargate 的 **Compute Savings Plan**，以及一个用于 SageMaker 的 **SageMaker Savings Plan**（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A** 不正确：EC2 Instance Savings Plans 仅适用于特定实例系列和 Region 中的 EC2 使用量；它们**不**覆盖 SageMaker 使用量（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
- **B** 不正确：Compute Savings Plans 覆盖 EC2、Lambda 和 Fargate，但不覆盖 SageMaker。SageMaker 需要 SageMaker AI Savings Plans（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。
- **E** 不正确：EC2 Instance Savings Plans 仅覆盖所选系列/Region 内的 EC2 实例使用量；它们**不**覆盖 Fargate（[Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html)）。

en.question: A company uses a Microsoft SQL Server database. The company's applications are connected to the database. The company wants to migrate to an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database with minimal changes to the application code. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to rewrite the SQL queries in the applications.
options.B: Enable Babelfish on Aurora PostgreSQL to run the SQL queries from the applications.
options.C: Migrate the database schema and data by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) and AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).
options.D: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to connect the applications to Aurora PostgreSQL.
options.E: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to rewrite the SQL queries in the applications.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **B and C**.

- **B is correct** because Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL is specifically designed for this scenario: it lets an Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster accept connections from SQL Server clients, and AWS states that SQL Server applications can work directly with Aurora PostgreSQL with “few code changes” and without changing database drivers. Babelfish also understands the SQL Server wire protocol and commonly used SQL Server statements, and supports the SQL Server T-SQL dialect on port 1433. [Using Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/babelfish.html)
- **C is correct** because the migration still needs the database schema and data moved. AWS DMS documentation says DMS Schema Conversion converts database schemas and code objects to a target-compatible format, and AWS DMS supports heterogeneous migrations between supported source and target engines. [What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html) AWS also documents SQL Server-to-PostgreSQL conversion support in AWS SCT, including SQL Server-to-PostgreSQL extension packs. [Migrating from SQL Server to PostgreSQL with AWS Schema Conversion Tool](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.SQLServer.ToPostgreSQL.html)

Incorrect options:

- **A is incorrect** because AWS SCT/DMS Schema Conversion converts database schemas and database code objects, not SQL queries embedded in application code. The requirement is minimal application code changes, which Babelfish addresses. [Best practices for AWS DMS: Converting schema](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_BestPractices.html)
- **D is incorrect** because Amazon RDS Proxy provides connection pooling, scalability, resilience, and authentication features; it does not make Aurora PostgreSQL understand SQL Server/T-SQL queries. [Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)
- **E is incorrect** because AWS DMS migrates data and supports heterogeneous database migrations; it does not rewrite SQL queries in application code. [What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Microsoft SQL Server 数据库。该公司的应用程序已连接到该数据库。该公司希望迁移到 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 数据库，并尽量减少对应用程序代码的更改。哪两个步骤的组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 重写应用程序中的 SQL 查询。
options.B: 在 Aurora PostgreSQL 上启用 Babelfish，以运行来自应用程序的 SQL 查询。
options.C: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 和 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 迁移数据库架构和数据。
options.D: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 将应用程序连接到 Aurora PostgreSQL。
options.E: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 重写应用程序中的 SQL 查询。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B 和 C**。

- **B 正确**，因为 Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL 专门针对这种场景而设计：它允许 Aurora PostgreSQL DB 集群接受来自 SQL Server 客户端的连接，并且 AWS 表示 SQL Server 应用程序可以在“少量代码更改”的情况下直接与 Aurora PostgreSQL 配合使用，且无需更改数据库驱动程序。Babelfish 还理解 SQL Server 线协议和常用的 SQL Server 语句，并在端口 1433 上支持 SQL Server T-SQL 方言。[Using Babelfish for Aurora PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/babelfish.html)
- **C 正确**，因为迁移仍然需要移动数据库架构和数据。AWS DMS 文档说明，DMS Schema Conversion 会将数据库架构和代码对象转换为与目标兼容的格式，并且 AWS DMS 支持在受支持的源引擎和目标引擎之间进行异构迁移。[What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html) AWS 还记录了 AWS SCT 中对 SQL Server 到 PostgreSQL 转换的支持，包括 SQL Server 到 PostgreSQL 扩展包。[Migrating from SQL Server to PostgreSQL with AWS Schema Conversion Tool](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/SchemaConversionTool/latest/userguide/CHAP_Source.SQLServer.ToPostgreSQL.html)

错误选项：

- **A 错误**，因为 AWS SCT/DMS Schema Conversion 转换的是数据库架构和数据库代码对象，而不是嵌入在应用程序代码中的 SQL 查询。要求是尽量减少应用程序代码更改，而 Babelfish 可以满足这一点。[Best practices for AWS DMS: Converting schema](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_BestPractices.html)
- **D 错误**，因为 Amazon RDS Proxy 提供连接池、可扩展性、弹性和身份验证功能；它不会让 Aurora PostgreSQL 理解 SQL Server/T-SQL 查询。[Amazon RDS Proxy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/rds-proxy.html)
- **E 错误**，因为 AWS DMS 迁移数据并支持异构数据库迁移；它不会重写应用程序代码中的 SQL 查询。[What is AWS Database Migration Service?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)

en.question: A company plans to rehost an application to Amazon EC2 instances that use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) as the attached storage. A solutions architect must design a solution to ensure that all newly created Amazon EBS volumes are encrypted by default. The solution must also prevent the creation of unencrypted EBS volumes. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the EC2 account attributes to always encrypt new EBS volumes.
options.B: Use AWS Config. Configure the encrypted-volumes identifier. Apply the default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.
options.C: Configure AWS Systems Manager to create encrypted copies of the EBS volumes. Reconfigure the EC2 instances to use the encrypted volumes.
options.D: Create a customer managed key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure AWS Migration Hub to use the key when the company migrates workloads.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon EBS encryption by default is the account/Region-level control designed for this requirement. AWS states that you can configure the AWS account to **enforce the encryption of new EBS volumes and snapshot copies**; when enabled for a Region, Amazon EBS encrypts volumes created when launching instances, and you **cannot disable it for individual volumes or snapshots in that Region**. The console path is under EC2 settings/data protection, and you can keep the AWS managed `aws/ebs` key or choose a symmetric customer managed KMS key ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. AWS Config encrypted-volumes** checks compliance after configuration changes. The `ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES` managed rule checks whether attached EBS volumes are encrypted and marks unencrypted volumes `NON_COMPLIANT` ([encrypted-volumes - AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/encrypted-volumes.html)). AWS Config rules flag noncompliant resources; even proactive rules do **not** remediate or prevent deployment ([Components of an AWS Config Rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_components.html)). Therefore, this does not prevent unencrypted volume creation.
- **C. Systems Manager encrypted copies** would be a remediation/migration approach for existing unencrypted resources, not a preventive default-encryption control. EBS encryption by default specifically has no effect on existing volumes, but it enforces encryption for newly created volumes ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)).
- **D. KMS key with Migration Hub** does not configure the EC2/EBS account attribute that enforces encryption for all new EBS volumes. EBS encryption by default can use the AWS managed `aws/ebs` key or a symmetric customer managed key, but the enforcement mechanism is the EBS encryption-by-default setting, not Migration Hub ([Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个应用程序重新托管到使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 作为附加存储的 Amazon EC2 实例上。解决方案架构师必须设计一个解决方案，以确保所有新创建的 Amazon EBS 卷默认加密。该解决方案还必须防止创建未加密的 EBS 卷。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 EC2 账户属性，以始终加密新的 EBS 卷。
options.B: 使用 AWS Config。配置 encrypted-volumes 标识符。应用默认的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥。
options.C: 配置 AWS Systems Manager 以创建 EBS 卷的加密副本。重新配置 EC2 实例以使用加密卷。
options.D: 在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中创建客户托管密钥。配置 AWS Migration Hub，使公司迁移工作负载时使用该密钥。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

Amazon EBS encryption by default 是为此需求设计的账户/Region 级控制。AWS 表示，你可以配置 AWS 账户以**强制加密新的 EBS 卷和快照副本**；当为某个 Region 启用后，Amazon EBS 会加密启动实例时创建的卷，并且你**无法为该 Region 中的单个卷或快照禁用它**。控制台路径位于 EC2 设置/数据保护下，并且你可以保留 AWS managed `aws/ebs` 密钥，或选择对称客户托管 KMS key（[Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. AWS Config encrypted-volumes** 会在配置更改后检查合规性。`ENCRYPTED_VOLUMES` 托管规则会检查附加的 EBS 卷是否已加密，并将未加密卷标记为 `NON_COMPLIANT`（[encrypted-volumes - AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/encrypted-volumes.html)）。AWS Config 规则会标记不合规资源；即使是主动规则也**不会**修复或阻止部署（[Components of an AWS Config Rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_components.html)）。因此，这不能防止创建未加密的卷。
- **C. Systems Manager encrypted copies** 是针对现有未加密资源的修复/迁移方法，而不是预防性的默认加密控制。EBS encryption by default 对现有卷没有影响，但它会强制加密新创建的卷（[Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)）。
- **D. KMS key with Migration Hub** 不会配置 EC2/EBS 账户属性来强制加密所有新的 EBS 卷。EBS encryption by default 可以使用 AWS managed `aws/ebs` 密钥或对称客户托管密钥，但强制执行机制是 EBS encryption-by-default 设置，而不是 Migration Hub（[Enable Amazon EBS encryption by default](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/encryption-by-default.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company wants to collect user clickstream data from the company's website for real-time analysis. The website experiences fluctuating traffic patterns throughout the day. The company needs a scalable solution that can adapt to varying levels of traffic. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams in on-demand mode to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Lambda to process the data in real time.
options.B: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Glue to process the data in real time.
options.C: Use Amazon Kinesis Video Streams to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Glue to process the data in real time.
options.D: Use Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink (previously known as Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics) to capture the clickstream data. Use AWS Lambda to process the data in real time.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is designed for rapid, continuous intake of streaming data, including **web clickstream data**, and AWS specifically lists real-time website clickstream processing as a typical use case. Its put-to-get delay is typically less than 1 second, and its elasticity lets the stream scale up or down ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). In **on-demand** capacity mode, Kinesis Data Streams automatically manages shards and accommodates workload throughput as it ramps up or down, which matches the fluctuating traffic requirement ([Kinesis Data Streams concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)). Lambda can then read records from the Kinesis stream and invoke the function to process batches; by default it invokes as records are available, and parallelization can help with volatile data volume ([Lambda with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Amazon Data Firehose is primarily a delivery service to destinations such as S3, Redshift, OpenSearch, HTTP endpoints, and Snowflake, and it uses destination-specific buffering/delivery behavior ([Firehose data delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/basic-deliver.html)). This is less appropriate than Kinesis Data Streams for sub-second, real-time clickstream analysis.
- **C:** Kinesis Video Streams is for streaming live video and related time-encoded media such as audio, images, RADAR, depth feeds, and similar data—not website clickstream events ([Kinesis Video Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisvideostreams/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)).
- **D:** Apache Flink is a distributed processing engine for computations over data streams; it is a processing/analytics framework that can consume streams, not the primary service to capture website clickstream data from producers ([Apache Flink with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/using-other-services-read-flink.html)).

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司希望从公司网站收集用户点击流数据，以进行实时分析。该网站全天的流量模式会波动。公司需要一种可扩展的解决方案，能够适应不同级别的流量。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 中按需模式的数据流来捕获点击流数据。使用 AWS Lambda 实时处理数据。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 捕获点击流数据。使用 AWS Glue 实时处理数据。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Video Streams 捕获点击流数据。使用 AWS Glue 实时处理数据。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Managed Service for Apache Flink（以前称为 Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics）捕获点击流数据。使用 AWS Lambda 实时处理数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 专为快速、连续地摄取流数据而设计，包括 **web clickstream data**，并且 AWS 明确将实时网站点击流处理列为典型使用场景。其 put-to-get 延迟通常小于 1 秒，并且其弹性使数据流能够向上或向下扩展（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。在 **on-demand** 容量模式下，Kinesis Data Streams 会自动管理分片，并在工作负载吞吐量上升或下降时适应它，这符合流量波动的要求（[Kinesis Data Streams concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/key-concepts.html)）。然后 Lambda 可以从 Kinesis 流读取记录并调用函数来处理批次；默认情况下，它会在记录可用时调用，并且并行化有助于处理波动的数据量（[Lambda with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** Amazon Data Firehose 主要是一种向 S3、Redshift、OpenSearch、HTTP endpoints 和 Snowflake 等目标传输数据的服务，并且使用特定于目标的缓冲/传输行为（[Firehose data delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/basic-deliver.html)）。与 Kinesis Data Streams 相比，它不太适合亚秒级的实时点击流分析。
- **C:** Kinesis Video Streams 用于流式传输实时视频以及相关的按时间编码的媒体，例如音频、图像、RADAR、深度馈送和类似数据，而不是网站点击流事件（[Kinesis Video Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kinesisvideostreams/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)）。
- **D:** Apache Flink 是一个分布式处理引擎，用于对数据流进行计算；它是一个可以消费流的处理/分析框架，而不是从生产者捕获网站点击流数据的主要服务（[Apache Flink with Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/using-other-services-read-flink.html)）。

en.question: A global company runs its workloads on AWS. The company's application uses Amazon S3 buckets across AWS Regions for sensitive data storage and analysis. The company stores millions of objects in multiple S3 buckets daily. The company wants to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an AWS CloudTrail event that has a rule to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning- enabled across Regions.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.C: Enable IAM Access Analyzer for S3 to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.
options.D: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point to identify all S3 buckets that are not versioning-enabled across Regions.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use Amazon S3 Storage Lens.**

Amazon S3 Storage Lens is designed for storage analytics at scale: it provides organization-wide visibility into S3 usage and activity, and its dashboard can drill down by organization, account, AWS Region, storage class, bucket, prefix, or Storage Lens group. AWS specifically states that S3 Storage Lens data-protection metrics provide insights for features such as encryption and **S3 Versioning**, and can identify buckets that are not following data protection best practices, including buckets not using S3 Versioning ([Understanding Amazon S3 Storage Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens_basics_metrics_recommendations.html)). This directly matches the requirement to identify buckets across Regions that are not versioning-enabled.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudTrail event/rule**: CloudTrail records AWS API activity and events, but it is not an S3 storage analytics dashboard for continuously identifying all existing buckets whose versioning is disabled. It would show events such as configuration changes, not provide the requested cross-Region inventory/analytics view of non-versioned buckets ([Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)).
- **C. IAM Access Analyzer for S3**: IAM Access Analyzer for S3 is for reviewing bucket access findings, such as external/public access, not for detecting whether versioning is enabled ([Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html)).
- **D. S3 Multi-Region Access Point**: Multi-Region Access Points route S3 traffic globally across Regions; they are not a compliance or analytics feature for identifying buckets without versioning ([Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)).

zh.question: 一家全球公司在 AWS 上运行其工作负载。该公司的应用程序使用跨 AWS Regions 的 Amazon S3 buckets 来存储和分析敏感数据。该公司每天在多个 S3 buckets 中存储数百万个对象。该公司希望识别所有未启用版本控制的 S3 buckets。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置一个 AWS CloudTrail 事件，该事件具有一条规则，用于识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 buckets。
options.B: 使用 Amazon S3 Storage Lens 识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 buckets。
options.C: 为 S3 启用 IAM Access Analyzer，以识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 buckets。
options.D: 创建一个 S3 Multi-Region Access Point，以识别跨 Regions 的所有未启用版本控制的 S3 buckets。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 Amazon S3 Storage Lens。**

Amazon S3 Storage Lens 专为大规模存储分析而设计：它提供对 S3 使用情况和活动的组织范围可见性，并且其控制面板可以按组织、账户、AWS Region、存储类、bucket、前缀或 Storage Lens group 进行深入分析。AWS 明确说明，S3 Storage Lens 数据保护指标可为加密和 **S3 Versioning** 等功能提供洞察，并且可以识别未遵循数据保护最佳实践的 buckets，包括未使用 S3 Versioning 的 buckets（[Understanding Amazon S3 Storage Lens](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage_lens_basics_metrics_recommendations.html)）。这直接符合识别跨 Regions 未启用版本控制的 buckets 的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. CloudTrail event/rule**：CloudTrail 记录 AWS API 活动和事件，但它不是一个用于持续识别所有已存在且版本控制已禁用的 buckets 的 S3 存储分析控制面板。它会显示配置更改等事件，而不会提供所请求的跨 Region 的未启用版本控制 buckets 清单/分析视图（[Understanding CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-events.html)）。
- **C. IAM Access Analyzer for S3**：IAM Access Analyzer for S3 用于审查 bucket 访问发现结果，例如外部/公共访问，而不是用于检测是否启用了版本控制（[Reviewing bucket access using IAM Access Analyzer for S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-analyzer.html)）。
- **D. S3 Multi-Region Access Point**：Multi-Region Access Points 在全球范围内跨 Regions 路由 S3 流量；它们不是用于识别未启用版本控制 buckets 的合规性或分析功能（[Managing multi-Region traffic with Multi-Region Access Points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessPoints.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to optimize its Amazon S3 storage costs for an application that generates many files that cannot be recreated. Each file is approximately 5 MB and is stored in Amazon S3 Standard storage. The company must store the files for 4 years before the files can be deleted. The files must be immediately accessible. The files are frequently accessed in the first 30 days of object creation, but they are rarely accessed after the first 30 days. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.B: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.C: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days after object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
options.D: Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days after object creation. Move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 4 years after object creation.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Use S3 Lifecycle to keep the objects in S3 Standard during the first 30 days, then transition them to **S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval**, and expire them after 4 years. S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to less-expensive storage classes and delete/expire them later, matching the required retention lifecycle ([AWS S3 Lifecycle documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)). After 30 days, the files are **rarely accessed** but still must be **immediately accessible**. AWS states that S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is for long-term data that is rarely accessed and requires **millisecond retrieval / real-time access** ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)). It is also recommended for data accessed about once per quarter and has lower storage costs than S3 Standard-IA, although with higher access costs ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)). The 5 MB object size is well above the 128 KB minimum billable/object size, and 4 years exceeds the 90-day minimum storage duration for Glacier Instant Retrieval.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** S3 One Zone-IA stores data in only one Availability Zone and is not resilient to physical loss of that AZ. AWS recommends One Zone-IA for data that can be re-created; the question says the files **cannot be recreated** ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **C:** S3 Standard-IA provides millisecond access and is suitable for long-lived infrequently accessed data, but for **rarely accessed** long-term data with millisecond access, S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is the more cost-optimized storage class; AWS notes it has lower storage costs than Standard-IA ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).
- **D:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is archival storage and objects are not available for real-time access; access requires restore and takes minutes to hours. Also, this option moves the files after 4 years instead of deleting them after the required 4-year retention period ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要为一个会生成许多无法重新创建的文件的应用程序优化其 Amazon S3 存储成本。每个文件约为 5 MB，并存储在 Amazon S3 Standard 存储中。公司必须将这些文件存储 4 年，之后才能删除。这些文件必须可立即访问。文件在对象创建后的前 30 天内会被频繁访问，但在前 30 天之后很少被访问。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在对象创建 30 天后将文件移动到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。在对象创建 4 年后删除文件。
options.B: 创建一个 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在对象创建 30 天后将文件移动到 S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)。在对象创建 4 年后删除文件。
options.C: 创建一个 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在对象创建 30 天后将文件移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。在对象创建 4 年后删除文件。
options.D: 创建一个 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在对象创建 30 天后将文件移动到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。在对象创建 4 年后将文件移动到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

使用 S3 Lifecycle 在前 30 天将对象保留在 S3 Standard 中，然后将其转换到 **S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval**，并在 4 年后使其过期。S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的存储类，并在之后删除/使其过期，从而匹配所需的保留生命周期（[AWS S3 Lifecycle documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。30 天后，文件**很少被访问**，但仍必须**可立即访问**。AWS 表示，S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 适用于很少访问且需要**毫秒级检索 / 实时访问**的长期数据（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。它还被推荐用于大约每季度访问一次的数据，并且其存储成本低于 S3 Standard-IA，尽管访问成本更高（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。5 MB 的对象大小远高于 128 KB 的最小计费/对象大小，且 4 年超过了 Glacier Instant Retrieval 的 90 天最短存储期限。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** S3 One Zone-IA 仅在一个 Availability Zone 中存储数据，无法抵御该 AZ 的物理丢失。AWS 建议将 One Zone-IA 用于可重新创建的数据；题目说这些文件**无法重新创建**（[S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **C:** S3 Standard-IA 提供毫秒级访问，适用于长期存在且不频繁访问的数据，但对于需要毫秒级访问的**很少访问**的长期数据，S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 是更具成本优化的存储类；AWS 指出其存储成本低于 Standard-IA（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 是归档存储，对象不能实时访问；访问需要还原，耗时从数分钟到数小时不等。此外，此选项是在 4 年后移动文件，而不是在要求的 4 年保留期后删除它们（[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

en.question: A company runs its critical storage application in the AWS Cloud. The application uses Amazon S3 in two AWS Regions. The company wants the application to send remote user data to the nearest S3 bucket with no public network congestion. The company also wants the application to fail over with the least amount of management of Amazon S3. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an active-active design between the two Regions. Configure the application to use the regional S3 endpoints closest to the user.
options.B: Use an active-passive configuration with S3 Multi-Region Access Points. Create a global endpoint for each of the Regions.
options.C: Send user data to the regional S3 endpoints closest to the user. Configure an S3 cross-account replication rule to keep the S3 buckets synchronized.
options.D: Set up Amazon S3 to use Multi-Region Access Points in an active-active configuration with a single global endpoint. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points provide a **single global endpoint** that routes S3 request traffic across AWS Regions without requiring separate regional endpoint logic in the application. AWS states that each Multi-Region Access Point global endpoint routes S3 data request traffic from sources including VPCs, on-premises data centers over AWS PrivateLink, and the public internet, and that PrivateLink can route requests into AWS or across Regions over a **private connection** with simple network configuration ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessConfiguration.html)). In an **active-active** Multi-Region Access Point, AWS automatically sends requests to the closest Region, and if a traffic disruption occurs, network traffic is automatically redirected to another active Region ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/FailoverConfiguration.html)). S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) copies objects across buckets in different Regions and helps minimize latency by maintaining object copies closer to users; AWS also notes that two-way CRR can keep data synchronized across Regions during failover and support high availability ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Using regional S3 endpoints closest to users requires the application to manage endpoint selection and failover logic. It also does not provide the Multi-Region Access Point single global endpoint or automatic redirection behavior.
- **B:** Active-passive does not send all requests to the closest available Region; passive Regions do not receive traffic. AWS describes active-passive as useful for disaster-recovery planning and failover controls, not as the lowest-management active routing model ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/FailoverConfiguration.html)). Also, a Multi-Region Access Point uses a global endpoint, not a separate global endpoint for each Region.
- **C:** Regional endpoints plus replication can keep copies in multiple Regions, but this still leaves the application responsible for routing users and handling failover. Also, the requirement is cross-Region synchronization, not specifically cross-account replication.

Therefore, **S3 Multi-Region Access Points in active-active mode with CRR** best meets the requirements for nearest-bucket routing, private/non-public-network access capability, automatic failover, and minimal S3 management.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行其关键存储应用程序。该应用程序在两个 AWS Regions 中使用 Amazon S3。公司希望该应用程序将远程用户数据发送到最近的 S3 bucket，并且不经过拥塞的公共网络。公司还希望该应用程序能够以最少的 Amazon S3 管理工作量进行故障转移。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在两个 Regions 之间实施 active-active 设计。配置应用程序使用最接近用户的区域性 S3 端点。
options.B: 将 S3 Multi-Region Access Points 与 active-passive 配置结合使用。为每个 Region 创建一个全局端点。
options.C: 将用户数据发送到最接近用户的区域性 S3 端点。配置 S3 跨账户复制规则以保持 S3 buckets 同步。
options.D: 设置 Amazon S3 使用 Multi-Region Access Points，并采用具有单个全局端点的 active-active 配置。配置 S3 Cross-Region Replication。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points 提供一个 **single global endpoint**，可跨 AWS Regions 路由 S3 请求流量，而无需应用程序中单独的区域端点逻辑。AWS 表示，每个 Multi-Region Access Point 全局端点都会从包括 VPCs、本地数据中心（通过 AWS PrivateLink）以及公共互联网在内的来源路由 S3 数据请求流量，并且 PrivateLink 可以通过 **private connection** 将请求路由到 AWS 内部或跨 Regions 路由，同时网络配置简单（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MultiRegionAccessConfiguration.html)）。在 **active-active** Multi-Region Access Point 中，AWS 会自动将请求发送到最近的 Region；如果发生流量中断，网络流量会自动重定向到另一个活动 Region（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/FailoverConfiguration.html)）。S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 会在不同 Regions 的 buckets 之间复制对象，并通过在更靠近用户的位置维护对象副本来帮助最大限度降低延迟；AWS 还指出，双向 CRR 可以在故障转移期间保持跨 Regions 的数据同步，并支持高可用性（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用最接近用户的区域性 S3 端点需要应用程序管理端点选择和故障转移逻辑。它也不提供 Multi-Region Access Point 单个全局端点或自动重定向行为。
- **B:** Active-passive 不会将所有请求发送到最近的可用 Region；被动 Regions 不接收流量。AWS 将 active-passive 描述为适用于灾难恢复规划和故障转移控制，而不是最低管理量的主动路由模型（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/FailoverConfiguration.html)）。此外，Multi-Region Access Point 使用全局端点，而不是为每个 Region 使用单独的全局端点。
- **C:** 区域端点加复制可以在多个 Regions 中保留副本，但这仍然让应用程序负责路由用户和处理故障转移。此外，要求是跨 Region 同步，而不是专门的跨账户复制。因此，**采用 active-active 模式并结合 CRR 的 S3 Multi-Region Access Points** 最能满足最近 bucket 路由、私有/非公共网络访问能力、自动故障转移以及最少 S3 管理的要求。

en.question: A company is migrating a data center from its on-premises location to AWS. The company has several legacy applications that are hosted on individual virtual servers. Changes to the application designs cannot be made. Each individual virtual server currently runs as its own EC2 instance. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the applications are reliable and fault tolerant after migration to AWS. The applications will run on Amazon EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that has a minimum of one and a maximum of one. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Use the AMI to create EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group Configure an Application Load Balancer in front of the Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Use AWS Backup to create an hourly backup of the EC2 instance that hosts each application. Store the backup in Amazon S3 in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a disaster recovery process to restore the EC2 instance for each application from its most recent backup.
options.C: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of each application instance. Launch two new EC2 instances from the AMI. Place each EC2 instance in a separate Availability Zone. Configure a Network Load Balancer that has the EC2 instances as targets.
options.D: Use AWS Mitigation Hub Refactor Spaces to migrate each application off the EC2 instance. Break down functionality from each application into individual components. Host each application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type.

en.explanation:
**Answer: C.**

To make each legacy EC2-hosted application reliable and fault tolerant without redesigning it, the best option is to create an AMI of each application server, run multiple EC2 instances from that AMI in separate Availability Zones, and place them behind a load balancer. AWS states that a load balancer distributes workloads across multiple compute resources and that using one increases application availability and fault tolerance; health checks allow traffic to be sent only to healthy targets ([Elastic Load Balancing benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)). AWS also recommends enabling multiple Availability Zones for load balancers so that, if one Availability Zone becomes unavailable or has no healthy targets, traffic can be routed to healthy targets in another Availability Zone ([Availability Zones and load balancer nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). A Network Load Balancer is suitable for distributing TCP connections to targets and creates a network interface in each enabled Availability Zone ([Request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:
