- **A:** An Auto Scaling group with minimum 1 and maximum 1 can replace a failed instance, but it still provides only one running application instance at a time. That is not as fault tolerant as having active targets in multiple Availability Zones. AWS documentation describes Availability Zone redundancy as maintaining instances across enabled Availability Zones for applications that need redundancy ([Auto Scaling group Availability Zone distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-availability-zone-balanced.html)).
- **B:** AWS Backup can restore an entire EC2 instance from a recovery point, but this is a restore-based disaster recovery process, not a continuously fault-tolerant architecture. A failure would require restoration from the latest backup and could lose data or cause downtime ([Restore an Amazon EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-ec2.html)).
- **D:** This violates the requirement that application design changes cannot be made. Refactoring into components and moving to ECS/Fargate is an application modernization effort, not a lift-and-shift fault-tolerance solution for unchanged EC2-based legacy applications.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将数据中心从本地位置迁移到 AWS。该公司有多个托管在单独虚拟服务器上的旧版应用程序。不能对应用程序设计进行更改。每个单独的虚拟服务器目前都作为其自己的 EC2 实例运行。解决方案架构师需要确保这些应用程序在迁移到 AWS 后可靠且具有容错能力。这些应用程序将在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个最小值为一、最大值为一的 Auto Scaling group。为每个应用程序实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 在 Auto Scaling group 中创建 EC2 实例。在 Auto Scaling group 前面配置一个 Application Load Balancer。
options.B: 使用 AWS Backup 为托管每个应用程序的 EC2 实例创建每小时备份。将备份存储在单独 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon S3 中。配置灾难恢复流程，从每个应用程序的最新备份恢复其 EC2 实例。
options.C: 为每个应用程序实例创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。从该 AMI 启动两个新的 EC2 实例。将每个 EC2 实例放置在单独的 Availability Zone 中。配置一个以这些 EC2 实例作为目标的 Network Load Balancer。
options.D: 使用 AWS Mitigation Hub Refactor Spaces 将每个应用程序从 EC2 实例迁移出去。将每个应用程序的功能分解为单独的组件。使用 AWS Fargate launch type 在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 上托管每个应用程序。

zh.explanation:
**答案：C.**

为了在不重新设计的情况下使每个托管在 EC2 上的旧版应用程序可靠且具有容错能力，最佳选项是为每台应用程序服务器创建 AMI，从该 AMI 在不同的 Availability Zones 中运行多个 EC2 实例，并将它们置于负载均衡器后面。AWS 指出，负载均衡器会在多个计算资源之间分配工作负载，使用负载均衡器可以提高应用程序可用性和容错能力；健康检查允许仅将流量发送到健康目标（[Elastic Load Balancing benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）。AWS 还建议为负载均衡器启用多个 Availability Zones，这样，如果一个 Availability Zone 变得不可用或没有健康目标，流量可以路由到另一个 Availability Zone 中的健康目标（[Availability Zones and load balancer nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。Network Load Balancer 适合将 TCP 连接分发到目标，并在每个启用的 Availability Zone 中创建一个网络接口（[Request routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A:** 最小值为 1、最大值为 1 的 Auto Scaling group 可以替换失败的实例，但它在任一时间仍然只提供一个正在运行的应用程序实例。这不如在多个 Availability Zones 中拥有活动目标那样具备容错能力。AWS 文档将 Availability Zone 冗余描述为：对于需要冗余的应用程序，在已启用的 Availability Zones 之间维护实例（[Auto Scaling group Availability Zone distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-availability-zone-balanced.html)）。
- **B:** AWS Backup 可以从恢复点还原整个 EC2 实例，但这是基于还原的灾难恢复流程，而不是持续容错的架构。故障发生后需要从最新备份进行还原，并且可能丢失数据或导致停机（[Restore an Amazon EC2 instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/restoring-ec2.html)）。
- **D:** 这违反了不能更改应用程序设计的要求。将应用程序重构为组件并迁移到 ECS/Fargate 是应用程序现代化工作，而不是针对未更改的基于 EC2 的旧版应用程序的直接迁移式容错解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to isolate its workloads by creating an AWS account for each workload. The company needs a solution that centrally manages networking components for the workloads. The solution also must create accounts with automatic security controls (guardrails). Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS Control Tower to deploy accounts. Create a networking account that has a VPC with private subnets and public subnets. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the subnets with the workload accounts.
options.B: Use AWS Organizations to deploy accounts. Create a networking account that has a VPC with private subnets and public subnets. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share the subnets with the workload accounts.
options.C: Use AWS Control Tower to deploy accounts. Deploy a VPC in each workload account. Configure each VPC to route through an inspection VPC by using a transit gateway attachment.
options.D: Use AWS Organizations to deploy accounts. Deploy a VPC in each workload account. Configure each VPC to route through an inspection VPC by using a transit gateway attachment.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS Control Tower is the lowest-overhead way to create governed workload accounts because it provides a multi-account landing zone, **controls/guardrails** for ongoing governance, and **Account Factory** to standardize and automate new account provisioning. The AWS Control Tower docs state that controls are also called guardrails and provide ongoing governance, and that Account Factory automates the account provisioning workflow with pre-approved configurations ([AWS Control Tower features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html), [Account Factory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/account-factory.html)).

For centralized networking, VPC subnet sharing is designed for this pattern: multiple AWS accounts can deploy application resources into **shared, centrally managed VPCs**, where the VPC owner shares subnets with participant accounts in the same AWS Organizations organization. AWS also notes that this reduces the number of VPCs to create and manage while still using separate accounts for billing and access control ([VPC sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)). Subnets can be shared with other accounts in the organization by using resource shares/AWS RAM operations ([Share a subnet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing-share-subnet-working-with.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B** uses AWS Organizations and AWS RAM for subnet sharing, but it does not provide the same built-in Control Tower landing zone, Account Factory automation, and guardrail/control framework. This requires more manual governance work than Control Tower.
* **C** uses AWS Control Tower for account governance, but deploying and operating a separate VPC in every workload account plus transit gateway attachments and an inspection VPC is more operationally complex than sharing centrally managed subnets.
* **D** combines both drawbacks: AWS Organizations instead of Control Tower for automated guardrails, and separate per-account VPCs with transit gateway routing, which increases operational overhead.

Therefore, **AWS Control Tower + a centralized networking account with shared VPC subnets via AWS RAM** best satisfies account isolation, automatic guardrails, centralized networking, and least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司希望通过为每个工作负载创建一个 AWS 账户来隔离其工作负载。该公司需要一种解决方案来集中管理这些工作负载的网络组件。该解决方案还必须创建带有自动安全控制（护栏）的账户。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Control Tower 部署账户。创建一个网络账户，其中包含一个具有私有子网和公有子网的 VPC。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 将子网共享给工作负载账户。
options.B: 使用 AWS Organizations 部署账户。创建一个网络账户，其中包含一个具有私有子网和公有子网的 VPC。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 将子网共享给工作负载账户。
options.C: 使用 AWS Control Tower 部署账户。在每个工作负载账户中部署一个 VPC。通过使用 transit gateway attachment 配置每个 VPC，使其通过检查 VPC 进行路由。
options.D: 使用 AWS Organizations 部署账户。在每个工作负载账户中部署一个 VPC。通过使用 transit gateway attachment 配置每个 VPC，使其通过检查 VPC 进行路由。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

AWS Control Tower 是创建受治理的工作负载账户时运营开销最低的方式，因为它提供多账户登录区、用于持续治理的 **controls/guardrails**，以及用于标准化和自动化新账户预置的 **Account Factory**。AWS Control Tower 文档说明，controls 也称为 guardrails，并提供持续治理；Account Factory 使用预先批准的配置自动化账户预置工作流（[AWS Control Tower features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)，[Account Factory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/account-factory.html)）。对于集中式网络，VPC 子网共享正是为这种模式设计的：多个 AWS 账户可以将应用程序资源部署到**共享的、集中管理的 VPC** 中，其中 VPC 所有者将子网共享给同一 AWS Organizations 组织中的参与账户。AWS 还指出，这可以减少需要创建和管理的 VPC 数量，同时仍使用独立账户进行计费和访问控制（[VPC sharing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing.html)）。可以使用 resource shares/AWS RAM 操作将子网共享给组织中的其他账户（[Share a subnet](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-sharing-share-subnet-working-with.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B** 使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS RAM 进行子网共享，但它不提供相同的内置 Control Tower 登录区、Account Factory 自动化以及 guardrail/control 框架。这比 Control Tower 需要更多手动治理工作。
* **C** 使用 AWS Control Tower 进行账户治理，但在每个工作负载账户中部署和运营单独的 VPC，再加上 transit gateway attachments 和检查 VPC，比共享集中管理的子网在运营上更复杂。
* **D** 同时包含两个缺点：使用 AWS Organizations 而不是 Control Tower 来实现自动护栏，并且使用每账户单独 VPC 与 transit gateway 路由，这会增加运营开销。因此，**AWS Control Tower + 通过 AWS RAM 共享 VPC 子网的集中式网络账户** 最能满足账户隔离、自动护栏、集中式网络和最少运营开销的要求。

en.question: A company hosts a website on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website serves static content. Website traffic is increasing. The company wants to minimize the website hosting costs. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Move the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the S3 bucket.
options.B: Move the website to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon ElastiCache cluster for the S3 bucket.
options.C: Move the website to AWS Amplify. Configure an ALB to resolve to the Amplify website.
options.D: Move the website to AWS Amplify. Configure EC2 instances to cache the website.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The site serves only static content, so keeping EC2 instances behind an ALB is unnecessary hosting overhead. AWS documentation describes a secure static website pattern where an **S3 bucket is the origin** and **CloudFront caches and serves objects**; subsequent requests from the same edge location are served from the CloudFront cache ([CloudFront secure static website solution overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/getting-started-secure-static-website-cloudformation-template.html)). CloudFront also supports Amazon S3 as an origin and distributes files from edge locations worldwide ([CloudFront content delivery setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). This directly fits static content and increasing traffic while eliminating EC2/ALB web-hosting costs.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** Amazon ElastiCache is not the right cache layer for static website objects in S3. AWS describes ElastiCache query caching as useful for read-heavy applications with repeated database queries, expensive queries, and high-concurrency database-read offload—not as a CDN for S3 static objects ([ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)).
- **C:** Amplify can host web applications, but adding an **ALB** does not minimize cost for a static website. AWS describes load balancers as distributing workloads across compute resources such as virtual servers ([Elastic Load Balancing benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)); that is unnecessary for static content served from a managed static origin/CDN.
- **D:** Moving to Amplify but then using **EC2 instances to cache** the website retains compute instances and operational cost, which conflicts with the goal of minimizing static hosting costs. CloudFront provides the managed edge cache for this use case.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上托管一个网站。该网站提供静态内容。网站流量正在增加。公司希望最大限度地降低网站托管成本。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将网站迁移到 Amazon S3 bucket。为该 S3 bucket 配置 Amazon CloudFront distribution。
options.B: 将网站迁移到 Amazon S3 bucket。为该 S3 bucket 配置 Amazon ElastiCache cluster。
options.C: 将网站迁移到 AWS Amplify。配置一个 ALB 解析到 Amplify 网站。
options.D: 将网站迁移到 AWS Amplify。配置 EC2 实例来缓存该网站。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** 该站点只提供静态内容，因此在 ALB 后面继续保留 EC2 实例会产生不必要的托管开销。AWS 文档描述了一种安全静态网站模式，其中 **S3 bucket 是源站**，并且 **CloudFront 缓存并提供对象**；来自同一边缘站点的后续请求会由 CloudFront 缓存提供服务（[CloudFront secure static website solution overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/getting-started-secure-static-website-cloudformation-template.html)）。CloudFront 还支持将 Amazon S3 作为源站，并从全球边缘站点分发文件（[CloudFront content delivery setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。这直接适合静态内容和不断增长的流量，同时消除了 EC2/ALB 网站托管成本。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **B:** Amazon ElastiCache 不是用于 S3 中静态网站对象的正确缓存层。AWS 将 ElastiCache 查询缓存描述为适用于具有重复数据库查询、昂贵查询以及需要卸载高并发数据库读取的读密集型应用程序，而不是作为 S3 静态对象的 CDN（[ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)）。
- **C:** Amplify 可以托管 Web 应用程序，但添加 **ALB** 并不能最大限度地降低静态网站的成本。AWS 将负载均衡器描述为在虚拟服务器等计算资源之间分配工作负载（[Elastic Load Balancing benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/what-is-load-balancing.html)）；对于从托管静态源站/CDN 提供服务的静态内容来说，这是不必要的。
- **D:** 迁移到 Amplify 后又使用 **EC2 实例来缓存** 网站，仍然保留了计算实例和运营成本，这与最大限度降低静态托管成本的目标相冲突。CloudFront 为此用例提供托管边缘缓存。

en.question: A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a media application that the company hosts on AWS. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access stored data. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.B: Create an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway. Configure tapes to use Amazon S3. Connect the application server to the Tape Gateway.
options.C: Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
options.D: Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Connect the application server to the file system.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server is the best fit because it provides fully managed Microsoft Windows file servers and has native support for the Server Message Block (SMB) protocol for network file access. AWS also states that, as a fully managed service, FSx for Windows File Server eliminates administrative overhead for setting up/provisioning file servers and storage volumes, keeps Windows software up to date, addresses hardware failures, and performs backups ([FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)). Clients access FSx for Windows file shares using SMB, and compute instances can map/mount the file share for application access ([Accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Volume Gateway is not the right Storage Gateway type for SMB file sharing. AWS describes Storage Gateway as offering file-based, volume-based, and tape-based solutions, and Volume Gateway specifically provides cloud-backed storage volumes mounted as **iSCSI** devices, not SMB file shares ([Volume Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **B:** Tape Gateway is for virtual tape storage and archiving backup data to S3 Glacier storage classes, not shared application file storage over SMB ([Tape Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).
- **C:** A Windows EC2 instance with a manually configured file share could provide SMB access, but it requires the company to administer the Windows server, storage, patching, availability, backups, and scaling. FSx for Windows File Server is purpose-built and fully managed, so it has lower administrative overhead ([FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在为其托管在 AWS 上的媒体应用程序实施共享存储解决方案。该公司需要能够使用 SMB 客户端访问已存储的数据。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway。创建一个使用所需客户端协议的文件共享。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件共享。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway。配置磁带以使用 Amazon S3。将应用程序服务器连接到 Tape Gateway。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EC2 Windows 实例。在该实例上安装并配置 Windows 文件共享角色。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件共享。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。将应用程序服务器连接到该文件系统。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 是最佳选择，因为它提供完全托管的 Microsoft Windows 文件服务器，并原生支持用于网络文件访问的 Server Message Block (SMB) 协议。AWS 还说明，作为一项完全托管的服务，FSx for Windows File Server 消除了设置/预置文件服务器和存储卷的管理开销，使 Windows 软件保持最新，处理硬件故障，并执行备份（[FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。客户端使用 SMB 访问 FSx for Windows 文件共享，计算实例可以映射/挂载该文件共享以供应用程序访问（[Accessing data using file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Volume Gateway 不是用于 SMB 文件共享的正确 Storage Gateway 类型。AWS 将 Storage Gateway 描述为提供基于文件、基于卷和基于磁带的解决方案，而 Volume Gateway 专门提供作为 **iSCSI** 设备挂载的云支持存储卷，而不是 SMB 文件共享（[Volume Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **B:** Tape Gateway 用于虚拟磁带存储以及将备份数据归档到 S3 Glacier 存储类，而不是通过 SMB 提供共享应用程序文件存储（[Tape Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。
- **C:** 手动配置文件共享的 Windows EC2 实例可以提供 SMB 访问，但它需要公司管理 Windows 服务器、存储、补丁、可用性、备份和扩展。FSx for Windows File Server 是专门构建且完全托管的，因此其管理开销更低（[FSx for Windows File Server overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing its production application's disaster recovery (DR) strategy. The application is backed by a MySQL database on an Amazon Aurora cluster in the us-east-1 Region. The company has chosen the us-west-1 Region as its DR Region. The company's target recovery point objective (RPO) is 5 minutes and the target recovery time objective (RTO) is 20 minutes. The company wants to minimize configuration changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an Aurora read replica in us-west-1 similar in size to the production application's Aurora MySQL cluster writer instance.
options.B: Convert the Aurora cluster to an Aurora global database. Configure managed failover.
options.C: Create a new Aurora cluster in us-west-1 that has Cross-Region Replication.
options.D: Create a new Aurora cluster in us-west-1. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to sync both clusters.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Convert the Aurora cluster to an Aurora global database. Configure managed failover.**

Aurora Global Database is purpose-built for multi-Region Aurora DR. It has one primary Region and read-only secondary Regions, and Aurora replicates data to secondary Regions using dedicated infrastructure with latency typically under a second ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)). For DR planning, AWS states that Aurora Global Database RTO can be “in the order of minutes” and RPO is typically measured in seconds ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)), which satisfies the 5-minute RPO and 20-minute RTO targets. Managed failover is specifically recommended for disaster recovery and automatically promotes the secondary cluster and later adds the old primary Region back as a secondary, preserving the topology ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)). Using the global writer endpoint can also minimize application connection changes because it remains the same after switchover or failover ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Aurora read replica in us-west-1:** Aurora Replicas are primarily for read scaling and intra-cluster high availability; AWS describes automatic promotion of Aurora Replicas within a DB cluster when the writer fails ([AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)). This is not the most operationally efficient cross-Region DR mechanism compared with Aurora Global Database managed failover.
- **C. New Aurora cluster with Cross-Region Replication:** This resembles building a secondary replication topology, but Aurora Global Database provides the managed cross-Region failover and lower RPO/RTO DR workflow specifically documented for Region-wide outages. A non-global/manual cross-Region approach would require more operational steps and endpoint/configuration changes.
- **D. AWS DMS sync between clusters:** DMS-based synchronization would add migration/replication infrastructure to manage and does not provide the integrated Aurora Global Database managed failover workflow. It is less operationally efficient for an Aurora-to-Aurora DR design with low RPO/RTO requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计其生产应用程序的灾难恢复 (DR) 策略。该应用程序由 us-east-1 Region 中 Amazon Aurora 集群上的 MySQL 数据库提供支持。该公司已选择 us-west-1 Region 作为其 DR Region。该公司的目标恢复点目标 (RPO) 为 5 分钟，目标恢复时间目标 (RTO) 为 20 分钟。该公司希望尽量减少配置更改。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 us-west-1 中创建一个 Aurora 只读副本，其大小与生产应用程序的 Aurora MySQL 集群写入器实例相似。
options.B: 将 Aurora 集群转换为 Aurora global database。配置托管故障转移。
options.C: 在 us-west-1 中创建一个具有 Cross-Region Replication 的新 Aurora 集群。
options.D: 在 us-west-1 中创建一个新 Aurora 集群。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 同步两个集群。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 将 Aurora 集群转换为 Aurora global database。配置托管故障转移。**

Aurora Global Database 专为多 Region Aurora DR 而构建。它有一个主 Region 和只读的辅助 Regions，Aurora 使用专用基础设施将数据复制到辅助 Regions，延迟通常低于一秒（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。对于 DR 规划，AWS 表示 Aurora Global Database RTO 可以达到“分钟级”，而 RPO 通常以秒为单位衡量（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)），这满足 5 分钟 RPO 和 20 分钟 RTO 目标。托管故障转移专门被推荐用于灾难恢复，它会自动提升辅助集群，并在之后将旧的主 Region 作为辅助重新添加回来，从而保留拓扑结构（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)）。使用全局写入器端点还可以最大限度地减少应用程序连接更改，因为它在切换或故障转移后保持不变（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. us-west-1 中的 Aurora 只读副本：** Aurora Replicas 主要用于读取扩展和集群内高可用性；AWS 描述了当写入器发生故障时，在 DB 集群内自动提升 Aurora Replicas（[AWS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Replication.html)）。与 Aurora Global Database 托管故障转移相比，这不是运营效率最高的跨 Region DR 机制。
- **C. 具有 Cross-Region Replication 的新 Aurora 集群：** 这类似于构建辅助复制拓扑，但 Aurora Global Database 提供了专门针对 Region 级中断而记录的托管跨 Region 故障转移和更低 RPO/RTO 的 DR 工作流。非全局/手动的跨 Region 方法需要更多运营步骤以及端点/配置更改。
- **D. 集群之间的 AWS DMS 同步：** 基于 DMS 的同步会增加需要管理的迁移/复制基础设施，并且不提供集成的 Aurora Global Database 托管故障转移工作流。对于具有低 RPO/RTO 要求的 Aurora 到 Aurora DR 设计，它的运营效率较低。

en.question: A company runs a critical data analysis job each week before the first day of the work week. The job requires at least 1 hour to complete the analysis. The job is stateful and cannot tolerate interruptions. The company needs a solution to run the job on AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a container for the job. Schedule the job to run as an AWS Fargate task on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster by using Amazon EventBridge Scheduler.
options.B: Configure the job to run in an AWS Lambda function. Create a scheduled rule in Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances that run Amazon Linux. Configure a crontab entry on the instances to run the analysis.
options.D: Configure an AWS DataSync task to run the job. Configure a cron expression to run the task on a schedule.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The workload is a weekly, scheduled, long-running job that must not be interrupted. Amazon ECS supports running containerized tasks on a schedule with Amazon EventBridge Scheduler; the AWS documentation says EventBridge Scheduler provides recurring cron-based schedules and that “You can schedule your Amazon ECS” tasks by using it ([Amazon ECS scheduled tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tasks-scheduled-eventbridge-scheduler.html)). Running the job as an ECS task on AWS Fargate avoids managing EC2 instances and is appropriate for a containerized batch-style job that needs to run for at least an hour.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** AWS Lambda is not suitable because Lambda has a maximum function timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)**, while the job requires at least 1 hour ([Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)).
- **C:** EC2 Spot Instances are not suitable for a stateful job that cannot tolerate interruptions. AWS documents that Spot Instances can receive interruption notices before EC2 stops or terminates them, and recommends architecting applications to be fault-tolerant for Spot interruptions ([Spot Instance interruption notices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-instance-termination-notices.html)).
- **D:** AWS DataSync is for data movement use cases such as migrating, archiving, replicating, or transferring data for processing; it is not a general-purpose service for running a stateful analysis job ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司每周在工作周第一天之前运行一项关键数据分析作业。该作业至少需要 1 小时才能完成分析。该作业是有状态的，且不能容忍中断。公司需要一个在 AWS 上运行该作业的解决方案。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该作业创建一个容器。使用 Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 将该作业计划为在 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群上作为 AWS Fargate 任务运行。
options.B: 将该作业配置为在 AWS Lambda 函数中运行。在 Amazon EventBridge 中创建计划规则以调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 配置一个运行 Amazon Linux 的 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances Auto Scaling 组。在实例上配置 crontab 条目以运行分析。
options.D: 配置一个 AWS DataSync 任务来运行该作业。配置 cron 表达式以按计划运行该任务。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.** 该工作负载是一个每周计划运行的长时间作业，并且不能被中断。Amazon ECS 支持使用 Amazon EventBridge Scheduler 按计划运行容器化任务；AWS 文档说明 EventBridge Scheduler 提供基于 cron 的重复计划，并且“You can schedule your Amazon ECS”任务可以使用它来安排（[Amazon ECS scheduled tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/tasks-scheduled-eventbridge-scheduler.html)）。将该作业作为 AWS Fargate 上的 ECS 任务运行，可以避免管理 EC2 实例，并且适合需要运行至少一小时的容器化批处理类作业。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** AWS Lambda 不合适，因为 Lambda 的最大函数超时时间为 **900 秒（15 分钟）**，而该作业至少需要 1 小时（[Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。
- **C:** EC2 Spot Instances 不适合不能容忍中断的有状态作业。AWS 文档说明，Spot Instances 在 EC2 停止或终止它们之前可能会收到中断通知，并建议针对 Spot 中断将应用程序架构设计为具备容错能力（[Spot Instance interruption notices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-instance-termination-notices.html)）。
- **D:** AWS DataSync 用于数据移动用例，例如迁移、归档、复制或传输数据以进行处理；它不是用于运行有状态分析作业的通用服务（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。

en.question: A company runs workloads in the AWS Cloud. The company wants to centrally collect security data to assess security across the entire company and to improve workload protection. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Configure a data lake in AWS Lake Formation. Use AWS Glue crawlers to ingest the security data into the data lake.
options.B: Configure an AWS Lambda function to collect the security data in .csv format. Upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure a data lake in Amazon Security Lake to collect the security data. Upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.D: Configure an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication instance to load the security data into an Amazon RDS cluster.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon Security Lake is purpose-built for this requirement. AWS documentation states that Security Lake helps centralize security-related log and event data, creates a purpose-built security data lake in the company’s account, collects data from cloud/on-premises/custom sources across accounts and Regions, and backs the data lake with Amazon S3 buckets. It also supports centrally enabling Security Lake across multiple AWS accounts and Regions, which directly matches assessing security across the company with the least development effort. Security Lake also automatically transforms and normalizes supported data, reducing custom ETL/post-processing work ([Security Lake features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security-lake/latest/userguide/what-is-security-lake.html)). The source management documentation further confirms that Security Lake runs ETL jobs, converts data to Parquet and OCSF, and stores processed source data in an S3 bucket in the AWS account ([Source management in Security Lake](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security-lake/latest/userguide/source-management.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Lake Formation can be used to build and secure a general-purpose data lake, but using Glue crawlers and building ingestion pipelines for security data requires more configuration and development than the purpose-built Security Lake solution.
- **B:** A Lambda function that collects CSV files in S3 is custom development and lacks the built-in multi-account, multi-Region collection, normalization, and security-data-lake capabilities of Security Lake.
- **D:** AWS DMS is for database migration/replication workloads, not centralized collection and normalization of security logs and events; it does not meet the security data lake requirement with minimal effort.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行工作负载。该公司希望集中收集安全数据，以评估整个公司的安全状况并改进工作负载保护。哪种解决方案能以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Lake Formation 中配置一个数据湖。使用 AWS Glue crawlers 将安全数据摄取到数据湖中。
options.B: 配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，以 .csv 格式收集安全数据。将数据上传到 Amazon S3 bucket。
options.C: 在 Amazon Security Lake 中配置一个数据湖来收集安全数据。将数据上传到 Amazon S3 bucket。
options.D: 配置一个 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication instance，将安全数据加载到 Amazon RDS cluster 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** Amazon Security Lake 是专为此需求构建的。AWS 文档指出，Security Lake 可帮助集中与安全相关的日志和事件数据，在公司的账户中创建专用的安全数据湖，从跨账户和 Region 的云/本地/自定义来源收集数据，并使用 Amazon S3 buckets 支撑该数据湖。它还支持在多个 AWS 账户和 Region 中集中启用 Security Lake，这直接符合以最少开发工作量评估整个公司安全状况的需求。Security Lake 还会自动转换和规范化受支持的数据，从而减少自定义 ETL/后处理工作（[Security Lake features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security-lake/latest/userguide/what-is-security-lake.html)）。来源管理文档进一步确认，Security Lake 会运行 ETL 作业，将数据转换为 Parquet 和 OCSF，并将处理后的源数据存储在 AWS 账户中的 S3 bucket 中（[Source management in Security Lake](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/security-lake/latest/userguide/source-management.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS Lake Formation 可用于构建和保护通用数据湖，但使用 Glue crawlers 并为安全数据构建摄取管道，与专门构建的 Security Lake 解决方案相比，需要更多配置和开发工作。
- **B:** 收集 S3 中 CSV 文件的 Lambda 函数属于自定义开发，并且缺少 Security Lake 内置的多账户、多 Region 收集、规范化以及安全数据湖能力。
- **D:** AWS DMS 用于数据库迁移/复制工作负载，而不是集中收集和规范化安全日志与事件；它无法以最少工作量满足安全数据湖需求。

en.question: A company is migrating five on-premises applications to VPCs in the AWS Cloud. Each application is currently deployed in isolated virtual networks on premises and should be deployed similarly in the AWS Cloud. The applications need to reach a shared services VPC. All the applications must be able to communicate with each other. If the migration is successful, the company will repeat the migration process for more than 100 applications. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Deploy software VPN tunnels between the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC.
options.B: Deploy VPC peering connections between the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC through the peering connection.
options.C: Deploy an AWS Direct Connect connection between the application VPCs and the shared services VPAdd routes from the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC and the applications VPCs. Add routes from the shared services VPC subnets to the applications VPCs.
options.D: Deploy a transit gateway with associations between the transit gateway and the application VPCs and the shared services VPC. Add routes between the application VPCs in their subnets and the application VPCs to the shared services VPC through the transit gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Transit Gateway is the lowest-overhead design for many isolated application VPCs that must communicate with each other and with a shared-services VPC. AWS describes Transit Gateway as a network transit hub used to interconnect VPCs, with attachments for one or more VPCs and route tables that control traffic between attachments ([AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)). AWS also states that Transit Gateway provides a managed hub-and-spoke design, can connect thousands of VPCs, centralizes routing in one place, and simplifies management because VPCs connect only to the Transit Gateway to reach connected networks ([AWS Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)). The Well-Architected Framework explicitly recommends hub-and-spoke over many-to-many mesh for multiple VPCs because it reduces complexity and management overhead, and identifies Transit Gateway as the managed, scalable hub for this topology ([REL02-BP04](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2024-06-27/framework/rel_planning_network_topology_prefer_hub_and_spoke.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Software VPN tunnels would create unnecessary tunnel/overlay management between VPCs. AWS notes that Transit Gateway provides hub-and-spoke VPC connectivity with **no VPN overlay required** and AWS-managed scalability/availability ([Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)).
- **B:** VPC peering is a one-to-one relationship. AWS states that transitive peering is not supported; if VPC B and VPC C need to communicate through VPC A, that is not allowed, and a unique peering connection is required between them ([VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)). This becomes a high-overhead full mesh for 100+ VPCs.
- **C:** Direct Connect is for dedicated network connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and AWS, not for simplifying VPC-to-VPC connectivity among many AWS VPCs ([Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). It also would not by itself provide scalable inter-application VPC routing like a Transit Gateway hub.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将五个本地应用程序迁移到 AWS Cloud 中的 VPC。每个应用程序目前都部署在本地隔离的虚拟网络中，并且在 AWS Cloud 中也应以类似方式部署。这些应用程序需要访问一个共享服务 VPC。所有应用程序都必须能够相互通信。如果迁移成功，该公司将对 100 多个应用程序重复该迁移流程。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 在应用程序 VPC 和共享服务 VPC 之间部署软件 VPN 隧道。在其子网中添加应用程序 VPC 之间到共享服务 VPC 的路由。
options.B: 在应用程序 VPC 和共享服务 VPC 之间部署 VPC 对等连接。通过对等连接，在其子网中添加应用程序 VPC 之间到共享服务 VPC 的路由。
options.C: 在应用程序 VPC 和共享服务 VPAdd routes from the application VPCs in their subnets to the shared services VPC and the applications VPCs 之间部署 AWS Direct Connect 连接。添加从共享服务 VPC 子网到应用程序 VPC 的路由。
options.D: 部署一个 transit gateway，并在 transit gateway 与应用程序 VPC 以及共享服务 VPC 之间建立关联。通过 transit gateway，在应用程序 VPC 的子网中添加应用程序 VPC 之间的路由，以及应用程序 VPC 到共享服务 VPC 的路由。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** AWS Transit Gateway 是针对许多必须彼此通信并与共享服务 VPC 通信的隔离应用程序 VPC 的最低开销设计。AWS 将 Transit Gateway 描述为用于互连 VPC 的网络中转枢纽，具有一个或多个 VPC 的 attachments 以及用于控制 attachments 之间流量的 route tables（[AWS Transit Gateway overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/what-is-transit-gateway.html)）。AWS 还说明，Transit Gateway 提供托管的 hub-and-spoke 设计，可以连接数千个 VPC，将路由集中在一个位置，并简化管理，因为 VPC 只需连接到 Transit Gateway 即可访问已连接的网络（[AWS Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。Well-Architected Framework 明确建议在多个 VPC 场景中使用 hub-and-spoke，而不是 many-to-many mesh，因为它降低了复杂性和管理开销，并将 Transit Gateway 作为该拓扑的托管、可扩展枢纽（[REL02-BP04](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/wellarchitected/2024-06-27/framework/rel_planning_network_topology_prefer_hub_and_spoke.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 软件 VPN 隧道会在 VPC 之间产生不必要的隧道/覆盖网络管理。AWS 指出，Transit Gateway 提供 hub-and-spoke VPC 连接，**无需 VPN overlay**，并具备 AWS 托管的可扩展性/可用性（[Transit Gateway whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/transit-gateway.html)）。
- **B:** VPC peering 是一对一关系。AWS 声明不支持 transitive peering；如果 VPC B 和 VPC C 需要通过 VPC A 通信，这是不允许的，它们之间需要唯一的对等连接（[VPC peering basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/vpc-peering-basics.html)）。对于 100+ 个 VPC，这会变成高开销的全网状结构。
- **C:** Direct Connect 用于本地基础设施与 AWS 之间的专用网络连接，而不是用于简化多个 AWS VPC 之间的 VPC 到 VPC 连接（[Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。它本身也无法像 Transit Gateway 枢纽那样提供可扩展的应用程序间 VPC 路由。

en.question: A company wants to use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to run its on-premises application in a hybrid environment. The application currently runs on containers on premises. The company needs a single container solution that can scale in an on-premises, hybrid, or cloud environment. The company must run new application containers in the AWS Cloud and must use a load balancer for HTTP traffic. Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type for the cloud application containers. Use an Amazon ECS Anywhere external launch type for the on-premises application containers.
options.B: Set up an Application Load Balancer for cloud ECS services.
options.C: Set up a Network Load Balancer for cloud ECS services.
options.D: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the AWS Fargate launch type. Use Fargate for the cloud application containers and the on-premises application containers.
options.E: Set up an ECS cluster that uses the Amazon EC2 launch type for the cloud application containers. Use Amazon ECS Anywhere with an AWS Fargate launch type for the on-premises application containers.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and B**.

- **A is correct** because the cloud containers can run on Amazon ECS with **AWS Fargate**, which AWS describes as a way to run containers without managing EC2 instances or server clusters. For the on-premises part of the hybrid environment, **Amazon ECS Anywhere** supports registering an external instance such as an on-premises server or VM to an ECS cluster, and ECS provides the **`EXTERNAL` launch type** to run tasks or services on those external instances ([Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html), [ECS Anywhere external launch type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch-type-external.html)).
- **B is correct** because the requirement is a load balancer for **HTTP** traffic. AWS states that Application Load Balancers route at the application layer for **HTTP/HTTPS**, and ECS on Fargate supports Application Load Balancers ([ALB for ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/alb.html), [Fargate service load balancing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **C is incorrect** because a Network Load Balancer routes at the transport layer, such as TCP/SSL or TCP/UDP, not the preferred layer 7 HTTP/HTTPS routing required here ([NLB for ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/nlb.html)).
- **D is incorrect** because Fargate is for running ECS tasks without managing AWS compute infrastructure; on-premises servers/VMs are handled through ECS Anywhere external instances and the `EXTERNAL` launch type, not Fargate ([Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html), [ECS Anywhere external launch type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch-type-external.html)).
- **E is incorrect** because it incorrectly pairs ECS Anywhere with an AWS Fargate launch type for on-premises containers. ECS Anywhere uses external instances and the `EXTERNAL` launch type for on-premises servers/VMs ([ECS Anywhere external launch type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch-type-external.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 在混合环境中运行其本地应用程序。该应用程序目前在本地的容器上运行。公司需要一个单一的容器解决方案，能够在本地、混合或云环境中扩展。公司必须在 AWS Cloud 中运行新的应用程序容器，并且必须为 HTTP 流量使用负载均衡器。哪一组操作组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 设置一个使用 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 ECS 集群，用于云端应用程序容器。对本地应用程序容器使用 Amazon ECS Anywhere 外部启动类型。
options.B: 为云端 ECS 服务设置 Application Load Balancer。
options.C: 为云端 ECS 服务设置 Network Load Balancer。
options.D: 设置一个使用 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 ECS 集群。对云端应用程序容器和本地应用程序容器都使用 Fargate。
options.E: 设置一个使用 Amazon EC2 启动类型的 ECS 集群，用于云端应用程序容器。对本地应用程序容器使用带有 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon ECS Anywhere。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A 和 B**。

- **A 正确**，因为云端容器可以在使用 **AWS Fargate** 的 Amazon ECS 上运行，AWS 将其描述为一种无需管理 EC2 实例或服务器集群即可运行容器的方式。对于混合环境中的本地部分，**Amazon ECS Anywhere** 支持将外部实例（例如本地服务器或 VM）注册到 ECS 集群，并且 ECS 提供 **`EXTERNAL` 启动类型**，用于在这些外部实例上运行任务或服务（[Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)，[ECS Anywhere external launch type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch-type-external.html)）。
- **B 正确**，因为要求是为 **HTTP** 流量使用负载均衡器。AWS 说明 Application Load Balancers 在应用层路由 **HTTP/HTTPS**，并且 Fargate 上的 ECS 支持 Application Load Balancers（[ALB for ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/alb.html)，[Fargate service load balancing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。错误选项：

- **C 不正确**，因为 Network Load Balancer 在传输层进行路由，例如 TCP/SSL 或 TCP/UDP，而不是此处所需的首选第 7 层 HTTP/HTTPS 路由（[NLB for ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/nlb.html)）。
- **D 不正确**，因为 Fargate 用于在无需管理 AWS 计算基础设施的情况下运行 ECS 任务；本地服务器/VM 通过 ECS Anywhere 外部实例和 `EXTERNAL` 启动类型来处理，而不是通过 Fargate（[Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)，[ECS Anywhere external launch type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch-type-external.html)）。
- **E 不正确**，因为它错误地将 ECS Anywhere 与用于本地容器的 AWS Fargate 启动类型配对。ECS Anywhere 对本地服务器/VM 使用外部实例和 `EXTERNAL` 启动类型（[ECS Anywhere external launch type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/launch-type-external.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating its workloads to AWS. The company has sensitive and critical data in on-premises relational databases that run on SQL Server instances. The company wants to use the AWS Cloud to increase security and reduce operational overhead for the databases. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Migrate the databases to Amazon EC2 instances. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for encryption.
options.B: Migrate the databases to a Multi-AZ Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB instance. Use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for encryption.
options.C: Migrate the data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Macie to ensure data security.
options.D: Migrate the databases to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to ensure data security.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Migrating to **Amazon RDS for SQL Server Multi-AZ** best preserves the SQL Server relational database engine while reducing operations and improving resilience/security. AWS states that Amazon RDS is a managed database service responsible for most management tasks, including backups, software patching, automatic failure detection, and recovery; RDS also supports Microsoft SQL Server as a familiar database engine and can provide high availability with a synchronous secondary DB instance for failover ([Amazon RDS advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)). For SQL Server specifically, RDS supports Multi-AZ deployments using Database Mirroring or Always On Availability Groups as a high-availability failover solution, and AWS recommends Multi-AZ for production/preproduction SQL Server databases ([RDS for SQL Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_SQLServer.html), [SQL Server Multi-AZ recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_SQLServerMultiAZ.Recommendations.html)). RDS encryption uses AWS KMS, and encrypted DB instances can use either an AWS managed key or a customer managed key; if no customer managed key is specified, RDS uses the AWS managed key for RDS ([RDS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Running SQL Server on **Amazon EC2** can use KMS-based storage encryption, but it does **not** reduce operational overhead as much as RDS. AWS notes that with EC2 database deployments, customers still spend more time managing software and hardware, including OS and database software updates, whereas RDS management covers OS installation/patching, database installation/patching, backups, scaling, and high availability ([RDS responsibility comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
- **C:** Amazon S3 with Macie is not a relational SQL Server database platform. Macie is a data security service for discovering sensitive data and monitoring the security posture of an **Amazon S3 data estate**, not for running SQL Server relational databases ([Amazon Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)).
- **D:** DynamoDB is a NoSQL database, not a like-for-like migration target for SQL Server relational workloads. AWS distinguishes RDBMS design from NoSQL design and states that DynamoDB is a NoSQL database with different query and schema design characteristics ([DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)). CloudWatch Logs also does not make this a relational SQL Server migration solution.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其工作负载迁移到 AWS。该公司在本地运行于 SQL Server 实例上的关系数据库中存有敏感且关键的数据。该公司希望使用 AWS Cloud 来提高这些数据库的安全性并降低运营开销。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS 托管式密钥进行加密。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到 Multi-AZ Amazon RDS for SQL Server DB 实例。使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS 托管式密钥进行加密。
options.C: 将数据迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon Macie 来确保数据安全。
options.D: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB 表。使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 来确保数据安全。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

迁移到 **Amazon RDS for SQL Server Multi-AZ** 最能保留 SQL Server 关系数据库引擎，同时减少运维并提高弹性/安全性。AWS 说明，Amazon RDS 是一项托管式数据库服务，负责大多数管理任务，包括备份、软件修补、自动故障检测和恢复；RDS 还支持 Microsoft SQL Server 作为熟悉的数据库引擎，并且可以通过用于故障转移的同步辅助 DB 实例提供高可用性（[Amazon RDS advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。对于 SQL Server，RDS 专门支持使用 Database Mirroring 或 Always On Availability Groups 的 Multi-AZ 部署，作为高可用性故障转移解决方案，并且 AWS 建议对生产/预生产 SQL Server 数据库使用 Multi-AZ（[RDS for SQL Server](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_SQLServer.html)，[SQL Server Multi-AZ recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_SQLServerMultiAZ.Recommendations.html)）。RDS 加密使用 AWS KMS，加密的 DB 实例可以使用 AWS 托管式密钥或客户托管式密钥；如果未指定客户托管式密钥，RDS 将使用用于 RDS 的 AWS 托管式密钥（[RDS encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 在 **Amazon EC2** 上运行 SQL Server 可以使用基于 KMS 的存储加密，但它并不像 RDS 那样显著降低运营开销。AWS 指出，在 EC2 数据库部署中，客户仍然需要花费更多时间管理软件和硬件，包括 OS 和数据库软件更新；而 RDS 管理涵盖 OS 安装/修补、数据库安装/修补、备份、扩展和高可用性（[RDS responsibility comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
- **C:** 结合 Macie 的 Amazon S3 不是关系型 SQL Server 数据库平台。Macie 是一种数据安全服务，用于发现敏感数据并监控 **Amazon S3 data estate** 的安全态势，而不是用于运行 SQL Server 关系数据库（[Amazon Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)）。
- **D:** DynamoDB 是 NoSQL 数据库，并不是 SQL Server 关系型工作负载的同类迁移目标。AWS 区分 RDBMS 设计与 NoSQL 设计，并说明 DynamoDB 是一种 NoSQL 数据库，具有不同的查询和架构设计特征（[DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。CloudWatch Logs 也不会使其成为关系型 SQL Server 迁移解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to migrate an application to AWS. The company wants to increase the application's current availability. The company wants to use AWS WAF in the application's architecture. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Auto Scaling group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and set the Auto Scaling group as the target. Connect a WAF to the ALB.
options.B: Create a cluster placement group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that hosts the application. Configure an Application Load Balancer and set the EC2 instances as the targets. Connect a WAF to the placement group.
options.C: Create two Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure the EC2 instances as the targets of an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Connect a WAF to the ALB.
options.D: Create an Auto Scaling group that contains multiple Amazon EC2 instances that host the application across two Availability Zones. Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and set the Auto Scaling group as the target. Connect a WAF to the Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Option A provides the most available architecture among the choices: an Auto Scaling group can maintain instances across enabled Availability Zones—AWS documentation says Auto Scaling maintains an equal number of instances across enabled AZs and can launch in another healthy AZ if an AZ launch attempt fails, which supports AZ redundancy ([Auto Scaling group Availability Zone distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-availability-zone-balanced.html)). The ALB/Auto Scaling integration is also valid: when using an Application Load Balancer with an Auto Scaling group, you attach the ALB **target group**, and instances are automatically registered with the load balancer ([Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)). AWS WAF is correctly placed on the ALB because AWS WAF can protect regional resources including an **Application Load Balancer** ([Resources that you can protect with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** A cluster placement group is not the right availability pattern. AWS states that a cluster placement group is within a **single Availability Zone** and cannot span multiple AZs; it is intended for low-latency/high-throughput networking, not Multi-AZ high availability ([Placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)). Also, AWS WAF is not associated with placement groups; WAF protects supported resources such as ALBs.
- **C:** The WAF-to-ALB placement is valid, and two instances across two AZs improves redundancy, but there is no Auto Scaling group to maintain or replace instances automatically. Option A is more available because the Auto Scaling group manages capacity across AZs.
- **D:** The Auto Scaling and ALB portion is valid, but the WAF association is wrong. AWS WAF web ACLs protect supported resources such as Application Load Balancers; Auto Scaling groups are not listed as protectable WAF resources ([Resources that you can protect with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将一个应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司希望提高该应用程序当前的可用性。该公司希望在应用程序架构中使用 AWS WAF。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Auto Scaling group，其中包含多个跨两个 Availability Zones 托管该应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例。配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，并将 Auto Scaling group 设置为目标。将 WAF 连接到 ALB。
options.B: 创建一个 cluster placement group，其中包含多个托管该应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例。配置一个 Application Load Balancer，并将 EC2 实例设置为目标。将 WAF 连接到 placement group。
options.C: 创建两个跨两个 Availability Zones 托管该应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例。将这些 EC2 实例配置为 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的目标。将 WAF 连接到 ALB。
options.D: 创建一个 Auto Scaling group，其中包含多个跨两个 Availability Zones 托管该应用程序的 Amazon EC2 实例。配置一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，并将 Auto Scaling group 设置为目标。将 WAF 连接到 Auto Scaling group。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

选项 A 在这些选项中提供了最高可用性的架构：Auto Scaling group 可以在已启用的 Availability Zones 中维护实例——AWS 文档说明 Auto Scaling 会在已启用的 AZs 中维持相等数量的实例，并且如果某个 AZ 中的启动尝试失败，可以在另一个运行状况良好的 AZ 中启动实例，从而支持 AZ 冗余（[Auto Scaling group Availability Zone distribution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-availability-zone-balanced.html)）。ALB/Auto Scaling 集成也是有效的：将 Application Load Balancer 与 Auto Scaling group 结合使用时，需要附加 ALB **target group**，实例会自动注册到负载均衡器（[Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)）。AWS WAF 正确放置在 ALB 上，因为 AWS WAF 可以保护包括 **Application Load Balancer** 在内的区域性资源（[Resources that you can protect with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** cluster placement group 不是正确的可用性模式。AWS 指出，cluster placement group 位于**单个 Availability Zone** 内，不能跨多个 AZs；它用于低延迟/高吞吐量网络，而不是 Multi-AZ 高可用性（[Placement strategies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/placement-strategies.html)）。此外，AWS WAF 不与 placement groups 关联；WAF 保护的是受支持的资源，例如 ALBs。
- **C:** WAF 到 ALB 的放置是有效的，并且跨两个 AZs 的两个实例提高了冗余性，但没有 Auto Scaling group 来自动维护或替换实例。选项 A 可用性更高，因为 Auto Scaling group 会跨 AZs 管理容量。
- **D:** Auto Scaling 和 ALB 部分是有效的，但 WAF 关联是错误的。AWS WAF web ACLs 保护受支持的资源，例如 Application Load Balancers；Auto Scaling groups 未被列为可受 WAF 保护的资源（[Resources that you can protect with AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。

en.question: A company manages a data lake in an Amazon S3 bucket that numerous applications access. The S3 bucket contains a unique prefix for each application. The company wants to restrict each application to its specific prefix and to have granular control of the objects under each prefix. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create dedicated S3 access points and access point policies for each application.
options.B: Create an S3 Batch Operations job to set the ACL permissions for each object in the S3 bucket.
options.C: Replicate the objects in the S3 bucket to new S3 buckets for each application. Create replication rules by prefix.
options.D: Replicate the objects in the S3 bucket to new S3 buckets for each application. Create dedicated S3 access points for each application.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Create dedicated S3 access points and access point policies for each application.**

Amazon S3 access points are designed to simplify access to shared datasets for applications that store data in S3. AWS states that each access point has distinct permissions and network controls, and each endpoint enforces a customized access point policy to control access by resource, user, or conditions ([Managing access to shared datasets with access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html)). Access point policies can also scope object access to a prefix; AWS provides an example granting `GetObject` and `PutObject` only for objects under a specific prefix such as `Jane/*` through an access point ([Configuring IAM policies for using access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-policies.html)). This matches the requirement for one shared bucket with application-specific prefixes and granular control, with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** S3 Batch Operations with ACLs would require managing permissions at the object ACL level. AWS notes that Object Ownership disables ACLs by default, access is then managed exclusively by policies, and AWS recommends keeping ACLs disabled for most modern S3 use cases ([Configuring ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/managing-acls.html)). This is higher overhead and less appropriate than policies/access points.
- **C:** Replicating objects into separate buckets by prefix adds extra buckets and replication configuration. The data already has application-specific prefixes in a shared bucket, and access points can control access without copying the data.
- **D:** This combines the unnecessary replication overhead of option C with access points. Dedicated access points alone meet the requirement; replicating data first does not reduce operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中管理一个数据湖，许多应用程序都会访问该数据湖。该 S3 bucket 为每个应用程序包含一个唯一的前缀。公司希望将每个应用程序限制为只能访问其特定前缀，并对每个前缀下的对象进行精细化控制。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个应用程序创建专用的 S3 access points 和 access point policies。
options.B: 创建一个 S3 Batch Operations 作业，为 S3 bucket 中的每个对象设置 ACL 权限。
options.C: 将 S3 bucket 中的对象复制到每个应用程序的新 S3 bucket。按前缀创建复制规则。
options.D: 将 S3 bucket 中的对象复制到每个应用程序的新 S3 bucket。为每个应用程序创建专用的 S3 access points。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 为每个应用程序创建专用的 S3 access points 和 access point policies。**

Amazon S3 access points 旨在简化应用程序对存储在 S3 中的共享数据集的访问。AWS 表示，每个 access point 都具有不同的权限和网络控制，并且每个端点都会强制执行自定义的 access point policy，以按资源、用户或条件控制访问（[Managing access to shared datasets with access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html)）。Access point policies 还可以将对象访问范围限定到某个前缀；AWS 提供了一个示例，通过 access point 仅对特定前缀（例如 `Jane/*`）下的对象授予 `GetObject` 和 `PutObject`（[Configuring IAM policies for using access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points-policies.html)）。这与在一个共享 bucket 中使用应用程序特定前缀并进行精细化控制的要求相匹配，并且运营开销最少。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 使用 ACL 的 S3 Batch Operations 需要在对象 ACL 级别管理权限。AWS 指出，Object Ownership 默认禁用 ACL，随后访问将完全由策略管理，并且 AWS 建议在大多数现代 S3 使用场景中保持 ACL 禁用（[Configuring ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/managing-acls.html)）。与 policies/access points 相比，这种方式开销更高且不太合适。
- **C:** 按前缀将对象复制到单独的 buckets 会增加额外的 buckets 和复制配置。数据已经在共享 bucket 中具有应用程序特定的前缀，access points 可以在不复制数据的情况下控制访问。
- **D:** 该选项将选项 C 中不必要的复制开销与 access points 结合在一起。仅使用专用 access points 就能满足要求；先复制数据并不会减少运营开销。

en.question: A company has an application that customers use to upload images to an Amazon S3 bucket. Each night, the company launches an Amazon EC2 Spot Fleet that processes all the images that the company received that day. The processing for each image takes 2 minutes and requires 512 MB of memory. A solutions architect needs to change the application to process the images when the images are uploaded. Which change will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use S3 Event Notifications to write a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an AWS Lambda function to read the messages from the queue and to process the images.
options.B: Use S3 Event Notifications to write a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure an EC2 Reserved Instance to read the messages from the queue and to process the images.
options.C: Use S3 Event Notifications to publish a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure a container instance in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to subscribe to the topic and to process the images.
options.D: Use S3 Event Notifications to publish a message with image details to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application to subscribe to the topic and to process the images.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

S3 Event Notifications can be configured for **new object created** events, and Amazon S3 can send those notifications to **Amazon SQS queues** (as well as SNS, Lambda, or EventBridge) ([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)). Lambda can then process messages from an SQS queue: Lambda polls the queue, invokes the function with message batches, and deletes messages after successful processing ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)).

This workload also fits Lambda limits: each image takes 2 minutes and 512 MB, while Lambda supports **128 MB to 10,240 MB** memory and a **900-second / 15-minute** timeout ([Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html)). Lambda is cost-effective here because it is serverless, scales automatically, and uses pay-per-use pricing; AWS also explicitly lists automatic file processing when files are uploaded to S3 as a Lambda use case ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **B:** S3 to SQS is valid, but using an EC2 Reserved Instance means provisioning and managing an instance for asynchronous work. For event-driven per-upload processing, Lambda is a better fit because it avoids server management and scales/pay-per-use automatically.
* **C:** S3 to SNS is supported, but an ECS container instance introduces managed container/instance capacity for a small 2-minute task. This is less cost-effective and less directly aligned than an SQS buffer plus Lambda event source mapping.
* **D:** Elastic Beanstalk is an application platform, not the most cost-effective event-driven compute choice for short image-processing jobs. It would require maintaining application environment capacity, whereas Lambda can process S3-upload-driven work without managing servers.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，客户使用该应用程序将图像上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。每天晚上，公司会启动一个 Amazon EC2 Spot Fleet 来处理公司当天收到的所有图像。每张图像的处理需要 2 分钟，并需要 512 MB 内存。解决方案架构师需要更改该应用程序，使其在图像上传时处理图像。哪项更改能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 将包含图像详细信息的消息写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置 AWS Lambda 函数从队列读取消息并处理图像。
options.B: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 将包含图像详细信息的消息写入 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置 EC2 Reserved Instance 从队列读取消息并处理图像。
options.C: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 将包含图像详细信息的消息发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。配置 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 中的容器实例订阅该主题并处理图像。
options.D: 使用 S3 Event Notifications 将包含图像详细信息的消息发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。配置 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 应用程序订阅该主题并处理图像。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

可以为 **new object created** 事件配置 S3 Event Notifications，并且 Amazon S3 可以将这些通知发送到 **Amazon SQS queues**（以及 SNS、Lambda 或 EventBridge）([Amazon S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html))。然后，Lambda 可以处理来自 SQS 队列的消息：Lambda 轮询队列，使用消息批次调用函数，并在成功处理后删除消息 ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html))。此工作负载也符合 Lambda 限制：每张图像需要 2 分钟和 512 MB，而 Lambda 支持 **128 MB to 10,240 MB** 内存和 **900-second / 15-minute** 超时 ([Lambda quotas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/gettingstarted-limits.html))。Lambda 在这里具有成本效益，因为它是无服务器的、可自动扩展，并采用按使用量付费的定价；AWS 还明确将文件上传到 S3 时的自动文件处理列为 Lambda 使用案例 ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html))。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

* **B:** S3 到 SQS 是有效的，但使用 EC2 Reserved Instance 意味着需要为异步工作预置和管理实例。对于事件驱动的按上传处理，Lambda 更合适，因为它避免了服务器管理，并能自动扩展/按使用量付费。
* **C:** 支持 S3 到 SNS，但 ECS 容器实例会为一个小型 2 分钟任务引入托管容器/实例容量。与 SQS 缓冲区加 Lambda 事件源映射相比，这种方式成本效益较低，也不够直接匹配。
* **D:** Elastic Beanstalk 是应用程序平台，并不是短时图像处理作业最具成本效益的事件驱动计算选择。它需要维护应用程序环境容量，而 Lambda 可以在无需管理服务器的情况下处理由 S3 上传驱动的工作。

en.question: A company wants to improve the availability and performance of its hybrid application. The application consists of a stateful TCP-based workload hosted on Amazon EC2 instances in different AWS Regions and a stateless UDP-based workload hosted on premises. Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to improve availability and performance? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an accelerator using AWS Global Accelerator. Add the load balancers as endpoints.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an origin that uses Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to the load balancers.
options.C: Configure two Application Load Balancers in each Region. The first will route to the EC2 endpoints, and the second will route to the on-premises endpoints.
options.D: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints.
options.E: Configure a Network Load Balancer in each Region to address the EC2 endpoints. Configure an Application Load Balancer in each Region that routes to the on-premises endpoints.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and D**.

**A is correct** because AWS Global Accelerator is designed to improve both availability and performance for internet applications. A standard accelerator routes traffic over the AWS global network to the optimal regional endpoint based on health, client location, and configured policies, and its endpoints can be **Network Load Balancers** or **Application Load Balancers** in one or more Regions ([AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)). Global Accelerator listeners also support **TCP and UDP**, matching the workloads in the question ([Global Accelerator listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html)).

**D is correct** because these are TCP/UDP workloads, so Network Load Balancers are the appropriate load balancer type. NLB target groups support **TCP, UDP, TCP_UDP, TLS, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC**, operate at layer 4, and can route flows consistently to targets ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)). NLBs also support registering targets by IP address, including targets **outside the VPC**, which fits the on-premises UDP workload ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)). Placing NLB endpoints in each Region gives Global Accelerator regional endpoints to use for health-based, low-latency routing.

**B is incorrect** because CloudFront is for accelerating and caching web content served over HTTP; its origins are S3 buckets or HTTP servers, and objects are content served over HTTP ([CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). It is not the right service for generic stateful TCP and UDP workloads.

**C is incorrect** because Application Load Balancers operate at OSI layer 7 and route based on application-layer request content ([Application Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)). They are not appropriate for UDP and generic stateful TCP workloads.

**E is incorrect** because it uses an Application Load Balancer for the on-premises UDP workload. The UDP workload requires an NLB, not an ALB, because NLB target groups support UDP while ALBs are application-layer load balancers.

zh.question: 一家公司希望提高其混合应用程序的可用性和性能。该应用程序由托管在不同 AWS Regions 的 Amazon EC2 实例上的有状态、基于 TCP 的工作负载，以及托管在本地的无状态、基于 UDP 的工作负载组成。解决方案架构师应采取哪种操作组合来提高可用性和性能？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Global Accelerator 创建一个加速器。将负载均衡器添加为端点。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，其源站使用 Amazon Route 53 基于延迟的路由将请求路由到负载均衡器。
options.C: 在每个 Region 中配置两个 Application Load Balancers。第一个将路由到 EC2 端点，第二个将路由到本地端点。
options.D: 在每个 Region 中配置一个 Network Load Balancer 来处理 EC2 端点。在每个 Region 中配置一个 Network Load Balancer，用于路由到本地端点。
options.E: 在每个 Region 中配置一个 Network Load Balancer 来处理 EC2 端点。在每个 Region 中配置一个 Application Load Balancer，用于路由到本地端点。

zh.explanation:
正确选择是 **A 和 D**。

**A 是正确的**，因为 AWS Global Accelerator 旨在提高互联网应用程序的可用性和性能。标准加速器会根据运行状况、客户端位置和配置的策略，通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到最佳区域端点，并且其端点可以是一个或多个 Regions 中的 **Network Load Balancers** 或 **Application Load Balancers**（[AWS Global Accelerator overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)）。Global Accelerator 侦听器还支持 **TCP 和 UDP**，与题目中的工作负载相匹配（[Global Accelerator listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-listeners.html)）。

**D 是正确的**，因为这些是 TCP/UDP 工作负载，因此 Network Load Balancers 是合适的负载均衡器类型。NLB 目标组支持 **TCP, UDP, TCP_UDP, TLS, QUIC, and TCP_QUIC**，在第 4 层运行，并且可以将流量一致地路由到目标（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。NLB 还支持按 IP 地址注册目标，包括 **outside the VPC** 的目标，这适合本地 UDP 工作负载（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。在每个 Region 中放置 NLB 端点，可为 Global Accelerator 提供区域端点，以便进行基于运行状况的低延迟路由。

**B 是不正确的**，因为 CloudFront 用于加速和缓存通过 HTTP 提供的 Web 内容；其源站是 S3 存储桶或 HTTP 服务器，对象是通过 HTTP 提供的内容（[CloudFront overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。它不适用于通用的有状态 TCP 和 UDP 工作负载。

**C 是不正确的**，因为 Application Load Balancers 在 OSI 第 7 层运行，并基于应用层请求内容进行路由（[Application Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。它们不适用于 UDP 和通用的有状态 TCP 工作负载。

**E 是不正确的**，因为它对本地 UDP 工作负载使用了 Application Load Balancer。UDP 工作负载需要 NLB，而不是 ALB，因为 NLB 目标组支持 UDP，而 ALB 是应用层负载均衡器。

en.question: A company runs a self-managed Microsoft SQL Server on Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS). Daily snapshots are taken of the EBS volumes. Recently, all the company’s EBS snapshots were accidentally deleted while running a snapshot cleaning script that deletes all expired EBS snapshots. A solutions architect needs to update the architecture to prevent data loss without retaining EBS snapshots indefinitely. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Change the IAM policy of the user to deny EBS snapshot deletion.
options.B: Copy the EBS snapshots to another AWS Region after completing the snapshots daily.
options.C: Create a 7-day EBS snapshot retention rule in Recycle Bin and apply the rule for all snapshots.
options.D: Copy EBS snapshots to Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon EBS Recycle Bin is designed for this exact accidental-deletion scenario: it lets you restore accidentally deleted EBS snapshots, and deleted resources that match a retention rule are retained for a specified period before permanent deletion ([Recover deleted EBS volumes, EBS snapshots, and EBS-backed AMIs with Recycle Bin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)). A Region-level retention rule can apply to all snapshots in the Region, and EBS snapshot retention periods can be 1–365 days, so a 7-day rule provides a limited recovery window without retaining snapshots indefinitely ([How does Recycle Bin work?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-concepts.html); [Create a Recycle Bin retention rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-create-rule.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Deny EBS snapshot deletion:** This could prevent the cleanup process from deleting expired snapshots at all, causing indefinite retention and operational issues. It also does not provide a controlled recovery window like Recycle Bin.
- **B. Copy snapshots to another Region:** AWS documents cross-Region snapshot copies as useful for disaster recovery/data redundancy, but copying snapshots to a new Region creates full, non-incremental copies and adds cost/operational overhead ([Copy an Amazon EBS snapshot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-copy-snapshot.html)). It is not the least-effort way to protect against accidental local deletion when Recycle Bin is available.
- **D. Copy EBS snapshots to S3 Standard-IA:** EBS snapshots are managed by EBS; the documented snapshot copy mechanism is copying snapshots as EBS snapshots, not manually copying them to an S3 storage class. This option would require extra development/architecture and is not the native solution.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 上运行自主管理的 Microsoft SQL Server。该公司每天都会对 EBS 卷创建快照。最近，在运行一个用于删除所有过期 EBS 快照的快照清理脚本时，该公司的所有 EBS 快照都被意外删除了。解决方案架构师需要更新架构，以防止数据丢失，同时又不无限期保留 EBS 快照。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 更改用户的 IAM policy，以拒绝删除 EBS 快照。
options.B: 每天完成快照创建后，将 EBS 快照复制到另一个 AWS Region。
options.C: 在 Recycle Bin 中创建一条 7 天的 EBS 快照保留规则，并将该规则应用于所有快照。
options.D: 将 EBS 快照复制到 Amazon S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.** Amazon EBS Recycle Bin 正是为这种意外删除场景而设计的：它允许你恢复意外删除的 EBS 快照，并且与保留规则匹配的已删除资源会在永久删除前保留指定时间段（[Recover deleted EBS volumes, EBS snapshots, and EBS-backed AMIs with Recycle Bin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin.html)）。Region 级别的保留规则可以应用于该 Region 中的所有快照，并且 EBS 快照保留期可以是 1–365 天，因此 7 天规则可以提供一个有限的恢复窗口，而不会无限期保留快照（[How does Recycle Bin work?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-concepts.html)；[Create a Recycle Bin retention rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/recycle-bin-create-rule.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Deny EBS snapshot deletion:** 这可能会阻止清理流程删除过期快照，从而导致无限期保留和运维问题。它也不像 Recycle Bin 那样提供受控的恢复窗口。
- **B. Copy snapshots to another Region:** AWS 文档说明跨 Region 快照复制可用于灾难恢复/数据冗余，但将快照复制到新的 Region 会创建完整的非增量副本，并增加成本和运维开销（[Copy an Amazon EBS snapshot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-copy-snapshot.html)）。在 Recycle Bin 可用的情况下，这并不是防止本地意外删除的最低工作量方式。
- **D. Copy EBS snapshots to S3 Standard-IA:** EBS 快照由 EBS 管理；文档化的快照复制机制是将快照作为 EBS 快照进行复制，而不是手动将其复制到某个 S3 存储类。此选项需要额外的开发/架构工作，并不是原生解决方案。

en.question: A company wants to use an AWS CloudFormation stack for its application in a test environment. The company stores the CloudFormation template in an Amazon S3 bucket that blocks public access. The company wants to grant CloudFormation access to the template in the S3 bucket based on specific user requests to create the test environment. The solution must follow security best practices. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the S3 object URL.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API that has the S3 bucket as the target. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the API Gateway URL.
options.C: Create a presigned URL for the template object. Configure the CloudFormation stack to use the presigned URL.
options.D: Allow public access to the template object in the S3 bucket. Block the public access after the test environment is created.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

CloudFormation stack creation can use `TemplateURL`; AWS states that this parameter is the URL of the file containing the template body and that the URL must point to a template located in an Amazon S3 bucket or Systems Manager document, with S3 locations using `https://` URLs ([CreateStack API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStack.html)). For a private S3 object, an S3 presigned URL is the appropriate request-specific access mechanism: S3 objects are private by default, and the object owner can share an object by creating a presigned URL that uses the creator’s security credentials to grant **time-limited** permission to download the object ([Sharing objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)). AWS also notes that the presigned URL’s capabilities are limited by the permissions of the user who created it and that it remains valid only for the specified period ([Download and upload objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)). This meets the requirement to grant CloudFormation access based on specific user requests without making the bucket public.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An S3 gateway VPC endpoint is for accessing S3 **from your VPC** over the AWS network ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)). It does not by itself grant the CloudFormation service access to a private S3 template object for a user-requested stack creation.
- **B:** CloudFormation `TemplateURL` must point to a template in an S3 bucket or Systems Manager document, not an arbitrary API Gateway URL ([CreateStack API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStack.html)). Adding API Gateway is unnecessary and does not solve S3 object authorization for CloudFormation.
- **D:** Temporarily allowing public access violates S3 security best practices. AWS recommends ensuring S3 buckets are not publicly accessible unless explicitly required and using S3 Block Public Access ([S3 security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望在测试环境中为其应用程序使用 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈。该公司将 CloudFormation 模板存储在一个阻止公有访问的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司希望基于特定用户创建测试环境的请求，授予 CloudFormation 对 S3 存储桶中模板的访问权限。该解决方案必须遵循安全最佳实践。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Amazon S3 创建一个 gateway VPC endpoint。配置 CloudFormation 堆栈使用 S3 对象 URL。
options.B: 创建一个以 S3 存储桶为目标的 Amazon API Gateway REST API。配置 CloudFormation 堆栈使用 API Gateway URL。
options.C: 为模板对象创建一个预签名 URL。配置 CloudFormation 堆栈使用该预签名 URL。
options.D: 允许对 S3 存储桶中的模板对象进行公有访问。在测试环境创建完成后阻止公有访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

CloudFormation 堆栈创建可以使用 `TemplateURL`；AWS 说明该参数是包含模板正文的文件的 URL，并且该 URL 必须指向位于 Amazon S3 存储桶或 Systems Manager 文档中的模板，其中 S3 位置使用 `https://` URLs（[CreateStack API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStack.html)）。对于私有 S3 对象，S3 预签名 URL 是适用于特定请求的访问机制：S3 对象默认是私有的，对象拥有者可以通过创建预签名 URL 来共享对象，该 URL 使用创建者的安全凭证授予下载对象的**限时**权限（[Sharing objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ShareObjectPreSignedURL.html)）。AWS 还指出，预签名 URL 的能力受创建该 URL 的用户权限限制，并且仅在指定期限内有效（[Download and upload objects with presigned URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/using-presigned-url.html)）。这满足了基于特定用户请求授予 CloudFormation 访问权限的要求，同时不会将存储桶设为公有。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** S3 gateway VPC endpoint 用于通过 AWS 网络**从你的 VPC**访问 S3（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。它本身并不会为用户请求的堆栈创建授予 CloudFormation 服务对私有 S3 模板对象的访问权限。
