- **B:** CloudFormation `TemplateURL` 必须指向 S3 存储桶或 Systems Manager 文档中的模板，而不是任意 API Gateway URL（[CreateStack API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_CreateStack.html)）。添加 API Gateway 是不必要的，也不能解决 CloudFormation 对 S3 对象的授权问题。
- **D:** 临时允许公有访问违反 S3 安全最佳实践。AWS 建议确保 S3 存储桶不会被公有访问，除非明确需要，并建议使用 S3 Block Public Access（[S3 security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security-best-practices.html)）。

en.question: A company has applications that run in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company outsources operational support of the applications. The company needs to provide access for the external support engineers without compromising security. The external support engineers need access to the AWS Management Console. The external support engineers also need operating system access to the company’s fleet ofAmazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux in private subnets. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST securely?

options.A: Confirm that AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) is installed on all instances. Assign an instance profile with the necessary policy to connect to Systems Manager. Use AWS IAM Identity Center to provide the external support engineers console access. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to assign the required permissions.
options.B: Confirm that AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) is installed on all instances. Assign an instance profile with the necessary policy to connect to Systems Manager. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to provide local IAM user credentials in each AWS account to the external support engineers for console access.
options.C: Confirm that all instances have a security group that allows SSH access only from the external support engineers’ source IP address ranges. Provide local IAM user credentials in each AWS account to the external support engineers for console access. Provide each external support engineer an SSH key pair to log in to the application instances.
options.D: Create a bastion host in a public subnet. Set up the bastion host security group to allow access from only the external engineers’ IP address ranges. Ensure that all instances have a security group that allows SSH access from the bastion host. Provide each external support engineer an SSH key pair to log in to the application instances. Provide local account IAM user credentials to the engineers for console access.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

This is the most secure solution because it uses centralized, federated console access plus Systems Manager Session Manager for OS access to private EC2 instances.

* Session Manager is designed for secure access to EC2 managed nodes and supports Linux. Its prerequisites include having **SSM Agent installed** on the managed nodes and the required Systems Manager permissions; AWS notes that `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` provides the required permissions for Session Manager in the relevant role/profile context ([Session Manager prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-prerequisites.html)).
* Session Manager improves security because it provides **centralized access control using IAM policies**, requires **no open inbound ports**, and removes the need to manage **SSH keys, bastion hosts, and jump boxes** ([Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)).
* IAM Identity Center is the appropriate way to give external support engineers AWS account/console access. AWS recommends that human users, including external collaborators, use federation and temporary credentials, and recommends IAM Identity Center for centralized access management ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). IAM Identity Center also provides one place to assign permissions to users/groups across multiple AWS accounts in an organization ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)) and uses permission sets for account access assignments ([Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B** uses Session Manager for instance access, but it provides **local IAM user credentials in each AWS account** for console access. That conflicts with AWS best practice to require human users to use federated access with temporary credentials and to use IAM Identity Center for centralized account access.
* **C** opens SSH access to instances and distributes SSH key pairs. Session Manager documentation explicitly says open inbound SSH ports increase risk and that Session Manager lets you close inbound ports and avoid managing SSH keys.
* **D** uses a bastion host and SSH keys. Session Manager removes the need to manage bastion hosts, jump boxes, and SSH keys, so this has a larger operational and security footprint than option A. It also uses local IAM users instead of centralized federated access.

zh.question: 一家公司有一些应用程序运行在 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织内。该公司将这些应用程序的运营支持外包。公司需要在不影响安全性的情况下为外部支持工程师提供访问权限。外部支持工程师需要访问 AWS Management Console。外部支持工程师还需要对公司在私有子网中运行 Amazon Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例机群进行操作系统访问。哪种解决方案能够以最安全的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 确认所有实例上都已安装 AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent)。分配一个具有连接到 Systems Manager 所需策略的实例配置文件。使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 为外部支持工程师提供控制台访问权限。使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 分配所需权限。
options.B: 确认所有实例上都已安装 AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent)。分配一个具有连接到 Systems Manager 所需策略的实例配置文件。使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 在每个 AWS 账户中向外部支持工程师提供本地 IAM 用户凭证以用于控制台访问。
options.C: 确认所有实例都有一个安全组，该安全组仅允许来自外部支持工程师源 IP 地址范围的 SSH 访问。在每个 AWS 账户中向外部支持工程师提供本地 IAM 用户凭证以用于控制台访问。为每位外部支持工程师提供一个 SSH 密钥对，用于登录应用程序实例。
options.D: 在公有子网中创建一个堡垒主机。设置堡垒主机安全组，使其仅允许来自外部工程师 IP 地址范围的访问。确保所有实例都有一个安全组，允许来自堡垒主机的 SSH 访问。为每位外部支持工程师提供一个 SSH 密钥对，用于登录应用程序实例。向工程师提供本地账户 IAM 用户凭证以用于控制台访问。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

这是最安全的解决方案，因为它使用集中式、联合的控制台访问，并使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 对私有 EC2 实例进行 OS 访问。

* Session Manager 专为安全访问 EC2 托管节点而设计，并支持 Linux。其先决条件包括在托管节点上安装 **SSM Agent**，以及具备所需的 Systems Manager 权限；AWS 指出，`AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 在相关角色/配置文件上下文中为 Session Manager 提供所需权限（[Session Manager prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-prerequisites.html)）。
* Session Manager 提高了安全性，因为它提供**使用 IAM policies 的集中式访问控制**，**无需打开入站端口**，并且不再需要管理 **SSH keys、bastion hosts 和 jump boxes**（[Session Manager benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager.html)）。
* IAM Identity Center 是为外部支持工程师提供 AWS 账户/控制台访问权限的适当方式。AWS 建议包括外部协作者在内的人类用户使用联合身份和临时凭证，并建议使用 IAM Identity Center 进行集中式访问管理（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。IAM Identity Center 还提供一个位置，用于在组织中的多个 AWS 账户之间向用户/组分配权限（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)），并使用权限集进行账户访问分配（[Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

* **B** 使用 Session Manager 进行实例访问，但它为控制台访问在每个 AWS 账户中提供**本地 IAM 用户凭证**。这与 AWS 最佳实践相冲突，后者要求人类用户使用带临时凭证的联合访问，并使用 IAM Identity Center 进行集中式账户访问。
* **C** 向实例开放 SSH 访问并分发 SSH 密钥对。Session Manager 文档明确说明，开放入站 SSH 端口会增加风险，而 Session Manager 使你能够关闭入站端口并避免管理 SSH 密钥。
* **D** 使用堡垒主机和 SSH 密钥。Session Manager 消除了管理堡垒主机、跳板机和 SSH 密钥的需要，因此与选项 A 相比，它具有更大的运维和安全负担。它还使用本地 IAM 用户，而不是集中式联合访问。

en.question: A company uses Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL to run its applications in the us-east-1 Region. The company also uses machine learning (ML) models to forecast annual revenue based on near real-time reports. The reports are generated by using the same RDS for PostgreSQL database. The database performance slows during business hours. The company needs to improve database performance. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create a cross-Region read replica. Configure the reports to be generated from the read replica.
options.B: Activate Multi-AZ DB instance deployment for RDS for PostgreSQL. Configure the reports to be generated from the standby database.
options.C: Use AWS Data Migration Service (AWS DMS) to logically replicate data to a new database. Configure the reports to be generated from the new database.
options.D: Create a read replica in us-east-1. Configure the reports to be generated from the read replica.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** The workload causing contention is reporting/ML read activity against the production RDS for PostgreSQL database in **us-east-1**. AWS states that RDS for PostgreSQL can scale reads by adding read replicas, and RDS read replicas are specifically appropriate for **business reporting** queries so those queries run against a read replica instead of the production DB instance ([RDS for PostgreSQL read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.html), [RDS read replica use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). Creating the replica in the same Region as the source satisfies the need to offload near-real-time reporting reads without adding unnecessary cross-Region architecture.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** A cross-Region read replica can serve reads, but the application and database are already in **us-east-1**. Cross-Region replicas are for cases such as geographical distribution or DR, which is not required here, so this is not the most cost-effective choice ([cross-Region PostgreSQL read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.Xregion.html)).
- **B:** A standard Multi-AZ DB instance deployment provides high availability with a synchronous standby, but AWS explicitly says it is **not a scaling solution for read-only scenarios** and that a standby replica **can’t serve read traffic**; use a read replica instead ([Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)).
- **C:** AWS DMS replication to a new database would add migration/replication infrastructure and operational complexity. Native RDS read replicas are the documented RDS feature for offloading reporting reads from the production DB instance, making DMS unnecessary for this requirement ([RDS read replica use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 us-east-1 Region 使用 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 运行其应用程序。该公司还使用机器学习 (ML) 模型，基于近实时报告来预测年度收入。这些报告使用同一个 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库生成。在业务时间内，数据库性能会变慢。公司需要提高数据库性能。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建跨 Region 只读副本。配置报告从该只读副本生成。
options.B: 为 RDS for PostgreSQL 激活 Multi-AZ DB instance 部署。配置报告从备用数据库生成。
options.C: 使用 AWS Data Migration Service (AWS DMS) 将数据逻辑复制到一个新数据库。配置报告从该新数据库生成。
options.D: 在 us-east-1 中创建只读副本。配置报告从该只读副本生成。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 导致资源争用的工作负载是针对 **us-east-1** 中生产 RDS for PostgreSQL 数据库的报告/ML 读取活动。AWS 说明，RDS for PostgreSQL 可以通过添加只读副本来扩展读取能力，并且 RDS 只读副本特别适用于**业务报告**查询，使这些查询在只读副本上运行，而不是在生产 DB instance 上运行（[RDS for PostgreSQL read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.html)，[RDS read replica use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。在与源相同的 Region 中创建副本，可以满足卸载近实时报告读取的需求，而无需增加不必要的跨 Region 架构。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **A:** 跨 Region 只读副本可以承担读取，但应用程序和数据库已经位于 **us-east-1**。跨 Region 副本适用于地理分布或 DR 等场景，而这里不需要这些，因此这不是最具成本效益的选择（[cross-Region PostgreSQL read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_PostgreSQL.Replication.ReadReplicas.Xregion.html)）。
- **B:** 标准 Multi-AZ DB instance 部署通过同步备用实例提供高可用性，但 AWS 明确说明它**不是只读场景的扩展解决方案**，并且备用副本**不能承担读取流量**；应改用只读副本（[Multi-AZ DB instance deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html)）。
- **C:** 使用 AWS DMS 复制到新数据库会增加迁移/复制基础设施和运维复杂性。原生 RDS 只读副本是有文档说明的 RDS 功能，用于从生产 DB instance 卸载报告读取，因此对于此需求不需要 DMS（[RDS read replica use cases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts its multi-tier, public web application in the AWS Cloud. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances, and its database runs on Amazon RDS. The company is anticipating a large increase in sales during an upcoming holiday weekend. A solutions architect needs to build a solution to analyze the performance of the web application with a granularity of no more than 2 minutes. What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?

options.A: Send Amazon CloudWatch logs to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon QuickS ght to perform further analysis.
options.B: Enable detailed monitoring on all EC2 instances. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to perform further analysis.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to fetch EC2 logs from Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to perform further analysis.
options.D: Send EC2 logs to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Redshift to fetch logs from the S3 bucket to process raw data for further analysis with Amazon QuickSight.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** Enabling detailed monitoring on the EC2 instances provides EC2 metrics in **1-minute periods**, which satisfies the requirement to analyze application performance with granularity of no more than 2 minutes. AWS also notes that basic monitoring provides most EC2 metrics only in **5-minute periods**, while detailed monitoring provides **1-minute** CloudWatch metrics and can be enabled for running or stopped instances ([AWS EC2 detailed monitoring](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/manage-detailed-monitoring.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Sending CloudWatch Logs to Redshift and analyzing with QuickSight is a log analytics/data warehousing approach, not the native EC2 performance metric solution. It does not directly provide the required EC2 metric granularity.
- **C:** A Lambda function fetching EC2 logs from CloudWatch Logs adds unnecessary custom processing and still focuses on logs, not EC2 CloudWatch performance metrics at 1-minute granularity.
- **D:** Sending EC2 logs to S3 and processing them with Redshift/QuickSight is also unnecessary and log-oriented. It does not address the requirement as directly as enabling EC2 detailed monitoring, which AWS documents as providing 1-minute metric periods.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中托管其多层公共 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，其数据库运行在 Amazon RDS 上。公司预计在即将到来的假日周末销售额会大幅增加。解决方案架构师需要构建一个解决方案，以不超过 2 分钟的粒度分析 Web 应用程序的性能。解决方案架构师应如何满足此要求？

options.A: 将 Amazon CloudWatch 日志发送到 Amazon Redshift。使用 Amazon QuickS ght 执行进一步分析。
options.B: 在所有 EC2 实例上启用详细监控。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标执行进一步分析。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，从 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 获取 EC2 日志。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标执行进一步分析。
options.D: 将 EC2 日志发送到 Amazon S3。使用 Amazon Redshift 从 S3 存储桶获取日志，以处理原始数据并使用 Amazon QuickSight 进行进一步分析。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 在 EC2 实例上启用详细监控可提供以 **1 分钟周期**生成的 EC2 指标，这满足以不超过 2 分钟的粒度分析应用程序性能的要求。AWS 还指出，基本监控仅以 **5 分钟周期**提供大多数 EC2 指标，而详细监控提供 **1 分钟**的 CloudWatch 指标，并且可为正在运行或已停止的实例启用（[AWS EC2 detailed monitoring](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/manage-detailed-monitoring.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 将 CloudWatch Logs 发送到 Redshift 并使用 QuickSight 进行分析是一种日志分析/数据仓库方法，而不是原生的 EC2 性能指标解决方案。它不能直接提供所需的 EC2 指标粒度。
- **C:** 使用 Lambda 函数从 CloudWatch Logs 获取 EC2 日志会增加不必要的自定义处理，并且仍然关注日志，而不是 1 分钟粒度的 EC2 CloudWatch 性能指标。
- **D:** 将 EC2 日志发送到 S3 并使用 Redshift/QuickSight 处理它们同样是不必要的，并且以日志为导向。它不如启用 EC2 详细监控那样直接满足该要求，AWS 文档说明该监控可提供 1 分钟的指标周期。

en.question: A company runs an application that stores and shares photos. Users upload the photos to an Amazon S3 bucket. Every day, users upload approximately 150 photos. The company wants to design a solution that creates a thumbnail of each new photo and stores the thumbnail in a second S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke a script every minute on a long-running Amazon EMR cluster. Configure the script to generate thumbnails for the photos that do not have thumbnails. Configure the script to upload the thumbnails to the second S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to invoke a script every minute on a memory- optimized Amazon EC2 instance that is always on. Configure the script to generate thumbnails for the photos that do not have thumbnails. Configure the script to upload the thumbnails to the second S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure an S3 event notification to invoke an AWS Lambda function each time a user uploads a new photo to the application. Configure the Lambda function to generate a thumbnail and to upload the thumbnail to the second S3 bucket.
options.D: Configure S3 Storage Lens to invoke an AWS Lambda function each time a user uploads a new photo to the application. Configure the Lambda function to generate a thumbnail and to upload the thumbnail to a second S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon S3 event notifications support **new object created events** and can send those notifications directly to an **AWS Lambda function**. That matches the requirement to process each newly uploaded photo immediately. Lambda is also appropriate and cost-effective for a low-volume, event-driven workload because AWS manages the compute infrastructure, capacity provisioning, and automatic scaling, and the function runs only when triggered by the S3 event. The S3 documentation also notes that using two buckets avoids a notification loop when a Lambda function writes output objects, which fits storing thumbnails in a second bucket ([S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html), [AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A long-running EMR cluster invoked every minute is excessive for about 150 photos per day. EMR is for distributed big data processing, and keeping a cluster running/scheduled for this small per-object task is not the most cost-effective approach compared with an event-driven Lambda function.
- **B:** An always-on EC2 instance also incurs continuous compute cost and requires server/OS management. Lambda is serverless and event-driven; AWS manages the underlying compute resources and scaling ([AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)).
- **D:** S3 Storage Lens is for publishing S3 **usage and activity metrics** to CloudWatch for operational visibility, not for invoking Lambda on each object upload. S3 event notifications—not Storage Lens—are the feature that supports new-object-created notifications to Lambda ([S3 Storage Lens metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/metrics-dimensions.html), [S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运行一个用于存储和共享照片的应用程序。用户将照片上传到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。每天，用户大约上传 150 张照片。公司希望设计一个解决方案，为每张新照片创建缩略图，并将缩略图存储在第二个 S3 存储桶中。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一条 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，在一个长期运行的 Amazon EMR 集群上每分钟调用一次脚本。配置该脚本为没有缩略图的照片生成缩略图。配置该脚本将缩略图上传到第二个 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 配置一条 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，在一台始终开启的内存优化型 Amazon EC2 实例上每分钟调用一次脚本。配置该脚本为没有缩略图的照片生成缩略图。配置该脚本将缩略图上传到第二个 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 配置 S3 事件通知，使其在用户每次向应用程序上传新照片时调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数生成缩略图，并将缩略图上传到第二个 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 配置 S3 Storage Lens，使其在用户每次向应用程序上传新照片时调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数生成缩略图，并将缩略图上传到第二个 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon S3 事件通知支持**新对象创建事件**，并且可以将这些通知直接发送到 **AWS Lambda function**。这符合立即处理每张新上传照片的要求。对于低容量、事件驱动型工作负载，Lambda 也很合适且具有成本效益，因为 AWS 会管理计算基础设施、容量预置和自动扩展，并且函数仅在由 S3 事件触发时运行。S3 文档还指出，当 Lambda 函数写入输出对象时，使用两个存储桶可以避免通知循环，这也符合将缩略图存储在第二个存储桶中的做法（[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)，[AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 对于每天大约 150 张照片，每分钟调用一次长期运行的 EMR 集群过于冗余。EMR 用于分布式大数据处理，而为这种小规模的逐对象任务保持集群运行/按计划调用，与事件驱动的 Lambda 函数相比，并不是最具成本效益的方法。
- **B:** 始终开启的 EC2 实例也会产生持续的计算成本，并且需要服务器/OS 管理。Lambda 是无服务器且事件驱动的；AWS 管理底层计算资源和扩展（[AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。
- **D:** S3 Storage Lens 用于将 S3 **使用情况和活动指标**发布到 CloudWatch，以提供运营可见性，而不是在每次对象上传时调用 Lambda。支持向 Lambda 发送新对象创建通知的功能是 S3 事件通知，而不是 Storage Lens（[S3 Storage Lens metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/metrics-dimensions.html)，[S3 Event Notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/EventNotifications.html)）。

en.question: A company has stored millions of objects across multiple prefixes in an Amazon S3 bucket by using the Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class. The company needs to delete all data older than 3 years except for a subset of data that must be retained. The company has identified the data that must be retained and wants to implement a serverless solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use S3 Inventory to list all objects. Use the AWS CLI to create a script that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance that deletes objects from the inventory list.
options.B: Use AWS Batch to delete objects older than 3 years except for the data that must be retained.
options.C: Provision an AWS Glue crawler to query objects older than 3 years. Save the manifest file of old objects. Create a script to delete objects in the manifest.
options.D: Enable S3 Inventory. Create an AWS Lambda function to filter and delete objects. Invoke the Lambda function with S3 Batch Operations to delete objects by using the inventory reports.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

S3 Inventory is appropriate because it produces scheduled reports that list objects and metadata, including **key name**, **last modified date**, and **storage class** (including `DEEP_ARCHIVE`), which can identify objects older than 3 years while excluding the retained subset ([S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html)). S3 Batch Operations is designed for large-scale operations on lists of S3 objects, can use an **S3 Inventory report as a manifest**, and can process up to billions of objects ([S3 Batch Operations basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html)). It also supports **Invoke AWS Lambda function** and is described as a fully managed, auditable, serverless experience ([supported operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops-operations.html)). A Lambda function can apply the retain/delete logic and delete the qualifying objects, meeting the serverless requirement.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Uses EC2 to run a CLI script, so it is not serverless and is less suitable for millions of objects.
- **B:** AWS Batch is for batch compute jobs; the option does not use S3 Inventory/manifest-driven S3 Batch Operations and is not the most direct S3-native serverless approach.
- **C:** AWS Glue crawlers catalog data schemas/metadata for analytics workflows; this option still requires a custom deletion script and does not use the S3-native bulk object operation mechanism.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 存储类，在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶的多个前缀中存储了数百万个对象。该公司需要删除所有超过 3 年的数据，但必须保留的一部分数据除外。该公司已经确定了必须保留的数据，并希望实施一个无服务器解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 S3 Inventory 列出所有对象。使用 AWS CLI 创建一个脚本，在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行该脚本，以从清单列表中删除对象。
options.B: 使用 AWS Batch 删除超过 3 年的对象，但必须保留的数据除外。
options.C: 预置一个 AWS Glue 爬网程序来查询超过 3 年的对象。保存旧对象的清单文件。创建一个脚本来删除清单中的对象。
options.D: 启用 S3 Inventory。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来筛选和删除对象。使用 S3 Batch Operations 调用 Lambda 函数，通过清单报告删除对象。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

S3 Inventory 是合适的，因为它会生成计划报告，列出对象和元数据，包括 **key name**、**last modified date** 和 **storage class**（包括 `DEEP_ARCHIVE`），这些信息可以在排除保留子集的同时识别超过 3 年的对象（[S3 Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-inventory.html)）。S3 Batch Operations 专为对 S3 对象列表执行大规模操作而设计，可以使用 **S3 Inventory report as a manifest**，并且可以处理多达数十亿个对象（[S3 Batch Operations basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops.html)）。它还支持 **Invoke AWS Lambda function**，并被描述为一种完全托管、可审计的无服务器体验（[supported operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/batch-ops-operations.html)）。Lambda 函数可以应用保留/删除逻辑并删除符合条件的对象，从而满足无服务器要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 使用 EC2 运行 CLI 脚本，因此它不是无服务器，并且不太适合处理数百万个对象。
- **B:** AWS Batch 用于批处理计算作业；该选项没有使用 S3 Inventory/manifest-driven S3 Batch Operations，也不是最直接的 S3 原生无服务器方法。
- **C:** AWS Glue 爬网程序用于为分析工作流编目数据架构/元数据；该选项仍然需要自定义删除脚本，并且没有使用 S3 原生的批量对象操作机制。

en.question: A company is building an application on AWS. The application uses multiple AWS Lambda functions to retrieve sensitive data from a single Amazon S3 bucket for processing. The company must ensure that only authorized Lambda functions can access the data. The solution must comply with the principle of least privilege. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Grant full S3 bucket access to all Lambda functions through a shared IAM role.
options.B: Configure the Lambda functions to run within a VPC. Configure a bucket policy to grant access based on the Lambda functions' VPC endpoint IP addresses.
options.C: Create individual IAM roles for each Lambda function. Grant the IAM roles access to the S3 bucket. Assign each IAM role as the Lambda execution role for its corresponding Lambda function.
options.D: Configure a bucket policy granting access to the Lambda functions based on their function ARNs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Lambda functions get permissions to access other AWS services through their **execution role**. AWS states that when a function is invoked, Lambda assumes the function's execution role and receives the permissions in that role's policy; Lambda also recommends granting only the permissions required, the principle of least privilege ([Lambda permissions and roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-basics.html)). Creating **individual IAM roles** for the functions lets the company scope each role to only the required `s3:GetObject` access for the specific bucket or prefixes. AWS's Lambda/S3 example also shows creating a custom permissions policy for S3 access and attaching it to a Lambda execution role ([Create a permissions policy / execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3-example.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** A shared role with **full S3 bucket access** violates least privilege and would allow all functions the same broad permissions, regardless of need.
- **B:** Running Lambda in a VPC does not by itself authorize S3 access. IP/VPC-endpoint-based controls are network conditions, not the primary least-privilege identity control for a Lambda function's access to AWS services. Lambda still uses an execution role for AWS service permissions ([Lambda permissions and roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-basics.html)).
- **D:** S3 bucket policies are resource-based policies that grant actions to specified **principals** such as accounts, users, roles, federated users, or AWS services ([How Amazon S3 works with IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security_iam_service-with-iam.html)). A Lambda **function ARN** is not the IAM principal that makes the S3 request; the function uses its execution role credentials. Therefore, the proper least-privilege control is to grant the execution roles the necessary S3 permissions.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个应用程序。该应用程序使用多个 AWS Lambda 函数从单个 Amazon S3 存储桶中检索敏感数据以进行处理。公司必须确保只有获得授权的 Lambda 函数可以访问这些数据。该解决方案必须符合最小权限原则。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过共享 IAM 角色向所有 Lambda 函数授予完整的 S3 存储桶访问权限。
options.B: 将 Lambda 函数配置为在 VPC 内运行。配置存储桶策略，根据 Lambda 函数的 VPC endpoint IP 地址授予访问权限。
options.C: 为每个 Lambda 函数创建单独的 IAM 角色。向这些 IAM 角色授予对 S3 存储桶的访问权限。将每个 IAM 角色分配为其对应 Lambda 函数的 Lambda execution role。
options.D: 配置存储桶策略，根据 Lambda 函数的函数 ARN 向其授予访问权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Lambda 函数通过其 **execution role** 获取访问其他 AWS 服务的权限。AWS 说明，当函数被调用时，Lambda 会代入该函数的 execution role，并获得该角色策略中的权限；Lambda 还建议仅授予所需权限，即最小权限原则（[Lambda permissions and roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-basics.html)）。为这些函数创建**单独的 IAM 角色**，可以让公司将每个角色的权限范围限定为仅对特定存储桶或前缀所需的 `s3:GetObject` 访问权限。AWS 的 Lambda/S3 示例也展示了为 S3 访问创建自定义权限策略，并将其附加到 Lambda execution role（[Create a permissions policy / execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3-example.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 具有**完整 S3 存储桶访问权限**的共享角色违反最小权限原则，并且会让所有函数拥有相同的宽泛权限，而不考虑实际需要。
- **B:** 在 VPC 中运行 Lambda 本身并不会授权访问 S3。基于 IP/VPC-endpoint 的控制属于网络条件，而不是控制 Lambda 函数访问 AWS 服务时最小权限身份的主要方式。Lambda 仍然使用 execution role 来获得 AWS 服务权限（[Lambda permissions and roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/concepts-basics.html)）。
- **D:** S3 存储桶策略是基于资源的策略，用于向指定的 **principals** 授予操作权限，例如账户、用户、角色、联合身份用户或 AWS 服务（[How Amazon S3 works with IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/security_iam_service-with-iam.html)）。Lambda **function ARN** 不是发起 S3 请求的 IAM principal；该函数使用其 execution role 凭证。因此，正确的最小权限控制方式是向 execution roles 授予必要的 S3 权限。

en.question: A company has developed a non-production application that is composed of multiple microservices for each of the company's business units. A single development team maintains all the microservices. The current architecture uses a static web frontend and a Java-based backend that contains the application logic. The architecture also uses a MySQL database that the company hosts on an Amazon EC2 instance. The company needs to ensure that the application is secure and available globally. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudFront and AWS Amplify to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that the microservices access by using Amazon API Gateway. Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that the microservices access by using Amazon API Gateway. Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that are in a target group behind a Network Load Balancer. Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS for MySQL.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 to host the static web frontend. Refactor the microservices to use AWS Lambda functions that are in a target group behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Option B uses managed and serverless services across all layers, which minimizes operational overhead while improving global availability and security. Amazon S3 can host the static frontend, and CloudFront can deliver S3-origin content securely over HTTPS from edge locations around the globe with low latency and high throughput ([S3 + CloudFront tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/tutorial-s3-cloudfront-route53-video-streaming.html)). For the backend, API Gateway can create HTTP endpoints that route requests to Lambda functions and can secure API access with authentication and authorization controls ([Lambda with API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)). Serverless development avoids managing long-running servers such as EC2 instances and can scale as application needs change ([Serverless development](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless/latest/devguide/welcome.html)). Migrating the self-managed MySQL database on EC2 to Amazon RDS for MySQL reduces database operations because RDS provides automated backups and point-in-time recovery ([RDS automated backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Although CloudFront/Amplify and Lambda/API Gateway are managed choices, keeping MySQL on an EC2 Reserved Instance still leaves the team responsible for database administration on EC2. A Reserved Instance is a billing construct, not an operational-overhead reduction like RDS automated backups.
- **C:** This option is invalid for the backend because Network Load Balancers do **not** support the `lambda` target type; AWS states that Application Load Balancers are the only load balancers that support Lambda targets ([NLB target types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)).
- **D:** S3 alone does not provide the same global HTTPS edge delivery as CloudFront, and the option keeps MySQL on an EC2 Reserved Instance, which increases operational responsibility compared with RDS. Although Application Load Balancers can use Lambda target groups ([ALB Lambda targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)), this option is not the lowest-operational-overhead globally available architecture.

zh.question: 一家公司开发了一个非生产应用程序，该应用程序由面向公司各业务部门的多个微服务组成。一个开发团队负责维护所有微服务。当前架构使用静态 Web 前端和包含应用程序逻辑的基于 Java 的后端。该架构还使用一个 MySQL 数据库，该数据库由公司托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司需要确保该应用程序安全并且可在全球范围内访问。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon CloudFront 和 AWS Amplify 托管静态 Web 前端。重构微服务以使用 AWS Lambda 函数，微服务通过 Amazon API Gateway 访问这些函数。将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3 托管静态 Web 前端。重构微服务以使用 AWS Lambda 函数，微服务通过 Amazon API Gateway 访问这些函数。将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudFront 和 Amazon S3 托管静态 Web 前端。重构微服务以使用位于 Network Load Balancer 后方目标组中的 AWS Lambda 函数。将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL。
options.D: 使用 Amazon S3 托管静态 Web 前端。重构微服务以使用位于 Application Load Balancer 后方目标组中的 AWS Lambda 函数。将 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon EC2 Reserved Instance。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

选项 B 在所有层都使用托管和无服务器服务，这可以最大限度地减少运营开销，同时提高全球可用性和安全性。Amazon S3 可以托管静态前端，CloudFront 可以通过 HTTPS 从全球边缘站点安全地交付以 S3 为源的内容，并提供低延迟和高吞吐量（[S3 + CloudFront tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/tutorial-s3-cloudfront-route53-video-streaming.html)）。对于后端，API Gateway 可以创建 HTTP 端点，将请求路由到 Lambda 函数，并且可以通过身份验证和授权控制来保护 API 访问（[Lambda with API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-apigateway.html)）。无服务器开发避免了管理长期运行的服务器（例如 EC2 实例），并且可以随着应用程序需求变化而扩展（[Serverless development](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless/latest/devguide/welcome.html)）。将 EC2 上自管理的 MySQL 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 可以减少数据库运维工作，因为 RDS 提供自动备份和时间点恢复（[RDS automated backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 尽管 CloudFront/Amplify 和 Lambda/API Gateway 是托管型选择，但将 MySQL 保留在 EC2 Reserved Instance 上仍然需要团队负责 EC2 上的数据库管理。Reserved Instance 是一种计费机制，而不是像 RDS 自动备份那样减少运营开销的方式。
- **C:** 此选项对于后端无效，因为 Network Load Balancers **不**支持 `lambda` 目标类型；AWS 声明 Application Load Balancers 是唯一支持 Lambda 目标的负载均衡器（[NLB target types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。
- **D:** 仅使用 S3 无法提供与 CloudFront 相同的全球 HTTPS 边缘交付能力，并且该选项将 MySQL 保留在 EC2 Reserved Instance 上，与 RDS 相比会增加运营责任。尽管 Application Load Balancers 可以使用 Lambda 目标组（[ALB Lambda targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/lambda-functions.html)），但此选项并不是运营开销最低且全球可用的架构。

en.question: A video game company is deploying a new gaming application to its global users. The company requires a solution that will provide near real-time reviews and rankings of the players. A solutions architect must design a solution to provide fast access to the data. The solution must also ensure the data persists on disks in the event that the company restarts the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket as the origin. Store the player data in the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create Amazon EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. Store the player data on the EC2 instances. Configure Amazon Route 53 with geolocation records to direct users to the closest EC2 instance.
options.C: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis duster. Store the player data in the ElastiCache cluster.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached duster. Store the player data in the ElastiCache cluster.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS is a managed in-memory data store, which fits the requirement for fast, near real-time access. For player rankings, Redis OSS supports **sorted sets**, while Memcached does not, according to the ElastiCache engine comparison table. The same table shows Redis OSS supports **high availability** and **backup and restore** for node-based clusters, unlike node-based Memcached. ElastiCache backups include the cache metadata and all cache data, and AWS writes backups to Amazon S3 durable storage, allowing the data to be restored into a new cache if needed ([engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html), [snapshot and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/backups.html)). This provides the required low-latency access and persistence with low operational overhead because AWS manages the cache service.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. CloudFront + S3**: S3 is durable, but this is object storage behind a CDN, not an in-memory data structure store for near real-time player reviews and leaderboard/ranking operations. It does not provide Redis-style sorted sets for rankings.
- **B. EC2 instances in multiple Regions**: This would require the company to operate and synchronize its own distributed data store across Regions, increasing operational overhead. It also does not inherently provide managed ranking data structures or managed durability.
- **D. ElastiCache for Memcached**: Memcached is simpler for object caching, but the ElastiCache comparison shows Memcached does **not** support sorted sets, high availability replication, automatic failover, or backup/restore for node-based clusters, making it unsuitable for persistent player rankings ([engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)).

zh.question: 一家视频游戏公司正在向其全球用户部署一款新的游戏应用程序。该公司需要一种解决方案，以提供近实时的玩家评论和排名。解决方案架构师必须设计一种解决方案，以提供对数据的快速访问。该解决方案还必须确保在公司重启应用程序时，数据能够持久保存在磁盘上。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配，并将 Amazon S3 存储桶作为源站。将玩家数据存储在 S3 存储桶中。
options.B: 在多个 AWS Regions 中创建 Amazon EC2 实例。将玩家数据存储在 EC2 实例上。配置 Amazon Route 53，并使用地理位置记录将用户定向到最近的 EC2 实例。
options.C: 部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis duster。将玩家数据存储在 ElastiCache 集群中。
options.D: 部署一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached duster。将玩家数据存储在 ElastiCache 集群中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS 是一种托管式内存数据存储，符合快速、近实时访问的要求。对于玩家排名，Redis OSS 支持 **sorted sets**，而根据 ElastiCache 引擎比较表，Memcached 不支持。该表还显示，与基于节点的 Memcached 不同，Redis OSS 对基于节点的集群支持 **high availability** 以及 **backup and restore**。ElastiCache 备份包括缓存元数据和所有缓存数据，并且 AWS 会将备份写入 Amazon S3 持久存储，使数据能够在需要时还原到新的缓存中（[engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)，[snapshot and restore](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/backups.html)）。这提供了所需的低延迟访问和持久性，并且运营开销低，因为 AWS 负责管理缓存服务。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. CloudFront + S3**：S3 具有持久性，但这是位于 CDN 后面的对象存储，而不是用于近实时玩家评论和排行榜/排名操作的内存数据结构存储。它不提供用于排名的 Redis 风格 sorted sets。
- **B. 多个 Regions 中的 EC2 实例**：这将要求公司自行运营并同步跨 Regions 的分布式数据存储，从而增加运营开销。它也不会天然提供托管的排名数据结构或托管的持久性。
- **D. ElastiCache for Memcached**：Memcached 更适合简单的对象缓存，但 ElastiCache 比较显示，Memcached 对基于节点的集群**不**支持 sorted sets、高可用性复制、自动故障转移或备份/还原，因此不适合持久化玩家排名（[engine comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/SelectEngine.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing an application on AWS that processes sensitive data. The application stores and processes financial data for multiple customers. To meet compliance requirements, the data for each customer must be encrypted separately at rest by using a secure, centralized key management solution. The company wants to use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to implement encryption. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Generate a unique encryption key for each customer. Store the keys in an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable server-side encryption.
options.B: Deploy a hardware security appliance in the AWS environment that securely stores customer- provided encryption keys. Integrate the security appliance with AWS KMS to encrypt the sensitive data in the application.
options.C: Create a single AWS KMS key to encrypt all sensitive data across the application.
options.D: Create separate AWS KMS keys for each customer's data that have granular access control and logging enabled.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

AWS KMS is the appropriate centralized key management service: AWS states that KMS provides centralized management and auditing, supports creating multiple KMS keys, and lets you define access controls on who can manage or use each key by attaching policies to the key ([AWS KMS concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts-intro.html)). Creating a separate customer managed KMS key for each customer provides separate encryption boundaries for each customer's data while retaining AWS-managed HSM-backed key storage, policy-based access control, and auditing. AWS also states that customer managed keys are keys you create, own, and manage; you have full control over key policies, IAM policies, and grants, and you can audit their usage in CloudTrail logs ([AWS KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). CloudTrail logs AWS KMS operations, including key management and cryptographic operations such as GenerateDataKey and Decrypt ([Logging AWS KMS API calls with AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/logging-using-cloudtrail.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Storing self-generated customer keys in an S3 bucket is not a centralized KMS-based key management solution and creates key lifecycle/security operational burden. It also does not use KMS key policies/grants as the primary access-control mechanism for the encryption keys.
- **B:** Deploying and integrating a hardware security appliance adds significant operational overhead. AWS KMS already uses a distributed fleet of FIPS 140-3 validated HSMs and provides key management through AWS-managed service interfaces ([AWS KMS concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts-intro.html)).
- **C:** A single KMS key for all customers does not meet the requirement that each customer's data be encrypted separately. It also prevents per-customer key-level access control and auditing separation.
- **D:** Meets the requirements with the least operational overhead by using managed AWS KMS keys, one per customer, with granular key policies/IAM policies/grants and CloudTrail auditing.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上设计一个处理敏感数据的应用程序。该应用程序为多个客户存储和处理财务数据。为了满足合规性要求，每个客户的数据都必须使用安全、集中式的密钥管理解决方案在静态状态下分别加密。该公司希望使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 来实施加密。哪种解决方案能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个客户生成一个唯一的加密密钥。将这些密钥存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。启用服务器端加密。
options.B: 在 AWS 环境中部署一个硬件安全设备，用于安全地存储客户提供的加密密钥。将该安全设备与 AWS KMS 集成，以加密应用程序中的敏感数据。
options.C: 创建一个单独的 AWS KMS key，用于加密整个应用程序中的所有敏感数据。
options.D: 为每个客户的数据创建单独的 AWS KMS keys，并启用精细访问控制和日志记录。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

AWS KMS 是适合的集中式密钥管理服务：AWS 表示，KMS 提供集中式管理和审计，支持创建多个 KMS keys，并允许你通过将策略附加到密钥来定义谁可以管理或使用每个密钥的访问控制（[AWS KMS concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts-intro.html)）。为每个客户创建单独的 customer managed KMS key，可为每个客户的数据提供单独的加密边界，同时保留由 AWS 托管、基于 HSM 的密钥存储、基于策略的访问控制和审计。AWS 还表示，customer managed keys 是你创建、拥有和管理的密钥；你可以完全控制 key policies、IAM policies 和 grants，并且可以在 CloudTrail logs 中审计其使用情况（[AWS KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。CloudTrail 会记录 AWS KMS 操作，包括密钥管理以及 GenerateDataKey 和 Decrypt 等加密操作（[Logging AWS KMS API calls with AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/logging-using-cloudtrail.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 将自行生成的客户密钥存储在 S3 存储桶中并不是基于 KMS 的集中式密钥管理解决方案，并且会带来密钥生命周期/安全运营负担。它也没有使用 KMS key policies/grants 作为加密密钥的主要访问控制机制。
- **B:** 部署并集成硬件安全设备会增加显著的运营开销。AWS KMS 已经使用由 FIPS 140-3 验证的分布式 HSM 集群，并通过 AWS 托管的服务接口提供密钥管理（[AWS KMS concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts-intro.html)）。
- **C:** 对所有客户使用单个 KMS key 不满足每个客户的数据必须分别加密的要求。它还会阻止按客户进行密钥级访问控制和审计隔离。
- **D:** 通过使用托管的 AWS KMS keys（每个客户一个），并结合精细的 key policies/IAM policies/grants 和 CloudTrail 审计，以最少的运营开销满足要求。

en.question: A company needs to design a resilient web application to process customer orders. The web application must automatically handle increases in web traffic and application usage without affecting the customer experience or losing customer orders. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use a NAT gateway to manage web traffic. Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to receive, process, and store processed customer orders. Use an AWS Lambda function to capture and store unprocessed orders.
options.B: Use a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to manage web traffic. Use an Application Load Balancer to receive customer orders from the NLUse Amazon Redshift with a Multi-AZ deployment to store unprocessed and processed customer orders.
options.C: Use a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) to manage web traffic. Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to receive and process customer orders. Use the GWLB to capture and store unprocessed orders. Use Amazon DynamoDB to store processed customer orders.
options.D: Use an Application Load Balancer to manage web traffic. Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to receive and process customer orders. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to store unprocessed orders. Use Amazon RDS with a Multi-AZ deployment to store processed customer orders.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** An Application Load Balancer is appropriate for a web application because it distributes incoming application traffic across targets in multiple Availability Zones, routes only to healthy targets, and scales as incoming traffic changes ([ALB docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)). Integrating Elastic Load Balancing with an EC2 Auto Scaling group lets instances be automatically registered/deregistered and lets the group scale based on demand, such as ALB request count per target ([EC2 Auto Scaling docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)). Amazon SQS is the right buffer for unprocessed orders because queues provide durable message storage and decouple producers from consumers, helping prevent order loss during traffic spikes ([Amazon SQS guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/modernization-integrating-microservices/sqs.html)). Amazon RDS Multi-AZ provides standby DB instances for failover support, making it suitable for resilient storage of processed orders ([RDS Multi-AZ docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A NAT gateway is for outbound internet access from private subnets, not for managing inbound web traffic. Lambda could capture events, but this option lacks the durable queue buffer needed to store unprocessed orders reliably during spikes.
- **B:** Using both an NLB and an ALB is unnecessary for this HTTP/web order-processing use case. Also, Amazon Redshift is an analytics/data warehouse service pattern, not the typical transactional store for customer orders; the option also does not include a durable queue for unprocessed orders.
- **C:** A Gateway Load Balancer is intended to distribute traffic to appliance instances, not to capture and store orders. DynamoDB can store processed orders, but the option has no durable order queue; GWLB is not a persistence mechanism.

zh.question: 一家公司需要设计一个具有弹性的 Web 应用程序来处理客户订单。该 Web 应用程序必须能够自动处理 Web 流量和应用程序使用量的增加，同时不影响客户体验或丢失客户订单。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 NAT gateway 来管理 Web 流量。使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups 来接收、处理和存储已处理的客户订单。使用 AWS Lambda function 来捕获和存储未处理的订单。
options.B: 使用 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 来管理 Web 流量。使用 Application Load Balancer 从 NLUse 接收客户订单 Amazon Redshift with a Multi-AZ deployment 来存储未处理和已处理的客户订单。
options.C: 使用 Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) 来管理 Web 流量。使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 来接收和处理客户订单。使用 GWLB 来捕获和存储未处理的订单。使用 Amazon DynamoDB 来存储已处理的客户订单。
options.D: 使用 Application Load Balancer 来管理 Web 流量。使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups 来接收和处理客户订单。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 来存储未处理的订单。使用 Amazon RDS with a Multi-AZ deployment 来存储已处理的客户订单。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** Application Load Balancer 适用于 Web 应用程序，因为它会将传入的应用程序流量分发到多个 Availability Zones 中的目标，仅路由到正常运行的目标，并随着传入流量变化而扩展（[ALB docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。将 Elastic Load Balancing 与 EC2 Auto Scaling group 集成，可以让实例自动注册/注销，并让该组根据需求进行扩展，例如基于每个目标的 ALB 请求计数（[EC2 Auto Scaling docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。Amazon SQS 是未处理订单的正确缓冲区，因为队列提供持久消息存储，并将生产者与消费者解耦，有助于在流量峰值期间防止订单丢失（[Amazon SQS guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/modernization-integrating-microservices/sqs.html)）。Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 提供用于故障转移支持的备用 DB 实例，使其适合用于已处理订单的弹性存储（[RDS Multi-AZ docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** NAT gateway 用于来自私有子网的出站互联网访问，而不是用于管理入站 Web 流量。Lambda 可以捕获事件，但此选项缺少在流量峰值期间可靠存储未处理订单所需的持久队列缓冲区。
- **B:** 对于这种 HTTP/Web 订单处理使用场景，同时使用 NLB 和 ALB 是不必要的。此外，Amazon Redshift 是一种分析/数据仓库服务模式，而不是客户订单的典型事务性存储；该选项也没有包含用于未处理订单的持久队列。
- **C:** Gateway Load Balancer 旨在将流量分发到设备实例，而不是捕获和存储订单。DynamoDB 可以存储已处理的订单，但该选项没有持久订单队列；GWLB 不是持久化机制。

en.question: A company is using AWS DataSync to migrate millions of files from an on-premises system to AWS. The files are 10 KB in size on average. The company wants to use Amazon S3 for file storage. For the first year after the migration, the files will be accessed once or twice and must be immediately available. After 1 year, the files must be archived for at least 7 years. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use an archive tool to group the files into large objects. Use DataSync to migrate the objects. Store the objects in S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval for the first year. Use a lifecycle configuration to transition the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.
options.B: Use an archive tool to group the files into large objects. Use DataSync to copy the objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use a lifecycle configuration to transition the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.
options.C: Configure the destination storage class for the files as S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Use a lifecycle policy to transition the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.
options.D: Configure a DataSync task to transfer the files to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA). Use a lifecycle configuration to transition the files to S3 Deep Archive after 1 year with a retention period of 7 years.

en.explanation:
A is the best answer.

S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval fits the first-year access requirement because it is for rarely accessed data that still requires millisecond retrieval, and AWS states that it provides the same latency and throughput as S3 Standard-IA while having lower storage costs than S3 Standard-IA (with higher access costs) [S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html). The data will be accessed only once or twice, so lower storage cost is the dominant factor.

The key cost issue is that the company has **millions of 10 KB files**. AWS notes that S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval has a 128 KB minimum object size, and DataSync stores objects smaller than 128 KB in S3 Standard when S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is selected [DataSync S3 storage class considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html). For long-term archive classes, AWS also states that S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive add 40 KB of metadata per archived object and specifically recommends considering aggregation of many small objects into fewer large objects to reduce overhead costs [S3 Lifecycle transition considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html). Therefore, using an archive tool to group the small files into larger objects is the most cost-effective approach.

After 1 year, S3 Glacier Deep Archive is appropriate because AWS describes it as the lowest-cost AWS storage option for archive data retained for multiple years and accessed less than once per year [S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html). S3 Lifecycle supports transitions from S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval to S3 Glacier Deep Archive [S3 Lifecycle supported transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B** uses S3 Standard-IA for the first year and then transitions to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval for the 7-year archive period. This is backwards: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval is for data requiring immediate access, while S3 Glacier Deep Archive is the lowest-cost long-term archive option.
* **C** does not aggregate the 10 KB files. That misses the major cost optimization for millions of small objects and may cause DataSync to store sub-128 KB objects in S3 Standard instead of S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. It also transitions to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval, not the lower-cost S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
* **D** also does not aggregate the small files. DataSync notes that objects smaller than 128 KB selected for S3 Standard-IA are stored in S3 Standard, and S3 Lifecycle documentation warns that transition request and per-object overhead costs can outweigh savings for small objects. This makes it less cost-effective than aggregating and using S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval followed by Deep Archive.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS DataSync 将数百万个文件从本地系统迁移到 AWS。这些文件平均大小为 10 KB。该公司希望使用 Amazon S3 进行文件存储。迁移后的第一年，这些文件将被访问一两次，并且必须立即可用。1 年后，这些文件必须归档至少 7 年。哪种解决方案将以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用归档工具将这些文件分组为大型对象。使用 DataSync 迁移这些对象。第一年将这些对象存储在 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 中。使用生命周期配置在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，并设置 7 年的保留期。
options.B: 使用归档工具将这些文件分组为大型对象。使用 DataSync 将这些对象复制到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。使用生命周期配置在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval，并设置 7 年的保留期。
options.C: 将这些文件的目标存储类配置为 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。使用生命周期策略在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，并设置 7 年的保留期。
options.D: 配置 DataSync 任务，将文件传输到 S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)。使用生命周期配置在 1 年后将文件转换到 S3 Deep Archive，并设置 7 年的保留期。

zh.explanation:
A 是最佳答案。

S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 符合第一年的访问要求，因为它适用于很少访问但仍需要毫秒级检索的数据，并且 AWS 表示它提供与 S3 Standard-IA 相同的延迟和吞吐量，同时存储成本低于 S3 Standard-IA（但访问成本更高）[S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)。这些数据只会被访问一两次，因此较低的存储成本是主导因素。关键成本问题在于该公司有 **数百万个 10 KB 文件**。AWS 指出 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 有 128 KB 的最小对象大小，并且当选择 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 时，DataSync 会将小于 128 KB 的对象存储在 S3 Standard 中 [DataSync S3 storage class considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/create-s3-location.html)。对于长期归档类，AWS 还表示 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 和 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 会为每个已归档对象添加 40 KB 的元数据，并特别建议考虑将许多小对象聚合为更少的大对象，以降低开销成本 [S3 Lifecycle transition considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)。因此，使用归档工具将小文件分组为较大的对象是最具成本效益的方法。

1 年后，S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是合适的，因为 AWS 将其描述为用于保留多年且每年访问少于一次的归档数据的最低成本 AWS 存储选项 [S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)。S3 Lifecycle 支持从 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 转换到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive [S3 Lifecycle supported transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **B** 第一年使用 S3 Standard-IA，然后在 7 年归档期转换到 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval。这是反过来的：S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 适用于需要即时访问的数据，而 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 才是成本最低的长期归档选项。
* **C** 没有聚合 10 KB 文件。这错过了针对数百万个小对象的主要成本优化，并且可能导致 DataSync 将小于 128 KB 的对象存储在 S3 Standard 中，而不是 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval 中。它还转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，而不是成本更低的 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。
* **D** 也没有聚合小文件。DataSync 指出，选择 S3 Standard-IA 的小于 128 KB 的对象会存储在 S3 Standard 中，并且 S3 Lifecycle 文档警告说，对于小对象，转换请求和每对象开销成本可能会超过节省的费用。这使其不如先聚合、再使用 S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval、随后转换到 Deep Archive 具备成本效益。

en.question: A company recently performed a lift and shift migration of its on-premises Oracle database workload to run on an Amazon EC2 memory optimized Linux instance. The EC2 Linux instance uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume with 64,000 IOPS. The database storage performance after the migration is slower than the performance of the on-premises database. Which solution will improve storage performance?

options.A: Add more Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volumes. Use OS commands to create a Logical Volume Management (LVM) stripe.
options.B: Increase the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to more than 64,000 IOPS.
options.C: Increase the size of the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume to 2 TB.
options.D: Change the EC2 Linux instance to a storage optimized instance type. Do not change the Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS volume.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** The existing `io1` volume is already at the documented per-volume maximum of **64,000 IOPS**. AWS states that `io1` volumes can be provisioned “up to 64,000 IOPS per volume” and that 64,000 IOPS is also required to reach the maximum `io1` throughput of 1,000 MiB/s ([Amazon EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/provisioned-iops.html)). To exceed what one EBS volume can deliver, AWS recommends striping: a RAID 0 stripe distributes I/O across volumes, and “if you add a volume, you get the straight addition of throughput and IOPS” ([Amazon EBS and RAID configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/raid-config.html)). LVM striping is the Linux logical-volume equivalent concept, so adding more `io1` volumes and striping them is the best way to improve storage performance beyond a single-volume limit.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **B:** You cannot increase a single `io1` EBS volume beyond **64,000 IOPS per volume** ([EBS `io1` performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/provisioned-iops.html)).
- **C:** Increasing the size to 2 TB does not by itself improve performance when the volume is already provisioned at the maximum 64,000 IOPS and maximum `io1` throughput characteristics.
- **D:** Changing to a storage optimized instance while keeping the same single `io1` volume does not remove the single-volume IOPS/throughput limit. AWS specifically documents striping multiple EBS volumes when higher performance than a single volume is required ([RAID 0 for EBS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/raid-config.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近将其本地 Oracle 数据库工作负载进行了直接迁移（lift and shift），使其在 Amazon EC2 内存优化型 Linux 实例上运行。该 EC2 Linux 实例使用一个 1 TB 的 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS 卷，配置了 64,000 IOPS。迁移后的数据库存储性能低于本地数据库的性能。哪种解决方案将提高存储性能？

options.A: 添加更多 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS 卷。使用 OS 命令创建 Logical Volume Management (LVM) 条带。
options.B: 将 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS 卷增加到超过 64,000 IOPS。
options.C: 将 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS 卷的大小增加到 2 TB。
options.D: 将 EC2 Linux 实例更改为存储优化型实例类型。不要更改 Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1) EBS 卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** 现有的 `io1` 卷已经达到文档中规定的每卷最大值 **64,000 IOPS**。AWS 声明 `io1` 卷可以预置“每卷最高 64,000 IOPS”，并且达到 `io1` 最大吞吐量 1,000 MiB/s 也需要 64,000 IOPS（[Amazon EBS Provisioned IOPS SSD volumes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/provisioned-iops.html)）。要超过单个 EBS 卷所能提供的性能，AWS 建议进行条带化：RAID 0 条带会将 I/O 分布到多个卷上，并且“如果添加一个卷，就会直接增加吞吐量和 IOPS”（[Amazon EBS and RAID configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/raid-config.html)）。LVM 条带化是 Linux 逻辑卷中的等价概念，因此添加更多 `io1` 卷并对其进行条带化，是突破单卷限制并提高存储性能的最佳方式。

**为什么其他选项是错误的：**

- **B:** 不能将单个 `io1` EBS 卷增加到超过 **每卷 64,000 IOPS**（[EBS `io1` performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/provisioned-iops.html)）。
- **C:** 当卷已经配置为最大 64,000 IOPS 以及最大 `io1` 吞吐特性时，将大小增加到 2 TB 本身并不会提高性能。
- **D:** 在保持同一个单独 `io1` 卷不变的情况下，改为存储优化型实例并不能消除单卷 IOPS/吞吐量限制。AWS 明确记录了在需要高于单个卷的性能时，应对多个 EBS 卷进行条带化（[RAID 0 for EBS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/raid-config.html)）。

en.question: A company is migrating from a monolithic architecture for a web application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 to a serverless microservices architecture. The company wants to use AWS services that support an event-driven, loosely coupled architecture. The company wants to use the publish/subscribe (pub/sub) pattern. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure one or more subscribers to read events from the SQS queue.
options.B: Configure an Amazon API Gateway REST API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the SNS topic.
options.C: Configure an Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API to write to a data stream in Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with enhanced fan-out. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the data stream.
options.D: Configure an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API to invoke an AWS Lambda function that publishes events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure one or more subscribers to receive events from the topic.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

Amazon SNS directly supports the required pub/sub pattern: publishers send messages to an SNS **topic**, and the topic delivers messages to **multiple subscribers** across endpoints such as Lambda, SQS, HTTP(S), and others. AWS also describes SNS fanout as replicating a message published to a topic and pushing it to multiple endpoints for parallel asynchronous processing, which matches an event-driven, loosely coupled microservices design ([Amazon SNS: How it works / scenarios](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)).

Between options B and D, both use SNS, but **D is more cost-effective** because it uses an API Gateway **HTTP API**. AWS states that HTTP APIs and REST APIs are both RESTful API products, but HTTP APIs are designed with minimal features so they can be offered at a **lower price**; HTTP APIs can also send requests to AWS Lambda functions ([API Gateway HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api.html), [Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A**: Amazon SQS is useful for decoupling and background work, but a single SQS queue is a queue/worker pattern, not the best fit for pub/sub fanout to multiple subscribers. AWS describes standard queue use cases such as decoupling live requests, allocating tasks to worker nodes, and batching messages ([Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)).
* **B**: This is functionally valid for pub/sub because it uses SNS, but it uses an API Gateway **REST API**. REST APIs have more features, whereas HTTP APIs are lower price when those extra features are not needed ([Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)). Therefore B is not the **most cost-effective**.
* **C**: Kinesis Data Streams with enhanced fan-out is not the most cost-effective choice for this general pub/sub requirement. AWS notes that enhanced fan-out provides each registered consumer its own read throughput, but it also has data retrieval cost and consumer-shard hour cost ([Kinesis enhanced fan-out consumers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/enhanced-consumers.html)). It is more specialized than needed for simple SNS-style pub/sub.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将托管在 Amazon EC2 上的 Web 应用程序从单体架构迁移到无服务器微服务架构。该公司希望使用支持事件驱动、松耦合架构的 AWS 服务。该公司希望使用发布/订阅（pub/sub）模式。哪种解决方案能够以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将事件发布到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置一个或多个订阅者从 SQS 队列读取事件。
options.B: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway REST API 来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将事件发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。配置一个或多个订阅者从 SNS 主题接收事件。
options.C: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway WebSocket API，将数据写入启用了增强型扇出的 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 数据流。配置一个或多个订阅者从该数据流接收事件。
options.D: 配置一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将事件发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。配置一个或多个订阅者从该主题接收事件。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

Amazon SNS 直接支持所需的 pub/sub 模式：发布者将消息发送到 SNS **topic**，该主题将消息传递给跨 Lambda、SQS、HTTP(S) 等端点的 **多个订阅者**。AWS 还将 SNS 扇出描述为复制发布到主题的消息，并将其推送到多个端点以进行并行异步处理，这与事件驱动、松耦合的微服务设计相匹配（[Amazon SNS: How it works / scenarios](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。在选项 B 和 D 之间，两者都使用 SNS，但 **D 更具成本效益**，因为它使用 API Gateway **HTTP API**。AWS 说明 HTTP APIs 和 REST APIs 都是 RESTful API 产品，但 HTTP APIs 设计为具备最少功能，因此可以以 **更低价格** 提供；HTTP APIs 还可以向 AWS Lambda 函数发送请求（[API Gateway HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api.html)，[Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **A**：Amazon SQS 对于解耦和后台工作很有用，但单个 SQS 队列是队列/工作者模式，并不是向多个订阅者进行 pub/sub 扇出的最佳匹配。AWS 描述的标准队列用例包括解耦实时请求、将任务分配给工作节点以及批处理消息（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)）。
* **B**：这在功能上对 pub/sub 是有效的，因为它使用 SNS，但它使用的是 API Gateway **REST API**。REST APIs 具有更多功能，而当不需要这些额外功能时，HTTP APIs 价格更低（[Choose between REST APIs and HTTP APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-vs-rest.html)）。因此，B 不是 **最具成本效益** 的。
* **C**：对于这种一般性的 pub/sub 需求，启用增强型扇出的 Kinesis Data Streams 不是最具成本效益的选择。AWS 指出，增强型扇出为每个已注册使用者提供其自己的读取吞吐量，但它也有数据检索成本和使用者分片小时成本（[Kinesis enhanced fan-out consumers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/enhanced-consumers.html)）。对于简单的 SNS 风格 pub/sub 来说，它比所需方案更加专门化。

en.question: A company recently migrated a monolithic application to an Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon RDS. The application has tightly coupled modules. The existing design of the application gives the application the ability to run on only a single EC2 instance. The company has noticed high CPU utilization on the EC2 instance during peak usage times. The high CPU utilization corresponds to degraded performance on Amazon RDS for read requests. The company wants to reduce the high CPU utilization and improve read request performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Configure an RDS read replica for read requests.
options.B: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Add an RDS read replica and redirect all read/write traffic to the replica.
options.C: Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum size of 1 and maximum size of 2. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity.
options.D: Resize the EC2 instance to an EC2 instance type that has more CPU capacity. Configure an Auto Scaling group with a minimum and maximum size of 1. Resize the RDS DB instance to an instance type that has more CPU capacity.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The application can run on only one EC2 instance, so the EC2 tier should be **vertically scaled** rather than horizontally scaled. AWS states that if an EC2 instance is over-utilized, you can resize it by changing its instance type to a larger one ([Amazon EC2 instance type changes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-resize.html)). Placing it in an Auto Scaling group with minimum and maximum size of 1 does not add horizontal scale, but it lets the group maintain one running instance; Auto Scaling attempts to maintain desired capacity and launches a replacement if an instance terminates unexpectedly ([Set scaling limits for your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/asg-capacity-limits.html)).

For the database read performance issue, an RDS read replica is appropriate because AWS lists scaling beyond the compute or I/O capacity of a single DB instance for **read-heavy workloads** as a read replica use case, and says excess read traffic can be directed to read replicas ([Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

* **B**: Incorrect because it says to redirect **all read/write traffic** to the read replica. RDS read replicas are read-only for normal application use; AWS says a read replica operates as a DB instance that allows only read-only connections ([Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).
* **C**: Incorrect because an Auto Scaling group with maximum size 2 implies horizontal scaling of the EC2 application tier, but the application design allows it to run on only a single EC2 instance. It also does not address the EC2 CPU bottleneck by resizing the EC2 instance.
* **D**: Incorrect because resizing the RDS DB instance may add capacity, but the stated RDS problem is degraded **read request** performance; a read replica is the AWS-recommended way to offload excess read traffic for read-heavy workloads. D also lacks the read-replica read-scaling benefit.

zh.question: 一家公司最近将一个单体应用程序迁移到一个 Amazon EC2 实例和 Amazon RDS。该应用程序的模块紧密耦合。该应用程序的现有设计使其只能在单个 EC2 实例上运行。公司注意到，在峰值使用时段，EC2 实例的 CPU 利用率很高。高 CPU 利用率对应着 Amazon RDS 读取请求性能下降。公司希望降低高 CPU 利用率并提高读取请求性能。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 EC2 实例调整为具有更多 CPU 容量的 EC2 实例类型。配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，其最小大小和最大大小均为 1。为读取请求配置一个 RDS 只读副本。
options.B: 将 EC2 实例调整为具有更多 CPU 容量的 EC2 实例类型。配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，其最小大小和最大大小均为 1。添加一个 RDS 只读副本，并将所有读/写流量重定向到该副本。
options.C: 配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，其最小大小为 1，最大大小为 2。将 RDS DB 实例调整为具有更多 CPU 容量的实例类型。
options.D: 将 EC2 实例调整为具有更多 CPU 容量的 EC2 实例类型。配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，其最小大小和最大大小均为 1。将 RDS DB 实例调整为具有更多 CPU 容量的实例类型。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

该应用程序只能在一个 EC2 实例上运行，因此 EC2 层应进行**纵向扩展**，而不是横向扩展。AWS 表示，如果 EC2 实例过度使用，你可以通过将其实例类型更改为更大的实例类型来调整其大小（[Amazon EC2 instance type changes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-resize.html)）。将其放入最小大小和最大大小均为 1 的 Auto Scaling 组不会增加横向扩展能力，但它可以让该组维持一个正在运行的实例；Auto Scaling 会尝试维持所需容量，并在实例意外终止时启动替代实例（[Set scaling limits for your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/asg-capacity-limits.html)）。对于数据库读取性能问题，RDS 只读副本是合适的，因为 AWS 将针对**读取密集型工作负载**扩展到超出单个 DB 实例的计算或 I/O 容量列为只读副本的使用场景，并表示可以将多余的读取流量定向到只读副本（[Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

* **B**：不正确，因为它说要将**所有读/写流量**重定向到只读副本。对于正常应用程序使用，RDS 只读副本是只读的；AWS 表示，只读副本作为仅允许只读连接的 DB 实例运行（[Working with DB instance read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。
* **C**：不正确，因为最大大小为 2 的 Auto Scaling 组意味着 EC2 应用程序层的横向扩展，但该应用程序设计只允许其在单个 EC2 实例上运行。它也没有通过调整 EC2 实例大小来解决 EC2 CPU 瓶颈。
* **D**：不正确，因为调整 RDS DB 实例大小可能会增加容量，但题目所述的 RDS 问题是**读取请求**性能下降；对于读取密集型工作负载，使用只读副本卸载多余读取流量是 AWS 推荐的方法。D 还缺少只读副本带来的读取扩展优势。

en.question: A company needs to grant a team of developers access to the company's AWS resources. The company must maintain a high level of security for the resources. The company requires an access control solution that will prevent unauthorized access to the sensitive data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Share the IAM user credentials for each development team member with the rest of the team to simplify access management and to streamline development workflows.
options.B: Define IAM roles that have fine-grained permissions based on the principle of least privilege. Assign an IAM role to each developer.
options.C: Create IAM access keys to grant programmatic access to AWS resources. Allow only developers to interact with AWS resources through API calls by using the access keys.
options.D: Create an AWS Cognito user pool. Grant developers access to AWS resources by using the user pool.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** IAM roles with fine-grained permissions are the best fit for secure developer access. AWS recommends that human users such as developers use temporary credentials by assuming roles, and recommends applying least-privilege permissions so identities receive only the permissions required for specific tasks ([IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). IAM policies should be crafted so users and roles can perform **only** the tasks they need; starting with minimum permissions is more secure than broad access ([Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Sharing IAM user credentials destroys individual accountability and is not a secure access-control model. It also conflicts with AWS guidance to use managed identities, temporary credentials, and least privilege rather than shared long-term credentials ([IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **C:** Access keys are long-term credentials. AWS says to rely on temporary credentials where possible instead of creating long-term credentials such as access keys; access keys are only for specific use cases that require them ([IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). This is therefore less secure than role-based temporary access.
- **D:** Amazon Cognito user pools are primarily for application user sign-up/sign-in and user directories. Cognito identity pools can issue AWS service credentials after sign-in, but a **user pool alone** is not the standard solution for granting workforce developers least-privilege access to company AWS resources ([Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要授予一个开发人员团队访问公司 AWS 资源的权限。公司必须为这些资源保持高安全级别。公司需要一种访问控制解决方案，以防止对敏感数据的未经授权访问。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 与团队其他成员共享每个开发团队成员的 IAM 用户凭证，以简化访问管理并优化开发工作流。
options.B: 根据最小权限原则定义具有精细权限的 IAM 角色。为每位开发人员分配一个 IAM 角色。
options.C: 创建 IAM 访问密钥以授予对 AWS 资源的编程访问权限。仅允许开发人员使用访问密钥通过 API 调用与 AWS 资源交互。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Cognito 用户池。通过使用该用户池授予开发人员访问 AWS 资源的权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 具有精细权限的 IAM 角色最适合用于安全的开发人员访问。AWS 建议开发人员等人类用户通过代入角色来使用临时凭证，并建议应用最小权限，使身份仅获得执行特定任务所需的权限（[IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。应精心设计 IAM 策略，使用户和角色只能执行他们需要的任务；从最低权限开始比授予广泛访问权限更安全（[Policies and permissions in IAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 共享 IAM 用户凭证会破坏个人问责制，并且不是安全的访问控制模型。它还与 AWS 关于使用托管身份、临时凭证和最小权限，而不是共享长期凭证的指导相冲突（[IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **C:** 访问密钥是长期凭证。AWS 表示，在可能的情况下应依赖临时凭证，而不是创建访问密钥等长期凭证；访问密钥仅适用于确实需要它们的特定使用场景（[IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。因此，这不如基于角色的临时访问安全。
- **D:** Amazon Cognito 用户池主要用于应用程序用户注册/登录和用户目录。Cognito 身份池可以在登录后颁发 AWS 服务凭证，但**仅使用用户池**并不是为企业开发人员授予对公司 AWS 资源的最小权限访问的标准解决方案（[Amazon Cognito user pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts a monolithic web application on an Amazon EC2 instance. Application users have recently reported poor performance at specific times. Analysis of Amazon CloudWatch metrics shows that CPU utilization is 100% during the periods of poor performance. The company wants to resolve this performance issue and improve application availability. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale vertically.
options.B: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the web server. Reference the AMI in a new launch template.
options.C: Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale vertically.
options.D: Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale horizontally.
options.E: Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale horizontally.

en.explanation:
The most cost-effective solution is to move the single EC2-hosted web application into a horizontally scalable, load-balanced architecture.

**B. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the web server. Reference the AMI in a new launch template — Correct.**  
An Auto Scaling group needs a configuration template to launch replacement or additional EC2 instances. AWS documentation states that Auto Scaling groups use launch templates as configuration templates for EC2 instances, including the AMI ID, instance type, security groups, and other launch settings. Creating an AMI from the existing web server and referencing it in a launch template allows new instances to be launched with the same application configuration. See [Create Auto Scaling groups using launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/create-auto-scaling-groups-launch-template.html) and [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html).

**E. Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale horizontally — Correct.**  
The application has CPU saturation only at specific times, which indicates variable demand. Horizontal scaling with an Auto Scaling group can add EC2 instances during high load and remove them when demand decreases, improving performance while avoiding the cost of permanently running a larger instance. AWS states that Auto Scaling can adjust the number of EC2 instances based on demand and scaling policies. A target tracking policy, for example, can scale out when CPU utilization exceeds a target and scale in when utilization drops.
