An Application Load Balancer distributes traffic across the instances and can be attached to the Auto Scaling group. See [Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html), [Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html), and [Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html).

**A. Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale vertically — Incorrect.**  
Compute Optimizer can recommend EC2 instance types for upsizing or downsizing, but vertical scaling alone does not improve availability because the application would still depend on a single EC2 instance. It also is less cost-effective for workload spikes at specific times because a larger instance would typically run continuously, including during low-demand periods. Compute Optimizer recommendations are useful for instance right-sizing, but they do not by themselves provide the load-balanced, highly available architecture required here. See [Viewing EC2 instance recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ec2-recommendations.html).

**C. Create an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer to scale vertically — Incorrect.**  
An Auto Scaling group with an Application Load Balancer is a horizontal scaling design, not vertical scaling. Auto Scaling groups adjust capacity by launching or terminating EC2 instances, not by increasing the CPU or memory of a running instance. See [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html).

**D. Use AWS Compute Optimizer to obtain a recommendation for an instance type to scale horizontally — Incorrect.**  
Compute Optimizer provides EC2 instance type recommendations for right-sizing individual instances. It does not create the horizontal scaling architecture needed to add and remove instances behind a load balancer. Horizontal scaling is implemented with an Auto Scaling group and scaling policies, not merely by obtaining an instance type recommendation. See [Viewing EC2 instance recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ec2-recommendations.html) and [Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 Amazon EC2 实例上托管了一个单体 Web 应用程序。应用程序用户最近报告在特定时间性能不佳。对 Amazon CloudWatch 指标的分析显示，在性能不佳期间 CPU 利用率为 100%。该公司希望解决此性能问题并提高应用程序可用性。哪组步骤的组合能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 获取用于垂直扩展的实例类型建议。
options.B: 从 Web 服务器创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。在新的启动模板中引用该 AMI。
options.C: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组和一个 Application Load Balancer 以进行垂直扩展。
options.D: 使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 获取用于水平扩展的实例类型建议。
options.E: 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组和一个 Application Load Balancer 以进行水平扩展。

zh.explanation:
最具成本效益的解决方案是将单个 EC2 托管的 Web 应用程序迁移到可水平扩展、负载均衡的架构中。

**B. 从 Web 服务器创建一个 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。在新的启动模板中引用该 AMI — 正确。**  
Auto Scaling 组需要一个配置模板来启动替换或额外的 EC2 实例。AWS 文档说明，Auto Scaling 组使用启动模板作为 EC2 实例的配置模板，其中包括 AMI ID、实例类型、安全组和其他启动设置。从现有 Web 服务器创建 AMI，并在启动模板中引用它，可以让新实例以相同的应用程序配置启动。请参阅 [Create Auto Scaling groups using launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/create-auto-scaling-groups-launch-template.html) 和 [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)。

**E. 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组和一个 Application Load Balancer 以进行水平扩展 — 正确。**  
该应用程序仅在特定时间出现 CPU 饱和，这表明需求是可变的。使用 Auto Scaling 组进行水平扩展可以在高负载期间添加 EC2 实例，并在需求下降时移除实例，从而在避免长期运行更大实例成本的同时提升性能。AWS 说明 Auto Scaling 可以根据需求和扩展策略调整 EC2 实例数量。例如，目标跟踪策略可以在 CPU 利用率超过目标值时横向扩展，并在利用率下降时横向缩减。Application Load Balancer 会在各实例之间分配流量，并且可以附加到 Auto Scaling 组。请参阅 [Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)、[Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html) 和 [Attach an Elastic Load Balancing load balancer to an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/attach-load-balancer-asg.html)。

**A. 使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 获取用于垂直扩展的实例类型建议 — 不正确。**  
Compute Optimizer 可以为 EC2 实例类型的升配或降配提供建议，但仅进行垂直扩展无法提高可用性，因为应用程序仍然依赖单个 EC2 实例。对于仅在特定时间出现的工作负载峰值，它的成本效益也较低，因为更大的实例通常会持续运行，包括在低需求期间。Compute Optimizer 建议有助于实例合理调整大小，但其本身并不能提供此处所需的负载均衡、高可用架构。请参阅 [Viewing EC2 instance recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ec2-recommendations.html)。

**C. 创建一个 Auto Scaling 组和一个 Application Load Balancer 以进行垂直扩展 — 不正确。**  
带有 Application Load Balancer 的 Auto Scaling 组是一种水平扩展设计，而不是垂直扩展。Auto Scaling 组通过启动或终止 EC2 实例来调整容量，而不是通过增加正在运行实例的 CPU 或内存来调整容量。请参阅 [What is Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)。

**D. 使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 获取用于水平扩展的实例类型建议 — 不正确。**  
Compute Optimizer 为单个实例的合理调整大小提供 EC2 实例类型建议。它不会创建在负载均衡器后添加和移除实例所需的水平扩展架构。水平扩展是通过 Auto Scaling 组和扩展策略实现的，而不仅仅是获取实例类型建议。请参阅 [Viewing EC2 instance recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ec2-recommendations.html) 和 [Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)。

en.question: A company runs all its business applications in the AWS Cloud. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. A solutions architect needs to review all permissions that are granted to IAM users to determine which IAM users have more permissions than required. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?

options.A: Use Network Access Analyzer to review all access permissions in the company's AWS accounts.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudWatch alarm that activates when an IAM user creates or modifies resources in an AWS account.
options.C: Use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Analyzer to review all the company’s resources and accounts.
options.D: Use Amazon Inspector to find vulnerabilities in existing IAM policies.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** IAM Access Analyzer is the purpose-built service for this requirement. AWS documentation states that it helps identify and review unused access in AWS Organizations and accounts, continuously monitors IAM roles and users, and provides findings that show unused services and actions for active IAM users and roles. It can also be created for the **current organization** to centrally review all AWS accounts in an organization, with no need to create an analyzer in every Region for unused-access findings ([IAM Access Analyzer unused access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html), [create organization unused access analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-analyzer-create-unused.html)). This meets the permissions-review need with the least administrative overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Network Access Analyzer** evaluates network paths/access, such as traffic to and from internet gateways, not IAM user permissions ([VPC Network Access Analyzer usage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-vpc-bpa-assess-impact-main.html)).
- **B. CloudWatch alarm** can alert on metrics/events, but it would only notify when activity occurs; it does not review all granted IAM permissions or identify excessive unused permissions across accounts. CloudWatch is an observability service for metrics, alarms, logs, and dashboards ([Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)).
- **D. Amazon Inspector** scans workloads such as EC2 instances, ECR container images, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure; it is not used to find over-permissive IAM user policies ([Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Cloud 中运行其所有业务应用程序。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理多个 AWS 账户。一名解决方案架构师需要审查授予 IAM 用户的所有权限，以确定哪些 IAM 用户拥有超出所需范围的权限。哪种解决方案能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Network Access Analyzer 审查公司 AWS 账户中的所有访问权限。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CloudWatch 警报，当 IAM 用户在 AWS 账户中创建或修改资源时激活。
options.C: 使用 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) Access Analyzer 审查公司的所有资源和账户。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Inspector 查找现有 IAM 策略中的漏洞。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** IAM Access Analyzer 是专为此需求构建的服务。AWS 文档说明，它可帮助识别和审查 AWS Organizations 和账户中的未使用访问权限，持续监控 IAM roles 和 users，并提供 findings，显示活动 IAM users 和 roles 的未使用 services 和 actions。还可以为 **current organization** 创建它，以便集中审查组织中的所有 AWS 账户，并且对于未使用访问权限 findings，无需在每个 Region 中创建 analyzer（[IAM Access Analyzer unused access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html)，[create organization unused access analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-analyzer-create-unused.html)）。这能以最少的管理开销满足权限审查需求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A. Network Access Analyzer** 评估网络路径/访问，例如进出 internet gateways 的流量，而不是 IAM 用户权限（[VPC Network Access Analyzer usage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-vpc-bpa-assess-impact-main.html)）。
- **B. CloudWatch alarm** 可以针对指标/事件发出警报，但它只会在活动发生时通知；它不会审查所有已授予的 IAM 权限，也不会识别跨账户的过度未使用权限。CloudWatch 是一项用于 metrics、alarms、logs 和 dashboards 的可观测性服务（[Amazon CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/WhatIsCloudWatch.html)）。
- **D. Amazon Inspector** 扫描 EC2 instances、ECR container images 和 Lambda functions 等工作负载，以发现软件漏洞和意外的网络暴露；它不用于查找权限过高的 IAM 用户策略（[Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)）。

en.question: A company needs to implement a new data retention policy for regulatory compliance. As part of this policy, sensitive documents that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket must be protected from deletion or modification for a fixed period of time. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable governance mode.
options.B: Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable compliance mode.
options.C: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket. Set a lifecycle policy to delete the objects after a specified period.
options.D: Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval for the retention duration.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Activate S3 Object Lock on the required objects and enable compliance mode.**

S3 Object Lock retention periods protect an object version for a **fixed amount of time**. In **compliance mode**, a protected object version cannot be overwritten or deleted by **any user, including the AWS account root user**, and its retention period cannot be shortened. AWS explicitly recommends compliance mode when you never want any user to be able to delete objects during a predefined retention period and when you have a requirement to store compliant data ([AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Governance mode** protects objects only from most users. Users with `s3:BypassGovernanceRetention` permission can override or remove governance-mode retention and delete the objects, so it is not the strongest fit for regulatory compliance requiring protection from deletion or modification for the full fixed period ([AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)).
- **C. Versioning with a lifecycle delete policy** keeps multiple versions of objects, but versioning is not an immutable retention control. It does not prevent authorized users from deleting or modifying object versions during the retention period. Lifecycle expiration is for managing deletes of current/noncurrent versions, not enforcing WORM compliance ([AWS S3 Versioning documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)).
- **D. Lifecycle transition to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval** archives objects and can reduce storage costs, but a storage-class transition does not by itself prevent deletion or modification. S3 Lifecycle rules are for transitioning, archiving, or deleting objects as part of lifecycle management ([AWS S3 Lifecycle documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要实施一项新的数据保留策略以满足监管合规要求。作为该策略的一部分，存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中的敏感文档必须在固定时间段内受到保护，防止被删除或修改。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在所需对象上激活 S3 Object Lock，并启用治理模式。
options.B: 在所需对象上激活 S3 Object Lock，并启用合规模式。
options.C: 在 S3 bucket 上启用版本控制。设置生命周期策略，在指定时间段后删除这些对象。
options.D: 配置 S3 Lifecycle 策略，在保留期限内将对象转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 在所需对象上激活 S3 Object Lock，并启用合规模式。**

S3 Object Lock 保留期会在**固定时间长度**内保护对象版本。在**合规模式**下，受保护的对象版本不能被**任何用户（包括 AWS 账户根用户）**覆盖或删除，并且其保留期不能被缩短。AWS 明确建议：当你绝不希望任何用户在预定义保留期内删除对象，并且你有存储合规数据的要求时，应使用合规模式（[AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. 治理模式**仅能保护对象免受大多数用户操作的影响。拥有 `s3:BypassGovernanceRetention` 权限的用户可以覆盖或移除治理模式保留并删除对象，因此它并不是满足监管合规要求（需要在整个固定期间内防止删除或修改）的最强匹配方案（[AWS S3 Object Lock documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lock.html)）。
- **C. 版本控制加生命周期删除策略**会保留对象的多个版本，但版本控制不是不可变保留控制。它不能防止授权用户在保留期内删除或修改对象版本。生命周期过期用于管理当前/非当前版本的删除，而不是强制执行 WORM 合规（[AWS S3 Versioning documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Versioning.html)）。
- **D. 生命周期转换到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval**会归档对象并可降低存储成本，但仅进行存储类别转换本身并不能防止删除或修改。S3 Lifecycle 规则用于在生命周期管理过程中转换、归档或删除对象（[AWS S3 Lifecycle documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html)）。

en.question: A company runs its customer-facing web application on containers. The workload uses Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. The web application is resource intensive. The web application needs to be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for customers. The company expects the application to experience short bursts of high traffic. The workload must be highly available. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate. Conduct load testing by using a third-party tool. Rightsize the Fargate tasks in Amazon CloudWatch.
options.B: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate for steady state and Fargate Spot for burst traffic.
options.C: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate Spot for steady state and Fargate for burst traffic.
options.D: Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate. Use AWS Compute Optimizer to rightsize the Fargate task.

en.explanation:
**Answer: B. Configure an ECS capacity provider with Fargate for steady state and Fargate Spot for burst traffic.**

Amazon ECS on Fargate capacity providers can use **both Fargate and Fargate Spot** for ECS tasks. AWS states that **Fargate Spot** runs interruption-tolerant ECS tasks at a **discounted rate compared to Fargate**, using spare capacity, but tasks can be interrupted with a two-minute warning ([Amazon ECS clusters for Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-capacity-providers.html)). Therefore, keeping the always-needed steady-state capacity on regular **Fargate** supports 24/7 availability, while using **Fargate Spot** for short burst capacity is the most cost-effective fit for temporary, extra demand.

Why the other options are not best:

- **A**: Fargate-only capacity with CloudWatch-based rightsizing may reduce overprovisioning, but it keeps all burst capacity on regular Fargate. It does not use the documented discounted Fargate Spot capacity for interruption-tolerant extra tasks, so it is not the most cost-effective for short bursts.
- **C**: Using **Fargate Spot for steady state** is inappropriate for a workload that must be highly available 24/7. AWS notes that Fargate Spot capacity can be interrupted and can also be unavailable during high demand; services retry, but Fargate does not replace Spot capacity with on-demand capacity ([Amazon ECS clusters for Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-capacity-providers.html)).
- **D**: AWS Compute Optimizer can provide ECS services on Fargate task-size recommendations and estimated savings ([Viewing Amazon ECS services on Fargate recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ecs-recommendations.html)). However, this option still uses only regular Fargate capacity for both steady state and bursts, so it is less cost-effective for burst traffic than combining Fargate with discounted Fargate Spot.

zh.question: 一家公司在容器上运行其面向客户的 Web 应用程序。该工作负载使用 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。该 Web 应用程序资源密集型。该 Web 应用程序需要每周 7 天、每天 24 小时对客户可用。公司预计该应用程序会经历短时间的高流量突增。该工作负载必须具备高可用性。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Fargate 配置 ECS 容量提供程序。使用第三方工具进行负载测试。在 Amazon CloudWatch 中为 Fargate 任务调整合适的大小。
options.B: 为稳定状态使用 Fargate、为突发流量使用 Fargate Spot 来配置 ECS 容量提供程序。
options.C: 为稳定状态使用 Fargate Spot、为突发流量使用 Fargate 来配置 ECS 容量提供程序。
options.D: 使用 Fargate 配置 ECS 容量提供程序。使用 AWS Compute Optimizer 为 Fargate 任务调整合适的大小。

zh.explanation:
**答案：B. 为稳定状态使用 Fargate、为突发流量使用 Fargate Spot 来配置 ECS 容量提供程序。**

Fargate 上的 Amazon ECS 容量提供程序可以为 ECS 任务同时使用 **Fargate 和 Fargate Spot**。AWS 指出，**Fargate Spot** 使用备用容量，以**相较于 Fargate 的折扣价格**运行可容忍中断的 ECS 任务，但任务可能会在收到两分钟警告后被中断（[Amazon ECS clusters for Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-capacity-providers.html)）。因此，将始终需要的稳定状态容量保留在常规 **Fargate** 上可支持 24/7 可用性，而将 **Fargate Spot** 用于短期突发容量，是满足临时额外需求的最具成本效益的选择。为什么其他选项不是最佳选择：

- **A**：仅使用 Fargate 的容量并基于 CloudWatch 调整大小可能会减少过度预置，但它将所有突发容量都保留在常规 Fargate 上。它没有使用文档中说明的、面向可容忍中断的额外任务的折扣 Fargate Spot 容量，因此对于短期突发并非最具成本效益。
- **C**：将 **Fargate Spot 用于稳定状态**不适合必须 24/7 高可用的工作负载。AWS 指出，Fargate Spot 容量可能会被中断，并且在高需求期间也可能不可用；服务会重试，但 Fargate 不会用按需容量替换 Spot 容量（[Amazon ECS clusters for Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/fargate-capacity-providers.html)）。
- **D**：AWS Compute Optimizer 可以提供 Fargate 上 ECS 服务的任务大小建议和预估节省（[Viewing Amazon ECS services on Fargate recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ecs-recommendations.html)）。但是，此选项仍然仅使用常规 Fargate 容量来处理稳定状态和突发，因此对于突发流量，其成本效益不如将 Fargate 与折扣 Fargate Spot 结合使用。

en.question: A company is building an application in the AWS Cloud. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company uses Amazon Route 53 for the DNS. The company needs a managed solution with proactive engagement to detect against DDoS attacks. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS Config. Configure an AWS Config managed rule that detects DDoS attacks.
options.B: Enable AWS WAF on the ALCreate an AWS WAF web ACL with rules to detect and prevent DDoS attacks. Associate the web ACL with the ALB.
options.C: Store the ALB access logs in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure Amazon GuardDuty to detect and take automated preventative actions for DDoS attacks.
options.D: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Configure hosted zones in Route 53. Add ALB resources as protected resources.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Shield Advanced is the managed AWS service for enhanced DDoS protection. AWS states that Shield Standard and Shield Advanced protect against DDoS attacks at layers 3, 4, and 7, and that customers can subscribe to Shield Advanced for higher levels of protection ([AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)). Shield Advanced also protects the exact resource types in the question: Route 53 hosted zones and Application Load Balancers, but protections apply only to resources that are explicitly specified ([protected resources list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-advanced-summary-protected-resources.html)). For proactive engagement, AWS says the Shield Response Team (SRT) contacts you directly during a possible attack, and that proactive engagement is available for web request floods on Application Load Balancers when the Shield Advanced protection has an associated Route 53 health check ([proactive engagement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-srt-proactive-engagement.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

* **A:** AWS Config evaluates and tracks resource configurations and compliance; its rules flag noncompliant configurations, not live DDoS attacks ([AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)).
* **B:** AWS WAF can protect an ALB and can help control HTTP/HTTPS requests, including common web attacks such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, but WAF alone does not provide Shield Advanced proactive SRT engagement ([AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)).
* **C:** GuardDuty is a threat detection service that analyzes logs and data sources for suspicious activity such as compromised credentials, malware, and cryptomining; it is not the managed DDoS protection service with proactive engagement, and it does not take automatic preventative DDoS mitigation actions from ALB access logs ([GuardDuty](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中构建一个应用程序。该应用程序托管在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该公司使用 Amazon Route 53 进行 DNS。该公司需要一个托管式解决方案，并具备主动参与能力，以检测 DDoS 攻击。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 启用 AWS Config。配置一个 AWS Config 托管规则来检测 DDoS 攻击。
options.B: 在 ALCreate 上启用 AWS WAF 一个 AWS WAF web ACL，并使用规则来检测和防止 DDoS 攻击。将该 web ACL 与 ALB 关联。
options.C: 将 ALB 访问日志存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。配置 Amazon GuardDuty 来检测 DDoS 攻击并采取自动化预防措施。
options.D: 订阅 AWS Shield Advanced。配置 Route 53 中的托管区域。将 ALB 资源添加为受保护资源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** AWS Shield Advanced 是用于增强型 DDoS 防护的 AWS 托管服务。AWS 表示，Shield Standard 和 Shield Advanced 可在第 3、4 和 7 层防御 DDoS 攻击，并且客户可以订阅 Shield Advanced 以获得更高级别的保护（[AWS Shield overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-overview.html)）。Shield Advanced 还保护题目中提到的确切资源类型：Route 53 托管区域和 Application Load Balancers，但保护仅适用于明确指定的资源（[protected resources list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-advanced-summary-protected-resources.html)）。对于主动参与，AWS 表示 Shield Response Team (SRT) 会在可能发生攻击期间直接联系你，并且当 Shield Advanced 保护关联了 Route 53 health check 时，主动参与可用于 Application Load Balancers 上的 Web 请求洪泛（[proactive engagement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-srt-proactive-engagement.html)）。

**为什么其他选项错误：**

* **A:** AWS Config 评估并跟踪资源配置和合规性；其规则标记不合规配置，而不是实时 DDoS 攻击（[AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)）。
* **B:** AWS WAF 可以保护 ALB，并可帮助控制 HTTP/HTTPS 请求，包括 SQL injection 和 cross-site scripting 等常见 Web 攻击，但仅靠 WAF 并不提供 Shield Advanced 的主动 SRT 参与（[AWS WAF](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。
* **C:** GuardDuty 是一种威胁检测服务，它分析日志和数据源以发现可疑活动，例如凭证泄露、恶意软件和加密货币挖矿；它不是具有主动参与能力的托管式 DDoS 防护服务，也不会基于 ALB 访问日志自动采取预防性 DDoS 缓解措施（[GuardDuty](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts a video streaming web application in a VPC. The company uses a Network Load Balancer (NLB) to handle TCP traffic for real-time data processing. There have been unauthorized attempts to access the application. The company wants to improve application security with minimal architectural change to prevent unauthorized attempts to access the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement a series of AWS WAF rules directly on the NLB to filter out unauthorized traffic.
options.B: Recreate the NLB with a security group to allow only trusted IP addresses.
options.C: Deploy a second NLB in parallel with the existing NLB configured with a strict IP address allow list.
options.D: Use AWS Shield Advanced to provide enhanced DDoS protection and prevent unauthorized access attempts.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **B. Recreate the NLB with a security group to allow only trusted IP addresses.**

A Network Load Balancer can use security groups to control which traffic is allowed to reach the load balancer. AWS documentation states that you can associate a security group with a Network Load Balancer to control allowed inbound traffic by port, protocol, and source, and that if no security group is assigned, all client traffic can reach the NLB listeners ([AWS ELB documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html)). Therefore, configuring the NLB with security group rules that allow only trusted source IP addresses directly addresses the requirement to prevent unauthorized access attempts with minimal architectural change.

Because the application uses an NLB for TCP traffic, security groups are the appropriate Layer 4 access control mechanism. If the existing NLB was created without a security group, recreating it with a security group is the required approach to apply this filtering at the load balancer level.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Implement a series of AWS WAF rules directly on the NLB to filter out unauthorized traffic.**  
  AWS WAF is designed to inspect and control HTTP and HTTPS web requests, and it is associated with supported web resources such as CloudFront distributions, Application Load Balancers, API Gateway, and similar resources. It is not applied directly to Network Load Balancers handling TCP traffic ([AWS WAF documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html), [AWS WAF supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)).

- **C. Deploy a second NLB in parallel with the existing NLB configured with a strict IP address allow list.**  
  Deploying a second NLB adds unnecessary complexity and is not the minimal architectural change. The requirement can be met by using security groups on the NLB to restrict access from trusted IP addresses.

- **D. Use AWS Shield Advanced to provide enhanced DDoS protection and prevent unauthorized access attempts.**  
  AWS Shield Advanced provides protection against distributed denial-of-service attacks at network, transport, and application layers ([AWS WAF and Shield documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)). Shield Advanced can protect Network Load Balancers in DDoS scenarios, but it is not an IP allow-listing access control mechanism for preventing ordinary unauthorized connection attempts ([Shield Advanced for EC2 and NLB documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-ec2-nlb.html)). The requirement is to allow only trusted IP addresses, which is better satisfied by NLB security groups.

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 中托管一个视频流 Web 应用程序。该公司使用 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 来处理用于实时数据处理的 TCP 流量。曾经出现过未经授权访问该应用程序的尝试。该公司希望通过最小的架构变更来提升应用程序安全性，以防止未经授权的应用程序访问尝试。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 直接在 NLB 上实施一系列 AWS WAF 规则，以过滤掉未经授权的流量。
options.B: 使用安全组重新创建 NLB，以仅允许受信任的 IP 地址。
options.C: 与现有 NLB 并行部署第二个 NLB，并配置严格的 IP 地址允许列表。
options.D: 使用 AWS Shield Advanced 提供增强型 DDoS 保护，并防止未经授权的访问尝试。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B. Recreate the NLB with a security group to allow only trusted IP addresses.**

Network Load Balancer 可以使用安全组来控制允许哪些流量到达负载均衡器。AWS 文档说明，你可以将安全组与 Network Load Balancer 关联，以按端口、协议和来源控制允许的入站流量；如果未分配安全组，则所有客户端流量都可以到达 NLB 侦听器（[AWS ELB documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html)）。因此，配置 NLB 安全组规则以仅允许受信任的源 IP 地址，直接满足了通过最小架构变更防止未经授权访问尝试的要求。由于该应用程序使用 NLB 处理 TCP 流量，安全组是合适的 Layer 4 访问控制机制。如果现有 NLB 在创建时没有安全组，则必须使用安全组重新创建它，才能在负载均衡器级别应用此过滤。

**其他选项为什么不正确：**

- **A. Implement a series of AWS WAF rules directly on the NLB to filter out unauthorized traffic.**  
  AWS WAF 旨在检查和控制 HTTP 与 HTTPS Web 请求，并与受支持的 Web 资源关联，例如 CloudFront 分配、Application Load Balancers、API Gateway 以及类似资源。它不会直接应用于处理 TCP 流量的 Network Load Balancers（[AWS WAF documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)，[AWS WAF supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/how-aws-waf-works-resources.html)）。

- **C. Deploy a second NLB in parallel with the existing NLB configured with a strict IP address allow list.**  
  部署第二个 NLB 会增加不必要的复杂性，并且不是最小的架构变更。可以通过在 NLB 上使用安全组来限制来自受信任 IP 地址的访问，从而满足该要求。

- **D. Use AWS Shield Advanced to provide enhanced DDoS protection and prevent unauthorized access attempts.**  
  AWS Shield Advanced 提供针对网络层、传输层和应用层分布式拒绝服务攻击的防护（[AWS WAF and Shield documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/what-is-aws-waf.html)）。Shield Advanced 可以在 DDoS 场景中保护 Network Load Balancers，但它不是用于防止普通未经授权连接尝试的 IP 允许列表访问控制机制（[Shield Advanced for EC2 and NLB documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/ddos-protections-ec2-nlb.html)）。要求是仅允许受信任的 IP 地址，这更适合通过 NLB 安全组来满足。

en.question: A healthcare company is developing an AWS Lambda function that publishes notifications to an encrypted Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The notifications contain protected health information (PHI). The SNS topic uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys for encryption. The company must ensure that the application has the necessary permissions to publish messages securely to the SNS topic. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a resource policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to publish messages to the topic.
options.B: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) for the SNS topic instead of customer managed keys.
options.C: Create a resource policy for the encryption key that the SNS topic uses that has the necessary AWS KMS permissions.
options.D: Specify the Lambda function's Amazon Resource Name (ARN) in the SNS topic's resource policy.
options.E: Associate an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API with the SNS topic to control access to the topic by using API Gateway resource policies.
options.F: Configure a Lambda execution role that has the necessary IAM permissions to use a customer managed key in AWS KMS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A, C, F.**

- **A — Create an SNS topic resource policy that allows publishing.** Amazon SNS topic access can be controlled with the topic access policy. AWS documentation shows that granting `sns:Publish` in a topic access control policy gives the specified principal permission to publish messages to the topic, and notes that custom policies can grant permissions to specific IAM roles or services by updating the topic `Policy` attribute with `SetTopicAttributes` ([SNS access control examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-access-policy-use-cases.html)).
- **C — Create/update the KMS key resource policy.** For an SNS topic encrypted with a **custom/customer managed KMS key**, AWS states that the key policy must include permissions that allow Amazon SNS to encrypt and decrypt messages, including `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` for the `sns.amazonaws.com` service principal ([SNS topic encryption setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-enable-encryption-for-topic.html)). KMS key policies are resource policies and are the primary way to control access to KMS keys; IAM permissions alone do not allow access unless the key policy permits it ([KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)).
- **F — Configure the Lambda execution role with needed IAM permissions.** A Lambda function uses its **execution role** to access AWS services and resources, and AWS recommends granting only the permissions required by the function ([Lambda execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)). Therefore, the execution role needs the necessary permissions to publish to SNS and to use the customer managed KMS key as required by the encrypted topic configuration.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B** is incorrect because the topic already uses AWS KMS customer managed keys for SNS server-side encryption. Replacing them with a different SSE-KMS arrangement does not address the required access permissions and would reduce customer control if it implied using an AWS managed key.
- **D** is incorrect because when Lambda function code publishes to SNS, the caller identity is the Lambda **execution role**, not the Lambda function ARN. The topic policy should grant `sns:Publish` to the appropriate principal such as the execution role/account, rather than merely listing the function ARN.
- **E** is incorrect because API Gateway is not involved in a Lambda function directly publishing to an SNS topic. The required controls are SNS topic permissions plus KMS key/IAM permissions, not API Gateway resource policies.

zh.question: 一家医疗保健公司正在开发一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数会将通知发布到一个加密的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。这些通知包含受保护的健康信息 (PHI)。该 SNS 主题使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户托管密钥进行加密。公司必须确保应用程序具备必要权限，以便安全地向该 SNS 主题发布消息。哪一组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为 SNS 主题创建资源策略，允许 Lambda 函数向该主题发布消息。
options.B: 对 SNS 主题使用带 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)，而不是使用客户托管密钥。
options.C: 为 SNS 主题所使用的加密密钥创建资源策略，并包含必要的 AWS KMS 权限。
options.D: 在 SNS 主题的资源策略中指定 Lambda 函数的 Amazon Resource Name (ARN)。
options.E: 将 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API 与 SNS 主题关联，通过使用 API Gateway 资源策略来控制对该主题的访问。
options.F: 配置一个 Lambda 执行角色，使其具有在 AWS KMS 中使用客户托管密钥所需的 IAM 权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A, C, F。**

- **A — 创建允许发布的 SNS 主题资源策略。** Amazon SNS 主题访问可以通过主题访问策略进行控制。AWS 文档显示，在主题访问控制策略中授予 `sns:Publish` 会向指定主体授予向该主题发布消息的权限，并指出可以通过使用 `SetTopicAttributes` 更新主题 `Policy` 属性，让自定义策略向特定 IAM roles 或服务授予权限（[SNS access control examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-access-policy-use-cases.html)）。
- **C — 创建/更新 KMS 密钥资源策略。** 对于使用 **custom/customer managed KMS key** 加密的 SNS 主题，AWS 指出密钥策略必须包含允许 Amazon SNS 加密和解密消息的权限，包括授予 `sns.amazonaws.com` 服务主体 `kms:Decrypt` 和 `kms:GenerateDataKey`（[SNS topic encryption setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-enable-encryption-for-topic.html)）。KMS 密钥策略是资源策略，也是控制 KMS 密钥访问的主要方式；除非密钥策略允许，否则仅有 IAM 权限并不能允许访问（[KMS key policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/key-policies.html)）。
- **F — 为 Lambda 执行角色配置所需的 IAM 权限。** Lambda 函数使用其 **执行角色** 来访问 AWS 服务和资源，AWS 建议仅授予函数所需的权限（[Lambda execution role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-intro-execution-role.html)）。因此，执行角色需要具备发布到 SNS 的必要权限，并需要具备按加密主题配置要求使用客户托管 KMS 密钥的必要权限。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B** 不正确，因为该主题已经使用 AWS KMS 客户托管密钥进行 SNS 服务器端加密。用不同的 SSE-KMS 安排替换它们并不能解决所需的访问权限问题；如果这意味着使用 AWS 托管密钥，还会降低客户控制能力。
- **D** 不正确，因为当 Lambda 函数代码发布到 SNS 时，调用者身份是 Lambda **执行角色**，而不是 Lambda 函数 ARN。主题策略应向适当主体（例如执行角色/账户）授予 `sns:Publish`，而不是仅仅列出函数 ARN。
- **E** 不正确，因为 Lambda 函数直接发布到 SNS 主题时不涉及 API Gateway。所需的控制是 SNS 主题权限加上 KMS 密钥/IAM 权限，而不是 API Gateway 资源策略。

en.question: A company has an employee web portal. Employees log in to the portal to view payroll details. The company is developing a new system to give employees the ability to upload scanned documents for reimbursement. The company runs a program to extract text-based data from the documents and attach the extracted information to each employee’s reimbursement IDs for processing. The employee web portal requires 100% uptime. The document extract program runs infrequently throughout the day on an on-demand basis. The company wants to build a scalable and cost-effective new system that will require minimal changes to the existing web portal. The company does not want to make any code changes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Run Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Use an AWS Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document.
options.B: Run Amazon EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group for the web portal. Run the document extract program on EC2 Spot Instances. Start document extract program instances when an employee uploads a new reimbursement document.
options.C: Purchase a Savings Plan to run the web portal and the document extract program. Run the web portal and the document extract program in an Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to host the web portal. Use Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function for the existing functionalities. Use the Lambda function to run the document extract program. Invoke the Lambda function when the API that is associated with a new document upload is called.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Keep the existing employee web portal on EC2 in an Auto Scaling group and add the new document-processing capability as an event-driven Lambda function. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling maintains the desired number of instances, replaces unhealthy instances, and can dynamically scale capacity to meet demand, which fits the always-available web portal requirement with minimal architectural change to the existing portal ([Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)). For the infrequent, on-demand document extraction workload, Lambda is a better fit because it runs code without managing servers, scales automatically, and uses pay-per-use pricing; AWS specifically lists file processing when files are uploaded as a Lambda use case ([What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)). Lambda can also be invoked asynchronously by Amazon S3 when a new object is created, which matches “run when an employee uploads a document” ([Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Spot Instances are not appropriate for a portal requiring 100% uptime. AWS notes that Spot Instances can be terminated by Amazon EC2 as Spot availability or price changes ([Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)).
- **C:** A Savings Plan can reduce costs, but it does not by itself create an event-driven, on-demand processing architecture. Savings Plans require a one- or three-year hourly compute commitment ([What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)). Running the infrequent extractor on EC2 in an Auto Scaling group is more operationally heavy and less naturally on-demand than Lambda.
- **D:** Moving the existing portal to S3, API Gateway, and Lambda would require a major re-architecture and likely code changes. Also, Amazon S3 website hosting is for **static** websites with static content and optional client-side scripts, not an existing dynamic payroll portal without changes ([Hosting a static website using Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个员工 Web 门户。员工登录该门户查看工资明细。该公司正在开发一个新系统，使员工能够上传用于报销的扫描文档。该公司运行一个程序，从文档中提取基于文本的数据，并将提取的信息附加到每位员工的报销 ID 上以进行处理。员工 Web 门户要求 100% 正常运行时间。文档提取程序在一天中按需、不频繁地运行。该公司希望构建一个可扩展且具有成本效益的新系统，并且需要对现有 Web 门户进行最少的更改。该公司不想进行任何代码更改。哪种解决方案能够以最少的实施工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Auto Scaling 组中运行用于 Web 门户的 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances。使用 AWS Lambda 函数运行文档提取程序。当员工上传新的报销文档时调用 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 在 Auto Scaling 组中运行用于 Web 门户的 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances。在 EC2 Spot Instances 上运行文档提取程序。当员工上传新的报销文档时启动文档提取程序实例。
options.C: 购买 Savings Plan 来运行 Web 门户和文档提取程序。在 Auto Scaling 组中运行 Web 门户和文档提取程序。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来托管 Web 门户。将 Amazon API Gateway 和 AWS Lambda 函数用于现有功能。使用 Lambda 函数运行文档提取程序。当调用与新文档上传相关联的 API 时调用 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A.**

将现有员工 Web 门户保留在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 上，并将新的文档处理能力作为事件驱动的 Lambda 函数添加。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会维持所需的实例数量、替换不健康实例，并且可以动态扩展容量以满足需求，这符合始终可用的 Web 门户要求，同时对现有门户的架构更改最少（[Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）。对于不频繁、按需的文档提取工作负载，Lambda 更适合，因为它无需管理服务器即可运行代码、可自动扩展，并采用按使用付费定价；AWS 明确将文件上传时的文件处理列为 Lambda 用例（[What is AWS Lambda?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。当创建新对象时，Lambda 也可以由 Amazon S3 异步调用，这与“在员工上传文档时运行”相匹配（[Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** Spot Instances 不适合要求 100% 正常运行时间的门户。AWS 指出，当 Spot 可用性或价格发生变化时，Spot Instances 可能会被 Amazon EC2 终止（[Auto Scaling groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/auto-scaling-groups.html)）。
- **C:** Savings Plan 可以降低成本，但它本身并不能创建事件驱动的按需处理架构。Savings Plans 需要一年或三年的每小时计算承诺（[What are Savings Plans?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html)）。在 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 上运行不频繁的提取程序，相比 Lambda 运营负担更重，也不如 Lambda 那样天然适合按需运行。
- **D:** 将现有门户迁移到 S3、API Gateway 和 Lambda 将需要重大重新架构，并且可能需要代码更改。此外，Amazon S3 网站托管用于包含静态内容和可选客户端脚本的 **static** 网站，而不是无需更改的现有动态工资门户（[Hosting a static website using Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。

en.question: A media company has a multi-account AWS environment in the us-east-1 Region. The company has an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic in a production account that publishes performance metrics. The company has an AWS Lambda function in an administrator account to process and analyze log data. The Lambda function that is in the administrator account must be invoked by messages from the SNS topic that is in the production account when significant metrics are reported. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an IAM resource policy for the Lambda function that allows Amazon SNS to invoke the function.
options.B: Implement an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue in the administrator account to buffer messages from the SNS topic that is in the production account. Configure the SQS queue to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Create an IAM policy for the SNS topic that allows the Lambda function to subscribe to the topic.
options.D: Use an Amazon EventBridge rule in the production account to capture the SNS topic notifications. Configure the EventBridge rule to forward notifications to the Lambda function that is in the administrator account.
options.E: Store performance metrics in an Amazon S3 bucket in the production account. Use Amazon Athena to analyze the metrics from the administrator account.

en.explanation:
The best choices are **A and C**.

- **A is correct**: For Amazon SNS to invoke a Lambda function, the Lambda function must have a resource-based policy statement that allows the SNS service principal to call `lambda:InvokeFunction`. AWS explicitly states that “for Amazon SNS to invoke your function, you need to grant it permission in a statement on a resource-based policy,” and shows `aws lambda add-permission` with `--principal sns.amazonaws.com` and the SNS topic ARN as the source ARN ([AWS Lambda SNS cross-account tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns-example.html)).
- **C is correct**: Because the SNS topic is in one account and the Lambda function is in another account, the topic account must allow the other account to subscribe. AWS states: “For your Lambda function in account B to subscribe to the Amazon SNS topic you created in account A, you need to grant permission for account B to subscribe to your topic,” and shows `aws sns add-permission` granting `Subscribe` and `ListSubscriptionsByTopic` on the SNS topic ([AWS Lambda SNS cross-account tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns-example.html)). AWS also documents that manually adding an SNS trigger requires both defining a Lambda resource-based policy and subscribing the Lambda function to the SNS topic, with extra permissions for cross-account subscriptions ([Invoking Lambda functions with Amazon SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is not the required combination**: An SQS queue can be subscribed to an SNS topic, but this would require a different integration pattern and additional queue access policy permissions for SNS to send messages to SQS. AWS documents that for SNS to send to SQS, the queue policy must allow `sqs:SendMessage` from the SNS topic ([Subscribing an Amazon SQS queue to an Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/subscribe-sqs-queue-to-sns-topic.html)). The question asks for invoking the existing Lambda function from the SNS topic; the direct documented cross-account SNS-to-Lambda solution is A + C.
- **D is incorrect**: The requirement is for SNS topic messages to invoke a Lambda function. The documented SNS-to-Lambda setup is to subscribe the Lambda function as an SNS endpoint; when a message is published to an SNS topic with a Lambda function subscribed, the Lambda function is invoked with the message payload ([Subscribing a Lambda function to an Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/lambda-console.html)). EventBridge is not necessary and is not the documented SNS subscription mechanism here.
- **E is incorrect**: Storing metrics in S3 and querying with Athena is an analytics approach, not a mechanism for SNS messages to invoke a Lambda function when significant metrics are reported.

zh.question: 一家媒体公司在 us-east-1 Region 中拥有一个多账户 AWS 环境。该公司在生产账户中有一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，用于发布性能指标。该公司在管理员账户中有一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于处理和分析日志数据。当报告重要指标时，管理员账户中的 Lambda 函数必须由生产账户中的 SNS 主题消息调用。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 为 Lambda 函数创建一个 IAM 资源策略，允许 Amazon SNS 调用该函数。
options.B: 在管理员账户中实施一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列，用于缓冲来自生产账户中 SNS 主题的消息。配置 SQS 队列以调用 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 为 SNS 主题创建一个 IAM 策略，允许 Lambda 函数订阅该主题。
options.D: 在生产账户中使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则捕获 SNS 主题通知。配置 EventBridge 规则将通知转发到管理员账户中的 Lambda 函数。
options.E: 将性能指标存储在生产账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon Athena 从管理员账户分析这些指标。

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **A 和 C**。

- **A 正确**：要让 Amazon SNS 调用 Lambda 函数，Lambda 函数必须具有基于资源的策略语句，允许 SNS 服务主体调用 `lambda:InvokeFunction`。AWS 明确指出，“for Amazon SNS to invoke your function, you need to grant it permission in a statement on a resource-based policy”，并展示了使用 `aws lambda add-permission`，其中包含 `--principal sns.amazonaws.com` 以及作为源 ARN 的 SNS 主题 ARN（[AWS Lambda SNS cross-account tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns-example.html)）。
- **C 正确**：由于 SNS 主题位于一个账户中，而 Lambda 函数位于另一个账户中，主题所在账户必须允许另一个账户订阅。AWS 指出：“For your Lambda function in account B to subscribe to the Amazon SNS topic you created in account A, you need to grant permission for account B to subscribe to your topic”，并展示了使用 `aws sns add-permission` 在 SNS 主题上授予 `Subscribe` 和 `ListSubscriptionsByTopic`（[AWS Lambda SNS cross-account tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns-example.html)）。AWS 还记录了手动添加 SNS 触发器需要同时定义 Lambda 基于资源的策略，并将 Lambda 函数订阅到 SNS 主题；对于跨账户订阅还需要额外权限（[Invoking Lambda functions with Amazon SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sns.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不是所需的组合**：SQS 队列可以订阅 SNS 主题，但这需要一种不同的集成模式，并且还需要额外的队列访问策略权限，才能让 SNS 向 SQS 发送消息。AWS 文档说明，对于 SNS 向 SQS 发送消息，队列策略必须允许来自 SNS 主题的 `sqs:SendMessage`（[Subscribing an Amazon SQS queue to an Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/subscribe-sqs-queue-to-sns-topic.html)）。题目要求从 SNS 主题调用现有的 Lambda 函数；直接且有文档说明的跨账户 SNS-to-Lambda 解决方案是 A + C。
- **D 不正确**：要求是让 SNS 主题消息调用 Lambda 函数。有文档说明的 SNS-to-Lambda 设置是将 Lambda 函数作为 SNS 端点进行订阅；当消息发布到已订阅 Lambda 函数的 SNS 主题时，Lambda 函数会使用该消息负载被调用（[Subscribing a Lambda function to an Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/lambda-console.html)）。EventBridge 不是必需的，也不是此处记录的 SNS 订阅机制。
- **E 不正确**：将指标存储在 S3 中并使用 Athena 查询是一种分析方法，而不是在报告重要指标时让 SNS 消息调用 Lambda 函数的机制。

en.question: A company is migrating an application from an on-premises location to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The company must use a custom subnet for pods that are in the company's VPC to comply with requirements. The company also needs to ensure that the pods can communicate securely within the pods' VPC. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Transit Gateway to directly manage custom subnet configurations for the pods in Amazon EKS.
options.B: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection from the company's on-premises IP address ranges to the EKS pods.
options.C: Use the Amazon VPC CNI plugin for Kubernetes. Define custom subnets in the VPC cluster for the pods to use.
options.D: Implement a Kubernetes network policy that has pod anti-affinity rules to restrict pod placement to specific nodes that are within custom subnets.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C**.

Amazon EKS uses the **Amazon VPC CNI plugin** for cluster networking, and the plugin gives Pods VPC-network IP addresses and sets up Pod-to-Pod communication. AWS documents that EKS implements cluster networking through the Amazon VPC CNI plugin and that the CNI binary sets up Pod networking to enable Pod-to-Pod communication ([Amazon VPC CNI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/vpc-cni.html)). For the custom subnet requirement, AWS specifically describes **custom networking** for deploying Pods in alternate subnets: the VPC CNI plugin can create secondary network interfaces in a different subnet, and with custom networking enabled, Pod IPs are assigned from secondary network interfaces; the specified subnets and security groups must be in the same VPC as the node ([Deploy Pods in alternate subnets with custom networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-custom-network.html)). Therefore, defining custom subnets for Pods through the VPC CNI custom networking feature meets both requirements.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: AWS Transit Gateway provides network connectivity, but it does not directly manage Amazon EKS Pod subnet allocation. The EKS custom subnet capability is provided by the Amazon VPC CNI custom networking feature, not Transit Gateway ([Deploy Pods in alternate subnets with custom networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-custom-network.html)).
- **B**: AWS Direct Connect connectivity from on premises does not configure which VPC subnets EKS Pods use. The requirement is Pod subnet placement inside the VPC, which is handled by VPC CNI custom networking.
- **D**: Kubernetes network policies restrict traffic to and from Pods at the IP/port level; they are for traffic segmentation, not assigning Pods to custom VPC subnets or controlling ENI/subnet selection ([Limit Pod traffic with Kubernetes network policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-network-policy.html)). Pod anti-affinity is a scheduling concept and does not satisfy custom VPC subnet allocation.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将一个应用程序从本地位置迁移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。为满足要求，该公司必须为位于公司 VPC 中的 pod 使用自定义子网。公司还需要确保这些 pod 能够在 pod 的 VPC 内安全通信。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS Transit Gateway，以直接管理 Amazon EKS 中 pod 的自定义子网配置。
options.B: 从公司的本地 IP 地址范围到 EKS pod 创建 AWS Direct Connect 连接。
options.C: 使用适用于 Kubernetes 的 Amazon VPC CNI plugin。在 VPC 集群中定义供 pod 使用的自定义子网。
options.D: 实施具有 pod 反亲和性规则的 Kubernetes network policy，以将 pod 放置限制在位于自定义子网内的特定节点上。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C**。

Amazon EKS 使用 **Amazon VPC CNI plugin** 进行集群联网，该插件为 Pods 提供 VPC 网络 IP 地址并设置 Pod 到 Pod 的通信。AWS 文档说明，EKS 通过 Amazon VPC CNI plugin 实现集群联网，并且 CNI 二进制文件会设置 Pod 网络以启用 Pod 到 Pod 的通信（[Amazon VPC CNI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/best-practices/vpc-cni.html)）。对于自定义子网要求，AWS 专门描述了用于在备用子网中部署 Pods 的 **custom networking**：VPC CNI plugin 可以在不同子网中创建辅助网络接口，并且在启用 custom networking 后，Pod IP 会从辅助网络接口分配；指定的子网和安全组必须与节点位于同一个 VPC 中（[Deploy Pods in alternate subnets with custom networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-custom-network.html)）。因此，通过 VPC CNI custom networking 功能为 Pods 定义自定义子网可以满足这两个要求。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A**：AWS Transit Gateway 提供网络连接，但它不直接管理 Amazon EKS Pod 子网分配。EKS 自定义子网功能由 Amazon VPC CNI custom networking 功能提供，而不是由 Transit Gateway 提供（[Deploy Pods in alternate subnets with custom networking](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-custom-network.html)）。
- **B**：来自本地的 AWS Direct Connect 连接不会配置 EKS Pods 使用哪些 VPC 子网。要求是在 VPC 内进行 Pod 子网放置，这由 VPC CNI custom networking 处理。
- **D**：Kubernetes network policies 在 IP/端口级别限制进出 Pods 的流量；它们用于流量分段，而不是将 Pods 分配到自定义 VPC 子网或控制 ENI/子网选择（[Limit Pod traffic with Kubernetes network policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/cni-network-policy.html)）。Pod 反亲和性是一个调度概念，不能满足自定义 VPC 子网分配要求。

en.question: A company hosts an ecommerce application that stores all data in a single Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that is fully managed by AWS. The company needs to mitigate the risk of a single point of failure. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Modify the RDS DB instance to use a Multi-AZ deployment. Apply the changes during the next maintenance window.
options.B: Migrate the current database to a new Amazon DynamoDB Multi-AZ deployment. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) with a heterogeneous migration strategy to migrate the current RDS DB instance to DynamoDB tables.
options.C: Create a new RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Manually restore the data from the existing RDS DB instance from the most recent snapshot.
options.D: Configure the DB instance in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with a minimum group size of three. Use Amazon Route 53 simple routing to distribute requests to all DB instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon RDS directly supports converting an existing Single-AZ DB instance to a **Multi-AZ DB instance deployment**. AWS states that modifying a DB instance to Multi-AZ improves availability by adding a standby instance in another Availability Zone and enabling synchronous replication between the primary and standby volumes. The console workflow is simply to choose **Convert to Multi-AZ deployment**, and AWS allows the change to be applied immediately or during the next maintenance window. This meets the requirement with the least implementation effort because it modifies the existing managed RDS database rather than migrating or rebuilding it ([Converting a DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Migrating.html)). Multi-AZ also mitigates the single point of failure because RDS automatically switches to the standby replica in another Availability Zone during planned or unplanned outages ([Failing over a Multi-AZ DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Migrating from RDS for MySQL to DynamoDB is a heterogeneous migration to a different database model and would require schema/application changes and DMS work. This is far more effort than modifying the existing RDS instance to Multi-AZ.
- **C:** Creating a new RDS instance and manually restoring from a snapshot can also produce a Multi-AZ database, but it is unnecessary operational effort. AWS documents that the existing DB instance can be modified/converted directly to Multi-AZ ([Converting a DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Migrating.html)).
- **D:** The database is an Amazon RDS DB instance, not a self-managed database on EC2. An EC2 Auto Scaling group and Route 53 simple routing do not provide the managed RDS synchronous standby and automatic failover behavior described for RDS Multi-AZ deployments ([Failing over a Multi-AZ DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司托管了一个电子商务应用程序，该应用程序将所有数据存储在一个由 AWS 完全托管的单个 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例中。公司需要降低单点故障的风险。哪种解决方案能够以最少的实施工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 修改 RDS DB 实例以使用 Multi-AZ 部署。在下一个维护时段应用更改。
options.B: 将当前数据库迁移到新的 Amazon DynamoDB Multi-AZ 部署。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 通过异构迁移策略将当前 RDS DB 实例迁移到 DynamoDB 表。
options.C: 在 Multi-AZ 部署中创建新的 RDS DB 实例。从最近的快照手动还原现有 RDS DB 实例中的数据。
options.D: 在 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中配置该 DB 实例，最小组大小为三。使用 Amazon Route 53 简单路由将请求分发到所有 DB 实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

Amazon RDS 直接支持将现有的 Single-AZ DB 实例转换为 **Multi-AZ DB instance deployment**。AWS 表示，将 DB 实例修改为 Multi-AZ 可通过在另一个 Availability Zone 中添加备用实例，并在主卷和备用卷之间启用同步复制来提高可用性。控制台工作流程只需选择 **Convert to Multi-AZ deployment**，AWS 允许立即应用更改或在下一个维护时段应用更改。这通过修改现有的托管 RDS 数据库，而不是迁移或重建数据库，以最少的实施工作量满足要求（[Converting a DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Migrating.html)）。Multi-AZ 还可降低单点故障风险，因为在计划内或计划外中断期间，RDS 会自动切换到另一个 Availability Zone 中的备用副本（[Failing over a Multi-AZ DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** 从 RDS for MySQL 迁移到 DynamoDB 是迁移到不同数据库模型的异构迁移，并且需要架构/应用程序更改以及 DMS 工作。这比将现有 RDS 实例修改为 Multi-AZ 需要多得多的工作量。
- **C:** 创建新的 RDS 实例并从快照手动还原也可以生成 Multi-AZ 数据库，但这是不必要的运维工作。AWS 文档说明，现有 DB 实例可以直接修改/转换为 Multi-AZ（[Converting a DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Migrating.html)）。
- **D:** 该数据库是 Amazon RDS DB 实例，而不是 EC2 上的自管理数据库。EC2 Auto Scaling 组和 Route 53 简单路由无法提供 RDS Multi-AZ 部署所描述的托管 RDS 同步备用和自动故障转移行为（[Failing over a Multi-AZ DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.Failover.html)）。

en.question: A company has multiple Microsoft Windows SMB file servers and Linux NFS file servers for file sharing in an on-premises environment. As part of the company's AWS migration plan, the company wants to consolidate the file servers in the AWS Cloud. The company needs a managed AWS storage service that supports both NFS and SMB access. The solution must be able to share between protocols. The solution must have redundancy at the Availability Zone level. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for storage. Configure multi-protocol access.
options.B: Create two Amazon EC2 instances. Use one EC2 instance for Windows SMB file server access and one EC2 instance for Linux NFS file server access.
options.C: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for SMB access. Use Amazon FSx for Lustre for NFS access.
options.D: Use Amazon S3 storage. Access Amazon S3 through an Amazon S3 File Gateway.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP is a fully managed file storage service that directly matches the requirements: AWS documentation states that FSx for ONTAP provides multi-protocol access using **NFS** and **SMB**, and that data can be accessed simultaneously from Linux, Windows, or macOS clients over NFS and SMB protocols. It also provides highly available and durable **Multi-AZ** deployment options; Multi-AZ file systems are designed to keep data continuously available even when an Availability Zone is unavailable, with synchronous replication across AZs to a standby file server ([FSx for ONTAP features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html), [how FSx for ONTAP works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/how-it-works-fsx-ontap.html), [availability and deployment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **B** is not the best choice because two EC2 file servers are self-managed, not a managed AWS storage service, and do not inherently provide a single shared multi-protocol storage layer or AZ-level managed redundancy.
* **C** is incorrect because using separate FSx services would not provide a consolidated file system that shares data between NFS and SMB protocols. Also, FSx for Lustre is accessed with the Lustre client from Linux-based compute environments, not as a general NFS/SMB multiprotocol file share ([FSx for Lustre access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)).
* **D** is incorrect because S3 File Gateway can create NFS or SMB file shares backed by S3, but the requirement is a managed AWS storage service with protocol sharing and AZ-level redundancy for consolidated file servers. FSx for ONTAP is the AWS managed file storage service explicitly documented for simultaneous NFS and SMB multiprotocol shared access.

zh.question: 一家公司在本地环境中有多个用于文件共享的 Microsoft Windows SMB 文件服务器和 Linux NFS 文件服务器。作为公司 AWS 迁移计划的一部分，公司希望将文件服务器整合到 AWS Cloud 中。公司需要一种托管式 AWS 存储服务，同时支持 NFS 和 SMB 访问。该解决方案必须能够在协议之间共享。该解决方案必须在 Availability Zone 级别具备冗余。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 进行存储。配置多协议访问。
options.B: 创建两个 Amazon EC2 实例。使用一个 EC2 实例进行 Windows SMB 文件服务器访问，使用一个 EC2 实例进行 Linux NFS 文件服务器访问。
options.C: 使用 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 进行 SMB 访问。使用 Amazon FSx for Lustre 进行 NFS 访问。
options.D: 使用 Amazon S3 存储。通过 Amazon S3 File Gateway 访问 Amazon S3。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 是一种完全托管的文件存储服务，直接符合这些要求：AWS 文档说明，FSx for ONTAP 使用 **NFS** 和 **SMB** 提供多协议访问，并且可以通过 NFS 和 SMB 协议从 Linux、Windows 或 macOS 客户端同时访问数据。它还提供高可用且持久的 **Multi-AZ** 部署选项；Multi-AZ 文件系统旨在即使某个 Availability Zone 不可用时也能保持数据持续可用，并通过跨 AZ 同步复制到备用文件服务器来实现这一点（[FSx for ONTAP features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html)、[how FSx for ONTAP works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/how-it-works-fsx-ontap.html)、[availability and deployment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

* **B** 不是最佳选择，因为两个 EC2 文件服务器是自管理的，而不是托管式 AWS 存储服务，并且它们本身并不提供单一共享的多协议存储层或 AZ 级别的托管冗余。
* **C** 不正确，因为使用单独的 FSx 服务无法提供一个在 NFS 和 SMB 协议之间共享数据的整合文件系统。此外，FSx for Lustre 是从基于 Linux 的计算环境使用 Lustre 客户端访问的，而不是作为通用的 NFS/SMB 多协议文件共享（[FSx for Lustre access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/LustreGuide/what-is.html)）。
* **D** 不正确，因为 S3 File Gateway 可以创建由 S3 支持的 NFS 或 SMB 文件共享，但要求是一个托管式 AWS 存储服务，具备用于整合文件服务器的协议共享和 AZ 级别冗余。FSx for ONTAP 是 AWS 托管文件存储服务，并且文档明确说明其支持同时进行 NFS 和 SMB 多协议共享访问。

en.question: A software company needs to upgrade a critical web application. The application currently runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance that the company hosts in a public subnet. The EC2 instance runs a MySQL database. The application's DNS records are published in an Amazon Route 53 zone. A solutions architect must reconfigure the application to be scalable and highly available. The solutions architect must also reduce MySQL read latency. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Launch a second EC2 instance in a second AWS Region. Use a Route 53 failover routing policy to redirect the traffic to the second EC2 instance.
options.B: Create and configure an Auto Scaling group to launch private EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Add the instances to a target group behind a new Application Load Balancer.
options.C: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster. Create the primary DB instance and reader DB instance in separate Availability Zones.
options.D: Create and configure an Auto Scaling group to launch private EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions. Add the instances to a target group behind a new Application Load Balancer.
options.E: Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL cluster with cross-Region read replicas.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: B and C.**

- **B is correct** because moving the web tier into an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones and placing it behind an Application Load Balancer provides both scalability and high availability. AWS states that to use geographic redundancy, you should span an Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs and attach a load balancer to distribute traffic; if one AZ is unhealthy, EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ. AWS also notes that an Application Load Balancer requires at least two AZs and can route traffic to healthy targets in another AZ if one AZ becomes unavailable. [EC2 Auto Scaling AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html), [ELB Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)
- **C is correct** because migrating the database to an Aurora MySQL DB cluster with a writer and reader in separate AZs improves database availability and read performance. Aurora supports up to 15 read-only Aurora Replicas, which can process `SELECT` queries for read-intensive applications, and AWS recommends distributing the primary and reader instances across multiple AZs so an AZ issue does not cause a cluster outage. [Aurora high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A is incorrect** because adding a single EC2 instance in another Region with Route 53 failover is a disaster recovery/failover pattern. It does not provide application-tier Auto Scaling, normal multi-AZ load balancing, or reduced MySQL read latency.
- **D is incorrect** because the appropriate pattern is an Auto Scaling group spanning multiple **Availability Zones within a Region**, attached to a load balancer. The AWS documentation describes spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple AZs in the Region you are working in; an ALB is also enabled across AZs, not used as a single target group spanning multiple Regions. [EC2 Auto Scaling AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)
- **E is incorrect** because Aurora cross-Region/global database capabilities are for multi-Region availability, low-latency global reads, and disaster recovery from Regional outages. The question requires scalable, highly available architecture and reduced MySQL read latency, which can be met by Aurora reader instances in separate AZs without cross-Region replicas. [Aurora global databases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)

zh.question: 一家软件公司需要升级一个关键 Web 应用程序。该应用程序目前运行在公司托管于公有子网中的单个 Amazon EC2 实例上。该 EC2 实例运行 MySQL 数据库。该应用程序的 DNS 记录发布在 Amazon Route 53 区域中。解决方案架构师必须重新配置该应用程序，使其具备可扩展性和高可用性。解决方案架构师还必须降低 MySQL 读取延迟。哪种解决方案组合将满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在第二个 AWS Region 中启动第二个 EC2 实例。使用 Route 53 故障转移路由策略将流量重定向到第二个 EC2 实例。
options.B: 创建并配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，以在多个 Availability Zones 中启动私有 EC2 实例。将这些实例添加到新的 Application Load Balancer 后面的目标组中。
options.C: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora MySQL 集群。在不同的 Availability Zones 中创建主 DB 实例和读取器 DB 实例。
options.D: 创建并配置一个 Auto Scaling 组，以在多个 AWS Regions 中启动私有 EC2 实例。将这些实例添加到新的 Application Load Balancer 后面的目标组中。
options.E: 将数据库迁移到具有跨 Region 只读副本的 Amazon Aurora MySQL 集群。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B 和 C。**

- **B 正确**，因为将 Web 层移入跨多个 Availability Zones 的 Auto Scaling 组，并将其置于 Application Load Balancer 后面，可以同时提供可扩展性和高可用性。AWS 说明，要使用地理冗余，应使 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 AZs，并附加负载均衡器来分发流量；如果某个 AZ 不健康，EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例。AWS 还指出，Application Load Balancer 至少需要两个 AZs，并且如果某个 AZ 不可用，可以将流量路由到另一个 AZ 中的健康目标。[EC2 Auto Scaling AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html), [ELB Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)
- **C 正确**，因为将数据库迁移到在不同 AZs 中具有写入器和读取器的 Aurora MySQL DB 集群，可以提高数据库可用性和读取性能。Aurora 支持最多 15 个只读 Aurora Replicas，这些副本可以为读取密集型应用程序处理 `SELECT` 查询，并且 AWS 建议将主实例和读取器实例分布在多个 AZs 中，以便 AZ 问题不会导致集群中断。[Aurora high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A 不正确**，因为在另一个 Region 中添加单个 EC2 实例并使用 Route 53 故障转移是一种灾难恢复/故障转移模式。它不能提供应用程序层 Auto Scaling、常规多 AZ 负载均衡或降低 MySQL 读取延迟。
- **D 不正确**，因为适当的模式是一个跨越一个 Region 内多个 **Availability Zones** 的 Auto Scaling 组，并附加到负载均衡器。AWS 文档描述的是在你正在使用的 Region 中使 Auto Scaling 组跨多个 AZs；ALB 也是跨 AZs 启用的，而不是作为跨多个 Regions 的单个目标组使用。[EC2 Auto Scaling AZs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)
- **E 不正确**，因为 Aurora 跨 Region/global database 功能用于多 Region 可用性、低延迟全球读取，以及从 Regional 中断中进行灾难恢复。题目要求可扩展、高可用的架构并降低 MySQL 读取延迟，这可以通过在单独 AZs 中使用 Aurora 读取器实例来满足，而无需跨 Region 副本。[Aurora global databases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)

en.question: A company runs thousands of AWS Lambda functions. The company needs a solution to securely store sensitive information that all the Lambda functions use. The solution must also manage the automatic rotation of the sensitive information. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create HTTP security headers by using Lambda@Edge to retrieve and create sensitive information
options.B: Create a Lambda layer that retrieves sensitive information
options.C: Store sensitive information in AWS Secrets Manager
options.D: Store sensitive information in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store
options.E: Create a Lambda consumer with dedicated throughput to retrieve sensitive information and create environmental variables

en.explanation:
The best choices are **B and C**.

- **C — Store sensitive information in AWS Secrets Manager.** AWS Secrets Manager is designed to “manage, retrieve, and rotate” secrets such as database credentials, application credentials, OAuth tokens, and API keys. AWS also states that you can configure an **automatic rotation schedule** for secrets, so rotation does not require application redeployment or manual updates ([Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). The rotation documentation confirms that Secrets Manager can set up automatic rotation, including managed rotation or rotation by Lambda function depending on the secret type ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)).
- **B — Create a Lambda layer that retrieves sensitive information.** A Lambda layer can contain supplementary code, libraries, or configuration files, and AWS specifically lists sharing dependencies across multiple functions as a reason to use layers: after creating a layer, you can apply it to any number of functions instead of packaging the same dependency into each function ([Managing Lambda dependencies with layers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)). For thousands of Lambda functions, putting common Secrets Manager retrieval logic in a layer minimizes duplicated code and operational overhead.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A** is unrelated. Lambda@Edge and HTTP security headers do not address centralized secure secret storage or automatic rotation for thousands of Lambda functions.
- **D** is not the best fit because Parameter Store can store and retrieve parameters and can be used by Lambda, but the cited requirement is automatic secret rotation. Parameter Store features include change events and notifications/expiration workflows, whereas Secrets Manager directly provides automatic rotation for secrets ([Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html), [Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)).
- **E** is not an AWS-recommended low-overhead pattern for secret management. Creating a separate consumer to populate environment variables would add operational complexity and would not provide the built-in secret lifecycle and automatic rotation capabilities that Secrets Manager provides.

zh.question: 一家公司运行着数千个 AWS Lambda 函数。该公司需要一种解决方案来安全地存储所有 Lambda 函数都会使用的敏感信息。该解决方案还必须管理敏感信息的自动轮换。哪一组步骤组合能以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 Lambda@Edge 检索并创建敏感信息，从而创建 HTTP 安全标头
options.B: 创建一个用于检索敏感信息的 Lambda layer
options.C: 将敏感信息存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中
options.D: 将敏感信息存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中
options.E: 创建一个具有专用吞吐量的 Lambda consumer，用于检索敏感信息并创建环境变量

zh.explanation:
最佳选择是 **B 和 C**。

- **C — 将敏感信息存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。** AWS Secrets Manager 旨在“管理、检索和轮换”密钥，例如数据库凭证、应用程序凭证、OAuth 令牌和 API 密钥。AWS 还说明，你可以为密钥配置**自动轮换计划**，因此轮换不需要重新部署应用程序或手动更新（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。轮换文档确认，Secrets Manager 可以设置自动轮换，包括托管轮换，或根据密钥类型使用 Lambda function 进行轮换（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。
- **B — 创建一个用于检索敏感信息的 Lambda layer。** Lambda layer 可以包含补充代码、库或配置文件，并且 AWS 明确将跨多个函数共享依赖项列为使用 layer 的原因：创建 layer 后，你可以将其应用于任意数量的函数，而不是将相同的依赖项打包到每个函数中（[Managing Lambda dependencies with layers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/chapter-layers.html)）。对于数千个 Lambda 函数，将通用的 Secrets Manager 检索逻辑放入 layer 可以最大限度地减少重复代码和运营开销。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A** 不相关。Lambda@Edge 和 HTTP 安全标头不能解决面向数千个 Lambda 函数的集中式安全密钥存储或自动轮换问题。
- **D** 不是最佳选择，因为 Parameter Store 可以存储和检索参数，也可以供 Lambda 使用，但题目提出的要求是密钥自动轮换。Parameter Store 的功能包括变更事件和通知/过期工作流，而 Secrets Manager 直接为密钥提供自动轮换（[Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html), [Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。
- **E** 不是 AWS 推荐的低开销密钥管理模式。创建单独的 consumer 来填充环境变量会增加运营复杂性，并且不会提供 Secrets Manager 所提供的内置密钥生命周期和自动轮换能力。

en.question: A company has an internal application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The EC2 instances are compute optimized and use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company wants to identify cost optimizations across the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a new AWS Cost and Usage Report. Search the report for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes.
options.B: Create new Amazon CloudWatch billing alerts. Check the alert statuses for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group, and the EBS volumes.
options.C: Configure AWS Compute Optimizer for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances, the Auto Scaling group and the EBS volumes.
options.D: Configure AWS Compute Optimizer for cost recommendations for the EC2 instances. Create a new AWS Cost and Usage Report. Search the report for cost recommendations for the Auto Scaling group and the EBS volumes.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C**.

AWS Compute Optimizer is the most operationally efficient choice because it directly generates optimization recommendations for all three resource types in the question: **Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups, and Amazon EBS volumes**. The AWS documentation lists these as supported resources for Compute Optimizer and states that optimization findings and recommendations are shown in the Compute Optimizer dashboard/recommendations pages ([AWS Compute Optimizer supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/what-is-compute-optimizer.html)). Compute Optimizer also provides cost-related fields such as **estimated monthly savings** and **savings opportunity** for recommendations ([EC2 recommendation savings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ec2-recommendations.html)). AWS also documents dedicated recommendation pages for **EC2 Auto Scaling groups** ([Auto Scaling group recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/asg-view-recommendations.html)) and **EBS volumes** ([EBS volume recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/ebs-view-recommendations.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: AWS Cost and Usage Reports provide detailed billing data delivered to Amazon S3 and can be queried or loaded into analytics services, but they are not described as a source of rightsizing or resource optimization recommendations ([Cost and Usage Reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)). Searching CUR manually is less operationally efficient and does not directly meet the recommendation requirement.
- **B**: CloudWatch billing alarms monitor estimated charges and trigger when charges exceed a threshold; they do not provide resource-level cost optimization recommendations ([CloudWatch billing alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/monitor_estimated_charges_with_cloudwatch.html)).
- **D**: This unnecessarily splits the solution. Compute Optimizer already supports EC2 instances, EC2 Auto Scaling groups, and EBS volumes, so using CUR for the Auto Scaling group and EBS volume recommendations adds manual effort without benefit.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个内部应用程序，运行在 Auto Scaling group 中的 Amazon EC2 instances 上。这些 EC2 instances 为计算优化型，并使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes。该公司希望识别 EC2 instances、Auto Scaling group 和 EBS volumes 的成本优化机会。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建新的 AWS Cost and Usage Report。搜索该报告，以查找 EC2 instances、Auto Scaling group 和 EBS volumes 的成本建议。
options.B: 创建新的 Amazon CloudWatch 账单告警。检查告警状态，以获取 EC2 instances、Auto Scaling group 和 EBS volumes 的成本建议。
options.C: 配置 AWS Compute Optimizer，以获取 EC2 instances、Auto Scaling group 和 EBS volumes 的成本建议。
options.D: 配置 AWS Compute Optimizer，以获取 EC2 instances 的成本建议。创建新的 AWS Cost and Usage Report。搜索该报告，以查找 Auto Scaling group 和 EBS volumes 的成本建议。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C**。

AWS Compute Optimizer 是运营效率最高的选择，因为它会直接为题目中的三类资源生成优化建议：**Amazon EC2 instances、Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups 和 Amazon EBS volumes**。AWS 文档将这些列为 Compute Optimizer 支持的资源，并说明优化结果和建议会显示在 Compute Optimizer 控制面板/建议页面中（[AWS Compute Optimizer supported resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/what-is-compute-optimizer.html)）。Compute Optimizer 还会为建议提供与成本相关的字段，例如 **estimated monthly savings** 和 **savings opportunity**（[EC2 recommendation savings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/view-ec2-recommendations.html)）。AWS 还记录了针对 **EC2 Auto Scaling groups**（[Auto Scaling group recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/asg-view-recommendations.html)）和 **EBS volumes**（[EBS volume recommendations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/compute-optimizer/latest/ug/ebs-view-recommendations.html)）的专用建议页面。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A**：AWS Cost and Usage Reports 提供详细的账单数据，会交付到 Amazon S3，并且可以被查询或加载到分析服务中，但它们并未被描述为 rightsizing 或资源优化建议的来源（[Cost and Usage Reports](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/what-is-cur.html)）。手动搜索 CUR 的运营效率较低，并且不能直接满足建议需求。
- **B**：CloudWatch billing alarms 会监控预估费用，并在费用超过阈值时触发；它们不提供资源级别的成本优化建议（[CloudWatch billing alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/monitor_estimated_charges_with_cloudwatch.html)）。
- **D**：这会不必要地拆分解决方案。Compute Optimizer 已经支持 EC2 instances、EC2 Auto Scaling groups 和 EBS volumes，因此使用 CUR 来获取 Auto Scaling group 和 EBS volume 建议会增加人工工作量，却没有收益。

en.question: A company is running a media store across multiple Amazon EC2 instances distributed across multiple Availability Zones in a single VPC. The company wants a high-performing solution to share data between all the EC2 instances, and prefers to keep the data within the VPC only. What should a solutions architect recommend?
