options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and call the service APIs from each instance's application
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and configure all instances to access it as a mounted volume
options.C: Configure an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and mount it across all instances
options.D: Configure an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and mount it across all instances

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Configure an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and mount it across all instances.**

Amazon EFS is the best fit because it provides shared file storage for EC2 instances. AWS states that Amazon EFS provides elastic file storage “so that you can share file data,” supports NFSv4, and is accessible from Amazon EC2; Regional EFS file systems store data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones and support high throughput, IOPS, low latency, and massively parallel access from compute instances ([What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)). AWS also describes multiple EC2 instances accessing an EFS file system configured for multiple Availability Zones in a VPC, with mount targets in each Availability Zone for performance and cost reasons ([How Amazon EFS works with Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)). EFS mount targets are created in the VPC, and the EFS mount helper resolves the file system ID to the local IP address of the mount target ENI without calling external resources, matching the requirement to keep access within the VPC ([EFS mount helper prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-helper-prerequisites.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 bucket with service APIs**: Amazon S3 is object storage accessed through API calls. It does not provide a native shared POSIX/NFS file system mounted concurrently by EC2 instances, which is what this workload requires.
- **B. S3 bucket mounted as a volume**: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 can expose S3 through a file interface, but AWS says it supports only basic file system operations, cannot modify existing files or delete directories, and does not support symbolic links or file locking; it is for applications that do not need all features of a shared file system or POSIX-style permissions ([Mount an Amazon S3 bucket as a local file system](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mountpoint.html)).
- **C. EBS volume mounted across all instances**: EBS is block storage. Even with EBS Multi-Attach, AWS limits attachment to instances in the **same Availability Zone**, while this workload spans multiple Availability Zones. AWS also warns that standard file systems such as XFS and EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers ([EBS Multi-Attach considerations and limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在单个 VPC 中跨多个 Availability Zones 分布的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个媒体商店。该公司希望获得一个高性能解决方案，用于在所有 EC2 实例之间共享数据，并且希望数据仅保留在 VPC 内。解决方案架构师应推荐什么？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket，并从每个实例的应用程序调用服务 API
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket，并配置所有实例将其作为挂载卷访问
options.C: 配置一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，并将其挂载到所有实例上
options.D: 配置一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system，并将其挂载到所有实例上

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. Configure an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system and mount it across all instances.**

Amazon EFS 是最佳选择，因为它为 EC2 实例提供共享文件存储。AWS 表示，Amazon EFS 提供弹性文件存储，“so that you can share file data”，支持 NFSv4，并且可从 Amazon EC2 访问；Regional EFS file systems 会跨多个 Availability Zones 冗余存储数据，并支持高吞吐量、IOPS、低延迟以及来自计算实例的大规模并行访问（[What is Amazon EFS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/whatisefs.html)）。AWS 还描述了多个 EC2 实例访问在 VPC 中为多个 Availability Zones 配置的 EFS file system，并在每个 Availability Zone 中设置 mount targets，以实现性能和成本方面的优势（[How Amazon EFS works with Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/how-it-works.html)）。EFS mount targets 在 VPC 中创建，并且 EFS mount helper 会将 file system ID 解析为 mount target ENI 的本地 IP 地址，而无需调用外部资源，这符合将访问保留在 VPC 内的要求（[EFS mount helper prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-helper-prerequisites.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. S3 bucket with service APIs**：Amazon S3 是通过 API 调用访问的对象存储。它不提供可由 EC2 实例并发挂载的原生共享 POSIX/NFS 文件系统，而这正是该工作负载所需要的。
- **B. S3 bucket mounted as a volume**：Mountpoint for Amazon S3 可以通过文件接口公开 S3，但 AWS 表示它仅支持基本文件系统操作，不能修改现有文件或删除目录，并且不支持符号链接或文件锁定；它适用于不需要共享文件系统全部功能或 POSIX 风格权限的应用程序（[Mount an Amazon S3 bucket as a local file system](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mountpoint.html)）。
- **C. EBS volume mounted across all instances**：EBS 是块存储。即使使用 EBS Multi-Attach，AWS 也将附加限制为同一 **Availability Zone** 中的实例，而该工作负载跨多个 Availability Zones。AWS 还警告说，XFS 和 EXT4 等标准文件系统并非为多个服务器同时访问而设计（[EBS Multi-Attach considerations and limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

en.question: A company uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL instance. To prepare for end-of-year processing, the company added a read replica to accommodate extra read-only queries from the company's reporting tool. The read replica CPU usage was 60% and the primary instance CPU usage was 60%. After end-of-year activities are complete, the read replica has a constant 25% CPU usage. The primary instance still has a constant 60% CPU usage. The company wants to rightsize the database and still provide enough performance for future growth. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Delete the read replica Do not make changes to the primary instance
options.B: Resize the read replica to a smaller instance size Do not make changes to the primary instance
options.C: Resize the read replica to a larger instance size Resize the primary instance to a smaller instance size
options.D: Delete the read replica Resize the primary instance to a larger instance

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Resize the read replica to a smaller instance size. Do not make changes to the primary instance.**

Amazon RDS read replicas are intended to handle excess read traffic and are specifically suitable for **business reporting queries** so those queries can run against a read replica instead of the production DB instance ([AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)). After the year-end workload is complete, the read replica is consistently only 25% utilized, so it is oversized for the current reporting workload. Amazon RDS DB instances can be modified, including by **changing the DB instance class** ([Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)). Rightsizing the read replica downward preserves read offload capacity for reporting and future growth while reducing overprovisioning. The primary instance remains at a steady 60% CPU, and the question gives no indication that it is saturated or needs resizing.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A:** Deleting the read replica removes the read-scaling and reporting offload capability. AWS lists read replicas as useful for scaling read-heavy workloads and for business reporting queries ([AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)).
* **C:** Making the underutilized read replica larger is the opposite of rightsizing. Resizing the primary smaller while it is still at 60% CPU also reduces headroom.
* **D:** Deleting the read replica removes the reporting/read-only query target. Scaling the primary larger is unnecessary based on the stated 60% CPU utilization and does not preserve the read-replica architecture that AWS recommends for reporting/read-heavy workloads.

zh.question: 一家公司使用一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 实例。为准备年终处理，该公司添加了一个只读副本，以容纳来自公司报告工具的额外只读查询。只读副本的 CPU 使用率为 60%，主实例的 CPU 使用率为 60%。年终活动完成后，只读副本的 CPU 使用率持续保持在 25%。主实例的 CPU 使用率仍然持续保持在 60%。公司希望对数据库进行合理调整，并且仍为未来增长提供足够的性能。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 删除只读副本；不要更改主实例。
options.B: 将只读副本调整为较小的实例大小；不要更改主实例。
options.C: 将只读副本调整为较大的实例大小；将主实例调整为较小的实例大小。
options.D: 删除只读副本；将主实例调整为较大的实例。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 将只读副本调整为较小的实例大小。不要更改主实例。**

Amazon RDS 只读副本旨在处理额外的读取流量，并且特别适合用于**业务报告查询**，这样这些查询可以针对只读副本运行，而不是针对生产 DB 实例运行（[AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。年终工作负载完成后，只读副本持续只有 25% 的利用率，因此对于当前的报告工作负载而言配置过大。Amazon RDS DB 实例可以修改，包括通过**更改 DB 实例类**进行修改（[Modifying an Amazon RDS DB instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.DBInstance.Modifying.html)）。将只读副本向下合理调整，可以保留用于报告和未来增长的读取分流能力，同时减少过度预置。主实例保持稳定的 60% CPU，题目没有表明它已饱和或需要调整大小。为什么其他选项不正确：

* **A:** 删除只读副本会移除读取扩展和报告分流能力。AWS 将只读副本列为可用于扩展读取密集型工作负载以及业务报告查询的功能（[AWS RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)）。
* **C:** 将利用率不足的只读副本调得更大，与合理调整大小的目标相反。在主实例仍为 60% CPU 的情况下将其调小，也会减少余量。
* **D:** 删除只读副本会移除报告/只读查询目标。根据所述 60% CPU 利用率，扩大主实例是不必要的，并且不会保留 AWS 针对报告/读取密集型工作负载所推荐的只读副本架构。

en.question: A company is migrating its databases to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company is migrating its applications to Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to optimize costs for long-running workloads. Which solution will meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use On-Demand Instances for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year Compute Savings Plan with the No Upfront option for the EC2 instances.
options.B: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 1 year term with the No Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the No Upfront option for the EC2 instances.
options.C: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 1 year term with the Partial Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 1 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the Partial Upfront option for the EC2 instances.
options.D: Purchase Reserved Instances for a 3 year term with the All Upfront option for the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL workloads. Purchase a 3 year EC2 Instance Savings Plan with the All Upfront option for the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** For stable, long-running workloads, the most cost-effective choice among the options is to make the longest commitment with the highest upfront payment. Amazon RDS Reserved DB instances can be reserved for a **one- or three-year term** and provide a **significant discount compared to on-demand DB instance pricing**; the **All Upfront** offering requires full payment at the start and has no other costs for the rest of the term. This fits the RDS for PostgreSQL workload. AWS also states that **EC2 Instance Savings Plans** provide savings up to **72% off On-Demand** in exchange for commitment to an instance family in a Region, and Savings Plans support **one-year or three-year** commitments with **All upfront, Partial upfront, or No upfront** payment options. Therefore, a 3-year All Upfront RDS Reserved Instance plus a 3-year All Upfront EC2 Instance Savings Plan is the lowest-cost commitment-based option listed for long-running workloads. ([RDS Reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html), [Savings Plans overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html), [Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html))

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Uses **On-Demand** for RDS, missing the RDS Reserved DB instance discount for a long-running database workload. It also uses a 1-year No Upfront compute commitment, which is less cost-optimized than the 3-year All Upfront option.
- **B:** Uses commitment discounts for both services, but only for **1 year** and with **No Upfront** payments. This is not the most cost-effective option compared with a 3-year All Upfront commitment.
- **C:** Better than B because it uses Partial Upfront, but it is still only a **1-year** term and only **Partial Upfront**, so it does not maximize long-term savings like D.
- **D:** Best matches the requirement because it applies commitment-based discounts to both RDS and EC2 with the longest term and All Upfront payment option available in the choices.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL。该公司正在将其应用程序迁移到 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司希望为长期运行的工作负载优化成本。哪种解决方案能够以最低成本满足此要求？

options.A: 对 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 工作负载使用 On-Demand Instances。为 EC2 实例购买 1 年期 Compute Savings Plan，并选择 No Upfront 选项。
options.B: 为 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 工作负载购买 1 年期 Reserved Instances，并选择 No Upfront 选项。为 EC2 实例购买 1 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan，并选择 No Upfront 选项。
options.C: 为 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 工作负载购买 1 年期 Reserved Instances，并选择 Partial Upfront 选项。为 EC2 实例购买 1 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan，并选择 Partial Upfront 选项。
options.D: 为 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 工作负载购买 3 年期 Reserved Instances，并选择 All Upfront 选项。为 EC2 实例购买 3 年期 EC2 Instance Savings Plan，并选择 All Upfront 选项。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** 对于稳定、长期运行的工作负载，在这些选项中最具成本效益的选择是做出最长承诺并支付最高的预付款。Amazon RDS Reserved DB instances 可以预留 **一年或三年期限**，并且与 on-demand DB instance pricing 相比提供 **显著折扣**；**All Upfront** 产品要求在开始时全额付款，并且在剩余期限内没有其他费用。这适用于 RDS for PostgreSQL 工作负载。AWS 还指出，**EC2 Instance Savings Plans** 可在承诺使用某个 Region 中的某个实例系列的情况下，提供最高 **72% off On-Demand** 的节省，并且 Savings Plans 支持 **一年或三年** 承诺，付款选项包括 **All upfront、Partial upfront 或 No upfront**。因此，3 年期 All Upfront RDS Reserved Instance 加上 3 年期 All Upfront EC2 Instance Savings Plan，是所列选项中针对长期运行工作负载成本最低的基于承诺的选项。([RDS Reserved DB instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithReservedDBInstances.html), [Savings Plans overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/what-is-savings-plans.html), [Savings Plans types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/savingsplans/latest/userguide/plan-types.html))

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 对 RDS 使用 **On-Demand**，错过了长期运行数据库工作负载可获得的 RDS Reserved DB instance 折扣。它还使用 1 年期 No Upfront 计算承诺，与 3 年期 All Upfront 选项相比，成本优化程度较低。
- **B:** 对两项服务都使用了承诺折扣，但期限只有 **1 年**，并且采用 **No Upfront** 付款。与 3 年期 All Upfront 承诺相比，这不是最具成本效益的选项。
- **C:** 比 B 更好，因为它使用 Partial Upfront，但它仍然只是 **1 年** 期限，并且只是 **Partial Upfront**，因此不像 D 那样最大化长期节省。
- **D:** 最符合要求，因为它对 RDS 和 EC2 都应用了基于承诺的折扣，并且使用了选项中可用的最长期限和 All Upfront 付款选项。

en.question: A company is using an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company must ensure that Kubernetes service accounts in the EKS cluster have secure and granular access to specific AWS resources by using IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA). Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an IAM policy that defines the required permissions Attach the policy directly to the IAM role of the EKS nodes.
options.B: Implement network policies within the EKS cluster to prevent Kubernetes service accounts from accessing specific AWS services.
options.C: Modify the EKS cluster's IAM role to include permissions for each Kubernetes service account. Ensure a one-to-one mapping between IAM roles and Kubernetes roles.
options.D: Define an IAM role that includes the necessary permissions. Annotate the Kubernetes service accounts with the Amazon ResourceName (ARN) of the IAM role.
options.E: Set up a trust relationship between the IAM roles for the service accounts and an OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **D and E**.

- **D is correct**: IRSA works by creating/using an IAM role with the permissions the workload needs, then associating that role with a Kubernetes service account. AWS states that you “associate an IAM role with a Kubernetes service account,” and the service account is annotated with `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` containing the IAM role ARN ([IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html), [Assign IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/associate-service-account-role.html)).
- **E is correct**: IRSA requires an IAM OIDC provider for the EKS cluster. AWS states that to use IAM roles for service accounts, “an IAM OIDC provider must exist for your cluster’s OIDC issuer URL,” and the role trust policy uses a federated OIDC principal with `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` ([Create an IAM OIDC provider for your cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/enable-iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html), [Assign IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/associate-service-account-role.html)).

Incorrect options:

- **A is wrong**: Attaching permissions to the EKS node IAM role gives permissions at the node level, not granular service-account-level permissions. AWS describes IRSA as an alternative to using the EC2 instance/node role and notes that permissions can be scoped to a service account for least privilege ([IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)).
- **B is wrong**: Kubernetes network policies control network traffic, not IAM authorization to AWS APIs. AWS API access from pods requires IAM credentials/permissions, which IRSA provides through service-account-associated IAM roles ([IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)).
- **C is wrong**: The solution is not to modify the EKS cluster IAM role or map IAM roles to Kubernetes roles. AWS’s IRSA process is to create an IAM OIDC provider, create an IAM role with a web identity trust policy for the service account, attach the required IAM policy, and annotate the Kubernetes service account with that role ARN ([Assign IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/associate-service-account-role.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。该公司必须通过使用 IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA)，确保 EKS 集群中的 Kubernetes service accounts 能够安全且精细地访问特定 AWS 资源。哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个定义所需权限的 IAM policy。将该 policy 直接附加到 EKS 节点的 IAM role。
options.B: 在 EKS 集群内实施 network policies，以防止 Kubernetes service accounts 访问特定 AWS 服务。
options.C: 修改 EKS 集群的 IAM role，为每个 Kubernetes service account 包含权限。确保 IAM roles 与 Kubernetes roles 之间一一映射。
options.D: 定义一个包含必要权限的 IAM role。使用该 IAM role 的 Amazon ResourceName (ARN) 注释 Kubernetes service accounts。
options.E: 在 service accounts 的 IAM roles 与 OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity provider 之间设置信任关系。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **D and E**。

- **D 正确**：IRSA 的工作方式是创建/使用一个具有工作负载所需权限的 IAM role，然后将该 role 与 Kubernetes service account 关联。AWS 说明你需要“associate an IAM role with a Kubernetes service account”，并且 service account 会使用 `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` 进行注释，其中包含 IAM role ARN（[IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)，[Assign IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/associate-service-account-role.html)）。
- **E 正确**：IRSA 要求 EKS 集群具有 IAM OIDC provider。AWS 说明，要使用 IAM roles for service accounts，“an IAM OIDC provider must exist for your cluster’s OIDC issuer URL”，并且 role trust policy 使用带有 `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` 的 federated OIDC principal（[Create an IAM OIDC provider for your cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/enable-iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)，[Assign IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/associate-service-account-role.html)）。错误选项：

- **A 错误**：将权限附加到 EKS node IAM role 会在节点级别授予权限，而不是在 service-account 级别提供精细权限。AWS 将 IRSA 描述为使用 EC2 instance/node role 的替代方案，并指出可以将权限限定到某个 service account，以实现 least privilege（[IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)）。
- **B 错误**：Kubernetes network policies 控制网络流量，而不是对 AWS APIs 的 IAM 授权。pods 访问 AWS API 需要 IAM 凭证/权限，而 IRSA 通过与 service account 关联的 IAM roles 提供这些权限（[IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)）。
- **C 错误**：解决方案不是修改 EKS cluster IAM role，也不是将 IAM roles 映射到 Kubernetes roles。AWS 的 IRSA 流程是创建 IAM OIDC provider，创建一个针对 service account 具有 web identity trust policy 的 IAM role，附加所需的 IAM policy，并使用该 role ARN 注释 Kubernetes service account（[Assign IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/associate-service-account-role.html)）。

en.question: A company regularly uploads confidential data to Amazon S3 buckets for analysis. The company's security policies mandate that the objects must be encrypted at rest. The company must automatically rotate the encryption key every year. The company must be able to track key rotation by using AWS CloudTrail. The company also must minimize costs for the encryption key. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
options.B: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
options.C: Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS)
options.D: Use server-side encryption with customer managed AWS KMS keys

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS).**

SSE-KMS can use the default **AWS managed key** for S3 if you do not specify a customer managed key; Amazon S3 creates and uses that AWS managed KMS key by default for SSE-KMS uploads ([S3 SSE-KMS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)). AWS managed KMS keys are automatically rotated every year, and there is no monthly fee for AWS managed keys ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). AWS KMS also writes a **RotateKey** event to CloudTrail when it rotates key material for an AWS managed key or customer managed key, so rotation can be tracked ([AWS KMS rotation docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)). This meets the encryption-at-rest, annual automatic rotation, CloudTrail tracking, and cost-minimization requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. SSE-C**: With customer-provided keys, S3 never stores the key; the customer must supply it and manage safeguards such as key rotation on the client side. This does not provide AWS-managed automatic annual key rotation or KMS CloudTrail rotation tracking ([SSE-C considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html)).
- **B. SSE-S3**: SSE-S3 encrypts objects at rest and has no additional fee, but it uses Amazon S3 managed keys, not KMS keys. The docs state S3 rotates the key “regularly,” not that it provides annual KMS key rotation with a CloudTrail **RotateKey** event ([SSE-S3 docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)).
- **D. Customer managed AWS KMS key**: This would satisfy rotation and CloudTrail tracking, but it does **not** minimize key cost because customer managed keys incur a monthly fee, whereas AWS managed keys have no monthly fee ([AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司定期将机密数据上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶中进行分析。公司的安全策略要求对象必须进行静态加密。公司必须每年自动轮换加密密钥。公司必须能够使用 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪密钥轮换。公司还必须尽量降低加密密钥的成本。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用客户提供的密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-C)
options.B: 使用 Amazon S3 托管密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-S3)
options.C: 使用 AWS KMS keys 进行服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)
options.D: 使用客户托管的 AWS KMS keys 进行服务器端加密

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C. 使用 AWS KMS keys 进行服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。**

如果你未指定 customer managed key，SSE-KMS 可以对 S3 使用默认的 **AWS managed key**；Amazon S3 会默认创建并使用该 AWS managed KMS key 来进行 SSE-KMS 上传（[S3 SSE-KMS docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)）。AWS managed KMS keys 每年自动轮换，并且 AWS managed keys 没有月度费用（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。当 AWS KMS 轮换 AWS managed key 或 customer managed key 的密钥材料时，还会向 CloudTrail 写入 **RotateKey** 事件，因此可以跟踪轮换（[AWS KMS rotation docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)）。这满足了静态加密、年度自动轮换、CloudTrail 跟踪以及成本最小化要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. SSE-C**：使用 customer-provided keys 时，S3 从不存储密钥；客户必须提供密钥，并在客户端管理密钥轮换等保护措施。这不提供由 AWS 管理的年度自动密钥轮换，也不提供 KMS CloudTrail 轮换跟踪（[SSE-C considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html)）。
- **B. SSE-S3**：SSE-S3 会对静态对象进行加密且没有额外费用，但它使用 Amazon S3 managed keys，而不是 KMS keys。文档说明 S3 会“定期”轮换密钥，而不是提供带有 CloudTrail **RotateKey** 事件的年度 KMS key 轮换（[SSE-S3 docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)）。
- **D. Customer managed AWS KMS key**：这可以满足轮换和 CloudTrail 跟踪要求，但它**不能**最小化密钥成本，因为 customer managed keys 会产生月度费用，而 AWS managed keys 没有月度费用（[AWS KMS key concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。

en.question: A company has migrated several applications to AWS in the past 3 months. The company wants to know the breakdown of costs for each of these applications. The company wants to receive a regular report that includes this information. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Use AWS Budgets to download data for the past 3 months into a .csv file. Look up the desired information.
options.B: Load AWS Cost and Usage Reports into an Amazon RDS DB instance. Run SQL queries to get the desired information.
options.C: Tag all the AWS resources with a key for cost and a value of the application's name. Activate cost allocation tags. Use Cost Explorerto get the desired information.
options.D: Tag all the AWS resources with a key for cost and a value of the application's name. Use the AWS Billing and Cost Management console todownload bills for the past 3 months. Look up the desired information.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Tagging resources with an application-name value and activating those tags as **cost allocation tags** is the appropriate way to break down AWS costs by application. AWS states that after tags are applied and activated, they can be used to organize resource costs, and specifically notes that tags such as **application names** can be used to track the total cost of an application across resources. Activated tags can also appear in **Cost Explorer** and be used to filter views there ([AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)). Cost Explorer can show historical cost data for up to the last 13 months, which covers the 3-month requirement, and its UI is available free of charge ([Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)). Cost Explorer query results can also be saved as reports ([Creating a Cost Explorer report](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-custom-reports.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Budgets is for budget tracking and alerts, not the most direct tool for detailed application-level cost analysis. Manually downloading and looking up CSV data is less suitable for a regular application cost report.
- **B:** Loading Cost and Usage Reports into Amazon RDS and running SQL queries could work, but it adds database cost and operational overhead. Cost Explorer with cost allocation tags provides the needed analysis more cost-effectively; the Cost Explorer UI is free ([Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)).
- **D:** Merely tagging resources and downloading bills is insufficient because user-defined tags must be **activated** before they appear in Cost Explorer or cost allocation reports. Manual bill review is also less efficient than using Cost Explorer reports ([AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在过去 3 个月内已将多个应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司想了解每个应用程序的成本明细。该公司希望定期收到包含此信息的报告。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Budgets 将过去 3 个月的数据下载到 .csv 文件中。查找所需信息。
options.B: 将 AWS Cost and Usage Reports 加载到 Amazon RDS DB 实例中。运行 SQL 查询以获取所需信息。
options.C: 使用一个表示成本的键和应用程序名称作为值来标记所有 AWS 资源。激活成本分配标签。使用 Cost Explorerto 获取所需信息。
options.D: 使用一个表示成本的键和应用程序名称作为值来标记所有 AWS 资源。使用 AWS Billing and Cost Management 控制台下载过去 3 个月的账单。查找所需信息。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

使用应用程序名称值标记资源，并将这些标签激活为 **cost allocation tags**，是按应用程序细分 AWS 成本的适当方式。AWS 说明，在应用并激活标签后，可以使用它们来组织资源成本，并特别指出可以使用诸如 **application names** 之类的标签来跟踪跨资源的应用程序总成本。已激活的标签也可以显示在 **Cost Explorer** 中，并用于在那里筛选视图（[AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。Cost Explorer 可以显示最多过去 13 个月的历史成本数据，涵盖 3 个月的要求，并且其 UI 可免费使用（[Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)）。Cost Explorer 查询结果也可以保存为报告（[Creating a Cost Explorer report](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-custom-reports.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** AWS Budgets 用于预算跟踪和提醒，并不是进行详细应用程序级成本分析的最直接工具。手动下载并查找 CSV 数据不太适合定期的应用程序成本报告。
- **B:** 将 Cost and Usage Reports 加载到 Amazon RDS 并运行 SQL 查询可能可行，但会增加数据库成本和运维开销。带有成本分配标签的 Cost Explorer 能以更具成本效益的方式提供所需分析；Cost Explorer UI 是免费的（[Cost Explorer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html)）。
- **D:** 仅标记资源并下载账单是不够的，因为用户定义的标签必须先被**激活**，才会出现在 Cost Explorer 或成本分配报告中。与使用 Cost Explorer 报告相比，手动查看账单的效率也较低（[AWS cost allocation tags](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/cost-alloc-tags.html)）。

en.question: An ecommerce company is preparing to deploy a web application on AWS to ensure continuous service for customers. The architecture includes a web application that the company hosts on Amazon EC2 instances, a relational database in Amazon RDS, and static assets that the company stores in Amazon S3. The company wants to design a robust and resilient architecture for the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. Deploy an RDS DB instance in the same Availability Zone. Use Amazon S3 with versioning enabled to store static assets.
options.B: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Deploy a Multi-AZ RDS DB instance. Use Amazon CloudFront to distribute static assets.
options.C: Deploy Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. Deploy an RDS DB instance in a second Availability Zone for cross-AZ redundancy. Serve static assets directly from the EC2 instances.
options.D: Use AWS Lambda functions to serve the web application. Use Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 for the database. Store static assets in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA).

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Option B is the most robust and resilient design because it removes single-AZ dependencies across the application tiers:

- For the web tier, AWS recommends spanning an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones for geographic redundancy. If an AZ becomes unhealthy or unavailable, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling launches instances in an unaffected AZ and later redistributes instances when the AZ recovers ([AWS Auto Scaling documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)).
- For the database tier, Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments are explicitly described as high availability deployments; a Multi-AZ DB cluster places DB instances in separate Availability Zones in the same Region ([Amazon RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)).
- For static assets, CloudFront can use an Amazon S3 bucket as an origin and distribute files from edge locations around the world, improving availability and performance for users ([Amazon CloudFront documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EC2 and RDS are both in a single Availability Zone, creating single-AZ failure risk. S3 versioning protects object versions but does not make the EC2/RDS architecture highly available.
- **C:** EC2 is still deployed in a single Availability Zone, and serving static assets directly from EC2 increases dependency on that single web tier. An RDS instance merely placed in another AZ is not the same as a managed Multi-AZ RDS deployment.
- **D:** Lambda and Aurora Serverless v2 can be valid for some architectures, but this option changes the application platform unnecessarily and stores static assets in **EFS One Zone-IA**, which is not a multi-AZ static content distribution approach. It is less aligned with the stated EC2/RDS/S3 architecture and resilience goals than option B.

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司正准备在 AWS 上部署一个 Web 应用程序，以确保为客户提供持续服务。该架构包括公司托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 应用程序、Amazon RDS 中的关系数据库，以及公司存储在 Amazon S3 中的静态资产。公司希望为该应用程序设计一个稳健且具有弹性的架构。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在单个可用区中部署 Amazon EC2 实例。在同一可用区中部署 RDS DB 实例。使用启用了版本控制的 Amazon S3 来存储静态资产。
options.B: 在跨多个可用区的 Auto Scaling 组中部署 Amazon EC2 实例。部署 Multi-AZ RDS DB 实例。使用 Amazon CloudFront 分发静态资产。
options.C: 在单个可用区中部署 Amazon EC2 实例。在第二个可用区中部署 RDS DB 实例以实现跨 AZ 冗余。直接从 EC2 实例提供静态资产。
options.D: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数提供 Web 应用程序。使用 Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 作为数据库。将静态资产存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone-Infrequent Access (One Zone-IA) 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

选项 B 是最稳健且最具弹性的设计，因为它消除了应用程序各层对单个 AZ 的依赖：

- 对于 Web 层，AWS 建议将 Auto Scaling 组跨多个可用区部署，以实现地理冗余。如果某个 AZ 变得不健康或不可用，Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 会在未受影响的 AZ 中启动实例，并在该 AZ 恢复后重新分布实例（[AWS Auto Scaling documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-add-az-console.html)）。
- 对于数据库层，Amazon RDS Multi-AZ 部署被明确描述为高可用性部署；Multi-AZ DB 集群会将 DB 实例放置在同一 Region 中的不同可用区内（[Amazon RDS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/multi-az-db-clusters-concepts.html)）。
- 对于静态资产，CloudFront 可以使用 Amazon S3 存储桶作为源站，并从全球各地的边缘站点分发文件，从而提高用户的可用性和性能（[Amazon CloudFront documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** EC2 和 RDS 都位于单个可用区中，产生单个 AZ 故障风险。S3 版本控制可保护对象版本，但不会使 EC2/RDS 架构具备高可用性。
- **C:** EC2 仍然部署在单个可用区中，并且直接从 EC2 提供静态资产会增加对该单一 Web 层的依赖。仅仅放置在另一个 AZ 中的 RDS 实例并不等同于托管的 Multi-AZ RDS 部署。
- **D:** Lambda 和 Aurora Serverless v2 对某些架构可能是有效的，但此选项不必要地改变了应用程序平台，并将静态资产存储在 **EFS One Zone-IA** 中，这不是一种 multi-AZ 静态内容分发方法。与选项 B 相比，它与题述的 EC2/RDS/S3 架构和弹性目标不太一致。

en.question: An ecommerce company runs several internal applications in multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. A security appliance in the company's networking account must inspect interactions between applications across AWS accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the networking account to send traffic to the security appliance. Configure the application accounts to send traffic to the NLB by using an interface VPC endpoint in the application accounts.
options.B: Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in the application accounts to send traffic directly to the security appliance.
options.C: Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) in the networking account to send traffic to the security appliance. Configure the application accounts to send traffic to the GWLB by using an interface GWLB endpoint in the application accounts.
options.D: Deploy an interface VPC endpoint in the application accounts to send traffic directly to the security appliance.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Gateway Load Balancer is purpose-built for deploying and scaling virtual security appliances such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and deep packet inspection systems. AWS states that GWLB provides a transparent network gateway and distributes traffic to the virtual appliances, and that GWLB endpoints securely exchange traffic across VPC boundaries between application servers in a consumer VPC and appliances in a provider VPC. The GWLB is deployed in the same VPC as the virtual appliances, and traffic from the consumer VPC is routed through the GWLB endpoint to the GWLB and back by using route tables ([AWS ELB Gateway Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)). This matches a centralized networking/security account inspecting application-to-application traffic across accounts. AWS also describes centralized inspection architectures where virtual appliances that inspect traffic are targets behind a GWLB ([AWS whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/using-gwlb-with-tg-for-cns.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A Network Load Balancer with an interface endpoint is for exposing TCP/UDP services through PrivateLink, not for transparent inline inspection of all IP traffic. AWS distinguishes interface endpoints from **Gateway Load Balancer endpoints**, which are specifically used to send traffic to a fleet of virtual appliances and route traffic using route tables ([AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)).
- **B:** An Application Load Balancer operates at the application layer for application traffic, not as a transparent network gateway for security appliance inspection across VPC/account boundaries. It also would not provide the GWLB endpoint routing model needed for centralized inspection.
- **D:** An interface VPC endpoint alone does not send arbitrary routed traffic directly to a security appliance for inspection. For virtual appliance inspection, AWS specifies creating a **Gateway Load Balancer endpoint** and routing traffic to it; the GWLB then distributes traffic to the appliances ([AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家电子商务公司在多个 AWS 账户中运行多个内部应用程序。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理其 AWS 账户。公司网络账户中的一个安全设备必须检查跨 AWS 账户的应用程序之间的交互。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在网络账户中部署 Network Load Balancer (NLB)，将流量发送到安全设备。通过在应用程序账户中使用 interface VPC endpoint，配置应用程序账户将流量发送到 NLB。
options.B: 在应用程序账户中部署 Application Load Balancer (ALB)，将流量直接发送到安全设备。
options.C: 在网络账户中部署 Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)，将流量发送到安全设备。通过在应用程序账户中使用 interface GWLB endpoint，配置应用程序账户将流量发送到 GWLB。
options.D: 在应用程序账户中部署 interface VPC endpoint，将流量直接发送到安全设备。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Gateway Load Balancer 专为部署和扩展虚拟安全设备而构建，例如防火墙、入侵检测/防御系统和深度包检测系统。AWS 表示，GWLB 提供透明的网络网关并将流量分发到虚拟设备，而且 GWLB endpoints 可以在使用者 VPC 中的应用程序服务器与提供者 VPC 中的设备之间跨 VPC 边界安全地交换流量。GWLB 部署在与虚拟设备相同的 VPC 中，来自使用者 VPC 的流量通过路由表经由 GWLB endpoint 路由到 GWLB 并返回（[AWS ELB Gateway Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)）。这与集中式网络/安全账户检查跨账户的应用程序到应用程序流量相匹配。AWS 还描述了集中式检查架构，其中检查流量的虚拟设备是 GWLB 后面的目标（[AWS whitepaper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/building-scalable-secure-multi-vpc-network-infrastructure/using-gwlb-with-tg-for-cns.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 带有 interface endpoint 的 Network Load Balancer 用于通过 PrivateLink 公开 TCP/UDP 服务，而不是用于对所有 IP 流量进行透明的内联检查。AWS 将 interface endpoints 与 **Gateway Load Balancer endpoints** 区分开来，后者专门用于将流量发送到一组虚拟设备，并使用路由表路由流量（[AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)）。
- **B:** Application Load Balancer 在应用层处理应用程序流量，而不是作为用于跨 VPC/账户边界进行安全设备检查的透明网络网关。它也无法提供集中式检查所需的 GWLB endpoint 路由模型。
- **D:** 单独的 interface VPC endpoint 不会将任意路由流量直接发送到安全设备进行检查。对于虚拟设备检查，AWS 指定要创建 **Gateway Load Balancer endpoint** 并将流量路由到它；然后 GWLB 将流量分发到这些设备（[AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)）。

en.question: A company runs its production workload on an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster that includes six Aurora Replicas. The company wants near-real-time reporting queries from one of its departments to be automatically distributed across three of the Aurora Replicas. Those three replicas have a different compute and memory specification from the rest of the DB cluster. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Create and use a custom endpoint for the workload
options.B: Create a three-node cluster clone and use the reader endpoint
options.C: Use any of the instance endpoints for the selected three nodes
options.D: Use the reader endpoint to automatically distribute the read-only workload

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Create and use a custom endpoint for the workload**

A custom endpoint is designed for exactly this case: it represents a **set of DB instances that you choose**, and when clients connect, Aurora performs connection balancing among the instances in that group. AWS also states that custom endpoints are useful when a cluster has DB instances with **different capacities and configuration settings**, and can be used for specialized groups such as reporting workloads ([Custom endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Custom.html)). Therefore, create a custom endpoint that includes only the three Aurora Replicas with the desired compute and memory specifications, and direct the department’s reporting queries to that endpoint.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B. Create a three-node cluster clone and use the reader endpoint** — An Aurora clone is a separate, independent cluster volume and is mainly useful for test, development, or analytical copies of data, not for automatically distributing near-real-time reporting queries against the existing production cluster replicas ([Cloning a volume for an Amazon Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Managing.Clone.html)). This is unnecessary and does not meet the requirement to use the selected replicas in the existing cluster.
- **C. Use any of the instance endpoints for the selected three nodes** — Instance endpoints connect to a **specific DB instance**, which is useful for diagnosis or tuning, not for automatic distribution across three replicas ([Amazon Aurora endpoint connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.Endpoints.html)).
- **D. Use the reader endpoint to automatically distribute the read-only workload** — The reader endpoint performs connection balancing among **all** Aurora Replicas, not only the three replicas with the different specifications ([Amazon Aurora endpoint connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.Endpoints.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 集群上运行其生产工作负载，该集群包含六个 Aurora Replicas。该公司希望来自某个部门的近实时报告查询能够自动分布到其中三个 Aurora Replicas 上。这三个副本的计算和内存规格与 DB 集群中的其余副本不同。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 为该工作负载创建并使用自定义端点
options.B: 创建一个三节点集群克隆并使用读取器端点
options.C: 使用所选三个节点的任意实例端点
options.D: 使用读取器端点自动分发只读工作负载

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 为该工作负载创建并使用自定义端点**

自定义端点正是为这种情况设计的：它表示你选择的 **一组 DB 实例**，当客户端连接时，Aurora 会在该组中的实例之间执行连接均衡。AWS 还说明，当集群中的 DB 实例具有 **不同的容量和配置设置** 时，自定义端点很有用，并且可用于报告工作负载等专门的实例组（[Custom endpoints for Amazon Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Endpoints.Custom.html)）。因此，应创建一个仅包含具有所需计算和内存规格的三个 Aurora Replicas 的自定义端点，并将该部门的报告查询定向到该端点。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B. 创建一个三节点集群克隆并使用读取器端点** — Aurora 克隆是一个单独的独立集群卷，主要适用于测试、开发或分析用途的数据副本，而不是用于针对现有生产集群副本自动分发近实时报告查询（[Cloning a volume for an Amazon Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Managing.Clone.html)）。这没有必要，也不满足使用现有集群中所选副本的要求。
- **C. 使用所选三个节点的任意实例端点** — 实例端点连接到一个 **特定 DB 实例**，这对诊断或调优有用，但不适用于在三个副本之间自动分发连接（[Amazon Aurora endpoint connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.Endpoints.html)）。
- **D. 使用读取器端点自动分发只读工作负载** — 读取器端点会在 **所有** Aurora Replicas 之间执行连接均衡，而不仅仅是在具有不同规格的三个副本之间（[Amazon Aurora endpoint connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Overview.Endpoints.html)）。

en.question: A company runs a Node js function on a server in its on-premises data center. The data center stores data in a PostgreSQL database. The company stores the credentials in a connection string in an environment variable on the server. The company wants to migrate its application to AWS and to replace the Node.js application server with AWS Lambda. The company also wants to migrate to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and to ensure that the database credentials are securely managed. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the database credentials as a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store Configure Parameter Store to automatically rotate the secrets every 30 days. Update the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from the parameter.
options.B: Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure Secrets Manager to automatically rotate the credentials every 30 days. Update the Lambda function to retrieve the credentials from the secret.
options.C: Store the database credentials as an encrypted Lambda environment variable. Write a custom Lambda function to rotate the credentials. Schedule the Lambda function to run every 30 days.
options.D: Store the database credentials as a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Configure automatic rotation for the key. Update the Lambda function to retneve the credentials from the KMS key.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built to manage database credentials: AWS says it helps you “manage, retrieve, and rotate database credentials” and replace hard-coded credentials with runtime retrieval calls. It also supports configuring an automatic rotation schedule for secrets, so the credentials can be rotated without updating application code ([AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). Secrets Manager rotation updates credentials in both the secret and the database/service, and Secrets Manager can set up automatic rotation ([Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). Lambda can retrieve Secrets Manager secrets by using the AWS Parameters and Secrets Lambda Extension or SDK-based approaches ([Use AWS Secrets Manager secrets in AWS Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/retrieving-secrets_lambda.html)). This meets the security and low-operational-overhead requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Parameter Store can securely store parameters and Lambda can retrieve them, but the cited Parameter Store features describe notifications/change events to indicate when a parameter has not been rotated, not built-in automatic database credential rotation. Secrets Manager is the AWS service documented for automatic secret rotation.
- **C:** Encrypted Lambda environment variables plus a custom rotation Lambda would require building and operating custom rotation logic. Secrets Manager provides managed secret storage and automatic rotation, so this is higher operational overhead.
- **D:** AWS KMS manages encryption keys, not database usernames/passwords. KMS automatic rotation rotates KMS key material for supported KMS keys; it does not rotate PostgreSQL database credentials ([AWS KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在其本地数据中心的一台服务器上运行一个 Node js 函数。该数据中心将数据存储在 PostgreSQL 数据库中。该公司将凭证存储在服务器上环境变量中的连接字符串里。该公司希望将其应用程序迁移到 AWS，并用 AWS Lambda 替换 Node.js 应用程序服务器。该公司还希望迁移到 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL，并确保数据库凭证得到安全管理。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将数据库凭证作为参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。配置 Parameter Store 每 30 天自动轮换密钥。更新 Lambda 函数以从该参数检索凭证。
options.B: 将数据库凭证作为密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置 Secrets Manager 每 30 天自动轮换凭证。更新 Lambda 函数以从该密钥检索凭证。
options.C: 将数据库凭证存储为加密的 Lambda 环境变量。编写一个自定义 Lambda 函数来轮换凭证。计划该 Lambda 函数每 30 天运行一次。
options.D: 将数据库凭证作为密钥存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中。为该密钥配置自动轮换。更新 Lambda 函数以从 KMS 密钥检索凭证。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS Secrets Manager 专为管理数据库凭证而构建：AWS 表示它可帮助你“管理、检索和轮换数据库凭证”，并用运行时检索调用替换硬编码凭证。它还支持为密钥配置自动轮换计划，因此可以在不更新应用程序代码的情况下轮换凭证（[AWS Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。Secrets Manager 轮换会同时更新密钥和数据库/服务中的凭证，并且 Secrets Manager 可以设置自动轮换（[Rotate AWS Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。Lambda 可以使用 AWS Parameters and Secrets Lambda Extension 或基于 SDK 的方法检索 Secrets Manager 密钥（[Use AWS Secrets Manager secrets in AWS Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/retrieving-secrets_lambda.html)）。这满足安全性和低运营开销要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** Parameter Store 可以安全地存储参数，Lambda 也可以检索这些参数，但所引用的 Parameter Store 功能描述的是用于指示参数未轮换的通知/变更事件，而不是内置的自动数据库凭证轮换。Secrets Manager 才是 AWS 文档中用于自动密钥轮换的服务。
- **C:** 加密的 Lambda 环境变量加上自定义轮换 Lambda 将需要构建和运营自定义轮换逻辑。Secrets Manager 提供托管式密钥存储和自动轮换，因此该方案运营开销更高。
- **D:** AWS KMS 管理加密密钥，而不是数据库用户名/密码。KMS 自动轮换会轮换受支持 KMS 密钥的 KMS 密钥材料；它不会轮换 PostgreSQL 数据库凭证（[AWS KMS key rotation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/rotate-keys.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to replicate existing and ongoing data changes from an on-premises Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. The amount of data to replicate varies throughout each day. The company wants to use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) for data replication. The solution must allocate only the capacity that the replication instance requires. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the AWS DMS replication instance with a Multi-AZ deployment to provision instances across multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an AWS DMS Serverless replication task to analyze and replicate the data while provisioning the required capacity.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale the size of the AWS DMS replication instance up or down based on the amount of data toreplicate.
options.D: Provision AWS DMS replication capacity by using Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with an AWS Fargate launch type to analyze and replicate the data while provisioning the required capacity.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** AWS DMS Serverless is designed for this requirement: it provides **automatic provisioning and scaling** and eliminates replication instance management tasks such as capacity estimation and provisioning. After a serverless replication starts, AWS DMS analyzes the replication workload metadata, computes the required capacity, provisions it, and starts data replication ([Working with AWS DMS Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.html)). AWS DMS Serverless also supports **Oracle** as both a source and a target, and it can autoscale replication resources between configured minimum and maximum DMS Capacity Units as workload changes ([AWS DMS Serverless components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.Components.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Multi-AZ for AWS DMS Serverless creates a standby replica in another Availability Zone for failover support; it does not solve variable-capacity provisioning by itself ([AWS DMS Serverless components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.Components.html)).
- **C:** Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling is not the mechanism for scaling an AWS DMS replication instance. The AWS-managed DMS Serverless feature is what removes capacity estimation/provisioning and manages scaling for DMS replication ([Working with AWS DMS Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.html)).
- **D:** Amazon ECS with Fargate is not how AWS DMS replication capacity is provisioned. AWS DMS Serverless provides the DMS-native automatic provisioning, scaling, and pay-for-use replication model ([Working with AWS DMS Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司希望将现有数据以及持续发生的数据变更从本地 Oracle 数据库复制到 Amazon RDS for Oracle。每天需要复制的数据量会有所变化。公司希望使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 进行数据复制。该解决方案必须只分配复制实例所需的容量。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS DMS 复制实例配置为 Multi-AZ 部署，以便在多个 Availability Zones 中预置实例。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS DMS Serverless 复制任务，在预置所需容量的同时分析并复制数据。
options.C: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 根据要复制的数据量向上或向下扩展 AWS DMS 复制实例的大小。
options.D: 通过使用带有 AWS Fargate 启动类型的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 来预置 AWS DMS 复制容量，以便在预置所需容量的同时分析并复制数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** AWS DMS Serverless 正是为此需求而设计的：它提供 **自动预置和扩展**，并消除容量估算和预置等复制实例管理任务。无服务器复制启动后，AWS DMS 会分析复制工作负载元数据，计算所需容量，进行预置，并开始数据复制（[Working with AWS DMS Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.html)）。AWS DMS Serverless 还支持将 **Oracle** 同时作为源和目标，并且可以随着工作负载变化，在配置的最小和最大 DMS Capacity Units 之间自动扩展复制资源（[AWS DMS Serverless components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.Components.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS DMS Serverless 的 Multi-AZ 会在另一个 Availability Zone 中创建一个备用副本以支持故障转移；它本身并不能解决可变容量预置问题（[AWS DMS Serverless components](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.Components.html)）。
- **C:** Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 不是扩展 AWS DMS 复制实例的机制。由 AWS 托管的 DMS Serverless 功能才是为 DMS 复制消除容量估算/预置并管理扩展的功能（[Working with AWS DMS Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.html)）。
- **D:** Amazon ECS with Fargate 不是预置 AWS DMS 复制容量的方式。AWS DMS Serverless 提供 DMS 原生的自动预置、扩展以及按使用付费的复制模型（[Working with AWS DMS Serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Serverless.html)）。

en.question: A company has a multi-tier web application. The application's internal service components are deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. The internal service components need to access third-party software as a service (SaaS) APIs that are hosted on AWS. The company needs to provide secure and private connectivity from the application's internal services to the third-party SaaS application. The company needs to ensure that there is minimal public internet exposure. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish a secure connection with the third-party SaaS provider.
options.B: Deploy AWS Transit Gateway to manage and route traffic between the application's VPC and the third-party SaaS provider.
options.C: Configure AWS PrivateLink to allow only outbound traffic from the VPC without enabling the third- party SaaS provider to establish.
options.D: Use AWS PrivateLink to create a private connection between the application's VPC and the third- party SaaS provider.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D. Use AWS PrivateLink to create a private connection between the application's VPC and the third-party SaaS provider.**

AWS PrivateLink is designed for this scenario: it establishes private connectivity from a VPC to supported AWS services, services hosted by other AWS accounts, AWS Marketplace services, and supported resources. AWS states that you do **not** need an internet gateway, NAT device, Direct Connect connection, or Site-to-Site VPN to communicate with the service, which minimizes public internet exposure. Traffic between the VPC endpoint and endpoint service/resource stays within the AWS network and does not traverse the public internet. The consumer creates the VPC endpoint, and the service consumer initiates the connection while the provider accepts or rejects it ([AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html), [AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Site-to-Site VPN**: Site-to-Site VPN is for creating an IPsec VPN connection between a VPC and a remote network/customer gateway. The SaaS APIs are hosted on AWS, and AWS PrivateLink avoids the need for a VPN while keeping traffic private within AWS ([VPN connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)).
- **B. Transit Gateway**: Transit Gateway is a centralized hub for connecting VPCs, VPN connections, Direct Connect gateways, third-party virtual appliances, and other transit gateways. It is useful for network routing at scale, but it is not the specific service for private consumer access to a third-party SaaS endpoint service with minimal public exposure ([SaaS networking services overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/saas-network-access-options/services.html)).
- **C. Configure PrivateLink to allow only outbound traffic...**: PrivateLink is the right technology, but this option is incomplete/misworded and frames the requirement as an outbound-only traffic rule. The complete solution is to create a PrivateLink private connection/VPC endpoint to the SaaS provider's endpoint service, as described in option D. PrivateLink connectivity is established through VPC endpoints to endpoint services/resources, with traffic remaining on the AWS network ([AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个多层 Web 应用程序。该应用程序的内部服务组件部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些内部服务组件需要访问托管在 AWS 上的第三方软件即服务 (SaaS) API。公司需要从应用程序的内部服务到第三方 SaaS 应用程序提供安全且私有的连接。公司需要确保尽量减少对公共互联网的暴露。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 实施 AWS Site-to-Site VPN，以与第三方 SaaS 提供商建立安全连接。
options.B: 部署 AWS Transit Gateway，以管理应用程序的 VPC 与第三方 SaaS 提供商之间的流量并进行路由。
options.C: 配置 AWS PrivateLink，仅允许来自 VPC 的出站流量，而不允许第三方 SaaS 提供商建立。
options.D: 使用 AWS PrivateLink 在应用程序的 VPC 与第三方 SaaS 提供商之间创建私有连接。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D. 使用 AWS PrivateLink 在应用程序的 VPC 与第三方 SaaS 提供商之间创建私有连接。**

AWS PrivateLink 正是为这种场景而设计的：它可以从 VPC 到受支持的 AWS 服务、其他 AWS 账户托管的服务、AWS Marketplace 服务以及受支持的资源建立私有连接。AWS 声明，你**不**需要 internet gateway、NAT device、Direct Connect connection 或 Site-to-Site VPN 即可与该服务通信，这可以最大限度地减少对公共互联网的暴露。VPC endpoint 与 endpoint service/resource 之间的流量会保留在 AWS 网络内，不会穿越公共互联网。使用者创建 VPC endpoint，服务使用者发起连接，而提供商接受或拒绝该连接（[AWS PrivateLink overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/endpoint-services-overview.html)，[AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Site-to-Site VPN**：Site-to-Site VPN 用于在 VPC 与远程网络/customer gateway 之间创建 IPsec VPN 连接。SaaS API 托管在 AWS 上，而 AWS PrivateLink 可以避免使用 VPN 的需要，同时将流量保持在 AWS 内部的私有网络中（[VPN connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpn-connections.html)）。
- **B. Transit Gateway**：Transit Gateway 是一个集中式枢纽，用于连接 VPC、VPN connections、Direct Connect gateways、第三方虚拟设备以及其他 transit gateways。它适用于大规模网络路由，但它并不是用于以最小公共暴露方式私有访问第三方 SaaS endpoint service 的特定服务（[SaaS networking services overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/saas-network-access-options/services.html)）。
- **C. Configure PrivateLink to allow only outbound traffic...**：PrivateLink 是正确的技术，但此选项不完整/表述不当，并将要求描述为仅出站流量规则。完整的解决方案是创建一个到 SaaS 提供商 endpoint service 的 PrivateLink 私有连接/VPC endpoint，如选项 D 所述。PrivateLink 连接是通过到 endpoint services/resources 的 VPC endpoints 建立的，并且流量会保留在 AWS 网络上（[AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)）。

en.question: A solutions architect needs to connect a company's corporate network to its VPC to allow on-premises access to its AWS resources. The solution must provide encryption of all traffic between the corporate network and the VPC at the network layer and the session layer. The solution also must provide security controls to prevent unrestricted access between AWS and the on-premises systems. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Direct Connect to connect to the VPC. Configure the VPC route tables to allow and deny traffic between AWS and on premises as required.
options.B: Create an IAM policy to allow access to the AWS Management Console only from a defined set of corporate IP addresses. Restrict user access based on job responsibility by using an IAM policy and roles.
options.C: Configure AWS Site-to-Site VPN to connect to the VPConfigure route table entries to direct traffic from on premises to the VPConfigure instance security groups and network ACLs to allow only required traffic from on premises.
options.D: Configure AWS Transit Gateway to connect to the VPC. Configure route table entries to direct traffic from on premises to the VPC. Configure instance security groups and network ACLs to allow only required traffic from on premises.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Site-to-Site VPN is designed to connect an on-premises network to a VPC: AWS says you can enable access from a VPC to remote/on-premises devices by creating a Site-to-Site VPN connection and configuring routing through it. It supports IPsec VPN connections, and AWS defines a VPN tunnel as an encrypted link between the customer network and AWS; each Site-to-Site VPN connection includes two encrypted IPsec VPN tunnels. AWS also states that IPsec secures IP communications by authenticating and encrypting each IP packet, and Site-to-Site VPN supports IKEv2 and additional encryption options such as AES-256. Therefore, it is the option that provides encrypted network connectivity between on premises and the VPC. The required access controls are met by configuring routes plus VPC security controls: security groups can be configured to allow only specific inbound/outbound traffic, and network ACLs can allow or deny specific subnet-level inbound/outbound traffic ([Site-to-Site VPN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html), [Site-to-Site VPN data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/data-protection.html), [security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html), [network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network connection to AWS/VPCs, but this option does not add an encrypted VPN or other encryption mechanism. AWS describes Direct Connect as linking the internal network to a Direct Connect location over Ethernet and creating virtual interfaces to AWS services or VPCs; that alone does not satisfy the stated encryption requirement ([Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).
- **B:** IAM policies can restrict access to AWS APIs/console, but they do not create network connectivity from the corporate network to the VPC and do not encrypt all network traffic between on premises and the VPC.
- **D:** A transit gateway is a transit hub that can interconnect VPCs and on-premises networks, but the option does not specify Site-to-Site VPN or another encrypted corporate connectivity method. A transit gateway attachment by itself does not meet the requirement for encrypted traffic between the corporate network and the VPC; Site-to-Site VPN is the encrypted VPN mechanism described by AWS ([Site-to-Site VPN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)).

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师需要将一家公司的企业网络连接到其 VPC，以允许本地访问其 AWS 资源。该解决方案必须在网络层和会话层为企业网络与 VPC 之间的所有流量提供加密。该解决方案还必须提供安全控制，以防止 AWS 与本地系统之间的不受限制访问。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 AWS Direct Connect 以连接到 VPC。配置 VPC 路由表，以根据需要允许和拒绝 AWS 与本地之间的流量。
options.B: 创建 IAM 策略，仅允许从一组定义的企业 IP 地址访问 AWS Management Console。使用 IAM 策略和角色基于工作职责限制用户访问。
options.C: 配置 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 以连接到 VPConfigure 路由表条目，将流量从本地引导到 VPConfigure 实例安全组和网络 ACL，以仅允许来自本地的所需流量。
options.D: 配置 AWS Transit Gateway 以连接到 VPC。配置路由表条目，将流量从本地引导到 VPC。配置实例安全组和网络 ACL，以仅允许来自本地的所需流量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Site-to-Site VPN 旨在将本地网络连接到 VPC：AWS 表示，您可以通过创建 Site-to-Site VPN 连接并配置通过该连接的路由，来启用从 VPC 到远程/本地设备的访问。它支持 IPsec VPN 连接，并且 AWS 将 VPN 隧道定义为客户网络与 AWS 之间的加密链路；每个 Site-to-Site VPN 连接都包含两个加密的 IPsec VPN 隧道。AWS 还指出，IPsec 通过对每个 IP 数据包进行身份验证和加密来保护 IP 通信，并且 Site-to-Site VPN 支持 IKEv2 以及 AES-256 等其他加密选项。因此，它是能够在本地与 VPC 之间提供加密网络连接的选项。通过配置路由以及 VPC 安全控制可满足所需的访问控制：安全组可以配置为仅允许特定的入站/出站流量，网络 ACL 可以允许或拒绝特定的子网级入站/出站流量（[Site-to-Site VPN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)、[Site-to-Site VPN data protection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/data-protection.html)、[security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)、[network ACL basics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/vpc-network-acls.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Direct Connect 提供到 AWS/VPCs 的专用私有网络连接，但此选项没有添加加密的 VPN 或其他加密机制。AWS 将 Direct Connect 描述为通过 Ethernet 将内部网络连接到 Direct Connect 位置，并创建到 AWS 服务或 VPCs 的虚拟接口；仅凭这一点不能满足所述的加密要求（[Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。
- **B:** IAM 策略可以限制对 AWS APIs/console 的访问，但它们不会创建从企业网络到 VPC 的网络连接，也不会加密本地与 VPC 之间的所有网络流量。
- **D:** transit gateway 是一个传输枢纽，可以互连 VPCs 和本地网络，但该选项未指定 Site-to-Site VPN 或其他加密的企业连接方法。transit gateway attachment 本身不能满足企业网络与 VPC 之间流量加密的要求；Site-to-Site VPN 是 AWS 描述的加密 VPN 机制（[Site-to-Site VPN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。

en.question: A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from a database in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB cluster. The company needs to make the application more secure with minimal programming effort. The company has created credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Store the credentials in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Create keys in AWS KMS. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation
options.B: Store the credentials in encrypted local storage. Configure the application to load the database credentials from the local storage. Set up a credentials rotation schedule by creating a cron job.
options.C: Store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule by creating an AWS Lambda function for Secrets Manager.
options.D: Store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule in the RDS for MySQL database by using Parameter Store.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Secrets Manager is purpose-built to manage, retrieve, and rotate database credentials and other secrets. AWS states that it helps remove hard-coded credentials by replacing them with a runtime call to Secrets Manager, and that you can configure an automatic rotation schedule so rotation does not require application redeployment ([Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). For rotation, Secrets Manager can update credentials in both the secret and the database/service, and for applicable secrets it uses a Lambda function for rotation ([Rotate Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)). AWS also provides rotation function templates specifically for **Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora MySQL** single-user and alternating-user rotation ([rotation templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/reference_available-rotation-templates.html)). This meets the requirements with minimal programming effort.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS KMS manages cryptographic keys used by applications and AWS services for encryption; it is not the credential lifecycle manager for database usernames/passwords. The Secrets Manager documentation specifically recommends Secrets Manager for secrets and KMS for encryption keys ([Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html); [KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)). Rotating a KMS key is not the same as rotating the database password.
- **B:** Encrypted local storage plus a cron job is custom operational work, leaves secrets tied to local hosts, and does not provide the managed retrieval and rotation integration that Secrets Manager provides.
- **D:** Parameter Store can store and retrieve centrally managed parameters, and supports features such as change events/notifications, but the documented managed secret rotation capability for updating both the secret and the database is a Secrets Manager feature, not a Parameter Store schedule in RDS ([Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html); [Rotate Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个自定义应用程序，其中嵌入了凭证，用于从 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB cluster 中的数据库检索信息。该公司需要以最少的编程工作量提高应用程序的安全性。该公司已在 RDS for MySQL 数据库上为应用程序用户创建了凭证。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将凭证存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 中。在 AWS KMS 中创建密钥。配置应用程序从 AWS KMS 加载数据库凭证。启用自动密钥轮换
options.B: 将凭证存储在加密的本地存储中。配置应用程序从本地存储加载数据库凭证。通过创建 cron job 来设置凭证轮换计划。
options.C: 将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序从 Secrets Manager 加载数据库凭证。通过为 Secrets Manager 创建 AWS Lambda function 来设置凭证轮换计划。
options.D: 将凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。配置应用程序从 Parameter Store 加载数据库凭证。通过使用 Parameter Store 在 RDS for MySQL 数据库中设置凭证轮换计划。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Secrets Manager 专为管理、检索和轮换数据库凭证及其他密钥而构建。AWS 表示，它通过将硬编码凭证替换为对 Secrets Manager 的运行时调用，帮助移除硬编码凭证，并且你可以配置自动轮换计划，使轮换不需要重新部署应用程序（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。对于轮换，Secrets Manager 可以同时更新密钥和数据库/服务中的凭证，并且对于适用的密钥，它使用 Lambda function 进行轮换（[Rotate Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。AWS 还专门为 **Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora MySQL** 单用户和交替用户轮换提供轮换函数模板（[rotation templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/reference_available-rotation-templates.html)）。这以最少的编程工作量满足要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** AWS KMS 管理应用程序和 AWS 服务用于加密的加密密钥；它不是数据库用户名/密码的凭证生命周期管理器。Secrets Manager 文档明确建议将 Secrets Manager 用于密钥，将 KMS 用于加密密钥（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html); [KMS keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/concepts.html)）。轮换 KMS 密钥并不等同于轮换数据库密码。
- **B:** 加密的本地存储加 cron job 属于自定义运维工作，会使密钥绑定到本地主机，并且不提供 Secrets Manager 所提供的托管检索和轮换集成。
- **D:** Parameter Store 可以存储和检索集中管理的参数，并支持变更事件/通知等功能，但用于同时更新密钥和数据库的文档化托管密钥轮换能力是 Secrets Manager 的功能，而不是 RDS 中的 Parameter Store 计划（[Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html); [Rotate Secrets Manager secrets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/rotating-secrets.html)）。

en.question: A company wants to move its application to a serverless solution. The serverless solution needs to analyze existing data and new data by using SQL. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data must be encrypted at rest and replicated to a different AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a new S3 bucket that uses server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE- KMS). Configure Cross-Region Replication (CRR). Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.B: Create a new S3 bucket that uses server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). Configure Cross-Region Replication (CRR). Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use Amazon RDS to query the data.
options.C: Configure Cross-Region Replication (CRR) on the existing S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
options.D: Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) on the existing S3 bucket. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon Athena is the right analytics service because it can analyze data **directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL**, and **Athena SQL is serverless**, with no infrastructure to set up or manage ([Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). For encryption, Amazon S3 buckets have default encryption enabled, and new objects are automatically encrypted with **server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)** at no additional cost ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)). For Regional replication, S3 **Cross-Region Replication (CRR)** is used to copy objects across S3 buckets in different AWS Regions ([S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)). Using the existing bucket with SSE-S3, CRR, and Athena avoids creating and reloading data into a new bucket and avoids KMS key management, so it has the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Athena is appropriate, and CRR can replicate across Regions, but creating a new bucket, configuring SSE-KMS with multi-Region keys, and loading the data into the new bucket adds unnecessary operational work. AWS notes that SSE-KMS is for cases where you need more control over keys, such as key rotation and access policy grants, while SSE-S3 is already the default encryption option for S3 buckets ([S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)).
- **B:** Amazon RDS is not the best fit for querying data that already resides in S3 in a serverless way. Athena is designed to query S3 data directly with SQL and is serverless ([Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)). This option also adds the overhead of a new bucket and data loading.
- **D:** This option uses Amazon RDS instead of Athena, so it does not provide the lowest-overhead serverless SQL analysis of S3 data. It also adds unnecessary SSE-KMS key-management overhead compared with SSE-S3.

zh.question: 一家公司希望将其应用程序迁移到无服务器解决方案。该无服务器解决方案需要使用 SQL 分析现有数据和新数据。公司将数据存储在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中。数据必须进行静态加密，并复制到不同的 AWS Region。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 S3 bucket，使用带有 AWS KMS multi-Region keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE- KMS)。配置 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。将数据加载到新的 S3 bucket 中。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.B: 创建一个新的 S3 bucket，使用 Amazon S3 managed keys 进行服务器端加密 (SSE-S3)。配置 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。将数据加载到新的 S3 bucket 中。使用 Amazon RDS 查询数据。
options.C: 在现有 S3 bucket 上配置 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。使用 Amazon S3 managed keys 进行服务器端加密 (SSE-S3)。使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.D: 在现有 S3 bucket 上配置 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。使用带有 AWS KMS multi-Region keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。使用 Amazon RDS 查询数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon Athena 是合适的分析服务，因为它可以**直接在 Amazon S3 中使用标准 SQL** 分析数据，并且 **Athena SQL 是无服务器的**，无需设置或管理基础设施（[Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。对于加密，Amazon S3 bucket 默认启用加密，新对象会自动使用 **server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)** 进行加密，且无需额外费用（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。对于区域复制，使用 S3 **Cross-Region Replication (CRR)** 在不同 AWS Regions 的 S3 bucket 之间复制对象（[S3 replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)）。使用现有 bucket，并结合 SSE-S3、CRR 和 Athena，可以避免创建新 bucket 并重新加载数据，也避免 KMS key 管理，因此具有最少的运营开销。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Athena 是合适的，并且 CRR 可以跨 Regions 复制，但创建新 bucket、配置带 multi-Region keys 的 SSE-KMS，以及将数据加载到新 bucket 中，会增加不必要的运营工作。AWS 指出，SSE-KMS 适用于你需要对密钥进行更多控制的情况，例如密钥轮换和访问策略授权，而 SSE-S3 已经是 S3 bucket 的默认加密选项（[S3 default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)）。
- **B:** Amazon RDS 不适合以无服务器方式查询已经位于 S3 中的数据。Athena 旨在使用 SQL 直接查询 S3 数据，并且是无服务器的（[Amazon Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)）。此选项还增加了新 bucket 和数据加载的开销。
- **D:** 此选项使用 Amazon RDS 而不是 Athena，因此无法为 S3 数据提供最低开销的无服务器 SQL 分析。与 SSE-S3 相比，它还增加了不必要的 SSE-KMS key-management 开销。

en.question: A company has a web application that has thousands of users. The application uses 8-10 user-uploaded images to generate AI images. Users can download the generated AI images once every 6 hours. The company also has a premium user option that gives users the ability to download the generated AI images anytime. The company uses the user-uploaded images to run AI model training twice a year. The company needs a storage solution to store the images. Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Move premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard. Move non-premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.B: Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive Move all generated AI images to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.
options.C: Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA). Move premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard. Move non-premium user-generated AI images to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
options.D: Move uploaded images to Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA). Move all generated AI images to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

A is the most cost-effective choice among the options because it maps each image category to the lowest-cost S3 class that still fits the access pattern:

- **User-uploaded source images** are needed only for AI model training twice a year. They are archival data, not user-facing data. AWS states that S3 Glacier storage classes are for low-cost, long-term storage and that storage classes with less frequent access and longer retrieval times offer lower storage costs. S3 Glacier Deep Archive is described as the **lowest-cost storage option in AWS** and is suitable for data that can wait hours to be retrieved, with a 180-day minimum storage duration—reasonable for twice-yearly training cycles if restores are planned in advance ([S3 Glacier storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html), [S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **Premium generated AI images** must be downloadable anytime, so they need immediate, low-latency access. S3 Standard is designed for frequently accessed data with millisecond access ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **Non-premium generated AI images** do not require unrestricted anytime downloads. S3 Standard-IA is designed for long-lived, infrequently accessed data while still providing millisecond access, making it more cost-effective than S3 Standard for that access pattern ([S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B**: S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is archival and objects are **not available for real-time access**; they must be restored before access.
