SQS standard queue**：标准队列具有很高的可扩展性，但它们提供 **at-least-once** 传递。AWS 指出，可能会传递某条消息的多个副本，因此应用程序必须具备幂等性（[Amazon SQS standard queues](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues.html)、[Amazon SQS at-least-once delivery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/standard-queues-at-least-once-delivery.html)）。这不满足“对每个表单仅处理一次”的要求。
- **D. Step Functions synchronous workflow**：Synchronous Express Workflows 具有 **at-most-once** 执行语义，并且不会自动管理幂等性；如果发生异常，工作流不会重新启动（[Choosing workflow type in Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/choosing-workflow-type.html)）。这不符合 Web 层和工作线程层之间对持久存储并转发队列的要求。

en.question: A finance company uses an on-premises search application to collect streaming data from various producers. The application provides real-time updates to search and visualization features. The company is planning to migrate to AWS and wants to use an AWS native solution. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon EC2 instances to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon S3 buckets tor storage. Use Amazon Athena to search the data. Use Amazon Managed Grafana to create visualizations.
options.B: Use Amazon EMR to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon Redshift for storage. Use Amazon Redshift Spectrum to search the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations.
options.C: Use Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon DynamoDB for storage. Use Amazon CloudWatch to create graphical dashboards to search and visualize the data.
options.D: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to ingest and process the data streams to Amazon OpenSearch Service. Use OpenSearch Service to search the data. Use Amazon QuickSight to create visualizations.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The requirement is an AWS-native replacement for a streaming search application that provides real-time updates for search and visualization. Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is designed for rapid, continuous data intake: AWS states that producers can push data directly into a stream and records can be available for processing in seconds, with real-time metrics, reporting, and analytics use cases ([Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)). Amazon OpenSearch Service is the right target for searchable indexed data, and AWS explicitly documents that you can load streaming data from Kinesis Data Streams to OpenSearch Service ([Loading streaming data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/integrations-kinesis.html)). AWS also documents an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline with Kinesis Data Streams for high-scale, low-latency continuous ingestion into OpenSearch domains and collections ([OpenSearch Ingestion with Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/configure-client-kinesis.html)). QuickSight can use OpenSearch as a data source, as shown by its `AmazonOpenSearchParameters` data source parameters ([QuickSight API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/APIReference/API_AmazonOpenSearchParameters.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** EC2-based ingestion is not the most AWS-native managed streaming solution, S3 is object storage rather than a real-time searchable index, and Athena queries data in S3 rather than providing real-time search updates.
- **B:** EMR and Redshift/Redshift Spectrum are more suitable for big data processing and data warehouse analytics, not a low-latency streaming search application.
- **C:** EKS adds container orchestration operational overhead, DynamoDB is not a search engine for full search/visualization workloads, and CloudWatch dashboards are primarily for operational metrics/log observability rather than searching application data streams.
- **D:** Combines managed real-time stream ingestion with a managed search/indexing service and visualization through QuickSight, matching all requirements.

zh.question: 一家金融公司使用本地部署的搜索应用程序从各种生产者收集流式数据。该应用程序为搜索和可视化功能提供实时更新。该公司计划迁移到 AWS，并希望使用 AWS 原生解决方案。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 实例将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon S3 存储桶中用于存储。使用 Amazon Athena 搜索数据。使用 Amazon Managed Grafana 创建可视化。
options.B: 使用 Amazon EMR 将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon Redshift 中用于存储。使用 Amazon Redshift Spectrum 搜索数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 创建可视化。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon DynamoDB 中用于存储。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 创建图形化控制面板来搜索和可视化数据。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 将数据流摄取并处理到 Amazon OpenSearch Service。使用 OpenSearch Service 搜索数据。使用 Amazon QuickSight 创建可视化。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

要求是为一个流式搜索应用程序提供 AWS 原生替代方案，该应用程序可为搜索和可视化提供实时更新。Amazon Kinesis Data Streams 专为快速、连续的数据摄取而设计：AWS 说明生产者可以将数据直接推送到流中，记录可在数秒内用于处理，并支持实时指标、报告和分析用例（[Kinesis Data Streams introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/introduction.html)）。Amazon OpenSearch Service 是可搜索索引数据的正确目标，并且 AWS 明确记录了可以将来自 Kinesis Data Streams 的流式数据加载到 OpenSearch Service（[Loading streaming data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/integrations-kinesis.html)）。AWS 还记录了一个结合 Kinesis Data Streams 的 OpenSearch Ingestion 管道，用于以高规模、低延迟的方式将数据连续摄取到 OpenSearch 域和集合中（[OpenSearch Ingestion with Kinesis Data Streams](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/configure-client-kinesis.html)）。QuickSight 可以将 OpenSearch 用作数据源，其 `AmazonOpenSearchParameters` 数据源参数展示了这一点（[QuickSight API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quicksight/latest/APIReference/API_AmazonOpenSearchParameters.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 基于 EC2 的摄取不是最具 AWS 原生特性的托管流式处理解决方案，S3 是对象存储而不是实时可搜索索引，并且 Athena 查询的是 S3 中的数据，而不是提供实时搜索更新。
- **B:** EMR 和 Redshift/Redshift Spectrum 更适合大数据处理和数据仓库分析，而不适合低延迟的流式搜索应用程序。
- **C:** EKS 增加了容器编排的运维开销，DynamoDB 不是用于完整搜索/可视化工作负载的搜索引擎，CloudWatch 控制面板主要用于运营指标/日志可观测性，而不是搜索应用程序数据流。
- **D:** 将托管的实时流摄取与托管搜索/索引服务以及通过 QuickSight 实现的可视化相结合，符合所有要求。

en.question: A company currently runs an on-premises application that usesASP.NET on Linux machines. The application is resource-intensive and serves customers directly. The company wants to modernize the application to .NET. The company wants to run the application on containers and to scale based on Amazon CloudWatch metrics. The company also wants to reduce the time spent on operational maintenance activities. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
options.B: Use AWS App2Container to containerize the application. Use an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 instances.
options.C: Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
options.D: Use AWS App Runner to containerize the application. Use App Runner to deploy the application to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

AWS App2Container is designed for this modernization path: on Linux it supports **.NET applications** and can generate container images and AWS deployment artifacts. The App2Container workflow can generate a **CloudFormation template** and deploy containers to Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, or AWS App Runner; for Linux deployments, its deployment feature table lists **Amazon ECS (AWS Fargate only)** as a supported target and allows modifying CPU and memory settings for resource-intensive applications ([App2Container compatibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/app2container/latest/UserGuide/compatibility-a2c.html), [What is AWS App2Container?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/app2container/latest/UserGuide/what-is-a2c.html)). Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate provides the least operational overhead among the ECS options because Fargate runs containers **without having to manage servers or clusters of EC2 instances** and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters ([ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). ECS Service Auto Scaling can use ECS-published and other **CloudWatch metrics** to scale the number of running tasks ([ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** ECS on **EC2 instances** requires managing the container host instances, which is more operational overhead than Fargate. Also, App2Container's Linux ECS deployment support is listed as **AWS Fargate only**.
- **C:** App Runner is a managed container application service that creates and maintains its own running web service from source code or a container image; it does not deploy the application to **Amazon ECS on Fargate** as stated in the option ([AWS App Runner](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-deployment-options/aws-apprunner.html)).
- **D:** App Runner does not deploy to **Amazon EKS on EC2 instances** as stated, and EKS on EC2 would add cluster and instance operational overhead compared with ECS on Fargate.

zh.question: 一家公司目前运行一个本地应用程序，该应用程序在 Linux 机器上使用ASP.NET。该应用程序资源密集型，并直接为客户提供服务。公司希望将该应用程序现代化为 .NET。公司希望在容器上运行该应用程序，并根据 Amazon CloudWatch 指标进行扩缩。公司还希望减少花在运营维护活动上的时间。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS App2Container 将应用程序容器化。使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板将应用程序部署到 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.B: 使用 AWS App2Container 将应用程序容器化。使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板将应用程序部署到 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.C: 使用 AWS App Runner 将应用程序容器化。使用 App Runner 将应用程序部署到 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)。
options.D: 使用 AWS App Runner 将应用程序容器化。使用 App Runner 将应用程序部署到 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

AWS App2Container 专为这种现代化路径而设计：在 Linux 上，它支持 **.NET applications**，并且可以生成容器镜像和 AWS 部署构件。App2Container 工作流可以生成 **CloudFormation template**，并将容器部署到 Amazon ECS、Amazon EKS 或 AWS App Runner；对于 Linux 部署，其部署功能表列出 **Amazon ECS (AWS Fargate only)** 作为受支持的目标，并允许为资源密集型应用程序修改 CPU 和内存设置（[App2Container compatibility](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/app2container/latest/UserGuide/compatibility-a2c.html)，[What is AWS App2Container?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/app2container/latest/UserGuide/what-is-a2c.html)）。在 ECS 选项中，AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon ECS 提供最少的运营开销，因为 Fargate 运行容器时**无需管理服务器或 EC2 实例集群**，并且无需预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群（[ECS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。ECS Service Auto Scaling 可以使用 ECS 发布的指标和其他 **CloudWatch metrics** 来扩缩正在运行的任务数量（[ECS service auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-auto-scaling.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** **EC2 instances** 上的 ECS 需要管理容器主机实例，这比 Fargate 带来更多运营开销。此外，App2Container 的 Linux ECS 部署支持被列为 **AWS Fargate only**。
- **C:** App Runner 是一种托管容器应用程序服务，可以从源代码或容器镜像创建并维护其自己的运行中 Web 服务；它不会像该选项所述那样将应用程序部署到 **Amazon ECS on Fargate**（[AWS App Runner](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/overview-deployment-options/aws-apprunner.html)）。
- **D:** App Runner 不会像所述那样部署到 **Amazon EKS on EC2 instances**，并且与 Fargate 上的 ECS 相比，EC2 上的 EKS 会增加集群和实例的运营开销。

en.question: A company is designing a new internal web application in the AWS Cloud. The new application must securely retrieve and store multiple employee usernames and passwords from an AWS managed service. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve usernames and passwords from Parameter Store.
options.B: Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager.
options.C: Store the employee credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use AWS CloudFormation and AWS Batch with the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Parameter Store.
options.D: Store the employee credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Use AWS CloudFormation and the BatchGetSecretValue API to retrieve the usernames and passwords from Secrets Manager.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Secrets Manager is the AWS managed service designed to manage, retrieve, and rotate credentials and other secrets; AWS states that applications should replace hard-coded credentials with runtime calls to Secrets Manager to retrieve credentials dynamically when needed ([Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). The `BatchGetSecretValue` API is specifically a **Secrets Manager** API that retrieves the encrypted `SecretString` or `SecretBinary` contents for **up to 20 secrets** in one call ([BatchGetSecretValue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/apireference/API_BatchGetSecretValue.html)). This directly matches the requirement to securely retrieve multiple usernames and passwords with low operational overhead. CloudFormation is also supported in the Secrets Manager workflow; AWS documents CloudFormation-created Secrets Manager resources such as rotation schedules and functions ([Secrets Manager with CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/cloudformation.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A and C:** `BatchGetSecretValue` is not a Systems Manager Parameter Store API; AWS lists Parameter Store retrieval APIs as `GetParameter`, `GetParameters`, and `GetParametersByPath` ([Parameter Store retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)). Therefore these options combine Parameter Store with the wrong API.
- **B:** Secrets Manager and `BatchGetSecretValue` are appropriate, but AWS Batch is unnecessary for an internal web application simply retrieving secrets. Adding AWS Batch introduces extra operational components without addressing the requirement. The API name `BatchGetSecretValue` refers to batching secret retrieval in Secrets Manager, not to the AWS Batch service ([BatchGetSecretValue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/apireference/API_BatchGetSecretValue.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中设计一个新的内部 Web 应用程序。新应用程序必须从 AWS 托管服务安全地检索和存储多个员工用户名和密码。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 将员工凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 BatchGetSecretValue API 从 Parameter Store 检索用户名和密码。
options.B: 将员工凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Batch 以及 BatchGetSecretValue API 从 Secrets Manager 检索用户名和密码。
options.C: 将员工凭证存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Batch 以及 BatchGetSecretValue API 从 Parameter Store 检索用户名和密码。
options.D: 将员工凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。使用 AWS CloudFormation 和 BatchGetSecretValue API 从 Secrets Manager 检索用户名和密码。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** AWS Secrets Manager 是 AWS 托管服务，专为管理、检索和轮换凭证及其他密钥而设计；AWS 指出，应用程序应将硬编码凭证替换为对 Secrets Manager 的运行时调用，以便在需要时动态检索凭证（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。`BatchGetSecretValue` API 明确是一个 **Secrets Manager** API，可在一次调用中检索**多达 20 个密钥**的加密 `SecretString` 或 `SecretBinary` 内容（[BatchGetSecretValue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/apireference/API_BatchGetSecretValue.html)）。这直接符合以低运营开销安全检索多个用户名和密码的要求。Secrets Manager 工作流也支持 CloudFormation；AWS 记录了由 CloudFormation 创建的 Secrets Manager 资源，例如轮换计划和函数（[Secrets Manager with CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/cloudformation.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A and C:** `BatchGetSecretValue` 不是 Systems Manager Parameter Store API；AWS 将 Parameter Store 检索 API 列为 `GetParameter`、`GetParameters` 和 `GetParametersByPath`（[Parameter Store retrieval](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)）。因此，这些选项将 Parameter Store 与错误的 API 组合在一起。
- **B:** Secrets Manager 和 `BatchGetSecretValue` 是合适的，但对于仅检索密钥的内部 Web 应用程序而言，AWS Batch 并不必要。添加 AWS Batch 会引入额外的运营组件，却不能满足额外需求。API 名称 `BatchGetSecretValue` 指的是在 Secrets Manager 中批量检索密钥，而不是指 AWS Batch 服务（[BatchGetSecretValue](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/apireference/API_BatchGetSecretValue.html)）。

en.question: A company that is in the ap-northeast-1 Region has a fleet of thousands of AWS Outposts servers. The company has deployed the servers at remote locations around the world. All the servers regularly download new software versions that consist of 100 files. There is significant latency before all servers run the new software versions. The company must reduce the deployment latency for new software versions. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in ap- northeast-1 that includes a CachingDisabled cache policy. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Create a second S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. Configure replication between the buckets. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses ap- northeast-1 as the primary origin and us-east-1 as the secondary origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Configure Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration. Download the software by using the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in ap-northeast-1. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket as the origin. Download the software by using signed URLs.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Amazon CloudFront is designed to speed distribution of static content through a worldwide edge network. AWS states that CloudFront routes requests to the edge location with the lowest latency, serves cached content immediately when present, and otherwise retrieves it from an origin such as an Amazon S3 bucket; copies of objects are cached in multiple edge locations around the world ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). For thousands of remote Outposts servers repeatedly downloading the same 100 software files, a CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin minimizes download latency because the files can be cached near the servers. CloudFront signed URLs also support controlled access: a signed URL allows the user/client to download the content, and CloudFront checks the edge cache or forwards to the origin as needed ([Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A `CachingDisabled` cache policy defeats the main latency benefit. CloudFront improves this use case largely by serving objects from edge caches; disabling caching would cause repeated origin retrieval instead of using cached software files.
- **B:** A secondary S3 bucket with replication and CloudFront origin failover adds unnecessary operational overhead. CloudFront origin groups are for high availability: CloudFront uses the secondary origin only when the primary origin fails or returns configured failure status codes, and cache misses normally go to the primary origin ([origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)). This does not improve normal global distribution latency compared with a single S3 origin behind CloudFront.
- **C:** S3 Transfer Acceleration can improve long-distance transfers to/from a centralized S3 bucket, with AWS examples including customers uploading globally, transferring gigabytes to terabytes across continents, or not using full bandwidth when uploading to S3 ([S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)). However, it does not provide CloudFront-style object caching at edge locations for thousands of clients downloading the same 100 files. CloudFront is the better fit for repeated global software distribution with the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家位于 ap-northeast-1 Region 的公司拥有由数千台 AWS Outposts 服务器组成的机群。该公司已将这些服务器部署在世界各地的远程位置。所有服务器都会定期下载由 100 个文件组成的新软件版本。在所有服务器都运行新软件版本之前存在显著延迟。公司必须降低新软件版本的部署延迟。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足此要求？

options.A: 在 ap-northeast-1 中创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。在 ap- northeast-1 中设置一个包含 CachingDisabled 缓存策略的 Amazon CloudFront distribution。将该 S3 bucket 配置为源站。使用 signed URLs 下载软件。
options.B: 在 ap-northeast-1 中创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。在 us-east-1 Region 中创建第二个 S3 bucket。配置这些 bucket 之间的复制。设置一个 Amazon CloudFront distribution，使用 ap- northeast-1 作为主源站，使用 us-east-1 作为辅助源站。使用 signed URLs 下载软件。
options.C: 在 ap-northeast-1 中创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。配置 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration。使用 S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint 下载软件。
options.D: 在 ap-northeast-1 中创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。设置一个 Amazon CloudFront distribution。将该 S3 bucket 配置为源站。使用 signed URLs 下载软件。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

Amazon CloudFront 旨在通过全球边缘网络加速静态内容的分发。AWS 表示，CloudFront 会将请求路由到延迟最低的边缘站点，在存在缓存内容时立即提供服务，否则会从 Amazon S3 bucket 等源站检索内容；对象副本会缓存在全球多个边缘站点中（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。对于数千台远程 Outposts 服务器反复下载相同的 100 个软件文件的情况，以 S3 bucket 作为源站的 CloudFront distribution 可以最大限度降低下载延迟，因为文件可以缓存在服务器附近。CloudFront signed URLs 还支持受控访问：signed URL 允许用户/客户端下载内容，CloudFront 会根据需要检查边缘缓存或转发到源站（[Use signed URLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-signed-urls.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** `CachingDisabled` 缓存策略破坏了主要的延迟优势。CloudFront 在此用例中的改进很大程度上来自从边缘缓存提供对象；禁用缓存会导致重复从源站检索，而不是使用已缓存的软件文件。
- **B:** 带复制的辅助 S3 bucket 和 CloudFront 源站故障转移会增加不必要的运营开销。CloudFront 源站组用于高可用性：只有当主源站失败或返回已配置的失败状态代码时，CloudFront 才会使用辅助源站，而缓存未命中通常会转到主源站（[origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)）。与 CloudFront 后面的单个 S3 源站相比，这不会改善正常的全球分发延迟。
- **C:** S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以改善与集中式 S3 bucket 之间的长距离传输，AWS 示例包括客户进行全球上传、跨洲传输 GB 到 TB 级数据，或上传到 S3 时未使用全部带宽（[S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。但是，对于数千个客户端下载相同 100 个文件的场景，它不提供 CloudFront 式的边缘站点对象缓存。对于以最少运营开销进行重复的全球软件分发，CloudFront 更适合。

en.question: A company currently runs an on-premises stock trading application by using Microsoft Windows Server. The company wants to migrate the application to the AWS Cloud. The company needs to design a highly available solution that provides low-latency access to block storage across multiple Availability Zones. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Configure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster nodes. Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as shared storage between the two cluster nodes.
options.B: Configure a Windows Server cluster that spans two Availability Zones on Amazon EC2 instances. Install the application on both cluster nodes. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set up application-level replication to sync data from one EBS volume in one Availability Zone to another EBS volume in the second Availability Zone.
options.C: Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Configure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2 instance in standby mode. Use an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file system to access the data by using Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) protocol.
options.D: Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances in two Availability Zones. Configure one EC2 instance as active and the second EC2 instance in standby mode. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volumes as storage attached to the EC2 instances. Set up Amazon EBS level replication to sync data from one io2 volume in one Availability Zone to another io2 volume in the second Availability Zone.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

The requirement is highly available, low-latency **block** storage across multiple AZs with the least implementation effort. Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP supports block access: AWS states that FSx for ONTAP data can be accessed using the **iSCSI block protocol**, and its Windows iSCSI documentation says FSx for ONTAP supports the iSCSI protocol for Windows clients ([FSx for ONTAP overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/how-it-works-fsx-ontap.html), [mount iSCSI on Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/mount-iscsi-windows.html)). FSx for ONTAP Multi-AZ file systems provide managed HA: the standby file server is in a different AZ, writes are synchronously replicated across AZs, and the file system is designed for continuous availability when an AZ is unavailable ([FSx for ONTAP high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html)). This gives the Windows EC2 active/standby application shared block access without building custom cross-AZ replication logic.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server provides Windows **file shares** accessed over **SMB**, not iSCSI block storage. It may be appropriate for SMB file workloads, but the question asks for block storage ([FSx for Windows file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)).
- **B**: EBS is block storage, but an EBS volume is replicated only **within its Availability Zone** and can be attached to EC2 instances in the **same Availability Zone**. Cross-AZ synchronization would require application-level replication, which is more implementation effort ([Amazon EBS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/EBSFeatures.html)).
- **D**: io2 EBS volumes are high-performance block storage, but EBS volumes are still AZ-scoped. AWS documentation describes EBS replication within an AZ and attachment to instances in the same AZ; the proposed "EBS level replication" across AZs is not a simple managed EBS feature for this use case, so it does not meet the least-effort requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司目前使用 Microsoft Windows Server 运行本地股票交易应用程序。该公司希望将该应用程序迁移到 AWS Cloud。公司需要设计一个高可用的解决方案，能够跨多个 Availability Zones 提供对块存储的低延迟访问。哪种解决方案能够以最少的实施工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个跨两个 Availability Zones、运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Windows Server 集群。在两个集群节点上安装该应用程序。使用 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 作为两个集群节点之间的共享存储。
options.B: 配置一个跨两个 Availability Zones、运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Windows Server 集群。在两个集群节点上安装该应用程序。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) 卷作为附加到 EC2 实例的存储。设置应用程序级复制，将数据从一个 Availability Zone 中的一个 EBS 卷同步到第二个 Availability Zone 中的另一个 EBS 卷。
options.C: 将应用程序部署在两个 Availability Zones 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。将一个 EC2 实例配置为活动状态，将第二个 EC2 实例配置为备用模式。使用 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ 文件系统，通过 Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) 协议访问数据。
options.D: 将应用程序部署在两个 Availability Zones 中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。将一个 EC2 实例配置为活动状态，将第二个 EC2 实例配置为备用模式。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) 卷作为附加到 EC2 实例的存储。设置 Amazon EBS 级复制，将数据从一个 Availability Zone 中的一个 io2 卷同步到第二个 Availability Zone 中的另一个 io2 卷。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

要求是以最少实施工作量，在多个 AZ 中提供高可用、低延迟的 **block** 存储。Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 支持块访问：AWS 表示 FSx for ONTAP 数据可以使用 **iSCSI block protocol** 访问，并且其 Windows iSCSI 文档说明 FSx for ONTAP 支持 Windows 客户端使用 iSCSI 协议（[FSx for ONTAP overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/how-it-works-fsx-ontap.html)，[mount iSCSI on Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/mount-iscsi-windows.html)）。FSx for ONTAP Multi-AZ 文件系统提供托管 HA：备用文件服务器位于不同 AZ，写入会跨 AZ 同步复制，并且文件系统设计为在 AZ 不可用时仍可持续可用（[FSx for ONTAP high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html)）。这使 Windows EC2 active/standby 应用程序能够获得共享块访问，而无需构建自定义跨 AZ 复制逻辑。其他选项错误的原因：

- **A**：Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 提供通过 **SMB** 访问的 Windows **file shares**，而不是 iSCSI 块存储。它可能适合 SMB 文件工作负载，但题目要求的是块存储（[FSx for Windows file shares](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/using-file-shares.html)）。
- **B**：EBS 是块存储，但 EBS 卷仅在其 **Availability Zone** 内复制，并且可以附加到 **same Availability Zone** 中的 EC2 实例。跨 AZ 同步需要应用程序级复制，这会增加实施工作量（[Amazon EBS features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/EBSFeatures.html)）。
- **D**：io2 EBS 卷是高性能块存储，但 EBS 卷仍然限定在 AZ 范围内。AWS 文档描述的是 EBS 在 AZ 内复制以及附加到同一 AZ 中的实例；所提出的跨 AZ “EBS level replication” 并不是适用于此用例的简单托管 EBS 功能，因此不满足最少工作量要求。

en.question: A company is designing a web application with an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company needs the ALB to receive HTTPS web traffic from the public internet. The ALB must send only HTTPS traffic to the web application servers hosted on the Amazon EC2 instances on port 443. The ALB must perform a health check of the web application servers over HTTPS on port 8443. Which combination of configurations of the security group that is associated with the ALB will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443.
options.B: Allow all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 for port 443.
options.C: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for port 443.
options.D: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for port 443.
options.E: Allow HTTPS outbound traffic to the web application instances for the health check on port 8443.
options.F: Allow HTTPS inbound traffic from the web application instances for the health check on port 8443.

en.explanation:
The correct combination is **A, C, and E**.

For an internet-facing Application Load Balancer with instances as targets, AWS recommends an **inbound** rule from `0.0.0.0/0` on the load balancer **listener** port, and **outbound** rules to the instance security group on both the **instance listener** port and the **health check** port. AWS also states that the ALB security group controls traffic allowed to reach and leave the load balancer and that the load balancer must be able to communicate with registered targets on both the listener port and the health check port ([Security groups for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-update-security-groups.html)).

- **A is correct**: The ALB must receive public HTTPS traffic, so it needs inbound HTTPS on port 443 from `0.0.0.0/0`, matching the AWS recommended inbound listener rule for an internet-facing load balancer.
- **C is correct**: The ALB must forward only HTTPS traffic to the EC2 web application servers on port 443, so it needs outbound HTTPS to the web application instances on port 443.
- **E is correct**: The ALB must perform HTTPS health checks on port 8443, so it needs outbound HTTPS to the web application instances on the health check port 8443.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect**: Allowing all outbound traffic to `0.0.0.0/0` on port 443 is broader than required. AWS recommends the outbound destination be the **instance security group**, not the entire internet, for the instance listener port.
- **D is incorrect**: This is an inbound rule on the ALB from the application instances. The required traffic direction for forwarding requests is outbound from the ALB to the instances, not inbound from the instances to the ALB. Security group rules distinguish inbound sources from outbound destinations ([Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules.html)).
- **F is incorrect**: Health checks originate from the ALB to the targets, so the ALB security group needs an outbound rule to the instances on port 8443, not an inbound rule from the instances.

zh.question: 一家公司正在设计一个使用面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的 Web 应用程序。公司需要 ALB 从公共互联网接收 HTTPS Web 流量。ALB 必须仅将 HTTPS 流量发送到托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Web 应用程序服务器的端口 443。ALB 必须通过 HTTPS 在端口 8443 上对 Web 应用程序服务器执行运行状况检查。与 ALB 关联的安全组应采用哪种配置组合才能满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 的 HTTPS 入站流量。
options.B: 允许到 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 的所有出站流量。
options.C: 允许到 Web 应用程序实例的端口 443 的 HTTPS 出站流量。
options.D: 允许来自 Web 应用程序实例的端口 443 的 HTTPS 入站流量。
options.E: 允许到 Web 应用程序实例的端口 8443 上运行状况检查的 HTTPS 出站流量。
options.F: 允许来自 Web 应用程序实例的端口 8443 上运行状况检查的 HTTPS 入站流量。

zh.explanation:
正确的组合是 **A、C 和 E**。对于以实例作为目标的面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer，AWS 建议在负载均衡器**侦听器**端口上配置来自 `0.0.0.0/0` 的**入站**规则，并在**实例侦听器**端口和**运行状况检查**端口上配置到实例安全组的**出站**规则。AWS 还说明，ALB 安全组控制允许到达和离开负载均衡器的流量，并且负载均衡器必须能够在侦听器端口和运行状况检查端口上与已注册目标通信（[Security groups for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-update-security-groups.html)）。

- **A 正确**：ALB 必须接收公共 HTTPS 流量，因此它需要在端口 443 上允许来自 `0.0.0.0/0` 的入站 HTTPS，这与 AWS 对面向互联网负载均衡器建议的入站侦听器规则一致。
- **C 正确**：ALB 必须仅将 HTTPS 流量转发到端口 443 上的 EC2 Web 应用程序服务器，因此它需要在端口 443 上向 Web 应用程序实例发送出站 HTTPS。
- **E 正确**：ALB 必须在端口 8443 上执行 HTTPS 运行状况检查，因此它需要在运行状况检查端口 8443 上向 Web 应用程序实例发送出站 HTTPS。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确**：允许到 `0.0.0.0/0` 的端口 443 的所有出站流量比所需范围更宽。AWS 建议对于实例侦听器端口，出站目标应为**实例安全组**，而不是整个互联网。
- **D 不正确**：这是 ALB 上来自应用程序实例的入站规则。转发请求所需的流量方向是从 ALB 出站到实例，而不是从实例入站到 ALB。安全组规则区分入站源和出站目标（[Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/security-group-rules.html)）。
- **F 不正确**：运行状况检查源自 ALB 并发送到目标，因此 ALB 安全组需要一条到端口 8443 上实例的出站规则，而不是来自实例的入站规则。

en.question: A company hosts an application on AWS. The application gives users the ability to upload photos and store the photos in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to use Amazon CloudFront and a custom domain name to upload the photo files to the S3 bucket in the eu-west-1 Region. Which solution will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in the us-east-1 Region. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
options.B: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a public certificate in eu-west-1. Use the certificate in CloudFront.
options.C: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration.
options.D: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront origin access control (OAC).
options.E: Configure Amazon S3 to allow uploads from CloudFront. Configure an Amazon S3 website endpoint.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and D.**

- **A is correct** because using a custom domain name with CloudFront over HTTPS requires a valid TLS certificate for the alternate domain name. AWS documentation states that to use an ACM certificate with a CloudFront distribution, you must request or import it in **US East (N. Virginia), `us-east-1`**; the S3 bucket's Region does not change this requirement ([CloudFront SSL/TLS certificate requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https-requirements.html)).
- **D is correct** because the S3 bucket should be configured as a regular S3 origin protected by **CloudFront origin access control (OAC)**. AWS documents that OAC uses a bucket policy to allow the CloudFront service principal to access the bucket, and provides a read/write example with `s3:PutObject`, which supports uploads through CloudFront to the S3 origin ([Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)).

**Incorrect options:**

- **B is wrong** because an ACM certificate for viewer HTTPS on CloudFront must be in `us-east-1`, not `eu-west-1` ([CloudFront SSL/TLS certificate requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https-requirements.html)).
- **C is wrong** because S3 Transfer Acceleration is a separate S3 feature that requires using the `bucket-name.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com` endpoint; it is not the CloudFront custom-domain-to-S3-origin access control solution requested here ([S3 Transfer Acceleration requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)).
- **E is wrong** because OAC requires a **regular S3 bucket origin**, not an S3 bucket configured as a website endpoint ([Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上托管一个应用程序。该应用程序允许用户上传照片，并将照片存储在 eu-west-1 区域的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。公司希望使用 Amazon CloudFront 和自定义域名将照片文件上传到 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 在 us-east-1 区域创建公有证书。在 CloudFront 中使用该证书。
options.B: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 在 eu-west-1 创建公有证书。在 CloudFront 中使用该证书。
options.C: 配置 Amazon S3 以允许来自 CloudFront 的上传。配置 S3 Transfer Acceleration。
options.D: 配置 Amazon S3 以允许来自 CloudFront origin access control (OAC) 的上传。
options.E: 配置 Amazon S3 以允许来自 CloudFront 的上传。配置 Amazon S3 website endpoint。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 D。**

- **A 正确**，因为在 CloudFront 上通过 HTTPS 使用自定义域名需要一个用于备用域名的有效 TLS 证书。AWS 文档说明，要将 ACM 证书与 CloudFront 分配一起使用，必须在 **US East (N. Virginia), `us-east-1`** 请求或导入该证书；S3 存储桶所在区域不会改变这一要求（[CloudFront SSL/TLS certificate requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https-requirements.html)）。
- **D 正确**，因为 S3 存储桶应配置为受 **CloudFront origin access control (OAC)** 保护的常规 S3 源。AWS 文档说明，OAC 使用存储桶策略来允许 CloudFront 服务主体访问该存储桶，并提供了包含 `s3:PutObject` 的读/写示例，该示例支持通过 CloudFront 上传到 S3 源（[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。

**错误选项：**

- **B 错误**，因为用于 CloudFront 查看器 HTTPS 的 ACM 证书必须位于 `us-east-1`，而不是 `eu-west-1`（[CloudFront SSL/TLS certificate requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/cnames-and-https-requirements.html)）。
- **C 错误**，因为 S3 Transfer Acceleration 是一个独立的 S3 功能，需要使用 `bucket-name.s3-accelerate.amazonaws.com` 端点；它不是此处请求的 CloudFront 自定义域名到 S3 源的访问控制解决方案（[S3 Transfer Acceleration requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)）。
- **E 错误**，因为 OAC 需要一个**常规 S3 存储桶源**，而不是配置为 website endpoint 的 S3 存储桶（[Restrict access to an Amazon S3 origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/private-content-restricting-access-to-s3.html)）。

en.question: A weather forecasting company collects temperature readings from various sensors on a continuous basis. An existing data ingestion process collects the readings and aggregates the readings into larger Apache Parquet files. Then the process encrypts the files by using client-side encryption with KMS managed keys (CSE-KMS). Finally, the process writes the files to an Amazon S3 bucket with separate prefixes for each calendar day. The company wants to run occasional SQL queries on the data to take sample moving averages for a specific calendar day. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure Amazon Athena to read the encrypted files. Run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon S3 Select to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.C: Configure Amazon Redshift to read the encrypted files. Use Redshift Spectrum and Redshift query editor v2 to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.
options.D: Configure Amazon EMR Serverless to read the encrypted files. Use Apache SparkSQL to run SQL queries on the data directly in Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A. Configure Amazon Athena to read the encrypted files and run SQL queries directly in Amazon S3.**

Athena is the most cost-effective fit for occasional SQL analytics on data already stored in S3. AWS states that Athena can analyze structured data in S3, including columnar formats such as **Apache Parquet**, and lets you run ad hoc ANSI SQL queries without loading the data or managing infrastructure. It is specifically recommended for interactive ad hoc SQL queries against S3 data without servers or clusters ([Athena: When should I use Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html)). Athena also supports **CSE-KMS** for datasets in S3 when the table is created with the required table properties such as `has_encrypted_data='true'` or `encryption_option='CSE_KMS'` and the KMS key information ([Athena encryption options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/encryption.html)).

Why the other options are not best:

* **B. Amazon S3 Select** – S3 Select can query Parquet, but it supports only a subset of SQL and can query **only one object per request**. The data is organized as multiple larger Parquet files under daily prefixes, and moving-average queries for a day are better handled by Athena across the day’s dataset. S3 Select also works with server-side encrypted objects, whereas the question specifies client-side encryption with KMS ([S3 Select requirements and limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/selecting-content-from-objects.html)).
* **C. Amazon Redshift Spectrum** – Redshift is a data warehouse option best suited for sophisticated reporting, complex joins, and large structured datasets. For occasional direct S3 queries, this is more complex and less cost-effective than serverless Athena ([Athena vs. Redshift guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html)).
* **D. Amazon EMR Serverless with SparkSQL** – EMR is appropriate when you need custom code or large-scale processing frameworks such as Spark, Hadoop, or Presto. For occasional SQL queries on Parquet files in S3, Athena is the simpler and more cost-effective serverless query service ([Athena vs. EMR guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html)).

zh.question: 一家天气预报公司持续从各种传感器收集温度读数。现有的数据摄取流程会收集这些读数，并将读数聚合到更大的 Apache Parquet 文件中。然后，该流程使用带有 KMS managed keys 的客户端加密（CSE-KMS）对文件进行加密。最后，该流程将文件写入 Amazon S3 bucket，并为每个日历日使用单独的前缀。该公司希望对数据运行偶尔的 SQL 查询，以获取特定日历日的样本移动平均值。哪种解决方案能够以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 Amazon Athena 读取加密文件。直接在 Amazon S3 中对数据运行 SQL 查询。
options.B: 使用 Amazon S3 Select 直接在 Amazon S3 中对数据运行 SQL 查询。
options.C: 配置 Amazon Redshift 读取加密文件。使用 Redshift Spectrum 和 Redshift query editor v2 直接在 Amazon S3 中对数据运行 SQL 查询。
options.D: 配置 Amazon EMR Serverless 读取加密文件。使用 Apache SparkSQL 直接在 Amazon S3 中对数据运行 SQL 查询。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A. 配置 Amazon Athena 读取加密文件，并直接在 Amazon S3 中运行 SQL 查询。**

对于已存储在 S3 中的数据进行偶尔的 SQL 分析，Athena 是最具成本效益的选择。AWS 表示，Athena 可以分析 S3 中的结构化数据，包括 **Apache Parquet** 等列式格式，并允许你在无需加载数据或管理基础设施的情况下运行临时 ANSI SQL 查询。它被特别推荐用于针对 S3 数据的交互式临时 SQL 查询，无需服务器或集群（[Athena: When should I use Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html)）。Athena 还支持 S3 中数据集的 **CSE-KMS**，前提是在创建表时使用所需的表属性，例如 `has_encrypted_data='true'` 或 `encryption_option='CSE_KMS'` 以及 KMS 密钥信息（[Athena encryption options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/encryption.html)）。其他选项不是最佳选择的原因：

* **B. Amazon S3 Select** – S3 Select 可以查询 Parquet，但它仅支持 SQL 的一个子集，并且每个请求**只能查询一个对象**。数据被组织为每日前缀下的多个较大的 Parquet 文件，而针对某一天的移动平均值查询更适合由 Athena 跨该日的数据集来处理。S3 Select 还适用于服务器端加密对象，而题目指定的是使用 KMS 的客户端加密（[S3 Select requirements and limits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/selecting-content-from-objects.html)）。
* **C. Amazon Redshift Spectrum** – Redshift 是一种数据仓库选项，最适合复杂报表、复杂连接以及大型结构化数据集。对于偶尔直接查询 S3 的场景，这比 serverless Athena 更复杂且成本效益更低（[Athena vs. Redshift guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html)）。
* **D. Amazon EMR Serverless with SparkSQL** – 当你需要自定义代码或 Spark、Hadoop、Presto 等大规模处理框架时，EMR 是合适的。对于 S3 中 Parquet 文件上的偶尔 SQL 查询，Athena 是更简单且更具成本效益的 serverless 查询服务（[Athena vs. EMR guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/when-should-i-use-ate.html)）。

en.question: A company is implementing a new application on AWS. The company will run the application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones within multiple AWS Regions. The application will be available through the internet. Users will access the application from around the world. The company wants to ensure that each user who accesses the application is sent to the EC2 instances that are closest to the user’s location. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.B: Implement an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.C: Implement an Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy. Use an internet-facing Application Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.
options.D: Implement an Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy. Use an internet-facing Network Load Balancer to distribute the traffic across all Availability Zones within the same Region.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The key requirement is to send global users to EC2 instances that are **closest to the user’s location** across multiple Regions. Route 53 **geoproximity routing** is designed for this: AWS states that it routes traffic based on the geographic location of both users and resources and “routes traffic to the closest resource that is available” ([Geoproximity routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geoproximity.html)). Within the selected Region, an internet-facing load balancer can receive internet traffic; AWS documentation says internet-facing load balancers have public IP addresses and can route requests from clients over the internet, and load balancer nodes route requests to healthy registered targets ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)). A Network Load Balancer can also have one network interface per enabled Availability Zone and route connections to targets in the Region/AZs ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Geolocation routing routes based on the user’s geographic location, but it is intended for choosing resources for specified locations such as continent/country/state, localization, content restrictions, or predictable endpoint mapping; it does not specifically route to the *closest available resource* the way geoproximity does ([Geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html)).
- **C:** Multivalue answer routing returns up to eight healthy records selected at random, not based on user/resource proximity ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)).
- **D:** Weighted routing sends traffic to resources in proportions that you specify, not based on which Region/resource is closest to the user ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上实施一个新应用程序。该公司将在多个 AWS Regions 内的多个 Availability Zones 中的多台 Amazon EC2 实例上运行该应用程序。该应用程序将通过互联网提供服务。用户将从世界各地访问该应用程序。公司希望确保访问该应用程序的每个用户都被发送到距离用户位置最近的 EC2 实例。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 实施 Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy。使用面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer 在同一 Region 内的所有 Availability Zones 之间分发流量。
options.B: 实施 Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy。使用面向互联网的 Network Load Balancer 在同一 Region 内的所有 Availability Zones 之间分发流量。
options.C: 实施 Amazon Route 53 multivalue answer routing policy。使用面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer 在同一 Region 内的所有 Availability Zones 之间分发流量。
options.D: 实施 Amazon Route 53 weighted routing policy。使用面向互联网的 Network Load Balancer 在同一 Region 内的所有 Availability Zones 之间分发流量。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 关键要求是将全球用户发送到跨多个 Regions、**最接近用户位置**的 EC2 实例。Route 53 **geoproximity routing** 正是为此而设计的：AWS 表示，它会根据用户和资源双方的地理位置来路由流量，并且“将流量路由到可用的最近资源” ([Geoproximity routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geoproximity.html))。在选定的 Region 内，面向互联网的负载均衡器可以接收互联网流量；AWS 文档说明，面向互联网的负载均衡器具有公有 IP 地址，可以通过互联网路由来自客户端的请求，并且负载均衡器节点会将请求路由到健康的已注册目标 ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html))。Network Load Balancer 还可以在每个已启用的 Availability Zone 中拥有一个网络接口，并将连接路由到该 Region/AZs 中的目标 ([How Elastic Load Balancing works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/userguide/how-elastic-load-balancing-works.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Geolocation routing 根据用户的地理位置进行路由，但它旨在为指定位置（例如洲/国家/州）选择资源，用于本地化、内容限制或可预测的端点映射；它并不像 geoproximity 那样专门路由到*最近的可用资源* ([Geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html))。
- **C:** Multivalue answer routing 会返回最多八条随机选择的健康记录，而不是基于用户/资源的接近程度 ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html))。
- **D:** Weighted routing 按你指定的比例将流量发送到资源，而不是根据哪个 Region/资源最接近用户来路由 ([Choosing a routing policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy.html))。

en.question: A financial services company plans to launch a new application on AWS to handle sensitive financial transactions. The company will deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company will use Amazon RDS for MySQL as the database. The company’s security policies mandate that data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit.
options.B: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure IPsec tunnels for encryption in transit.
options.C: Implement third-party application-level data encryption before storing data in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Configure AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS certificates for encryption in transit.
options.D: Configure encryption at rest for Amazon RDS for MySQL by using AWS KMS managed keys. Configure a VPN connection to enable private connectivity to encrypt data in transit.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

Amazon RDS supports native encryption at rest with AWS KMS: RDS encrypted DB instances protect underlying storage, and RDS uses an AWS KMS key; you can use the AWS managed key for Amazon RDS or a customer managed key ([RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)). For encryption in transit, RDS supports SSL/TLS from the application to the DB instance ([RDS encrypted connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.html)), and for RDS for MySQL specifically, Amazon RDS creates and installs an SSL/TLS certificate on the DB instance when it provisions the instance ([RDS for MySQL SSL/TLS support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/MySQL.Concepts.SSLSupport.html)). ACM also reduces certificate-management overhead by handling creation, storage, and renewal of SSL/TLS certificates for AWS applications ([ACM overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html)). Therefore, using managed KMS-based RDS encryption plus SSL/TLS is the lowest-operational-overhead managed approach.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** KMS-based RDS encryption at rest is appropriate, but configuring **IPsec tunnels** for in-transit encryption is unnecessary operational overhead when RDS supports SSL/TLS connections directly.
- **C:** Third-party application-level encryption adds key-management, application, and operational complexity. RDS already provides managed encryption at rest using KMS.
- **D:** A VPN can provide private connectivity, but it is not the least-overhead way to meet database in-transit encryption requirements. RDS supports SSL/TLS directly from the application to the DB instance, so a VPN is not required solely for encryption in transit.

zh.question: 一家金融服务公司计划在 AWS 上推出一个新应用程序，用于处理敏感的金融交易。该公司将在 Amazon EC2 实例上部署该应用程序。该公司将使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 作为数据库。公司的安全策略要求数据必须在静态和传输过程中加密。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 通过使用 AWS KMS 托管密钥为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 配置静态加密。配置 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS 证书以实现传输中加密。
options.B: 通过使用 AWS KMS 托管密钥为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 配置静态加密。配置 IPsec 隧道以实现传输中加密。
options.C: 在将数据存储到 Amazon RDS for MySQL 之前，实施第三方应用程序级数据加密。配置 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) SSL/TLS 证书以实现传输中加密。
options.D: 通过使用 AWS KMS 托管密钥为 Amazon RDS for MySQL 配置静态加密。配置 VPN 连接以启用私有连接，从而加密传输中的数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

Amazon RDS 支持使用 AWS KMS 进行原生静态加密：RDS 加密的数据库实例会保护底层存储，并且 RDS 使用 AWS KMS key；你可以使用适用于 Amazon RDS 的 AWS 托管密钥或客户托管密钥（[RDS encryption overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Overview.Encryption.html)）。对于传输中加密，RDS 支持从应用程序到数据库实例的 SSL/TLS（[RDS encrypted connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_CommonTasks.Connect.html)），并且对于 RDS for MySQL，Amazon RDS 在预置实例时会在数据库实例上创建并安装 SSL/TLS 证书（[RDS for MySQL SSL/TLS support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/MySQL.Concepts.SSLSupport.html)）。ACM 还通过处理 AWS 应用程序的 SSL/TLS 证书的创建、存储和续订来减少证书管理开销（[ACM overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/acm/latest/userguide/acm-overview.html)）。因此，使用托管的基于 KMS 的 RDS 加密加上 SSL/TLS，是运营开销最低的托管方法。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 基于 KMS 的 RDS 静态加密是合适的，但当 RDS 直接支持 SSL/TLS 连接时，配置 **IPsec tunnels** 来实现传输中加密会带来不必要的运营开销。
- **C:** 第三方应用程序级加密会增加密钥管理、应用程序和运营复杂性。RDS 已经提供使用 KMS 的托管静态加密。
- **D:** VPN 可以提供私有连接，但它不是满足数据库传输中加密要求的最低开销方式。RDS 支持从应用程序到数据库实例的直接 SSL/TLS，因此仅为了传输中加密并不需要 VPN。

en.question: A company is migrating its on-premises Oracle database to an Amazon RDS for Oracle database. The company needs to retain data for 90 days to meet regulatory requirements. The company must also be able to restore the database to a specific point in time for up to 14 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create Amazon RDS automated backups. Set the retention period to 90 days.
options.B: Create an Amazon RDS manual snapshot every day. Delete manual snapshots that are older than 90 days.
options.C: Use the Amazon Aurora Clone feature for Oracle to create a point-in-time restore. Delete clones that are older than 90 days.
options.D: Create a backup plan that has a retention period of 90 days by using AWS Backup for Amazon RDS.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**. AWS Backup is a fully managed service that centralizes and automates backup policies and schedules, reducing custom scripts and manual processes, and backup plans can be used to define requirements for regulatory compliance ([AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)). For Amazon RDS, AWS Backup can create periodic snapshots, which are treated as RDS manual backups, and it also supports continuous backups for RDS that enable PITR by maintaining transaction logs alongside automated snapshots ([Amazon RDS backups with AWS Backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/rds-backup.html)). Continuous backups allow restoring to a specified date and time within the retention period ([Restoring a continuous backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/point-in-time-recovery-restoring.html)); the continuous-backup retention maximum is 35 days, so a 14-day PITR requirement is supported ([Changing your retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/point-in-time-recovery-retention-period.html)). A backup plan can therefore automate RDS backup management for the 90-day retention requirement while also supporting the required 14-day PITR window.

Why the other options are incorrect:

* **A** is incorrect because native Amazon RDS automated backups for a DB instance can be retained only **0 to 35 days**, so they cannot be set to 90 days ([RDS backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)).
* **B** is incorrect because daily manual snapshots with manual deletion after 90 days would meet retention only with ongoing scheduling and cleanup work. The question asks for the **least operational overhead**, and AWS Backup is designed to automate and centralize these backup tasks ([AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)).
* **C** is incorrect because Aurora cloning is for creating clones from **Amazon Aurora DB clusters**, not for an Amazon RDS for Oracle DB instance, and it is meant for use cases such as development/testing copies rather than automated 90-day backup retention plus PITR ([Aurora cloning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Managing.Clone.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其本地 Oracle 数据库迁移到 Amazon RDS for Oracle 数据库。该公司需要保留数据 90 天以满足监管要求。该公司还必须能够在最长 14 天内将数据库还原到特定时间点。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 Amazon RDS 自动备份。将保留期设置为 90 天。
options.B: 每天创建一个 Amazon RDS 手动快照。删除早于 90 天的手动快照。
options.C: 使用适用于 Oracle 的 Amazon Aurora Clone 功能创建时间点还原。删除早于 90 天的克隆。
options.D: 使用 AWS Backup for Amazon RDS 创建一个保留期为 90 天的备份计划。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。AWS Backup 是一项完全托管的服务，可集中并自动化备份策略和计划，从而减少自定义脚本和手动流程，并且备份计划可用于定义监管合规要求（[AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。对于 Amazon RDS，AWS Backup 可以创建周期性快照，这些快照会被视为 RDS 手动备份；它还支持 RDS 的连续备份，通过在自动快照旁维护事务日志来启用 PITR（[Amazon RDS backups with AWS Backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/rds-backup.html)）。连续备份允许在保留期内还原到指定的日期和时间（[Restoring a continuous backup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/point-in-time-recovery-restoring.html)）；连续备份的最长保留期为 35 天，因此支持 14 天的 PITR 要求（[Changing your retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/point-in-time-recovery-retention-period.html)）。因此，备份计划可以自动化 RDS 备份管理，以满足 90 天保留要求，同时也支持所需的 14 天 PITR 窗口。其他选项错误的原因：

* **A** 错误，因为 DB 实例的原生 Amazon RDS 自动备份只能保留 **0 到 35 天**，因此不能设置为 90 天（[RDS backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)）。
* **B** 错误，因为每日手动快照并在 90 天后手动删除，只有在持续进行调度和清理工作的情况下才能满足保留要求。题目要求的是**最少的运营开销**，而 AWS Backup 旨在自动化并集中管理这些备份任务（[AWS Backup overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/whatisbackup.html)）。
* **C** 错误，因为 Aurora cloning 用于从 **Amazon Aurora DB clusters** 创建克隆，而不是用于 Amazon RDS for Oracle DB instance，并且它适用于开发/测试副本等用例，而不是自动化的 90 天备份保留加 PITR（[Aurora cloning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.Managing.Clone.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing a new application that uses a relational database to store user data and application configurations. The company expects the application to have steady user growth. The company expects the database usage to be variable and read-heavy, with occasional writes. The company wants to cost-optimize the database solution. The company wants to use an AWS managed database solution that will provide the necessary performance. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD storage to ensure consistent performance for read and write operations.
options.B: Deploy the database on Amazon Aurora Serverless to automatically scale the database capacity based on actual usage to accommodate the workload.
options.C: Deploy the database on Amazon DynamoDB. Use on-demand capacity mode to automatically scale throughput to accommodate the workload.
options.D: Deploy the database on Amazon RDS. Use magnetic storage and use read replicas to accommodate the workload.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The workload requires a **relational** managed database, has variable/read-heavy usage, and must be cost-optimized. Aurora Serverless is designed for variable workloads: AWS states that it automatically scales database capacity to meet peak load and scales back down afterward, so you do not need to provision for peak or average capacity. AWS also states that Aurora Serverless is cost-effective during low activity because it avoids overprovisioning and you pay only for the database resources consumed, measured per second ([Aurora Serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)). Its capacity scales up and down in ACUs as load changes, including separate writer/reader scaling behavior for read-heavy workloads ([How Aurora Serverless works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** RDS with Provisioned IOPS SSD can provide consistent low-latency I/O, but AWS says Provisioned IOPS is for I/O-intensive workloads and that you are charged for provisioned resources whether or not you use them. That makes it less cost-effective for variable usage with only occasional writes ([RDS storage types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).
- **C:** DynamoDB on-demand can scale, but the requirement is for a **relational database**. AWS distinguishes RDBMS from NoSQL databases and identifies DynamoDB as a NoSQL database, which uses a different schema design model ([DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)).
- **D:** Magnetic storage is a legacy RDS storage type. AWS recommends using General Purpose SSD or Provisioned IOPS SSD for new storage needs and lists limits such as no storage autoscaling and a maximum of 1,000 IOPS, so this is not the best managed, performant, cost-optimized choice for steady growth ([RDS magnetic storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个新应用程序，该应用程序使用关系数据库来存储用户数据和应用程序配置。公司预计该应用程序的用户将稳定增长。公司预计数据库使用量会有波动，并且以读取为主，偶尔进行写入。公司希望对数据库解决方案进行成本优化。公司希望使用一种 AWS 托管数据库解决方案，以提供所需的性能。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon RDS 上部署数据库。使用 Provisioned IOPS SSD 存储，以确保读写操作具有一致的性能。
options.B: 在 Amazon Aurora Serverless 上部署数据库，以根据实际使用情况自动扩展数据库容量来适应工作负载。
options.C: 在 Amazon DynamoDB 上部署数据库。使用按需容量模式自动扩展吞吐量来适应工作负载。
options.D: 在 Amazon RDS 上部署数据库。使用磁存储并使用只读副本来适应工作负载。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 该工作负载需要一个**关系型**托管数据库，使用量可变且以读取为主，并且必须进行成本优化。Aurora Serverless 专为可变工作负载而设计：AWS 表示，它会自动扩展数据库容量以满足峰值负载，并在之后缩减容量，因此你无需按峰值或平均容量进行预置。AWS 还表示，Aurora Serverless 在低活动期间具有成本效益，因为它避免了过度预置，并且你只需为消耗的数据库资源付费，按秒计量（[Aurora Serverless use cases and advantages](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。随着负载变化，其容量会以 ACUs 为单位上下扩展，包括针对读取密集型工作负载的独立写入器/读取器扩展行为（[How Aurora Serverless works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.how-it-works.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 使用 Provisioned IOPS SSD 的 RDS 可以提供一致的低延迟 I/O，但 AWS 表示 Provisioned IOPS 适用于 I/O 密集型工作负载，并且无论你是否使用这些资源，都要为已预置的资源付费。因此，对于使用量可变且仅偶尔写入的情况，它的成本效益较低（[RDS storage types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。
- **C:** DynamoDB 按需模式可以扩展，但要求是使用**关系数据库**。AWS 将 RDBMS 与 NoSQL 数据库区分开来，并将 DynamoDB 标识为 NoSQL 数据库，它使用不同的架构设计模型（[DynamoDB NoSQL design](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-general-nosql-design.html)）。
- **D:** 磁存储是一种旧版 RDS 存储类型。AWS 建议新的存储需求使用 General Purpose SSD 或 Provisioned IOPS SSD，并列出了诸如不支持存储自动扩展以及最高 1,000 IOPS 等限制，因此对于稳定增长而言，这不是最佳的托管、高性能、成本优化选择（[RDS magnetic storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/CHAP_Storage.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts its application on several Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC. The company creates a dedicated Amazon S3 bucket for each customer to store their relevant information in Amazon S3. The company wants to ensure that the application running on EC2 instances can securely access only the S3 buckets that belong to the company’s AWS account. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create a gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 that is attached to the VPC. Update the IAM instance profile policy to provide access to only the specific buckets that the application needs.
options.B: Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet with a security group that allows access to only Amazon S3. Update the route tables to use the NAT Gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

An S3 gateway VPC endpoint is the appropriate network path because AWS states that with a gateway endpoint, resources in a VPC can access Amazon S3 **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device**, and there is no additional charge for gateway endpoints ([AWS PrivateLink: Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). The `s3:ResourceAccount` condition key directly matches the requirement: AWS says you can use `aws:ResourceAccount` or `s3:ResourceAccount` in IAM or VPC endpoint policies to restrict user, role, or application access to S3 buckets owned by a specific AWS account ID, and to restrict clients in a VPC from accessing buckets you do not own ([Amazon S3 policy keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/amazon-s3-policy-keys.html)). AWS also provides an example that denies access to S3 buckets unless they are owned by the specified AWS account using `StringNotEquals` with `s3:ResourceAccount` ([AWS PrivateLink: Control access using bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html#bucket-policies-s3)). This avoids maintaining an ever-growing list of customer bucket ARNs, so it has the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A gateway endpoint is good, but maintaining an IAM instance profile policy with every specific customer bucket is operationally burdensome as new customer buckets are created. It also restricts by enumerated bucket names rather than by the owning AWS account.
- **B:** A NAT gateway is not the best secure or least-overhead path to S3. AWS documents that an S3 gateway endpoint avoids the need for a NAT device for VPC-to-S3 access ([AWS PrivateLink: Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). Also, NAT gateways are not controlled with security groups in the way described.
- **D:** This uses a NAT gateway unnecessarily and requires bucket policies on all buckets, which creates more operational overhead than one identity policy/endpoint-based approach. The gateway endpoint solution is simpler and avoids the NAT device requirement for S3 access.

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 内的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上托管其应用程序。该公司为每个客户创建一个专用的 Amazon S3 存储桶，用于在 Amazon S3 中存储其相关信息。该公司希望确保在 EC2 实例上运行的应用程序只能安全地访问属于该公司 AWS 账户的 S3 存储桶。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个附加到 VPC 的 Amazon S3 网关端点。更新 IAM 实例配置文件策略，仅提供对应用程序所需的特定存储桶的访问权限。
options.B: 在公有子网中创建一个 NAT gateway，并配置一个仅允许访问 Amazon S3 的安全组。更新路由表以使用 NAT Gateway。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

S3 gateway VPC endpoint 是合适的网络路径，因为 AWS 说明，使用 gateway endpoint 时，VPC 中的资源可以访问 Amazon S3，**无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device**，并且 gateway endpoints 不收取额外费用（[AWS PrivateLink: Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。`s3:ResourceAccount` 条件键直接符合该要求：AWS 表示，你可以在 IAM 或 VPC endpoint policies 中使用 `aws:ResourceAccount` 或 `s3:ResourceAccount`，以将用户、角色或应用程序对 S3 buckets 的访问限制为由特定 AWS account ID 拥有的存储桶，并限制 VPC 中的客户端访问你不拥有的 buckets（[Amazon S3 policy keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/amazon-s3-policy-keys.html)）。AWS 还提供了一个示例，使用带有 `s3:ResourceAccount` 的 `StringNotEquals` 拒绝访问 S3 buckets，除非这些存储桶由指定的 AWS account 拥有（[AWS PrivateLink: Control access using bucket policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html#bucket-policies-s3)）。这避免了维护不断增长的客户 bucket ARNs 列表，因此运营开销最少。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** gateway endpoint 是好的，但随着新客户 buckets 的创建，在 IAM instance profile policy 中维护每个特定客户 bucket 会带来运营负担。它还通过枚举的 bucket 名称进行限制，而不是按拥有方 AWS account 进行限制。
- **B:** NAT gateway 不是通往 S3 的最佳安全或最低开销路径。AWS 文档说明，S3 gateway endpoint 可以避免 VPC 到 S3 访问对 NAT device 的需求（[AWS PrivateLink: Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。此外，NAT gateways 不能以所描述的方式通过安全组进行控制。
- **D:** 这不必要地使用了 NAT gateway，并且需要在所有 buckets 上配置 bucket policies，这比一个基于 identity policy/endpoint 的方法产生更多运营开销。gateway endpoint 解决方案更简单，并避免了 S3 访问对 NAT device 的需求。

en.question: A company is building a cloud-based application on AWS that will handle sensitive customer data. The application uses Amazon RDS for the database, Amazon S3 for object storage, and S3 Event Notifications that invoke AWS Lambda for serverless processing. The company uses AWS IAM Identity Center to manage user credentials. The development, testing, and operations teams need secure access to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3 while ensuring the confidentiality of sensitive customer data. The solution must comply with the principle of least privilege. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use IAM roles with least privilege to grant all the teams access. Assign IAM roles to each team with customized IAM policies defining specific permission for Amazon RDS and S3 object access based on team responsibilities.
options.B: Enable IAM Identity Center with an Identity Center directory. Create and configure permission sets with granular access to Amazon RDS and Amazon S3. Assign all the teams to groups that have specific access with the permission sets.
options.C: Create individual IAM users for each member in all the teams with role-based permissions. Assign the IAM roles with predefined policies for RDS and S3 access to each user based on user needs. Implement IAM Access Analyzer for periodic credential evaluation.
options.D: Use AWS Organizations to create separate accounts for each team. Implement cross-account IAM roles with least privilege. Grant specific permission for RDS and S3 access based on team roles and responsibilities.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

The company already uses IAM Identity Center for workforce credentials, and the requirement is secure, least-privilege access with the least operational overhead. AWS recommends that human users use federation with temporary credentials and recommends IAM Identity Center for centralized access management to AWS accounts and permissions ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). IAM Identity Center provides “one place” to assign permissions to groups of users and lets you create custom permissions that meet security needs ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)). Permission sets are specifically used to determine access levels, and AWS recommends assigning access directly to groups rather than individual users to simplify administration ([Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)). IAM Identity Center permission sets can be made restrictive to follow least privilege ([Manage AWS accounts with permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** IAM roles and custom policies can implement least privilege, but managing team access directly with IAM roles is more operational work than using IAM Identity Center groups and permission sets for workforce access. AWS explicitly recommends IAM Identity Center for centralized access management for human users ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **C:** Creating individual IAM users for team members increases credential-management overhead and does not follow the AWS best practice for human users, which is to use federation with temporary credentials through an identity provider such as IAM Identity Center ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **D:** Separate AWS accounts and cross-account roles can be useful for isolation, but they introduce additional account and role-management overhead. The question asks for the least operational overhead, and IAM Identity Center already supports group-based permission assignment from a single place ([What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上构建一个基于云的应用程序，该应用程序将处理敏感客户数据。该应用程序使用 Amazon RDS 作为数据库，使用 Amazon S3 作为对象存储，并使用 S3 Event Notifications 调用 AWS Lambda 进行无服务器处理。该公司使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 来管理用户凭证。开发、测试和运维团队需要安全访问 Amazon RDS 和 Amazon S3，同时确保敏感客户数据的机密性。该解决方案必须符合最小权限原则。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用具有最小权限的 IAM roles 向所有团队授予访问权限。为每个团队分配 IAM roles，并使用自定义 IAM policies 根据团队职责定义对 Amazon RDS 和 S3 对象访问的特定权限。
options.B: 启用带有 Identity Center directory 的 IAM Identity Center。创建并配置 permission sets，以对 Amazon RDS 和 Amazon S3 进行精细粒度访问。将所有团队分配到具有特定访问权限的组，并通过 permission sets 管理这些访问权限。
options.C: 为所有团队中的每个成员创建单独的 IAM users，并授予基于角色的权限。根据用户需求，为每个用户分配具有预定义 RDS 和 S3 访问策略的 IAM roles。实施 IAM Access Analyzer 以进行定期凭证评估。
options.D: 使用 AWS Organizations 为每个团队创建单独的账户。实施具有最小权限的跨账户 IAM roles。根据团队角色和职责授予对 RDS 和 S3 访问的特定权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

该公司已经使用 IAM Identity Center 管理员工凭证，并且要求是以最少的运营开销实现安全的、最小权限访问。AWS 建议人类用户使用带临时凭证的联合身份，并建议使用 IAM Identity Center 对 AWS 账户和权限进行集中访问管理（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。IAM Identity Center 提供“一个位置”来为用户组分配权限，并允许你创建满足安全需求的自定义权限（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。Permission sets 专门用于确定访问级别，并且 AWS 建议直接向组而不是单个用户分配访问权限，以简化管理（[Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)）。IAM Identity Center permission sets 可以设置为限制性权限，以遵循最小权限原则（[Manage AWS accounts with permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** IAM roles 和自定义策略可以实现最小权限，但直接使用 IAM roles 管理团队访问权限比使用 IAM Identity Center 组和 permission sets 来管理员工访问需要更多运营工作。AWS 明确建议对人类用户使用 IAM Identity Center 进行集中访问管理（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **C:** 为团队成员创建单独的 IAM users 会增加凭证管理开销，并且不符合 AWS 对人类用户的最佳实践；该最佳实践是通过身份提供商（例如 IAM Identity Center）使用带临时凭证的联合身份（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **D:** 单独的 AWS 账户和跨账户角色可用于隔离，但它们会引入额外的账户和角色管理开销。题目要求最少的运营开销，而 IAM Identity Center 已经支持从单一位置进行基于组的权限分配（[What is IAM Identity Center?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。

en.question: A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains sensitive data files. The company has an application that runs on virtual machines in an on-premises data center. The company currently uses AWS IAM Identity Center. The application requires temporary access to files in the S3 bucket. The company wants to grant the application secure access to the files in the S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket policy that permits access to the bucket from the public IP address range of the company’s on-premises data center.
options.B: Use IAM Roles Anywhere to obtain security credentials in IAM Identity Center that grant access to the S3 bucket. Configure the virtual machines to assume the role by using the AWS CLI.
options.C: Install the AWS CLI on the virtual machine. Configure the AWS CLI with access keys from an IAM user that has access to the bucket.
options.D: Create an IAM user and policy that grants access to the bucket. Store the access key and secret key for the IAM user in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to retrieve the access key and secret key at startup.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** IAM Roles Anywhere is designed for workloads that run outside AWS, such as on-premises servers and applications. AWS documentation states that IAM Roles Anywhere can obtain **temporary security credentials in IAM** for servers, containers, and applications outside AWS, and that those workloads can use the same IAM policies and IAM roles to access AWS resources without managing long-term AWS credentials ([IAM Roles Anywhere introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/userguide/introduction.html)). AWS IAM best practices also specifically recommend that workloads outside AWS, including on-premises servers, use temporary credentials, and list IAM Roles Anywhere as a way to request temporary AWS credentials for such workloads ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)). The IAM Roles Anywhere credential helper can be configured as a credential process for AWS SDKs and the AWS CLI to obtain temporary credentials for a target role ([credential helper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/userguide/credential-helper.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** An S3 bucket policy based only on the on-premises public IP range does not provide the application with temporary AWS credentials or role-based identity. It is weaker for sensitive data because it grants access based on network source rather than authenticated workload identity.
- **C:** Configuring the AWS CLI with IAM user access keys uses long-term credentials. AWS recommends relying on temporary credentials instead of long-term credentials such as access keys where possible ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).
- **D:** Storing IAM user access keys in Secrets Manager protects storage of the secret, but the application is still using long-term IAM user credentials. The requirement is for temporary access, and AWS recommends temporary credentials with IAM roles for workloads, including workloads outside AWS ([IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个包含敏感数据文件的 Amazon S3 存储桶。该公司有一个运行在本地数据中心虚拟机上的应用程序。该公司目前使用 AWS IAM Identity Center。该应用程序需要对 S3 存储桶中的文件进行临时访问。该公司希望授予该应用程序对 S3 存储桶中文件的安全访问权限。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 S3 存储桶策略，允许从公司本地数据中心的公有 IP 地址范围访问该存储桶。
options.B: 使用 IAM Roles Anywhere 在 IAM Identity Center 中获取授予 S3 存储桶访问权限的安全凭证。配置虚拟机使用 AWS CLI 代入该角色。
options.C: 在虚拟机上安装 AWS CLI。使用有权访问该存储桶的 IAM 用户的访问密钥配置 AWS CLI。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 用户和策略，授予对该存储桶的访问权限。将该 IAM 用户的访问密钥和秘密密钥存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。配置应用程序在启动时检索访问密钥和秘密密钥。

zh.explanation:
