**正确答案：B。** IAM Roles Anywhere 专为在 AWS 之外运行的工作负载而设计，例如本地服务器和应用程序。AWS 文档说明，IAM Roles Anywhere 可以为 AWS 之外的服务器、容器和应用程序获取 **IAM 中的临时安全凭证**，并且这些工作负载可以使用相同的 IAM 策略和 IAM 角色来访问 AWS 资源，而无需管理长期 AWS 凭证（[IAM Roles Anywhere introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/userguide/introduction.html)）。AWS IAM 最佳实践还特别建议 AWS 之外的工作负载（包括本地服务器）使用临时凭证，并将 IAM Roles Anywhere 列为此类工作负载请求临时 AWS 凭证的一种方式（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。IAM Roles Anywhere credential helper 可以配置为 AWS SDKs 和 AWS CLI 的 credential process，以获取目标角色的临时凭证（[credential helper](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rolesanywhere/latest/userguide/credential-helper.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 仅基于本地公有 IP 范围的 S3 存储桶策略不会为应用程序提供临时 AWS 凭证或基于角色的身份。对于敏感数据而言，这种方式较弱，因为它基于网络来源而不是经过身份验证的工作负载身份来授予访问权限。
- **C:** 使用 IAM 用户访问密钥配置 AWS CLI 会使用长期凭证。AWS 建议尽可能依赖临时凭证，而不是访问密钥等长期凭证（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。
- **D:** 将 IAM 用户访问密钥存储在 Secrets Manager 中可以保护秘密的存储，但应用程序仍在使用长期 IAM 用户凭证。要求是临时访问，并且 AWS 建议对工作负载使用带有 IAM 角色的临时凭证，包括 AWS 之外的工作负载（[IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts its core network services, including directory services and DNS, in its on-premises data center. The data center is connected to the AWS Cloud using AWS Direct Connect (DX). Additional AWS accounts are planned that will require quick, cost-effective, and consistent access to these network services. What should a solutions architect implement to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?

options.A: Create a DX connection in each new account. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers.
options.B: Configure VPC endpoints in the DX VPC for all required services. Route the network traffic to the on-premises servers.
options.C: Create a VPN connection between each new account and the DX VPRoute the network traffic to the on-premises servers.
options.D: Configure AWS Transit Gateway between the accounts. Assign DX to the transit gateway and route network traffic to the on-premises servers.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** AWS Transit Gateway is designed as a central network hub: AWS documentation states that “a transit gateway is a network transit hub” used to connect VPCs and on-premises networks ([AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/designing-control-tower-landing-zone/inter-vpc.html)). For Direct Connect, AWS documents associating a Direct Connect gateway with “a transit gateway when you have multiple VPCs in the same Region,” and also describes Direct Connect Gateway as globally available and eliminating the need for multiple Direct Connect gateways ([AWS Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)). AWS Prescriptive Guidance also shows Direct Connect with Transit Gateway, where “the transit gateway routes traffic through the centralized Direct Connect gateway” to on-premises over a private dedicated connection ([AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/designing-control-tower-landing-zone/transit-vif.html)). This provides consistent, scalable access for new accounts/VPCs with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Creating a separate DX connection in each new account is not low-overhead or cost-effective. The documented pattern is centralization with Direct Connect Gateway/Transit Gateway, not duplicating DX per account.
- **B:** VPC endpoints are for connecting to services powered by AWS PrivateLink, including many AWS services ([Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-interface-endpoint.html)). They are not the right mechanism to route traffic to on-premises directory/DNS servers over Direct Connect.
- **C:** Creating a VPN connection for each new account adds per-account configuration and operational overhead and does not use the existing Direct Connect path as cleanly as a centralized Transit Gateway design.

zh.question: 一家公司在其本地数据中心托管核心网络服务，包括目录服务和 DNS。该数据中心使用 AWS Direct Connect (DX) 连接到 AWS Cloud。公司计划增加更多 AWS 账户，这些账户将需要快速、经济高效且一致地访问这些网络服务。解决方案架构师应实施什么方案，以在满足这些要求的同时实现最少的运营开销？

options.A: 在每个新账户中创建一个 DX 连接。将网络流量路由到本地服务器。
options.B: 在 DX VPC 中为所有必需服务配置 VPC endpoints。将网络流量路由到本地服务器。
options.C: 在每个新账户与 DX VPRoute 之间创建 VPN 连接，将网络流量路由到本地服务器。
options.D: 在账户之间配置 AWS Transit Gateway。将 DX 分配给 transit gateway，并将网络流量路由到本地服务器。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D.** AWS Transit Gateway 被设计为中央网络枢纽：AWS 文档说明，“a transit gateway is a network transit hub”，用于连接 VPCs 和本地网络（[AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/designing-control-tower-landing-zone/inter-vpc.html)）。对于 Direct Connect，AWS 记录了在“a transit gateway when you have multiple VPCs in the same Region”的情况下将 Direct Connect gateway 与其关联，并且还说明 Direct Connect Gateway 是全球可用的，可消除对多个 Direct Connect gateways 的需求（[AWS Direct Connect](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/direct-connect-gateways-intro.html)）。AWS Prescriptive Guidance 还展示了 Direct Connect 与 Transit Gateway 的配合使用，其中“the transit gateway routes traffic through the centralized Direct Connect gateway”通过私有专用连接路由到本地（[AWS Prescriptive Guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/designing-control-tower-landing-zone/transit-vif.html)）。这为新账户/VPCs 提供了一致、可扩展的访问，并且运营开销最少。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 在每个新账户中创建单独的 DX 连接并不是低开销或经济高效的做法。文档化的模式是使用 Direct Connect Gateway/Transit Gateway 进行集中化，而不是为每个账户重复创建 DX。
- **B:** VPC endpoints 用于连接由 AWS PrivateLink 提供支持的服务，包括许多 AWS 服务（[Amazon VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-interface-endpoint.html)）。它们不是通过 Direct Connect 将流量路由到本地目录/DNS 服务器的正确机制。
- **C:** 为每个新账户创建 VPN 连接会增加按账户配置和运营开销，并且不像集中式 Transit Gateway 设计那样干净地使用现有 Direct Connect 路径。

en.question: A company hosts its main public web application in one AWS Region across multiple Availability Zones. The application uses an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A web development team needs a cost-optimized compute solution to improve the company’s ability to serve dynamic content globally to millions of customers. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Configure the existing ALB as the origin.
options.B: Use Amazon Route 53 to serve traffic to the ALB and EC2 instances based on the geographic location of each customer.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket with public read access enabled. Migrate the web application to the S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket for website hosting.
options.D: Use AWS Direct Connect to directly serve content from the web application to the location of each customer.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and configure the existing ALB as the origin.**

CloudFront is designed to speed up delivery of both **static and dynamic web content** through a worldwide edge-location network, routing users to the lowest-latency edge location and using the AWS backbone network to improve performance ([CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)). AWS also documents that CloudFront can route traffic to **Application Load Balancers**, and when using EC2 web servers behind a load balancer, you can specify the load balancer URL as the CloudFront origin ([CloudFront origins: Application Load Balancer / EC2 custom origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)). This meets the requirement to improve global delivery while reusing the existing ALB and Auto Scaling architecture.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Route 53 geolocation routing can choose DNS targets based on user location, but it does not itself provide a global edge network, caching, or dynamic content acceleration. It is mainly for routing users to selected resources such as regional load balancers ([Route 53 geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html)). The application is currently in one Region, so this does not solve global dynamic content performance as well as CloudFront.
- **C:** Amazon S3 website hosting is for **static** websites. The scenario requires serving a public web application with **dynamic content**, so migrating the application to a public S3 website bucket is not appropriate ([S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)).
- **D:** AWS Direct Connect links an internal network to an AWS Direct Connect location over a dedicated Ethernet fiber connection; it is for private connectivity to AWS, not for directly serving a public web application globally to millions of internet customers ([AWS Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 AWS Region 的多个 Availability Zones 中托管其主要的公共 Web 应用程序。该应用程序使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。Web 开发团队需要一种成本优化的计算解决方案，以提高公司向全球数百万客户提供动态内容的能力。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配。将现有 ALB 配置为源站。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Route 53 根据每位客户的地理位置将流量提供给 ALB 和 EC2 实例。
options.C: 创建启用公共读取访问权限的 Amazon S3 存储桶。将 Web 应用程序迁移到 S3 存储桶。将 S3 存储桶配置为网站托管。
options.D: 使用 AWS Direct Connect 直接从 Web 应用程序向每位客户的位置提供内容。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A. 创建 Amazon CloudFront 分配并将现有 ALB 配置为源站。**

CloudFront 旨在通过全球边缘站点网络加速交付 **静态和动态 Web 内容**，将用户路由到延迟最低的边缘站点，并使用 AWS 骨干网络提升性能（[CloudFront introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)）。AWS 还记录了 CloudFront 可以将流量路由到 **Application Load Balancers**，并且在负载均衡器后使用 EC2 Web 服务器时，可以将负载均衡器 URL 指定为 CloudFront 源站（[CloudFront origins: Application Load Balancer / EC2 custom origin](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/DownloadDistS3AndCustomOrigins.html)）。这满足了在复用现有 ALB 和 Auto Scaling 架构的同时改进全球交付的要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** Route 53 地理位置路由可以根据用户位置选择 DNS 目标，但它本身不提供全球边缘网络、缓存或动态内容加速。它主要用于将用户路由到选定资源，例如区域负载均衡器（[Route 53 geolocation routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-geo.html)）。该应用程序当前位于一个 Region 中，因此这并不能像 CloudFront 那样有效解决全球动态内容性能问题。
- **C:** Amazon S3 网站托管适用于 **静态** 网站。该场景需要提供带有 **动态内容** 的公共 Web 应用程序，因此将应用程序迁移到公共 S3 网站存储桶并不合适（[S3 static website hosting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/WebsiteHosting.html)）。
- **D:** AWS Direct Connect 通过专用以太网光纤连接将内部网络连接到 AWS Direct Connect 位置；它用于连接到 AWS 的私有连接，而不是用于向全球数百万互联网客户直接提供公共 Web 应用程序（[AWS Direct Connect overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company stores user data in AWS. The data is used continuously with peak usage during business hours. Access patterns vary, with some data not being used for months at a time. A solutions architect must choose a cost-effective solution that maintains the highest level of durability while maintaining high availability. Which storage solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Amazon S3 Standard
options.B: Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.C: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.D: Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **B. Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering**.

S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed specifically for data with **unknown, changing, or unpredictable access patterns**. AWS states that it optimizes storage costs by automatically moving objects to the most cost-effective access tier as access patterns change, with no performance impact and no retrieval fees. It is designed for **99.999999999% durability** and **99.9% availability**, stored across **three or more Availability Zones**, which satisfies the high durability and high availability requirements for continuously used data with variable access patterns ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Amazon S3 Standard**: S3 Standard provides higher designed availability (99.99%) and the same 99.999999999% durability, but it is intended for frequently accessed data. It does not automatically optimize costs when some objects are unused for months, so it is not the most cost-effective choice for changing access patterns ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **C. Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive**: This class is for long-lived archive data accessed less than once a year, with retrieval times of hours. The question says the data is used continuously and must maintain high availability, so Deep Archive is not suitable for active access ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).
- **D. Amazon S3 One Zone-IA**: Although it has 99.999999999% durability, it stores data in only one Availability Zone, has lower designed availability (99.5%), and is not resilient to the physical loss of that Availability Zone. AWS recommends it for data that can be re-created, not for user data requiring high availability and maximum resiliency ([AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司将用户数据存储在 AWS 中。该数据会被持续使用，并且在业务时间有使用高峰。访问模式各不相同，有些数据可能一次数月都不会被使用。解决方案架构师必须选择一种经济高效的解决方案，在保持高可用性的同时维持最高级别的持久性。哪种存储解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: Amazon S3 Standard
options.B: Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering
options.C: Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
options.D: Amazon S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **B. Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering**。

S3 Intelligent-Tiering 专为具有**未知、变化或不可预测访问模式**的数据而设计。AWS 表示，它会随着访问模式的变化自动将对象移动到最具成本效益的访问层，从而优化存储成本，并且不会影响性能，也不收取检索费用。它旨在提供 **99.999999999% 持久性**和 **99.9% 可用性**，并跨**三个或更多 Availability Zones** 存储，这满足了对具有可变访问模式且持续使用的数据的高持久性和高可用性要求（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A. Amazon S3 Standard**：S3 Standard 提供更高的设计可用性 (99.99%) 以及相同的 99.999999999% 持久性，但它适用于频繁访问的数据。当某些对象数月未使用时，它不会自动优化成本，因此对于不断变化的访问模式来说，它不是最具成本效益的选择（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **C. Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive**：此存储类适用于每年访问少于一次的长期归档数据，检索时间为数小时。题目说明数据会被持续使用，并且必须保持高可用性，因此 Deep Archive 不适合主动访问（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。
- **D. Amazon S3 One Zone-IA**：虽然它具有 99.999999999% 的持久性，但它仅在一个 Availability Zone 中存储数据，设计可用性较低 (99.5%)，并且无法抵御该 Availability Zone 的物理丢失。AWS 建议将其用于可重新创建的数据，而不是用于需要高可用性和最大弹性的用户数据（[AWS S3 storage classes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/storage-class-intro.html)）。

en.question: A company is testing an application that runs on an Amazon EC2 Linux instance. A single 500 GB Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSO (gp2) volume is attached to the EC2 instance. The company will deploy the application on multiple EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. All instances require access to the data that is stored in the EBS volume. The company needs a highly available and resilient solution that does not introduce significant changes to the application's code. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Provision an EC2 instance that uses NFS server software. Attach a single 500 GB gp2 EBS volume to the instance.
options.B: Provision an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Configure the file system as an SMB file store within a single Availability Zone.
options.C: Provision an EC2 instance with two 250 GB Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS volumes.
options.D: Provision an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Configure the file system to use General Purpose performance mode.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

Amazon EFS is the managed shared file system option for Linux EC2 instances. AWS documentation states that EFS can be mounted on EC2 Linux instances using the EFS mount helper or standard NFS client, and can be automatically mounted when an instance starts, which fits Auto Scaling with minimal application changes ([Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)). A Regional EFS file system stores data redundantly across multiple Availability Zones and provides continuous availability even if one or more AZs are unavailable, meeting the high availability and resilience requirement ([Availability and durability of EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)). General Purpose performance mode is also recommended by AWS because it has the lowest per-operation latency and is the default/recommended mode ([Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

* **A**: An EC2 instance running NFS server software with one EBS volume creates a self-managed single server dependency. It is not the highly available/resilient managed multi-AZ solution requested.
* **B**: FSx for Windows File Server is an SMB Windows file service, and the option specifies **Single-AZ**. AWS notes Single-AZ FSx for Windows file systems use a single Windows file server instance and storage in one AZ, while Multi-AZ is recommended for most production workloads because of its high availability and durability model ([Security Hub FSx.5 control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/fsx-controls.html)). It is also not the natural fit for a Linux/NFS workload.
* **C**: Two EBS volumes attached to one EC2 instance do not provide shared file access for multiple Auto Scaling instances. EBS Multi-Attach is supported only for Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1`/`io2` volumes, not gp2, is limited to instances in the same AZ, and standard file systems such as XFS/EXT4 are not designed for simultaneous access by multiple servers ([EBS Multi-Attach considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司正在测试一个运行在 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例上的应用程序。一个单独的 500 GB Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSO (gp2) 卷已附加到该 EC2 实例。该公司将把该应用程序部署到 Auto Scaling 组中的多个 EC2 实例上。所有实例都需要访问存储在该 EBS 卷中的数据。公司需要一个高可用且具有弹性的解决方案，并且不会对应用程序代码引入重大更改。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 预置一个使用 NFS 服务器软件的 EC2 实例。将一个单独的 500 GB gp2 EBS 卷附加到该实例。
options.B: 预置一个 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统。将该文件系统配置为单个 Availability Zone 内的 SMB 文件存储。
options.C: 预置一个带有两个 250 GB Provisioned IOPS SSD EBS 卷的 EC2 实例。
options.D: 预置一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。将该文件系统配置为使用 General Purpose 性能模式。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。

Amazon EFS 是适用于 Linux EC2 实例的托管共享文件系统选项。AWS 文档说明，可以使用 EFS mount helper 或标准 NFS 客户端将 EFS 挂载到 EC2 Linux 实例上，并且可以在实例启动时自动挂载，这适合 Auto Scaling，并且只需对应用程序进行最少更改（[Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。Regional EFS 文件系统会跨多个 Availability Zones 冗余存储数据，并且即使一个或多个 AZ 不可用，也能提供持续可用性，从而满足高可用性和弹性要求（[Availability and durability of EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/features.html)）。AWS 也推荐 General Purpose 性能模式，因为它具有最低的单操作延迟，并且是默认/推荐模式（[Amazon EFS performance specifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/performance.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

* **A**：运行 NFS 服务器软件并带有一个 EBS 卷的 EC2 实例会产生自管理的单服务器依赖。它不是题目要求的高可用/弹性的托管多 AZ 解决方案。
* **B**：FSx for Windows File Server 是 SMB Windows 文件服务，并且该选项指定为 **Single-AZ**。AWS 指出，Single-AZ FSx for Windows 文件系统在一个 AZ 中使用单个 Windows 文件服务器实例和存储，而对于大多数生产工作负载，推荐使用 Multi-AZ，因为其高可用性和持久性模型（[Security Hub FSx.5 control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/fsx-controls.html)）。它也不是 Linux/NFS 工作负载的自然匹配选择。
* **C**：附加到一个 EC2 实例的两个 EBS 卷无法为多个 Auto Scaling 实例提供共享文件访问。EBS Multi-Attach 仅支持 Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1`/`io2` 卷，不支持 gp2，并且仅限于同一 AZ 中的实例；XFS/EXT4 等标准文件系统并非设计用于多个服务器同时访问（[EBS Multi-Attach considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)）。

en.question: A company recently launched a new application for its customers. The application runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. End users use TCP to communicate with the application. The application must be highly available and must automatically scale as the number of users increases. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add a Network Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure an Auto Scaling group for the EC2 instances.
options.C: Add an Application Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.
options.D: Manually add more EC2 instances for the application.
options.E: Add a Gateway Load Balancer in front of the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **A and B**.

- **A. Add a Network Load Balancer**: The clients use **TCP** to communicate with the application. AWS documentation states that Network Load Balancer target groups support **TCP** and that an NLB operates at Layer 4 and routes TCP connections to targets. An NLB can also be enabled across multiple Availability Zones to improve fault tolerance, and Elastic Load Balancing scales as traffic changes ([Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)).
- **B. Configure an Auto Scaling group**: Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling can launch or terminate instances as demand increases or decreases, balances instances across multiple Availability Zones, replaces impaired instances, and can automatically register/deregister instances with a load balancer. AWS also states there are no additional fees for EC2 Auto Scaling itself, which supports the “most cost-effective” requirement ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **C. Application Load Balancer**: ALB is for Layer 7 application traffic. Its listeners support **HTTP and HTTPS**, not generic TCP listeners, so it is not the best fit when the requirement specifically says end users use TCP ([ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)).
- **D. Manually add more EC2 instances**: Manual scaling does not meet the requirement to **automatically scale** as users increase. EC2 Auto Scaling is the AWS service designed to adjust capacity automatically ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)).
- **E. Gateway Load Balancer**: Gateway Load Balancer is intended for deploying and scaling virtual appliances such as firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and deep packet inspection systems. That is not the stated use case of load balancing TCP application traffic to EC2 instances ([Gateway Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司最近为其客户推出了一个新应用程序。该应用程序运行在跨两个可用区的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上。终端用户使用 TCP 与该应用程序通信。该应用程序必须具有高可用性，并且必须随着用户数量的增加自动扩展。哪一组步骤能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 EC2 实例前面添加 Network Load Balancer。
options.B: 为 EC2 实例配置 Auto Scaling 组。
options.C: 在 EC2 实例前面添加 Application Load Balancer。
options.D: 为该应用程序手动添加更多 EC2 实例。
options.E: 在 EC2 实例前面添加 Gateway Load Balancer。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A 和 B**。

- **A. 添加 Network Load Balancer**：客户端使用 **TCP** 与应用程序通信。AWS 文档指出，Network Load Balancer 目标组支持 **TCP**，并且 NLB 运行在 Layer 4，会将 TCP 连接路由到目标。NLB 还可以跨多个可用区启用以提高容错能力，并且 Elastic Load Balancing 会随着流量变化进行扩展（[Network Load Balancer introduction](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/introduction.html)）。
- **B. 配置 Auto Scaling 组**：Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 可以随着需求增加或减少来启动或终止实例，在多个可用区之间平衡实例，替换受损实例，并且可以自动向负载均衡器注册/取消注册实例。AWS 还说明 EC2 Auto Scaling 本身不收取额外费用，这支持了“最具成本效益”的要求（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **C. Application Load Balancer**：ALB 用于 Layer 7 应用程序流量。其监听器支持 **HTTP and HTTPS**，不支持通用 TCP 监听器，因此当要求明确说明终端用户使用 TCP 时，它并不是最合适的选择（[ALB listeners](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-listeners.html)）。
- **D. 手动添加更多 EC2 实例**：手动扩展不满足随着用户增加而 **automatically scale** 的要求。EC2 Auto Scaling 是 AWS 中用于自动调整容量的服务（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)）。
- **E. Gateway Load Balancer**：Gateway Load Balancer 旨在部署和扩展虚拟设备，例如防火墙、入侵检测/防御系统以及深度包检测系统。这并不是题目所描述的将 TCP 应用程序流量负载均衡到 EC2 实例的用例（[Gateway Load Balancer overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/gateway/introduction.html)）。

en.question: A company is designing the architecture for a new mobile app that uses the AWS Cloud. The company uses organizational units (OUs) in AWS Organizations to manage its accounts. The company wants to tag Amazon EC2 instances with data sensitivity by using values of sensitive and nonsensitive. IAM identities must not be able to delete a tag or create instances without a tag. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: In Organizations, create a new tag policy that specifies the data sensitivity tag key and the required values. Enforce the tag values for the EC2 instances. Attach the tag policy to the appropriate OU.
options.B: In Organizations, create a new service control policy (SCP) that specifies the data sensitivity tag key and the required tag values. Enforce the tag values for the EC2 instances. Attach the SCP to the appropriate OU.
options.C: Create a tag policy to deny running instances when a tag key is not specified. Create another tag policy that prevents identities from deleting tags. Attach the tag policies to the appropriate OU.
options.D: Create a service control policy (SCP) to deny creating instances when a tag key is not specified. Create another SCP that prevents identities from deleting tags. Attach the SCPs to the appropriate OU.
options.E: Create an AWS Config rule to check if EC2 instances use the data sensitivity tag and the specified values. Configure an AWS Lambda function to delete the resource if a noncompliant resource is found.

en.explanation:
**Correct answers: A and D.**

- **A is correct** because AWS Organizations **tag policies** are designed to standardize tags across accounts. A tag policy can define the required tag key and allowed tag values, and it can enforce noncompliant tagging operations for specified resource types. AWS documentation gives an EC2 example where a tag key can only have specific values and is enforced for `ec2:ALL_SUPPORTED` resources. AWS also notes that untagged resources are not evaluated by tag policies, so this must be combined with an access-control mechanism. [Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html) [Tag policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_example-tag-policies.html)
- **D is correct** because an SCP can act as an organization-wide permissions guardrail. SCPs restrict the maximum permissions of IAM users and roles in member accounts. For EC2 creation, AWS states that to force users to specify tags when creating a resource, you must use `aws:RequestTag` or `aws:TagKeys` on the resource-creating action; these condition keys can also be applied to `ec2:DeleteTags`. Therefore, SCP deny statements can block `RunInstances` when the required tag key is absent and block deletion of the tag. [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) [EC2 tagging permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/supported-iam-actions-tagging.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** SCPs are appropriate for denying actions, but the native Organizations feature for specifying and enforcing standardized tag keys/allowed values is a **tag policy**. This option also does not address preventing tag deletion.
- **C:** Tag policies do not deny IAM actions such as launching instances or deleting tags. AWS explicitly states that untagged resources are not evaluated for tag policy compliance, so tag policies alone cannot prevent launching untagged instances. [Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)
- **E:** AWS Config rules evaluate compliance information and can remediate noncompliant resources after evaluation; this is detective/remediating, not preventive. It does not ensure IAM identities cannot create untagged instances or delete tags. [AWS Config features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)

zh.question: 一家公司正在为一个使用 AWS Cloud 的新移动应用设计架构。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的组织单位 (OUs) 来管理其账户。该公司希望使用 sensitive 和 nonsensitive 这两个值，通过数据敏感性标签来标记 Amazon EC2 实例。IAM 身份不得能够删除标签，也不得能够在没有标签的情况下创建实例。哪一组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 Organizations 中，创建一个新的标签策略，指定数据敏感性标签键和必需的值。对 EC2 实例强制执行这些标签值。将该标签策略附加到相应的 OU。
options.B: 在 Organizations 中，创建一个新的服务控制策略 (SCP)，指定数据敏感性标签键和必需的标签值。对 EC2 实例强制执行这些标签值。将该 SCP 附加到相应的 OU。
options.C: 创建一个标签策略，以在未指定标签键时拒绝运行实例。创建另一个标签策略，防止身份删除标签。将这些标签策略附加到相应的 OU。
options.D: 创建一个服务控制策略 (SCP)，以在未指定标签键时拒绝创建实例。创建另一个 SCP，防止身份删除标签。将这些 SCP 附加到相应的 OU。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS Config 规则，以检查 EC2 实例是否使用数据敏感性标签和指定的值。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，在发现不合规资源时删除该资源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A 和 D。**

- **A 正确**，因为 AWS Organizations **tag policies** 旨在跨账户标准化标签。标签策略可以定义必需的标签键和允许的标签值，并且可以针对指定资源类型强制执行不合规的标记操作。AWS 文档给出了一个 EC2 示例，其中某个标签键只能具有特定值，并且会针对 `ec2:ALL_SUPPORTED` 资源强制执行。AWS 还指出，未标记的资源不会由标签策略评估，因此必须将其与访问控制机制结合使用。[Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html) [Tag policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_example-tag-policies.html)
- **D 正确**，因为 SCP 可以作为组织范围的权限护栏。SCP 会限制成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色的最大权限。对于 EC2 创建，AWS 表示，要强制用户在创建资源时指定标签，必须在创建资源的操作上使用 `aws:RequestTag` 或 `aws:TagKeys`；这些条件键也可以应用于 `ec2:DeleteTags`。因此，SCP 拒绝语句可以在缺少必需标签键时阻止 `RunInstances`，并阻止删除该标签。[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) [EC2 tagging permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/supported-iam-actions-tagging.html)

**其他选项为何不正确：**

- **B:** SCP 适合用于拒绝操作，但用于指定并强制执行标准化标签键/允许值的原生 Organizations 功能是 **tag policy**。此选项也没有解决防止标签删除的问题。
- **C:** 标签策略不会拒绝 IAM 操作，例如启动实例或删除标签。AWS 明确说明，未标记的资源不会被评估其标签策略合规性，因此仅靠标签策略无法防止启动未标记的实例。[Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)
- **E:** AWS Config 规则会评估合规性信息，并且可以在评估后修复不合规资源；这是检测/修复性的，而不是预防性的。它不能确保 IAM 身份无法创建未标记的实例或删除标签。[AWS Config features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/WhatIsConfig.html)

en.question: A company runs database workloads on AWS that are the backend for the company's customer portals. The company runs a Multi-AZ database cluster on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company needs to implement a 30-day backup retention policy. The company currently has both automated RDS backups and manual RDS backups. The company wants to maintain both types of existing RDS backups that are less than 30 days old. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups by using AWS Backup. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days.
options.B: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.
options.C: Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups. Manually delete manual backups that are older than 30 days.
options.D: Disable RDS automated backups. Delete automated backups and manual backups that are older than 30 days automatically by using AWS CloudFormation. Configure the RDS backup retention policy to 30 days for automated backups.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon RDS natively supports changing the backup retention period after the database is created. For a **Multi-AZ DB cluster**, the automated backup retention period can be set to **1–35 days**, so setting it to **30 days** directly satisfies the automated-backup requirement without using another backup service ([RDS backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)). Manual snapshots are different: AWS states that, unlike automated backups, **manual snapshots aren't subject to the backup retention period and don't expire** ([Creating a DB snapshot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CreateSnapshot.html)). Therefore, to keep only manual backups that are less than 30 days old, the older manual snapshots must be deleted separately. This is the most cost-effective option because it uses native RDS retention and removes unneeded manual-snapshot storage; RDS backup storage includes both automated backups and manual DB snapshots ([Backup storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** AWS Backup is unnecessary for setting RDS automated backup retention because RDS already provides the required 30-day retention setting natively. Adding AWS Backup does not improve the requirement and is not the most cost-effective approach.
- **B:** Disabling automated backups is unnecessary and conflicts with the requirement to maintain existing automated backups less than 30 days old. Also, for a Multi-AZ DB cluster, the retention period is **1–35 days**, not 0; setting retention to 0 disables automated backups only for DB instances, and RDS notes that changing between 0 and nonzero can cause an outage for DB instances ([RDS backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)).
- **D:** This has the same problem as B: disabling automated backups is unnecessary and inappropriate for a Multi-AZ DB cluster. Using CloudFormation to automate deletion adds complexity and does not make the solution more cost-effective than simply configuring native RDS retention and deleting expired manual snapshots.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行数据库工作负载，作为公司客户门户的后端。该公司在 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 上运行一个 Multi-AZ 数据库集群。公司需要实施 30 天的备份保留策略。公司目前同时拥有自动 RDS 备份和手动 RDS 备份。公司希望保留两种类型的现有 RDS 备份中少于 30 天的备份。哪种解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Backup 将自动备份的 RDS 备份保留策略配置为 30 天。手动删除超过 30 天的手动备份。
options.B: 禁用 RDS 自动备份。删除超过 30 天的自动备份和手动备份。将自动备份的 RDS 备份保留策略配置为 30 天。
options.C: 将自动备份的 RDS 备份保留策略配置为 30 天。手动删除超过 30 天的手动备份。
options.D: 禁用 RDS 自动备份。使用 AWS CloudFormation 自动删除超过 30 天的自动备份和手动备份。将自动备份的 RDS 备份保留策略配置为 30 天。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。**

Amazon RDS 原生支持在数据库创建后更改备份保留期。对于 **Multi-AZ DB cluster**，自动备份保留期可以设置为 **1–35 天**，因此将其直接设置为 **30 天** 即可满足自动备份要求，而无需使用其他备份服务（[RDS backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)）。手动快照则不同：AWS 声明，与自动备份不同，**手动快照不受备份保留期约束，并且不会过期**（[Creating a DB snapshot](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_CreateSnapshot.html)）。因此，要仅保留少于 30 天的手动备份，必须单独删除更早的手动快照。这是最具成本效益的选项，因为它使用原生 RDS 保留功能并移除不需要的手动快照存储；RDS 备份存储包括自动备份和手动 DB 快照（[Backup storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 设置 RDS 自动备份保留不需要 AWS Backup，因为 RDS 已经原生提供所需的 30 天保留设置。添加 AWS Backup 不会改善对该要求的满足，并且不是最具成本效益的方法。
- **B:** 禁用自动备份是不必要的，并且与保留少于 30 天的现有自动备份这一要求相冲突。此外，对于 Multi-AZ DB cluster，保留期是 **1–35 天**，而不是 0；将保留期设置为 0 仅会对 DB instances 禁用自动备份，并且 RDS 指出，在 0 和非零之间更改可能会导致 DB instances 中断（[RDS backup retention period](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.BackupRetention.html)）。
- **D:** 这与 B 存在相同问题：禁用自动备份对于 Multi-AZ DB cluster 来说是不必要且不合适的。使用 CloudFormation 自动删除会增加复杂性，并且不会比简单配置原生 RDS 保留并删除过期手动快照更具成本效益。

en.question: A company is planning to migrate a legacy application to AWS. The application currently uses NFS to communicate to an on-premises storage solution to store application data. The application cannot be modified to use any other communication protocols other than NFS for this purpose. Which storage solution should a solutions architect recommend for use after the migration?

options.A: AWS DataSync
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.D: Amazon EMR File System (Amazon EMRFS)

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)**.

Amazon EFS is the appropriate storage service because the application must continue using NFS. AWS documentation states that EFS file systems can be mounted using a standard Linux NFS client and that Amazon EFS supports NFSv4.0 and NFSv4.1 protocols when mounting file systems on EC2 instances ([Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. AWS DataSync** — DataSync is a high-speed **file transfer** service used to transfer file or object data to, from, and between AWS storage services; it can work with NFS as a source/transfer location, but it is not the runtime NFS storage solution for the migrated application ([What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)).
- **B. Amazon EBS** — EBS provides block storage volumes attached to EC2 instances, used like local drives. It is not a managed shared NFS file system ([Amazon EBS persistent block storage for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)).
- **D. Amazon EMRFS** — Amazon EMR is for running big data frameworks such as Hadoop and Spark for analytics workloads, not for providing an NFS-compatible file system to a legacy application ([What is Amazon EMR?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司计划将一个旧版应用程序迁移到 AWS。该应用程序目前使用 NFS 与本地存储解决方案通信，以存储应用程序数据。出于此目的，该应用程序无法修改为使用除 NFS 之外的任何其他通信协议。解决方案架构师应建议在迁移后使用哪种存储解决方案？

options.A: AWS DataSync
options.B: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
options.C: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
options.D: Amazon EMR File System (Amazon EMRFS)

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C. Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)**。

Amazon EFS 是合适的存储服务，因为该应用程序必须继续使用 NFS。AWS 文档说明，EFS 文件系统可以使用标准 Linux NFS 客户端挂载，并且 Amazon EFS 在 EC2 实例上挂载文件系统时支持 NFSv4.0 和 NFSv4.1 协议（[Mounting EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. AWS DataSync** — DataSync 是一种高速 **文件传输** 服务，用于在 AWS 存储服务之间以及向 AWS 存储服务传输文件或对象数据；它可以将 NFS 作为源/传输位置，但它不是迁移后应用程序运行时所需的 NFS 存储解决方案（[What is AWS DataSync?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/datasync/latest/userguide/what-is-datasync.html)）。
- **B. Amazon EBS** — EBS 提供附加到 EC2 实例的块存储卷，像本地驱动器一样使用。它不是托管的共享 NFS 文件系统（[Amazon EBS persistent block storage for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/storage_ebs.html)）。
- **D. Amazon EMRFS** — Amazon EMR 用于运行 Hadoop 和 Spark 等大数据框架来处理分析工作负载，而不是为旧版应用程序提供与 NFS 兼容的文件系统（[What is Amazon EMR?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-what-is-emr.html)）。

en.question: A company uses GPS trackers to document the migration patterns of thousands of sea turtles. The trackers check every 5 minutes to see if a turtle has moved more than 100 yards (91.4 meters). If a turtle has moved, its tracker sends the new coordinates to a web application running on three Amazon EC2 instances that are in multiple Availability Zones in one AWS Region. Recently, the web application was overwhelmed while processing an unexpected volume of tracker data. Data was lost with no way to replay the events. A solutions architect must prevent this problem from happening again and needs a solution with the least operational overhead. What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the data. Configure the application to scan for new data in the bucket for processing.
options.B: Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint to handle transmitted location coordinates. Use an AWS Lambda function to process each item concurrently.
options.C: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to store the incoming data. Configure the application to poll for new messages for processing.
options.D: Create an Amazon DynamoDB table to store transmitted location coordinates. Configure the application to query the table for new data for processing. Use TTL to remove data that has been processed.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon SQS is the best fit because it inserts a durable buffer between the GPS trackers and the processing application. AWS states that SQS queues redundantly store messages across multiple SQS servers, that producers send messages to the queue and consumers receive them when ready, and that messages remain in the queue during processing until the consumer deletes them. SQS also scales transparently to handle load spikes without provisioning, which matches the requirement for least operational overhead and prevents data loss during unexpected bursts ([Amazon SQS benefits and architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. S3 bucket with application scanning**: S3 can store data, but this design turns the application into a polling/scanning system over objects rather than a purpose-built message buffer. It adds application logic and operational overhead and does not provide the native queue lifecycle of receive, visibility timeout, and delete that SQS provides for work processing ([Amazon SQS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)).
- **B. API Gateway with Lambda**: API Gateway can route HTTP requests to Lambda functions ([API Gateway Lambda proxy integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-lambda-proxy-integrations.html)), but this option changes the processing platform rather than solving the replay/buffering problem for the existing application. Without a durable queue between ingestion and processing, a downstream processing spike can still create failure-handling and retry concerns.
- **D. DynamoDB table queried for new data with TTL**: DynamoDB is a database, not a work queue. Querying for unprocessed records and using TTL for cleanup requires custom state management and polling logic. SQS already provides the correct producer/consumer queue model, redundant message storage, visibility timeout while processing, and deletion after successful processing ([Amazon SQS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 GPS 跟踪器记录数千只海龟的迁徙模式。跟踪器每 5 分钟检查一次海龟是否移动了超过 100 码（91.4 米）。如果海龟移动了，其跟踪器会将新的坐标发送到一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序运行在一个 AWS Region 中多个 Availability Zones 内的三台 Amazon EC2 实例上。最近，该 Web 应用程序在处理意外大量的跟踪器数据时不堪重负。数据丢失，并且无法重放事件。解决方案架构师必须防止此问题再次发生，并且需要一个运营开销最低的解决方案。解决方案架构师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储数据。配置应用程序扫描存储桶中的新数据以进行处理。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon API Gateway 端点来处理传输的位置坐标。使用 AWS Lambda 函数并发处理每个项目。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列来存储传入数据。配置应用程序轮询新消息以进行处理。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表来存储传输的位置坐标。配置应用程序查询该表中的新数据以进行处理。使用 TTL 删除已处理的数据。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon SQS 是最合适的选择，因为它在 GPS 跟踪器和处理应用程序之间插入了一个持久缓冲区。AWS 表示，SQS 队列会在多个 SQS 服务器之间冗余存储消息，生产者将消息发送到队列，消费者在准备好时接收消息，并且消息在处理期间会保留在队列中，直到消费者将其删除。SQS 还可以透明扩展以处理负载峰值，无需预置资源，这符合最低运营开销的要求，并可防止在意外突发期间发生数据丢失（[Amazon SQS benefits and architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. S3 bucket with application scanning**：S3 可以存储数据，但此设计会使应用程序变成一个对对象进行轮询/扫描的系统，而不是使用专门构建的消息缓冲区。它增加了应用程序逻辑和运营开销，并且不提供 SQS 为工作处理提供的接收、可见性超时和删除等原生队列生命周期（[Amazon SQS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)）。
- **B. API Gateway with Lambda**：API Gateway 可以将 HTTP 请求路由到 Lambda 函数（[API Gateway Lambda proxy integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/set-up-lambda-proxy-integrations.html)），但此选项更改的是处理平台，而不是为现有应用程序解决重放/缓冲问题。如果在摄取和处理之间没有持久队列，下游处理峰值仍可能带来故障处理和重试方面的问题。
- **D. DynamoDB table queried for new data with TTL**：DynamoDB 是数据库，而不是工作队列。查询未处理记录并使用 TTL 进行清理需要自定义状态管理和轮询逻辑。SQS 已经提供了正确的生产者/消费者队列模型、冗余消息存储、处理期间的可见性超时，以及成功处理后的删除功能（[Amazon SQS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company's software development team needs an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ cluster. The RDS cluster will serve as a backend for a desktop client that is deployed on premises. The desktop client requires direct connectivity to the RDS cluster. The company must give the development team the ability to connect to the cluster by using the client when the team is in the office. Which solution provides the required connectivity MOST securely?

options.A: Create a VPC and two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Use AWS Site- to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
options.B: Create a VPC and two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN with a customer gateway in the company's office.
options.C: Create a VPC and two private subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the private subnets. Use RDS security groups to allow the company's office IP ranges to access the cluster.
options.D: Create a VPC and two public subnets. Create the RDS cluster in the public subnets. Create a cluster user for each developer. Use RDS security groups to allow the users to access the cluster.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Creating the RDS cluster in **private subnets** keeps the database off the public internet. AWS states that a DB subnet group is a collection of subnets, **typically private**, used for RDS DB instances, and that for a DB instance to be publicly accessible, all subnets in its DB subnet group must be public ([Amazon RDS DB subnet groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_VPC.WorkingWithRDSInstanceinaVPC.html)). AWS Site-to-Site VPN provides the required office-to-VPC connectivity: AWS describes it as a connection between a VPC and an on-premises network, supporting IPsec VPN, with a VPN connection being a **secure connection** and a VPN tunnel being an **encrypted link** between the customer network and AWS ([AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)). AWS also documents that a Site-to-Site VPN uses a customer gateway/customer gateway device on the on-premises side and a gateway on the AWS side ([How AWS Site-to-Site VPN works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/how_it_works.html)). This meets the requirement for direct client connectivity from the office while minimizing public exposure.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Uses public subnets for the RDS cluster. Although Site-to-Site VPN is secure, making the database publicly accessible is less secure than keeping it in private subnets.
- **C:** Private subnets plus security group rules for office IP ranges do not by themselves create network connectivity from the on-premises office to the VPC. A VPN or similar private connectivity path is still required.
- **D:** Public subnets and security group allowances expose the database path over the public internet. Creating database users does not solve the network-security requirement and is less secure than private subnets plus VPN.

zh.question: 一家公司的软件开发团队需要一个 Amazon RDS Multi-AZ cluster。该 RDS cluster 将作为部署在本地的桌面客户端的后端。该桌面客户端需要直接连接到 RDS cluster。公司必须让开发团队在办公室时能够使用该客户端连接到该集群。哪种解决方案能够以最安全的方式提供所需的连接？

options.A: 创建一个 VPC 和两个公有子网。在公有子网中创建 RDS cluster。使用 AWS Site- to-Site VPN，并在公司的办公室中配置 customer gateway。
options.B: 创建一个 VPC 和两个私有子网。在私有子网中创建 RDS cluster。使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN，并在公司的办公室中配置 customer gateway。
options.C: 创建一个 VPC 和两个私有子网。在私有子网中创建 RDS cluster。使用 RDS security groups 允许公司的办公室 IP 范围访问该集群。
options.D: 创建一个 VPC 和两个公有子网。在公有子网中创建 RDS cluster。为每位开发人员创建一个集群用户。使用 RDS security groups 允许这些用户访问该集群。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。**

在 **private subnets** 中创建 RDS cluster 可使数据库不暴露在公共互联网中。AWS 说明，DB subnet group 是一组子网的集合，**通常是私有的**，用于 RDS DB instances；并且如果某个 DB instance 要能够被公开访问，其 DB subnet group 中的所有子网都必须是公有子网（[Amazon RDS DB subnet groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_VPC.WorkingWithRDSInstanceinaVPC.html)）。AWS Site-to-Site VPN 提供所需的办公室到 VPC 连接：AWS 将其描述为 VPC 与本地网络之间的连接，支持 IPsec VPN，其中 VPN connection 是一个 **secure connection**，VPN tunnel 是客户网络与 AWS 之间的 **encrypted link**（[AWS Site-to-Site VPN](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)）。AWS 还记录了 Site-to-Site VPN 在本地侧使用 customer gateway/customer gateway device，并在 AWS 侧使用网关（[How AWS Site-to-Site VPN works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/how_it_works.html)）。这满足了从办公室进行直接客户端连接的要求，同时最大限度地减少公共暴露。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 对 RDS cluster 使用公有子网。虽然 Site-to-Site VPN 是安全的，但让数据库可公开访问不如将其保留在私有子网中安全。
- **C:** 私有子网加上针对办公室 IP 范围的 security group 规则，本身并不会创建从本地办公室到 VPC 的网络连接。仍然需要 VPN 或类似的私有连接路径。
- **D:** 公有子网和 security group 允许规则会使数据库路径暴露在公共互联网之上。创建数据库用户并不能解决网络安全要求，并且不如私有子网加 VPN 安全。

en.question: A solutions architect is creating an application that will handle batch processing of large amounts of data. The input data will be held in Amazon S3 and the output data will be stored in a different S3 bucket. For processing, the application will transfer the data over the network between multiple Amazon EC2 instances. What should the solutions architect do to reduce the overall data transfer costs?

options.A: Place all the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group.
options.B: Place all the EC2 instances in the same AWS Region.
options.C: Place all the EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone.
options.D: Place all the EC2 instances in private subnets in multiple Availability Zones.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **C. Place all the EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone.**

The cost-sensitive part of the question is that the application transfers large amounts of data **between multiple EC2 instances** during processing. AWS documentation identifies **data transfer between Availability Zones in the same Region** as regional data transfer usage that can be charged, with metering for inbound and outbound traffic for a resource ([Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)). Therefore, keeping the EC2 instances in the **same Availability Zone** avoids cross-AZ EC2-to-EC2 transfer charges and reduces data transfer cost. For the S3 portion, AWS also recommends accessing S3 buckets from EC2 instances in the **same Region** to reduce latency and data transfer costs ([Amazon S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. Auto Scaling group**: Auto Scaling changes capacity, but it does not by itself ensure that instances are colocated to avoid inter-AZ transfer costs.
- **B. Same AWS Region**: This helps for S3 access, but EC2 instances in different Availability Zones within that Region can still incur regional inter-AZ data transfer charges ([Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)).
- **D. Private subnets in multiple Availability Zones**: Private subnets do not eliminate data transfer charges, and spreading the EC2 instances across multiple AZs increases the chance of charged cross-AZ traffic.

zh.question: 一名解决方案架构师正在创建一个应用程序，用于处理大量数据的批处理。输入数据将保存在 Amazon S3 中，输出数据将存储在另一个 S3 存储桶中。在处理过程中，该应用程序将在多个 Amazon EC2 实例之间通过网络传输数据。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施来降低总体数据传输成本？

options.A: 将所有 EC2 实例放置在一个 Auto Scaling 组中。
options.B: 将所有 EC2 实例放置在同一个 AWS Region 中。
options.C: 将所有 EC2 实例放置在同一个 Availability Zone 中。
options.D: 将所有 EC2 实例放置在多个 Availability Zones 中的私有子网内。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C. 将所有 EC2 实例放置在同一个 Availability Zone 中。**

本题中对成本敏感的部分是：应用程序在处理过程中会在**多个 EC2 实例之间**传输大量数据。AWS 文档指出，**同一 Region 中 Availability Zones 之间的数据传输**属于区域性数据传输用量，可能会收费，并且会针对资源的入站和出站流量进行计量（[Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)）。因此，将 EC2 实例保留在**同一个 Availability Zone** 中，可以避免跨 AZ 的 EC2 到 EC2 传输费用，并降低数据传输成本。对于 S3 部分，AWS 也建议从**同一 Region** 中的 EC2 实例访问 S3 存储桶，以降低延迟和数据传输成本（[Amazon S3 performance guidelines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/optimizing-performance-guidelines.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. Auto Scaling group**：Auto Scaling 会改变容量，但它本身并不能确保实例共置在一起以避免跨 AZ 传输成本。
- **B. Same AWS Region**：这有助于访问 S3，但该 Region 内不同 Availability Zones 中的 EC2 实例仍可能产生区域性跨 AZ 数据传输费用（[Understanding data transfer charges](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cur/latest/userguide/cur-data-transfers-charges.html)）。
- **D. Private subnets in multiple Availability Zones**：私有子网不会消除数据传输费用，并且将 EC2 实例分散到多个 AZ 会增加产生收费的跨 AZ 流量的可能性。

en.question: A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company's IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days. What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.
options.B: Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.
options.C: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.
options.D: Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.** AWS Secrets Manager is the managed service designed to store, retrieve, and rotate database credentials. AWS documentation states that Secrets Manager helps manage and rotate database credentials and supports configuring an automatic rotation schedule, avoiding application updates when credentials rotate ([Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)). For Aurora, AWS documents that Aurora can manage the master user password in Secrets Manager, generate and store the password there, allow a customer managed KMS key or Secrets Manager KMS key for encryption, and that the rotation schedule can be modified ([Aurora password management with Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)). Secrets Manager also encrypts secret values with AWS KMS, and you can choose a customer managed symmetric KMS key when creating a secret ([Secrets Manager encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)). Therefore, using Secrets Manager with a KMS key and setting a 14-day rotation schedule meets the requirement with the least operational effort.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Systems Manager Parameter Store `SecureString` can store an encrypted password, but this option requires implementing and maintaining a custom Lambda rotation process. Secrets Manager/Aurora already provide managed credential storage and rotation capabilities, reducing operational effort.
- **C:** Storing credentials in an encrypted EFS file and writing custom Lambda rotation logic is a file-based, manually managed design. It does not use the native Aurora/Secrets Manager integration and adds unnecessary operational complexity.
- **D:** Storing credentials in an encrypted S3 object and periodically downloading them also requires custom rotation, distribution, and synchronization logic. This is more operationally burdensome than Secrets Manager, which is intended for programmatic retrieval and automatic rotation of secrets.

zh.question: 一家公司托管一个多层 Web 应用程序，该应用程序使用 Amazon Aurora MySQL DB 集群进行存储。应用程序层托管在 Amazon EC2 实例上。公司的 IT 安全准则要求数据库凭证必须加密，并且每 14 天轮换一次。解决方案架构师应采取什么措施，以用最少的运维工作量满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密密钥。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 创建一个使用该 KMS 密钥并包含相应凭证的新密钥。将该密钥与 Aurora DB 集群关联。配置 14 天的自定义轮换周期。
options.B: 在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中创建两个参数：一个用于用户名的字符串参数，另一个使用 SecureString 类型用于密码。为密码参数选择 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密，并在应用程序层加载这些参数。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 14 天轮换一次密码。
options.C: 将包含凭证的文件存储在 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统中。在应用程序层的所有 EC2 实例中挂载该 EFS 文件系统。限制文件系统上该文件的访问权限，使应用程序可以读取该文件，并且只有超级用户可以修改该文件。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 14 天在 Aurora 中轮换密钥，并将新凭证写入该文件。
options.D: 将包含凭证的文件存储在应用程序用于加载凭证的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶中。定期将该文件下载到应用程序，以确保使用正确的凭证。实现一个 AWS Lambda 函数，每 14 天轮换 Aurora 凭证，并将这些凭证上传到 S3 存储桶中的该文件。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。** AWS Secrets Manager 是一项托管服务，专为存储、检索和轮换数据库凭证而设计。AWS 文档指出，Secrets Manager 可帮助管理和轮换数据库凭证，并支持配置自动轮换计划，从而避免在凭证轮换时更新应用程序（[Secrets Manager overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)）。对于 Aurora，AWS 文档说明 Aurora 可以在 Secrets Manager 中管理主用户密码，在其中生成并存储密码，允许使用客户托管的 KMS 密钥或 Secrets Manager KMS 密钥进行加密，并且可以修改轮换计划（[Aurora password management with Secrets Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-secrets-manager.html)）。Secrets Manager 还会使用 AWS KMS 加密密钥值，并且你可以在创建密钥时选择客户托管的对称 KMS 密钥（[Secrets Manager encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)）。因此，使用 Secrets Manager 搭配 KMS 密钥并设置 14 天的轮换计划，可以用最少的运维工作量满足要求。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **B:** Systems Manager Parameter Store `SecureString` 可以存储加密密码，但此选项需要实现并维护自定义 Lambda 轮换流程。Secrets Manager/Aurora 已经提供托管的凭证存储和轮换功能，可减少运维工作量。
- **C:** 将凭证存储在加密的 EFS 文件中并编写自定义 Lambda 轮换逻辑，是一种基于文件、手动管理的设计。它没有使用原生的 Aurora/Secrets Manager 集成，并增加了不必要的运维复杂性。
- **D:** 将凭证存储在加密的 S3 对象中并定期下载，同样需要自定义轮换、分发和同步逻辑。这比 Secrets Manager 的运维负担更重，而 Secrets Manager 是为以编程方式检索和自动轮换密钥而设计的。

en.question: A streaming media company is rebuilding its infrastructure to accommodate increasing demand for video content that users consume daily. The company needs to process terabyte-sized videos to block some content in the videos. Video processing can take up to 20 minutes. The company needs a solution that will scale with demand and remain cost-effective. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS Lambda functions to process videos. Store video metadata in Amazon DynamoDB. Store video content in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) and AWS Fargate to implement microservices to process videos. Store video metadata in Amazon Aurora. Store video content in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
options.C: Use Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to process videos. Store video content in Amazon S3 Standard. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) for queuing and to decouple processing tasks.
options.D: Deploy a containerized video processing application on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) on Amazon EC2. Store video metadata in Amazon RDS in a single Availability Zone. Store video content in Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

Video processing can run for up to 20 minutes, so a container-based compute layer is a better fit than Lambda. AWS Fargate with Amazon ECS runs containers **without managing servers or EC2 clusters** and removes the need to provision, configure, or scale VM clusters, which supports scaling with demand and lower operational overhead ([AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)). Amazon ECS guidance also notes that ECS can run workloads from small environments to global scale and that, when architected appropriately, you pay only for resources needed when needed ([ECS auto scaling and capacity management best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-availability.html)). Storing large video objects in **S3 Intelligent-Tiering** is cost-effective because it monitors access patterns and automatically moves objects among frequent, infrequent, and archive instant access tiers without performance impact or operational overhead ([S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)). Aurora is appropriate for metadata because it is a fully managed relational database with high-performance storage that grows automatically and standardizes clustering and replication ([Amazon Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Lambda is not suitable because the maximum Lambda timeout is **900 seconds (15 minutes)**, while processing can take up to 20 minutes ([Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)).
- **C:** EC2 Auto Scaling with SQS could process asynchronous work, but it requires managing EC2-based capacity and stores video in **S3 Standard**, not S3 Intelligent-Tiering, so it is less aligned with the requirement for a cost-effective, low-operational-overhead solution for large video objects.
- **D:** EKS on EC2 adds more operational complexity than ECS on Fargate, the metadata database is single-AZ, and **S3 Glacier Deep Archive** is for archive data accessed less than once a year; objects are not available for real-time access and standard retrieval typically takes hours, making it unsuitable for daily-consumed video content ([S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)).

zh.question: 一家流媒体公司正在重建其基础设施，以适应用户每天消费的视频内容不断增长的需求。该公司需要处理 TB 级大小的视频，以屏蔽视频中的某些内容。视频处理最长可能需要 20 分钟。该公司需要一个能够随需求扩展并保持成本效益的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数处理视频。将视频元数据存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 中。将视频内容存储在 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 和 AWS Fargate 实现微服务来处理视频。将视频元数据存储在 Amazon Aurora 中。将视频内容存储在 Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering 中。
options.C: 使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例处理视频。将视频内容存储在 Amazon S3 Standard 中。使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 进行排队并解耦处理任务。
options.D: 在 Amazon EC2 上的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上部署容器化的视频处理应用程序。将视频元数据存储在单个 Availability Zone 中的 Amazon RDS 中。将视频内容存储在 Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

视频处理最长可能运行 20 分钟，因此基于容器的计算层比 Lambda 更合适。AWS Fargate 与 Amazon ECS 结合运行容器，**无需管理服务器或 EC2 集群**，并且无需预置、配置或扩展 VM 集群，这支持随需求扩展并降低运营开销（[AWS Fargate for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/AWS_Fargate.html)）。Amazon ECS 指南还指出，ECS 可以运行从小型环境到全球规模的工作负载，并且在架构设计得当的情况下，你只需在需要时为所需资源付费（[ECS auto scaling and capacity management best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/capacity-availability.html)）。将大型视频对象存储在 **S3 Intelligent-Tiering** 中具有成本效益，因为它会监控访问模式，并在频繁访问、低频访问和归档即时访问层之间自动移动对象，而不会影响性能或产生运营开销（[S3 Intelligent-Tiering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intelligent-tiering-overview.html)）。Aurora 适合用于元数据，因为它是一个完全托管的关系数据库，具有可自动增长的高性能存储，并对集群和复制进行了标准化（[Amazon Aurora overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** Lambda 不适合，因为 Lambda 的最大超时时间是 **900 秒（15 分钟）**，而处理最长可能需要 20 分钟（[Lambda timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)）。
- **C:** EC2 Auto Scaling 与 SQS 可以处理异步工作，但它需要管理基于 EC2 的容量，并且将视频存储在 **S3 Standard** 中，而不是 S3 Intelligent-Tiering，因此与针对大型视频对象的成本效益高、低运营开销解决方案这一要求不太一致。
- **D:** EKS on EC2 比 ECS on Fargate 增加了更多运营复杂性，元数据数据库是 single-AZ，并且 **S3 Glacier Deep Archive** 用于一年访问少于一次的归档数据；对象无法用于实时访问，标准检索通常需要数小时，因此不适合每日消费的视频内容（[S3 Glacier Deep Archive](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/glacier-storage-classes.html)）。

en.question: A company runs an on-premises application on a Kubernetes cluster. The company recently added millions of new customers. The company's existing on-premises infrastructure is unable to handle the large number of new customers. The company needs to migrate the on-premises application to the AWS Cloud. The company will migrate to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The company does not want to manage the underlying compute infrastructure for the new architecture on AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use a self-managed node to supply compute capacity. Deploy the application to the new EKS cluster.
options.B: Use managed node groups to supply compute capacity. Deploy the application to the new EKS cluster.
options.C: Use AWS Fargate to supply compute capacity. Create a Fargate profile. Use the Fargate profile to deploy the application.
options.D: Use managed node groups with Karpenter to supply compute capacity. Deploy the application to the new EKS cluster.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon EKS with AWS Fargate is the lowest-operational-overhead fit because Fargate runs Kubernetes Pods without requiring the company to provision, configure, or scale VM/node groups; AWS says you also do not need to choose server types, decide when to scale node groups, or optimize cluster packing. EKS uses **Fargate profiles** to control which Pods run on Fargate, and Pods matching the profile selectors are scheduled on Fargate. ([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html), [Fargate profiles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate-profile.html))

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A. Self-managed nodes** require the most operational work. AWS documentation notes that self-managed nodes require “a lot more manual maintenance,” so this does not meet the least-operational-overhead requirement. ([EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html))
- **B. Managed node groups** reduce some node lifecycle work, but they still use Amazon EC2 instances and Auto Scaling groups in the customer’s AWS account; the documentation also states you are responsible for deploying patched AMI versions to managed node groups. This is more operational overhead than Fargate. ([Managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html))
- **D. Managed node groups with Karpenter** still relies on EC2-backed node capacity and adds another provisioning/scaling component. Since the requirement is to avoid managing the underlying compute infrastructure, Fargate is a better match than node groups plus autoscaling tooling. ([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html), [Managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html))

zh.question: 一家公司在 Kubernetes 集群上运行本地应用程序。该公司最近新增了数百万新客户。该公司现有的本地基础设施无法处理大量新客户。公司需要将本地应用程序迁移到 AWS Cloud。公司将迁移到 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。公司不希望管理 AWS 上新架构的底层计算基础设施。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用自管理节点来提供计算容量。将应用程序部署到新的 EKS 集群。
options.B: 使用托管节点组来提供计算容量。将应用程序部署到新的 EKS 集群。
options.C: 使用 AWS Fargate 来提供计算容量。创建 Fargate 配置文件。使用 Fargate 配置文件部署应用程序。
options.D: 使用带有 Karpenter 的托管节点组来提供计算容量。将应用程序部署到新的 EKS 集群。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** 使用 AWS Fargate 的 Amazon EKS 是运营开销最低的选择，因为 Fargate 可以运行 Kubernetes Pods，而不要求公司预置、配置或扩展 VM/节点组；AWS 表示，您也不需要选择服务器类型、决定何时扩展节点组，或优化集群装箱。EKS 使用 **Fargate profiles** 来控制哪些 Pods 在 Fargate 上运行，匹配配置文件选择器的 Pods 会被调度到 Fargate 上。([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html), [Fargate profiles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate-profile.html))

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A. Self-managed nodes** 需要最多的运营工作。AWS 文档指出，自管理节点需要 “a lot more manual maintenance”，因此这不符合最少运营开销的要求。([EKS compute options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-compute.html))
- **B. Managed node groups** 减少了一部分节点生命周期工作，但它们仍然使用客户 AWS 账户中的 Amazon EC2 实例和 Auto Scaling 组；文档还说明，您负责将已修补的 AMI 版本部署到托管节点组。这比 Fargate 具有更多运营开销。([Managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html))
- **D. Managed node groups with Karpenter** 仍然依赖由 EC2 支撑的节点容量，并增加了另一个预置/扩展组件。由于要求是避免管理底层计算基础设施，因此 Fargate 比节点组加自动扩展工具更匹配。([EKS Fargate](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html), [Managed node groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/managed-node-groups.html))

en.question: A company is launching a new application that requires a structured database to store user profiles, application settings, and transactional data. The database must be scalable with application traffic and must offer backups. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Deploy a self-managed database on Amazon EC2 instances by using open source software. Use Spot Instances for cost optimization. Configure automated backups to Amazon S3.
options.B: Use Amazon RDS. Use on-demand capacity mode for the database with General Purpose SSD storage. Configure automatic backups with a retention period of 7 days.
options.C: Use Amazon Aurora Serverless for the database. Use serverless capacity scaling. Configure automated backups to Amazon S3.
options.D: Deploy a self-managed NoSQL database on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for cost optimization. Configure automated backups directly to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** Amazon Aurora is a fully managed, ACID-compliant relational database engine, suitable for structured application data and transactions. AWS states that Aurora PostgreSQL is a “fully managed, PostgreSQL-compatible, and ACID-compliant relational database engine” and that routine tasks such as backup and recovery are easy to manage with Aurora ([Aurora PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.AuroraPostgreSQL.html)). Aurora Serverless is specifically suited for a new application where the required DB size is uncertain: AWS says it can “autoscale to the capacity requirements of your application,” automatically scale for peak load, and scale back down afterward; AWS also notes that it is cost-effective because you pay only for database resources consumed ([Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)). Automated backup storage is stored in Amazon S3 for Amazon RDS/Aurora backups ([RDS automated backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)).

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** A self-managed database on EC2 creates operational overhead for provisioning, patching, backup, and recovery that Aurora manages for you. Spot Instances are intended for fault-tolerant workloads; AWS describes Spot as for “fault-tolerant workloads,” which is not ideal for a persistent transactional database ([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-leveraging-ec2-spot-instances/when-to-use-spot-instances.html)).
- **B:** Amazon RDS with General Purpose SSD and automated backups can meet many database requirements, but provisioned/on-demand database capacity is less cost-effective for an uncertain or variable new workload than Aurora Serverless, which scales capacity up and down and avoids overprovisioning ([Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)).
- **D:** The requirement is for a structured database with transactional data. A self-managed NoSQL database is not the best fit for relational structured/ACID transactional requirements, and it also adds EC2 operational overhead. Storing backups directly in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval is not as suitable for routine database backup and recovery as managed automated backups.

zh.question: 一家公司正在推出一个新应用程序，该应用程序需要一个结构化数据库来存储用户配置文件、应用程序设置和事务数据。该数据库必须能够随应用程序流量扩展，并且必须提供备份。哪种解决方案能够以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用开源软件在 Amazon EC2 实例上部署自管理数据库。使用 Spot Instances 进行成本优化。配置到 Amazon S3 的自动备份。
options.B: 使用 Amazon RDS。对数据库使用按需容量模式，并使用 General Purpose SSD 存储。配置保留期为 7 天的自动备份。
options.C: 对数据库使用 Amazon Aurora Serverless。使用无服务器容量扩展。配置到 Amazon S3 的自动备份。
options.D: 在 Amazon EC2 实例上部署自管理 NoSQL 数据库。使用 Reserved Instances 进行成本优化。配置直接到 Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 的自动备份。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** Amazon Aurora 是一个完全托管、符合 ACID 的关系数据库引擎，适用于结构化应用程序数据和事务。AWS 表示 Aurora PostgreSQL 是一个“完全托管、与 PostgreSQL 兼容且符合 ACID 的关系数据库引擎”，并且备份和恢复等例行任务可以通过 Aurora 轻松管理（[Aurora PostgreSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Aurora.AuroraPostgreSQL.html)）。Aurora Serverless 特别适合所需 DB 大小不确定的新应用程序：AWS 表示它可以“自动扩展到应用程序的容量需求”，针对峰值负载自动扩展，并在之后缩减；AWS 还指出它具有成本效益，因为你只需为实际消耗的数据库资源付费（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。对于 Amazon RDS/Aurora 备份，自动备份存储保存在 Amazon S3 中（[RDS automated backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_WorkingWithAutomatedBackups.html)）。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 在 EC2 上运行自管理数据库会产生 Aurora 可替你管理的配置、修补、备份和恢复等运维开销。Spot Instances 适用于容错型工作负载；AWS 将 Spot 描述为用于“容错型工作负载”，这对于持久性事务数据库并不理想（[Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/whitepapers/latest/cost-optimization-leveraging-ec2-spot-instances/when-to-use-spot-instances.html)）。
- **B:** 使用 General Purpose SSD 和自动备份的 Amazon RDS 可以满足许多数据库需求，但对于不确定或可变的新工作负载，预置/按需数据库容量不如 Aurora Serverless 具有成本效益；Aurora Serverless 可以上下扩展容量并避免过度预置（[Using Aurora serverless](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-serverless-v2.html)）。
- **D:** 要求是用于事务数据的结构化数据库。自管理 NoSQL 数据库并不最适合关系型结构化/ACID 事务要求，而且还会增加 EC2 运维开销。与托管自动备份相比，将备份直接存储在 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 中并不适合常规数据库备份和恢复。

en.question: A company runs its legacy web application on AWS. The web application server runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in the public subnet of a VPC. The web application server collects images from customers and stores the image files in a locally attached Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The image files are uploaded every night to an Amazon S3 bucket for backup. A solutions architect discovers that the image files are being uploaded to Amazon S3 through the public endpoint. The solutions architect needs to ensure that traffic to Amazon S3 does not use the public endpoint. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for the S3 bucket that has the necessary permissions for the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to use the gateway VPC endpoint.
options.B: Move the S3 bucket inside the VPC. Configure the subnet route table to access the S3 bucket through private IP addresses.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 access point for the Amazon EC2 instance inside the VPConfigure the web application to upload by using the Amazon S3 access point.
options.D: Configure an AWS Direct Connect connection between the VPC that has the Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon S3 to provide a dedicated network path.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

A gateway VPC endpoint is the intended solution for private connectivity from resources in a VPC to Amazon S3. AWS states that you can access S3 from a VPC using **gateway VPC endpoints**, and after creating the endpoint you add it as a **target in the route table** for traffic destined to S3. AWS also states that with an S3 gateway endpoint, you can access S3 from the VPC **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device** and at no additional charge ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). The S3 User Guide also describes a gateway endpoint as a gateway specified in a route table to access S3 from a VPC over the AWS network ([Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** You cannot “move” an S3 bucket inside a VPC. The documented pattern is to access S3 **from** a VPC using VPC endpoints, not to place S3 buckets in VPC subnets ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)).
- **C:** S3 access points are primarily for simplifying and controlling access to S3 data. They can enforce permissions and network controls, but the option does not configure the VPC route path to S3. The requirement is specifically to avoid the public endpoint path; AWS documents VPC endpoints as the mechanism for routing VPC-to-S3 traffic over the AWS network ([Managing access to shared datasets with access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html), [Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).
- **D:** Direct Connect links an internal/on-premises network to AWS through a Direct Connect location. This scenario is EC2 in a VPC accessing S3, so Direct Connect is not the appropriate in-VPC solution ([What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS 上运行其旧版 Web 应用程序。该 Web 应用程序服务器运行在 VPC 公有子网中的一个 Amazon EC2 实例上。Web 应用程序服务器从客户处收集图像，并将图像文件存储在本地挂载的 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷中。图像文件每晚都会上传到一个 Amazon S3 bucket 进行备份。解决方案架构师发现，图像文件正在通过公有端点上传到 Amazon S3。解决方案架构师需要确保发往 Amazon S3 的流量不使用公有端点。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 S3 bucket 创建一个 gateway VPC endpoint，并为该 VPC 配置必要的权限。配置子网路由表以使用该 gateway VPC endpoint。
options.B: 将 S3 bucket 移入 VPC 内部。配置子网路由表，通过私有 IP 地址访问该 S3 bucket。
options.C: 为 VPConfigure 内部的 Amazon EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon S3 access point。配置 Web 应用程序使用该 Amazon S3 access point 进行上传。
options.D: 在具有 Amazon EC2 实例的 VPC 与 Amazon S3 之间配置 AWS Direct Connect 连接，以提供专用网络路径。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**
