gateway VPC endpoint 是从 VPC 中的资源到 Amazon S3 进行私有连接的预期解决方案。AWS 说明，你可以使用 **gateway VPC endpoints** 从 VPC 访问 S3，并且在创建端点后，你需要将其添加为目标为 S3 的流量在路由表中的 **target**。AWS 还说明，使用 S3 gateway endpoint 时，你可以从 VPC 访问 S3，**无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device**，并且不收取额外费用（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。S3 User Guide 还将 gateway endpoint 描述为在路由表中指定的网关，用于通过 AWS 网络从 VPC 访问 S3（[Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 你不能将 S3 bucket “移动”到 VPC 内部。文档化的模式是使用 VPC endpoints **从** VPC 访问 S3，而不是将 S3 buckets 放置在 VPC 子网中（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。
- **C:** S3 access points 主要用于简化和控制对 S3 数据的访问。它们可以强制执行权限和网络控制，但该选项没有配置到 S3 的 VPC 路由路径。要求明确是避免公有端点路径；AWS 将 VPC endpoints 记录为通过 AWS 网络路由 VPC-to-S3 流量的机制（[Managing access to shared datasets with access points](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/access-points.html), [Types of VPC endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。
- **D:** Direct Connect 通过 Direct Connect location 将内部/本地网络连接到 AWS。此场景是 VPC 中的 EC2 访问 S3，因此 Direct Connect 不是合适的 VPC 内解决方案（[What is Direct Connect?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company is creating a prototype of an ecommerce website on AWS. The website consists of an Application Load Balancer, an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances for web servers, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance that runs with the Single-AZ configuration. The website is slow to respond during searches of the product catalog. The product catalog is a group of tables in the MySQL database that the company does not update frequently. A solutions architect has determined that the CPU utilization on the DB instance is high when product catalog searches occur. What should the solutions architect recommend to improve the performance of the website during searches of the product catalog?

options.A: Migrate the product catalog to an Amazon Redshift database. Use the COPY command to load the product catalog tables.
options.B: Implement an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to cache the product catalog. Use lazy loading to populate the cache.
options.C: Add an additional scaling policy to the Auto Scaling group to launch additional EC2 instances when database response is slow.
options.D: Turn on the Multi-AZ configuration for the DB instance. Configure the EC2 instances to throttle the product catalog queries that are sent to the database.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** The bottleneck is repeated product-catalog reads against MySQL, and the catalog changes infrequently. AWS states that ElastiCache query caching is effective for **read-heavy applications where the same queries are executed repeatedly with data that changes infrequently**, and for high-concurrency cases where offloading reads to ElastiCache reduces database CPU pressure and improves throughput ([Amazon ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html)). Lazy loading is also a fit: the application checks the cache first; on a cache miss it reads from the database and then writes the result into the cache for faster later retrieval ([ElastiCache lazy loading](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Redshift** is not the best fit for low-latency ecommerce catalog lookups. AWS describes Amazon Redshift as a **data warehouse** that integrates with ETL, BI reporting, data mining, and analytics tools, and its architecture is designed for complex analytical queries ([Amazon Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_high_level_system_architecture.html)).
- **C. Scaling the EC2 Auto Scaling group** does not address the identified bottleneck: high CPU on the RDS DB instance during searches. Adding web servers would likely increase the number of database queries rather than reduce database CPU load.
- **D. Multi-AZ for the existing DB instance** improves availability, not search performance for a single-standby Multi-AZ DB instance. AWS states that a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has one standby DB instance that provides failover support but **doesn't serve read traffic** ([Amazon RDS Multi-AZ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html)). Throttling queries would reduce user experience rather than improving catalog-search performance.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上创建一个电子商务网站的原型。该网站由一个 Application Load Balancer、一个用于 Web 服务器的 Amazon EC2 实例 Auto Scaling 组，以及一个以 Single-AZ 配置运行的 Amazon RDS for MySQL DB 实例组成。在搜索产品目录时，网站响应缓慢。产品目录是 MySQL 数据库中的一组表，公司并不经常更新这些表。解决方案架构师已确定，在发生产品目录搜索时，DB 实例上的 CPU 利用率很高。解决方案架构师应建议什么来改善网站在搜索产品目录时的性能？

options.A: 将产品目录迁移到 Amazon Redshift 数据库。使用 COPY 命令加载产品目录表。
options.B: 实施一个 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis 集群来缓存产品目录。使用延迟加载来填充缓存。
options.C: 向 Auto Scaling 组添加额外的扩展策略，以便在数据库响应缓慢时启动额外的 EC2 实例。
options.D: 为 DB 实例开启 Multi-AZ 配置。配置 EC2 实例对发送到数据库的产品目录查询进行限流。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** 瓶颈在于针对 MySQL 的重复产品目录读取，而该目录很少变化。AWS 表示，ElastiCache 查询缓存对于**读密集型应用程序非常有效，在这些应用程序中，相同的查询会对变化不频繁的数据重复执行**；在高并发场景中，将读取卸载到 ElastiCache 可以降低数据库 CPU 压力并提高吞吐量 ([Amazon ElastiCache query caching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/caching-database-query-results.html))。延迟加载也很适合：应用程序首先检查缓存；如果缓存未命中，则从数据库读取，然后将结果写入缓存，以便之后更快检索 ([ElastiCache lazy loading](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/Strategies.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Redshift** 并不最适合低延迟的电子商务目录查找。AWS 将 Amazon Redshift 描述为一个**数据仓库**，它可与 ETL、BI 报告、数据挖掘和分析工具集成，其架构专为复杂分析查询而设计 ([Amazon Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_high_level_system_architecture.html))。
- **C. 扩展 EC2 Auto Scaling 组** 并不能解决已识别的瓶颈：搜索期间 RDS DB 实例上的 CPU 很高。添加 Web 服务器很可能会增加数据库查询数量，而不是降低数据库 CPU 负载。
- **D. 现有 DB 实例的 Multi-AZ** 可提高可用性，而不是提高单备用 Multi-AZ DB 实例的搜索性能。AWS 表示，Multi-AZ DB 实例部署有一个备用 DB 实例用于提供故障转移支持，但**不提供读取流量服务** ([Amazon RDS Multi-AZ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZ.html))。对查询进行限流会降低用户体验，而不是改善目录搜索性能。

en.question: A company currently stores 5 TB of data in on-premises block storage systems. The company's current storage solution provides limited space for additional data. The company runs applications on premises that must be able to retrieve frequently accessed data with low latency. The company requires a cloud- based storage solution. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 File Gateway. Integrate S3 File Gateway with the on-premises applications to store and directly retrieve files by using the SMB file system.
options.B: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes as iSCSI targets.
options.C: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with stored volumes as iSCSI targets.
options.D: Use an AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway. Integrate Tape Gateway with the on-premises applications to store virtual tapes in Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway with cached volumes as iSCSI targets.**

The company is using on-premises **block storage** and needs a cloud-based solution while preserving low-latency access for **frequently accessed** data. AWS states that Volume Gateway provides cloud-backed storage volumes mounted as **iSCSI devices** from on-premises application servers. For **cached volumes**, data is stored in Amazon S3 while a copy of frequently accessed subsets is retained locally; this minimizes the need to scale on-premises storage and retains low-latency access to frequently accessed data ([AWS Volume Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). This directly matches the limited on-premises capacity and low-latency hot-data requirements.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** S3 File Gateway is file-based, providing access to S3 through NFS or SMB file protocols, not block storage/iSCSI volumes. It is not the best match for applications currently using block storage ([AWS S3 File Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).
- **C:** Stored volumes provide low-latency access to the **entire dataset** by storing all data locally and asynchronously backing it up to S3 ([AWS Volume Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)). That does not address the limited on-premises storage capacity as operationally efficiently as cached volumes.
- **D:** Tape Gateway is for cloud-backed virtual tape storage and archiving backup data in S3 Glacier storage classes, not for low-latency application block storage access ([AWS Tape Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司目前在本地块存储系统中存储 5 TB 数据。该公司当前的存储解决方案可用于额外数据的空间有限。该公司在本地运行应用程序，这些应用程序必须能够以低延迟检索频繁访问的数据。该公司需要一个基于云的存储解决方案。哪种解决方案将以最高运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon S3 File Gateway。将 S3 File Gateway 与本地应用程序集成，通过使用 SMB 文件系统来存储并直接检索文件。
options.B: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway，并将缓存卷作为 iSCSI 目标。
options.C: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway，并将存储卷作为 iSCSI 目标。
options.D: 使用 AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway。将 Tape Gateway 与本地应用程序集成，以在 Amazon S3 中存储虚拟磁带。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 使用 AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway，并将缓存卷作为 iSCSI 目标。**

该公司正在使用本地 **block storage**，并且需要一个基于云的解决方案，同时为**频繁访问**的数据保留低延迟访问。AWS 表示，Volume Gateway 提供由云支持的存储卷，这些卷从本地应用程序服务器挂载为 **iSCSI devices**。对于**缓存卷**，数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，同时在本地保留频繁访问子集的副本；这最大限度地减少了扩展本地存储的需求，并保留了对频繁访问数据的低延迟访问（[AWS Volume Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。这直接符合本地容量有限以及对热数据低延迟访问的要求。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** S3 File Gateway 是基于文件的，通过 NFS 或 SMB 文件协议提供对 S3 的访问，而不是块存储/iSCSI 卷。对于当前使用块存储的应用程序，它不是最佳匹配（[AWS S3 File Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。
- **C:** 存储卷通过将所有数据存储在本地并异步备份到 S3，为**整个数据集**提供低延迟访问（[AWS Volume Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。与缓存卷相比，这无法以同样高的运营效率解决本地存储容量有限的问题。
- **D:** Tape Gateway 用于云支持的虚拟磁带存储，并将备份数据归档到 S3 Glacier 存储类中，而不是用于低延迟的应用程序块存储访问（[AWS Tape Gateway docs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/tgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。

en.question: A company operates a food delivery service. Because of recent growth, the company's order processing system is experiencing scaling problems during peak traffic hours. The current architecture includes Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group that collect orders from an application. A second group of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group fulfills the orders. The order collection process occurs quickly, but the order fulfillment process can take longer. Data must not be lost because of a scaling event. A solutions architect must ensure that the order collection process and the order fulfillment process can both scale adequately during peak traffic hours. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the CPUUtilization metric for each instance in both Auto Scaling groups. Configure each Auto Scaling group's minimum capacity to meet its peak workload value.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the CPUUtilization metric for each instance in both Auto Scaling groups. Configure a CloudWatch alarm to invoke an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to create additional Auto Scaling groups on demand.
options.C: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use one SQS queue for order collection. Use the second SQS queue for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queues. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on notifications that the queues send.
options.D: Provision two Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use one SQS queue for order collection. Use the second SQS queue for order fulfillment. Configure the EC2 instances to poll their respective queues. Scale the Auto Scaling groups based on the number of messages in each queue.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

Using SQS queues decouples the fast order-collection tier from the slower order-fulfillment tier. Amazon SQS distributed queues store messages redundantly across multiple SQS servers, which helps ensure orders are not lost if worker instances scale in or are replaced ([Resilience in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html)). AWS also documents this exact scaling pattern: an Auto Scaling group processes messages from an SQS queue, CloudWatch tracks queue backlog, and a target tracking policy scales the group based on the queue backlog/number of messages per instance ([Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)). AWS further notes that messages not processed when an instance is terminated are returned to the SQS queue for another instance to process, supporting the “no data loss because of a scaling event” requirement ([Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Scaling both Auto Scaling groups primarily on `CPUUtilization` does not directly reflect the backlog of orders waiting to be processed. Setting minimum capacity to peak workload is static overprovisioning, not adequate dynamic scaling for variable peak traffic.
- **B:** CPU-based alarms and SNS-triggered creation of additional Auto Scaling groups is not the documented scaling pattern. AWS documents scaling the existing Auto Scaling group with scaling policies based on SQS backlog metrics, not creating new Auto Scaling groups on demand.
- **C:** SQS is appropriate, but the scaling trigger is wrong. Queues do not “send notifications” to scale Auto Scaling groups in this pattern; AWS documents using CloudWatch metrics/alarms and scaling policies based on the number of queued messages or backlog per instance ([Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运营一项食品配送服务。由于最近的增长，该公司的订单处理系统在流量高峰时段遇到扩展问题。当前架构包括一个 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例，这些实例从应用程序收集订单。第二个 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例负责履行订单。订单收集过程发生得很快，但订单履行过程可能需要更长时间。数据不得因为扩展事件而丢失。解决方案架构师必须确保订单收集过程和订单履行过程都能在流量高峰时段充分扩展。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控两个 Auto Scaling 组中每个实例的 CPUUtilization 指标。将每个 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量配置为满足其峰值工作负载值。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控两个 Auto Scaling 组中每个实例的 CPUUtilization 指标。配置 CloudWatch 警报以调用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，从而按需创建额外的 Auto Scaling 组。
options.C: 预置两个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。使用一个 SQS 队列进行订单收集。使用第二个 SQS 队列进行订单履行。配置 EC2 实例轮询各自的队列。根据队列发送的通知来扩展 Auto Scaling 组。
options.D: 预置两个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。使用一个 SQS 队列进行订单收集。使用第二个 SQS 队列进行订单履行。配置 EC2 实例轮询各自的队列。根据每个队列中的消息数量来扩展 Auto Scaling 组。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

使用 SQS 队列可以将快速的订单收集层与较慢的订单履行层解耦。Amazon SQS 分布式队列会在多个 SQS 服务器之间冗余存储消息，这有助于确保在工作实例缩减或被替换时订单不会丢失（[Resilience in Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html)）。AWS 还记录了这种确切的扩展模式：一个 Auto Scaling 组处理来自 SQS 队列的消息，CloudWatch 跟踪队列积压，并且目标跟踪策略根据队列积压/每个实例的消息数量来扩展该组（[Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。AWS 进一步指出，当实例终止时未处理的消息会返回到 SQS 队列，以便另一个实例处理，从而支持“不会因为扩展事件而导致数据丢失”的要求（[Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 主要根据 `CPUUtilization` 扩展两个 Auto Scaling 组并不能直接反映等待处理的订单积压。将最小容量设置为峰值工作负载是静态的过度预置，而不是针对可变峰值流量的充分动态扩展。
- **B:** 基于 CPU 的警报以及通过 SNS 触发创建额外 Auto Scaling 组并不是记录在案的扩展模式。AWS 记录的是根据 SQS 积压指标，使用扩展策略来扩展现有 Auto Scaling 组，而不是按需创建新的 Auto Scaling 组。
- **C:** SQS 是合适的，但扩展触发方式错误。在这种模式中，队列不会“发送通知”来扩展 Auto Scaling 组；AWS 记录的是使用 CloudWatch 指标/警报以及基于排队消息数量或每个实例积压的扩展策略（[Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)）。

en.question: An online gaming company is transitioning user data storage to Amazon DynamoDB to support the company's growing user base. The current architecture includes DynamoDB tables that contain user profiles, achievements, and in-game transactions. The company needs to design a robust, continuously available, and resilient DynamoDB architecture to maintain a seamless gaming experience for users. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create DynamoDB tables in a single AWS Region. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use global tables to replicate data across multiple Regions.
options.B: Use DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) to cache frequently accessed data. Deploy tables in a single AWS Region and enable auto scaling. Configure Cross-Region Replication manually to additional Regions.
options.C: Create DynamoDB tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use on-demand capacity mode. Use DynamoDB Streams for Cross-Region Replication between Regions.
options.D: Use DynamoDB global tables for automatic multi-Region replication. Deploy tables in multiple AWS Regions. Use provisioned capacity mode. Enable auto scaling.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.** DynamoDB global tables are a fully managed, multi-Region, multi-active feature that automatically replicates table data across Regions, provides fast local reads/writes, and is intended for business continuity and high availability. Any replica can serve reads and writes, and applications can shift traffic to another Region for high resilience and low/zero RPO if one Region is interrupted ([Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)). For capacity, AWS states that a global table must be either on-demand or **provisioned with auto scaling enabled**; with provisioned auto scaling, settings are replicated across Regions, and auto scaling adjusts capacity based on consumption ([Throughput capacity planning for DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-global-table-design.prescriptive-guidance.throughput.html)). Provisioned mode is appropriate when workloads are steady or can be forecast and provides cost predictability, while auto scaling decreases throughput when workload decreases so you do not pay for unused provisioned capacity ([DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html), [DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)). This best matches robust, continuously available, resilient, and cost-effective multi-Region DynamoDB architecture.

**Why the other options are wrong:**

- **A:** Global tables with on-demand capacity would provide multi-Region availability, but on-demand is pay-per-request and is chosen when you do not want to plan capacity. For a large/growing gaming workload where capacity can be managed, provisioned capacity with auto scaling gives better cost predictability. The option also starts by saying tables are in a single Region, which is less directly aligned with the required multi-Region resilient design.
- **B:** DAX can improve read latency by caching frequently accessed data, but it does not provide DynamoDB multi-Region replication or business continuity. Manually configured cross-Region replication also contradicts the AWS-managed benefit of global tables, which replicate automatically without building and maintaining your own replication solution ([Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)).
- **C:** DynamoDB Streams can be used as part of custom replication logic, but this requires building and operating replication and conflict-handling yourself. Global tables are the AWS-managed feature for automatic multi-Region replication and high availability, so this is less robust and less operationally efficient than D.

zh.question: 一家在线游戏公司正在将用户数据存储迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB，以支持公司不断增长的用户群。当前架构包括包含用户资料、成就和游戏内交易的 DynamoDB 表。公司需要设计一个稳健、持续可用且具有弹性的 DynamoDB 架构，以便为用户维持无缝的游戏体验。哪种解决方案能够以最高成本效益满足这些要求？

options.A: 在单个 AWS Region 中创建 DynamoDB 表。使用按需容量模式。使用全局表在多个 Region 之间复制数据。
options.B: 使用 DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) 缓存频繁访问的数据。在单个 AWS Region 中部署表并启用自动扩缩。手动配置 Cross-Region Replication 到其他 Region。
options.C: 在多个 AWS Region 中创建 DynamoDB 表。使用按需容量模式。使用 DynamoDB Streams 在 Region 之间进行 Cross-Region Replication。
options.D: 使用 DynamoDB global tables 进行自动多 Region 复制。在多个 AWS Region 中部署表。使用预置容量模式。启用自动扩缩。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。** DynamoDB global tables 是一项完全托管的、多 Region、多活功能，可自动跨 Region 复制表数据，提供快速的本地读/写，并且旨在实现业务连续性和高可用性。任何副本都可以提供读取和写入服务；如果某个 Region 中断，应用程序可以将流量切换到另一个 Region，以获得高弹性和低/零 RPO（[Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。对于容量，AWS 声明 global table 必须是按需模式，或者是**启用自动扩缩的预置模式**；使用预置自动扩缩时，设置会跨 Region 复制，并且自动扩缩会根据消耗情况调整容量（[Throughput capacity planning for DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/bp-global-table-design.prescriptive-guidance.throughput.html)）。当工作负载稳定或可预测时，预置模式是合适的，并且能提供成本可预测性；而自动扩缩会在工作负载下降时降低吞吐量，因此你不必为未使用的预置容量付费（[DynamoDB throughput capacity](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/capacity-mode.html), [DynamoDB auto scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/AutoScaling.html)）。这最符合稳健、持续可用、具有弹性且具有成本效益的多 Region DynamoDB 架构。

**其他选项错误的原因：**

- **A:** 使用按需容量的 Global tables 可以提供多 Region 可用性，但按需模式是按请求付费，并且适用于你不想规划容量的情况。对于大型/不断增长的游戏工作负载，如果可以管理容量，启用自动扩缩的预置容量能够提供更好的成本可预测性。该选项还一开始说明表位于单个 Region，这与所需的多 Region 弹性设计不够直接一致。
- **B:** DAX 可以通过缓存频繁访问的数据来改善读取延迟，但它不提供 DynamoDB 多 Region 复制或业务连续性。手动配置的跨 Region 复制也与 global tables 的 AWS 托管优势相矛盾；global tables 会自动复制，而无需构建和维护你自己的复制解决方案（[Global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)）。
- **C:** DynamoDB Streams 可以作为自定义复制逻辑的一部分使用，但这需要你自己构建和运维复制以及冲突处理。Global tables 是用于自动多 Region 复制和高可用性的 AWS 托管功能，因此相比 D，此选项不够稳健，且运营效率更低。

en.question: A company runs its media rendering application on premises. The company wants to reduce storage costs and has moved all data to Amazon S3. The on-premises rendering application needs low-latency access to storage. The company needs to design a storage solution for the application. The storage solution must maintain the desired application performance. Which storage solution will meet these requirements in the MOST cost-effective way?

options.A: Use Mountpoint for Amazon S3 to access the data in Amazon S3 for the on-premises application.
options.B: Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.
options.C: Copy the data from Amazon S3 to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.
options.D: Configure an on-premises file server. Use the Amazon S3 API to connect to S3 storage. Configure the application to access the storage from the on-premises file server.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway to provide storage for the on-premises application.**

Amazon S3 File Gateway is designed for exactly this hybrid file-access pattern: it lets on-premises applications store and retrieve objects in Amazon S3 through standard file protocols such as NFS and SMB, and AWS says it is a cost-effective alternative to on-premises storage that provides **low-latency access through transparent local caching** ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)). AWS also recommends deploying the gateway close to NFS/SMB clients because lower latency between clients and the gateway improves performance, and S3 File Gateway is designed to tolerate higher latency between the gateway and Amazon S3 than between the gateway and clients ([S3 File Gateway throughput guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance-Throughput.html)).

- **A is incorrect:** Mountpoint for Amazon S3 can mount an S3 bucket as a local file system and is suitable for high-throughput, read-heavy workloads, but it translates file operations into S3 API calls and supports only basic file system operations; it is not the best fit for an on-premises application needing low-latency cached file access through standard NFS/SMB protocols ([Mountpoint for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mountpoint.html)).
- **C is incorrect:** FSx File Gateway provides low-latency access to **FSx for Windows File Server** shares and requires an FSx for Windows File Server file system; copying all data from S3 into FSx adds another managed file system and is less cost-effective when the data already resides in S3. Also, AWS states FSx File Gateway is no longer available to new customers ([Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)).
- **D is incorrect:** Building an on-premises file server that uses the S3 API would add self-managed infrastructure and would not provide the managed transparent local caching and NFS/SMB integration that S3 File Gateway provides for low-latency on-premises access ([Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在本地运行其媒体渲染应用程序。该公司希望降低存储成本，并已将所有数据迁移到 Amazon S3。本地渲染应用程序需要低延迟访问存储。该公司需要为该应用程序设计一个存储解决方案。该存储解决方案必须维持所需的应用程序性能。哪种存储解决方案将以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Mountpoint for Amazon S3 为本地应用程序访问 Amazon S3 中的数据。
options.B: 配置 Amazon S3 File Gateway 为本地应用程序提供存储。
options.C: 将数据从 Amazon S3 复制到 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server。配置 Amazon FSx File Gateway 为本地应用程序提供存储。
options.D: 配置本地文件服务器。使用 Amazon S3 API 连接到 S3 存储。配置应用程序从本地文件服务器访问该存储。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. 配置 Amazon S3 File Gateway 为本地应用程序提供存储。**

Amazon S3 File Gateway 正是为这种混合文件访问模式而设计的：它允许本地应用程序通过 NFS 和 SMB 等标准文件协议在 Amazon S3 中存储和检索对象，并且 AWS 表示它是本地存储的一种具有成本效益的替代方案，可通过**透明的本地缓存提供低延迟访问**（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。AWS 还建议将 gateway 部署在靠近 NFS/SMB 客户端的位置，因为客户端与 gateway 之间较低的延迟可以提升性能，并且 S3 File Gateway 的设计能够容忍 gateway 与 Amazon S3 之间的延迟高于 gateway 与客户端之间的延迟（[S3 File Gateway throughput guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/Performance-Throughput.html)）。

- **A 不正确：** Mountpoint for Amazon S3 可以将 S3 bucket 挂载为本地文件系统，并适用于高吞吐量、以读取为主的工作负载，但它会将文件操作转换为 S3 API 调用，并且仅支持基本文件系统操作；对于需要通过标准 NFS/SMB 协议进行低延迟缓存文件访问的本地应用程序而言，它不是最佳选择（[Mountpoint for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mountpoint.html)）。
- **C 不正确：** FSx File Gateway 提供对 **FSx for Windows File Server** 共享的低延迟访问，并且需要一个 FSx for Windows File Server 文件系统；在数据已经位于 S3 中的情况下，将所有数据从 S3 复制到 FSx 会增加另一个托管文件系统，成本效益较低。此外，AWS 表示 FSx File Gateway 不再面向新客户提供（[Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)）。
- **D 不正确：** 构建一个使用 S3 API 的本地文件服务器会增加自管理基础设施，并且无法提供 S3 File Gateway 为低延迟本地访问所提供的托管透明本地缓存和 NFS/SMB 集成（[Amazon S3 File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/what-is-file-s3.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts its enterprise resource planning (ERP) system in the us-east-1 Region. The system runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Customers use a public API that is hosted on the EC2 instances to exchange information with the ERP system. International customers report slow API response times from their data centers. Which solution will improve response times for the international customers MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an AWS Direct Connect connection that has a public virtual interface (VIF) to provide connectivity from each customer's data center to us-east-1. Route customer API requests by using a Direct Connect gateway to the ERP system API.
options.B: Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API. Configure the CachingOptimized managed cache policy to provide improved cache efficiency.
options.C: Set up AWS Global Accelerator. Configure listeners for the necessary ports. Configure endpoint groups for the appropriate Regions to distribute traffic. Create an endpoint in the group for the API.
options.D: Use AWS Site-to-Site VPN to establish dedicated VPN tunnels between Regions and customer networks. Route traffic to the API over the VPN connections.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** AWS Global Accelerator is designed to improve performance for applications used by global users. AWS states that Global Accelerator improves application performance for local and global users and, for standard accelerators, routes traffic over the AWS global network to endpoints based on client location, health, and configured policies; supported endpoints include **Amazon EC2 instances** [What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html). Its traffic path uses the AWS global network and edge TCP termination to provide “faster response times (lower latency) and increased throughput” [How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html). This directly matches a public API on EC2 in us-east-1 with international customers experiencing latency.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. Direct Connect public VIF**: Direct Connect would require customer-specific connectivity and BGP/public VIF provisioning; AWS notes public VIF requests can take up to **72 business hours** for review and approval [Create a Direct Connect public virtual interface](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-public-vif.html). Creating connections from each customer data center is not the most cost-effective or scalable way to accelerate a public API for many international customers.
- **B. CloudFront with CachingOptimized policy**: CloudFront can accelerate cacheable content, but this option specifically chooses the **CachingOptimized** policy. AWS says this policy optimizes cache efficiency by excluding query strings and cookies from the cache key and has a minimum TTL greater than 0, causing CloudFront to cache content even with `no-cache`, `no-store`, or `private` directives [Use managed cache policies - CachingOptimized](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-managed-cache-policies.html). That is a poor fit for an ERP information-exchange API that is likely dynamic and request-specific.
- **D. Site-to-Site VPN**: AWS Site-to-Site VPN is a secure IPsec connection between an on-premises network and a VPC, with customer gateway devices and VPN tunnels [What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html). Building VPNs with each customer network does not cost-effectively improve a public API’s global response times.

zh.question: 一家公司在 us-east-1 Region 托管其企业资源计划 (ERP) 系统。该系统运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上。客户使用托管在 EC2 实例上的公共 API 与 ERP 系统交换信息。国际客户报告称，从他们的数据中心访问该 API 的响应时间较慢。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式改善国际客户的响应时间？

options.A: 创建一个具有公共虚拟接口 (VIF) 的 AWS Direct Connect 连接，以提供从每个客户的数据中心到 us-east-1 的连接。使用 Direct Connect 网关将客户 API 请求路由到 ERP 系统 API。
options.B: 在 API 前面设置一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配。配置 CachingOptimized 托管缓存策略，以提高缓存效率。
options.C: 设置 AWS Global Accelerator。为必要的端口配置侦听器。为适当的 Regions 配置端点组以分发流量。在该组中为 API 创建一个端点。
options.D: 使用 AWS Site-to-Site VPN 在 Regions 和客户网络之间建立专用 VPN 隧道。通过 VPN 连接将流量路由到 API。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** AWS Global Accelerator 旨在提升全球用户所使用应用程序的性能。AWS 表示，Global Accelerator 可提升本地和全球用户的应用程序性能，并且对于标准加速器，会基于客户端位置、运行状况和配置的策略，通过 AWS 全球网络将流量路由到端点；支持的端点包括 **Amazon EC2 instances** [What is AWS Global Accelerator?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/what-is-global-accelerator.html)。其流量路径使用 AWS 全球网络和边缘 TCP 终止来提供“更快的响应时间（更低延迟）和更高吞吐量” [How AWS Global Accelerator works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/introduction-how-it-works.html)。这与 us-east-1 中 EC2 上的公共 API 以及遇到延迟的国际客户这一场景直接匹配。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. Direct Connect public VIF**：Direct Connect 需要特定于客户的连接以及 BGP/public VIF 配置；AWS 指出 public VIF 请求的审核和批准最多可能需要 **72 business hours** [Create a Direct Connect public virtual interface](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/create-public-vif.html)。从每个客户数据中心创建连接，并不是为许多国际客户加速公共 API 的最具成本效益或可扩展的方式。
- **B. CloudFront with CachingOptimized policy**：CloudFront 可以加速可缓存内容，但此选项特别选择了 **CachingOptimized** 策略。AWS 表示，该策略通过从缓存键中排除查询字符串和 Cookie 来优化缓存效率，并且其最小 TTL 大于 0，这会导致 CloudFront 即使在存在 `no-cache`、`no-store` 或 `private` 指令时也缓存内容 [Use managed cache policies - CachingOptimized](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/using-managed-cache-policies.html)。这并不适合很可能是动态且特定于请求的 ERP 信息交换 API。
- **D. Site-to-Site VPN**：AWS Site-to-Site VPN 是本地网络与 VPC 之间的安全 IPsec 连接，涉及客户网关设备和 VPN 隧道 [What is AWS Site-to-Site VPN?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpn/latest/s2svpn/VPC_VPN.html)。与每个客户网络建立 VPN，并不能以具成本效益的方式改善公共 API 的全球响应时间。

en.question: A company tracks customer satisfaction by using surveys that the company hosts on its website. The surveys sometimes reach thousands of customers every hour. Survey results are currently sent in email messages to the company so company employees can manually review results and assess customer sentiment. The company wants to automate the customer survey process. Survey results must be available for the previous 12 months. Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST scalable way?

options.A: Send the survey results data to an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that is connected to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Create an AWS Lambda function to poll the SQS queue, call Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis, and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Set the TTL for all records to 365 days in the future.
options.B: Send the survey results data to an API that is running on an Amazon EC2 instance. Configure the API to store the survey results as a new record in an Amazon DynamoDB table, call Amazon Comprehend for sentiment analysis, and save the results in a second DynamoDB table. Set the TTL for all records to 365 days in the future.
options.C: Write the survey results data to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function to read the data and call Amazon Rekognition for sentiment analysis. Store the sentiment analysis results in a second S3 bucket. Use S3 lifecycle policies on each bucket to expire objects after 365 days.
options.D: Send the survey results data to an Amazon API Gateway endpoint that is connected to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the SQS queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function that calls Amazon Lex for sentiment analysis and saves the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Set the TTL for all records to 365 days in the future.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **A**.

**Why A is correct:** The survey traffic can spike to thousands per hour, so a decoupled serverless ingestion and processing pipeline is the most scalable fit. API Gateway can integrate with SQS using the **SQS-SendMessage** integration, which “delivers a message to the specified queue” ([API Gateway SQS integration reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-develop-integrations-aws-services-reference.html)). Lambda can then process the queue because, with SQS event source mappings, “Lambda polls the queue and invokes your function,” and each event can contain a batch of messages ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)). Amazon Comprehend is the correct managed ML service for text sentiment: AWS states that you can use Comprehend “to determine the sentiment of content in UTF-8 encoded text documents” and that it supports operations such as `DetectSentiment` and `BatchDetectSentiment` ([Amazon Comprehend Sentiment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/how-sentiment.html)). DynamoDB TTL satisfies the 12-month retention requirement because TTL lets you define a per-item expiration timestamp, after which DynamoDB automatically deletes expired items ([DynamoDB TTL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Running the API on an EC2 instance is less scalable and more operationally burdensome than using API Gateway + SQS + Lambda. It also tightly couples ingestion, sentiment analysis, and storage instead of buffering bursts with SQS.
- **C:** Amazon Rekognition is not the right service for survey text sentiment. AWS describes Rekognition as an image and video analysis service with computer vision capabilities, not text sentiment analysis ([Amazon Rekognition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html)).
- **D:** Amazon Lex is not the correct service for sentiment analysis of survey results. AWS describes Lex as a service for building conversational interfaces and chatbots using voice and text, not for general sentiment detection ([Amazon Lex V2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lexv2/latest/dg/what-is.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司通过在其网站上托管的调查来跟踪客户满意度。这些调查有时每小时会触达数千名客户。调查结果目前通过电子邮件发送给公司，以便公司员工可以手动审查结果并评估客户情绪。公司希望自动化客户调查流程。必须能够获取过去 12 个月的调查结果。哪种解决方案将以最具可扩展性的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将调查结果数据发送到连接到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列的 Amazon API Gateway 端点。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来轮询 SQS 队列，调用 Amazon Comprehend 进行情绪分析，并将结果保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。将所有记录的 TTL 设置为未来 365 天。
options.B: 将调查结果数据发送到在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的 API。配置该 API 将调查结果作为新记录存储在 Amazon DynamoDB 表中，调用 Amazon Comprehend 进行情绪分析，并将结果保存在第二个 DynamoDB 表中。将所有记录的 TTL 设置为未来 365 天。
options.C: 将调查结果数据写入 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 S3 Event Notifications 调用 AWS Lambda 函数来读取数据并调用 Amazon Rekognition 进行情绪分析。将情绪分析结果存储在第二个 S3 存储桶中。对每个存储桶使用 S3 生命周期策略，使对象在 365 天后过期。
options.D: 将调查结果数据发送到连接到 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列的 Amazon API Gateway 端点。配置 SQS 队列调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数调用 Amazon Lex 进行情绪分析并将结果保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。将所有记录的 TTL 设置为未来 365 天。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **A**。

**为什么 A 正确：** 调查流量可能激增到每小时数千次，因此解耦的无服务器摄取和处理管道是最具可扩展性的选择。API Gateway 可以使用 **SQS-SendMessage** 集成与 SQS 集成，该集成“将消息传递到指定队列”([API Gateway SQS integration reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/http-api-develop-integrations-aws-services-reference.html))。随后 Lambda 可以处理该队列，因为使用 SQS 事件源映射时，“Lambda 轮询队列并调用你的函数”，且每个事件可以包含一批消息 ([Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html))。Amazon Comprehend 是用于文本情绪分析的正确托管 ML 服务：AWS 表示你可以使用 Comprehend “确定 UTF-8 编码文本文档中内容的情绪”，并且它支持 `DetectSentiment` 和 `BatchDetectSentiment` 等操作 ([Amazon Comprehend Sentiment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/how-sentiment.html))。DynamoDB TTL 满足 12 个月保留要求，因为 TTL 允许你定义每个项目的过期时间戳，之后 DynamoDB 会自动删除已过期的项目 ([DynamoDB TTL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/TTL.html))。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 在 EC2 实例上运行 API 的可扩展性较低，且运维负担比使用 API Gateway + SQS + Lambda 更大。它还将摄取、情绪分析和存储紧密耦合在一起，而不是使用 SQS 缓冲突发流量。
- **C:** Amazon Rekognition 不是用于调查文本情绪分析的正确服务。AWS 将 Rekognition 描述为具有计算机视觉功能的图像和视频分析服务，而不是文本情绪分析服务 ([Amazon Rekognition](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/rekognition/latest/dg/what-is.html))。
- **D:** Amazon Lex 不是用于调查结果情绪分析的正确服务。AWS 将 Lex 描述为一种使用语音和文本构建对话式界面和聊天机器人的服务，而不是用于通用情绪检测 ([Amazon Lex V2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lexv2/latest/dg/what-is.html))。

en.question: A company uses AWS Systems Manager for routine management and patching of Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an IP address type target group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). New security protocols require the company to remove EC2 instances from service during a patch. When the company attempts to follow the security protocol during the next patch, the company receives errors during the patching window. Which combination of solutions will resolve the errors? (Choose two.)

options.A: Change the target type of the target group from IP address type to instance type.
options.B: Continue to use the existing Systems Manager document without changes because it is already optimized to handle instances that are in an IP address type target group behind an ALB.
options.C: Implement the AWSEC2-PatchLoadBalanacerInstance Systems Manager Automation document to manage the patching process.
options.D: Use Systems Manager Maintenance Windows to automatically remove the instances from service to patch the instances.
options.E: Configure Systems Manager State Manager to remove the instances from service and manage the patching schedule. Use ALB health checks to re-route traffic.

en.explanation:
The best answers are **C and D**.

- **C is correct** because the AWS-managed `AWSEC2-PatchLoadBalancerInstance` Automation runbook is specifically designed to patch an EC2 instance attached to a Classic Load Balancer, ALB, or NLB. Its workflow determines the load balancer or target group, verifies the instance is healthy, removes the instance from the load balancer or target group, waits for connection draining, runs `AWS-RunPatchBaseline`, and then reattaches the instance ([AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-awsec2-patch-load-balancer-instance.html)).
- **D is correct** because Systems Manager Maintenance Windows are intended for high-priority, time-bound operations such as patching. AWS specifically notes that patching often involves removing nodes from a load balancer, patching them, and putting them back into production as a series of tasks in a patch window ([Choosing between State Manager and Maintenance Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-vs-maintenance-windows.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A is incorrect** because changing the target group target type is not the right fix; AWS states that after a target group is created, you **can't change its target type**. Also, the managed Automation runbook already handles removing and reattaching targets during patching ([ALB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)).
- **B is incorrect** because continuing to use an existing generic patching document would not satisfy the new requirement to remove instances from service unless it performs the deregister/drain/patch/reregister workflow. The AWS-managed runbook in option C provides that workflow.
- **E is incorrect** because State Manager is primarily for maintaining desired configuration state and compliance, whereas AWS recommends Maintenance Windows when operations are time-sensitive and include patching during specified periods. ALB health checks alone do not provide the required controlled removal, draining, patching, and reattachment workflow.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Systems Manager 对 Amazon EC2 实例进行日常管理和修补。这些 EC2 实例位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 IP 地址类型目标组中。新的安全协议要求公司在修补期间将 EC2 实例从服务中移除。当公司在下一次修补期间尝试遵循该安全协议时，公司在修补窗口期间收到错误。哪种解决方案组合将解决这些错误？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将目标组的目标类型从 IP 地址类型更改为实例类型。
options.B: 继续使用现有的 Systems Manager 文档且不进行更改，因为它已经针对处理位于 ALB 后面的 IP 地址类型目标组中的实例进行了优化。
options.C: 实施 AWSEC2-PatchLoadBalanacerInstance Systems Manager Automation 文档来管理修补过程。
options.D: 使用 Systems Manager Maintenance Windows 自动将实例从服务中移除以修补实例。
options.E: 配置 Systems Manager State Manager 以将实例从服务中移除并管理修补计划。使用 ALB 运行状况检查来重新路由流量。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **C 和 D**。

- **C 正确**，因为 AWS 托管的 `AWSEC2-PatchLoadBalancerInstance` Automation runbook 专门用于修补附加到 Classic Load Balancer、ALB 或 NLB 的 EC2 实例。其工作流会确定负载均衡器或目标组，验证实例是否健康，将实例从负载均衡器或目标组中移除，等待连接耗尽，运行 `AWS-RunPatchBaseline`，然后重新附加实例（[AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-awsec2-patch-load-balancer-instance.html)）。
- **D 正确**，因为 Systems Manager Maintenance Windows 旨在用于高优先级、有时间限制的操作，例如修补。AWS 特别指出，修补通常涉及将节点从负载均衡器中移除、修补它们，然后在修补窗口中以一系列任务的形式将它们放回生产环境（[Choosing between State Manager and Maintenance Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-vs-maintenance-windows.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A 不正确**，因为更改目标组目标类型不是正确的修复方法；AWS 声明，在创建目标组后，你**无法更改其目标类型**。此外，托管的 Automation runbook 已经可以在修补期间处理移除和重新附加目标（[ALB target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-target-groups.html)）。
- **B 不正确**，因为继续使用现有的通用修补文档无法满足将实例从服务中移除的新要求，除非它执行注销/耗尽连接/修补/重新注册工作流。选项 C 中的 AWS 托管 runbook 提供了该工作流。
- **E 不正确**，因为 State Manager 主要用于维护所需的配置状态和合规性，而 AWS 建议在操作具有时间敏感性并包括在指定时段内进行修补时使用 Maintenance Windows。仅靠 ALB 运行状况检查无法提供所需的受控移除、连接耗尽、修补和重新附加工作流。

en.question: A medical company wants to perform transformations on a large amount of clinical trial data that comes from several customers. The company must extract the data from a relational database that contains the customer data. Then the company will transform the data by using a series of complex rules. The company will load the data to Amazon S3 when the transformations are complete. All data must be encrypted where it is processed before the company stores the data in Amazon S3. All data must be encrypted by using customer-specific keys. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational effort?

options.A: Create one AWS Glue job for each customer. Attach a security configuration to each job that uses server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3) to encrypt the data.
options.B: Create one Amazon EMR cluster for each customer. Attach a security configuration to each cluster that uses client-side encryption with a custom client-side root key (CSE-Custom) to encrypt the data.
options.C: Create one AWS Glue job for each customer. Attach a security configuration to each job that uses client-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (CSE-KMS) to encrypt the data.
options.D: Create one Amazon EMR cluster for each customer. Attach a security configuration to each cluster that uses server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) to encrypt the data.

en.explanation:
The correct answer is **C**.

**C. Create one AWS Glue job for each customer. Attach a security configuration to each job that uses client-side encryption with AWS KMS managed keys (CSE-KMS) to encrypt the data.**

AWS Glue is the best fit because this is an ETL workload: extract data from a relational database, transform it with complex rules, and load the transformed data to Amazon S3. AWS Glue is a managed ETL service that provisions and manages the resources required to run ETL jobs, reducing operational effort compared with managing clusters yourself ([AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)).

Using a separate AWS Glue job and security configuration per customer allows the company to associate customer-specific encryption settings with each customer’s processing workflow. AWS Glue security configurations define encryption properties used by jobs, and AWS Glue supports AWS KMS-based client-side encryption settings such as CSE-KMS in its security configuration model ([Managing security configurations on the AWS Glue console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/console-security-configurations.html)). This satisfies the requirement to encrypt data where it is processed and to use customer-specific keys, while avoiding the operational overhead of managing Amazon EMR clusters.

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A. AWS Glue with SSE-S3** is not sufficient because SSE-S3 uses Amazon S3 managed keys, not customer-specific keys. The requirement explicitly states that all data must be encrypted by using customer-specific keys.

- **B. Amazon EMR with CSE-Custom** can provide client-side encryption, but it requires creating and managing an EMR cluster for each customer and implementing a custom key provider. AWS documentation for EMR CSE-Custom states that you must implement a custom `Keyring` and provide custom code/JARs, which increases operational effort ([Setup CSE-CUSTOM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-s3a-cse-custom.html)). This is not the least operationally intensive solution.

- **D. Amazon EMR with SSE-KMS** uses customer-managed KMS keys, but it still requires creating and operating EMR clusters for each customer. Amazon EMR supports security configurations for encryption, including Amazon S3 and local disk encryption, but managing separate clusters adds more operational overhead than using serverless AWS Glue jobs ([Encryption options for Amazon EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-data-encryption-options.html)). In addition, SSE-KMS is server-side encryption, whereas the requirement emphasizes encryption where the data is processed before storage in Amazon S3.

zh.question: 一家医疗公司希望对来自多个客户的大量临床试验数据执行转换。该公司必须从包含客户数据的关系数据库中提取数据。然后，公司将使用一系列复杂规则转换数据。转换完成后，公司会将数据加载到 Amazon S3。所有数据在公司将其存储到 Amazon S3 之前，必须在处理位置进行加密。所有数据都必须使用客户特定的密钥进行加密。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 为每个客户创建一个 AWS Glue 作业。为每个作业附加一个安全配置，该配置使用 Amazon S3 托管密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE-S3) 来加密数据。
options.B: 为每个客户创建一个 Amazon EMR 集群。为每个集群附加一个安全配置，该配置使用带有自定义客户端根密钥的客户端加密 (CSE-Custom) 来加密数据。
options.C: 为每个客户创建一个 AWS Glue 作业。为每个作业附加一个安全配置，该配置使用 AWS KMS 托管密钥的客户端加密 (CSE-KMS) 来加密数据。
options.D: 为每个客户创建一个 Amazon EMR 集群。为每个集群附加一个安全配置，该配置使用 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS) 来加密数据。

zh.explanation:
正确答案是 **C**。

**C. 为每个客户创建一个 AWS Glue 作业。为每个作业附加一个安全配置，该配置使用 AWS KMS 托管密钥的客户端加密 (CSE-KMS) 来加密数据。**

AWS Glue 是最佳选择，因为这是一个 ETL 工作负载：从关系数据库提取数据，使用复杂规则转换数据，并将转换后的数据加载到 Amazon S3。AWS Glue 是一项托管 ETL 服务，可预置并管理运行 ETL 作业所需的资源，与自行管理集群相比，可减少运营工作量（[AWS Glue: How it works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/how-it-works.html)）。为每个客户使用单独的 AWS Glue 作业和安全配置，使公司能够将客户特定的加密设置与每个客户的处理工作流相关联。AWS Glue 安全配置定义作业使用的加密属性，并且 AWS Glue 在其安全配置模型中支持基于 AWS KMS 的客户端加密设置，例如 CSE-KMS（[Managing security configurations on the AWS Glue console](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/console-security-configurations.html)）。这满足了在数据处理位置加密数据并使用客户特定密钥的要求，同时避免了管理 Amazon EMR 集群的运营开销。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **A. AWS Glue with SSE-S3** 不足以满足要求，因为 SSE-S3 使用 Amazon S3 托管密钥，而不是客户特定密钥。要求明确指出所有数据都必须使用客户特定的密钥进行加密。

- **B. Amazon EMR with CSE-Custom** 可以提供客户端加密，但它需要为每个客户创建并管理一个 EMR 集群，并实现自定义密钥提供程序。有关 EMR CSE-Custom 的 AWS 文档指出，必须实现自定义 `Keyring` 并提供自定义代码/JAR，这会增加运营工作量（[Setup CSE-CUSTOM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ReleaseGuide/emr-s3a-cse-custom.html)）。这不是运营强度最低的解决方案。

- **D. Amazon EMR with SSE-KMS** 使用客户管理的 KMS keys，但仍然需要为每个客户创建和运行 EMR 集群。Amazon EMR 支持用于加密的安全配置，包括 Amazon S3 和本地磁盘加密，但与使用无服务器 AWS Glue 作业相比，管理单独集群会增加更多运营开销（[Encryption options for Amazon EMR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/emr/latest/ManagementGuide/emr-data-encryption-options.html)）。此外，SSE-KMS 是服务器端加密，而要求强调的是在将数据存储到 Amazon S3 之前，在数据处理位置进行加密。

en.question: A company hosts a website analytics application on a single Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance. The analytics application is highly resilient and is designed to run in stateless mode. The company notices that the application is showing signs of performance degradation during busy times and is presenting 5xx errors. The company needs to make the application scale seamlessly. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.
options.B: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization is more than 75%.
options.D: Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group that includes the launch template. Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: D.**

The application is stateless and resilient, so it is a good fit for horizontal scaling. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling organizes EC2 instances into Auto Scaling groups that use launch templates, can add capacity for peak loads and remove capacity when demand is lower, and can use Spot and On-Demand purchase options to optimize cost through Spot usage ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)). Attaching an Application Load Balancer is also appropriate because Elastic Load Balancing distributes incoming traffic across EC2 instances so that no one instance is overwhelmed, automatically registers/deregisters Auto Scaling group instances, and can use ALB metrics such as request count per target to scale as demand fluctuates ([Use Elastic Load Balancing with an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)). Spot capacity is the most cost-effective purchase option here because AWS documents Spot savings compared with the equivalent On-Demand total ([Spot Instance savings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-savings.html)). AWS also documents that Spot Fleets can be scaled with target tracking, step scaling, and scheduled scaling policies ([Amazon EC2 Spot Fleet and Application Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-ec2.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** A second On-Demand instance behind an ALB improves capacity, but it is a fixed-size deployment. It does not scale seamlessly up and down with changing demand, and On-Demand-only capacity is not the most cost-effective compared with Spot usage.
- **B:** Route 53 weighted routing can distribute DNS responses, but it is not a seamless application scaling solution. It does not automatically register/deregister scaled instances or use ALB target metrics the way an Auto Scaling group with Elastic Load Balancing can.
- **C:** Stopping an instance to change its instance type is vertical scaling and is disruptive, not seamless. It also leaves the workload dependent on a single instance and does not provide elastic horizontal scaling or load distribution.

zh.question: 一家公司在单个 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance 上托管一个网站分析应用程序。该分析应用程序具有很高的弹性，并设计为以无状态模式运行。公司注意到该应用程序在繁忙时段出现性能下降的迹象，并且会返回 5xx 错误。公司需要使该应用程序能够无缝扩展。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建该 Web 应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 启动第二个 EC2 On-Demand Instance。使用 Application Load Balancer 在两个 EC2 实例之间分配负载。
options.B: 创建该 Web 应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。使用该 AMI 启动第二个 EC2 On-Demand Instance。使用 Amazon Route 53 加权路由在两个 EC2 实例之间分配负载。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来停止 EC2 实例并更改实例类型。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报，当 CPU 利用率超过 75% 时调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 创建该 Web 应用程序的 Amazon Machine Image (AMI)。将该 AMI 应用于启动模板。创建一个包含该启动模板的 Auto Scaling 组。配置启动模板以使用 Spot Fleet。将 Application Load Balancer 附加到该 Auto Scaling 组。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：D。**

该应用程序是无状态且具有弹性的，因此非常适合水平扩展。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 将 EC2 实例组织到使用启动模板的 Auto Scaling 组中，可以在峰值负载时增加容量，在需求较低时移除容量，并且可以使用 Spot 和 On-Demand 购买选项，通过 Spot 使用来优化成本（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/what-is-amazon-ec2-auto-scaling.html)）。附加 Application Load Balancer 也是合适的，因为 Elastic Load Balancing 会在 EC2 实例之间分配传入流量，确保没有单个实例被压垮，自动注册/注销 Auto Scaling 组实例，并且可以使用 ALB 指标（例如每个目标的请求计数）根据需求波动进行扩展（[Use Elastic Load Balancing with an Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)）。Spot 容量是这里最具成本效益的购买选项，因为 AWS 文档说明了与等效 On-Demand 总成本相比的 Spot 节省情况（[Spot Instance savings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/spot-savings.html)）。AWS 还记录了 Spot Fleets 可以通过目标跟踪、步进扩展和计划扩展策略进行扩展（[Amazon EC2 Spot Fleet and Application Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-ec2.html)）。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 在 ALB 后面添加第二个 On-Demand 实例可以提高容量，但这是固定规模的部署。它不能随着需求变化无缝地上下扩展，而且与使用 Spot 相比，仅使用 On-Demand 容量并不是最具成本效益的做法。
- **B:** Route 53 加权路由可以分配 DNS 响应，但它不是无缝的应用程序扩展解决方案。它不会像结合 Elastic Load Balancing 的 Auto Scaling 组那样自动注册/注销已扩展的实例，也不会使用 ALB 目标指标。
- **C:** 停止实例以更改其实例类型属于垂直扩展，并且具有中断性，不是无缝的。它还会使工作负载仍然依赖单个实例，并且不提供弹性的水平扩展或负载分配。

en.question: A company runs an environment where data is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The objects are accessed frequently throughout the day. The company has strict da ta encryption requirements for data that is stored in the S3 bucket. The company currently uses AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) for encryption. The company wants to optimize costs associated with encrypting S3 objects without making additional calls to AWS KMS. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3).
options.B: Use an S3 Bucket Key for server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) on the new objects.
options.C: Use client-side encryption with AWS KMS customer managed keys.
options.D: Use server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) stored in AWS KMS.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B. Use an S3 Bucket Key for SSE-KMS on the new objects.**

The company already uses AWS KMS and wants to reduce encryption-related cost without causing additional AWS KMS calls for frequently accessed S3 objects. AWS documentation states that without an S3 Bucket Key, S3 makes a call to AWS KMS every time a request is made against a KMS-encrypted object. When an S3 Bucket Key is configured for SSE-KMS, S3 uses a short-lived bucket-level key that reduces the need for S3 to call AWS KMS, and subsequent requests that use the bucket-level key do **not** result in AWS KMS API requests. AWS also states that S3 Bucket Keys can reduce AWS KMS request costs by up to 99% and can be configured for SSE-KMS on new objects ([Reducing the cost of SSE-KMS with Amazon S3 Bucket Keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-key.html), [Using SSE-KMS: Amazon S3 Bucket Keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A. SSE-S3** encrypts objects with Amazon S3 managed keys and has no additional SSE-S3 fees, but it changes the encryption approach away from AWS KMS. The question says the company currently uses AWS KMS and wants to optimize costs associated with encrypting S3 objects, not abandon SSE-KMS ([Using server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)).
- **C. Client-side encryption with AWS KMS customer managed keys** would not meet the requirement to avoid additional AWS KMS calls; using AWS KMS keys still involves KMS cryptographic operations, and it also shifts encryption/decryption work to the client rather than optimizing S3 SSE-KMS access patterns.
- **D. SSE-C stored in AWS KMS** is not a valid solution as stated. With SSE-C, the customer provides and manages the encryption keys; S3 never stores the encryption key, and the key must be supplied with requests. It is not “stored in AWS KMS” ([Using server-side encryption with customer-provided keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司运行的环境将数据存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。这些对象全天都会被频繁访问。该公司对存储在 S3 bucket 中的数据有严格的数据加密要求。该公司目前使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 进行加密。该公司希望在不对 AWS KMS 进行额外调用的情况下，优化与加密 S3 对象相关的成本。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用带有 Amazon S3 托管密钥的服务器端加密 (SSE-S3)。
options.B: 对新对象使用 S3 Bucket Key 进行带有 AWS KMS keys 的服务器端加密 (SSE-KMS)。
options.C: 使用带有 AWS KMS customer managed keys 的客户端加密。
options.D: 使用存储在 AWS KMS 中的客户提供密钥进行服务器端加密 (SSE-C)。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B. Use an S3 Bucket Key for SSE-KMS on the new objects.**

该公司已经使用 AWS KMS，并且希望在不导致频繁访问的 S3 对象产生额外 AWS KMS 调用的情况下降低与加密相关的成本。AWS 文档说明，如果没有 S3 Bucket Key，每次针对 KMS 加密对象发出请求时，S3 都会调用 AWS KMS。当为 SSE-KMS 配置 S3 Bucket Key 时，S3 会使用一个短期的 bucket 级别密钥，从而减少 S3 调用 AWS KMS 的需要，并且使用该 bucket 级别密钥的后续请求**不会**产生 AWS KMS API 请求。AWS 还说明，S3 Bucket Keys 可以将 AWS KMS 请求成本降低高达 99%，并且可以为新对象配置 SSE-KMS（[Reducing the cost of SSE-KMS with Amazon S3 Bucket Keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-key.html)，[Using SSE-KMS: Amazon S3 Bucket Keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A. SSE-S3** 使用 Amazon S3 托管密钥加密对象，并且没有额外的 SSE-S3 费用，但它会将加密方式从 AWS KMS 改为其他方式。题目说明该公司目前使用 AWS KMS，并且希望优化与加密 S3 对象相关的成本，而不是放弃 SSE-KMS（[Using server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingServerSideEncryption.html)）。
- **C. Client-side encryption with AWS KMS customer managed keys** 不符合避免额外 AWS KMS 调用的要求；使用 AWS KMS keys 仍然涉及 KMS 加密操作，而且它还会将加密/解密工作转移到客户端，而不是优化 S3 SSE-KMS 访问模式。
- **D. SSE-C stored in AWS KMS** 按照表述并不是一个有效的解决方案。使用 SSE-C 时，客户提供并管理加密密钥；S3 从不存储加密密钥，并且请求中必须提供该密钥。它并不是“stored in AWS KMS”（[Using server-side encryption with customer-provided keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/ServerSideEncryptionCustomerKeys.html)）。

en.question: A company runs multiple workloads on virtual machines (VMs) in an on-premises data center. The company is expanding rapidly. The on-premises data center is not able to scale fast enough to meet business needs. The company wants to migrate the workloads to AWS. The migration is time sensitive. The company wants to use a lift-and-shift strategy for non-critical workloads. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) to collect data about the VMs.
options.B: Use AWS Application Migration Service. Install the AWS Replication Agent on the VMs.
options.C: Complete the initial replication of the VMs. Launch test instances to perform acceptance tests on the VMs.
options.D: Stop all operations on the VMs. Launch a cutover instance.
options.E: Use AWS App2Container (A2C) to collect data about the VMs.
options.F: Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to migrate the VMs.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **B, C, and D**.

AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) is the appropriate service for this time-sensitive VM rehost: AWS describes it as a “highly automated lift-and-shift (rehost) solution” that can migrate physical, virtual, or cloud servers and replicate source servers into the AWS account before launching them on AWS ([AWS MGN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/what-is-mgn.html)).

- **B is correct**: AWS MGN requires installing the AWS Replication Agent on each source server to add it to Application Migration Service ([Installing the AWS Replication Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/agent-installation.html)).
- **C is correct**: After servers are added and launch settings are configured, AWS says it is crucial to launch test instances before cutover to verify that the source servers function properly in AWS ([Launching test instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/launching-test-servers.html)).
- **D is correct**: After testing is finalized, AWS MGN performs cutover, migrating source servers to cutover instances on AWS; the process includes launching cutover instances from the Test and cutover menu ([Launching a cutover instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/launch-cutover-gs.html)). Stopping source operations is consistent with a planned cutover window to avoid ongoing changes during transition.

Incorrect options:

- **A**: AWS SCT is for database schema conversion, not collecting and migrating entire VMs. AWS DMS documentation says AWS SCT converts source schemas for database migrations ([AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).
- **E**: AWS App2Container transforms applications running in VMs into containers and generates artifacts for ECS/EKS, which is containerization/modernization, not a simple VM lift-and-shift ([App2Container pattern](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/migrate-on-premises-java-applications-to-aws-using-aws-app2container.html)).
- **F**: AWS DMS migrates databases, data warehouses, NoSQL databases, and other data stores; it does not migrate whole VMs ([AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在本地数据中心的虚拟机 (VMs) 上运行多个工作负载。该公司正在快速扩张。本地数据中心无法足够快速地扩展以满足业务需求。该公司希望将工作负载迁移到 AWS。迁移具有时间敏感性。该公司希望对非关键工作负载使用 lift-and-shift 策略。哪组步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT) 收集有关 VMs 的数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS Application Migration Service。在 VMs 上安装 AWS Replication Agent。
options.C: 完成 VMs 的初始复制。启动测试实例以对 VMs 执行验收测试。
options.D: 停止 VMs 上的所有操作。启动 cutover 实例。
options.E: 使用 AWS App2Container (A2C) 收集有关 VMs 的数据。
options.F: 使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 迁移 VMs。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **B、C 和 D**。

AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) 是适用于这种时间敏感型 VM rehost 的服务：AWS 将其描述为一种“高度自动化的 lift-and-shift (rehost) 解决方案”，可以迁移物理服务器、虚拟服务器或云服务器，并在 AWS 上启动之前将源服务器复制到 AWS 账户中（[AWS MGN overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/what-is-mgn.html)）。

- **B 正确**：AWS MGN 要求在每台源服务器上安装 AWS Replication Agent，以将其添加到 Application Migration Service（[Installing the AWS Replication Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/agent-installation.html)）。
- **C 正确**：在添加服务器并配置启动设置后，AWS 表示，在 cutover 之前启动测试实例至关重要，以验证源服务器在 AWS 中能否正常运行（[Launching test instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/launching-test-servers.html)）。
- **D 正确**：测试完成后，AWS MGN 执行 cutover，将源服务器迁移到 AWS 上的 cutover 实例；该流程包括从 Test and cutover 菜单启动 cutover 实例（[Launching a cutover instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/mgn/latest/ug/launch-cutover-gs.html)）。停止源端操作与计划的 cutover 窗口一致，可避免在过渡期间持续发生变更。错误选项：

- **A**：AWS SCT 用于数据库架构转换，而不是收集和迁移整个 VMs。AWS DMS 文档指出，AWS SCT 为数据库迁移转换源架构（[AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。
- **E**：AWS App2Container 将在 VMs 中运行的应用程序转换为容器，并为 ECS/EKS 生成构件，这属于容器化/现代化，而不是简单的 VM lift-and-shift（[App2Container pattern](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/migrate-on-premises-java-applications-to-aws-using-aws-app2container.html)）。
- **F**：AWS DMS 迁移数据库、数据仓库、NoSQL 数据库和其他数据存储；它不会迁移整个 VMs（[AWS DMS overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。

en.question: A company hosts an application in a private subnet. The company has already integrated the application with Amazon Cognito. The company uses an Amazon Cognito user pool to authenticate users. The company needs to modify the application so the application can securely store user documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Which combination of steps will securely integrate Amazon S3 with the application? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool to generate secure Amazon S3 access tokens for users when they successfully log in.
options.B: Use the existing Amazon Cognito user pool to generate Amazon S3 access tokens for users when they successfully log in.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 VPC endpoint in the same VPC where the company hosts the application.
options.D: Create a NAT gateway in the VPC where the company hosts the application. Assign a policy to the S3 bucket to deny any request that is not initiated from Amazon Cognito.
options.E: Attach a policy to the S3 bucket that allows access only from the users' IP addresses.

en.explanation:
The correct choices are **A and C**.

- **A is correct** because an Amazon Cognito **identity pool** is the component that exchanges authenticated identity information for temporary AWS credentials. AWS states that identity pools “generate temporary AWS credentials for the users of your app” and can “sign API requests to AWS services like Amazon S3.” A user pool can be configured as an identity provider to the identity pool, and users can exchange the user pool token for AWS credentials to make signed requests to AWS services ([Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)).
- **C is correct** because the application is in a private subnet and needs private, secure connectivity to S3. Amazon S3 supports VPC endpoints; a gateway endpoint lets resources in a VPC access S3 over the AWS network, and AWS notes that for S3 VPC endpoints, network traffic remains on the AWS network ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **B is incorrect** because a Cognito **user pool** authenticates users, but it is not the service that provides AWS credentials for direct S3 access. AWS distinguishes this by saying identity pools act as an AWS identity provider for apps with IAM-authorized resource dependencies, while user pools can be used as an IdP to an identity pool ([Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)).
- **D is incorrect** because a NAT gateway is not required for private S3 access when an S3 VPC endpoint can be used. Also, bucket policies do not use “initiated from Amazon Cognito” as the network-origin control; AWS documents restricting S3 bucket access from a specific VPC endpoint with the `aws:sourceVpce` condition instead ([AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)).
- **E is incorrect** because allowing access only from users’ IP addresses is not an appropriate secure integration pattern for Cognito-authenticated S3 access, especially for a private-subnet application. Access should be controlled with IAM permissions from the identity pool and, if needed, endpoint/bucket policies tied to the VPC endpoint.

zh.question: 一家公司在私有子网中托管一个应用程序。该公司已经将该应用程序与 Amazon Cognito 集成。该公司使用 Amazon Cognito user pool 对用户进行身份验证。该公司需要修改该应用程序，使其能够将用户文档安全地存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。哪一组步骤可以将 Amazon S3 与该应用程序安全集成？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Cognito identity pool，以便在用户成功登录时为用户生成安全的 Amazon S3 访问令牌。
options.B: 使用现有的 Amazon Cognito user pool，在用户成功登录时为用户生成 Amazon S3 访问令牌。
options.C: 在公司托管该应用程序的同一 VPC 中创建一个 Amazon S3 VPC endpoint。
options.D: 在公司托管该应用程序的 VPC 中创建一个 NAT gateway。为 S3 bucket 分配一项策略，以拒绝任何不是从 Amazon Cognito 发起的请求。
options.E: 为 S3 bucket 附加一项策略，仅允许来自用户 IP 地址的访问。

zh.explanation:
正确选项是 **A and C**。

- **A 正确**，因为 Amazon Cognito **identity pool** 是将经过身份验证的身份信息交换为临时 AWS 凭证的组件。AWS 说明 identity pools “generate temporary AWS credentials for the users of your app”，并且可以 “sign API requests to AWS services like Amazon S3”。User pool 可以配置为 identity pool 的身份提供商，用户可以将 user pool 令牌交换为 AWS 凭证，以便向 AWS 服务发出签名请求（[Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)）。
- **C 正确**，因为该应用程序位于私有子网中，并且需要与 S3 建立私有、安全的连接。Amazon S3 支持 VPC endpoints；gateway endpoint 允许 VPC 中的资源通过 AWS 网络访问 S3，并且 AWS 指出，对于 S3 VPC endpoints，网络流量会保留在 AWS 网络上（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。其他选项不正确的原因：

- **B 不正确**，因为 Cognito **user pool** 对用户进行身份验证，但它不是为直接 S3 访问提供 AWS 凭证的服务。AWS 通过说明 identity pools 可作为具有 IAM 授权资源依赖项的应用程序的 AWS 身份提供商来区分这一点，而 user pools 可以用作 identity pool 的 IdP（[Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-identity.html)）。
- **D 不正确**，因为当可以使用 S3 VPC endpoint 时，私有 S3 访问不需要 NAT gateway。此外，bucket policies 不使用“initiated from Amazon Cognito”作为网络来源控制；AWS 文档说明应改用 `aws:sourceVpce` 条件来限制来自特定 VPC endpoint 的 S3 bucket 访问（[AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/privatelink-interface-endpoints.html)）。
- **E 不正确**，因为仅允许来自用户 IP 地址的访问并不是针对 Cognito 身份验证的 S3 访问的合适安全集成模式，尤其是对于私有子网应用程序。访问应通过 identity pool 的 IAM 权限进行控制，并且如有需要，可使用与 VPC endpoint 绑定的 endpoint/bucket policies。

en.question: A company has a three-tier web application that processes orders from customers. The web tier consists of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The processing tier consists of EC2 instances. The company decoupled the web tier and processing tier by using Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). The storage layer uses Amazon DynamoDB. At peak times, some users report order processing delays and halls. The company has noticed that during these delays, the EC2 instances are running at 100% CPU usage, and the SQS queue fills up. The peak times are variable and unpredictable. The company needs to improve the performance of the application. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use scheduled scaling for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale out the processing tier instances for the duration of peak usage times. Use the CPU Utilization metric to determine when to scale.
options.B: Use Amazon ElastiCache for Redis in front of the DynamoDB backend tier. Use target utilization as a metric to determine when to scale.
options.C: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution to cache the responses for the web tier. Use HTTP latency as a metric to determine when to scale.
options.D: Use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling target tracking policy to scale out the processing tier instances. Use the ApproximateNumberOfMessages attribute to determine when to scale.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **D**.

The symptoms identify the processing tier as the bottleneck: worker EC2 instances are at 100% CPU and the SQS queue is backing up. AWS explicitly documents this pattern: you can scale an Auto Scaling group in response to load in an SQS queue, and for variable demand you should use dynamic scaling. AWS recommends target tracking with an SQS-derived metric, calculating backlog from the `ApproximateNumberOfMessages` queue attribute and the number of in-service instances; when backlog per instance exceeds the target, the group scales out [Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html). Target tracking policies automatically scale an Auto Scaling group based on a target metric value and adapt to application usage patterns without manual intervention [Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: Scheduled scaling is for **predictable** load changes at specific times. The question states that peak times are variable and unpredictable, so scheduled scaling is not the right primary solution [Scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html).
- **B**: ElastiCache in front of DynamoDB might help read-heavy database workloads, but the described bottleneck is the processing EC2 fleet and an accumulating SQS queue. It does not directly add worker capacity to drain the queue.
- **C**: CloudFront caches web-tier responses. The problem is delayed order processing in the processing tier, with SQS messages accumulating and worker CPU saturated. Caching web responses does not scale the SQS-consuming processing instances.

Therefore, scaling the processing tier dynamically based on SQS queue depth/backlog is the solution that matches the bottleneck and the unpredictable peaks.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个用于处理客户订单的三层 Web 应用程序。Web 层由位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例组成。处理层由 EC2 实例组成。该公司使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 将 Web 层和处理层解耦。存储层使用 Amazon DynamoDB。在高峰时段，一些用户报告订单处理出现延迟和停滞。该公司注意到，在这些延迟期间，EC2 实例以 100% CPU 使用率运行，并且 SQS 队列被填满。高峰时段是可变且不可预测的。该公司需要提高应用程序的性能。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 的计划扩缩，在高峰使用时段期间横向扩展处理层实例。使用 CPU Utilization 指标来确定何时扩缩。
options.B: 在 DynamoDB 后端层前面使用 Amazon ElastiCache for Redis。使用目标利用率作为指标来确定何时扩缩。
options.C: 添加一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配来缓存 Web 层的响应。使用 HTTP 延迟作为指标来确定何时扩缩。
options.D: 使用 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 目标跟踪策略来横向扩展处理层实例。使用 ApproximateNumberOfMessages 属性来确定何时扩缩。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **D**。这些症状表明处理层是瓶颈：工作节点 EC2 实例达到 100% CPU，且 SQS 队列出现积压。AWS 明确记录了这种模式：你可以根据 SQS 队列中的负载来扩缩 Auto Scaling 组；对于可变需求，应使用动态扩缩。AWS 建议使用基于 SQS 派生指标的目标跟踪，通过 `ApproximateNumberOfMessages` 队列属性和服务中实例数量来计算积压量；当每个实例的积压量超过目标值时，该组会横向扩展 [Scaling policy based on Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)。目标跟踪策略会根据目标指标值自动扩缩 Auto Scaling 组，并在无需人工干预的情况下适应应用程序使用模式 [Target tracking scaling policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A**：计划扩缩适用于在特定时间发生的**可预测**负载变化。题目说明高峰时段是可变且不可预测的，因此计划扩缩不是正确的主要解决方案 [Scheduled scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-scheduled-scaling.html)。
- **B**：在 DynamoDB 前面使用 ElastiCache 可能有助于读密集型数据库工作负载，但所描述的瓶颈是处理 EC2 队列以及不断累积的 SQS 队列。它不会直接增加用于清空队列的工作节点容量。
- **C**：CloudFront 缓存 Web 层响应。问题是处理层中的订单处理延迟，SQS 消息不断累积且工作节点 CPU 饱和。缓存 Web 响应不会扩展消费 SQS 的处理实例。因此，根据 SQS 队列深度/积压量动态扩缩处理层，才是与瓶颈和不可预测高峰相匹配的解决方案。

en.question: A company's production environment consists of Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances that run constantly between Monday and Saturday. The instances must run for only 12 hours on Sunday and cannot tolerate interruptions. The company wants to cost-optimize the production environment. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Purchase Scheduled Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that run for only 12 hours on Sunday. Purchase Standard Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that run constantly between Monday and Saturday.
options.B: Purchase Convertible Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that run for only 12 hours on Sunday. Purchase Standard Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that run constantly between Monday and Saturday.
options.C: Use Spot Instances for the EC2 instances that run for only 12 hours on Sunday. Purchase Standard Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that run constantly between Monday and Saturday.
options.D: Use Spot Instances for the EC2 instances that run for only 12 hours on Sunday. Purchase Convertible Reserved Instances for the EC2 instances that run constantly between Monday and Saturday.

en.explanation:
**Answer: A**

The workload has two different usage patterns: predictable continuous usage from Monday through Saturday, and a predictable recurring 12-hour window on Sunday with no interruption tolerance. For the recurring Sunday window, Scheduled Instances are the best match among the options because AWS describes them as EC2 capacity purchased by the hour for a one-year term with a specified schedule, and the schedule includes recurrence and a slot duration in hours ([PurchaseScheduledInstances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_PurchaseScheduledInstances.html), [ScheduledInstance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_ScheduledInstance.html), [ScheduledInstanceRecurrence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_ScheduledInstanceRecurrence.html)).
