For the constantly running Monday-Saturday instances, Standard Reserved Instances are most cost-effective because Reserved Instances provide significant savings over On-Demand, and Standard RIs provide the most significant discount compared with Convertible RIs ([Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)).

Why the other options are wrong:

* **B**: Convertible RIs provide flexibility to exchange instance attributes, but AWS states they provide a **lower discount** than Standard RIs. They are not the most cost-effective choice for a fixed, predictable 12-hour Sunday schedule or stable Monday-Saturday usage ([Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)).
* **C**: Spot Instances can be interrupted by Amazon EC2 when capacity is no longer available, so they do not meet the requirement that the Sunday workload cannot tolerate interruptions ([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)).
* **D**: This has the same Spot Instance interruption problem for Sunday, and it also uses Convertible RIs for the constant workload even though Standard RIs provide the larger discount for stable usage ([Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html), [Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)).

Note: Current AWS API documentation states that Scheduled Instances can no longer be purchased, but among the provided exam options, the Scheduled Instance pattern is the one that matches the predictable recurring 12-hour non-interruptible Sunday requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司的生产环境由 Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances 组成，这些实例在周一到周六之间持续运行。这些实例在周日只需运行 12 小时，并且不能容忍中断。该公司希望对生产环境进行成本优化。哪种解决方案将以最低成本满足这些要求？

options.A: 为周日仅运行 12 小时的 EC2 实例购买 Scheduled Reserved Instances。为周一到周六之间持续运行的 EC2 实例购买 Standard Reserved Instances。
options.B: 为周日仅运行 12 小时的 EC2 实例购买 Convertible Reserved Instances。为周一到周六之间持续运行的 EC2 实例购买 Standard Reserved Instances。
options.C: 对周日仅运行 12 小时的 EC2 实例使用 Spot Instances。为周一到周六之间持续运行的 EC2 实例购买 Standard Reserved Instances。
options.D: 对周日仅运行 12 小时的 EC2 实例使用 Spot Instances。为周一到周六之间持续运行的 EC2 实例购买 Convertible Reserved Instances。

zh.explanation:
**答案：A**

该工作负载有两种不同的使用模式：从周一到周六的可预测持续使用，以及周日一个可预测的重复 12 小时时间窗口，并且不能容忍中断。对于周日的重复时间窗口，在这些选项中 Scheduled Instances 最匹配，因为 AWS 将其描述为按小时购买、期限为一年的 EC2 容量，并带有指定计划；该计划包括重复规则和以小时为单位的时段持续时间（[PurchaseScheduledInstances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_PurchaseScheduledInstances.html)、[ScheduledInstance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_ScheduledInstance.html)、[ScheduledInstanceRecurrence](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/APIReference/API_ScheduledInstanceRecurrence.html)）。对于周一到周六持续运行的实例，Standard Reserved Instances 最具成本效益，因为 Reserved Instances 相比 On-Demand 可提供显著节省，而 Standard RIs 相比 Convertible RIs 可提供最大的折扣（[Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)）。其他选项错误的原因：

* **B**：Convertible RIs 提供交换实例属性的灵活性，但 AWS 表示它们提供的**折扣较低**，低于 Standard RIs。对于固定、可预测的周日 12 小时计划或稳定的周一到周六使用模式，它们不是最具成本效益的选择（[Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)）。
* **C**：当容量不再可用时，Spot Instances 可能会被 Amazon EC2 中断，因此它们不满足周日工作负载不能容忍中断的要求（[Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)）。
* **D**：此选项在周日存在相同的 Spot Instance 中断问题，并且还对持续运行的工作负载使用 Convertible RIs，尽管对于稳定使用，Standard RIs 可提供更大的折扣（[Spot Instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-spot-instances.html)、[Reserved Instances overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-reserved-instances.html)）。注意：当前 AWS API 文档说明 Scheduled Instances 已无法再购买，但在给定的考试选项中，Scheduled Instance 模式是与可预测、重复、周日 12 小时且不可中断的要求相匹配的方案。

en.question: A digital image processing company wants to migrate its on-premises monolithic application to the AWS Cloud. The company processes thousands of images and generates large files as part of the processing workflow. The company needs a solution to manage the growing number of image processing jobs. The solution must also reduce the manual tasks in the image processing workflow. The company does not want to manage the underlying infrastructure of the solution. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with Amazon EC2 Spot Instances to process the images. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to orchestrate the workflow. Store the processed files in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).
options.B: Use AWS Batch jobs to process the images. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the workflow. Store the processed files in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.C: Use AWS Lambda functions and Amazon EC2 Spot Instances to process the images. Store the processed files in Amazon FSx.
options.D: Deploy a group of Amazon EC2 instances to process the images. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the workflow. Store the processed files in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.**

AWS Batch is the best fit for thousands of image-processing jobs because it is a fully managed batch computing service. AWS states that AWS Batch “removes the undifferentiated heavy lifting of configuring and managing the required infrastructure,” automatically provisions compute resources, and optimizes workload distribution based on job scale ([AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)). Step Functions is appropriate for reducing manual workflow tasks because it creates workflows to “automate processes” and orchestrate distributed applications and services ([AWS Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)). Amazon S3 is the right storage target for large generated files because it is object storage with industry-leading scalability and can store and protect “any amount of data” ([Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)).

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** ECS on EC2 Spot Instances still involves EC2-based container capacity and more infrastructure management than using AWS Batch. EFS can store files, but this option has higher operational overhead than fully managed batch jobs plus S3.
- **C:** Lambda is not paired correctly with EC2 Spot Instances for this requirement, and the option still includes EC2 infrastructure. Amazon FSx is managed file storage, but the solution does not provide the same managed batch job scheduling and workflow orchestration as AWS Batch with Step Functions.
- **D:** A fleet of EC2 instances has the highest operational overhead because the company must manage the compute instances. An EBS volume is also not an appropriate scalable shared object store for a growing number of large processed files compared with S3.

zh.question: 一家数字图像处理公司希望将其本地单体应用程序迁移到 AWS Cloud。该公司处理数千张图像，并在处理工作流中生成大型文件。公司需要一种解决方案来管理不断增长的图像处理作业数量。该解决方案还必须减少图像处理工作流中的手动任务。公司不想管理该解决方案的底层基础设施。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 与 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 来处理图像。配置 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 来编排工作流。将处理后的文件存储在 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 中。
options.B: 使用 AWS Batch 作业来处理图像。使用 AWS Step Functions 来编排工作流。将处理后的文件存储在 Amazon S3 bucket 中。
options.C: 使用 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon EC2 Spot Instances 来处理图像。将处理后的文件存储在 Amazon FSx 中。
options.D: 部署一组 Amazon EC2 instances 来处理图像。使用 AWS Step Functions 来编排工作流。将处理后的文件存储在 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume 中。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B.**

AWS Batch 最适合处理数千个图像处理作业，因为它是一项完全托管的批量计算服务。AWS 表示，AWS Batch “removes the undifferentiated heavy lifting of configuring and managing the required infrastructure,” 会自动预置计算资源，并根据作业规模优化工作负载分配（[AWS Batch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/batch/latest/userguide/what-is-batch.html)）。Step Functions 适合用于减少手动工作流任务，因为它可以创建工作流来 “automate processes”，并编排分布式应用程序和服务（[AWS Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/welcome.html)）。Amazon S3 是大型生成文件的正确存储目标，因为它是对象存储，具有行业领先的可扩展性，并且可以存储和保护 “any amount of data”（[Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A:** 在 EC2 Spot Instances 上运行 ECS 仍然涉及基于 EC2 的容器容量，并且相比使用 AWS Batch 需要更多基础设施管理。EFS 可以存储文件，但与完全托管的批处理作业加 S3 相比，此选项的运营开销更高。
- **C:** 对于此需求，Lambda 与 EC2 Spot Instances 的搭配不正确，并且该选项仍然包含 EC2 基础设施。Amazon FSx 是托管文件存储，但该解决方案没有提供与 AWS Batch 结合 Step Functions 相同的托管批处理作业调度和工作流编排能力。
- **D:** 一组 EC2 instances 的运营开销最高，因为公司必须管理这些计算实例。与 S3 相比，EBS volume 也不适合作为可扩展的共享对象存储来存放不断增长的大量大型处理后文件。

en.question: A company's image-hosting website gives users around the world the ability to up load, view, and download images from their mobile devices. The company currently hosts the static website in an Amazon S3 bucket. Because of the website's growing popularity, the website's performance has decreased. Users have reported latency issues when they upload and download images. The company must improve the performance of the website. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST implementation effort?

options.A: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the S3 bucket to improve the download performance. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration to improve the upload performance.
options.B: Configure Amazon EC2 instances of the right sizes in multiple AWS Regions. Migrate the application to the EC2 instances. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the website traffic equally among the EC2 instances. Configure AWS Global Accelerator to address global demand with low latency.
options.C: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the S3 bucket as an origin to improve the download performance. Configure the application to use CloudFront to upload images to improve the upload performance. Create S3 buckets in multiple AWS Regions. Configure replication rules for the buckets to replicate users' data based on the users' location. Redirect downloads to the S3 bucket that is closest to each user's location.
options.D: Configure AWS Global Accelerator for the S3 bucket to improve network performance. Create an endpoint for the application to use Global Accelerator instead of the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: A.**

The site already uses Amazon S3 for static image storage, so the least-effort performance improvement is to add the managed acceleration services that directly fit the two latency problems:

- **Downloads/views:** Amazon CloudFront can use an **S3 bucket as an origin** and delivers cached content from globally distributed edge locations close to viewers, improving image download latency. AWS states that CloudFront uses edge servers close to viewers to deliver content quickly, and that an origin can be an Amazon S3 bucket. [CloudFront documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)
- **Uploads:** S3 Transfer Acceleration is specifically intended for customers who upload to a centralized S3 bucket from around the world, and AWS notes that after enabling it, data transfer speed to the bucket can increase. [S3 Transfer Acceleration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **B:** Migrating a static S3-hosted website to EC2 instances in multiple Regions, adding load balancers, and configuring Global Accelerator is far more implementation effort than using CloudFront plus S3 Transfer Acceleration. It also replaces the simple S3 static-hosting model unnecessarily.
- **C:** CloudFront can improve downloads, but creating multiple S3 buckets, replication rules, and location-based redirection is significantly more complex than required. S3 Transfer Acceleration directly addresses global uploads to a centralized bucket with less effort.
- **D:** Global Accelerator is not the right service to attach directly to an S3 bucket. AWS Global Accelerator endpoint resource types include Application Load Balancers, Network Load Balancers, EC2 instances, and Elastic IP addresses; S3 buckets are not listed as accelerator endpoints. [Global Accelerator endpoint requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html)

zh.question: 一家公司的图片托管网站使全球用户能够从其移动设备上传、查看和下载图片。该公司目前将静态网站托管在一个 Amazon S3 bucket 中。由于网站越来越受欢迎，网站性能已经下降。用户报告在上传和下载图片时存在延迟问题。公司必须提高网站性能。哪种解决方案能够以最少的实施工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 S3 bucket 配置 Amazon CloudFront distribution 以提高下载性能。启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration 以提高上传性能。
options.B: 在多个 AWS Regions 中配置适当大小的 Amazon EC2 instances。将应用程序迁移到 EC2 instances。使用 Application Load Balancer 在 EC2 instances 之间平均分配网站流量。配置 AWS Global Accelerator 以低延迟满足全球需求。
options.C: 配置使用 S3 bucket 作为 origin 的 Amazon CloudFront distribution 以提高下载性能。配置应用程序使用 CloudFront 上传图片以提高上传性能。在多个 AWS Regions 中创建 S3 buckets。为这些 buckets 配置复制规则，以根据用户位置复制用户数据。将下载重定向到最接近每个用户位置的 S3 bucket。
options.D: 为 S3 bucket 配置 AWS Global Accelerator 以提高网络性能。创建一个端点，使应用程序使用 Global Accelerator 而不是 S3 bucket。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：A。**

该站点已经使用 Amazon S3 进行静态图片存储，因此投入最少的性能改进方式是添加与两个延迟问题直接匹配的托管加速服务：

- **下载/查看：** Amazon CloudFront 可以使用 **S3 bucket 作为 origin**，并从靠近查看者的全球分布式边缘站点交付缓存内容，从而改善图片下载延迟。AWS 表示，CloudFront 使用靠近查看者的边缘服务器来快速交付内容，并且 origin 可以是 Amazon S3 bucket。[CloudFront documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/Introduction.html)
- **上传：** S3 Transfer Acceleration 专门用于从世界各地上传到集中式 S3 bucket 的客户，AWS 指出启用后，到该 bucket 的数据传输速度可以提高。[S3 Transfer Acceleration documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **B:** 将静态 S3 托管的网站迁移到多个 Regions 中的 EC2 instances、添加负载均衡器并配置 Global Accelerator，与使用 CloudFront 加 S3 Transfer Acceleration 相比，实施工作量要大得多。它还不必要地替换了简单的 S3 静态托管模型。
- **C:** CloudFront 可以改善下载，但创建多个 S3 buckets、复制规则和基于位置的重定向比所需方案复杂得多。S3 Transfer Acceleration 以更少的工作量直接解决了向集中式 bucket 进行全球上传的问题。
- **D:** Global Accelerator 不是直接附加到 S3 bucket 的正确服务。AWS Global Accelerator endpoint 资源类型包括 Application Load Balancers、Network Load Balancers、EC2 instances 和 Elastic IP addresses；S3 buckets 未列为 accelerator endpoints。[Global Accelerator endpoint requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/global-accelerator/latest/dg/about-endpoints-caveats.html)

en.question: A company runs an application in a private subnet behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in a VPC. The VPC has a NAT gateway and an internet gateway. The application calls the Amazon S3 API to store objects. According to the company's security policy, traffic from the application must not travel across the internet. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?

options.A: Configure an S3 interface endpoint. Create a security group that allows outbound traffic to Amazon S3.
options.B: Configure an S3 gateway endpoint. Update the VPC route table to use the endpoint.
options.C: Configure an S3 bucket policy to allow traffic from the Elastic IP address that is assigned to the NAT gateway.
options.D: Create a second NAT gateway in the same subnet where the legacy application is deployed. Update the VPC route table to use the second NAT gateway.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: B.** An Amazon S3 **gateway VPC endpoint** is designed for this use case: AWS documentation states that after creating the gateway endpoint, you add it as a target in the VPC route table for traffic destined to Amazon S3. It also states that with a gateway endpoint, resources can access S3 from the VPC **without requiring an internet gateway or NAT device** and with **no additional cost** ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). This satisfies the security requirement that traffic must not travel across the internet and is the most cost-effective option.

- **A is incorrect:** An S3 interface endpoint can provide private connectivity, but AWS documentation notes that S3 interface endpoints are available **for an additional cost**, while S3 gateway endpoints have no additional charge ([Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)). Therefore, it is not the most cost-effective solution for VPC-to-S3 access.
- **C is incorrect:** Allowing the S3 bucket policy based on the NAT gateway Elastic IP still routes application traffic through the NAT gateway toward public S3 endpoints. NAT gateways incur hourly and per-GB processing charges ([Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)) and do not meet the requirement to avoid internet pathing as well as a VPC endpoint does.
- **D is incorrect:** Adding another NAT gateway increases NAT gateway costs and still does not create private VPC endpoint access to S3. AWS recommends considering interface or gateway endpoints for AWS service traffic to reduce NAT gateway charges ([Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 中的 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后方的私有子网内运行一个应用程序。该 VPC 具有 NAT gateway 和 internet gateway。该应用程序调用 Amazon S3 API 来存储对象。根据公司的安全策略，来自该应用程序的流量不得经过互联网。哪种解决方案能够以最具成本效益的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个 S3 interface endpoint。创建一个允许出站流量到 Amazon S3 的 security group。
options.B: 配置一个 S3 gateway endpoint。更新 VPC route table 以使用该 endpoint。
options.C: 配置一个 S3 bucket policy，以允许来自分配给 NAT gateway 的 Elastic IP 地址的流量。
options.D: 在部署旧版应用程序的同一子网中创建第二个 NAT gateway。更新 VPC route table 以使用第二个 NAT gateway。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：B。** Amazon S3 **gateway VPC endpoint** 正是为此用例而设计的：AWS 文档说明，在创建 gateway endpoint 后，您将其作为 VPC route table 中发往 Amazon S3 的流量目标添加。文档还说明，使用 gateway endpoint，资源可以从 VPC 访问 S3，**无需 internet gateway 或 NAT device**，并且**没有额外费用**（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。这满足了流量不得经过互联网的安全要求，并且是最具成本效益的选项。

- **A 不正确：** S3 interface endpoint 可以提供私有连接，但 AWS 文档指出，S3 interface endpoints **会产生额外费用**，而 S3 gateway endpoints 没有额外收费（[Gateway endpoints for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/vpc-endpoints-s3.html)）。因此，对于 VPC 到 S3 的访问，它不是最具成本效益的解决方案。
- **C 不正确：** 基于 NAT gateway Elastic IP 在 S3 bucket policy 中允许访问，仍然会将应用程序流量通过 NAT gateway 路由到公共 S3 endpoints。NAT gateways 会产生按小时和按 GB 处理的费用（[Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)），并且不像 VPC endpoint 那样满足避免互联网路径的要求。
- **D 不正确：** 添加另一个 NAT gateway 会增加 NAT gateway 成本，并且仍然不会创建到 S3 的私有 VPC endpoint 访问。AWS 建议考虑使用 interface 或 gateway endpoints 来处理 AWS service 流量，以降低 NAT gateway 费用（[Pricing for NAT gateways](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/nat-gateway-pricing.html)）。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster on Amazon EC2 instances. The application has a UI that uses Amazon DynamoDB and data services that use Amazon S3 as part of the application deployment. The company must ensure that the EKS Pods for the UI can access only Amazon DynamoDB and that the EKS Pods for the data services can access only Amazon S3. The company uses AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Which solution meals these requirements?

options.A: Create separate IAM policies for Amazon S3 and DynamoDB access with the required permissions. Attach both IAM policies to the EC2 instance profile. Use role-based access control (RBAC) to control access to Amazon S3 or DynamoDB for the respective EKS Pods.
options.B: Create separate IAM policies for Amazon S3 and DynamoDB access with the required permissions. Attach the Amazon S3 IAM policy directly to the EKS Pods for the data services and the DynamoDB policy to the EKS Pods for the UI.
options.C: Create separate Kubernetes service accounts for the UI and data services to assume an IAM role. Attach the AmazonS3FullAccess policy to the data services account and the AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess policy to the UI service account.
options.D: Create separate Kubernetes service accounts for the UI and data services to assume an IAM role. Use IAM Role for Service Accounts (IRSA) to provide access to the EKS Pods for the UI to Amazon S3 and the EKS Pods for the data services to DynamoDB.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.**

Amazon EKS supports IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA), where you associate an IAM role with a Kubernetes service account and configure Pods to use that service account instead of using the EC2 instance role. AWS states that IRSA lets you scope IAM permissions to a service account, and **only Pods that use that service account have access to those permissions**; it also provides credential isolation so a Pod retrieves credentials for the IAM role associated with its service account ([Amazon EKS IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)). The eksctl documentation also describes IRSA as mapping IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts to provide fine-grained permissions for EKS applications that use AWS services such as S3 and DynamoDB ([eksctl IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/iamserviceaccounts.html)).

Therefore, using separate service accounts/roles for the UI and data-service Pods, with DynamoDB permissions for the UI service account and S3 permissions for the data-service service account, meets the requirement. In a production design, the policies should be scoped to the required actions and resources rather than broad `FullAccess`, but among the options this is the only one with the correct service-to-Pod mapping and the correct IRSA-style mechanism.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A:** Attaching both S3 and DynamoDB policies to the EC2 instance profile gives the node role both permissions. That does not isolate AWS permissions per Pod. EKS documentation recommends associating IAM roles with service accounts instead of using the EC2 instance role for application credentials ([Amazon EKS IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)). Kubernetes RBAC controls access to Kubernetes API resources, not AWS service API permissions.
- **B:** IAM policies are not attached directly to individual EKS Pods. The supported mechanism is to bind IAM roles to Kubernetes service accounts and run Pods with those service accounts ([eksctl IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/iamserviceaccounts.html)).
- **D:** Although it mentions IRSA, it assigns the permissions to the wrong workloads: it gives UI Pods access to S3 and data-service Pods access to DynamoDB, which is the opposite of the requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群中。该应用程序有一个使用 Amazon DynamoDB 的 UI，以及在应用程序部署中使用 Amazon S3 的数据服务。公司必须确保 UI 的 EKS Pods 只能访问 Amazon DynamoDB，并且数据服务的 EKS Pods 只能访问 Amazon S3。公司使用 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)。哪种解决方案满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Amazon S3 和 DynamoDB 访问权限分别创建具有所需权限的 IAM policies。将这两个 IAM policies 都附加到 EC2 instance profile。使用 role-based access control (RBAC) 来控制相应 EKS Pods 对 Amazon S3 或 DynamoDB 的访问。
options.B: 为 Amazon S3 和 DynamoDB 访问权限分别创建具有所需权限的 IAM policies。将 Amazon S3 IAM policy 直接附加到数据服务的 EKS Pods，并将 DynamoDB policy 附加到 UI 的 EKS Pods。
options.C: 为 UI 和数据服务创建单独的 Kubernetes service accounts，以便代入 IAM role。将 AmazonS3FullAccess policy 附加到数据服务账户，并将 AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess policy 附加到 UI service account。
options.D: 为 UI 和数据服务创建单独的 Kubernetes service accounts，以便代入 IAM role。使用 IAM Role for Service Accounts (IRSA) 为 UI 的 EKS Pods 提供对 Amazon S3 的访问权限，并为数据服务的 EKS Pods 提供对 DynamoDB 的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C.**

Amazon EKS 支持 IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA)，你可以将 IAM role 与 Kubernetes service account 关联，并配置 Pods 使用该 service account，而不是使用 EC2 instance role。AWS 表示，IRSA 允许你将 IAM 权限限定到某个 service account，并且**只有使用该 service account 的 Pods 才能访问这些权限**；它还提供凭证隔离，使 Pod 检索与其 service account 关联的 IAM role 的凭证（[Amazon EKS IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)）。eksctl 文档还将 IRSA 描述为将 IAM roles 映射到 Kubernetes service accounts，以便为使用 S3 和 DynamoDB 等 AWS 服务的 EKS 应用程序提供细粒度权限（[eksctl IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/iamserviceaccounts.html)）。因此，为 UI 和数据服务 Pods 使用单独的 service accounts/roles，并为 UI service account 配置 DynamoDB 权限、为数据服务 service account 配置 S3 权限，可以满足要求。在生产设计中，policies 应限定到所需的 actions 和 resources，而不是宽泛的 `FullAccess`，但在这些选项中，这是唯一一个具有正确 service-to-Pod 映射和正确 IRSA 风格机制的选项。

**其他选项不正确的原因：**

- **A:** 将 S3 和 DynamoDB policies 都附加到 EC2 instance profile 会使 node role 同时拥有这两种权限。这无法按 Pod 隔离 AWS 权限。EKS 文档建议将 IAM roles 与 service accounts 关联，而不是使用 EC2 instance role 作为应用程序凭证（[Amazon EKS IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)）。Kubernetes RBAC 控制的是对 Kubernetes API resources 的访问，而不是 AWS service API 权限。
- **B:** IAM policies 不能直接附加到单个 EKS Pods。受支持的机制是将 IAM roles 绑定到 Kubernetes service accounts，并使用这些 service accounts 运行 Pods（[eksctl IRSA documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/eksctl/iamserviceaccounts.html)）。
- **D:** 虽然它提到了 IRSA，但它将权限分配给了错误的工作负载：它给 UI Pods 访问 S3 的权限，并给数据服务 Pods 访问 DynamoDB 的权限，这与要求相反。

en.question: A company needs to give a globally distributed development team secure access to the company's AWS resources in a way that complies with security policies. The company currently uses an on-premises Active Directory for internal authentication. The company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts that support multiple projects. The company needs a solution to integrate with the existing infrastructure to provide centralized identity management and access control. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Set up AWS Directory Service to create an AWS managed Microsoft Active Directory on AWS. Establish a trust relationship with the on-premises Active Directory. Use IAM rotes that are assigned to Active Directory groups to access AWS resources within the company's AWS accounts.
options.B: Create an IAM user for each developer. Manually manage permissions for each IAM user based on each user's involvement with each project. Enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) as an additional layer of security.
options.C: Use AD Connector in AWS Directory Service to connect to the on-premises Active Directory. Integrate AD Connector with AWS IAM Identity Center. Configure permissions sets to give each AD group access to specific AWS accounts and resources.
options.D: Use Amazon Cognito to deploy an identity federation solution. Integrate the identity federation solution with the on-premises Active Directory. Use Amazon Cognito to provide access tokens for developers to access AWS accounts and resources.

en.explanation:
**Correct answer: C.** IAM Identity Center is designed for workforce access to AWS accounts and can connect to an existing identity source and synchronize users and groups. AWS states that IAM Identity Center provides “one place” to assign permissions to groups of users in multiple AWS accounts, and an organization instance is the best practice and the only instance type that manages access to AWS accounts across AWS Organizations ([IAM Identity Center overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)). For an existing self-managed/on-premises Active Directory, IAM Identity Center supports using an existing **AD Connector** or AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory as the Active Directory identity source ([Using Active Directory as an identity source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/gs-ad.html)). AD Connector specifically redirects directory requests to on-premises Microsoft AD without caching information in the cloud, lets users use existing corporate credentials, and helps enforce existing security policies ([AD Connector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_ad_connector.html)). Permission sets are created under **Multi-account permissions** and are used with an organization instance of IAM Identity Center ([Create a permission set](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtocreatepermissionset.html)). This provides centralized access control with the least operational overhead.

**Why the other options are incorrect:**

- **A** is workable in some cases, but it requires deploying and operating AWS Managed Microsoft AD and establishing a trust relationship with the on-premises AD. Because the company already has on-premises AD and only needs centralized AWS account access, AD Connector plus IAM Identity Center avoids creating a separate managed directory, reducing overhead.
- **B** creates separate IAM users and manually manages permissions per developer/project. That is not centralized workforce identity management and has high administrative overhead compared with IAM Identity Center’s group-based multi-account permissions.
- **D** uses Amazon Cognito, which is primarily for adding authentication and authorization to **web and mobile apps**, not for centralized workforce access to multiple AWS accounts ([Amazon Cognito app integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-integrate-apps.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司需要以符合安全策略的方式，为全球分布的开发团队提供对公司 AWS 资源的安全访问权限。该公司目前使用本地 Active Directory 进行内部身份验证。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 来管理支持多个项目的多个 AWS 账户。该公司需要一个解决方案，以便与现有基础设施集成，提供集中式身份管理和访问控制。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 AWS Directory Service，在 AWS 上创建 AWS 托管的 Microsoft Active Directory。与本地 Active Directory 建立信任关系。使用分配给 Active Directory 组的 IAM rotes 来访问公司 AWS 账户内的 AWS 资源。
options.B: 为每位开发人员创建一个 IAM 用户。根据每位用户参与的每个项目，手动管理每个 IAM 用户的权限。强制执行多重身份验证 (MFA) 作为额外的安全层。
options.C: 使用 AWS Directory Service 中的 AD Connector 连接到本地 Active Directory。将 AD Connector 与 AWS IAM Identity Center 集成。配置权限集，为每个 AD 组授予对特定 AWS 账户和资源的访问权限。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Cognito 部署身份联合解决方案。将该身份联合解决方案与本地 Active Directory 集成。使用 Amazon Cognito 为开发人员提供访问令牌，以访问 AWS 账户和资源。

zh.explanation:
**正确答案：C。** IAM Identity Center 专为员工访问 AWS 账户而设计，可以连接到现有身份源并同步用户和组。AWS 表示，IAM Identity Center 提供“一个位置”，用于向多个 AWS 账户中的用户组分配权限，并且组织实例是最佳实践，也是唯一能够跨 AWS Organizations 管理对 AWS 账户访问权限的实例类型（[IAM Identity Center overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/what-is.html)）。对于现有的自管理/本地 Active Directory，IAM Identity Center 支持使用现有的 **AD Connector** 或 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 目录作为 Active Directory 身份源（[Using Active Directory as an identity source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/gs-ad.html)）。AD Connector 会将目录请求重定向到本地 Microsoft AD，而不会在云中缓存信息，允许用户使用现有公司凭证，并帮助执行现有安全策略（[AD Connector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directoryservice/latest/admin-guide/directory_ad_connector.html)）。权限集是在 **Multi-account permissions** 下创建的，并与 IAM Identity Center 的组织实例一起使用（[Create a permission set](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtocreatepermissionset.html)）。这以最少的运营开销提供集中式访问控制。

**为什么其他选项不正确：**

- **A** 在某些情况下可行，但它需要部署和运营 AWS Managed Microsoft AD，并与本地 AD 建立信任关系。由于公司已经有本地 AD，并且只需要集中式 AWS 账户访问，因此 AD Connector 加 IAM Identity Center 可以避免创建单独的托管目录，从而降低开销。
- **B** 会创建单独的 IAM 用户，并按开发人员/项目手动管理权限。这不是集中式员工身份管理，并且与 IAM Identity Center 基于组的多账户权限相比，管理开销很高。
- **D** 使用 Amazon Cognito，它主要用于向 **web and mobile apps** 添加身份验证和授权，而不是用于对多个 AWS 账户的集中式员工访问（[Amazon Cognito app integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-integrate-apps.html)）。

en.question: A company is developing an application in the AWS Cloud. The application's HTTP API contains critical information that is published in Amazon API Gateway. The critical information must be accessible from only a limited set of trusted IP addresses that belong to the company's internal network. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up an API Gateway private integration to restrict access to a predefined set of IP addresses.
options.B: Create a resource policy for the API that denies access to any IP address that is not specifically allowed.
options.C: Directly deploy the API in a private subnet. Create a network ACL. Set up rules to allow the traffic from specific IP addresses.
options.D: Modify the security group that is attached to API Gateway to allow inbound traffic from only the trusted IP addresses.

en.explanation:
The best answer is **B**.

API Gateway supports **resource policies** that can control who can invoke an API based on request context such as source IP. AWS provides an example resource policy that uses `aws:SourceIp` to deny API invocation traffic from specified IP ranges; the same mechanism can be written as an allowlist pattern that denies requests whose source IP is not in the trusted corporate ranges. This directly meets the requirement to make the API accessible only from a limited set of trusted internal-network IP addresses ([API Gateway resource policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-resource-policies-examples.html)).

Why the other options are incorrect:

- **A**: A private integration is for connecting API Gateway to private HTTP/HTTPS resources inside a VPC through a VPC link. AWS describes it as a way to expose private VPC backend resources to clients outside the VPC, not as a source-IP allowlist mechanism for clients invoking the API ([Private integrations for REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/private-integration.html)).
- **C**: API Gateway is a managed service; you do not directly deploy an API Gateway API into a private subnet and protect it with a subnet network ACL. Private APIs use VPC endpoints/PrivateLink and have their own considerations, but that is different from placing API Gateway in a subnet ([Private REST APIs considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-apis.html)).
- **D**: Security groups are not attached to API Gateway as if it were an EC2 instance or load balancer in your VPC. The supported API Gateway-level way to restrict invocation by source IP is a resource policy, not an API Gateway security group.

Therefore, **B** is the correct solution.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS Cloud 中开发一个应用程序。该应用程序的 HTTP API 包含发布在 Amazon API Gateway 中的关键信息。这些关键信息必须只能由属于公司内部网络的一组有限的受信任 IP 地址访问。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 设置 API Gateway private integration，以将访问限制为一组预定义的 IP 地址。
options.B: 为该 API 创建一个 resource policy，拒绝任何未被明确允许的 IP 地址访问。
options.C: 将该 API 直接部署在 private subnet 中。创建一个 network ACL。设置规则以允许来自特定 IP 地址的流量。
options.D: 修改附加到 API Gateway 的 security group，仅允许来自受信任 IP 地址的入站流量。

zh.explanation:
最佳答案是 **B**。

API Gateway 支持 **resource policies**，可以根据请求上下文（例如源 IP）控制谁可以调用 API。AWS 提供了一个示例 resource policy，该策略使用 `aws:SourceIp` 来拒绝来自指定 IP 范围的 API 调用流量；相同机制也可以写成允许列表模式，用于拒绝源 IP 不在受信任企业范围内的请求。这直接满足了让该 API 只能由一组有限的受信任内部网络 IP 地址访问的要求（[API Gateway resource policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-resource-policies-examples.html)）。为什么其他选项不正确：

- **A**：private integration 用于通过 VPC link 将 API Gateway 连接到 VPC 内部的私有 HTTP/HTTPS 资源。AWS 将其描述为一种向 VPC 外部客户端公开私有 VPC 后端资源的方式，而不是一种针对调用 API 的客户端的源 IP 允许列表机制（[Private integrations for REST APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/private-integration.html)）。
- **C**：API Gateway 是一项托管服务；你不能将 API Gateway API 直接部署到 private subnet 中并用子网 network ACL 来保护它。Private APIs 使用 VPC endpoints/PrivateLink，并有其自身的注意事项，但这不同于将 API Gateway 放入子网中（[Private REST APIs considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-apis.html)）。
- **D**：Security groups 不会像附加到 VPC 中的 EC2 实例或负载均衡器那样附加到 API Gateway。按源 IP 限制调用的受支持 API Gateway 级方式是 resource policy，而不是 API Gateway security group。因此，**B** 是正确的解决方案。
